1.quote: Age is an issue of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it doesn't matter.
1.name: Mark Twain

2.quote: Anyone who stops learning is old, whether at twenty or eighty. Anyone who keeps learning stays young. The greatest thing in life is to keep your mind young.
2.name: Henry Ford

3.quote: Wrinkles should merely indicate where smiles have been.
3.name: Mark Twain

4.quote: True terror is to wake up one morning and discover that your high school class is running the country.
4.name: Kurt Vonnegut

5.quote: A diplomat is a man who always remembers a woman's birthday but never remembers her age.
5.name: Robert Frost

6.quote: As I grow older, I pay less attention to what men say. I just watch what they do.
6.name: Andrew Carnegie

7.quote: How incessant and great are the ills with which a prolonged old age is replete.
7.name: C. S. Lewis

8.quote: Old age, believe me, is a good and pleasant thing. It is true you are gently shouldered off the stage, but then you are given such a comfortable front stall as spectator.
8.name: Confucius

9.quote: Old age has deformities enough of its own. It should never add to them the deformity of vice.
9.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

10.quote: Nobody grows old merely by living a number of years. We grow old by deserting our ideals. Years may wrinkle the skin, but to give up enthusiasm wrinkles the soul.
10.name: Samuel Ullman

11.quote: An archaeologist is the best husband a woman can have. The older she gets the more interested he is in her.
11.name: Agatha Christie

12.quote: All diseases run into one, old age.
12.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

13.quote: Bashfulness is an ornament to youth, but a reproach to old age.
13.name: Aristotle

14.quote: Like everyone else who makes the mistake of getting older, I begin each day with coffee and obituaries.
14.name: Bill Cosby

15.quote: Age appears to be best in four things old wood best to burn, old wine to drink, old friends to trust, and old authors to read.
15.name: Francis Bacon

16.quote: None are so old as those who have outlived enthusiasm.
16.name: Henry David Thoreau

17.quote: Every man over forty is a scoundrel.
17.name: George Bernard Shaw

18.quote: Forty is the old age of youth fifty the youth of old age.
18.name: Victor Hugo

19.quote: You can't help getting older, but you don't have to get old.
19.name: George Burns

20.quote: Alas, after a certain age every man is responsible for his face.
20.name: Albert Camus

21.quote: Youth is when you're allowed to stay up late on New Year's Eve. Middle age is when you're forced to.
21.name: Bill Vaughan

22.quote: Old age is like everything else. To make a success of it, you've got to start young.
22.name: Theodore Roosevelt

23.quote: A comfortable old age is the reward of a well-spent youth. Instead of its bringing sad and melancholy prospects of decay, it would give us hopes of eternal youth in a better world.
23.name: Maurice Chevalier

24.quote: A man growing old becomes a child again.
24.name: Sophocles

25.quote: I will never be an old man. To me, old age is always 15 years older than I am.
25.name: Francis Bacon

27.quote: What most persons consider as virtue, after the age of 40 is simply a loss of energy.
27.name: Voltaire

28.quote: Age is a very high price to pay for maturity.
28.name: Tom Stoppard

29.quote: Old age is no place for sissies.
29.name: Bette Davis

30.quote: I don't feel old. I don't feel anything till noon. That's when it's time for my nap.
30.name: Bob Hope

31.quote: As I approve of a youth that has something of the old man in him, so I am no less pleased with an old man that has something of the youth. He that follows this rule may be old in body, but can never be so in mind.
31.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

32.quote: I don't believe one grows older. I think that what happens early on in life is that at a certain age one stands still and stagnates.
32.name: T. S. Eliot

33.quote: Advice in old age is foolish for what can be more absurd than to increase our provisions for the road the nearer we approach to our journey's end.
33.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

34.quote: When grace is joined with wrinkles, it is adorable. There is an unspeakable dawn in happy old age.
34.name: Victor Hugo

35.quote: It takes a long time to become young.
35.name: Pablo Picasso

36.quote: After thirty, a body has a mind of its own.
36.name: Bette Midler

37.quote: There is a fountain of youth: it is your mind, your talents, the creativity you bring to your life and the lives of people you love. When you learn to tap this source, you will truly have defeated age.
37.name: Sophia Loren

38.quote: Age is not a particularly interesting subject. Anyone can get old. All you have to do is live long enough.
38.name: Don Marquis

39.quote: Old minds are like old horses you must exercise them if you wish to keep them in working order.
39.name: John Adams

40.quote: Forty is the old age of youth, fifty is the youth of old age.
40.name: Hosea Ballou

41.quote: Youth is the gift of nature, but age is a work of art.
41.name: Stanislaw Lec

42.quote: Preparation for old age should begin not later than one's teens. A life which is empty of purpose until 65 will not suddenly become filled on retirement.
42.name: Dwight L. Moody

43.quote: There is always some specific moment when we become aware that our youth is gone but, years after, we know it was much later.
43.name: Mignon McLaughlin

44.quote: Growing old is no more than a bad habit which a busy person has no time to form.
44.name: Andre Maurois

45.quote: As long as any adult thinks that he, like the parents and teachers of old, can become introspective, invoking his own youth to understand the youth before him, he is lost.
45.name: Margaret Mead

46.quote: Old age is fifteen years older than I am.
46.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

47.quote: Aging is not lost youth but a new stage of opportunity and strength.
47.name: Betty Friedan

48.quote: The great secret that all old people share is that you really haven't changed in seventy or eighty years. Your body changes, but you don't change at all. And that, of course, causes great confusion.
48.name: Doris Lessing

49.quote: The trick is growing up without growing old.
49.name: Casey Stengel

50.quote: Old age comes on suddenly, and not gradually as is thought.
50.name: Emily Dickinson

51.quote: I think your whole life shows in your face and you should be proud of that.
51.name: Lauren Bacall

52.quote: I'm happy to report that my inner child is still ageless.
52.name: James Broughton

53.quote: Youth is the best time to be rich, and the best time to be poor.
53.name: Euripides

54.quote: It is sad to grow old but nice to ripen.
54.name: Brigitte Bardot

55.quote: One of the many things nobody ever tells you about middle age is that it's such a nice change from being young.
55.name: William Feather

56.quote: After you're older, two things are possibly more important than any others: health and money.
56.name: Helen Gurley Brown

57.quote: You end up as you deserve. In old age you must put up with the face, the friends, the health, and the children you have earned.
57.name: Judith Viorst

58.quote: I'm not interested in age. People who tell me their age are silly. You're as old as you feel.
58.name: Henri Frederic Amiel

59.quote: Inflation is when you pay fifteen dollars for the ten-dollar haircut you used to get for five dollars when you had hair.
59.name: Sam Ewing

60.quote: My notion of a wife at 40 is that a man should be able to change her, like a bank note, for two 20s.
60.name: Warren Beatty

61.quote: As you age naturally, your family shows more and more on your face. If you deny that, you deny your heritage.
61.name: Frances Conroy

62.quote: Old age is like a plane flying through a storm. Once you're aboard, there's nothing you can do.
62.name: Golda Meir

63.quote: In youth the days are short and the years are long. In old age the years are short and day's long.
63.name: Pope Paul VI

64.quote: The aging process has you firmly in its grasp if you never get the urge to throw a snowball.
64.name: Doug Larson

65.quote: Age is how we determine how valuable you are.
65.name: Jane Elliot

66.quote: Middle age is when your age starts to show around your middle.
66.name: Bob Hope

67.quote: Aging seems to be the only available way to live a long life.
67.name: Kitty O'Neill Collins

68.quote: I think when the full horror of being fifty hits you, you should stay home and have a good cry.
68.name: Josh Billings

69.quote: To keep the heart unwrinkled, to be hopeful, kindly, cheerful, reverent that is to triumph over old age.
69.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

70.quote: If you're old, don't try to change yourself, change your environment.
70.name: B. F. Skinner

71.quote: Old age is an excellent time for outrage. My goal is to say or do at least one outrageous thing every week.
71.name: Louis Kronenberger

72.quote: I want to get old gracefully. I want to have good posture, I want to be healthy and be an example to my children.
72.name: Sting

73.quote: You know you're getting old when all the names in your black book have M. D. after them.
73.name: Harrison Ford

74.quote: What makes old age so sad is not that our joys but our hopes cease.
74.name: Jean Paul

76.quote: While one finds company in himself and his pursuits, he cannot feel old, no matter what his years may be.
76.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

77.quote: To resist the frigidity of old age, one must combine the body, the mind, and the heart. And to keep these in parallel vigor one must exercise, study, and love.
77.name: Alan Bleasdale

78.quote: Old age is the most unexpected of all the things that can happen to a man.
78.name: James Thurber

79.quote: No one can avoid aging, but aging productively is something else.
79.name: Katharine Graham

80.quote: If you haven't turned rebel by twenty you've got no heart if you haven't turned establishment by thirty you've got no brains!
80.name: Kevin Spacey

81.quote: Oh rage! Oh despair! Oh age, my enemy!
81.name: Pierre Corneille

82.quote: I don't want to fight aging I want to take good care of myself, but plastic surgery and all that? I'm not interested.
82.name: Christine Lahti

83.quote: Middle age is the time when a man is always thinking that in a week or two he will feel as good as ever.
83.name: Don Marquis

84.quote: We should so provide for old age that it may have no urgent wants of this world to absorb it from meditation on the next. It is awful to see the lean hands of dotage making a coffer of the grave.
84.name: Pearl S. Buck

85.quote: Middle age is the awkward period when Father Time starts catching up with Mother Nature.
85.name: Harold Coffin

86.quote: Middle age is youth without levity, and age without decay.
86.name: Doris Day

87.quote: No man is ever old enough to know better.
87.name: Holbrook Jackson

88.quote: The denunciation of the young is a necessary part of the hygiene of older people, and greatly assists the circulation of the blood.
88.name: Logan P. Smith

89.quote: In youth we run into difficulties. In old age difficulties run into us.
89.name: Beverly Sills

90.quote: We pay when old for the excesses of youth.
90.name: J. B. Priestley

91.quote: The answer to old age is to keep one's mind busy and to go on with one's life as if it were interminable. I always admired Chekhov for building a new house when he was dying of tuberculosis.
91.name: Leon Edel

92.quote: We've put more effort into helping folks reach old age than into helping them enjoy it.
92.name: Frank A. Clark

93.quote: The real sadness of fifty is not that you change so much but that you change so little.
93.name: Max Lerner

95.quote: He has a profound respect for old age. Especially when it's bottled.
95.name: Gene Fowler

96.quote: Whatever poet, orator or sage may say of it, old age is still old age.
96.name: Sinclair Lewis

97.quote: To keep the heart unwrinkled, to be hopeful, kindly, cheerful, reverent - that is to triumph over old age.
97.name: Thomas Bailey Aldrich

98.quote: In old age we are like a batch of letters that someone has sent. We are no longer in the past, we have arrived.
98.name: Knut Hamsun

99.quote: There's no such thing as old age, there is only sorrow.
99.name: Fay Weldon

100.quote: Those who love deeply never grow old they may die of old age, but they die young.
100.name: Dorothy Canfield Fisher

101.quote: I get all fired up about aging in America.
101.name: Willard Scott

102.quote: The really frightening thing about middle age is the knowledge that you'll grow out of it.
102.name: Doris Day

103.quote: There is an anti-aging possibility, but it has to come from within.
103.name: Susan Anton

104.quote: The lovely thing about being forty is that you can appreciate twenty-five-year-old men more.
104.name: Colleen McCullough

105.quote: When a noble life has prepared old age, it is not decline that it reveals, but the first days of immortality.
105.name: Muriel Spark

106.quote: The whole business of marshaling one's energies becomes more and more important as one grows older.
106.name: Hume Cronyn

107.quote: The tendency of old age to the body, say the physiologists, is to form bone. It is as rare as it is pleasant to meet with an old man whose opinions are not ossified.
107.name: Bob Wells

108.quote: Old age adds to the respect due to virtue, but it takes nothing from the contempt inspired by vice it whitens only the hair.
108.name: Ira Gershwin

109.quote: As men get older, the toys get more expensive.
109.name: Marvin Davis

110.quote: I find that a man is as old as his work. If his work keeps him from moving forward, he will look forward with the work.
110.name: William Ernest Hocking

111.quote: Common sense is the collection of prejudices acquired by age eighteen.
111.name: Albert Einstein

112.quote: Reading, after a certain age, diverts the mind too much from its creative pursuits. Any man who reads too much and uses his own brain too little falls into lazy habits of thinking.
112.name: Albert Einstein

113.quote: Confusion of goals and perfection of means seems, in my opinion, to characterize our age.
113.name: Albert Einstein

114.quote: Perfection of means and confusion of ends seem to characterize our age.
114.name: Albert Einstein

115.quote: The age of a woman doesn't mean a thing. The best tunes are played on the oldest fiddles.
115.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

116.quote: Life would be infinitely happier if we could only be born at the age of eighty and gradually approach eighteen.
116.name: Mark Twain

117.quote: A stockbroker urged me to buy a stock that would triple its value every year. I told him, 'At my age, I don't even buy green bananas.'
117.name: Claude Pepper

118.quote: When marrying, ask yourself this question: Do you believe that you will be able to converse well with this person into your old age? Everything else in marriage is transitory.
118.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

119.quote: Probably the happiest period in life most frequently is in middle age, when the eager passions of youth are cooled, and the infirmities of age not yet begun as we see that the shadows, which are at morning and evening so large, almost entirely disappear at midday.
119.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

120.quote: Age is whatever you think it is. You are as old as you think you are.
120.name: Muhammad Ali

121.quote: As human beings, our greatness lies not so much in being able to remake the world - that is the myth of the atomic age - as in being able to remake ourselves.
121.name: Mahatma Gandhi

122.quote: A man loves the meat in his youth that he cannot endure in his age.
122.name: William Shakespeare

123.quote: In every country and every age, the priest had been hostile to Liberty.
123.name: Thomas Jefferson

124.quote: The heresy of one age becomes the orthodoxy of the next.
124.name: Helen Keller

125.quote: The golden age is before us, not behind us.
125.name: William Shakespeare

126.quote: Every formula of every religion has in this age of reason, to submit to the acid test of reason and universal assent.
126.name: Mahatma Gandhi

127.quote: Thomas Jefferson once said, 'We should never judge a president by his age, only by his works.' And ever since he told me that, I stopped worrying.
127.name: Ronald Reagan

128.quote: No woman should ever be quite accurate about her age. It looks so calculating.
128.name: Oscar Wilde

129.quote: At twenty years of age the will reigns at thirty, the wit and at forty, the judgment.
129.name: Benjamin Franklin

130.quote: Age does not protect you from love. But love, to some extent, protects you from age.
130.name: Anais Nin

131.quote: Information is the oxygen of the modern age. It seeps through the walls topped by barbed wire, it wafts across the electrified borders.
131.name: Ronald Reagan

132.quote: Old age is just a record of one's whole life.
132.name: Muhammad Ali

133.quote: We prefer world law in the age of self-determination to world war in the age of mass extermination.
133.name: John F. Kennedy

134.quote: Each age, it is found, must write its own books or rather, each generation for the next succeeding.
134.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

135.quote: Education is the best provision for old age.
135.name: Aristotle

136.quote: The secret of staying young is to live honestly, eat slowly, and lie about your age.
136.name: Lucille Ball

137.quote: Sometimes I think it would be easier to avoid old age, to die young, but then you'd never complete your life, would you? You'd never wholly know you.
137.name: Marilyn Monroe

138.quote: I don't think of myself as a poor deprived ghetto girl who made good. I think of myself as somebody who from an early age knew I was responsible for myself, and I had to make good.
138.name: Oprah Winfrey

139.quote: The kids are old enough now - I just want to let them be kids. I don't want to comment on them too much. They're at an age where I just want to let them be kids.
139.name: Eminem

140.quote: He who is of calm and happy nature will hardly feel the pressure of age, but to him who is of an opposite disposition youth and age are equally a burden.
140.name: Plato

141.quote: Why should society feel responsible only for the education of children, and not for the education of all adults of every age?
141.name: Erich Fromm

142.quote: I've got volumes on how not to behave. I've got more information now than a guy should have at my age.
142.name: Charlie Sheen

143.quote: I'm at the age where food has taken the place of sex in my life. In fact, I've just had a mirror put over my kitchen table.
143.name: Rodney Dangerfield

144.quote: Age is something that doesn't matter, unless you are a cheese.
144.name: Luis Bunuel

145.quote: Hesitation increases in relation to risk in equal proportion to age.
145.name: Ernest Hemingway

146.quote: Books were my pass to personal freedom. I learned to read at age three, and soon discovered there was a whole world to conquer that went beyond our farm in Mississippi.
146.name: Oprah Winfrey

147.quote: In our age there is no such thing as 'keeping out of politics.' All issues are political issues, and politics itself is a mass of lies, evasions, folly, hatred and schizophrenia.
147.name: George Orwell

148.quote: I must confess, I was born at a very early age.
148.name: Groucho Marx

149.quote: The secret of genius is to carry the spirit of the child into old age, which mean never losing your enthusiasm.
149.name: Aldous Huxley

150.quote: It is utterly false and cruelly arbitrary to put all the play and learning into childhood, all the work into middle age, and all the regrets into old age.
150.name: Margaret Mead

151.quote: We aren't in an information age, we are in an entertainment age.
151.name: Tony Robbins

152.quote: To me - old age is always ten years older than I am.
152.name: John Burroughs

153.quote: Age is not important unless you're a cheese.
153.name: Helen Hayes

154.quote: No matter what age you are, or what your circumstances might be, you are special, and you still have something unique to offer. Your life, because of who you are, has meaning.
154.name: Barbara de Angelis

155.quote: A woman has the age she deserves.
155.name: Coco Chanel

156.quote: The older I grow the more I distrust the familiar doctrine that age brings wisdom.
156.name: H. L. Mencken

157.quote: Youngsters of the age of two and three are endowed with extraordinary strength. They can lift a dog twice their own weight and dump him into the bathtub.
157.name: Erma Bombeck

158.quote: He who has not the spirit of this age, has all the misery of it.
158.name: Voltaire

159.quote: Instead of being presented with stereotypes by age, sex, color, class, or religion, children must have the opportunity to learn that within each range, some people are loathsome and some are delightful.
159.name: Margaret Mead

160.quote: I think being able to age gracefully is a very important talent. It is too late for me.
160.name: Clint Eastwood

161.quote: Error is acceptable as long as we are young but one must not drag it along into old age.
161.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

162.quote: Age wrinkles the body. Quitting wrinkles the soul.
162.name: Douglas MacArthur

163.quote: I don't need you to remind me of my age. I have a bladder to do that for me.
163.name: Stephen Fry

164.quote: Talk is by far the most accessible of pleasures. It costs nothing in money, it is all profit, it completes our education, founds and fosters our friendships, and can be enjoyed at any age and in almost any state of health.
164.name: Robert Louis Stevenson

165.quote: Men of age object too much, consult too long, adventure too little, repent too soon, and seldom drive business home to the full period, but content themselves with a mediocrity of success.
165.name: Dale Carnegie

166.quote: Better pass boldly into that other world, in the full glory of some passion, than fade and wither dismally with age.
166.name: James Joyce

167.quote: Age merely shows what children we remain.
167.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

168.quote: Each moment of a happy lover's hour is worth an age of dull and common life.
168.name: Aphra Behn

169.quote: The credit of advancing science has always been due to individuals and never to the age.
169.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

170.quote: Dressing up is a bore. At a certain age, you decorate yourself to attract the opposite sex, and at a certain age, I did that. But I'm past that age.
170.name: Katharine Hepburn

171.quote: I was born at the age of twelve on an MGM lot.
171.name: Judy Garland

172.quote: A woman telling her true age is like a buyer confiding his final price to an Armenian rug dealer.
172.name: Mignon McLaughlin

173.quote: How young can you die of old age?
173.name: Steven Wright

174.quote: Legend: A lie that has attained the dignity of age.
174.name: H. L. Mencken

175.quote: Age does not protect you from love. But love, to some extent, protects you from age.
175.name: Jeanne Moreau

176.quote: Every great architect is - necessarily - a great poet. He must be a great original interpreter of his time, his day, his age.
176.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

177.quote: At the age of six I wanted to be a cook. At seven I wanted to be Napoleon. And my ambition has been growing steadily ever since.
177.name: Salvador Dali

178.quote: Middle age is when you're sitting at home on a Saturday night and the telephone rings and you hope it isn't for you.
178.name: Ogden Nash

179.quote: If youth knew if age could.
179.name: Sigmund Freud

180.quote: I think the biggest disease the world suffers from in this day and age is the disease of people feeling unloved. I know that I can give love for a minute, for half an hour, for a day, for a month, but I can give. I am very happy to do that, I want to do that.
180.name: Princess Diana

181.quote: The charm of history and its enigmatic lesson consist in the fact that, from age to age, nothing changes and yet everything is completely different.
181.name: Aldous Huxley

182.quote: Men are like wine - some turn to vinegar, but the best improve with age.
182.name: Pope John XXIII

183.quote: I created Punk for this day and age. Do you see Britney walking around wearing ties and singing punk? Hell no. That's what I do. I'm like a Sid Vicious for a new generation.
183.name: Avril Lavigne

184.quote: We are all geniuses up to the age of ten.
184.name: Aldous Huxley

185.quote: It is well for the world that in most of us, by the age of thirty, the character has set like plaster, and will never soften again.
185.name: William James

186.quote: Every age has its own poetry in every age the circumstances of history choose a nation, a race, a class to take up the torch by creating situations that can be expressed or transcended only through poetry.
186.name: Jean-Paul Sartre

187.quote: Old age is not a matter for sorrow. It is matter for thanks if we have left our work done behind us.
187.name: Thomas Carlyle

188.quote: I suppose when they reach a certain age some men are afraid to grow up. It seems the older the men get, the younger their new wives get.
188.name: Elizabeth Taylor

189.quote: Sex at age 90 is like trying to shoot pool with a rope.
189.name: George Burns

190.quote: Publishing is in a kind of Jurassic age.
190.name: Paulo Coelho

191.quote: Age is just a number. It's totally irrelevant unless, of course, you happen to be a bottle of wine.
191.name: Joan Collins

192.quote: Whatever you may look like, marry a man your own age - as your beauty fades, so will his eyesight.
192.name: Phyllis Diller

194.quote: Youth is a blunder Manhood a struggle, Old Age a regret.
194.name: Benjamin Disraeli

195.quote: To teach how to live without certainty and yet without being paralysed by hesitation is perhaps the chief thing that philosophy, in our age, can do for those who study it.
195.name: Bertrand Russell

196.quote: It is possible that mankind is on the threshold of a golden age but, if so, it will be necessary first to slay the dragon that guards the door, and this dragon is religion.
196.name: Bertrand Russell

197.quote: Nobody expects to trust his body overmuch after the age of fifty.
197.name: Alexander Hamilton

198.quote: Old age realizes the dreams of youth: look at Dean Swift in his youth he built an asylum for the insane, in his old age he was himself an inmate.
198.name: Soren Kierkegaard

199.quote: In youth we learn in age we understand.
199.name: Marie von Ebner-Eschenbach

200.quote: Believe me, that was a happy age, before the days of architects, before the days of builders.
200.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

201.quote: I have the problems of, I must confess, old age.
201.name: Billy Graham

202.quote: Not just in commerce but in the world of ideas too our age is putting on a veritable clearance sale. Everything can be had so dirt cheap that one begins to wonder whether in the end anyone will want to make a bid.
202.name: Soren Kierkegaard

203.quote: Bad news isn't wine. It doesn't improve with age.
203.name: Colin Powell

204.quote: It were a real increase of human happiness, could all young men from the age of nineteen be covered under barrels, or rendered otherwise invisible and there left to follow their lawful studies and callings, till they emerged, sadder and wiser, at the age of twenty-five.
204.name: Thomas Carlyle

205.quote: People who refuse to rest honorably on their laurels when they reach retirement age seem very admirable to me.
205.name: Helen Hayes

206.quote: Not to expose your true feelings to an adult seems to be instinctive from the age of seven or eight onwards.
206.name: George Orwell

207.quote: The heart never grows better by age I fear rather worse, always harder. A young liar will be an old one, and a young knave will only be a greater knave as he grows older.
207.name: Lord Chesterfield

208.quote: For age is opportunity no less Than youth itself, though in another dress, And as the evening twilight fades away The sky is filled with stars, invisible by day.
208.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

209.quote: Age is a case of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it don't matter.
209.name: Satchel Paige

210.quote: Have regular hours for work and play make each day both useful and pleasant, and prove that you understand the worth of time by employing it well. Then youth will be delightful, old age will bring few regrets, and life will become a beautiful success.
210.name: Louisa May Alcott

211.quote: Admiration of the proletariat, like that of dams, power stations, and aeroplanes, is part of the ideology of the machine age.
211.name: Bertrand Russell

212.quote: But the age of chivalry is gone. That of sophisters, economists, and calculators has succeeded and the glory of Europe is extinguished forever.
212.name: Edmund Burke

213.quote: Childhood: the period of human life intermediate between the idiocy of infancy and the folly of youth - two removes from the sin of manhood and three from the remorse of age.
213.name: Ambrose Bierce

214.quote: Experience is a revelation in the light of which we renounce our errors of youth for those of age.
214.name: Ambrose Bierce

215.quote: My view is that at a younger age your optimism is more and you have more imagination etc. You have less bias.
215.name: Abdul Kalam

216.quote: The ruling ideas of each age have ever been the ideas of its ruling class.
216.name: Karl Marx

217.quote: In the information age, you don't teach philosophy as they did after feudalism. You perform it. If Aristotle were alive today he'd have a talk show.
217.name: Timothy Leary

218.quote: Once I planned to write a book of poems entirely about the things in my pocket. But I found it would be too long and the age of the great epics is past.
218.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

219.quote: The harvest of old age is the recollection and abundance of blessing previously secured.
219.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

220.quote: It is the spirit of the age to believe that any fact, no matter how suspect, is superior to any imaginative exercise, no matter how true.
220.name: Gore Vidal

221.quote: The arrogance of age must submit to be taught by youth.
221.name: Edmund Burke

222.quote: The biggest disease this day and age is that of people feeling unloved.
222.name: Princess Diana

223.quote: Old age: the crown of life, our play's last act.
223.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

224.quote: I think women should start to embrace their age. What's the alternative to getting older? You die. I can't change the day I was born. But I can take care of my skin, my body, my mind, and try to live my life and be happy.
224.name: Olivia Munn

225.quote: Age is getting to know all the ways the world turns, so that if you cannot turn the world the way you want, you can at least get out of the way so you won't get run over.
225.name: Miriam Makeba

226.quote: Few women, I fear, have had such reason as I have to think the long sad years of youth were worth living for the sake of middle age.
226.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower

227.quote: One crowded hour of glorious life is worth an age without a name.
227.name: Walter Scott

228.quote: Wives are young men's mistresses, companions for middle age, and old men's nurses.
228.name: Francis Bacon

229.quote: Wisdom doesn't necessarily come with age. Sometimes age just shows up all by itself.
229.name: Tom Wilson

230.quote: It is a blessed thing that in every age some one has had the individuality enough and courage enough to stand by his own convictions.
230.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

231.quote: And in my own life, in my own small way, I've tried to give back to this country that has given me so much. That's why I left a job at a law firm for a career in public service, working to empower young people to volunteer in their communities. Because I believe that each of us - no matter what our age or background or walk of life - each of us has something to contribute to the life of this nation.
231.name: Michelle Obama

232.quote: No lying knight or lying priest ever prospered in any age, but especially not in the dark ones. Men prospered then only in following an openly declared purpose, and preaching candidly beloved and trusted creeds.
232.name: John Ruskin

233.quote: A man does not die of love or his liver or even of old age he dies of being a man.
233.name: Miguel de Unamuno

234.quote: It is with an old love as it is with old age a man lives to all the miseries, but is dead to all the pleasures.
234.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

235.quote: I cried on my 18th birthday. I thought 17 was such a nice age. You're young enough to get away with things, but you're old enough, too.
235.name: Liv Tyler

236.quote: We live in an age when to be young and to be indifferent can be no longer synonymous. We must prepare for the coming hour. The claims of the Future are represented by suffering millions and the Youth of a Nation are the trustees of Posterity.
236.name: Benjamin Disraeli

237.quote: Age shouldn't affect you. It's just like the size of your shoes - they don't determine how you live your life! You're either marvellous or you're boring, regardless of your age.
237.name: Steven Morrissey

238.quote: Rashness belongs to youth prudence to old age.
238.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

239.quote: Many believe - and I believe - that I have been designated for this work by God. In spite of my old age, I do not want to give it up I work out of love for God and I put all my hope in Him.
239.name: Michelangelo

240.quote: Old age is a tyrant, who forbids, under pain of death, the pleasures of youth.
240.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

241.quote: The defects of the mind, like those of the face, grow worse with age.
241.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

242.quote: The enemy of society is middle class and the enemy of life is middle age.
242.name: Orson Welles

243.quote: Some say that the age of chivalry is past, that the spirit of romance is dead. The age of chivalry is never past, so long as there is a wrong left unredressed on earth.
243.name: Charles Kingsley

244.quote: Man has no Body distinct from his Soul for that called Body is a portion of Soul discerned by the five Senses, the chief inlets of Soul in this age.
244.name: William Blake

245.quote: Do you remember when you were 10 or 11 years old and you really thought your folks were the best? They were completely omniscient and you took their word for everything. And then you got older and you went through this hideous age when suddenly they were the devil, they were bullies, and they didn't know anything.
245.name: Chuck Palahniuk

246.quote: This is the patent age of new inventions for killing bodies, and for saving souls. All propagated with the best intentions.
246.name: Lord Byron

247.quote: The mind that is wise mourns less for what age takes away than what it leaves behind.
247.name: William Wordsworth

248.quote: The age of chivalry is past. Bores have succeeded to dragons.
248.name: Charles Dickens

249.quote: Anything you cannot relinquish when it has outlived its usefulness possesses you, and in this materialistic age a great many of us are possessed by our possessions.
249.name: Peace Pilgrim

250.quote: Like many women my age, I am 28 years old.
250.name: Mary Schmich

251.quote: Life, an age to the miserable, and a moment to the happy.
251.name: Francis Bacon

252.quote: We are always the same age inside.
252.name: Gertrude Stein

253.quote: I am, as I've said, merely competent. But in an age of incompetence, that makes me extraordinary.
253.name: Billy Joel

254.quote: Swing voters are more appropriately known as the 'idiot voters' because they have no set of philosophical principles. By the age of fourteen, you're either a Conservative or a Liberal if you have an IQ above a toaster.
254.name: Ann Coulter

255.quote: If you live to be one hundred, you've got it made. Very few people die past that age.
255.name: George Burns

256.quote: Old age is far more than white hair, wrinkles, the feeling that it is too late and the game finished, that the stage belongs to the rising generations. The true evil is not the weakening of the body, but the indifference of the soul.
256.name: Andre Maurois

257.quote: Old age has its pleasures, which, though different, are not less than the pleasures of youth.
257.name: W. Somerset Maugham

258.quote: Old age is when the liver spots show through your gloves.
258.name: Phyllis Diller

259.quote: There is no absurdity so palpable but that it may be firmly planted in the human head if you only begin to inculcate it before the age of five, by constantly repeating it with an air of great solemnity.
259.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

260.quote: Those who improve with age embrace the power of personal growth and personal achievement and begin to replace youth with wisdom, innocence with understanding, and lack of purpose with self-actualization.
260.name: Bo Bennett

261.quote: Nearly all the powerful people of this age are unbelievers, the best of them in doubt and misery, the most in plodding hesitation, doing as well as they can, what practical work lies at hand.
261.name: John Ruskin

262.quote: What is an adult? A child blown up by age.
262.name: Simone de Beauvoir

263.quote: Intelligent life on a planet comes of age when it first works out the reason for its own existence.
263.name: Richard Dawkins

264.quote: I am of a healthy long lived race, and our minds improve with age.
264.name: William Butler Yeats

265.quote: The wisdom of age: don't stop walking.
265.name: Mason Cooley

266.quote: As the age of television progresses the Reagans will be the rule, not the exception. To be perfect for television is all a President has to be these days.
266.name: Gore Vidal

267.quote: Before anything else, we need a new age of Enlightenment. Our present political systems must relinquish their claims on truth, justice and freedom and have to replace them with the search for truth, justice, freedom and reason.
267.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

268.quote: Age is strictly a case of mind over matter. If you don't mind, it doesn't matter.
268.name: Jack Benny

269.quote: I'm 36 and if I met a woman of my own age and married her, I'd also be marrying her former life, her past. It might be OK for some people - I don't want to judge it or anything - but it's not for me. It would destroy my creativity.
269.name: Henry Rollins

270.quote: I believe we should encourage children to sing and play instruments from an early age.
270.name: Mick Jagger

271.quote: You should not consider a man's age but his acts.
271.name: Sophocles

272.quote: At my age flowers scare me.
272.name: George Burns

273.quote: I would go out with women my age, but there are no women my age.
273.name: George Burns

274.quote: It is not well to make great changes in old age.
274.name: Charles Spurgeon

275.quote: Setting a good example for your children takes all the fun out of middle age.
275.name: William Feather

276.quote: You are 27 or 28 right? It is very tough to live at that age. When nothing is sure. I have sympathy with you.
276.name: Haruki Murakami

277.quote: The stars shall fade away, the sun himself Grow dim with age, and nature sink in years, But thou shalt flourish in immortal youth, Unhurt amidst the wars of elements, The wrecks of matter, and the crush of worlds.
277.name: Joseph Addison

278.quote: Young men soon give, and soon forget, affronts old age is slow in both.
278.name: Joseph Addison

279.quote: By all but the pathologically romantic, it is now recognized that this is not the age of the small man.
279.name: John Kenneth Galbraith

280.quote: It is not the young people that degenerate they are not spoiled till those of mature age are already sunk into corruption.
280.name: Charles de Montesquieu

281.quote: To be happy, we must be true to nature and carry our age along with us.
281.name: William Hazlitt

282.quote: Youth cannot know how age thinks and feels. But old men are guilty if they forget what it was to be young.
282.name: J. K. Rowling

283.quote: It is the malady of our age that the young are so busy teaching us that they have no time left to learn.
283.name: Eric Hoffer

284.quote: I'm at peace with myself and where I am. In the past, I was always looking to see how everybody else was doing. I wasn't competitive, I was comparative. I just wanted to be where everybody else was. Now I've gotten to an age when I am not comparing anymore.
284.name: Courteney Cox

285.quote: We of Africa protest that, in this day and age, we should continue to be treated as lesser human beings than other races.
285.name: Robert Mugabe

286.quote: Marriage is not about age it's about finding the right person.
286.name: Sophia Bush

287.quote: We have entered an age in which education is not just a luxury permitting some men an advantage over others. It has become a necessity without which a person is defenseless in this complex, industrialized society. We have truly entered the century of the educated man.
287.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

288.quote: Old age is the verdict of life.
288.name: Amelia Barr

289.quote: The passions grafted on wounded pride are the most inveterate they are green and vigorous in old age.
289.name: George Santayana

290.quote: Every age can be enchanting, provided you live within it.
290.name: Brigitte Bardot

291.quote: It is unthinkable for a Frenchman to arrive at middle age without having syphilis and the Cross of the Legion of Honor.
291.name: Andre Gide

292.quote: It is folly for an eminent man to think of escaping censure, and a weakness to be affected with it. All the illustrious persons of antiquity, and indeed of every age in the world, have passed through this fiery persecution.
292.name: Joseph Addison

293.quote: There must be a day or two in a man's life when he is the precise age for something important.
293.name: Franklin P. Adams

294.quote: It is old age, rather than death, that is to be contrasted with life. Old age is life's parody, whereas death transforms life into a destiny: in a way it preserves it by giving it the absolute dimension. Death does away with time.
294.name: Simone de Beauvoir

295.quote: I don't care about age very much.
295.name: Chinua Achebe

296.quote: Old age and the passage of time teach all things.
296.name: Sophocles

297.quote: I think age is a very high price to pay for maturity.
297.name: Tom Stoppard

298.quote: I had used eclectic therapy and behavior therapy on myself at the age of 19 to get over my fear of public speaking and of approaching young women in public.
298.name: Albert Ellis

299.quote: Children rarely want to know who their parents were before they were parents, and when age finally stirs their curiosity, there is no parent left to tell them.
299.name: Russell Baker

300.quote: Middle age occurs when you are too young to take up golf and too old to rush up to the net.
300.name: Franklin P. Adams

301.quote: Old age: I fall asleep during the funerals of my friends.
301.name: Mason Cooley

302.quote: Staid middle age loves the hurricane passions of opera.
302.name: Mason Cooley

303.quote: Middle age went by while I was mourning for my lost youth.
303.name: Mason Cooley

304.quote: In passing, we should note this curious mark of our own age: the only absolute allowed is the absolute insistence that there is no absolute.
304.name: Francis Schaeffer

305.quote: It's not catastrophes, murders, deaths, diseases, that age and kill us it's the way people look and laugh, and run up the steps of omnibuses.
305.name: Virginia Woolf

306.quote: Not even old age knows how to love death.
306.name: Sophocles

307.quote: It's really amazing that in the age of unbelief, as a smart man called it, there isn't even more fraud. After all, with no God, there's no one to ever call you to account, and no accounting at all if you can get away with it.
307.name: Ben Stein

308.quote: I think that a man should not live beyond the age when he begins to deteriorate, when the flame that lighted the brightest moment of his life has weakened.
308.name: Fidel Castro

309.quote: Temper never mellows with age, and a sharp tongue is the only edged tool that grows keener with constant use.
309.name: Washington Irving

310.quote: It is not by the gray of the hair that one knows the age of the heart.
310.name: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

311.quote: I think the sport of wrestling, which I became involved with at the age of 14, I competed until I was 34, kind of old for a contact sport. I coached the sport until I was 47. I think the discipline of wrestling has given me the discipline I have to write.
311.name: John Irving

312.quote: Another belief of mine that everyone else my age is an adult, whereas I am merely in disguise.
312.name: Margaret Atwood

313.quote: Age carries all things away, even the mind.
313.name: Virgil

314.quote: Age steals away all things, even the mind.
314.name: Virgil

315.quote: In fact, my courage and my bravery at a young age was the thing I was bullied for, a kind of 'Who do you think you are?'
315.name: Lady Gaga

316.quote: A bad manner spoils everything, even reason and justice a good one supplies everything, gilds a No, sweetens a truth, and adds a touch of beauty to old age itself.
316.name: Baltasar Gracian

317.quote: As technology advances, it reverses the characteristics of every situation again and again. The age of automation is going to be the age of 'do it yourself.'
317.name: Marshall McLuhan

318.quote: The excess of our youth are checks written against our age and they are payable with interest thirty years later.
318.name: Charles Caleb Colton

319.quote: At the age when Bengali youth almost inevitably writes poetry, I was listening to European classical music.
319.name: Satyajit Ray

320.quote: I smoke ten to fifteen cigars a day. At my age I have to hold on to something.
320.name: George Burns

321.quote: I'm at the age now where just putting my cigar in its holder is a thrill.
321.name: George Burns

322.quote: Age becomes reality when you hear someone refer to that attractive young woman standing next to the woman in the green dress, and you find that you're the one in the green dress.
322.name: Lois Wyse

323.quote: Our scientific age demands that we provide definitions, measurements, and statistics in order to be taken seriously. Yet most of the important things in life cannot be precisely defined or measured. Can we define or measure love, beauty, friendship, or decency, for example?
323.name: Dennis Prager

324.quote: The nearer people approach old age the closer they return to a semblance of childhood, until the time comes for them to depart this life, again like children, neither tired of living nor aware of death.
324.name: Desiderius Erasmus

325.quote: Old age is a special problem for me because I've never been able to shed the mental image I have of myself - a lad of about 19.
325.name: E. B. White

326.quote: People until I was 60 would always say they thought I looked younger, which I think, without flattering myself, I did, but I think I certainly have, as George Orwell says people do after a certain age, the face they deserve.
326.name: Christopher Hitchens

327.quote: The one thing that unites all human beings, regardless of age, gender, religion or ethnic background, is that we all believe we are above-average drivers.
327.name: Dave Barry

328.quote: Why do people talk of the horrors of old age? It's great. I feel like a fine old car with the parts gradually wearing out, but I'm not complaining,, Those who find growing old terrible are people who haven't done what they wanted with their lives.
328.name: Martha Gellhorn

329.quote: As winter strips the leaves from around us, so that we may see the distant regions they formerly concealed, so old age takes away our enjoyments only to enlarge the prospect of the coming eternity.
329.name: Jean Paul

330.quote: God employs several translators some pieces are translated by age, some by sickness, some by war, some by justice.
330.name: John Donne

331.quote: No man was ever so completely skilled in the conduct of life, as not to receive new information from age and experience.
331.name: Jonathan Swift

332.quote: Interest is the spur of the people, but glory that of great souls. Invention is the talent of youth, and judgment of age.
332.name: Jonathan Swift

333.quote: Invention is the talent of youth, as judgment is of age.
333.name: Jonathan Swift

334.quote: I'm very pleased to be here. Let's face it, at my age I'm very pleased to be anywhere.
334.name: George Burns

335.quote: I must be more sensible and realize that at my age, illusions are hardly permitted and they will always destroy me.
335.name: Paul Cezanne

336.quote: My age and health will never allow me to realize the dream of art I've been pursuing all my life.
336.name: Paul Cezanne

337.quote: My husband gave me a necklace. It's fake. I requested fake. Maybe I'm paranoid, but in this day and age, I don't want something around my neck that's worth more than my head.
337.name: Rita Rudner

338.quote: From as long as, literally as far back as I can remember I've liked puns, word jokes, I can literally recall looking at a comic at the age of six or seven and I remember what I enjoyed and what it was precisely and how the joke worked.
338.name: Tom Stoppard

339.quote: The terror of the atom age is not the violence of the new power but the speed of man's adjustment to it, the speed of his acceptance.
339.name: E. B. White

340.quote: I was born in ancient times, at the end of the world, in a patriarchal Catholic and conservative family. No wonder that by age five I was a raging feminist - although the term had not reached Chile yet, so nobody knew what the heck was wrong with me.
340.name: Isabel Allende

341.quote: The information encoded in your DNA determines your unique biological characteristics, such as sex, eye color, age and Social Security number.
341.name: Dave Barry

342.quote: O love, if I regret the age when one savors you, it is not for the hour of pleasure, but for the one that follows it.
342.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

343.quote: In the television age, the key distinction is between the candidate who can speak poetry and the one who can only speak prose.
343.name: Richard M. Nixon

344.quote: Age does not matter if the matter does not age.
344.name: Jean Paul

345.quote: I'm well past the age where I'm acceptable. You get to a certain age and you are forbidden access. You're not going to get the kind of coverage that you would like in music magazines, you're not going to get played on radio and you're not going to get played on television. I have to survive on word of mouth.
345.name: David Bowie

346.quote: Ours is essentially a tragic age, so we refuse to take it tragically.
346.name: David Herbert Lawrence

347.quote: Ours is an excessively conscious age. We know so much, we feel so little.
347.name: David Herbert Lawrence

348.quote: Everybody past a certain age, regardless of how they look on the outside, pretty much constantly dreams of being able to escape from their lives.
348.name: Doug Coupland

349.quote: One keeps forgetting old age up to the very brink of the grave.
349.name: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

350.quote: In the age of the individual's liquidation, the question of individuality must be raised anew.
350.name: Theodor Adorno

351.quote: I ask you to pray for me, for once age has overtaken us, we find consolation only in religion.
351.name: Paul Cezanne

352.quote: Today more than ever we need creative minds to address the issues of the age. And one of the most urgent is this: How can humanity know so much, achieve so much, and still fail so many people so badly?
352.name: King Abdullah II

353.quote: Women lie about their age men lie about their income.
353.name: William Feather

354.quote: A major advantage of age is learning to accept people without passing judgment.
354.name: Liz Carpenter

355.quote: The people who live in a golden age usually go around complaining how yellow everything looks.
355.name: Randall Jarrell

356.quote: There was no respect for youth when I was young, and now that I am old, there is no respect for age, I missed it coming and going.
356.name: J. B. Priestley

357.quote: Everyone knows that by far the happiest and universally enjoyable age of man is the first. What is there about babies which makes us hug and kiss and fondle them, so that even an enemy would give them help at that age?
357.name: Desiderius Erasmus

358.quote: Well, I'm in my 60s now. I finally look it, I think. People until I was 60 would always say they thought I looked younger, which I think, without flattering myself, I did, but I think I certainly have, as George Orwell says people do after a certain age, the face they deserve.
358.name: Christopher Hitchens

359.quote: Save your money. You're going to need twice as much money in your old age as you think.
359.name: Michael Caine

360.quote: If you read back in the Bible, the letter of the apostle Paul to the church of Thessalonia, he said that in the latter days before the end of the age that the Earth would be caught up in what he called the birth pangs of a new order.
360.name: Pat Robertson

361.quote: There is no self-knowledge but an historical one. No one knows what he himself is who does not know his fellow men, especially the most prominent one of the community, the master's master, the genius of the age.
361.name: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel

362.quote: Middle age is when your old classmates are so grey and wrinkled and bald they don't recognize you.
362.name: Bennett Cerf

363.quote: In this electronic age we see ourselves being translated more and more into the form of information, moving toward the technological extension of consciousness.
363.name: Marshall McLuhan

364.quote: You can judge your age by the amount of pain you feel when you come in contact with a new idea.
364.name: Pearl S. Buck

365.quote: The sanitary and mechanical age we are now entering makes up for the mercy it grants to our sense of smell by the ferocity with which it assails our sense of hearing.
365.name: Havelock Ellis

366.quote: Middle age is when you've met so many people that every new person you meet reminds you of someone else.
366.name: Ogden Nash

367.quote: There are people whose watch stops at a certain hour and who remain permanently at that age.
367.name: Helen Rowland

368.quote: My justification is that most people my age spend a lot of time thinking about what they're going to do for the next five or ten years. The time they spend thinking about their life, I just spend drinking.
368.name: Amy Winehouse

369.quote: They that have lived a single day have lived an age.
369.name: Jean de la Bruyere

370.quote: From the age of fifteen, dogma has been the fundamental principle of my religion: I know no other religion I cannot enter into the idea of any other sort of religion religion, as a mere sentiment, is to me a dream and a mockery.
370.name: John Henry Newman

371.quote: The class distinctions proper to a democratic society are not those of rank or money, still less, as is apt to happen when these are abandoned, of race, but of age.
371.name: W. H. Auden

372.quote: Old age, calm, expanded, broad with the haughty breadth of the universe, old age flowing free with the delicious near-by freedom of death.
372.name: Edith Wharton

373.quote: We are living in the machine age. For the first time in history the comedian has been compelled to supply himself with jokes and comedy material to compete with the machine. Whether he knows it or not, the comedian is on a treadmill to oblivion.
373.name: Fred Allen

374.quote: At a certain age it just became apparent to me that this was probably the work that I would have to do.
374.name: Daniel Day-Lewis

375.quote: Genius is present in every age, but the men carrying it within them remain benumbed unless extraordinary events occur to heat up and melt the mass so that it flows forth.
375.name: Denis Diderot

376.quote: Every age needs men who will redeem the time by living with a vision of the things that are to be.
376.name: Adlai E. Stevenson

377.quote: I would like to see more airplay for all artists, no matter what age. I think there's a lot of money being spent toward the young guys, but a lot of the older guys are the ones who blazed the trail for those young guys.
377.name: Willie Nelson

378.quote: In my old age, I'll be in L.A.
378.name: David Hockney

379.quote: I shall not grow conservative with age.
379.name: Elizabeth Cady Stanton

380.quote: I first learned that there were black people living in some place called other than the United States in the western hemisphere when I was a very little boy, and my father told me that when he was a boy about my age, he wanted to be an Episcopal priest, because he so admired his priest, a black man from someplace called Haiti.
380.name: Henry Louis Gates

381.quote: Why should 20-year-olds only be considered sexy? I think we get better with age.
381.name: Jenny McCarthy

382.quote: I saw how many people were poor and how many kids my age went to school hungry in the morning, which I don't think most of my contemporaries in racially segregated schools in the South thought very much about at the time.
382.name: Charles Kuralt

383.quote: When you get to my age life seems little more than one long march to and from the lavatory.
383.name: A. C. Benson

384.quote: I think, if you put a camera in anyone's life and document it daily from the age of 21 to 27, there are going to be things that aren't always pretty.
384.name: Sienna Miller

385.quote: Non-disclosure in the Internet Age is quickly perceived as a breach of trust. Government, corporations and each of us as individuals must recalibrate how we live and share our lives appropriate to the information now available and the expectations of others.
385.name: Simon Mainwaring

386.quote: Where children are, there is the golden age.
386.name: Novalis

387.quote: Sure I played, did you think I was born at the age of 70 sitting in a dugout trying to manage guys like you?
387.name: Casey Stengel

388.quote: To be free in an age like ours, one must be in a position of authority. That in itself would be enough to make me ambitious.
388.name: Hannah Arendt

389.quote: I came to water late. I learned to swim at the age of 20.
389.name: Liam Neeson

390.quote: People are so busy dreaming the American Dream, fantasizing about what they could be or have a right to be, that they're all asleep at the switch. Consequently we are living in the Age of Human Error.
390.name: Florence King

391.quote: I was getting hot flashes and sweats on a regular basis. That's not normal, even for my age.
391.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

392.quote: I remember at the age of five travelling on a trolley car with my mother past a group of women on a picket line at a textile plant, seeing them being viciously beaten by security people. So that kind of thing stayed with me.
392.name: Noam Chomsky

393.quote: Age is not all decay it is the ripening, the swelling, of the fresh life within, that withers and bursts the husk.
393.name: George MacDonald

394.quote: I knew at a young age, whether I was playing baseball or hockey or lacrosse, that my teammates were counting on me, whether it be to strike the last batter out in a baseball game or score a big goal in a hockey game.
394.name: Wayne Gretzky

395.quote: The funniest racism is the racism between minorities. It's something you don't see dramatized, but almost every minority I know who's my age, they have these funny stories about their parents stereotyping other minorities.
395.name: Mindy Kaling

396.quote: It's ironic that at age 32, at probably the greatest moment of my career, with The Godfather having such an enormous success, I wasn't even aware of it, because I was somewhere else under the deadline again.
396.name: Francis Ford Coppola

397.quote: I'm asked all the time in interviews about who I am, and I know a few people my age who have a strong sense of self, but I couldn't say I know myself and sum it up and give it to you in a little package. I don't know myself at all yet.
397.name: Kristen Stewart

398.quote: Alexander at the head of the world never tasted the true pleasure that boys of his own age have enjoyed at the head of a school.
398.name: Horace Walpole

399.quote: To separate children from others of similar age and qualifications solely because of their race generates a feeling of inferiority as to their status in the community that may affect their hearts and minds in a way unlikely ever to be undone.
399.name: Earl Warren

400.quote: In an age of incompetence, I've been able to last in this crazy business. I actually know how to play my ax and write a song. That's my job.
400.name: Billy Joel

401.quote: In this age of media and Internet access, we are much more talkative than ever before.
401.name: David Duchovny

402.quote: Over the years Woodstock got glorified and romanticised and became the event that symbolised Utopia. It's the last page of our collective memory of the age of innocence. Then things turned ugly and would never be the same again.
402.name: Ang Lee

403.quote: Every time I see something terrible, it's like I see it at age 19. I keep a freshness that way.
403.name: Ralph Nader

404.quote: I hate to mention age, but I come from an era when we weren't consumed by technology and television.
404.name: Jimmy Buffett

405.quote: We are approaching a new age of synthesis. Knowledge cannot be merely a degree or a skill, it demands a broader vision, capabilities in critical thinking and logical deduction without which we cannot have constructive progress.
405.name: Li Ka Shing

406.quote: Morality comes with the sad wisdom of age, when the sense of curiosity has withered.
406.name: Graham Greene

407.quote: Every age yearns for a more beautiful world. The deeper the desperation and the depression about the confusing present, the more intense that yearning.
407.name: Johan Huizinga

408.quote: To be told that one can be dependent on one's parents until age 26 should strike a young person who wants to grow up as demeaning, not as something to celebrate.
408.name: Dennis Prager

409.quote: Does age matter? Time doesn't matter.
409.name: Sandra Bullock

410.quote: I figured out it was a social thing, what women were allowed to do. At a very young age, I decided I was not going to follow women's rules.
410.name: Joan Jett

411.quote: We were really grown up for our age and it was an incredible special band.
411.name: Joan Jett

412.quote: Age is the first limitation on roles that I've ever had to encounter, and I hit that awhile ago.
412.name: Jack Nicholson

413.quote: I can't hit on women in public any more. I didn't decide this it just doesn't feel right at my age.
413.name: Jack Nicholson

414.quote: This is the first age that's ever paid much attention to the future, which is a little ironic since we may not have one.
414.name: Arthur C. Clarke

415.quote: I feel we live in the kind of culture now where you have to be very smart to navigate the right way, and I just don't have those smarts. I think with age and time it will change, but I can't obsess about it.
415.name: Sienna Miller

416.quote: The secret of long life is double careers. One to about age sixty, then another for the next thirty years.
416.name: David Ogilvy

417.quote: I knew at an early age I wanted to act. Acting was always easy for me. I don't believe in predestination, but I do believe that once you get where ever it is you are going, that is where you were going to be.
417.name: Morgan Freeman

418.quote: The age in which we live, this non-stop distraction, is making it more impossible for the young generation to ever have the curiosity or discipline, because you need to be alone to find out anything.
418.name: Vivienne Westwood

419.quote: I can feel the 60S looming. In my profession, I've just moved along with my age. By thinking in decades, rather than whether someone's 42 or 47, you can give yourself a whole 10 years to turn yourself around in.
419.name: Francesca Annis

420.quote: We all know now that people can look good for their age. It isn't so extraordinary, I don't know why people go on about it so much.
420.name: Francesca Annis

421.quote: A lot of music you might listen to is pretty vapid, it doesn't always deal with our deeper issues. These are the things I'm interested in now, particularly at my age.
421.name: Annie Lennox

422.quote: Life expectancy in many parts of Africa can be something around the age of thirty five to thirty eight. I mean you're very fortunate if you live to that age. In fact when I went to Uganda for the first time one of the things that occurred to me was that I saw very few elderly people.
422.name: Annie Lennox

423.quote: Light and funny has a more compelling quality when you're younger. But I haven't abandoned the genre: I love falling down I love Lucille Ball. It's just that a lot of those stories revolve around problems that I can't convincingly portray at this age.
423.name: Julia Roberts

424.quote: I had the good fortune to be able to right an injustice that I thought was being heaped on young people by lowering the voting age, where you had young people that were old enough to die in Vietnam but not old enough to vote for their members of Congress that sent them there.
424.name: Birch Bayh

425.quote: The value of old age depends upon the person who reaches it. To some men of early performance it is useless. To others, who are late to develop, it just enables them to finish the job.
425.name: Thomas Hardy

426.quote: I've gotten crankier in my old age.
426.name: Shirley MacLaine

427.quote: I've been very competitive by nature from a young age, whether it was eating a bowl of pasta faster than somebody else, or always wanting to be the first one in line.
427.name: Maria Sharapova

428.quote: Death comes not to the living soul, nor age to the loving heart.
428.name: Phoebe Cary

429.quote: I'm not busy, a woman with three children under the age of 10 wouldn't think my schedule looked so busy.
429.name: Garrison Keillor

430.quote: High expectations weren't nurtured in my neck of nowhere back then - children weren't fawned over from an early age as 'gifted' and groomed for a prizewinning future self-esteem was considered something you had to pick from the garden yourself.
430.name: James Wolcott

431.quote: Not by age but by capacity is wisdom acquired.
431.name: Plautus

432.quote: Whoever marries the spirit of this age will find himself a widower in the next.
432.name: William Ralph Inge

433.quote: Of middle age the best that can be said is that a middle-aged person has likely learned how to have a little fun in spite of his troubles.
433.name: Don Marquis

434.quote: Old age is always wakeful as if, the longer linked with life, the less man has to do with aught that looks like death.
434.name: Herman Melville

435.quote: What I think is amazing is not that 85% of people who get married under the age of 25 get divorced, it's that 15% of them stay together. How did they manage to pull that off? You almost can't wait too long. It's the single simplest measure to predict divorce.
435.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

436.quote: I avoid talking before the youth of the age as I would dancing before them: for if one's tongue don't move in the steps of the day, and thinks to please by its old graces, it is only an object of ridicule.
436.name: Horace Walpole

437.quote: I'm glad I was born when I was. My time was the golden age of variety. If I were starting out again now, maybe things would happen for me, but it certainly would not be on a variety show with 28 musicians, 12 dancers, two major guest stars, 50 costumes a week by Bob Mackie. The networks just wouldn't spend the money today.
437.name: Carol Burnett

438.quote: I was taught from a young age that many people would treat me as a second-class citizen because I was African-American and because I was female.
438.name: Queen Latifah

439.quote: Even from a very early age, I knew I didn't want to miss out on anything life had to offer just because it might be considered dangerous.
439.name: Nicole Kidman

440.quote: We live in an age where anonymity is growing in magnitude like a bomb going off.
440.name: Jock Sturges

441.quote: I was a mixture of being incredibly old for my age and incredibly backwards. I was born quite old, but then I stopped growing. I lived with my mum and dad till I was 30.
441.name: Helena Bonham Carter

442.quote: The Word of fire burns today On the lips of our prophets in an evil age.
442.name: Margaret Walker

443.quote: What is wrong with the Iranians in addition to the nuclear bomb? This is the only country on Earth in the 21st century that has renewed imperialistic ambitions. They really want to become the hegemon of the Middle East in an age that gave up imperialism.
443.name: Shimon Peres

444.quote: I think it's quite extraordinary that people cast me as if I'm Warren Beatty: until I met my present wife, at the age of 35, you could name two girlfriends.
444.name: Colin Firth

445.quote: Craziest thing I've done for love is getting married. I think it's crazy. I think it's crazy, crazy, crazy. I'm never going to say I wouldn't do it again but I have to make sure it's love and not settling for the 'I have to do this by a certain age,' which is kind of what I did.
445.name: Jenny McCarthy

446.quote: You never choose the way that you're raised, it's just the way that you were raised, but you do get to a certain age where you're in a position to question the expectations of you and the way that you've been formed by your surroundings.
446.name: Mia Wasikowska

447.quote: We tried not to age, but time had its rage.
447.name: Pete Townshend

448.quote: I want to age with some dignity.
448.name: Pete Townshend

449.quote: This is my 20th year in the sport. I've known swimming and that's it. I don't want to swim past age 30 if I continue after this Olympics, and come back in 2016, I'll be 31. I'm looking forward to being able to see the other side of the fence.
449.name: Michael Phelps

450.quote: Young man, the secret of my success is that an early age I discovered that I was not God.
450.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

451.quote: I'd like to talk about free markets. Information in the computer age is the last genuine free market left on earth except those free markets where indigenous people are still surviving. And that's basically becoming limited.
451.name: Russell Means

452.quote: I would often find myself, at the age of 21, at midnight, running down a dark street on my own with 10 men chasing me. And the fact they had cameras in their hands made that legal.
452.name: Sienna Miller

453.quote: Bring a wife home to your house when you are of the right age, not far short of 30 years, nor much above this is the right time for marriage.
453.name: Hesiod

454.quote: There are only two things a child will share willingly communicable diseases and its mother's age.
454.name: Benjamin Spock

455.quote: Although it is generally known, I think it's about time to announce that I was born at a very early age.
455.name: Douglas Horton

456.quote: I think it's your mental attitude. So many of us start dreading age in high school and that's a waste of a lovely life. 'Oh, I'm 30, oh, I'm 40, oh, 50.' Make the most of it.
456.name: Betty White

457.quote: No, no, I was only funny on stage, really. I, I, think I was funny as a person toward my classmates when I was very young. You know, when I was a child, up to about the age of 12.
457.name: Rowan Atkinson

458.quote: What goes on in Europe concerns us greatly because, if Europe comes apart, the E.U. comes apart, then you're going to have enormous impact on America, that's a very big trading partner of ours, and people own securities around the world in this day and age.
458.name: Michael Bloomberg

459.quote: Your body actually reminds you about your age and your injuries - the body has a stronger memory than your mind.
459.name: Mikhail Baryshnikov

461.quote: I never had little brothers, so I was totally not used to hearing a lot of cussing at a young age! I learned what 'pull my finger' meant the hard way.
461.name: Danica McKellar

462.quote: My sister and I shared a bedroom our entire lives and I believe she discovered the Beatles when she was about 11 and I'm four years younger. So from the age of 7 until 17 we had nothing but Beatles paraphernalia in our room, even those little stuffed Beatles that went on stands that are dressed as the Sgt. Pepper band.
462.name: Christina Ricci

463.quote: But look, I was born in 1956, the peak year for births in US history. I think I'm very representative of many of the thought processes my generation have been through and, by and large, people of my age have had their imprint planted on the consciousness of western society for a long time.
463.name: Tom Hanks

464.quote: I basically get stereotyped a lot in terms of being a girl and writing 'chick' music for teenage girls or something. I think, if anything, the press kind of, because of my gender and my age, tends to kind of relegate my work to this sort of special-interest group. It's part of the cultural dynamic, I guess.
464.name: Ani DiFranco

465.quote: What is amazing for a woman of my age is that I change as the world is changing-and changing very, very fast. I don't think my mother had that opportunity to change.
465.name: Jeanne Moreau

467.quote: To me age is a number, just a number. Who cares?
467.name: Jeanne Moreau

468.quote: If you're extremely, painfully frightened of age, it shows.
468.name: Jeanne Moreau

469.quote: For a man who has compared himself to Theodore Roosevelt and the nation's challenges to those of the Gilded Age, Obama put forward a tepid agenda.
469.name: Ron Fournier

470.quote: I wrote a screenplay for a 'Sweet Valley High' adaptation, and it's really amazing to me how many women who are my age have responded to the idea and are excited about the movie.
470.name: Diablo Cody

471.quote: Let age, not envy, draw wrinkles on thy cheeks.
471.name: Thomas Browne

472.quote: Here's my Golden Rule for a tarnished age: Be fair with others, but keep after them until they're fair with you.
472.name: Alan Alda

473.quote: Children under five are the poorest age group in America, and one in four infants, toddlers and preschoolers are poor during the years of greatest brain development.
473.name: Marian Wright Edelman

474.quote: Everyone talks about age, but it's not about age. It's about work ethic. Winning never gets old.
474.name: Lisa Leslie

475.quote: Age is a terrible avenger. The lessons of life give you so much to work with, but by the time you've got all this great wisdom, you don't get to be young anymore.
475.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

476.quote: Science cannot tell theology how to construct a doctrine of creation, but you can't construct a doctrine of creation without taking account of the age of the universe and the evolutionary character of cosmic history.
476.name: John Polkinghorne

477.quote: I came of age believing that, no matter what happened, I would always be able to support myself.
477.name: William J. Clinton

478.quote: It is not classified as a pagan religion. The so-called New Age activities and this are not called religions and therefore don't come under the prohibition of mingling church and state that we have in this country.
478.name: Dixie Lee Ray

479.quote: No sex, age, or condition is above or below the absolute necessity of modesty but without it one vastly beneath the rank of man.
479.name: Bruce Barton

480.quote: People tend to become more emotionally intelligent as they age and mature.
480.name: Daniel Goleman

481.quote: With age, you get to a place where you don't want to knock people out. You just want to give people a hug.
481.name: Vin Diesel

482.quote: Age is no barrier. It's a limitation you put on your mind.
482.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

483.quote: Whoever, fleeing marriage and the sorrows that women cause, does not wish to wed comes to a deadly old age.
483.name: Hesiod

484.quote: Age has been the perfect fire extinguisher for flaming youth.
484.name: Navjot Singh Sidhu

485.quote: I prefer younger men. In some ways, they are much more open to a woman being stronger and independent then some of the men my age.
485.name: Kim Cattrall

486.quote: You have to be desirable. And that's why so many woman of my age or even younger are pushed to Botox and plastic surgery, all the things that people say, 'Why do women do this?' Where do you go in your 50s in your career?
486.name: Kim Cattrall

487.quote: It is my art. I am better at it than I ever was. And I will do it as long as I can. When you reach a certain age you can slough off what is unnecessary and concentrate on what is. And why not?
487.name: Arthur Miller

488.quote: I feel like a lot of the female relationships I see on TV or in movies are in some way free of the kind of jealousy and anxiety and posturing that has been such a huge part of my female friendships, which I hope lessens a little bit with age.
488.name: Lena Dunham

489.quote: At my age, no one is married, no one has kids, no one has a career.
489.name: Lena Dunham

490.quote: One of the many pleasures of old age is giving things up.
490.name: Malcolm Muggeridge

491.quote: There's also some element of coming of age during the Reagan administration, which everybody has painted as some glorious time in America, but I remember as being a very, very dark time. There was apocalypse in the air the punk rock movement made sense.
491.name: John Cusack

492.quote: If you explode onto the scene at a very young age, there are so many people pulling you in different directions. It takes time to recalibrate and see what's important.
492.name: Clive Owen

493.quote: Situational unawareness in the private marketplace or on the battlefield will cost you your livelihood or your life. In the Age of Obama, however, such willful ignorance is a job prerequisite. The less you know the better.
493.name: Michelle Malkin

494.quote: We virtually never feel our age, but thinking that we should can lead to disaster.
494.name: Martha Beck

495.quote: We grew up in a very creative environment and were exposed to the arts at a very young age, so it's not a surprise that all of us are in some form of the arts.
495.name: Spike Lee

496.quote: I want to be part of the resurgence of things that are tangible, beautiful and soulful, rather than just give in to the digital age. But when I talk to people about this they just say, 'Yeah, I know what you mean,' and stare at their mobiles.
496.name: Jack White

497.quote: I wanted to do two things when I was growing up, about your age. I wanted to play in the NBA, and I wanted to be a businessman after my basketball career was over, and that is what I am doing now.
497.name: Magic Johnson

498.quote: The idea of regretting not doing this seemed insane to me. Sitting in the corner at a bar at age 60, saying: 'I could've been Bond. Buy me a drink.' That's the saddest place I could be. At least now at 60 I can say: 'I was Bond. Now buy me a drink.'
498.name: Daniel Craig

499.quote: There's a vintage which comes with age and experience.
499.name: Jon Bon Jovi

500.quote: It's not the normal way to look at things but I experienced death at a really young age and because of that it's been part of my mental landscape that death is really very possible.
500.name: Cate Blanchett

501.quote: I've an enormous respect for my mother who at the age of 39 raised three children, and I grew up with my grandmother in the household. And so it was a really strong household of women - my poor brother! It was great growing up with so many generations of women.
501.name: Cate Blanchett
