502.quote: Every age develops its own peculiar forms of pathology, which express in exaggerated form its underlying character structure.
502.name: Christopher Lasch

503.quote: I love my kids, and the moments I have with them, and it's kind of weird, it's such an age old cliche, but the way that my sons, the way they make me feel when I look at them, the way they say things, no one else would probably react to them, but it's a special thing for me.
503.name: Michael Rapaport

504.quote: There's a very small group of elite actresses who are my age, who people want to work with. It's not easy to get a good job with good actors.
504.name: Amanda Peet

505.quote: A final word: I am not knowledgeable about the internet. I do not have a computer. I guess that at 74 years of age, I don't have the patience to learn.
505.name: David Wilkerson

506.quote: It lies in human nature that where you experience your first laughs, you also remember the age kindly.
506.name: Vaclav Havel

507.quote: We tried not to age, but time had its rage.
507.name: Patti Smith

508.quote: Michelle Pfeiffer hasn't been finding a lot of work recently because she doesn't like what a woman her age is offered. That's a real double standard. You get Sean Connery, who gets older and older, still playing opposite young ladies, but it doesn't work the other way around.
508.name: Denzel Washington

509.quote: Old age and treachery will always beat youth and exuberance.
509.name: David Mamet

510.quote: My wife and I, unlike many intellectuals, spent five years working on assembly lines. We came to fully understand the criticisms of the industrial age, in which you are an appendage of a machine that sets the pace.
510.name: Alvin Toffler

511.quote: Even one voice can be heard loudly all over the world in this day and age.
511.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

512.quote: At this age, I should be leading a quiet life.
512.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

513.quote: Any new financial order for the world must tackle the three chief challenges of our age.
513.name: James Buchan

514.quote: There are signs that the age of petroleum has passed its zenith. Adjusted for inflation, a barrel of crude oil now sells for three times its long-run average. The large western oil companies, which cartellised the industry for much of the 20th century, are now selling more oil than they find, and are thus in the throes of liquidation.
514.name: James Buchan

515.quote: With the song 'This Christmas' I wanted to do something that was kind of different. I mean, Donny Hathaway is an amazing artist. So I wanted to bring my flavor to the song so when people over the age of 45 or 50 hear it they'll be like 'OK, he did his thing with that record.' It's like I can appeal to everybody and not just a younger demographic.
515.name: Chris Brown

516.quote: In an age when the fashion is to be in love with yourself, confessing to be in love with somebody else is an admission of unfaithfulness to one's beloved.
516.name: Russell Baker

517.quote: Rereading A.J. Liebling carries me happily back to an age when all good journalists knew they had plenty to be modest about, and were.
517.name: Russell Baker

518.quote: Reason is a crutch for age, but youth is strong enough to walk alone.
518.name: John Dryden

519.quote: What's a man's age? He must hurry more, that's all Cram in a day, what his youth took a year to hold.
519.name: Robert Browning

520.quote: What Youth deemed crystal, Age finds out was dew.
520.name: Robert Browning

521.quote: A face to lose youth for, to occupy age With the dream of, meet death with.
521.name: Robert Browning

522.quote: I believe the true function of age is memory. I'm recording as fast as I can.
522.name: Rita Mae Brown

523.quote: So Harry Potter came in and it is nice that I have kids of the right age. I took them to London and they walked around the set and met Harry Potter and that is thrilling.
523.name: Gary Oldman

524.quote: All we can do when we think of kids today is think of more hours of school, earlier age at the computer, and curfews. Who would want to grow up in that world?
524.name: James Hillman

525.quote: The reason for the sadness of this modern age and the men who live in it is that it looks for the truth in everything and finds it.
525.name: Edmond de Goncourt

526.quote: No, but way before that, I've been doing little dances in movies for years. Yeah, that was an amazing chance. You know, at my age to be able to do a music dance video, very unusual.
526.name: Christopher Walken

527.quote: There probably aren't a lot of actors my age who tap dance.
527.name: Christopher Walken

528.quote: I started auditioning when I was about 10 and I didn't get my first job until I was 12, and two years at that age is really hard.
528.name: Anna Kendrick

529.quote: I remember being in Hollywood at the age of 16 and marveling at the stars. The idea of being part of it never entered my mind. It was too far-fetched.
529.name: Bryan Adams

530.quote: The older generation had greater respect for land than science. But we live in an age when science, more than soil, has become the provider of growth and abundance. Living just on the land creates loneliness in an age of globality.
530.name: Shimon Peres

531.quote: One of my grandfathers, actually, having gone out there as a minister, decided he would better serve the people as a doctor. So at a very late age - at the age of 38 in fact - he changed course and decided to become a doctor.
531.name: Colin Firth

532.quote: I'm totally into new age and self-help books. I used to work in a bookstore and that's the section they gave me, and I got way into it. I just loved the power of positive thinking, letting yourself go.
532.name: Jason Mraz

533.quote: It's the kind of clothes that mothers and daughters can wear, in terms of concept, It's not about age. It's about taste, and it's about lifestyle. I believe women of all ages can wear anything.
533.name: Ralph Lauren

534.quote: The reason for the slow progress of the world seems to lie in a single fact. Every man is born under the yoke, and grows up beneath the oppressions of his age.
534.name: John Jay Chapman

535.quote: A newspaper is lumber made malleable. It is ink made into words and pictures. It is conceived, born, grows up and dies of old age in a day.
535.name: Jim Bishop

536.quote: Just as we reject racism, sexism, ageism, and heterosexism, we reject speciesism. The species of a sentient being is no more reason to deny the protection of this basic right than race, sex, age, or sexual orientation is a reason to deny membership in the human moral community to other humans.
536.name: Gary L. Francione

537.quote: I am a grandmother now, and that means age is creeping on, creeping on.
537.name: Lillie Langtry

538.quote: I love things that age well - things that don't date, that stand the test of time and that become living examples of the absolute best.
538.name: Giorgio Armani

539.quote: Many women my age have known the experience of giving up crucial parts of themselves to please the man they love.
539.name: Joyce Maynard

540.quote: American Idol transcends age, gender, ethnicity, everything.
540.name: Carrie Underwood

541.quote: You get to a certain age and you can't judge yourself on your dad or your parents.
541.name: Ellie Goulding

542.quote: I'd like to look like Madonna when I'm her age. I also look at athletes and love their bodies. I've always wanted to be muscly, not skinny. A lot of women yo-yo around, but I'm always aware if I'm getting a bit out of shape. I never look at the scales but I can just tell. It goes on my tum and bum.
542.name: Ellie Goulding

543.quote: I could always sing, from a really young age, but my voice was really weird. I used to make my mum turn up the radio every day in our house. She was well into music so I got that from her.
543.name: Ellie Goulding

544.quote: I think women get caught up too much in having a plan - 'I'm going to get married at this age I'm going to have a kid at this age' - and then they just try to find a guy who will fit into that picture. I don't want my life to be based on that.
544.name: Julia Stiles

545.quote: I was always concerned with writing to my age at a particular moment. That was the way I would keep faith with the audience that supported me as I went along.
545.name: Bruce Springsteen

546.quote: Experts tell us that 90% of all brain development occurs by the age of five. If we don't begin thinking about education in the early years, our children are at risk of falling behind by the time they start Kindergarten.
546.name: Robert. L. Ehrlich

547.quote: When I was seventeen, I worked as a counsellor at a co-ed sleep-away camp for eight weeks. I loved it but it could be harrowing - it was far too much responsibility for someone my age.
547.name: Harlan Coben

548.quote: Music has always been my protection against the world, from a very young age. I feel safe inside of a jam.
548.name: Trey Anastasio

549.quote: We are the children of a technological age. We have found streamlined ways of doing much of our routine work. Printing is no longer the only way of reproducing books. Reading them, however, has not changed.
549.name: Lawrence Clark Powell

550.quote: Religion is the best antidote to the individualism of the consumer age. The idea that society can do without it flies in the face of history and, now, evolutionary biology.
550.name: Jonathan Sacks

551.quote: Religiosity turns out to be the best indicator of civic involvement: it's more accurate than education, age, income, gender or race.
551.name: Jonathan Sacks

552.quote: The year I was born, 1956, was the peak year for babies being born, and there are more people essentially our age than anybody else. We could crush these new generations if we decided too.
552.name: Tom Hanks

553.quote: Adulthood is the ever-shrinking period between childhood and old age. It is the apparent aim of modern industrial societies to reduce this period to a minimum.
553.name: Thomas Szasz

554.quote: I was born at the age of twelve on a Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer lot.
554.name: Edward Koch

555.quote: We live in an age of instant knowledge. And there's almost a sense of entitlement to that.
555.name: J. J. Abrams

556.quote: It's the golden age of French cinema again but it's because Sarkozy had the guts to push through copyright law.
556.name: Harvey Weinstein

557.quote: I started in the restaurant business at the age of 19 as a waitress. I loved the atmosphere and the camaraderie of the restaurant business. I loved not having to go to an office. I loved making people happy.
557.name: Anne Burrell

558.quote: My view is pensioners don't have the one option that people of working age have. They can't really increase their income, because they are no longer able to work.
558.name: Iain Duncan Smith

559.quote: Work is transformative. It gives you a greater chance of a greater income. You can affect your life while you're of working age, so you have scope and opportunity. Pensioners do not.
559.name: Iain Duncan Smith

560.quote: I think you can't really escape any kind of spiritual education as a child, whether it's New Age or Judaism or Buddhism or whatever it is. You can't escape it, even if you completely disagree with it, you still have it as a foundation that you base things off of.
560.name: Jack White

561.quote: At my age the only problem is with remembering names. When I call everyone darling, it has damn all to do with passionately adoring them, but I know I'm safe calling them that. Although, of course, I adore them too.
561.name: Richard Attenborough

562.quote: What I really tried to do with Helen was make her show this sad side of her. She was married off at 16, was so young and living in this castle that can't leave because of how she looks, and married to a man she hates and three times her age.
562.name: Diane Kruger

563.quote: I never took guitar lessons. I took classical piano lessons from the age of six when we lived in Holland. And when we moved to America, it was just the typical thing except I was really good at it so was my brother.
563.name: Eddie Van Halen

564.quote: I never took guitar lessons. I took classical piano lessons from the age of six when we lived in Holland.
564.name: Eddie Van Halen

565.quote: When I write about a 15-year old, I jump, I return to the days when I was that age. It's like a time machine. I can remember everything. I can feel the wind. I can smell the air. Very actually. Very vividly.
565.name: Haruki Murakami

566.quote: We live in an age, in an era where there is so much negativity, there is so much violence in the world, there is so much unrest and people are at war, that I wanted to promote the word love and red signifies love.
566.name: Elton John

567.quote: I'm 20 years old. I like to party as much as anyone my age. Going clubbing is my way of relaxing or releasing a lot of stress. I don't feel that I should have to justify that part of my life. I don't know that I'm necessarily an addict.
567.name: Lindsay Lohan

568.quote: I am happy being able to play roles with people my age because once you do something really mature there is no turning back.
568.name: Lindsay Lohan

569.quote: Compared to a lot of actresses my age, I'm actually overweight.
569.name: Lindsay Lohan

570.quote: This is what I asked for, and in this day and age that's what actually goes on. But what hurts me the most is that I work just as hard as any other actress around my age, like Scarlett Johansson, but I just don't get the opportunities that they get because people are so distracted by the mess that I created in my life.
570.name: Lindsay Lohan

571.quote: At a young age, I was interested in comic books, which was really how I learnt to read. The name Cage came from a comic book character called Power Man.
571.name: Nicolas Cage

572.quote: There is a certain age at which a child looks at you in all earnestness and delivers a long, pleased speech in all the true inflections of spoken English, but with not one recognizable syllable.
572.name: Annie Dillard

573.quote: I can't wait to be that age and hanging out with a bunch of people hanging out all day playing golf and going to the beach, all my own age. We'd be laughing and having a good time and getting loopy on our prescription drugs. Driving golf carts around. I can't wait.
573.name: Cameron Diaz

574.quote: I would love a family. I'm at the age where the wish for a child gets stronger. But who knows.
574.name: Cameron Diaz

575.quote: I love physical kinds of comedy and getting down and dirty and doing stunts. When I was growing up, I was always getting into fights with guys and usually punching out boys my age because I was a lot bigger and tougher. So I'm naturally accustomed to putting myself into the headspace of a girl who can take care of herself.
575.name: Cameron Diaz

576.quote: Love, with very young people, is a heartless business. We drink at that age from thirst, or to get drunk it is only later in life that we occupy ourselves with the individuality of our wine.
576.name: Isak Dinesen

577.quote: Age for me is just a number.
577.name: Haile Gebrselassie

578.quote: You hit a certain age and - especially because of TV - the young cooks coming up say, 'You're a sellout, because you're doing something other than what you should be doing.' 'Top Chef' is a double-edged sword for me: There's a whole group of people who will not come to the restaurants because they assume I'm not in them anymore, all I do is TV.
578.name: Tom Colicchio

579.quote: Some of your teachers are actually closer in age to you than you think.
579.name: Maya Lin

580.quote: From an early age I didn't buy into the value systems of working hard in a nine-to-five job. I thought creativity, friendship and loyalty and pushing the boundaries of what was acceptable was much more interesting.
580.name: Adam Clayton

581.quote: I didn't have any success in show business until I was 30 to 31 years of age.
581.name: Adam Carolla

582.quote: I hate the idea that you shouldn't wear something just because you're a certain age.
582.name: Miuccia Prada

583.quote: I am firmly of the opinion that women who make a lot of effort to hang onto their looks in middle age (unless they are beauties, entertainers or prostitutes) are rather sad, as one should surely have something more substantial to recommend one by this time, such as kindness or cleverness.
583.name: Julie Burchill

584.quote: As a precocious teen I dreamed of being Graham Greene. Well, as it turned out, I never wrote a great novel, sadly, and I never converted to Catholicism, happily, but I did do one thing he did. That is, in middle age I moved to a seaside town and got into a right barney with the local powers-that-be.
584.name: Julie Burchill

585.quote: Age should not have its face lifted, but it should rather teach the world to admire wrinkles as the etchings of experience and the firm line of character.
585.name: Clarence Day

586.quote: Age is only a number, a cipher for the records. A man can't retire his experience. He must use it. Experience achieves more with less energy and time.
586.name: Bernard Baruch

587.quote: To me, old age is always fifteen years older than I am.
587.name: Bernard Baruch

588.quote: I wear clothes that most people in the Midwest would probably deem inappropriate at my age. And I rock a bikini all summer long. I know that it's not normal, but I just don't care. I live once.
588.name: Liz Phair

589.quote: I've lost touch with a lot of that boutique-type music just because of my age, and raising my son and the multiple jobs I have at this point.
589.name: Liz Phair

590.quote: There's no way to approach anything in an objective way. We're completely subjective our view of the world is completely controlled by who we are as human beings, as men or women, by our age, our history, our profession, by the state of the world.
590.name: Charlie Kaufman

591.quote: Age is not measured by years. Nature does not equally distribute energy. Some people are born old and tired while others are going strong at seventy.
591.name: Dorothy Thompson

592.quote: Maybe it is something to do with age, but I have become fonder of poetry than of prose.
592.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

593.quote: When I was younger, my whole sense of self-worth was based on whether or not I was working, which was awful. And I had a baby at 20 years old, so it wasn't just about me. At around the age of 30 there was a stretch where I wasn't working - certainly not on anything I liked, anyway - and I started to do other things.
593.name: Kiefer Sutherland

594.quote: I grew up on the golden age of children's TV.
594.name: Edward Norton

595.quote: I do wish I could tell you my age but it's impossible. It keeps changing all the time.
595.name: Greer Garson

596.quote: Pretend to be dumb, that's the only way to reach old age.
596.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

597.quote: The excitement of learning separates youth from old age. As long as you're learning you're not old.
597.name: Rosalyn S. Yalow

598.quote: The history of my life must begin by the earliest circumstance which my memory can evoke it will therefore commence when I had attained the age of eight years and four months.
598.name: Giacomo Casanova

599.quote: We are in an electronic technology age now and it's about time we put away the old stuff.
599.name: Monica Edwards

600.quote: At the age of 20 I bought a used Fiat 127. This was the only one I could afford!
600.name: Carlos Ghosn

601.quote: At my age, I don't think anyone is untouched by cancer.
601.name: Bryan Cranston

602.quote: We try, we fail, we posture, we aspire, we pontificate - and then we age, shrink, die, and vanish.
602.name: George Saunders

603.quote: My habit would have been to veer towards the dark - to prove I was something edgy, or maybe to prove that I was cognisant of the dark side. Now, with age and confidence, I can say, yeah, that's true, but I am cognisant of the fact that people can do things well. And can be more loving than you expect.
603.name: George Saunders

604.quote: It is not possible to live in this age if you don't have a sense of many contradictory forces.
604.name: Rem Koolhaas

605.quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.
605.name: Zoe Saldana

606.quote: You need some insecurity if you're an actor. It keeps the pot boiling. I haven't yet started to think about retiring. I was shocked when I heard about Paul Newman retiring at age 82. Most actors just fade away like old soldiers.
606.name: Al Pacino

607.quote: It's hard for women at my age in Hollywood, but I'm not discouraged.
607.name: Jane Fonda

608.quote: We're still living with the old paradigm of age as an arch. That's the old metaphor: You're born, you peak at midlife and decline into decrepitude.
608.name: Jane Fonda

609.quote: We can no longer waste time and money. Every day, more than 2,000 girls in America, age 15-19, give birth - in the wealthiest, most educated nation in the world! Neither you nor I should accept this statistic.
609.name: Jane Fonda

610.quote: The reality is sobering: in the United States one in three girls will become pregnant before age 20, totaling more than 750,000 girls per year.
610.name: Jane Fonda

611.quote: I am hoping for peaceful transition into a new age. Obama has already played a great role in initiating us into that vision. If he were to be harmed in any way, it would spawn the birth of a million Obamas.
611.name: Saul Williams

612.quote: I definitely don't look my age. So I actively look for roles that will help people change their perception of me.
612.name: Elijah Wood

613.quote: The age thing really bugs me. Do people have more of a right to not like what I say because I'm 19?
613.name: Fiona Apple

614.quote: There are a lot of downsides to being male. We age faster and die younger. But give us this: we're lifetime baby-making machines. Women's reproductive abilities start to wane when they're as young as 35. Men? We're good to go pretty much till we're dead.
614.name: Jeffrey Kluger

615.quote: Older fatherhood isn't all bad: testosterone rates drop about 1% per year as men age, making them less reactive and more patient, and a professionally established middle-aged man is likely to have more time and money to devote to his kids than a twenty-something who's just getting started.
615.name: Jeffrey Kluger

616.quote: Credit or debit cards, for starters, are nothing short of shoppers' Novocain. Even in the age of digital purchases and virtual money, we still attach a special value to dirty paper with pictures of presidents on it. Handing some of that to a cashier simply hurts more than handing over a little sliver of plastic.
616.name: Jeffrey Kluger

617.quote: When it comes to raising civilized kids there are no hard rules, but there are two things on which most parents agree: Boys are generally wilder than girls, and adolescents are wilder than kids of any other age. If you've got an adolescent boy, you're in the sweet spot for trouble.
617.name: Jeffrey Kluger

618.quote: It seems to me there is a change in what audiences want to see. I can only hope that's correct, because there's an awful lot of people of my age around now and we outnumber the others.
618.name: Maggie Smith

619.quote: A truly great book should be read in youth, again in maturity and once more in old age, as a fine building should be seen by morning light, at noon and by moonlight.
619.name: Robertson Davies

620.quote: In Hollywood, you play a mom, and the next thing you know, you're on 'The Golden Girls.' They age you so fast.
620.name: Gabrielle Union

621.quote: A great age of literature is perhaps always a great age of translations.
621.name: Ezra Pound

622.quote: I can't get my knickers in a twist about my age and ageing in an industry that caters to the ids of 14-year-olds.
622.name: Vera Farmiga

623.quote: I was living on the wrong side of the tracks in Evanston, Illinois, in a home for boys. We had these Jackson 5 records. I really related to their voices - they were about my age, but they were doing it.
623.name: Eddie Vedder

624.quote: By age seven, I used to comb my hair for performances, just pull my hair up into a bun. Granted, it wasn't a very intricate hairstyle. Still, to be that responsible and disciplined at age seven is unusual.
624.name: Janet Jackson

625.quote: It begins and ends with money. It's absurd in this day and age when we need so much money for education, health, for people, that a $100 million dollars can be spent on a film. It's obscene.
625.name: Kathleen Turner

626.quote: I am at that age when you panic at the slightest thing.
626.name: Rupert Everett

627.quote: Being gay and being a woman has one big thing in common, which is that we both become invisible after the age of 42. Who wants a gay 50-year-old? No one, let me tell you.
627.name: Rupert Everett

628.quote: I began to speak well at a very advanced age - 15, 16, 17 years old. It was psychological: the trauma of war, my family and growing up on my own. I was more or less a street kid.
628.name: Roberto Cavalli

629.quote: We Jews have a special attachment to the Book. The study of page after page in tomes yellowing with age was obligatory.
629.name: Theodore Bikel

630.quote: Having come to live in this age is as though one were to have entered another country. Learn its language or risk being left out.
630.name: Theodore Bikel

631.quote: I don't want to look at other people my age in leather. Why would I put it on?
631.name: George Michael

632.quote: I believe that the fight against crime starts in the home. Parents must take responsibility for their children and show them love and guidance from an early age so they learn to respect the rights of others.
632.name: Blanche Lincoln

633.quote: At an early age, I started my own paper route. Once I saw how you could service people and do a good job and get paid for it, I just wanted to be the best I could be in whatever I did.
633.name: Puff Daddy

634.quote: Middle age: when you begin to exchange your emotions for symptoms.
634.name: Irvin S. Cobb

635.quote: Brain power improves by brain use, just as our bodily strength grows with exercise. And there is no doubt that a large proportion of the female population, from school days to late middle age, now have very complicated lives indeed.
635.name: A. N. Wilson

636.quote: I began to understand my sensations, to know what I wanted, at around the age of forty - but only vaguely.
636.name: Camille Pissarro

637.quote: I grew up on a farm in a small town where you do or say one thing and everybody knows about it. You see it happen, there's always the town gossip - 'Oh did you hear about so and so, or did you hear what went on in this household?' So I learned at a very young age just to keep my mouth shut.
637.name: Garrett Hedlund

638.quote: If you love somebody, you love them. My parents had a 25-year age gap between them and my mum was the breadwinner, my dad the house husband. I'm a strong believer that a good relationship can work, whatever the situation.
638.name: Katherine Jenkins

639.quote: The Border Ballads, for instance, and the Robin Hood Ballads, clearly suppose a state of society which is nothing but a very circumscribed and not very important heroic age.
639.name: Lascelles Abercrombie

640.quote: By the age of 9 or 10, I knew that I had to cut my own cloth and make my own way.
640.name: John le Carre

641.quote: When you're my age and you see a story, you better go for it pretty quickly. I'd just like to get a few more novels under my belt.
641.name: John le Carre

642.quote: Catholics and evangelicals need to remain allied, and in solidarity, against the increasingly aggressive secularism of our age.
642.name: Gary Bauer

643.quote: I don't know whether it's age or maturity, but I certainly find myself committed more and more to the looser forms of Western democracy at any price.
643.name: John le Carre

644.quote: Losing both parents at a young age gave me a sense that you can't really control life - so you'd better live it while it's here. I stopped believing in a storybook existence a long time ago. All you can do is push in a direction and see what comes of it.
644.name: Jon Hamm

645.quote: Old age is not a disease - it is strength and survivorship, triumph over all kinds of vicissitudes and disappointments, trials and illnesses.
645.name: Maggie Kuhn

646.quote: I was a very sickly kid. While I was in the hospital at age 7, my Dad brought me a stack of comic books to keep me occupied. I was hooked.
646.name: Len Wein

647.quote: Study until twenty-five, investigation until forty, profession until sixty, at which age I would have him retired on a double allowance.
647.name: Thomas Moore

648.quote: In the digital age of 'overnight' success stories such as Facebook, the hard slog is easily overlooked.
648.name: James Dyson

649.quote: The greatest writers of this age, are aware of the mystery of our existence.
649.name: J. B. Priestley

650.quote: The chief role of the universities is to prolong adolescence into middle age, at which point early retirement ensures that we lack the means or the will to enforce significant change.
650.name: J. G. Ballard

651.quote: My grandparents got married at a very young age, and a lot of what I think about marriage is based on their relationship. I watched them over the years and saw how they dealt with everything together, as a team.
651.name: Kyle Chandler

652.quote: My grandparents got married at a very young age, and a lot of what I think about marriage is based on their relationship.
652.name: Kyle Chandler

653.quote: At my age it is unseemly to be pessimistic.
653.name: Naguib Mahfouz

654.quote: I don't know why people are so obsessed with age anyway. I mean, 90 is the new 70 70 is the new 50 and 50 is the new 40 so the whole act-your-age thing? Only up to a point.
654.name: Joan Collins

655.quote: I don't look my age, I don't feel my age and I don't act my age. To me age is just a number.
655.name: Joan Collins

656.quote: I believe that parents need to make nutrition education a priority in their home environment. It's crucial for good health and longevity to instill in your children sound eating habits from an early age.
656.name: Cat Cora

657.quote: Most poetry in the modern age has retreated to the private sphere, turning its back on the political realm.
657.name: Terry Eagleton

658.quote: We incorporated new tastes and flavors into our kids' diets from a very early age, which helped to develop their palates and prevented them from becoming picky eaters. We don't buy junk food and give them options of fresh fruit, yogurt, raw almonds, or dried whole grain cereals for snack time.
658.name: Cat Cora

659.quote: Filth and old age, I'm sure you will agree, are powerful wardens upon chastity.
659.name: Geoffrey Chaucer

660.quote: It has been claimed at times that our modern age of technology facilitates dictatorship.
660.name: Henry A. Wallace

661.quote: Working on the 'Ice Age' movies, I'm really proud to be in them.
661.name: Seann William Scott

662.quote: No Congress ever has seen fit to amend the Constitution to address any issue related to marriage. No Constitutional Amendment was needed to ban polygamy or bigamy, nor was a Constitutional Amendment needed to set a uniform age of majority to ban child marriages.
662.name: Judy Biggert

663.quote: We're taught at such a young age that you can always be better and that you're never perfect and that you're never good enough.
663.name: Shawn Johnson

664.quote: The young people have MTV and rock and roll. Why would they go to read poetry? Poetry belongs to the Stone Age. It awakens in us perceptions that go back to those times.
664.name: Robert Morgan

665.quote: Study is the bane of childhood, the oil of youth, the indulgence of adulthood, and a restorative in old age.
665.name: Walter Savage Landor

666.quote: Because of my age and because there's more work on the small screen. What it's missing in quality it makes up for in quantity. From an actor's selfish point of view.
666.name: Cesar Romero

667.quote: Old age is an insult. It's like being smacked.
667.name: Lawrence Durrell

668.quote: Age puzzles me. I thought it was a quiet time. My seventies were interesting and fairly serene, but my eighties are passionate. I grow more intense as I age.
668.name: Florida Scott-Maxwell

669.quote: One of the great challenges of our age, in which the tools of our productivity are also the tools of our leisure, is to figure out how to make more useful those moments of procrastination when we're idling in front of our computer screens.
669.name: Joshua Foer

670.quote: I happen to be interested in watching a face age. I like faces of women aging so it makes me personally quite sad. That's a beautiful gift from God. If people don't want to see that anymore then I won't be in anymore movies.
670.name: Debra Winger

671.quote: Never say never, but the thought of electively cutting oneself is beyond my grasp, and I also object to it politically. Denying the lines on our faces makes a comment about age and wisdom I don't care to make.
671.name: Debra Winger

672.quote: People pay to see movies with women looking beautiful, but I think there will be a place for me to play women looking my own age.
672.name: Debra Winger

673.quote: There's a small club of women who are willing to age.
673.name: Debra Winger

674.quote: I hope to find the roles that are age appropriate but not yearning to be younger, or parenting ad nauseam.
674.name: Debra Winger

675.quote: I try to write lyrics so that they won't age, which sort of leaves you with the big subjects like death and love and sex and violence.
675.name: Florence Welch

676.quote: In the modern media age we are rarely surprised by what we see. Whether it's on television or film or in the theatre, everything is so advertised, so trailed, that most entertainment is merely what you thought it was going to be like.
676.name: Rowan Atkinson

677.quote: Your 40s are a major trough. About the age of 50, feelings of satisfaction begin to rebound and keep rising into your 50s, 60s and 70s, with health being a major factor.
677.name: Jane Pauley

678.quote: I came back to work when my children were two months old. At that early age, they seem to have little awareness of anybody but their Raggedy Ann dolls, so it wasn't a matter of them missing me. I was missing them.
678.name: Jane Pauley

679.quote: Being successful at a very young age gave me the confidence and the capability to try out other things.
679.name: Joshua Lederberg

680.quote: About the time I turned 50, I experienced the profound biological change that often accompanies women at that age. Also, I put two kids in college and lost both of my parents, so I'm no longer somebody's daughter.
680.name: Jane Pauley

681.quote: I feel more mature than most people my age.
681.name: Leighton Meester

682.quote: Age does not bring you wisdom, age brings you wrinkles.
682.name: Estelle Getty

683.quote: Maybe I'll be a feminist in my old age.
683.name: Bjork

684.quote: I feel the 21st century is another new age. Not only can we collaborate again with nature, but we have to. It's an emergency.
684.name: Bjork

685.quote: You can fake your age or mask it, but the passion that moves the characters has to be real.
685.name: Victoria Abril

686.quote: I think that clearly it has an influence, to be coming of age during the punk rock era, to come from a difficult and sporadically violent background, to have been in and out of such chaos, I think it actually helps. But I don't know for sure.
686.name: Craig Ferguson

687.quote: I'd date someone younger or older age doesn't matter to me. Or looks, really - it's all about maturity.
687.name: Leona Lewis

688.quote: Try to keep your soul young and quivering right up to old age.
688.name: George Sand

689.quote: I wanted to be a forest ranger or a coal man. At a very early age, I knew I didn't want to do what my dad did, which was work in an office.
689.name: Harrison Ford

690.quote: Parenting is an impossible job at any age.
690.name: Harrison Ford

691.quote: Sally Field looks amazing in general, never mind her age! She's a phenomenally talented actress and has had a career spanning so many decades.
691.name: Alison Sweeney

692.quote: I've had two romances since moving to Las Vegas. One was with somebody 12 years older than me, and the other was the same age, and neither worked out. I know people still think of me as one of Hugh Hefner's girlfriends, and he of course was much older than me, but that was a whole different lifestyle and a different kind of dating.
692.name: Holly Madison

693.quote: From age 16, I lived and breathed wine. I read every magazine and book about wine.
693.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

694.quote: IQ is a commodity, data is a commodity. I'm far more interested in watching people interact at a restaurant with their smartphone. We can all read 'Tech Crunch,' 'Ad Age.' I would rather be living in the trenches. I would rather be going to Whole Foods in Columbus Circle to watch people shop with their smartphones.
694.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

695.quote: Genius worship is the inevitable sign of an uncreative age.
695.name: Clive Bell

696.quote: I appreciate and enjoy my age.
696.name: Nikki Giovanni

697.quote: I've been going through photos of my mother, looking back on her life and trying to put it into context. Very few people age gracefully enough to be photographed through their aging.
697.name: Jamie Lee Curtis

698.quote: I am rediscovering the whole sexual dimension of life at the age of 86, really. And that also means discovering the feminine. So the whole of this dimension, which I had been seeking for a very long time, is now sort of opening itself up to me.
698.name: Bede Griffiths

699.quote: I think all writers of my age who are brought up on films probably by the age of 16 have seen many more films than they have read classics of literature. We can't help but be influenced by film. Film has got some great tricks that it's taught writers.
699.name: David Mitchell

700.quote: Some broad themes brought me where I am today. At a very young age, my hobby became thinking and finding connections.
700.name: Dean Kamen

701.quote: I think you have to be a little bit strict. You can't be friend and their parent in a lot of situations, especially in this day and age where it's so dangerous for kids. So there's a bit of sternness, I guess, in the way I raise my kids.
701.name: Tim McGraw

702.quote: In the 1970s and 1980s there was so little decent fiction for young people, but we're now in a golden age that shows no sign of fading. Philip Pullman, J. K. Rowling, Lemony Snicket are only three of the best known among a good number of equals.
702.name: David Mitchell

703.quote: I want to sell to people my own age, because that's the way I write songs.
703.name: John Mellencamp

704.quote: You get to a certain age and you just want to prove that you can still rock - that you've still got it.
704.name: Jarvis Cocker

705.quote: I always thought that I might retire from any form of sexuality by the age of 40 and just become a dignified older person.
705.name: Jarvis Cocker

706.quote: It's only at this age that I can say the word 'art' without flinching.
706.name: Mira Nair

707.quote: Well, once you've resigned yourself to the fact that you are the more mature pop performer and you're past the age you ever thought you would do it, you might as well do it as long as you can. As long as I can still lift a microphone, then I'll do it, you know.
707.name: Jarvis Cocker

708.quote: I hope to have one more boxing match at the age of 55. Given that demographic at the age of 55 to 65, you've got to make a statement with your life. Otherwise, you are just existing.
708.name: George Foreman

709.quote: I think it's hard, the fact that there's a certain age that we can't have kids anymore.
709.name: Courteney Cox

710.quote: While I had often said that I wanted to die in bed, what I really meant was that in my old age I wanted to be stepped on by an elephant while making love.
710.name: Roger Zelazny

711.quote: I basically started playing violin at the age of six. That lasted about three years because my previous teacher died and the second teacher didn't really know how to successfully get me going.
711.name: Miroslav Vitous

712.quote: Age acquires no value save through thought and discipline.
712.name: James Truslow Adams

713.quote: I've had to be a man since I was 12 or 13. I had a job. And I was playing the piano for people twice my age. Handling responsibility is what makes a man a man.
713.name: Jamie Foxx

714.quote: Old age isn't so bad when you consider the alternative.
714.name: Maurice Chevalier

715.quote: Up until age 40, most men are just not as mature as women. So, it makes sense that a lot of women date up in age a bit.
715.name: Patti Stanger

716.quote: Think back to yourself at age 18. I know I was mighty different than the Patti I am today. As we grow up, we grow out of our haircuts, our apartments and - often times - our romantic decisions.
716.name: Patti Stanger

717.quote: I was well motivated. What I wanted to do was work for myself. I had twenty two jobs before I started my business at the age of twenty three and I didn't want one more boss telling me what to do. So I was motivated simply because I didn't want a boss.
717.name: Barbara Corcoran

718.quote: Regardless of age, regardless of position, regardless of the business we happen to be in, all of us need to understand the importance of branding. We are CEOs of our own companies: Me, Inc. To be in business today, our most important job is to be head marketer for the brand called You.
718.name: Tom Peters

719.quote: An age which is incapable of poetry is incapable of any kind of literature except the cleverness of a decadence.
719.name: Raymond Chandler

720.quote: I've always felt that sexuality is a really slippery thing. In this day and age, it tends to get categorized and labeled, and I think labels are for food. Canned food.
720.name: Michael Stipe

721.quote: There must be a law against forcing children to perform at an early age. Children should have a wonderful childhood. They should not be given too much responsibility.
721.name: Maria Callas

722.quote: Each age tries to form its own conception of the past. Each age writes the history of the past anew with reference to the conditions uppermost in its own time.
722.name: Frederick Jackson Turner

723.quote: People quit on jobs. They quit on marriages. They quit on school. There's an immediacy of this day and age that doesn't lend itself to being committed to anything.
723.name: Emily Blunt

724.quote: I nearly died of double bronchial pneumonia at the age of five.
724.name: Roger Moore

725.quote: The wonderful thing about age is that your knees don't work as well, you can't run down steps quite as easily and obviously you can't lift heavy weights. But your mind doesn't feel any different.
725.name: Roger Moore

726.quote: In a secular age, an authentic miracle must purport to be a hoax, in order to gain credit in the world.
726.name: Angela Carter

727.quote: But I think it's a little different in Europe, because 40 is really the best age for a woman. That's when we hit our peak and become this ripe fruit.
727.name: Juliette Binoche

728.quote: My mother was 45 when she had me, so when I was in high school my parents were the same age as my friends' grandparents.
728.name: Jack White

729.quote: In the age of television, image becomes more important than substance.
729.name: S. I. Hayakawa

730.quote: Just call me a family man and an actor who digs his whole scene, side interests and all. Just say I feel mighty good at the ripe old age of 27.
730.name: Bobby Darin

731.quote: Maybe back in the day you didn't need to be the greatest looking to be on TV and you didn't need to speak the best, but in this day and age, I think you need to be the package. You need to look the part for your sponsors, you need to be able to speak the part for the media and to big CEOs.
731.name: Danica Patrick

732.quote: The culture of independent film criticism has totally gone down the drain and this seems to come with the territory of the consumer age that we are now living in.
732.name: Wim Wenders

733.quote: There are only three things that can kill a farmer: lightning, rolling over in a tractor, and old age.
733.name: Bill Bryson

734.quote: They say eyes clear with age.
734.name: Philip Larkin

735.quote: Growing up on stage, I was introduced to makeup at a young age and I will never forget the first time I tried on a L'Oreal Paris iconic lipstick - it was instant glamour and I've been hooked ever since.
735.name: Lea Michele

737.quote: Despite what anti-aging ads say, growing older can be better. I feel better in my skin, 100 percent. You have greater effects of gravity, but the better sense of yourself you have is something I wouldn't trade. Women who lie about their age - 'why?'
737.name: Demi Moore

738.quote: For the moment I prefer to be a beautiful woman of my age than try desperately to look 30.
738.name: Demi Moore

739.quote: It's a little silly to finally learn how to write at this age. But I long ago realized I was secretly sincere.
739.name: Annie Dillard

740.quote: It's not always possible to sit down and eat at home in this day and age of fast-paced living, but if you are going to eat out, do so as a family and support all the great local places in your areas. I'll still eat at the same diner I did as a kid with my parents.
740.name: Michael Symon

741.quote: I worked hard in gymnastics since the time I was six years old until I retired at 23 years of age.
741.name: Nadia Comaneci

742.quote: I did successfully kick tobacco at the age of 34. I smoked for like 20 years, from 14 to 34.
742.name: Larry Hagman

743.quote: India saw from the beginning, and, even in her ages of reason and her age of increasing ignorance, she never lost hold of the insight, that life cannot be rightly seen in the sole light, cannot be perfectly lived in the sole power of its externalities.
743.name: Sri Aurobindo

744.quote: Back in the 1960s, I saw Peter, Paul and Mary. I was at that age, about 14, and I was mesmerized.
744.name: Lucinda Williams

745.quote: For me from a pretty young age up until about 21 years old hallucinogenics had a huge place in my life.
745.name: Jon Fishman

746.quote: A sense of freedom is something that, happily, comes with age and life experience.
746.name: Diane Keaton

747.quote: Writers obviously have to bear witness to the harsh face of the age.
747.name: Alexander McCall Smith

748.quote: Stop living a day at a time and stop worrying about age.
748.name: Helen Reddy

749.quote: Young women from a very young age are taught that life will be easier if you can just turn on the charming smile and say very little and be complacent and docile and sweet.
749.name: Amber Heard

750.quote: I started writing when I had three kids under the age of 4. I used to write every ten minutes I got to sit in front of a computer. Now, when I have more time, I function the same way: if it's writing time, I write.
750.name: Jodi Picoult

751.quote: I'm never overawed by a situation and I think that's because I've always looked several years older than I am. So because people were treating me like I was 40 when I was 29, I've always felt in control of a situation. People used to say, when you're 32, you'll look 32. I'm still waiting for that moment, where my age catches up with my appearance.
751.name: Chris O'Dowd

752.quote: I am 54 and age is slowly writing itself on my face.
752.name: Arthur Smith

753.quote: I envy the sensibility in Europe, appreciating beauty in women as they age. I'm going to go that way. I might dye my gray hair for a bit, but beyond that the buck stops. I'm not having any work done.
753.name: Rachel Bilson

754.quote: It was Julie Burchill who decreed that, beyond a certain age, a man should not be seen in a leather jacket.
754.name: Arthur Smith

755.quote: As a result of the digital age and the decline of first-class mail, there is no question that the Postal Service must change and develop a new business model.
755.name: Bernie Sanders

756.quote: I've watched my peers get better with age and hoped that would happen with me.
756.name: Bonnie Raitt

757.quote: I never wanted to do TV. I just did what I was trained to do through the Special Forces, and I've been doing that from a very young age.
757.name: Bear Grylls

758.quote: Here's a proposal, offered only partly in jest: no resident of the United States, whether born here or abroad, should get to be a citizen until age 18, at which time each such resident has to take a test.
758.name: Eric Liu

759.quote: Second to agriculture, humbug is the biggest industry of our age.
759.name: Alfred Nobel

760.quote: When it comes down to it, it's about who you know, and who's a fan. It's about whether you're the right age, whether you're hot or not, whether the studio is into you or not.
760.name: Marlee Matlin

761.quote: Another principle is, the deepest affections of our hearts gather around some human form in which are incarnated the living thoughts and ideas of the passing age.
761.name: Matthew Simpson

762.quote: My acting career began at age three and my parents got me into it. I was in a McDonald's commercial.
762.name: Corey Feldman

763.quote: I think that age as a number is not nearly as important as health. You can be in poor health and be pretty miserable at 40 or 50. If you're in good health, you can enjoy things into your 80s.
763.name: Bob Barker

764.quote: I just yesterday returned from a trip where I photographed a woman with two children whom I photographed first when she was the age of the older of the two children.
764.name: Jock Sturges

765.quote: You live in a deranged age, more deranged that usual, because in spite of great scientific and technological advances, man has not the faintest idea of who he is or what he is doing.
765.name: Walker Percy

766.quote: To write a story about New York that only deals with people in your age and socioeconomic bracket, that feels dishonest to me. So much of New York comes from everyone bumping into each other.
766.name: Josh Radnor

767.quote: My mother inspired me to treat others as I would want to be treated regardless of age, race or financial status.
767.name: Tommy Hilfiger

768.quote: And from the first time I picked up a basketball at age eight - I had a lot of difficulty when I first picked up a basketball, because I was a scrub - there were things that I liked about it.
768.name: Julius Erving

769.quote: Right up until the time I retired at age 37, I felt like there were still things that I could do better.
769.name: Julius Erving

770.quote: In 1981, at age 31, I was voted the best player in basketball, and the most valuable player in the league.
770.name: Julius Erving

771.quote: The great thing about arriving at this age is that I don't even care about my career anymore.
771.name: Ron Perlman

772.quote: Almost all of your life is lived by the seat of your pants, one unexpected event crashing into another, with no pattern or reason, and then you finally reach a point, around my age, where you spend more time than ever looking back. Why did this happen? Look where that led? You see the shape of things.
772.name: Ron Perlman

773.quote: I've always been intrigued by color and by interesting hair. I was one of those weird little girls doing my own hair at the age of 9. I was, like, getting weird gels and new brushes and cornrow holders. I would tweak and perm at the age of 13.
773.name: Nicki Minaj

774.quote: There are no college courses to build up self-esteem or high school or elementary school. If you don't get those values at a early age, nurtured in your home, you don't get them.
774.name: T. D. Jakes

775.quote: The freethinking of one age is the common sense of the next.
775.name: Matthew Arnold

776.quote: If children are not introduced to music at an early age, I believe something fundamental is actually being taken from them.
776.name: Luciano Pavarotti

777.quote: Middle age is when your broad mind and narrow waist begin to change places.
777.name: E. Joseph Cossman

778.quote: As an American, you have a right to good health care that is effective, accessible, and affordable, that serves you from infancy through old age, that allows you to go to practitioners and facilities of your choosing, and that offers a broad range of therapeutic options.
778.name: Andrew Weil

779.quote: Women would be disproportionately affected by the privatization of social security. It is one of the most important safety nets for American women in old age, or in times of disability, to insure financial income for their families.
779.name: Barbara Mikulski

780.quote: Low levels of vitamin D in the population as a whole suggest that most people need to take a vitamin D supplement. This may be especially true for seniors, as the ability to synthesize vitamin D in the skin declines with age.
780.name: Andrew Weil

781.quote: Part of the reason I sort of shot out like a cannon out of Michigan and left home at such an early age is because I had to feel independent.
781.name: Madonna Ciccone

782.quote: I think that everyone at any age should ask themselves, 'where do I want to be today, where do I want to be tomorrow, and where do I want to be in a hundred years?' We all have clear answers to those questions. We only have so much time. It's a real shame if we don't spend our lives trying to do that.
782.name: Jack Antonoff

783.quote: My parents got married late and they had kids late, so I never felt a social or cultural thing to be married or pregnant or a homeowner by a certain age.
783.name: Anna Kendrick

784.quote: I'm a pretty big dork. It's crazy. I'm one of those people who grew up with all kinds of musicals, but I was right at that age where 'Rent' was a big deal for me and for my friends.
784.name: Anna Kendrick

785.quote: My parents were really, really cool about supporting what I wanted to do at a really young age. I think I was about 10 when I caught the bug. They would drive me down to New York if there were auditions. When I was 12, I did this show on Broadway called 'High Society,' so we moved to New York for the run of that.
785.name: Anna Kendrick

786.quote: I was very sexual from a very young age.
786.name: Portia de Rossi

787.quote: It is a sobering thought that when Mozart was my age, he had been dead for two years.
787.name: Tom Lehrer

788.quote: And I'm not as young as I once was. At my age, I don't have time to be bored.
788.name: Lev Grossman

789.quote: I was drafted into the Army when I was 19 and came out at age 22. Most people that I knew didn't think they'd come home alive. I didn't think I would either, so I was happy when I did.
789.name: Ed Koch

790.quote: One already feels like an anachronism, writing novels in the age of what-ever-this-is-the-age-of, but touring to promote them feels doubly anachronistic. The marketplace is showing an increasing intolerance for the time-honored practice of printing information on paper and shipping it around the country.
790.name: Lev Grossman

791.quote: To own the dominant, or only, newspaper in a mid-sized American city was, for many decades, a kind of license to print money. In the Internet age, however, no one has figured out how to rescue the newspaper in the United States or abroad.
791.name: Eric Alterman

792.quote: I grew up loving horses. I was relatively obsessed, starting with my rocking horse at age 2, all the way through my painting and drawing phase.
792.name: Diane Lane

793.quote: I was equally in love with singing and acting from an early age.
793.name: Minnie Driver

794.quote: You can construct the character of a man and his age not only from what he does and says, but from what he fails to say and do.
794.name: Norman Douglas

795.quote: I never played much golf as a kid. I caddied quite a bit but never got serious into golf until about age 15.
795.name: Lee Trevino

796.quote: These days too many of us seem inclined to cover our ears, close our eyes, and blindly follow the most narrow, conservative tenets of religion or else seek comfort in the ancient traditions of New Age ritual.
796.name: Joan D. Vinge

797.quote: There is no age, height, or weight requirement to skate. It is good exercise no matter what your age is. If you want to be competitive, most start young. But, I practice with many adult competitors.
797.name: Nancy Kerrigan

798.quote: I remember when I was 6 years old and my brother used to go seek out guys that were 13 to come over and play football against me while he was the 'permanent quarterback.' I didn't know exactly what the age difference was, but I was already playing against older guys.
798.name: Junior Seau

799.quote: Well, my son really loves wildlife. And everytime he draws a polar bear I want to tell him there probably won't any by the time, he's my age. That's kinda hard to deal with.
799.name: Thom Yorke

800.quote: To be perfectly honest, I think that as I'm growing older, I'm just growing more impatient. I'll be very happy if at some point people say, 'Michael's grown wiser and softer in his old age.' But we'll have to wait and see what my next project is.
800.name: Michael Haneke

801.quote: A woman my age is not supposed to be attractive or sexually appealing. I just get kinda tired of that.
801.name: Kathleen Turner

802.quote: Listen, in England people are already writing their memoirs at the age of 23.
802.name: Rupert Everett

803.quote: I was apprehensive. I feared every time I talked about poetry, it would be filtered through the lens of race, sex, and age.
803.name: Rita Dove

804.quote: Everyone takes pause at 40. It's the age you have to assess everything in your life. It's the fictitious marker that's always coming up when you're young. The world really does look at you to kind of have it together by 40, and be successful by 40. Whatever success means.
804.name: Paul Feig

805.quote: I started out modeling at a young age and surrounded myself with different brilliant minds. I have so many people to get educated from, and I've been a sponge.
805.name: Kellan Lutz

806.quote: People say women shouldn't have long hair over a certain age, but I've never done what everyone says.
806.name: Jane Seymour

807.quote: We tend to think of age only in time, but I don't think it has much to do with time at all there's a whole load of other things. I've met 16-year-olds who are old and 90-year-olds who are young.
807.name: Roger Daltrey

808.quote: It looks good when you see someone kicking at the age of 51 with no double. It's kinda cool for people to know that past 50 we can keep flexible.
808.name: Jean Claude Van Damme

809.quote: The second album was emotionally exhausting and my life felt like it had become very serious at a very young age.
809.name: Delta Goodrem

810.quote: I never felt totally, 100%, patriotically English, I'd seen a lot of the world by an early age - sort of spent a lot of time traveling around Lebanon and I'd seen Babylon, and Damascus, and all sorts of places in the Middle East by the time I was ten. Then we'd return to Ruslip in West London, Done a fair bit of traveling really.
810.name: Andy Serkis

811.quote: The first feminine feature that goes, with advancing age, is the neck.
811.name: Gloria Swanson

812.quote: You just never know when you're living in a golden age.
812.name: Alexander Payne

813.quote: We now have an opportunity, though, to do something we didn't do in the industrial age, and that is to get a leg up on this, to bring the public in quickly, to have an informed debate.
813.name: Jeremy Rifkin

814.quote: I've spent as much as 30 grand on a watch but it's not about flaunting my wealth. I don't have many extravagances but watches are my biggest one. I must have 30 of them now. I've been collecting since the age of nine, when I won a black TAG in a karting event.
814.name: Jenson Button

815.quote: We were making the first step out of the age of chemistry and physics, and into the age of biology.
815.name: Jeremy Rifkin

816.quote: I feel like women are asked their age more than men.
816.name: Kristen Wiig

817.quote: Even in this day and age, if you're not married, there are people who are like, 'Awww! Don't worry, it'll happen for you someday.'
817.name: Kristen Wiig

818.quote: For students today, only 10 percent of children from working-class families graduate from college by the age of 24 as compared to 58 percent of upper-middle-class and wealthy families.
818.name: Patrick J. Kennedy

819.quote: I have worked very hard on being aware of my childhood but moving forward and not letting it bring me down emotionally. That is a hard thing - especially when you have children of your own and you remember what happened to you at that age.
819.name: Samantha Morton

820.quote: Traveling to Russia and Germany and being able to see the world at a young age was really cool for me, and I really liked that.
820.name: Mia Wasikowska

821.quote: I vividly remember being 14. That was the age when I started to get happy: I started being a writer and stopped being a loser.
821.name: Anthony Horowitz

822.quote: The balance of private good and general welfare is at the bottom of civilized morals but the morals of the Heroic Age are founded on individuality, and on nothing else.
822.name: Lascelles Abercrombie

823.quote: I also find it interesting that a lot of people in their 30s are not married and don't have kids. There are a lot of people in this age bracket that are out there dating and trying to find love. And I never thought that at my age I would be.
823.name: John Stamos

824.quote: The reason can only be this: heroic poetry depends on an heroic age, and an age is heroic because of what it is, not because of what it does.
824.name: Lascelles Abercrombie

825.quote: The 19th century was the age of Individualism the 20th and 21st are the ages of Socialism.
825.name: Francis Parker Yockey

826.quote: We live in an age of mediocrity.
826.name: Lauren Bacall

827.quote: I gambled and I lost. I failed in securing my options for this choice for myself, but I succeeded in verifying the Dark Age is still with us.
827.name: Jack Kevorkian

828.quote: I always looked really young for my age. And once I hit 23, 24 and 25, I was then allowed to play the cool 18-year-olds and stuff.
828.name: Ben Barnes

829.quote: I want to be age appropriate. I don't want to be that girl you see walking away and she looks 25 and then she turns around and she looks 90.
829.name: Stevie Nicks

830.quote: When I was at school, I was in choirs more than anything else, from a very young age, about 9 years old. And then I started taking drum lessons.
830.name: Ben Barnes

831.quote: I was always obsessed with being famous. I had Marilyn Monroe paper dolls as a child, and I was always obsessed with her. I've just been really driven in that direction, and none of my friends were. So, I don't know what put that bug in me at a young age.
831.name: Holly Madison

832.quote: All my early school reports from the age of 5 were 'Daniel must learn not to distract others.'
832.name: Dan Stevens

833.quote: At the age of 11 I was about 6 ft. tall and my voice had completely broken. That caused problems. I was this gangly, spotty, very unattractive kid. I wasn't cool and I wasn't a nerd. I didn't even want to fit in with anyone.
833.name: Dan Stevens

834.quote: I've always tried to do my very best, and I want to be the very best age, whatever age I am.
834.name: Ann-Margret

835.quote: I never quite toed the line. I was a bit disruptive. All my early school reports from the age of 5 were 'Daniel must learn not to distract others.' And now, that's what I do for a living.
835.name: Dan Stevens

836.quote: One problem with age is that patience begins to ebb.
836.name: Carl Hiaasen

837.quote: Men of my age live in a state of continual desperation.
837.name: Vita Sackville-West

838.quote: Starting a new retirement plan for those below a certain age is something tens of millions of Americans have already been through at work.
838.name: Mitch Daniels

839.quote: Anybody under the age of forty knows hip-hop, gospel and R&ampB pretty well, and it's all a part of what we consider to be 'black music.' There is a natural synergy between the three.
839.name: John Legend

840.quote: Well, Jeff Buckley for me is one of the greatest singers I've ever heard. And the reason why is he has an amazing range, amazing emotional power in his voice. And the music he put around it also just had this passion and this soul to it and this spirit to it that very few artists have, and he passed at a very young age.
840.name: John Legend

841.quote: It's getting better generally, daily, especially in TV, for women in acting and age and looks count less. As more women come into the business. Change of any sort takes a long time to happen.
841.name: Julie Walters

842.quote: I think the most exciting thing is that you expect people our age to know the music, but actually a lot of kids know the music, and if anything is left, we have left really good music, and that's the important part, not the mop-tops or whatever.
842.name: Ringo Starr

843.quote: It doesn't matter what color, sex, religion, age, sexual orientation, etc., everyone should have the same freedoms and liberties.
843.name: Lance Bass

844.quote: Childhood itself is scarcely more lovely than a cheerful, kindly, sunshiny old age.
844.name: Lydia M. Child

845.quote: In my older age, I've learned to take things slower, because I used to be that total-fall-in-love-after-a-day guy.
845.name: Lance Bass

846.quote: You watch yourself age and it's hard to feel like a sex symbol.
846.name: Idris Elba

847.quote: I like to be alone so I can write. But focus can hurt you. I don't want to be some stress casualty in early middle age.
847.name: James Ellroy

848.quote: I'd always thought the Rats were good fun, but one of the very nice things about being of Saga age is that I can actually look back and think, When I was younger I was in a great band. It was always a collective thing.
848.name: Bob Geldof

849.quote: I do think I feel it but you don't think you are cause at a certain time you are no age but you don't think you are anything. You feel the life you have lived. I feel that. It's been a long fifty years.
849.name: Bob Geldof

850.quote: The crucial task of old age is balance: keeping just well enough, just brave enough, just gay and interested and starkly honest enough to remain a sentient human being.
850.name: Florida Scott-Maxwell

851.quote: My first job was in retail at the age of 14, and I have worked in the industry ever since.
851.name: Rachel Roy

852.quote: I believed my story would be helpful to young women my daughter's age, who are still in the process of forming themselves as women, and in need of encouragement to remain true to themselves.
852.name: Joyce Maynard

853.quote: Old age and sickness bring out the essential characteristics of a man.
853.name: Felix Frankfurter

854.quote: We hold that the most wonderful and splendid proof of genius is a great poem produced in a civilized age.
854.name: Thomas B. Macaulay

855.quote: The age we live in is a busy age in which knowledge is rapidly advancing towards perfection.
855.name: Jeremy Bentham

856.quote: In a spiritually sensitive culture, then, it might well be that age is something to be admired or envied.
856.name: Rowan D. Williams

857.quote: What though youth gave love and roses, Age still leaves us friends and wine.
857.name: Thomas More

858.quote: If there is anything I would do differently in my life, it is that I would study business more. I'm trying to teach my daughter Chloe at an early age about investing and money so she's not afraid of it.
858.name: Donna Mills

859.quote: Any young man who is unmarried at the age of twenty one is a menace to the community.
859.name: Brigham Young

860.quote: Time, in general, has always been a central obsession of mine - what it does to people, how it can constitute a plot all on its own. So naturally, I am interested in old age.
860.name: Anne Tyler

861.quote: The first crocodile I ever caught was at nine years of age, and it was a rescue.
861.name: Steve Irwin

862.quote: It is strange to be known so universally and yet to be so lonely.
862.name: Albert Einstein

863.quote: Alone we can do so little together we can do so much.
863.name: Helen Keller

864.quote: It's often just enough to be with someone. I don't need to touch them. Not even talk. A feeling passes between you both. You're not alone.
864.name: Marilyn Monroe

865.quote: Associate with men of good quality if you esteem your own reputation for it is better to be alone than in bad company.
865.name: George Washington

866.quote: I restore myself when I'm alone.
866.name: Marilyn Monroe

867.quote: A man is born alone and dies alone and he experiences the good and bad consequences of his karma alone and he goes alone to hell or the Supreme abode.
867.name: Chanakya

868.quote: I have to be alone very often. I'd be quite happy if I spent from Saturday night until Monday morning alone in my apartment. That's how I refuel.
868.name: Audrey Hepburn

869.quote: I don't want to be alone, I want to be left alone.
869.name: Audrey Hepburn

870.quote: You cannot be lonely if you like the person you're alone with.
870.name: Wayne Dyer

871.quote: We allow our ignorance to prevail upon us and make us think we can survive alone, alone in patches, alone in groups, alone in races, even alone in genders.
871.name: Maya Angelou

872.quote: If it's true that our species is alone in the universe, then I'd have to say the universe aimed rather low and settled for very little.
872.name: George Carlin

873.quote: Language, has created the word 'loneliness' to express the pain of being alone. And it has created the word 'solitude' to express the glory of being alone.
873.name: Paul Tillich

874.quote: I love to be alone. I never found the companion that was so companionable as solitude.
874.name: Henry David Thoreau

875.quote: Look at the sky. We are not alone. The whole universe is friendly to us and conspires only to give the best to those who dream and work.
875.name: Abdul Kalam

876.quote: Every man must do two things alone he must do his own believing and his own dying.
876.name: Martin Luther

877.quote: Loneliness is my least favorite thing about life. The thing that I'm most worried about is just being alone without anybody to care for or someone who will care for me.
877.name: Anne Hathaway

878.quote: I have never found a companion that was so companionable as solitude. We are for the most part more lonely when we go abroad among men than when we stay in our chambers. A man thinking or working is always alone, let him be where he will.
878.name: Henry David Thoreau

879.quote: I finally faced the fact that it isn't a crime not having friends. Being alone means you have fewer problems.
879.name: Whitney Houston

880.quote: Yes, I guess you could say I am a loner, but I feel more lonely in a crowed room with boring people than I feel on my own.
880.name: Henry Rollins

881.quote: The only real progress lies in learning to be wrong all alone.
881.name: Albert Camus

882.quote: If you are lonely when you're alone, you are in bad company.
882.name: Jean-Paul Sartre

883.quote: Life could be wonderful if people would leave you alone.
883.name: Charlie Chaplin

884.quote: All men's miseries derive from not being able to sit in a quiet room alone.
884.name: Blaise Pascal

885.quote: We are rarely proud when we are alone.
885.name: Voltaire

886.quote: We are all sentenced to solitary confinement inside our own skins, for life.
886.name: Tennessee Williams

887.quote: It's an interesting combination: Having a great fear of being alone, and having a desperate need for solitude and the solitary experience. That's always been a tug of war for me.
887.name: Jodie Foster

888.quote: Unlike a drop of water which loses its identity when it joins the ocean, man does not lose his being in the society in which he lives. Man's life is independent. He is born not for the development of the society alone, but for the development of his self.
888.name: B. R. Ambedkar

889.quote: If I am a legend, then why am I so lonely?
889.name: Judy Garland

890.quote: A man can be himself only so long as he is alone.
890.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

891.quote: What a lovely surprise to finally discover how unlonely being alone can be.
891.name: Ellen Burstyn

892.quote: Still and all, why bother? Here's my answer. Many people need desperately to receive this message: I feel and think much as you do, care about many of the things you care about, although most people do not care about them. You are not alone.
892.name: Kurt Vonnegut

893.quote: When so many are lonely as seem to be lonely, it would be inexcusably selfish to be lonely alone.
893.name: Tennessee Williams

894.quote: You come into the world alone and you go out of the world alone yet it seems to me you are more alone while living than even going and coming.
894.name: Emily Carr

895.quote: To live alone is the fate of all great souls.
895.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

896.quote: The time you feel lonely is the time you most need to be by yourself.
896.name: Doug Coupland

897.quote: I've also seen that great men are often lonely. This is understandable, because they have built such high standards for themselves that they often feel alone. But that same loneliness is part of their ability to create.
897.name: Yousuf Karsh

898.quote: In Genesis, it says that it is not good for a man to be alone but sometimes it is a great relief.
898.name: John Barrymore

899.quote: I only go out to get me a fresh appetite for being alone.
899.name: Lord Byron

900.quote: The lonely become either thoughtful or empty.
900.name: Mason Cooley

901.quote: There's a tremendous difference between alone and lonely. You could be lonely in a group of people. I like being alone. I like eating by myself. I go home at night and just watch a movie or hang out with my dog. I have to exert myself and really say, oh God, I've got to see my friends 'cause I'm too content being by myself.
901.name: Drew Barrymore

902.quote: I really enjoy being single again. I spent a lot of time in a relationship and the nearer we came to the end, the more difficult it got. You don't see things clearly as long as you're still involved.
902.name: Dido Armstrong

903.quote: The best part about being alone is that you really don't have to answer to anybody. You do what you want.
903.name: Justin Timberlake

904.quote: The desire to get married, which - I regret to say, I believe is basic and primal in women - is followed almost immediately by an equally basic and primal urge - which is to be single again.
904.name: Nora Ephron

905.quote: Who knows what true loneliness is - not the conventional word but the naked terror? To the lonely themselves it wears a mask. The most miserable outcast hugs some memory or some illusion.
905.name: Joseph Conrad

906.quote: Living alone makes it harder to find someone to blame.
906.name: Mason Cooley

907.quote: As a body everyone is single, as a soul never.
907.name: Hermann Hesse

908.quote: The capacity for not feeling lonely can carry a very real price, that of feeling nothing at all.
908.name: Doug Coupland

909.quote: Always give a word or sign of salute when meeting or passing a friend, or even a stranger, if in a lonely place.
909.name: Tecumseh

910.quote: All men's misfortunes spring from their hatred of being alone.
910.name: Jean de la Bruyere

911.quote: To dare to live alone is the rarest courage since there are many who had rather meet their bitterest enemy in the field, than their own hearts in their closet.
911.name: Charles Caleb Colton

912.quote: Even in the presence of others he was completely alone.
912.name: Robert M. Pirsig

913.quote: Alone let him constantly meditate in solitude on that which is salutary for his soul, for he who meditates in solitude attains supreme bliss.
913.name: Guru Nanak

914.quote: I have so many different personalities in me and I still feel lonely.
914.name: Tori Amos

915.quote: I never said, 'I want to be alone.' I only said, 'I want to be left alone.' There is all the difference.
915.name: Greta Garbo

916.quote: Every man is born as many men and dies as a single one.
916.name: Martin Heidegger

917.quote: I paint self-portraits because I am so often alone, because I am the person I know best.
917.name: Frida Kahlo

918.quote: As I get older I'm more and more comfortable being alone.
918.name: Sienna Miller

919.quote: I'm fascinated with myself and love hearing the sound of my own voice. I'd like to hear what I have to say. A lot of people don't like being alone because they truly don't like themselves, but I love me.
919.name: Gene Simmons

920.quote: I would be married, but I'd have no wife, I would be married to a single life.
920.name: Charles Bukowski

921.quote: Unless we love and are loved, each of us is alone, each of us is deeply lonely.
921.name: Mortimer Adler

922.quote: A man content to go to heaven alone will never go to heaven.
922.name: Boethius

923.quote: He that can live alone resembles the brute beast in nothing, the sage in much, and God in everything.
923.name: Baltasar Gracian

924.quote: Remember we're all in this alone.
924.name: Lily Tomlin

925.quote: Solitude is the profoundest fact of the human condition. Man is the only being who knows he is alone.
925.name: Octavio Paz

926.quote: Absolutely lonely people have few personal interactions of any kind.
926.name: Martha Beck

927.quote: Is he alone who has courage on his right hand and faith on his left hand?
927.name: Charles Lindbergh

928.quote: Don't go away. I don't want to be alone. I can't stand being alone.
928.name: Arnold Rothstein

929.quote: Inside myself is a place where I live all alone and that is where I renew my springs that never dry up.
929.name: Pearl S. Buck

931.quote: I would rather be a beggar and single than a queen and married.
931.name: Elizabeth I

932.quote: If you make friends with yourself you will never be alone.
932.name: Maxwell Maltz

933.quote: Only the lonely know the way I feel tonight.
933.name: Roy Orbison

934.quote: Be able to be alone. Lose not the advantage of solitude, and the society of thyself.
934.name: Thomas Browne

935.quote: The longer one is alone, the easier it is to hear the song of the earth.
935.name: Robert Anton Wilson

936.quote: All of our unhappiness comes from our inability to be alone.
936.name: Jean de la Bruyere

937.quote: When the people you love are gone, you're alone.
937.name: Keanu Reeves

938.quote: You can't fake it when you're alone with God, you know.
938.name: Jim Bakker

939.quote: Nothing makes us so lonely as our secrets.
939.name: Paul Tournier

940.quote: If you're going to put yourself above everybody else, you might end up alone.
940.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

941.quote: By all means use some time to be alone.
941.name: Edward Young

942.quote: I think I jump around more when I'm alone.
942.name: Nicolas Cage

943.quote: When I'm alone, I can sleep crossways in bed without an argument.
943.name: Zsa Zsa Gabor

944.quote: There are places and moments in which one is so completely alone that one sees the world entire.
944.name: Jules Renard
