1561.quote: I like to have a massage therapist come to my house, get a massage, take a bath, go to bed. That's a perfect night alone for me.

1572.quote: Say not that honor is the child of boldness, nor believe thou that the hazard of life alone can pay the price of it: it is not to the action that it is due, but to the manner of performing it.
1572.name: Akhenaton

1574.quote: Hiking is the best workout!, You can hike for three hours and not even realize you're working out. And, hiking alone lets me have some time to myself.
1574.name: Jamie Luner

1575.quote: I can barely remember what I wrote yesterday, let alone 10 years ago.

1576.name: John Dingell

1579.quote: For each one of us stands alone in the midst of a universe.

1582.quote: I think the idea that you can go this alone is - was a huge mistake. And unfortunately, there was a price paid in terms of suffering and pain for people in New Orleans.
1582.name: Michael Chertoff

1583.quote: Your thoughts and emotions are yours alone.

1584.quote: But the wicked passions of men's hearts alone seem strong enough to leave pictures that persist the good are ever too luke-warm.

1585.name: Angelina Jolie

1586.quote: If you tell people where to go, but not how to get there, you'll be amazed at the results.

1587.quote: It is amazing what you can accomplish if you do not care who gets the credit.

1590.quote: It's amazing the clarity that comes with psychotic jealousy.

1593.quote: When you have confidence, you can have a lot of fun. And when you have fun, you can do amazing things.

1594.quote: The thing that is really hard, and really amazing, is giving up on being perfect and beginning the work of becoming yourself.

1595.quote: If there was an observer on Mars, they would probably be amazed that we have survived this long.

1596.quote: I am indeed amazed when I consider how weak my mind is and how prone to error.
1596.name: Rene Descartes

1597.quote: People are generally amazed that I would take an interest in any form that would require me to stop talking for three hours.

1598.quote: With love, you should go ahead and take the risk of getting hurt because love is an amazing feeling.
1598.name: Britney Spears

1600.quote: You will never cease to be the most amazed person on earth at what God has done for you on the inside.
1600.name: Oswald Chambers

1610.quote: The body is an amazing machine, If you eat the right things your body will perform incredibly well!

1611.quote: I really love the internet. They say chat-rooms are the trailer park of the internet but I find it amazing.
1611.name: Carrie Fisher

1614.quote: I'm always amazed at anyone's interest in what I have to say.

1616.quote: When the youth of America gets together, amazing things happen.
1616.name: Tom Ford

1619.quote: It's an amazing luxury to say I'm 31 years old and I'm gonna take a year off. That's pretty amazing.
1619.name: Sarah McLachlan

1620.quote: Isn't it amazing the way the future succeeds in creating an appropriate past?

1621.quote: It's amazing how much trouble you can get in when you don't have anything else to do.

1622.quote: I like pens. My writing is so amazing there's never a need to erase.
1622.name: Todd Barry

1623.quote: I am constantly amazed by Tina Fey. And I am Tina Fey.
1623.name: Tina Fey

1624.quote: I was always amazed about how much I could finally squeeze into a thirty second commercial.

1625.quote: I've had to calm down, I have a kid! It is amazing. It's the best thing ever. Nothing better than it.
1625.name: Kevin Pietersen

1626.quote: Amazingly when you add life and consciousness to the equation you can actually explain some of the biggest puzzles of science.

1627.quote: Amazement awaits us at every corner.
1627.name: James Broughton

1628.quote: There are a lot of people with a lot of money, and I'm amazed they don't understand what a great pleasure it can be to give.

1629.quote: The body can do amazing things in a situation when it is really called for.
1629.name: Suzanne Farrell

1630.quote: I have a ridiculous fear of sharks but I'd jump in the water in a second for an amazing role.

1631.quote: You would be amazed what the ordinary guy knows.

1633.quote: In 29 years, I had recorded over 2,200 songs. I was amazed.

1634.quote: It's amazing to me that young people will still pick up a cigarette.

1637.quote: It's the most amazing feeling to hold your child in your arms.

1638.quote: To me, when a great band is playing together, it's amazing for me.

1641.quote: To feel the presence of the Lord is an amazing thing.

1647.quote: It's amazing that the amount of news that happens in the world every day always just exactly fits the newspaper.

1650.quote: May your trails be crooked, winding, lonesome, dangerous, leading to the most amazing view. May your mountains rise into and above the clouds.

1651.quote: Why is Cloud 9 so amazing? What is wrong with Cloud 8? That joke came off the top of my head, and the top of my head ain't funny!

1656.quote: It's an amazing feeling to go into a studio and really be alone.

1661.quote: If I can inspire people by showing that following a dream by working hard and being determined is possible, it's amazing.

1662.quote: I love a beautiful gown on stage, and luckily I've been fortunate to wear some amazing dresses.
1662.name: Leona Lewis

1663.quote: I get such lovely gifts from fans, amazing pictures, handmade jewellery. I'm very lucky!

1664.quote: I believe I could have had a career in the music industry without 'X Factor,' but it was an amazing platform that propelled me to where I am now.

1666.quote: Sally Field looks amazing in general, never mind her age! She's a phenomenally talented actress and has had a career spanning so many decades.

1668.quote: We watch a lot of Discovery Channel, shows like 'The Biggest Loser' and even 'Amazing Race.' You learn a lot about the world, it's fun and nobody's interested in beating anybody down. And then the opposite: I'm a huge fan of 'Survivor.'

1675.quote: I think having children is the most amazing thing.

1676.quote: I put the costume on and said 'It's not very comfortable, but it looks amazing,' so it's all good.

1677.quote: My mother is the coolest, most amazing person I know.
1677.name: J. J. Abrams

1678.quote: There are some amazing stories from all over this country, where people's work and contribution has been acknowledged. To be part of that is an absolutely fantastic feeling.

I didn't think I had a chance in hell of being in the film, but I knew I had to go for it.
1679.name: Emily Mortimer

1680.quote: I really would love to do a piece like Julia Roberts or Charlize Theron in 'Erin Brockovich' or 'North Country.' They were both so amazing and so inspiring. I would love to touch someone in the way their performances touched me.

1682.quote: I have a full life: I have two amazing kids, I have great friends, great family. And right now, that's plenty for me to manage. A new relationship just seems like way too much work.

1684.quote: It is amazing to think after all that has happened in this country in the last few years, the last few decades, that so many people have this blind faith that government is our friend and therefore, so we don't need protections against it.

1685.quote: Once the kids are in school, it's amazing what you can do.
1685.name: Laura Schlessinger

1686.quote: The feeling of your baby taking nourishment from your body for the first time is amazing, and it remains the most touching moment of my life.
1686.name: Laura Schlessinger

1687.name: Lea Michele

1688.quote: Every now and then, I have blissful moments of thanking God for all the amazing things that are happening. 1688.name: Lea Michele

1689.quote: I'm overjoyed and beyond honored to be a part of the L'Oreal Paris family. I'm such a fan of L'Oreal Paris not just for all of their amazing products, but for what they stand for.
1689.name: Lea Michele

1690.quote: I got fitter when I did 'Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat.' I wore a loincloth - that's a lot of motivation!
1690.name: Donny Osmond

1691.quote: Of course this is Vegas and it is the melting pot for all over the world, but people from all over the world know Donny and Marie. It is amazing. 1692.quote: Working with amazing people, you continue to learn and develop yourself, as an actor and as a person.
1692.name: Josh Hutcherson

1694.quote: As his partner on this amazing journey, I can tell you Mitt Romney was not handed success. He built it.
1694.name: Ann Romney

1695.name: Mike Myers

1696.name: Joe Nichols

1697.quote: I work with all these amazing voice actors that do a kajillion voices.
1697.name: Katey Sagal

1698.quote: You have to wait for a big star to come in and generate interest on a project, and now that has become me, which is an amazing blessing.
1698.name: Jeremy Renner

1699.name: Charles Schumer

1700.quote: I mean, there are some amazing storytelling being done on the small screen right now. That's what so cool about being in television right now. Studios, networks are starting to throw more resources, better writers, more production values, and to be part of that is awesome.
1700.name: Ian Somerhalder

1701.quote: I love vintage shopping, I think it's really fun. And I love the feeling of finding the most amazing piece for less.
1701.name: Emma Roberts

1702.quote: It's been such a deep and amazing journey for me, getting close to John Keats, and also I love Shelley and Byron. I mean, the thing about the Romantic poets is that they've got the epitaph of romantic posthumously. They all died really young, and Keats, the youngest of them all.
1702.name: Jane Campion

1703.quote: In football you always get judged on your last game. Whoever you are, or how amazing you are, it's the last game that everyone has seen.
1703.name: Thierry Henry

1704.quote: I just want to be a part of great stories, whether I'm part of an amazing ensemble cast or I'm leading it or the antagonist or whatever.

1705.quote: The last real movie stars were probably Redford and Newman. And things were different then. There wasn't this amazing amount of magazines and information about them.

1708.name: Portia de Rossi

1709.name: Eric Alterman

1710.name: David Walliams

1716.name: Curtis Stone

1717.quote: I go to Saint Barth in the French West Indies for two weeks each year. That place is amazing. Amazing people, beautiful beaches, great wine, wonderful harbors, It's incredibly romantic.

2047.quote: You must never be satisfied with losing. You must get angry, terribly angry, about losing. But the mark of the good loser is that he takes his anger out on himself and not his victorious opponents or on his teammates.
2047.name: Richard M. Nixon

2048.quote: The fear really hits you. That's what you feel first. And then it's the anger and frustration. Part of the problem is how little we understand about the ultimate betrayal of the body when it rebels against itself.
2048.name: Charles Bronson

2049.quote: Acting in anger and hatred throughout my life, I frequently precipitated what I feared most, the loss of friendships and the need to rely upon the very people I'd abused.
2049.name: Luke Ford

2050.quote: The one who cannot restrain their anger will wish undone, what their temper and irritation prompted them to do.
2050.name: Horace

2051.quote: Be modest, humble, simple. Control your anger.
2051.name: Abraham Cahan

2052.quote: People are always angry at America. They're absolutely certain that America either caused their problems or is deliberately not fixing their problems. But the anger is always directed at America and never at Americans.
2052.name: P. J. O'Rourke

2053.quote: You've just got to have a sense of respect for the person you have children with. Anger doesn't help anybody. Ultimately you have to say forgiveness is important, and honoring what you had together is important. But it's easy to say and harder to do.
2053.name: Nicole Kidman

2054.quote: As far as having peace within myself, the one way I can do that is forgiving the people who have done wrong to me. It causes more stress to build up anger. Peace is more productive.
2054.name: Rodney King

2055.quote: The voice of the intelligence is drowned out by the roar of fear. It is ignored by the voice of desire. It is contradicted by the voice of shame. It is biased by hate and extinguished by anger. Most of all it is silenced by ignorance.
2055.name: Karl A. Menninger

2056.quote: The world in general doesn't know what to make of originality it is startled out of its comfortable habits of thought, and its first reaction is one of anger.
2056.name: W. Somerset Maugham

2057.quote: I'd be lying if I said I wasn't angry some days. But I really have worked hard to put a lot of the anger and disappointment in the past.
2057.name: Monica Lewinsky

2058.quote: Five enemies of peace inhabit with us - avarice, ambition, envy, anger, and pride if these were to be banished, we should infallibly enjoy perpetual peace.
2058.name: Petrarch

2059.quote: Lawyers are men who hire out their words and anger.
2059.name: Horace

2060.quote: It's a joke to think that anyone is one thing. We're all such complex creatures. But if I'm going to be a poster child for anything, anger's a gorgeous emotion. It gets a bad rap, but it can make great changes happen.
2060.name: Alanis Morissette

2061.quote: Anger will never disappear so long as thoughts of resentment are cherished in the mind. Anger will disappear just as soon as thoughts of resentment are forgotten.
2061.name: John Dryden

2062.quote: Do not follow vain desires for verily he who prospers is preserved from lust, greed and anger.
2062.name: Abu Bakr

2063.quote: All those who offer an opinion on any doubtful point should first clear their minds of every sentiment of dislike, friendship, anger or pity.
2063.name: Sallust

2064.quote: I really believe that all of us have a lot of darkness in our souls. Anger, rage, fear, sadness. I don't think that's only reserved for people who have horrible upbringings. I think it really exists and is part of the human condition. I think in the course of your life you figure out ways to deal with that.
2064.name: Kevin Bacon

2065.quote: Do not meddle in the affairs of wizards, for they are subtle and quick to anger.
2065.name: J. R. R. Tolkien

2066.quote: When I was younger, I was terrified to express anger because it would often kick-start a horrible reaction in the men in my life. So I bit my tongue. I was left to painstakingly deal with the aftermath of my avoidance later in life, in therapy or through the lyrics of my songs.
2066.name: Alanis Morissette

2067.quote: The flame of anger, bright and brief, sharpens the barb of love.
2067.name: Walter Savage Landor

2068.quote: What starts the process, really, are laughs and slights and snubs when you are a kid. If your anger is deep enough and strong enough, you learn that you can change those attitudes by excellence, personal gut performance.
2068.name: Richard M. Nixon

2069.quote: Although you may spend your life killing, You will not exhaust all your foes. But if you quell your own anger, your real enemy will be slain.
2069.name: Nagarjuna

2070.quote: The opposite of anger is not calmness, its empathy.
2070.name: Mehmet Oz

2071.quote: A lot of my humor does come from anger. It's like, you're not gonna pull one over on me - which is pretty much my motto anyways.
2071.name: Courteney Cox

2072.quote: President Obama clearly cannot run on his record. All he's offering is more of the same. That's not good. Look at the economy. It's stagnating. And so, what they're now going to try and do is bring this campaign down to little things, distractions, distortions, smear, fear, anger, frustration.
2072.name: Paul Ryan

2073.quote: To talk about balance, it's easier to talk about what's out of balance. And I think anytime that you have any disease, and disease meaning lack of ease, lack of flow, dis-ease. So any time there's disease, you're out of balance, whether it's jealousy, anger, greed, anxiety, fear.
2073.name: Ricky Williams

2074.quote: People are unjust to anger - it can be enlivening and a lot of fun.
2074.name: Philip Roth

2075.quote: Anger is never without an argument, but seldom with a good one.
2075.name: Indira Gandhi

2076.quote: All anger is not sinful, because some degree of it, and on some occasions, is inevitable. But it becomes sinful and contradicts the rule of Scripture when it is conceived upon slight and inadequate provocation, and when it continues long.
2076.name: Wilson Mizner

2077.quote: George wrote Taxman, and I played guitar on it. He wrote it in anger at finding out what the taxman did. He had never known before then what could happen to your money.
2077.name: Paul McCartney

2078.quote: Grab the broom of anger and drive off the beast of fear.
2078.name: Zora Neale Hurston

2079.quote: I don't think your ability to fight has anything to do with how big you are. It's to do with how much anger is in you.
2079.name: Amy Winehouse

2080.quote: Like fragile ice anger passes away in time.
2080.name: Ovid

2081.quote: My therapist says I still haven't got in touch with my anger. Maybe one day I'm going to explode. But I'm still really happy. I know it looks like a strange and painful upbringing - all those experiences led me to the paths that I'm on now.
2081.name: Drew Barrymore

2082.quote: When someone says that I'm angry it's actually a compliment. I have not always been direct with my anger in my relationships, which is part of why I'd write about it in my songs because I had such fear around expressing anger as a woman.
2082.name: Alanis Morissette

2083.quote: I think I'm basically the same guy I always was. Maybe I've learned, through experience, to rein in some of the anger and temper they say redheads normally have.
2083.name: Willie Nelson

2084.quote: Growing up in a particular neighborhood, growing up in a working-class family, not having much money, all of those things fire you and can give you an edge, can give you an anger.
2084.name: Gary Oldman

2085.quote: Well, all comedy starts with anger. You get angry, and its never for a good reason, right? You know its not a good reason. And then you try and work it from there.
2085.name: Jerry Seinfeld

2086.quote: What influenced me was Tori Amos, who was unapologetic about expressing anger through music, and Sinead O'Connor. Those two in particular were really moving for me, and very inspiring, before I wrote 'Jagged Little Pill.'
2086.name: Alanis Morissette

2087.quote: Anger is as a stone cast into a wasp's nest.
2087.name: Pope Paul VI

2088.quote: My dear brothers, take note of this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry, for man's anger does not bring about the righteous life that God desires.
2088.name: Beverly Sills

2089.quote: I'm an angry person, angrier than most people would imagine, I get flashes of anger. What works for me is working out when it's useful to use that anger.
2089.name: Alan Alda

2090.quote: Quite a lot of our contemporary culture is actually shot through with a resentment of limits and the passage of time, anger at what we can't do, fear or even disgust at growing old.
2090.name: Rowan Williams

2091.quote: Words can be said in bitterness and anger, and often there seems to be an element of truth in the nastiness. And words don't go away, they just echo around.
2091.name: Jane Goodall

2092.quote: Religion can emerge in all forms of feeling: here wild anger, there the sweetest pain here consuming hatred, there the childlike smile of serene humility.
2092.name: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel

2093.quote: Fantastic tyrant of the amorous heart. How hard thy yoke, how cruel thy dart. Those escape your anger who refuse your sway, and those are punished most, who most obey.
2093.name: Matthew Prior

2094.quote: I turned to music originally because of my past and needing a release or an outlet to get out anger or frustration or hurt.
2094.name: Christina Aguilera

2095.quote: Wars spring from unseen and generally insignificant causes, the first outbreak being often but an explosion of anger.
2095.name: Thucydides

2096.quote: I have to say that anger is the blanket that comes around me, and that blunts and blurs my sense of proportion.
2096.name: Pete Townshend

2097.quote: I'm fascinated by rap and by hip-hop. I think there's a lot of poetry in it. There's a lot of anger, a lot of social energy in it. And I think you'd better listen to it pretty carefully, 'cause it's important.
2097.name: John F. Kerry

2098.quote: The bare recollection of anger kindles anger.
2098.name: Publilius Syrus

2099.quote: There was never an angry man that thought his anger unjust.
2099.name: Saint Francis de Sales

2100.quote: I think we all have a lot of darkness in our bellies. As an actor, the challenge of tapping into that, reaching down into that sadness or anger, is very therapeutic.
2100.name: Kevin Bacon

2101.quote: Allowing children to show their guilt, show their grief, show their anger, takes the sting out of the situation.
2101.name: Martha Beck

2102.quote: I think that Scottish people, like Canadians, are often misunderstood and what I like about my Scottish friends and relatives is how quickly it can go from love to anger. It's a great dynamic.
2102.name: Mike Myers

2103.quote: He who is incapable of feeling strong passions, of being shaken by anger, of living in every sense of the word, will never be a good actor.
2103.name: Sarah Bernhardt

2104.quote: Anger may repast with thee for an hour, but not repose for a night the continuance of anger is hatred, the continuance of hatred turns malice.
2104.name: Francis Quarles

2105.quote: Yeah, to me, acting is very therapeutic. I get out a lot of anger and frustration.
2105.name: Diane Kruger

2106.quote: I grew up looking at my father as to how to behave. In watching him I grasped so many things. His own temperament was of a calm person. He was very composed and I never saw anger in him. To me, that was fascinating.
2106.name: Sachin Tendulkar

2107.quote: All who consult on doubtful matters, should be void of hatred, friendship, anger, and pity.
2107.name: Sallust

2108.quote: Men make angry music and it's called rock-and-roll women include anger in their vocabulary and suddenly they're angry and militant.
2108.name: Ani DiFranco

2109.quote: I've been trying to learn how to not be so conflicted about things like my own anger. I've always had a place in my music for my anger as a way of compensating for not having a mechanism to express it in my everyday life. So I've been trying to be more true to myself, and that helps me to chill out a little bit. But politically, uh-uh. No.
2109.name: Ani DiFranco

2110.quote: Shock, confusion, fear, anger, grief, and defiance. On Sept. 11, 2001, and for the three days following the worst terrorist attack on U.S. soil, President George W. Bush led with raw emotion that reflected the public's whipsawing stages of acceptance.
2110.name: Ron Fournier

2111.quote: For me music is a vehicle to bring our pain to the surface, getting it back to that humble and tender spot where, with luck, it can lose its anger and become compassion again.
2111.name: Paula Cole

2112.quote: In plain terms, a child is a complicated creature who can drive you crazy. There's a cruelty to childhood, there's an anger.
2112.name: Maurice Sendak

2113.quote: Anger is an expensive luxury in which only men of certain income can indulge.
2113.name: George William Curtis

2114.quote: I'm not a screamer. I'm confrontational, but I don't think that translates into anger.
2114.name: Rachel Maddow

2115.quote: All through life I've harbored anger rather than expressed it at the moment.
2115.name: Jessica Lange

2116.quote: My passion and energy get mistaken for anger.
2116.name: Gary Oldman

2117.quote: When we can lay down our fear and anger and choose responses other than aggression, we create the conditions for bringing out the best in us humans.
2117.name: Margaret J. Wheatley

2119.quote: At the time, 1980, people regarded actresses involved with production with a certain amount of fear, resentment and anger.
2119.name: Jacqueline Bisset

2120.quote: The great thing about celebrity culture is that they can't seem to stop themselves from displaying their ridiculous behaviour. I feel it's my job as a serious investigative journalist to witness all kinds of behaviour and then report back to the audience through the prism of my own anger and bitterness.
2120.name: Kathy Griffin

2121.quote: In general I was a good kid. It usually took a lot to make me mad. But once I reached the boiling point, I lost all rational control. Totally without thinking, when my anger was aroused, I grabbed the nearest brick, rock, or stick to bash someone. It was as if I had no conscious will in the matter.
2121.name: Benjamin Carson

2122.quote: Anger elicits anger, fear elicits fear, no matter how well meaning we may be.
2122.name: Martha Beck

2123.quote: Anger and hate against one we love steels our hearts, but contempt or pity leaves us silent and ashamed.
2123.name: Edgar Rice Burroghs

2124.quote: I have a right to my anger, and I don't want anybody telling me I shouldn't be, that it's not nice to be, and that something's wrong with me because I get angry.
2124.name: Maxine Waters

2126.quote: The intoxication of anger, like that of the grape, shows us to others, but hides us from ourselves.
2126.name: John Dryden

2127.quote: The upside to anger? Getting it out of your system. You got to express your anger. Then you have room for more positive things. If I hold something in a long time, and then I speak it, it's amazing how the light shines so much brighter.
2127.name: Reba McEntire

2128.quote: I drank for about 25 years getting over the loss of my father and I took the anger out on myself. I did a good job at beating myself up at sometimes. I don't drink anymore but my alcoholic head occasionally says different. 'Nil By Mouth' was a love letter to my father because I needed to resolve some issues in order to be able to forgive him.
2128.name: Gary Oldman

2129.quote: Anger has a way of seeping into every other emotion and planting itself in there.
2129.name: Dane Cook

2130.quote: Anger is a great force. If you control it, it can be transmuted into a power which can move the whole world.
2130.name: William Shenstone

2131.quote: It's usually a big kind of vent of frustration or anger or sadness that puts me in the right frame of mind to write. It's such a cliche to say that artists write when they're down, but it's true for me. It's a relief to get out what's eating away at my heart or my soul or my head.
2131.name: Ellie Goulding

2132.quote: Anger tears me up inside, My own, or anyone else's.
2132.name: Betty White

2133.quote: He took over anger to intimidate subordinates, and in time anger took over him.
2133.name: Milan Kundera

2134.quote: We are losing sight of civility in government and politics. Debate and dialogue is taking a back seat to the politics of destruction and anger and control. Dogma has replaced thoughtful discussion between people of differing views.
2134.name: James McGreevey

2135.quote: I don't play pyrotechnic scales. I play about frustration, patience, anger. Music is an extension of my soul.
2135.name: Dick Dale

2136.quote: I'm not someone who feels anger on particular issues.
2136.name: Theresa May

2137.quote: Take the high road. No matter how much strife, and consternation, frustration and anger you might be confronted with - don't go to that level.
2137.name: Tim Gunn

2138.quote: Something my mum taught me years and years and years ago, is life's just too short to carry around a great bucket-load of anger and resentment and bitterness and hatreds and all that sort of stuff.
2138.name: Kevin Rudd

2139.quote: My humour has always come from anger, but I have to make sure I don't just get angry and jump on a soapbox.
2139.name: Carl Hiaasen

2141.quote: And I think there's something about conservatives frankly - and the Left, when it comes to their channels of persuasion, are unpersuasive. They are, most of them are hate-filled, obscenity-clogged rants of anger and hatred.
2141.name: Karl Rove

2142.quote: If anger proceeds from a great cause, it turns to fury if from a small cause, it is peevishness and so is always either terrible or ridiculous.
2142.name: Jeremy Taylor

2143.quote: I accrued anger from people's low opinion of me and my work, and for the work I might be capable of.
2143.name: Harrison Ford

2144.quote: I've learned that football sometimes was an outlet. It was a way for me to release anger, release frustration.
2144.name: Emmitt Smith

2145.quote: Anger is a momentary madness, so control your passion or it will control you.
2145.name: G. M. Trevelyan

2146.quote: It's a very difficult thing for people to accept, seeing women act out anger on the screen. We're more accustomed to seeing men expressing rage and women crying.
2146.name: Rebecca De Mornay

2147.quote: He best keeps from anger who remembers that God is always looking upon him.
2147.name: B. C. Forbes

2148.quote: I did not want to put myself on the line, as an Australian playing Britain's greatest comic actor. The fans of Sellers are obsessive, possessive - and aggressive. I did not want to risk their anger - or my own reputation.
2148.name: Geoffrey Rush

2149.quote: On banks, I make no apology for attacking spivs and gamblers who did more harm to the British economy than Bob Crow could achieve in his wildest Trotskyite fantasies, while paying themselves outrageous bonuses underwritten by the taxpayer. There is much public anger about banks and it is well deserved.
2149.name: Vince Cable

2150.quote: Whether one agrees or disagrees with the tactics of the Occupy Wall Street movement, it's easy to understand the inspiration for its anger as well as its impatience.
2150.name: Eric Alterman

2151.quote: When you learn that a truth is a lie, anger follows.
2151.name: Grace Slick

2152.quote: Good satire comes from anger. It comes from a sense of injustice, that there are wrongs in the world that need to be fixed. And what better place to get that well of venom and outrage boiling than a newsroom, because you're on the front lines.
2152.name: Carl Hiaasen

2153.quote: In high school I dated a white woman. She would come to visit me on the rez. And her dad, who was very racist, didn't like that at all. And he told her one time, 'You shouldn't go on the rez if you're white because Indians have a lot of anger in their heart.'
2153.name: Sherman Alexie

2154.quote: People have said I'm the candidate of anger. Well, we have a right to be angry. We lost 3 million jobs. We lost our place as the moral leader of the world.
2154.name: Howard Dean

2155.quote: I think anger and laughter are very close to each other, when you think about it.
2155.name: Albert Brooks

2156.quote: All improv turns into anger. All comedy improv basically turns into anger, because that's all people know how to do when they're improvising. If you notice shows that are improvising are generally people yelling at each other.
2156.name: Albert Brooks

2157.quote: As the plane got closer to Miami, I had this terrible feeling he was dying. Maybe he was telling me that he was going. I felt anger, panic, despair and helplessness.
2157.name: Robin Gibb

2158.quote: Men are fair, and they have learned not to personalize anger - they can disagree with you and argue to the bone, but afterward they still consider you a nice person with whom the underlying human relationship need not be altered.
2158.name: Warren Farrell

2159.quote: I guess because I had such a horrible life growing up, going from place to place not knowing what I was gonna do and ending up being homeless, there was a lot of pain and a lot of anger that was coming out through my guitar playing.
2159.name: Dave Mustaine

2160.quote: Wise anger is like fire from a flint: there is great ado to get it out and when it does come, it is out again immediately.
2160.name: Edward Everett Hale

2161.quote: I had a lot of anger because I wasn't happy with the way I had been raised.
2161.name: Patrick Swayze

2162.quote: So I'm not worried about the emotions I carry with me, because I'm happy that I have them I think it's good for the work I do. The emotions that are not healthy are the ones you hold inside, like anger.
2162.name: Diana Ross

2163.quote: But one of the hardest things for me to do was to access anger. I could do it on stage. But when I did it on film it was hard for me. That probably has to do with the intimacy of film. And my own personal issues with expressing anger. So I had to learn how to do that.
2163.name: Ellen Barkin

2164.quote: To rule one's anger is well to prevent it is better.
2164.name: Tryon Edwards

2165.quote: I was able to do To Sleep with Anger, a very powerful film about African Americans, their spirituality, and the things that happened within a small community and a family.
2165.name: Danny Glover

2166.quote: The anger of lovers renews their love.
2166.name: Terence

2167.quote: Life is precious and there's not a lot of room for anger.
2167.name: Fran Drescher

2168.quote: I think I would cope like anyone copes with any tragedy. I'm sure I would be very upset for a while and then there would come a point where I would either have to stay in this place of darkness and anger, or I'd have to accept that it happened.
2168.name: Jason Ritter

2169.quote: Everybody kind of perceives me as being angry. It's not anger, it's motivation.
2169.name: Roger Clemens

2170.quote: There are people still in the Republican Party that I believe practice the communication of anger, of disappointment, of regret, of pain, of sorrow, of suffering. That's not what the American people want to hear.
2170.name: Frank Luntz

2171.quote: I've purged myself of bitterness and anger and remained open to love.
2171.name: Tatum O'Neal

2172.quote: Imagine a thousand more such daily intrusions in your life, every hour and minute of every day, and you can grasp the source of this paranoia, this anger that could consume me at any moment if I lost control.
2172.name: Jack Henry Abbott

2173.quote: There is an element of anger among women who've been raped. There's certainly a major element of humiliation. But it really does seem like a medical condition of shock and horror.
2173.name: Nicholas D. Kristof

2174.quote: When you start suppressing feelings at an early age, it hurts you down the road. Full expression of anger and pain is very important.
2174.name: Andrew Shue

2175.quote: I was very fortunate to play sports. All the anger in me went out. I had to do what I had to do. If you stay angry all the time, then you really don't have a good life.
2175.name: Willie Mays

2176.quote: I understand Tea Partyers' anger with the system, but they are in way over their heads and often racially motivated, and I can't be part of that.
2176.name: Zach Galifianakis

2177.quote: I do like to write nasty songs. It's a useful weapon to have, and it's cathartic as well, because I create art out of anger, something positive out of something negative.
2177.name: Lisa Marie Presley

2178.quote: As a culture I see us as presently deprived of subtleties. The music is loud, the anger is elevated, sex seems lacking in sweetness and privacy.
2178.name: Shelley Berman

2179.quote: I was a pretty angry kid, and I got into military history largely as a way to vent my own anger. As I got older it narrowed down to a more specific focus on individual violence. I'm just trying to understand where it came from.
2179.name: Caleb Carr

2180.quote: I get in trouble when I say things like, 'I'm attracted to violence.' I was a pretty angry kid, and I got into military history largely as a way to vent my own anger. As I got older it narrowed down to a more specific focus on individual violence. I'm just trying to understand where it came from.
2180.name: Caleb Carr

2181.quote: Anger is a transient hatred or at least very like it.
2181.name: Robert South

2182.quote: That's the conundrum of cartoon stripping, as opposed to political cartoons. When your anger is the driving force of your drawing hand, failure follows. The anger is OK, but it has to serve the interests of the heart, frankly.
2182.name: Berkeley Breathed

2183.quote: Generalised anger and frustration is something that gets you in the studio, and gets you to work - though it's not necessarily evident in anything that's finished.
2183.name: Bruce Nauman

2184.quote: Most men's anger about religion is as if two men should quarrel for a lady they neither of them care for.
2184.name: Edward F. Halifax

2185.quote: But on second thought, after I decreed the state of emergency, I came to the conclusion that that was impossible to achieve without bloodshed because the street protesters were full of anger and nearly out of control. This is why I thought we needed to find another way out.
2185.name: Eduard Shevardnadze

2186.quote: I suppose there's an anger in all of us. Some hidden rage that you keep at bay.
2186.name: Dominic Cooper

2187.quote: Deep down, my mom had long suspected I was gay, Much of her anger and hurt came from her sense of betrayal that she was the last to be told.
2187.name: Chaz Bono

2188.quote: I'm generally quite an angry person, and I like to channel my anger toward something creative.
2188.name: Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy

2189.quote: I think there is a big difference between expressing the pain and anger that many African Americans and other people of color may feel versus language that I think now crosses the line and goes into hate.
2189.name: Michael Nutter

2190.quote: Being told about the effects of climate change is an appeal to our reason and to our desire to bring about change. But to see that Africans are the hardest hit by climate change, even though they generate almost no greenhouse gas, is a glaring injustice, which also triggers anger and outrage over those who seek to ignore it.
2190.name: Sigmar Gabriel

2191.quote: I've spent a lot of time and money trying to keep my anger in control.
2191.name: Yancy Butler

2192.quote: Fear is the only true enemy, born of ignorance and the parent of anger and hate.
2192.name: Edward Albert

2193.quote: The anger of a person who is strong, can always bide its time.
2193.name: James Whitcomb Riley

2194.quote: Anger begins with folly, and ends with repentance.
2194.name: Beverly Sills

2195.quote: I am ready to accept all accusations, allegations, anger - but I have to succeed.
2195.name: Boris Trajkovski

2196.quote: Indulge not thyself in the passion of anger it is whetting a sword to wound thine own breast, or murder thy friend.
2196.name: Akhenaton

2197.quote: I guess lyrically they're similar because they're talking about escaping the kind of misery that likes company. 'The Last One Alive,' for me, is very simple. It's just about alienation, really, that causes anger.
2197.name: Jon Crosby

2198.quote: What if you threw a protest and no one showed up? The lack of angst and anger and emotion is a big positive.
2198.name: Jay Alan Sekulow

2199.quote: I did not think that I was angry, but clearly anger was reflected in my writing. I did not think that I had been affected emotionally, but it was clear from my writing that I was still very emotional about the trial some six months after it ended.
2199.name: Christopher Darden

2200.quote: Every child senses, with all the horse sense that's in him, that any parent is angry inside when children misbehave and they dread more the anger that is rarely or never expressed openly, wondering how awful it might be.
2200.name: Benjamin Spock

2201.quote: I was never jailed. The fact is that I was arrested, but I went into a diversion programme, and by that time I'd already begun working in what was called anger management. It was a painful and awful moment.
2201.name: David Soul

2202.quote: Keep your temper. A decision made in anger is never sound.
2202.name: Ford Frick

2203.quote: Because society would rather we always wore a pretty face, women have been trained to cut off anger.
2203.name: Nancy Friday

2204.quote: Unless and until Barack Obama addresses the full depth of Americans' anger with his full arsenal of policy smarts and political gifts, his presidency and, worse, our economy will be paralyzed.
2204.name: Frank Rich

2205.quote: The Anger Management Tour was another beautiful thing. I loved that tour.
2205.name: Obie Trice

2206.quote: I've always turned my anger inwards towards self-destruction.
2206.name: Mackenzie Phillips

2207.quote: Our task, of course, is to transmute the anger that is affliction into the anger that is determination to bring about change. I think, in fact, that one could give that as a definition of revolution.
2207.name: Barbara Deming

2208.quote: Bosnia is under my skin. It's the place you cannot leave behind. I was obsessed by the nightmare of it all there was this sense of guilt, and an anger that has become something much deeper over these last years.
2208.name: Paddy Ashdown

2209.quote: Our second phase was to develop a school curriculum that teaches tolerance, respect for differences, conflict resolution, anger management, and other attributes of peace.
2209.name: Eddie Bernice Johnson

2210.quote: The American people are smart. They've gotten sick of the predictable hyperpartisan talking points and canned anger.
2210.name: John Avlon

2211.quote: I share the anger, but, ultimately, to govern this country, it takes more than anger. It takes experience. It takes positions that reflect the best values of the American people.
2211.name: Joe Lieberman

2212.quote: If either player abandon the game by quitting the table in anger, or in an otherwise offensive manner or by momentarily resigning the game or refuses to abide by the decision of the Umpire, the game must be scored against him.
2212.name: Howard Staunton

2213.quote: After my second-to-last record, 'The Greatest', I had gone on tour for a while, and I didn't play an instrument for about five years. And I got kind of - it's not self-esteem or whatever, or anger toward myself - but disappointed in myself that I hadn't been challenging myself to learn musically.
2213.name: Cat Power

2214.quote: That feeds anger, and I mean when we went and at last thank heavens got towards peace in Northern Ireland we went for justice within Northern Ireland as well as using security well, as well as a political settlement, but surely that is the lesson.
2214.name: Clare Short

2215.quote: And we know there has been horrendous loss of life and suffering and we know that there is anger. Anyone who came anywhere near the general election in constituencies with a substantial Muslim population knows that.
2215.name: Clare Short

2216.quote: Anger may be kindled in the noblest breasts: but in these slow droppings of an unforgiving temper never takes the shape of consistency of enduring hatred.
2216.name: M. Kathleen Casey

2217.quote: I've chosen my wedding ring large and heavy to continue forever. But exactly because of that all the time that Dave and I have an argument I feel it like handcuffs, and on anger time I throw it in a basket. Poor Dave, he bought me three wedding rings already!
2217.name: Carmen Miranda

2218.quote: So many women keep their anger inside and let it build until they explode and then people blow them off again.
2218.name: Rosalind Wiseman

2220.quote: I also had to work through the violation of my date rape, my unhealthy relationships with men, my anger toward the people involved in the scandal, and those who exploited me afterwards.
2220.name: Donna Rice

2221.quote: Fairest and dearest, your wrath and anger are more heavy than I can bear but learn that I cannot tell what you wish me to say without sinning against my honour too grievously.
2221.name: Marie de France

2222.quote: Violence is a problem we all want to solve. I want to make sure that kids learn to deal with anger by learning how to talk with people to solve problems. Here in the United States Senate I want to make sure we have safe schools, safe neighborhoods and good things for kids to do after school!
2222.name: Patty Murray

2223.quote: My heart has been heavy and I have deliberated within my own conscience, knowing that my decision should not come out of my initial emotion of anger toward the President for such reckless behavior, but should be based on the facts.
2223.name: Blanche Lincoln

2224.quote: Insurgents have capitalized on popular resentment and anger towards the United States and the Iraqi government to build their own political, financial and military support, and the faith of Iraqi citizens in their new government has been severely undermined.
2224.name: Tom Lantos

2225.quote: I had a lot of anger inside me and that came out at times that were not particularly advantageous to me career-wise.
2225.name: Mickey Rourke

2226.quote: Another night, I dreamed I saw my father sweeping out the barn floor clean, and would not suffer the wheat to be brought in the barn. He appeared to me to be in anger.
2226.name: Joanna Southcott

2227.quote: Us investigators who went out into the field were faced on occasion with a lot of anger, by people saying why has it taken you five or six year to come and see me?
2227.name: Tony Greig

2228.quote: I like people and get along, and I'm afraid to express my anger and my rage.
2228.name: Fisher Stevens

2229.quote: I was shocked at the anger toward me.
2229.name: Bernadine Dohrn

2230.quote: My anger with the US was not at first, that they had used that weapon - although that anger came later.
2230.name: Wilfred Burchett

2231.quote: A little anger is a good thing if it isn't on your own behalf, if it's for others deserving of your anger, your empathy.
2231.name: David Simon

2232.quote: The anger that Uncle Junior has comes from my background. My father was the son of an Italian immigrant, and I've seen the fire of the Italian temperament. It can be explosive sometimes in ways that are both funny and tragic.
2232.name: Dominic Chianese

2233.quote: The quickest way to defuse fear or insecurity or anger is usually humor. I think comics figure that out quickly, and, once you figure it out, you think, 'Hey, if I can do this and get paid, that would be kind of cool.'
2233.name: Billy Gardell

2234.quote: I may have been the only candidate in America who failed to ride the wave of anti-establishment anger to victory.
2234.name: Mickey Kaus

2235.quote: The preparation, commitment and desire to win will be no less than the last time I drove a grand prix car in anger.
2235.name: Nigel Mansell

2236.quote: There's no anger ever in a spiritual. There's always the dream of a hope of a better day coming. That God understands the troubles that I'm experiencing.
2236.name: Jessye Norman

2237.quote: I want to express myself to feel that what I feel is real. My joy, my pain, my anger.
2237.name: Annabella Sciorra

2238.quote: It absolutely helped - to write the father in both 'Juicy' and 'Beasts,' I had to see the whole story from his point of view. All of a sudden I understood more of what my own father must be going through - the fear, the frustration, the anger, the hope that he'll leave a legacy.
2238.name: Lucy Alibar

2239.quote: Whoever incites anger has a strong insurance against indifference.
2239.name: Philip Stanhope

2240.quote: I think a certain amount of anger has been a fuel of mine, if you want - but also some sort of sadness, and plain mischief, of course.
2240.name: Siouxsie Sioux

2241.quote: The reason why I love people, and writing about them, is because they don't always respond with hate and anger. If they did I wouldn't have a story to tell. Who wants to know about someone who was brutalised and became brutal? I'm interested in the exceptions.
2241.name: Chris Cleave

2242.quote: You can survive with anger, but you can't live with it forever.
2242.name: Ariel Dorfman

2243.quote: The nice thing about anger is that, as an emotion, it's strong enough to unplug me from the comedian's mind for a minute and just be a frustrated member of the citizenry.
2243.name: Seth Meyers

2244.quote: I think people should be angry at things that are worthy of anger. Injustice is outrageous and deserves outrage.
2244.name: Chris Hayes

2245.quote: Successful prime-time television of any genre produces some kind of emotional reaction in the viewers. There are a lot of different emotions to tap into. The emotion of the reward of discovery, the feeling of righteous anger, the feelings of pathos and sadness, or sentimentality of being moved by something.
2245.name: Chris Hayes

2246.quote: My character had been in the chair for seven years. He had gone through his anger, depression, drug and alcohol abuse. He had gone through everything, now he was up, he was happy, he was filled with his dream.
2246.name: Gregory Hines

2247.quote: I realised one day that men are emotional cripples. We can't express ourselves emotionally, we can only do it with anger and humour. Emotional stability and expression comes from women.
2247.name: Bob Hoskins

2248.quote: My hope is that out of all the anger and seeming hostility that we hear in some of today's music will come some sort of coalition that will become politically involved.
2248.name: Roberta Flack

2249.quote: I'm not angry, I'm not an angry person, but I do sometimes like playing with the perception of anger, as in pretending that I'm more angry than I actually am, and sometimes it works quite well.
2249.name: Calvin Harris

2250.quote: With Stacy, it was interesting because you know he was within all this chaos, all these different lives that were so broken and so much anger and so much frustration and their skating came out of that, their different styles came out of that.
2250.name: John Robinson

2251.quote: I use the music to vent, and a lot of the stuff that I am writing about or was writing about contained a lot of anger and anxiety, stress and depression, so that's how the album came out so dark.
2251.name: Vanilla Ice

2252.quote: I don't think I could play a character that I couldn't relate to somehow. I'm not unfamiliar with frustration, anger, shame, helplessness and a load of other emotions that make up our psycho-soup. I try to focus on that frustration, that sense of unfairness, and multiply it.
2252.name: Terry O'Quinn

2253.quote: I'm really busted up over this and I'm very, very sorry to those people in the audience, the blacks, the Hispanics, whites - everyone that was there that took the brunt of that anger and hate and rage and how it came through.
2253.name: Michael Richards

2254.quote: The anger that appears to be building up between the sexes becomes more virulent with every day that passes. And far from women taking the blame, the fact is that men are invariably portrayed as the bad guys. Being a good man is like being a good Nazi.
2254.name: Dave Thomas

2255.quote: For a long time I thought I could deal with my anger and hostility on my own. But I couldn't. I denied that it had affected me, and yet I was so frantic on the inside with other people: I needed to be constantly reassured.
2255.name: Kelly McGillis

2256.quote: The poor monkey, quietly seated on the ground, seemed to be in sore trouble at this display of anger.
2256.name: Henry Walter Bates

2257.quote: It is only with burning anger that we can speak of this attack by counter-revolutionary reactionary elements against the capital of our country, against our people's democratic order and the power of the working class.
2257.name: Janos Kadar

2258.quote: The anger in the Brigade against those who fought the Republic in the rear was sharpened by reports of weapons, even tanks, being kept from the front and hidden for treacherous purposes.
2258.name: Bill Alexander

2259.quote: In the final analysis, the incident is seen as originating from an emotional expression of the frustration and anger of the proud people of China who had been subject to ever increasing oppression from without and decadent corruption from within.
2259.name: Chen Ning Yang

2260.quote: Our humor turns our anger into a fine art.
2260.name: Mary Kay Blakely

2261.quote: Anger is implanted in us as sort of sting, to make us gnash with our teeth against the devil, to make us vehement against him, not to set us in array against each other.
2261.name: Richard Savage

2262.quote: When anger rushes unrestrained to action, like a hot steed, it stumbles on its way. The man of thought strikes deepest and strikes safely.
2262.name: Richard Savage

2263.quote: I think that all the anger and cynicism comes from suppressing things that we always wanted.
2263.name: John Lee Hancock

2264.quote: There is not in nature, a thing that makes man so deformed, so beastly, as doth intemperate anger.
2264.name: Alan Bleasdale

2265.quote: In the heat of our campaigns, we have all become accustomed to a little anger and exaggeration. Yet, on the whole, our political process has served us well.
2265.name: Edmund S. Muskie

2266.quote: I don't have the feeling of being motivated by anger, revenge or frustration.
2266.name: Agnes Obel

2267.quote: Anger is seldom without argument but seldom with a good one.
2267.name: Lord Halifax

2268.quote: As a system of philosophy it is not like the Tower of Babel, so daring its high aim as to seek a shelter against God's anger but it is like a pyramid poised on its apex.
2268.name: Adam Sedgwick

2269.quote: Anger becomes limiting, restricting. You can't see through it. While anger is there, look at that, too. But after a while, you have to look at something else.
2269.name: Thylias Moss

2270.quote: I love each and every one of you but, like my own family, you thrill, you frustrate, you anger.
2270.name: John Buchanan

2271.quote: More marriages might survive if the partners realized that sometimes the better comes after the worse.
2271.name: Doug Larson

2272.quote: We are not the same persons this year as last nor are those we love. It is a happy chance if we, changing, continue to love a changed person.
2272.name: W. Somerset Maugham

2273.quote: There is no more lovely, friendly and charming relationship, communion or company than a good marriage.
2273.name: Martin Luther

2274.quote: Marriage is the most natural state of man, and, the state in which you will find solid happiness.
2274.name: Benjamin Franklin

2275.quote: Marriage is an alliance entered into by a man who can't sleep with the window shut, and a woman who can't sleep with the window open.
2275.name: George Bernard Shaw

2276.quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
2276.name: Marilyn Monroe

2277.quote: The heart of marriage is memories and if the two of you happen to have the same ones and can savor your reruns, then your marriage is a gift from the gods.
2277.name: Bill Cosby

2278.quote: Mom and Dad were married 64 years. And if you wondered what their secret was, you could have asked the local florist - because every day Dad gave Mom a rose, which he put on her bedside table. That's how she found out what happened on the day my father died - she went looking for him because that morning, there was no rose.
2278.name: Mitt Romney

2279.quote: Strike an average between what a woman thinks of her husband a month before she marries him and what she thinks of him a year afterward, and you will have the truth about him.
2279.name: H. L. Mencken

2280.quote: Marriage is an act of will that signifies and involves a mutual gift, which unites the spouses and binds them to their eventual souls, with whom they make up a sole family - a domestic church.
2280.name: Pope John Paul II

2281.quote: A wedding anniversary is the celebration of love, trust, partnership, tolerance and tenacity. The order varies for any given year.
2281.name: Paul Sweeney

2282.quote: The secret of a happy marriage is finding the right person. You know they're right if you love to be with them all the time.
2282.name: Julia Child

2283.quote: You will reciprocally promise love, loyalty and matrimonial honesty. We only want for you this day that these words constitute the principle of your entire life and that with the help of divine grace you will observe these solemn vows that today, before God, you formulate.
2283.name: Pope John Paul II

2284.quote: Some people ask the secret of our long marriage. We take time to go to a restaurant two times a week. A little candlelight, dinner, soft music and dancing. She goes Tuesdays, I go Fridays.
2284.name: Henny Youngman

2285.quote: Why does a woman work ten years to change a man's habits and then complain that he's not the man she married?
2285.name: Barbra Streisand

2286.quote: The concept of two people living together for 25 years without a serious dispute suggests a lack of spirit only to be admired in sheep.
2286.name: A. P. Herbert

2287.quote: One should believe in marriage as in the immortality of the soul.
2287.name: Honore de Balzac

2288.quote: A lot of good love can happen in ten years.
2288.name: Jim Carrey

2289.quote: Chains do not hold a marriage together. It is threads, hundreds of tiny threads, which sew people together through the years.
2289.name: Simone Signoret

2290.quote: Under this window in stormy weather I marry this man and woman together Let none but Him who rules the thunder Put this man and woman asunder.
2290.name: Jonathan Swift

2291.quote: The bonds of matrimony are like any other bonds - they mature slowly.
2291.name: Peter De Vries

2292.quote: I've been in love with the same woman for forty-one years. If my wife finds out, she'll kill me.
2292.name: Henny Youngman

2293.quote: Never tell a secret to a bride or a groom wait until they have been married longer.
2293.name: E. W. Howe

2294.quote: I think you have to be willing to take a bullet for somebody if you're going to stand up there, take your vows, and be married to them for the rest of your life.
2294.name: Blake Shelton

2295.quote: If you love somebody, you love them. My parents had a 25-year age gap between them and my mum was the breadwinner, my dad the house husband. I'm a strong believer that a good relationship can work, whatever the situation.
2295.name: Katherine Jenkins

2296.quote: Married people from my generation are like an endangered species!
2296.name: Patrice Leconte

2297.quote: That there's no more important decision in life than who you marry.
2297.name: Brad Paisley

2298.quote: Marriage is a coming together for better or for worse, hopefully enduring, and intimate to the degree of being sacred.
2298.name: William O. Douglas

2299.quote: You marry somebody you love everything about them. You grow to learn about them. You never learn everything.
2299.name: Chris Daughtry

2300.quote: Love is not weakness. It is strong. Only the sacrament of marriage can contain it.
2300.name: Boris Pasternak

2301.quote: My mother and stepfather were married 43 years, so I have watched a long marriage. I feel like I had a very good role model for that. And, you know, it's just a number.
2301.name: Jamie Lee Curtis

2302.quote: Love grows more tremendously full, swift, poignant, as the years multiply.
2302.name: Zane Grey

2303.quote: Each year on the anniversary of Martin Luther King Jr.'s birth, America has the opportunity to reflect on our nation's progress towards the realization of his dream.
2303.name: Adam Schiff

2304.quote: So I think you have to marry for the right reasons, and marry the right person.
2304.name: Anne Bancroft

2305.quote: Next month, I will celebrate my 30th anniversary of marriage with my beautiful bride, Vicki. Our marriage has been a blessing. I have gained even more respect for the institution over the past 3 decades and will defend it against attack.
2305.name: Todd Tiahrt

2306.quote: But to sustain a marriage for 50 years, you have to get real a little bit and find someone who is understanding and who you can grow with. My mom always says, 'Marry the man who loves you a millimeter more.'
2306.name: Ali Larter

2307.quote: We had a relationship that lasted 44 years. Herbert and I lived together 10 years before we were married. He always gave me a little heart for whatever anniversary.
2307.name: Uta Hagen

2308.quote: The day before the anniversary of D-Day, we lost a man who was equaled by few and surpassed by none as a leader in the cause of freedom: Ronald Reagan.
2308.name: Mac Thornberry

2309.quote: Last week, the House of Representatives passed a resolution honoring the victims and heroes of September 11th. As we commemorate the anniversary of 9-11, we must also remember that the threat is still very real today.
2309.name: Michael McCaul

2310.quote: Since I wrote to you last we have got our chapel beautifully lighted with gas and have had our anniversary.
2310.name: John Hawley

2311.quote: So while an incredible amount of progress has been made, on this fifth anniversary, I wanted to come here and tell the people of this city directly: My administration is going to stand with you - and fight alongside you - until the job is done. Until New Orleans is all the way back, all the way.
2311.name: Barack Obama

2312.quote: I've been sober for two-and-a-half years, My children are happy. In August, my wife and I will celebrate our fifteenth wedding anniversary. My band is back together with a sold-out tour.
2312.name: Trey Anastasio

2313.quote: I have for some time urged that a nuclear abolition summit to mark the effective end of the nuclear era be convened in Hiroshima and Nagasaki on the 70th anniversary of the bombings of those cities, with the participation of national leaders and representatives of global civil society.
2313.name: Daisaku Ikeda

2314.quote: And this year is going to be the 25th anniversary of the 17-0 team, the only undefeated season.
2314.name: Don Shula

2315.quote: The London games mark the 24th anniversary of my winning two golds and setting the world record in the heptathlon. Someone is going to want it records are made to be broken - it's only a matter of time. I hope mine will outlive me.
2315.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

2316.quote: We can't forget what happened on May 4th, 1970, when four students gave up their lives because they had the American constitutional right of peaceful protest. They gave up their lives. And to sing that song in that spot on that anniversary was very emotional for us.
2316.name: Graham Nash

2317.quote: See, the 'On the Road' that came out in 1957 was censored. A lot of the honesty of it, the bitter honesty, is in the original scroll version that came out in 2007 on the 50-year anniversary. Back then, there was so much post-Second World War fear that was imposed on everybody - 'You must live life this way' - and these guys were bored.
2317.name: Garrett Hedlund

2318.quote: The chances of a reunion now are less likely. I was thinking of having a 40th anniversary of the band, but now they are really another band, so it's all a bit weird.
2318.name: Alvin Lee

2319.quote: On this important anniversary, we must remember that while we have come a long way in eliminating barriers, critical work remains to ensure all Americans can live up to their full potential.
2319.name: Jim Ramstad

2320.quote: And currently, there are four to five new works in the pipeline for upcoming celebrations such as the Sydney 2000 Olympics, Australian Federation, my 50th Birthday, and Sydney Dance Company's 25th Anniversary.
2320.name: Graeme Murphy

2321.quote: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to recognize the Peace Corps as it reached its 45th anniversary on March 1, 2006.
2321.name: Solomon Ortiz

2322.quote: Perhaps a hundred people assembled one evening, May 15, 1876, at the time when the country was celebrating the hundredth anniversary of its political independence.
2322.name: Felix Adler

2323.quote: Presently, the Commission for Commemorating 350 Years of American Jewish History has been brought about to encourage and sponsor a variety of historical activities that advance our understanding of the American Jewish experience as it marks this milestone anniversary.
2323.name: Jon Porter

2324.quote: I am so excited this year getting to play the 85th Anniversary Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. Everyone knows on Thanksgiving morning to get up, turn on the TV and watch the parade, so to be an actual participant is going to be fun and I'm looking forward to it. I am gonna have to put on my deer hunting gear, though, to stay warm!
2324.name: Rodney Atkins

2325.quote: I was always very grateful to 'em and am grateful to 'em now. I went back a couple of years ago and did their 20th anniversary show. But the longer I stayed on Hee Haw, the worse things got for me musically.
2325.name: Buck Owens

2326.quote: June 2005 is the five year anniversary of the debut of Battle Pope.
2326.name: Robert Kirkman

2327.quote: It is a matter of public shame that while we have now commemorated our hundredth anniversary, not one in every ten children attending Public schools throughout the colonies is acquainted with a single historical fact about Australia.
2327.name: Henry Lawson

2328.quote: As the third anniversary of the September 11th attacks draws near we must ensure our nation is prepared to handle the continued threat of violence and terrorism on our country.
2328.name: Leonard Boswell

2329.quote: This anniversary serves to help remind the American people that, in the wake of one of the greatest political scandals and misuse of power in our history as a nation, scandal produced important reforms that served this nation well for two decades.
2329.name: Elliot Richardson

2330.quote: I didn't make my first solo record until 1981 so I don't have any 60's or 70's recordings but I am working on a large boxed set called DUST to be released next year, the 20th anniversary of my first solo record.
2330.name: Adrian Belew

2331.quote: Actually, the year anniversary of what you just heard, my son Grahame and I are going to be in a play together, and I'm acting for the first time in front of an audience that doesn't consist of a high school drama class.
2331.name: Phil Lesh

2332.quote: This year, as we celebrate the 230th anniversary of America's independence, please remember the symbols that are sacred to this country. Fly Old Glory high and show your respect and admiration for this great nation and the values we hold dear.
2332.name: Kenny Marchant

2333.quote: On July 18, we will mark the 12th anniversary of the senseless loss of 85 lives in the bombing of the Jewish Cultural Center in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
2333.name: Tom Lantos

2334.quote: I did that Dior Couture 60th anniversary show in July. It took so long to get ready, I think I would have rather been watching.
2334.name: Linda Evangelista

2335.quote: I feel there should have been some recognition of the Spice Girls at this year's 25th anniversary. We flew the flag for Britain around the globe in the 1990s and we achieved a hell of a lot.
2335.name: Melanie Chisholm

2336.quote: It was very hard for all of us. It's still very hard. The anniversary of his death just passed, and every single one of his friends, still, after all these years, it's unbelievable.
2336.name: Eydie Gorme

2337.quote: My last trip to New Orleans was for the fifth anniversary of Katrina, and I had the awesome opportunity to bring my family down. We all worked on a house together and met some of the families.
2337.name: AnnaLynne McCord

2338.quote: 1 month ago the American people stopped to remember the third anniversary of the beginning of the Iraq war. We thought first and foremost of the selflessness, patriotism and heroism by our troops, our National Guard and Reserves.
2338.name: Rosa DeLauro

2339.quote: Both the Obama and Romney campaigns said they pulled all their political ads today in observance of the September 11th anniversary. But politics wasn't very far offstage. The Obama campaign sees foreign policy as an advantage this year.
2339.name: Mara Liasson

2340.quote: The 150th anniversary of Penn State will highlight what is important and good about this distinguished institution and the fine people and research that it produces.
2340.name: Don Sherwood

2341.quote: We shape our buildings thereafter they shape us.
2341.name: Winston Churchill

2342.quote: Whatever good things we build end up building us.
2342.name: Jim Rohn

2343.quote: I don't build in order to have clients. I have clients in order to build.
2343.name: Ayn Rand

2344.quote: A building has integrity just like a man. And just as seldom.
2344.name: Ayn Rand

2345.quote: Every great architect is - necessarily - a great poet. He must be a great original interpreter of his time, his day, his age.
2345.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

2346.quote: We require from buildings two kinds of goodness: first, the doing their practical duty well: then that they be graceful and pleasing in doing it.
2346.name: John Ruskin

2347.quote: An architect's most useful tools are an eraser at the drafting board, and a wrecking bar at the site.
2347.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

2348.quote: Light, God's eldest daughter, is a principal beauty in a building.
2348.name: Thomas Fuller

2349.quote: Architecture should speak of its time and place, but yearn for timelessness.
2349.name: Frank Gehry

2351.quote: I don't divide architecture, landscape and gardening to me they are one.
2351.name: Luis Barragan

2352.quote: Architecture is the art of how to waste space.
2352.name: Philip Johnson

2353.quote: My passion and great enjoyment for architecture, and the reason the older I get the more I enjoy it, is because I believe we - architects - can effect the quality of life of the people.
2353.name: Richard Rogers

2354.quote: Building art is a synthesis of life in materialised form. We should try to bring in under the same hat not a splintered way of thinking, but all in harmony together.
2354.name: Alvar Aalto

2355.quote: The higher the building the lower the morals.
2355.name: Noel Coward

2356.quote: A house is a machine for living in.
2356.name: Le Corbusier

2357.quote: A great building must begin with the unmeasurable, must go through measurable means when it is being designed and in the end must be unmeasurable.
2357.name: Louis Kahn

2358.quote: Those who look for the laws of Nature as a support for their new works collaborate with the creator.
2358.name: Antonio Gaudi

2359.quote: Architecture is basically a container of something. I hope they will enjoy not so much the teacup, but the tea.
2359.name: Yoshio Taniguchi

2360.quote: Architecture is the learned game, correct and magnificent, of forms assembled in the light.
2360.name: Le Corbusier

2361.quote: I believe that the way people live can be directed a little by architecture.
2361.name: Tadao Ando

2362.quote: Space has always been the spiritual dimension of architecture. It is not the physical statement of the structure so much as what it contains that moves us.
2362.name: Arthur Erickson

2363.quote: Great buildings that move the spirit have always been rare. In every case they are unique, poetic, products of the heart.
2363.name: Arthur Erickson

2364.quote: Architecture starts when you carefully put two bricks together. There it begins.
2364.name: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

2365.quote: I try to give people a different way of looking at their surroundings. That's art to me.
2365.name: Maya Lin

2366.quote: Architecture is the reaching out for the truth.
2366.name: Louis Kahn

2367.quote: We should concentrate our work not only to a separated housing problem but housing involved in our daily work and all the other functions of the city.
2367.name: Alvar Aalto

2368.quote: Make big plans aim high in hope and work, remembering that a noble, logical diagram once recorded will not die.
2368.name: Daniel Burnham

2369.quote: Architecture arouses sentiments in man. The architect's task therefore, is to make those sentiments more precise.
2369.name: Adolf Loos

2370.quote: To provide meaningful architecture is not to parody history but to articulate it.
2370.name: Daniel Libeskind

2371.quote: To me, a building - if it's beautiful - is the love of one man, he's made it out of his love for space, materials, things like that.
2371.name: Martha Graham

2372.quote: Form follows profit is the aesthetic principle of our times.
2372.name: Richard Rogers

2373.quote: Warmth isn't what minimalists are thought to have.
2373.name: Maya Lin

2374.quote: But the building's identity resided in the ornament.
2374.name: Louis Sullivan

2375.quote: It is not the beauty of a building you should look at its the construction of the foundation that will stand the test of time.
2375.name: David Allan Coe

2376.quote: I hate vacations. If you can build buildings, why sit on the beach?
2376.name: Philip Johnson

2377.quote: A city building, you experience when you walk a suburban building, you experience when you drive.
2377.name: Helmut Jahn

2378.quote: Every building is a prototype. No two are alike.
2378.name: Helmut Jahn

2379.quote: The loftier the building, the deeper must the foundation be laid.
2379.name: Thomas a Kempis

2380.quote: I love building spaces: architecture, furniture, all of it, probably more than fashion. The development procedure is more tactile. It's about space and form and it's something you can share with other people.
2380.name: Donna Karan

2381.quote: Architecture is a visual art, and the buildings speak for themselves.
2381.name: Julia Morgan

2382.quote: We build buildings which are terribly restless. And buildings don't go anywhere. They shouldn't be restless.
2382.name: Minoru Yamasaki

2383.quote: Architecture tends to consume everything else, it has become one's entire life.
2383.name: Arne Jacobsen

2384.quote: What people want, above all, is order.
2384.name: Stephen Gardiner

2385.quote: The interior of the house personifies the private world the exterior of it is part of the outside world.
2385.name: Stephen Gardiner

2386.quote: If you give people nothingness, they can ponder what can be achieved from that nothingness.
2386.name: Tadao Ando

2387.quote: Nothing requires the architect's care more than the due proportions of buildings.
2387.name: Marcus V. Pollio

2388.quote: Proportions are what makes the old Greek temples classic in their beauty. They are like huge blocks, from which the air has been literally hewn out between the columns.
2388.name: Arne Jacobsen

2389.quote: Architecture is not an inspirational business, it's a rational procedure to do sensible and hopefully beautiful things that's all.
2389.name: Harry Seidler

2390.quote: Not many architects have the luxury to reject significant things.
2390.name: Rem Koolhaas

2391.quote: Cities are the greatest creations of humanity.
2391.name: Daniel Libeskind

2392.quote: No architect troubled to design houses that suited people who were to live in them, because that would have meant building a whole range of different houses. It was far cheaper and, above all, timesaving to make them identical.
2392.name: Michael Ende

2393.quote: If I have a style, I am not aware of it.
2393.name: Michael Graves

2394.quote: Don't clap too hard - it's a very old building.
2394.name: John Osborne

2396.quote: The work of art shows people new directions and thinks of the future. The house thinks of the present.
2396.name: Adolf Loos

2397.quote: My buildings don't speak in words but by means of their own spaciousness.
2397.name: Thom Mayne

2398.quote: Designed by architects with honorable intentions but hands of palsy.
2398.name: Jimmy Breslin

2399.quote: The dialogue between client and architect is about as intimate as any conversation you can have, because when you're talking about building a house, you're talking about dreams.
2399.name: Robert A. M. Stern

2400.quote: The Romans were not inventors of the supporting arch, but its extended use in vaults and intersecting barrel shapes and domes is theirs.
2400.name: Harry Seidler

2401.quote: The bungalow had more to do with how Americans live today than any other building that has gone remotely by the name of architecture in our history.
2401.name: Russell Lynes

2402.quote: Color in certain places has the great value of making the outlines and structural planes seem more energetic.
2402.name: Antonio Gaudi

2403.quote: In any architecture, there is an equity between the pragmatic function and the symbolic function.
2403.name: Michael Graves

2404.quote: At a certain point, I just put the building and the art impulse together. I decided that building was a legitimate way to make sculpture.
2404.name: Martin Puryear

2405.quote: For many years, I have lived uncomfortably with the belief that most planning and architectural design suffers for lack of real and basic purpose. The ultimate purpose, it seems to me, must be the improvement of mankind.
2405.name: James Rouse

2406.quote: The frightening thought that what you draw may become a building makes for reasoned lines.
2406.name: Saul Steinberg

2407.quote: Buildings should serve people, not the other way around.
2407.name: John Portman

2408.quote: Architects in the past have tended to concentrate their attention on the building as a static object. I believe dynamics are more important: the dynamics of people, their interaction with spaces and environmental condition.
2408.name: John Portman

2409.quote: My buildings will be my legacy, they will speak for me long after I'm gone.
2409.name: Julia Morgan

2410.quote: In Los Angeles, by the time you're 35, you're older than most of the buildings.
2410.name: Delia Ephron

2411.quote: Rome has not seen a modern building in more than half a century. It is a city frozen in time.
2411.name: Richard Meier

2412.quote: Even at the United Nations, where legend has it that the building was designed so that there could be no corner offices, the expanse of glass in individual offices is said to be a dead giveaway as to rank. Five windows are excellent, one window not so great.
2412.name: Enid Nemy

2413.quote: I have designed the most buildings of any living American architect.
2413.name: Alexander Jackson Davis

2414.quote: I am but an architectural composer.
2414.name: Alexander Jackson Davis

2415.quote: As a designer, the mission with which we have been charged is simple: providing space at the right cost.
2415.name: Harry von Zell

2416.quote: They can do without architecture who have no olives nor wines in the cellar.
2416.name: Henry David Thoreau

2418.quote: Fashion is architecture: it is a matter of proportions.
2418.name: Coco Chanel

2419.quote: The greatest advances of civilization, whether in architecture or painting, in science and literature, in industry or agriculture, have never come from centralized government.
2419.name: Milton Friedman

2420.quote: I paint mostly from real life. It has to start with that. Real people, real street scenes, behind the curtain scenes, live models, paintings, photographs, staged setups, architecture, grids, graphic design. Whatever it takes to make it work.
2420.name: Bob Dylan

2421.quote: Prose is architecture, not interior decoration, and the Baroque is over.
2421.name: Ernest Hemingway

2422.quote: Switzerland is a small, steep country, much more up and down than sideways, and is all stuck over with large brown hotels built on the cuckoo clock style of architecture.
2422.name: Ernest Hemingway

2423.quote: The ancient Romans built their greatest masterpieces of architecture, their amphitheaters, for wild beasts to fight in.
2423.name: Voltaire
