3409.name: Jack Nicholson

3410.quote: I realize that every picture isn't a work of art.
3410.name: Conrad Hall

3411.quote: To be honest, I sort of feel like 'movie actor' isn't of this time. I love it. But it's a 20th-century art form.
3411.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

3412.quote: I view art as an inspirational tool.
3412.name: Thomas Kincade

3413.quote: What is art but a way of seeing?
3413.name: Saul Bellow

3414.quote: Any fool can have bad luck the art consists in knowing how to exploit it.
3414.name: Frank Wedekind

3415.quote: Good art provides people with a vocabulary about things they can't articulate.
3415.name: Mos Def

3416.quote: It has taken me years of struggle, hard work and research to learn to make one simple gesture, and I know enough about the art of writing to realize that it would take as many years of concentrated effort to write one simple, beautiful sentence.
3416.name: Isadora Duncan

3417.quote: Art may imitate life, but life imitates TV.
3417.name: Ani DiFranco

3418.quote: Celebrity doesn't have anything to do with art or craft. It's about being rich and thinking that you're better than everybody else.
3418.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

3419.quote: It is commonly supposed that the art of pleasing is a wonderful aid in the pursuit of fortune but the art of being bored is infinitely more successful.
3419.name: Nicolas Chamfort

3420.quote: I've sort of escaped my background, as people often do, through art and culture.
3420.name: Danny Boyle

3421.quote: It is the glory and good of Art, That Art remains the one way possible Of speaking truth, to mouths like mine at least.
3421.name: Robert Browning

3422.quote: The art of the parenthesis is one of the greatest secrets of eloquence in Society.
3422.name: Nicolas Chamfort

3423.quote: The worst state of affairs is when science begins to concern itself with art.
3423.name: Paul Klee

3424.quote: I was the hero of the young insurgent working class art movement.
3424.name: Elia Kazan

3425.quote: Thou art my single day, God lends to leaven What were all earth else, with a feel of heaven.
3425.name: Robert Browning

3426.quote: The art of being sick is not the same as the art of getting well.
3426.name: Tony Snow

3427.quote: Poetry is emotion put into measure. The emotion must come by nature, but the measure can be acquired by art.
3427.name: Thomas Hardy

3428.quote: I'd like to introduce someone who has just come into my life. I've admired him for 35 years. He's someone who represents integrity, honesty, art, and on top of that stuff I'm actually sleeping with him.
3428.name: Shirley MacLaine

3429.quote: An art whose medium is language will always show a high degree of critical creativeness, for speech is itself a critique of life: it names, it characterizes, it passes judgment, in that it creates.
3429.name: Thomas Mann

3430.quote: Art is nothing but the expression of our dream the more we surrender to it the closer we get to the inner truth of things, our dream-life, the true life that scorns questions and does not see them.
3430.name: Franz Marc

3431.quote: The art of communication is the language of leadership.
3431.name: James Humes

3432.quote: I love to collect modern art.
3432.name: Maria Sharapova

3433.quote: For nine years I worked to change what was hairdressing then into a geometric art form with color, perm without setting which had never been done before.
3433.name: Vidal Sassoon

3434.quote: I choose films for their artistic value. I don't need a mansion or a Jaguar. When I leave this Earth, I won't take any money with me. All I will leave behind will be my art.
3434.name: Brad Renfro

3435.quote: Alchemy is the art of far and near, and I think poetry is alchemy in that way. It's delightful to distort size, to see something that's tiny as though it were vast.
3435.name: Robert Morgan

3436.quote: Only in men's imagination does every truth find an effective and undeniable existence. Imagination, not invention, is the supreme master of art as of life.
3436.name: Joseph Conrad

3437.quote: The idea of avant-garde art is a very suspicious thing to me, the idea that poetry is new and it keeps being new the way Chevrolets every year are new.
3437.name: Robert Morgan

3438.quote: Any work that aspires, however humbly, to the condition of art should carry its justification in every line.
3438.name: Joseph Conrad

3439.quote: When thou art at Rome, do as they do at Rome.
3439.name: Miguel de Cervantes

3440.quote: Rock isn't art, it's the way ordinary people talk.
3440.name: Billy Idol

3441.quote: Tell me thy company, and I'll tell thee what thou art.
3441.name: Miguel de Cervantes

3442.quote: Book-jacket design may become a lost art, like album-cover design, without which late-20th-century iconography would have been pauperized.
3442.name: James Wolcott

3443.quote: Art is nature speeded up and God slowed down.
3443.name: Malcolm De Chazal

3444.quote: There was a big drive when I was at art school to make you aware of the economy of meaning - after all, this was still during the tail end of minimalism. Being responsible for everything you put in your picture, and being able to defend it. Keeping everything clear around you so you know what is operating. To open the wound and keep it clean.
3444.name: Jane Campion

3445.quote: I was very much into buying contemporary art, but I've just decided I want to get rid of it all. Not that it's not great art, but all of a sudden my mood has changed, and I want to go back to seventeenth- and eighteenth-century masters.
3445.name: Sylvester Stallone

3446.quote: I did this Super-8 film at art school called 'Tissues,' this black comedy about a family whose father has been arrested for child molestation. I was absolutely thrilled by every inch of it, and would throw my projector in the back of my car and show it to anybody who would watch it.
3446.name: Jane Campion

3447.quote: The great art of films does not consist of descriptive movement of face and body but in the movements of thought and soul transmitted in a kind of intense isolation.
3447.name: Louise Brooks

3448.quote: Magic becomes art when it has nothing to hide.
3448.name: Ben Okri

3449.quote: Science is spectral analysis. Art is light synthesis.
3449.name: Karl Kraus

3450.quote: My first love is art, and I see a lot of things in an artistic way.
3450.name: Robert Carlyle

3451.quote: In my world, history comes down to language and art. No one cares much about what battles were fought, who won them and who lost them - unless there is a painting, a play, a song or a poem that speaks of the event.
3451.name: Theodore Bikel

3452.quote: A compromise is the art of dividing a cake in such a way that everyone believes he has the biggest piece.
3452.name: Ludwig Erhard

3453.quote: Wushu is a move in Chinese, a physical move. An attack. Wushu is like an art.
3453.name: Jet Li

3454.quote: Choosing to be positive and having a grateful attitude is going to determine how you're going to live your life.
3454.name: Joel Osteen

3455.quote: My attitude is that if you push me towards something that you think is a weakness, then I will turn that perceived weakness into a strength.
3455.name: Michael Jordan

3456.quote: Weakness of attitude becomes weakness of character.
3456.name: Albert Einstein

3457.quote: Nothing can stop the man with the right mental attitude from achieving his goal nothing on earth can help the man with the wrong mental attitude.
3457.name: Thomas Jefferson

3458.quote: Attitude is a little thing that makes a big difference.
3458.name: Winston Churchill

3459.quote: Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.
3459.name: Zig Ziglar

3460.quote: There is little difference in people, but that little difference makes a big difference. The little difference is attitude. The big difference is whether it is positive or negative.
3460.name: W. Clement Stone

3461.quote: Develop an attitude of gratitude, and give thanks for everything that happens to you, knowing that every step forward is a step toward achieving something bigger and better than your current situation.
3461.name: Brian Tracy

3462.quote: Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of human freedoms - to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances, to choose one's own way.
3462.name: Viktor E. Frankl

3463.quote: A positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events and outcomes. It is a catalyst and it sparks extraordinary results.
3463.name: Wade Boggs

3464.quote: Morality is simply the attitude we adopt towards people whom we personally dislike.
3464.name: Oscar Wilde

3465.quote: It is not the body's posture, but the heart's attitude that counts when we pray.
3465.name: Billy Graham

3466.quote: People may hear your words, but they feel your attitude.
3466.name: John C. Maxwell

3467.quote: But the attitude of faith is to let go, and become open to truth, whatever it might turn out to be.
3467.name: Alan Watts

3468.quote: Character is the result of two things: mental attitude and the way we spend our time.
3468.name: Elbert Hubbard

3469.quote: Our attitude towards others determines their attitude towards us.
3469.name: Earl Nightingale

3470.quote: Adopting the right attitude can convert a negative stress into a positive one.
3470.name: Hans Selye

3471.quote: Take the attitude of a student, never be too big to ask questions, never know too much to learn something new.
3471.name: Og Mandino

3472.quote: The reactionary is always willing to take a progressive attitude on any issue that is dead.
3472.name: Theodore Roosevelt

3473.quote: Ability is what you're capable of doing. Motivation determines what you do. Attitude determines how well you do it.
3473.name: Raymond Chandler

3474.quote: Cock your hat - angles are attitudes.
3474.name: Frank Sinatra

3475.quote: When you pray for anyone you tend to modify your personal attitude toward him.
3475.name: Norman Vincent Peale

3476.quote: If you are going to achieve excellence in big things, you develop the habit in little matters. Excellence is not an exception, it is a prevailing attitude.
3476.name: Colin Powell

3477.quote: I'm only going to stand before God and give an account for my life, not for somebody else's life. If I have a bad attitude, then I need to say there's no point in me blaming you for what's wrong in my life.
3477.name: Joyce Meyer

3478.quote: It is our attitude at the beginning of a difficult task which, more than anything else, will affect its successful outcome.
3478.name: William James

3479.quote: My attitude is, if someone's going to criticize me, tell me to my face.
3479.name: Simon Cowell

3480.quote: Having a positive mental attitude is asking how something can be done rather than saying it can't be done.
3480.name: Bo Bennett

3481.quote: My general attitude to life is to enjoy every minute of every day. I never do anything with a feeling of, 'Oh God, I've got to do this today.'
3481.name: Richard Branson

3482.quote: A complainer is like a Death Eater because there's a suction of negative energy. You can catch a great attitude from great people.
3482.name: Barbara Corcoran

3483.quote: The meaning of things lies not in the things themselves, but in our attitude towards them.
3483.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

3484.quote: Pink isn't just a color, it's an attitude!
3484.name: Miley Cyrus

3485.quote: The remarkable thing is, we have a choice everyday regarding the attitude we will embrace for that day.
3485.name: Charles R. Swindoll

3486.quote: A positive attitude can really make dreams come true - it did for me.
3486.name: David Bailey

3487.quote: Good humor is one of the best articles of dress one can wear in society.
3487.name: William Makepeace Thackeray

3488.quote: When you are thwarted, it is your own attitude that is out of order.
3488.name: Meister Eckhart

3489.quote: I think it's my adventure, my trip, my journey, and I guess my attitude is, let the chips fall where they may.
3489.name: Leonard Nimoy

3490.quote: Bad attitudes will ruin your team.
3490.name: Terry Bradshaw

3491.quote: For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.
3491.name: Walter Scott

3492.quote: Happiness is an attitude of mind, born of the simple determination to be happy under all outward circumstances.
3492.name: J. Donald Walters

3493.quote: Great effort springs naturally from great attitude.
3493.name: Pat Riley

3494.quote: Attitudes are more important than facts.
3494.name: George MacDonald

3496.quote: Attitude determines the altitude of life.
3496.name: Edwin Louis Cole

3497.quote: Our attitude toward life determines life's attitude towards us.
3497.name: John N. Mitchell

3498.quote: The greatest discovery of my generation is that man can alter his life simply by altering his attitude of mind.
3498.name: James Truslow Adams

3499.quote: But my attitude about it is I have miles to go before I sleep.
3499.name: Peabo Bryson

3500.quote: The attitude is very important. Because, your behavior radiates how you feel.
3500.name: Lou Ferrigno

3501.quote: When you ain't got no money, you gotta get an attitude.
3501.name: Richard Pryor

3502.quote: Civilization is a method of living, an attitude of equal respect for all men.
3502.name: Jane Addams

3503.quote: Most of us start out with a positive attitude and a plan to do our best.
3503.name: Marilu Henner

3504.quote: There are no menial jobs, only menial attitudes.
3504.name: Jr. William J. Brennan

3506.quote: The biggest challenge is how to affect public attitudes and make people care.
3506.name: Jim Fowler

3507.quote: If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude.
3507.name: Maya Angelou

3508.quote: It is very important to generate a good attitude, a good heart, as much as possible. From this, happiness in both the short term and the long term for both yourself and others will come.
3508.name: Dalai Lama

3509.quote: Your living is determined not so much by what life brings to you as by the attitude you bring to life not so much by what happens to you as by the way your mind looks at what happens.
3509.name: Khalil Gibran

3510.quote: Happiness doesn't depend on any external conditions, it is governed by our mental attitude.
3510.name: Dale Carnegie

3511.quote: Whenever you're in conflict with someone, there is one factor that can make the difference between damaging your relationship and deepening it. That factor is attitude.
3511.name: William James

3512.quote: Keep a good attitude and do the right thing even when it's hard. When you do that you are passing the test. And God promises you your marked moments are on their way.
3512.name: Joel Osteen

3513.quote: Success or failure depends more upon attitude than upon capacity successful men act as though they have accomplished or are enjoying something. Soon it becomes a reality. Act, look, feel successful, conduct yourself accordingly, and you will be amazed at the positive results.
3513.name: William James

3514.quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
3514.name: W. Clement Stone

3515.quote: The only disability in life is a bad attitude.
3515.name: Scott Hamilton

3516.quote: If you have a positive attitude and constantly strive to give your best effort, eventually you will overcome your immediate problems and find you are ready for greater challenges.
3516.name: Pat Riley

3517.quote: You cannot control what happens to you, but you can control your attitude toward what happens to you, and in that, you will be mastering change rather than allowing it to master you.
3517.name: Brian Tracy

3518.quote: The greatest discovery of all time is that a person can change his future by merely changing his attitude.
3518.name: Oprah Winfrey

3519.quote: A healthy attitude is contagious but don't wait to catch it from others. Be a carrier.
3519.name: Tom Stoppard

3520.quote: Any fact facing us is not as important as our attitude toward it, for that determines our success or failure. The way you think about a fact may defeat you before you ever do anything about it. You are overcome by the fact because you think you are.
3520.name: Norman Vincent Peale

3521.quote: Excellence is not a skill. It is an attitude.
3521.name: Ralph Marston

3522.quote: I hope the millions of people I've touched have the optimism and desire to share their goals and hard work and persevere with a positive attitude.
3522.name: Michael Jordan

3523.quote: We cannot change our past. We can not change the fact that people act in a certain way. We can not change the inevitable. The only thing we can do is play on the one string we have, and that is our attitude.
3523.name: Charles R. Swindoll

3524.quote: I was looking for something a lot heavier, yet melodic at the same time. Something different from heavy metal, a different attitude.
3524.name: Kurt Cobain

3525.quote: Spend some time this weekend on home improvement improve your attitude toward your family.
3525.name: Bo Bennett

3526.quote: We awaken in others the same attitude of mind we hold toward them.
3526.name: Elbert Hubbard

3527.quote: There is little difference in people, but that little difference makes a big difference. That little difference is attitude. The big difference is whether it is positive or negative.
3527.name: Robert Collier

3528.quote: Ability is what you're capable of doing. Motivation determines what you do. Attitude determines how well you do it.
3528.name: Lou Holtz

3529.quote: The last of human freedoms - the ability to chose one's attitude in a given set of circumstances.
3529.name: Viktor E. Frankl

3530.quote: Attitude is more important than the past, than education, than money, than circumstances, than what people do or say. It is more important than appearance, giftedness, or skill.
3530.name: Charles R. Swindoll

3531.quote: Being black is not a matter of pigmentation - being black is a reflection of a mental attitude.
3531.name: Steven Biko

3532.quote: People in tough times - it doesn't mean they don't have a great attitude.
3532.name: Joel Osteen

3533.quote: A strong positive mental attitude will create more miracles than any wonder drug.
3533.name: Patricia Neal

3534.quote: Certain thoughts are prayers. There are moments when, whatever be the attitude of the body, the soul is on its knees.
3534.name: Victor Hugo

3535.quote: Leadership is practiced not so much in words as in attitude and in actions.
3535.name: Harold S. Geneen

3536.quote: If a person gets his attitude toward money straight, it will help straighten out almost every other area in his life.
3536.name: Billy Graham

3537.quote: I've reached a point in my life where it's the little things that matter, I was always a rebel and probably could have got much farther had I changed my attitude. But when you think about it, I got pretty far without changing attitudes. I'm happier with that.
3537.name: Veronica Lake

3538.quote: Fairness is not an attitude. It's a professional skill that must be developed and exercised.
3538.name: Brit Hume

3539.quote: I think whether you're having setbacks or not, the role of a leader is to always display a winning attitude.
3539.name: Colin Powell

3540.quote: Be sure what you want and be sure about yourself. Fashion is not just beauty, it's about good attitude. You have to believe in yourself and be strong.
3540.name: Adriana Lima

3541.quote: Hitler and Mussolini were only the primary spokesmen for the attitude of domination and craving for power that are in the heart of almost everyone. Until the source is cleared, there will always be confusion and hate, wars and class antagonisms.
3541.name: Jiddu Krishnamurti

3542.quote: There must be something solemn, serious, and tender about any attitude which we denominate religious. If glad, it must not grin or snicker if sad, it must not scream or curse.
3542.name: William James

3543.quote: Sales are contingent upon the attitude of the salesman - not the attitude of the prospect.
3543.name: W. Clement Stone

3544.quote: A positive attitude is not going to save you. What it's going to do is, everyday, between now and the day you die, whether that's a short time from now or a long time from now, that every day, you're going to actually live.
3544.name: Elizabeth Edwards

3545.quote: Always keep that happy attitude. Pretend that you are holding a beautiful fragrant bouquet.
3545.name: Earl Nightingale

3546.quote: Black Consciousness is an attitude of the mind and a way of life, the most positive call to emanate from the black world for a long time.
3546.name: Steven Biko

3547.quote: I think music is the greatest art form that exists, and I think people listen to music for different reasons, and it serves different purposes. Some of it is background music, and some of it is things that might affect a person's day, if not their life, or change an attitude. The best songs are the ones that make you feel something.
3547.name: Eddie Vedder

3548.quote: We submit to the majority because we have to. But we are not compelled to call our attitude of subjection a posture of respect.
3548.name: Ambrose Bierce

3549.quote: The winner's edge is not in a gifted birth, a high IQ, or in talent. The winner's edge is all in the attitude, not aptitude. Attitude is the criterion for success.
3549.name: Denis Waitley

3550.quote: Having a clear faith, based on the creed of the church is often labeled today as fundamentalism. Whereas relativism, which is letting oneself be tossed and swept along by every wind of teaching, look like the only attitude acceptable to today's standards.
3550.name: Pope Benedict XVI

3551.quote: Today's students can put dope in their veins or hope in their brains. If they can conceive it and believe it, they can achieve it. They must know it is not their aptitude but their attitude that will determine their altitude.
3551.name: Jesse Jackson

3552.quote: I think a lot of times we don't pay enough attention to people with a positive attitude because we assume they are naive or stupid or unschooled.
3552.name: Amy Adams

3553.quote: A great attitude does much more than turn on the lights in our worlds it seems to magically connect us to all sorts of serendipitous opportunities that were somehow absent before the change.
3553.name: Earl Nightingale

3554.quote: Chaotic people often have chaotic lives, and I think they create that. But if you try and have an inner peace and a positive attitude, I think you attract that.
3554.name: Imelda Staunton

3555.quote: I am Classic Rock Revisited. I revisit it every waking moment of my life because it has the spirit and the attitude and the fire and the middle finger. I am Rosa Parks with a Gibson guitar.
3555.name: Ted Nugent

3556.quote: And the attitude of faith is the very opposite of clinging to belief, of holding on.
3556.name: Alan Watts

3557.quote: Our lives are not determined by what happens to us but how we react to what happens, not by what life brings us but the attitude we bring to life.
3557.name: Wade Boggs

3558.quote: Being a sex symbol has to do with an attitude, not looks. Most men think it's looks, most women know otherwise.
3558.name: Kathleen Turner

3559.quote: I am responsible. Although I may not be able to prevent the worst from happening, I am responsible for my attitude toward the inevitable misfortunes that darken life.
3559.name: Walter Anderson

3560.quote: No rational argument will have a rational effect on a man who does not want to adopt a rational attitude.
3560.name: Karl Popper

3561.quote: When I was a child I asked my mother what homosexuality was about and she said - and this was 100 years ago in Germany and she was very open-minded - 'It's like hair color. It's nothing. Some people are blond and some people have dark hair. It's not a subject.' This was a very healthy attitude.
3561.name: Karl Lagerfeld

3562.quote: Success or failure in business is caused more by the mental attitude even than by mental capacities.
3562.name: Walter Scott

3563.quote: Obama does not represent America. Nor does he represent anything what our forefathers stood for. This country is basically built on an attitude. It's a way of life. It's not because you're born here. It's not that you're supposed to take from those who have and give to those who haven't. That kills a country. It killed Russia.
3563.name: Luke Scott

3564.quote: Stop this attitude that older people ain't any good anymore! We're as good as we ever were - if we ever were any good.
3564.name: Dolly Parton

3565.quote: My attitude to peace is rather based on the Burmese definition of peace - it really means removing all the negative factors that destroy peace in this world. So peace does not mean just putting an end to violence or to war, but to all other factors that threaten peace, such as discrimination, such as inequality, poverty.
3565.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

3566.quote: Your attitude is like a box of crayons that color your world. Constantly color your picture gray, and your picture will always be bleak. Try adding some bright colors to the picture by including humor, and your picture begins to lighten up.
3566.name: Allen Klein

3567.quote: Crime is terribly revealing. Try and vary your methods as you will, your tastes, your habits, your attitude of mind, and your soul is revealed by your actions.
3567.name: Agatha Christie

3568.quote: Some people say I have attitude - maybe I do, but I think you have to. You have to believe in yourself when no one else does - that makes you a winner right there.
3568.name: Venus Williams

3569.quote: The minute you try to talk business with him he takes the attitude that he is a gentleman and a scholar, and the moment you try to approach him on the level of his moral integrity he starts to talk business.
3569.name: Raymond Chandler

3570.quote: Stiletto, I look at it more as an attitude as opposed to a high-heeled shoe.
3570.name: Lita Ford

3571.quote: If somebody says no to you, or if you get cut, Michael Jordan was cut his first year, but he came back and he was the best ever. That is what you have to have. The attitude that I'm going to show everybody, I'm going to work hard to get better and better.
3571.name: Magic Johnson

3572.quote: When you have vision it affects your attitude. Your attitude is optimistic rather than pessimistic.
3572.name: Charles R. Swindoll

3573.quote: What matters to me is that I do what I think is right and I see, I'm a numbers guy, that's my attitude. I know we have a debt tsunami coming, we are bankrupting this country and I'm in a position where I can actually advance ideas to prevent that from happening. That's exactly what I should be doing.
3573.name: Paul Ryan

3574.quote: I developed a nutty attitude where I'd think, If some guy really loves me he doesn't care if I'm fat. I'd come up with all these stupid reasons why it would be OK to be fat.
3574.name: Kirstie Alley

3575.quote: Really you just gotta keep chugging along and keep a positive attitude and get through all the problems. You gotta face them, otherwise you don't get through.
3575.name: Lesley Gore

3576.quote: Solidarity is an attitude of resistance, I suppose, or it should be.
3576.name: Christopher Hitchens

3577.quote: There's always the motivation of wanting to win. Everybody has that. But a champion needs, in his attitude, a motivation above and beyond winning.
3577.name: Pat Riley

3578.quote: Americans are the most generous country on the planet. I've worked in Europe, I've worked in Australia. There is no where else where you get absolutely no attitude for being a foreigner. If you do your job well, they embrace you.
3578.name: Hugh Jackman

3579.quote: When I go to the clinic next and sit with a tube in my arm and watch the poison go in, I'm in an attitude of abject passivity. It doesn't feel like fighting at all it just feels like submitting.
3579.name: Christopher Hitchens

3580.quote: Our judgments judge us, and nothing reveals us, exposes our weaknesses, more ingeniously than the attitude of pronouncing upon our fellows.
3580.name: Paul Valery

3581.quote: Pessimism only describes an attitude, and not facts, and hence is entirely subjective.
3581.name: Francis Parker Yockey

3582.quote: I was kicked out of school because of my attitude. I was not assimilating. So I went to work, taking any jobs I could get.
3582.name: Richard Pryor

3583.quote: A lot of times I find that people who are blessed with the most talent don't ever develop that attitude, and the ones who aren't blessed in that way are the most competitive and have the biggest heart.
3583.name: Tom Brady

3584.quote: So long as you've got your friends about you, and a good positive attitude, you don't really have to care what everyone else thinks.
3584.name: Gail Porter

3585.quote: I separated from the Southern Baptists when they adopted the discriminatory attitude towards women, because I believe what Paul taught in Galatians that there is no distinction in God's eyes between men and women, slaves and masters, Jews and non-Jews - everybody is created equally in the eyes of God.
3585.name: Jimmy Carter

3586.quote: My attitude toward men who mess around is simple: If you find 'em, kill 'em.
3586.name: Loretta Lynn

3587.quote: Prayer is talking with God. God knows your heart and is not so concerned with your words as He is with the attitude of your heart.
3587.name: Josh McDowell

3588.quote: You can't study comedy it's within you. It's a personality. My humor is an attitude.
3588.name: Don Rickles

3589.quote: You call to a dog and a dog will break its neck to get to you. Dogs just want to please. Call to a cat and its attitude is, 'What's in it for me?'
3589.name: Lewis Grizzard

3590.quote: The compulsion to do good is an innate American trait. Only North Americans seem to believe that they always should, may, and actually can choose somebody with whom to share their blessings. Ultimately this attitude leads to bombing people into the acceptance of gifts.
3590.name: Ivan Illich

3591.quote: I keep guitars that are, you know, the neck's a little bit bent and it's a little bit out of tune. I want to work and battle it and conquer it and make it express whatever attitude I have at that moment. I want it to be a struggle.
3591.name: Jack White

3592.quote: Most of my arguments with musicians through the years have had more to do with their attitude about music, or their attitude about their own lives, or their personal responsibility. Music has never really been the big centerpiece of the fight.
3592.name: Billy Corgan

3593.quote: I love everybody. One of the great things about me is that I have a very positive attitude.
3593.name: Imelda Marcos

3594.quote: Mankind's true moral test, its fundamental test (which lies deeply buried from view), consists of its attitude towards those who are at its mercy: animals. And in this respect mankind has suffered a fundamental debacle, a debacle so fundamental that all others stem from it.
3594.name: Milan Kundera

3595.quote: It's sort of a mental attitude about critical thinking and curiosity. It's about mindset of looking at the world in a playful and curious and creative way.
3595.name: Adam Savage

3596.quote: Punk was defined by an attitude rather than a musical style.
3596.name: David Byrne

3597.quote: It's a fundamental, social attitude that the 1% supports symphonies and operas and doesn't support Johnny learning to program hip-hop beats. When I put it like that, it sounds like, 'Well, yeah,' but you start to think, 'Why not, though?' What makes one more valuable than another?
3597.name: David Byrne

3598.quote: I think people feel threatened by homosexuality. The problem isn't about gay people, the problem is about the attitude towards gay people. People think that all gays are Hannibal Lecters. But gay people are sons and daughters, politicians and doctors, American heroes and daughters of American heroes.
3598.name: Hollis Stacy

3599.quote: I have this theory that, depending on your attitude, your life doesn't have to become this ridiculous charade that it seems so many people end up living.
3599.name: Christian Bale

3600.quote: It was just like a dream. I could have ended up with an album that's not all that different from anything else coming out of Nashville. Mutt made the difference. He took these songs, my attitude, my creativity, and colored them in a way that is unique.
3600.name: Shania Twain

3601.quote: I look at Jagger and the like and if I see a good attitude I'll admire it but I wouldn't copy their style.
3601.name: Michael Hutchence

3602.quote: My attitude is never to be satisfied, never enough, never.
3602.name: Duke Ellington

3603.quote: Today's youth are told to get rich or die trying and they really shouldn't take that attitude forward with them.
3603.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

3604.quote: The purely agitational attitude is not good enough for a detailed consideration of a subject.
3604.name: Jawaharlal Nehru

3605.quote: Not every religion has to have St. Augustine's attitude to sex. Why even in our culture marriages are celebrated in a church, everyone present knows what is going to happen that night, but that doesn't prevent it being a religious ceremony.
3605.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein

3606.quote: Never refuse an assignment except when there is a conflict of interest, a potential of danger to you or your family, or you hold a strongly biased attitude about the subject under focus.
3606.name: Jessica Savitch

3607.quote: We can revolutionize the attitude of inner city brown and black kids to learning. We need a civil rights movement within the African-American community.
3607.name: Henry Louis Gates

3608.quote: It's a question of keeping one's eyes and ears open and watching how other people play the game. They're watching me too, to see what my attitude is like.
3608.name: Charles Dance

3609.quote: Yes, we're still five little people with a noisy attitude.
3609.name: Angus Young

3610.quote: In individual industries where female labour pays an important role, any movement advocating better wages, shorter working hours, etc., would not be doomed from the start because of the attitude of those women workers who are not organized.
3610.name: Clara Zetkin

3611.quote: On 'Van Halen,' I was a young punk, and everything revolved around the fastest kid in town, gunslinger attitude. But I'd say that at the time of 'Fair Warning,' I started concentrating more on songwriting. But I guess in most people's minds I'm just a gunslinger.
3611.name: Eddie Van Halen

3612.quote: Design is about point of view, and there should be some sort of woman or lifestyle or attitude in one's head as a designer.
3612.name: Vera Wang

3613.quote: Liberalism is an attitude rather than a set of dogmas - an attitude that insists upon questioning all plausible and self-evident propositions, seeking not to reject them but to find out what evidence there is to support them rather than their possible alternatives.
3613.name: Morris Raphael Cohen

3614.quote: The Dolls were an attitude. If nothing else they were a great attitude.
3614.name: Johnny Thunders

3615.quote: I was impressed by Hendrix. His attitude was brilliant. Even the way he walked was amazing.
3615.name: Ritchie Blackmore

3616.quote: The best way to inspire people to superior performance is to convince them by everything you do and by your everyday attitude that you are wholeheartedly supporting them.
3616.name: Harold S. Geneen

3617.quote: I think it's your mental attitude. So many of us start dreading age in high school and that's a waste of a lovely life. 'Oh, I'm 30, oh, I'm 40, oh, 50.' Make the most of it.
3617.name: Betty White

3618.quote: The attitude that nature is chaotic and that the artist puts order into it is a very absurd point of view, I think. All that we can hope for is to put some order into ourselves.
3618.name: Willem de Kooning

3619.quote: Britishness is just a way of putting things together and a certain don't care attitude about clothes. You don't care, you just do it and it looks great.
3619.name: Vivienne Westwood

3620.quote: It remains to consider what attitude thoughtful men and Christian believers should take respecting them, and how they stand related to beliefs of another order.
3620.name: Asa Gray

3622.quote: I've never run into a guy who could win at the top level in anything today and didn't have the right attitude, didn't give it everything he had, at least while he was doing it wasn't prepared and didn't have the whole program worked out.
3622.name: Ted Turner

3623.quote: That's what I love from metal, and that's what I love from hip-hop. That's what I love from any music that's hard, that's got an edge to it-The attitude in it.
3623.name: Kid Rock

3624.quote: That attitude that fighting is probably not fair, but you have to defend yourself anyway and damage the enemy, has been profoundly consequential as far as my political activism goes.
3624.name: June Jordan

3625.quote: Seek out that particular mental attribute which makes you feel most deeply and vitally alive, along with which comes the inner voice which says, 'This is the real me,' and when you have found that attitude, follow it.
3625.name: James Truslow Adams

3626.quote: People think, 'She's a model. She must have such an attitude. She must be so stuck up.' But I'm normal. I cry. I'm not rich. I drive a 1987 Chevrolet Celebrity.
3626.name: Summer Altice

3627.quote: My grandfather was a man, when he talked about freedom, his attitude was really interesting. His view was that you had obligations or you had responsibilities, and when you fulfilled those obligations or responsibilities, that then gave you the liberty to do other things.
3627.name: Clarence Thomas

3628.quote: I think failure is nothing more than life's way of nudging you that you are off course. My attitude to failure is not attached to outcome, but in not trying. It is liberating. Most people attach failure to something not working out or how people perceive you. This way, it is about answering to yourself.
3628.name: Sara Blakely

3629.quote: Part of our western outlook stems from the scientific attitude and its method of isolating the parts of a phenomenon in order to analyze them.
3629.name: Arthur Erickson

3630.quote: There is a single thread of attitude, a single direction of flow, that joins our present time to its early burgeoning in Mediterranean civilization.
3630.name: Arthur Erickson

3631.quote: We live in a country that used to have a can-do attitude, and now we have a 'what-can-you-do-for-me?' attitude, and what I try to do is find ways that we can develop common ground.
3631.name: Benjamin Carson

3632.quote: Could we change our attitude, we should not only see life differently, but life itself would come to be different.
3632.name: Katherine Mansfield

3633.quote: The ideal attitude is to be physically loose and mentally tight.
3633.name: Arthur Ashe

3634.quote: An attitude to life which seeks fulfillment in the single-minded pursuit of wealth - in short, materialism - does not fit into this world, because it contains within itself no limiting principle, while the environment in which it is placed is strictly limited.
3634.name: E. F. Schumacher

3635.quote: You may not be able to change a situation, but with humor you can change your attitude about it.
3635.name: Allen Klein

3636.quote: What was past was past. I suppose that was the general attitude.
3636.name: V. S. Naipaul

3637.quote: Iraq is just a symbol of the attitude of western democracies to the rest of the world.
3637.name: Harold Pinter

3638.quote: I don't mean this in a stuck-up way, but I needed an attitude song.
3638.name: Gwen Stefani

3639.quote: I met my grandfather just before he died, and it was the first time that I had seen Dad with a relative of his. It was interesting to see my own father as a son and the body language and alteration in attitude that comes with that, and it sort of changed our relationship for the better.
3639.name: Christian Bale

3640.quote: I don't think it's a good attitude in your life to feel that you have to be rich to have self-esteem.
3640.name: Tom Petty

3641.quote: All we need, really, is a change from a near frigid to a tropical attitude of mind.
3641.name: Marjory Stoneman Douglas

3642.quote: An aristocratic culture does not advertise its emotions. In its forms of expression it is sober and reserved. Its general attitude is stoic.
3642.name: Johan Huizinga

3643.quote: I was impressed by Hendrix. Not so much by his playing, as his attitude - he wasn't a great player, but everything else about him was brilliant.
3643.name: Ritchie Blackmore

3644.quote: Attitude is attitude, whether you're a West Coast gangster or East Coast gangster, you know?
3644.name: Paul Walker

3645.quote: You know, I always say white is not a colour, white is an attitude, and if you haven't got trillions of dollars in the bank that you don't need, you can't be white.
3645.name: Dick Gregory

3646.quote: Being a part of SKECHERS is exciting. It is such a hip company with a great attitude and image.
3646.name: Carrie Underwood

3647.quote: It is precisely the purpose of the public opinion generated by the press to make the public incapable of judging, to insinuate into it the attitude of someone irresponsible, uninformed.
3647.name: Walter Benjamin

3648.quote: Coaches will eventually notice a great attitude, and they respect that.
3648.name: Heather O'Reilly

3649.quote: The novelist teaches the reader to comprehend the world as a question. There is wisdom and tolerance in that attitude. In a world built on sacrosanct certainties the novel is dead.
3649.name: Milan Kundera

3650.quote: No one's going to be able to operate without a grounding in the basic sciences. Language would be helpful, although English is becoming increasingly international. And travel. You have to have a global attitude.
3650.name: Rupert Murdoch

3651.quote: My second husband believed I had such a fickle attitude to friendship that each Friday he would update the list of my 'Top Ten' friends in the manner of a Top Of The Pops chart countdown.
3651.name: Julie Burchill

3652.quote: If you can kill animals, the same attitude can kill human beings. The mentality is the same which exploits nature and which creates wars.
3652.name: Satish Kumar

3653.quote: My attitude is, do as much as I can while I'm free. And if I'm arrested I'll still do as much as I can.
3653.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

3654.quote: There are a lot of movies I'd like to throw away. That's not to say that I went in with that attitude. Any film I ever started, I went in with all the hope and best intentions in the world, but some films just don't work.
3654.name: Kiefer Sutherland

3655.quote: By making a comeback, I'm changing the attitude of people toward me. If I'd known that people would react so enthusiastically, I'd have done it years ago.
3655.name: Mark Spitz

3656.quote: Today, I think the attitude is that governing is not necessarily good politics, and the result is that it's much more partisan and much more divided.
3656.name: Leon Panetta

3657.quote: That term's definitely got a negative aura to it, because people think a diva is somebody with an attitude who demands things all the time. Of course there is that type of diva, but my idea of a diva has always been a singer - whether male or female - who gets on that stage and captivates you with their presence and their voice.
3657.name: Jordin Sparks

3658.quote: Oh, I don't think Tom Sowell would tell anybody to join the administration. That's not his style. But I think his attitude has always been if it had to be done he'd prefer me to do it than somebody else.
3658.name: Clarence Thomas

3659.quote: The Senator from Massachusetts has given us ample grounds to doubt the judgment and the attitude he brings to bear on vital issues of national security.
3659.name: Dick Cheney

3660.quote: I perfectly understood President Obama's attitude throughout the French presidential campaign. He had no reason to distance himself from Nicolas Sarkozy. It's the basic solidarity that leaders who worked together owe to each other.
3660.name: Francois Hollande

3661.quote: I think it has something to do with being British. We don't take ourselves as seriously as some other countries do. I think a lot of people take themselves far too seriously I find that a very tedious attitude.
3661.name: Joan Collins

3662.quote: I failed the LSAT. Basically, if I had not failed, I'd have been a lawyer and there would be no Spanx. I think failure is nothing more than life's way of nudging you that you are off course. My attitude to failure is not attached to outcome, but in not trying. It is liberating.
3662.name: Sara Blakely

3663.quote: My attitude to writing is like when you do wallpapering, you remember where all the little bits are that don't meet. And then your friends say: It's terrific!
3663.name: Harrison Birtwistle

3664.quote: Liberalism is a really old British tradition and it has a completely different attitude towards the individual and the relationship between the individual and the state than the collectivist response of Labour, and particularly Old Labour, does.
3664.name: Nick Clegg

4167.quote: Through Kurt I saw the beauty of minimalism and the importance of music that's stripped down.
4167.name: Dave Grohl

4168.quote: I trust in nature for the stable laws of beauty and utility. Spring shall plant and autumn garner to the end of time.
4168.name: Robert Browning

4169.quote: I don't get anything for free. I pay for all my beauty treatments.
4169.name: Jennifer Lopez

4170.quote: Rarely do great beauty and great virtue dwell together.
4170.name: Petrarch

4171.quote: I didn't have any confidence in my beauty when I was young. I felt like a character actress, and I still do.
4171.name: Meryl Streep

4172.quote: I really admire a woman for her intelligence, her personality. Beauty is not enough.
4172.name: Roberto Cavalli

4173.quote: I write for no other purpose than to add to the beauty that now belongs to me. I write a book for no other reason than to add three or four hundred acres to my magnificent estate.
4173.name: Jack London

4174.quote: They saw me, those reckless seekers of beauty, and in a night I was famous.
4174.name: Lillie Langtry

4176.quote: Beauty and fullness of tone can be achieved by having the whole orchestra play with high clarinets and a carefully selected number of piccolos.
4176.name: Gustav Mahler

4177.quote: I think the beauty of working with young people is they remind you of the spirit of acting and it's just a big play.
4177.name: Eric Bana

4178.quote: I am obsessed with beauty. I want everything to be perfect, and of course it isn't. And that's a tough place to be because you're never satisfied.
4178.name: Robert Mapplethorpe

4179.quote: The beautiful seems right by force of beauty and the feeble wrong because of weakness.
4179.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

4180.quote: I would like to say to people, open your eyes and find beauty where you normally don't expect it.
4180.name: Jean Paul Gaultier

4181.quote: Art is the unceasing effort to compete with the beauty of flowers - and never succeeding.
4181.name: Gian Carlo Menotti

4182.quote: Thankfully, beauty is easier to remove than apply, and a swipe of demaquillage in the right direction and you are you once again.
4182.name: Margaret Cho

4183.quote: Just because you are blind and unable to see my beauty doesn't mean it does not exist.
4183.name: Margaret Cho

4184.quote: Order is the shape upon which beauty depends.
4184.name: Pearl S. Buck

4185.quote: For the mind disturbed, the still beauty of dawn is nature's finest balm.
4185.name: Edwin Way Teale

4186.quote: Women are so unforgiving of themselves. We don't recognize our own beauty because we're too busy comparing ourselves to other people.
4186.name: Kelly Osbourne

4187.quote: But every great scripture, whether Hebrew, Indian, Persian, or Chinese, apart from its religious value will be found to have some rare and special beauty of its own and in this respect the original Bible stands very high as a monument of sublime poetry and of artistic prose.
4187.name: Lafcadio Hearn

4188.quote: Part of the beauty of Judaism, and surely this is so for other faiths also, is that it gently restores control over time. Three times a day we stop what we are doing and turn to God in prayer. We recover perspective. We inhale a deep breath of eternity.
4188.name: Jonathan Sacks

4189.quote: I've actually spent a lot of time researching beauty products, how they are produced and how they are sold.
4189.name: Lauren Conrad

4190.quote: For I must tell you that we artists cannot tread the path of Beauty without Eros keeping company with us and appointing himself as our guide.
4190.name: Thomas Mann

4191.quote: Solitude gives birth to the original in us, to beauty unfamiliar and perilous - to poetry. But also, it gives birth to the opposite: to the perverse, the illicit, the absurd.
4191.name: Thomas Mann

4192.quote: What is sacred among one people may be ridiculous in another and what is despised or rejected by one cultural group, may in a different environment become the cornerstone for a great edifice of strange grandeur and beauty.
4192.name: Hu Shih

4193.quote: Art is beauty, the perpetual invention of detail, the choice of words, the exquisite care of execution.
4193.name: Theophile Gautier

4194.quote: I'm not one of those women who thinks beauty is a curse.
4194.name: Diane Kruger

4195.quote: A lot of directors idealize their leading ladies or turn them into these objects of sexuality and beauty.
4195.name: Diane Kruger

4196.quote: I like the idea of accessibility, coming from a lower-middle-class background myself, I feel like beauty and products should be accessible to all women over the world.
4196.name: Diane Kruger

4197.quote: Beauty in art is often nothing but ugliness subdued.
4197.name: Jean Rostand

4198.quote: What saddens me is the corruption of youth and beauty, and the loss of soul, which is only replaced by money.
4198.name: Lisa Bonet

4199.quote: When I think of art I think of beauty. Beauty is the mystery of life. It is not in the eye it is in the mind. In our minds there is awareness of perfection.
4199.name: Agnes Martin

4200.quote: The very definition of 'beauty' is outside.
4200.name: Adam Carolla

4201.quote: I always loved aesthetics. Not particularly fashion, but an idea of beauty.
4201.name: Miuccia Prada

4202.quote: Now, I'm not saying I'm fashionable, but there are sociological interests that matter to me, things that are theoretical, political, intellectual and also concerned with vanity and beauty that we all think about but that I try to mix up and translate into fashion.
4202.name: Miuccia Prada

4203.quote: What sort of sap doesn't know by now that picture-perfect beauty is all done with smoke and mirrors anyway?
4203.name: Julie Burchill

4204.quote: Shame, like beauty, is often in the eye of the beholder.
4204.name: Julie Burchill

4205.quote: The truth of the matter is, beauty is a specific thing, rare and fleeting. Some of us have it in our teens, 20s and 30s and then lose it most of us have it not at all. And that's perfectly okay. But lying to yourself that you have it when you don't seems to me simple-minded at best and psychotic at worst.
4205.name: Julie Burchill

4206.quote: What I find most upsetting about this new all-consuming beauty culture is that the obsession with good looks, and how you can supposedly attain them, is almost entirely female-driven.
4206.name: Julie Burchill

4207.quote: Surely being a Professional Beauty - let alone an ageing one - is one of the most insecure and doomed careers imaginable.
4207.name: Julie Burchill

4208.quote: I've always thought of beauty therapy, 'alternative' treatments and the like as the female equivalent of brothels - for essentially self-deceiving people who feel a bit hollow and have to pay to be touched.
4208.name: Julie Burchill

4209.quote: These women whose antics we smirk at good-naturedly in the pap-traps put themselves out there at least partly on their beauty they are in showbiz, and showing what they've got is part of their business as much as it is for male show-ponies from the Chippendales to George Clooney.
4209.name: Julie Burchill

4210.quote: Natural beauty takes at least two hours in front of a mirror.
4210.name: Pamela Anderson

4211.quote: It is not the beauty of a building you should look at its the construction of the foundation that will stand the test of time.
4211.name: David Allan Coe

4212.quote: One of the things that people don't realize is that that natural beauty, those recreational forests, they have an economic development impact for the state as well.
4212.name: Ed Rendell

4213.quote: Endeavour to be faithful, and if there is any beauty in your thought, your style will be beautiful if there is any real emotion to express, the expression will be moving.
4213.name: George Henry Lewes

4214.quote: Black beauty - he's a dark horse.
4214.name: Tim Vine

4215.quote: I shall give you hunger, and pain, and sleepless nights. Also beauty, and satisfactions known to few, and glimpses of the heavenly life. None of these you shall have continually, and of their coming and going you shall not be foretold.
4215.name: Howard Lindsay

4216.quote: People don't associate red hair, pale skin, and freckles with beauty.
4216.name: Shirley Manson

4217.quote: I still believe that capitalism is too harsh and I believe that, even within that, there is a lot of satisfaction and beauty if you happen to be one of the lucky ones, although that doesn't eradicate the reality of the suffering. It's all true at once, kind of humming and sublime.
4217.name: George Saunders

4218.quote: Physical beauty is such a strange thing.
4218.name: Jock Sturges

4219.quote: I was kind of a jock in school. Beauty wasn't something I spent a lot of time on.
4219.name: Nina Dobrev

4220.quote: I'm very accepting with my age. It's like notches on your belt: experience, wisdom, and a different kind of beauty. There comes a day when you've become comfortable in your skin.
4220.name: Zoe Saldana

4221.quote: My wife has brought great beauty into my life. And my daughter has brought me nothing but joy. Those qualities were greatly lacking.
4221.name: Christopher Meloni

4222.quote: My mother never put an emphasis on looks. She let us grow up on our own time line. She never forced any beauty regimen into my world.
4222.name: Rachel McAdams

4223.quote: It is very necessary to have markers of beauty left in a world seemingly bent on making the most evil ugliness.
4223.name: Thornton Wilder

4224.quote: Hollywood needs to recognise all shades of African American beauty.
4224.name: Gabrielle Union

4225.quote: Editing yourself is like an irksome coin toss. You've got to strip yourself of super ego and operate from the id. Maybe I've got my Freud mixed up. It's just hard to trade a beauty shot for the performance with truth and a brightly lit zit.
4225.name: Vera Farmiga

4226.quote: Beauty is a radiance that originates from within and comes from inner security and strong character.
4226.name: Jane Seymour

4227.quote: I tried for a while to be an agricultural worker and was hopelessly bored. To me it was meaningless. I would stand around in heaps of manure and sings about the beauty of the work I wasn't doing.
4227.name: Theodore Bikel

4228.quote: I tried for a while to be an agricultural worker and was hopelessly bored. I would stand around in heaps of manure and sing about the beauty of the work I wasn't doing.
4228.name: Theodore Bikel

4229.quote: Art requires philosophy, just as philosophy requires art. Otherwise, what would become of beauty?
4229.name: Paul Gauguin

4230.quote: I really like where Tony Robbins says that we're all hypnotized to see beauty this one specific way, and it's true.
4230.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

4231.quote: Beauty fades! I just turned 29, so I probably don't have that many good years left in me.
4231.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

4232.quote: Beauty, to me is about being comfortable in your own skin.
4232.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

4233.quote: You can't possibly fathom the ins and outs of a prepubescent beauty treatment until you've felt the strange but exhilarating tingle of a cottage-cheese-and-Pop-Rocks facial.
4233.name: Sloane Crosley

4234.quote: As Ralph's character begins to discover the political thriller aspect of the film, he falls deeper in love with his wife, so the two run together. That's the beauty of this film. It has fast pace and excitement, but it also has heart and soul.
4234.name: Rachel Weisz

4235.quote: Beauty can come in strange forms.
4235.name: James Dyson

4236.quote: And I think of that again as I've written in several of my beauty books, a lot of health comes from the proper eating habits, which are something that - you know, I come from a generation that wasn't - didn't have a lot of food.
4236.name: Joan Collins

4237.quote: Well I've written four beauty books as well.
4237.name: Joan Collins

4238.quote: Bologna is the best city in Italy for food and has the least number of tourists. With its medieval beauty, it has it all.
4238.name: Mario Batali

4239.quote: I think we have become obsessed with beauty and personally I'm really saddened by the way women mutilate their faces today in search of that.
4239.name: Halle Berry

4240.quote: Beauty, more than bitterness, makes the heart break.
4240.name: Sara Teasdale

4241.quote: I thought to be feminine was to give in to straight culture, or the beauty standard, but in my heart I had a flair for fashion and style. They were passions I kept secret because I didn't understand I could love clothes and hair and makeup and still like girls.
4241.name: Beth Ditto

4242.quote: Thanks to capitalism, the importance placed on beauty has never been so manipulated. We are the guinea pigs force-fed ads that tell us how pathetic we are: that we will never be loved, happy or valuable unless we have the body, the face, the hair, even the personality that will apparently be ours, if only we buy their products.
4242.name: Beth Ditto

4243.quote: She gave up beauty in her tender youth, gave all her hope and joy and pleasant ways she covered up her eyes lest they should gaze on vanity, and chose the bitter truth.
4243.name: Christina Rossetti

4244.quote: I really like to be able to have variety and to try different things - that's the beauty of fashion.
4244.name: Leighton Meester

4245.quote: Beauty is first and foremost an emotion.
4245.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

4246.quote: It's the beauty and curse of doing a daily show. Some days you've got nothing to talk about and other days Dick Cheney shoots his lawyer in the face and everyone is happy.
4246.name: Craig Ferguson

4247.quote: The beauty that addresses itself to the eyes is only the spell of the moment the eye of the body is not always that of the soul.
4247.name: George Sand

4249.quote: With guys I revere, like Marcus Garvey or Malcolm X, their look is less about style than purpose and the expression of beauty. It wasn't just about being noticed, you know?

4251.name: Chaim Potok

4252.name: Jane Smiley

4253.quote: Beauty comes from a life well lived. If you've lived well, your smile lines are in the right places, and your frown lines aren't too bad, what more do you need?

4255.quote: The way in which mathematicians and physicists and historians talk is quite different, and what a physicist means by physical intuition and what a mathematician means by beauty or elegance are things worth thinking about.

4256.quote: I know it sounds a bit corny, but I do think that beauty and sexiness come from within.
4256.name: Rachel Stevens

4257.name: Eric Davis

4258.quote: Nothing surpasses the beauty and elegance of a bad idea.
4258.name: Craig Bruce

4259.quote: Beauty is as relative as light and dark. Thus, there exists no beautiful woman, none at all, because you are never certain that a still far more beautiful woman will not appear and completely shame the supposed beauty of the first.

4261.name: Lea Michele

4262.quote: Our situation today shows that beauty demands for itself at least as much courage and decision as do truth and goodness, and she will not allow herself to be separated and banned from her two sisters without taking them along with herself in an act of mysterious vengeance.
4262.name: Hans Urs von Balthasar

4263.quote: For me art and chess are closely related, both are forms in which the self finds beauty and expression.
4263.name: Vladimir Kramnik

4264.quote: But I think it is a serious issue to wonder about the other platonic absolutes of say beauty and morality.
4264.name: Roger Penrose

4265.name: Pamela Anderson

4266.quote: What delights us in visible beauty is the invisible.
4266.name: Marie von Ebner-Eschenbach

4267.quote: There is a role and function for beauty in our time.
4267.name: Tadao Ando

4268.quote: I like the beauty of Faulkner's poetry. But I don't like his themes, not at all.
4268.name: Manuel Puig

4269.quote: You get more churches burned down in the United States in the last two years than in the last hundred, because of the lack of understanding of culture and diversity and the beauty of it.
4269.name: Edward James Olmos

4270.quote: You, too, women, cast away all the cowards from your embraces they will give you only cowards for children, and you who are the daughters of the land of beauty must bear children who are noble and brave.
4270.name: Giuseppe Garibaldi

4271.quote: All my writing is about the recognition that there is no single reality. But the beauty of it is that you nevertheless go on, walking towards utopia, which may not exist, on a bridge which might end before you reach the other side.
4271.name: Marguerite Young

4272.quote: I thought it might be a good move to get into a beauty contest so I tried for Miss Pennsylvania and won. I think that helped me get noticed, at least by the people of Pennsylvania.
4272.name: Sharon Stone

4273.quote: The beauty of a strong, lasting commitment is often best understood by men incapable of it.
4273.name: Murray Kempton

4274.quote: What I like about cities is that everything is king size, the beauty and the ugliness.
4274.name: Joseph Brodsky

4275.quote: Beauty is a precious trace that eternity causes to appear to us and that it takes away from us. A manifestation of eternity, and a sign of death as well.
4275.name: Eugene Ionesco

4276.quote: A beautiful bouquet or a long-lasting flowering plant is a traditional gift for women, but I have recommended that both men and women keep fresh flowers in the home for their beauty, fragrance, and the lift they give our spirits.
4276.name: Andrew Weil

4277.quote: Avon invented the concept of direct marketing and direct selling beauty. And that's still very valid to us. We'll have a firm that will be around for another 114 years as strongly as it was the first 114.
4277.name: Andrea Jung

4278.quote: A representative is free delivery she's a personal beauty consultant. Some people want that high touch.
4278.name: Andrea Jung

4279.quote: The game in beauty is changing so much, if your product isn't high tech or can't make a unique performance claim - plump your lips, reduce your lines, look glossy, and stay on for 24 hours - you can't go to market today. I'm not just talking about a $20 lipstick, but a $5 lipstick!
4279.name: Andrea Jung

4280.quote: There are two ways to worry words. One is hoping for the greatest possible beauty in what is created. The other is to tell the truth.
4280.name: June Jordan

4281.quote: I think the 1970s will always be the decade for me. Obviously, I grew up in that era, but the beauty standard was touchable, kissable.
4281.name: Tom Ford

4282.quote: Faith goes out through the window when beauty comes in at the door.
4282.name: George Edward Moore

4283.quote: Grandeur and beauty are so very opposite, that you often diminish the one as you increase the other. Variety is most akin to the latter, simplicity to the former.
4283.name: William Shenstone

4284.quote: Power and beauty come from a very deep place.
4284.name: Brooke Burke

4285.quote: Beauty can't amuse you, but brainwork - reading, writing, thinking - can.
4285.name: Helen Gurley Brown

4286.quote: Wigs have always been a part of my life and have become a staple accessory in my closet. I can remember being a little girl and hearing all the commotion in my house from my mom, aunts and grandmother when picking out their wigs for the day. It was such a good time for them and part of their everyday beauty routine.
4286.name: Sherri Shepherd

4287.quote: I think we should all be tolerant of each other and embrace each others' strengths and differences and uniqueness and beauty.
4287.name: Martina McBride

4288.quote: I have girls who are concerned about how they look compared to models or what have you. It's my responsibility to teach them that beauty is more than superficial.
4288.name: Martina McBride

4289.quote: The beauty about the D-list is that people who are on it probably don't know they are.
4289.name: Kathy Griffin

4290.quote: I find, in being black, a thing of beauty: a joy a strength a secret cup of gladness.
4290.name: Ossie Davis

4291.quote: I'm only wanted by directors for the image I give off, and it makes me angry. I always wanted to be an actor and not a beauty pageant winner.
4291.name: Jude Law

4292.quote: My idea of beauty is somebody that doesn't have to try too much, someone who is effortless and fresh.
4292.name: Jessica Ennis

4293.quote: The English Bible - a book which, if everything else in our language should perish, would alone suffice to show the whole extent of its beauty and power.
4293.name: Thomas B. Macaulay

4294.quote: A supermodel needed to be able to be on 'Sports Illustrated,' to be able to walk runways, to be able to do beauty ads, to be on covers. And the girls now can no longer be on covers and be in the ads because your actresses have taken over all the jobs. I don't know what happened, but we want our jobs back.
4294.name: Kim Alexis

4295.quote: Familiarity is a magician that is cruel to beauty but kind to ugliness.
4295.name: Ouida

4296.quote: There's a beauty in being part of a band, when there's equality and trust.
4296.name: Scott Weiland

4297.quote: I learned the truth at seventeen, That love was meant for beauty queens, And high school girls with clear skinned smiles, Who married young and then retired.
4297.name: Janis Ian

4298.quote: It's nice to just embrace the natural beauty within you.
4298.name: Victoria Justice

4299.quote: A few years ago I lost 30 pounds, and people still wanted to criticize. And honestly, I'm happy with myself if I'm a little heavier. I realized: 'Why am I trying to conform to someone else's idea of beauty?' I think I'm beautiful either way.
4299.name: Khloe Kardashian

4300.quote: We have magnificent brains, but we use a great deal of our brilliance to keep ourselves stuck and ignorant, to keep ourselves from not shining. We are so afraid of our beauty and radiance and brilliance because it scared the adults around us when we were children.
4300.name: Patricia Sun

4301.quote: If I weren't performing, I'd be a beauty editor or a therapist. I love creativity, but I also love to help others. My mother was a hairstylist, and they listen to everyone's problems - like a beauty therapist!
4301.name: Beyonce Knowles

4302.quote: You don't know what the Chinese expect in the way of beauty. The presentation is just a farce. You come into a room filled with 50 people and they don't talk to you. There's very little interaction.
4302.name: Helmut Jahn

4303.quote: Los Angeles is like a beauty parlor at the end of the universe.
4303.name: Emily Mortimer

4304.quote: A special kind of beauty exists which is born in language, of language, and for language.
4304.name: Gaston Bachelard

4305.quote: Beauty must appeal to the senses, must provide us with immediate enjoyment, must impress us or insinuate itself into us without any effort on our part.
4305.name: Claude Debussy

4306.quote: The ideal has many names, and beauty is but one of them.
4306.name: Ninon de L'Enclos

4307.quote: As an inspiration to the author, I do not think the cat can be over-estimated. He suggests so much grace, power, beauty, motion, mysticism. I do not wonder that many writers love cats I am only surprised that all do not.
4307.name: Carl Van Vechten

4308.quote: I'm proud that today, at 43 years old, I've come to value the aging process and focus on inner rather than outer beauty.
4308.name: Carre Otis

4309.quote: There's no such thing is aging, but maturing and knowledge. It's beautiful, I call that beauty.
4309.name: Celine Dion

4310.quote: Not longer loved or fostered by religion, beauty is lifted from its face as a mask, and its absence exposes features on that face which threaten to become incomprehensible to man.
4310.name: Hans Urs von Balthasar

4311.quote: We no longer dare to believe in beauty and we make of it a mere appearance in order the more easily to dispose of it.
4311.name: Hans Urs von Balthasar

4312.quote: I believe every chess player senses beauty, when he succeeds in creating situations, which contradict the expectations and the rules, and he succeeds in mastering this situation.
4312.name: Vladimir Kramnik

4313.quote: The development of beauty in chess never depends on you alone. No matter how much imagination and creativity you invest, you still do not create beauty. Your opponent must react at the same highest level.
4313.name: Vladimir Kramnik

4314.quote: I really wanted there to be something in my life that I enjoy just for the beauty of it.
4314.name: Robert Caro

4315.quote: The New York City Ballet is obviously speaking to a whole new generation and bringing it the same wonder and beauty that it brought previous generations.
4315.name: Robert Caro

4316.quote: Many a genius has been slow of growth. Oaks that flourish for a thousand years do not spring up into beauty like a reed.
4316.name: George Henry Lewes

4317.quote: Every performance is different. That's the beauty of it.
4317.name: Van Morrison

4318.quote: My daily beauty regimen is definitely always in the mornings, and at night, always washing my face with a basic cleanser. I also use a moisturizer with SPF to follow up.
4318.name: Shay Mitchell

4319.quote: We all have to find beauty within us, as opposed to just our exterior.
4319.name: Shay Mitchell

4320.quote: People tend not to use this word beauty because it's not intellectual - but there has to be an overlap between beauty and intellect.
4320.name: Tadao Ando

4321.quote: One night I'll be in Los Angeles and it'll be a Latin crowd, and then another night I'll go to Fresno and it'll be an all-black crowd. To me, that's the beauty of the music.
4321.name: Pitbull

4322.quote: That's the beauty of being a comedian - it's the one job you're allowed to do that. We're lucky. We're really lucky.
4322.name: Colin Quinn

4323.quote: The difference between Marilyn Monroe and the early Pamela Anderson is not that great. What's amazing is that the taste of American men and international tastes in terms of beauty have essentially stayed the same. Styles change, but our view of beauty stays the same.
4323.name: Hugh Hefner

4324.quote: I felt Joyce was an influence on my fiction, but in a very general way, as a kind of inspiration and a model for the beauty of language.
4324.name: Don DeLillo

4325.quote: The beauty of having a producer is that you have someone who says, You're finished.
4325.name: Sheryl Crow

4326.quote: Comics are so full of amazing work. And I can't look at a drawing of a woman without thinking of, for instance, Wallace Wood and his amazing way of capturing beauty.
4326.name: Frank Miller

4327.quote: I cannot go to Montreal without going to Beauty's, my favorite place for breakfast, where I have the Mish-Mash omelet with hot dogs, salami, eggs, green peppers, and onions, and the best banana bread in the world. It's legendary!
4327.name: Gail Simmons

4328.quote: Beauty set up distance between other people and me. It warped their behavior.
4328.name: Candice Bergen

4329.quote: People see you as an object, not as a person, and they project a set of expectations onto you. People who don't have it think beauty is a blessing, but actually it sets you apart.
4329.name: Candice Bergen

4330.quote: A child does not notice the greatness and the beauty of nature and the splendor of God in his works.
4330.name: Rudolf Otto

4331.quote: Once you go inside and weed through the muck, you will find the real beauty, the truth about yourself.
4331.name: Lindsay Wagner

4332.quote: I used to wear a lot of red lipstick, and when I got a pimple, I'd cover it up with eyeliner to turn it into a beauty mark.
4332.name: Selma Blair

4335.name: Tia Carrere

4341.name: Walter Pater

4435.quote: Beauty seen is never lost, God's colors all are fast.

4445.quote: The beauty we love is very silent. It smiles softly to itself, but never speaks.

4447.quote: A woman's beauty is one of her great missions.

4449.name: Elliott Erwitt

4452.name: Vince Gill

4453.quote: In the 19th century, you had bourgeois art without politics - an almost frozen idea of what beauty is.
4453.name: Douglas Sirk

4454.quote: My beauty icon is Angelina Jolie.

4455.quote: It's not like I'm sitting at home coming up with some secret beauty plan.

4462.name: Cristina Saralegui

4476.name: Robert Bridges
