4497.name: Jung Chang

4498.quote: When you are at the bottom, you find beauty in such little things, and goodness in such little gestures. When I compare any struggle today to ones that I may have had in my childhood, there is nothing that can bring me down.
4498.name: Natalia Vodianova

4499.quote: This is why cup finals are so special because on the day anyone can beat anyone. That's what it's all about and that's why for me the FA Cup and the Carling Cup are the best cups in the world. That's the beauty of the cup.
4499.name: Ian Rush

4500.quote: I've been on the cover of 'Time' magazine three times, not for my beauty but because what I was doing was newsworthy around the world. I've worked with teams all my life, but I've been nice and I've been kind.
4500.name: Cheryl Tiegs

4501.quote: I look OK. I look better in person than I do on film, which is bad because it's how I make my living, but I am not a beauty and on balance I am glad.
4501.name: Felicity Huffman

4502.quote: Beauty can make you powerful in a way that isn't good for you. Being OK is better for the person I have become.
4502.name: Felicity Huffman

4503.quote: I'm from Canada, and New Zealand feels like you took all the best bits of Canada and squished them onto a tiny island like Hawaii. I was absolutely blown away by the beauty of the South Island.
4503.name: Evangeline Lilly

4504.quote: Shortly thereafter, some friends encouraged me to try out for the Miss South Carolina World beauty pageant. To my surprise, I won - and was sent to New York City to compete nationally.
4504.name: Donna Rice

4505.quote: This is so cliche, but my beauty icon would have to be Angelina Jolie. She looks like she wears natural makeup, but she's still beautiful.
4505.name: Tila Tequila

4506.quote: I think every person has their own identity and beauty. Everyone being different is what is really beautiful. If we were all the same, it would be boring.
4506.name: Tila Tequila

4507.quote: My sisters and I were fortunate to travel through Asia and Europe at very young ages. We confronted extraordinary beauty in Athens and unspeakable poverty in India.
4507.name: Mary Chapin Carpenter

4508.quote: Pastry is different from cooking because you have to consider the chemistry, beauty and flavor. It's not just sugar and eggs thrown together. I tell my pastry chefs to be in tune for all of this. You have to be challenged by using secret or unusual ingredients.
4508.name: Ron Ben-Israel

4510.quote: The beauty comes with the balance. Everyone should find his own balance in his personal as well as his professional life. Once you do so, you will feel and look beautiful.
4510.name: Karolina Kurkova

4511.quote: In things to be seen at once, much variety makes confusion, another vice of beauty. In things that are not seen at once, and have no respect one to another, great variety is commendable, provided this variety transgress not the rules of optics and geometry.
4511.name: Christopher Wren

4512.quote: You don't have to save the world, but you can be in the world-that's where the beauty comes from.
4512.name: Daphne Zuniga

4513.quote: Seek goodness and be goodness. Seek beauty and be beauty. Seek love and be love.
4513.name: Bryant McGill

4514.quote: I know as an actor there is a certain liberation auditioning for a role that has no beauty requirements.
4514.name: Mireille Enos

4515.quote: You can muck around with different guitars for certain bits, but you have to have your own sound. That's your benchmark, that's your sound. I also play a Black Beauty. It sounds amazing.
4515.name: Dan Hawkins

4516.quote: I have to hit the gym. I have beauty appointments. I have to work toward my next job and maintaining my image, just like an athlete.
4516.name: Linda Evangelista

4517.quote: The beauty of 'The Walking Dead' and the beauty of being on a television show for a while, is that, it's your backstory, it's part of what you are, it's what you carry with you every day.
4517.name: Laurie Holden

4518.quote: We need a balanced, long term energy policy to reduce our dependence on foreign oil and preserve the beauty of the land we love.
4518.name: Heather Wilson

4519.quote: Find beauty not only in the thing itself but in the pattern of the shadows, the light and dark which that thing provides.
4519.name: Junichiro Tanizaki

4520.quote: When the soul looks out of its body, it should see only beauty in its path. These are the sights we must hold in mind, in order to move to a higher place.
4520.name: Yusef Lateef

4521.quote: The sport of horse racing which, at its best, showcases the majestic beauty of this animal and the athleticism of jockeys, has reached an alarming level of corruption and exploitation.
4521.name: Tom Udall

4522.quote: We were astonished by the beauty and refinement of the art displayed by the objects surpassing all we could have imagined - the impression was overwhelming.
4522.name: Howard Carter

4523.quote: The beauty of jazz is that it's malleable. People are addressing it to suit their own personalities.
4523.name: Pat Metheny

4524.quote: Beauty is but a flower, which wrinkles will devour.
4524.name: Thomas Nash

4525.quote: I live by the philosophy that beauty starts from within, and I make a conscious effort to fill my body with nutrients through the food I eat.
4525.name: Miranda Kerr

4526.quote: Everyone has a different beauty and different qualities and I think that women need to learn to love their qualities and be comfortable in the fact that everyone is different.
4526.name: Miranda Kerr

4527.quote: The beauty of a face is not a separate quality but a relation or proportion of qualities to each other.
4527.name: George H. Mead

4528.quote: Truth isn't always beauty, but the hunger for it is.
4528.name: Nadine Gordimer

4529.quote: I don't believe in one ideal beauty.
4529.name: Zac Posen

4530.quote: I have a talent for happiness. I look with the eyes of a painter, and I see beauty.
4530.name: Sylvia Kristel

4531.quote: I just want to continue to break barriers and to show the industry and the world that beauty is diverse, and you don't have to be a certain stereotype to be beautiful.
4531.name: Joan Smalls

4532.quote: I believe that true beauty of chess is more than enough to satisfy all possible demands.
4532.name: Alexander Alekhine

4533.quote: Oh! this opponent, this collaborator against your will, whose notion of beauty always differs from yours and whose means are often too limited for active assistance to your intentions!
4533.name: Alexander Alekhine

4534.quote: The beauty of it is when you can just show up and hit the notes.
4534.name: John Lone

4535.quote: I just try to play music from my heart and bring as much beauty as I can to as many people as I can. Just give them other alternatives, especially people who aren't exposed to creative music.
4535.name: Charlie Haden

4536.quote: We're here to bring beauty to the world and make a difference in this planet. That's what art forms are about.
4536.name: Charlie Haden

4537.quote: I'd like to make really important movies, like American Beauty. I was really proud to be a part of that movie.
4537.name: Allison Janney

4538.quote: Even in decline, a virtuous man increases the beauty of his behavior. A burning stick, though turned to the ground, has its flame drawn upwards.
4538.name: Saskya Pandita

4539.quote: Knowing who the actors were as you were designing them helped, with Catherine's beauty and Renee's frailty, they directed me visually just by who they were.
4539.name: Colleen Atwood

4540.quote: The arts, quite simply, nourish the soul. They sustain, comfort, inspire. There is nothing like that exquisite moment when you first discover the beauty of connecting with others in celebration of larger ideals and shared wisdom.
4540.name: Gordon Gee

4541.quote: I think Islam has been hijacked by the idea that all Muslims are terrorists that Islam is about hate, about war, about jihad - I think that hijacks the spirituality and beauty that exists within Islam. I believe in allowing Islam to be seen in context and in its entirety and being judged on what it really is, not what you think it is.
4541.name: Aasif Mandvi

4542.quote: There's one more thing I want to say. It's a touchy subject. Black beauty. Black sensuality. We live in a culture where the beauty of black people isn't always as celebrated as other types. I'd like to help change that if I can!
4542.name: Jody Watley

4543.quote: Truth is, I cut my hair for freedom, not for beauty.
4543.name: Chrisette Michele

4544.quote: When I was young my Father used to tell me that the two most worthwhile pursuits in life were the pursuit of truth and of beauty and I believe that Alfred Nobel must have felt much the same when he gave these prizes for literature and the sciences.
4544.name: Frederick Sanger

4545.quote: Surely these women won't lose any more of their beauty and charm by putting a ballot in a ballot box once a year than they are likely to lose standing in foundries or laundries all year round. There is no harder contest than the contest for bread, let me tell you that.
4545.name: Rose Schneiderman

4546.quote: My main aim has always been to do good quality films with roles that have some substance. With Power and Beauty there were loads of things that I liked about the movie, which made me opt for it.
4546.name: Natasha Henstridge

4547.quote: Fashion is quite inclusive and good at embracing different things and different forms of beauty. It's a very liberal industry. You can be yourself. Just not overweight.
4547.name: Andrej Pejic

4548.quote: My mum is my beauty icon, because she represents what I think beauty is.
4548.name: Bar Refaeli

4549.quote: My everyday job is about superficial beauty, but when I'm not working I prefer to work on my inner beauty - I read a lot, I try to learn.
4549.name: Bar Refaeli

4550.quote: Beauty, of course, is the most important requirement and the paramount asset of the applicant.
4550.name: Florenz Ziegfeld

4551.quote: In all my career, in my ups and downs, I've never had a beauty campaign. This was meaningful that at almost 41 years old, I could be getting my first beauty campaign. It made me feel really great.
4551.name: Teri Hatcher

4552.quote: I'm 40 and I just got my first beauty campaign with Clairol Nice and Easy.
4552.name: Teri Hatcher

4553.quote: This was meaningful that at almost 41 years old, I could be getting my first beauty campaign.
4553.name: Teri Hatcher

4554.quote: Beauty, like truth, is relative to the time when one lives and to the individual who can grasp it. The expression of beauty is in direct ratio to the power of conception the artist has acquired.
4554.name: Gustave Courbet

4555.quote: Visual surprise is natural in the Caribbean it comes with the landscape, and faced with its beauty, the sigh of History dissolves.
4555.name: Derek Walcott

4556.quote: I know no subject more elevating, more amazing, more ready to the poetical enthusiasm, the philosophical reflection, and the moral sentiment than the works of nature. Where can we meet such variety, such beauty, such magnificence?
4556.name: James Thomson

4557.quote: For, when with beauty we can virtue join, We paint the semblance of a form divine.
4557.name: Matthew Prior

4558.quote: I've just finished reading a book about the brilliant Margaret Rutherford. She wasn't a beauty, but inside she was absolutely blazing and passionate about her work. She's one of those life-affirming characters.
4558.name: Sophie Thompson

4559.quote: My definition of love is being full. Complete. It makes everything lighter. Beauty is something you see. Love is something you feel.
4559.name: Sharon Tate

4560.quote: Through my optimism I naturally prefer and capture the beauty in life.
4560.name: Leni Riefenstahl

4561.quote: I like to find the beauty in the ugly. When I'm in a thrift store, I gravitate toward pieces I know I'll wear a ton, and insane pieces that I'm sure most people would consider gross. But I find them inspiring. Our van is currently stocked with some of my random findings from this tour. Maybe I'll call my aesthetic 'van fashion.'
4561.name: Victoria Legrand

4563.quote: Instead, it appears to be a particular mark of beauty that it is considered with tranquil satisfaction that it pleases if we also do not possess it and we are still far removed from demanding to possess it.
4563.name: Moses Mendelssohn

4564.quote: I was always anti-marriage. I didn't understand monogamy. I couldn't figure out how that could last. And then I met Bryn and I started to understand the beauty of constancy and history and change and going on the roller coaster with someone - of having a partner in life.
4564.name: Maria Bello

4565.quote: Life deprived of beauty is not worthy of being called human.
4565.name: Luis Barragan

4566.quote: Rich men's houses are seldom beautiful, rarely comfortable, and never original. It is a constant source of surprise to people of moderate means to observe how little a big fortune contributes to Beauty.
4566.name: Margot Asquith

4567.quote: The best beauty advice I ever received is to keep skin hydrated and limit harsh exposure to the sun. If you are set on the tanned look, there are plenty of great creams that will give you a healthy-looking glow.
4567.name: Erica Durance

4568.quote: I maintain my inner beauty by trying to lead a balanced life in general. I try to eat healthy foods, but, that doesn't mean I won't treat myself now and then! I work out almost every day, which gives me more energy and helps me feel stronger. I also try to be a genuinely good person to the people around me.
4568.name: Erica Durance

4569.quote: Acting is still, of course, what I love to do most. The beauty of it is that by changing characters, it never gets boring.
4569.name: Christopher Lambert

4570.quote: I always say beauty is only sin deep.
4570.name: Hector Hugh Munro

4571.quote: All I wanted was to connect my moods with those of Paris. Beauty paints and when it painted most, I shot.
4571.name: Ernst Haas

4572.quote: Coming in solemn beauty like slow old tunes of Spain.
4572.name: John Masefield

4573.quote: Where is there beauty when you see deprivation and starvation?
4573.name: Rosalind Russell

4574.quote: Beauty doesn't matter because in the end, we all lose our looks and all we have is our heart.
4574.name: Ann Curry

4575.quote: We have to get back to the beauty of just being alive in this present moment.
4575.name: Mary McDonnell

4576.quote: In prison, inmates sometimes use Cheetos and grape juice as makeup. I wouldn't use that beauty regimen around Britney Spears - she might lick your face off!
4576.name: Joel McHale

4577.quote: I feel fortunate that I'm not a beauty. I'm not a classic beauty. I feel it is harder for girls who are like that. There are fewer parts.
4577.name: Olivia Colman

4578.quote: But my most favourite pursuit, after my daily exertions at the Foundry, was Astronomy. There were frequently clear nights when the glorious objects in the Heavens were seen in most attractive beauty and brilliancy.
4578.name: James Nasmyth

4579.quote: To copy beauty forfeits all pretense to fame to copy faults is want of sense.
4579.name: Charles Churchill

4580.quote: Beauty, sweet love, is like the morning dew, Whose short refresh upon tender green, Cheers for a time, but till the sun doth show And straight is gone, as it had never been.
4580.name: Samuel Daniel

4581.quote: What I loved about 'Summer' was that they were these four bright kids with a wonderful future. In a way, she was the one with the brains, and then you have the beauty queen and the jock and the introvert.
4581.name: Kevin Williamson

4582.quote: Stories aren't the beauty of what did happen. They're the beauty of what could happen.
4582.name: Brad Meltzer

4583.quote: I will admit to hoarding beauty products. I'm a beauty lady.
4583.name: Naya Rivera

4584.quote: Beauty, unlike the rest of the gifts handed out at birth, does not require dedication, patience and hard work to pay off. But it's also the only gift that does not keep on giving.
4584.name: Paulina Porizkova

4585.quote: Beauty magazines make my girlfriend feel ugly.
4585.name: James De La Vega

4586.quote: Coercion may prevent many transgressions but it robs even actions which are legal of a part of their beauty. Freedom may lead to many transgressions, but it lends even to vices a less ignoble form.
4586.name: Wilhelm von Humboldt

4587.quote: People come to see beauty, and I dance to give it to them.
4587.name: Judith Jamison

4588.quote: And beauty immortal awakes from the tomb.
4588.name: James Beattie

4589.quote: I do believe very much in the idea of unexpected or 'convulsive' beauty - beauty in the service of liberty.
4589.name: Jeff Vandermeer

4590.quote: The double hundred Fowler hit in the Madras Test was an absolute beauty.
4590.name: David Gower

4591.quote: Everyone can identify with a fragrant garden, with beauty of sunset, with the quiet of nature, with a warm and cozy cottage.
4591.name: Thomas Kincade

4592.quote: People who put my paintings on their walls are putting their values on their walls: faith, family, home, a simpler way of living, the beauty of nature, quiet, tranquillity, peace, joy, hope. They beckon you into this world that provides an alternative to your nightly news broadcast.
4592.name: Thomas Kincade

4593.quote: Hold fast to youth and beauty.
4593.name: Elizabeth Arden

4594.quote: Tramping is too easy with all this money. My days were more exciting when I was penniless and had to forage around for my next meal, I've decided that I'm going to live this life for some time to come. The freedom and simple beauty of it is just too good to pass up.
4594.name: Christopher McCandless

4595.quote: It never seems to occur to some people, that, like beauty, a sense of humor may sometimes be fatal.
4595.name: Edgar Rice Burroghs

4596.quote: The closest thing I use to beauty products is the grease on the pizza from John's Pizzeria.
4596.name: Mark Feuerstein

4597.quote: I'm very proud of my love for Whitney Houston. She really changed my life. She made my life a better life. She was so beautiful in her love for God, her love for her family and her love for music. She truly loved her music. She could do everything! She had flawless rhythm, flawless pitch, flawless feeling, and flawless beauty.
4597.name: Narada Michael Walden

4598.quote: I first fell in love with music when I was a little boy. When I first heard music, I felt the beauty in it. Then, being able to tap along on a table top and box was great, but my favorite thing to do was to watch records spin. I would almost get hypnotized by it. These things are what drew me in initially.
4598.name: Narada Michael Walden

4599.quote: I'm not a party animal I took my job as Miss USA very seriously, Sometimes, of course, I want to let it all go. Even though I'm a beauty queen, you're also an unofficial ambassador, and there's a lot of pressure.
4599.name: Rima Fakih

4600.quote: The beauty of dystopia is that it lets us vicariously experience future worlds - but we still have the power to change our own.
4600.name: Ally Condie

4601.quote: I have a fantastic wife, and not only in terms of external beauty. Her priority and mine is our children. That is our choice.
4601.name: Luis Figo

4602.quote: I played with the same band for years and years and there's a beauty to having one solid core that you keep exploring. On the other hand, it's nice to throw yourself in different situations where you find out things about your own resources.
4602.name: Grant-Lee Phillips

4603.quote: The ever increasing spiritual damage caused by life within the big city will make this hunger practically uncontrollable when we build here on this the landscape of our homeland we must be clear that we will protect its beauty.
4603.name: Fritz Todt

4604.quote: In places where this beauty has already disappeared, we will reconstruct it.
4604.name: Fritz Todt

4605.quote: The awesomeness of God is that even in the works of the Beach Boys, Beatles, etc., the beauty of the music is a mere reflection of what God does everyday. He creates music of all kinds and moods.
4605.name: John Foster

4606.quote: It is conventional to call 'monster' any blending of dissonant elements. I call 'monster' every original inexhaustible beauty.
4606.name: Alfred Jarry

4607.quote: As long as I love Beauty I am young.
4607.name: W. H. Davies

4608.quote: When I first thought of the idea for 'Sweet Valley High,' I loved the idea of high school as microcosm of the real world. And what I really liked was how it moved things on from 'Sleeping Beauty'-esque romance novels where the girl had to wait for the hero. This would be girl-driven, very different, I decided - and indeed it is.
4608.name: Francine Pascal

4609.quote: Though there might not be any easy answers to the problem of poverty, its most compelling scribes do not resign themselves to representation solely for the sake of those age-old verities of truth and beauty.
4609.name: Leslie Jamison

4610.quote: Far from creating a new formalism, what these can yield is something far transcending surface values since they not only embody form as beauty, but also form in which intuitions or ideas or conjectures have taken visible substance.
4610.name: Max Bill

4611.quote: Beauty: the adjustment of all parts proportionately so that one cannot add or subtract or change without impairing the harmony of the whole.
4611.name: Leon Battista Alberti

4612.quote: Time takes the ugliness and horror out of death and turns it into beauty.
4612.name: Dodie Smith

4613.quote: I'm not out here to win a beauty contest.
4613.name: Kirk Gibson

4614.quote: I think Whitman more than any other poet possessed the gift of revealing to others the beauty of everything around us, the beauty of nature, the beauty of human beings.
4614.name: Ella R. Bloor

4615.quote: I'm not trying to stump anybody, it's the beauty of the language that I'm interested in.
4615.name: Buddy Holly

4616.quote: Suddenly life has new meaning to me, there's beauty up above and things we never take notice of, you wake up suddenly you're in love.
4616.name: Billy Ocean

4617.quote: Beauty is altogether in the eye of the beholder.
4617.name: Lew Wallace

4618.quote: Perfect health, like perfect beauty, is a rare thing and so, it seems, is perfect disease.
4618.name: Peter Latham

4619.quote: The beauty of having short hair is that I actually can wash and style it at home!
4619.name: Meagan Good

4620.quote: The cottage garden most for use designed, Yet not of beauty destitute.
4620.name: Charlotte Smith

4621.quote: You will also allow me to thank the Academy for inviting me to lecture in Stockholm, for its hospitality, and for the opportunity afforded me for admiring the charm of your people and the beauty of your country.
4621.name: Guglielmo Marconi

4622.quote: It's harder, but we're still finding oil in Oklahoma today. The bar has been raised on startup companies, but it can still be done. Every regulation and every rule limits you, but, yes, it can still be done. That's the beauty of living in a free country and having the freedom to have an idea and become an entrepreneur.
4622.name: Harold Hamm

4623.quote: Great designers seldom make great advertising men, because they get overcome by the beauty of the picture - and forget that merchandise must be sold.
4623.name: James Randolph Adams

4624.quote: The beauty of the past belongs to the past.
4624.name: Margaret Bourke-White

4625.quote: It is important to fund young researchers who want to do curiosity-driven research. Curiosity-driven research is a part of life. Some people are curious. They want to learn more about nature and society should help that. It's like art: you can learn more and bring more beauty.
4625.name: Serge Haroche

4626.quote: I have no right to beauty. I had been condemned to masculine ugliness.
4626.name: Renee Vivien

4627.quote: Search for beauty without features, something deeper than any signs.
4627.name: Francesca da Rimini

4628.quote: I have several computer companies. One of them I have a program for wide-format printing. I have a beauty program. So I have several different programs that I own for printing.
4628.name: Jerry Mathers

4629.quote: There are elements of intrinsic beauty in the simplification of a house built on the log cabin idea.
4629.name: Gustav Stickley

4630.quote: First, there is the bare beauty of the logs themselves with their long lines and firm curves. Then there is the open charm felt of the structural features which are not hidden under plaster and ornament, but are clearly revealed, a charm felt in Japanese architecture.
4630.name: Gustav Stickley

4631.quote: There is an abiding beauty which may be appreciated by those who will see things as they are and who will ask for no reward except to see.
4631.name: Vera Brittain

4632.quote: I think love and beauty are what life is all about.
4632.name: John Derek

4633.quote: Beauty is the first test: there is no permanent place in the world for ugly mathematics.
4633.name: Godfrey Harold Hardy

4634.quote: For the greater beauty of the instrument, the balls representing the planets are to be of considerable bigness but so contrived, that they may be taken off at pleasure, and others, much smaller, and fitter for some purposes, put in their places.
4634.name: David Rittenhouse

4635.quote: Literature boils with the madcap careers of writers brought to the edge by the demands of living on their nerves, wringing out their memories and their nightmares to extract meaning, truth, beauty.
4635.name: Herbert Gold

4636.quote: I have a book out called 'The Beauty Equation' and it discusses how off track we have gone in considering beauty.
4636.name: Nigel Barker

4637.quote: Jazz is a very democratic musical form. It comes out of a communal experience. We take our respective instruments and collectively create a thing of beauty.
4637.name: Max Roach

4638.quote: But I fear, my lot being cast in Scotland, that beauty would not be content.
4638.name: Anne Boyd

4639.quote: For most people, we often marvel at the beauty of a sunrise or the magnificence of a full moon, but it is impossible to fathom the magnitude of the universe that surrounds us.
4639.name: Richard H. Baker

4640.quote: Hath the spirit of all beauty Kissed you in the path of duty?
4640.name: Anna Katharine Green

4641.quote: There are two kinds of artists in this world those that work because the spirit is in them, and they cannot be silent if they would, and those that speak from a conscientious desire to make apparent to others the beauty that has awakened their own admiration.
4641.name: Anna Katharine Green

4642.quote: We Orientals find beauty not only in the thing itself but in the pattern of the shadows, the light and darkness which that thing provides.
4642.name: Junichiro Tanizaki

4643.quote: Mathematics are the result of mysterious powers which no one understands, and which the unconscious recognition of beauty must play an important part. Out of an infinity of designs a mathematician chooses one pattern for beauty's sake and pulls it down to earth.
4643.name: Marston Morse

4644.quote: A small house must depend on its grouping with other houses for its beauty, and for the preservation of light air and the maximum of surrounding open space.
4644.name: Clarence Stein

4645.quote: Personality is more important than beauty, but imagination is more important than both of them.
4645.name: Laurette Taylor

4646.quote: You can take no credit for beauty at sixteen. But if you are beautiful at sixty, it will be your own soul's doing.
4646.name: Marie Carmichael Stopes

4647.quote: And queenly is the state she keeps, In beauty's lofty trust secure.
4647.name: William Allen Butler

4648.quote: If beauty isn't genius it usually signals at least a high level of animal cunning.
4648.name: Peter York

4649.quote: I don't know what the secret to longevity as an actress is. It's more than talent and beauty. Maybe it's the audience seeing itself in you.
4649.name: Joan Blondell

4650.quote: The beauty of women was the first expression of my photography.
4650.name: Alberto Korda

4651.quote: What I want to give in the theatre is beauty, that's what I want to give.
4651.name: Dame Edith Evans

4652.quote: I want the Arabic Granada, that which is art, which is all that seems to me beauty and emotion.
4652.name: Isaac Albeniz

4653.quote: The flowers anew, returning seasons bring but beauty faded has no second spring.
4653.name: Ambrose Philips

4654.quote: Those who find beauty in all of nature will find themselves at one with the secrets of life itself.
4654.name: L. Wolfe Gilbert

4655.quote: All the beauty of the world, 'tis but skin deep.
4655.name: Ralph Venning

4656.quote: Beauty is the still birth of suffering, every woman knows that.
4656.name: Emily Prager

4657.quote: I feel by posing for Playboy I've discovered my own sexuality and beauty, and I feel more confident than ever.
4657.name: Heather Kozar

4658.quote: Things turn out best for the people who make the best of the way things turn out.
4658.name: John Wooden

4659.quote: Experience hath shewn, that even under the best forms of government those entrusted with power have, in time, and by slow operations, perverted it into tyranny.
4659.name: Thomas Jefferson

4660.quote: In any moment of decision, the best thing you can do is the right thing, the next best thing is the wrong thing, and the worst thing you can do is nothing.
4660.name: Theodore Roosevelt

4661.quote: To be nobody but yourself in a world which is doing its best, night and day, to make you everybody else means to fight the hardest battle which any human being can fight and never stop fighting.
4661.name: Edward Estlin (e. e. cummings)

4662.quote: In the practice of tolerance, one's enemy is the best teacher.
4662.name: Dalai Lama

4663.quote: I believe that a simple and unassuming manner of life is best for everyone, best both for the body and the mind.
4663.name: Albert Einstein

4664.quote: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
4664.name: Ernest Hemingway

4665.quote: The only real failure in life is not to be true to the best one knows.
4665.name: Buddha

4666.quote: You have to accept whatever comes and the only important thing is that you meet it with courage and with the best that you have to give.

5577.name: Fiona Apple

5578.quote: The best thing you can do is find a person who loves you for exactly what you are.
5578.name: Diablo Cody

5579.quote: I was just doing my job in the ring and doing my best to make people happy.
5579.name: Manny Pacquiao

5580.quote: The best form of government is that which is most likely to prevent the greatest sum of evil.
5580.name: James Monroe

5581.quote: Do the best that you can in the place where you are, and be kind.
5581.name: Scott Nearing

5582.quote: If being an attractive woman got you attention for directing, then the entire 'best director' category would be comprised of models. To me, that is just the most ludicrous connection that you could make.
5582.name: Diablo Cody

5583.quote: I wanna change the game in way where I'm not knocking nobody out of the way, not claiming to be the best at this or that, but just doing wonders with the gift I've been given.
5583.name: Anthony Hamilton

5584.quote: I don't think I ever got the hang of the writers' room. I love collaborating with people, but I really do my best work alone, and I think I would want to - if I did something again, I think I'd want to take total ownership the way Aaron Sorkin or David Kelley does.
5584.name: Diablo Cody

5585.quote: Speaking of Twitter, I don't even know if I composed a blog entry in 2009, as I was too busy parceling my every thought into cute 140-character sound bites. I used to only worry about being pithy for a living now some of my best lines are wasted on a free app!
5585.name: Diablo Cody

5586.quote: The best way to begin genuine bipartisanship to make America stronger is to work together on the real crises facing our country, not to manufacture an artificial crisis to serve a special interest agenda out of touch with the needs of Americans.
5586.name: John F. Kerry

5587.quote: The best way to deal with that is to live in a fully conscious, compassionate, loving way. Don't wait until you're on your deathbed to recognize that this is the only way to live.
5587.name: Morrie Schwartz

5588.quote: The best player I ever played with was Dennis Johnson.
5588.name: Larry Bird

5589.quote: I get a lot of the ideas when I'm resting - either when I'm meditating or getting some kind of work done on my back, like physical therapy or acupuncture. That's where I get my best ideas, maybe because I'm balancing my body.
5589.name: Katy Perry

5590.quote: One of the best parts of growing older? You can flirt all you like since you've become harmless.
5590.name: Liz Smith

5591.quote: Once you are labeled 'the best' you want to stay up there, and you can't do it by loafing around.
5591.name: Larry Bird

5592.quote: I'm either going to go completely mental, completely bankrupt, or have the best success of my life.
5592.name: Katy Perry

5593.quote: One of the best things for a woman to hear is that she is sexy.
5593.name: Scarlett Johansson

5594.quote: Recruitment and retention are critical to sustain our Armed Forces with the best men and women willing to stand in the gap and make huge sacrifices to ensure our freedom.
5594.name: Zack Wamp

5595.quote: What I love best in life is new starts.
5595.name: Karl Lagerfeld

5596.quote: I've found the best way is to not be scared of the attention but to be grateful for it and open to it. It makes my days better rather than being annoyed that people want my attention.
5596.name: Brandon Routh

5597.quote: Democracy functions best when we have an active citizenry.
5597.name: Rick Perry

5598.quote: God gave us the gift of life it is up to us to give ourselves the gift of living well.
5598.name: Voltaire

5599.quote: The more you praise and celebrate your life, the more there is in life to celebrate.
5599.name: Oprah Winfrey

5600.quote: My father gave me the greatest gift anyone could give another person, he believed in me.
5600.name: Jim Valvano

5601.quote: I think, at a child's birth, if a mother could ask a fairy godmother to endow it with the most useful gift, that gift should be curiosity.
5601.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

5602.quote: The greatest gift that you can give to others is the gift of unconditional love and acceptance.
5602.name: Brian Tracy

5603.quote: Every year on your birthday, you get a chance to start new.
5603.name: Sammy Hagar

5604.quote: All the world is birthday cake, so take a piece, but not too much.
5604.name: George Harrison

5605.quote: Thirty was so strange for me. I've really had to come to terms with the fact that I am now a walking and talking adult.
5605.name: C. S. Lewis

5606.quote: How old would you be if you didn't know how old you are?
5606.name: Satchel Paige

5607.quote: I remember when the candle shop burned down. Everyone stood around singing 'Happy Birthday.'
5607.name: Steven Wright

5608.quote: Presents don't really mean much to me. I don't want to sound mawkish, but - it was the realization that I have a great many people in my life who really love me, and who I really love.
5608.name: Gabriel Byrne

5609.quote: You know you're getting old when you get that one candle on the cake. It's like, 'See if you can blow this out.'
5609.name: Jerry Seinfeld

5610.quote: A gift consists not in what is done or given, but in the intention of the giver or doer.
5610.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

5611.quote: For my birthday I got a humidifier and a de-humidifier, I put them in the same room and let them fight it out.
5611.name: Steven Wright

5612.quote: You know you're getting old when the candles cost more than the cake.
5612.name: Bob Hope

5613.quote: A friend never defends a husband who gets his wife an electric skillet for her birthday.
5613.name: Erma Bombeck

5614.quote: I wanted to buy a candle holder, but the store didn't have one. So I got a cake.
5614.name: Mitch Hedberg

5615.quote: The way I see it, you should live everyday like its your birthday.
5615.name: Paris Hilton

5616.quote: It is lovely, when I forget all birthdays, including my own, to find that somebody remembers me.
5616.name: Ellen Glasgow

5617.quote: There are three hundred and sixty-four days when you might get un-birthday presents, and only one for birthday presents, you know.
5617.name: Lewis Carroll

5618.quote: The only thing better than singing is more singing.
5618.name: Ella Fitzgerald

5619.quote: It was on my fifth birthday that Papa put his hand on my shoulder and said, 'Remember, my son, if you ever need a helping hand, you'll find one at the end of your arm.'
5619.name: Sam Levenson

5620.quote: To me - old age is always ten years older than I am.
5620.name: John Burroughs

5621.quote: Let us celebrate the occasion with wine and sweet words.
5621.name: Plautus

5622.quote: About astrology and palmistry: they are good because they make people vivid and full of possibilities. They are communism at its best. Everybody has a birthday and almost everybody has a palm.
5622.name: Kurt Vonnegut

5623.quote: We have to be able to grow up. Our wrinkles are our medals of the passage of life. They are what we have been through and who we want to be.
5623.name: Lauren Hutton

5624.quote: The return of my birthday, if I remember it, fills me with thoughts which it seems to be the general care of humanity to escape.
5624.name: Samuel Johnson

5625.quote: If you look over the years, the styles have changed - the clothes, the hair, the production, the approach to the songs. The icing to the cake has changed flavors. But if you really look at the cake itself, it's really the same.
5625.name: John Oates

5626.quote: A gift, with a kind countenance, is a double present.
5626.name: Thomas Fuller

5627.quote: I cried on my 18th birthday. I thought 17 was such a nice age. You're young enough to get away with things, but you're old enough, too.
5627.name: Liv Tyler

5628.quote: Our birthdays are feathers in the broad wing of time.
5628.name: Jean Paul

5629.quote: Like many women my age, I am 28 years old.
5629.name: Mary Schmich

5630.quote: There is still no cure for the common birthday.
5630.name: John Glenn

5631.quote: I'm not materialistic. I believe in presents from the heart, like a drawing that a child does.
5631.name: Victoria Beckham

5633.quote: Handmade presents are scary because they reveal that you have too much free time.
5633.name: Doug Coupland

5634.quote: New Year's Day is every man's birthday.
5634.name: Charles Lamb

5635.quote: Most of us can remember a time when a birthday - especially if it was one's own - brightened the world as if a second sun has risen.
5635.name: Robert Staughton Lynd

5636.quote: Your children need your presence more than your presents.
5636.name: Jesse Jackson

5637.quote: Being seventy is not a sin.
5637.name: Golda Meir

5638.quote: The best way to remember your wife's birthday is to remember it once.
5638.name: E. Joseph Cossman

5639.quote: If you can give your child only one gift, let it be enthusiasm.
5639.name: Bruce Barton

5641.quote: Love the giver more than the gift.
5641.name: Brigham Young

5642.quote: When someone asks if you'd like cake or pie, why not say you want cake and pie?
5642.name: Lisa Loeb

5643.quote: I often buy myself presents. Sometimes I will spend $100,000 in one day in a posh boutique.
5643.name: Celine Dion

5644.quote: My biggest hero, Gregory Peck, was my birthday present on April 14, 1973. I just sat and stared at him.
5644.name: Loretta Lynn

5645.quote: The main prank that we play with props is for people's birthdays. The special effects people will put a little explosive in the cake so it blows up in their face - that's always fun to play on a guest star, or one of the trainees or someone who's new.
5645.name: Catherine Bell

5646.quote: To my surprise, my 70s are nicer than my 60s and my 60s than my 50s, and I wouldn't wish my teens and 20s on my enemies.
5646.name: Lionel Blue

5647.quote: When I turned 60, it didn't bother me at all.
5647.name: Yoko Ono

5648.quote: We'll take the cake with the red cherry on top.
5648.name: Navjot Singh Sidhu

5649.quote: I binge when I'm happy. When everything is going really well, every day is like I'm at a birthday party.
5649.name: Kirstie Alley

5650.quote: I used to be good with kids, but as I get older, I'm grumpy and terrible with them. As for doing a gig at a 6-year old's birthday party, you couldn't pay me enough.
5650.name: Johnny Vegas

5651.quote: I quit high school on my birthday. It was my senior year and I didn't see the point. This was 1962, and I was ready to make music.
5651.name: Barry White

5652.quote: Only then, approaching my fortieth birthday, I made philosophy my life's work.
5652.name: Karl Jaspers

5653.quote: I had a birthday one night on a farm we were shooting on. I walked into the tent, and there were 150 people waiting for me, all wearing masks of my face.
5653.name: Stephen Hopkins

5654.quote: My mother asked me what I wanted for my birthday, so I said I wanted to read poetry with her.
5654.name: Guy Johnson

5655.quote: Would ye both eat your cake and have your cake?
5655.name: John Heywood

5656.quote: In 1993 my birthday present was a star on Hollywood's Walk of Fame.
5656.name: Annette Funicello

5657.quote: I'm amazed. When I was 40, I thought I'd never make 50. And at 50 I thought the frosting on the cake would be 60. At 60, I was still going strong and enjoying everything.
5657.name: Gloria Stuart

5658.quote: When I was little I thought, isn't it nice that everybody celebrates on my birthday? Because it's July 4th.
5658.name: Gloria Stuart

5659.quote: This is a wonderful way to celebrate an 80th birthday, I wanted to be 65 again, but they wouldn't let me - Homeland Security.
5659.name: Art Buchwald

5660.quote: I do like to shock and surprise people. When it's all in good fun, of course.
5660.name: Ruth Warrick

5661.quote: I crashed my boyfriend's birthday when I was 12 years old. He didn't invite me and so I showed up.
5661.name: Isla Fisher

5662.quote: A diplomat is a man who always remembers a woman's birthday but never remembers her age.
5662.name: Robert Frost

5663.quote: I wrapped my Christmas presents early this year, but I used the wrong paper. See, the paper I used said 'Happy Birthday' on it. I didn't want to waste it so I just wrote 'Jesus' on it.
5663.name: Demetri Martin

5664.quote: Success is like reaching an important birthday and finding you're exactly the same.
5664.name: Audrey Hepburn

5665.quote: The day which we fear as our last is but the birthday of eternity.
5665.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

5666.quote: With my wife I don't get no respect. I made a toast on her birthday to 'the best woman a man ever had.' The waiter joined me.
5666.name: Rodney Dangerfield

5667.quote: It was my 16th birthday - my mom and dad gave me my Goya classical guitar that day. I sat down, wrote this song, and I just knew that that was the only thing I could ever really do - write songs and sing them to people.
5667.name: Stevie Nicks

5668.quote: Just hit my 75th birthday, I'm feeling great!
5668.name: Colin Powell

5669.quote: You know, maybe I was just born in the wrong time, but I love all things romantic. Puffy understands that. For my last birthday, he covered my hotel room floor with rose petals and had flowers and candles all over the room.
5669.name: Jennifer Lopez

5670.quote: Mum loves me being famous! She is so excited and proud, as she had me so young and couldn't support me, so I am living her dream, it's sweeter for both of us. It's her 40th birthday soon and I'm going to buy her 40 presents.
5670.name: Adele

5671.quote: I'm most comfortable in my birthday suit.
5671.name: Amanda Seyfried

5672.quote: It's odd the things that people remember. Parents will arrange a birthday party, certain it will stick in your mind forever. You'll have a nice time, then two years later you'll be like, 'There was a pony there? Really? And a clown with one leg?'
5672.name: David Sedaris

5673.quote: Some people won't go the extra mile, and then on their birthday, when no one makes a fuss, they feel neglected and bitter.
5673.name: Anne Lamott

5674.quote: You always get a special kick on opening day, no matter how many you go through. You look forward to it like a birthday party when you're a kid. You think something wonderful is going to happen.
5674.name: Joe DiMaggio

5675.quote: I trained to be a priest - started to. I went to seminary school when I was 11. I wanted to be a priest, but when they told me I could never have sex, not even on my birthday, I changed my mind.
5675.name: Johnny Vegas

5676.quote: I gave a funny speech at my wife's birthday party, and I'm thinking, 'Hey, I've still got it.'
5676.name: Larry David

5677.quote: My ace in the hole as a human being used to be my capacity for remembering birthdays. I worked at it. Whenever I made a new friend, I made a point of finding out his or her birthday early on, and I would record it in my Filofax calendar.
5677.name: Susan Orlean

5678.quote: I want a chainsaw very badly, because I think cutting down a tree would be unbelievably satisfying. I have asked for a chainsaw for my birthday, but I think I'll probably be given jewelry instead.
5678.name: Susan Orlean

5679.quote: I just had my 30th birthday and we went turkey shooting. It's what I wanted to do, so we went.
5679.name: Kelly Clarkson

5680.quote: Every day, every birthday candle I blow out, every penny I throw over my shoulder in a wishing well, every time my daughter says, 'Let's make a wish on a star,' there's one thing I wish for: wisdom.
5680.name: Rene Russo

5681.quote: I left school on my 15th birthday.
5681.name: David Bailey

5682.quote: The worst part about celebrating another birthday is the shock that you're only as well as you are.
5682.name: Anne Lamott

5683.quote: I like to go to anybody else's birthday, and if I'm invited I'm a good guest. But I never celebrate my birthdays. I really don't care.
5683.name: Mikhail Baryshnikov

5684.quote: When I was a kid, for my birthday every year, my mother made me pasta bechamel, which is rigatoni with a white cream sauce.
5684.name: Giada De Laurentiis

5685.quote: Anybody can have a birthday. It requires nothing. Murderers have birthdays. It's the opposite of anything that I believe in. And I don't like at work where you stop everything to sing 'Happy Birthday' to someone. I feel like that's for children.
5685.name: Mindy Kaling

5686.quote: My best kiss was on stage. Kelly Rowland from Destiny's Child gave me a really nice soft kiss on my lips during a performance on my birthday. It was amazing.
5686.name: Chris Brown

5687.quote: I tried to bake a cake for my mother's birthday - it took me four hours. It was terrible, and I cried for three days.
5687.name: Rachael Ray

5688.quote: My happiest memory of childhood was my first birthday in reform school. This teacher took an interest in me. In fact, he gave me the first birthday presents I ever got: a box of Cracker Jacks and a can of ABC shoe polish.
5688.name: Flip Wilson

5689.quote: If we celebrate Martin Luther King Jr.'s birthday at a time of presidential inaugurals, this is thanks to Ronald Reagan who created the holiday, and not to the Democratic Congress of the Carter years, which rejected it.
5689.name: David Horowitz

5690.quote: Interventions are really emotionally exhausting and I would never ever want to have one. In the same way, I would never want to have a surprise birthday party. That would be horrible.
5690.name: Margaret Cho

5691.quote: I had been offered a Hollywood contract before my 18th birthday. It gave me the spark I needed.
5691.name: Gene Tierney

5692.quote: It is ironic that the one thing that all religions recognize as separating us from our creator, our very self-consciousness, is also the one thing that divides us from our fellow creatures. It was a bitter birthday present from evolution.
5692.name: Annie Dillard

5693.quote: I tend to foster drama via bleakness. If I want the reader to feel sympathy for a character, I cleave the character in half, on his birthday. And then it starts raining. And he's made of sugar.
5693.name: George Saunders

5694.quote: My second play, The Birthday Party, I wrote in 1958 - or 1957. It was totally destroyed by the critics of the day, who called it an absolute load of rubbish.
5694.name: Harold Pinter

5695.quote: Since graduation, I have measured time in 4-by-5-inch pieces of paper, four days on the left and three on the right. Every social engagement, interview, reading, flight, doctor's appointment, birthday and dry-cleaning reminder has been handwritten between metal loops.
5695.name: Sloane Crosley

5696.quote: I'm a summer baby, so I usually have my birthday as a good summer memory.
5696.name: Sloane Crosley

5697.quote: The Queen of Crafts herself, Martha Stewart, and I have the same birthday. I prefer to think it's the glue-gun wielding, perfect-tart-producing Martha and not the copper pan-throwing, jail-going Martha. But I suppose if I am going to share a calendar square with some of Martha, I have to share it with all of Martha.
5697.name: Sloane Crosley

5698.quote: I'm over the moon to be involved in the 'Doctor Who' Christmas special. I can't quite believe it as it's a part of the family tradition at the Jenkins household. I heard the news that I got the role on my 30th birthday and it was the best birthday present ever.
5698.name: Katherine Jenkins

5699.quote: The first guitar I ever got was for my 13th birthday.
5699.name: Rick Springfield

5700.quote: As I approach my 88th birthday, it's become apparent to me that my eyes and ears, among other appurtenances, aren't quite what they used to be. The prospect of long flights to wherever in search of whatever are not quite as appealing.
5700.name: Mike Wallace

5701.quote: I've got some incredible fans actually - so loyal and they make me birthday cards and Christmas cards. I got this package of poems and artwork based around the songs. They've got this thing called 'Floetry' where they all have to put in artwork. They've set up their own competitions and stuff which is kind of amazing.
5701.name: Florence Welch

5702.quote: All my favorite stars, my family and my friends are here. I'm having the happiest birthday that an 18-year-old girl could ever have.
5702.name: Brandy Norwood

5703.quote: John Candy knew he was going to die. He told me on his 40th birthday. He said, well, Maureen, I'm on borrowed time.
5703.name: Maureen O'Hara

5704.quote: I have had fans make me the big picture collages of the photo books I have had fans send me birthday cakes, sing to me on my voicemail. I have had fans flash me. I have had older fans give me their bras and underwear onstage.
5704.name: Puff Daddy

5705.quote: The day before my 16th birthday I got my guitar.
5705.name: Stevie Nicks

5706.quote: I hate birthdays. I hate birthday parties. I hate them. I don't know what it is, anybody's only got to come wafting near me with a piece of cake with a candle on and I break out in hives.
5706.name: Cat Deeley

5707.quote: I saw Richard Linklater's film 'Slacker' for my twenty-first birthday. That was the moment when it all seemed possible. This guy gave me hope.
5707.name: Kevin Smith

5708.quote: The reason I met my husband was because I remembered a friend's birthday. The moral of the story is: Remember people's birthdays.
5708.name: Julianna Margulies

5709.quote: You know, we'd just had a birthday, he was, you know, he still had a future out of him, and all I can is he was just one of the most beautiful people in the world, a very gifted man, and it's a loss to the world, not just for us.
5709.name: Robin Gibb

5710.quote: Citizens, thank you for all your birthday wishes. I am 88 years old today and still lucky to live in the greatest city in the world.
5710.name: Ed Koch

5711.quote: I worked at an ice cream parlor called Chadwicks. We wore old-timey outfits and had to bang a drum, play a kazoo, and sing 'Happy Birthday' to people while giving them free birthday sundaes. Lots of ice cream scooping and $1 tips.
5711.name: Amy Poehler

5712.quote: For the youth, the indignation of most things will just surge as each birthday passes.
5712.name: Chris Evans

5713.quote: I've never looked forward to a birthday like I'm looking forward to my new daughter's birthday, because two days after that is when I can apply for reinstatement.
5713.name: Pete Rose

5714.quote: I play PC and Xbox games at home, and I just got a PSP as a birthday present.
5714.name: Uwe Boll

5715.quote: We didn't have a whole lot of money when I was growing up either. I would always ask for magic books or magic tricks for my birthday or for Christmas and the rest of the year I either had to mow lawns or find part time jobs to help supplement the cost of doing magic.
5715.name: Lance Burton

5716.quote: With my daughter, we do arts and crafts, we read a lot, we listen to music, and we cut the strings off balloons and bounce them around after birthday parties.
5716.name: Lisa Loeb

5717.quote: I was fired at the pinnacle of my career, on my 39th birthday. And in the year that followed, I learned that there are many psychological phases of being 'let go.'
5717.name: Mika Brzezinski

5718.quote: I get uncomfortable when people give me presents and watch me open them. I don't have birthday parties, because the idea of a group of people singing and looking at me while I'm blowing out candles gives me hives.
5718.name: Brit Marling

5719.quote: My mom won't let me buy high-fashion stuff unless it's TK Maxx or a birthday occasion.
5719.name: Chloe Moretz

5720.quote: My mom and my father's birthday are on the same day.
5720.name: Victor Cruz

5721.quote: I'm trying to get the record that I made at my birthday party last year, trying to get that out, and the lawyers are diddling around with it and it probably won't be out until next year. I don't know.
5721.name: Marian McPartland

5722.quote: And currently, there are four to five new works in the pipeline for upcoming celebrations such as the Sydney 2000 Olympics, Australian Federation, my 50th Birthday, and Sydney Dance Company's 25th Anniversary.
5722.name: Graeme Murphy

5723.quote: I was quite a shy child. I would get terribly nervous and throw up before my birthday party. And then I would be fine. I feel the same now. I get nervous, then it's fine.
5723.name: Matthew Macfadyen

5724.quote: I can put my legs behind my head and sing 'Happy Birthday.' Because that's something that me and my friends used to do when we were in gymnastics class as kids, and I can still do it. I was doing it since I was 8 and 9. They used to call me Gumby. Very bendy.
5724.name: Emmy Rossum

5725.quote: I want to say that probably 24 hours after I told CBS that I was stepping down at my 65th birthday, I was already regretting it. And I regretted it every day since.
5725.name: Walter Cronkite

5726.quote: On my birthday, I was in Milan for the collections.
5726.name: Eva Herzigova

5727.quote: I lost twins at 14 weeks, and I had to have an D and C on my birthday.
5727.name: Amy Weber

5728.quote: I always wanted to shave. It is a very natural process. For my birthday I got a lot of shaving stuff.
5728.name: Chaz Bono

5729.quote: I told my father I wanted to play the banjo, and so he saved the money and got ready to give me a banjo for my next birthday, and between that time and my birthday, I lost interest in the banjo and was playing guitar.
5729.name: Jackson Browne

5730.quote: As far as those kinds of things, I also played at the concert to call for the release of Nelson Mandela when he was a political prisoner in South Africa. We were celebrating his 70th birthday and calling for his release.
5730.name: Jackson Browne

5731.quote: I love photography. My boyfriend's got a great camera, which I bought for his birthday.
5731.name: Sarah Sutton

5732.quote: My son had his eighth birthday recently and we had a chance to borrow the film and show it to all of his friends that was at his birthday party and they loved it. I was a little nervous. I said they might not even like it, and say his daddy's movie is wack, but they loved it.
5732.name: Blair Underwood

5733.quote: I grew up doing all that stuff because I was obsessed with the '50s. I had sock hops for birthday parties. So I've always done The Twist and stuff. It was pretty natural and, with my parents doing it all the time, I'd just copy them. Not very pretty.
5733.name: Brittany Snow

5734.quote: For my birthday my husband learned to cook and is cooking one day a week for me. But he only likes to do fancy dishes. So we end up with weird, obscure things in the refrigerator.
5734.name: Cheryl Hines

5735.quote: My first recognition of age setting in was exactly on my 36th birthday. I have no idea why, on this day of all days, I looked in the mirror and realized my face no longer looked young.
5735.name: Paulina Porizkova

5736.quote: And for the city's birthday, we will host events in every neighborhood of the city, inviting all of our residents to share in the celebration of Boston's great epic - the story of neighbors who support one another where it matters most.
5736.name: Thomas Menino

5737.quote: I hate birthdays. I thought that I only hated my own birthday, and then I realized that I hate my children's birthdays too.
5737.name: Samantha Bee

5738.quote: I suddenly realized how much I loved her when we attended Alfred Hitchcock's 75th birthday party last August. There was something magical about that night, and it made me see how much she really meant to me.
5738.name: Rod Taylor

5739.quote: Any time women come together with a collective intention, it's a powerful thing. Whether it's sitting down making a quilt, in a kitchen preparing a meal, in a club reading the same book, or around the table playing cards, or planning a birthday party, when women come together with a collective intention, magic happens.
5739.name: Phylicia Rashad

5740.quote: I started running around my 30th birthday. I wanted to lose weight I didn't anticipate the serenity. Being in motion, suddenly my body was busy and so my head could work out some issues I had swept under a carpet of wine and cheese. Good therapy, that's a good run.
5740.name: Michael Weatherly

5741.quote: Well, I started conducting kind of by accident. I wanted to give myself a special birthday present for my fortieth birthday, and I was living in San Francisco at the time and I started attending some of the concerts and then simply dropping hints.
5741.name: Bobby McFerrin

5742.quote: My mom FedExes a red velvet cake she makes from scratch to me every birthday.
5742.name: Molly Sims

5743.quote: Nicole will come up in conversations where it's in a part of the conversation. Or we may be somewhere and I would tell some story about their mother and I. You know, we always honor her birthday.
5743.name: O. J. Simpson

5744.quote: I went to a rare live Van Dyke show and met him there. And then he came to a show of mine and we spoke back stage. The third time was at Brian Wilson's birthday party.
5744.name: Matthew Sweet
