6746.quote: I love sleeping in a moving car more than sleeping in bed.
6746.name: Ben Stein

6747.quote: The body is like a car: the older you become the more care you have to take care of it - and you don't leave a Ferrari out in the sun.
6747.name: Joan Collins

6748.quote: I wanted to be a mechanic. When I was 14 I wanted to quit school and go work on my car. But my dad said Son, you shouldn't do that. You should stay in school until your education is finished, and when you're done, don't make your hobby your job.
6748.name: Eric Bana

6749.quote: The newly decorated theatres produced things like car parks and restaurants, so you could have a good night out, quite cheaply without all that bother of having to go somewhere else.
6749.name: Timothy West

6750.quote: My daughter Lila loves the smell of gasoline - she always says, 'Mummy, keep the door open,' when I'm filling up the car. I've heard it is one of the most preferred scents in the world - maybe that's something to study for my next fragrance!
6750.name: Kate Moss

6751.quote: Consider what kind of car you get. Buy cars and other products that have the least impact environmentally.
6751.name: Al Gore

6752.quote: Once you become successful, people know where you live, the type of house you live in, the kind of car you drive, the clothes you wear, and so it would be patronising to go and talk like a welder. Welding's a mystery to me now. You can't go back, your life changes every day.
6752.name: Billy Connolly

6753.quote: There is a limit to the application of democratic methods. You can inquire of all the passengers as to what type of car they like to ride in, but it is impossible to question them as to whether to apply the brakes when the train is at full speed and accident threatens.
6753.name: Leon Trotsky

6754.quote: Food is not just what we put in our mouths to fill up it is culture and identity. Reason plays some role in our decisions about food, but it's rarely driving the car.
6754.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

6755.quote: Removing the faults in a stage-coach may produce a perfect stage-coach, but it is unlikely to produce the first motor car.
6755.name: Edward de Bono

6756.quote: Buyers decide in the first eight seconds of seeing a home if they're interested in buying it. Get out of your car, walk in their shoes and see what they see within the first eight seconds.
6756.name: Barbara Corcoran

6757.quote: I'm still that little girl who lisped and sat in the back of the car and threw vegetables at the back of her head when we drove home from the market. That never goes.
6757.name: Tracey Ullman

6758.quote: I want to be remembered for the work that I've done, rather than the car accidents that I've gotten into, the men that I've not dated - or the man that I have.
6758.name: Lindsay Lohan

6759.quote: My first car was a motorcycle.
6759.name: Adam Carolla

6760.quote: So I was getting into my car, and this bloke says to me 'Can you give me a lift?' I said 'Sure, you look great, the world's your oyster, go for it.''
6760.name: Tim Vine

6761.quote: Is fuel efficiency really what we need most desperately? I say that what we really need is a car that can be shot when it breaks down.
6761.name: Russell Baker

6762.quote: Design is important, it's an important dimension in the car. It's not the only one.
6762.name: Carlos Ghosn

6763.quote: We have some worse scenarios for which we need to prepare as companies. For the moment, we're planning for the worst, and the worst is now, and the car market is down more than 15 percent in France. There is so much uncertainty.
6763.name: Carlos Ghosn

6764.quote: I've got CDs in my car, listening all the time for that next song, because everybody's looking.
6764.name: Reba McEntire

6765.quote: You sell a screenplay like you sell a car. If someone drives it off a cliff, that's it.
6765.name: Rita Mae Brown

6766.quote: If a movie is really working, you forget for two hours your Social Security number and where your car is parked. You are having a vicarious experience. You are identifying, in one way or another, with the people on the screen.
6766.name: Roger Ebert

6767.quote: I didn't come from a trailer park. I grew up middle class and my dad had money and my mom made my lunch. I got a car when I was sixteen. I'm proud of that.
6767.name: Kid Rock

6768.quote: Normal is getting dressed in clothes that you buy for work, driving through traffic in a car that you are still paying for, in order to get to a job that you need so you can pay for the clothes, car and the house that you leave empty all day in order to afford to live in it.
6768.name: Ellen Goodman

6769.quote: The irony is that it was tougher to rent a car from Cerberus when it owned Alamo than to buy a semi-automatic. To rent a car, one had to provide ID, a drivers' license, and get insurance coverage. To buy a gun? Cash and carry, from the back of a station wagon at a gun show. No concerns about downstream liability or risk.
6769.name: Eliot Spitzer

6770.quote: At least 50 times. I've jumped off a building, jumped off a cliff in a car. I've been in bedrooms when women came in with knives and guns.
6770.name: Dennis Rodman

6771.quote: Can you design a Rorschach test that's going to make everyone feel something every time - and that looks like a Rorschach test? It's easy to show a picture of a kitten or a car accident. The question is, how abstract can you get and still get the audience to feel something when they don't know what's happening to them?
6771.name: Jason Reitman

6772.quote: The American Dream has run out of gas. The car has stopped. It no longer supplies the world with its images, its dreams, its fantasies. No more. It's over. It supplies the world with its nightmares now: the Kennedy assassination, Watergate, Vietnam.
6772.name: J. G. Ballard

6773.quote: You know what I really love? The CD players in a car. How when you put the CD right up by the slot, it actually takes it out of your hand, like it's hungry. It pulls it in, and you feel like it wants more silver discs.
6773.name: Tom Waits

6774.quote: My mother gave me this book called Feature Films at Used Car Prices by a guy named Rick Schmidt. I gotta credit the guy, cuz he gave me the most practical advice. It empowers you.
6774.name: Vin Diesel

6775.quote: At a car dealership, the person who sells the car is the hero, and also gets the commission. But if the mechanics don't service that car well, the customer won't return.
6775.name: Roger Staubach

6776.quote: When life was worrying about a car payment or a rent payment and a bill, you're so consumed with that, you really don't have time to know yourself. That's surviving and getting by.
6776.name: Fred Durst

6777.quote: The city needs a car like a fish needs a bicycle.
6777.name: Dean Kamen

6778.quote: If you don't have the story and the unfolding of the trajectory of the saga, it's like getting in a car and not having any gas.
6778.name: Gus Van Sant

6779.quote: Anything that's different from your own realm of experience as a human being, whether it's driving a car or a boat, or using guns, anything that separates you from yourself and leads you more towards this character's existence is a big help.
6779.name: Colin Farrell

6780.quote: I think you have to feel comfortable with your car. You have to go into turn one, every lap, with confidence. You have to be sure of yourself and your equipment.
6780.name: Danica Patrick

6781.quote: Someday we'll look back on this moment and plow into a parked car.
6781.name: Evan Davis

6782.quote: My definition of a redundancy is an air-bag in a politician's car.
6782.name: Larry Hagman

6783.quote: You must do as your people do. If my people are poor, I must be poor. People ask me, 'Why don't you find a personal coach or a private car?' I can't. Then I won't be part of my people.
6783.name: Haile Gebrselassie

6784.quote: I swear my car won't run unless I'm picking my nose: At least, I'm that superstitious about it, so I don't want to take any chances.
6784.name: Adam Carolla

6785.quote: I think we're getting to the point where everyone's getting fat and everyone's getting allergic, or claims to be allergic to something and people can't walk from their front door to their car without a bottle of water in their hand because they have to hydrate every three and half steps.
6785.name: Adam Carolla

6786.quote: A critic is a man who knows the way but can't drive the car.
6786.name: Kenneth Tynan

6787.quote: Nobody's ever asked me to pay for a meal before I've eaten it, I've never been pulled over just because I was driving the wrong kind of car in the wrong kind of area at the wrong time of night.
6787.name: Wentworth Miller

6788.quote: When I saw all those other drivers, I realized that they wanted to win that money just as much as I did. But I didn't have to worry. A tire came off my car and I was lucky I got it off the track.
6788.name: Buck Baker

6789.quote: I remember walking the dog one day, I saw a car full of teenage girls, and one of them rolled down the window and yelled, 'Marc Jacobs!' in a French accent.
6789.name: Marc Jacobs

6790.quote: It just seemed too weird to me. I don't know, maybe they were smoking a joint in the car downstairs from their parents' apartment. I had to go that far to put together a scenario of how they could have possibly recognized me.
6790.name: Marc Jacobs

6791.quote: You want to make sure this particular car is going to please the customer and then you're going to be rewarded with something that is going to please the shareholder.
6791.name: Carlos Ghosn

6792.quote: The bass player's function, along with the drums, is to be the engine that drives the car, everything else is merely colours.
6792.name: Suzi Quatro

6793.quote: Spending $1 for a brand new house would feel very, very good. Spending $1,000 for a ham sandwich would feel very, very bad. Spending $19,000 for a small family car would feel, well, more or less right. But as with physical pain, fiscal pain can depend on the individual, and everyone has a different threshold.
6793.name: Jeffrey Kluger

6794.quote: I think I'm actually quite a materialistic person, I value what it takes to make a car or build a nice house. Money does change things, but how it changes people depends on how they react to it.
6794.name: Roland Gift

6795.quote: Sometimes I wish I could drive a car, but I'm gonna drive a car one day, so I don't worry about that.
6795.name: Stevie Wonder

6796.quote: The year most of my high school friends and I got our driver's permits, the coolest thing one could do was stand outside after school and twirl one's car keys like a lifeguard whistle. That jingling sound meant freedom and power.
6796.name: Sloane Crosley

6797.quote: The lead car is unique, except for the one behind it which is identical.
6797.name: Murray Walker

6798.quote: Either the car is stationary, or it's on the move.
6798.name: Murray Walker

6799.quote: I'm a car fanatic and each morning I wake up with a smile on my face, whether I'm commentating on the Formula One or at Silver Hatch racetrack in Roary the Racing Car.
6799.name: Murray Walker

6800.quote: I am so sick of reading about another car bomb, another suicide bomber, another 10, 20, 30, 70, 100 people dead in a day, both Americans and Iraqis.
6800.name: Rosanne Cash

6801.quote: Police departments no longer have to pay overtime or divert resources from other projects to find out where an individual goes - all they have to do is place a tracking device on someone's car or ask a cell phone company for that individual's location history and the technology does the work for them.
6801.name: Ron Wyden

6802.quote: I've always been a bit of a car freak.
6802.name: Eric Bana

6803.quote: Over my lifetime, the car had actually transcended the fact that it is a car. It has become a venue.
6803.name: Eric Bana

6804.quote: It was 100 feet of 16 mm black-and-white film of a car coming to a stop sign, and driving off. I had to decide how to frame and light it. It was magic. There was a sense of mystery.
6804.name: Conrad Hall

6805.quote: Stay humble. Always answer your phone - no matter who else is in the car.
6805.name: Jack Lemmon

6806.quote: One morning, about four o'clock, I was driving my car just about as fast as I could. I thought, Why am I out this time of night? I was miserable, and it came to me: I'm falling in love with somebody I have no right to fall in love with.
6806.name: June Carter Cash

6807.quote: I enjoy racing historic motorcars from the '50s and '60s. The seed of my interest was planted when I was about 12 years old and took over my mother's Morris Minor. I drove it around my father's farm. But my favorite car is still a McLaren F1, which I have had for 10 years.
6807.name: Rowan Atkinson

6808.quote: When you put gas in your car you are making a political statement, because you are supporting the empires that control and continue the destruction of some countries.
6808.name: Javier Bardem

6809.quote: A suburban mother's role is to deliver children obstetrically once, and by car forever after.
6809.name: Peter De Vries

6810.quote: A muscle is like a car. If you want it to run well early in the morning, you have to warm it up.
6810.name: Florence Griffith Joyner

6811.quote: It's like, it's kind of like if you ever had a car and it was a bit of a clunker but you love it, that's my show. It's a bit of a clunker but I know where everything is and I like it.
6811.name: Craig Ferguson

6812.quote: When I was really little I would sit in the back of my dad's car when he'd be playing old-school music. He'd turn down the music and turn around and I'd be singing and know all of the words but I didn't even know how to talk. From then on I've always wanted to be a singer.
6812.name: Leona Lewis

6813.quote: Sometimes, when my wife and I were going out to dinner, I would take my laptop with me and work in the car, so as to take advantage of the half hour going and coming.
6813.name: Thomas Friedman

6814.quote: I've got Asperger's syndrome and I'm not a very good people person, so I've always been more comfortable around machinery. Not in a weird way - I don't want to marry my car or anything stupid like that!
6814.name: Gary Numan

6815.quote: Okay, let's talk about cartoon labels for half a second - some people think anything with a dog or a car or a colorful alien is garbage, which is not true. Look at Big Moose Red. It's, like, a $6 wine with a cheesy label, and it's actually a solid wine.
6815.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

6816.quote: My mother is a big believer in being responsible for your own happiness. She always talked about finding joy in small moments and insisted that we stop and take in the beauty of an ordinary day. When I stop the car to make my kids really see a sunset, I hear my mother's voice and smile.
6816.name: Jennifer Garner

6817.quote: I dated a guy and he liked me but I didn't like him. I went through his wardrobe and cleaned out his house and got him to get a new car. He said to me, 'If I give you $10,000, will you find me my wife because I want someone like you?' And within a year, he got married. That was the first match that led to me leaving my corporate job.
6817.name: Patti Stanger

6818.quote: I'm lucky because my dad taught me to be frugal and save. And that's important because I want to know that I don't have to take an acting job for two or three years if I don't want to and that I'll still be able to make my house and car payments and buy food for my dogs.
6818.name: Ashley Greene

6819.quote: There are certain times I don't want my picture taken. If my wife's stepping out of a car and it looks like it's going to come out an indecent picture, don't I have a right to object?
6819.name: Bobby Darin

6820.quote: I mean, you've kind of got the track down, especially with ovals. The only thing that improves is that when race conditions come, you know what to expect slightly more from the track and from your car.
6820.name: Danica Patrick

6821.quote: I think that Indy is special to me. The greater the distance between the last time I drove an Indy car and the next time, I wouldn't like that to be too big.
6821.name: Danica Patrick

6822.quote: On Memorial Day, I was out floating on Lake Norman and came across Denny Hamlin. We struck up a conversation, and one of the first things we were talking about was how much it helped him when he started racing the Cup car and how much it helped his Nationwide program.
6822.name: Danica Patrick

6823.quote: Every time I get into a Nationwide car after being in a Cup car, I feel so much more comfortable than I did previously.
6823.name: Danica Patrick

6824.quote: No matter how good you are, how brave you are or anything, it comes down to that car so many times. Not every time, but so many times.
6824.name: Danica Patrick

6825.quote: I'm a big believer in everybody being themselves. If not doing a swimsuit calendar is yourself, that's great. But if doing a swimsuit calendar is yourself, then you should be able to do it. What I do outside the car adds to who I am and expresses a different side of me.
6825.name: Danica Patrick

6826.quote: I think women like Ferraris. A Ferrari is everybody's car.
6826.name: Tim Allen

6827.quote: Freedom is not an ideal, it is not even a protection, if it means nothing more than freedom to stagnate, to live without dreams, to have no greater aim than a second car and another television set.
6827.name: Adlai Stevenson

6828.quote: I started rapping before anybody had ever bought a car from it. It was truly about the art form and the culture, more so than now, where it's a successful way to make money. Back then you had to be doing it because you liked it.
6828.name: Ice T

6829.quote: Austin sounds a little bit like Aston Martin, which is the type of car James Bond would drive.
6829.name: Mike Myers

6830.quote: Racism has been for everyone like a horrible, tragic car crash, and we've all been heavily sedated from it. If we don't come into consciousness of this tragedy, there's going to be a violent awakening we don't want. The question is, can we wake up?
6830.name: Anna Deavere Smith

6831.quote: It was my father who instilled the 'never say no' attitude I carry around with me today, and who instilled in me a sense of wonder, always taking us on adventures in the car, never telling us the destination.
6831.name: Marlee Matlin

6832.quote: I did this Super-8 film at art school called 'Tissues,' this black comedy about a family whose father has been arrested for child molestation. I was absolutely thrilled by every inch of it, and would throw my projector in the back of my car and show it to anybody who would watch it.
6832.name: Jane Campion

6833.quote: The culture is going into a psychological depression. We are concerned about our place in the world, about being competitive: Will my children have as much as I have? Will I ever own my own home? How can I pay for a new car? Are immigrants taking away my white world?
6833.name: James Hillman

6834.quote: By the time the children go to bed, I am as drained as any mother who has spent her day working, car pooling, building Lego castles and shopping for the precisely correct soccer cleat.
6834.name: Ayelet Waldman

6835.quote: I think we've been dulled by capitalism. We're just blobs now - we're so worried about how we can keep paying the lease on the car, the mortgage, the lease on the toaster and all that. You can't really think about much else. If you lose that, you lose the whole lot.
6835.name: Rupert Everett

6836.quote: Before now, I've always taken my mixes out to the car and listened to them in the parking lot. I still do that, but more so now I'm listening to it on the Beat box, and I think people should give it at least a listen and check it out and see what it is.
6836.name: Dr. Dre

6837.quote: I like structure - like driving: go past the school on the street, stay on the right side, no hitting the car, go in right, you'll see a big church, stop and take a left, and you'll have it. By doing this I'm giving a structure of life, a path of light, and showing what happens between me and me, which is something very beautiful.
6837.name: Jean Claude Van Damme

6838.quote: I'd kind of like to have a classic old muscle car. I think that would be fun.
6838.name: Brooke Burke

6839.quote: Once I accepted Christ I immediately had peace. I still didn't have a place to live, I still didn't have a car, but I had peace.
6839.name: Sherri Shepherd

6840.quote: When I was a kid I got busted for throwing a rock through a car window and egging a house on halloween.
6840.name: Gavin DeGraw

6841.quote: Sometimes movie-making happens like clockwork other times, like a car accident.
6841.name: Eric Roberts

6842.quote: I don't put myself on Jeff Beck's level, but I can relate to him when he says he'd rather be working on his car collection than playing the guitar.
6842.name: Ritchie Blackmore

6843.quote: The thing people don't understand is that touring or travelling or whatever you do in my position means you go to all these cool places all over the world, but you see everything from a car window. You don't get to see much of the city or meet people at all.
6843.name: Taylor Momsen

6844.quote: I'm just attracted to playing people who are ostensible unlikable. That's not to say that there's something in there that makes you care. It might be that you just find them so awful that you just can't stop watching, like a car crash.
6844.name: Steve Coogan

6845.quote: I like to put on hardcore when I have to clean my apartment, which I hate to do, but it's motivational. I like old heavy metal when I'm outside working on my car. Music has definite functions for me.
6845.name: Peter Steele

6846.quote: I don't actually own a car.
6846.name: Chris Martin

6847.quote: The only thing I do on a computer is play Texas Hold 'Em, really. Obviously my cell phone is a computer. My car is a computer. I'm on computers every day without actively seeking them out.
6847.name: John Hawkes

6848.quote: Johnny Guitar, just one of my favorite singers of all time. I met him when we were both on the road with Johnny Otis in the '50s when I was a teenager. We traveled the country in a car together.I would hear him sing every night.
6848.name: Etta James

6849.quote: But I have a driver, so I can return calls while I'm in the car.
6849.name: Donna Shalala

6850.quote: L.A. has a fantastic car scene and because the climate is so gentle, cars can last forever.
6850.name: Lee Child

6851.quote: I'd really like to get the girl, shoot the gun, drive the car, have fun. I even have these kind of action dreams, where I'm the action guy.
6851.name: Kevin Bacon

6852.quote: I was raised in Chicago and I guess that was one of the special breeding grounds for gangsters of all colors. That was the Detroit of the gangster world. The car industry was thugs.
6852.name: Quincy Jones

6853.quote: I sing in the car if I'm in LA, because you're like soundproofed.
6853.name: Jimmy Fallon

6854.quote: We had the guys from X Men 2 do the cameras. They had a 360 camera that would go from one car, up in the air and over to another car in a continuous shot while the film was still rolling, going 90 mph.
6854.name: Jimmy Fallon

6855.quote: In New York, you've got Donald Trump, Woody Allen, a crack addict and a regular Joe, and they're all on the same subway car.
6855.name: Ethan Hawke

6856.quote: I was turning 20 during my first record. Those decade birthdays always kind of cause me, it seems, to reflect, look back, and then look forward. I just was closing this period of my life where I was living in a car and scrambling my whole life to then signing a six-record deal with Atlantic.
6856.name: Jewel

6857.quote: In addition to this, they already have a fuel cell car on the road in Japan. It is subsidized from within the corporation because they are still at a high cost.
6857.name: Maurice Strong

6858.quote: Toyota was the first to put a commercial fuel cell powered car on the road, and I have no doubt that Toyota will continue to be in the front lines in the development of competitive fuel cell vehicles.
6858.name: Maurice Strong

6859.quote: I borrowed my friend's car the other day in an attempt to persuade my husband that we needed a car and literally this is true, in the first day of borrowing the car, I got three tickets and I rear-ended it.
6859.name: Emily Mortimer

6860.quote: I used to look like a deer in headlights on the red carpet. You step out of the car and it's bedlam. Everyone's got crazy eyes.
6860.name: Emily Blunt

6861.quote: Well, I've been in a few car wrecks.
6861.name: Dave Matthews

6862.quote: I don't want a flashy car, just something that would allow me to stop using the Tube. And it would be good not to have to rely on my mum all the time, particularly when I have to listen to her singing in her car.
6862.name: Andy Murray

6863.quote: When you read about a car crash in which two or three youngsters are killed, do you pause to dwell on the amount of love and treasure and patience parents poured into bodies no longer suitable for open caskets?
6863.name: Jim Bishop

6864.quote: A life can get knocked into a new orbit by a car crash, a lottery win or just a bleary-eyed consultant giving bad news in a calm voice.
6864.name: David Mitchell

6865.quote: Home, nowadays, is a place where part of the family waits till the rest of the family brings the car back.
6865.name: Earl Wilson

6866.quote: With all the hybrid stuff and things like that, I think that's a fabulous direction to go with cars in that sense. As someone who grew up around muscle cars, I'll never not be able to not love a muscle car. Not that I don't care about the environment, that's not it. But I adore muscle cars.
6866.name: Michael Symon

6867.quote: I don't even own a car.
6867.name: Bill Nighy

6868.quote: Of course, I'm older now. I'm in a different place in my life than when I wrote the songs for 'Car Wheels' or 'Essence' or whatever. Different things were going on.
6868.name: Lucinda Williams

6869.quote: I hate fishing, and I can't imagine why anyone would want to hike when you can get in the car and drive.
6869.name: Joseph Barbera

6870.quote: I would make tea for Joni Mitchell or clean her car, anything to be in the studio and watch her work.
6870.name: Sheena Easton

6871.quote: If any demonstrator ever lays down in front of my car, it'll be the last car he'll ever lay down in front of.
6871.name: George C. Wallace

6872.quote: I am endlessly busy, bringing up five young kids, and trying to keep up with the three older ones. I still spend most of my life driving car pools.
6872.name: Danielle Steel

6873.quote: Yes, I did and a lot of my friends who are in the same program as I were very much supportive, and the most important thing they said to me is do not let this interfere with what you have to do in taking car of yourself. That was the most important thing.
6873.name: Naomi Campbell

6874.quote: I read murder mysteries. I exercise 40 minutes a day. I watch videotapes while I exercise. I listen to audiotapes when I am in my car. And I try to stay in three different centuries.
6874.name: Grover Norquist

6875.quote: People don't understand that it was maybe my biggest pleasure to drive an F1 car when it's wet.
6875.name: Alain Prost

6876.quote: The people who criticise you will not be the ones taking care of your legs when you are in your wheelchair. People who never drove a car in these conditions, they just don't know.
6876.name: Alain Prost

6877.quote: When you're in a car which can win every race, or fight for a win every race, that is pressure.
6877.name: Jenson Button

6878.quote: We go through the whole season working on next season's car and developing the car and making sure we fit in the car and all that sort of stuff. And we obviously give ideas of what we would hope next year's car would have even if it's small things like buttons on the steering wheel and different positions and whatever.
6878.name: Jenson Button

6879.quote: We all drive differently and have different styles. For me I need a car I can develop beneath me and feel comfortable in. If the car feels neutral and unbalanced it doesn't work for me.
6879.name: Jenson Button

6880.quote: I need to develop a car and engineer a car in a position that feels comfortable for me, and I don't think anyone can do a better job than I can in that position. The problem for me is if I can't get the car there I do struggle more than some.
6880.name: Jenson Button

6881.quote: To understand the intensity of driving an F1 car, you have to be in it. When you're driving a 750hp machine at 200mph, the noise and the vibrations are incredible. The G-force when you take big corners is like someone trying to rip your head off. You hit the brakes, and it feels as if the skin is being pulled off your body.
6881.name: Jenson Button

6882.quote: To drive an F1 car you have to be a little mad. On the morning of a race there's a mix of excitement and fear. If it's a wet track, then it's worse as you're not in control most of the time, which is the thing all drivers fear the most.
6882.name: Jenson Button

6883.quote: When I do retire, I know for a fact that I'll never be able to replace the incredible feeling I get when I'm driving an F1 car.
6883.name: Jenson Button

6884.quote: In the car and in front of the camera I tend to be very calm but behind the scenes I can get fired up and passionate, I just don't see the need to shout my mouth off in public.
6884.name: Jenson Button

6885.quote: I don't purposely speed, but I might go over by five or six miles an hour from time to time. It doesn't give me a buzz driving on normal roads, because I can't go fast enough. It's never going to be anything like an F1 car.
6885.name: Jenson Button

6886.quote: The fast, flowing parts, the high-speed corners, that's where a Formula One car is at its best - changes of direction, pulling high g-forces left and right.
6886.name: Jenson Button

6887.quote: A lot of people think Formula One isn't a sport because everyone drives a car when they go to work in the morning. But we're pulling up to six G on a corner or during breaking, which is almost like being a fighter pilot. So we have to do a lot of work on our neck muscles.
6887.name: Jenson Button

6888.quote: I keep my weight low, although you need to be able to move your weight around the race car to change the balance. I'm 6ft and I'm 70kg so I haven't much fat on me.
6888.name: Jenson Button

6889.quote: You're pulling 4-5G for a lot of the corners around the lap. We build up lactic acid because there are a lot of vibrations in the car, and you have to have strong legs to hit the brake pedal. We need to be fit to do every lap at 100%.
6889.name: Jenson Button

6890.quote: When you're doing a TV show, it's not like you just shoot for six weeks and you're in an editing room with all of your footage. It's like a guitar or a car, you have to fine tune things. You stop doing what's not working, you work on what is working and you add things that do work.
6890.name: Chris Pratt

6891.quote: Television is such an evolving medium. When you're doing a TV show, it's not like you just shoot for six weeks and you're in an editing room with all of your footage. It's like a guitar or a car, you have to fine tune things. You stop doing what's not working, you work on what is working and you add things that do work.
6891.name: Chris Pratt

6892.quote: If your goal is to be the biggest movie star in the world, a 10-movie contract is gold. It was never my goal. Up until now, I made movies - and I have a nice house, a nice car. I'm fortunate, happy and grateful. Life is good.
6892.name: Chris Evans

6893.quote: It's that I don't like white paper backgrounds. A woman does not live in front of white paper. She lives on the street, in a motor car, in a hotel room.
6893.name: Helmut Newton

6894.quote: Most of us would never consider getting our car repaired without first receiving an estimate of the charges, but this is exactly what we do when we need to go to a hospital for treatment.
6894.name: Dan Lipinski

6895.quote: My very best friend died in a car accident when I was 16 years old. That was the hardest blow emotionally that I have ever had to endure. Suddenly, you realize tomorrow might not come. Now I live by the motto, 'Today is what I have.'
6895.name: Amber Heard

6896.quote: I grew up in Texas, and people love their American-made muscle cars there. I grew up around people who loved cars and took care of cars and my dad's a big car nut, so I learned a little bit about cars - how to love them, most importantly. I think that from the time I could remember, I've always envisioned myself in a vintage muscle car.
6896.name: Amber Heard

6897.quote: We talked about many issues, like welfare, is it the way of life or hand up? Talked about size of government, how much should it tax families and small businesses? And when we left that lunch, we got in the car and I looked over at Chuck and said, 'I'll be damned. we're Republicans.'
6897.name: Susana Martinez

6898.quote: Sometimes I feel like I'm not only the engine but the caboose. I have to be in the front car and pull forward, and at the same time run around behind and push everybody along with me.
6898.name: Sandra Lee

6899.quote: That's what I love. Not being interrupted, sitting in a car by myself and listening to music in the rain. There are so many great songs yet to sing.
6899.name: Alison Krauss

6900.quote: I know I will die in a car crash.
6900.name: Katie Price

6901.quote: I married a pretty famous girl, and when we drive through town there's usually a car following us, when I walk out of my front door in Chelsea there's six guys waiting for me.
6901.name: Kevin Pietersen

6902.quote: I've tried everything other than jumping out of a plane, but nothing gives you an adrenaline rush like racing a car.
6902.name: Nigel Mansell

6903.quote: I take cabs if I need to get somewhere or I take car service. I don't drive, I wouldn't mind riding a bike, People think that because you become an entertainer you gotta have this rock star thug image. I'm an artist, man. I'm going to live like an artist.
6903.name: ASAP Rocky

6904.quote: The energy of the crowd is insane. Twenty thousand people. It's the biggest jolt of adrenaline. It's very hard to explain. You know the old story about the woman lifting the car off her kid? It's in that realm. You can actually hurt yourself and not know it.
6904.name: Tom Petty

6905.quote: The first time I rode a bike I was four or five. I crashed into the back of a car.
6905.name: David Millar

6906.quote: If one's honest about it, spending time in a car with children is pretty ghastly.
6906.name: Arabella Weir

6907.quote: I lived on the top of one hill and the school was at the top of another hill. Nobody ever went to school by car - we didn't have any cars during the war. So that to and from school was itself a training.
6907.name: Roger Bannister

6908.quote: It's a tricky place, especially the last sector. I wasn't happy in practice. I wasn't happy with the car and I wasn't happy with myself. But I always thought there was more in the car.
6908.name: Sebastian Vettel

6909.quote: Qualifying is all about putting everything that you have and that the car has in one lap. It's like a rush, I really enjoy that.
6909.name: Sebastian Vettel

6910.quote: All in all it was a smooth race, the car was very well balanced. I'm very proud to be the first winner here in India.
6910.name: Sebastian Vettel

6911.quote: There is no secret, once we go to qualifying, we all seem to enjoy it. Qualifying is all about putting everything that you have and that the car has in one lap. It's like a rush, I really enjoy that.
6911.name: Sebastian Vettel

6912.quote: When you walk the track and you see a corner and realise you were going round it at 160mph, you wonder who could be so stupid to take a corner at that speed. But in the car, you don't even think about that.
6912.name: Sebastian Vettel

6913.quote: Simply racing a Formula 1 car is an achievement.
6913.name: Sebastian Vettel

6914.quote: We always kept believing in ourselves and our team and the car.
6914.name: Sebastian Vettel

6915.quote: I could never drive in a great big car people like me because I'm a man of the people, a hustler.
6915.name: Terry McAuliffe

6916.quote: Life's too short when you find yourself sitting in a car for four hours every day trying to get from East L.A. to West L.A. to Hollywood and then back to East L.A.
6916.name: Garrett Hedlund

6917.quote: I was an economics major in college, and every summer after school, I would drive my car from California, from Claremont men's college at the time, to New York. And I worked on Wall Street.
6917.name: Henry Kravis

6918.quote: Divorced men are more likely to meet their car payments than their child support obligations.
6918.name: Susan Faludi

6919.quote: I'm carded for R-rated movies. And I get talked down to a lot. When I try to go rent a car or buy an airplane ticket or other stuff adults do, I get 'Okaaaaaay, honey.' I remember when I was 18, getting crayons in a restaurant.
6919.name: Kristen Bell

6920.quote: When I climb into my car, I enter my destination into a GPS device, whose spatial memory supplants my own. I have photographs to store the images I want to remember, books to store knowledge and now, thanks to Google, I rarely have to remember anything more than the right set of search terms to access humankind's collective memory.
6920.name: Joshua Foer

6921.quote: I own stock, and I also insure my car with Geico.
6921.name: Ernie Banks

6922.quote: My next adventure will be being in a car with Mischa at the wheel.
6922.name: Rachel Bilson

6923.quote: A few years ago I was at a party and this guy threw me over his shoulder, ran across the street, put me in his car, and stuck his tongue in my mouth.
6923.name: Rachel Bilson

6924.quote: People go to car races to watch the crashes.
6924.name: Johnny Knoxville

6925.quote: Everybody has a gun in their car in Detroit.
6925.name: Jim Harrison

6926.quote: A woman is gentle, soft, delicate, and a man's position is to protect her, help her up stairs, make sure she's in the car safely first. Take good care of your woman, and the sky's the limit!
6926.name: Taraji P. Henson

6927.quote: I'm a crazy car guy. I've got an airplane hangar full of cars.
6927.name: Paul Walker

6928.quote: You know, if you're Guy Kawasaki and you create a car that gets 500 miles a gallon with zero emissions, people on the Internet would say: 'I could have done that in half an hour, and it's been done before. What's the big deal? I expected something more from him.' Meanwhile, they didn't do it, right? They're still living at home with their mothers.
6928.name: Guy Kawasaki

6929.quote: We should tell our kids to just have fun, participate and not get bent on winning or losing. But every coach, when they say that, they say it tongue in cheek, 'Don't worry about winning': If you win I'll get you ice cream, but if you lose I'm going to pout in the car.
6929.name: Bode Miller

6930.quote: It's so funny looking back, but my so-called overnight success actually took 15 years. I remember when I didn't have any money, and my only car was mom's Hyundai.
6930.name: Criss Angel

6931.quote: I have mentally overcome situations most of you would be terrified to ever attempt: heights, fire, needles, spiders, snakes, angry monkeys, being shot, being hit by a car, going blind - you name it, I have been in a situation where I have had to mentally overcome my inherent fears to do my job.
6931.name: Criss Angel

6932.quote: I'm starting to think about things that I want to do, things that are fun. One of them is driving a car like a Porsche. I've driven a lot of cars - sedans, trucks and big family vehicles all year long. But there's nothing like a four-wheel-drive Porsche.
6932.name: Kevin O'Leary

6933.quote: I drank a lot when I was a teenager and I don't drink any more, because that's when I thought, you know, I'm gonna end up a car wreck.
6933.name: Kristin Davis

6934.quote: I'm a big potato chip girl. I don't like chocolate and cakes and all that, but I have to have my potato chips. I've got bags in the back of my car right now! But I never beat myself up about it, because, look: You can't give up every damn thing. You need something in your life that you like just because you like it!
6934.name: NeNe Leakes

6935.quote: I've always been an avid reader. If I don't have a book in the car, I'll stop and pick one up just to have something to read. I don't even remember learning to read.
6935.name: Janis Ian

6936.quote: My work is more about trying to ask good questions and not trying to come up with big shows. Every fashion company is doing that, every car company is doing that.
6936.name: Laurie Anderson

6937.quote: Every song has a composer, every book has an author, every car has a maker, every painting has a painter, and every building has a builder. So it isn't irrational to take this simple logic a little further and say that nature must have had a Maker. It would be irrational to believe that it made itself.
6937.name: Ray Comfort

6938.quote: Here's the thing that I think about life - if you manage to get into a space where you don't need that much, where the overhead of your life is not that great and you're pretty happy and relaxed without that much stuff, you are really liberated because you never have to say yes to something because you want another refrigerator or car!
6938.name: Brit Marling

6939.quote: The biggest thrill a ballplayer can have is when your son takes after you. That happened when my Bobby was in his championship Little League game. He really showed me something. Struck out three times. Made an error that lost the game. Parents were throwing things at our car and swearing at us as we drove off. Gosh, I was proud.
6939.name: Bob Uecker

6940.quote: I'd like to have the flying car, I think that'd be really cool.
6940.name: Rupert Grint

6941.quote: Anyone can write a story based on the kind of horror where you see a guy in car and then there's the bad guy in the back seat. It's infantile to rely on that for telling a story. That's like going to bed and thinking there's a monster under your bed. It's silly.
6941.name: Sergio Aragones

6942.quote: I always loved music. You know, my parents said I started singing when I was 4, in the car.
6942.name: Bob Seger

6943.quote: I think fear is what keeps us from going over the edge. I mean, as a race car driver, I don't think what makes a good race car driver is a fearless person. I think it's somebody that is comfortable being behind the wheel of something that's somewhat out of control.
6943.name: Jeff Gordon

6944.quote: I really enjoy not getting in a car and running errands on bikes.
6944.name: Stone Gossard

6945.quote: To say that I am organized is an understatement, but my car tells a different story.
6945.name: Emily Procter

6946.quote: I lived in small town out in the desert and my friend used to steal his mom's car in the middle of the night. He'd drive over to my house, I'd sneak out and we'd go out to the desert and just burn things down.
6946.name: Mark Hoppus

6947.quote: So, I remember when I was a kid, I was waiting for my mom to come home when she was working late, and, you know, I was like, 'Oh my God, what happened to her? Is she OK? Did something happen to her getting in the car?' I was a little kid. But those are actually early onsets of anxiety.
6947.name: Vinny Guadagnino

6948.quote: On my job I end up jumping out of planes. Last week I got in an 18-wheeler and drove down a runway onto a skid track. The week before that they put me in a car and sunk me to the bottom of a lake to see if I could escape without an oxygen tank.
6948.name: Rick Mercer

6949.quote: In L.A., I don't really want to go out because traffic sucks so bad. I'm sorry, I'm not going to spend five hours a day in my car, so you have to choose where you live very carefully.
6949.name: Holly Madison

6950.quote: I quit after a bad car accident. The thing about boxing is that you can be a star for five or six years, but when you go back to the old life, it's tough.
6950.name: Olivier Martinez

6951.quote: A lot of the songs start with an image. I was sitting there playing the guitar and I pictured this old, dirty green car, with the window rolled down, in the hot, hot, hot Texas heat, and this beautiful woman I knew when I was a kid sitting behind the wheel, looking out at me.
6951.name: Edie Brickell

6952.quote: I hate modern car radios. In my car, I don't even have a push-button radio. It's just got a dial and two knobs. Just AM. One knob makes it louder, and one knob changes the station. When you're driving, that's all I want.
6952.name: Chris Isaak

6953.quote: I once went to one of those parties where everyone throws their car keys into the middle of the room. I don't know who got my moped, but I drove that Peugeot for years.
6953.name: Victoria Wood

6954.quote: Come rain or shine I walk short distances rather than taking my car.
6954.name: Sophie Ellis-Bextor

6955.quote: I think the Smart Car is awesome. The only problem is I've been on the freeway and felt like I was going to be blown away like a Tim Hortons coffee cup, so I may have to upgrade to a Mini Cooper - something a little stronger.
6955.name: Ellen Page

6956.quote: The way you continue to be a successful business is you don't wait for the car to go off the cliff. You have to manage yourself. And make sure you do it in the right way so you are not making decisions in crisis.
6956.name: Roger Goodell

6957.quote: We each own one car, and we have a reasonable house. It's a lovely place to be, but it's not extravagant.
6957.name: Reese Witherspoon

6958.quote: As soon as I began to earn what might be called fairly large sums, I bought a car and began to explore the country around New York.
6958.name: Kate Smith

6959.quote: If you saw a dog going to be crushed under a car, wouldn't you help him?
6959.name: Oskar Schindler

6960.quote: One thing that worried me was how writers get categorized and so they end up having to write the same kind of book again and again. That is fine if it is what you want to do, but I would rather be locked in the trunk of my car with a weasel than write the same book every three years until I die.
6960.name: Justin Cronin

6961.quote: I've worked as a labourer, driven taxis and school buses, and been a car mechanic - whatever I could do just to get by. But it does mean that I know a little bit about a lot of things.
6961.name: Cory Monteith

6962.quote: What I enjoy doing more than anything is, I have my little antique car collection, and when the weather is pretty I like to get out one of my old cars. I have a little route I run down in the country, down Nachez Trace Parkway. The loop down through there is just really relaxing, not much traffic.
6962.name: Alan Jackson

6963.quote: I am a horrible visual artist. I can't fix a car, sew, knit, cook, etc. Statistically, there is more I don't do than do.
6963.name: Carrie Brownstein

6964.quote: The word 'geek' today does not mean what it used to mean. A geek isn't the skinny kid with a pocket protector and acne. There can be computer geeks, video game geeks, car geeks, military geeks, and sports geeks. Being a geek just means that you're passionate about something.
6964.name: Olivia Munn

6965.quote: A geek isn't the skinny kid with a pocket protector and acne. There can be computer geeks, video game geeks, car geeks, military geeks, and sports geeks. Being a geek just means that you're passionate about something.
6965.name: Olivia Munn

6966.quote: In the heat of the Russian summer a sleeping car is the most horrible instrument of martyrdom imaginable.
6966.name: Manfred von Richthofen

6967.quote: When I grew up there wasn't air-conditioning or anything of that nature, and this old car had a wall thickness of about ten inches. So we had a little warmer house in the winter and a little cooler in the summer.
6967.name: Merle Haggard

6968.quote: It sounds like something from a Woody Guthrie song, but it's true I was raised in a freight car.
6968.name: Merle Haggard

6969.quote: There were times when I thought I would never own a car.
6969.name: Victor Cruz

6970.quote: The image is where you have dinner at night, who you're seeing. It's what car you drive and how you dress. People in the industry sell that, and it creates a dream. There's nothing else.
6970.name: Elle Macpherson

6971.quote: I'm the one who gets called up about a problem. I'm the one who gets called up about the street lighting and the abandoned car. I'm the one who gets blamed if the police don't arrive. I'm the one they blame if a city truck is broken down.
6971.name: Richard M. Daley

6972.quote: You know, it's amazing. I don't even have a car, would you believe it? I had a motorbike and it got stolen last year. So I've got to buy another one of those, I suppose. I can treat myself to that.
6972.name: Michael Fassbender

6973.quote: I always keep a ball in the car. You never know.
6973.name: Hakeem Olajuwon

6974.quote: I've made movies that cost less than one car chase.
6974.name: Sam Mendes

6975.quote: In 1950, when the Giants signed me, they gave me $15,000. I bought a 1950 Mercury. I couldn't drive, but I had it in the parking lot there, and everybody that could drive would drive the car. So it was like a community thing.
6975.name: Willie Mays

6976.quote: Some people think my father was a spy, because of working for that government agency in Vietnam, but he can't find his car keys, much less keep a national secret.
6976.name: Lauren Graham

6977.quote: All I want to know is that I can keep this house for the rest of my days and I want to make good music, and have the odd sports car in the garage, obviously!
6977.name: Jay Kay

6978.quote: It's not a case of 'look at me in my car' it's more, 'look at the car'. I like the idea of other people enjoying them, because everything has become a bit faceless and nobody likes the motor car any more.
6978.name: Jay Kay

6979.quote: I didn't get my first car until I was 22. It was a BMW 1602 and now I've got it back I'm waiting to restore it.
6979.name: Jay Kay

6980.quote: All the times being like, 'Who rented this car and why are we going to this place?' You take the easy route and go, 'Oh, thanks for the champagne. I'll have another.'
6980.name: Rosario Dawson

6981.quote: The United Nations four or five years ago put out a study that said the meat industry, meat-eating, growing meat for food is the No. 1 killer of our planet - not No. 2 or No. 3: No 1. You know what's No. 2? Transportation. Everyone thinks that No. 1 is transportation, and goes out and buys a hybrid car. Screw the hybrid cars. Don't eat hamburgers.
6981.name: Maggie Q

6982.quote: You cannot expect the guy who drove the car into the ditch to navigate it out of the ditch. You have to put a new driver in the seat. I'm not saying the new driver is going to be any better, but we need a new driver. Kerry is the only choice.
6982.name: John Mellencamp

6983.quote: The idea that maybe you don't have to own a car if you only need one occasionally may catch on, just like time-sharing caught on in real estate.
6983.name: Steve Case

6984.quote: I have always had this mentality because I hated to break anything on the car.
6984.name: Alain Prost

6985.quote: One of my biggest problems this season was with the clutch at the start of the race. I hate to risk the car.
6985.name: Alain Prost

6986.quote: I don't like to go over curbs, because I don't want to be hard on the car.
6986.name: Alain Prost

6987.quote: You were not in control You had no visibility: maybe there was a car in front of you, maybe not.
6987.name: Alain Prost

6988.quote: We have an uncanny ability to make birds do what we want them to do. In Blood Simple there's a shot from the bumper of a car and it's going up this road and a huge flock of birds takes off at the perfect moment.
6988.name: Joel Coen

6989.quote: I took guitar a while back, and my heart wasn't in it at the time, but I'm ready to try it again. I sing in the car, at home - it's a huge part of my life, especially since I'm from Tennessee.
6989.name: Lucy Hale

6990.quote: I love Lady Antebellum and Miranda Lambert - they write from the heart. But it's hard to find a country music lover in L.A. None of my friends really listen to it, and they hate getting in the car with me because I just blast Taylor Swift.
6990.name: Lucy Hale

6991.quote: I definitely love that all these car brands are coming out with hybrid forms of every car that they have. It's very awesome because I think it does make a difference, and it doesn't hurt that you save a lot of money on gas.
6991.name: Lucy Hale

6992.quote: I've always had an affinity and a passion for cars and that whole car culture.
6992.name: Ludacris

6993.quote: Paul is Starsky, and I met him before shooting. He was very kind and encouraged us to go with what we wanted to do. It was very sweet to see them back with the car after 25 years.
6993.name: Ben Stiller

6994.quote: I grew up in Texas and we used to go to Padre Island, eight hours in the car down to the beach.
6994.name: St. Vincent

6995.quote: My dad used to love Steely Dan, the Stones, Jethro Tull and all that. There was always Steely Dan going in my dad's car, but I remember The Royal Scam in particular because it has 'Kid Charlemagne' on it.
6995.name: St. Vincent

6996.quote: When I was in New York, I was making a living. We had a summer house and a car that I could put in a garage. That's something for a stage actor.
6996.name: William H. Macy

6997.quote: Your car should drive itself. It's amazing to me that we let humans drive cars, It's a bug that cars were invented before computers.
6997.name: Eric Schmidt

6998.quote: Consider the perverse effect cap and trade has on altruistic actions. Say you decide to buy a small, high-efficiency car. That reduces your emissions, but not your country's. Instead it allows somebody else to buy a bigger S.U.V. - because the total emissions are set by the cap.
6998.name: James Hansen

6999.quote: Every summer my husband and I pack our suitcases, load our kids into the car, and drive from tense, crowded New York City to my family's cottage in Maine. It's on an island, with stretches of sea and sandy beaches, rocky coasts, and pine trees. We barbecue, swim, lie around, and try to do nothing.
6999.name: Hope Davis

7000.quote: It's like, no matter what I do, I always feel like I'm five years old, and I end up in the back of my father's car looking out the window, and nothing has changed in 25 years.
7000.name: Dylan McDermott

7001.quote: I did a twenty foot print and John Cage is involved in that because he was the only person I knew in New York who had a car and who would be willing to do this.
7001.name: Robert Rauschenberg

7002.quote: I was 16 years old, driving to LA, and sleeping in my car, just trying to make it happen.
7002.name: Nick Cannon

7003.quote: I arrived in California with no job, no car, and no money, but, like millions of other girls, a dream.
7003.name: Victoria Principal

7004.quote: I remember when metal was something you really had to search out, and now I hear it on car commercials.
7004.name: Trevor Dunn

7005.quote: You know, sitting in the car when they got back in and - first of all, it was relief. I was not - there were two get away cars or switch cars they were called. And, you know, the group tended to include everyone.
7005.name: Patty Hearst

7006.quote: So much of life is luck. One day you make a right turn and get hit by a car. Turn left and you meet the love of your life. I think I made the correct turn.
7006.name: Loretta Swit

7007.quote: The ought to be a worldwide cultural taskforce that just stops you when you have ideas like combining The Red Desert with an armored car heist movie.
7007.name: Steven Soderbergh

7008.quote: Well, it is so difficult right now when you look out on the road and how fast people go and the more and more cars you see out there, for teenagers, you'd think a kid that literally, a few years before, was sitting back in a car seat in the back seat is now behind the wheel.
7008.name: Amy Klobuchar

7009.quote: But I also like to shower my parents with presents. I bought them a beautiful car and a house.
7009.name: Eva Herzigova

7010.quote: And we turned off and 30 miles south they're standing in the middle of our road blocking our way, stopped the car, got out, took us through the path in the woods, where the craft was on the ground.
7010.name: Betty Hill

7011.quote: So if you're a robot and you're living on this planet, you can do things that you can't do in real life - things that you wished you could do: like fly like have a car that flies like have furniture that is alive.
7011.name: William Joyce

7012.quote: Going to car racing school was phenomenal.
7012.name: Michelle Rodriguez

7013.quote: A gun can be dangerous. But a gun can protect you, you can hunt for food with it - you know, the tool itself is a tool. The intention of the party using the tool is a part of the process, right? You know: the knife cuts the steak, stabs the person, saves somebody from danger, cuts somebody out of a car.
7013.name: Peter Guber

7014.quote: I've made club songs, and I've made radio songs, and I've made the car songs.
7014.name: T-Pain

7015.quote: My first car was an '84 Ford Taurus. It caught on fire from me trying to change the fuel pump, so that wasn't good at all. Dried leaves on the ground while I was trying to change the fuel pump. Don't do that. Do it on concrete.
7015.name: T-Pain

7016.quote: We need a number of solutions - we need more efficiency and conservation. Efficiency is a big one. I think car companies need to do a lot better in producing more efficient cars. They have the technology, we just need to demand them as consumers.
7016.name: Daryl Hannah

7017.quote: Twenty years ago, I was living in a lovely cottage on the edge of Dartmoor but I couldn't afford to run a car.
7017.name: Mary Wesley

7018.quote: I don't want to be in my car all day. I love getting up in the morning in Venice and walking my dogs down to the cafe to get my tea, and then perhaps going to a bookstore and sitting and reading, then walking to the beach.
7018.name: Jessica Chastain

7019.quote: The day I won an Emmy was also the day my father passed away. I received a call from my sister on the way to the ceremony and had to turn my car around and catch the first flight back to Karachi.
7019.name: Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy

7312.name: William Daniels

7313.quote: If you don't drink, smoke, or drive a car, you're a tax evader.
7313.name: Thomas S. Foley

7314.quote: I wanted to end my life so bad and was in my car ready to go down that ramp into the water, and I did go part way, but I stopped. I went again and stopped. I then got out of the car and stood by the car a nervous wreck.
7314.name: Susan Smith

7315.quote: If you don't like something, change it. If you can't change it, change your attitude.
7315.name: Maya Angelou

7316.quote: Change does not roll in on the wheels of inevitability, but comes through continuous struggle. And so we must straighten our backs and work for our freedom. A man can't ride you unless your back is bent.
7316.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

7317.quote: God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.
7317.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

7318.quote: Change will not come if we wait for some other person or some other time. We are the ones we've been waiting for. We are the change that we seek.
7318.name: Barack Obama

7319.quote: You must be the change you wish to see in the world.
7319.name: Mahatma Gandhi

7320.quote: For the past 33 years, I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself: 'If today were the last day of my life, would I want to do what I am about to do today?' And whenever the answer has been 'No' for too many days in a row, I know I need to change something.
7320.name: Steve Jobs

7321.quote: It may be hard for an egg to turn into a bird: it would be a jolly sight harder for it to learn to fly while remaining an egg. We are like eggs at present. And you cannot go on indefinitely being just an ordinary, decent egg. We must be hatched or go bad.
7321.name: C. S. Lewis

7322.quote: All changes, even the most longed for, have their melancholy for what we leave behind us is a part of ourselves we must die to one life before we can enter another.
7322.name: Anatole France

7323.quote: I'm not going to change the way I look or the way I feel to conform to anything. I've always been a freak. So I've been a freak all my life and I have to live with that, you know. I'm one of those people.
7323.name: John Lennon

7324.quote: All great change in America begins at the dinner table.
7324.name: Ronald Reagan

7325.quote: Everyone thinks of changing the world, but no one thinks of changing himself.
7325.name: Leo Tolstoy

7326.quote: When we are no longer able to change a situation - we are challenged to change ourselves.
7326.name: Viktor E. Frankl

7327.quote: Never believe that a few caring people can't change the world. For, indeed, that's all who ever have.
7327.name: Margaret Mead

7328.quote: If you do not change direction, you may end up where you are heading.
7328.name: Lao Tzu

7329.quote: A fanatic is one who can't change his mind and won't change the subject.
7329.name: Winston Churchill

7330.quote: To improve is to change to be perfect is to change often.
7330.name: Winston Churchill

7331.quote: If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
7331.name: Wayne Dyer

7332.quote: If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
7332.name: Frederick Douglass

7333.quote: Action and reaction, ebb and flow, trial and error, change - this is the rhythm of living. Out of our over-confidence, fear out of our fear, clearer vision, fresh hope. And out of hope, progress.
7333.name: Bruce Barton

7334.quote: Any change, even a change for the better, is always accompanied by drawbacks and discomforts.
7334.name: Arnold Bennett

7335.quote: If we don't change, we don't grow. If we don't grow, we aren't really living.
7335.name: Gail Sheehy

7336.quote: A small group of thoughtful people could change the world. Indeed, it's the only thing that ever has.
7336.name: Margaret Mead

7337.quote: If there is anything that we wish to change in the child, we should first examine it and see whether it is not something that could better be changed in ourselves.
7337.name: Carl Jung

7338.quote: Things do not change we change.
7338.name: Henry David Thoreau

7339.quote: Always remember that the future comes one day at a time.
7339.name: Dean Acheson

7340.quote: Only the wisest and stupidest of men never change.
7340.name: Confucius

7341.quote: Progress is a nice word. But change is its motivator. And change has its enemies.
7341.name: Robert Kennedy

7342.quote: The only way to make sense out of change is to plunge into it, move with it, and join the dance.
7342.name: Alan Watts

7343.quote: Don't change on me. Don't extort me unless you intend to do it forever.
7343.name: Tupac Shakur

7344.quote: Change in all things is sweet.
7344.name: Aristotle

7345.quote: Money and success don't change people they merely amplify what is already there.
7345.name: Will Smith

7346.quote: They must often change, who would be constant in happiness or wisdom.
7346.name: Confucius

7347.quote: I can't really change my life to accommodate people who are jealous. I don't see why I should.
7347.name: Sting

7348.quote: All change is not growth, as all movement is not forward.
7348.name: Ellen Glasgow

7349.quote: Because things are the way they are, things will not stay the way they are.
7349.name: Bertolt Brecht

7350.quote: For changes to be of any true value, they've got to be lasting and consistent.
7350.name: Tony Robbins

7351.quote: We cannot change anything until we accept it. Condemnation does not liberate, it oppresses.
7351.name: Carl Jung

7352.quote: It's the most unhappy people who most fear change.
7352.name: Mignon McLaughlin

7353.quote: He who rejects change is the architect of decay. The only human institution which rejects progress is the cemetery.
7353.name: Harold Wilson

7355.quote: Very often a change of self is needed more than a change of scene.
7355.name: A. C. Benson

7356.quote: If you're in a bad situation, don't worry it'll change. If you're in a good situation, don't worry it'll change.
7356.name: Sr. John A. Simone

7357.quote: We all have big changes in our lives that are more or less a second chance.
7357.name: Harrison Ford

7358.quote: Life belongs to the living, and he who lives must be prepared for changes.
7358.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

7359.quote: There is nothing permanent except change.
7359.name: Heraclitus

7360.quote: If you want to make enemies, try to change something.
7360.name: Woodrow Wilson

7361.quote: Without accepting the fact that everything changes, we cannot find perfect composure. But unfortunately, although it is true, it is difficult for us to accept it. Because we cannot accept the truth of transience, we suffer.
7361.name: Shunryu Suzuki

7362.quote: Most people already know what they're doing wrong. When I get them to church I want to tell them that you can change.
7362.name: Joel Osteen

7364.quote: Change means that what was before wasn't perfect. People want things to be better.
7364.name: Esther Dyson

7365.quote: Change will never happen when people lack the ability and courage to see themselves for who they are.
7365.name: Bryant H. McGill

7366.quote: Change alone is eternal, perpetual, immortal.
7366.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

7367.quote: Loss is nothing else but change, and change is Nature's delight.
7367.name: Marcus Aurelius

7368.quote: One must change one's tactics every ten years if one wishes to maintain one's superiority.
7368.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

7369.quote: Without change, something sleeps inside us, and seldom awakens. The sleeper must awaken.
7369.name: Frank Herbert

7370.quote: I cannot say whether things will get better if we change what I can say is they must change if they are to get better.
7370.name: Georg C. Lichtenberg

7371.quote: Not only is women's work never done, the definition keeps changing.
7371.name: Bill Copeland

7372.quote: One change always leaves the way open for the establishment of others.
7372.name: Niccolo Machiavelli

7373.quote: He that will not apply new remedies must expect new evils for time is the greatest innovator.
7373.name: Francis Bacon

7374.quote: Lord, where we are wrong, make us willing to change where we are right, make us easy to live with.
7374.name: Peter Marshall

7375.quote: Our dilemma is that we hate change and love it at the same time what we really want is for things to remain the same but get better.
7375.name: Sydney J. Harris

7376.quote: True life is lived when tiny changes occur.
7376.name: Leo Tolstoy

7377.quote: Change, like sunshine, can be a friend or a foe, a blessing or a curse, a dawn or a dusk.
7377.name: William Arthur Ward

7378.quote: Relentless, repetitive self talk is what changes our self-image.
7378.name: Denis Waitley

7379.quote: Just when I think I have learned the way to live, life changes.
7379.name: Hugh Prather

7380.quote: When it becomes more difficult to suffer than to change, you will change.
7380.name: Robert Anthony

7381.quote: There are two kinds of fools: those who can't change their opinions and those who won't.
7381.name: Josh Billings

7382.quote: You must welcome change as the rule but not as your ruler.
7382.name: Denis Waitley

7383.quote: The first step toward change is awareness. The second step is acceptance.
7383.name: Nathaniel Branden

7384.quote: Change is inevitable. Change is constant.
7384.name: Benjamin Disraeli

7385.quote: All I want to do is change the world.
7385.name: W. Clement Stone

7386.quote: Change is the only constant. Hanging on is the only sin.
7386.name: Denise McCluggage

7387.quote: Things alter for the worse spontaneously, if they be not altered for the better designedly.
7387.name: Francis Bacon

7388.quote: Future shock is the shattering stress and disorientation that we induce in individuals by subjecting them to too much change in too short a time.
7388.name: Alvin Toffler

7389.quote: In a progressive country change is constant change is inevitable.
7389.name: Benjamin Disraeli

7390.quote: You're only as young as the last time you changed your mind.
7390.name: Timothy Leary

7391.quote: In times of rapid change, experience could be your worst enemy.
7391.name: J. Paul Getty

7392.quote: Opinions are made to be changed - or how is truth to be got at?
7392.name: Lord Byron

7393.quote: If you want to change attitudes, start with a change in behavior.
7393.name: William Glasser

7394.quote: The foolish and the dead alone never change their opinions.
7394.name: James Russell Lowell

7395.quote: Anyone who thinks there's safety in numbers hasn't looked at the stock market pages.
7395.name: Irene Peter

7396.quote: We live in a moment of history where change is so speeded up that we begin to see the present only when it is already disappearing.
7396.name: R. D. Laing

7397.quote: Christians are supposed not merely to endure change, nor even to profit by it, but to cause it.
7397.name: Harry Emerson Fosdick

7399.quote: To change what you get you must change who you are.
7399.name: Vernon Howard

7400.quote: Just because everything is different doesn't mean anything has changed.
7400.name: Irene Peter

7401.quote: When you are through changing, you are through.
7401.name: Bruce Barton

7402.quote: The truth does not change according to our ability to stomach it.
7402.name: Flannery O'Connor

7403.quote: Since we cannot change reality, let us change the eyes which see reality.
7403.name: Nikos Kazantzakis

7404.quote: The world hates change, yet it is the only thing that has brought progress.
7404.name: Charles Kettering

7405.quote: All things must change to something new, to something strange.
7405.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

7406.quote: A lot of people get impatient with the pace of change.
7406.name: James Levine

7407.quote: The world is changing very fast. Big will not beat small anymore. It will be the fast beating the slow.
7407.name: Rupert Murdoch

7408.quote: The thing that lies at the foundation of positive change, the way I see it, is service to a fellow human being.
7408.name: Lech Walesa

7409.quote: Change is inevitable. Change for the better is a full-time job.
7409.name: Adlai E. Stevenson

7410.quote: When you jump for joy, beware that no one moves the ground from beneath your feet.
7410.name: Stanislaw Lec

7411.quote: People change and forget to tell each other.
7411.name: Lillian Hellman

7412.quote: True change takes place in the imagination.
7412.name: Thomas Moore

7413.quote: To change a habit, make a conscious decision, then act out the new behavior.
7413.name: Maxwell Maltz

7414.quote: I don't know if you can change things, but it's a drop in the ocean.
7414.name: Julie Walters

7415.quote: If you want to change the culture, you will have to start by changing the organization.
7415.name: Mary Douglas

7417.quote: What we call progress is the exchange of one nuisance for another nuisance.
7417.name: Havelock Ellis

7418.quote: If you feel like it's difficult to change, you will probably have a harder time succeeding.
7418.name: Andrea Jung

7419.quote: The more things change, the more they are the same.
7419.name: Alphonse Karr

7420.quote: The main dangers in this life are the people who want to change everything, or nothing.
7420.name: Nancy Astor

7421.quote: Change is not only likely, it's inevitable.
7421.name: Barbara Sher

7422.quote: Could we change our attitude, we should not only see life differently, but life itself would come to be different.
7422.name: Katherine Mansfield

7423.quote: Change occurs in direct proportion to dissatisfaction, but dissatisfaction never changes.
7423.name: Douglas Horton

7424.quote: We emphasize that we believe in change because we were born of it, we have lived by it, we prospered and grew great by it. So the status quo has never been our god, and we ask no one else to bow down before it.
7424.name: Carl T. Rowan

7425.quote: The world changes in direct proportion to the number of people willing to be honest about their lives.
7425.name: Armistead Maupin

7426.quote: If you can change three lives in 10, three lives in a hundred, that's got to be good, hasn't it?
7426.name: Ian Botham

7427.quote: Perfection is immutable. But for things imperfect, change is the way to perfect them.
7427.name: Owen Feltham

7428.quote: As with anything creative, change is inevitable.
7428.name: Enya

7429.quote: I try to contrast life today is full of contrast, We have to change.
7429.name: Gianni Versace

7430.quote: Everything in life that we really accept undergoes a change.
7430.name: Katherine Mansfield

7431.quote: I shall not change my course because those who assume to be better than I desire it.
7431.name: Victoria Woodhull

7432.quote: Weep not that the world changes - did it keep a stable, changeless state, it were cause indeed to weep.
7432.name: William C. Bryant

7433.quote: People want change but not too much change. Finding that balance is tricky for every politician.
7433.name: Eleanor Clift

7434.quote: Our fathers valued change for the sake of its results we value it in the act.
7434.name: Alice Meynell

7435.quote: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
7435.name: John F. Kennedy

7436.quote: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
7436.name: Norman Vincent Peale

7437.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
7437.name: Nelson Mandela

7438.quote: If you accept the expectations of others, especially negative ones, then you never will change the outcome.
7438.name: Michael Jordan

7439.quote: What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
7439.name: Plutarch

7440.quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
7440.name: Harriet Tubman

7441.quote: If the facts don't fit the theory, change the facts.
7441.name: Albert Einstein

7442.quote: Change your life today. Don't gamble on the future, act now, without delay.
7442.name: Simone de Beauvoir

7443.quote: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.
7443.name: Jimmy Dean

7444.quote: The pessimist complains about the wind the optimist expects it to change the realist adjusts the sails.
7444.name: William Arthur Ward

7445.quote: When you forgive, you in no way change the past - but you sure do change the future.
7445.name: Bernard Meltzer

7446.quote: Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world indeed, it's the only thing that ever has.
7446.name: Margaret Mead

7447.quote: I don't need a friend who changes when I change and who nods when I nod my shadow does that much better.
7447.name: Plutarch

7448.quote: It is not the strongest of the species that survives, nor the most intelligent that survives. It is the one that is the most adaptable to change.
7448.name: Charles Darwin

7449.quote: We are taught you must blame your father, your sisters, your brothers, the school, the teachers - but never blame yourself. It's never your fault. But it's always your fault, because if you wanted to change you're the one who has got to change.
7449.name: Katharine Hepburn

7450.quote: You change your life by changing your heart.
7450.name: Max Lucado

7451.quote: There are three constants in life, change, choice and principles.
7451.name: Stephen Covey

7452.quote: The Chinese government wants me to say that for many centuries Tibet has been part of China. Even if I make that statement, many people would just laugh. And my statement will not change past history. History is history.
7452.name: Dalai Lama

7453.quote: If you realize that all things change, there is nothing you will try to hold on to. If you are not afraid of dying, there is nothing you cannot achieve.
7453.name: Lao Tzu

7454.quote: You can change your world by changing your words, Remember, death and life are in the power of the tongue.
7454.name: Joel Osteen

7455.quote: It behooves every man who values liberty of conscience for himself, to resist invasions of it in the case of others: or their case may, by change of circumstances, become his own.
7455.name: Thomas Jefferson

7456.quote: Chinese people themselves, they really want change.
7456.name: Dalai Lama

7457.quote: I am invariably late for appointments - sometimes as much as two hours. I've tried to change my ways but the things that make me late are too strong, and too pleasing.
7457.name: Marilyn Monroe

7458.quote: For time and the world do not stand still. Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or the present are certain to miss the future.
7458.name: John F. Kennedy

7459.quote: Progress is impossible without change, and those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything.
7459.name: George Bernard Shaw

7460.quote: You must take personal responsibility. You cannot change the circumstances, the seasons, or the wind, but you can change yourself. That is something you have charge of.
7460.name: Jim Rohn

7461.quote: Prayer does not change God, but it changes him who prays.
7461.name: Soren Kierkegaard

7462.quote: No one wants to die. Even people who want to go to heaven don't want to die to get there. And yet death is the destination we all share. No one has ever escaped it. And that is as it should be, because Death is very likely the single best invention of Life. It is Life's change agent. It clears out the old to make way for the new.
7462.name: Steve Jobs

7463.quote: It takes a lot of courage to release the familiar and seemingly secure, to embrace the new. But there is no real security in what is no longer meaningful. There is more security in the adventurous and exciting, for in movement there is life, and in change there is power.
7463.name: Alan Cohen

7464.quote: Find joy in everything you choose to do. Every job, relationship, home, it's your responsibility to love it, or change it.
7464.name: Chuck Palahniuk

7465.quote: If you don't like how things are, change it! You're not a tree.
7465.name: Jim Rohn

7466.quote: You are always free to change your mind and choose a different future, or a different past.
7466.name: Richard Bach

7467.quote: The need for change bulldozed a road down the center of my mind.
7467.name: Maya Angelou

7468.quote: I believe that you control your destiny, that you can be what you want to be. You can also stop and say, 'No, I won't do it, I won't behave his way anymore. I'm lonely and I need people around me, maybe I have to change my methods of behaving,' and then you do it.
7468.name: Leo Buscaglia

7469.quote: The spirit of democracy is not a mechanical thing to be adjusted by abolition of forms. It requires change of heart.
7469.name: Mahatma Gandhi

7470.quote: I have noticed even people who claim everything is predestined, and that we can do nothing to change it, look before they cross the road.
7470.name: Stephen Hawking
