7915.quote: It is time to change our policy of appeasement toward the Palestinians, to strengthen our ties with the nation of Israel.
7915.name: Rick Perry

7916.quote: Our nation is being led astray by ungodly judges, mayors and governors, who are given to change, defying the Constitution and substituting their own wicked agendas.
7916.name: David Wilkerson

7917.quote: For the last 20 years of my life, I've had the mantra to do amazing parts with amazing people in amazing projects, so I'm attracted to good story, writing and character and good people. That's what I'm always searching for and I don't think that's ever going to change.
7917.name: John Hawkes

7918.quote: Making money is not gonna change anything about what I am, except I won't answer the door.
7918.name: Abel Ferrara

7919.quote: I just think that sometimes we hang onto people or relationships long after they've ceased to be of any use to either of you. I'm always meeting new people, and my list of friends seems to change quite a bit.
7919.name: John Cleese

7920.quote: The only change is that baseball has turned Paige from a second class citizen to a second class immortal.
7920.name: Satchel Paige

7921.quote: The idea of the sacred is quite simply one of the most conservative notions in any culture, because it seeks to turn other ideas - uncertainty, progress, change - into crimes.
7921.name: Salman Rushdie

7922.quote: Cubism was an attack on the perspective that had been known and used for 500 years. It was the first big, big change. It confused people: they said, 'Things don't look like that!'
7922.name: David Hockney

7923.quote: Economically, it's more expensive to make movies. I hope digital movies change that.
7923.name: Ang Lee

7924.quote: I didn't want to go out and change anything. I just wanted to make the music that was part of my background, which was rock and blues and hip-hop.
7924.name: Kid Rock

7925.quote: I love to watch times change!
7925.name: Karl Lagerfeld

7926.quote: It's best to leap into something you know you love. You might change your mind later, but that is the privilege of youth.
7926.name: Charles Kuralt

7927.quote: I hope to bring much more attention to important issues and change for issues and practices that are harming animals.
7927.name: Kesha

7928.quote: Effectively, change is almost impossible without industry-wide collaboration, cooperation and consensus.
7928.name: Simon Mainwaring

7929.quote: What is sure is that technological change is accelerating in all directions and, like children playing in a fountain, consumers are reveling in the experience.
7929.name: Simon Mainwaring

7930.quote: The question remains: which brands will commit to creating a private sector pillar of social change, and which will become casualties of their own outdated thinking?
7930.name: Simon Mainwaring

7931.quote: The creative destruction that social media is currently unleashing will change more than technology or the leader board of the Fortune 100. It is driving a qualitative shift in the nature of relationships between brands and their customers.
7931.name: Simon Mainwaring

7932.quote: It is time for corporate America to become 'the third pillar' of social change in our society, complementing the first two pillars of government and philanthropy. We need the entire private sector to begin committing itself not just to making profits, but to fulfilling higher and larger purposes by contributing to building a better world.
7932.name: Simon Mainwaring

7933.quote: When people align around shared political, social, economic or environmental values, and take collective action, thinking and behavior that compromises the lives of millions of people around the world can truly change.
7933.name: Simon Mainwaring

7934.quote: Brands must empower their community to be change agents in their own right. To that end, they need to take on a mentoring role. This means the brand provides the tools, techniques and strategies for their customers to become more effective marketers in achieving their own goals.
7934.name: Simon Mainwaring

7935.quote: With the never-ending stream of new social technologies, apps and platforms rolling out every day, its easy to get lost in the minutiae of social media. Yet for there to be effective change, especially within large, top-down, hierarchical institutions, a company must have an over-arching understanding of the new role it has to play.
7935.name: Simon Mainwaring

7936.quote: And it's absolutely true that male sexual behaviour and female responses to male demands change a lot when they start communicating - and the levels of the communication that I've seen on the ground in very, very poor areas are so high and I think why don't we have that here?
7936.name: Emma Thompson

7937.quote: I have always been aware that you have to get people listening before you can change their minds. Any artist's big fear is being ignored, so if you get debate, that's great.
7937.name: Damien Hirst

7938.quote: We think that democracy can change a lot of things, but we're being fooled, because democracy is not the election. We've been taught that democracy is having elections. And it isn't. Elections are the most horrendous aspect of democracy. It's the most mundane, trivial, disappointing, dirty aspect.
7938.name: Gael Garcia Bernal

7939.quote: Before 'Schindler's List,' I wouldn't have believed movies had a lot of power for social change.
7939.name: Liam Neeson

7940.quote: The best thing about acting is that I get to lose myself in another character and actually get paid for it, It's a great outlet. I'm not really sure who I am - it seems I change every day.
7940.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

7941.quote: I believe that history has shape, order, and meaning that exceptional men, as much as economic forces, produce change and that passe abstractions like beauty, nobility, and greatness have a shifting but continuing validity.
7941.name: Camille Paglia

7942.quote: I respect the astute and rigorously unsentimental David Horowitz as one of America's most original and courageous political analysts. He has the true 1960s spirit - audacious and irreverent, yet passionately engaged and committed to social change.
7942.name: Camille Paglia

7943.quote: The '80s made up for all the abuse I took during the '70s. I outlived all my critics. By the time I retired, everybody saw me as a venerable institution. Things do change.
7943.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

7944.quote: I think change is possible, but only for individuals who were never truly gay in the first place and who have a strong personal motivation to recover their heterosexuality.
7944.name: Marilyn vos Savant

7945.quote: When you lead change, sometimes you get arrows in your back. I mean, that's just the way the real world is.
7945.name: Carly Fiorina

7946.quote: An apology might help, but you can change your life without one.
7946.name: Robin Quivers

7947.quote: When he was born, I looked at my little boy and felt an unconditional love I never knew was inside me. As he grew, and I watched him stagger about, squeak his first words, and turn into a beautiful little boy, that feeling did not change.
7947.name: Tony Parsons

7948.quote: Even if I know I shall never change the masses, never transform anything permanent, all I ask is that the good things also have their place, their refuge.
7948.name: Richard Wagner

7949.quote: Mental illness is the last frontier. The gay thing is part of everyday life now on a show like 'Modern Family,' but mental illness is still full of stigma. Maybe it is time for that to change.
7949.name: Eric McCormack

7950.quote: I love street style, seeing how girls wear pieces and how their pair accessories with their outfit. How they pair shoes with a bag and go to day to night and change things up.
7950.name: Maria Sharapova

7951.quote: The only change I can really see is that I don't have to shop for pants in stores anymore.
7951.name: Larry David

7953.quote: Sometimes I have these fantasies of just moving to a foreign country and coming back with a full head of hair. Or not even come back! Make a new life there with hair, Change my name, just see what happens.
7953.name: Larry David

7954.quote: Anyone who's lost someone to cancer will say this, that you have to struggle to try to remember the person before the diagnosis happened, because they really do change - as anyone would change.
7954.name: Mindy Kaling

7955.quote: We are volcanoes. When we women offer our experience as our truth, as human truth, all the maps change. There are new mountains.
7955.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

7956.quote: Change is vital, improvement the logical form of change.
7956.name: James Cash Penney

7957.quote: Rather than saying, 'My checking account is a wreck,' change it to 'I will learn how to track my spending and balance my checkbook.'
7957.name: Suze Orman

7958.quote: I mean, if you didn't get it or if you didn't feel like you enjoyed it, sometimes that experience can change.
7958.name: Keanu Reeves

7959.quote: It took me so many years to move out. I'm definitely a bit of a Peter Pan, reluctant to grow up. It all seemed really nice at home-why change it? Part of me would prefer not to have any responsibility whatsoever.
7959.name: Helena Bonham Carter

7960.quote: I have to struggle to change people's perceptions of me. I grew very frustrated with the perception that I'm this shy, retiring, inhibited aristocratic creature when I'm absolutely not like that at all. I think I'm much more outgoing and exuberant than my image.
7960.name: Helena Bonham Carter

7961.quote: To some extent, Seattle remains a frontier metropolis, a place where people can experiment with their lives, and change and grow and make things happen.
7961.name: Tom Robbins

7962.quote: I change my mind so much I need two boyfriends and a girlfriend.
7962.name: Pink

7963.quote: Don't manage - lead change before you have to.
7963.name: Jack Welch

7964.quote: Probably the most visible example of unintended consequences, is what happens every time humans try to change the natural ecology of a place.
7964.name: Margaret J. Wheatley

7965.quote: Everything will change. The only question is growing up or decaying.
7965.name: Nikki Giovanni

7966.quote: One good teacher in a lifetime may sometimes change a delinquent into a solid citizen.
7966.name: Philip Wylie

7967.quote: A technical solution may be defined as one that requires a change only in the techniques of the natural sciences, demanding little or nothing in the way of change in human values or ideas of morality.
7967.name: Garrett Hardin

7968.quote: You put high heels on and you change.
7968.name: Manolo Blahnik

7969.quote: I mean, language fascinates me anyway, and different words have different energies and you can change the whole drive of a sentence.
7969.name: Alan Rickman

7970.quote: The art of living does not consist in preserving and clinging to a particular mode of happiness, but in allowing happiness to change its form without being disappointed by the change happiness, like a child, must be allowed to grow up.
7970.name: Charles Morgan

7971.quote: One reason we resist making deliberate choices is that choice equals change and most of us, feeling the world is unpredictable enough, try to minimise the trauma of change in our personal lives.
7971.name: Hugh Mackay

7972.quote: That man is a creature who needs order yet yearns for change is the creative contradiction at the heart of the laws which structure his conformity and define his deviancy.
7972.name: Freda Adler

7973.quote: We're not trying to change the world just music.
7973.name: Jonathan Davis

7974.quote: I feel we live in the kind of culture now where you have to be very smart to navigate the right way, and I just don't have those smarts. I think with age and time it will change, but I can't obsess about it.
7974.name: Sienna Miller

7975.quote: I wouldn't change a single thing, because one change alters every moment that follows it.
7975.name: Sidney Poitier

7976.quote: The first resistance to social change is to say it's not necessary.
7976.name: Gloria Steinem

7977.quote: Our economic system, run for profit and waste and based primarily on the extractive industries, is the cause of climate change. We have wasted the earth's treasure and we can no longer exploit it cheaply.
7977.name: Vivienne Westwood

7978.quote: You can love more than one person in your life, but things will be different. There'll be a different dynamic. Needs and desires change.
7978.name: Francesca Annis

7979.quote: Excellent firms don't believe in excellence - only in constant improvement and constant change.
7979.name: Tom Peters

7980.quote: I don't have clear-cut positions. I get baffled by things. I have viewpoints. Sometimes they change.
7980.name: Annie Lennox

7981.quote: Change of fashion is the tax levied by the industry of the poor on the vanity of the rich.
7981.name: Nicolas Chamfort

7982.quote: Creative thinking inspires ideas. Ideas inspire change.
7982.name: Barbara Januszkiewicz

7983.quote: I think it true that, you know, sometimes things start to change even before a government changes and, actually, I think you can begin to see even the Labour machine beginning to understand that it has become over-reliant on targets and processes, that local governments have been over-bossed and bullied.
7983.name: David Cameron

7984.quote: We have the character of an island nation: independent, forthright, passionate in defence of our sovereignty. We can no more change this British sensibility than we can drain the English Channel. And because of this sensibility, we come to the European Union with a frame of mind that is more practical than emotional.
7984.name: David Cameron

7985.quote: The biggest danger to the European Union comes not from those who advocate change, but from those who denounce new thinking as heresy. In its long history Europe has experience of heretics who turned out to have a point.
7985.name: David Cameron

7986.quote: One new feature or fresh take can change everything.
7986.name: Neil Young

7987.quote: I've had some movies that have been ridiculed, but that's OK with me. I don't feel that really defines me. Should I change who I am to be popular?
7987.name: Kevin Costner

7988.quote: If we are to change our world view, images have to change. The artist now has a very important job to do. He's not a little peripheral figure entertaining rich people, he's really needed.
7988.name: Vaclav Havel

7989.quote: The ultimate end of all revolutionary social change is to establish the sanctity of human life, the dignity of man, the right of every human being to liberty and well-being.
7989.name: Emma Goldman

7990.quote: The challenge is not to replace Obama but with who. It's not enough to just change up the uniform, if we don't change the team and the game plan, we won't save our country.
7990.name: Sarah Palin

7991.quote: Your race and gender don't change, but you can choose to change your political affiliation at will.
7991.name: John Podhoretz

7992.quote: Pop culture is a reflection of social change, not a cause of social change.
7992.name: John Podhoretz

7993.quote: All non-incumbent campaigns promise hope and change, but Obama took the promise to a new level of absurdity. He suggested that a vote for him would literally transform the Earth.
7993.name: John Podhoretz

7994.quote: Many individuals are doing what they can. But real success can only come if there is a change in our societies and in our economics and in our politics.
7994.name: David Attenborough

7995.quote: Success cannot come from standstill men. Methods change and men must change with them.
7995.name: James Cash Penney

7996.quote: The Philippines is a terrible name, coming from Spain. Phillip II was the father of the inquisition, who I believe died of syphilis. It is my great regret that we didn't change the name of our country.
7996.name: Imelda Marcos

7997.quote: No matter how many modern parts I do, people still refer to me as Mrs. Costume Drama. Fight Club is a studio pic, and I've done very few of those. I've got a feeling it's going to change things for me.
7997.name: Helena Bonham Carter

7998.quote: I ran for president in order to be able to try to change Washington D.C. from the inside. Our federal government is broken.
7998.name: Herman Cain

7999.quote: It's been really fun to see with each album when I change to see the fans of the show emulate my style and with the first record a lot of the kids in the crowd were wearing neck ties like I was and now you'll see a lot of girls with pink hair. It's cool, it's actually really neat.
7999.name: Avril Lavigne

8000.quote: When fish experience something that would cause other animals physical pain, they behave in ways suggestive of pain, and the change in behaviour may last several hours.
8000.name: Peter Singer

8001.quote: I learned to change my accent in England, your accent identifies you very strongly with a class, and I did not want to be held back.
8001.name: Sting

8002.quote: Some say that I should settle down, go slower and not push so hard, so quickly for such transformational change. To them, I say that you misunderstand the size of the problems we face, the strength of the status quo and the urgency of the people's desire for change.
8002.name: Eliot Spitzer

8003.quote: I absolutely don't care about my looks and I'm so used to them that I wouldn't change a thing. I would end up missing my defects.
8003.name: Colin Firth

8004.quote: Maybe we all change over time.
8004.name: Elizabeth Edwards

8005.quote: I just want people to know that if they want to change the direction of the country, they can do it, but only if they're active, informed, and engaged.
8005.name: Jim DeMint

8006.quote: Some people seem to understand this - that life and change take time - but I am not one of those people.
8006.name: Anne Lamott

8007.quote: I think I'm actually quite a materialistic person, I value what it takes to make a car or build a nice house. Money does change things, but how it changes people depends on how they react to it.
8007.name: Roland Gift

8008.quote: I have a big fear of change, or negative change, anyway. I'm basically the same person I was when I won 'Idol,' or when I was 10.
8008.name: Kelly Clarkson

8009.quote: I don't think my principles change. I think the way in which you apply those principles to modern society changes.
8009.name: William Hague

8010.quote: You change with the guys you date.
8010.name: Jessica Simpson

8011.quote: If a person with a bullet in Dallas can change the world, imagine a person with an idea could do.
8011.name: J. Michael Straczynski

8012.quote: If a man like Malcolm X could change and repudiate racism, if I myself and other former Muslims can change, if young whites can change, then there is hope for America.
8012.name: Eldridge Cleaver

8013.quote: Human memory is a marvelous but fallacious instrument. The memories which lie within us are not carved in stone not only do they tend to become erased as the years go by, but often they change, or even increase by incorporating extraneous features.
8013.name: Primo Levi

8014.quote: It is well for people who think to change their minds occasionally in order to keep them clean. For those who do not think, it is best at least to rearrange their prejudices once in a while.
8014.name: Luther Burbank

8015.quote: People with high blood pressure, diabetes - those are conditions brought about by life style. If you change the life style, those conditions will leave.
8015.name: Dick Gregory

8016.quote: I was away from the front lines for a while this spring, living with other troops, and considerable fighting took place while I was gone. When I got ready to return to my old friends at the front I wondered if I would sense any change in them.
8016.name: Ernie Pyle

8152.quote: From year to year, environmental changes are incremental and often barely register in our lives, but from evolutionary or geological perspectives, what is happening is explosive change.

8158.quote: I don't think I'm really open to having Washington change me.

8177.name: Jeff Goodell

8178.quote: Climate change is a global issue - from the point of view of the Earth's climate, a molecule of CO2 emitted in Bejing is the same as a molecule emitted in Sydney.
8178.name: Jeff Goodell

8179.quote: What's certain is that a totalitarian enclave like Cuba's can't continue to exist, so change will definitely come there, eventually.
8179.name: Vaclav Havel

8180.quote: Every day I'm thinking about change.
8180.name: Miuccia Prada

8181.quote: Ever since the collapse of cap and trade legislation and the realization that President Obama is unlikely to ever utter the words 'climate change' in public again, much less use the bully pulpit to prepare the nation for the catastrophic risks of inaction, the movement has been in a funk.
8181.name: Jeff Goodell

8182.quote: I mean, I think we're put here on earth to make your own destiny, to begin with. I don't think there's anything you can do this way or that way to change anything.
8182.name: Waylon Jennings

8183.quote: Maybe more climate activists will think about the climate change not as an international problem to be resolved in an air-conditioned meeting hall, but as a guerilla war to be fought in the streets.
8183.name: Jeff Goodell

8184.quote: I don't think the Palestinian people or Afghan children or some other things I'm concerned about are at the top of other people's agendas - not right now, when America is going through such a recession and people are suffering across the board financially. But I think all that will change.
8184.name: Patti Smith

8185.quote: One of the big questions in the climate change debate: Are humans any smarter than frogs in a pot? If you put a frog in a pot and slowly turn up the heat, it won't jump out. Instead, it will enjoy the nice warm bath until it is cooked to death. We humans seem to be doing pretty much the same thing.
8185.name: Jeff Goodell

8186.quote: I've always looked the same. Since I was a child, I hated having to deal with my hair. I hated having to change my clothes. As a kid, I had a sailor shirt and the same old corduroy pants, and that's what I wanted to wear everyday.
8186.name: Patti Smith

8187.quote: You may not be able to change a situation, but with humor you can change your attitude about it.
8187.name: Allen Klein

8188.quote: When the fabric of society is so rigid that it cannot change quickly enough, adjustments are achieved by social unrest and revolutions.
8188.name: John Boyd Orr

8189.quote: President Obama's version of America is a divided one - pitting us against each other based on our income level, gender, and social status. His policies have failed! We are not better off than we were 4 years ago, and no rhetoric, bumper sticker, or campaign ad can change that.
8189.name: Mia Love

8190.quote: The experience of being in space didn't change my perspective of myself or of the planet or of life. I had no spiritual experience.
8190.name: Sally Ride

8191.quote: Sureness is something like a neck brace, which we clamp around our lives, hoping to somehow protect ourselves from the frightening, constant whiplash of change. Sadly, the brace doesn't always hold.
8191.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

8192.quote: As somebody who, in my second marriage, insisted on a prenuptial agreement, I can also testify that sometimes it is an act of love to chart the exit strategy before you enter the union, in order to make sure that not only you, but your partner as well, knows that there will be no World War III should hearts and minds, for any sad reason, change.
8192.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

8193.quote: In politics there are some candidates who use change to promote their careers, and then there are those like John McCain who use their careers to promote change.
8193.name: Sarah Palin

8194.quote: If you want to change the way your banking system is regulated, if you want to learn the mistakes of what's gone wrong, then you have to change your government.
8194.name: George Osborne

8195.quote: Even before he came to power in 1997, Gordon Brown promised to change the accounts to parliament from simple litanies of cash in and cash out, to a more commercial system that took notice of the public property the departments were using. This system is known as resource accounting.
8195.name: James Buchan

8196.quote: I know how bad Albany is. I know it better than most. I understand why people are angry. I'm angry. The question is going to be, how do you change Albany, what is the plan for change, and then how do you actually get it done?
8196.name: Andrew Cuomo

8197.quote: Only I can change my life. No one can do it for me.
8197.name: Carol Burnett

8198.quote: News reports don't change the world. Only facts change it, and those have already happened when we get the news.
8198.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

8199.quote: One of the things I like enormously about Bob Weinstein is that that he's the only studio head I have ever known who will change his mind and say he was wrong.
8199.name: Dean Koontz

8200.quote: You know, for 300 years it's been kind of the same. There are restaurants in New Orleans that the menu hasn't changed in 125 years, so how is one going to change or evolve the food?
8200.name: Emeril Lagasse

8201.quote: There are women who make things better, there are women who change things, there are women who make things happen, who make a difference. I want to be one of those women.
8201.name: Vera Farmiga

8202.quote: The politicians always told us that the Cold War stand-off could only change by way of nuclear war. None of them believed that such systemic change was possible.
8202.name: Lech Walesa

8203.quote: Geological change usually takes thousands of years to happen but we are seeing the climate changing not just in our lifetimes but also year by year.
8203.name: James Lovelock

8204.quote: I don't think we're yet evolved to the point where we're clever enough to handle a complex a situation as climate change. The inertia of humans is so huge that you can't really do anything meaningful.
8204.name: James Lovelock

8205.quote: The only thing I fear more than change is no change. The business of being static makes me nuts.
8205.name: Twyla Tharp

8206.quote: The problem with being sure that God is on your side is that you can't change your mind, because God sure isn't going to change His.
8206.name: Roger Ebert

8207.quote: I don't think anything changes until ideas change. The usual American viewpoint is to believe that something is wrong with the person.
8207.name: James Hillman

8208.quote: If you actually want to change your world, there is a better way of doing it than blowing yourself up.
8208.name: Salman Rushdie

8209.quote: You have to come in and be that character when you walk into the room. That's what one of my first acting teachers taught me. You know, don't go in there being Jennifer and then expect to flip and change, because they're not going to have that imagination.
8209.name: Jennifer Lopez

8210.quote: When you first have a baby your life doesn't change. I mean, you have a little less sleep and you drag these cuddly things around you and it's just amazing. But you still get to be you. Once they get to, like, five, six and school and it starts to get, like, 'Wow, they got real problems. They're my responsibility.' Oh my God. That is overwhelming.
8210.name: Gwen Stefani

8211.quote: I think if there's any difference between me and a traditional CEO, it's that I've been unwilling to change myself or shape my personality around what's expected.
8211.name: Andrew Mason

8212.quote: I think your alcohol intake has to change. You know, usually a big person feels they can drink anything they want to and as much as they want to and I've cut that way back.
8212.name: Mike Ditka

8213.quote: Just because you liked something as a youngster doesn't mean you have to like it as an adult. You can change your taste a little bit on the sweets and things like that.
8213.name: Mike Ditka

8214.quote: I'm all about change, and I know things are going to move forward in life, and that's just how it goes.
8214.name: Kid Rock

8215.quote: To be in a situation where you have no rights whatsoever is something I wish everybody could experience. People's attitudes would change. It would be a better place.
8215.name: Tommy Chong

8216.quote: You know who is against democracy in the Middle East? The husbands. They got used to their way of life. Now, the traditional way of life must change. Everybody must change. If you don't give equal rights to women, you can't progress.
8216.name: Shimon Peres

8217.quote: I always try to keep the circumstances in my life fresh. I like to change the physical environment I live in, change the people around me and try to experience things for the first time. I think that keeps one on their toes, creatively and spiritually.
8217.name: Lenny Kravitz

8218.quote: Imagine if the pension funds and endowments that own much of the equity in our financial services companies demanded that those companies revisit the way mortgages were marketed to those without adequate skills to understand the products they were being sold. Management would have to change the way things were done.
8218.name: Eliot Spitzer

8219.quote: One of the most important things that I did to turn my life around was to realize and to accept that from this minute, that's all we have. Everything that happened behind us we cannot change so you might as well look to the future.
8219.name: Nick Carter

8220.quote: One-third of Americans have already been forced to change their lifestyle because their disposable income is gone. A guy can't go to the corner bar after a rough day at work to have a beer, that's gone to oil!
8220.name: Terry McAuliffe

8221.quote: The reality of split government puts a premium on creativity within the administration. President Obama needs to put the right people in charge of the agencies and then have them push the bounds of administrative power to change policy through those agencies. President Obama has a pretty good track record of this.
8221.name: Eliot Spitzer

8222.quote: I'm not going to change the world overnight. It's one person at a time, and hopefully they're people in positions of power who can help people get in those roles and really, truly embrace colorblind casting.
8222.name: Gabrielle Union

8223.quote: Really, each era has its own false nostalgia. We all put a picket fence up around something. For my generation it was the '50s, and for other generations it will be something else. Change is scary for everyone, as is complexity, contradiction, and an uncertain future.
8223.name: Gary Ross

8224.quote: I always get bored with my hair. That's why I would always change it throughout my career.
8224.name: Janet Jackson

8225.quote: We may need to change the way we think. As in Israel, I think there should be a mandatory draft, where you go away for the service of your country for three years.
8225.name: Steven Tyler

8226.quote: There was a great complexity to my father. He was a devoted family man. But, in the same breath, he simply was not suited to an anchored life. He should have been somebody who had a backpack, an old map, a bit of change in his pocket and that was it - roaming the world.
8226.name: Christian Bale

8227.quote: The world will change for the better when people decide they are sick and tired of being sick and tired of the way the world is, and decide to change themselves.
8227.name: Sydney Madwed

8228.quote: All we need, really, is a change from a near frigid to a tropical attitude of mind.
8228.name: Marjory Stoneman Douglas

8229.quote: I moved to New York last year and I love it. It's a huge change and I've always wanted to spend time there. It's like a more intense London, and everything's up a few notches. The lights are brighter, the pace is faster and the food's better.
8229.name: Rachel Weisz

8230.quote: Everything can change at any moment, suddenly and forever.
8230.name: Paul Auster

8231.quote: I was advised by an American agent when I was about 19 to change my surname.
8231.name: Rachel Weisz

8232.quote: When you have that window of opportunity called a crisis, move as quickly as you can, get as much done as you can. There's a momentum for change that's very compelling.
8232.name: Anne M. Mulcahy

8233.quote: When you have a tough loss, go through it and agonize. I had one loss that I still want to change, but at the same time I realize it is an important part of who I am.
8233.name: Andrew Shue

8234.quote: Turbulence is life force. It is opportunity. Let's love turbulence and use it for change.
8234.name: Ramsey Clark

8235.quote: I thought, well, you might see curves there, but that's just a bone - so even if I lose weight that's not going to change anything. That's how I look. That's my shape. Do the math.
8235.name: Christina Hendricks

8236.quote: Look at all the buses now that want exact change, exact change. I figure if I give them exact change, they should take me exactly where I want to go.
8236.name: George C. Wallace

8237.quote: I'm a role model now. I didn't know I was gonna have 13-year-old fans, so I've tried to change a few things here and there. But I also know that the girls don't want me to be Miley Cyrus, either.
8237.name: Nicki Minaj

8238.quote: As far as I was concerned, either I was a homosexual or I wasn't, so making films would change nothing.
8238.name: Claude Chabrol

8239.quote: I am going to get political on you. Because I am the most shallow person in the world, my mission is to see men's formal wear change a little bit. It is too rigid! Everybody looks like a penguin!
8239.name: Steven Cojocaru

8240.quote: When characters change on screen, it makes you feel better about yourself. You think, 'Oh I change too, I'm constantly becoming a better person.'
8240.name: Jason Reitman

8241.quote: If your life changes, we can change the world, too.
8241.name: Yoko Ono

8242.quote: Aside from my work, in my everyday private life, I'm not a very adventureous person. I don't look for change.
8242.name: Namie Amuro

8243.quote: I just think we're living in a time of massive, amazing change, like the Industrial Revolution on acid.
8243.name: Kelly Lynch

8244.quote: We may think there is willpower involved, but more likely, change is due to want power. Wanting the new addiction more than the old one. Wanting the new me in preference to the person I am now.
8244.name: George A. Sheehan

8245.quote: Too many people just eat to consume calories. Try dining for a change.
8245.name: John Walters

8246.quote: You must change in order to survive.
8246.name: Pearl Bailey

8247.quote: We are like a woman with a difficult pregnancy. We have to rebuild the social classes in Egypt, and we must change the way things were.
8247.name: Naguib Mahfouz

8248.quote: On the political front, of course it's a zero-sum game. If it's all white males holding positions, you bring 10 women in, then it's, 'Women are coming!' Get 10 blacks and it's, 'Blacks are coming!' 'Hispanics are coming!' Zero-sum game. The seatmates might change but the chairs don't move. In the economy, the number of chairs can actually increase.
8248.name: Jesse Jackson

8249.quote: When I'm bored or tired of being blonde, I'll throw on a wig. It's a lot less of a permanent way to change your look, and I have about 10 - all different colors, shapes, bobs, long hair, short, feathered.
8249.name: Sara Blakely

8250.quote: I am artistic so I reserve the right to change my mind at any point. I just like to do different things. What is more important than the name is that people know that I really like acting, I enjoy it and I want people to know that I am serious.
8250.name: LL Cool J

8251.quote: Is there any wonder why we are in such big trouble? Any question why the people don't trust their government anymore, and demand a change?
8251.name: Chris Christie

8252.quote: I like the way my heart beats, I like the way I think I don't need or want anything to change that.
8252.name: Jordin Sparks

8253.quote: Fall is my favorite season in Los Angeles, watching the birds change color and fall from the trees.
8253.name: David Letterman

8254.quote: Since 'Idol' I've gotten used to having an amazing hair and make-up team around me, so I'm starting to get picky. I know what I like now and I'm happy to say 'Could we maybe change that?' if I don't like something. I don't yell or anything, but I think I could definitely start to act a little diva-ish when it comes to my look.
8254.name: Jordin Sparks

8255.quote: I think I can change the game.
8255.name: Venus Williams

8256.quote: As far as friendships go, things change even without the fame. People start moving on. I have a few friends that are married and are starting to have kids and I'm like, 'Oh my goodness gracious - that's so insane.' I also have friends who are just doing their own thing, which is cool.
8256.name: Jordin Sparks

8257.quote: If I have to change my lifestyle, I don't want to live.
8257.name: Robert Mapplethorpe

8258.quote: Well, I had braces and I had to wear headgear! I loved my braces, actually. For me, they were like a piece of jewelry! Instead of the silver or pewter I had gold braces. It was so much fun, I loved them. I got to change the colors and stuff and I had the rubber bands.
8258.name: Jordin Sparks

8259.quote: I wouldn't change one thing about my professional life, and I make it a point not to dwell on my mistakes.
8259.name: Ethel Merman

8260.quote: Christians should be ready for a change because Jesus was the greatest changer in history.
8260.name: Ralph Abernathy

8261.quote: I'm definitely open to change, but at the same time I am quite stubborn.
8261.name: Andy Murray

8262.quote: One of the things I've always personally tried to stress with this band was to have some kind of visual aspect and to be consistent with it - like, not to change.
8262.name: Peter Steele

8263.quote: No foreigner has a place asking another people, another country, to change their constitution.
8263.name: Hamid Karzai

8264.quote: The only way to change is to vote. People are responsible.
8264.name: Paul Wellstone

8265.quote: You want to balance the budget in this country? We change the salary structure for Congress and the President. Every year they don't balance the budget, we don't pay them.
8265.name: Daniel Keys Moran

8266.quote: Change brings opportunities. On the other hand, change can be confusing.
8266.name: Michael Porter

8267.quote: Finishing food is about the tiny touches. In the last seconds you can change everything.
8267.name: Mario Batali

8268.quote: So I think it's - what was important to me is that I found that I can't change the fact that people already have made an opinion about me. But I don't think that should stop me from trying to correct some of the misperceptions that are out there.
8268.name: Monica Lewinsky

8269.quote: There are many challenges, there are many obstacles let us try to change the obstacles to advantages.
8269.name: Harri Holkeri

8270.quote: I don't change. The things around me change.
8270.name: Jeremy Renner

8271.quote: Doubt is an uneasy and dissatisfied state from which we struggle to free ourselves and pass into the state of belief while the latter is a calm and satisfactory state which we do not wish to avoid, or to change to a belief in anything else.
8271.name: Charles Sanders Peirce

8272.quote: I was born left-handed, but I was made to use my other hand. When I was writing 'Famished Road,' which was very long, I got repetitive stress syndrome. My right wrist collapsed, so I started using my left hand. The prose I wrote with my left hand came out denser, so later on I had to change it.
8272.name: Ben Okri

8273.quote: Whoever is content with the world, and who profits from its lack of justice, does not want to change it.
8273.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

8274.quote: But I think it's more that when you're young, you're invincible, you're immortal - or at least you think you are. The possibilities are limitless, you're inventing the future. Then you get older and suddenly you have a history. It's fixed. You can't change anything. I find that a bit disturbing, to be honest.
8274.name: Damien Hirst

8275.quote: Worry is a useless mulling over of things we cannot change.
8275.name: Peace Pilgrim

8276.quote: If you continually write and read yourself as a fiction, you can change what's crushing you.
8276.name: Jeanette Winterson

8277.quote: Obama has no power to change American policy because there are people who specialize in drawing these policies, which have been and still are hostile towards Islam.
8277.name: Muqtada al Sadr

8278.quote: I don't write for any group. I write to bring about a change in consciousness.
8278.name: Jeanette Winterson

8279.quote: And I do believe that the way to change a society, to uplift people - not just their spirit, but to uplift their society and economic base - is through education.
8279.name: Rainn Wilson

8280.quote: I don't read reviews because by then it's too late - whatever anyone says, the book won't change. It is written.
8280.name: Jeanette Winterson

8281.quote: You know, Motorcycle Diaries has no incredible stories, no sudden plot twists, it doesn't play that way. It's about recognizing that instance of change and embracing it.
8281.name: Gael Garcia Bernal

8282.quote: Sometimes when we are generous in small, barely detectable ways it can change someone else's life forever.
8282.name: Margaret Cho

8283.quote: The Bush-Cheney administration had betrayed some basic American values. So there was hunger for change.
8283.name: Al Gore

8284.quote: I'd say that after my father passed my writing changed, it went deeper. Most would say 'matured' but I don't think I'd use that word in relation to my progress. I think 'change' is a little more accurate.
8284.name: Rick Springfield

8285.quote: I do genuinely believe that the political system is not linear. When it reaches a tipping point fashioned by a critical mass of opinion, the slow pace of change we're used to will no longer be the norm. I see a lot of signs every day that we're moving closer and closer to that tipping point.
8285.name: Al Gore

8286.quote: There are those people who are in your corner no matter what, you can't do any wrong, even when you do wrong. And then there are those people that no matter what you do they are going to dislike you and that's not going to change.
8286.name: Brett Favre

8287.quote: Pick up a rifle and you change instantly from a subject to a citizen.
8287.name: Jeff Cooper

8288.quote: We are all born with a unique genetic blueprint, which lays out the basic characteristics of our personality as well as our physical health and appearance, And yet, we all know that life experiences do change us.
8288.name: Joan D. Vinge

8289.quote: Injuries obviously change the way you approach the game.
8289.name: Brett Favre

8290.quote: I had a very insightful friend who warned me back when I stopped reading scripts, 'It's easier to change directions while you're still moving.' If you stop, it's harder to get started again. I still don't think I made the wrong decision, but he was right.
8290.name: Debra Winger

8291.quote: Styles, like everything else, change. Style doesn't.
8291.name: Linda Ellerbee

8292.quote: We have no reason to think that climate change is harmful if you look at the world as a whole. Most places, in fact, are better off being warmer than being colder. And historically, the really bad times for the environment and for people have been the cold periods rather than the warm periods.
8292.name: Freeman Dyson

8293.quote: It's better to get smart than to get mad. I try not to get so insulted that I will not take advantage of an opportunity to persuade people to change their minds.
8293.name: John H. Johnson

8294.quote: If you don't like the way the world is, you change it. You have an obligation to change it. You just do it one step at a time.
8294.name: Marian Wright Edelman

8295.quote: I wrote seven Myron Bolitar novels in a row, and I never want to write a Myron book where he just solves a crime. Every one of them I want to be personal, and I want him to grow and change. The problem with that is, it makes the series limited, you can't write a series where a guy is always going through some kind of crisis.
8295.name: Harlan Coben

8296.quote: Change is not a destination, just as hope is not a strategy.
8296.name: Rudy Giuliani

8297.quote: A leopard does not change his spots, or change his feeling that spots are rather a credit.
8297.name: Ivy Compton-Burnett

8298.quote: The Howard Hughes I knew began to change after his plane crash in 1941.
8298.name: Gene Tierney

8299.quote: I want art to make me think. In order to do that, it may piss me off, or make me uncomfortable. That promotes awareness and change, or at least some discussion.
8299.name: Pink

8300.quote: I'd be happy to be taken as a woman - and that's what I was initially trying to do when I started throwing on dresses and stuff. But that wasn't going to happen because everyone kept calling me sir. So I thought I'd change the method and just start wearing what I wanted to wear.
8300.name: Eddie Izzard

8301.quote: Governments cannot make marriages or turn feckless individuals into responsible citizens. That needs another kind of change agent.
8301.name: Jonathan Sacks

8302.quote: I don't want to clip on the armour every morning. I've seen some politicians do this and they get a bit mangled and bitter. I just refuse to do that. I refuse to be angry or bitter or complain, and I remain open. I may sometimes be a bit too open but I'm not going to change that one bit.
8302.name: Nick Clegg

8303.quote: Much can and must be done by governments, but they cannot of themselves change lives.
8303.name: Jonathan Sacks

8304.quote: Most of what needs to be changed in the euro zone can be done without treaty changes. The demand for treaty change is as political as it is legal and I don't think it's going to happen soon.
8304.name: Nick Clegg

8305.quote: Europe is dying. That is one of the unsayable truths of our time. We are undergoing the moral equivalent of climate change and no one is talking about it.
8305.name: Jonathan Sacks

8306.quote: What creates freedom? A revolution in the streets? Mass protest? Civil war? A change of government? The ousting of the old guard and its replacement by the new? History, more often than not, shows that hopes raised by such events are often dashed, sooner rather than later.
8306.name: Jonathan Sacks

8307.quote: My kid could get a bad X-ray and I could get a call from the doctor saying I have something growing in my bum and that would change my perspective on everything instantaneously, on what is and what is not important.
8307.name: Tom Hanks

8308.quote: You do have to change things as warfare changes.
8308.name: Charles Schumer

8309.quote: A man's character may be learned from the adjectives which he habitually uses in conversation.
8309.name: Mark Twain

8310.quote: Truthful words are not beautiful beautiful words are not truthful. Good words are not persuasive persuasive words are not good.
8310.name: Lao Tzu

8311.quote: The single biggest problem in communication is the illusion that it has taken place.
8311.name: George Bernard Shaw

8312.quote: Electric communication will never be a substitute for the face of someone who with their soul encourages another person to be brave and true.
8312.name: Charles Dickens

8313.quote: I'm a great believer that any tool that enhances communication has profound effects in terms of how people can learn from each other, and how they can achieve the kind of freedoms that they're interested in.
8313.name: Bill Gates

8314.quote: Any problem, big or small, within a family, always seems to start with bad communication. Someone isn't listening.
8314.name: Emma Thompson

8315.quote: Take advantage of every opportunity to practice your communication skills so that when important occasions arise, you will have the gift, the style, the sharpness, the clarity, and the emotions to affect other people.
8315.name: Jim Rohn

8316.quote: To effectively communicate, we must realize that we are all different in the way we perceive the world and use this understanding as a guide to our communication with others.
8316.name: Tony Robbins

8317.quote: By and large, language is a tool for concealing the truth.
8317.name: George Carlin

8318.quote: The most important thing in communication is hearing what isn't said.
8318.name: Peter Drucker

8319.quote: I learned never to empty the well of my writing, but always to stop when there was still something there in the deep part of the well, and let it refill at night from the springs that fed it.
8319.name: Ernest Hemingway

8320.quote: Of all of our inventions for mass communication, pictures still speak the most universally understood language.
8320.name: Walt Disney

8321.quote: First learn the meaning of what you say, and then speak.
8321.name: Epictetus

8322.quote: Communication is a skill that you can learn. It's like riding a bicycle or typing. If you're willing to work at it, you can rapidly improve the quality of evry part of your life.
8322.name: Brian Tracy

8323.quote: Be still when you have nothing to say when genuine passion moves you, say what you've got to say, and say it hot.
8323.name: David Herbert Lawrence

8324.quote: Photography is more than a medium for factual communication of ideas. It is a creative art.
8324.name: Ansel Adams

8325.quote: Every day I try to be in communication with the universe in an unconscious way.
8325.name: Paulo Coelho

8326.quote: The game of life is a game of boomerangs. Our thoughts, deeds and words return to us sooner or later with astounding accuracy.
8326.name: Florence Scovel Shinn

8327.quote: Bad human communication leaves us less room to grow.
8327.name: Rowan D. Williams

8328.quote: Communication - the human connection - is the key to personal and career success.
8328.name: Paul J. Meyer

8329.quote: The communication of the dead is tongued with fire beyond the language of the living.
8329.name: T. S. Eliot

8330.quote: Genius is the ability to put into effect what is on your mind.
8330.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

8331.quote: There is no pleasure to me without communication: there is not so much as a sprightly thought comes into my mind that it does not grieve me to have produced alone, and that I have no one to tell it to.
8331.name: Michel de Montaigne

8332.quote: Communication leads to community, that is, to understanding, intimacy and mutual valuing.
8332.name: Rollo May

8681.name: Paul Vixie

8682.quote: If net neutrality goes away, it will fundamentally change everything about the Internet.
8682.name: James Hilton

8683.quote: I've tried word processors, but I think I'm too old a dog to use one.
8683.name: Dee Brown

8684.quote: As a rule, software systems do not work well until they have been used, and have failed repeatedly, in real applications.
8684.name: Dave Parnas

8685.name: Dale Dougherty

8686.quote: Computers make me totally blank out.
8686.name: Dalai Lama

8687.quote: Computers themselves, and software yet to be developed, will revolutionize the way we learn.
8687.name: Steve Jobs

8688.name: Steve Jobs

That doesn't mean we don't listen to customers, but it's hard for them to tell you what they want when they've never seen anything remotely like it.
8689.name: Steve Jobs

8690.name: Mark Zuckerberg

8691.quote: Few companies that installed computers to reduce the employment of clerks have realized their expectations, They now need more, and more expensive clerks even though they call them 'operators' or 'programmers.'
8691.name: Peter Drucker

8692.quote: There is no heaven or afterlife for broken-down computers that is a fairy story for people afraid of the dark.
8692.name: Stephen Hawking

8693.quote: There is a computer disease that anybody who works with computers knows about. It's a very serious disease and it interferes completely with the work. The trouble with computers is that you 'play' with them!

8694.quote: There is a real danger that computers will develop intelligence and take over. We urgently need to develop direct connections to the brain so that computers can add to human intelligence rather than be in opposition.
8694.name: Stephen Hawking

8695.quote: Globalization, as defined by rich people like us, is a very nice thing, you are talking about the Internet, you are talking about cell phones, you are talking about computers. This doesn't affect two-thirds of the people of the world.
8695.name: Jimmy Carter

8696.quote: Computers and the Internet have made it really easy to rant. It's made everyone overly opinionated.
8696.name: Scott Weiland

8697.quote: The real story of Facebook is just that we've worked so hard for all this time. I mean, the real story is actually probably pretty boring, right? I mean, we just sat at our computers for six years and coded.
8697.name: Mark Zuckerberg

8698.quote: Sci-fi films are the epic films of the day because we can no longer put 10,000 extras in the scene - but we can draw thousands of aliens with computers.
8698.name: William Shatner

8699.quote: Don't try to be like Jackie. There is only one Jackie. Study computers instead.
8699.name: Jackie Chan

8700.quote: I'm interested in all kinds of pictures, however they are made, with cameras, with paint brushes, with computers, with anything.
8700.name: David Hockney

8701.quote: That's what happens nowadays with people working on computers. They can so easily fix things with their mouse and take out all the, 'Oh, somebody coughed in the background we need to take that out' - or somebody hit a bad note. Those are all the best moments.
8701.name: Jack White

8702.quote: Google is working on self-driving cars, and they seem to work. People are so bad at driving cars that computers don't have to be that good to be much better.
8702.name: Marc Andreessen

8703.quote: We're getting so pulled in by computers and technology, and our kids have their face in the computers all day. The human relationship is being diminished by this.
8703.name: Lenny Kravitz

8704.quote: I have a crazy amount of different jobs, so the way I manage that is to not do more than one at a time. It's like old computers that had small memory chips, they would do something called swapping, where they would fill the memory with one task, do it and get it out.
8704.name: Louis C. K.

8705.quote: Electronic aids, particularly domestic computers, will help the inner migration, the opting out of reality. Reality is no longer going to be the stuff out there, but the stuff inside your head. It's going to be commercial and nasty at the same time.
8705.name: J. G. Ballard

8706.quote: People are so bad at driving cars that computers don't have to be that good to be much better. Any time you stand in line at the D.M.V. and look around, you're like, Oh, my God, I wish all these people were replaced by computer drivers.
8706.name: Marc Andreessen

8707.quote: Technology is like water it wants to find its level. So if you hook up your computer to a billion other computers, it just makes sense that a tremendous share of the resources you want to use - not only text or media but processing power too - will be located remotely.
8707.name: Marc Andreessen

8708.quote: It was used for decades to describe talented computer enthusiasts, people whose skill at using computers to solve technical problems and puzzles was - and is - respected and admired by others possessing similar technical skills.
8708.name: Kevin Mitnick

8709.quote: Why does everyone think the future is space helmets, silver foil, and talking like computers, like a bad episode of Star Trek?
8709.name: Tracey Ullman

8710.quote: I understand that computers, which I once believed to be but a hermaphrodite typewriter-cum-filing cabinet, offer the cyber literate increased ability to communicate. I do not think this is altogether a bad thing, however it may appear on the surface.
8710.name: David Mamet

8711.quote: You have riches and freedom here but I feel no sense of faith or direction. You have so many computers, why don't you use them in the search for love?
8711.name: Lech Walesa

8712.quote: I use many different gadgets connected with computers I use PCs, laptops and a Palm Pilot. I also use the Internet to visit websites, especially within Polish-language Internet. I usually go to political discussion groups and sites - of course, as I use my real name, people never believe that they are chatting with me!
8712.name: Lech Walesa

8713.quote: I'm not afraid of computers taking over the world.
8713.name: Thom Yorke

8714.quote: I don't know anything about computers.
8714.name: Adam Carolla

8715.quote: I get hired to hack into computers now and sometimes it's actually easier than it was years ago.
8715.name: Kevin Mitnick

8716.quote: Beatbullying's 'The Big March 2012' is such a brilliant campaign and I am very proud to be a part of it. 8716.name: Katherine Jenkins

8717.quote: Today, computers are almost second nature to most of us.
8717.name: James Dyson

8718.quote: I've always been at the intersection of computers and whatever they can revolutionize.
8718.name: Jeff Bezos

8719.name: Ray Comfort

8722.quote: The technological revolution at home makes it much easier for computers to do our work.
8722.name: Fareed Zakaria

8723.quote: I wish people would turn off their computers, go outside, talk to people, touch people, lick people, enjoy each other's company and smell each other on the rump.

8725.quote: We could say we want the Web to reflect a vision of the world where everything is done democratically. To do that, we get computers to talk with each other in such a way as to promote that ideal.
8725.name: Tim Berners-Lee

8727.name: Jaron Lanier

8728.quote: I am of the very last generation who didn't have computers at school. As we grow old we'll become something of an aberration.
8728.name: Steve Coogan

8729.quote: Our lives sometimes depend on computers performing as predicted.
8729.name: Philip Emeagwali

8730.quote: The only thing I do on a computer is play Texas Hold 'Em, really. Obviously my cell phone is a computer. My car is a computer. I'm on computers every day without actively seeking them out.
8730.name: John Hawkes

8731.quote: The next major explosion is going to be when genetics and computers come together. I'm talking about an organic computer - about biological substances that can function like a semiconductor.

8732.quote: I look like a geeky hacker, but I don't know anything about computers.

8735.name: Richard Stallman

8736.quote: The great advance of personal computers was not the computing power per se but the fact that it brought it right to your face, that you had control over it, that were confronted with it and could steer it.

8737.name: Carrie-Anne Moss

8741.quote: I'm really anti-option, so computers have been my nightmare with recording. I don't want endless tracks I want less tracks. I want decisions to be made.
8741.name: Ian MacKaye

8742.quote: I was a 'Duck Hunt' and 'Mario' guy, and stuff like that. I was never technologically driven. I never had all the cool, new toys. I was the youngest child, I wasn't the only child, so I wasn't spoiled as a kid. And, we were on the farm, so we didn't have a lot. Also, with computers, I'm not very good with them. I just check my email.
8742.name: Garrett Hedlund

8743.quote: We're just into toys, whether it's motorcycles or race cars or computers. I've got the Palm Pilot right here with me, I've got the world's smallest phone. Maybe it's just because I'm still a big little kid and I just love toys, you know?
8743.name: Catherine Bell

8744.quote: Anyway, all these computers and digital gadgets are no good. They just fill your head with numbers and that can't be good for you.

8750.quote: In fact, technology has been the story of human progress from as long back as we know. In 100 years people will look back on now and say, 'That was the Internet Age.' And computers will be seen as a mere ingredient to the Internet Age.

8765.quote: If the machines can take the drudgery out of it and just leave us with the joy of drawing, then that's the best of both worlds - and I'll use those computers!

8768.quote: Your car should drive itself. It's amazing to me that we let humans drive cars, It's a bug that cars were invented before computers.

8769.quote: Computers, like automobiles and airplanes, do only what people tell them to do.

8771.quote: It was a huge challenge to learn digital painting well enough so that computers don't pop into mind when one sees one.

8772.quote: The trick with computers I think, is to approach old and new things with the same reverence as you would like your favourite chair and not be seduced by the constant innovation otherwise you never do anything.

8773.quote: It's interesting to see what people are saying about me. I like keep up with the latest rumors! A while back there was a rumor that I was going to do a film with Demi Moore about the takeover of Commodore computers!

8774.quote: Everyone has this perception that the bloggers, they say horrible things about you and they hide behind their computers where you can't see them.

8778.quote: Every ISP is being attacked, maliciously both from in the United States and outside of the United States, by those who want to invade people's privacy. But more importantly they want to take control of computers, they want to hack them, they want to steal information.

8779.quote: Computers have become more friendly, understandable, and lots of years and thought have been put into developing software to convince people that they want and need a computer.

8780.quote: I don't care how big and fast computers are, they're not as big and fast as the world.

8782.name: James Iha

8783.quote: But I'm so slow on it because I find it terribly hard writing blind on computers. The computer speaks to me, but it's just so slow, I'm so terribly slow using it.
8783.name: Jack Vance

8784.quote: I continue to meet people who have had their Web pages hijacked, their browsers corrupted, in some cases, their children exposed to inappropriate material from these dangerous programs hidden in their family computers.
8784.name: Cliff Stearns

8785.quote: It seems like everything that we see perceived in the brain before we actually use our own eyes, that everything we see is coming through computers or machines and then is being input in our brain cells. So that really worries me.

8786.quote: But computers have changed the world for everyone, so there will be some way of working it out.

8787.quote: The idea that so many kids eat rubbish and sit on computers all day long appals me and getting them into sport is a major way of getting them off computers and leading healthier lives.
8787.name: Kirsty Gallacher

8788.quote: Before computers, telephone lines and television connect us, we all share the same air, the same oceans, the same mountains and rivers. We are all equally responsible for protecting them.
8788.name: Julia Louis-Dreyfus

8789.quote: Something else has happened with computers.
8789.name: Seth Lloyd

8790.quote: What's happened with society is that we have created these devices, computers, which already can register and process huge amounts of information, which is a significant fraction of the amount of information that human beings themselves, as a species, can process.
8790.name: Seth Lloyd

8791.quote: One of the things that is not so good is that a decision was made long ago about the size of an IP address - 32 bits. At the time it was a number much larger than anyone could imagine ever having that many computers but it turned out to be to small.
8791.name: Jon Postel

8792.quote: China has legally purchased high performance computers, advanced machine tools, and semiconductor-manufacturing equipment from several American companies.
8792.name: Charles Foster Bass

8793.quote: Over the eons I've been a fan of, and sucker for, each latest automated system to 'simplify' and 'bring order to' my life. Very early on this led me to the beautiful-and-doomed Lotus Agenda for my DOS computers, and Actioneer for the early Palm.
8793.name: James Fallows

8794.quote: I am a huge supporter for cash for caulkers - which allows people to make improvement for energy efficient in their homes. We should do the same for Americans purchasing appliances and computers and for that matter, new air-conditioner and heating units.
8794.name: Harold Ford

8795.quote: While the recent addition of the National Guard providing a support role manning computers and cameras has allowed more Border Patrol agents to work the field, more agents are still needed.
8795.name: Timothy Murphy

8796.quote: Comic books aren't nerdy. You'd have to be an idiot to think computers are nerdy.
8796.name: Adam Brody

8797.quote: We've been working now with computers and education for 30 years, computers in developing countries for 20 years, and trying to make low-cost machines for 10 years. This is not a sudden turn down the road.
8797.name: Nicholas Negroponte

8798.quote: My e-mail address is actually my wife's e-mail address. I actually hate computers.
8798.name: Joe Sakic

8799.quote: People are craving this great progress in electronics, going after computers, the Internet, etc. It's a giant progress technologically. But they must have a balance of soul, a balance for human beauty. That means art has an important role.
8799.name: Mstislav Rostropovich

8800.quote: Computers are scary. They're nightmares to fix, lose our stuff, and, on occasion, they crash, producing the blue screen of death. Steve Jobs knew this. He knew that computers were bulky and hernia-inducing and Darth Vader black. He understood the value of declarative design.
8800.name: Wesley Morris

8801.quote: I like computers. I like the Internet. It's a tool that can be used. But don't be misled into thinking that these technologies are anything other than aspects of a degenerate economic system.
8801.name: Jerry Brown

8802.quote: And it's here and it's ready and we can really revolutionize the way we educate our children with tablet computers, and I'm committed to doing whatever I can to speaking to whomever I can to send this signal - to pound this message home. Now is the time.
8802.name: LeVar Burton

8803.quote: I don't look at computers as opponents. For me it is much more interesting to beat humans.
8803.name: Magnus Carlsen

8804.quote: I've never been much of a computer guy at least in terms of playing with computers. Actually until I was about 11 I didn't use a computer for preparing for games at all. I was playing a bit online, was using the chess club mainly. Now, obviously, the computer is an important tool for me preparing for my games.
8804.name: Magnus Carlsen

8805.quote: Well, the big products in electronics in the '50s were radio and television. The first big computers were just beginning to come in and represented the most logical market for us to work in.
8805.name: Jack Kilby

8806.quote: Eventually, I believe, current attempts to understand the mind by analogy with man-made computers that can perform superbly some of the same external tasks as conscious beings will be recognized as a gigantic waste of time.
8806.name: Thomas Nagel

8807.quote: It is an interesting fact that during my tour I was never allowed access to computers, radios, or anything else that I might damage through curiosity, or perhaps something more sinister.
8807.name: Robert B. Laughlin

8808.quote: Video games and computers have become babysitters for kids.
8808.name: Taylor Kitsch

8809.quote: People are on their computers more than watching TV, because you can only watch voyeur TV, which is basically what reality shows are, for so long.
8809.name: Stephen Root

8810.quote: After a semester or so, my infatuation with computers burnt out as quickly as it had begun.
8810.name: Eric Allin Cornell

8811.quote: If I was designing a web site for elementary school children, I might have a much higher percentage of older computers with outdated browsers since keeping up with browser and hardware technology has not traditionally been a strong point of most elementary schools.
8811.name: Mike Davidson

8812.quote: I have three brothers and they're all into computers. They're all intellects. My mother would pay me a quarter a page to read a book and I couldn't make 50 cents. I just couldn't do it.
8812.name: Josh Holloway

8813.quote: I am cursed with computers something always goes wrong.
8813.name: Carla Bruni

8814.quote: Kids are finding out about the potential for discovery online from other sources many of them have computers at home, for instance, or their friends have them.
8814.name: Daniel Greenberg

8815.quote: I realized that I loved using computers to create something, but being an architect just wasn't going to keep me interested. The idea of a life spent obsessing over bathroom details for an Upper East Side penthouse was pretty depressing.
8815.name: Joseph Kosinski

8816.quote: Computers are hierarchical. We have a desktop and hierarchical files which have to mean everything.
8816.name: Ted Nelson

8817.quote: They were saying computers deal with numbers. This was absolutely nonsense. Computers deal with arbitrary information of any kind.
8817.name: Ted Nelson

8818.quote: Nowadays shots are created in post-production, on computers. It's not really photography.
8818.name: Mary Ellen Mark

8819.quote: People don't understand computers. Computers are magical boxes that do things. People believe what computers tell them.
8819.name: Bruce Schneier

8820.quote: So a more sensible thing it seemed to me was to go to Silicon Valley and be pushing on the technology companies to accelerate the use of audio and music in computers.
8820.name: Thomas Dolby

8821.quote: Interactive computers and software will, I think, provide a less costly method of doing some kinds of inquiry, in knowledge acquisition and even reasoning and interaction.
8821.name: Roy Romer

8822.quote: We all grew up, our grandmothers and mothers had about three channels to watch, so we watched those soaps and now, a generation has grown up with the Internet and computers and video games.
8822.name: Jack Wagner

8823.quote: We can just assume they have much more and powerful, more advanced technology, all the new computers, everything could be much more easier and help them to build much more and many more nuclear weapons.
8823.name: Mordechai Vanunu

8824.quote: Well, my wife always says to me, and I think it's true, it's very difficult for us to understand the Elizabethan understanding and enjoyment and perception of form as it is to say, it would be for them to understand computers or going to the moon or something.
8824.name: Mark Rylance

8825.quote: Diaspora starts about a thousand years from now. Most of human civilisation has moved inside computers essentially, a major branch of our descendants consists of conscious software.
8825.name: Greg Egan

8826.quote: Obviously, our children, who have been playing with their computers since the age of five or six, don't have quite the same brain as those who were brought up on wooden or metal toys, whose brains are certainly atrophied by comparison.
8826.name: Claude Vorilhon

8827.quote: When I was in Japan on tour in 2010, I felt like I was 30 years into the future. I love technology and they are so advanced with their phones, computers, everything. I think they had the iPhone way before we did in the U.S. I love gadgets, games, social media and I try to stay ahead on all that stuff, but they get it all first.
8827.name: Soulja Boy

8828.quote: Smartphones can relay patients' data to hospital computers in a continuous stream. Doctors can alter treatment regimens remotely, instead of making patients come in for a visit.
8828.name: Charles C. Mann

8829.quote: A smartphone links patients' bodies and doctors' computers, which in turn are connected to the Internet, which in turn is connected to any smartphone anywhere.
