8993.quote: It's really cool when a guy tips 20 per cent quickly and effortlessly so that when the check comes, he opens it and signs his name and done.
8993.name: Danica McKellar

8994.quote: Every night I fell asleep to a different Beatles album. So I'm very familiar with the Beatles Ringo was my favorite Beatle until I grew up and then changed. I made the switch over to George Harrison just in time to regain my cool.
8994.name: Christina Ricci

8995.quote: I want Maggie Gyllenhaal. I don't know why. I don't think she necessarily looks like me or acts like me, I just think she's a cool actress and she could play me, so there you go.
8995.name: Diablo Cody

8996.quote: Oh, my God, this amazing cool breeze is coming through my window and the sun is shining. I'm happy.
8996.name: Liv Tyler

8997.quote: The cool kindliness of sheets, that soon smooth away trouble and the rough male kiss of blankets.
8997.name: Rupert Brooke

8998.quote: I'm not a movie star. People know me, but they don't necessarily know what they know me for. I get recognised, but it's not like Justin Bieber. It's a nice thing, people are cool.
8998.name: Jr. Harry Connick

8999.quote: I really, specifically, love acting, and I think it's a really cool thing to be really indulgent and follow that. I have a lot of ambitions in life, but for the next few years, I just want to be an actor.
8999.name: Kristen Stewart

9000.quote: It's interesting to feel the pressure of having to be outgoing, because I think in general, as a human being, I'm pessimistic and introverted. But, it's cool, because it's a whole different side of me, and I impress myself. Even at times when I think that there's no possible way that I can be engaging, I'll suddenly pull it out and impress myself.
9000.name: Nate Ruess

9001.quote: Part of Obama's persona is self-reliance. He's calm he's cool he's self-possessed. In many ways, he has tried to define himself in opposition to Clinton's sometimes needy, often undisciplined, emotionalism.
9001.name: Dee Dee Myers

9002.quote: Obama has made America cool again - and more than that, he's made his own brand arguably the most powerful the world has ever known.
9002.name: Dee Dee Myers

9004.quote: When I was kid, I remember playing 'Vogue' by Madonna over and over and over again. And ah, you know, something about the beat was really cool, and Madonna, visually, was on TV all the time and I thought she was just so beautiful.
9004.name: Adam Lambert

9005.quote: You have to watch all sides of your advancement, you have to make sure people's bodies and minds are healthy and their morale is cool before you can really go out and play great music.
9005.name: Shirley Manson

9006.quote: It's not cool to be an alcoholic.
9006.name: Chester Bennington

9007.quote: Manners are love in a cool climate.
9007.name: Quentin Crisp

9008.quote: Maybe that first, gigantic deficit the Reaganites piled up was an accident, just a combination of deluded 'supply side' tax cuts and a huge bag of good stuff for the Pentagon. But pretty quickly conservatives discovered that deficits, when done correctly, did something really cool: deficits defunded the Left.
9008.name: Thomas Frank

9009.quote: Acknowledging class was always difficult for 'New Democrats' - it was second-wave, it was divisive - but 2008 made retro politics cool again.
9009.name: Thomas Frank

9010.quote: If you do a trick and it doesn't work out, that can stick with you. I like to go back, nail the trick, and, 'OK, I'm cool, it's all good.'
9010.name: Shaun White

9011.quote: What drives me now is the fact that I feel like I still have so many tricks that I want to learn and so many things that I can still do. And so many cool things outside of sports that I have been doing.
9011.name: Shaun White

9012.quote: I mean, I get letters in the mail because I had a heart defect when I was one, I had surgeries and stuff. And so you get these letters in the mail that just, they are crazy, they are just like, yes, well our son is dealing with the same thing and we saw you on TV and I mean it is such a cool thing to inspire and kind of give hope.
9012.name: Shaun White

9013.quote: An orange on the table, your dress on the rug, and you in my bed, sweet present of the present, cool of night, warmth of my life.
9013.name: Jacques Prevert

9014.quote: My parents are the coolest of the cool on every single level, and it's because they have a deep appreciation for every moment of their lives.
9014.name: Rashida Jones

9015.quote: In early high school years, I was pretty chubby, and I spent a lot of time on my computer, before it was cool to have a computer - because there was a time that was true. So that's where I developed my personality.
9015.name: Rashida Jones

9016.quote: I'm friends with a lot of my exes, but it took time. We didn't just get into it. I don't think you can be friends until you're cool with them dating someone else. That's when you know.
9016.name: Rashida Jones

9017.quote: A lot of pop people out there are cool, but they overdo it.
9017.name: Norah Jones

9018.quote: The pop world is cool, but I never really thought of myself as part of it or wanting to be a part of it because I'm on a label that's not really like that. They're not trying to dress me up, they're not trying to do things like that. I feel like I'm sort of separate from that, actually.
9018.name: Norah Jones

9019.quote: I could do without 'cool' publications calling me 'mom jazz.' But I laughed all the way to the bank, baby.
9019.name: Norah Jones

9020.quote: When I entered high school I was an A-student, but not for long. I wanted the fancy clothes. I wanted to hang out with the guys. I went from being an A-student to a B-student to a C-student, but I didn't care. I was getting the high fives and the low fives and the pats on the back. I was cool.
9020.name: Benjamin Carson

9021.quote: I'm a sappy mom now. I didn't think I would be. I thought I'd be a cool mom who keeps everything in perspective.
9021.name: Katherine Heigl

9022.quote: My uncle's a lawyer and I remember going to see him in court and thinking, 'That's cool, too bad I could never be a lawyer.'
9022.name: Lena Dunham

9023.quote: I remember once acting really cool on a bus with this girl named Stephanie. When I got home, I realized that I had a really big zit on my forehead. If you have acne problems, you really shouldn't be acting like Don Juan.
9023.name: John Cusack

9024.quote: I used to be a cool chick but I'm not anymore.
9024.name: Britney Spears

9025.quote: In the Lamborghini I have to avoid certain roads because of pot holes, and there's nowhere to put my drink, no cup holder. And I'm not going to lie, it looks pretentious. I used to think it was cool to, like, drive it to dinner. Now? Like I really need to be looked at any more.
9025.name: Danica Patrick

9026.quote: Long intros are cool because there's a little bit of anticipation, you know?
9026.name: Miranda Lambert

9027.quote: As a kid, I did want to be an old-timer, since they were the ones with the big stories and the cool clothes. I wanted to go there. Now, I guess I want to bring that with me and go back in time.
9027.name: Tom Waits

9028.quote: My parents used to throw great New Year's Eve parties. They invited such an eclectic mix of showbiz people. All those cool people were always hanging out at our apartment.
9028.name: Ben Stiller

9029.quote: And we have a little herb garden, which survived the winter thanks to global warming. It makes me feel like a cool, old Italian housewife, that I kept my rosemary alive outside all winter.
9029.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

9030.quote: It was a very cool thing to be a smart girl, as opposed to some other, different kind. And I think that made a great deal of difference to me growing up and in my life afterward.
9030.name: Elena Kagan

9031.quote: Cynicism is kind of like folding your arms and stepping back and commenting on things, like the old guys in 'The Muppets,' just throwing out comments all the time, whereas there are other people on the ground really trying to affect things and improve their lives and the lives of other people. I think it's noble and I think it's cool.
9031.name: Josh Radnor

9032.quote: I haven't left the house without a packet of Kleenex in my back pocket for as long as I can remember. Whenever I start thinking I'm incredibly cool, the packet of Kleenex in my back pocket brings me right back down to earth.
9032.name: Josh Radnor

9033.quote: And of course I've got kids of my own now, and they love me being in the Harry Potter films. I'm now part of a phenomenon. You become incredibly cool to your kids, and you get a young fan base. So you became the cool dad at school. You're suddenly hip.
9033.name: Gary Oldman

9034.quote: There aren't many poster children for cool angst. Everybody thinks it's cool if you're the bad girl.
9034.name: Fiona Apple

9035.quote: For the last few years, it's been so chic for everybody to be miserable. Like if you're in with the cool crowd, you can't be happy.
9035.name: Lenny Kravitz

9036.quote: Now I'm way into suits that I can put on whether I took a shower or not, and wear barefoot and paint my toes black or whatever color the suit is. It's very cool to wear suits like that. Roll up the sleeves and just say yee-haw.
9036.name: Steven Tyler

9037.quote: How serious can a movie about time-traveling robots be? You want it to be cool and fun.
9037.name: Christian Bale

9038.quote: I did find some time to go to a record store and check out 'Headstrong' actually in the racks. It was pretty cool I never thought I'd see my own CD sitting there with everyone else's. I made my Mom take lots of pics!
9038.name: Ashley Tisdale

9039.quote: All I know about thermal pollution is that if we continue our present rate of growth in electrical energy consumption it will simply take, by the year 2000, all our freshwater streams to cool the generators and reactors.
9039.name: David R. Brower

9040.quote: I haven't took no punishment. There's nothing cool about taking punishment.
9040.name: Jr. Floyd Mayweather

9041.quote: Australia is so cool that it's hard to even know where to start describing it. The beaches are beautiful so is the weather. Not too crowded. Great food, great music, really nice people. It must be a lot like Los Angeles was many years ago.
9041.name: Mary-Kate Olsen

9043.quote: I don't wanna abandon my identity as LL Cool J, but at the same time, I had to figure out how to let people know that I'm really serious about making these movies.
9043.name: LL Cool J

9044.quote: What is more important than the name is that people know that I really like acting, I enjoy it and I want people to know that I am serious. The name thing: I will always be L.L. Cool J.
9044.name: LL Cool J

9045.quote: I'm taking a lot of my favorite artists, different people, my favorite music and marrying that with what I do as a comic. It's very collaborative, arty, fun and cool.
9045.name: Margaret Cho

9046.quote: The problem to me is violence. It's not cool to kill somebody or hurt people.
9046.name: Mark Ruffalo

9047.quote: When you're a kid, you see your parents reading the newspaper and you're like, 'God, why are they reading the newspaper?' When you're young, you're not reading the newspaper. But there comes a time in your life when the newspaper's cool.
9047.name: Fred Durst

9048.quote: Come Christmas Eve, we usually go to my mom and dad's. Everybody brings one gift and then we play that game when we all steal it from each other. Some are really cool, others are useful and some are a bit out there.
9048.name: Amy Grant

9049.quote: Tweeting is like sending out cool telegrams to your friends once a week.
9049.name: Tom Hanks

9050.quote: I'm obsessed with the 1920s, everything from the style to the lifestyle. It was a really cool era.
9050.name: Lauren Conrad

9051.quote: These days it's cool to be ethnic and to be different, but when I was a kid, it was not cool - at all. My friends would come over and my mom would make crepes with eggs, stuffed with mozzarella cheese, tomatoes and spinach. And they'd be like, 'What is this?'
9051.name: Giada De Laurentiis

9052.quote: I think a lot of young kids at school are very conscious of trying to keep credibility in case they kind of stand out in a crowd and get bullied by trying to stay cool and stuff. And my whole thing, all the way through school, was I was just a goof, I didn't care.
9052.name: Dominic Monaghan

9053.quote: Orlando's a really cool guy. They hired him for 'Lord of the Rings' out of drama school. He's very new at this still and doesn't have a lot of experience. So we were in this together and we've tried to help each other out. We felt very equal which was good.
9053.name: Diane Kruger

9054.quote: I have a kind of boring personal life, to the paparazzi anyway, and I don't hang with the cool crowd.
9054.name: Diane Kruger

9055.quote: Justin Timberlake is everything, and what more could you want in a person? He's funny. He's cute. He's great. He just understands. I get him and he gets me, and that's cool.
9055.name: Britney Spears

9056.quote: Survival, in the cool economics of biology, means simply the persistence of one's own genes in the generations to follow.
9056.name: Lewis Thomas

9057.quote: I've always been scared of advertising folk. I've met them at parties and I've been to their offices and I've always found them intimidatingly cool. At one company I visited, they held their meetings in a caravan that had somehow been installed in the place, a rather more exotic place to gather than the typical BBC glass box.
9057.name: Evan Davis

9058.quote: I was trying to break out of the suburbs, and when I did break out, I don't think I took my whole self with me - I think I played a role of being too cool and hip.
9058.name: Liz Phair

9060.quote: I wondered how they would top the Pirates and skeletons and moonlight, because that's a pretty cool concept.
9060.name: Orlando Bloom

9061.quote: I'm trying to mix the cool, independent stuff with the big stuff, but it's been difficult finding the right roles. It's been an interesting ride as far as my career pendulum is concerned.
9061.name: Orlando Bloom

9062.quote: The truth is - I found myself doing these huge action-adventure movies, and um, and which are cool man. And I really love doing them. And thankfully I haven't had too much dialogue, because if I had I would have really made a mess of it. You know what I mean?
9062.name: Orlando Bloom

9063.quote: It's hard to encapsulate my inspiration because there are so many different looks, but I think it's just like, sexy girl you see walking down the street in a cool outfit. A lot of eyelet, a lot of leather, playing with the hard and the soft, the good and bad inside of us all.
9063.name: Chloe Sevigny

9065.quote: I'm finding, as I get older, that I'm not much of a believer in redemption. I mean, I believe in redemption in real life - redemption does happen, and it's cool when it does - but I find myself getting leery of my desire for it in stories (especially my own).
9065.name: George Saunders

9066.quote: The cool parts - the parts that have won Dubai its reputation as 'the Vegas of the Middle East' or 'the Venice of the Middle East' or 'the Disney World of the Middle East, if Disney World were the size of San Francisco and out in a desert' - have been built in the last ten years.
9066.name: George Saunders

9067.quote: It's cool to be a part of recovery. This is just who I am, this is what I write about, what I do, and most of my work has been a reflection of what I've been going through in one way or another.
9067.name: Chester Bennington

9068.quote: I read the script for Wonder Boys, and I said that was almost perfect, it was so classy, cool and funny. It's a really specific thing. We stuck to it, it turned out good and a lot of people liked it.
9068.name: Jr. Robert Downey

9069.quote: Yeah, my dream would be to work for 6 months and then have 6 months to play, just snowboarding, surfing, and going to cool places to listen and be alone and kinda chill out.
9069.name: Marc Newson

9070.quote: I would like to do a musical, if I could find a cool one. A song-and-dance role is closer to me personally than other characters I play.
9070.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

9071.quote: I used to love to draw. I didn't want to go to art class because I felt that would be too corny when I was young, but architectural drafting was the cool thing to do because there was more precision. It taught me a lot about building and structures and doorways and frames and windowsills.
9071.name: Ice Cube

9072.quote: In the summer I wear shorts with a bright top and ankle boots or just sandals. I'll add a nice scarf, maybe a hat, some cool sunglasses. It's all about the accessories.
9072.name: Alessandra Ambrosio

9073.quote: Look at Scottish guys wearing kilts - you could look at them and laugh, but the way they carry themselves, how can you? You can wear some of the weirdest things and be cool. If you believe in it, that's what makes it cool.
9073.name: Andre Benjamin

9074.quote: If I wasn't even famous or had any success, I would still wake up and put tons of make-up on, and put on a cool outfit. That's always been who I've been my whole life, so that's never gonna change. I love fashion. I love getting dressed up. I love Halloween, too.
9074.name: Gwen Stefani

9075.quote: Hip-hop is still cool at a party. But to me, hip-hop has never been strictly a party it is also there to elevate consciousness.
9075.name: Saul Williams

9076.quote: But when you're a working actor - and that's what you keep saying in your head, how blessed you are to have a job - and you are working with heavyweights, working with the best guys in TV, it's pretty cool. Exhausting, but cool.
9076.name: Christopher Meloni

9077.quote: It is a weird feeling to have people go, 'Hey Chris' like they know me. But, number one, 99 percent of my experiences have been really cool. People couldn't be nicer and more positive.
9077.name: Christopher Meloni

9078.quote: I'd love to date somebody cool, fun, funny.
9078.name: Rihanna

9079.quote: The second I met Zac, I thought he was a really cool guy. It's hard not to have chemistry with someone who is so attractive.
9079.name: Vanessa Hudgens

9080.quote: You can be cool and at the same time respect your woman, who will hopefully become your wife, who will hopefully become the mother of your kids. America needs to get back to family values.
9080.name: Martin Lawrence

9081.quote: I think I'm drawn to more villain-type characters, because it's so cool to get to say all the things you want to say. In Hollywood, you get to this position where you have to bite your tongue so much. You take all your experiences of not being able to say what you really want to say, and channel that through your character.
9081.name: Gabrielle Union

9082.quote: Being cool, having a 'cool' energy is just not attractive to me.
9082.name: Selena Gomez

9083.quote: No matter how good you are, at some point your kids are gonna have to create their own independence and think that Mom and Dad aren't cool, just to establish themselves. That's what adolescence is about. They're gonna go through that no matter what.
9083.name: Eddie Vedder

9084.quote: The ballplayer who loses his head, who can't keep his cool, is worse than no ballplayer at all.
9084.name: Lou Gehrig

9085.quote: I know what it feels like to have the door slammed firmly in my face, so I'm cool with that.
9085.name: Mos Def

9086.quote: I am surprised by how not-adopted the video reply has been. What keeps other people from doing it, I think, is that they think a video comes across as 'I'm cool, look at how many e-mails I get.' That perception doesn't scare me, because I know who I am.
9086.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

9087.quote: People are more comfortable learning about wine because now they can just Google, you know, 'Soave,' and say, 'Oh, O.K., cool.'
9087.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

9088.quote: In my teens, I was never part of the cool crowd.
9088.name: Jennifer Garner

9089.quote: For most of my life, I've thought of myself as pretty cool.
9089.name: Nikki Giovanni

9090.quote: When Brian told me he grew up in New Mexico, I told him I thought it is cool that people from other countries play football. He corrected me on my geography and agreed to sit down with me anyway.
9090.name: Terry Bradshaw

9091.quote: Personally, I was never the cool kid. I was always sort of a bookworm. I would just like to be more like Troy, because he's so cool.
9091.name: Zac Efron

9092.quote: Personally, I was never the cool kid. I was always sort of a bookworm.
9092.name: Zac Efron

9093.quote: Spider-Man's probably my favorite. You see, Batman is a billionaire and there's nothing really cool about a billionaire saving the world. But Spider-Man is Peter Parker, a conflicted character who puts on a suit and saves the world. I love that.
9093.name: Zac Efron

9094.quote: Yeah, I get to fight in 'Eclipse.' My trainer is teaching me MMA right now. So. Cool.
9094.name: Ashley Greene

9095.quote: My parents are pretty cool people.
9095.name: Dominic Monaghan

9096.quote: The term 'geek' for me is like you having a passion, interest in something that is unabashed and you don't care if people think it's not cool. You think it's cool and that's your thing.
9096.name: Dominic Monaghan

9097.quote: I am an unconventional beauty. I grew up in a high school where if you didn't have a nose job and money and if you weren't thin, you weren't cool, popular, beautiful. I was always told that I wasn't pretty enough to be on television.
9097.name: Lea Michele

9098.quote: But my main thing that I would love to see as a fan of 'Glee,' like I said, is to really get into the character and who they are and what they do outside of school. I think that that's interesting. And then of course the themed stuff and the album episodes are all really cool too.
9098.name: Lea Michele

9099.quote: I was in choir in school. I kind of just did it. I already knew I wanted to sing. My music program in my school wasn't really great - people didn't really want to be part of the choir, they didn't want to do the plays and stuff like that. It definitely wasn't the cool thing to do.
9099.name: Lea Michele

9100.quote: I really felt like I finally made it. Having your first fake pregnancy rumor. It was really awesome. I feel like it's part of what happens in this business, but that's a real one. That's a cool one to get.
9100.name: Lea Michele

9101.quote: I want to be a cool mom.
9101.name: Tori Spelling

9102.quote: I was never considered cool throughout my teens: a very important time to be accepted by someone, especially your peers. Yes, I had all the screaming women, but the guys hated my guts.
9102.name: Donny Osmond

9103.quote: Maybe I am a little bit guilty of trying to convince myself that I am cool to this point - even today. But I am so much more healthy than I used to be in my twenties, because I was not accepted at all.
9103.name: Donny Osmond

9104.quote: It's cool to play a vampire and be a part of this new, hot genre.
9104.name: Josh Hutcherson

9105.quote: When you get to play a character that's in love, it's cool.
9105.name: Josh Hutcherson

9106.quote: I've never believed in singing about Satan and thinking he's cool, because he's not.
9106.name: Dave Mustaine

9107.quote: Both conservatives and liberals watch 'Parks and Recreation,' and they each think the show is for them, which is really cool. 'SNL' was totally different. It was exciting because everyone was paying attention. Political humor works when people know what you're talking about.
9107.name: Amy Poehler

9108.quote: There's a lot of gimmick infringement out there, but that's cool. It's a compliment. But it all started right when I first came into the Garden. I came down to 'Eye of the Tiger' and when I hit the ring with the Sheik, I just put my hand up to my ear by accident, and the crowd got louder. I was like 'Oh, that works.'
9108.name: Hulk Hogan

9109.quote: All of a sudden, Hulk Hogan has become retro. Hulk Hogan has become cool again. So to come out and to hear how loud the fans are. To hear how loyal the fans are, it's truly overwhelming. I just can't believe I've been reborn in the WWE.
9109.name: Hulk Hogan

9110.quote: My definition of cool is finding your own definition of cool and not necessarily taking your lead from what other people tell you or from what you might read from magazines or see on TV.
9110.name: Wentworth Miller

9111.quote: I got tired of the Ramones around the time I quit and I really got into rap. I thought it was the new punk rock. LL Cool J was my biggest idol.
9111.name: Dee Dee Ramone

9112.quote: Everything that's cool that happens, I look at my wife and I say, 'We need to enjoy this moment right here! This is really special!'
9112.name: Joe Nichols

9113.quote: In my mind, as long as I did what was right for me, I was cool. But that's not the way it works. You have to think about other people and take their feelings into account.
9113.name: Joe Nichols

9114.quote: There's been a lot of really cool stuff that's happened to me throughout my career, and I remember everything, but I don't think I savored every moment of it like I should have or like I do now.
9114.name: Joe Nichols

9115.quote: Americans are cool if you show just a chink of vulnerability, they respond so much. They'll pat you on the arm and say, 'Hey kid, you're all right.' Brits will respond but they are much more cynical.
9115.name: Bear Grylls

9116.quote: I'm blessed to have cool roles in these big movies.
9116.name: Jeremy Renner

9117.quote: I mean, there are some amazing storytelling being done on the small screen right now. That's what so cool about being in television right now. Studios, networks are starting to throw more resources, better writers, more production values, and to be part of that is awesome.
9117.name: Ian Somerhalder

9118.quote: I've helped create over 400 jobs in the worst economy of my lifetime. That's cool.
9118.name: Curt Schilling

9119.quote: My whole thing is that I want to explore why you read books, what's the purpose of reading, and maybe that it's not that cool to hate something just because it's popular.
9119.name: Josh Radnor

9120.quote: The thing that's cool about the recording booth is that it's so perfunctory, so cut-to-the-chase.
9120.name: Ron Perlman

9121.quote: I really wanted to do something positive on the Internet. I wanted to try to get young people talking about, thinking about, life's big questions-make it cool and OK to wonder about the heart, the soul and free will and God and death and big topics like that, big human topics.
9121.name: Rainn Wilson

9122.quote: Vince Vaughn is a genuine person, awesome guy. He'll come to a lot of my shows. It's not that often that you can meet someone as cool as Vince.
9122.name: Dane Cook

9123.quote: It's cool to express myself, but I've had to learn that doing interviews isn't completely therapy - spilling everything about yourself isn't healthy all the time. But I've been through things that have made me a stronger person, and if I can help some people, I will.
9123.name: Fergie

9124.quote: My parents were really, really cool about supporting what I wanted to do at a really young age. I think I was about 10 when I caught the bug. They would drive me down to New York if there were auditions. When I was 12, I did this show on Broadway called 'High Society,' so we moved to New York for the run of that.
9124.name: Anna Kendrick

9125.quote: More and more, Democrats are starting to worry they that they have a more um, colorful version of Jimmy Carter on their hands. Obama acts cool as a proverbial cucumber but that awful '70s show seems frightfully close to a rerun.
9125.name: Eric Alterman

9126.quote: I've noticed that once you leave London you do kind of become a bit more famous. People in London are a bit too cool for school. It's not so unusual to see someone from London in the street. But outside of London people are a bit more excited to see you and come out and support you.
9126.name: David Walliams

9127.quote: That was excellent! I mean, it didn't do anything, but it looked really cool!
9127.name: Adam Savage

9128.quote: I always hated high-school shows and high-school movies, because they were always about the cool kids. It was always about dating and sex, and all the popular kids, and the good-looking kids. And the nerds were super-nerdy cartoons, with tape on their glasses. I never saw 'my people' portrayed accurately.
9128.name: Paul Feig

9129.quote: It's healthy to have older friends. You go, 'Look, I'm younger than them!' That's always the nice thing, if you can be the youngest one in the room at times. Like if you're always the oldest one in the room, you'll start to feel like the oldest person in the world. So get older friends, because they're cool. Get cool older friends.
9129.name: Paul Feig

9130.quote: Period costume films are fun to discover, but they're not relatable. It's more, 'Wow, that's cool - did it really look like that back then?' Whereas with a comedy, you're like, 'Yeah, that's me, that's my friends.' No matter what, I want people to relate.
9130.name: Paul Feig

9131.quote: As tempting as it seems to wear tennis shoes with your tux, don't do it. I think it looks ridiculous. If you're 14 years old, maybe give it a shot. In general, don't portray anything that says 'I'm too cool and I don't care.'
9131.name: Paul Feig

9132.quote: Most of an award-show host's job is showing up and keeping a cool head and soldiering through it, whether it's the Oscars or the Hallmark Channel's 'Hero Dog Awards.'
9132.name: Rob Sheffield

9133.quote: Big Star invented a vision of bohemian rock &amp roll cool that had nothing to do with New York, Los Angeles or London, which made them completely out of style in the 1970s, but also made them an inspiration to generations of weird Southern kids.
9133.name: Rob Sheffield

9134.quote: I love Poseidon. His trident - his weapon - is really cool.
9134.name: Kellan Lutz

9135.quote: Hats off to starting a franchise younger than we all did in 'Twilight' and keeping your cool. The 'Harry Potter' men and women had, what, a 10-year run?
9135.name: Kellan Lutz

9136.quote: Even in high school, I had friends that I didn't know were gay until years later. I'd find out on Facebook or something and be like, 'Oh, that explains some things,' or 'Wow, no wonder they were so cool.'
9136.name: Kellan Lutz

9137.quote: It's interesting because a lot of my 16-year-old kids' friends know me from 'Wedding Crashers,' and not so much Bond. My kids have a good laugh. I was 20 then. The look I had then was the look that a lot of their friends are assuming now. They think it's cool. What goes around comes around.
9137.name: Jane Seymour

9138.quote: I think you have to be cool to be a good flirt, and I don't think I'm very cool.
9138.name: Harry Styles

9139.quote: When I see my staff take a step back because I've lost my cool about something food-related, I say never apologise for your standards. If someone doesn't meet them, then you should explain that and that you want it changed. I want my staff to be like that, too.
9139.name: Curtis Stone

9140.quote: I got a chance to have my dream come true, and I wanted to make sure I made the decision as to when I dropped my last album. If I don't feel like this album is an incredible piece of work, then I'm cool with the albums I've done. I don't have to put out another album.
9140.name: Puff Daddy

9141.quote: Basically, after an ABC sitcom I did, I ended up with a holding deal with 20th Century Fox. Absolutely cool. It pays you to be unemployed. And the bigger the entity that gives you the deal, the better.
9141.name: Nathan Fillion

9142.quote: I'm constantly pitching one episode where we see life through Castle's eyes. I think Castle's just a little off as far as his perception goes. A very, very clever man, but I want to see the world as Castle sees it - kind of a rose-colored glasses, all the women find him irresistible, all the guys find him super cool and do whatever he says.
9142.name: Nathan Fillion

9143.quote: I'm comfortable only when there's a mutual attraction. That's what anyone wants. If I find out she's not attracted to me, it brings down my level of attraction to her. If I'm interested and find out she's not, I tend to cool off.
9143.name: Nathan Fillion

9144.quote: I think my printing to this day looks like the printing right out of a comic book. Actually, I always wanted to be in a comic book. I watched cartoons when I was a kid, too, and both comics and cartoons lit fire in my imagination. This realm holds a lot of interest for me, a lot of passion for me. So to be comic-ized, yeah, that's cool.
9144.name: Nathan Fillion

9145.quote: I remember my first test in F1. After five laps, I came back to the pits and tried to play it cool - 'Oh yeah, I'm fine, I'm on top of this' - but I was completely lost.
9145.name: Sebastian Vettel

9146.quote: That's the hardest thing about being a mom. You want to be cool, and you want them to like you all the time, but you can't always have that. You're gonna have times where you have to say no, and you won't be the most popular person in the house.
9146.name: Martina McBride

9147.quote: Traveling to Russia and Germany and being able to see the world at a young age was really cool for me, and I really liked that.
9147.name: Mia Wasikowska

9148.quote: Music is music, ultimately. If it makes you feel good, cool.
9148.name: Prince

9149.quote: Me and my dad are friends. We're cool. I'll never be disappointed again, because I don't expect anything anymore from him. I just let him exist, and that's how we get along.
9149.name: Drake

9150.quote: At the age of 11 I was about 6 ft. tall and my voice had completely broken. That caused problems. I was this gangly, spotty, very unattractive kid. I wasn't cool and I wasn't a nerd. I didn't even want to fit in with anyone.
9150.name: Dan Stevens

9151.quote: When I left Europe in 1987 I did so with the thought that my relevance as a composition teacher would benefit from a certain cool distance to certain tendencies I had been observing for several years with increasing disquiet.
9151.name: Brian Ferneyhough

9152.quote: I like cool jackets - a nice fall or winter coat. You can get a lot of use out of it, and you'll wear it frequently, so it can really set the tone of your uniform for the season.
9152.name: John Legend

9153.quote: Our career is a dream. I mean, we get to act, travel around the world, and meet cool people. What's not to love!
9153.name: Mary-Kate Olsen

9154.quote: Edie Sedgwick had a cool style she pushed the envelope for the time.
9154.name: Taylor Momsen

9155.quote: The thing people don't understand is that touring or travelling or whatever you do in my position means you go to all these cool places all over the world, but you see everything from a car window. You don't get to see much of the city or meet people at all.
9155.name: Taylor Momsen

9156.quote: My legs are really long and that's cool apparently, but I'm totally klutzy. I mean, I'm like Bambi. I fall all over myself because I can't control my arms and my really long legs.
9156.name: Taylor Momsen

9157.quote: Well, a sort of epiphany: I was in a great band. And it's very cool to be at 53 and realise that when you were a kid you were in a great band.
9157.name: Bob Geldof

9158.quote: It's the same with visual arts, you have some really cool, wonderful striking images that make you think and then again you have wonderful striking images that just take you away from the existing world for a second. And I like the latter a bit more.
9158.name: Ville Valo

9159.quote: We aren't cool and never will be.
9159.name: Chris Martin

9160.quote: My family moved - first to Washington, D.C., and then, in the spring of 1975, to Lebanon, where my father worked as a diplomat at the American embassy. My parents were enthusiastic about the move, so my older brother and I felt like we were off to some place kind of cool.
9160.name: Greg Kinnear

9161.quote: Playing and singing at the same time is pretty cool, but sometimes it's difficult to know when you can just really let go a bit because you've got to get back to bloody microphone and sing some stuff.
9161.name: Graham Coxon

9162.quote: If a musician wants to be an actor, everyone thinks that's pretty cool. But if an actor wants to play a song, even if they've been doing it for 40 years, that's bad news.
9162.name: John Hawkes

9163.quote: Jazz took too much discipline. You have to come in at the right place, which is different than me singing the blues, where I can sing, 'Oh, baby,' if there's a pause in the melody. With jazz, you better leave that space open, or put in something real cool.
9163.name: Etta James

9164.quote: It's always cool to meet people who can do things that you have no capacity to do.
9164.name: Kevin James

9165.quote: I'd like to see a world free of strife, stress, pain, hunger, war - a cool place where everyone could live.
9165.name: Dionne Warwick

9166.quote: It's cool to play a sinister bad guy who also has a human side.
9166.name: Lukas Haas

9167.quote: Sitting at the table during Color Purple and looking up and suddenly realizing I was acting in front of Steven Spielberg, was pretty cool. It was pretty good.
9167.name: Whoopi Goldberg

9168.quote: Growing up, politics never trickled down to the areas we come from. But people from Obama's camp, and Obama himself, reached out to me and asked for my help on the campaign. We've sat and had dinner, and we've spoken on the phone. He's a very sharp guy. Very charming. Very cool.
9168.name: Jay-Z

9169.quote: You make your first album, you make some money, and you feel like you still have to show face, like 'I still go to the projects.' I'm like, why? Your job is to inspire people from your neighborhood to get out. You grew up there. What makes you think it's so cool?
9169.name: Jay-Z

9170.quote: The cool part of being an entertainer is getting the opportunity to get your feet wet in all areas.
9170.name: Paula Abdul

9171.quote: Someone once told me that something they really liked about me was that they thought that I was really down to earth and not high-maintenance. I think that was cool. It's important to stay grounded.
9171.name: Victoria Justice

9172.quote: I think it's really cool how J. Lo's been able to balance an acting career and a music career. That's something I strive for.
9172.name: Victoria Justice

9173.quote: I went to Catholic high school for half a year and religion wasn't the cool thing to talk about even at a catholic high school. It never came up.
9173.name: Mandy Moore

9174.quote: But, on another level it's really sort of this really cool coming of age story, it reminds me of like The Breakfast Club or something like that, if I can be so bold to associate with The Breakfast Club.
9174.name: Will Estes

9175.quote: Having been to Europe and working and traveling there, the restaurants my wife and I remember were always off the beaten trail restaurants. So I tried to seek a little 'off the beaten trail,' but cool area.
9175.name: Todd English

9176.quote: When people recognise me they just kind of go 'Hi how are you,' really kind of cool you know.
9176.name: Rachel Stevens

9177.quote: I love the song 'El Rey.' And for years, I never knew what the song was totally about. It was something new for me. I'd never sung a song in Spanish before. Then I got the translation and saw what a really cool song it was.
9177.name: George Strait

9178.quote: All this stuff is so mind-blowing to me that I get to do in my life. Throwing the first pitch out at the White Sox game on a random Wednesday? Like who am I? How did I get this life? I'm glad I'm not jaded, and little kids are the least jaded people in the entire world, so it's fun to be around people that still find wonder in how cool things are.
9178.name: Jonah Hill

9179.quote: I was terribly shy when I was growing up, I really wasn't confident with other people and I think I was always afraid of up or not being this very cool, amazing person that I wanted to be.
9179.name: Emily Mortimer

9180.quote: 51st State was one that I loved doing because the character was so out there, and in a way I was sad to leave the character behind. I'm afraid I could never be that cool in real life!
9180.name: Emily Mortimer

9181.quote: I'm physically completely mal-coordinated. My best friend used to make me run for the bus just to give herself a quick, cheap laugh because I definitely don't have that sophisticated cool thing down.
9181.name: Emily Mortimer

9182.quote: I was not a good-lookin' girl. I was extremely skinny. I wasn't pretty. I wasn't cool.
9182.name: Celine Dion

9183.quote: It's cool to go to a place that has posters up and it's one night only. It feels more special.
9183.name: Todd Barry

9184.quote: In my hometown there is a pub named after me - The Frome Flyer on Jenson Avenue. How cool is that?!
9184.name: Jenson Button

9185.quote: I was in a really crummy pop-punk band. I think we did a whole bunch of Blink-182 covers, and we were on the fringe of losers and jocks. So we invited all the cool kids to come watch us play in our bass player's brother's bedroom. And it was terrible, but everyone thought we were so cool.
9185.name: Nate Ruess

9186.quote: I think it's really cool, but Jimmy Eat World and Gin Blossoms did it better than anyone. People don't realize just how awesome the Arizona history is, especially for alternative music. Growing up, that's all I ever wanted to be was those two bands.
9186.name: Nate Ruess

9187.quote: I'm a fan of designers and clothes that look beautiful, but more importantly, make me feel beautiful and confident. It's why I've always loved Stella McCartney, and more recently, Prabal Gurung. Their pieces are cool, yet timeless, and the fits are effortlessly flattering.
9187.name: Shay Mitchell

9188.quote: In high school I was an outcast, I wasn't cool to hang out with. I ate my lunch in a bathroom stall because that was the one place I could go where I wouldn't been seen.
9188.name: Shay Mitchell

9189.quote: Most of the time you're too busy to think about it. But every now and then you say, 'I work at 'Saturday Night Live,' and that is so cool.
9189.name: Tina Fey

9190.quote: I wanted to escape Small Town U.S.A. To dismiss the boundaries, to explore. My life experience came from watching movies, TV, and reading books and magazines. When your culture comes from watching TV everyday, you're bombarded with images of things that seem cool, places that seem interesting, people who have jobs and careers and opportunities.
9190.name: Trent Reznor

9191.quote: As an investor, what we're not looking for is 'oh this is a cool app,' it's 'is this something that can become a big business?' You need to find those that can become real businesses.
9191.name: Niklas Zennstrom

9192.quote: I'm a comic book artist. So I think to myself, what do I like to draw? I like to draw hot chicks, fast cars and cool guys in trench coats. So that's what I write about.
9192.name: Frank Miller

9193.quote: I thought Daredevil was kind of cool because he couldn't do anything. I mean, he's blind. It wasn't that he could fly. His major power was an impediment. So I was intrigued. When I took over he was kind of like Spider-Man-lite, but I was able to project a lot of my Catholic imagery onto it. And I'd always wanted to do a crime comic.
9193.name: Frank Miller

9194.quote: But acting is very much a profession that is you're hot one moment and not the next - and that is totally cool. I think that's what I find most fascinating and most exciting about it - is that it can be gone in a puff of smoke.
9194.name: Keira Knightley

9195.quote: Man, I love the 'Lord of the Rings' movies. Some people would say I'm weird for liking those types of movies, but they are so cool.
9195.name: Robert Griffin III

9196.quote: Robert De Niro, It seemed like a pretty cool thing to do to put his name on my resume next.
9196.name: Famke Janssen

9197.quote: I don't count on the boy who waits till October, when it's cool and fun, then decides he wants to play.
9197.name: Darrell Royal

9198.quote: Apparently it's cool to watch The Daily Show.
9198.name: Rob Corddry

9199.quote: That was cool and that sucked all at the same time.
9199.name: Adam Savage

9200.quote: If your album sells, that's cool, more people find out about you, more people get turned on to what we're really about-which is a live rock and roll band.
9200.name: Nikki Sixx

9201.quote: When I look at President Obama, I see a leader with a cool head, a caring heart and an open mind, a president who has demonstrated through his demeanor and through his deeds that he is uniquely qualified to heal our divisions, rebuild our nation and lead us to a brighter future together.
9201.name: Charlie Crist

9202.quote: When the soul drifts uncertainly between life and the dream, between the mind's disorder and the return to cool reflection, it is in religious thought that we should seek consolation.
9202.name: Gerard De Nerval

9203.quote: I represent the kids who come from nothing but who understand it all and love it all. That's what I represent - those are the cool kids, you know, the kids of tomorrow, because who would've known that I'd be who I am today? We are the kids of tomorrow.
9203.name: ASAP Rocky

9204.quote: When I was 24, I was full of life. I was that ham who wanted to be famous, a movie star, all that stuff. I think it's cool. But it was not what I was searching for, really. It was more a delusion.
9204.name: Jean Claude Van Damme

9205.quote: We have newsreaders behaving like actors, lowering their voices if it's a sad story, as if we didn't know it's a sad story. There isn't a single cool newsreader.
9205.name: Tom Baker

9206.quote: Sydney in the 1960s wasn't the exuberant multicultural metropolis it is today. Out in the city's western reaches, days passed in a sun-struck stupor. In the evenings, families gathered on their verandas waiting for the 'southerly buster' - the thunderstorm that would break the heat and leave the air cool enough to allow sleep.
9206.name: Geraldine Brooks

9207.quote: I've had fans come and knock on my door. I'm usually polite, but I'm usually very direct and say, 'It's not cool that you come here uninvited.'
9207.name: Gary Allan

9208.quote: I was a 'Duck Hunt' and 'Mario' guy, and stuff like that. I was never technologically driven. I never had all the cool, new toys. I was the youngest child, I wasn't the only child, so I wasn't spoiled as a kid. And, we were on the farm, so we didn't have a lot. Also, with computers, I'm not very good with them. I just check my email.
9208.name: Garrett Hedlund

9209.quote: What's weird is that I work with these directors and then I start channeling them. I kind of turn into them a bit - which is cool when you're working with Clint Eastwood.
9209.name: Jamie Bell

9210.quote: I think that Obama is very cool. And I think he's clever, and I think he can be witty. But I don't think he's funny in either the way that Reagan was funny - or John McCain and Dick Cheney are both funny in that ruthless, kind of mean way.
9210.name: Mo Rocca

9211.quote: We do this basically for ourselves. People appreciate it, which is cool, but I think they appreciate that we're doing it for ourselves. We're doing it our way, and how people like it is not up to us. We like it.
9211.name: James Hetfield

9212.quote: In Hollywood today, it's cool for guys to wear nail polish and earrings in their lips and tongues. I don't get it.
9212.name: Scott Caan

9213.quote: If only media people would stop reaching for the low-hanging fruit, which is cynicism and pessimism, and stopped trying so hard to be hip and cool and have a swagger.
9213.name: Emilio Estevez

9214.quote: I'm an actor. I try to play a character in a really cool story, the very best I can.
9214.name: Matthew Fox

9215.quote: I wasn't one of the cool kids by any stretch. I just bumbled along really.
9215.name: Matthew Rhys

9216.quote: Well, it's a little harder in New York. It's not as forgiving to a film crew. You hold up a bunch of New Yorkers who can't cross the street, they're not going to take it well. Southern California? They'll wait. It's cool man. In New York, they're like, 'Are you kidding me? I gotta get to work.'
9216.name: Matthew Rhys

9217.quote: When I was younger, the pressure was just being cool. I never thought of myself as a cool guy. I always thought of myself as more of the goofy guy.
9217.name: Paul Walker

9218.quote: I could finally quit my job as a bartender and stop dreaming that I might be Superman and know that I was. Then I started thinking about how cool it was.
9218.name: Brandon Routh

9219.quote: I really love rap music. I grew up in the '80s and '90s with Public Enemy, N.W.A., LL Cool J - I'm a hip-hop encyclopedia. But I got kind of frustrated with the chauvinistic side of rap music, the one that makes it hard to write songs about love and relationships.
9219.name: Mayer Hawthorne

9220.quote: There aren't as many girl superheroes, but there are cool ones. Banshee, for instance.
9220.name: Kat Dennings

9221.quote: I'd love to be an artist that's multifaceted. At the moment, I am not. But wouldn't that be cool if I was like, 'Yeah, let me pull out my guitar and play you a song.' I would adore that. I am so far not gifted in that way. But I am a very hard worker and a very determined person, so who knows?
9221.name: Anne Hathaway

9222.quote: I'm thought of as a cool, unemotional dancer, but inside I'm not.
9222.name: Suzanne Farrell

9223.quote: My sister has three kids so I've spent a lot of time around children and I've always really liked them and wanted my own. It's cool because you think all babies are the same but they aren't at all. They all have such different personalities. It's crazy.
9223.name: Bode Miller

9224.quote: It's very cool to be able to say that my first real film was 'Footloose' and my second film I got to star alongside Tom Cruise and Catherine Zeta-Jones.
9224.name: Julianne Hough

9225.quote: But live shows are cool. I just got back into the idea of enjoying it live.
9225.name: Graham Coxon

9226.quote: Lonnie was ahead of his time, but at the same time he was right in there with Albert Collins's Cool Sounds.
9226.name: Stevie Ray Vaughan

9227.quote: I always looked really young for my age. And once I hit 23, 24 and 25, I was then allowed to play the cool 18-year-olds and stuff.
9227.name: Ben Barnes

9228.quote: I get recognised sometimes, and that's really cool. I've tried certain disguises, but that doesn't work.
9228.name: Rupert Grint

9229.quote: For me the stunts are so cool, they're one of my favourite things when we're doing the film.
9229.name: Rupert Grint

9230.quote: People recognize me, call me Ron, and ask me questions. It's really cool and weird as well.
9230.name: Rupert Grint

9231.quote: I'd like to have the flying car, I think that'd be really cool.
9231.name: Rupert Grint

9232.quote: My band is so dedicated, everybody works very hard. The No. 1 priority is the show, and it's pretty cool because we all pull together, and it's fun. It's like being on a sports team or something.
9232.name: Bob Seger

9233.quote: I think Al Gore has done a great service in making global warming cool. He's basically taken it from a nerdy, almost ignored issue to making it what it is - namely, a problem.
9233.name: Bjorn Lomborg

9234.quote: For a long time the people at my shows were sort of the Pantera-tattoo trucker guys, really cool dudes, but I don't know what happened to them. That's the crowd that I like, the ones that don't get so offended just to be offended.
9234.name: Dave Attell

9235.quote: I don't watch reality TV. I'm cool.
9235.name: Dave Attell

9236.quote: The band feels loose in all the right ways, and it's just so cool looking out and seeing all of these people that I haven't seen in a while.
9236.name: Trey Anastasio

9237.quote: You know, you grow up with the image of John Travolta being super cool - 'Saturday Night Fever,' Brian De Palma, handsome young god, he, in reality, is a very silly man. And I mean that in a good way. He'll walk around the set talking in little weird voices, making people laugh.
9237.name: Eric Stoltz

9238.quote: What's cool about indie rock is that one band can do effectively the same thing as another band, and one band nails it, and the other one doesn't. I like that elusiveness.
9238.name: Andrew Bird

9239.quote: With all of you men out there who think that having a thousand different ladies is pretty cool, I have learned in my life I've found out that having one woman a thousand different times is much more satisfying.
9239.name: Wilt Chamberlain

9240.quote: I want you to see that I'm looking. Look at me look at you. I'm cool with that.
9240.name: Busta Rhymes

9241.quote: I could never dream of being cool.
9241.name: Andrea Corr

9242.quote: You actually don't want people thinking your product is cool, because then you're a fad.
9242.name: Sean Parker

9243.quote: I think being a wealthy member of the establishment is the antithesis of cool. Being a countercultural revolutionary is cool. So to the extent that you've made a billion dollars, you've probably become uncool.
9243.name: Sean Parker

9244.quote: My relationship with my mom is so amazing. We never got to have that stage that people go through, like when you're 13 and you think you're too cool for your parents. When you're embarrassed by them and stuff. We never went through that because I was constantly working and she constantly had to be there.
9244.name: Hilary Duff

9245.quote: You show up in Paris, and on the drive from the airport to the hotel you're like, 'This is so cool! I want to see something! I want to go to the Eiffel Tower!' And then you leave the next morning. You think, Oh, I didn't get to do anything. I tell people: I've been just about everywhere, but I've seen nothing.
9245.name: Taylor Lautner

9246.quote: Everybody thinks it's going to be so glamorous, so cool, you're on 'Glee,' you know, a hit show or whatever.
9246.name: Idina Menzel

9247.quote: I was probably cool around the end of 2002.
9247.name: Martin Freeman

9248.quote: But being on location and shooting, whether its in Puerto Rico or Atlanta, it always reminds me of how really cool my job can be. Interacting with the fans is one of the best parts of it.
9248.name: Dwayne Johnson

9249.quote: People connect with me just as a cool, around-the-way type of guy.
9249.name: Wiz Khalifa

9250.quote: You don't have to be a certain thing to be cool. If you're white, you don't have to act black or whatever. Just be you and know who you are.
9250.name: Wiz Khalifa

9251.quote: And in a world without heroes, as the movie trailer voice-over guy might say, the slightly awkward can be slightly cool.
9251.name: Adam Brody

9252.quote: To me, what I love about the draft is first, you see the young men who are realizing their dreams that they've worked so hard for. That's a pretty cool thing. You saw the emotion from some of these guys the other day. And then, the second thing is this total sense of hope and optimism. And, I think that's great for everybody.
9252.name: Roger Goodell

9253.quote: I do, I kick major butt in 'Dredd.' I get to kill people. I break a guy's neck by roundhouse kicking him in the face. It was me, I did it. I learned how to roundhouse kick. I also do it with my hands cuffed behind my back so it's pretty cool I have to say. Yeah, leather body suit, blonde hair, the whole thing.
9253.name: Olivia Thirlby

9254.quote: I shall go the way of the open sea, to the lands I knew before you came, and the cool ocean breezes shall blow from me the memory of your name.
9254.name: Adela Florence Nicolson

9255.quote: I'm more into the Spawn toys. They're really cool. They're coming out with a Techno Spawn series and another series, The Dark Ages, which are really cool.
9255.name: Jason Mewes

9256.quote: It's cool to be recognised by your peers.
9256.name: Frank Ocean

9257.quote: The idea of recognising your strengths and using them in as versatile a way as you can is cool to me.
9257.name: Frank Ocean

9258.quote: What I do doesn't sit well in the world of hipsterville. I don't have a cool card, but I also don't have thin skin.
9258.name: Chris Daughtry

9259.quote: Above all, film is a business, Independence is a really cool thing as you can be a bit more bold, and take a few more chances with what you do.
9259.name: Mel Gibson

9260.quote: I used to lie between cool, clean sheets at night after I'd had a bath, after I had washed my hair and scrubbed my knuckles and finger-nails and teeth. Then I could lie quite still in the dark with my face to the window with the trees in it, and talk to God.
9260.name: Frances Farmer

9261.quote: My strangest media moment a photo session they all had dressed up like 50 gangsters. That was pretty cool. We have to get some more of those kind of photos sometimes.
9261.name: Kerry King

9262.quote: When I decided to launch my first knitwear line, it was because I saw a void in the basics category. The editors were always looking for cool, fashion-forward tees and sweaters. So that's where I started.
9262.name: Alexander Wang

9263.quote: If people are taking pictures of me at Starbucks, it's not the end of the world. It's cool, it's fun, it's exciting.
9263.name: Cory Monteith

9264.quote: And looking at today's music scene, I think it's cool that there are a lot of consumers and fans not limited by what radio and the record companies tell them to buy.
9264.name: Juice Newton

9265.quote: The cool thing about music is no one can take music away from you, writing wise.
9265.name: Darren Criss

9266.quote: I don't think, generally speaking, people become writers because they were the really good, really cool, attractive kid in class. I'll be honest. This is our revenge for people who were much better looking and more popular than us. I was a bit like that, I suppose.
9266.name: Steven Moffat

9267.quote: If you can get a teen leader in each sector of a student population, you can pull people in. Everybody wants to get involved, but most are too afraid. When they see a person they think is cool leading it, they're first to join.
9267.name: Andrew Shue

9288.quote: Being in love is not cool!

9345.quote: Most people are really cool and I really don't mind talking to them and answering their questions.

9368.quote: This wired generation is kind of cool.

9377.quote: I found out some really cool ways to swing around the Winchester.
9377.name: Shane West

9382.quote: Actually just recently I came up with that idea, watching the movie 'Legally Blonde' and I was like, 'Cool, that's something I want to do.'

9389.name: Ashley Scott

9391.quote: Punk's influence on music, movies, art, design and fashion is no longer in doubt. It is used as the measurement for what is cool.

9392.quote: I like that band Get Hustle. They're cool live. I haven't heard their records, though.

9394.quote: Courtney Love is really cool and funny. I would like to meet Julia Roberts and Cameron Diaz. I think I could play their daughters.

9396.quote: They have decided to tour under the name of Ten Years After which I don't think is very cool. To be honest, they have had to do that as it's the only way they can get any work.

9397.quote: I've been such an oddball my whole life, but I've always been cool and I've always dressed fairly smartly.

9399.quote: Orlando's a part of me. The next guy's a part of me. And the next guy's a part of me. That's all I'm trying to do, is tell cool stories that people can relate to.

9402.quote: I never set out to become 'famous.' I mean, when you're 14 you think 'I'm gonna become a writer and people will want my autograph and that'll be cool,' but you grow up and you learn that's just not how the world works. I resigned myself to the fact that I would probably never be published and if I did it probably wouldn't be a big deal.
