9413.name: Alexander Ludwig

9414.quote: When I first started acting I was about nine years old. I had never been to audition in my life and my agent sent me out. It was just a commercial for 'Harry Potter.' That was the first thing I ever went out for and I got the 'Harry Potter' commercial which was really cool, but I didn't play Harry Potter.
9414.name: Alexander Ludwig

9415.quote: If we really wanted to be cool, and everyone in the world had Pro Tools, we could just put it up on the internet and everyone could make their own record out of it.
9415.name: Charlie Hunter

9416.quote: In politics almost all of us are nerds, so that's just a given, but we're cool nerds.
9416.name: Jonathan Krohn

9417.quote: They used to say it was bad for Indians to drink, but it's bad for anybody. When they drink they lose their cool, a lot of us. Like when we played with Sonny Boy, I would never get paid, you know. He would drink up all the money.
9417.name: Ike Turner

9418.quote: If I took over the 'Glamour' offices for a day, I would put Joe Pesci on the cover. I would say 'We've got to change all these magazines a little bit. We have to bring out a different version of what is, like, cool. You know, what's winning. Joe Pesci, Burt Reynolds.'
9418.name: Jake Johnson

9419.quote: You know, what 'New Girl' is doing is they're bringing in really cool people. These are home-run people who aren't your typical guest-star-type people.
9419.name: Jake Johnson

9420.quote: My first three years of high school, I wasn't that cool.
9420.name: Jonathan Bennett

9421.quote: I never think of myself as any kind of sex symbol, but I get letters from all over, all sorts. It's really cool. I get a lot from inmates, which is kind of scary. But the best was the guy who wanted to send me a plane ticket to fly me to his prom.
9421.name: Laura Prepon

9422.quote: There are some people who have stayed with us our whole career, which is pretty cool too.
9422.name: Mike McCready

9423.quote: I'm so critical of myself. I'm actually really, really proud of the film. It's really cool to see a movie at Sundance because everybody is so supportive.
9423.name: Giovanni Ribisi

9424.quote: My parents have always been cool. They even became surrogates to friends of mine who didn't have such supportive parents.
9424.name: Olivia Williams

9425.quote: We got to do a few things with President Clinton. To be invited to Washington again to play with Ashanti and all those other cool people there in front of President Bush and the rest of the world feels awesome. I'm really looking forward to going.
9425.name: Darius Rucker

9426.quote: The thing about stand-up was, I was doing all this sketch and YouTube stuff where I was not being censored and I got to do my own thing, and it was really cool.
9426.name: Donald Glover

9427.quote: Having your own character in a video game is pretty cool.
9427.name: Josie Maran

9428.quote: The military is a very cool world to write about. I went down to Ft. Benning, Ga., for military training, and I learned a lot about soldiers and officers and why they joined up and what their life has been like.
9428.name: David Baldacci

9429.quote: Unless something real cool comes along, I will probably be doing features, so long as I can make a living doing that. Otherwise, I will do another show.
9429.name: Danny Masterson

9430.quote: I am a huge fashion fan. It's a really cool way to express yourself.
9430.name: Kiernan Shipka

9431.quote: I do resent that when you're in the most cool, powerful time of your life, which is your 40s, you're put out to pasture. I think women are so much cooler when they're older. So it's a drag that we're not allowed to age.
9431.name: Rosanna Arquette

9432.quote: If it was just me and Elvis one on one, which only happened once or twice in the times that I did see him, it was a really comfortable. He was a cool guy. Easy laugh, nice guy.
9432.name: Mac Davis

9433.quote: I think you go through a period as a teenager of being quite cool and unaffected by things.
9433.name: Miranda Otto

9434.quote: I definitely dislike pomposity and artifice. I hope that I'm not that. Once I write a song, it belongs to the world, and the way people perceive it, it's cool.
9434.name: Daryl Hall

9435.quote: The simplest way to do something cool is the cross-turn. Like in the '80s - Michael Jackson did it. You jump and cross your legs together at the same time, and then spin out of it. That's it.
9435.name: Heather Morris

9436.quote: You don't want to be too cool. But you don't want to be too dorky. Still, I find it so much better to see a guy at a club being a dork, and having fun, than trying to be sexy.
9436.name: Heather Morris

9437.quote: I just did a part in 'Sin City 2.' I got to do a scene with Ray Liotta. Amazing man, extraordinary gentleman who was just so kind to me, I'm so excited about that I think it's gonna be very cool.
9437.name: Juno Temple

9438.quote: Almost all the fans I meet are pretty cool people. They're intelligent and tend to think about things a bit more than your average rock'n'roll fans: sensible people I wouldn't mind having a drink with.
9438.name: Peter Buck

9439.quote: The name Crow was inspired by a number of things. I thought it would be cool to have a robot with sort of a Native American feel to it.
9439.name: Joel Hodgson

9440.quote: But if you think you aren't creative that's cool, too. I think being around people who aren't creative is kind of refreshing and nice.
9440.name: Joel Hodgson

9441.quote: It feels quite cool, in a mad way, to be someone who skulks about in the shadows.
9441.name: Peter Baynham

9442.quote: I'd wear flip-flops and jeans. I guess that's not cool.
9442.name: Bill Rancic

9443.quote: Meyer and I have a bit in common because we're both left-handed. I think it's great that he seeks out that advice because he's not too cool or too uncomfortable to ask for it.
9443.name: Barry Zito

9444.quote: Everyone focuses on the earthly state, but how cool might death be? I believe in spiritual rebirth, and I can't wait to experience that.
9444.name: Barry Zito

9445.quote: I love people, and I love to be with people and to make music with people, but my natural state is to revert back to being by myself in my house, which is cool because that's where I practice and write and listen and study.
9445.name: Esperanza Spalding

9446.quote: I think I'm much too earnest to be as cool as 'Boyd Crowder'.
9446.name: Walton Goggins

9447.quote: I love Prince Harry. Good looking and a bit of a rebel. Me and his dad are as thick as thieves and I knew Harry before I knew his dad so we've met a few times. I think he's amazing. And I think you can relate to him because he's made mistakes. He's cool.
9447.name: Cheryl Cole

9448.quote: My friend and I sang an a cappella rendition of Extreme's 'More Than Words' at one of our football pep rallies in a desperate attempt to look cool. For a while, I wore pink Converse All Stars because I thought it made me seem daring and irreverent.
9448.name: Ed Helms

9449.quote: I try to explain to people that you get the roles that are right when they're right. If you have a nerd character but you're kind of a cool guy, you're probably not going to get the nerd part. The nerd is going to get the nerd part. You know, someone like me.
9449.name: Ed Helms

9450.quote: I'm a massive fan of Drake, and we walked right past him. He's too cool to be clapping One Direction though.
9450.name: Zayn Malik

9451.quote: I saw a drummer play once when I was a kid and I thought, that's really cool. You know, you're moving. You're using your arms and fingers. So I tried it and I loved it.
9451.name: Bill Kreutzmann

9452.quote: I think that was a moment of cool panic there.
9452.name: Ron Atkinson

9453.quote: I love seeing people having fun. Everyone over in L.A. is too cool for it. That's the problem.
9453.name: Lukas Haas

9454.quote: I've always thought vampires were interesting because they live forever, they're always well-financed, they dress well, you know what I mean? And they're, like, cool. Usually vampire - you've never seen a broke vampire. Have you?
9454.name: Michael Ealy

9455.quote: I'm not geeky but I have my geeky, corky moments, and then I've got some aspects of cool in me, I guess.
9455.name: Nick Cannon

9456.quote: When you think back to your first kiss, your hair is perfect and she was wearing a cool outfit. We remember it with restraint and we remember it with style. We remember it as idealistically as you can think.
9456.name: Stephen Chbosky

9457.quote: I always loved Kate Winslet, but after you meet her you really love her because she's a cool chick.
9457.name: Peter Farrelly

9458.quote: When you have kids, you just love them. It's similar to when you're in love with someone. You just think they are so cool and want to be around them all the time, but what if she starts being embarrassed and only giving me charity visits? I want her to actually want to see me, so that's what I'm going for!
9458.name: Jeremy Sisto

9459.quote: I just got an iPhone, which is cool, but I don't download movies, I don't watch Hulu, I don't have Netflix. I don't do any of that. But I do geek out to music.
9459.name: Miles Teller

9460.quote: When things are really good, really easy it's not cool for me.
9460.name: Romario

9461.quote: We looked at each other standing on the podium, and I think we all were tearing up. But we had to keep it cool. I think we did. Then we let out a breath.
9461.name: Michael Irvin

9462.quote: Even as a kid, if I would come across something cool in the record store, that would be how I found out about bands. It's kind of the same way these days. In a way even less because there are no record stores to go to anymore.
9462.name: Scott Ian

9463.quote: I know a lot of people dread going to work every morning, but my work is playing pretend and doing stunts and screaming. It's a lot of fun and I get to play dress up. Every day is exciting and different and new and cool. I couldn't be more grateful.
9463.name: Nina Dobrev

9464.quote: Thirty years ago, we were in a movie theater and thought it was so cool because we were finally delivered from the horrors of stained glass and wooden pews.
9464.name: Bill Hybels

9465.quote: There were a few 6th form girls that I got with when I was I the 6th form, they were really nice, so that was cool.
9465.name: Charlie Simpson

9466.quote: Lots of people say to me, 'I completely hate Busted'. That's completely cool with me. I understand why.
9466.name: Charlie Simpson

9467.quote: I hear good things about Xbox Live from some of my younger teammates. I think it would be fun to be able to challenge fans all over the world. It would be cool to be able to play some of my friends back home in the States. I'm looking forward to trying it.
9467.name: Claudio Reyna

9468.quote: I actually bought a travel guitar, and that guitar is really cool. You can actually fold the guitar, and you can plug headphones into it, but it's acoustic, or semi-acoustic.
9468.name: Daniel Ek

9469.quote: I'm not going chic, I swear. The geek endures. But, I mean, a snazzy cool suit looks good.
9469.name: Jon Heder

9470.quote: I'm not that into reading. If I'm gonna read, I'm gonna read some cool sci-fi book or something, not some stupid self-help book.
9470.name: Jon Heder

9471.quote: I think working with Johnny Depp was very intimidating. It was my fault though. I mean he's a total cool nice, nice guy, but I was just so, I don't know, overpowered by his presence. Like he's a very mystic person. He's older so I never really warmed up around him. I was so stiff.
9471.name: Franka Potente

9472.quote: I would think flying would be pretty cool. You would be able to fly away from all your enemies and get where you're going much faster. But being invisible? You probably wouldn't use that for the good of man.
9472.name: Randy Johnson

9473.quote: We should be recklessly abandoned to Jesus, and just turn it over to Him. Through the support I think the sacrifices will be made and we'll all be cool with it.
9473.name: Stacie Orrico

9474.quote: If you work in casting, it's sort of not cool to want to act. A lot of people think that casting directors are frustrated actors, but it wasn't true with any of the casting people I knew.
9474.name: Catherine Keener

9475.quote: I didn't audition for the part! The role was offered to me, and I was so excited to be a part of 'The Haunting Hour.' It is such a cool show and it was so much fun shooting the 'Intruders.'
9475.name: Willow Shields

9476.quote: For 'The Haunting Hour,' I thought it would be a lot of fun. It was great to play this cool kid role. My episode is called 'The Intruders' and my character is this mean, angry teenager because her younger brother was just born and he gets all of the attention. She's always playing tricks on her family, and there are some cool twists.
9476.name: Willow Shields

9477.quote: Even though I never worked with her, it was still really cool to have Brooke Shields on set. She was so nice and so funny.
9477.name: Atticus Shaffer

9478.quote: The quickest way to defuse fear or insecurity or anger is usually humor. I think comics figure that out quickly, and, once you figure it out, you think, 'Hey, if I can do this and get paid, that would be kind of cool.'
9478.name: Billy Gardell

9479.quote: I like men who are very cool but who are also so brilliant that they are almost insane. Sean Penn, Gary Oldman, Bob Dylan, Tom Waits - men who would be flipping burgers if they hadn't found an outlet for their brilliant mind-sets.
9479.name: Jolene Blalock

9480.quote: My favorite type of music to sing and to listen to, you know, rock. It's not always metal, but you know, half the time it is. Metal's cool, you know? Not everybody on 'American Idol' listens to metal.
9480.name: James Durbin

9481.quote: I like America. I think it's pretty cool.
9481.name: Mary Lynn Rajskub

9482.quote: I was a drama major also so it's cool to cuss for meaning, but for no apparent reason, no.
9482.name: Kel Mitchell

9483.quote: I already have legitimacy as a filmmaker and now I'm trying to do stuff that's just fun. Until I find a cool tangible subject again that I want to tackle.
9483.name: John Singleton

9484.quote: I wanted to dress cool, and get all the ladies.
9484.name: John Singleton

9485.quote: It's cool for me because I'm a director, but I'm also a teacher. I'm a lover of cinema, and I love working with people who are hungry and have the energy to really do better work.
9485.name: John Singleton

9486.quote: People always used to say to me, 'Don't you want your own show? That'd be so cool if you had your own show.' I said, 'You know, it's not gonna happen. So - no.'
9486.name: Candy Crowley

9487.quote: All literature consists of whatever the writer thinks is cool. The reader will like the book to the degree that he agrees with the writer about what's cool.
9487.name: Steven Brust

9488.quote: It's now possible to play and take lessons from any place of the world. The concept of physical distance doesn't exist in the online world, and that is so cool!
9488.name: Alexandra Kosteniuk

9489.quote: A female piano player is always pretty cool to me.
9489.name: Chrisette Michele

9490.quote: So, it's cool that, yes, Hal Jordan is a superhero, but my character is a real-world hero in her own life.
9490.name: Blake Lively

9491.quote: I just really like fun, cool, interesting, quirky girls. And sometimes you find that in 6'2 model bodies and sometimes they're short and brunette. All shapes and sizes - it's really about the personality. That sounds cliche, but it's so freaking true!
9491.name: Dylan O'Brien

9492.quote: What we do every night is we change out the set list as much as we can to make sure that (fans can) go home and tell their friends they experienced something unique and cool.
9492.name: Isaac Hanson

9493.quote: One of the great bands we opened up for was Priest back in '89. That was really great because at that time we had never met them, never toured with them before. They were a big influence on Slayer, so to open up for them was really cool.
9493.name: Dave Lombardo

9494.quote: To me, it all comes down to things being character-driven. It's hard for me to look beyond that. CG and all this cool stuff - so be it. But to me, it pretty much begins and ends with character-driven plots rather than technologically-driven plots.
9494.name: Billy West

9495.quote: The nude scenes were a little eerie and I felt a bit odd. Yeah, when the camera scanned up my body, I said to my friend, 'Now, that's a close-up.' I mean, you see every inch of my body. But I'm okay with it and so it was cool.
9495.name: Natasha Henstridge

9496.quote: Almost any film that you do is an opportunity to open you up and make you more aware of an area that you might not be thinking about. That's what is kind of cool, or one of the cool things about this profession.
9496.name: Joan Allen

9497.quote: Rhyme patterns are nothing without meanings to the words. A lot of rappers can do those flows, but the raps aren't really about anything - which is cool sometimes, but to have the flow and the message is one of my favorite things.
9497.name: J. Cole

9498.quote: When you go in and do a cool, small character, it feels less like work and more like fun.
9498.name: Balthazar Getty

9499.quote: I remember being in Atlantic City once when I was 18 or 19, and a sea of people were screaming and pulling their hair because I was there. It was weird. Nobody deserves adulation like that. I tried to explain it to my kids once. I said, 'Mommy used to be kind of cool, kind of like a Britney Spears.'
9499.name: Genie Francis

9500.quote: It was really cool to work with Dakota Fanning. I've watched her grow up and I've always loved her films, loved her. It was amazing working with someone who was American as well, because obviously it's going to be a different energy straightaway. We got on really well she's so professional and hardworking.
9500.name: Kaya Scodelario

9501.quote: My niece was very much caught up in the vampire craze for young adults, and she thought having a vampire boyfriend would be a cool thing. What do you do on a first date? The more I thought about it, the more fun I had imagining what you'd serve a vampire for dinner.
9501.name: Deborah Harkness

9502.quote: It's great that people are basically spending their two weeks of vacation to come out and be with us in some weird part of the world. And I think we owe it to them to take 'em to some cool places.
9502.name: Jeff Ament

9503.quote: It's just cool to me that Bon Jovi knows my name!
9503.name: Josh Hopkins

9504.quote: Being an author of banned books is cool, I've decided.
9504.name: Lauren Myracle

9505.quote: What I find cool about being a banned author is this: I'm writing books that evoke a reaction, books that, if dropped in a lake, go down not with a whimper but a splash.
9505.name: Lauren Myracle

9506.quote: That's always a cool thing to be the voice of what the eyes are seeing. It gives you the role of the Greek chorus and that's always fun to do.
9506.name: Jorge Garcia

9507.quote: I just saw the movie for the first time in its entirely last night. It's really cool when you're in with an audience that's so tuned in and plugged in to what's going on.
9507.name: Sasha Alexander

9508.quote: Sometimes, the other characters are too normal and then you start to be brought back to reality but then Luna shows up and she is just so funny and cool and honest and slightly mad and she's all that matters. She is 100% true. She puts on no shows, because she is so comfortable with herself.
9508.name: Evanna Lynch

9509.quote: As a father, you immediately become uncool, especially the older they get. The older you get, it's inevitable that, as cool as you think you are, you're probably just as lame in your kids' eyes.
9509.name: Mark Consuelos

9510.quote: You always have in the back of your mind that would be cool if you get recognized. But you can't concentrate on any of those things. You've got to just keep playing and doing your music and the rest is just a bonus.
9510.name: Michael Kiwanuka

9511.quote: My role in 'Legally Blonde' was really rewarding, because I had so much fun working on the movie. I've had really rewarding experiences on tiny low budget films that you'll never see but where I had a cool time creating characters as well. I love almost all of the characters I've played.
9511.name: Alanna Ubach

9512.quote: That wasn't the way that things was supposed to be. And all because the so-called culture that I thought was right, that I thought it was cool, and I thought it was fun, and it was exciting at the time. It all led to me laying in a prison bunk by myself with no one to talk to but myself.
9512.name: Michael Vick

9513.quote: I try not to name too many labels - not because it's not cool, but because it starts getting political.
9513.name: Nelly

9514.quote: I'm confident - confident in my skin, and I'm cool with my flaws and all that stuff.
9514.name: Minka Kelly

9515.quote: Now that I finally have the time for it, this web surfing stuff turns out to be as interesting and fun and addictive as you've all been telling me. Zipping from link to link, chasing an idea across the noosphere, sucking up information like a killer whale - way cool.
9515.name: Spider Robinson

9516.quote: I hate it when people come up to me on trains and ask 'Are you Soulja Boy?' If people want pictures or autographs, that's cool, but I don't like the dumb questions.
9516.name: Soulja Boy

9517.quote: I love my mother Ali so much. I'm a momma's boy. I just have a very cool mom. It's not as though I had any say in the matter. I'm just really fortunate. She's the most kind, loving, giving woman.
9517.name: Hayden Christensen

9518.quote: Greg Berlanti, David Nutter, Andrew Kreisberg and Marc Guggenheim are the people I wanted to work with. They're smart, they're funny, they're cool, they're edgy.
9518.name: Katie Cassidy

9519.quote: I wouldn't compare myself to any past Idol contestant, because I don't feel like I am like any of them. Maybe stories are cool but my story is different from most people's story. I don't like to compare myself to other people, I like to just be me.
9519.name: Naima Adedapo

9520.quote: The Dead was cool, It's a great horror story. I went to the casting director of this movie and talked to him, then they called my agent and had me come in and read for it and they wanted to use me.
9520.name: Matthew McGrory

9521.quote: Cool things happen. Ace's guitar flies through space, goes through a hole, and blows up. I throw drumsticks and they come flying at you.
9521.name: Peter Criss

9522.quote: I have this idealistic and maybe naive thought that almost any song can be anything. If you record one song today, it would maybe be exciting and cool. But I could record the same song next week and it would be something completely different.
9522.name: Sondre Lerche

9523.quote: I work with really cool people, and so far I haven't been approached in any embarrassing manner when it comes to image.
9523.name: Sondre Lerche

9524.quote: There is a bit of a movement as far as younger people in country music. That is cool because people are saying things like, 'I didn't listen to country music until so-and-so came along.' And I'm like, 'Yeah! Now you know why I love it.'
9524.name: Hunter Hayes

9525.quote: You're not really necessarily the coolest guy in their life. You are a conduit to the really cool people.
9525.name: Tony Shalhoub

9526.quote: We found out the Gemini spacesuit was, well, oxygen was flowing to keep me cool as well as to breathe, and it wasn't good enough. My visor got fogged.
9526.name: Gene Cernan

9527.quote: A guy's biggest style mistake is definitely trying to look too cool. As long as you've got a good pair of jeans, a good pair of boots and a few good shirts, you're fine.
9527.name: Luke Evans

9528.quote: I liked the name Frog Brigade because it lent itself to a lot of cool imagery with the whole frog thing.
9528.name: Les Claypool

9529.quote: I have this desire to just while away weeks, months and years. It took me two years to make this record but that was with me trying to condense my process and not disappear down the rabbit hole with all the cool things I've collected. I could take 10 years and not explore everything I want to with these instruments.
9529.name: Gotye

9530.quote: Maybe you are the 'cool' generation If coolness means a capacity to stay calm and use your head in the service of ends passionately believed in, then it has my admiration.
9530.name: Jr. Kingman Brewster

9531.quote: Spiderman can climb walls and he's got a cool outfit.
9531.name: Rhona Mitra

9532.quote: I am kind of a private person, so I don't miss that part of show business at all. Looking back on my career in television and making a movie like 'The Sound of Music' from an adult point of view, it actually seems kind of unreal. I was involved in shows that people grew up with - that hold memories for them - and it's a cool feeling.
9532.name: Angela Cartwright

9534.quote: There is something exciting about being in an environment in which it's really cool to be smart.
9534.name: Freeman A. Hrabowski III

9535.quote: Looking so cool, his greed is hard to conceal, he's fresh out of law school, you gave him a license to steal.
9535.name: Al Stewart

9536.quote: I'm a big fan of all the Boston guys that are acting - Matt Damon , Ben Affleck, Mark Wahlberg - they made a great career out of it, and they found a way to do it and still be cool guys, so that's kind of where I want to be.
9536.name: Kenny Wormald

9537.quote: I was a dancer, and it's not really cool for a boy to dance, so it was inspiring to see a movie like 'Footloose' where a guy is dancing masculine and had a proper reason behind it. It made me feel cool, and when these kids would make fun of me, I'd be like, 'Oh, didn't you see 'Footloose,' man?'
9537.name: Kenny Wormald

9538.quote: I think it can be fun to be single and date-like when you don't want a relationship. Or when you've just gotten out of a relationship, and, after get over the initial shock, your thinking, Hey, it's kind of cool being single.
9538.name: Breckin Meyer

9539.quote: My whole family actually, but my parents. I had such a normal and amazing childhood. I've been so lucky. My parents are cool and normal. They don't talk about the business and I still have stuff to do at their house.
9539.name: Kaley Cuoco

9540.quote: I used to skip out of high school and go flying. It was just one of those things, I thought it was kind of a cool thing to do. I never thought about doing that as a profession, but I started checking things out and I found out there was a flight school down in Daytona Beach, called Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University.
9540.name: Jerry Doyle

9541.quote: I was 35 years old and in a position to take a shot at whatever I wanted to try. The Air Force said I was too old to fly fighter jets. I thought about becoming a fishing boat captain, before deciding that acting seemed pretty cool.
9541.name: Jerry Doyle

9542.quote: I got a phone call from Fearne Cotton. It was amazing! I literally couldn't believe it. It was so cool. It was the night before I was going on her show to sing on the 'Live Lounge.' She was so lovely.
9542.name: Birdy

9543.quote: Dinosaurs was a cool idea, but we just couldn't find a way to make it really fun. We've got a bunch of great game ideas that we want to bring to life over the next several years.
9543.name: Sid Meier

9544.quote: I went to engineering school, which I thought was what I wanted to do, for about two weeks. We had an orientation class and we met this guy where he worked and stuff and it was cool, but I was like, 'There is no way this is going to be my life.'
9544.name: Evan Glodell

9545.quote: With these men and women who work-for the cause with all their hearts, with cool heads and skilled hands we will master every fate.
9545.name: Gustav Krupp

9546.quote: Atlanta is an incredibly cool city.
9546.name: Andrew Lincoln

9547.quote: I liked the way my character, Shane, was first introduced. You get introduced to her through this sexual action, and I thought that was so cool and just kind of summed up what she enjoys and who she is, to a certain extent. She's a complete sexual being and the great thing is that she doesn't apologize for it. It's just who she is. We rarely see women be able to do that on television.
9547.name: Katherine Moennig

9548.quote: What I like about the 'Underworld' thing is that it's a mix of cool genres, as well as creating its own message.
9548.name: Theo James

9549.quote: I saw 'Captain America' in 3D. It's cool. I liked the beginning. It's a really good setup.
9549.name: Theo James

9550.quote: I've got two brothers and two sisters, so there's five of us and we're all very close, which is cool.
9550.name: Theo James

9551.quote: I like starting. It's pretty cool.
9551.name: Al Leiter

9552.quote: I'm a big techno fan. I love that thumping kick drum. We heard a version of 'Lost in Love' and it was thrash metal. It sounded cool!
9552.name: Graham Russell

9553.quote: I know some actors feel classes are not cool or they create negative public relations, but I continue to crave the story just beyond my reach. To grasp that brass ring I need to continue to fine-tune my talents.
9553.name: Michael Welch

9554.quote: And when I was a kid being an actor was not cool. I'm thirty now and when I was a kid in the 80s that wasn't a cool thing to be.
9554.name: Vincent Kartheiser

9555.quote: Again, like I said, we're not trying to censor anyone. If you think drugs are cool, fine. Make that movie. We are not going to stop you, or try to stop you, but we would encourage other people to be a bit more responsible about their portrayal of drug usage.
9555.name: Gerald McRaney

9556.quote: I do love to walk around in New York because people will notice me, smile, but they never bother anyone. New Yorkers are very cool. I love New York.
9556.name: Creed Bratton

9557.quote: I grew up on the South Side of Chicago, north Beverly. It was cool, everybody's cool on the block.
9557.name: Craig Robinson

9558.quote: Working with Omarion is pretty amazing. That's like my brother. He's really cool.
9558.name: Teyana Taylor

9559.quote: When I was in high school, my friends and I would drive out into the country to abandoned houses and structures, haha, to ghost hunt. We would scare each other so bad! We would sometimes camp out by the abandoned buildings just to scare ourselves! Such good times. The adrenaline of real fear is so cool!
9559.name: Keegan Allen

9560.quote: I don't want to stay underground for just the cool people.
9560.name: Buzz Osborne

9561.quote: Being a kid and growing up is such a cool part of life.
9561.name: Devon Werkheiser

9562.quote: The alternative scene, for a couple years now, has been taken seriously and that's a cool thing. I don't think it's exploded or anything, but I think it's pretty cool that it still exists, it's still affecting people.
9562.name: Bob Odenkirk

9563.quote: I noticed that this defense attorney is a very, very intelligent man, and he's very cool and he's very knowledgeable, and I think that personally I'd like to have an attorney like him.
9563.name: Tommy Bond

9564.quote: Everyone is different, but I'm not standoffish at all. I'm not one of those people who prefer to write a note. I'll walk right up to you and ask you out! Even if the answer's no, I'm totally cool with it.
9564.name: Corbin Bleu

9565.quote: I am a very open, social, friendly person, and when it comes to people approaching me and asking for an autograph, I am totally cool with doing any of that. It's a lot of fun.
9565.name: Corbin Bleu

9566.quote: A couple days ago, I saw a lot of people tweeting, 'Oh, it's so cool 'Home' is being used in the Olympics!' We don't really get to watch much TV, man, with the concerts every night, but I wish I could have seen it. I really just found out through Twitter and my management texting me. I thought it was really awesome.
9566.name: Phillip Phillips

9567.quote: I think there are four or five interesting pockets where a lot of cool technology companies are getting started. Chicago is one of them. New York is certainly another. Silicon Valley really dominates. And you're seeing some stuff out of Boston and Seattle and down South.
9567.name: Eric Lefkofsky

9568.quote: And getting stunt coordinator Dan Bradley and everybody from the whole 'Bourne Supremacy' crew, I think was real cool for our film because we do a bunch of really big jumps in this movie.
9568.name: Sean William Scott

9569.quote: I just thought it could make a really cool movie. It's not that it's just a buddy comedy but it's all about two guys hating each other and towards the end they're good friends. I liked that these two guys were best friends from the very beginning, and they're crazy.
9569.name: Sean William Scott

9570.quote: I think it's really cool to embrace the pain of something that may have hurt you and be able to express it through music.
9570.name: Ciara

9571.quote: People spend hours constantly checking and tweeting and Facebooking. And it's cool to check up on your friends and see what's going on in the world, but it's not cool to spend five hours of your day on the computer looking at the Internet.
9571.name: Ty Segall

9572.quote: Well, I look at it like this: When you go to a restaurant, the less you know about what happens in the kitchen, the more you enjoy your meal. If the soup tastes good, everything's cool, and you don't necessarily want to know what's in it. The same thing holds true with movies.
9572.name: Jeffrey Wright

9573.quote: It's really cool to know that you've put something together that isn't for a particular audience. It's so often that a TV show can really only speak to one sect of the population, and this really is something that appeals to a worldwide fan base. People who are into the pursuit of knowledge. Their reaction has meant the world to us.
9573.name: David Krumholtz

9574.quote: I've always been into guitars, we want to put keyboards on, but keyboard players don't look cool onstage, they just keep their heads down. There has never been a cool keyboard player, apart from Elton John.
9574.name: Noel Gallagher

9575.quote: To me, anyone with an Australian accent wielding a tennis racket is cool.
9575.name: Adrian Smith

9576.quote: On a film set everyone is very cool. Well, blase really.
9576.name: Anthony Daniels

9577.quote: But it's cool working with female directors because I'm a girl, so you do relate to them more. You can talk to them about other stuff like clothes and all that.
9577.name: Elle Fanning

9578.quote: You know, Southerners are pretty cool.
9578.name: Fred Schneider

9579.quote: I don't mind what the role is at all I just want to play cool characters.
9579.name: Daniel Cudmore

9580.quote: Florida has been really cool to us. This is our first big club tour, and Pennywise has been really nice.
9580.name: Brandon Thomas

9581.quote: I've won some pretty cool things in my life and I have a lot of great titles.
9581.name: Heather O'Reilly

9582.quote: It's fun to be a part of pop history. Anytime you can be referenced in that respect it can be cool.
9582.name: Joey McIntyre

9583.quote: Will Smith is young, he's cool and my kids have his CDs.
9583.name: Robert Conrad

9584.quote: Two weeks later, we played our first concert and had 100 people there. It was pretty cool.
9584.name: Will Champion

9585.quote: White people couldn't do black music back in the day because they weren't funky or bad enough. They weren't from the ghettoes, but hip-hop and R&ampB changed all of that because white kids want to be down with it. They wanted to learn it so they studied the culture. It's kind of a cool thing because we shouldn't be so separate.
9585.name: Narada Michael Walden

9586.quote: I grew up around hip-hop so I didn't think it was about being cool or being black or being white or whatever.
9586.name: Chad Hugo

9587.quote: It's pretty cool to be able to hang out with the President and have the race-winning car on the South Lawn.
9587.name: Buddy Rice

9588.quote: I love 'Goodfellas' because it's a great movie - it's funny and there is action at perfect points. I just think Martin Scorsese makes everyone look really cool.
9588.name: Booboo Stewart

9589.quote: I've done four other films since 'Submarine,' so that's quite cool. It's just good to have people respect your work I've never had that before. Yeah, my life has changed crazy. I'm a kid from a small town in south Wales, I play my Xbox usually and all that sort of stuff, and it's a whole new world.
9589.name: Craig Roberts

9590.quote: The 'Being Human' people were really cool and let me improvise. They had such a good working atmosphere. It was a cool set-up and a really good environment to be in.
9590.name: Craig Roberts

9591.quote: I'm getting a lot of stick because my character in 'Young Dracula' wanted to be vampire, so now that I am a vampire, everyone's like, 'You finally did it!' But it's cool and I loved doing 'Young Dracula.' That show's finished and I don't know why it ended, so it was brilliant to go into 'Being Human,' which is like the adult version of it.
9591.name: Craig Roberts

9592.quote: I'd love to pop back into 'Being Human' as Adam. I love the character so much. I've never really played a character like that. I'm always playing the geek, so to play a kid who is very energetic when he wants to be, and who is always trying to get the girls, was really cool.
9592.name: Craig Roberts

9593.quote: I want to speak up and tell you that mascara and clothes don't make you cool, neither do name-brand handbags, but being a leader can.
9593.name: Renee Olstead

9594.quote: Picking a best friend who stands up for what she believes in, is true to herself and allows you to be yourself without judgement of how 'cool' you are? Well, now you're picking a friend for life.
9594.name: Renee Olstead

9595.quote: I was never interested in making cool, distilled, pure objects.
9595.name: Martin Puryear

9596.quote: I've had cameos on some cool shows.
9596.name: Paul Wesley

9597.quote: I wasn't some weird loner in school, but I definitely wasn't invited to any of the cool parties.
9597.name: Paul Wesley

9598.quote: I was always a sci-fi and fantasy geek. I was in the 'Lord of the Rings' club and all my cool friends made fun of me.
9598.name: Melissa de la Cruz

9600.quote: I'm not cool with ACORN or the working families' party, or people that vote like democrats and run on Republican lines.
9600.name: Doug Hoffman

9601.quote: I once saw a picture in the paper of John Hegley with 'poet' written on his knuckles, and I thought that was pretty cool, so I was quite up front about it.
9601.name: Jon McGregor

9602.quote: I've never won an award for anything, and I think it's weird. I mean, that's really cool but it's strange to think you could get an award for acting. I always thought that was strange.
9602.name: Bobby Cannavale

9603.quote: They use all of the music that I did in the '50s, '60s and the '70s behind people like Tupac and LL Cool J. I'm into all that stuff.
9603.name: Donald Byrd

9604.quote: I feel like my music is just an extension of my acting. I treat the songs like scenes that tell a story, it's very similar. My favorite thing is when cartoon fans show up to my live gigs! They are always the most kick-butt audience members 'cause they're not trying to act all cool like a lot of the music fans do! It's refreshing!!
9604.name: Grey DeLisle

9605.quote: My favorite thing is when cartoon fans show up to my live gigs! They are always the most kick-butt audience members 'cause they're not trying to act all cool like a lot of the music fans do!
9605.name: Grey DeLisle

9606.quote: We believe the ice sheet was not around all the time. It was only around during cool snaps of the climate.
9606.name: Kenneth R. Miller

9607.quote: I remember in high school trying to get home from water-polo practice in time so I could see Happy Days on television when it first came on, because I was so blown away by it. It was just such a cool thing.
9607.name: Ted McGinley

9608.quote: In the old days, a TV sync was perceived as not so cool or whittling away at your indie cred. Now it's seen as much more of an opportunity than a sellout, as a way to find fans who wouldn't have ordinarily come across their genre of music.
9608.name: Alexandra Patsavas

9609.quote: I am working on a dress sock line of funky, colorful, cool designs.
9609.name: Rob Kardashian

9610.quote: The cool thing about writing is that there is really never a typical day. Sometimes I get a rhythm going and head off to work every morning and come home at night. Sometimes I'll write for two days straight and then be utterly blank for the next two.
9610.name: Patricia Briggs

9611.quote: It's cool to be in the paper every once in awhile and people read about you and they know who you are.
9611.name: Taylor Phinney

9612.quote: I'm playing with Bonnie Raitt. I don't have to sing it. I just have to play it. That's cool.
9612.name: Billy Preston

9613.quote: Personally, I just got one of these Vonage IP phones. It's actually pretty cool. It comes with one of these Cisco ATA routers where you just plug an analog handset in.
9613.name: Rob Glaser

9614.quote: I used to do this as a kid. And now they're paying me for it, which is cool.
9614.name: William Kempe

9615.quote: L.A.'s cool I had a run with it to where it just pretty much wore me out. I love the weather and I have great friends there, great family, but I really cannot take a lot of the culture. Like Nashville, where everybody's a songwriter, everybody out there is an actor.
9615.name: Shooter Jennings

9616.quote: There aren't many things that are universally cool, and it's cool not to litter. I'd never do it.
9616.name: Matthew McConaughey

9617.quote: There's nothing less funny than someone who looks cool. There's nothing more unappealing.
9617.name: Eric Wareheim

9618.quote: They very seldom let me lose my cool. They made me like I was Polly Perfect, which was ridiculous so that when I bump into kids on the street they'd say 'I wish my Mom were like you.'
9618.name: Charlotte Rae

9619.quote: Comedy is so hard to do, so it was very cool to do dead pan humor.
9619.name: Brittany Daniel

9620.quote: The cool wind blew in my face and all at once I felt as if I had shed dullness from myself. Before me lay a long gray line with a black mark down the center. The birds were singing. It was spring.
9620.name: Burl Ives

9621.quote: I'm cool with where I'm at. It's certain things I wanna do to be better, but I'm good.
9621.name: Jazmine Sullivan

9622.quote: You can think of Hollywood as high school. TV actors are freshmen, comedy actors are maybe juniors, and dramatic actors - they're the cool seniors.
9622.name: Owen Wilson

9623.quote: But Freedom Strike was actually quite cool.
9623.name: Tone Loc

9624.quote: Now that we are cool, he said, and regret that we hurt each other, I am not sorry that it happened.
9624.name: William Henry Hudson

9625.quote: The cool thing about my profession is that I can do it until the day I die.
9625.name: Candace Cameron

9626.quote: I get to hang out with people I think are awesome, and do work I think is awesome. It's really cool.
9626.name: Harold Perrineau

9627.quote: It's cool to have critical success because it's always nice for your peers to say, 'Good job.' But who cares about them?
9627.name: Zac Hanson

9628.quote: In France, we don't yet have the craft that American TV does or big studios like Paramount. It was so cool going through those famous gates when you have your own little pass and picture on it. Woo hoo, I'm going to work!
9628.name: Lizzie Brochere

9629.quote: My sister and I said, Dad, are you doing to do anything about that? And he mentioned treatments other people sent him that he'd been working on. So we thought it would be kind of cool to give these guys a real script.
9629.name: Rae Dawn Chong

9630.quote: The cool thing about working and meeting a lot of people through your acting is that you never know who you might work with, in the future.
9630.name: Tania Raymonde

9631.quote: I hated the idea of a high school sweetheart. Growing up, oh my God, it just made me sick. I wanted to have a range of cool boyfriends. I wanted to travel around and date these interesting men. Then it just happened. You fall in love.
9631.name: Charlotte Arnold

9632.quote: When I was in school I read a lot of comic books and pretend I was in them and kids would tease me and call me names. But now I do the same things and people say that I'm artistic and cool and I'm doing the exact same thing I did in high school.
9632.name: Jr. Freddie Prinze

9633.quote: I was raised to believe in myself. I know I'm cool. I'm not trying to brag or say I'm the man or anything like that. I don't lie or cheat, and I'm not mean to anybody. I treat people with respect.
9633.name: Jr. Freddie Prinze

9634.quote: Internet mailing lists are like Fox television shows. They have really cool previews, and they get you all excited about them, but they just don't live up to their promises.
9634.name: John Dobbin

9635.quote: Definitely River Phoenix is somebody that I thought, 'This guy is very cool.' I wanted to be like him when I was a kid.
9635.name: Jim Sturgess

9636.quote: I thought that 'Twilight' would be a kind of girl movie, but it was cool.
9636.name: Kodi Smit-McPhee

9637.quote: I'm in a comic book now. That was cool. That's something that I'm still sorta reeling about, 'cause I read comics as a kid. Someone drew me, and actually did a pretty good job!
9637.name: Rutina Wesley

9638.quote: Film and television are just different. Film is cool because it's a complete package. You know the beginning, middle, and end. You can plan it out more, which I like. But with television you get a new script every week, so it's constantly a mystery as to what you're going to be doing.
9638.name: Austin Butler

9639.quote: I never had a cool older brother or sister to turn me on to cool music. I had to discover it for myself.
9639.name: Tony Kanal

9640.quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking. Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice. And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
9640.name: Steve Jobs

9641.quote: You gain strength, courage, and confidence by every experience in which you really stop to look fear in the face. You are able to say to yourself, 'I lived through this horror. I can take the next thing that comes along.'
9641.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

9642.quote: I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it. The brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.
9642.name: Nelson Mandela

9643.quote: Courage is what it takes to stand up and speak courage is also what it takes to sit down and listen.
9643.name: Winston Churchill

9644.quote: There are no easy answers' but there are simple answers. We must have the courage to do what we know is morally right.
9644.name: Ronald Reagan

9645.quote: Courage is the most important of all the virtues, because without courage you can't practice any other virtue consistently. You can practice any virtue erratically, but nothing consistently without courage.
9645.name: Maya Angelou

9647.quote: We must build dikes of courage to hold back the flood of fear.
9647.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

9648.quote: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear, not absence of fear.
9648.name: Mark Twain

9649.quote: He who is not courageous enough to take risks will accomplish nothing in life.
9649.name: Muhammad Ali

9650.quote: Courage is not simply one of the virtues, but the form of every virtue at the testing point.
9650.name: C. S. Lewis

9651.quote: Courage is being scared to death, and saddling up anyway.
9651.name: John Wayne

9652.quote: Don't Make Assumptions. Find the courage to ask questions and to express what you really want. Communicate with others as clearly as you can to avoid misunderstandings, sadness and drama. With just this one agreement, you can completely transform your life.
9652.name: Miguel Angel Ruiz

9653.quote: You will never do anything in this world without courage. It is the greatest quality of the mind next to honor.
9653.name: Aristotle

9654.quote: Efforts and courage are not enough without purpose and direction.
9654.name: John F. Kennedy

9655.quote: One man with courage is a majority.
9655.name: Thomas Jefferson

9656.quote: Have the courage to say no. Have the courage to face the truth. Do the right thing because it is right. These are the magic keys to living your life with integrity.
9656.name: W. Clement Stone

9657.quote: Faced with what is right, to leave it undone shows a lack of courage.
9657.name: Confucius

9658.quote: How few there are who have courage enough to own their faults, or resolution enough to mend them.
9658.name: Benjamin Franklin

9659.quote: Who could refrain that had a heart to love and in that heart courage to make love known?
9659.name: William Shakespeare

9660.quote: Inaction breeds doubt and fear. Action breeds confidence and courage. If you want to conquer fear, do not sit home and think about it. Go out and get busy.
9660.name: Dale Carnegie

9661.quote: It takes a lot of courage to release the familiar and seemingly secure, to embrace the new. But there is no real security in what is no longer meaningful. There is more security in the adventurous and exciting, for in movement there is life, and in change there is power.
9661.name: Alan Cohen

9662.quote: A great part of courage is the courage of having done the thing before.
9662.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

9663.quote: Have courage for the great sorrows of life and patience for the small ones and when you have laboriously accomplished your daily task, go to sleep in peace.
9663.name: Victor Hugo

9664.quote: He is a man of courage who does not run away, but remains at his post and fights against the enemy.
9664.name: Socrates

9666.quote: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
9666.name: Anais Nin

9667.quote: The only service a friend can really render is to keep up your courage by holding up to you a mirror in which you can see a noble image of yourself.
9667.name: George Bernard Shaw

9668.quote: Failure is unimportant. It takes courage to make a fool of yourself.
9668.name: Charlie Chaplin

9669.quote: Men make history and not the other way around. In periods where there is no leadership, society stands still. Progress occurs when courageous, skillful leaders seize the opportunity to change things for the better.
9669.name: Harry S. Truman

9670.quote: The most courageous act is still to think for yourself. Aloud.
9670.name: Coco Chanel

9671.quote: Those who lack the courage will always find a philosophy to justify it.
9671.name: Albert Camus

9672.quote: Success is never final, failure is never fatal. It's courage that counts.
9672.name: John Wooden

9673.quote: Courage is contagious. When a brave man takes a stand, the spines of others are often stiffened.
9673.name: Billy Graham

9674.quote: Be courageous. I have seen many depressions in business. Always America has emerged from these stronger and more prosperous. Be brave as your fathers before you. Have faith! Go forward!
9674.name: Thomas A. Edison

9675.quote: Courage is a kind of salvation.
9675.name: Plato

9676.quote: Courage is fear holding on a minute longer.
9676.name: George S. Patton

9677.quote: Man cannot discover new oceans unless he has the courage to lose sight of the shore.
9677.name: Andre Gide

9678.quote: Creativity requires the courage to let go of certainties.
9678.name: Erich Fromm

9679.quote: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
9679.name: Vincent Van Gogh

9680.quote: God, give us grace to accept with serenity the things that cannot be changed, courage to change the things which should be changed and the wisdom to distinguish the one from the other.
9680.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

9681.quote: Courage is fire, and bullying is smoke.
9681.name: Benjamin Disraeli

9682.quote: America was not built on fear. America was built on courage, on imagination and an unbeatable determination to do the job at hand.
9682.name: Harry S. Truman

9683.quote: It requires more courage to suffer than to die.
9683.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

9684.quote: Courage is found in unlikely places.
9684.name: J. R. R. Tolkien

9685.quote: Courage is the greatest of all virtues, because if you haven't courage, you may not have an opportunity to use any of the others.
9685.name: Samuel Johnson

9686.quote: To have courage for whatever comes in life - everything lies in that.
9686.name: Saint Teresa of Avila

9687.quote: Any intelligent fool can make things bigger and more complex, It takes a touch of genius - and a lot of courage to move in the opposite direction.
9687.name: E. F. Schumacher

9688.quote: The opposite for courage is not cowardice, it is conformity. Even a dead fish can go with the flow.
9688.name: Jim Hightower

9689.quote: One man with courage makes a majority.
9689.name: Andrew Jackson

9690.quote: Real courage is when you know you're licked before you begin, but you begin anyway and see it through no matter what.
9690.name: Harper Lee

9691.quote: I'm grateful to God for His bountiful gifts, He gave me courage and faith in myself.
9691.name: Loretta Young

9692.quote: A great deal of talent is lost to the world for want of a little courage. Every day sends to their graves obscure men whose timidity prevented them from making a first effort.
9692.name: Sydney Smith

9693.quote: The secret to happiness is freedom, And the secret to freedom is courage.
9693.name: Thucydides

9694.quote: A lot of people do not muster the courage to live their dreams because they are afraid to die.
9694.name: Les Brown

9695.quote: We must have courage to bet on our ideas, to take the calculated risk, and to act. Everyday living requires courage if life is to be effective and bring happiness.
9695.name: Maxwell Maltz

9696.quote: The courage to be is the courage to accept oneself, in spite of being unacceptable.
9696.name: Paul Tillich

9697.quote: Never be discouraged. If I were sunk in the lowest pits of Nova Scotia, with the Rocky Mountains piled on me, I would hang on, exercise faith, and keep up good courage, and I would come out on top.
9697.name: Jr. Joseph Smith

9698.quote: It is only necessary to have courage, for strength without self-confidence is useless.
9698.name: Giacomo Casanova

9699.quote: We have a powerful potential in out youth, and we must have the courage to change old ideas and practices so that we may direct their power toward good ends.
9699.name: Mary McLeod Bethune

9700.quote: Courage - a perfect sensibility of the measure of danger, and a mental willingness to endure it.
9700.name: William Tecumseh Sherman

9701.quote: If you are lucky enough to find a way of life you love, you have to find the courage to live it.
9701.name: John Irving

9702.quote: Courage is not the absence of despair it is, rather, the capacity to move ahead in spite of despair.
9702.name: Rollo May

9703.quote: Courage is being afraid but going on anyhow.
9703.name: Dan Rather

9704.quote: Clear thinking requires courage rather than intelligence.
9704.name: Thomas Szasz

9705.quote: People with courage and character always seem sinister to the rest.
9705.name: Hermann Hesse

9706.quote: Do not lose courage in considering your own imperfections.
9706.name: Saint Francis de Sales

9707.quote: The best protection any woman can have, is courage.
9707.name: Elizabeth Cady Stanton

9708.quote: The trials on the road to world harmony are no greater than the courage of those who accept the challenge.
9708.name: Carl Lewis

9709.quote: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
9709.name: Lao Tzu

9710.quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
9710.name: Winston Churchill

9711.quote: We gain strength, and courage, and confidence by each experience in which we really stop to look fear in the face, we must do that which we think we cannot.
9711.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

9712.quote: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
9712.name: Walt Disney

9713.quote: God grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.
9713.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

9714.quote: Mistakes are always forgivable, if one has the courage to admit them.
9714.name: Bruce Lee

9715.quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
9715.name: Maya Angelou

9716.quote: I, with a deeper instinct, choose a man who compels my strength, who makes enormous demands on me, who does not doubt my courage or my toughness, who does not believe me naive or innocent, who has the courage to treat me like a woman.
9716.name: Anais Nin

9717.quote: You have to accept whatever comes and the only important thing is that you meet it with courage and with the best that you have to give.
9717.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

9718.quote: Courage means to keep working a relationship, to continue seeking solutions to difficult problems, and to stay focused during stressful periods.
9718.name: Denis Waitley

9719.quote: History, despite its wrenching pain, cannot be unlived, but if faced with courage, need not be lived again.
9719.name: Maya Angelou

9720.quote: One isn't necessarily born with courage, but one is born with potential. Without courage, we cannot practice any other virtue with consistency. We can't be kind, true, merciful, generous, or honest.
9720.name: Maya Angelou

9721.quote: You don't develop courage by being happy in your relationships everyday. You develop it by surviving difficult times and challenging adversity.
9721.name: Epicurus

10241.quote: People don't follow titles, they follow courage.
10241.name: William Wells Brown

10242.quote: Moral courage is higher and a rarer virtue than physical courage.
10242.name: William Slim

10243.quote: Support the strong, give courage to the timid, remind the indifferent, and warn the opposed.
10243.name: Whitney M. Young

10244.quote: Greatness, in the last analysis, is largely bravery - courage in escaping from old ideas and old standards and respectable ways of doing things.
10244.name: James Robinson

10245.quote: I emphasize, that the Harrimans showed great courage and loyalty and confidence in us, because three or four of us were really running the business, the day to day business.
10245.name: Prescott Bush

10246.quote: Have the courage to face a difficulty lest it kick you harder than you bargain for.
10246.name: Stanislaus I

10247.quote: To him that waits all things reveal themselves, provided that he has the courage not to deny, in the darkness, what he has seen in the light.
10247.name: Coventry Patmore

10248.quote: There's no mystique to acting. It's only common sense - and a bit of courage.
10248.name: Bill Hunter

10249.quote: Resignation is the courage of Christian sorrow.
10249.name: Alexandre Vinet

10250.quote: There can be a fundamental gulf of gracelessness in a human heart which neither our love nor our courage can bridge.
10250.name: Patrick Campbell

10251.quote: I know that if I'd had to go and take an exam for acting, I wouldn't have got anywhere. You don't take exams for acting, you take your courage.
10251.name: Dame Edith Evans

10252.quote: You cannot build character and courage by taking away a man's initiative and independence.
10252.name: William Boetcker

10253.quote: I want to encourage our people, to educate our people to have the courage to understand and fight for their rights.
10253.name: Megawati Sukarnoputri

10254.quote: It is easier for a father to have children than for children to have a real father.
10254.name: Pope John XXIII

10255.quote: When one has not had a good father, one must create one.
10255.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

10256.quote: My father? I never knew him. Never even seen a picture of him.
10256.name: Eminem

10257.quote: I am not ashamed to say that no man I ever met was my father's equal, and I never loved any other man as much.
10257.name: Hedy Lamarr

10258.quote: Whoever does not have a good father should procure one.
10258.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

10259.quote: I made a decision when my father passed away that I was going to be who God made me to be and not try to preach like my father.
10259.name: Joel Osteen

10260.quote: I stopped loving my father a long time ago. What remained was the slavery to a pattern.
10260.name: Anais Nin

10261.quote: I just wish I could understand my father.
10261.name: Michael Jackson

10262.quote: I know that I will never find my father in any other man who comes into my life, because it is a void in my life that can only be filled by him.
10262.name: Halle Berry

10263.quote: Fathers are biological necessities, but social accidents.
10263.name: Margaret Mead

10264.quote: Sons have always a rebellious wish to be disillusioned by that which charmed their fathers.
10264.name: Aldous Huxley

10265.quote: The place of the father in the modern suburban family is a very small one, particularly if he plays golf.
10265.name: Bertrand Russell

10266.quote: My father was my teacher. But most importantly he was a great dad.
10266.name: Beau Bridges

10267.quote: The fundamental defect of fathers, in our competitive society, is that they want their children to be a credit to them.
10267.name: Bertrand Russell

10268.quote: I have never been a material girl. My father always told me never to love anything that cannot love you back.
10268.name: Imelda Marcos

10269.quote: Every parent is at some time the father of the unreturned prodigal, with nothing to do but keep his house open to hope.
10269.name: John Ciardi

10270.quote: Babies don't need fathers, but mothers do. Someone who is taking care of a baby needs to be taken care of.
10270.name: Amy Heckerling

10271.quote: A father is a man who expects his son to be as good a man as he meant to be.
10271.name: Frank A. Clark

10272.quote: All the learnin' my father paid for was a bit o' birch at one end and an alphabet at the other.
10272.name: George Eliot

10273.quote: Undeservedly you will atone for the sins of your fathers.
10273.name: Horace

10274.quote: I pressed my father's hand and told him I would protect his grave with my life. My father smiled and passed away to the spirit land.
10274.name: Chief Joseph

10275.quote: A father is always making his baby into a little woman. And when she is a woman he turns her back again.
10275.name: Enid Bagnold

10276.quote: It is much easier to become a father than to be one.
10276.name: Kent Nerburn

10277.quote: There's sometimes a weird benefit to having an alcoholic, violent father. He really motivated me in that I never wanted to be anything like him.
10277.name: Dean Koontz

10278.quote: My father was not a failure. After all, he was the father of a president of the United States.
10278.name: Harry S. Truman

10279.quote: I hope I am remembered by my children as a good father.
10279.name: Orson Scott Card

10280.quote: The child is father of the man.
10280.name: William Wordsworth

10281.quote: My father, had sharper eyes than the rest of our people.
10281.name: Chief Joseph

10282.quote: Being a father, being a friend, those are the things that make me feel successful.
10282.name: William Hurt

10283.quote: Dad was the only adult male I ever trusted.
10283.name: Michael Reagan

10284.quote: An angry father is most cruel towards himself.
10284.name: Publilius Syrus

10285.quote: There is too much fathering going on just now and there is no doubt about it fathers are depressing.
10285.name: Gertrude Stein

10286.quote: The time not to become a father is eighteen years before a war.
10286.name: E. B. White

10287.quote: My father taught me that the only way you can make good at anything is to practice, and then practice some more.
10287.name: Pete Rose

10288.quote: When I was 18, I thought my father was pretty dumb. After a while when I got to be 21, I was amazed to find out how much he'd learned in three years.
10288.name: Frank Butler

10289.quote: I kept my babies fed. I could have dumped them, but I didn't. I decided that whatever trip I was on, they were going with me. You're looking at a real daddy.
10289.name: Barry White

10290.quote: Whenever I fail as a father or husband, a toy and a diamond always works.
10290.name: Shahrukh Khan

10291.quote: Humor is always based on a modicum of truth. Have you ever heard a joke about a father-in-law?
10291.name: Dick Clark

10292.quote: It is impossible to please all the world and one's father.
10292.name: Jean de La Fontaine

10293.quote: A dramatic thing, the first time you stand up to your dad.
10293.name: Lenny Kravitz

10294.quote: A father's disappointment can be a very powerful tool.
10294.name: Michael Bergin

10295.quote: It was my father who taught me to value myself. He told me that I was uncommonly beautiful and that I was the most precious thing in his life.
10295.name: Dawn French

10296.quote: But the love of adventure was in father's blood.
10296.name: Buffalo Bill

10297.quote: I'm a father. It isn't just my life any more. I don't want my kid finding bottles in the house or seeing his father completely smashed.
10297.name: Billie Joe Armstrong

10298.quote: My father never raised his hand to any one of his children, except in self-defense.
10298.name: Fred Allen

10299.quote: I never had a speech from my father 'this is what you must do or shouldn't do' but I just learned to be led by example. My father wasn't perfect.
10299.name: Adam Sandler

10300.quote: I wanted to take up music, so my father bought me a blunt instrument. He told me to knock myself out.
10300.name: Jay London

10301.quote: My father wouldn't get us a TV, he wouldn't allow a TV in the house.
10301.name: Janis Joplin

10302.quote: The surprising thing about fatherhood was finding my inner mush. Now I want to share it with the world.
10302.name: Christopher Meloni

10303.quote: I inherited that calm from my father, who was a farmer. You sow, you wait for good or bad weather, you harvest, but working is something you always need to do.
10303.name: Miguel Indurain

10304.quote: The most important influence in my childhood was my father.
10304.name: DeForest Kelley

10305.quote: My father was grounded, a very meat-and-potatoes man. He was a baker.
10305.name: Anthony Hopkins

10306.quote: My father-in-law gets up at 5 o'clock in the morning and watches the Discovery Channel. I don't know why there's this big rush to do this.
10306.name: Jeff Foxworthy

10307.quote: Feels good to try, but playing a father, I'm getting a little older. I see now that I'm taking it more serious and I do want that lifestyle.
10307.name: Adam Sandler

10308.quote: I'm more comfortable with whatever's wrong with me than my father was whenever he felt he failed or didn't measure up to the standard he set.
10308.name: John Malkovich

10309.quote: I wasn't anything special as a father. But I loved them and they knew it.
10309.name: Jr. Sammy Davis

10310.quote: Watching your husband become a father is really sexy and wonderful.
10310.name: Cindy Crawford

10311.quote: Father or stepfather - those are just titles to me. They don't mean anything.
10311.name: Oliver Hudson

10312.quote: If my father had hugged me even once, I'd be an accountant right now.
10312.name: Ray Romano

10313.quote: What harsh judges fathers are to all young men!
10313.name: Terence

10314.quote: My father, he was like the rock, the guy you went to with every problem.
10314.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

10315.quote: My father wants me to be like my brother, but I can't be.
10315.name: Robert Mapplethorpe

10316.quote: I would never have done what I'd done if I'd considered my father as somebody I wanted to please.
10316.name: Robert Mapplethorpe

10317.quote: Nobody ever asks a father how he manages to combine marriage and a career.
10317.name: Sam Ewing

10318.quote: Father told me that if I ever met a lady in a dress like yours, I must look her straight in the eyes.
10318.name: Prince Charles

10319.quote: My father was the guy on the block who said hi to everyone.
10319.name: Damon Wayans

10320.quote: My grandfather, along with Carnegie, was a pioneer in philanthropy, which my father then practiced on a very large scale.
10320.name: David Rockefeller

10321.quote: I love the comic opportunities that come up in the context of a father-son relationship.
10321.name: Harrison Ford

10322.quote: I wanted to be a forest ranger or a coal man. At a very early age, I knew I didn't want to do what my dad did, which was work in an office.
10322.name: Harrison Ford

10323.quote: That is the thankless position of the father in the family - the provider for all, and the enemy of all.
10323.name: August Strindberg

10324.quote: As Daddy said, life is 95 percent anticipation.
10324.name: Gloria Swanson

10325.quote: I was raised by free-spirited people, though my father gave me a very strong work ethic.
10325.name: Diane Lane

10326.quote: As a little girl I used to daydream about my real father coming on a white horse to rescue me.
10326.name: Christine Keeler

10327.quote: Do you know that other than my father, I've never had a man take care of me?
10327.name: Dionne Warwick

10328.quote: Employee fathers need to step up to the plate and put their family needs on the table.
10328.name: James Levine

10329.quote: I love my dad, although I'm definitely critical of him sometimes, like when his pants are too tight. But I love him so much and I try to be really supportive of him.
10329.name: Liv Tyler

10330.quote: Child-rearing is my main interest now. I'm a hands-on father.
10330.name: Sean Penn

10331.quote: Because of my father, we are that Shining City on a Hill.
10331.name: Michael Reagan

10332.quote: No, I never thought about my father's money as my money.
10332.name: Christie Hefner

10333.quote: But I have to be careful not to let the world dazzle me so much that I forget that I'm a husband and a father.
10333.name: Herbie Hancock

10334.quote: I have always thought of Walt Disney as my second father.
10334.name: Annette Funicello

10335.quote: My father was never anti-anything in our house.
10335.name: Errol Flynn

10336.quote: Aeneas carried his aged father on his back from the ruins of Troy and so do we all, whether we like it or not, perhaps even if we have never known them.
10336.name: Angela Carter

10337.quote: One of my earliest memories is of my father carrying me in one arm with a picket sign in the other.
10337.name: Camryn Manheim

10338.quote: My father loved people, children and pets.
10338.name: Tony Visconti

10339.quote: My father was the most rational and the most dispassionate of men.
10339.name: Simon Newcomb

10340.quote: I grew up not liking my father very much. I never saw him cry. But he must have. Everybody cries.
10340.name: Charley Pride

10341.quote: My father taught me how to substitute realities.
10341.name: Mira Sorvino

10342.quote: My father and I have a very good relationship. We always got along. But I always scold him.
10342.name: Amy Sedaris

10343.quote: My dad taught me true words you have to use in every relationship. Yes, baby.
10343.name: Star Jones

10344.quote: I'm a fun father, but not a good father. The hard decisions always went to my wife.
10344.name: John Lithgow

10345.quote: Thirteen, 13 children, and I love - I love them all. And I think I've been a good father to all of them.
10345.name: Anthony Quinn

10346.quote: I was punished for blowing the whistle on my father's lifestyle.
10346.name: Tatum O'Neal

10347.quote: Fathers in today's modern families can be so many things.
10347.name: Oliver Hudson

10348.quote: My father invented a cure for which there was no disease and unfortunately my mother caught it and died of it.
10348.name: Victor Borge

10349.quote: So my father was a person who never lied to me. If I had a question, he answered it. I knew a lot of things at a young age because I was intrigued.
10349.name: Nick Cannon

10350.quote: My father was something of a rainbow-chaser.
10350.name: Marc Davis

10351.quote: My father was always telling himself no one was perfect, not even my mother.
10351.name: Broderick Crawford

10352.quote: The best money advice ever given me was from my father. When I was a little girl, he told me, 'Don't spend anything unless you have to.'
10352.name: Dinah Shore

10353.quote: My father was an Episcopalian minister, and I've always been comforted by the power of prayer.
10353.name: Anna Lee

10354.quote: When I was a kid, I used to imagine animals running under my bed. I told my dad, and he solved the problem quickly. He cut the legs off the bed.
10354.name: Lou Brock

10355.quote: Being a father to my family and a husband is to me much more important than what I did in the business.
10355.name: Tom Bosley

10356.quote: My dad always said, 'Don't worry what people think, because you can't change it.'
10356.name: Daisy Donovan

10357.quote: Rich men's sons are seldom rich men's fathers.
10357.name: Herbert Kaufman

10358.quote: When a father, absent during the day, returns home at six, his children receive only his temperament, not his teaching.
10358.name: Robert Bly

10359.quote: No man is responsible for his father. That was entirely his mother's affair.
10359.name: Margaret Turnbull

10360.quote: My brother Bob doesn't want to be in government - he promised Dad he'd go straight.
10360.name: John F. Kennedy

10361.quote: Dad, wherever you are, you are gone but you will never be forgotten.
10361.name: Conrad Hall

10362.quote: Dad almost died of a heart attack in the middle of making Apocalypse Now, the biggest movie of his life. It doesn't make you want to jump into that business.
10362.name: Charlie Sheen

10363.quote: Dad kept us out of school, but school comes and goes. Family is forever.
10363.name: Charlie Sheen

10364.quote: What is a normal childhood? We weren't rich, we were pretty middle-class. My dad survived from job to job with him taking care of so many relatives, he couldn't save any money.
10364.name: Charlie Sheen

10365.quote: Dad needs to show an incredible amount of respect and humor and friendship toward his mate so the kids understand their parents are sexy, they're fun, they do things together, they're best friends. Kids learn by example. If I respect Mom, they're going to respect Mom.
10365.name: Tim Allen

10366.quote: I like to think my dad was easygoing and kind, and I think some of those things have been passed down. I am like him in a sense of being positive and hopeful. He was compassionate, and I've got a lot of that in me as well.
10366.name: Joel Osteen

10367.quote: Mom and Dad were married 64 years. And if you wondered what their secret was, you could have asked the local florist - because every day Dad gave Mom a rose, which he put on her bedside table. That's how she found out what happened on the day my father died - she went looking for him because that morning, there was no rose.
10367.name: Mitt Romney

10368.quote: My mom and dad gave their kids the greatest gift of all - the gift of unconditional love. They cared deeply about who we would be, and much less about what we would do.
10368.name: Mitt Romney

10369.quote: My dad had a church of 90 people when I was born. It was just, over the years it continued to grow.
10369.name: Joel Osteen

10370.quote: I didn't try to copy my dad or fit into the pressure or the mold that everybody tried to make me fit into.
10370.name: Joel Osteen

10371.quote: I was built up from my dad more than anyone else.
10371.name: John Wooden

10372.quote: I'm not sure what the future holds but I do know that I'm going to be positive and not wake up feeling desperate. As my dad said 'Nic, it is what it is, it's not what it should have been, not what it could have been, it is what it is.'
10372.name: Nicole Kidman

10373.quote: I've told Billy if I ever caught him cheating, I wouldn't kill him because I love his children and they need a dad. But I would beat him up. I know where all of his sports injuries are.
10373.name: Angelina Jolie

10374.quote: My dad had been born in Mexico and his family had to leave during the Mexican revolution.
10374.name: Mitt Romney

10375.quote: You know, my dad served in the President's Cabinet after his time as a governor. He told me he enjoyed being governor a lot more. Now, I understand why. If I do my job well, I can make a difference in people's lives and I can help our children realize their dreams.
10375.name: Mitt Romney

10376.quote: When my mom ran for the Senate, my dad was there for her every step of the way. I can still hear her saying in her beautiful voice, 'Why should women have any less say than men, about the great decisions facing our nation?'
10376.name: Mitt Romney

10377.quote: Me and my dad are the biggest promoters of an estate tax in the US. It's not a popular position.
10377.name: Bill Gates

10378.quote: And my dad, you're a great actor but you're a better father.
10378.name: Angelina Jolie

10379.quote: I've got high standards when it comes to boys. As my dad says, all girls should! I'm from the South - Tennessee, to be exact - and down there, we're all about southern hospitality. I know that if I like a guy, he better be nice, and above all, my dad has to approve of him!
10379.name: Miley Cyrus

10380.quote: Don't forget Mother's Day. Or as they call it in Beverly Hills, Dad's Third Wife Day.
10380.name: Jay Leno

10381.quote: My father used to play with my brother and me in the yard. Mother would come out and say, 'You're tearing up the grass' 'We're not raising grass,' Dad would reply. 'We're raising boys.'
10381.name: Harmon Killebrew

10382.quote: When I was about 12 years old back in Houston, my Dad used to take us to the driving range.
10382.name: Ron White

10383.quote: My dad said to me growing up: 'When all is said and done, if you can count all your true friends on one hand, you're a lucky man.'
10383.name: Josh Charles

10384.quote: I think a dad has to make his daughter feel that he's genuinely interested in what she's going through.
10384.name: Jr. Harry Connick

10385.quote: Apparently, one in five people in the world are Chinese. And there are five people in my family, so it must be one of them. It's either my mum or my dad. Or my older brother, Colin. Or my younger brother, Ho-Chan-Chu. But I think it's Colin.
10385.name: Tim Vine

10386.quote: Don't force your kids into sports. I never was. To this day, my dad has never asked me to go play golf. I ask him. It's the child's desire to play that matters, not the parent's desire to have the child play. Fun. Keep it fun.
10386.name: Tiger Woods

10387.quote: It was my 16th birthday - my mom and dad gave me my Goya classical guitar that day. I sat down, wrote this song, and I just knew that that was the only thing I could ever really do - write songs and sing them to people.
10387.name: Stevie Nicks

10388.quote: Anyone can be a father, but it takes someone special to be a dad, and that's why I call you dad, because you are so special to me. You taught me the game and you taught me how to play it right.
10388.name: Wade Boggs
