10389.quote: My dad was like a stage mother he always pushed me to do what I wanted.
10389.name: Jim Carrey

10390.quote: One of the greatest titles in the world is parent, and one of the biggest blessings in the world is to have parents to call mom and dad.
10390.name: Jim DeMint

10391.quote: My dad encouraged us to fail. Growing up, he would ask us what we failed at that week. If we didn't have something, he would be disappointed. It changed my mindset at an early age that failure is not the outcome, failure is not trying. Don't be afraid to fail.
10391.name: Sara Blakely

10392.quote: My dad was my best friend and greatest role model. He was an amazing dad, coach, mentor, soldier, husband and friend.
10392.name: Tiger Woods

10393.quote: I never saw any of my dad's stories. My mother said he had piles and piles of manuscripts.
10393.name: Stephen King

10394.quote: My dad used to say, 'You wouldn't worry so much about what people thought about you if you knew how seldom they did.
10394.name: Phil McGraw

10395.quote: Dad taught me everything I know. Unfortunately, he didn't teach me everything he knows.
10395.name: Al Unser

10396.quote: All that really matters is I have two beautiful kids, and I'm trying to be the best dad I can possibly be, and that's the most important thing of all.
10396.name: Tiger Woods

10397.quote: I started out mopping floors, waiting tables, and tending bar at my dad's tavern. I put myself through school working odd jobs and night shifts. I poured my heart and soul into a small business. And when I saw how out-of-touch Washington had become with the core values of this great nation, I put my name forward and ran for office.
10397.name: John Boehner

10398.quote: I always wanted what Mom and Dad had.
10398.name: Kim Kardashian

10399.quote: My dad is still Christian Scientist. My mom's not, and I'm not. But I believe in God, and that there's a higher power and an intelligence that's bigger than us and that we can rely on. It's not just us, thinking we are the ones in control of everything. That idea gives me support.
10399.name: Ellen DeGeneres

10400.quote: Fortunately, as it pertains to guns, my dad and uncle introduced me to guns the way it needs to be done: smart, slow and safe.
10400.name: Ted Nugent

10401.quote: My dad raised me with some good advice: 'Always tell the truth. Always shoot from the hip. You might not have many friends, but you'll never have enemies, because people will always know where you're coming from.'
10401.name: Pink

10402.quote: My dad is a motorcycle guy, not some Hollywood dude.
10402.name: Shia LaBeouf

10403.quote: I feel lazy when I'm not working. I learned all my business sense from my dad. He always believed in me, and I think the last thing he said to me before he passed away was, 'I know you're gonna be OK. I'm not worried about you'.
10403.name: Kim Kardashian

10404.quote: My dad loves what I do and I support my parents financially because they didn't have a job that gave them a pension.
10404.name: Marilyn Manson

10405.quote: My dad, bless him, was a musician. And his dad had thought that his music was rubbish.
10405.name: Paul McCartney

10406.quote: I'm a pretty hands-on dad and make the most of my custody. I take care of my little one whenever I can, and she determines what I can do and where I can do it.
10406.name: Paul McCartney

10407.quote: And my dad drilled it in my head, you know, 'If you want it bad enough, and you're willing to make the sacrifices, you can do it. But first you have to believe in yourself.
10407.name: Jennie Finch

10408.quote: But there's no substitute for a full-time dad. Dads who are fully engaged with their kids overwhelmingly tend to produce children who believe in themselves and live full lives.
10408.name: Tony Dungy

10409.quote: I think I've got my business notions and my sense for that sort of thing from my dad. My dad never had a chance to go to school. He couldn't read and write. But he was so smart. He was just one of those people that could just make the most of anything and everything that he had to work with.
10409.name: Dolly Parton

10410.quote: When I was younger, my family would go camping and fishing on our ranches. My dad loves being around all kinds of animals. He's the one who got me to be a really big animal lover.
10410.name: Paris Hilton

10411.quote: Where I come from, you don't really talk about how much you're earning. Those things are private. My dad never told my mum how much he was earning. I'm certainly not going to tell the world. I'm doing well.
10411.name: Paul McCartney

10412.quote: My dad was a particularly polite kind of guy, very courteous.
10412.name: Paul McCartney

10413.quote: Looking back, I think I was always musical. My dad was very musical, and I think my mom was musical.
10413.name: Paul McCartney

10414.quote: I'm very at ease, and I like it. I never thought I would be such a family-oriented guy I didn't think that was part of my makeup. But somebody said that as you get older you become the person you always should have been, and I feel that's happening to me. I'm rather surprised at who I am, because I'm actually like my dad!
10414.name: David Bowie

10415.quote: I get that same queasy, nervous, thrilling feeling every time I go to work. That's never worn off since I was 12 years-old with my dad's 8-millimeter movie camera.
10415.name: Steven Spielberg

10416.quote: My dad took me to my first movie.
10416.name: Steven Spielberg

10417.quote: And I saw the sax line-up that he had behind him and I thought, I'm going to learn the saxophone. When I grow up, I'm going to play in his band. So I sort of persuaded my dad to get me a kind of a plastic saxophone on the hire purchase plan.
10417.name: David Bowie

10418.quote: I love being a dad. I just love it.
10418.name: Jerry Seinfeld

10419.quote: My dad was the town drunk. Most of the time that's not so bad but New York City?
10419.name: Henny Youngman

10420.quote: I wanted to be a skinny little ballerina but I was a voluptuous little Italian girl whose dad had meatballs on the table every night.
10420.name: Lady Gaga

10421.quote: My dad became a soap opera actor, and I was an extra in a skating rink scene on the soap. I didn't audition. It was nepotism all the way.
10421.name: Jennifer Aniston

10422.quote: My dad was good with actions.
10422.name: William Shatner

10423.quote: My dad died of a stroke.
10423.name: William Shatner

10424.quote: There is nothing that would upset me more than my dad being bribed by the press. It's like, 'Just let them run it, then. Don't you give them ammunition.'
10424.name: Adele

10425.quote: I have never been jealous. Not even when my dad finished fifth grade a year before I did.
10425.name: Jeff Foxworthy

10426.quote: I asked my daughter when she was 16, What's the buzz on the street with the kids? She's going, to be honest, Dad, most of my friends aren't into Kiss. But they've all been told that it's the greatest show on Earth.
10426.name: Ace Frehley

10427.quote: I'm a dad, I'm a husband, I'm an activist, I'm a writer and I'm just a student of the world.
10427.name: Michael J. Fox

10428.quote: My Dad, a small-town lawyer, was also named Paul. Until we lost him when I was 16, he was a gentle presence in my life. I like to think he'd be proud of me and my sister and brothers, because I'm sure proud of him and of where I come from, Janesville, Wisconsin.
10428.name: Paul Ryan

10429.quote: Mom was 50 when my Dad died. She got on a bus every weekday for years, and rode 40 miles each morning to Madison. She earned a new degree and learned new skills to start her small business. It wasn't just a new livelihood. It was a new life.
10429.name: Paul Ryan

10430.quote: My mother raised three children on her own and my dad was a doctor working 16 hours a day.
10430.name: Christopher Meloni

10431.quote: Studies show that children best flourish when one mom and one dad are there to raise them.
10431.name: John Boehner

10432.quote: As my dad said, you have an obligation to leave the world better than how you found it. And he also reminded us to be givers in this life, and not takers.
10432.name: Phil Crane

10433.quote: You see another side of Draco when he's with his dad. When Draco is with his dad, he doesn't say anything. He keeps his mouth shut. He's sort of bullied by his dad, so he acts very different.
10433.name: Tom Felton

10434.quote: I mean, I look at my dad. He was twenty when he started having a family, and he was always the coolest dad. He did everything for his kids, and he never made us feel like he was pressured. I know that it must be a great feeling to be a guy like that.
10434.name: Adam Sandler

10435.quote: I was in the bath at the time, and my dad came running in and said, 'Guess who they want to play Harry Potter!?' and I started to cry. It was probably the best moment of my life.
10435.name: Daniel Radcliffe

10436.quote: Working with my dad was such a gas. We approached the work in a similar way. We only made two films together when I was an adult, Tucker, and Blown Away, but it was so much fun to play with your parent like that.
10436.name: Jeff Bridges

10437.quote: For me, growing up, the downside of it was that as a kid you don't want to stand out. You don't want to have a famous father let alone get a job because of your famous father, you know? But I'm a product of nepotism. That's how I got my foot in the door, through my dad.
10437.name: Jeff Bridges

10438.quote: Great dad. Yeah, he would ask me for money on birthdays and, you know, inappropriate times. And I just wrote him off like, 'You're not a father.' I just learned you cannot emotionally invest in people who are not attainable.
10438.name: Drew Barrymore

10439.quote: Now I meditate twice a day for half an hour. In meditation, I can let go of everything. I'm not Hugh Jackman. I'm not a dad. I'm not a husband. I'm just dipping into that powerful source that creates everything. I take a little bath in it.
10439.name: Hugh Jackman

10440.quote: One afternoon when I was 9, my dad told me I'd be skipping school the next day. Then we drove 12 hours from Melbourne to Sydney for the Centenary Test, a once-in-a-lifetime commemorative cricket match. It was great fun - especially for a kid who was a massive sports fan.
10440.name: Hugh Jackman

10441.quote: I don't know, I just want to be happy. I could be in a hole somewhere. Or I could completely lose it and be some hippy living in the woods with my dad.
10441.name: Shia LaBeouf

10442.quote: I didn't know my dad for a long time. My dad was on drugs and my dad was at the VA Hospital, my dad was off in his own world selling drugs or using them or there would be crack heads in the house or whatever it would be.
10442.name: Shia LaBeouf

10443.quote: My parents were working class folks. My dad was a bartender for most of his life, my mom was a maid and a cashier and a stock clerk at WalMart. We were not people of financial means in terms of significant financial means. I always told them, 'I didn't always have what I wanted. I always had what I needed.' My parents always provided that.
10443.name: Marco Rubio

10444.quote: My dad was a bartender. My mom was a cashier, a maid and a stock clerk at K-Mart. They never made it big. They were never rich. And yet they were successful. Because just a few decades removed from hopelessness, they made possible for us all the things that had been impossible for them.
10444.name: Marco Rubio

10445.quote: Without my dad, I wouldn't be here.
10445.name: Maria Sharapova

10446.quote: My dad played fiddle as well.
10446.name: Robert Plant

10447.quote: I want to be a young dad. By 25 or 26 I want to see myself, like, married or start looking for a family.
10447.name: Justin Bieber

10448.quote: When I was younger, I had a perm, and it was really big. My mom was a hairdresser, so even my dad had a perm! I looked like a poodle, but it was cool at the time.
10448.name: Heidi Klum

10449.quote: My friends say, 'Man you're going to have kids sleeping on pillowcases with your face on it! You're going to be on toothbrushes and magnets and stuff.' I guess now that I'm a dad, I'm thrilled about that.
10449.name: Hugh Jackman

10450.quote: My kids are not that interested in my movie career, by the way. My son, in particular, never talks about it. He just wants me as his dad.
10450.name: Hugh Jackman

10451.quote: I've never heard my dad say a bad word about anybody. He always keeps his emotions in check and is a true gentleman. I was taught that losing it was indulgent, a selfish act.
10451.name: Hugh Jackman

10452.quote: Now my dad is with me, traveling with me and a big part of this whole thing is I like to mix it up a little bit, you know. Who gets to take their father on a private jet across the country and stay in first class hotels? So we're enjoying it, but I'd stop if it's not possible.
10452.name: Shia LaBeouf

10453.quote: My dad used to say, 'Just because you dress up in a coat and tie, it doesn't influence your intelligence.'
10453.name: Tiger Woods

10454.quote: My Dad used to tell us: 'En este pais, ustedes van a poder lograr todas las cosas que nosotros no pudimos' 'In this country, you will be able to accomplish all the things we never could.'
10454.name: Marco Rubio

10455.quote: My dad, he is such a soft man. Even if he has these opinions about my boyfriends, he will be the sweetest guy. He will make you feel like you're fascinating and awesome, even if he doesn't like you that much.
10455.name: Amanda Seyfried

10456.quote: I'm not a religious person. My mom was of Jewish blood and my dad was Protestant.
10456.name: Daniel Radcliffe

10457.quote: My dad believes in God, I think. I'm not sure if my mom does. I don't.
10457.name: Daniel Radcliffe

10458.quote: My dad's got a brilliant eye for scripts 'cos he's a literary agent. He and my agent read a load of scripts and filter them.
10458.name: Daniel Radcliffe

10459.quote: Joanna points her camera at a section of society unused to having cameras pointed at it. But I don't know about categorizing them in terms of class I'm a bit wary of that. My dad is the son of a shipbuilder.
10459.name: Tom Hiddleston

10460.quote: It's an ongoing joy being a dad.
10460.name: Liam Neeson

10461.quote: My dad would give me $10, which is a lot of money when you're 9, to sing at church, on tables at restaurants, at family functions, just about anywhere.
10461.name: Katy Perry

10462.quote: I forgive my mom for being a psycho and my dad for being a loser.
10462.name: Nikki Sixx

10463.quote: It is a sad commentary of our times when our young must seek advice and counsel from 'Dear Abby' instead of going to Mom and Dad.
10463.name: Abigail Van Buren

10464.quote: There are absolutely no problems between me, my dad and my sister. Obviously I grew up with just my mum, but my relationship with my dad is just fine.
10464.name: Norah Jones

10465.quote: I try to be a hard boiled sometimes. My kids see right through it. I'm acting. It's always, 'When I say you'll be back at 11, that means 11, not 11.15. Do you hear me!?' Then, 'Yeah, Dad.'
10465.name: Liam Neeson

10466.quote: My grandfather and my uncle both died from colorectal cancer, my dad almost died from it and I have the gene for it.
10466.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

10467.quote: A father and two sons run Adelphia. It's a cable company. And they took from that company a billion dollars. A billion. Three people - three people took a billion dollars. What were they gonna do, start their own space program? 'Let's send the monkey to Mars, Dad!'
10467.name: Lewis Black

10468.quote: One of the scary things is that, when you're a kid, you look at your dad as the man who has no fear. When you're an adult, you realize your father had fear, and that you have it, too.
10468.name: David Duchovny

10469.quote: I'm just a pretty regular dad.
10469.name: Ang Lee

10470.quote: I think my dad is a lot cooler than other dads. He still acts like he's still 17.
10470.name: Miley Cyrus

10471.quote: My dad says I could sing before I could talk, if that's possible. I was always humming and things like that.
10471.name: Miley Cyrus

10472.quote: I once said to my father, when I was a boy, 'Dad we need a third political party.' He said to me, 'I'll settle for a second.'
10472.name: Ralph Nader

10473.quote: My Dad was my biggest supporter. He never put pressure on me.
10473.name: Bobby Orr

10474.quote: My dad always used to tell me that if they challenge you to an after-school fight, tell them you won't wait-you can kick their ass right now.
10474.name: Cameron Diaz

10475.quote: I'm a dad, and I no longer see a way for my kids to even inherit the money that I'm making, let alone go out there, have an idea, and create it in their own lifetime.
10475.name: Glenn Beck

10476.quote: I like all the angels around because they protect me and my daughter. I mean, her Dad's an angel.
10476.name: Courtney Love

10477.quote: My dad never blew anything up, but he probably had friends who did. He and my mom have always preached that the pen is mightier than a Molotov cocktail.
10477.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

10478.quote: Overcoming my dad telling me that I could never amount to anything is what has made me the megalomaniac that you see today.
10478.name: Bono

10479.quote: Going to the theater is such a joyous experience. My dad would take my sister and me to plays when we were very young, like six or seven years old.
10479.name: Julia Roberts

10480.quote: My dad's a beautiful man, but like a lot of Mexican men, or men in general, a lot of men have a problem with the balance of masculinity and femininity - intuition and compassion and tenderness - and get overboard with the macho thing. It took him a while to become more, I would say, conscious, evolved.
10480.name: Carlos Santana

10482.quote: I can definitely say the older I've got the better I've become at being a dad and a husband.
10482.name: Rod Stewart

10483.quote: My dad always said, 'Champ, the measure of a man is not how often he is knocked down, but how quickly he gets up.'
10483.name: Joe Biden

10484.quote: I was a mixture of being incredibly old for my age and incredibly backwards. I was born quite old, but then I stopped growing. I lived with my mum and dad till I was 30.
10484.name: Helena Bonham Carter

10485.quote: I'm turning into a stricter dad.
10485.name: David Duchovny

10486.quote: I have four shelves covered with journals that I've written. Dad and I are writing songs together. I've probably written 100 songs.
10486.name: Miley Cyrus

10487.quote: I probably have an earlier curfew than anyone. My mom wants to keep me really safe and my dad's not overly protective, but he's a dad no matter what.
10487.name: Miley Cyrus

10488.quote: I don't really know any other musicians like me. I grew up backstage with my dad who played in a post-war dance band, so I always feel at home at a venue.
10488.name: Pete Townshend

10489.quote: I love my dad and we have a very good relationship now.
10489.name: Norah Jones

10490.quote: I'm the whitest guy you will ever meet. The first time I saw an African-American, my dad had to tell me to stop staring.
10490.name: Glenn Beck

10491.quote: When I was little, we had a Golden Book that had all these Disney characters in one portrait on the first page. My dad used to read from it every night. We'd play this game of find Pluto or find Donald Duck. He'd read us stories and do all the voices. Those are great memories.
10491.name: Danica McKellar

10492.quote: Most children - I know I did when I was a kid - fantasize another set of parents. Or fantasize no parents. They don't tell their real parents about that - you don't want to tell Mom and Dad. Kids lead a very private life. And I was a typical child, I think. I was a liar.
10492.name: Maurice Sendak

10493.quote: Most children - I know I did when I was a kid - fantasize another set of parents. Or fantasize no parents. They don't tell their real parents about that - you don't want to tell Mom and Dad.
10493.name: Maurice Sendak

10494.quote: My Dad is my hero. He's 85 now and he is in great health. He is handsome and strong. He has an incredible moral and ethical backbone. I couldn't have been luckier with my parents.
10494.name: Jr. Harry Connick

10495.quote: My dad was the district attorney of New Orleans for about 30 years. And when he opened his campaign headquarters back in the early '70s, when I was 5 years old, my mother wanted me to play the national anthem. And they got an upright piano on the back of a flatbed truck and I played it.
10495.name: Jr. Harry Connick

10496.quote: My dad and mom believed that you do what you have to do in private and don't make a big deal out of it. Just try to help people as much as you can.
10496.name: Jr. Harry Connick

10497.quote: Well, my dad was the district attorney of New Orleans for about 30 years.
10497.name: Jr. Harry Connick

10498.quote: What I do now is all my dad's fault, because he bought me a guitar as a boy, for no apparent reason.
10498.name: Rod Stewart

10499.quote: My dad bought me a guitar and people would ask me to play.
10499.name: Rod Stewart

10500.quote: I shouldn't have got married. My dad told me. I was 35 and I got married. He said, 'You're too young to be married'. 'What? I'm 35'. Said, 'You're far too young. You haven't lived yet'. He was right, bless him, thanks, Dad.
10500.name: Rod Stewart

10501.quote: My dad is a Deadhead, my mom's a Jewish-American princess from Jersey.
10501.name: Adam Lambert

10502.quote: My mom was a waitress, and my dad was a plumber who worked for the City of San Clemente fixing mains breaks, so not too glamorous.
10502.name: Shaun White

10504.quote: My dad got me a huge board when I was little. He loves to surf. He suited me up and sent me out on this huge wave. I went under, and when I came out and the board hit me in the face. So I said, I never wanted to do this again. I stayed away until I was 13.
10504.name: Shaun White

10505.quote: We all started snowboarding in the beginning as a family just to be closer together, go on trips. It was our soccer, but instead of Dad yelling at me from the sideline he is there riding with me and hitting the jumps even before I am hitting them.
10505.name: Shaun White

10506.quote: From 1965 to 1967, my dad, Jack Gilligan, served in Congress and helped pass landmark laws like the Voting Rights Act.
10506.name: Kathleen Sebelius

10507.quote: My dad always tell me to make decisions from love and not from fear.
10507.name: Rashida Jones

10508.quote: My dad takes care of me as a manager and as a dad. That's his job, you know, to take care of me. He has my best interests at heart.
10508.name: Jessica Simpson

10509.quote: I can talk to my dad like he's my manager, and put 'Dad' on the back burner. We've been doing it since I was 13.
10509.name: Jessica Simpson

10510.quote: My dad's a doctor, and when I was 8, I went to one of his medical conferences where they were demonstrating laser surgery on a chicken. I was so mad that a chicken had to die, I never ate meat again.
10510.name: Natalie Portman

10511.quote: When I was in nursery school, the teachers asked me, y'know, 'What does your dad do for a living?' So I said 'He helps women get pregnant!' They called my mom and they were like, 'What exactly does your husband do?'
10511.name: Natalie Portman

10512.quote: You always hear people saying, 'I hope I'm not turning into my dad', but I'd be honoured if I became half as decent a bloke as he is.
10512.name: Johnny Vegas

10513.quote: I came back from university thinking I knew all about politics and racism, not knowing my dad had been one of the youngest-serving Labour councillors in the town and had refused to work in South Africa years ago because of the situation there. And he's never mentioned it - you just find out. That's a real man to me. A sleeping lion.
10513.name: Johnny Vegas

10514.quote: I wanted to be a mechanic. When I was 14 I wanted to quit school and go work on my car. But my dad said Son, you shouldn't do that. You should stay in school until your education is finished, and when you're done, don't make your hobby your job.
10514.name: Eric Bana

10515.quote: My dad taught me from my youngest childhood memories through these connections with Aboriginal and tribal people that you must always protect people's sacred status, regardless of the pest.
10515.name: Steve Irwin

10516.quote: I haven't been baptised. My dad's not in the church and is not a religious person. My mum is more spiritual - she does Thai-chi and goes to Stonehenge and things like that. I'm proud to be pagan. Finland is not really a religious country. I'm still looking for my god.
10516.name: Ville Valo

10517.quote: My dad was a Methodist minister.
10517.name: George McGovern

10518.quote: The problem with me, as far as getting married and having a family, is that my comedy is so important to me. So I don't know if I'll ever be as good a dad as my dad.
10518.name: Adam Sandler

10519.quote: But my dad also was a remarkable man, a good person, a principled individual, a man of integrity.
10519.name: Sidney Poitier

10520.quote: My dad was a militant atheist, or is a militant atheist. My mum was sort of bought up in a religious family because she was a Protestant from Ireland but wasn't especially religious.
10520.name: Tony Blair

10521.quote: My dad had a commercial film company, so he had a videotape player before anyone. So he got Mel Brooks movies or Citizen Kane or some classic old movies. And every summer the revival house in Evanston would show the great films from the '50s and '60s and '70s.
10521.name: John Cusack

10522.quote: I go off and make movies I come home, and I'm a dad and I hang with my girls.
10522.name: Clive Owen

10523.quote: They have had such a crazy life living with me as their dad. Not crazy but different from their friends.
10523.name: Sebastian Bach

10524.quote: Yeah, my dad bought me a guitar when I was like 10, and I didn't really want it then.
10524.name: Miranda Lambert

10525.quote: I've dated all kinds of guys and didn't know who I'd end up with. But I kind of assumed it would be someone more like my dad than not.
10525.name: Miranda Lambert

10526.quote: My dad's whole family is in Madras and I was born in America so we didn't have that big Indian community. I don't really have anything interesting to say about it. When I talk about it people are like, 'meh, let's talk about something else.'
10526.name: Mindy Kaling

10527.quote: I have to remind my dad, 'Journalists - no matter how many cigars they smoke with you - are not your friends, so don't talk to them.'
10527.name: Cameron Diaz

10528.quote: I like to believe that I've got a lot of guardian warriors sittin' on my shoulder including my dad.
10528.name: Patrick Swayze

10529.quote: I used to say, 'Man, I think I'd be a really good dad. I'll be a great provider. I'm funny I'll go on trips with them - I'll do all sorts of stuff.' But the momming? I'm not made for that. I have a really good mom I know what she put into it.
10529.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

10530.quote: My dad's probably one of the kindest people in the world. When I was younger that's not how I was- I was a little spoiled brat.
10530.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

10531.quote: I spent a lot of time on farms when I was young. My uncle and my dad owned a big farm.
10531.name: Emeril Lagasse

10532.quote: I have this complex. I don't like too much exposure. I don't know why it is. Maybe it's bred in me, because my dad always told me to be humble and don't think you're too good.
10532.name: Mark Viduka

10533.quote: And of course I've got kids of my own now, and they love me being in the Harry Potter films. I'm now part of a phenomenon. You become incredibly cool to your kids, and you get a young fan base. So you became the cool dad at school. You're suddenly hip.
10533.name: Gary Oldman

10534.quote: My humanitarian work evolved from being with my family. My mom, my dad, they really set a great example for giving back. My mom was a nurse, my dad was a school teacher. But my mom did a lot of things for geriatrics and elderly people. She would do home visits for free.
10534.name: Cat Cora

10535.quote: It wasn't like I was self-motivated. My dad started me. It was his dream before it was mine.
10535.name: Venus Williams

10536.quote: I'm always on the court with my dad.
10536.name: Venus Williams

10537.quote: You get to a certain age and you can't judge yourself on your dad or your parents.
10537.name: Ellie Goulding

10538.quote: Not much shocked me. You know, I worked in a home for Alzheimer's patients and my dad used to be really into murders and stuff, so I saw dead bodies. It desensitised me to a lot of things.
10538.name: Ellie Goulding

10539.quote: The only day I remember of my parents' marriage was the day my dad walked out. As I stood there at five years old, with my older sister and younger brother, I knew that he was gone.
10539.name: Ellie Goulding

10540.quote: My dad was a homicide cop in the gay neighborhood in the city when gay neighborhoods were desperate, depressing, sad places run by the mob. The only gay people he'd met when I came out to him were corpses.
10540.name: Dan Savage

10541.quote: But while mum and dad were incredibly caring, it was also a very chaotic household where everyone fought about everything. So I know what it's like to internalize all that chaos.
10541.name: Dave Eggers

10542.quote: My dad was diagnosed with cancer, so we ended up burying him a year to the day that he was diagnosed.
10542.name: Seann William Scott

10543.quote: My role model is my dad.
10543.name: Seann William Scott

10544.quote: My dad liked to boil a squirrel head and suck the brains out the nose. Smaller than a chicken, bigger than a rat.
10544.name: Beth Ditto

10545.quote: My mother told me Homer Ditto was not my father. Nope. Mom had had a fling with some other guy who was my dad. Some dude who didn't stick around too long who Mom was happy to get rid of. She chose Homer, and Homer chose me, so he lent me his name even though I didn't have his blood.
10545.name: Beth Ditto

10546.quote: If my Dad doesn't like you, you will know. My Mom is just too innocent to ever lie. She doesn't even cuss.
10546.name: Channing Tatum

10547.quote: My father was so good-natured and had such a happy disposition. I've always confused him with Jimmy Stewart. So, think Jimmy Stewart. That's my dad.
10547.name: Jane Pauley

10548.quote: I am quite strict as a dad but I don't want to be censorious.
10548.name: Nick Clegg

10549.quote: My dad's side of the family had lots of artists and musicians. There's an emotional, quite sentimental quality to Slavic culture. It's very open, it loves art, it loves music, it loves literature. It's very warm, it's very up, it's very down. I would celebrate that.
10549.name: Nick Clegg

10550.quote: I say this as a young dad seeing children going into primary school: I don't think we should underestimate the formative effect on a child of those first years in primary school.
10550.name: Nick Clegg

10551.quote: When I was really little I would sit in the back of my dad's car when he'd be playing old-school music. He'd turn down the music and turn around and I'd be singing and know all of the words but I didn't even know how to talk. From then on I've always wanted to be a singer.
10551.name: Leona Lewis

10552.quote: I do love a bit of fashion. I grew up around a lot of it as my mum and dad had clothing stores so my mum was always designing a lot, and I definitely had that as an influence.
10552.name: Leona Lewis

10553.quote: My dad is such a good man. You know how when you are a child you think your dad is invincible? Well, I still think that - he is so wise and everything I do I ask my dad's advice about first.
10553.name: Leona Lewis

10554.quote: I feel like I've lived quite a sheltered life, like my mom and dad were quite protective of me.
10554.name: Leona Lewis

10555.quote: My dad was just a big Joseph Campbell nut.
10555.name: Trey Parker

10556.quote: I bought a house for my mom, I bought a house for my dad, I bought a house for my sister.
10556.name: Trey Parker

10557.quote: I watched Italia '90 with my Mum and Dad and my brother, you know, leaping around the house when the penalties were on, It would be great to be part of that, to have that kind of impact.
10557.name: Steven Gerrard

10558.quote: I'm not an American, but I have this weird connection to America in different ways through my dad living here for five years, my godfather being an American who I'm very close to.
10558.name: Damian Lewis

10559.quote: My dad was a baggage handler at Heathrow and careful with money. He worked hard and had three jobs when I was young. I wish I'd inherited his care for money. Sadly, I've grown up to be rather scatty when it comes to finances.
10559.name: Gary Numan

10560.quote: Before breaking into music, I had various jobs: forklift driver, driving a courier. But I was forced into working rather than doing it off my own bat because that was my dad's way: you got a job and paid your way.
10560.name: Gary Numan

10561.quote: I have one brother, John, an airline pilot, who is seven years younger. He's adopted, though we're still blood related - he's my cousin. My parents couldn't have any more children after me, so when Dad's brother died, they adopted John, then just a baby.
10561.name: Gary Numan

10562.quote: I met Gemma, my wife, when she was 12. She had a schoolgirl crush on me and her dad had arranged for her to meet me. Later, she started coming to my concerts, but I only got to know her well after her mother died. I rang to see how she was, and that's how it started.
10562.name: Gary Numan

10563.quote: My dad is like a cactus - introverted and tough. I'm a people person, like my mom, but I got my competitiveness from my dad. He came to this country from Belarus with nothing and built a real business. He's my hero for giving me that need to run a business and for having enormous confidence in me.
10563.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

10564.quote: I'm concerned a little bit with the culture of celebrating the fundraise. My dad taught me that when you borrow money it's the worst day of your life.
10564.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

10565.quote: You have to respect your parents. They are giving you an at-bat. If you're an entrepreneur and go into the family business, you want to grow fast. Patience is important. But respect the other party, My dad and I pulled it off because we really respect each other.
10565.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

10566.quote: People who build family businesses are not classically trained. They have to deal with an enormous amount of politics. You think corporate politics are tough? Go work for your dad or your mom.
10566.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

10567.quote: My parents were kind of over protective people. Me and my sister had to play in the backyard all the time. They bought us bikes for Christmas but wouldn't let us ride in the street, we had to ride in the backyard. Another Christmas, my dad got me a basketball hoop and put it in the middle of the lawn! You can't dribble on grass.
10567.name: Jimmy Fallon

10568.quote: My mom grew up in poverty in Oklahoma - like Dust Bowl, nine people in one room kind of place - and the way she got out of poverty was through education. My dad grew up without a dad, with very little and he also made his way out through education.
10568.name: Jennifer Garner

10569.quote: I am lucky to have had an attentive, curious and loving dad and heart-smart, down-to-earth, gifted mother. They changed the outlooks of their own lives and have never forgotten the people and organizations that helped them dream bigger than their circumstances should have allowed.
10569.name: Jennifer Garner

10570.quote: My dad and my uncles owned a bar outside of Cincinnati. I worked there growing up, mopping floors, waiting tables.
10570.name: John Boehner

10571.quote: My hat was pulled down and this girl said 'Are you really him?' I whispered 'Yeah, I'm really him.' She screamed, 'Mom! Dad! It's Heath Ledger!
10571.name: Josh Hartnett

10572.quote: My dad works in child protection and he's spent many, many years in that line of work.
10572.name: Chris Hemsworth

10573.quote: At one point my dad called me and said, 'You have always been a great salesman. I think it's time you come home and sell swimming pools.'
10573.name: Courteney Cox

10574.quote: You know, my mother's beautiful, my dad was a really handsome man, and there was a lot of talk about looks when I was growing up.
10574.name: Courteney Cox

10575.quote: I mean, my dad's a television producer, and I knew I could get a job as an assistant or a reader with one of his friends, but it wasn't exactly what I wanted to do.
10575.name: J. J. Abrams

10576.quote: My dad had this philosophy that if you tell children they're beautiful and wonderful then they believe it, and they will be. So I never thought I was unattractive. But I was never one of the girls at school who had lots of boyfriends.
10576.name: Emily Mortimer

10577.quote: It's a complex relationship when your dad happened to be president and you are president and then you have all the amateur psychology that goes on when people try to speculate about motivations.
10577.name: Jeb Bush

10578.quote: My guess is my brother would call his mom and his dad pretty regularly, a lot more than I probably did.
10578.name: Jeb Bush

10579.quote: I'm lucky because my dad taught me to be frugal and save. And that's important because I want to know that I don't have to take an acting job for two or three years if I don't want to and that I'll still be able to make my house and car payments and buy food for my dogs.
10579.name: Ashley Greene

10580.quote: My mom and dad just loved the fact that I fooled around. They just embraced it. They'd always kind of enjoy it, and they liked it when I made them laugh.
10580.name: Dominic Monaghan

10581.quote: Often as a child you see someone with a learning disability or Down's Syndrome and my mum and dad were always very quick to explain exactly what was going on and to be in their own way inclusive and welcoming.
10581.name: Christopher Eccleston

10582.quote: When I started writing, I did have some idealised notion of my dad as a writer. But I have less and less of a literary rivalry with him as I've gone on. I certainly don't feel I need his approval, although maybe that's because I'm confident that I've got it.
10582.name: Paul Theroux

10583.quote: It was, you know, probably 80 degrees out in L.A., and my dad took me outside and there was snow. At the time, I thought, 'Every kid doesn't have snow in their backyard on Christmas?'
10583.name: Tori Spelling

10584.quote: I'd like to play Matt Damon's daddy. He's a wonderful actor, I really admire him, and I'd like to play his dad one day.
10584.name: Larry Hagman

10585.quote: The one thing that kept our family together was the music. The only thing that our family would share emotionally was to have our dad cry over something the kids did with music.
10585.name: Dennis Wilson

10586.quote: I am the granddaughter of a Welsh coal miner who was determined that his kids get out of the mines. My dad got his first job when he was six years old, in a little village in Wales called Nantyffyllon, cleaning bottles at the Colliers Arms.
10586.name: Ann Romney

10587.quote: It's just really making sure I am doing the best job I can do as a dad. I do think that is my No. 1 job.
10587.name: Tony Dungy

10588.quote: My dad read the Bible ten times, and I want to do it in my lifetime. But it's definitely tough getting through.
10588.name: Pamela Anderson

10589.quote: My Dad was from Liverpool, and he picked it up in the army. He'd often come out with this stuff.
10589.name: Mike Myers

10590.quote: My dad loved to laugh. He was very funny and very silly.
10590.name: Mike Myers

10591.quote: My dad sold encyclopedias and my mom worked in a factory office.
10591.name: Mike Myers

10592.quote: My mother always taught me, even my dad, just never let other people's opinions of you shape your opinion of yourself. And I never have and I never will.
10592.name: Ruben Studdard

10593.quote: I loved climbing because of the freedom, and having time and space. I remember coming off Everest for the last time, thinking of Dad and wishing that he could have seen what I saw. He would have loved it.
10593.name: Bear Grylls

10594.quote: Becoming a dad means you have to be a role model for your son and be someone he can look up to.
10594.name: Wayne Rooney

10595.quote: I was lucky to have my dad in my life. As crazy as things got, I always had him to put his hand on my shoulder.
10595.name: Sharon Stone

10596.quote: Within our culture, every school has a swimming pool. We lived on the coast. People swam in the surf. It's a very sporty nation and at that particular time anyone who had an artistic bent was very much an outsider. So if you liked reading or ideas or playing the piano then your dad viewed you as a sissy, basically.
10596.name: Geoffrey Rush

10597.quote: My dad always taught me to never be satisfied, to want more and know that what is done is done.
10597.name: Thierry Henry

10598.quote: So much of my aesthetic was formed by my dad.
10598.name: Ron Perlman

10599.quote: My dad wanted to name me after Rainier Maria Rilke, the poet.
10599.name: Rainn Wilson

10600.quote: My dad was always such a frustrated artist. He always worked very hard to support his family, doing a bunch of ridiculous jobs. He wanted to be a painter, but then he also wrote science-fiction novels in his spare time.
10600.name: Rainn Wilson

10601.quote: The founder of the Mona Foundation actually knew my dad for years, and the more I learned about it, the more I realized I really found the perfect charity. It sponsors schools and educational initiatives all over the planet.
10601.name: Rainn Wilson

10602.quote: I had bohemian parents in Seattle in the last '60s living in a houseboat. My dad wrote science fiction novels and painted big murals and oil paintings.
10602.name: Rainn Wilson

10603.quote: As a father now, I wouldn't do what my dad did, because it left me feeling emotionally unstable as a kid. But he didn't do the things he did out of selfishness or malice.
10603.name: Anthony Kiedis

10604.quote: I know my dad is a big Internet freak, and he's been known to be a Wikileaker.
10604.name: Anthony Kiedis

10605.quote: In a school where everyone is famous or rich or whatever, you have a culture, 'What does your dad do?' 'What does your mom do?'
10605.name: Cynthia Nixon

10606.quote: I think 'Family Guy' and 'American Dad' have definitely staked out their own style and territory, and now the accusations are coming that 'The Simpsons' is taking jokes from 'Family Guy.' And I can tell you, that ain't the case.
10606.name: Matt Groening

10607.quote: I grew up in the world of bad television, on my dad's sets and then as a young schmuck on dating shows and so on.
10607.name: George Clooney

10608.quote: My mum always told me I was precious, while my dad always told me I was worthless. I think that's a good grounding for a balanced life.
10608.name: Alan Cumming

10609.quote: I used to have a silk dressing gown an uncle bought in Japan and when I came downstairs in it, my dad used to call me Davinia. There was never embarrassment about that kind of thing. My sister used to dress me up a lot. She thought I was a little doll.
10609.name: David Walliams

10610.quote: I think it's easiest to teach by example. My dad didn't tell us to work hard we just saw how hard he worked. I know I have shortcomings - like a short fuse - but I've learned you can't come home from a long day of work and snap at the kids.
10610.name: Chris O'Donnell

10611.quote: I had lost relationships with my dad, my brother and sister and I was just like, you know what, this is definitely the time to just get it together and so that's what I did.
10611.name: Nicole Richie

10612.quote: You know, I'm just - I'm really happy for my dad.
10612.name: Nicole Richie

10613.quote: I had the opportunity to go to law school, and my dad, who was an accountant, couldn't believe I wanted to walk away from that and start cooking.
10613.name: Curtis Stone

10614.quote: Now that I'm a dad, I'm practicing what I call 'one- handed cooking,' because I've got something more important in my other arm. I'm whipping up lots of frittatas and omelets.
10614.name: Curtis Stone

10615.quote: My dad has been married to his wife for 15 years and wherever he goes there better be a seat for her. I like real couples that tell you how to get through on Wednesdays when you're just at the end of your rope - the ones who really know how to make it through. We have to stop looking at Hollywood couples because you're going to get disappointed.
10615.name: Sherri Shepherd

10616.quote: My sisters have been baptized and my dad is a deacon at his church now. Sadly my mother passed away but what I can say is that the Jehovah Witnesses took very good care of her up until she died.
10616.name: Sherri Shepherd

10617.quote: My dad worked two jobs and moved us to the suburbs, and just being a black person, I went through a lot of racism and being called names and being bullied every single day. And it was hard. I didn't have any friends.
10617.name: Sherri Shepherd

10618.quote: I listened to the radio, so I was influenced by everyone from Michael Jackson to Milli Vanilli. But thankfully my dad had a collection of Cat Stevens albums while my mom was listening to jazz.
10618.name: Jason Mraz

10619.quote: My dad has sometimes felt that I grew up a little lacking in sufficient eccentricity - in the sense that I'm willing to live as an adult in a house with walls that are parallel to each other, that sort of thing.
10619.name: Jaron Lanier

10620.quote: I was into all kinds of music as a teen - country music, because my dad was in a band that played country, and whatever my sister and brother were into.
10620.name: Martina McBride

10621.quote: My dad was a huge country music fan, but he also had a band and he sang. So he'd listen to a lot of music and the songs that he'd learn for the band were more from the male artists. So my earliest country memories were Waylon Jennings, Conway Twitty, George Jones, Johnny Paycheck even.
10621.name: Martina McBride

10622.quote: I never saw my dad cry. My son saw me cry. My dad never told me he loved me, and consequently I told Scott I loved him every other minute. The point is, I'll make less mistakes than my dad, my sons hopefully will make less mistakes than me, and their sons will make less mistakes than their dads.
10622.name: James Caan

10623.quote: Me and my dad are friends. We're cool. I'll never be disappointed again, because I don't expect anything anymore from him. I just let him exist, and that's how we get along.
10623.name: Drake

10624.quote: My dad's family were pretty working class, actually.
10624.name: Dan Stevens

10625.quote: My dad tells me that he took us to a pantomime when I was very, very small - panto being a sort of English phenomenon. There's traditionally a part of the show where they'll invite kids up on the stage to interact with the show. I was too young to remember this, but my dad says that I was running up onstage before they even asked us.
10625.name: Dan Stevens

10626.quote: My dad liked a lot of Motown, but I didn't listen to it until my teenage years.
10626.name: John Legend

10627.quote: I love my mom and dad.
10627.name: Taylor Momsen

10628.quote: The only time I ever look good dancing is if I'm next to my dad at a wedding.
10628.name: Cat Deeley

10629.quote: Mental illness can happen to anybody. You can be a dustman, a politician, a Tesco worker, anyone. It could be your dad, your brother or your aunt.
10629.name: Frank Bruno

10630.quote: There's a lot of research behind the scenes that you don't get to see, but I have an instinct that my dad nurtured from when I was born. I was very lucky then.
10630.name: Steve Irwin

10631.quote: I didn't have any role models really. My best friend was a dog. My mum and dad saved a dog from the gutter and that dog was my brother before Jesse was born. Sami was his name and he was my role model.
10631.name: Ville Valo

10632.quote: My dad used to draw these great cartoon figures. His dream was being a cartoonist, but he never achieved it, and it kind of broke my heart. I think part of my interest in art had to do with his yearning for something he could never have.
10632.name: Kathryn Bigelow

10633.quote: My grandfather had two boys, my uncle had three boys, my dad had me and my two brothers, each of my brothers have had two boys. Then something happened with the chromosomal experiment and suddenly I've got three girls.
10633.name: Greg Kinnear

10634.quote: My dad had this rock hard body and would work 12- to 13-hour days. The guys he worked with were scrap-iron guys. Nobody on that road crew had read a book in 10 years, but there was something about the way they lived I really admired.
10634.name: Richard Russo

10635.quote: A company that pays attention to the family unit is a successful company. We don't isolate the family. We don't make rides that say, 'Hey mom, dad, you go sit on the bench.'
10635.name: Michael Eisner

10636.quote: My dad was rubbish at all other aspects of his financial life, but he's pretty good at paying the rent.
10636.name: Robert Carlyle

10637.quote: I've always taken my love of children from my father. He was a children magnet. Suddenly, having my first child hit home what my dad went through.
10637.name: Robert Carlyle

10638.quote: My memories are of my dad taking me to football on Saturday mornings, and my mum taking me swimming. Those are the things I remember from my childhood, not sitting around the table debating capitalism and the profit squeeze.
10638.name: David Miliband

10639.quote: My dad was a ham, too. He could sell those women anything. Of all his sons, I was the only one he could trust to sell as well as he could. I was proud of that.
10639.name: Paul Lynde

10640.quote: Politicians, talk in generalities and lies, and I think they've caused all our grief. They're so awful, they're really funny. I hate thinking this because my dad loved politics.
10640.name: Paul Lynde

10641.quote: My mom's a social worker, and my dad works in non-profit organisations.
10641.name: Seth Rogen

10642.quote: After graduating from flares and platforms in the early 1970s, I started drama school wearing a pair of khaki dungarees with one of my Dad's Army shirts, accessorised by a cat's basket doubling as a handbag. Very Lady Gaga.
10642.name: Jenny Eclair

10643.quote: I've just got crap hair. Although I inherited a lot of stuff from my dad, including giant knees, I didn't get his good, thick hair. I got my mother's thin, wispy, non-event hair instead.
10643.name: Jenny Eclair

10644.quote: I was into the Mets because my Dad worked at IBM where he got free Mets tickets, so I was into the Mets, then I got to 'Saturday Night Live' where my boss has unbelievable N.Y. Yankees tickets, so he invites us to the games. I'm going to all the games, so I might as well root for the team I'm gonna go sit with.
10644.name: Jimmy Fallon

10645.quote: I always wanted to be a stay-at-home dad making art, making movies.
10645.name: Robert Rodriguez

10646.quote: In high school I dated a white woman. She would come to visit me on the rez. And her dad, who was very racist, didn't like that at all. And he told her one time, 'You shouldn't go on the rez if you're white because Indians have a lot of anger in their heart.'
10646.name: Sherman Alexie

10647.quote: When I was a kid, my step dad started this business and would go out and get lost cows and stuff. He was part-time truck driver, farmer and cowboy. He taught me how to ride from an early age.
10647.name: Tim McGraw

10648.quote: I haven't really decided to be an actor yet! I started doing plays when I was about 15 or 16. I only did it because my dad saw a bunch of pretty girls in a restaurant and he asked them where they came from and they said drama group. He said, 'Son, that is where you need to go.'
10648.name: Robert Pattinson

10649.quote: My dad says he likes to bask in my glow.
10649.name: Robert Pattinson

10650.quote: I grew up with baseball I played in Little League and went to games with my dad. But I, as I grew up, became more of a basketball fanatic than a baseball one.
10650.name: Jonah Hill

10651.quote: My mom was a professional. My dad and mom met each other in a movie called 'New Faces of 1937.' My mom went under the name Thelma Leeds, and she did a few movies, and she was really a great singer, and when she married my dad and started to have a family, she sang at parties.
10651.name: Albert Brooks

10652.quote: I love being a dad, it keeps me fit and inspired and children are so funny. They always supply you with acting material!
10652.name: Wesley Snipes

10653.quote: My first outdoor cooking memories are full of erratic British summers, Dad swearing at a barbecue that he couldn't put together, and eventually eating charred sausages, feeling brilliant.
10653.name: Jamie Oliver

10654.quote: I want any excuse to come home. My dad is not a spring chicken any more. If anyone says, 'Go buy a postage stamp in London,' I'll go and do it.
10654.name: Emily Mortimer

10655.quote: We all have experiences in our lives that change us, and we all learn from people, like my dad, but at the end of the day, it's only us. And we're only responsible to make ourselves happy.
10655.name: Tom Brady

10656.quote: I was born in 1968, just eighteen months after my sister Chrisse and just one year after Dad passed the bar exam.
10656.name: Carre Otis

10657.quote: My dad was an editor and a writer, and that's actually what I aspired to be.
10657.name: Anne M. Mulcahy

10658.quote: Baseball is the president tossing out the first ball of the season. And a scrubby schoolboy playing catch with his dad on a Mississippi farm.
10658.name: Ernie Harwell

10659.quote: I have great faith that Heaven's there and I'll see my brothers and my mom and dad when I get there.
10659.name: Ernie Harwell

10660.quote: When I was 7, my dad asked his friend to teach me. I played my first tournament competition when I was 8. I remember I shot around 125.
10660.name: Yani Tseng

10661.quote: If a dad does his job, we don't need prisons, we don't need jails. That's what I saw growing up.
10661.name: Mike Singletary

10662.quote: I've become a less brave traveller since I became a dad, but in the past I was more foolhardy than brave.
10662.name: David Mitchell

10663.quote: My dad was working abroad, in Iraq, and he was a doctor. We used to go and visit him, in Baghdad, off and on. For the first ten years of my life, we used to go backwards and forwards to Baghdad, so that was quite amazing. I spent a lot of time traveling around the Middle East.
10663.name: Andy Serkis

10664.quote: I stayed in Baghdad every summer until I was 14. My dad's sister is still there, but many of my relatives have managed to get out. People forget that there are still people there who are not radicalized in any particular direction, trying to live normal lives in a very difficult situation.
10664.name: Andy Serkis

10665.quote: My mom and dad got divorced when I was very young, and growing up in a family where the head of the household wasn't a man made a big difference.
10665.name: Dave Mustaine

10666.quote: I was always the new kid in school, I'm the kid from a broken family, I'm the kid who had no dad showing up at the father-son stuff, I'm the kid that was using food stamps at the grocery store.
10666.name: Dave Mustaine

10667.quote: My dad had a personal style which was very attractive. It was quite reserved and quite elegant, and it was infectious.
10667.name: Bill Nighy

10668.quote: Every kid needs to say, 'I want what my mom and dad have.'
10668.name: Josh McDowell

10669.quote: In my case, I was born to parents who were very young, and I don't think they were entirely ready to have a child. My dad was going to college and working two or three jobs at the same time, and my mum was working and going to school.
10669.name: Gillian Anderson

10670.quote: My dad was an absentee dad, so it was always important to me that I was part of my daughter's life, and she deserved two parents, which is part of the rationale behind us staying married for 30 years.
10670.name: Samuel L. Jackson

10671.quote: My senior year of high school, when I was getting recruited for college, my dad goes to me, 'You can become an Olympic champion.' And that's the first time that I'd heard someone else say that to me. I was like, 'Uh, are you talking to me?'
10671.name: Ryan Lochte

10672.quote: The worst advice I ever received from my dad was to play by the book.
10672.name: Dimebag Darrell

10673.quote: The only time I think about life beyond F1 is when I contemplate becoming a dad. But there's no way that's going to happen while I'm still racing. To be successful in F1 you need to be very selfish in lots of ways and you're away from home for long periods. That's not the kind of father I want to be.
10673.name: Jenson Button

10674.quote: But you know, my dad called me the laziest white kid he ever met. When I screamed back at him that he was putting down a race of people to call me lazy, his answer was that's not what he was doing, and that I was also the dumbest white kid he ever met.
10674.name: Norman Lear

10675.quote: My dad said: 'It looks like you'll be world No.1 in a few hours and I wanted to be the first to say congratulations.'
10675.name: Lee Westwood

10676.quote: Dad sometimes patted me on the knee and called me his Little Schmuck.
10676.name: Michael Reagan

10677.quote: I had never said, 'dad, I love you.'
10677.name: Michael Reagan

10678.quote: My dad dragged me to a Bruce Springsteen concert as a kid. It was my first concert, but I fell asleep in the middle. My second concert was Weezer on the 'Pinkerton' tour, and 'Pinkerton' is the reason why I'm doing this.
10678.name: Nate Ruess

10679.quote: I came from somewhat of a musical family. I had an uncle on Broadway. My dad kind of knows how to play instruments. Although, I always find it annoying when he does play an instrument.
10679.name: Nate Ruess

10680.quote: I grew up in a predominantly Caucasian neighborhood, but my mom is Filipino-Spanish and my dad is Irish.
10680.name: Shay Mitchell

10681.quote: The moment my doctor told me, I went silent. My mum and dad were with me, then we all went to pieces. I was saying, No, I've got my flight to Sydney in two hours. I'm getting on a plane.
10681.name: Kylie Minogue

10682.quote: I grew up in Texas, and people love their American-made muscle cars there. I grew up around people who loved cars and took care of cars and my dad's a big car nut, so I learned a little bit about cars - how to love them, most importantly. I think that from the time I could remember, I've always envisioned myself in a vintage muscle car.
10682.name: Amber Heard

10683.quote: When I used to do musical theatre, my dad refused to come backstage. He never wanted to see the props up close or the sets up close. He didn't want to see the magic.
10683.name: Nia Vardalos

10684.quote: My mother's a psychologist, my stepfather's a psychologist, my stepmother is a therapist and my dad's a lawyer. So it was all prominent in my life. I don't know anyone who doesn't know someone on some form of prescription medicine.
10684.name: Zach Braff

10685.quote: As a kid who wasn't into sports, at school I felt almost alienated at times, whereas in the theatre community there was this amazing sense of camaraderie. Early on, we would go to rehearsals with my dad and I was like the mascot for the backstage crew. That was a big part of my childhood, so I dreamed of one day doing a play in London.
10685.name: Zach Braff

10686.quote: It was tough at the time but when I was younger, my Dad. I would say my Dad, because without him I wouldn't have been here. I mean it was tough for me because he was really demanding. With him, it was never enough, you know, anything I did was never enough.
10686.name: Thierry Henry

10687.quote: My dad said, 'The thing that I was told that was really helpful was that I mustn't be afraid of the things I was afraid of when I was five years old'. The shock of his childhood had put him in this defensive crouch against the world, and he needed to know that he had a nice wife and kids and it wasn't the same any more.
10687.name: Tom Hooper

10688.quote: When I was growing up my mother would say, 'Your dad may have to learn about being a father because he lost his own and that would have affected him'.
10688.name: Tom Hooper

10689.quote: I feel connected to the Second World War because my father lost his father in that war. So, through my dad and the effect it had on him of losing his father young, I always felt connected to the war. It goes back years, but it still feels to me as if we're completely living in it.
10689.name: Tom Hooper

10690.quote: I'm a military kid, both parents in the military - Mom did 12 years, Dad did 21, served in two wars. So discipline is something that was huge.
10690.name: Robert Griffin III

10691.quote: One thing my dad always told me, was he would make sure I always had what he didn't have. He couldn't play basketball because he didn't have tennis shoes - so I had five pairs of tennis shoes.
10691.name: Robert Griffin III

10692.quote: You always give credit where credit is due - to high school coaches, college coaches - but my dad, the foundation that he built with me, is where all of this came from. The speed, the determination, the mindset, just the natural belief that you can do anything you put your mind to, it all comes from my dad.
10692.name: Robert Griffin III

10693.quote: I don't know much about only children. I was the middle one of three, and if ever I was alone with mum and dad, it was a rare moment.
10693.name: Elizabeth Hurley

10694.quote: I think in my case, I had no choice but to have a good sense of humor. I grew up with my dad, Danny Thomas, and George Burns and Bob Hope and Milton Berle and Sid Caesar and all those guys were at our house all the time and telling jokes and making each other laugh.
10694.name: Marlo Thomas

10695.quote: Dad taught us about morals, values and goals. Having a tight-knit family was important to him.
10695.name: Junior Seau

10696.quote: I wanted to perform well for my mom and dad, because in high school, I didn't have a job. My brothers, they worked at Pizza Hut or places like that, but sports, that was my way of giving back.
10696.name: Junior Seau

10697.quote: The only ones I trust really are my Mum and Dad and those who are closest to me.
10697.name: Katie Price

10698.quote: My dad said if you become a tennis professional just make sure you get into the top hundred, because you have to make a little bit of money. You make a living so you can pay your coaching and, you know, your travels.
10698.name: Roger Federer

10699.quote: Money stress is what used to remind me of my Dad most.
10699.name: Ted Rall

10700.quote: My dad was the manager at the 45,000-acre ranch, but he owned his own 1,200-acre ranch, and I owned four cattle that he gave to me when I graduated from grammar school, from the eighth grade. And those cows multiplied, and he kept track of them for years for me. And that was my herd.
10700.name: Dave Brubeck

10701.quote: My dad's not here, but he's watching in heaven.
10701.name: Bubba Watson

10702.quote: My dad was a diplomat and after living in America, where I was born, he was posted to Cairo.
10702.name: Arabella Weir

10703.quote: My dad was depressed a lot of the time, and there were a lot of things in his life that he never resolved.
10703.name: Juliana Hatfield

10704.quote: I'd love to be a dad. I hope I'd be great at it. That's every man's fear, yet his most important job.
10704.name: Matt Damon

10705.quote: My parents divorced when I was young but I was brought up in two really loving households. I didn't have a contentious relationship with my mom or dad.
10705.name: Matt Damon

10706.quote: I come from an ordinary family - my dad is a carpenter, a roof-maker - and we've always loved racing together.
10706.name: Sebastian Vettel

10707.quote: When dad told me Mr Steptoe had passed away, I broke down.
10707.name: Louise Brown

10708.quote: Both my mum and dad were great readers, and we would go every Saturday morning to the library, and my sister and I had a library card when we could pass off something as a signature, and all of us would come with an armful of books.
10708.name: Geraldine Brooks

10709.quote: I knew I was going to be a journalist when I was eight years old and I saw the printing presses rolling at the Sydney newspaper where my dad worked as a proofreader.
10709.name: Geraldine Brooks

10710.quote: My dad's a scratch golfer and I've got the knack of seeing something and then replicating it. I saw my dad swing a club and I worked out how to do the same thing. My backswing and follow-through have been basically the same since I was two.
10710.name: Rory McIlroy

10711.quote: My mom and dad worked very hard to give me the best chance in - not just in golf but in life. You know, I was an only child, you know, my dad worked three jobs at one stage. My mom worked night shifts in a factory.
10711.name: Rory McIlroy

10712.quote: I wanted to make a point of basing myself at home, being close to my family. I'll never be able to repay Mum and Dad for what they did, but at least they know they'll never have to work another day. I'll do whatever it takes to look after them.
10712.name: Rory McIlroy

10713.quote: Dad and mom would have preferred that I be a doctor, a lawyer, a scientist, or a great humanitarian.
10713.name: Levon Helm

10714.quote: My dad and I played music. He teaches me a song or two every time I'm home.
10714.name: Levon Helm

10715.quote: Although my dad was a doctor, we weren't necessarily a super-artsy family. We were just a classic, traditional family who got to take a lot of piano lessons and became a bunch of musicians.
10715.name: Lisa Loeb

10716.quote: I'm the fun dad, I am also the disciplinarian.
10716.name: Johnny Knoxville

10717.quote: You know my dad pushed me to believe that I was going to be the best. I just never thought of life without tennis, even looking forward.
10717.name: Andre Agassi

10718.quote: My dad was this sort of avant-garde guy who did all kinds of weird things. He was a true original and anybody who met him never forgot him.
10718.name: Paul Thomas Anderson

10719.quote: I'm into being a dad, that's where my focus is most of the time. I'm an actor that's my job, but it's not my life. I have a lot of other interests too.
10719.name: Paul Walker

10720.quote: We busted a lot of family secrets with this. But to make a long story short, my parents relationship was built heavily on security issues for my Mom, and when my Dad couldn't provide security, the relationship unraveled.
10720.name: Kenny Loggins

10721.quote: My dad taught me to play bass. He's a bass player he still plays in a band in Michigan to this day. He taught me to play bass when I was about 6. I used to just go to band practice with him, and whoever didn't show up for rehearsal that day, I would take their spot.
10721.name: Mayer Hawthorne

10722.quote: My dad calls me 'Mac' a lot, from 'Mike Tyson's Punch Out' - Little Mac is the main character. I was obsessed. I can still beat Mike Tyson on 'Punch Out.'
10722.name: Mayer Hawthorne

10723.quote: I don't think I've had a holiday in my entire life that wasn't about my dad's work.
10723.name: Kat Dennings

10724.quote: I want to stay healthy, keep fit, eat well, keep a low profile and be a good dad.
10724.name: Frank Bruno

10725.quote: OK, so my parents were married in 1955 and my mom knew my dad was gay and my dad knew he was gay and so I was, like, 'Why in the heck did you get married?' Like, what was going on? What was that time? It's like this crazy paradox that my whole life is based on, or my family's based on. So I spent a lot of time trying to understand '55.
10725.name: Mike Mills

10726.quote: My dad's gay experiences really had a very positive influence on me and my straight relationships - how to better accept all the weirdness and ambiguity and ups and downs and paradoxes. I knew from the beginning I was writing about love.
10726.name: Mike Mills

10727.quote: I think my dad is the only Arabic descendent who is an unsuccessful businessman.
10727.name: Shakira

10728.quote: When my father died in my arms it had such a profound affect on me that at that very moment when my dad passed I realized that I needed to face my own fears.
10728.name: Criss Angel

10729.quote: I had an amazing childhood, lots of love. But my dad worked his tail off, getting up at 4 in the morning and going off at 5, 6 o'clock, yet he always had time to spend with his kids and his wife.
10729.name: Criss Angel

10730.quote: When I was a boy, I used to pull a big cross saw with my dad. He'd use his right hand, so I'd have to use my left.
10730.name: Joe Frazier

10731.quote: I've got a really great family round me, two sisters and an older brother and my mum and dad. Everybody's equal.
10731.name: Nicholas Hoult

10732.quote: My mum was raised Jewish, my dad is very scientifically minded, and my school was vaguely Christian. We sang hymns in school. I liked the hymns bit, but apart from that, I can take it or leave it. So I had lots of different influences when I was younger.
10732.name: Ben Barnes

10733.quote: My dad is a doctor, a professor of psychiatry, and my mum is a psychotherapist.
10733.name: Ben Barnes

10734.quote: I often talk with other actors about that time when you've just finished a job, because I think you do take on the characteristics of some of the characters you play. Sometimes it can be a great thing and sometimes it's a bit haunting because you're not quite sure how to leave it on set. My dad talks about it as being 'de-personalised.'
10734.name: Ben Barnes

10735.quote: My dad was a Marine. He was one of the Montford Point Marines. Those are the equivalent of the Tuskegee Airmen for Marines. He's a tough, tough guy. When I was 15 we had a fight, and I didn't speak to him for 10 years.
10735.name: Larry Elder

10736.quote: My mom and my dad were married 56 years, and the fact that I reconciled with my dad I think made their marriage a little bit better as well.
10736.name: Larry Elder

10737.quote: If anybody had a reason to become a delinquent, to become a criminal, to be angry at the man, to be angry at the white man, to be angry at America, it's my dad, but he did not feel that way at all.
10737.name: Larry Elder

10738.quote: My dad? He died when I was 19, which is a bad time for your dad to die, because there's an awful lot of things you have to resolve with your parents past your teens if you've been a difficult teenager.
10738.name: Robbie Coltrane

10739.quote: More and more couples are having this negotiation or discussion, but I'm still amazed at the number who aren't and where the cultural norm sort of kicks in and they just assume that mom's got to be the one who stays home, not dad.
10739.name: James Levine

10740.quote: My parents moved to American Samoa when I was three or four years old. My dad was principal of a high school there. It was idyllic for a kid. I had a whole island for a backyard. I lived there until I was eight years old and we moved to Santa Barbara.
10740.name: Eric Stoltz

10741.quote: Parents don't understand kids and kids don't understand parents. My parents were divorced when I was really young and I went to live with my dad.
10741.name: Mark Hoppus

10742.quote: My grandfather was a lawyer, my dad was a lawyer, my mum was a lawyer, I got an uncle who's a lawyer, I got cousins that are lawyers.
10742.name: Benicio Del Toro

10743.quote: I pop gum. My parents get so annoyed with me. I know my dad wishes he never taught me how to do that.
10743.name: Hilary Duff

10744.quote: My dad is a nurse midwife, one of about only 50 male midwives in the U.S., I think.
10744.name: Matthew Morrison

10745.quote: I'm the most inappropriate dad. I curse in front of my kids and their friends. I let my kids watch R-rated movies. I'll walk by the movie theater and say, 'Let's go see that,' and my kids will say, 'No, it's rated R. It's not appropriate for kids.' I'm like Uncle Dad. We have fun. I don't live with them, but I drive over four days a week.
10745.name: Marlon Wayans

10746.quote: I think I had kind of an advantage. When I was growing up, my dad had just got out of jail and he had a great record collection. He had - it was all - these were the songs. So I heard a lot of these songs, like, my whole life, so for me it was easy. I already knew what I was going to sing.
10746.name: Chris Isaak

10747.quote: My mom and dad played this music all the time when I was growing up, so to me songs by Jerry Lee and Fats Domino are the classics, they're the best songs ever.
10747.name: Chris Isaak

10748.quote: I can definitely tell when mum has got money because then she likes to go shopping to spend it, whereas dad is steadier and avoids splurges. I like to think I've inherited both sides.
10748.name: Sophie Ellis-Bextor

10749.quote: You know not having my real dad around and having a step dad made me want to be a great dad. So now I have been one for 9 years. And now 3 daughters. So, that is what I am - a dad, first and foremost, before anything else. It's just something that comes natural now.
10749.name: Tim McGraw

10750.quote: My dad has been a big influence on me, because he's always had his own business. He really taught me business sense and how to be a focused individual, but also how to have fun and make everyone around you have fun.
10750.name: Wiz Khalifa

10751.quote: I love to cook. My dad's a really excellent cook and his style is: Look in the fridge and make whatever there is with whatever ingredients you have and I like cooking like that, too.
10751.name: Olivia Thirlby

10752.quote: I could not tell you the date of my mother's death. I could not tell you the date of my dad's death. These are not dates that I find significant.
10752.name: O. J. Simpson

10753.quote: My Dad hated his job. He sold overcoats, but he wanted to make movies. He had a failed career working with the Ritz Brothers - they were like the Marx Brothers, only a tier below. I always had a picture in my mind of him in a straw hat.
10753.name: Steve Sabol

10754.quote: People who have not done their research on me do not know that I am European, born in Copenhagen, Denmark to an Italian father from Napoli and a mother from Alabama who was singing opera and went to Europe, met my dad, fell in love, and then moved back to Rome, where I was raised, between Rome and Hamburg.
10754.name: Giancarlo Esposito

10755.quote: I have always had the feeling I could do anything and my dad told me I could. I was in college before I found out he might be wrong.
10755.name: Ann Richards

10756.quote: It's not like he called me up and asked me. They've never wanted to throw us into that world, and I think our decision probably shocked them. But I love my dad, and I think I'd regret it if I didn't do this.
10756.name: Jenna Bush

10757.quote: My dad saw my husband's boss at a conference, and he said to stop paying my husband until we produce children.
10757.name: Jenna Bush

10758.quote: I'm more like my father, personality-wise. But my mom and I get alone really well - obviously, because my mom and my dad get along so well.
10758.name: Jenna Bush

10759.quote: I'm sure there were times when I wish I had thought, 'Gosh, that might really embarrass mom and dad,' but our parents didn't raise us to think about them. They're very selfless and they wanted us to have as normal of a college life as possible. So really, we didn't think of any repercussions.
10759.name: Jenna Bush

10760.quote: In the 'Garnethill' trilogy, people always forget that Maureen O'Donnell's dad was a journalist and she did art history at uni and her brother did law, but no-one ever thinks they're middle-class - they're just working class because they speak with accents.
10760.name: Denise Mina

10761.quote: There's been times when I've had heartbreaking moments and I'm like, 'I can't believe you said that,' or 'I can't believe you did that'. And it hurts, it still hurts, and it'll always hurt, but I've never had somebody that I truly cared about just walk out on me, whether it was a boyfriend, or an aunt, mom or dad.
10761.name: Shailene Woodley

10762.quote: My parents were involved in everything I did. They were showbiz people themselves. My dad was an actor. They were parents they did what parents are supposed to do.
10762.name: Tina Yothers

10763.quote: I remember my dad working with me on breaking down my script and writing out a back story for my character and all that stuff.
10763.name: Jason Bateman

10764.quote: I grew up in a small town in Illinois, and my dad was a basketball coach. Thanks to him, I have excellent fundamentals in both basketball and baseball.
10764.name: Nick Offerman

10765.quote: I went to my dad when I was 17 and said, 'I want to be a country music star.' Which every dad loves to hear. And he said, 'I want you to go to college.' So we had a discussion. And I'm pretty stubborn. I'm a lot like him. And he said, 'If you go to college and graduate, I'll pay your first six months of rent in Nashville.' So he bribed me.
10765.name: Eric Church

10766.quote: That is where the irony of the film comes off, in terms of the language it employs - where he tries desperately to be a 'TV Dad,' to give advice and it's so pat it becomes ridiculous.
10766.name: Atom Egoyan

10767.quote: My dad is a bank president and my mom was an accountant and they didn't think that seeking the life of a freelance writer was very practical, you see. Of course, I was just as determined to do it.
10767.name: Kevin J. Anderson

10768.quote: I'm going to take care of the man I'm with. I grew up in a household where my mum takes care of my dad - she cooks, she does everything - and that's the kind of girl I am.
10768.name: Nicole Scherzinger

10769.quote: My dad came out of the Roosevelt era and the Depression. One person and one party made a difference in his life. That's what everybody forgot when they called my father and other people political bosses.
10769.name: Richard M. Daley

10770.quote: I have found having my dad as my North Star has worked well for me.
10770.name: Tony Parsons

10771.quote: I just went off for two months traveling around Europe on a motorcycle and pretty much turned my phone off. I did 5,000 miles with my dad. We went through Holland, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro, Italy, and then I did Spain and France by myself.
10771.name: Michael Fassbender

10772.quote: My mom's been married three times my dad has been married a lot. I didn't really see my dad that much.
10772.name: Skeet Ulrich

10773.quote: I think I'm extremely vulnerable and that in some ways I seek out rejection. Never feeling like you're getting that pat on the back from dad is probably at the heart of that.
10773.name: Skeet Ulrich

10774.quote: My dad is a very quick-witted, sarcastic, dry, humorous guy, whereas my mom's very silly, and that side of the family is very musical.
10774.name: Tim Heidecker
