10775.quote: My dad, of course, like a lot of Asian parents, wanted me to be an engineer or doctor and never could understand why I would want to be a lawyer. And then, when I first said I wanted to run for office, he thought that was absolutely insane.
10775.name: Gary Locke

10776.quote: I know exactly where I've come from, I know exactly who my mum and dad are.
10776.name: Christopher Eccleston

10777.quote: I remember opening my dad's closet and there were, like, 40 suits, every color of the rainbow, plaid and winter and summer. He had two jewelry boxes full of watches and lighters and cuff links. And just, he was that guy. He was probably unfulfilled in his life in many ways.
10777.name: Jon Hamm

10778.quote: My dad used to flush my mother's head down the toilet. I was so screwed up.
10778.name: Jessica Hahn

10779.quote: My dad's passion was to teach adults to read so they could read to their kids.
10779.name: Jennie Garth

10780.quote: My dad knows how to tell a story. He'd make me laugh by doing all the different voices.
10780.name: Lily Collins

10781.quote: My dad came from Cuba when he was a teenager not speaking English. And I grew up here speaking Spanglish. That's the world in which I grew up, and that's a world in which a lot of second generation immigrants find themselves.
10781.name: Ted Cruz

10782.quote: A large part of my life revolves around my dad. Sometimes, I even feel a strong sense of connection, something very tangible when I learn something new in the martial arts.
10782.name: Brandon Lee

10783.quote: My dad, Donald, was a vet and had a practice in Yorkshire. Cats and dogs were his bread and butter, but his greatest love was large animals.
10783.name: Alastair Campbell

10784.quote: Like my dad, I have a Christmas party most years. I like to celebrate and see as many people as possible.
10784.name: Lauren Graham

10785.quote: My dad doesn't get any of my jokes. He laughs at them, but he doesn't understand them. He's just laughing because people around him are laughing.
10785.name: Zach Galifianakis

10786.quote: I'm trying to have my own thing, and I don't know if it's even possible. I didn't realize so many people actually think I'm trying to be like my dad. I read comments like 'She's no Elvis.' I'm not trying to be. I never set out to be.
10786.name: Lisa Marie Presley

10787.quote: My mum and dad had worked incredibly hard to afford me an education.
10787.name: Benedict Cumberbatch

10788.quote: One day my dad would say, 'OK, if you want to play tennis I can help you out.' And that's how it started. And I had a goal. I wanted to beat my mom first. And my parents and my brother. And that was the ultimate goal.
10788.name: Caroline Wozniacki

10789.quote: My dad has always been my coach. And I've spent so much time with him. So he's one of my best friends. And I can talk to him about everything.
10789.name: Caroline Wozniacki

10790.quote: Our last jam session was this past Christmas. Dad played his harmonica, mom sang in English and Italian, and I played guitar. I'm so happy that we could share that musical experience for one last time.
10790.name: Tony Visconti

10791.quote: My dad's sense of humor was direct and sometimes surreal - his quick wit is well known amongst our family and friends. He raised me on Spike Jones records and W.C. Fields movies, and his sense of humor fell somewhere in between.
10791.name: Tony Visconti

10792.quote: Jenna's traveled with me they've both traveled with their dad. This is the only time they've been old enough in all of their dad's campaigns to really be involved in.
10792.name: Laura Bush

10793.quote: My dad remembers being in school with my uncle, and the teacher would say outright to the class that the Japanese were second-class citizens and shouldn't be trusted.
10793.name: Mike Shinoda

10794.quote: Listen, everything I did in my childhood was competitive. Everything we did my dad made it into a game to win. We used to drive my mum nuts.
10794.name: Lee Westwood

10795.quote: The satisfaction you get when you finally beat your dad is amazing, that rush of adrenaline.
10795.name: Lee Westwood

10796.quote: I think he would have been proud and smiling, when we laid him to rest because his family was together. I think that was a great gift to be able to give Dad at the end.
10796.name: Michael Reagan

10797.quote: You know my father as governor, as president, but I knew him as dad. I was so proud to have the Reagan name and to be Ronald Reagan's son.
10797.name: Michael Reagan

10798.quote: I remember once, we got an interview, and he said, 'Dad, these people are writing about me like I'm an adult. Don't they know I'm a kid?' I have never tried to encourage him to get a music image like other musicians have.
10798.name: Ornette Coleman

10799.quote: I didn't always want to be a dad.
10799.name: Liam Gallagher

10800.quote: My dad used to love Steely Dan, the Stones, Jethro Tull and all that. There was always Steely Dan going in my dad's car, but I remember The Royal Scam in particular because it has 'Kid Charlemagne' on it.
10800.name: St. Vincent

10801.quote: Growing up, I didn't give my grandfather's photography a second thought. I wasn't involved in his work, except that I helped my dad print his negatives.
10801.name: Kim Weston

10802.quote: I didn't want to travel. I didn't want to leave my family. I heard all these stories from Dad about not having Edward around when he was young, and I didn't want that to happen.
10802.name: Kim Weston

10803.quote: My dad took me to all the best rock and punk shows when I was growing up and music has always been a part of my life. So I'm very interested in the music scene and I suppose that's why I've ended up going out with musicians. Dave Pirner is still one of my best friends.
10803.name: Winona Ryder

10804.quote: My parents are very hard working people who did everything they could for their children. I have two brothers and they worked dog hard to give us an education and provide us with the most comfortable life possible. My dad provided for his family daily. So, yes, that is definitely in my DNA.
10804.name: David Oyelowo

10805.quote: When my dad needed a shirt ironed, he would yell downstairs to my mother, who would drop everything and iron his shirt.
10805.name: Hope Davis

10806.quote: My dad was kind of a pool shark and had a Frank Sinatra, Dean Martin thing going on. I've always been fascinated by the fifties because of him. There was a hip, cool, anything-goes atmosphere back then, but looking good was still a priority.
10806.name: Dylan McDermott

10807.quote: My dad had emphysema and both of my parents had chronic bronchitis and ended up with cancers - all smoking related.
10807.name: Loni Anderson

10808.quote: Dad made it to Gold Shield Detective, so he always busted Robin, my oldest brother, and me. Always got caught, whatever we were doing.
10808.name: Kevin Eubanks

10809.quote: I am blessed to have Mom and Dad.
10809.name: Kevin Eubanks

10810.quote: My dad told us up front, 'Guys, if you want to play sports, go ahead, but it's your decision.'
10810.name: Peyton Manning

10811.quote: As a dad I'm emotionally dedicated but I'm not 'figuring out their life plans'. But of course as I'm telling them about the rights of wrongs I'm thinking back to what I was like at their age.
10811.name: Peter Mullan

10812.quote: When I was on Broadway when I was little, I remember always driving through Times Square with my dad to the theater. Now when I go back, you can't even drive on Broadway in the 40s. New Times Square is too touristy to me.
10812.name: Jenna Ushkowitz

10813.quote: I had my heart set on becoming an English teacher, but stumbled into acting after meeting a theatrical agent in my dad's restaurant in San Diego.
10813.name: Charisma Carpenter

10814.quote: The Rat Pack was the piece that really kicked me out of that little funk that I was in and then Ted called me up and asked me if I wanted to be the dad in Blow.
10814.name: Ray Liotta

10815.quote: Dad was just an emotional wreck. He was drinking a lot of the time, he was smoking a lot of pot. And because he takes certain medications, the drinking was making him, you know, he wasn't even present, really.
10815.name: Jack Osbourne

10816.quote: If I have a problem, stuff's going through my head, I feel like using, I usually go and talk to my dad, I decided to get sober a lot younger than he did. He first tried to get sober when he was like 32, I believe.
10816.name: Jack Osbourne

10817.quote: And then before going back for my sophomore year, I decided to change my major to arts and sciences, and my dad cut a deal with me: He said if I'd quit school he'd pay my rent for the next three years, as if I were in school.
10817.name: Sarah Silverman

10818.quote: I was born and brought up in Liverpool with my clever little sister Jemma, who is 14 and wants to be a vet. My mum Jane is an administrator and my dad Peter is a taxi driver.
10818.name: Jennifer Ellison

10819.quote: Dad worked in a warehouse when I was little and I didn't see him for three years as he was doing all the overtime God gave him to buy me new ballet shoes, or a new tutu.
10819.name: Jennifer Ellison

10820.quote: People say I'm not good at writing about men. My dad left when I was 16. Give me a break. I'm doing the best I can.
10820.name: Jennifer Weiner

10821.quote: My dad loved black singers. So listening to New Orleans music, eventually I wanted to play an instrument.
10821.name: Bill Kreutzmann

10822.quote: Dad was a very gentle, sweet man.
10822.name: Tony Scott

10823.quote: I had to learn how to chop wood actually - I don't think my dad would have let me go chop wood in the backyard growing up.
10823.name: Jennifer Lawrence

10824.quote: It is because my dad died suddenly that I became an actor. I thought, I'm going to make money doing this thing I enjoy.
10824.name: Paul Giamatti

10825.quote: Growing up, I saw my dad do charity work for children with health issues. That had a profound effect on me.
10825.name: David Boreanaz

10826.quote: I'm looking out for myself, but I'm looking out for my dad, too.
10826.name: Jamie Redknapp

10827.quote: I know I'm 25 now, but there's still that little lad inside me who likes his dad there to see him.
10827.name: Jamie Redknapp

10828.quote: My dad knows the business, and he tells me I've got to do what's best for me.
10828.name: Jamie Redknapp

10829.quote: Although my dad Harry is the manager of West Ham, we get on very well.
10829.name: Jamie Redknapp

10830.quote: At 18, I guarded the parking lot at the Catholic church bingos. Now my dad made sure I could take care of myself. I carried a Smith and Wesson 357 magnum.
10830.name: Susana Martinez

10831.quote: My dad was a golden gloves boxer in the Marine Corps, then a deputy sheriff. My mom worked as an office assistant.
10831.name: Susana Martinez

10832.quote: Comedy was why I got into acting the first place. Peter Sellers was a huge influence on my wanting to act. I grew up with him and found him hysterical. The Pink Panther films were an inspiration, from my earliest childhood days, when I was watching them with my brother and my dad.
10832.name: Sally Hawkins

10833.quote: I remember once giving my dad some drawings and writings and said, 'If you could just give these to the publisher, that would be great.' And I was about five!
10833.name: Sally Hawkins

10834.quote: My dad was an engineer, and he became the CEO of Chevron. His was an engineer's mind-set: Everything's kind of a problem how do you approach the problem?
10834.name: Bill Keller

10835.quote: My dad was a carpenter and I would work with him during the summer and umpire on the nights I wasn't playing.
10835.name: Jim Evans

10836.quote: I couldn't be a cameraman or a designer or an actor - I have to be a director because I learned how to do that from my dad.
10836.name: Joe Wright

10837.quote: My mom and dad met at UCLA when he as a captain in the Air Force and she was in her junior year.
10837.name: Tracy Austin

10838.quote: My dad instilled in me a great sense of humor. I wasn't bullied at school because my outward attitude was confident, and that helps.
10838.name: Warwick Davis

10839.quote: When I was born in 1970 with a rare genetic disorder called spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia congenita (SED), medical science wasn't what it is today and my mum and dad were treated terribly by the medical profession.
10839.name: Warwick Davis

10840.quote: My dad left when I was 3 1/2, and he left my mom and I.
10840.name: David Cassidy

10841.quote: As a father, I do everything my dad didn't do. My son Beau's birth changed my life.
10841.name: David Cassidy

10842.quote: I found myself very lost after 'The Partridge Family,' and I lost my dad and I lost my manager, and I lived in a bubble, and it took me 15 years to get through that and a lot of psychotherapy, and I'm laughing about it now!
10842.name: David Cassidy

10843.quote: I came up poor. My mother only had a fourth-grade education. My dad didn't have any education at all. But they were very structured. They worked hard. You know, they didn't complain. They didn't murmur. And they believe in the Christ.
10843.name: Evander Holyfield

10844.quote: Well, for one thing, you know my dad was a cop.
10844.name: Edward Burns

10845.quote: My dad used to say to me, 'You look more like me than I do.'
10845.name: Dhani Harrison

10846.quote: I did rebel. I was the rebel in my family, because my dad wanted me to go and just travel with him.
10846.name: Dhani Harrison

10847.quote: The music I want to hear in my head sounds somewhere between Jimi Hendrix and Massive Attack. It's not really like my dad, but there will always be similarities because we have the same vocal cords, and I learnt the guitar the way he taught me.
10847.name: Dhani Harrison

10848.quote: I don't really plan to be a pop star I just want to be able to make music without the whole My Dad thing hanging over me, which everyone in my position goes through.
10848.name: Dhani Harrison

10849.quote: You can' t help being a musician because you've grown up with music, yet being one means being compared to your dad and being slated for it. But I really don't have the ambitions of most people going into the industry.
10849.name: Dhani Harrison

10850.quote: When my dad toured in '91, I think my first gig properly was the Tokyo Dome, 50,000 people indoors. That was pretty scary. I was 12, or 13.
10850.name: Dhani Harrison

10851.quote: I was recording stuff with my dad when I was like five, six years old. I played with him on tour. I'd gone with him to Japan in '91, played some gigs, did a couple shows at the Albert Hall.
10851.name: Dhani Harrison

10852.quote: My dad lived till he was 78, my mum was in her 80s, and I've got two uncles who are in their 90s now.
10852.name: Ron Wood

10853.quote: My dad was a sports writer when I was younger and then he became just a general columnist. But I grew up with him literally getting into brawls with football coaches.
10853.name: Amy Klobuchar

10854.quote: My dad was a musician and I traveled around with him, so it was something that I knew.
10854.name: Taryn Manning

10855.quote: As a brother and sister, our tastes were pretty different growing up. He liked a lot of early hip hop. My dad didn't understand it and would try to talk him out of it.
10855.name: Taryn Manning

10856.quote: My dad was quiet, angry, shut down. So my thing is: I express everything that's there. I want to get it all out.
10856.name: Glen Hansard

10857.quote: I owe a lot to my dad, just for having provided the wrestling business for us to get into.
10857.name: Owen Hart

10858.quote: There was a bit of a comparison that Bret was making between Vince McMahon and my dad. He looked up to Vince as a dad and stuff, and it was a shame to see the whole thing end the way it did.
10858.name: Owen Hart

10859.quote: My dad was a big believer in treating people well, oftentimes even when he himself wasn't well.
10859.name: Neil Cavuto

10860.quote: And what is a stage dad, or a stage mom? It's someone who's protective. That's all.
10860.name: Nigel Lythgoe

10861.quote: My dad's half-Lebanese, my mom is full Lebanese. I'm three-quarters Lebanese. Irish-Lebanese.
10861.name: Tom Shadyac

10862.quote: Most young people haven't used their storytelling skills since they were 8 or 9 or 10 and wanted to persuade Mom and Dad to take them to the ball game.
10862.name: Peter Guber

10863.quote: My dad always told me that the best way to get somebody to get at you is to talk bad about them to somebody else.
10863.name: T-Pain

10864.quote: My dad always told me that anyone's voice is just another instrument added to the music.
10864.name: T-Pain

10865.quote: David and Dad didn't get along too well growing up. I mean we all got along, but it was harder on David, because David wasn't going to be the son that Dad wanted. But now they're like best friends.
10865.name: Amy Sedaris

10866.quote: Mom and Dad would stay in bed on Sunday morning, but the kids would have to go to church.
10866.name: Lynn Johnston

10867.quote: I wanted my children to have the same exposure to the water I had. My strongest memories of Northeast Harbor are going in a small Whaler with my dad, looking for osprey.
10867.name: Parker Stevenson

10868.quote: My dad was a musician, it was just what he did, like another guy's dad drives a meat truck. Our house was normal. We weren't taken with the fact our dad was a musician.
10868.name: Branford Marsalis

10869.quote: My dad has a really great record collection that basically went up to the year I was born: 1984.
10869.name: Ezra Koenig

10870.quote: My dad grew up in a working-class Jewish neighbourhood, and I got a scholarship from my dad's union to go to college. I went there to get an education, not as an extension of privilege.
10870.name: Ezra Koenig

10871.quote: My dad was a musician. He was a singer and he played the guitar, so music was always around.
10871.name: Kris Allen

10872.quote: I've always wanted to be a dad.
10872.name: Kris Allen

10873.quote: My first memory of the Rolling Stones is listening to 'Satisfaction' at a sixth-grade slumber party at a friend's house in Ankara, Turkey, where my family was living at the time. In the middle of our sleepover, my friend's dad stopped the record when he heard the words 'girlie action!'
10873.name: Gayle King

10874.quote: My dad used to say, 'You have to become part of the machine to beat the machine,' and there's some validity in it. But honestly, even when I'm inside the machine, you still see me. I stick out a little bit.
10874.name: Michael Shannon

10875.quote: Your kids can say some cruel things to you at times. For example, Nicole, Miles and Sofie are standing there in the room and I'm dressed to kill in my own mind. They'll say to me, 'Dad, you're not going out there looking like that are you?' If that doesn't kill a star, I don't know what does!
10875.name: Lionel Richie

10876.quote: I am an obsessive garage cleaner - my wife and the neighbors make fun of me. I remember that my father was the same way, and now when I'm out there unearthing things in the garage, I realize I am becoming my dad!
10876.name: Chris O'Donnell

10877.quote: Keep in my mind my dad didn't become a huge, huge mega actor until I was halfway through high school - so right around the time he's going through his big renaissance is right when I'm starting to do my high school revolting.
10877.name: Colin Hanks

10878.quote: My dad has always been extremely supportive in every decision I've made and much more interested in me picking what I wanted to do.
10878.name: Colin Hanks

10879.quote: I knew that I needed to do something that I desperately loved. There was a period where I did question if it was acting because I knew that I would be making things hard on myself. I knew that there was going to be a little bit of a hullabaloo because of my dad being who he is and all that.
10879.name: Colin Hanks

10880.quote: When I was younger it was - you know, my dad dressed up in drag on 'Bosom Buddies.' And that was what I was having to deal with at the time. And then around the time that I was into college was when he became statue-worthy I guess you could say.
10880.name: Colin Hanks

10881.quote: This is like my dad's race team where we had one Legend car. If we wrecked it, we couldn't race the next week unless we had enough parts to put it back together again.
10881.name: Kurt Busch

10882.quote: Before, I guess, mum and dad were everything, but now, in my case, I had two new girls and all of a sudden they're completely dependent on you and there's a third generation. It's a funny shift all of a sudden. You have the babies, you have yourself and then you have your parents.
10882.name: Roger Federer

10883.quote: I was just a kid and I didn't have a dad. That's hard, because when you're a kid, you blame yourself for everything. And I blamed myself for him not being around, for my parents not being together.
10883.name: Jonathan Rhys Meyers

10884.quote: You can tell your uncle stuff that you could not tell your dad. That is kind of the role of an uncle. I feel very much like a father sometimes but sometimes I feel like a teammate.
10884.name: Dusty Baker

10885.quote: Whenever I'm in theatre situations I will go out of my way not to talk about my father, but in the film world I can be really proud of my family and say, 'You know what: my dad's a really, really famous theatre director,' because nobody has any idea.
10885.name: Rebecca Hall

10886.quote: My dad was great. He was very droll, very dry.
10886.name: Albert Finney

10887.quote: A lot of times I would go into a room and audition for whatever sitcom it was and they would expect me to do sort of what my dad was doing and I am not him so they would be disappointed and I would feel nervous and not know exactly how to do it.
10887.name: Jason Ritter

10888.quote: Even if I tried to be my dad, it would be a mediocre, slightly embarrassing version.
10888.name: Jason Ritter

10889.quote: I knew I really made it when my dad saw me in London and after the performance he had no notes to me and just said 'You are doing your own thing and I am proud of you.'
10889.name: Jason Ritter

10890.quote: And my dad wanted me to play the trumpet because that's what he liked. His idol was Louis Armstrong. My dad thought my teeth came together in a way that was perfect for playing the trumpet.
10890.name: Jackson Browne

10891.quote: Now, guitar was pretty cool. Everybody knew something on the guitar. So I wanted to play guitar, but I told my dad if he wanted me to keep studying something, I'd like to study piano.
10891.name: Jackson Browne

10892.quote: I grew up in Greenwich Village. Dad was friends with John Lennon and Yoko Ono.
10892.name: Yancy Butler

10893.quote: I think there's nothing better than laughing in life, so that's nice, to be thought of as someone who can make someone laugh. It's 'cause I think life is hard. You know, my dad was a really silly man. A great Irish silly man. And that's fine.
10893.name: Joan Cusack

10894.quote: I'm a dad and that's pretty important.
10894.name: Todd Akin

10895.quote: My dad was a football player - a soccer player - for Manchester United, and I loved playing football, but I also happened to be the guy in class who was pretty good at sight reading. My teacher gave me scripts, and I was very comfortable.
10895.name: Ian McShane

10896.quote: Well, Steve Vai joined my dad's band right around the time when I actually started playing guitar. So he gave me a couple of lessons on fundamentals, and gave me some scales and practice things to work on. But I pretty much learned everything by ear.
10896.name: Dweezil Zappa

10897.quote: And, you know, my dad would show me some things sometimes, but the best things that I got to do were to actually see really good players play up close. That gives you an idea of fingering and technique and what not.
10897.name: Dweezil Zappa

10898.quote: I liked a lot of the things other people liked - Jimi Hendrix, The Beatles, Van Halen, AC/DC - but if I compared it to my dad's music, there just seemed to be elements missing.
10898.name: Dweezil Zappa

10899.quote: I didn't really hear any other music other than what my dad was working on until I was 12. My recollection of hearing other music was that I liked some things that I heard but I always thought, 'Where's the rest of it?' It didn't have the same amount of detail or instrumentation or imagination in the arrangements.
10899.name: Dweezil Zappa

10900.quote: My dad taught me to be a leader or a follower, and he said follower ain't fun. So I want to be the leader of Bubba Watson.
10900.name: Bubba Watson

10901.quote: I had just lost my dad and I remembered all the songs we used to go and hear at concerts, and the records around the house and sometimes we'd play together.
10901.name: Vince Gill

10902.quote: The real beauty of it - key to my life was playing key chords on a banjo. For somebody else it may be a golf club that mom and dad put in their hands or a baseball or ballet lessons. Real gift to give to me and put it in writing.
10902.name: Vince Gill

10903.quote: I'm being a dad and a good husband.
10903.name: Chad Smith

10904.quote: I'm worried because of my mother, she's going to see my performance and she's quite hard. She's going to see me naked. And my Dad, woah. Yeah, they're going to see me like a woman, you know?
10904.name: Eva Green

10905.quote: My dad didn't want me to play guitar. He played piano, so I chose that. And I ended up loving it.
10905.name: Gavin DeGraw

10906.quote: Growing up, my father was a financial analyst for an oil company. He was just a regular dad. And when I would say, 'Hey, come see my play,' he'd say, 'Sure.' He'd see one, 'Oh, good play' - you know, very typical dad reaction.
10906.name: Eric McCormack

10907.quote: I was a sickly baby, and after two sets of adoptive parents took me home, they returned me to the orphanage because of a serious respiratory infection. But as they say, the third time's a charm, because my mom and dad adopted me and took me into their home where I was raised in a family full of love.
10907.name: Rodney Atkins

10908.quote: Right now, it hasn't affected my music other than the fact that I don't have time to write any of it. That's no different from when I first started and I lived at home. I would play the guitar in the afternoon and then my mom or my dad would come home and I'd have to quit.
10908.name: Paul Westerberg

10909.quote: The best thing about being a dad? Well, I think it's just the thing that every man wants - to have a son and heir.
10909.name: George Best

10910.quote: We all feel really blessed to have been with my dad for these 85 years.
10910.name: Beau Bridges

10911.quote: I've always wanted to be a dad. I just can't wait to have a little rug rat running around. I used to want five or six kids, but maybe I've become too self-absorbed over the years. I think two would be perfect.
10911.name: Josh Duhamel

10912.quote: I lost my dad way too early and it was agonisingly awful. I missed him so much and I hated knowing that I could never again pick up the phone to tell him about my day.
10912.name: Monica Seles

10913.quote: But more importantly, I think he remembered how very close I was with my own dad, who had died in 1997.
10913.name: Richard Marx

10914.quote: My dad worked several jobs to pay for my expense in skating.
10914.name: Nancy Kerrigan

10915.quote: I was who I was in high school in accordance with the rules of conduct for a normal person, like obeying your mom and dad. Then I got out of high school and moved out of the house, and I just started, for lack of a better term, running free.
10915.name: Iggy Pop

10916.quote: My kids love it. I thought I was the coolest dad in the world when I got to be in a Bond film, but 'Harry Potter', too? Well, I think I qualify for a medal for exceptional parenting or something, don't you?
10916.name: Robbie Coltraine

10917.quote: My parents were both actors my dad sort of quite early on. My mother acted for a while, and now she's a painter.
10917.name: Sam Rockwell

10918.quote: I'm an artist, and I go in the studio and make my music. And then I'll give it to my dad and he does what he does. And he does, you know, the press, and figuring out shows and whatnot. When it comes to my artistic freedom, he doesn't, like, step on my toes or anything.
10918.name: Ashlee Simpson

10919.quote: A lot of young filmmakers bring their movies to my dad because he always gives lots of good editing ideas and notes. He'd be a good film professor.
10919.name: Sofia Coppola

10920.quote: Mom was the one who taught me unconditional love. With Dad, I'd always felt there was something to live up to - expectations. But in the last year, we had a wonderful relationship.
10920.name: Greg Louganis

10921.quote: I didn't want to have braces when I was a kid and I'm pretty sure my dad didn't want to pay for them.
10921.name: Jessica Pare

10922.quote: Life is different than it was in the Nineties. I'm a dad, and there are other things I have to get done in an afternoon than just being an artist.
10922.name: Chris Robinson

10923.quote: If you had told me at 45 years old that I would have to go on tour to get rest, I would've said, 'That's not how it works.' But nothing can be more gratifying. I'm a very hands-on dad.
10923.name: Chris Robinson

10924.quote: So I was always around music and my dad was in his own way a progressive jazzer, a big band jazzer guy.
10924.name: Billy Sherwood

10925.quote: My dad farmed, my granddad was a farmer. I wanted to be a farmer.
10925.name: Sam Brownback

10926.quote: When my dad died a lot of songs came, and they're still coming.
10926.name: Rosanne Cash

10927.quote: Because I was starting out in my 20's. I wanted to do it on my own. I didn't want to use my dad or have people say I was using him.
10927.name: Rosanne Cash

10928.quote: I'm afraid that this is me getting on my high horse now but we have yob television, yob newspapers, and funny enough whereas it was my mum and dad, school, police, church who used to set the standards, now it's tabloids and yob television who set the standards by which people live.
10928.name: Gordon Strachan

10929.quote: That's what my Dad always told me, on the ballot, they should always have a third choice, like none of the above, then if enough people picked that, they'd have to get new candidates.
10929.name: Meg White

10930.quote: I always had a standard of, back when I was doing the country music I always told people I would never record a song that I wouldn't sit down and sing in front of my mom and dad.
10930.name: Ricky Skaggs

10931.quote: I deal with my sons like young men. If they have a problem with something, they come to me. I am the type of dad that will drop everything I am doing for them, and always tell them to talk to me about it.
10931.name: Tracy Morgan

10932.quote: I think when I was a kid, and I was in England and it was all about The Stones, The Who, The Kinks and The Beatles and that's what my dad was into.
10932.name: Slash

10933.quote: My dad is a huge rock and roll lead guitar fan. I didn't even really know that until recently. Everything has to have a guitar solo in it.
10933.name: Slash

10934.quote: My dad is a huge rock n' roll lead guitar fan.
10934.name: Slash

10935.quote: I was born in Corpus Christi, Texas, the youngest of four girls, including my oldest sister, Lisa, who has special needs. My mom was a special education teacher, and my dad worked on the Army base. We weren't wealthy, but we were determined to succeed.
10935.name: Eva Longoria

10936.quote: I'm Bam Margera. And I feel like kicking my dad's butt all day today.
10936.name: Bam Margera

10937.quote: Dad went to Canada to learn how to fly with the Royal Canadian Air Force. He took me on my first airplane ride, where I could have a hand on the stick.
10937.name: Wally Schirra

10938.quote: The last thing I want my child to see is Dad running around in the middle of the pack. That would really upset me. And that would upset him. I would be embarrassed to take him to school with kids saying, 'Hey, how'd your dad do this weekend?' 'Well, he finished fifth or sixth'.
10938.name: Dan Wheldon

10939.quote: I had the best of both worlds when I was a kid. I'd spend a quiet week with my mum, then I'd go to my dad's property in the Adelaide Hills, where there were all these kids and animals running around.
10939.name: Teresa Palmer

10940.quote: My dad would always say, 'What can you do to make the world a better place?' Well, I can make people laugh.
10940.name: Jon Lovitz

10941.quote: Tiffany is very proud to have the last name and she's proud of her dad.
10941.name: Marla Maples

10942.quote: As much as I transferred my mother to Elizabeth Shore of The Black Dahlia, as much as her dad mutated into an obsession with crime in general, well, I have thought about other things throughout the years.
10942.name: James Ellroy

10943.quote: I grew up watching Monday Night Football with Howard Cosell and the other guys with my dad.
10943.name: Lisa Guerrero

10944.quote: So my dad raised me, and he's a huge football fan.
10944.name: Lisa Guerrero

10945.quote: When I found out I got this job, I cried, of course - I'm a girly-girl - and then I called my dad, and he cried, too. On so many levels, this is a thrill for me.
10945.name: Lisa Guerrero

10946.quote: I grew up loving Walter Payton. My dad used to always show us film of him.
10946.name: Shaun Alexander

10947.quote: You know when everyone's watching, your mom and dad, your friends in high school who thought they were better than you. You get your chance to get in the spotlight and shine.
10947.name: Shaun Alexander

10948.quote: We would make songs, and the producers said we should play it for my dad. I was kind of scared, I didn't know what to think cuz we were just joking around.
10948.name: Lil' Romeo

10949.quote: My dad was a workaholic. I saw him work seven days a week.
10949.name: Kay Bailey Hutchison

10950.quote: I love my hockey, but if you can do that and go home and just be a dad and husband, then you have the best of both worlds.
10950.name: Curtis Joseph

10951.quote: Although becoming a singer was my plan A after first hearing Whitney Houston when I was 17, I started off with plan B by going to the teacher-training college that my dad went to. It was a slow coming of age.
10951.name: Toni Braxton

10952.quote: I finished high school, moved to Nashville for college, and set out to break into the music business. Every night when I called home with news of my experiences, my mom and dad would encourage me to keep taking those small steps.
10952.name: Trisha Yearwood

10953.quote: We sat together as a family for dinner at night. And my mother had a job. My dad had a job. But there was always a meal on the table at 6:00, you know.
10953.name: Trisha Yearwood

10954.quote: From time to time, I'll look back through the personal journals I've scribbled in throughout my life, the keepers of my raw thoughts and emotions. The words poured forth after my dad died, when I went through a divorce, and after I was diagnosed with breast cancer. There are so many what-ifs scribbled on those pages.
10954.name: Hoda Kotb

10955.quote: So I go to my first book signing, and these two girls came up and gave me a piece of paper: '10 reasons you should date our dad. He climbed Mount Kilimanjaro. He's a lawyer.' He didn't know what was going on. He didn't even know me. They called him, and he came down and asked me out that day. Now I'm dating their dad!
10955.name: Hoda Kotb

10956.quote: Being an only child, I didn't have any other family but my mom and dad really, since the rest of my family lived quite far away from London.
10956.name: Tom Hardy

10957.quote: I wanted my dad to be proud of me, and I fell into acting because there wasn't anything else I could do, and in it I found a discipline that I wanted to keep coming back to, that I love and I learn about every day.
10957.name: Tom Hardy

10958.quote: My dad still calls me and makes sure I'm taking my vitamins.
10958.name: Melanie Fiona

10959.quote: I'm gonna be the best dad that ever lived. I'll have a ranch with a race car track and a golf course.
10959.name: Jeremy London

10960.quote: Recently, I was in Bernalda, my dad's ancestral home town in Italy. He has just refurbished a palazzo and turned it into a hotel, so we had my sister's wedding there. It was beautiful.
10960.name: Roman Coppola

10961.quote: My dad had been shortstop when he was in college, and you know, when you're a kid, you want to be just like your dad.
10961.name: Derek Jeter

10962.quote: As it has been told to me, my Dad had some kind of deal with Dick Clark. But when we got here, that fell through. So we were out here with no job, no furniture, no food.
10962.name: Danny Bonaduce

10963.quote: In the original draft I was 27 and Peter was 55 in the script. That's not the same as a guy in his 40s and a dad in the end of his 70s. It's a different point in both our lives.
10963.name: Paul Reiser

10964.quote: In fact, I had the idea because of Peter Falk. I saw my dad watching a Peter Falk movie and something clicked in my head. I gotta go make a movie for Peter Falk and me.
10964.name: Paul Reiser

10965.quote: And in that time, I lost my dad and had kids of my own. It was like, OK, I get it now. I know what fatherhood is all about. And you look at your parents differently.
10965.name: Paul Reiser

10966.quote: My Dad was so open creatively that I was off in search of black turtleneck bathing suits with long sleeves.
10966.name: Moon Unit Zappa

10967.quote: My mother is Italian and my dad's Irish. In my family, we're expressive. Nobody holds back.
10967.name: Kate Walsh

10968.quote: My Dad died during the flu epidemic in 1918 when I was 4 years old. He left a lot of classical recordings behind that I began listening to at an early age, so he must have been a music lover.
10968.name: Tom Glazer

10969.quote: Well, I am a lot like my dad, and the character of Ted is based on my dad.
10969.name: Max Cannon

10970.quote: Dad was a bus driver, and when he finished work he would repair cars.
10970.name: Bruno Tonioli

10971.quote: When it came to the stylish and graceful art of ballroom dancing, my dad was a king of the clubs, a prowling tiger and a wonderfully natural mover.
10971.name: Bruno Tonioli

10972.quote: Dad said that he was prouder of me than he'd ever been when I came out.
10972.name: Randy Harrison

10973.quote: Everybody always wants to rebel against their parents' music, but nobody listened to music louder than my dad.
10973.name: Dan Auerbach

10974.quote: I used to be really nervous when I sang. Like, when I was a kid starting young, 18 and 19, and my dad really had to sort of push me to start singing in front of people. Ever since I got out there and really started doing it, the only thing I've ever tried to do is just sort of is be myself, you know, never put on a voice. Sing naturally.
10974.name: Dan Auerbach

10975.quote: My dad was very fun and very adventurous, and from a formative age I learned to value men who would do things on a whim.
10975.name: Rachel Hunter

10976.quote: My dad let me figure out what I wanted to do on my own.
10976.name: Georgia Jagger

10977.quote: My dad's not a very intimidating father figure.
10977.name: Georgia Jagger

10978.quote: My dad's supportive of all my endeavors.
10978.name: Georgia Jagger

10979.quote: My dad has more sparkly stuff than most men.
10979.name: Georgia Jagger

10980.quote: When I was about 12 and first started wearing lipstick, my dad would ask, 'Are you wearing makeup?' I would say back, 'You're wearing more makeup there than I am!'
10980.name: Georgia Jagger

10981.quote: I can't remember a major league game where I could make eye contact with my dad. I kept wondering if he was going to yell at me for hanging a pitch or something.
10981.name: David Cone

10982.quote: My dad had a movie theater so I was there every night.
10982.name: Brion James

10983.quote: I'm really, really lucky. I was given my dad's good genes.
10983.name: Josh Brolin

10984.quote: I started playing ball when I was a kid. My dad was a pro ball player and he passed on his knowledge to me.
10984.name: Kurt Russell

10985.quote: At times I've got a really big ego. But I'll tell you the best thing about me. I'm some guy's dad I'm some little gal's dad. When I die, if they say I was Annie's husband and Zachary John and Anna Kate's father, boy, that's enough for me to be remembered by. That's more than enough.
10985.name: John Denver

10986.quote: I realised I could run after finding out that my dad used to run and it gave me the morale that if he did it then maybe I could also run.
10986.name: David Rudisha

10987.quote: I get around OK with a toolbox. As a kid, I picked up skills following my dad through the oil fields of Oklahoma and West Texas. My wife Janine is hard to impress, but she does think it's cool when I fix things around the house.
10987.name: Ronnie Dunn

10988.quote: My dad is a really honest, hardworking, straight guy.
10988.name: Joe Lando

10989.quote: I had a dad you know.
10989.name: Darrell Hammond

10990.quote: And I remember leaving my place in L.A. and - my father is a big fight fan - and I said, 'Dad, I got a couple of days off and I'm getting ready to go to Houston to sign to fight Muhammad Ali.
10990.name: Wilt Chamberlain

10991.quote: When you get pure joy out of 'being' rather than 'doing' or 'seeing,' that's when you realize how big and unexplainable some things are and being a dad is one of those very few things.
10991.name: Brendan Fehr

10992.quote: Also, to be honest, my dad wanted me to be an athlete. And I think all sons want to prove something to their dad. So now, aged 35, I want to see what I can achieve physically.
10992.name: Joe Manganiello

10993.quote: I'm one of five kids and we lived on a massive farm in New South Wales with my mum and dad.
10993.name: Abbie Cornish

10994.quote: Dad, I'm in some trouble. There's been an accident and you're going to hear all sorts of things about me from now on. Terrible things.
10994.name: Edward Kennedy

10995.quote: My dad's a bodybuilder. My whole life I've been taught to train the hard way. I believe in earning strength, not buying it. My grandfather raised me old school: In baseball, you work for whatever you get.
10995.name: Gary Sheffield

10996.quote: My background is basically scientific math. My Dad was a physicist, so I have it in my blood somewhere. Scientific method is very important to me. I think anything that contradicts it is probably not true.
10996.name: John Astin

10997.quote: My father was Catholic, my mother was Protestant, and because of that I got Christened in both churches, so I've got all these names, but my Dad always called me Mick.
10997.name: Mickey Spillane

10998.quote: When I was a teenager, my dad used to call me 'Hollywood' because I wore sunglasses all the time, even at night. Cue song.
10998.name: Michael Weatherly

10999.quote: My dad's one of my biggest heroes. I also think Paul Newman's an inspiration. I know a lot of people say that, but I love that he's a great role model and a humanitarian. I admire people who don't necessarily want to change the world, but try to make it a better environment.
10999.name: Alex Pettyfer

11000.quote: It would be nice if I did have a good relationship with my family, and yes, part of me longs to have a mum and dad who love and accept me for who I am. But if they never do, it's OK.
11000.name: Heather Graham

11001.quote: He was a manager, one of the singers, I guess talent coordinator for the local talent in Harlem. His name was Lover Patterson. He was living right across the street from where my dad had his restaurant. I guess he saw a lot of kids come in, a lot of my buddies.
11001.name: Ben E. King

11002.quote: Many forms, sizes and colors, I think there are heroes in sports, in life, It would be cliche to say my dad, my granddad. I think I'm a fan of people who were brave, my aunt, my grandmother, those are my heroes.
11002.name: George Eads

11003.quote: My mother's incredibly giving, almost too giving at times. And, my dad is a real logical person. He's got logic for every situation. They've been married for 24 years, so there was that stability, also. I really learned to think on my own at a very young age.
11003.name: Brian Austin Green

11004.quote: I'm left handed, but my dad taught me to play guitar right-handed.
11004.name: Dustin Diamond

11005.quote: My mum and my dad are the sweetest couple.
11005.name: Rita Ora

11006.quote: My dad was vehemently opposed to electric guitars. He did not look on that kind of music as legitimate in any way.
11006.name: Dan Fogelberg

11007.quote: My dad served in the Air Force as ground crew for several years, and doesn't really talk about it. I know that it's there. I think my main thing about direct or indirect experiences as near to home as it were is the idea of self-sacrifice really.
11007.name: Jeremy Northam

11008.quote: Our dad was a great guy and we will never forget him.
11008.name: Lara St. John

11009.quote: That's a tough question I've been acting since I was 10. My dad was an entrepreneur, so I guess something along those lines. I wouldn't want a 9-5 job.
11009.name: Will Estes

11010.quote: I've been acting since I was 10. My dad was an entrepreneur, so I guess something along those lines. I wouldn't want a 9-5 job.
11010.name: Will Estes

11011.quote: On the one hand, I've had such a normal upbringing with my mum, who has kept me grounded, but on the other, the wild experiences through my dad.
11011.name: Julian Lennon

11012.quote: My mom's a Catholic, and my dad's a Jew, and they didn't want anything to do with anything.
11012.name: Isabelle Huppert

11013.quote: The only other time I can recall my dad getting upset at me was when I missed a hockey practice. My parents were away, so my buddy and I decided to skip it. I never told my dad about it, but he found out from the coach.
11013.name: Mike Weir

11014.quote: Well my dad was a pretty good player at one stage and my two older brothers played golf as well. So there were always golf clubs flying around the house.
11014.name: Retief Goosen

11015.quote: I wasn't sure how my dad would react. There was an agent sitting behind them and he told me he was embarrassed to watch the scenes. My parents have always been very open. They trust my decisions.
11015.name: Shannon Elizabeth

11016.quote: I used to listen to my dad a lot as a way of trying to be close to him, as well, because my parents were divorced and I didn't spend that much time with him. And I used to put headphones on and listen to my dad talk and sing and I found that quite, bonding with him, in a weird way.
11016.name: Teddy Thompson

11017.quote: It was sort of just a family sport. My mom and dad were pretty keen golfers when I was young and so were my grandparents, and I just sort of tagged along with them.
11017.name: Karrie Webb

11018.quote: Things with my dad were pretty good until I won an Academy Award. He was really loving to me until I got more attention than he did. Then he hated me.
11018.name: Tatum O'Neal

11019.quote: I would ask my dad what he did, and he'd say, 'I listen to people's problems.' In some way what he did for a living is in my genes.
11019.name: Marcia Cross

11020.quote: But although Australia was also involved in the Vietnam conflict, I can remember my dad telling us that if we were in Australia, we wouldn't be drafted until we were 20.
11020.name: Mel Gibson

11021.quote: When I was a kid, I wanted to walk with my dad's limp - my dad was my hero - but that infuriated him, and he would make me walk back and forth in the living room until I walked without it.
11021.name: David Alan Grier

11022.quote: When I grew up, people said, 'You'll never be the man your dad was.' And I said, 'Gee, I hope not.'
11022.name: Rip Torn

11023.quote: My dad has always been really helpful. He taught me that talent is a bonus, but persistence is what wins out.
11023.name: Zosia Mamet

11024.quote: But my father was also the one who told me I needed to clean up my mouth or I'd never find a man. What's very important to him is manners. Show up on time. Always send thank-you letters. He is one of the more thoughtful humans I've ever met. He's a great man and a very good dad.
11024.name: Zosia Mamet

11025.quote: I didn't want to play a lawyer. I didn't want to play a doctor. I didn't want to play a single dad. I wanted to do something I felt I could learn from, something that would be a challenge and something that would not dry up.
11025.name: William Petersen

11026.quote: I feel that marrying younger and being quite a young dad helped me with the stability of my career.
11026.name: Patrick Duffy

11027.quote: I worked with my dad for 15 years. I apprenticed under him and decided I wanted to become an architect. So I went to college for it and then the acting bug got me.
11027.name: Patrick Duffy

11028.quote: Indians mock their corrupt politicians relentlessly, but they regard their honest politicians with silent suspicion. The first thing they do when they hear of a supposedly 'clean' politician is to grin. It is a cliche that honest politicians in India tend to have dishonest sons, who collect money from people seeking an audience with Dad.
11028.name: Aravind Adiga

11029.quote: I was born and raised in the high desert of Nevada in a tiny town called Searchlight. My dad was a hard rock miner. My mom took in wash. I grew up around people of strong values - even if they rarely talked about them.
11029.name: Harry Reid

11030.quote: I think women look for that quality in a man of being a good dad whether they're immediately wanting to be a parent or not.
11030.name: Emily VanCamp

11031.quote: I'm just as insufferable and useless as every other dad is. The dynamic never changes, no matter what you do for a living.
11031.name: Glenn Frey

11032.quote: My dad's Irish music was such a huge influence.
11032.name: Dido Armstrong

11033.quote: I feel very warm towards Mum and Dad for giving us the independence they did. My childhood, and the fact we didn't have a TV, gave me a boundless imagination.
11033.name: Dido Armstrong

11034.quote: I want babies. I think I'll be a great dad.
11034.name: Oliver Hudson

11035.quote: My dad was a singer in a band and neither of my parents went to college, and I ended up getting into Harvard and was the first person in my family that went to college and it happened to be Harvard.
11035.name: Dean Norris

11036.quote: The best thing I ever learned from my dad was he knew he wasn't the best of singers, but he always knew he was a great entertainer, and I always thought that was a good concept to bring along, that ultimately acting is an entertainment art and you have to be aware of the fact that you want people to be excited to be watching you.
11036.name: Dean Norris

11037.quote: My dad's era believed that there was something noble in being a good guy - the kind of guy that lived straight and narrow, told the truth, and stood up for what he believed was right.
11037.name: Dean Norris

11038.quote: My dad had been an actor, not only had my dad been an actor, but his dad had been an actor, and my great-grandfather had been an actor. And who knows before then?
11038.name: David Hyde Pierce

11039.quote: I went and took golf lessons so Dad would let me play with him. I was just terrible, but I was able to have a wonderful time just walking around with Dad. I can see the real pleasure of that game.
11039.name: David Hyde Pierce

11040.quote: When you're nearing 35, going, 'Hey Dad, I can't make these payments,' just isn't cool.
11040.name: Eleanor Mondale

11041.quote: I wanted to be an actress. I think it had a lot to do with being a kid and watching how every time my dad would stand up to talk people would applaud, that was pretty cool.
11041.name: Eleanor Mondale

11042.quote: I look at my little girl and I wonder what she's going to be and what she's going to do and what is it that leads girls certain directions in life. I think a lot of that goes back to what kind of father they had, and so it makes me want to be the best dad I can possibly be.
11042.name: Jake Owen

11043.quote: I had always loved music. I grew up listening to classic country, Waylon Jennings, Merle Haggard. My dad loved Vern Gosdin and Keith Whitley. So I kept going to class and started getting totally into playing guitar and teaching myself these songs.
11043.name: Jake Owen

11044.quote: My dad has always been very proud of me but I think I have exceeded his expectations. When I told him I wanted to be an actor and moved to New York City, I think he assumed I would be playing the guitar on the subway and collecting spare change in my guitar case. The fact that I'm not doing that means that I'm a huge success.
11044.name: Jesse Tyler Ferguson

11045.quote: Dad really had little to do with the songs, except to perform them.
11045.name: Nancy Sinatra

11046.quote: I wanted to travel with my dad to be close to him again. Having babies and raising my own family took so much of my time, I didn't have a chance to be with him very often.
11046.name: Nancy Sinatra

11047.quote: My dad was the baby. When he was born they were already successful. They sent him to business school - he probably would have loved to have been a poet or a writer or something, and he was very creative.
11047.name: Bob Balaban

11048.quote: My dad was born in Chicago in 1908, his parents came from Russia. They settled in Chicago, where they lived in a little tiny grocery store with eight or nine children - in the backroom all together - and my grandmother got the idea to go into the movie business.
11048.name: Bob Balaban

11049.quote: My dad told me that no one could ever make it as a writer, that my chances were equivalent to winning the lottery - which was good for me, because I like to have something to prove.
11049.name: Poppy Z. Brite

11050.quote: From my dad I learned to be good to people, to always be honest and straightforward. I learned hard work and perseverance.
11050.name: Luke Bryan

11051.quote: My dad is very successful in his business. He's always been big in having hobbies and having little ways to get away. He always made time for hunting and fishing. He always encouraged me to do it.
11051.name: Luke Bryan

11052.quote: We had our first earthquake over here recently. That was a bizarre feeling. I just became disoriented and I remember my dad freaking out. Nothing broke or anything.
11052.name: Ashley Scott

11053.quote: I suppose not everyone has a dad who wrote a book saying he didn't believe in the Parliamentary road to socialism.
11053.name: Ed Miliband

11054.quote: There was nothing more important I could do than be supportive as a dad.
11054.name: Arne Duncan

11055.quote: My dad named me Dakota and my mom came up with my first name Hannah. So it's Hannah Dakota Fanning.
11055.name: Dakota Fanning

11056.quote: My dad was a master butcher and I trained to be a butcher when I left school. I didn't enjoy it at the time but I love cooking now, so perhaps I would have been a chef.
11056.name: Brendan Coyle

11057.quote: I started off playing the clarinet, after I was inspired by listening to my dad's Benny Goodman records.
11057.name: Alvin Lee

11058.quote: I absolutely love working with my dad because there is such an ease about it, and I also love his company.
11058.name: Samuel West

11059.quote: I've got an idea for a modern day faerie tale that I think would made a great short novel. But I just don't have the time to work on it right now. I'm way too busy with the 'Kingkiller Chronicles' and being a new dad.
11059.name: Patrick Rothfuss

11060.quote: If you met my dad, I think a lot of things would be put to rest. Because my pops is a pretty silly guy. But, Coldcut, they're based in the U.K. I'm a big fan of jazz music, so American music has had a big influence on what I listen to.
11060.name: Eric San

11061.quote: When I realized I was having trouble reading, I was too embarrassed to ask for help. Some teachers believed in me, but I just wasn't focused on school - I was into the music and trying to please my dad.
11061.name: Fantasia Barrino

11062.quote: I'm an ambassador for the Make-A-Wish Foundation, and one of the children, his wish was to go to the Emmys, so he's going to be my date, along with my husband, and my dad and his girlfriend. So we're going to have a really fun night and it's going to be really exciting. I'm really excited for him to experience that.
11062.name: Christina Hendricks

11063.quote: My little son, Atticus, desperately needs his dad and I haven't been there for him, and that's sad.
11063.name: Daniel Baldwin

11064.quote: Work ethic has always been stressed in my family. My dad is going to be 80 years old and he still works part time. My mom just retired a couple years ago and she's in her mid- to late 70s.
11064.name: Jamie Moyer

11065.quote: My dad always said I was hard-headed, that it would take something like that to wake me up spiritually, and I guess it did. My heart had gotten so beat up that I didn't have anything left to give.
11065.name: Scott Stapp

11066.quote: You know, no matter what I am or what I do for a living, I'm still, you know, the husband and the dad and the protector of the house, and I have to be conscientious about that.
11066.name: Richie Sambora

11067.quote: Going through the grief period of my dad and losing him - that was the worst thing because you know when you get that call. When you are seven, eight years old, you have that almost vision in your mind of what that's going to be like and what your going to feel like and it doesn't prepare you.
11067.name: Richie Sambora

11068.quote: I love being a dad. I'd have more kids if I could. I'd take a couple more, one or two more before I croak.
11068.name: Richie Sambora

11069.quote: I've got my dad's height and smoking habit. But I think I've got my mum's looks and sensibilities.
11069.name: Max Irons

11070.quote: My dad was an entrepreneurial businessman, and maybe I got some of his ability.
11070.name: Thomas Jane

11071.quote: The people on my mum's side of the family are atheist intellectuals who are ueber-proper. My dad's side of the family are missionaries who are more comfortable sitting around in sweatpants than they are in a five-star restaurant. But those two influences converged in my life.
11071.name: Evangeline Lilly

11072.quote: I recruited my dad to be my bass player and fired him on several occasions. He stayed on as a bus driver.
11072.name: Chely Wright

11073.quote: Whenever I did a good performance, my Dad and my uncles, who were rabid movie fans, took me to the movies. There began my underlying love affair with film.
11073.name: Mel Torme

11074.quote: My dad thinks Obama is a socialist and all these extreme views.
11074.name: Jonathan Krohn

11075.quote: I'm a good dad I spend a lot of time with my kids.
11075.name: Steve Zahn

11076.quote: I was trying to make art that my son could look on in the future and would realize I was thinking about him very much during these times, that he can look and see my dad's thinking about me, but to also embed in these things something that is bigger than all of us.
11076.name: Jeff Koons

11077.quote: I'm probably a little more like my dad. But because of my mom, I never saw being a woman as being an impediment to being able to do something. She had her Ph.D. before I was born.
11077.name: Mary Cheney

11078.quote: We always had lutefisk for Christmas dinner, after which Dad read from the Norwegian Bible.
11078.name: Peter Agre

11079.quote: Dad was a chemistry professor at Saint Olaf College in Minnesota, then Oxford College in Minnesota, and a very active member of the American Chemical Society education committee, where he sat on the committee with Linus Pauling, who had authored a very phenomenally important textbook of chemistry.
11079.name: Peter Agre

11080.quote: To those of you who are wearing ties, I think my dad would appreciate it if you took them off.
11080.name: Robert Moog

11081.quote: For my birthday this year, my girlfriends - who knew I'd just inherited my dad's turntable - gave me a carton of albums like 'Blue Kentucky Girl,' by Emmylou Harris, and 'Off the Wall,' by Michael Jackson. It's all stuff we grew up with. I mean, you can't have a music collection without Prince's 'Purple Rain' - it just can't be done!
11081.name: Connie Britton

11082.quote: We came from a family where we ran our own small business. Our dad made his own products. We made our own sausages, our own meatloafs, our own pickles. Dad had to do everything himself. He had to figure out how to finance his business.
11082.name: Marcy Kaptur

11083.quote: My dad keeps joking about sneaking into my grandparents' house and switching out their HBO for PBS so they think I'm on 'Downton Abbey.'
11083.name: Allison Williams

11084.quote: The best advice my dad ever gave me is that acting is believing. Acting is not acting. It isn't putting on a face and dancing around in a mask. It's believing that you are that character and playing him as if it were a normal day in the life of that character.
11084.name: Haley Joel Osment

11085.quote: My dad never told me that when you audition, you might not get the role. He wanted to wait until my first disappointment to tell me.
11085.name: Haley Joel Osment

11086.quote: I was really bright as a kid and tested well, and it was clear that I was going to get scholarships to any schools I wanted. My dad always said I could be an engineer at that time it was the elite of society: steady job, working in science, which was then the answer to every problem we had. It was kind of a mandate. Kind of a dream he had for me.
11086.name: James Wood

11087.quote: My parents loved each other. I was raised in a house of total love and respect. My dad worked very hard and my mother was incredibly devoted to him. I can unequivocally, without any peradventure of doubt, tell you that I was raised with the kind of love that we only dream of.
11087.name: James Wood

11088.quote: Dad is my best mate and I can tell Mum absolutely anything. I really appreciate Mum and Dad. Why are we so close? Young parents, I think. The rock business keeps their minds young.
11088.name: Kim Wilde

11089.quote: I wasn't aware of my dad being an actor when I was young. I remember there was an Australian children's entertainer on television called Ralph Harris and when I'd say my father was an actor, kids would say, you know, 'oh, is he Ralph Harris?' And I had to say no and then they would lose interest.
11089.name: Jared Harris

11090.quote: He described how, as a boy of 14, his dad had been down the mining pit, his uncle had been down the pit, his brother had been down the pit, and of course he would go down the pit.
11090.name: Barbara Castle

11091.quote: When my dad was badly weakened by the flu and my mom wanted to call an ambulance to take him to the emergency room, he wouldn't go unless he could shave first and change into a nice shirt and a pair of slacks.
11091.name: Rich Lowry

11092.quote: I'm probably going to get in trouble for this but 'American Dad' is one of my favourite shows. It gets very dark in places but the jokes are there.
11092.name: Donald Glover

11093.quote: My dad is this very sensible guy who never let me feel that anything was beyond my station.
11093.name: Mireille Enos

11094.quote: When I was little, I used to work with my dad on the engine of his car. Mostly this was a matter of me handing him wrenches.
11094.name: Mireille Enos

11095.quote: My dad is kind of a rascal, like in a Dickensian sense. He just goes from career to career.
11095.name: Benjamin Walker

11096.quote: My life isn't that dramatic. My dad really loves me, he just can't talk on the phone. He's too crippled and shy, and that's almost harder. He's there and he loves me, and I try and try and try, it's just impossible to have a relationship.
11096.name: Joey Lauren Adams

11097.quote: I don't deal with death very well. My brother, John Candy, my dad, my mom, Brandon Tartikoff just a couple of weeks ago. I mean, you lose a lot of people in your life, and that's one thing I am constantly working on - pain management.
11097.name: James Belushi

11098.quote: I don't know if there is a gene for comedy, but my dad was a very funny man. He just didn't know it. He was a naturally funny character, and when my brother and I would laugh at things he said and did, he would say, 'What do you think is so funny?'
11098.name: James Belushi

11099.quote: My dad was in the army so we moved around a lot and I changed schools every year and had to make new friends, and I found that if I was the funny guy I could do that easier.
11099.name: Jason Gann

11100.quote: I would say the most help I got was from my dad. My dad is a civil engineer in Switzerland he's 90 years old now, so he's no longer active as a civil engineer, but still a very active person.
11100.name: Claude Nicollier

11101.quote: My dad has no control over who works with me. Me, me and me alone has to take responsibility for anything.
11101.name: Shane MacGowan

11102.quote: Growing up, I had a front row seat to seeing two people work really hard. My dad scrubbed toilets at a private Catholic school for a while, and that was to help me get through school.
11102.name: Mia Love

11103.quote: My family was very supportive of whatever I wanted because my grandfather was an opera singer. My dad's dad. So my dad has an appreciation for the arts, and he let me choose my own path.
11103.name: Tony Hale

11104.quote: I always wanted to be a father. I have a beautiful relationship with my dad and beautiful memories. I always knew I was going to have a family.
11104.name: Ricky Martin

11105.quote: Every family is different. I am mom and I am dad and I'm going to do my best. You should be proud, walk through life saying I have the coolest family. I am part of a modern family.
11105.name: Ricky Martin

11106.quote: My dad served in two wars has been flying airplanes for 60 years now. He was certainly quite an inspiration.
11106.name: John L. Phillips

11107.quote: I remember my dad, who coached football, would buy some of his players football shoes when they couldn't afford it.
11107.name: Chaske Spencer

11108.quote: But Dad and I are the only father-and-daughter acts who have both had No. 1 songs in England.
11108.name: Lily Allen

11109.quote: My dad passed away before my freshman year, and it altered how I thought. I was depressed - I didn't hang out with my friends. I worked through it by dancing.
11109.name: Heather Morris

11110.quote: My goal is for Gunnar to outlive me. That's the way it should be. My dream is for him to be a dad himself one day, so he can find out all the anxiety that kids bring to their dads.
11110.name: Boomer Esiason

11111.quote: My dad and grandpa were in the army and as a country singer you're constantly playing at military bases all across the country and meeting soldiers and their families and hearing their stories.
11111.name: Dierks Bentley

11112.quote: My dad was my first coach and drove me extremely hard from a very young age.
11112.name: Candace Parker

11113.quote: From my first dunk at 14 years old to my second NCAA Championship at the University of Tennessee, my intense training with my dad was always to credit.
11113.name: Candace Parker

11114.quote: On my best days, such as when I was a junior in high school coming off a 42-point performance and near triple-double, my dad was there to tell me I haven't arrived yet and bring me back to reality.
11114.name: Candace Parker

11115.quote: I love playing a dad. It's hard to find family dramas that are genuinely funny.
11115.name: Peter Gallagher

11116.quote: If a cow walked into this room, I'd probably walk out. I could milk it, but my dad never forced me to do a lot of chores like that, mostly because he loved doing it himself.
11116.name: Stuart Appleby

11117.quote: My dad is a pilot so I think I was born with the travel bug.
11117.name: Isabel Lucas

11118.quote: I didn't really get into golf until I was about 14. My mom and dad were taking lessons from a pro an hour and a half from our farm in Cohuna, Australia. When they got home, I'd ask my mom to explain everything they learned - drills and all.
11118.name: Stuart Appleby

11119.quote: I had my footballing heroes such as Bryan Robson and Diego Maradona but my dad was a rugby league star, and he was my real hero. But the relationship with my mum was rocky and we saw things that would affect any youngster.
11119.name: Ryan Giggs

11120.quote: A mustache really defines your face. My dad had a mustache when I was growing up, and I can still remember when he shaved it, he looked like a completely different person.
11120.name: Jason Sudeikis

11121.quote: Some musicians I know are incredible fathers. Like Keith Richards. A fantastic dad.
11121.name: Jack Bruce

11122.quote: I love Prince Harry. Good looking and a bit of a rebel. Me and his dad are as thick as thieves and I knew Harry before I knew his dad so we've met a few times. I think he's amazing. And I think you can relate to him because he's made mistakes. He's cool.
11122.name: Cheryl Cole

11123.quote: We all have roles in life. I'm a dad, a husband, this and that, but basically I only feel justified in being alive when I'm on the stage.
11123.name: Jack Bruce

11124.quote: I have a weird sense of humour. My dad's the same. We love watching 'Monty Python' together.
11124.name: Miranda Kerr

11125.quote: My grandmother was an actress too. In the thirties and forties she was under contract with Universal Studios. Crazy credits, lots of them. My dad was also under contract with Universal Studios. And my first film was shot on the same stage they both worked on at Universal.
11125.name: Chris Pine

11126.quote: I got stuck up a tree when I was about seven, and my dad had to come and get the ladder to get me down. I loved to climb all the way up to the top. I must have been a koala in my past life.
11126.name: Miranda Kerr

11127.quote: No, like I said, my dad was never really part of the tennis. His involvement around what I did with the tennis and with my mom and my grandparents was really not a part of my life.
11127.name: Jimmy Connors

11128.quote: I've hung out at dozens of playgrounds, bored out of my mind, with not even a look of comfort from disapproving mothers all around me. Either they think I'm a pedophile or a deadbeat dad. That's what I get for being a single dad - suspicious looks at the playground.
11128.name: Dominic West

11129.quote: My mum's parents were from Ireland, my dad's mum was American-Irish.
11129.name: Dominic West

11130.quote: Obviously, losing a parent is very difficult. I miss my dad every day, but I know he would be proud to see me continuing to swim and going for another shot at the Olympics.
11130.name: Eric Shanteau

11131.quote: I actually study boxing - my dad was a Golden Gloves champion so I learned how to fight at a very young age. Growing up in Brooklyn you always had to watch your back, so I pretty much learned to protect myself.
11131.name: Lana Parrilla

11132.quote: I'd always assumed that I would die at about the same age as my dad - he was 45. I am five years in credit now. I can't get my head around the fact that I am older than he was - ever.
11132.name: Ian Hislop

11133.quote: I'm a four star general in this thing, and you don't rise to the ranks of a four star general by hanging about the house being the perfect dad.
11133.name: Sam Elliott

11134.quote: As I get older and I get a few more years experience I become more like Dad, you know, King Lear.
11134.name: David Crystal

11135.quote: One day when I was like 9, I heard the Beatles on the radio, and I asked my dad who they were. He told me they were the best band in the world, and I became obsessed. He started giving me their albums in sequential order, and I listened to them - and only them - until I was probably in high school.
11135.name: Lukas Haas

11136.quote: I think people like to think I'm in some way financially dependent on my family - on my dad - but the fact of the matter is I've been emancipated from my father since I was 14 years old. That's something people don't know or understand.
11136.name: Devon Aoki

11137.quote: My mom grew up in Kansas, my dad in Indiana. They had boring childhoods.
11137.name: Hunter Parrish

11138.quote: My mom was a dancer, my dad's a singer and I've always had that kind of music in my life.
11138.name: Elvis Stojko

11139.quote: From about eight years old I was always making things on the sewing machine. Friends would see me making dresses and costumes, and I'd use difficult fabrics such as Lycra and elastic. But you know, my dad was creative and my brother is inventive too.
11139.name: Melissa George

11140.quote: Mum and dad thought I was going to say I was pregnant. I said oh no, no, I've just been nominated for a Golden Globe. They were like, oh that's lovely, love.
11140.name: Melissa George

11141.quote: One of the accidental joys of my writing life has been that I've had some lovely, surprisingly good fortune with readers, and I've brought readers to my dad's work. I can't tell you the joy that gives me. Because my father's work was masterful.
11141.name: Andre Dubus III

11142.quote: Somewhere in my wildest childhood I must have done something right. Being able to make a boyhood dream come true is one thing, but to have a kid come along and thrill his dad like Brett Hull has thrilled me over his career is too much for one guy to handle.
11142.name: Bobby Hull

11143.quote: My dad and mom divorced when I was around ten, and I didn't live with him after that, though he was close by and we saw each other weekly. I wasn't really aware that he was a writer I didn't start reading his writing until I was about fifteen. It occurred to me then that my dad was kind of special he's still one of my favorite writers.
11143.name: Andre Dubus III

11144.quote: The most challenging part of being a dad is self-restraint. So often your instinct is to teach and tell. I am constantly reminding myself to listen to them.
11144.name: Michael Chiklis

11145.quote: I'm a dad now and whatever I'm doing in life I usually put a lot of effort into it - usually too much effort, so it kind of comes off ridiculous at times.
11145.name: Jeremy Sisto

11146.quote: I grew up in a big Irish, Catholic family. My dad was a pretty rough guy. So one of my brothers left home when he was 15 and found his way to the gym. It gave me the opportunity to go and spend some time with him and work out in the gym.
11146.name: Gerry Cooney

11147.quote: I know who my dad is, I've met him a few times, but I don't even call him dad. I know it sounds horrible, but I don't even see him as part of my family, to be honest. If you want the truth, it doesn't bother me because I don't know any different. I just know that me and my mum, that was my family.
11147.name: Sally Pearson

11148.quote: My folks have played everything from rock, disco, pop, funk, and blues. My dad has always brought and played different genres like jazz, classical, and Latin. With all this in my pocket, I feel I have a taste of everything for my influences.
11148.name: Haley Reinhart

11149.quote: I love my daughter, but she had me on couscous and fixed me pastas and made me eat oatmeal every morning and what else, turkey burgers, turkey bacon, and that kind of stuff. So she wants her dad to live a long time, and I do, too.
11149.name: Dusty Baker

11150.quote: It's always been a dream of mine to get somewhere and to have my mom and dad with me up there.
11150.name: Haley Reinhart

11151.quote: My dad wanted me to play when I was a kid, so I learned to play the guitar. I pursued a career in music because I love it so much and I enjoy what it does to those who hear it.
11151.name: Randy Travis

11152.quote: I needed to step away from music because the truth was I couldn't be the dad I wanted to be to my kids. My truth was that I could not reconcile the two worlds - the entertainment world and being the dad I wanted to be in the present. You can't substitute time, you just can't.
11152.name: Corey Hart

11153.quote: All my band members were old enough to be my dad. It was like this family vibe.
11153.name: Hunter Hayes

11154.quote: Truthfully, I'm still Corey Hart, Dad, first.
11154.name: Corey Hart

11155.quote: I think that every therapist that I know, including my dad and my sister, have their own issues. But that empathy is what makes them good at their job.
11155.name: Laura Benanti

11156.quote: Dad worked his entire career as an aviation technician. Mom was a legal secretary who became a teacher. We lived a simple American life.
11156.name: Brian Sandoval

11157.quote: My dad was good friends with the Bad Medicine Blues Band - one of the only blues bands in Fargo, as you can imagine! He took me out to see them play when I was 12 years old and I was really inspired by their guitar player, Ted Larsen.
11157.name: Jonny Lang

11158.quote: My dad was a good athlete. My mom had longevity. There were some athletic genes that certainly got passed down.
11158.name: Hale Irwin

11159.quote: I miss my Dad. My Dad loved cheesy monster movies, so we'd have Godzilla movie marathons. Those are some of my favorite memories, laughing at how the monster outfits were so bad, like black garbage bags for heads.
11159.name: Ahmet Zappa

11160.quote: I've always had an affinity for lawyers. My dad is a lawyer. He's retired now. My brother is a lawyer.
11160.name: Scott Bakula

11161.quote: Every dad who loves his daughter is not going to want her to go with the penniless slacker loser poet bum, when she could go out with someone who's successful.
11161.name: John Leguizamo

11162.quote: My dad died when I was three so my mom had to raise four kids on her own, and I think there's a part of me that pulls upon having watched my mom do that our whole lives. She had to make it work.
11162.name: Leslie Bibb

11163.quote: Usually a family is led through the mom or the dad and their career and for the family to be led by my career, even though God has led it, could be a lot of pressure.
11163.name: Stacie Orrico

11164.quote: No one was more important than my mom and dad. I know they are watching from a place up in heaven here today to make sure all their kids are doing good.
11164.name: Eddie Murray

11165.quote: My dad recently reminded me that my grandfather's cousin was Lefty Frizzell.
11165.name: Parker Posey

11166.quote: I was brought up in a car family, my dad loved cars and I was taught the art of making an Austin 7 operate.
11166.name: Nick Mason

11167.quote: My dad's an architect and my mom owned a French bakery for twelve years.
11167.name: Alison Lohman

11168.quote: My mum was very conscious about fashion and my dad was born into the tailoring tradition, so fashion has always been my life, although now, really, I wear the same thing - just in different weights - light and heavy cashmere in winter and cotton in summer.
11168.name: Domenico Dolce

11169.quote: I always told my dad I'd play professional football.
11169.name: Anthony Doerr

11170.quote: My dad doesn't like religion much, but I grew up very close to the Baptist tradition. God isn't this distant thing. God is right here with you all the time. He's your buddy, and you can talk about everything.
11170.name: Lucy Alibar
