11171.quote: My dad was an inventor, and I think I've always had a rosy view of technology, or at least its potential.
11171.name: Scott McCloud

11172.quote: My dad, like many Southern men, is this very emotionally expressive person who isn't as articulate in words about his feelings as he is with breaking a chair or something like that.
11172.name: Lucy Alibar

11173.quote: My dad was an engineer and so I had this picture of science and technology and pursuits of the mind as being more impressive than artistic pursuits, which I saw a as kind of frivolous.
11173.name: Scott McCloud

11174.quote: I also turn down what's probably a good amount of coinage to be made out of playing dads, an incredible number of obnoxious dad.
11174.name: Bill Pullman

11175.quote: My mom and dad - they were always there. They were always on the set. They focused on our family life. The entertainment business wasn't the end-all. They weren't out to get the next big paycheck or the next big movie. It was about 'What can we do as a family.'
11175.name: Candace Cameron Bure

11176.quote: I lost my mother, who suffered from Alzheimer's disease, and we had to relocate my dad after 58 years in the family home. That was tough.
11176.name: Doug Davidson

11177.quote: You know that family is going to be there for you no matter what. My dad gave me a freakin' kidney!
11177.name: Sarah Hyland

11178.quote: I have mostly been terrified of listening to scary stories around a campfire. We camp a lot as a family, and at night my dad would try and tell us scary stories. This made eating s'mores difficult. The story would start with something like, 'and the old man who lived in these woods,' I would then run back into the camper terrified.
11178.name: Willow Shields

11179.quote: Everyone gets surprised because neither one of my parents play golf. Like I said in my speech, my aunt and uncle really love golf, and we visited them, and she gave me two clubs. Like people think when they don't know who my dad is, they think he's my coach.
11179.name: Lydia Ko

11180.quote: My sensei was a British karate champion named Brian Fitkin. He was my mentor and because I had a hard relationship with my dad, he became a father figure to me.
11180.name: Dolph Lundgren

11181.quote: To me I'm just a regular person going to the mall with friends, and now I'm in Forever 21 and I see this random group of girls staring at me and taking pictures. But now I usually have my dad, who is a really tall and intimidating person with me, so he's kind of my bodyguard.
11181.name: Rebecca Black

11182.quote: Save a boyfriend for a rainy day - and another, in case it doesn't rain.
11182.name: Mae West

11183.quote: Falling in love and having a relationship are two different things.
11183.name: Keanu Reeves

11184.quote: I don't have a girlfriend. But I do know a woman who'd be mad at me for saying that.
11184.name: Mitch Hedberg

11185.quote: You can't stop loving or wanting to love because when its right it's the best thing in the world. When you're in a relationship and its good, even if nothing else in your life is right, you feel like your whole world is complete.
11185.name: Keith Sweat

11186.quote: Real magic in relationships means an absence of judgment of others.
11186.name: Wayne Dyer

11187.quote: If there hadn't been women we'd still be squatting in a cave eating raw meat, because we made civilization in order to impress our girlfriends.
11187.name: Orson Welles

11188.quote: Nothing is perfect. Life is messy. Relationships are complex. Outcomes are uncertain. People are irrational.
11188.name: Hugh Mackay

11189.quote: I'm not the girl who always has a boyfriend. I'm the girl who rarely has a boyfriend.
11189.name: Taylor Swift

11190.quote: I like the bad-boy types. Generally the guy I'm attracted to is the guy in the club with all the tattoos and nail polish. He's usually the lead singer in a punk band and plays guitar. But my serious boyfriends are relatively clean-cut, nice guys. So it's strange.
11190.name: Megan Fox

11191.quote: There's only two people in your life you should lie to, the police and your girlfriend.
11191.name: Jack Nicholson

11192.quote: Smart women love smart men more than smart men love smart women.
11192.name: Natalie Portman

11193.quote: Assumptions are the termites of relationships.
11193.name: Henry Winkler

11194.quote: I'm quite sensitive to women. I saw how my sister got treated by boyfriends. I read this thing that said when you are in a relationship with a woman, imagine how you would feel if you were her father. That's been my approach, for the most part.
11194.name: Orlando Bloom

11195.quote: Nothing defines humans better than their willingness to do irrational things in the pursuit of phenomenally unlikely payoffs. This is the principle behind lotteries, dating, and religion.
11195.name: Scott Adams

11196.quote: It seems essential, in relationships and all tasks, that we concentrate only on what is most significant and important.
11196.name: Soren Kierkegaard

11197.quote: A relationship requires a lot of work and commitment.
11197.name: Greta Scacchi

11198.quote: However successful you are, there is no substitute for a close relationship. We all need them.
11198.name: Francesca Annis

11199.quote: Do not just look at your boyfriend as just a boyfriend. Look at him as a friend, too.
11199.name: Vanessa Hudgens

11200.quote: Treasure your relationships, not your possessions.
11200.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

11201.quote: Personally, I don't like a girlfriend to have a husband. If she'll fool her husband, I figure she'll fool me.
11201.name: Orson Welles

11202.quote: Right now I'm pretty single, My career is my boyfriend.
11202.name: Christina Aguilera

11203.quote: You know, the man of my dreams might walk round the corner tomorrow. I'm older and wiser and I think I'd make a great girlfriend. I live in the realm of romantic possibility.
11203.name: Stevie Nicks

11204.quote: People could rationally decide that prolonged relationships take up too much time and effort and that they'd much rather do other kinds of things. But most people are afraid of rejection.
11204.name: Albert Ellis

11205.quote: You know when I feel inwardly beautiful? When I am with my girlfriends and we are having a 'goddess circle'.
11205.name: Jennifer Aniston

11206.quote: I am a hopeless romantic and I love to spoil my girlfriends.
11206.name: Orlando Bloom

11207.quote: I used to be a real prince charming if I went on a date with a girl. But then I'd get to where I was likely to have a stroke from the stress of keeping up my act. I've since learned the key to a good date is to pay attention on her.
11207.name: Matthew Perry

11208.quote: Well, a girlfriend once told me never to fight with anybody you don't love.
11208.name: Jack Nicholson

11209.quote: If you can lie, you can act, and if you can lie to crazy girlfriends, you can act under pressure.
11209.name: Joe Rogan

11210.quote: If you don't have a valentine, hang out with your girlfriends, don't go looking for someone. When it's right, they'll come to you.
11210.name: Carmen Electra

11211.quote: I don't know the first real thing about the dating game. I don't know how to talk to a specific person and connect. I just think you have to go to person by person and do the best you can with people in general.
11211.name: Jason Schwartzman

11212.quote: I'm 31 now. I think I'm beginning to understand what life is, what romance is, and what a relationship means.
11212.name: Adam Sandler

11213.quote: My boyfriend and I broke up. He wanted to get married and I didn't want him to.
11213.name: Rita Rudner

11214.quote: Watching your daughter being collected by her date feels like handing over a million dollar Stradivarius to a gorilla.
11214.name: Jim Bishop

11215.quote: I can't even find someone for a platonic relationship, much less the kind where someone wants to see me naked.
11215.name: Gilbert Gottfried

11216.quote: If you're a sports fan you realize that when you meet somebody, like a girlfriend, they kind of have to root for your team. They don't have a choice.
11216.name: Jimmy Fallon

11217.quote: I suppose I was a little bit of what would be called today a nerd. I didn't have girlfriends, and really I wasn't a very social boy.
11217.name: Charles Kuralt

11218.quote: I don't understand the whole dating thing. I know right off the bat if I'm interested in someone, and I don't want them to waste their money on me and take me out to eat if I know I'm not interested in that person.
11218.name: Britney Spears

11219.quote: Everything I buy is vintage and smells funny. Maybe that's why I don't have a boyfriend.
11219.name: Lucy Liu

11220.quote: Practically all the relationships I know are based on a foundation of lies and mutually accepted delusion.
11220.name: Kim Cattrall

11221.quote: Right now, I'm as single as a slice of American cheese.
11221.name: Nick Cannon

11222.quote: I've been dating since I was fifteen. I'm exhausted. Where is he?
11222.name: Kristin Davis

11223.quote: I've never been Romeo who meets a girl and falls for her immediately. It's been a much slower process for me each time I've gone into a relationship.
11223.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

11224.quote: I change my mind so much I need two boyfriends and a girlfriend.
11224.name: Pink

11225.quote: I'm dating a woman now who, evidently, is unaware of it.
11225.name: Garry Shandling

11226.quote: I've had enough boyfriends and enough issues. I'd seen enough train wrecks.
11226.name: Taylor Dayne

11227.quote: If your best friend has stolen your girlfriend, it does become life and death.
11227.name: Ben Kingsley

11228.quote: I was dating this guy and we would spend all day text messaging each other. And he thought that he could tell that he liked me more because he actually spelt the word 'YOU' and I just put the letter 'U'.
11228.name: Kelly Osbourne

11229.quote: Which is, I'm an optimist that two people can be together to work out their conflicts. And that commitment, I think, might be what love is, because they both grow from their relationship.
11229.name: Garry Shandling

11230.quote: I didn't have a financial need, and I wasn't very gifted at relationships. I probably was more like what we think of boys as being: hard to pin down and wary of commitment.
11230.name: Candice Bergen

11231.quote: My boyfriend calls me 'princess', but I think of myself more along the lines of 'monkey' and 'retard'.
11231.name: Alicia Silverstone

11232.quote: We are constantly protecting the male ego, and it's a disservice to men. If a man has any sensitivity or intelligence, he wants to get the straight scoop from his girlfriend.
11232.name: Betty Dodson

11233.quote: Thank God I never got in a fight. All of the jock dudes hated me, but all of their girlfriends thought I was nice so they wouldn't touch me. It was infuriating to them.
11233.name: Mark Hoppus

11234.quote: I have a lot of boyfriends, I want you to write that. Every country I visit, I have a different boyfriend. And I kiss them all.
11234.name: Anna Kournikova

11235.quote: I love being a single mom. But it's definitely different when you're dating.
11235.name: Brooke Burns

11236.quote: I always say now that I'm in my blonde years. Because since the end of my marriage, all of my girlfriends have been blonde.
11236.name: Hugh Hefner

11237.quote: Maybe the most that you can expect from a relationship that goes bad is to come out of it with a few good songs.
11237.name: Marianne Faithfull

11238.quote: Rumors about me? Calista Flockhart, Pam Anderson, and Matt Damon. That's who I'm dating.
11238.name: Ben Affleck

11239.quote: My girlfriend bought me a down jacket, she said it fit my personality.
11239.name: Jay London

11240.quote: You show your vulnerability through relationships, and those feelings are your soft spot. You need to have a soft spot.
11240.name: Victoria Pratt

11241.quote: Last year my boyfriend gave me a painting - a very personal one. I really prefer personal gifts or ones made by someone for me. Except diamonds. That's the exception to the rule.
11241.name: Minnie Driver

11242.quote: Things were a lot simpler in Detroit. I didn't care about anything but boyfriends.
11242.name: Madonna Ciccone

11243.quote: I have stepped off the relationship scene to come to terms with myself. I have spent most of my adult life being 'someone's girlfriend', and now I am happy being single.
11243.name: Penelope Cruz

11244.quote: I think if I could have a boyfriend like my brothers I'd be really happy. But without the brother thing.
11244.name: Patricia Velasquez

11245.quote: At this year's Open, I'll have five boyfriends.
11245.name: Anna Kournikova

11246.quote: I fantasize about going back to high school with the knowledge I have now. I would shine. I would have a good time, I would have a girlfriend. I think that's where a lot of my pain comes from. I think I never had any teenage years to go back to.
11246.name: Spalding Gray

11247.quote: I don't know any of us who are in relationships that are totally honest - it doesn't exist.
11247.name: Richard Gere

11248.quote: It was just that we had this phenomenal honeymoon relationship that just kept on going.
11248.name: James Levine

11249.quote: In a relationship you have to open yourself up.
11249.name: Neil LaBute

11250.quote: It's always been my personal feeling that unless you are married, there is something that is not very dignified about talking about who you are dating.
11250.name: Luke Wilson

11251.quote: Relationships in general make people a bit nervous. It's about trust. Do I trust you enough to go there?
11251.name: Neil LaBute

11252.quote: I started dating older men, and I would fall in love with them. I thought they could teach me about life.
11252.name: Daphne Zuniga

11253.quote: I think more dating stuff is scheduling. It's needing people who understand your work schedule.
11253.name: Jennifer Love Hewitt

11254.quote: It's weird, I never wish anything bad upon anybody, except two or three old girlfriends.
11254.name: Carrot Top

11255.quote: What I remember most about junior homecoming was my date getting sick afterwards. That kinda sucked. Then, senior year, someone got gum in her hair when we were dancing. She had to get one of the chaperones to take her to the office and cut up her hair. I felt really bad for her, but it worked out fine.
11255.name: James Lafferty

11256.quote: I stopped dating for six months a year ago. Dating requires a lot of energy and focus.
11256.name: Daphne Zuniga

11257.quote: Appearance is something you should definitely consider when you're going out. Have your girlfriend clip your nails or something like that.
11257.name: Usher

11258.quote: I'm not cynical about marriage or romance. I enjoyed being married. And although being single was fun for a while, there was always the risk of dating someone who'd owned a lunch box with my picture on it.
11258.name: Shaun Cassidy

11259.quote: The prospect of dating someone in her twenties becomes less appealing as you get older. At some point in your fife, your tolerance level goes down and you realize that, with someone much younger, there's nothing really to talk about.
11259.name: Clint Eastwood

11260.quote: Workshops and seminars are basically financial speed dating for clueless people.
11260.name: Doug Coupland

11261.quote: I prefer ordinary girls - you know, college students, waitresses, that sort of thing. Most of the girls I go out with are just good friends. Just because I go out to the cinema with a girl, it doesn't mean we are dating.
11261.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

11262.quote: My philosophy of dating is to just fart right away.
11262.name: Jenny McCarthy

11263.quote: Pamela Anderson Lee released a statement confirming that she has had her breast implants removed. Doctors say that Pamela is doing fine and that her old implants are now dating Charlie Sheen.
11263.name: Conan O'Brien

11264.quote: I want my audience to know me for my work, not because of who I'm dating or what drugs I'm on or what club I went to.
11264.name: Shia LaBeouf

11265.quote: It's a big responsibility dating me. Because I come with a little bit of baggage, you know?
11265.name: Demi Lovato

11266.quote: Good-looking individuals are treated better than homely ones in virtually every social situation, from dating to trial by jury.
11266.name: Martha Beck

11267.quote: I can't even explain to you how terrible that feels, that I equate dating a woman with punishment, shame, guilt, disappointment, reproach, reprimand, persecution. It's a nightmare.
11267.name: John Mayer

11268.quote: When I was first divorced, I started dating younger women, and it was really exciting. But after a while I was like, 'This is just dumb.'
11268.name: Louis C. K.

11269.quote: You are not alone with a guy until you are a proper age. You don't go to certain levels with men until you are married or you have a certain relationship.
11269.name: Daisy Fuentes

11270.quote: I'm honest about the journey I've been on, so I definitely don't take dating lightly anymore.
11270.name: Demi Lovato

11271.quote: I can't imagine dating a boy, meeting him only outside the home. What's a home and family for if it's not the center of one's life?
11271.name: Loretta Young

11272.quote: When I started dating I had this kind of Romeo and Juliet, fateful romantic idea about love which was almost that you were a victim and there was a lot of pain involved and that was how it should be.
11272.name: Emma Watson

11273.quote: All my freakouts have been pretty private and directed at family pets and/or people I have been dating for too short a time to freak out at in that way.
11273.name: Lena Dunham

11274.quote: People say, 'Just say who you're dating. Then people will stop being so ravenous about it.' It's like, No they won't! They'll ask for specifics.
11274.name: Kristen Stewart

11275.quote: I wouldn't tell you anything about anybody I cared about because it becomes entertainment for other people, and it sort of just cheapens everything in your life. I would never tell you if I was dating anybody.
11275.name: Kristen Stewart

11276.quote: I'm not very experienced with boys or the whole dating thingy.
11276.name: Vanessa Hudgens

11277.quote: Well, dating has become a sport and not about finding the person you love.
11277.name: Rashida Jones

11278.quote: I'm friends with a lot of my exes, but it took time. We didn't just get into it. I don't think you can be friends until you're cool with them dating someone else. That's when you know.
11278.name: Rashida Jones

11279.quote: I'm not great at dating, but I need to do it to relax.
11279.name: Lena Dunham

11280.quote: Dating is just awkward moments and one person wants more than the other. It's just that constant strangeness. I think it's a very real thing.
11280.name: Jason Schwartzman

11281.quote: I give dating advice on a regular basis. It's not that I'm any expert, but it's always nice to share that with your friends.
11281.name: Ashley Tisdale

11282.quote: I don't really believe in rules, but I do like old-fashioned dating where you don't call the guy until he calls you. I don't think it's like he's got to do this and that's the rule.
11282.name: Ashley Tisdale

11283.quote: I don't have the best dating track record.
11283.name: Lauren Conrad

11284.quote: Dating is all about the chase. It's fun!
11284.name: Lauren Conrad

11285.quote: Dating in Los Angeles can be hard, which makes it all the better when you meet a really nice guy.
11285.name: Lauren Conrad

11286.quote: I'm not old-fashioned when it comes to dating, but there's something nice about a guy pulling out a girl's chair and opening the door for her, even if it's just in the beginning.
11286.name: Lauren Conrad

11287.quote: My mom is going to kill me for talking about sleeping with people. But I don't want to put myself in the position where I'm in a monogamous relationship right now. I'm not dating just one person. 'Sex and the City' changed everything for me because those girls would sleep with so many people.
11287.name: Lindsay Lohan

11288.quote: Coming through the fire and through the storm of life with a strong man, my fiance Ashanti, whom I've been dating for eight months and two wonderful children beside me, I'm just so happy that I have been able to maintain my integrity and get to where I am today with the right energy around me.
11288.name: Angie Stone

11289.quote: I'm much more interested in what an actor has to say about something substantial and important than who they're dating or what clothes they're wearing or some other asinine, insignificant aspect of their life.
11289.name: Ben Affleck

11290.quote: I've had two romances since moving to Las Vegas. One was with somebody 12 years older than me, and the other was the same age, and neither worked out. I know people still think of me as one of Hugh Hefner's girlfriends, and he of course was much older than me, but that was a whole different lifestyle and a different kind of dating.
11290.name: Holly Madison

11291.quote: I have put gay dating on the map.
11291.name: Patti Stanger

11292.quote: I had to find a diet that would kick me back into dating shape, because I know that I can't date at size 8. I have to date at size 2. And it's just a fact of nature. Go get your injections and your chemical peels. You gotta look good to attract a man.
11292.name: Patti Stanger

11293.quote: Taylor Swift dates guys so she can write a breakup song about them. I don't think she's dating for love - I think she's dating for creativity. So let's get her off the market and put her in dating detox. If she really wants love, she has to stop writing music about them.
11293.name: Patti Stanger

11294.quote: The rich are different. Their wants are very high maintenance. They'll pick eye color and hair color, all the way down to what she does for a living, what school she went to. Their list can be extremely long. But at the end of the day, dating is dating, because they're human beings.
11294.name: Patti Stanger

11295.quote: Dating is kind of hard. Like dinner or something like that. Like a forced awkward situation is very strange. Especially for me, for some reason.
11295.name: Zac Efron

11296.quote: I grew up in the world of bad television, on my dad's sets and then as a young schmuck on dating shows and so on.
11296.name: George Clooney

11297.quote: No one knew me until I met my wife Lulu. Lulu's mother used to ask, Which one is Maurice? For six months she thought Lulu was dating Barry.
11297.name: Maurice Gibb

11298.quote: I'm so an all-or-nothing person in dating, always. I'm big on not wasting time. And so, yeah, if something's not working, it's time to not hold people back.
11298.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

11299.quote: I don't know why anyone would want to ask an actor for dating advice. We are not the poster children for healthy relationships.
11299.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

11300.quote: After a number of years dating, we decided we were good partners.
11300.name: Melinda Gates

11301.quote: I always hated high-school shows and high-school movies, because they were always about the cool kids. It was always about dating and sex, and all the popular kids, and the good-looking kids. And the nerds were super-nerdy cartoons, with tape on their glasses. I never saw 'my people' portrayed accurately.
11301.name: Paul Feig

11302.quote: Dating is really hard because everyone puts on a front. It's really difficult to see who is who, so it is important to be yourself.
11302.name: Brooke Burke

11303.quote: At the time that I knew them, they were not living together. They began dating again after their divorce, so I didn't really see fighting.
11303.name: Kato Kaelin

11304.quote: Dodi got a lot of criticism when he began dating Princess Diana. No one seemed to think he was good enough for her.
11304.name: Lorna Luft

11305.quote: I'm often dating people, but I don't say it because you sort of know it won't last long.
11305.name: Graham Norton

11306.quote: It's just me and my 6-month-old puppy. I am not dating anyone.
11306.name: Bridget Hall

11307.quote: I was dating my first boyfriend in high school for a long time, and we broke up before prom. I hadn't met anyone else that I really wanted to go with, and my friends have always been amazing. So I went with my friends and got a million photos with them!
11307.name: Shay Mitchell

11308.quote: The Google algorithm was a significant development. I've had thank-you emails from people whose lives have been saved by information on a medical website or who have found the love of their life on a dating website.
11308.name: Tim Berners-Lee

11309.quote: I've had a little bad, bad media luck the new year. Well, apparently I'm dating Bill Clinton, which makes me nervous. I didn't know, though.
11309.name: Julie Bowen

11310.quote: I also find it interesting that a lot of people in their 30s are not married and don't have kids. There are a lot of people in this age bracket that are out there dating and trying to find love. And I never thought that at my age I would be.
11310.name: John Stamos

11311.quote: Dating co-stars is natural. When you're working with someone, it's habit.
11311.name: Rachel Bilson

11312.quote: We had two rules growing up in my house: If you're going to take a shower, do it with whomever you're dating so you don't waste water and if you buy one for yourself, buy six, because everybody's going to want one.
11312.name: Moon Unit Zappa

11313.quote: If I'm with a man, is that going to prevent me from achieving my goal? What sacrifices will I have to make in terms of being myself, if I'm with a man? Something that young women find out really quickly is that when you start dating, all of a sudden you're supposed to have a role. You're not allowed to just be yourself.
11313.name: Candace Bushnell

11314.quote: Evolution is unobservable. It's based on blind faith in a few dry bones and on unreliable dating systems in which the gullible trust. Kids should be allowed to make up their own minds about this issue, and not be censored to 'one side is all we will let you hear.'
11314.name: Ray Comfort

11315.quote: I ain't scared to do another dating show, but I ain't really trying to. I want to do a talk show or something. I've done enough dating on television. I'm ready to spread my wings, and go down other avenues.
11315.name: Flavor Flav

11316.quote: Like many of you, I've always been slightly obsessed with vampires, dating back to the prime-time series 'Dark Shadows,' which I followed avidly as a kid.
11316.name: Bill Condon

11317.quote: I like the idea of dating, but I'm not dating anyone exclusively, particularly right now. It's hard to be in a relationship unless you're ready to go public with it. So it's a lot easier for me to not be in a relationship. I really don't want that part of my life to be tabloid fodder.
11317.name: Cory Monteith

11318.quote: I wish I was dating one of the ladies in 'Bollywood Hero.' They're gorgeous. Any of them.
11318.name: Chris Kattan

11320.quote: Mary Tyler Moore was a working woman whose story lines were not always about dating and men. They were about work friendships and relationships, which is what I feel my adult life has mostly been about.
11320.name: Tina Fey

11321.quote: I'm very open to dating and finding a guy.
11321.name: Kristin Cavallari

11322.quote: Are you kidding? I'm a terrible cook, but John is a really great one. Literally, I never cook. The whole time we were dating, I prepared two officially romantic meals. Both of them were such disasters that he begs me never to go into the kitchen again.
11322.name: Rebecca Romijn

11324.quote: I have no wisdom to share on dating.
11324.name: Rachel Dratch

11325.quote: I'm not interested in dating. I like being with my own best friend, me. Certain women, particularly older women, cannot believe I like going to a social event by myself. But I do.
11325.name: Gloria Allred

11326.quote: So if I was dating somebody now and the relationship didn't work out, I'd take that as failing.
11326.name: Gavin DeGraw

11327.quote: You know, I had my mother and my father convincing me that he would be going back to Hollywood and he'd be back with the actresses and dating them and that he wasn't serious about me at all. So I had him saying one thing to me and my parents telling me something else.
11327.name: Priscilla Presley

11328.quote: Dating is different when you get older. You're not as trusting, or as eager to get back out there and expose yourself to someone.
11328.name: Toni Braxton

11329.quote: So I go to my first book signing, and these two girls came up and gave me a piece of paper: '10 reasons you should date our dad. He climbed Mount Kilimanjaro. He's a lawyer.' He didn't know what was going on. He didn't even know me. They called him, and he came down and asked me out that day. Now I'm dating their dad!
11329.name: Hoda Kotb

11330.quote: Celebrities say they date other celebrities because they have the same job. But I think they just like dating famous people. Celebrities attract each other, like cattle.
11330.name: Jason Lee

11331.quote: I've always gone out with much younger guys. But I rushed into relationships before really getting to know the person. What would come up as a warning sign within the first two weeks of dating would usually be the exact reason the relationship would end!
11331.name: Carrie Ann Inaba

11332.quote: Here's the funny thing about the response I've been aware of to my dating famous people: It's been very negative. I'm either not good-looking enough, not a good enough actor or not successful enough for these people.
11332.name: Dax Shepard

11333.quote: It's ironic, really. Guys should be excited that I got Kristen Bell. If Brad Pitt gets Kristen Bell, it's like, 'Well, of course he did.' With me, it should be, 'Oh good, a normal-looking guy got her. Maybe I'll get me a Kristen Bell.' But guys hate my guts for always dating women I have no right to be with.
11333.name: Dax Shepard

11334.quote: Stuff about me dating Kim Kardashian - I have no idea where that came from and all these other rumors. I don't think I'm that type.
11334.name: Jeremy Lin

11335.quote: I think feminism's a bit misinterpreted. It was about casting off all gender roles. There's nothing wrong with a man holding a door open for a girl. But we sort of threw away all the rules, so everybody's confused. And dating becomes a sloppy, uncomfortable, unpleasant thing.
11335.name: Zosia Mamet

11336.quote: The woman I am currently crazy about was a vegetarian for a year until I started dating her. As is the case with most vegetarians, she had never eaten properly prepared meat, only commercially packaged or otherwise abused flesh.
11336.name: Steve Albini

11337.quote: I don't mind dating younger men now.
11337.name: Jackee Harry

11338.quote: Women always try to see the one good part of The Weird Guy because the dating landscape is so bleak. Women will say, 'He's very odd, but he likes to cook. He's creepy, but he makes good pancakes!'
11338.name: Zoe Lister-Jones

11339.quote: The learned are not agreed as to the time when the Gospel of John was written some dating it as early as the year 68, others as late as the year 98 but it is generally conceded to have been written after all the others.
11339.name: Simon Greenleaf

11340.quote: I'm opening up my heart to the idea of dating. It's funny - my friends would always come to me for romantic advice. I know nothing, and things have changed since I was dating in high school! I'm really trying hard to spend this time working on myself.
11340.name: Olivia Wilde

11341.quote: I heard on public radio recently, there's a thing called Weed Dating. Singles get together in a garden and weed and then they take turns, they keep matching up with other people. Two people will weed down one row and switch over with two other people. It's in Vermont. I don't think I'd be very good at Weed Dating.
11341.name: Jr. Roy Blount

11342.quote: It was funny actually because that was still during the time we were dating. He would get all these calls because supposedly before we broke up, we had already broken up in the trades, in the rags or whatever.
11342.name: Rosario Dawson

11343.quote: I've been in plenty of situations where someone I'm dating had more time for a console than me.
11343.name: Josie Maran

11344.quote: I tried to tell them about the dating process because I'm single now and how horrible it is and how many foolish experiences I had had dating. So I was really selling him hard, but the whole time he really wanted me!
11344.name: Andie MacDowell

11345.quote: My wife and I have been together since 1986. I graduated in '86 and she graduated in '88. We began dating when she was 17. Actually she turned 18 when we started kissing and stuff.
11345.name: Jr. Cuba Gooding

11346.quote: I highly suggest marriage to all my friends who are dating.
11346.name: Jerry O'Connell

11347.quote: You're talking to someone who has been married to various people for the last 40 years of her life. Dating is not really something familiar. I've never really been a dater.
11347.name: Stockard Channing

11348.quote: I am dating, but it is hard to find someone quick enough and funny enough. I am quite demanding.
11348.name: Anne Robinson

11349.quote: Years later I would hear my father say the divorce had left him dating his children. That still meant picking us up every Sunday for a matinee and, if he had the money, an early dinner somewhere.
11349.name: Andre Dubus III

11350.quote: In my own relationships, I know that I should break up with someone who doesn't encourage me to be strong and make my own choices and do what's best in my life, so if you're dating someone who doesn't want you to be the best person you can be, you shouldn't be dating them.
11350.name: Veronica Roth

11351.quote: I'm a fan of horrors. I love the ones that make you jump. My girlfriend hates it. I've been dating her for one-and-a-half years and I'm crazy about her, but she's terrified of horror films. Not the cute 'Will you hold me?' way, but she's weeping. With 'House of Wax,' we'll be sleeping and I'll go to the bathroom and she's sitting up waiting for me.
11351.name: Jared Padalecki

11352.quote: Yeah, I think everybody has the crises of questioning themselves at some point or other in their lives. Is this where I should live? The job I should have? The girl I should be dating? Is this the friend I should have?
11352.name: Chris Messina

11353.quote: I feel like I am a real artist and I want to be able to feel what I am singing about. So when I sing, 'Leave (Get Out),' I have been through that. I think it is just a new generation, whether people are ready for it or not. Teenagers are dating.
11353.name: JoJo

11354.quote: Dating and getting attention from boys was something that came later to me.
11354.name: Rachelle Lefevre

11355.quote: It's weird to have people so interested in your personal life. It's a part of the business that grosses me out. I'm always bummed out for people who just happen to be dating a celebrity, and they're also famous, and they can't live their life.
11355.name: Andy Samberg

11356.quote: My daughter's mother and I are no longer dating, and the people I'm most likely to date are those around me, who are athletes.
11356.name: Tyson Gay

11357.quote: I do like dating cynics - they tend to be incredibly funny.
11357.name: Chris Pine

11358.quote: Work takes up a lot of my brain space. So when I work, it's one thing. I don't have a lot of time to think about dating.
11358.name: Chris Pine

11359.quote: I can't wait for my little sisters to start dating, because it will really be fun to pick on their boyfriends.
11359.name: David Gallagher

11360.quote: I've been dating younger men since my 20s, When I was 29, I dated someone 21, younger men are just more fun. I like their energy. I've always been kind of young for my age.
11360.name: Dana Delany

11361.quote: I'm enjoying dating. I'm single, though, I'm not in a relationship.
11361.name: Matt Czuchry

11362.quote: I grew up between the two world wars and received a rather solid general education, the kind middle class children enjoyed in a country whose educational system had its roots dating back to the Austro-Hungarian Monarchy.
11362.name: George Andrew Olah

11363.quote: My original inspiration was my mom: a few years after the death of my dad, she started dating one my teachers!
11363.name: Meg Cabot

11364.quote: I think a nice romantic dinner should be saved for when you and the girl you're dating or seeing have something special and it's a more special occasion.
11364.name: Ben Savage

11365.quote: Frankly, the reason I joined MENSA is because I was dating a guy at the time who spoke five languages and could solve a Rubik's Cube literally with his eyes closed because it's just an algorithm.
11365.name: Ashley Rickards

11366.quote: I don't talk about who I'm dating because when you break up, you wind up reliving it in the media.
11366.name: Bridget Fonda

11367.quote: I'm the one who's dating the craft-service guy instead of the producer. Plus, if a producer is going to date a hot young thing, I'm probably not the first person on their list - the weird, quirky, funny girl.
11367.name: Whitney Cummings

11368.quote: I don't really talk about my personal life. It's a strange and funny and weird thing. Sometimes you have a conversation with someone and the paparazzi snaps a picture of you and people decide you're dating. If I try to answer everything people say, I would be up all night.
11368.name: Tracee Ellis Ross

11369.quote: I was dating a guy that was a huge wrestling fan and I'm embarrassed to say it now but I used to make fun of him for watching it.
11369.name: Torrie Wilson

11370.quote: I got that experience through dating dozens of men for six years after college, getting an entry level magazine job at 21, working in the fiction department at Good Housekeeping and then working as a fashion editor there as well as writing many articles for the magazine.
11370.name: Judith Krantz

11371.quote: I'm a bad dater - I'm just not good at it. It's so weird dating in this town. It's like high school. I get a lot of people who have their publicist call my agent to ask, 'Is she dating anyone?'
11371.name: Jules Asner

11372.quote: The Peking man was a thinking being, standing erect, dating to the beginning of the Ice Age.
11372.name: Davidson Black

11373.quote: A man who won't die for something is not fit to live.
11373.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

11374.quote: To be idle is a short road to death and to be diligent is a way of life foolish people are idle, wise people are diligent.
11374.name: Buddha

11375.quote: The fear of death is the most unjustified of all fears, for there's no risk of accident for someone who's dead.
11375.name: Albert Einstein

11376.quote: The fear of death follows from the fear of life. A man who lives fully is prepared to die at any time.
11376.name: Mark Twain

11377.quote: Death is no more than passing from one room into another. But there's a difference for me, you know. Because in that other room I shall be able to see.
11377.name: Helen Keller

11378.quote: What we have done for ourselves alone dies with us what we have done for others and the world remains and is immortal.
11378.name: Albert Pike

11379.quote: I didn't attend the funeral, but I sent a nice letter saying I approved of it.
11379.name: Mark Twain

11380.quote: No one wants to die. Even people who want to go to heaven don't want to die to get there. And yet death is the destination we all share. No one has ever escaped it. And that is as it should be, because Death is very likely the single best invention of Life. It is Life's change agent. It clears out the old to make way for the new.
11380.name: Steve Jobs

11381.quote: Our dead are never dead to us, until we have forgotten them.
11381.name: George Eliot

11382.quote: While I thought that I was learning how to live, I have been learning how to die.
11382.name: Leonardo da Vinci

11383.quote: Life is hard. Then you die. Then they throw dirt in your face. Then the worms eat you. Be grateful it happens in that order.
11383.name: David Gerrold

11384.quote: Suicide is man's way of telling God, 'You can't fire me - I quit.'
11384.name: Bill Maher

11385.quote: I saw few die of hunger of eating, a hundred thousand.
11385.name: Benjamin Franklin

11386.quote: Death most resembles a prophet who is without honor in his own land or a poet who is a stranger among his people.
11386.name: Khalil Gibran

11387.quote: Let no one weep for me, or celebrate my funeral with mourning for I still live, as I pass to and fro through the mouths of men.
11387.name: Quintus Ennius

11388.quote: The life of the dead is placed in the memory of the living.
11388.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

11389.quote: The day which we fear as our last is but the birthday of eternity.
11389.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

11390.quote: Die, v.: To stop sinning suddenly.
11390.name: Elbert Hubbard

11391.quote: A friend who dies, it's something of you who dies.
11391.name: Gustave Flaubert

11392.quote: No one can confidently say that he will still be living tomorrow.
11392.name: Euripides

11393.quote: They tell us that suicide is the greatest piece of cowardice, that suicide is wrong when it is quite obvious that there is nothing in the world to which every man has a more unassailable title than to his own life and person.
11393.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

11394.quote: I have never killed a man, but I have read many obituaries with great pleasure.
11394.name: Clarence Darrow

11395.quote: For death is no more than a turning of us over from time to eternity.
11395.name: William Penn

11396.quote: A dying man needs to die, as a sleepy man needs to sleep, and there comes a time when it is wrong, as well as useless, to resist.
11396.name: Stewart Alsop

11397.quote: Dying is easy, it's living that scares me to death.
11397.name: Annie Lennox

11398.quote: Death will be a great relief. No more interviews.
11398.name: Katharine Hepburn

11399.quote: I decided to devote my life to telling the story because I felt that having survived I owe something to the dead. and anyone who does not remember betrays them again.
11399.name: Elie Wiesel

11400.quote: I am become death, the destroyer of worlds.
11400.name: J. Robert Oppenheimer

11401.quote: I've told my children that when I die, to release balloons in the sky to celebrate that I graduated. For me, death is a graduation.
11401.name: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

11402.quote: Those who have the strength and the love to sit with a dying patient in the silence that goes beyond words will know that this moment is neither frightening nor painful, but a peaceful cessation of the functioning of the body.
11402.name: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

11403.quote: Man always dies before he is fully born.
11403.name: Erich Fromm

11404.quote: From my rotting body, flowers shall grow and I am in them and that is eternity.
11404.name: Edvard Munch

11405.quote: When you're dead, you're dead. That's it.
11405.name: Marlene Dietrich

11406.quote: I had seen birth and death but had thought they were different.
11406.name: T. S. Eliot

11407.quote: Death is a very dull, dreary affair, and my advice to you is to have nothing whatsoever to do with it.
11407.name: W. Somerset Maugham

11408.quote: Because of indifference, one dies before one actually dies.
11408.name: Elie Wiesel

11409.quote: Millions long for immortality who don't know what to do with themselves on a rainy Sunday afternoon.
11409.name: Susan Ertz

11410.quote: Call no man happy till he is dead.
11410.name: Aeschylus

11411.quote: Do not fear death so much but rather the inadequate life.
11411.name: Bertolt Brecht

11412.quote: Cursed is the man who dies, but the evil done by him survives.
11412.name: Abu Bakr

11413.quote: A man does not die of love or his liver or even of old age he dies of being a man.
11413.name: Miguel de Unamuno

11414.quote: Birth and death we all move between these two unknowns.
11414.name: Bryant H. McGill

11415.quote: Some people are so afraid do die that they never begin to live.
11415.name: Henry Van Dyke

11416.quote: Life is better than death, I believe, if only because it is less boring, and because it has fresh peaches in it.
11416.name: Alice Walker

11417.quote: To himself everyone is immortal he may know that he is going to die, but he can never know that he is dead.
11417.name: Samuel Butler

11418.quote: Pale Death beats equally at the poor man's gate and at the palaces of kings.
11418.name: Horace

11419.quote: Men fear death as children fear to go in the dark and as that natural fear in children is increased by tales, so is the other.
11419.name: Francis Bacon

11420.quote: Since the day of my birth, my death began its walk. It is walking toward me, without hurrying.
11420.name: Jean Cocteau

11421.quote: It is possible to provide security against other ills, but as far as death is concerned, we men live in a city without walls.
11421.name: Epicurus

11422.quote: The dead cannot cry out for justice. It is a duty of the living to do so for them.
11422.name: Lois McMaster Bujold

11423.quote: The timing of death, like the ending of a story, gives a changed meaning to what preceded it.
11423.name: Mary Catherine Bateson

11424.quote: Of all the gods only death does not desire gifts.
11424.name: Aeschylus

11425.quote: Whenever death may surprise us, let it be welcome if our battle cry has reached even one receptive ear and another hand reaches out to take up our arms.
11425.name: Che Guevara

11426.quote: One death is a tragedy one million is a statistic.
11426.name: Joseph Stalin

11427.quote: Let us beware of saying that death is the opposite of life. The living being is only a species of the dead, and a very rare species.
11427.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

11428.quote: Ordinary people seem not to realize that those who really apply themselves in the right way to philosophy are directly and of their own accord preparing themselves for dying and death.
11428.name: Socrates

11429.quote: Look, I don't want to wax philosophic, but I will say that if you're alive you've got to flap your arms and legs, you've got to jump around a lot, for life is the very opposite of death, and therefore you must at very least think noisy and colorfully, or you're not alive.
11429.name: Mel Brooks

11430.quote: There is no lonelier man in death, except the suicide, than that man who has lived many years with a good wife and then outlived her. If two people love each other there can be no happy end to it.
11430.name: Ernest Hemingway

11431.quote: People living deeply have no fear of death.
11431.name: Anais Nin

11432.quote: I postpone death by living, by suffering, by error, by risking, by giving, by losing.
11432.name: Anais Nin

11433.quote: Death is nothing, but to live defeated and inglorious is to die daily.
11433.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

11434.quote: Death is caused by swallowing small amounts of saliva over a long period of time.
11434.name: George Carlin

11435.quote: The death of a beautiful woman, is unquestionably the most poetical topic in the world.
11435.name: Edgar Allan Poe

11436.quote: Regard your soldiers as your children, and they will follow you into the deepest valleys look on them as your own beloved sons, and they will stand by you even unto death.
11436.name: Sun Tzu

11437.quote: I have thought there was some advantage even in death, by which we mingle with the herd of common men.
11437.name: Henry David Thoreau

11438.quote: At a formal dinner party, the person nearest death should always be seated closest to the bathroom.
11438.name: George Carlin

11439.quote: No evil can happen to a good man, either in life or after death.
11439.name: Plato

11440.quote: Life levels all men. Death reveals the eminent.
11440.name: George Bernard Shaw

11441.quote: If you believe in God, believe in Death Row East.
11441.name: Tupac Shakur

11442.quote: Absence and death are the same - only that in death there is no suffering.
11442.name: Theodore Roosevelt

11443.quote: For centuries the death penalty, often accompanied by barbarous refinements, has been trying to hold crime in check yet crime persists. Why? Because the instincts that are warring in man are not, as the law claims, constant forces in a state of equilibrium.
11443.name: Albert Camus

11444.quote: It is better to risk starving to death then surrender. If you give up on your dreams, what's left?
11444.name: Jim Carrey

11445.quote: Men are convinced of your arguments, your sincerity, and the seriousness of your efforts only by your death.
11445.name: Albert Camus

11446.quote: Love, we say, is life but love without hope and faith is agonizing death.
11446.name: Elbert Hubbard

11447.quote: Death is not the worst that can happen to men.
11447.name: Plato

11448.quote: There will one day spring from the brain of science a machine or force so fearful in its potentialities, so absolutely terrifying, that even man, the fighter, who will dare torture and death in order to inflict torture and death, will be appalled, and so abandon war forever.
11448.name: Thomas A. Edison

11449.quote: It is not the end of the physical body that should worry us. Rather, our concern must be to live while we're alive - to release our inner selves from the spiritual death that comes with living behind a facade designed to conform to external definitions of who and what we are.
11449.name: Elisabeth Kubler-Ross

11450.quote: We get into the habit of living before acquiring the habit of thinking. In that race which daily hastens us towards death, the body maintains its irreparable lead.
11450.name: Albert Camus

11451.quote: Death is not extinguishing the light it is only putting out the lamp because the dawn has come.
11451.name: Rabindranath Tagore

11452.quote: There will be no lasting peace either in the heart of individuals or in social customs until death is outlawed.
11452.name: Albert Camus

11453.quote: A belief in hell and the knowledge that every ambition is doomed to frustration at the hands of a skeleton have never prevented the majority of human beings from behaving as though death were no more than an unfounded rumor.
11453.name: Aldous Huxley

11454.quote: You hear a lot about God these days: God, the beneficent God, the all-great God, the Almighty God, the most powerful God, the giver of life God, the creator of death. I mean, we're hearing about God all the time, so we better learn how to deal with it. But if we know anything about God, God is arbitrary.
11454.name: Bob Dylan

11455.quote: Death is not the greatest loss in life. The greatest loss is what dies inside us while we live.
11455.name: Norman Cousins

11456.quote: Life is pleasant. Death is peaceful. It's the transition that's troublesome.
11456.name: Isaac Asimov

11457.quote: The safest course is to do nothing against one's conscience. With this secret, we can enjoy life and have no fear from death.
11457.name: Voltaire

11458.quote: Death solves all problems - no man, no problem.
11458.name: Joseph Stalin

11459.quote: Death to me means nothing as long as I can die fast.
11459.name: Bob Dylan

11460.quote: Bullfighting is the only art in which the artist is in danger of death and in which the degree of brilliance in the performance is left to the fighter's honor.
11460.name: Ernest Hemingway

11461.quote: Fear of death increases in exact proportion to increase in wealth.
11461.name: Ernest Hemingway

11462.quote: We cast away priceless time in dreams, born of imagination, fed upon illusion, and put to death by reality.
11462.name: Judy Garland

11463.quote: As a well-spent day brings happy sleep, so a life well spent brings happy death.
11463.name: Leonardo da Vinci

11464.quote: Achieving life is not the equivalent of avoiding death.
11464.name: Ayn Rand

11465.quote: Death is a release from the impressions of the senses, and from desires that make us their puppets, and from the vagaries of the mind, and from the hard service of the flesh.
11465.name: Marcus Aurelius

11466.quote: Madame, all stories, if continued far enough, end in death, and he is no true-story teller who would keep that from you.
11466.name: Ernest Hemingway

11467.quote: Know one knows whether death, which people fear to be the greatest evil, may not be the greatest good.
11467.name: Plato

11468.quote: Personally, I would be delighted if there were a life after death, especially if it permitted me to continue to learn about this world and others, if it gave me a chance to discover how history turns out.
11468.name: Carl Sagan

11469.quote: Must not all things at the last be swallowed up in death?
11469.name: Plato

11470.quote: I simply can't build my hopes on a foundation of confusion, misery and death, I think, peace and tranquillity will return again.
11470.name: Anne Frank

11471.quote: It is vain for the coward to flee death follows close behind it is only by defying it that the brave escape.
11471.name: Voltaire

11472.quote: A useless life is an early death.
11472.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

11473.quote: Dependency is death to initiative, to risk-taking and opportunity. It's time to stop the spread of government dependency and fight it like the poison it is.
11473.name: Mitt Romney

11474.quote: Despise not death, but welcome it, for nature wills it like all else.
11474.name: Marcus Aurelius

11475.quote: Give me liberty or give me death.
11475.name: Patrick Henry

11476.quote: Death is a commingling of eternity with time in the death of a good man, eternity is seen looking through time.
11476.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

11477.quote: Because I could not stop for death, He kindly stopped for me The carriage held but just ourselves and immortality.
11477.name: Emily Dickinson

11478.quote: In India we only read about death, sickness, terrorism, crime.
11478.name: Abdul Kalam

11479.quote: The death of my father is probably the biggest thing that I ever faced. Daddy and I were best friends.
11479.name: Joel Osteen

11480.quote: As long as your body is healthy and under control and death is distant, try to save your soul when death is immanent what can you do?
11480.name: Chanakya

11481.quote: We all pay for life with death, so everything in between should be free.
11481.name: Bill Hicks

11482.quote: If a man can bridge the gap between life and death, if he can live on after he's dead, then maybe he was a great man.
11482.name: James Dean

11483.quote: I'm not afraid of death, but I'm in no hurry to die. I have so much I want to do first.
11483.name: Stephen Hawking

11484.quote: Death, like birth, is a secret of Nature.
11484.name: Marcus Aurelius

11485.quote: There are worse things in life than death. Have you ever spent an evening with an insurance salesman?
11485.name: Woody Allen

11486.quote: An unused life is an early death.
11486.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

11487.quote: Justifying conscription to promote the cause of liberty is one of the most bizarre notions ever conceived by man! Forced servitude, with the risk of death and serious injury as a price to live free, makes no sense.
11487.name: Ron Paul

11488.quote: Death is not an event in life: we do not live to experience death. If we take eternity to mean not infinite temporal duration but timelessness, then eternal life belongs to those who live in the present.
11488.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein

11489.quote: If death meant just leaving the stage long enough to change costume and come back as a new character, would you slow down? Or speed up?
11489.name: Chuck Palahniuk

11490.quote: When we have lost everything, including hope, life becomes a disgrace, and death a duty.
11490.name: W. C. Fields

11491.quote: Whether you like it or not, you're forced to come to the realisation that death is out there. But I don't fear death, I'm a fatalist. I believe when it's your time, that's it. It's the hand you're dealt.
11491.name: Clint Eastwood

11492.quote: In our brief national history we have shot four of our presidents, worried five of them to death, impeached one and hounded another out of office. And when all else fails, we hold an election and assassinate their character.
11492.name: P. J. O'Rourke

11493.quote: There's something about death that is comforting. The thought that you could die tomorrow frees you to appreciate your life now.
11493.name: Angelina Jolie

11494.quote: I've been looking at some video clips on YouTube of President Obama - then candidate Obama - going through Iowa making promises. The gap between his promises and his performance is the largest I've seen, well, since the Kardashian wedding and the promise of 'til death do we part.
11494.name: Mitt Romney

11495.quote: Any man's death diminishes me, because I am involved in Mankind And therefore never send to know for whom the bell tolls it tolls for thee.
11495.name: John Donne

11496.quote: The death of democracy is not likely to be an assassination from ambush. It will be a slow extinction from apathy, indifference, and undernourishment.
11496.name: Robert M. Hutchins

11497.quote: Absolute silence leads to sadness. It is the image of death.
11497.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

11498.quote: Prohibit the taking of omens, and do away with superstitious doubts. Then, until death itself comes, no calamity need be feared.
11498.name: Sun Tzu

11499.quote: There is no such thing as inner peace. There is only nervousness or death. Any attempt to prove otherwise constitutes unacceptable behavior.
11499.name: Fran Lebowitz

11500.quote: After your death you will be what you were before your birth.
11500.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

11501.quote: Death is the solution to all problems. No man - no problem.
11501.name: Joseph Stalin

11502.quote: Death is a distant rumor to the young.
11502.name: Andy Rooney

11503.quote: Foolish men imagine that because judgment for an evil thing is delayed, there is no justice but only accident here below. Judgment for an evil thing is many times delayed some day or two, some century or two, but it is sure as life, it is sure as death.
11503.name: Thomas Carlyle

11504.quote: He who is the author of a war lets loose the whole contagion of hell and opens a vein that bleeds a nation to death.
11504.name: Thomas Paine

11505.quote: Drown in a cold vat of whiskey? Death, where is thy sting?
11505.name: W. C. Fields

11506.quote: I know not what others may choose but, as for me, give me liberty or give me death.
11506.name: Patrick Henry

11507.quote: Guilt is perhaps the most painful companion of death.
11507.name: Coco Chanel

11508.quote: I love the name of honor, more than I fear death.
11508.name: Julius Caesar

11509.quote: The U.S. couldn't even get rid of Saddam Hussein. And we all know that the EU is just a passing fad. They'll be killing each other again in less than a year. I'm sick to death of all these fascist lawsuits.
11509.name: Bill Gates

11510.quote: I have more than once in my time woken up feeling like death.
11510.name: Christopher Hitchens

11511.quote: No true believer could be intolerant or a persecutor. If I were a magistrate and the law carried the death penalty against atheists, I would begin by sending to the stake whoever denounced another.
11511.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

11512.quote: The fear of death comes from limited awareness.
11512.name: Deepak Chopra

11513.quote: I went to medical school because I wanted to ask the big questions. Do we have a soul? Does God exist? What happens after death?
11513.name: Deepak Chopra

11514.quote: Every spiritual tradition has this idea of death and resurrection. It's not unique to Christianity.
11514.name: Deepak Chopra

11515.quote: All I want is a gentleman. I'm sick to bloody death of bastards.
11515.name: Katie Price

11516.quote: Crucial to understanding federalism in modern day America is the concept of mobility, or 'the ability to vote with your feet.' If you don't support the death penalty and citizens packing a pistol - don't come to Texas. If you don't like medicinal marijuana and gay marriage, don't move to California.
11516.name: Rick Perry

11517.quote: It is impossible that anything so natural, so necessary, and so universal as death, should ever have been designed by providence as an evil to mankind.
11517.name: Jonathan Swift

11518.quote: Communism possesses a language which every people can understand - its elements are hunger, envy, and death.
11518.name: Heinrich Heine

11519.quote: Death is the liberator of him whom freedom cannot release, the physician of him whom medicine cannot cure, and the comforter of him whom time cannot console.
11519.name: Charles Caleb Colton

11520.quote: Death is one moment, and life is so many of them.
11520.name: Tennessee Williams

11521.quote: A pun does not commonly justify a blow in return. But if a blow were given for such cause, and death ensued, the jury would be judges both of the facts and of the pun, and might, if the latter were of an aggravated character, return a verdict of justifiable homicide.
11521.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

11522.quote: Man, as long as he lives, is immortal. One minute before his death he shall be immortal. But one minute later, God wins.
11522.name: Elie Wiesel

11523.quote: Death obsesses me, yes it does. I can't really understand why it doesn't obsess everyone - I think it does really, I'm just a little more out about it.
11523.name: J. K. Rowling

11524.quote: Prepare a noble death song for the day when you go over the great divide.
11524.name: Tecumseh

11525.quote: The nearer people approach old age the closer they return to a semblance of childhood, until the time comes for them to depart this life, again like children, neither tired of living nor aware of death.
11525.name: Desiderius Erasmus

11526.quote: Like all of us in this storm between birth and death, I can wreak no great changes on the world, only small changes for the better, I hope, in the lives of those I love.
11526.name: Dean Koontz

11527.quote: It is a sign of creeping inner death when we can no longer praise the living.
11527.name: Eric Hoffer

11528.quote: Football (soccer) is a matter of life and death, except more important.
11528.name: Bill Shankly

11529.quote: Death is not the biggest fear we have our biggest fear is taking the risk to be alive - the risk to be alive and express what we really are.
11529.name: Miguel Angel Ruiz

11530.quote: I never really got on that well with Yoko anyway. Strangely enough, I only started to get to know her after John's death.
11530.name: Paul McCartney

11531.quote: The rumors of my death have been greatly exaggerated.
11531.name: Paul McCartney

11532.quote: Take care of your life and the Lord will take care of your death.
11532.name: George Whitefield

11533.quote: Those who welcome death have only tried it from the ears up.
11533.name: Wilson Mizner

11534.quote: I mean in the South African case, many of those who were part of death squads would have been respectable members of their white community, people who went to church on Sunday, every Sunday.
11534.name: Desmond Tutu

11535.quote: An evil life is a kind of death.
11535.name: Ovid

11536.quote: Death is less bitter punishment than death's delay.
11536.name: Ovid

11537.quote: My life comes down to three moments: the death of my father, meeting my husband, and the birth of my daughter. Everything I did previous to that just doesn't seem to add up to very much.
11537.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

11538.quote: How strange this fear of death is! We are never frightened at a sunset.
11538.name: George MacDonald

11539.quote: I feel monotony and death to be almost the same.
11539.name: Charlotte Bronte

11540.quote: Whether or not we believe in survival of consciousness after death, reincarnation, and karma, it has very serious implications for our behavior.
11540.name: Stanislav Grof

11541.quote: A man may devote himself to death and destruction to save a nation but no nation will devote itself to death and destruction to save mankind.
11541.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

11542.quote: We want our idols to be dead because it makes death a much less scary place.
11542.name: Doug Coupland

11543.quote: Not the torturer will scare me, nor the body's final fall, nor the barrels of death's rifles, nor the shadows on the wall, nor the night when to the ground the last dim star of pain, is hurled but the blind indifference of a merciless, unfeeling world.
11543.name: Roger Waters

11544.quote: Only a humanity to whom death has become as indifferent as its members, that has itself died, can inflict it administratively on innumerable people.
11544.name: Theodor Adorno

11546.quote: Birth was the death of him.
11546.name: Samuel Beckett

11547.quote: Death is the sound of distant thunder at a picnic.
11547.name: W. H. Auden

11548.quote: Death is easier than a wretched life and better never to have born than to live and fare badly.
11548.name: Aeschylus

11549.quote: When I came back to Dublin I was courtmartialed in my absence and sentenced to death in my absence, so I said they could shoot me in my absence.
11549.name: Brendan Behan

11550.quote: Generosity during life is a very different thing from generosity in the hour of death one proceeds from genuine liberality and benevolence, the other from pride or fear.
11550.name: Horace Mann

11551.quote: An 'unemployed' existence is a worse negation of life than death itself.
11551.name: Jose Ortega y Gasset

11552.quote: Faithfulness to the past can be a kind of death above ground. Writing of the past is a resurrection the past then lives in your words and you are free.
11552.name: Jessamyn West

11553.quote: As far as thinking about death and murder and various ways of killing people and how people die, I probably have the most twisted mind in Slayer.
11553.name: Tom Araya

11554.name: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

11555.quote: Poor Georgia O'Keeffe. Death didn't soften the opinions of the art world toward her paintings.
11555.name: Jerry Saltz

11556.quote: And yet, I suppose you mourn the loss or the death of what you thought your life was, even if you find your life is better after. You mourn the future that you thought you'd planned.
11556.name: Lynn Redgrave

11557.quote: Death is the veil which those who live call life They sleep, and it is lifted.
11557.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

11559.quote: We live in grief for having left the womb, for having left the teat, then school, then home. In my case, it was leaving marriages, and the death of my wife.
11559.name: William Shatner

11560.quote: Madness need not be all breakdown. It may also be break-through. It is potential liberation and renewal as well as enslavement and existential death.
11560.name: R. D. Laing

11561.quote: Success is like death. The more successful you become, the higher the houses in the hills get and the higer the fences get.
11561.name: Kevin Spacey

11562.quote: Once you start doing only what you've already proven you can do, you're on the road to death.
11562.name: Jerry Seinfeld

11563.quote: Death gives us sleep, eternal youth, and immortality.
11563.name: Jean Paul

11564.quote: All societies on the verge of death are masculine. A society can survive with only one man no society will survive a shortage of women.
11564.name: Germaine Greer

11565.quote: Death is softer by far than tyranny.
11565.name: Aeschylus

11566.quote: For children preserve the fame of a man after his death.
11566.name: Aeschylus

11567.quote: Smiles, tears, of all my life! - and, if God choose, I shall but love thee better after death.
11567.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

11568.quote: Being an old maid is like death by drowning, a really delightful sensation after you cease to struggle.
11568.name: Edna Ferber

11569.quote: Pain and death are part of life. To reject them is to reject life itself.
11569.name: Havelock Ellis

11570.quote: McVeigh's lawyer got him the death penalty, which, quite frankly, I could have done.
11570.name: Jon Stewart
