11571.name: Paul Ryan

11572.quote: Do not seek death. Death will find you. But seek the road which makes death a fulfillment.
11572.name: Dag Hammarskjold

11573.quote: Life is a great sunrise. I do not see why death should not be an even greater one.
11573.name: Vladimir Nabokov

11574.quote: Every parting is a form of death, as every reunion is a type of heaven.
11574.name: Tryon Edwards

11575.quote: An important consequence of freeing oneself from the fear of death is a radical opening to spirituality of a universal and non-denominational type.
11575.name: Stanislav Grof

11576.quote: Man has but three events in his life: to be born, to live, and to die. He is not conscious of his birth, he suffers at his death and he forgets to live.
11576.name: Jean de la Bruyere

11577.quote: Rock and menopause do not mix. It is not good, it sucks and every day I fight it to the death, or, at the very least, not let it take me over.
11577.name: Stevie Nicks

11578.quote: In the first book of my Discworld series, published more than 26 years ago, I introduced Death as a character there was nothing particularly new about this - death has featured in art and literature since medieval times, and for centuries we have had a fascination with the Grim Reaper.
11578.name: Terry Pratchett

11579.quote: Death was like love, a romantic escape.
11579.name: Brigitte Bardot

11580.quote: We have abolished the death penalty for humans, so why should it continue for animals?
11580.name: Brigitte Bardot

11581.quote: I don't believe in life after death. But I do believe in some grinding destiny that watches over us on earth. If I didn't, the safety valve would give and the boiler would explode.
11581.name: Hedy Lamarr

11582.quote: No society has been able to abolish human sadness, no political system can deliver us from the pain of living, from our fear of death, our thirst for the absolute. It is the human condition that directs the social condition, not vice versa.
11582.name: Eugene Ionesco

11583.quote: A text of Tibetan Buddhism describes the time of death as a unique opportunity for spiritual liberation from the cycles of death and rebirth and a period that determines our next incarnation.
11583.name: Stanislav Grof

11584.quote: Life and death are important. Don't suffer them in vain.
11584.name: Bodhidharma

11585.quote: The acceptance of death gives you more of a stake in life, in living life happily, as it should be lived. Living for the moment.
11585.name: Sting

11586.quote: That which is so universal as death must be a benefit.
11586.name: Friedrich Schiller

11587.quote: The call of death is a call of love. Death can be sweet if we answer it in the affirmative, if we accept it as one of the great eternal forms of life and transformation.
11587.name: Hermann Hesse

11588.quote: What is the value of sticking a microphone in a man's face right after he has learned of his wife's death?
11588.name: Jessica Savitch

11589.quote: I offer neither pay, nor quarters, nor food I offer only hunger, thirst, forced marches, battles and death. Let him who loves his country with his heart, and not merely with his lips, follow me.
11589.name: Giuseppe Garibaldi

11590.quote: I think about death a lot, like I think we all do. I don't think of suicide as an option, but as fun. It's an interesting idea that you can control how you go. It's this thing that's looming, and you can control it.
11590.name: Ryan Gosling

11591.quote: The wages of sin are death, but by the time taxes are taken out, it's just sort of a tired feeling.
11591.name: Paula Poundstone

11592.quote: Not ignorance, but ignorance of ignorance, is the death of knowledge.
11592.name: Alfred North Whitehead

11593.quote: I believe that his death and resurrection transformed humanity's relationship with God.
11593.name: Timothy Radcliffe

11594.quote: Islam is a religion of success. Unlike Christianity, which has as its main image, in the west at least, a man dying in a devastating, disgraceful, helpless death.
11594.name: Karen Armstrong

11595.quote: Become an internationalist and learn to respect all life. Make war on machines. And in particular the sterile machines of corporate death and the robots that guard them.
11595.name: Abbie Hoffman

11596.quote: Does not the very word 'creative' mean to build, to initiate, to give out, to act - rather than to be acted upon, to be subjective? Living photography is positive in its approach, it sings a song of life - not death.
11596.name: Berenice Abbott

11597.quote: Death is an absolute mystery. We are all vulnerable to it, it's what makes life interesting and suspenseful.
11597.name: Jeanne Moreau

11598.quote: It's just as idiotic to say there is no life after death as it is to say there is one.
11598.name: Jeanne Moreau

11599.quote: Knowing how to die is knowing how to live. What is death anyway? It's the outcome of life.
11599.name: Jeanne Moreau

11600.quote: When I did 'Bumble-ardy,' I was so intensely aware of death. Eugene, my friend and partner, was dying here in the house when I did 'Bumble-ardy'. I did 'Bumble-ardy' to save myself. I did not want to die with him. I wanted to live, as any human being does.
11600.name: Maurice Sendak

11602.quote: The distinctions of fine art bore me to death.
11602.name: Maurice Sendak

11603.quote: As a kid, all I thought about was death.
11603.name: Maurice Sendak

11604.quote: When theater becomes a soothing middle-class thing, when it's packaged as the Night Out, then that's the death of it.
11604.name: Ralph Fiennes

11605.quote: Living is a sickness to which sleep provides relief every sixteen hours. It's a palliative. The remedy is death.
11605.name: Nicolas Chamfort

11606.quote: Monarchs ought to put to death the authors and instigators of war, as their sworn enemies and as dangers to their states.
11606.name: Elizabeth I

11607.quote: Death is a delightful hiding place for weary men.
11607.name: Herodotus

11608.quote: The enemy fought with savage fury, and met death with all its horrors, without shrinking or complaining: not one asked to be spared, but fought as long as they could stand or sit.
11608.name: Davy Crockett

11609.quote: I know I'm drinking myself to a slow death, but then I'm in no hurry.
11609.name: Robert Benchley

11610.quote: For days after death hair and fingernails continue to grow, but phone calls taper off.
11610.name: Johnny Carson

11611.quote: It is a horrible fact that we can read in the daily paper, without interrupting our breakfast, numerical reckonings of death and destruction that ought to break our hearts or scare us out of our wits.
11611.name: Wendell Berry

11612.quote: I've always been scared to death of pain - afraid, even, to think of it.
11612.name: Loretta Young

11613.quote: Policemen so cherish their status as keepers of the peace and protectors of the public that they have occasionally been known to beat to death those citizens or groups who question that status.
11613.name: David Mamet

11614.quote: At a certain age, death becomes familiar to you-or a loss becomes familiar-the tragedies that are more commonplace in life.
11614.name: Jessica Lange

11615.quote: Loved. You can't use it in the past tense. Death does not stop that love at all.
11615.name: Ken Kesey

11616.quote: Have an earnestness for death and you will have life.
11616.name: Abu Bakr

11617.quote: There is no harm in patience, and no profit in lamentation. Death is easier to bear (than) that which precedes it, and more severe than that which comes after it. Remember the death of the Apostle of God, and your sorrow will be lessened.
11617.name: Abu Bakr

11618.quote: You can cry about death and very properly so, your own as well as anybody else's. But it's inevitable, so you'd better grapple with it and cope and be aware that not only is it inevitable, but it has always been inevitable, if you see what I mean.
11618.name: David Attenborough

11619.quote: Sinful and forbidden pleasures are like poisoned bread they may satisfy appetite for the moment, but there is death in them at the end.
11619.name: Tryon Edwards

11620.quote: I'm very comfortable with the nature of life and death, and that we come to an end. What's most difficult to imagine is that those dreams and early yearnings and desires of childhood and adolescence will also disappear. But who knows? Maybe you become part of the eternal whatever.
11620.name: Hugh Hefner

11621.quote: If you make every game a life and death proposition, you're going to have problems. For one thing, you'll be dead a lot.
11621.name: Dean Smith

11622.quote: It's an incredible con job when you think about it, to believe something now in exchange for something after death. Even corporations with their reward systems don't try to make it posthumous.
11622.name: Gloria Steinem

11623.quote: Yes, people pull the trigger - but guns are the instrument of death. Gun control is necessary, and delay means more death and horror.
11623.name: Eliot Spitzer

11624.quote: Disease, insanity, and death were the angels that attended my cradle, and since then have followed me throughout my life.
11624.name: Edvard Munch

11625.quote: People always say that pregnant women have a glow. And I say it's because you're sweating to death.
11625.name: Jessica Simpson

11626.quote: The end of the animal trade would leave more time to trap or beat to death pop star wannabes.
11626.name: Simon Cowell

11627.quote: We are weak, writing is difficult, but for my own sake I do not regret this journey, which has shown that Englishmen can endure hardships, help one another, and meet death with as great a fortitude as ever in the past.
11627.name: Robert Falcon Scott

11628.quote: The sole equality on earth is death.
11628.name: Philip James Bailey

11629.quote: I put for the general inclination of all mankind, a perpetual and restless desire of power after power, that ceaseth only in death.
11629.name: Thomas Hobbes

11630.quote: Without fullness of experience, length of days is nothing. When fullness of life has been achieved, shortness of days is nothing. That is perhaps why the young have usually so little fear of death they live by intensities that the elderly have forgotten.
11630.name: Lewis Mumford

11631.quote: I intend to leave after my death a large fund for the promotion of the peace idea, but I am skeptical as to its results.
11631.name: Alfred Nobel

11632.quote: Sleep is lovely, death is better still, not to have been born is of course the miracle.
11632.name: Heinrich Heine

11633.quote: Life isn't fair. It's just fairer than death, that's all.
11633.name: William Goldman

11634.quote: I feel like I don't watch that many shows with death.
11634.name: Lena Dunham

11635.quote: Consciousness after death demonstrates the possibility of consciousness operating independently of the body.
11635.name: Stanislav Grof

11636.quote: Whenever I watch TV and see those poor starving kids all over the world, I can't help but cry. I mean I'd love to be skinny like that, but not with all those flies and death and stuff.
11636.name: Mariah Carey

11637.quote: When applied to politics and taken to its extreme, kitsch is the mask of death. Fascism was all aesthetics. There was no core principle to it. There was no truth to it.
11637.name: John Cusack

11638.quote: All interest in disease and death is only another expression of interest in life.
11638.name: Thomas Mann

11639.quote: I love this pedal to death. The only way you could keep me from playing one is by chopping off my legs!
11639.name: Kirk Hammett

11640.quote: Even when you're making a movie about life, death is a presence, and I guess it's part of my dramatic viewpoint. I'm not sure why exactly. Maybe I'm drawn to it as a story element.
11640.name: Gus Van Sant

11641.quote: Once a disease has entered the body, all parts which are healthy must fight it: not one alone, but all. Because a disease might mean their common death. Nature knows this and Nature attacks the disease with whatever help she can muster.
11641.name: Paracelsus

11642.quote: People can undergo a sudden change of thinking and loyalties under threat of death or intense social pressure and isolation from friends and family.
11642.name: Keith Henson

11643.quote: It's not the normal way to look at things but I experienced death at a really young age and because of that it's been part of my mental landscape that death is really very possible.
11643.name: Cate Blanchett

11644.quote: I made a supreme effort not to do that thing that parents do, which is to bore people without children to death by going on and on about how funny their children are, so there's none of that hopefully.
11644.name: Jo Brand

11645.quote: Courage is the art of being the only one who knows you're scared to death.
11645.name: Earl Wilson

11647.quote: I believe that people would be alive today if there were a death penalty.
11647.name: Nancy Reagan

11648.quote: For three days after death, hair and fingernails continue to grow but phone calls taper off.
11648.name: Johnny Carson

11822.name: Herbert Simon

11824.name: Arthur Erickson

11825.quote: Sacred spaces can be created in any environment.
11825.name: Christy Turlington

11826.quote: Design works if it's authentic, inspired, and has a clear point of view. It can't be a collection of input.

11829.quote: Luck is the residue of design.

11830.name: Pierre Bonnard

11831.quote: Good buildings come from good people, ad all problems are solved by good design.
11831.name: Stephen Gardiner

11834.quote: Design is not making beauty, beauty emerges from selection, affinities, integration, love.

11835.name: Robert Collier

11836.quote: Design is not for philosophy it's for life.
11836.name: Issey Miyake

11837.quote: About half my designs are controlled fantasy, 15 percent are total madness and the rest are bread-and-butter designs.
11837.name: Manolo Blahnik

11839.name: Isaac Mizrahi

11841.name: Tadao Ando

11844.name: Gianni Versace

11846.quote: I design for the woman who loves being a woman.
11846.name: Diane von Furstenberg

11848.name: Marc Newson

11850.name: Donald Norman

11851.quote: The proper study of mankind is the science of design.

11859.name: Robin Day

11861.name: Kenzo Tange

11862.name: David McFadden

11877.name: Charles Stanley

11880.name: John Adams

11886.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

11888.name: Tom Peters

11890.name: Ellen DeGeneres

11902.name: Philip Johnson

11908.quote: The actual tragedies of life bear no relation to one's preconceived ideas. In the event, one is always bewildered by their simplicity, their grandeur of design, and by that element of the bizarre which seems inherent in them.

11909.quote: At some point in your life, if you're lucky, you get to design the way in which things evolve.

11923.quote: Interior design is a business of trust.

11926.quote: I like design, I like details, to me it is just another form of self-expression.

11934.quote: No wonder the film industry started in the desert in California where, like all desert dwellers, they dream their buildings, rather than design them.

11936.name: Venus Williams

11938.name: Vera Wang

11939.quote: Book-jacket design may become a lost art, like album-cover design, without which late-20th-century iconography would have been pauperized.

11940.name: Carlos Ghosn

11941.name: Ice Cube

11942.quote: A person should design the way he makes a living around how he wishes to make a life.

11943.name: Genevieve Gorder

11945.name: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

11946.name: Jason Reitman

11947.name: Venus Williams

11949.quote: I'd love to design bridal dresses.
11949.name: Lauren Conrad

11950.quote: I thank Marc Jacobs so much for giving me the opportunity to design a shoe for Louis Vuitton, but the thing that broke my heart most was when they said, 'You're finished. The shoe's finished.'

11951.quote: So, I'm always around video games but I've always been interested in them from a visual perspective, with the graphic design and that whole thing. I don't know if that comes from my love of photography or what but that's always what's held my interest about them.
11951.name: Sophia Bush

11952.quote: When I design and wonder what the point is, I think of someone having a bad time in their life. 11952.name: Miuccia Prada

11953.quote: I mean, I think about it, but I don't design my record to get a certain public response.
11953.name: Liz Phair

11954.quote: Marc Jacobs is full of creative people and Louis Vuitton is again a name on the door, a name that has existed for many years but I'm a collaborator there and I bring in other people, other artists and I work with a great creative design team.
11954.name: Marc Jacobs

11955.quote: But I'm blessed to work with great people. I collaborate with brilliant stylists both here and in Paris. I work with a great design team. I really allow everyone to bring their ideas. I almost rely on them to inspire me.
11955.name: Marc Jacobs

11956.quote: I approve designs not because I think I am more gifted or somebody who can see ahead three or four years from now, but just to make sure that the design is a logical, rational decision, taken after analyzing pros and cons.

11957.quote: When I come to a design decision, people know that is that.
11957.name: Carlos Ghosn

11958.quote: For me, unemployment and poverty in the Greater Montreal area is not mainly a problem of structure, or design, or statistics. It is a profoundly human situation.
11958.name: Kim Campbell

11959.name: Jack Nicklaus

11960.quote: I've wanted to design golf courses ever since I was a kid. I suppose it comes from the way I've played the game. To find the proper way to play any hole, I've always begun by asking myself what the architect has tried to do with it.
11960.name: Jack Nicklaus

11961.quote: A Nicklaus Design golf course is done by the guys in my company that I work with, that have been trained in my vision, and they do what they think I might do. 11961.name: Jack Nicklaus

11962.quote: A jellyfish is little more than a pulsating bell, a tassel of trailing tentacles and a single digestive opening through which it both eats and excretes - as regrettable an example of economy of design as ever was.
11962.name: Jeffrey Kluger

11963.quote: Leopard is an animal design, and my designs come from nature.
11963.name: Roberto Cavalli

11964.quote: I became an art major, took every art class my school had to offer. In college, I majored in Advertising Art and Design.
11964.name: Len Wein

11965.quote: Britain's great strength is its innovative, design and engineering natural ability and we're not using it.
11965.name: James Dyson

11966.quote: I don't design down to a price.
11966.name: James Dyson

11967.quote: I'm not into politics but I am committed to a cause: ensuring design technology and engineering stays on the U.K. curriculum, alongside science and maths - grounding abstract theory, merging the practical with the academic.
11967.name: James Dyson

11968.quote: When you say 'design,' everybody thinks of magazine pages. So it's an emotive word. Everybody thinks it's how something looks, whereas for me, design is pretty much everything.
11968.name: James Dyson

11969.quote: I don't particularly follow the Bauhaus school of design, where you make everything into a black box - simplify it.
11969.name: James Dyson

11970.quote: Design and technology should be the subject where mathematical brainboxes and science whizzkids turn their bright ideas into useful products.
11970.name: James Dyson

11971.quote: Design is a plan for arranging elements in such a way as best to accomplish a particular purpose.
11971.name: Charles Eames

11972.quote: The details are not the details. They make the design.
11972.name: Charles Eames

11973.quote: I think fashion is a lot of fun. I love clothes. More than fashion or brand labels, I love design. I love the thought that people put into clothes. 11973.name: Anne Hathaway

11974.quote: I'd like to design something like a city or a museum. I want to do something hands on rather than just play golf which is the sport of the religious right.
11974.name: Brad Pitt

11975.quote: I'm drawn to furniture design as complete architecture on a minor scale.
11975.name: Brad Pitt

11976.quote: McSweeney's as a publishing company is built on a business model that only works when we sell physical books. So we try to put a lot of effort into the design and production of the book-as-object.
11976.name: Dave Eggers

11977.quote: When I announced the development of Perl 6, I said it was going to be a community design. I designed Perl, myself. It's limited by my own brain power. So I wanted Perl 6 to be a community design.
11977.name: Larry Wall

11978.quote: I've always been a bit of a decorator. I think if I wasn't a singer I'd probably be in stage setting or interior design or something. I like clutter and I'm quite visually greedy. 11978.name: Florence Welch

11979.quote: I think a lot of times people design restaurants with flash in mind. I think you should design restaurants with function in mind. Make sure it's functional and works with what you're trying to accomplish. Design can come later.
11979.name: Bobby Flay

11980.quote: Design is so critical it should be on the agenda of every meeting in every single department.
11980.name: Tom Peters

11981.quote: I am a fashion designer. I'm not an environmentalist. When I get up in the morning, number one I'm a mother and a wife, and number two I design clothes. So the main thing I need to do is create, hopefully, exquisitely beautiful, desirable objects for my customer.
11981.name: Stella McCartney

11982.quote: Complexity is one of the great problems in environmental design.
11982.name: Christopher Alexander

11983.quote: Once you understand this way, you will be able to make your room alive you will be able to design a house together with your family a garden for your children places where you can work beautiful terraces where you can sit and dream.
11983.name: Christopher Alexander

11984.quote: We worked with the engineers in the design and construction and testing phases in those various areas, then we would get back together at the end of the week and brief each other as to what had gone on.
11984.name: Alan Shepard

11985.quote: The level of detail and craft is something that's inscribed within the original design concept. And so when I begin to draw, I know what kind of detailing I want the building to have.
11985.name: Tadao Ando

11986.quote: Web users ultimately want to get at data quickly and easily. They don't care as much about attractive sites and pretty design.
11986.name: Tim Berners-Lee
