12300.quote: My goal? To test out every diet and exercise regimen on planet earth and figure out which work best. I sweated, I cooked, I learned to pole dance. In the end, I lost weight, lowered my cholesterol and doubled my energy level. I feel better than I ever have.
12300.name: A. J. Jacobs

12301.quote: I'm eating a lot of organic proteins and vegetables! Maintaining a healthy, balanced diet is my No. 1 priority because I'm nursing my daughter.
12301.name: Lily Aldridge

12302.quote: I almost fainted. There was no family history. I had been eating a vegetarian diet and I exercised.
12302.name: Rue McClanahan

12303.quote: The sad thing is, when it comes to diet, is that even when well-intentioned Feds try to do right by us, they fail. Either they're outvoted by puppets of agribusiness, or they are puppets of agribusiness.
12303.name: Mark Bittman

12304.quote: Let me pose you a question. Can farm-raised salmon be organic when its feed has nothing to do with its natural diet, even if the feed itself is supposedly organic, and the fish themselves are packed tightly in pens, swimming in their own filth?
12304.name: Mark Bittman

12305.quote: I am involved in Greenpeace. And I just recently completely switched my diet over to near-veganism. So you try to do little things that you can. I recycle every single day. Every single thing in my house that can be recycled is.
12305.name: Lindsey Shaw

12306.quote: Eating at home is fine, as I can easily work around the foods that don't agree with me and still eat heartily with the rest of my family. I don't force them to follow my diet.
12306.name: Andrea McLean

12307.quote: Love is such an objective thing. I mean, I can say I love my family, or I love my Diet Coke. So I guess, in different ways, yeah, I do believe in love.
12307.name: Emilie de Ravin

12308.quote: The more I read and watched about the meat industry, the more determined I became to keep meat out of my diet. The things I saw in slaughterhouse exposes made me feel sick and I refused to just ignore what I now knew.
12308.name: Renee Olstead

12309.quote: The vegan diet is obviously lacking whatever essential nutrient it is that makes people likeable.
12309.name: Jim Goad

12310.quote: If I could give one tip for people - it's not an exercise or nutrition regimen. It's to walk your talk and believe in yourself, because at the end of the day, the dumbbell and diet don't get you in shape. It's your accountability to your word.
12310.name: Brett Hoebel

12311.quote: If you think of exercise as a 60-minute commitment 3 times a week at the gym, you're missing the point completely. If you think that going on a diet has something to do with nutrition, you don't see the forest through the trees. It is a lifestyle. I know it sounds cliche, but you have to find things you love to do.
12311.name: Brett Hoebel

12312.quote: I dream about 'Cheers.' Like when you go on a diet and you dream of pizza. I always think of those wonderful years. I loved working on it.
12312.name: George Wendt

12313.quote: Hope is a very thin diet.
12313.name: Thomas Shadwell

12314.quote: The 17 Day Diet' keeps your body and metabolism guessing. I call this 'body confusion'.
12314.name: Mike Moreno

12315.quote: This cream will help one's nature strengthen and grow, The diet gives support in my decline.
12315.name: Du Fu

12316.quote: My soul is dark with stormy riot: directly traced over to diet.
12316.name: Samuel Hoffenstein

12317.quote: If cooking becomes an art form rather than a means of providing a reasonable diet, then something is clearly wrong.
12317.name: Tom Jaine

12318.quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
12318.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

12319.quote: All our dreams can come true, if we have the courage to pursue them.
12319.name: Walt Disney

12320.quote: All men dream, but not equally. Those who dream by night in the dusty recesses of their minds, wake in the day to find that it was vanity: but the dreamers of the day are dangerous men, for they may act on their dreams with open eyes, to make them possible.
12320.name: T. E. Lawrence

12321.quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
12321.name: Harriet Tubman

12322.quote: Dream as if you'll live forever. Live as if you'll die today.
12322.name: James Dean

12323.quote: A dreamer is one who can only find his way by moonlight, and his punishment is that he sees the dawn before the rest of the world.
12323.name: Oscar Wilde

12324.quote: A dream doesn't become reality through magic it takes sweat, determination and hard work.
12324.name: Colin Powell

12326.quote: Deep into that darkness peering, long I stood there, wondering, fearing, doubting, dreaming dreams no mortal ever dared to dream before.
12326.name: Edgar Allan Poe

12327.quote: I'm sick of following my dreams. I'm just going to ask them where they're goin', and hook up with them later.
12327.name: Mitch Hedberg

12328.quote: My dream is of a place and a time where America will once again be seen as the last best hope of earth.
12328.name: Abraham Lincoln

12329.quote: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with success unexpected in common hours.
12329.name: Henry David Thoreau

12330.quote: Reality is wrong. Dreams are for real.
12330.name: Tupac Shakur

12331.quote: There are those who look at things the way they are, and ask why, I dream of things that never were, and ask why not?
12331.name: Robert Kennedy

12332.quote: Yesterday is but today's memory, and tomorrow is today's dream.
12332.name: Khalil Gibran

12333.quote: We all have dreams. But in order to make dreams come into reality, it takes an awful lot of determination, dedication, self-discipline, and effort.
12333.name: Jesse Owens

12334.quote: If you take responsibility for yourself you will develop a hunger to accomplish your dreams.
12334.name: Les Brown

12335.quote: To accomplish great things, we must not only act, but also dream not only plan, but also believe.
12335.name: Anatole France

12336.quote: All human beings are also dream beings. Dreaming ties all mankind together.
12336.name: Jack Kerouac

12337.quote: Do all you can to make your dreams come true.
12337.name: Joel Osteen

12338.quote: You have to dream before your dreams can come true.
12338.name: Abdul Kalam

12339.quote: Dreams have only one owner at a time. That's why dreamers are lonely.
12339.name: Erma Bombeck

12340.quote: Dreams are today's answers to tomorrow's questions.
12340.name: Edgar Cayce

12341.quote: Dream no small dreams for they have no power to move the hearts of men.
12341.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

12342.quote: Throw your dreams into space like a kite, and you do not know what it will bring back, a new life, a new friend, a new love, a new country.
12342.name: Anais Nin

12343.quote: Dreams are the touchstones of our character.
12343.name: Henry David Thoreau

12344.quote: A man is not old until regrets take the place of dreams.
12344.name: John Barrymore

12345.quote: The most pitiful among men is he who turns his dreams into silver and gold.
12345.name: Khalil Gibran

12346.quote: Judge of your natural character by what you do in your dreams.
12346.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

12347.quote: Dreams pass into the reality of action. From the actions stems the dream again and this interdependence produces the highest form of living.
12347.name: Anais Nin

12348.quote: Who looks outside, dreams who looks inside, awakes.
12348.name: Carl Jung

12350.quote: He was a dreamer, a thinker, a speculative philosopher, or, as his wife would have it, an idiot.
12350.name: Douglas Adams

12351.quote: Dream and give yourself permission to envision a You that you choose to be.
12351.name: Joy Page

12352.quote: Myths are public dreams, dreams are private myths.
12352.name: Joseph Campbell

12353.quote: I'm a dreamer. I have to dream and reach for the stars, and if I miss a star then I grab a handful of clouds.
12353.name: Mike Tyson

12354.quote: Youth is a wonderful thing. What a crime to waste it on children.
12354.name: George Bernard Shaw

12355.quote: The interpretation of dreams is the royal road to a knowledge of the unconscious activities of the mind.
12355.name: Sigmund Freud

12356.quote: I close my eyes, then I drift away, into the magic night I softly say. A silent prayer, like dreamers do, then I fall asleep to dream my dreams of you.
12356.name: Roy Orbison

12357.quote: It takes a lot of courage to show your dreams to someone else.
12357.name: Erma Bombeck

12358.quote: The best way to make your dreams come true is to wake up.
12358.name: Paul Valery

12359.quote: Great dreams of great dreamers are always transcended.
12359.name: Abdul Kalam

12361.quote: We all dream we do not understand our dreams, yet we act as if nothing strange goes on in our sleep minds, strange at least by comparison with the logical, purposeful doings of our minds when we are awake.
12361.name: Erich Fromm

12362.quote: Each man should frame life so that at some future hour fact and his dreaming meet.
12362.name: Victor Hugo

12363.quote: Dreams are true while they last, and do we not live in dreams?
12363.name: Alfred Lord Tennyson

12365.quote: I am accustomed to sleep and in my dreams to imagine the same things that lunatics imagine when awake.
12365.name: Rene Descartes

12366.quote: Without leaps of imagination, or dreaming, we lose the excitement of possibilities. Dreaming, after all, is a form of planning.
12366.name: Gloria Steinem

12367.quote: So many of our dreams at first seem impossible, then they seem improbable, and then, when we summon the will, they soon become inevitable.
12367.name: Christopher Reeve

12368.quote: Living in dreams of yesterday, we find ourselves still dreaming of impossible future conquests.
12368.name: Charles Lindbergh

12369.quote: I've always said that one night, I'm going to find myself in some field somewhere, I'm standing on grass, and it's raining, and I'm with the person I love, and I know I'm at the very point I've been dreaming of getting to.
12369.name: Drew Barrymore

12370.quote: The world needs dreamers and the world needs doers. But above all, the world needs dreamers who do.
12370.name: Sarah Ban Breathnach

12371.quote: No one should negotiate their dreams. Dreams must be free to fly high. No government, no legislature, has a right to limit your dreams. You should never agree to surrender your dreams.
12371.name: Jesse Jackson

12372.quote: Sometimes, the only realists are the dreamers.
12372.name: Paul Wellstone

12373.quote: Ideologies separate us. Dreams and anguish bring us together.
12373.name: Eugene Ionesco

12374.quote: I think we dream so we don't have to be apart so long. If we're in each other's dreams, we can play together all night.
12374.name: Bill Watterson

12375.quote: When you cease to dream you cease to live.
12375.name: Malcolm Forbes

12376.quote: Only in our dreams are we free. The rest of the time we need wages.
12376.name: Terry Pratchett

12377.quote: All the things one has forgotten scream for help in dreams.
12377.name: Elias Canetti

12378.quote: Dreaming or awake, we perceive only events that have meaning to us.
12378.name: Jane Roberts

12379.quote: I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly dreaming I am a man.
12379.name: Zhuangzi

12380.quote: A dream you dream alone is only a dream. A dream you dream together is reality.
12380.name: Yoko Ono

12381.quote: All men of action are dreamers.
12381.name: James Huneker

12382.quote: I stand for freedom of expression, doing what you believe in, and going after your dreams.
12382.name: Madonna Ciccone

12383.quote: Like all dreamers, I mistook disenchantment for truth.
12383.name: Jean-Paul Sartre

12384.quote: The dreamer can know no truth, not even about his dream, except by awaking out of it.
12384.name: George Santayana

12385.quote: Those who have compared our life to a dream were right, we were sleeping wake, and waking sleep.
12385.name: Michel de Montaigne

12386.quote: Dream manfully and nobly, and thy dreams shall be prophets.
12386.name: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

12387.quote: I am a dreamer. Seriously, I'm living on another planet.
12387.name: Eva Green

12388.quote: God's gifts put man's best dreams to shame.
12388.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

12389.quote: I have always been amazed at the way an ordinary observer lends so much more credence and attaches so much more importance to waking events than to those occurring in dreams, Man, is above all the plaything of his memory.
12389.name: Andre Breton

12390.quote: Perhaps life is just that, a dream and a fear.
12390.name: Joseph Conrad

12391.quote: I don't use drugs, my dreams are frightening enough.
12391.name: M. C. Escher

12392.quote: I tell people I'm too stupid to know what's impossible. I have ridiculously large dreams, and half the time they come true.
12392.name: Debi Thomas

12393.quote: Dreaming of a tomorrow, which tomorrow, will be as distant then as 'tis today.
12393.name: Lope de Vega

12394.quote: Dreams will get you nowhere, a good kick in the pants will take you a long way.
12394.name: Baltasar Gracian

12396.quote: My dreams were all my own I accounted for them to nobody they were my refuge when annoyed - my dearest pleasure when free.
12396.name: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley

12397.quote: Man is a genius when he is dreaming.
12397.name: Akira Kurosawa

12398.quote: The world of men is dreaming, it has gone mad in its sleep, and a snake is strangling it, but it can't wake up.
12398.name: David Herbert Lawrence

12399.quote: We are near waking when we dream we are dreaming.
12399.name: Novalis

12400.quote: You have to have a dream so you can get up in the morning.
12400.name: Billy Wilder

12401.quote: Was it only by dreaming or writing that I could find out what I thought?
12401.name: Joan Didion

12402.quote: I was always a dreamer, in childhood especially. People thought I was a little strange.
12402.name: Charley Pride

12403.quote: People are so busy dreaming the American Dream, fantasizing about what they could be or have a right to be, that they're all asleep at the switch. Consequently we are living in the Age of Human Error.
12403.name: Florence King

12404.quote: This is the city of dreamers and time and again it's the place where the greatest dream of all, the American dream, has been tested and has triumphed.
12404.name: Michael Bloomberg

12405.quote: Only the dreamer shall understand realities, though in truth his dreaming must be not out of proportion to his waking.
12405.name: Margaret Fuller

12406.quote: One of the most adventurous things left us is to go to bed. For no one can lay a hand on our dreams.
12406.name: E. V. Lucas

12407.quote: We all keep dreaming, and luckily, dreams come true.
12407.name: Katie Holmes

12408.quote: You know, Willie Wonka said it best: we are the makers of dreams, the dreamers of dreams.
12408.name: Herb Brooks

12409.quote: Married or unmarried, young or old, poet or worker, you are still a dreamer, and will one time know, and feel, that your life is but a dream.
12409.name: Donald G. Mitchell

12410.quote: I challenge you to be dreamers I challenge you to be doers and let us make the greatest place in the world even better.
12410.name: Brian Schweitzer

12411.quote: The interpretation of dreams is a great art.
12411.name: Paracelsus

12413.quote: People need dreams, there's as much nourishment in 'em as food.
12413.name: Dorothy Gilman

12414.quote: That's what keeps me going: dreaming, inventing, then hoping and dreaming some more in order to keep dreaming.
12414.name: Joseph Barbera

12416.quote: Writers write. Dreamers talk about it.
12416.name: Jerry B. Jenkins

12417.quote: Oh, I was never a businessman. I was a visionary, a dreamer.
12417.name: Jim Bakker

12418.quote: Take everything easy and quit dreaming and brooding and you will be well guarded from a thousand evils.
12418.name: Amy Lowell

12420.quote: We should never discourage young people from dreaming dreams.
12420.name: Lenny Wilkens

12421.quote: Only things the dreamers make live on. They are the eternal conquerors.
12421.name: Herbert Kaufman

12422.quote: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
12422.name: Henry David Thoreau

12423.quote: I believe in everything until it's disproved. So I believe in fairies, the myths, dragons. It all exists, even if it's in your mind. Who's to say that dreams and nightmares aren't as real as the here and now?
12423.name: John Lennon

12424.quote: Life is full of beauty. Notice it. Notice the bumble bee, the small child, and the smiling faces. Smell the rain, and feel the wind. Live your life to the fullest potential, and fight for your dreams.
12424.name: Ashley Smith

12425.quote: Follow your dreams, work hard, practice and persevere. Make sure you eat a variety of foods, get plenty of exercise and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
12425.name: Sasha Cohen

12426.quote: I like the dreams of the future better than the history of the past.
12426.name: Thomas Jefferson

12427.quote: Cherish your visions and your dreams as they are the children of your soul, the blueprints of your ultimate achievements.
12427.name: Napoleon Hill

12428.quote: Your vision will become clear only when you can look into your own heart. Who looks outside, dreams who looks inside, awakes.
12428.name: Carl Jung

12429.quote: Friends, they cherish one another's hopes. They are kind to one another's dreams.
12429.name: Henry David Thoreau

12430.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
12430.name: Robert Fulghum

12431.quote: I prefer to be a dreamer among the humblest, with visions to be realized, than lord among those without dreams and desires.
12431.name: Khalil Gibran

12432.quote: But I, being poor, have only my dreams I have spread my dreams under your feet Tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
12432.name: William Butler Yeats

12433.quote: The only thing that comes to a sleeping man is dreams.
12433.name: Tupac Shakur

12434.quote: I have learned, that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
12434.name: Henry David Thoreau

12435.quote: A man is a god in ruins. When men are innocent, life shall be longer, and shall pass into the immortal, as gently as we awake from dreams.
12435.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

12436.quote: Trust in dreams, for in them is hidden the gate to eternity.
12436.name: Khalil Gibran

12437.quote: Consult not your fears but your hopes and your dreams. Think not about your frustrations, but about your unfulfilled potential. Concern yourself not with what you tried and failed in, but with what it is still possible for you to do.
12437.name: Pope John XXIII

12438.quote: The only time you really live fully is from thirty to sixty. The young are slaves to dreams the old servants of regrets. Only the middle-aged have all their five senses in the keeping of their wits.
12438.name: Theodore Roosevelt

12439.quote: Our truest life is when we are in dreams awake.
12439.name: Henry David Thoreau

12440.quote: If there are dreams about a beautiful South Africa, there are also roads that lead to their goal. Two of these roads could be named Goodness and Forgiveness.
12440.name: Nelson Mandela

12441.quote: The ninety and nine are with dreams, content but the hope of the world made new, is the hundredth man who is grimly bent on making those dreams come true.
12441.name: Edgar Allan Poe

12442.quote: The biggest adventure you can take is to live the life of your dreams.
12442.name: Oprah Winfrey

12443.quote: If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
12443.name: Henry David Thoreau

12444.quote: I'll let you be in my dreams if I can be in yours.
12444.name: Bob Dylan

12445.quote: I am against nature. I don't dig nature at all. I think nature is very unnatural. I think the truly natural things are dreams, which nature can't touch with decay.
12445.name: Bob Dylan

12446.quote: It is better to risk starving to death then surrender. If you give up on your dreams, what's left?
12446.name: Jim Carrey

12447.quote: Dreams are often most profound when they seem the most crazy.
12447.name: Sigmund Freud

12448.quote: I really had a lot of dreams when I was a kid, and I think a great deal of that grew out of the fact that I had a chance to read a lot.
12448.name: Bill Gates

12449.quote: Keep true to the dreams of your youth.
12449.name: Friedrich Schiller

12450.quote: Hold fast to dreams, for if dreams die, life is a broken-winged bird that cannot fly.
12450.name: Langston Hughes

12451.quote: Sometimes dreams are wiser than waking.
12451.name: Black Elk

12452.quote: Why does the eye see a thing more clearly in dreams than the imagination when awake?
12452.name: Leonardo da Vinci

12453.quote: Believe in love. Believe in magic. Hell, believe in Santa Clause. Believe in others. Believe in yourself. Believe in your dreams. If you don't, who will?
12453.name: Jon Bon Jovi

12454.quote: Tread softly because you tread on my dreams.
12454.name: William Butler Yeats

12455.quote: We cast away priceless time in dreams, born of imagination, fed upon illusion, and put to death by reality.
12455.name: Judy Garland

12456.quote: Man, alone, has the power to transform his thoughts into physical reality man, alone, can dream and make his dreams come true.
12456.name: Napoleon Hill

12457.quote: Our life is composed greatly from dreams, from the unconscious, and they must be brought into connection with action. They must be woven together.
12457.name: Anais Nin

12458.quote: Dreams must be heeded and accepted. For a great many of them come true.
12458.name: Paracelsus

12459.quote: Business and growing jobs is about taking risk, sometimes failing, sometimes succeeding, but always striving. It is about dreams. Usually, it doesn't work out exactly as you might have imagined. Steve Jobs was fired at Apple. He came back and changed the world.
12459.name: Mitt Romney

12460.quote: Just what future the Designer of the universe has provided for the souls of men I do not know, I cannot prove. But I find that the whole order of Nature confirms my confidence that, if it is not like our noblest hopes and dreams, it will transcend them.
12460.name: Henry Norris Russell

12461.quote: I'd say it's been my biggest problem all my life, it's money. It takes a lot of money to make these dreams come true.
12461.name: Walt Disney

12462.quote: Keep your dreams alive. Understand to achieve anything requires faith and belief in yourself, vision, hard work, determination, and dedication. Remember all things are possible for those who believe.
12462.name: Gail Devers

12463.quote: Don't give up on your dreams, or your dreams will give up on you.
12463.name: John Wooden

12464.quote: If you dream the proper dreams, and share the myths with people, they will want to grow up to be like you.
12464.name: Ray Bradbury

12465.quote: Computers are magnificent tools for the realization of our dreams, but no machine can replace the human spark of spirit, compassion, love, and understanding.
12465.name: Louis Gerstner

12466.quote: Both dreams and myths are important communications from ourselves to ourselves. If we do not understand the language in which they are written, we miss a great deal of what we know and tell ourselves in those hours when we are not busy manipulating the outside world.
12466.name: Erich Fromm

12467.quote: Dreams do come true, if we only wish hard enough, You can have anything in life if you will sacrifice everything else for it.
12467.name: James M. Barrie

12468.quote: The greatest achievement was at first and for a time a dream. The oak sleeps in the acorn, the bird waits in the egg, and in the highest vision of the soul a waking angel stirs. Dreams are the seedlings of realities.
12468.name: James Allen

12469.quote: High achievers spot rich opportunities swiftly, make big decisions quickly and move into action immediately. Follow these principles and you can make your dreams come true.
12469.name: Robert H. Schuller

12470.quote: How blessed are some people, whose lives have no fears, no dreads to whom sleep is a blessing that comes nightly, and brings nothing but sweet dreams.
12470.name: Bram Stoker

12471.quote: Never underestimate the power of dreams and the influence of the human spirit. We are all the same in this notion: The potential for greatness lives within each of us.
12471.name: Wilma Rudolph

12472.quote: You know, my dad served in the President's Cabinet after his time as a governor. He told me he enjoyed being governor a lot more. Now, I understand why. If I do my job well, I can make a difference in people's lives and I can help our children realize their dreams.
12472.name: Mitt Romney

12473.quote: When all of your wishes are granted, many of your dreams will be destroyed.
12473.name: Marilyn Manson

12474.quote: Help others achieve their dreams and you will achieve yours.
12474.name: Les Brown

12475.quote: It is not true that people stop pursuing dreams because they grow old, they grow old because they stop pursuing dreams.
12475.name: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

12476.quote: In my dreams I hear again the crash of guns, the rattle of musketry, the strange, mournful mutter of the battlefield.
12476.name: Douglas MacArthur

12477.quote: Anyone who has lost track of time when using a computer knows the propensity to dream, the urge to make dreams come true and the tendency to miss lunch.
12477.name: Tim Berners-Lee

12478.quote: What is a television apparatus to man, who has only to shut his eyes to see the most inaccessible regions of the seen and the never seen, who has only to imagine in order to pierce through walls and cause all the planetary Baghdads of his dreams to rise from the dust.
12478.name: Salvador Dali

12479.quote: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
12479.name: Les Brown

12480.quote: Our life dreams the Utopia. Our death achieves the Ideal.
12480.name: Victor Hugo

12481.quote: I have dreamed in my life, dreams that have stayed with me ever after, and changed my ideas they have gone through and through me, like wine through water, and altered the color of my mind.
12481.name: Emily Bronte

12482.quote: Obviously one must hold oneself responsible for the evil impulses of one's dreams. In what other way can one deal with them? Unless the content of the dream rightly understood is inspired by alien spirits, it is part of my own being.
12482.name: Sigmund Freud

12483.quote: Old age realizes the dreams of youth: look at Dean Swift in his youth he built an asylum for the insane, in his old age he was himself an inmate.
12483.name: Soren Kierkegaard

12484.quote: No matter how carefully you plan your goals they will never be more than pipe dreams unless you pursue them with gusto.
12484.name: W. Clement Stone

12485.quote: I never ask a man what his business is, for it never interests me. What I ask him about are his thoughts and dreams.
12485.name: H. P. Lovecraft

12486.quote: Dream lofty dreams, and as you dream, so you shall become. Your vision is the promise of what you shall one day be your ideal is the prophecy of what you shall at last unveil.
12486.name: James Allen

12487.quote: If you can't read, it's going to be hard to realize dreams.
12487.name: Booker T. Washington

12488.quote: Follow your dreams, believe in yourself and don't give up.
12488.name: Rachel Corrie

12489.quote: Never let life impede on your ability to manifest your dreams. Dig deeper into your dreams and deeper into yourself and believe that anything is possible, and make it happen.
12489.name: Corin Nemec

12490.quote: I never paint dreams or nightmares. I paint my own reality.
12490.name: Frida Kahlo

12491.quote: The life of a man consists not in seeing visions and in dreaming dreams, but in active charity and in willing service.
12491.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

12492.quote: You know, the man of my dreams might walk round the corner tomorrow. I'm older and wiser and I think I'd make a great girlfriend. I live in the realm of romantic possibility.
12492.name: Stevie Nicks

12493.quote: I am a walking piece of art every day, with my dreams and my ambitions forward at all times in an effort to inspire my fans to lead their life in that way.
12493.name: Lady Gaga

12494.quote: A lot of people do not muster the courage to live their dreams because they are afraid to die.
12494.name: Les Brown

12495.quote: You have all the reason in the world to achieve your grandest dreams. Imagination plus innovation equals realization.
12495.name: Denis Waitley

12496.quote: We become not a melting pot but a beautiful mosaic. Different people, different beliefs, different yearnings, different hopes, different dreams.
12496.name: Jimmy Carter

12497.quote: What is life? A madness. What is life? An illusion, a shadow, a story. And the greatest good is little enough for all life is a dream, and dreams themselves are only dreams.
12497.name: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

12498.quote: You have many years ahead of you to create the dreams that we can't even imagine dreaming. You have done more for the collective unconscious of this planet than you will ever know.
12498.name: Steven Spielberg

12499.quote: The success I have achieved in bodybuilding, motion pictures, and business would not have been possible without the generosity of the American people and the freedom here to pursue your dreams.
12499.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

12500.quote: It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
12500.name: J. K. Rowling

12501.quote: Ocean is more ancient than the mountains, and freighted with the memories and the dreams of Time.
12501.name: H. P. Lovecraft

12502.quote: Dreams are illustrations, from the book your soul is writing about you.
12502.name: Marsha Norman

12503.quote: There's nothing as exciting as a comeback - seeing someone with dreams, watching them fail, and then getting a second chance.
12503.name: Rachel Griffiths

12504.quote: Lose your dreams and you might lose your mind.
12504.name: Mick Jagger

12505.quote: Take, if you must, this little bag of dreams, Unloose the cord, and they will wrap you round.
12505.name: William Butler Yeats

12506.quote: It's insecurity that is always chasing you and standing in the way of your dreams.
12506.name: Vin Diesel

12507.quote: A positive attitude can really make dreams come true - it did for me.
12507.name: David Bailey

12508.quote: Mr. Tennyson has said that more things are wrought by prayer than this world dreams of, but he wisely refrains from saying whether they are good or bad things.
12508.name: Samuel Butler

12509.quote: My own dreams fortunately came true in this great state. I became Mr. Universe I became a successful businessman. And even though some people say I still speak with a slight accent, I have reached the top of the acting profession.
12509.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

12510.quote: I'm not just a boy toy. I have feelings and dreams like anybody else.
12510.name: Jon Stewart

12511.quote: The world is seldom what it seems to man, who dimly sees, realities appear as dreams, and dreams realities.
12511.name: Samuel Johnson

12512.quote: Most new jobs won't come from our biggest employers. They will come from our smallest. We've got to do everything we can to make entrepreneurial dreams a reality.
12512.name: Ross Perot

12513.quote: When the legends die, the dreams end there is no more greatness.
12513.name: Tecumseh

12514.quote: I tell kids to pursue their basketball dreams, but I tell them to not let that be their only dream.
12514.name: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

12515.quote: Flying dreams mean that you're doing the right thing with your life.
12515.name: Doug Coupland

12516.quote: Common sense tells us that the things of the earth exist only a little, and that true reality is only in dreams.
12516.name: Charles Baudelaire

12517.quote: My parent's divorce and hard times at school, all those things combined to mold me, to make me grow up quicker. And it gave me the drive to pursue my dreams that I wouldn't necessarily have had otherwise.
12517.name: Christina Aguilera

12518.quote: It is in our idleness, in our dreams, that the submerged truth sometimes comes to the top.
12518.name: Virginia Woolf

12519.quote: The way to kill a man or a nation is to cut off his dreams, the way the whites are taking care of the Indians: killing their dreams, their magic, their familiar spirits.
12519.name: William S. Burroughs

12520.quote: But are not the dreams of poets and the tales of travellers notoriously false?
12520.name: H. P. Lovecraft

12521.quote: There are many talented people who haven't fulfilled their dreams because they over thought it, or they were too cautious, and were unwilling to make the leap of faith.
12521.name: James Cameron

12522.quote: An athlete cannot run with money in his pockets. He must run with hope in his heart and dreams in his head.
12522.name: Emil Zatopek

12523.quote: The work goes on, the cause endures, the hope still lives and the dreams shall never die.
12523.name: Edward Kennedy

12524.quote: I want my boys to have an understanding of people's emotions, their insecurities, people's distress, and their hopes and dreams.
12524.name: Princess Diana

12525.quote: There are a lot of things that are personally uncomfortable to show, especially me without makeup and completely bloated or crying. But I've realized that it's time for me to show my audience that you don't have to be perfect to achieve your dreams. Because nobody relates to being perfect.
12525.name: Katy Perry

12526.quote: For all life is a dream, and dreams themselves are only dreams.
12526.name: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

12527.quote: A horse is the projection of peoples' dreams about themselves - strong, powerful, beautiful - and it has the capability of giving us escape from our mundane existence.
12527.name: Pam Brown

12528.quote: Follow your dreams. Just make sure to have fun too.
12528.name: Chris Brown

12529.quote: We must look for ways to be an active force in our own lives. We must take charge of our own destinies, design a life of substance and truly begin to live our dreams.
12529.name: Les Brown

12530.quote: Lonesome. Lonesome. I know what it means. Here all by my lonesome, dreaming empty dreams. Weary. Weary at the close of day, wondering if tomorrow brings me joy or sorrow.
12530.name: Leon Redbone

12531.quote: To the degree we're not living our dreams, our comfort zone has more control of us than we have over ourselves.
12531.name: Peter McWilliams

12532.quote: Dream small dreams. If you make them too big, you get overwhelmed and you don't do anything. If you make small goals and accomplish them, it gives you the confidence to go on to higher goals.
12532.name: John H. Johnson

12533.quote: Yet it is in our idleness, in our dreams, that the submerged truth sometimes comes to the top.
12533.name: Virginia Woolf

12534.quote: It takes someone with a vision of the possibilities to attain new levels of experience. Someone with the courage to live his dreams.
12534.name: Les Brown

12535.quote: Our dreams must be stronger than our memories. We must be pulled by our dreams, rater than pushed by our memories.
12535.name: Jesse Jackson

12536.quote: The human heart has hidden treasures, In secret kept, in silence sealed The thoughts, the hopes, the dreams, the pleasures, Whose charms were broken if revealed.
12536.name: Charlotte Bronte

12537.quote: I can never decide whether my dreams are the result of my thoughts, or my thoughts the result of my dreams.
12537.name: David Herbert Lawrence

12538.quote: A test of what is real is that it is hard and rough. Joys are found in it, not pleasure. What is pleasant belongs to dreams.
12538.name: Simone Weil

12539.quote: Though we may have desires or bold goals, for whatever reason, most of us don't think we can achieve something beyond what we're qualified to achieve. Why, I ask, do we let reality interfere with our dreams?
12539.name: Simon Sinek

12540.quote: Dreams are not without meaning wherever thay may come from-from fantasy, from the elements, or from other inspiration.
12540.name: Paracelsus

12541.quote: I just write what I wanted to write. I write what amuses me. It's totally for myself. I never in my wildest dreams expected this popularity.
12541.name: J. K. Rowling

12542.quote: All of us gave it all we've got, overcame a whole lot just being on the show and learned a lot about ourselves. We're just normal people trying to do what we love and follow our dreams.
12542.name: Carrie Underwood

12543.quote: Freedom and democracy are dreams you never give up.
12543.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

12544.quote: My fear is that I go up to the girl of my dreams and say 'I'm sorry, but I've got to say hello to you,' and she slides the stool back and gets up and walks away, saying, 'Not for me, Bub. I don't want anything to do with you.'
12544.name: John Mayer

12545.quote: People are never more insecure than when they become obsessed with their fears at the expense of their dreams.
12545.name: Norman Cousins

12546.quote: Much can be inferred about a man from his mistress: in her one beholds his weaknesses and his dreams.
12546.name: Georg C. Lichtenberg

12547.quote: Dreams can become a reality when we possess a vision that is characterized by the willingness to work hard, a desire for excellence, and a belief in our right and our responsiblity to be equal members of society.
12547.name: Janet Jackson

12548.quote: I just kind of wake up with a new idea and new dreams every day, and I follow that dream, as they say.
12548.name: Dolly Parton

12549.quote: I did commit to myself that I would not jump back into being the workaholic that I can be before I gave myself an honest opportunity to create the marriage of my dreams and to create the beginning of the family of my dreams, and that took a hot second.
12549.name: Alanis Morissette

12550.quote: We do not really feel grateful toward those who make our dreams come true they ruin our dreams.
12550.name: Eric Hoffer

12551.quote: In dreams the truth is learned that all good works are done in the absence of a caress.
12551.name: Leonard Cohen

12552.quote: You must recognize, embrace, and be honest about what is real for you today and allow that understanding to inform the choices you make. Only then will you be able to build the future of your dreams.
12552.name: Suze Orman

12553.quote: I'm aware of the mystery around us, so I write about coincidences, premonitions, emotions, dreams, the power of nature, magic.
12553.name: Isabel Allende

12554.quote: Dreams are like paper, they tear so easily.
12554.name: Gilda Radner

12555.quote: When we see the face of a child, we think of the future. We think of their dreams about what they might become, and what they might accomplish.
12555.name: Desmond Tutu

12556.quote: I don't design clothes, I design dreams.
12556.name: Ralph Lauren

12557.quote: Everybody past a certain age, regardless of how they look on the outside, pretty much constantly dreams of being able to escape from their lives.
12557.name: Doug Coupland

12558.quote: It is one of the blessings of this world that few people see visions and dream dreams.
12558.name: Zora Neale Hurston

12559.quote: Rude contact with facts chased my visions and dreams quickly away, and in their stead I beheld the horrors, the corruption, the evils and hypocrisy of society, and as I stood among them, a young wife, a great wail of agony went out from my soul.
12559.name: Victoria Woodhull

12560.quote: Stay focused, go after your dreams and keep moving toward your goals.
12560.name: LL Cool J

12561.quote: To this day, some of my closest friends say, 'Gaga, you know, everything's great. You're a singer your dreams have come true.' But, still, when certain things are said to you over and over again as you're growing up, it stays with you and you wonder if they're true.
12561.name: Lady Gaga

12562.quote: Dreams don't have deadlines. I'm thinking of doing bigger and better things and having more fun with it.
12562.name: LL Cool J

12563.quote: To every people the land is given on condition. Perceived or not, there is a Covenant, beyond the constitution, beyond sovereign guarantee, beyond the nation's sweetest dreams of itself.
12563.name: Leonard Cohen

12564.quote: There's a joy and a pain about directing where the dreams you have are becoming concrete but the attention to detail, the need for time is such that it's overwhelming at times, and the stream of responsibility.
12564.name: William Shatner

12565.quote: Hope lies in dreams, in imagination, and in the courage of those who dare to make dreams into reality.
12565.name: Jonas Salk

12566.quote: Dreams are real as long as they last. Can we say more of life?
12566.name: Havelock Ellis

12567.quote: Take pleasure in your dreams relish your principles and drape your purest feelings on the heart of a precious lover.
12567.name: Giotto di Bondone

12568.quote: To be given the opportunity to help shape new artists' careers and mentor them to see their dreams come to fruition is a task I welcome with open arms.
12568.name: Christina Aguilera

12569.quote: I know how men in exile feed on dreams.
12569.name: Aeschylus

12570.quote: A friend told me that teenage girls are always looking for someone to pin their dreams on. That doesn't make it any less weird though.
12570.name: Orlando Bloom

12571.quote: To all, to each, a fair good-night, and pleasing dreams, and slumbers light.
12571.name: Walter Scott

12572.quote: A runner must run with dreams in his heart, not money in his pocket.
12572.name: Emil Zatopek

12573.quote: I have had dreams and I have had nightmares, but I have conquered my nightmares because of my dreams.
12573.name: Jonas Salk

12574.quote: We should be dreaming. We grew up as kids having dreams, but now we're too sophisticated as adults, as a nation. We stopped dreaming. We should always have dreams.
12574.name: Herb Brooks

12575.quote: But what I was going to say was, I just figured I'm going to go boldly in the direction of my dreams, say it as Thoreau would say, and just see where it takes me.
12575.name: Demetri Martin

12576.quote: At first, dreams seem impossible, then improbable, and eventually inevitable.
12576.name: Christopher Reeve

12577.quote: What is the conservative movement? It's pretty straightforward. We believe that the way prosperity is created is when people have the freedom and the opportunity to pursue their dreams.
12577.name: Marco Rubio

12578.quote: The follow your dreams thing is really important because so many people are railroaded into taking other paths by their family, their friends, people who should be supportive going, 'What are you talking about?' Even just seemingly regular career paths, but if it's not what people expect for you they kind of react funny.
12578.name: Joan Jett

12579.quote: I think when you're in a relationship where you really care for the other person, when they achieve their dreams it's better than when you do yourself.
12579.name: Nicole Kidman

12580.quote: For even in dreams a good deed is not lost.
12580.name: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

12581.quote: Whatever dreams I have wished have come true.
12581.name: Annette Funicello

12582.quote: No one may speak for the dead, no one may interpret their mutilated dreams and visions.
12582.name: Elie Wiesel

12583.quote: I'd definitely be the kind of parent who enabled my child's dreams. I'd just watch and nurture and guide them. I have the blueprints of what not to do, I think I'd be a good parent, actually.
12583.name: Drew Barrymore

12584.quote: Winners, I am convinced, imagine their dreams first. They want it with all their heart and expect it to come true. There is, I believe, no other way to live.
12584.name: Joe Montana

12585.quote: The real hero is always a hero by mistake he dreams of being an honest coward like everybody else.
12585.name: Umberto Eco

12586.quote: I am so excited to let fans in on how important my relationship with my family is to me. I hope to motivate mothers and daughters to build lifetimes of memories together and inspire kids around the world to live their dreams.
12586.name: Miley Cyrus

12587.quote: Instead of plotting the demise of the traditional family, as some politicians and religious leaders would have you believe, gay people mow their lawns and watch 'American Idol' and video their children's concerts and have the same hopes and dreams that their straight counterparts do.
12587.name: Jodi Picoult

12588.quote: Seems like God don't see fit to give the black man nothing but dreams - but He did give us children to make them dreams seem worthwhile.
12588.name: Lorraine Hansberry

12589.quote: Like all young reporters - brilliant or hopelessly incompetent - I dreamed of the glamorous life of the foreign correspondent: prowling Vienna in a Burberry trench coat, speaking a dozen languages to dangerous women, narrowly escaping Sardinian bandits - the usual stuff that newspaper dreams are made of.
12589.name: Russell Baker

12590.quote: People's dreams are made out of what they do all day. The same way a dog that runs after rabbits will dream of rabbits. It's what you do that makes your soul, not the other way around.
12590.name: Barbara Kingsolver

12591.quote: As a young man you don't notice at all that you were, after all, badly affected. For years afterwards, at least ten years, I kept getting these dreams, in which I had to crawl through ruined houses, along passages I could hardly get through.
12591.name: Otto Dix

12592.quote: Love is the most terrible, and also the most generous of the passions it is the only one which includes in its dreams the happiness of someone else.
12592.name: Alphonse Karr

12593.quote: I'm living out my dreams and I love what I do.
12593.name: Ashley Tisdale

12594.quote: I paint what cannot be photographed, that which comes from the imagination or from dreams, or from an unconscious drive.
12594.name: Man Ray

12595.quote: Today, I'm very happy about myself, because I realized my dreams. I learned how to understand what people want.
12595.name: Roberto Cavalli

12596.quote: Within our dreams and aspirations we find our opportunities.
12596.name: Sugar Ray Leonard

12597.quote: Dream the impossible because dreams do come true.
12597.name: Elijah Wood

12598.quote: The American Dream has run out of gas. The car has stopped. It no longer supplies the world with its images, its dreams, its fantasies. No more. It's over. It supplies the world with its nightmares now: the Kennedy assassination, Watergate, Vietnam.
12598.name: J. G. Ballard

12599.quote: We've removed the ceiling above our dreams. There are no more impossible dreams.
12599.name: Jesse Jackson

12600.quote: Women are not in love with me but with the picture of me on the screen. I am merely the canvas on which women paint their dreams.
12600.name: Rudolph Valentino

12601.quote: Dreams become reality when we put our minds to it.
12601.name: Queen Latifah

12602.quote: The readers are the ones who let us live our dreams. I try to write books which are really compelling - that you'd take on vacation and rather than going out, you'd read in your hotel room because you had to find out what happened. Hopefully that's what readers are responding to.
12602.name: Harlan Coben

12603.quote: Men don't come up to you to just talk. We come up to you with a plan. We're looking across the room at you, and we don't care about your hopes and dreams. We don't care about what your future holds. We saw something we wanted.
12603.name: Steve Harvey

12604.quote: It's not like I don't have my own wants and dreams anymore - it's just that the kids come first. It's primal.
12604.name: Angie Harmon

12605.quote: One day it just hit me. This is it. You are not in love. So either stay in it because you have a child or be brave and find the man of your dreams and marry him for real.
12605.name: Brandy Norwood

12606.quote: Dreams are where we visit the many lands and landscapes of human possibility and discover the one where we feel at home. The great religious leaders were all dreamers.
12606.name: Jonathan Sacks

12607.quote: Dreaming in public is an important part of our job description, as science writers, but there are bad dreams as well as good dreams. We're dreamers, you see, but we're also realists, of a sort.
12607.name: William Gibson

12608.quote: As you look back at your life, there are just a million different things that have happened, just in the right way, to allow you to make your dreams come true. And you know, someone has all that under control.
12608.name: Michael P. Anderson

12609.quote: In a couple, sometimes, one or both people have to give up their personal life, dreams and ambitions for the good of the family.
12609.name: Monica Bellucci

12610.quote: Men never cling to their dreams with such tenacity as at the moment when they are losing faith in them, and know it, but do not dare yet to confess it to themselves.
12610.name: William Graham Sumner

12611.quote: Take what you can from your dreams, make them as real as anything.
12611.name: Dave Matthews

12612.quote: God, that dumping ground of our dreams.
12612.name: Jean Rostand

12613.quote: I am consumed with the fear of failing. Reaching deep down and finding confidence has made all my dreams come true.
12613.name: Arsenio Hall

12614.quote: What better model of a synthesis than a nocturnal dream? Dreams simplify, don't they?
12614.name: Manuel Puig

12615.quote: After having done this whole slew of press for 'Big Love,' now I'll have anxiety dreams for like a week and a half about all the stupid things I said. I can't even imagine being in front of the cameras all the time. I had a weird dream the other night that I was on 'Jersey Shore.'
12615.name: Chloe Sevigny

12616.quote: Even having to do the amount of press that I have to do is dreadful and gives me so much anxiety. After having done this whole slew of press for 'Big Love,' now I'll have anxiety dreams for like a week and a half about all the stupid things I said.
12616.name: Chloe Sevigny

12617.quote: Barack Obama knows that to create an economy built to last, we need to focus on middle-class families. Families who stay up on Sunday nights pacing the floor, like my dad did, while their children, tucked in bed, dream big dreams. Families who aren't sure what Monday morning will bring, but who believe our nation's best days are still ahead.
12617.name: Charles Schumer

12618.quote: When we are motivated by goals that have deep meaning, by dreams that need completion, by pure love that needs expressing, then we truly live.
12618.name: Greg Anderson

12619.quote: The permanent temptation of life is to confuse dreams with reality. The permanent defeat of life comes when dreams are surrendered to reality.
12619.name: James A. Michener

12620.quote: Everyone wants to look their best, everyone has dreams of wanting to look like something else. But we are who we are.
12620.name: Samantha Morton

12621.quote: I say to my colleagues never confine your best work, your hopes, your dreams, the aspiration of the American people to what will be signed by George W. Bush because that is too limiting a factor.
12621.name: Nancy Pelosi

12622.quote: Prime Minister Sharon, Prime Minister Abbas, I urge you today to end the designs of those who seek destruction, annihilation and occupation, and I urge you to have the will and the courage to begin to realize our dreams of peace, prosperity and coexistence.
12622.name: King Abdullah II

12623.quote: I'm not certain, but I have a little gypsy blood in me. And my mother always told me that her grandma could give someone the evil eye, and I'd better not cross her because she had some of that blood in her. Mother always believed that she could predict the future, and she had dreams that came true.
12623.name: Sam Raimi

12624.quote: The atmosphere is much too near for dreams. It forces us to action. It is close to us. We are in it and of it. It rouses us both to study and to do. We must know its moods and also its motive forces.
12624.name: Cleveland Abbe

12625.quote: You know, one of my biggest dreams in life is to play a Disney princess.
12625.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

12626.quote: When I look back over my life it's almost as if there was a plan laid out for me - from the little girl who was so passionate about animals who longed to go to Africa and whose family couldn't afford to put her through college. Everyone laughed at my dreams. I was supposed to be a secretary in Bournemouth.
12626.name: Jane Goodall

12627.quote: Always wear cute pyjamas to bed, you'll never know who u will meet in your dreams.
12627.name: Joel Madden

12628.quote: A player dreams of being a superstar, but he doesn't want people flocking all over him asking for an autograph.
12628.name: Dennis Rodman

12629.quote: They should invent some way to tape-record your dreams. I've written songs in my dreams that were Beatles songs. Then I'd wake up and they'd be gone.
12629.name: Alice Cooper

12630.quote: The Columbia is lost, but the dreams that inspired its crew remain with us.
12630.name: Dick Cheney

12631.quote: Cherish your visions and your dreams, as they are the children of your soul the blueprints of your ultimate achievements.
12631.name: Napolean Hill

12632.quote: Never set limits, go after your dreams, don't be afraid to push the boundaries. And laugh a lot - it's good for you!
12632.name: Paula Radcliffe

12633.quote: I want to help children in Serbia and around the world so they can realize their dreams.
12633.name: Novak Djokovic

12634.quote: Those born into poverty or on the margins of society require our extra support to realize their dreams.
12634.name: Novak Djokovic

12635.quote: I know it sounds corny, but when you follow your dreams, it happens. And if it's music, take it seriously.
12635.name: Enrique Iglesias

12636.quote: There's a lot of blood, sweat, and guts between dreams and success.
12636.name: Paul Bryant

12637.quote: You have the dreams that you want, and then you have to do other jobs until you can get to that dream.
12637.name: Channing Tatum

12638.quote: I save my dreams and hopes for my kids. When I'm making a wish under a bridge or tunnel, it's always for them.
12638.name: Alison Sweeney

12639.quote: If I thought that any of this was pre ordained, then it takes away any kind of incentive to struggle, or to put up with things, to reach for those impossible dreams, all those dramatic things.
12639.name: Gary Numan

12640.quote: I think basically becoming famous has taken the place of going to Heaven in modern society, hasn't it? That's the place where your dreams will come true. It's an act of faith now they think that's going to sort things out.
12640.name: Jarvis Cocker

12641.quote: When violence becomes imbedded in a region, then this affects everything. It affects your dreams, your fantasies and relationships, and your religion becomes violent, too.
12641.name: Karen Armstrong

12642.quote: There's a line I have that our family was designed more for public than for private. But there are definitely some things that are only mine. I am someone who dreams at night, and you don't know what I'm dreaming.
12642.name: Carrie Fisher

12643.quote: My father, his spirit is with me constantly, and I'm a believer in that world and the world of dreams and that stuff.
12643.name: Ziggy Marley

12644.quote: I've never been bashful to say that I'm not really interested in Formula One. When I lived in England, it's all I wanted to do and I thought that anything else would somehow be a compromise to my dreams. But then when I came back to the States, I realised how much I loved being back in the States.
12644.name: Danica Patrick

12645.quote: I've been interested in dreams since I as a kid and I've wanted to do a film about them for a long time.
12645.name: Christopher Nolan

12646.quote: But I have been interested in dreams, really since I was a kid. I have always been fascinated by the idea that your mind, when you are asleep, can create a world in a dream and you are perceiving it as though it really existed.
12646.name: Christopher Nolan

12647.quote: The buildings that I build very often have a dreamlike reality. I don't mean by that they have a fantasy quality at all, in fact quite the reverse. They contain in some degree the ingredients that give dreams their power, stuff that's very close to us.
12647.name: Christopher Alexander

12648.quote: Freedom is not an ideal, it is not even a protection, if it means nothing more than freedom to stagnate, to live without dreams, to have no greater aim than a second car and another television set.
12648.name: Adlai Stevenson

12649.quote: I think cinema is closer to allegories than to reality. It's closer to our dreams.
12649.name: Manuel Puig

12650.quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
12650.name: Jonas Salk

12651.quote: In my wildest dreams, I could not have imagined a sweeter life.
12651.name: Hugh Hefner

12652.quote: Vain hopes are like certain dreams of those who wake.
12652.name: Quintilian

12653.quote: My professional dreams were coming true while I was living a personal nightmare.
12653.name: Dane Cook

12655.quote: Dreams have always expanded our understanding of reality by challenging our boundaries of the real, of the possible.
12655.name: Henry Reed

12656.quote: It has never been my object to record my dreams, just the determination to realize them.
12656.name: Man Ray

12657.quote: We used to talk about wanting to get some money, but that's when hip-hop was based on your dreams and your fantasy. The whole thing now is the dreams and fantasies were achieved, and you don't want to make it the focal point. You can't keep beating that dead horse.
12657.name: Puff Daddy

12658.quote: My mother was always working for a job, so I guess I was always trained that I should have multiple jobs, multiple aspirations. And I remember she had multiple aspirations, always hearing about her dreams and things she did in the past and things she wanted to do.
12658.name: Puff Daddy

12659.quote: Good dreams don't come cheap, you've got to pay for them and If you just dream when you're asleep this is no way for them to come alive, to survive.
12659.name: Harry Chapin

12660.quote: I was always someone who lived in the future all the time, it was always the next thing - dreams of escape.
12660.name: Julie Walters

12661.quote: There's a good deal in common between the mind's eye and the TV screen, and though the TV set has all too often been the boobtube, it could be, it can be, the box of dreams.
12661.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

12662.quote: You'll be much more successful if you follow your dreams and follow your passions.

12825.name: Kyle Shewfelt

12826.quote: Dreams can be like charades in which we act out words rather than see or speak them.
12826.name: Jane Roberts

12827.quote: I think there must be a place inside of us where dreams go and wait their turn.
12827.name: Sue Monk Kidd

12828.quote: Gradually it occurred to me that we spend a great deal of life asleep and that dreams are little narratives, little stories. I thought, 'Who's choreographing this stuff?'
12828.name: Sue Monk Kidd

12829.quote: I think I usually have quite ordinary dreams. Sometimes my dreams take me to other dimensions. I can travel in my mind especially when I'm dreaming I focus my mind on what I want to dream. If I want to fly, I focus on flying.
12829.name: Uri Geller

12830.quote: Our dreams are a second life. I have never been able to penetrate without a shudder those ivory or horned gates which separate us from the invisible world.
12830.name: Gerard De Nerval

12831.quote: Hopefully kids will look at me and see that your dreams can come true.
12831.name: Roy Keane

12832.quote: Hopes are but the dreams of those that wake.
12832.name: Matthew Prior

12833.quote: Jazz to me is a living music. It's a music that since its beginning has expressed the feelings, the dreams, hopes, of the people.
12833.name: Dexter Gordon

12834.quote: The idea of being able to serve as an example, based upon how to process, how to think, how to realize our own dreams, we can pass that down to our children.
12834.name: Stedman Graham

12835.quote: Horror, for me, has to involve some sort of fantasy. Horror is something that is in your dreams or your nightmares.
12835.name: Cassandra Peterson

12836.quote: It's surreal to know my dreams are coming true.
12836.name: Mario Vazquez

12837.quote: I want to find someone who's really into something like I'm really into something, so that I can support them and we can both cheer each other on. I've got a lot of dreams I want to achieve, and I hope someone can cheer me on as I'll cheer them on in their dreams.
12837.name: Hunter Hayes

12838.quote: I put a lot of faith in dreams. I know that big movie roles and opportunities are going to happen.
12838.name: Krista Allen

12839.quote: Hollywood is the dream factory, and no one dreams about older women.
12839.name: Amy Heckerling

12840.quote: If there is one place on the face of earth where all the dreams of living men have found a home from the very earliest days when man began the dream of existence, it is India.
12840.name: Romain Rolland

12841.quote: I just want to be myself and go for my own dreams and goals.
12841.name: Natalie du Toit

12843.quote: O reason, reason, abstract phantom of the waking state, I had already expelled you from my dreams, now I have reached a point where those dreams are about to become fused with apparent realities: now there is only room here for myself.
12843.name: Louis Aragon

12844.quote: I don't remember my dreams. I'm one of those weird people. I know there are tricks and things you can do, but I never remember my dreams.
12844.name: Jayma Mays

12845.quote: One of the dreams of Zionism was to be a bridge. Instead, we are creating exclusion between the East and the West instead of creating bridges we are contributing to the conflict between East and West by our stupid desire to have more.
12845.name: A. B. Yehoshua

12846.quote: As far as my dreams go, all I want to do is be a working actor, and I happily achieved that.
12846.name: Lucas Grabeel

12847.quote: IN April 1882 my father died and I was at once whirled out of my land of dreams into a very different sphere.
12847.name: Edward Carpenter

12848.quote: But what I'd really like to tell you is I never dreamed of being in the Hall of Fame. Standing here with all these great players was beyond any of my dreams.
12848.name: Robin Yount

12849.quote: I had dreams of catching the ball for the final out in the World Series and being mobbed by my teammates. Well, I guess all my dreams didn't come true.
12849.name: Robin Yount

12850.quote: Right now, I have some big dreams. But at the same time, if I get annoyed and harassed by the media, I'll just quit. I don't care. We're set for life. I have quite a temper.
12850.name: Anna Benson

12851.quote: If you have a dream, just lie about it. Lie your way unto your dreams.
12851.name: Joel McHale

12852.quote: I'm following my dreams and doing what I love as a designer. I did not want to be one of those kids with a famous last name that doesn't do anything. That is very unfulfilling to me and I'm very happy.
12852.name: Nicky Hilton

12853.quote: Las Vegas is a very strange place. It's a place of broken dreams.
12853.name: Concha Buika

12854.quote: I had dreams, but I didn't have the sense that they would necessarily work out. They seemed very far-fetched.
12854.name: Greta Gerwig

12855.quote: The Oval Office symbolizes, the Constitution, the hopes and dreams, and I'm going to say democracy. And when you have a dress code in the Supreme Court and a dress code on the floor of the Senate, floor of the House, I think it's appropriate to have an expectation that there will be a dress code that respects the office of the President.
12855.name: Andrew Card

12856.quote: I worry whether it's not really the best way to live one's life - trying to fulfill the dreams you had as a child. Maybe it's quite a backwards approach.
12856.name: Joe Cornish

12857.quote: The name Air Supply sort of came from nowhere. I get a lot of my things in dreams and I just had a dream about it one night, and I woke up and said that's just got to be the name. That was in 1975.
12857.name: Graham Russell

12858.quote: Art is for entertainment purposes, but it's also to reflect our dreams, our hopes, the present, the future the past - whether it's good or bad.
12858.name: Amber Valletta

12859.quote: I can think of some things that would be fun, but I'm living my dreams.
12859.name: Mike Farrell

12860.quote: My dreams for the future are simple: work, a happy, healthy family, a lovely long motorcycle ride, and continuing the struggle to awaken people to the need for serious human rights reform.
12860.name: Mike Farrell

12862.quote: Our fathers had their dreams we have ours the generation that follows will have its own. Without dreams and phantoms man cannot exist.
12862.name: Olive Schreiner

12863.quote: As I've grown - dare I say it - older, I had hopes of indulging my dreams of being a sailor.
12863.name: Jimmy Webb

12864.quote: I think L.A.'s terrific. You fly an hour and a half and you're in the mountains in three feet of powder. I also think it's a much better city if you're working as an actor. If you're not working and you don't see your dreams coming true, there can be a lot of heartache.
12864.name: Scott Patterson

12865.quote: Now, everybody, I suppose, is aware that in recent years the silly business of divination by dreams has ceased to be a joke and has become a very serious science.
12865.name: Arthur Machen

12866.quote: It is all nonsense, to be sure and so much the greater nonsense inasmuch as the true interpretation of many dreams - not by any means of all dreams - moves, it may be said, in the opposite direction to the method of psycho-analysis.
12866.name: Arthur Machen

12867.quote: If a man dreams that he has committed a sin before which the sun hid his face, it is often safe to conjecture that, in sheer forgetfulness, he wore a red tie, or brown boots with evening dress.
12867.name: Arthur Machen

12868.quote: In the fifties I had dreams about touching a naked woman and she would turn to bronze or the dream about hot dogs chasing donuts through the Lincoln Tunnel.
12868.name: Robert Klein

12869.quote: I have lived with my husband more than I have with my parents, I live beside him, and know his worries, his hopes, and his dreams for his nation. We believe that things happen by design, not in an arbitrary way. And we believe it is our duty to make things happen.
12869.name: Mozah bint Nasser Al Missned

12870.quote: We don't have an eternity to realize our dreams, only the time we are here.
12870.name: Susan Taylor

12871.quote: In my dreams I am not crippled. In my dreams, I dance.
12871.name: Louise Brooks

12872.quote: When you're a kid, you have these big ideas and these big dreams to make a change, or maybe you feel like you can't make a difference.
12872.name: AnnaSophia Robb

12873.quote: We didn't know how to run a business, but we had dreams and talent.
12873.name: Ruth Handler

12874.quote: They were using the dolls to project their dreams of their own futures as adult women.
12874.name: Ruth Handler

12875.quote: The London Games will be designed for the athletes and we will provide them with the very best venues and the very best conditions to pursue their sporting dreams in London.
12875.name: Sebastian Coe

12876.quote: American dreams are strongest in the hearts of those who have seen America only in their dreams.
12876.name: Pico Iyer

12877.quote: In my childhood, America was like a religion. Then, real-life Americans abruptly entered my life - in jeeps - and upset all my dreams.
12877.name: Sergio Leone

12878.quote: Hollywood has always been a cage, a cage to catch our dreams.
12878.name: John Huston

12879.quote: I've succeeded beyond my wildest dreams - financially and the amount of fun I have in my life.
12879.name: Phil Hartman

12880.quote: Deep down, I'm a Texas girl looking for that big romance every girl dreams about. Biologically, I look forward to being a cornerstone of a family. I'll be in my glory when I have a child on my knee.
12880.name: Renee Zellweger

12881.quote: I'm a journeyman actor, and I don't ever want to forget that. With romantic-lead dreams.
12881.name: William Sanderson

12882.quote: I look up to people who succeed in accomplishing their dreams.
12882.name: Joanna Noelle Levesque

12883.quote: Dreams have as much influence as actions.
12883.name: Stephane Mallarme

12884.quote: There's a logic to dreams that doesn't necessarily follow linear narrative. You don't know why things happen, it's your subconscious pushing you, to give you information.
12884.name: Justin Theroux

12885.quote: I've been blessed by doing classic plays on Broadway, which was one of my great dreams forever.
12885.name: Michael Emerson

12886.quote: It is possible for a kid from east Texas, raised in south central LA and Carson, who believes in his dreams, commits himself to them with his heart, to touch them and to have them happen.
12886.name: Forest Whitaker

12887.quote: People have to remain positive and believe in those dreams. It's really important.
12887.name: Kirsty Coventry

12888.quote: Our citizens and those who have gone before us charted the broad outlines of where we need to go, and they would envy our opportunity to translate those dreams into action. And I believe they will judge us very harshly should we fail to act.
12888.name: Dave Freudenthal

12889.quote: In my wildest dreams I never thought - well, I never thought I'd work.
12889.name: Steve Carell

12890.quote: Dreams grow holy put in action.
12890.name: Adelaide Anne Procter

12891.quote: Dreams take you beyond what you think you can do in life.
12891.name: Vikram Chatwal

12892.quote: We can bring to characters dark and bright sides that nobody even dreams about.
12892.name: Sonia Braga

12893.quote: When I walk up on that shore in Florida, I want millions of those AARP sisters and brothers to look at me and say, 'I'm going to go write that novel I thought it was too late to do. I'm going to go work in Africa on that farm that those people need help at. I'm going to adopt a child. It's not too late, I can still live my dreams.'
12893.name: Diana Nyad

12894.quote: It's not too late, I can still live my dreams.
12894.name: Diana Nyad

12895.quote: If you choose not to pursue your dreams, you'll still be a part of a dream - only it will be someone else's.
12895.name: Mike Hawkins

12896.quote: Dreams from 1991 are becoming reality. We will build good relations between nations and people. We will strive towards mutual respect and equality of every individual, sex, race and national or any other minority.
12896.name: Janez Drnovsek

12897.quote: I love my early movies, but naturalism is an artist's early style. Now I want to deal with feelings, dreams, an acceptance of irrationality.
12897.name: Irvin Kershner

12898.quote: We are selling dreams. We are merchants of happiness.
12898.name: Bernard Loiseau

12899.quote: Every actor dreams of getting a big break, a big opportunity.
12899.name: Liam McIntyre

12900.quote: The armored cars of dreams, contrived to let us do so many a dangerous thing.
12900.name: Elizabeth Bishop

12901.quote: To become truly immortal, a work of art must escape all human limits: logic and common sense will only interfere. But once these barriers are broken, it will enter the realms of childhood visions and dreams.
12901.name: Giorgio de Chirico

12902.quote: Ground not upon dreams you know they are ever contrary.
12902.name: Thomas Middleton

12903.quote: They should hold themselves absolutely upon the immovable foundation of truth and nature, whereby alone they can save themselves from misapprehensions and from the danger of being entirely carried away from reality into mere dreams and fictions.
12903.name: Ethan A. Hitchcock
