12904.name: Atifete Jahjaga

12905.quote: We need affordable space travel to inspire our youth, to let them know that they can experience their dreams, can set significant goals and be in a position to lead all of us to future progress in exploration, discovery and fun. Thanks to the X Prize for the inspiration.
12905.name: Burt Rutan

12906.quote: Books that distribute things, with as daring a freedom as we use in dreams, put us on our feet again.
12906.name: Marsilio Ficino

12907.quote: When a child, my dreams rode on your wishes, I was your son, high on your horse, My mind a top whipped by the lashes Of your rhetoric, windy of course.
12907.name: Stephen Spender

12908.quote: I adore this adventure, I adore working with youth. For me it's a daily challenge, working to help these youths realize their dreams.
12908.name: Patrick Roy

12909.quote: All my dreams are coming true all across the board for some reason.
12909.name: Jay Electronica

12910.quote: America allows us to be able to dream, then gives us the ability to achieve those dreams.
12910.name: Rick Mears

12911.quote: Wide awake I can make my most fantastic dreams come true.
12911.name: Lorenz Hart

12912.quote: I appreciate everything that has been done for me. After a difficult start, I've just followed my dreams.
12912.name: Victor Ortiz

12913.quote: My mom taught me to go after my dreams. I have this faith in myself that I must have gotten from her.
12913.name: Amy Jo Johnson

12914.quote: After all those days in the cotton fields, the dreams came true on a gold record on a piece of wood. It's in my den where I can look at it every day. I wear it out lookin' at it.
12914.name: Carl Perkins

12915.quote: Let us keep the dance of rain our fathers kept and tread our dreams beneath the jungle sky.
12915.name: Arna Bontemps

12916.quote: We are people with all the hopes, dreams, passions, and faults of everyone else. Eighty percent of us are born into families with no history of dwarfism.
12916.name: Billy Barty

12917.quote: You don't get old until you replace dreams with regrets.
12917.name: Troy Dumais

12918.quote: My new life goes beyond my dreams because my dream was Formula One and I achieved it. I'm a driver, I feel like a driver. I have won this race because I am alive.
12918.name: Maria de Villota

12919.quote: War is eternity jammed into frantic minutes that will fill a lifetime with dreams and nightmares.
12919.name: John Cory

12920.quote: In our dreams we are always young.
12920.name: Sarah Louise Delany

12921.quote: But I am delighted to be a Dodger, I grew up a Dodger fan and now my dreams have really come true.
12921.name: Milton Bradley

12922.quote: Don't be afraid of your dreams.
12922.name: Jacques Parizeau

12923.quote: Tell me about yourself - your struggles, your dreams, your telephone number.
12923.name: Peter Arno

12924.quote: When your dreams tire, they go underground and out of kindness that's where they stay.
12924.name: Libby Houston

12925.quote: I'll see you in my dreams.
12925.name: Gus Kahn

12926.quote: There are no dreams too large, no innovation unimaginable and no frontiers beyond our reach.
12926.name: John S. Herrington

12927.quote: I would go to bed every night and have dreams about having a time machine and somehow I'd have the ability to move through time and space freely, and save Anne Frank.
12927.name: Jeff Mangum

12928.quote: Education is the most powerful weapon which you can use to change the world.
12928.name: Nelson Mandela

12929.quote: The only thing that interferes with my learning is my education.
12929.name: Albert Einstein

12930.quote: It is the mark of an educated mind to be able to entertain a thought without accepting it.
12930.name: Aristotle

12931.quote: My mother said I must always be intolerant of ignorance but understanding of illiteracy. That some people, unable to go to school, were more educated and more intelligent than college professors.
12931.name: Maya Angelou

12932.quote: Education is an admirable thing, but it is well to remember from time to time that nothing that is worth knowing can be taught.
12932.name: Oscar Wilde

12933.quote: In the first place, God made idiots. That was for practice. Then he made school boards.
12933.name: Mark Twain

12934.quote: Education is the ability to listen to almost anything without losing your temper or your self-confidence.
12934.name: Robert Frost

12935.quote: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
12935.name: Benjamin Franklin

12936.quote: An education isn't how much you have committed to memory, or even how much you know. It's being able to differentiate between what you know and what you don't.
12936.name: Anatole France

12937.quote: The roots of education are bitter, but the fruit is sweet.
12937.name: Aristotle

12938.quote: Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire.
12938.name: William Butler Yeats

12939.quote: Develop a passion for learning. If you do, you will never cease to grow.
12939.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

12940.quote: Education is the key to unlock the golden door of freedom.
12940.name: George Washington Carver

12941.quote: Education is the best friend. An educated person is respected everywhere. Education beats the beauty and the youth.
12941.name: Chanakya

12942.quote: A liberal education is at the heart of a civil society, and at the heart of a liberal education is the act of teaching.
12942.name: A. Bartlett Giamatti

12943.quote: It is a thousand times better to have common sense without education than to have education without common sense.
12943.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

12944.quote: I spent three days a week for 10 years educating myself in the public library, and it's better than college. People should educate themselves - you can get a complete education for no money. At the end of 10 years, I had read every book in the library and I'd written a thousand stories.
12944.name: Ray Bradbury

12945.quote: He who opens a school door, closes a prison.
12945.name: Victor Hugo

12946.quote: The only person who is educated is the one who has learned how to learn and change.
12946.name: Carl Rogers

12947.quote: Education is not preparation for life education is life itself.
12947.name: John Dewey

12948.quote: The goal of education is the advancement of knowledge and the dissemination of truth.
12948.name: John F. Kennedy

12949.quote: Education is a progressive discovery of our own ignorance.
12949.name: Will Durant

12951.quote: A human being is not attaining his full heights until he is educated.
12951.name: Horace Mann

12952.quote: Education doesn't change life much. It just lifts trouble to a higher plane of regard.
12952.name: Robert Frost

12953.quote: Don't limit a child to your own learning, for he was born in another time.
12953.name: Rabindranath Tagore

12954.quote: I would rather entertain and hope that people learned something than educate people and hope they were entertained.
12954.name: Walt Disney

12955.quote: No one has yet realized the wealth of sympathy, the kindness and generosity hidden in the soul of a child. The effort of every true education should be to unlock that treasure.
12955.name: Emma Goldman

12956.quote: Change is the end result of all true learning.
12956.name: Leo Buscaglia

12957.quote: America is becoming so educated that ignorance will be a novelty. I will belong to the select few.
12957.name: Will Rogers

12958.quote: Why should society feel responsible only for the education of children, and not for the education of all adults of every age?
12958.name: Erich Fromm

12959.quote: The direction in which education starts a man will determine his future in life.
12959.name: Plato

12960.quote: Education is a better safeguard of liberty than a standing army.
12960.name: Edward Everett

12961.quote: The more that learn to read the less learn how to make a living. That's one thing about a little education. It spoils you for actual work. The more you know the more you think somebody owes you a living.
12961.name: Will Rogers

12962.quote: Education's purpose is to replace an empty mind with an open one.
12962.name: Malcolm Forbes

12963.quote: Data is not information, information is not knowledge, knowledge is not understanding, understanding is not wisdom.
12963.name: Clifford Stoll

12964.quote: An educated person is one who has learned that information almost always turns out to be at best incomplete and very often false, misleading, fictitious, mendacious - just dead wrong.
12964.name: Russell Baker

12965.quote: The illiterate of the future will not be the person who cannot read. It will be the person who does not know how to learn.
12965.name: Alvin Toffler

12966.quote: Much education today is monumentally ineffective. All too often we are giving young people cut flowers when we should be teaching them to grow their own plants.
12966.name: John W. Gardner

12967.quote: Education is simply the soul of a society as it passes from one generation to another.
12967.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

12968.quote: Children have to be educated, but they have also to be left to educate themselves.
12968.name: Ernest Dimnet

12969.quote: I am often amazed at how much more capability and enthusiasm for science there is among elementary school youngsters than among college students.
12969.name: Carl Sagan

12970.quote: I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning to sail my ship.
12970.name: Aeschylus

12971.quote: The love of learning, the sequestered nooks, And all the sweet serenity of books.
12971.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

12972.quote: Some people will never learn anything, for this reason, because they understand everything too soon.
12972.name: Alexander Pope

12973.quote: Education, n.: That which discloses to the wise and disguises from the foolish their lack of understanding.
12973.name: Ambrose Bierce

12974.quote: No man who worships education has got the best out of education, Without a gentle contempt for education no man's education is complete.
12974.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

12975.quote: Education is learning what you didn't even know you didn't know.
12975.name: Daniel J. Boorstin

12977.quote: Learning is not attained by chance, it must be sought for with ardor and diligence.
12977.name: Abigail Adams

12978.quote: Learning, n. The kind of ignorance distinguishing the studious.
12978.name: Ambrose Bierce

12979.quote: An educated man is thoroughly inoculated against humbug, thinks for himself and tries to give his thoughts, in speech or on paper, some style.
12979.name: Alan K. Simpson

12980.quote: When I get a little money I buy books and if any is left I buy food and clothes.
12980.name: Desiderius Erasmus

12981.quote: When a subject becomes totally obsolete we make it a required course.
12981.name: Peter Drucker

12982.quote: To the uneducated, an A is just three sticks.
12982.name: A. A. Milne

12983.quote: The whole purpose of education is to turn mirrors into windows.
12983.name: Sydney J. Harris

12984.quote: Poor people cannot rely on the government to come to help you in times of need. You have to get your education. Then nobody can control your destiny.
12984.name: Charles Barkley

12985.quote: Education is what survives when what has been learned has been forgotten.
12985.name: B. F. Skinner

12986.quote: Good teaching is one-fourth preparation and three-fourths pure theatre.
12986.name: Gail Godwin

12987.quote: Education is all a matter of building bridges.
12987.name: Ralph Ellison

12988.quote: The object of education is to prepare the young to educate themselves throughout their lives.
12988.name: Robert M. Hutchins

12989.quote: Some people drink from the fountain of knowledge, others just gargle.
12989.name: Robert Anthony

12990.quote: I prefer the company of peasants because they have not been educated sufficiently to reason incorrectly.
12990.name: Michel de Montaigne

12991.quote: If I were again beginning my studies, I would follow the advice of Plato and start with mathematics.
12991.name: Galileo Galilei

12992.quote: The great difficulty in education is to get experience out of ideas.
12992.name: George Santayana

12993.quote: An educated people can be easily governed.
12993.name: Frederick The Great

12994.quote: Learning is a result of listening, which in turn leads to even better listening and attentiveness to the other person. In other words, to learn from the child, we must have empathy, and empathy grows as we learn.
12994.name: Alice Miller

12995.quote: I think everyone should go to college and get a degree and then spend six months as a bartender and six months as a cabdriver. Then they would really be educated.
12995.name: Al McGuire

12996.quote: Education is the transmission of civilization.
12996.name: Will Durant

12997.quote: If the education of our kids comes from radio, television, newspapers - if that's where they get most of their knowledge from, and not from the schools, then the powers that be are definitely in charge, because they own all those outlets.
12997.name: Maynard James Keenan

12999.quote: If the Romans had been obliged to learn Latin, they would never have found time to conquer the world.
12999.name: Heinrich Heine

13000.quote: The only real failure in life is one not learned from.
13000.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

13001.quote: He who studies books alone will know how things ought to be, and he who studies men will know how they are.
13001.name: Charles Caleb Colton

13002.quote: It is with children that we have the best chance of studying the development of logical knowledge, mathematical knowledge, physical knowledge, and so forth.
13002.name: Jean Piaget

13003.quote: America is the best half-educated country in the world.
13003.name: Nicholas M. Butler

13004.quote: I read Shakespeare and the Bible, and I can shoot dice. That's what I call a liberal education.
13004.name: Tallulah Bankhead

13005.quote: It is always in season for old men to learn.
13005.name: Aeschylus

13006.quote: Education, has produced a vast population able to read but unable to distinguish what is worth reading.
13006.name: G. M. Trevelyan

13007.quote: If an ignorant person is attracted by the things of the world, that is bad. But if a learned person is thus attracted, it is worse.
13007.name: Abu Bakr

13008.quote: True, a little learning is a dangerous thing, but it still beats total ignorance.
13008.name: Abigail Van Buren

13009.quote: It is only as we develop others that we permanently succeed.
13009.name: Harvey S. Firestone

13011.quote: I would like to learn, or remember, how to live.
13011.name: Annie Dillard

13012.quote: Real education must ultimately be limited to men who insist on knowing, the rest is mere sheep-herding.
13012.name: Ezra Pound

13013.quote: It has been said that 80% of what people learn is visual.
13013.name: Allen Klein

13014.quote: Men and women must be educated, in a great degree, by the opinions and manners of the society they live in.
13014.name: Mary Wollstonecraft

13015.quote: I learned more stuff in church than I did in the world.
13015.name: Al Green

13016.quote: The willingness to learn new skills is very high.
13016.name: Angela Merkel

13017.quote: To the extent that we are all educated and informed, we will be more equipped to deal with the gut issues that tend to divide us.
13017.name: Caroline Kennedy Schlossberg

13018.quote: If I had learned education I would not have had time to learn anything else.
13018.name: Cornelius Vanderbilt

13020.quote: You can educate yourself right out of a relationship with God.
13020.name: Tammy Faye Bakker

13021.quote: The simplest schoolboy is now familiar with truths for which Archimedes would have sacrificed his life.
13021.name: Ernest Renan

13022.quote: I know a lot of people think I'm dumb. Well, at least I ain't no educated fool.
13022.name: Leon Spinks

13023.quote: Every educated person is a future enemy.
13023.name: Martin Bormann

14043.quote: His lordship may compel us to be equal upstairs, but there will never be equality in the servants' hall.

14044.quote: Any serious shift towards more sustainable societies has to include gender equality.

14045.quote: I do not want to be the angel of any home: I want for myself what I want for other women, absolute equality. After that is secured, then men and women can take turns being angels.

14047.quote: In a state therefore of great equality and virtue, where pure and simple manners prevailed, the increase of the human species would evidently be much greater than any increase that has been hitherto known.

14048.quote: Feudal societies don't create great cinema we have great theatre. The egalitarian societies create great cinema. The Americans, the French. Because equality is sort of what the cinema deals with. It deals with stories which don't fall into 'Everybody in their place and who's who,' and all that. But the theatre's full of that.
14048.name: Brian Cox

14049.quote: There's a remarkable amount of sexism on TV. When male characters are flawed, they're interesting, deep and complex. But when female characters are flawed, they're just a mess. It's good to put more flawed but interesting female characters out there because it promotes equality.

14050.quote: Character cannot be developed in ease and quiet. Only through experience of trial and suffering can the soul be strengthened, ambition inspired, and success achieved.
14050.name: Helen Keller

14051.quote: Security is mostly a superstition. It does not exist in nature, nor do the children of men as a whole experience it. Avoiding danger is no safer in the long run than outright exposure. Life is either a daring adventure, or nothing.

14052.quote: The most beautiful thing we can experience is the mysterious. It is the source of all true art and science.

14053.quote: Experience hath shewn, that even under the best forms of government those entrusted with power have, in time, and by slow operations, perverted it into tyranny.
14053.name: Thomas Jefferson

14054.quote: Happiness cannot be traveled to, owned, earned, worn or consumed. Happiness is the spiritual experience of living every minute with love, grace, and gratitude.
14054.name: Denis Waitley

14055.quote: It was the experience of mystery - even if mixed with fear - that engendered religion.
14055.name: Albert Einstein

14056.quote: Experience demands that man is the only animal which devours his own kind, for I can apply no milder term to the general prey of the rich on the poor.
14056.name: Thomas Jefferson

14057.quote: Let us with caution indulge the supposition that morality can be maintained without religion. Reason and experience both forbid us to expect that national morality can prevail in exclusion of religious principle.

14058.name: Barbara de Angelis

14059.quote: I believe that anyone can conquer fear by doing the things he fears to do, provided he keeps doing them until he gets a record of successful experience behind him.
14059.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

14060.quote: I don't believe people are looking for the meaning of life as much as they are looking for the experience of being alive.
14060.name: Joseph Campbell

14062.quote: If money is your hope for independence you will never have it. The only real security that a man will have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience, and ability.
14062.name: Henry Ford

14063.quote: Beliefs have the power to create and the power to destroy. Human beings have the awesome ability to take any experience of their lives and create a meaning that disempowers them or one that can literally save their lives.
14063.name: Tony Robbins

14064.quote: The marvelous richness of human experience would lose something of rewarding joy if there were no limitations to overcome. The hilltop hour would not be half so wonderful if there were no dark valleys to traverse.
14064.name: Helen Keller

14065.quote: Many people know so little about what is beyond their short range of experience. They look within themselves - and find nothing! Therefore they conclude that there is nothing outside themselves either.
14065.name: Helen Keller

14066.quote: Never, never and never again shall it be that this beautiful land will again experience the oppression of one by another.
14066.name: Nelson Mandela

14067.quote: I had rather have a fool to make me merry than experience to make me sad and to travel for it too!
14067.name: William Shakespeare

14068.quote: Be brave. Take risks. Nothing can substitute experience.
14068.name: Paulo Coelho

14069.quote: If history repeats itself, and the unexpected always happens, how incapable must Man be of learning from experience.
14069.name: George Bernard Shaw

14070.quote: Experience teaches us that it is much easier to prevent an enemy from posting themselves than it is to dislodge them after they have got possession.
14070.name: George Washington

14071.quote: My experience has been that work is almost the best way to pull oneself out of the depths.
14071.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

14072.quote: Unwearied ceaseless effort is the price that must be paid for turning faith into a rich infallible experience.
14072.name: Mahatma Gandhi

14073.quote: Good judgment comes from experience, and a lot of that comes from bad judgment.
14073.name: Will Rogers

14074.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
14074.name: Robert Fulghum

14075.quote: I am a woman in process. I'm just trying like everybody else. I try to take every conflict, every experience, and learn from it. Life is never dull.

14076.quote: Experience keeps a dear school, but fools will learn in no other.

14078.quote: We choose our joys and sorrows long before we experience them.
14078.name: Khalil Gibran

14083.quote: It is a common experience that a problem difficult at night is resolved in the morning after the committee of sleep has worked on it.

14084.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

14086.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

14087.quote: Experience has shown, and a true philosophy will always show, that a vast, perhaps the larger portion of the truth arises from the seemingly irrelevant.
14087.name: Edgar Allan Poe

14088.quote: Wealth is the ability to fully experience life.

14089.quote: What each must seek in his life never was on land or sea. It is something out of his own unique potentiality for experience, something that never has been and never could have been experienced by anyone else.

14090.quote: I have but one lamp by which my feet are guided, and that is the lamp of experience.

14097.quote: I don't have to have faith, I have experience.

14098.quote: Men are wise in proportion, not to their experience, but to their capacity for experience.

14105.quote: Sleep - the most beautiful experience in life - except drink.

14113.name: John Milton

14114.name: Henry Ford

14134.quote: I know it's an experience that I need to have if God's putting me through it.
14134.name: Lil Wayne

14136.quote: If merely 'feeling good' could decide, drunkenness would be the supremely valid human experience.
14136.name: William James

14137.quote: You are not a human being in search of a spiritual experience. You are a spiritual being immersed in a human experience.
14137.name: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

14138.quote: How is it possible that a being with such sensitive jewels as the eyes, such enchanted musical instruments as the ears, and such fabulous arabesque of nerves as the brain can experience itself anything less than a god.

14139.quote: If you want to run, run a mile. If you want to experience a different life, run a marathon.
14139.name: Emil Zatopek

14140.quote: Each morning when I awake, I experience again a supreme pleasure - that of being Salvador Dali.
14140.name: Salvador Dali

14141.quote: Travel, in the younger sort, is a part of education in the elder, a part of experience.
14141.name: Francis Bacon

14142.quote: The soul should always stand ajar, ready to welcome the ecstatic experience.
14142.name: Emily Dickinson

14145.quote: My experience of the world is that things left to themselves don't get right.

14147.quote: Optimism with some experience behind it is much more energizing than plain old experience with a certain degree of cynicism.
14147.name: Twyla Tharp

14148.quote: But my experience is that people who have been through painful, difficult times are filled with compassion.
14148.name: Amy Grant

14149.quote: Refusal to believe until proof is given is a rational position denial of all outside of our own limited experience is absurd.
14149.name: Annie Besant

14150.quote: There are worlds of experience beyond the world of the aggressive man, beyond history, and beyond science. The moods and qualities of nature and the revelations of great art are equally difficult to define we can grasp them only in the depths of our perceptive spirit.
14150.name: Ansel Adams

14151.quote: All partisan movements add to the fullness of our understanding of society as a whole. They never detract or, in any case, one must not allow them to do so. Experience adds to experience.
14151.name: Alice Walker

14152.quote: Many of the insights of the saint stem from their experience as sinners.
14152.name: Eric Hoffer

14153.quote: As a medical doctor, it is my duty to evaluate the situation with as much data as I can gather and as much expertise as I have and as much experience as I have to determine whether or not the wish of the patient is medically justified.
14153.name: Jack Kevorkian

14154.quote: Good judgement comes from experience. Experience comes from bad judgement.
14154.name: Jim Horning

14155.quote: Experience seems to most of us to lead to conclusions, but empiricism has sworn never to draw them.
14155.name: George Santayana

14156.quote: The word experience is like a shrapnel shell, and bursts into a thousand meanings.
14156.name: George Santayana

14157.quote: Parents lend children their experience and a vicarious memory children endow their parents with a vicarious immortality.
14157.name: George Santayana

14158.quote: Because our entire universe is made up of consciousness, we never really experience the universe directly we just experience our consciousness of the universe, our perception of it, so right, our only universe is perception.
14158.name: Alan Moore

14159.quote: Masterpieces are not single and solitary births they are the outcome of many years of thinking in common, of thinking by the body of the people, so that the experience of the mass is behind the single voice.
14159.name: Virginia Woolf

14160.quote: It takes someone with a vision of the possibilities to attain new levels of experience. Someone with the courage to live his dreams.
14160.name: Les Brown

14161.quote: Memory is not an instrument for exploring the past but its theatre. It is the medium of past experience, as the ground is the medium in which dead cities lie interred.
14161.name: Walter Benjamin

14163.quote: Experience is never limited, and it is never complete it is an immense sensibility, a kind of huge spider-web of the finest silken threads suspended in the chamber of consciousness, and catching every air-borne particle in its tissue.
14163.name: Henry James

14164.quote: All the suffering and joy we experience depend on conditions.
14164.name: Bodhidharma

14165.quote: Simplicity is the most difficult thing to secure in this world it is the last limit of experience and the last effort of genius.
14165.name: George Sand

14166.quote: Historically, musicians know what it is like to be outside the norm - walking the high wire without a safety net. Our experience is not so different from those who march to the beat of different drummers.
14166.name: Billy Joel

14167.quote: But although all our knowledge begins with experience, it does not follow that it arises from experience.
14167.name: Immanuel Kant

14168.quote: It is possible to experience an awakening in this life through realising just how precious each moment, each mental process, and each breath truly is.
14168.name: Christy Turlington

14169.quote: What an artist is trying to do for people is bring them closer to something, because of course art is about sharing. You wouldn't be an artist unless you wanted to share an experience, a thought.
14169.name: David Hockney

14170.quote: You lose your individuality a huge amount when you have no money, and I certainly had that experience.
14170.name: J. K. Rowling

14171.quote: At times I experience hardship in trying to find the proper point of balance between traditional things and my own personality.
14171.name: Princess Masako

14172.quote: Wisdom and penetration are the fruit of experience, not the lessons of retirement and leisure. Great necessities call out great virtues.
14172.name: Abigail Adams

14173.quote: That peace which is within us, we must experience it. And if we are searching for peace outside we will never find the peace within.
14173.name: Prem Rawat

14174.quote: Experience is the best teacher of all. And for that, there are no guarantees that one will become an artist. Only the journey matters.
14174.name: Harry Callahan

14175.quote: I'm afraid, based on my own experience, that fascism will come to America in the name of national security.
14175.name: Jim Garrison

14176.quote: The new spirituality is that it will produce an experience in human encounters in which we become a living demonstration of the basic spiritual teaching 'We are all one.'
14176.name: Neale Donald Walsch

14177.quote: There are some hurts that we experience that can be forgiven but we won't forget them.
14177.name: Joyce Meyer

14178.quote: No place epitomizes the American experience and the American spirit more than New York City.
14178.name: Michael Bloomberg

14179.quote: To 'choose' dogma and faith over doubt and experience is to throw out the ripening vintage and to reach greedily for the Kool-Aid.
14179.name: Christopher Hitchens

14180.quote: Most men are very attached to the idea of being male, and usually experience a lot of fear and insecurity around the idea of being a man. Most women are very identified with their gender, and also experience a tremendous amount of fear and insecurity.
14180.name: Andrew Cohen

14181.quote: You don't know what unconditional love is. You may say you do, but if you don't have a child, you don't know what that is. But when you experience it, it is the most fulfilling ever.
14181.name: Regina King

14182.quote: I maybe had a first love and had my heart broken, but reflecting on it, I don't think that was love. I think as I'm getting older and having more in-depth relationships, maybe I'll experience it. At the moment, I don't know, exactly, if I've been in love.
14182.name: Selena Gomez

14183.quote: The traveler was active he went strenuously in search of people, of adventure, of experience. The tourist is passive he expects interesting things to happen to him. He goes 'sight-seeing.'
14183.name: Daniel J. Boorstin

14184.quote: Yes, I've been trepanned. That's quite an interesting experience, especially for my brain surgeon, who saw my thoughts flying around in my brain.
14184.name: Keith Richards

14185.quote: God is only a great imaginative experience.
14185.name: David Herbert Lawrence

14186.quote: Myth is an attempt to narrate a whole human experience, of which the purpose is too deep, going too deep in the blood and soul, for mental explanation or description.
14186.name: David Herbert Lawrence

14187.quote: No man was ever so completely skilled in the conduct of life, as not to receive new information from age and experience.
14187.name: Jonathan Swift

14188.quote: There is no more lively sensation than that of pain its impressions are certain and dependable, they never deceive as may those of the pleasure women perpetually feign and almost never experience.
14188.name: Marquis de Sade

14189.quote: Music is your own experience, your own thoughts, your wisdom. If you don't live it, it won't come out of your horn. They teach you there's a boundary line to music. But, man, there's no boundary line to art.
14189.name: Charlie Parker

14190.quote: The dictum that truth always triumphs over persecution is one of the pleasant falsehoods which men repeat after one another till they pass into commonplaces, but which all experience refutes.
14190.name: John Stuart Mill

14191.quote: If you want plenty of experience in dealing with difficult people, then have kids.
14191.name: Bo Bennett

14192.quote: I had some experience in dealing with people who have mental illness and depression, but I didn't see the signs in myself. I couldn't ask for help because I didn't know I needed help.
14192.name: Clara Hughes

14193.quote: I write out of my intellectual experience.
14193.name: Tom Stoppard

14194.quote: It would be my guess that Madonna is not a very happy woman. From my own experience, having gone through persona changes like that, that kind of clawing need to be the center of attention is not a pleasant place to be.
14194.name: David Bowie

14195.quote: The great living experience for every man is his adventure into the woman. The man embraces in the woman all that is not himself, and from that one resultant, from that embrace, comes every new action.
14195.name: David Herbert Lawrence

14196.quote: High school is such a shared experience in North American culture.
14196.name: Doug Coupland

14197.quote: Imagine a judicial nominee said 'my experience as a white man makes me better than a Latina woman.' Wouldn't they have to withdraw? New racism is no better than old racism.
14197.name: Newt Gingrich

14198.quote: The experience of life consists of the experience which the spirit has of itself in matter and as matter, in mind and as mind, in emotion, as emotion, etc.

14199.quote: But it's a journey and the sad thing is you only learn from experience, so as much as someone can tell you things, you have to go out there and make your own mistakes in order to learn.

14200.quote: Of two pleasures, if there be one which all or almost all who have experience of both give a decided preference, irrespective of any feeling of moral obligation to prefer it, that is the more desirable pleasure.

14201.quote: My friends, whoever has had experience of evils knows how whenever a flood of ills comes upon mortals, a man fears everything but whenever a divine force cheers on our voyage, then we believe that the same fate will always blow fair.
14201.name: Aeschylus

14202.quote: I think I'm basically the same guy I always was. Maybe I've learned, through experience, to rein in some of the anger and temper they say redheads normally have.
14202.name: Willie Nelson

14203.quote: Such happiness as life is capable of comes from the full participation of all our powers in the endeavor to wrest from each changing situations of experience its own full and unique meaning.
14203.name: John Dewey

14204.quote: War is delightful to those who have had no experience of it.
14204.name: Desiderius Erasmus

14205.quote: I never intended for the Monster Ball to be a religious experience, it just became one.
14205.name: Lady Gaga

14206.quote: I'm not one aspect of the human experience - none of us is.
