14826.quote: Failure should be our teacher, not our undertaker. Failure is delay, not defeat. It is a temporary detour, not a dead end. Failure is something we can avoid only by saying nothing, doing nothing, and being nothing.
14826.name: Denis Waitley

14827.quote: I don't believe in failure. It is not failure if you enjoyed the process.
14827.name: Oprah Winfrey

14828.quote: There is no such thing as failure. There are only results.
14828.name: Tony Robbins

14829.quote: If you're doing your best, you won't have any time to worry about failure.
14829.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

14830.quote: Success is often achieved by those who don't know that failure is inevitable.
14830.name: Coco Chanel

14831.quote: A failure is not always a mistake, it may simply be the best one can do under the circumstances. The real mistake is to stop trying.
14831.name: B. F. Skinner

14832.quote: If you're not failing every now and again, it's a sign you're not doing anything very innovative.
14832.name: Woody Allen

14833.quote: Restlessness is discontent and discontent is the first necessity of progress. Show me a thoroughly satisfied man and I will show you a failure.
14833.name: Thomas A. Edison

14834.quote: Winning is great, sure, but if you are really going to do something in life, the secret is learning how to lose. Nobody goes undefeated all the time. If you can pick up after a crushing defeat, and go on to win again, you are going to be a champion someday.
14834.name: Wilma Rudolph

14835.quote: One's only rival is one's own potentialities. One's only failure is failing to live up to one's own possibilities. In this sense, every man can be a king, and must therefore be treated like a king.
14835.name: Abraham Maslow

14836.quote: It is impossible to live without failing at something, unless you live so cautiously that you might has well not have lived at all, in which case you have failed by default.
14836.name: J. K. Rowling

14837.quote: Achievement is not always success, while reputed failure often is. It is honest endeavor, persistent effort to do the best possible under any and all circumstances.
14837.name: Orison Swett Marden

14838.quote: Show me a thoroughly satisfied man and I will show you a failure.
14838.name: Thomas A. Edison

14839.quote: I really don't think life is about the I-could-have-beens. Life is only about the I-tried-to-do. I don't mind the failure but I can't imagine that I'd forgive myself if I didn't try.
14839.name: Nikki Giovanni

14840.quote: I think you can have 10,000 explanations for failure, but no good explanation for success.
14840.name: Paulo Coelho

14841.quote: It is not because the truth is too difficult to see that we make mistakes, we make mistakes because the easiest and most comfortable course for us is to seek insight where it accords with our emotions - especially selfish ones.
14841.name: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

14842.quote: To establish true self-esteem we must concentrate on our successes and forget about the failures and the negatives in our lives.
14842.name: Denis Waitley

14843.quote: Failure after long perseverance is much grander than never to have a striving good enough to be called a failure.
14843.name: George Eliot

14844.quote: Through perseverance many people win success out of what seemed destined to be certain failure.
14844.name: Benjamin Disraeli

14845.quote: Go on failing. Go on. Only next time, try to fail better.
14845.name: Samuel Beckett

14846.quote: Failure is a word unknown to me.
14846.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

14847.quote: All that is necessary to break the spell of inertia and frustration is this: Act as if it were impossible to fail. That is the talisman, the formula, the command of right about face which turns us from failure to success.
14847.name: Dorthea Brande

14848.quote: Don't be afraid of missing opportunities. Behind every failure is an opportunity somebody wishes they had missed.
14848.name: Lily Tomlin

14849.quote: Every failure is a step to success.
14849.name: William Whewell

14850.quote: You will be a failure, until you impress the subconscious with the conviction you are a success. This is done by making an affirmation which 'clicks.'
14850.name: Florence Scovel Shinn

14851.quote: It's best to have failure happen early in life. It wakes up the Phoenix bird in you so you rise from the ashes.
14851.name: Anne Baxter

14852.quote: The only failure one should fear, is not hugging to the purpose they see as best.
14852.name: George Eliot

14853.quote: There is only one failure in life possible, and that is not to be true to the best one knows.
14853.name: George Eliot

14854.quote: We failed, but in the good providence of God apparent failure often proves a blessing.
14854.name: Robert E. Lee

14855.quote: Success is not built on success. It's built on failure. It's built on frustration. Sometimes its built on catastrophe.
14855.name: Sumner Redstone

14856.quote: For every failure, there's an alternative course of action. You just have to find it. When you come to a roadblock, take a detour.
14856.name: Mary Kay Ash

14857.quote: Success comes when people act together failure tends to happen alone.
14857.name: Deepak Chopra

14858.quote: They who have conquered doubt and fear have conquered failure.
14858.name: James Allen

14859.quote: Do not be embarrassed by your failures, learn from them and start again.
14859.name: Richard Branson

14860.quote: The season of failure is the best time for sowing the seeds of success.
14860.name: Paramahansa Yogananda

14861.quote: The young think that failure is the Siberian end of the line, banishment from all the living, and tend to do what I then did - which was to hide.
14861.name: James A. Baldwin

14862.quote: There are some defeats more triumphant than victories.
14862.name: Michel de Montaigne

14863.quote: It is wise to keep in mind that neither success nor failure is ever final.
14863.name: Roger Babson

14864.quote: All human actions are equivalent, and all are on principle doomed to failure.
14864.name: Carl Sandburg

14865.quote: Failure happens all the time. It happens every day in practice. What makes you better is how you react to it.
14865.name: Mia Hamm

14866.quote: Indecision and delays are the parents of failure.
14866.name: George Canning

14867.quote: A person who doubts himself is like a man who would enlist in the ranks of his enemies and bear arms against himself. He makes his failure certain by himself being the first person to be convinced of it.
14867.name: Alexandre Dumas

14868.quote: Do not blame anybody for your mistakes and failures.
14868.name: Bernard Baruch

14869.quote: If at first you don't succeed, failure may be your style.
14869.name: Quentin Crisp

14870.quote: Success and failure are equally disastrous.
14870.name: Tennessee Williams

14871.quote: Success isn't permanent and failure isn't fatal.
14871.name: Mike Ditka

14872.quote: It is not a disgrace to fail. Failing is one of the greatest arts in the world.
14872.name: Charles Kettering

14873.quote: Show me a good and gracious loser and I'll show you a failure.
14873.name: Knute Rockne

14874.quote: The great question is not whether you have failed, but whether you are content with failure.
14874.name: Laurence J. Peter

14875.quote: You gotta lose 'em some of the time. When you do, lose 'em right.
14875.name: Casey Stengel

14876.quote: The only risk of failure is promotion.
14876.name: Scott Adams

14877.quote: We climb to heaven most often on the ruins of our cherished plans, finding our failures were successes.
14877.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

14878.quote: Do not let your ambitions become a sanctuary for your failures.
14878.name: Bryant H. McGill

14879.quote: A life which does not go into action is a failure.
14879.name: Arnold J. Toynbee

14880.quote: I hate to be a failure. I hate and regret the failure of my marriages. I would gladly give all my millions for just one lasting marital success.
14880.name: J. Paul Getty

14881.quote: There could be no honor in a sure success, but much might be wrested from a sure defeat.
14881.name: Ann Landers

14882.quote: Success represents the 1% of your work which results from the 99% that is called failure.
14882.name: Soichiro Honda

14883.quote: A hatred of failure has always been part of my nature.
14883.name: Paul Getty

14884.quote: Success is never final, but failure can be.
14884.name: Bill Parcells

14886.quote: Often the difference between a successful person and a failure is not one has better abilities or ideas, but the courage that one has to bet on one's ideas, to take a calculated risk - and to act.
14886.name: Andre Malraux

14887.quote: Success breeds complacency. Complacency breeds failure. Only the paranoid survive.
14887.name: Andy Grove

14888.quote: Failure to prepare is preparing to fail.
14888.name: Mike Murdock

14889.quote: Our failings sometimes bind us to one another as closely as could virtue itself.
14889.name: Luc de Clapiers

14890.quote: It would be great to be able to pass on to someone all of the successes, the failures, and the knowledge that one has had. To help someone, avoid all the fire, pain and anxiety would be wonderful.
14890.name: Sylvester Stallone

14891.quote: Don't be afraid of failure be afraid of petty success.
14891.name: Maude Adams

14892.quote: My life has been nothing but a failure.
14892.name: Claude Monet

14893.quote: You always pass failure on your way to success.
14893.name: Mickey Rooney

14894.quote: Never walk away from failure. On the contrary, study it carefully and imaginatively for its hidden assets.
14894.name: Michael Korda

14895.quote: I never see failure as failure, but only as the game I must play and win.
14895.name: Tom Hopkins

14896.quote: We may be personally defeated, but our principles never!
14896.name: William Lloyd Garrison

14897.quote: The world is divided into two categories: failures and unknowns.
14897.name: Francis Picabia

14898.quote: I have probably purchased fifty 'hot tips' in my career, maybe even more. When I put them all together, I know I am a net loser.
14898.name: Charles M. Schwab

14899.quote: Notice the difference between what happens when a man says to himself, I have failed three times, and what happens when he says, I am a failure.
14899.name: S. I. Hayakawa

14900.quote: Failure is a word that I simply don't accept.
14900.name: John H. Johnson

14901.quote: The most important of my discoveries have been suggested to me by my failures.
14901.name: Humphry Davy

14902.quote: Remember the two benefits of failure. First, if you do fail, you learn what doesn't work and second, the failure gives you the opportunity to try a new approach.
14902.name: Roger von Oech

14903.quote: At least I have the modesty to admit that lack of modesty is one of my failings.
14903.name: Hector Berlioz

14904.quote: Before you can win a game, you have to not lose it.
14904.name: Chuck Noll

14905.quote: I wasn't afraid to fail. Something good always comes out of failure.
14905.name: Anne Baxter

14906.quote: Losing is no disgrace if you've given your best.
14906.name: Jim Palmer

14907.quote: Socialism is a philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy, its inherent virtue is the equal sharing of misery.
14907.name: Winston Churchill

14908.quote: In order to succeed, your desire for success should be greater than your fear of failure.
14908.name: Bill Cosby

14909.quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
14909.name: Winston Churchill

14910.quote: Think twice before you speak, because your words and influence will plant the seed of either success or failure in the mind of another.
14910.name: Napoleon Hill

14911.quote: Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm.
14911.name: Winston Churchill

14912.quote: I don't know the key to success, but the key to failure is trying to please everybody.
14912.name: Bill Cosby

14913.quote: You build on failure. You use it as a stepping stone. Close the door on the past. You don't try to forget the mistakes, but you don't dwell on it. You don't let it have any of your energy, or any of your time, or any of your space.
14913.name: Johnny Cash

14914.quote: Develop success from failures. Discouragement and failure are two of the surest stepping stones to success.
14914.name: Dale Carnegie

14915.quote: Failure is simply the opportunity to begin again, this time more intelligently.
14915.name: Henry Ford

14916.quote: The only real failure in life is not to be true to the best one knows.
14916.name: Buddha

14917.quote: Leadership is solving problems. The day soldiers stop bringing you their problems is the day you have stopped leading them. They have either lost confidence that you can help or concluded you do not care. Either case is a failure of leadership.
14917.name: Colin Powell

14918.quote: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
14918.name: Colin Powell

14919.quote: I honestly think it is better to be a failure at something you love than to be a success at something you hate.
14919.name: George Burns

14920.quote: Failure is success if we learn from it.
14920.name: Malcolm Forbes

14921.quote: Defeat is not the worst of failures. Not to have tried is the true failure.
14921.name: George Edward Woodberry

14922.quote: Success or failure depends more upon attitude than upon capacity successful men act as though they have accomplished or are enjoying something. Soon it becomes a reality. Act, look, feel successful, conduct yourself accordingly, and you will be amazed at the positive results.
14922.name: William James

14923.quote: It has always seemed strange to me, the things we admire in men, kindness and generosity, openness, honesty, understanding and feeling, are the concomitants of failure in our system. And those traits we detest, sharpness, greed, acquisitiveness, meanness, egotism and self-interest, are the traits of success. And while men admire the quality of the first they love the produce of the second.
14923.name: John Steinbeck

14924.quote: A little more persistence, a little more effort, and what seemed hopeless failure may turn to glorious success.
14924.name: Elbert Hubbard

14925.quote: Success depends upon previous preparation, and without such preparation there is sure to be failure.
14925.name: Confucius

14926.quote: The fact that we are here today to debate raising America's debt limit is a sign of leadership failure. America has a debt problem and a failure of leadership. Americans deserve better. I, therefore, intend to oppose the effort to increase America's debt.
14926.name: Barack Obama

14927.quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
14927.name: W. Clement Stone

14928.quote: A man who has never made a woman angry is a failure in life.
14928.name: Christopher Morley

14929.quote: As kids we're not taught how to deal with success we're taught how to deal with failure. If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. If at first you succeed, then what?
14929.name: Charlie Sheen

14930.quote: Failure will never overtake me if my determination to succeed is strong enough.
14930.name: Og Mandino

14931.quote: People in their handlings of affairs often fail when they are about to succeed. If one remains as careful at the end as he was at the beginning, there will be no failure.
14931.name: Lao Tzu

14932.quote: Think like a queen. A queen is not afraid to fail. Failure is another steppingstone to greatness.
14932.name: Oprah Winfrey

14933.quote: Socialism in general has a record of failure so blatant that only an intellectual could ignore or evade it.
14933.name: Thomas Sowell

14934.quote: Once you start a working on something, don't be afraid of failure and don't abandon it. People who work sincerely are the happiest.
14934.name: Chanakya

14935.quote: Never fret for an only son, the idea of failure will never occur to him.
14935.name: George Bernard Shaw

14936.quote: Most great people have attained their greatest success just one step beyond their greatest failure.
14936.name: Napoleon Hill

14937.quote: Failure is the key to success each mistake teaches us something.
14937.name: Morihei Ueshiba

14938.quote: Failure is unimportant. It takes courage to make a fool of yourself.
14938.name: Charlie Chaplin

14939.quote: My reputation grows with every failure.
14939.name: George Bernard Shaw

14940.quote: Success is never final, failure is never fatal. It's courage that counts.
14940.name: John Wooden

14941.quote: A failure is a man who has blundered, but is not able to cash in the experience.
14941.name: Elbert Hubbard

14942.quote: Optimism is a kind of heart stimulant - the digitalis of failure.
14942.name: Elbert Hubbard

14943.quote: Failure is simply a few errors in judgment, repeated every day.
14943.name: Jim Rohn

14944.quote: The line between failure and success is so fine that we scarcely know when we pass it: so fine that we are often on the line and do not know it.
14944.name: Elbert Hubbard

14945.quote: The majority of men meet with failure because of their lack of persistence in creating new plans to take the place of those which fail.
14945.name: Napoleon Hill

14946.quote: In America, there's a failure to appreciate Europe's leading role in the world.
14946.name: Barack Obama

14947.quote: No man ever achieved worth-while success who did not, at one time or other, find himself with at least one foot hanging well over the brink of failure.
14947.name: Napoleon Hill

14948.quote: Tragedy in life normally comes with betrayal and compromise, and trading on your integrity and not having dignity in life. That's really where failure comes.
14948.name: Tom Cochrane

14949.quote: Failure doesn't mean you are a failure it just means you haven't succeeded yet.
14949.name: Robert H. Schuller

14950.quote: The Bush Administration's failure to be consistently involved in helping Israel achieve peace with the Palestinians has been both wrong for our friendship with Israel, as well as badly damaging to our standing in the Arab world.
14950.name: Barack Obama

14951.quote: Why should anybody be interested in some old man who was a failure?
14951.name: Ernest Hemingway

14952.quote: So while I will never minimize the costs involved in military action, I am convinced that a failure to act in Libya would have carried a far greater price for America.
14952.name: Barack Obama

14953.quote: The theory seems to be that as long as a man is a failure he is one of God's children, but that as soon as he succeeds he is taken over by the Devil.
14953.name: H. L. Mencken

14954.quote: Failure comes only when we forget our ideals and objectives and principles.
14954.name: Jawaharlal Nehru

14955.quote: There's always failure. And there's always disappointment. And there's always loss. But the secret is learning from the loss, and realizing that none of those holes are vacuums.
14955.name: Michael J. Fox

14956.quote: You must accept that you might fail then, if you do your best and still don't win, at least you can be satisfied that you've tried. If you don't accept failure as a possibility, you don't set high goals, you don't branch out, you don't try - you don't take the risk.
14956.name: Rosalynn Carter

14957.quote: The guns and the bombs, the rockets and the warships, are all symbols of human failure.
14957.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

14958.quote: I hate failure and that divorce was a Number One failure in my eyes. It was the worst period of my life. Neither Desi nor I have been the same since, physically or mentally.
14958.name: Lucille Ball

14959.quote: In all our deeds, the proper value and respect for time determines success or failure.
14959.name: Malcolm X

14960.quote: A person who doubts himself is like a man who would enlist in the ranks of his enemies and bear arms agains himself. He makes his failure certain by himself being the first person to be convinced of it.
14960.name: Ambrose Bierce

14961.quote: A man can get discouraged many times but he is not a failure until he begins to blame somebody else and stops trying.
14961.name: John Burroughs

14962.quote: There is but one cause of human failure. And that is man's lack of faith in his true Self.
14962.name: William James

14963.quote: If those committed to the quest fail, they will be forgiven. When lost, they will find another way. The moral imperative of humanism is the endeavor alone, whether successful or not, provided the effort is honorable and failure memorable.
14963.name: E. O. Wilson

14964.quote: There can be no failure to a man who has not lost his courage, his character, his self respect, or his self-confidence. He is still a King.
14964.name: Orison Swett Marden

14965.quote: Every great work, every big accomplishment, has been brought into manifestation through holding to the vision, and often just before the big achievement, comes apparent failure and discouragement.
14965.name: Florence Scovel Shinn

14966.quote: Fear stifles our thinking and actions. It creates indecisiveness that results in stagnation. I have known talented people who procrastinate indefinitely rather than risk failure. Lost opportunities cause erosion of confidence, and the downward spiral begins.
14966.name: Charles Stanley

14967.quote: There is no failure except in no longer trying. There is no defeat except from within, no really insurmountable barrier save our own inherent weakness of purpose.
14967.name: Kin Hubbard

14968.quote: Sound character provides the power with which a person may ride the emergencies of life instead of being overwhelmed by them. Failure is, the highway to success.
14968.name: Og Mandino

14969.quote: Failure is not an option. Everyone has to succeed.
14969.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

14970.quote: Destiny: A tyrant's authority for crime and a fool's excuse for failure.
14970.name: Ambrose Bierce

14971.quote: Forget about the consequences of failure. Failure is only a temporary change in direction to set you straight for your next success.
14971.name: Denis Waitley

14972.quote: Laziness is a secret ingredient that goes into failure. But it's only kept a secret from the person who fails.
14972.name: Robert Half

14973.quote: No man is a failure who is enjoying life.
14973.name: William Feather

14974.quote: While it is important for people to see your promise you must also remember that hope is the keeper of both happiness and disappointment, the father of both progress and failure.
14974.name: Bryant H. McGill

14975.quote: If there exists no possibility of failure, then victory is meaningless.
14975.name: Robert H. Schuller

14976.quote: I'd rather be a failure at something I love than a success at something I hate.
14976.name: George Burns

14977.quote: No man can be a failure if he thinks he's a success If he thinks he is a winner, then he is.
14977.name: Robert W. Service

14978.quote: Failure is not our only punishment for laziness there is also the success of others.
14978.name: Jules Renard

14979.quote: The failure of national economic policy is costing us more than jobs it has begun to weaken that uniquely American spirit of risk-taking, large ambition, and optimism about the future. We must rally them now to bold departures that rebuild our national morale as well as our material prosperity.
14979.name: Mitch Daniels

14980.quote: Why do I talk about the benefits of failure? Simply because failure meant a stripping away of the inessential. I stopped pretending to myself that I was anything other than what I was, and began to direct all my energy into finishing the only work that mattered to me.
14980.name: J. K. Rowling

14981.quote: I'm proof against that word failure. I've seen behind it. The only failure a man ought to fear is failure of cleaving to the purpose he sees to be best.
14981.name: George Eliot

14982.quote: All human actions are equivalent and all are on principle doomed to failure.
14982.name: Jean-Paul Sartre

14983.quote: Ideology, politics and journalism, which luxuriate in failure, are impotent in the face of hope and joy.
14983.name: P. J. O'Rourke

14984.quote: Not failure, but low aim, is crime.
14984.name: James Russell Lowell

14985.quote: In Torch Song, I did that character almost non-stop from 1978 until I made the movie in 1987. Then I had some failure, which also colors how you react to doing other things.
14985.name: Harvey Fierstein

14986.quote: The idea of capitalism is not just success but also the failure that allows success to happen.
14986.name: P. J. O'Rourke

14987.quote: Creative risk taking is essential to success in any goal where the stakes are high. Thoughtless risks are destructive, of course, but perhaps even more wasteful is thoughtless caution which prompts inaction and promotes failure to seize opportunity.
14987.name: Gary Ryan Blair

14988.quote: They talk about the failure of socialism but where is the success of capitalism in Africa, Asia and Latin America?
14988.name: Fidel Castro

14989.quote: Don't fear failure so much that you refuse to try new things. The saddest summary of a life contains three descriptions: could have, might have, and should have.
14989.name: Louis E. Boone

14990.quote: There are only really a few stories to tell in the end, and betrayal and the failure of love is one of those good stories to tell.
14990.name: Sean Lennon

14991.quote: To begin to think with purpose, is to enter the ranks of those strong ones who only recognize failure as one of the pathways to attainment.
14991.name: James Allen

14992.quote: Failure is a great teacher, and I think when you make mistakes and you recover from them and you treat them as valuable learning experiences, then you've got something to share.
14992.name: Steve Harvey

14993.quote: My fault, my failure, is not in the passions I have, but in my lack of control of them.
14993.name: Jack Kerouac

14994.quote: Failure is instructive. The person who really thinks learns quite as much from his failures as from his successes.
14994.name: John Dewey

14995.quote: Success or failure in business is caused more by the mental attitude even than by mental capacities.
14995.name: Walter Scott

14996.quote: You may have a fresh start any moment you choose, for this thing that we call 'failure' is not the falling down, but the staying down.
14996.name: Mary Pickford

14997.quote: My dad encouraged us to fail. Growing up, he would ask us what we failed at that week. If we didn't have something, he would be disappointed. It changed my mindset at an early age that failure is not the outcome, failure is not trying. Don't be afraid to fail.
14997.name: Sara Blakely

14998.quote: He who risks and fails can be forgiven. He who never risks and never fails is a failure in his whole being.
14998.name: Paul Tillich

14999.quote: Big companies are like marching bands. Even if half the band is playing random notes, it still sounds kind of like music. The concealment of failure is built into them.
14999.name: Doug Coupland

15000.quote: A failure establishes only this, that our determination to succeed was not strong enough.
15000.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

15001.quote: One of the reasons people stop learning is that they become less and less willing to risk failure.
15001.name: John W. Gardner

15002.quote: My father was not a failure. After all, he was the father of a president of the United States.
15002.name: Harry S. Truman

15003.quote: Greatly begin. Though thou have time, but for a line, be that sublime. Not failure, but low aim is crime.
15003.name: James Russell Lowell

15004.quote: Mohammed was not an apparent failure. He was a dazzling success, politically as well as spiritually, and Islam went from strength to strength to strength.
15004.name: Karen Armstrong

15005.quote: No experience is a cause of success or failure. We do not suffer from the shock of our experiences, so-called trauma - but we make out of them just what suits our purposes.
15005.name: Alfred Adler

15006.quote: The freedom to fail is vital if you're going to succeed. Most successful people fail from time to time, and it is a measure of their strength that failure merely propels them into some new attempt at success.
15006.name: Michael Korda

15007.quote: No matter how vast, how total, the failure of man here on earth, the work of man will be resumed elsewhere. War leaders talk of resuming operations on this front and that, but man's front embraces the whole universe.
15007.name: Henry Miller

15008.quote: I have a lack of fear, whereas in the past the fear of failure was a powerful motivator. Anyway, I have great expectations for the future, but I just don't know if I'm the monarch of all I survey.
15008.name: Sylvester Stallone

15009.quote: War remains the decisive human failure.
15009.name: John Kenneth Galbraith

15010.quote: Failure is only postponed success as long as courage 'coaches' ambition. The habit of persistence is the habit of victory.
15010.name: Herbert Kaufman

15011.quote: If Liberia has failed, then, it is no evidence of the failure of the Negro in government. It is merely evidence of the failure of slavery.
15011.name: Carter G. Woodson

15012.quote: Every adversity, every failure, and every heartache, carries with it the Seed of an equivalent or greater Benefit.
15012.name: Napolean Hill

15013.quote: However things may seem, no evil thing is success and no good thing is failure.
15013.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

15014.quote: There is not a fiercer hell than the failure in a great object.
15014.name: John Keats

15015.quote: We learn wisdom from failure much more than from success. We often discover what will do, by finding out what will not do and probably he who never made a mistake never made a discovery.
15015.name: Samuel Smiles

15016.quote: Success is not a good teacher, failure makes you humble.
15016.name: Shahrukh Khan

15017.quote: Women, like men, should try to do the impossible. And when they fail, their failure should be a challenge to others.

16543.quote: All in the Family was intellectual it was art.

16545.quote: I think every girl needs to love herself, regardless of anything. Like if you're having a bad day, if you don't like your hair, if you don't have the best family situation, whatever, you have to love yourself and you can't do anything until you love yourself first.

16546.quote: In my family, we were Americans, we were Republicans and we were Methodists.

16547.name: Bill Murray

16552.name: J. Edgar Hoover

16553.quote: Family love is messy, clinging, and of an annoying and repetitive pattern, like bad wallpaper.

16555.name: Barry Goldwater

16556.name: Tim Vine

16557.quote: If you have autism in the family history, you still vaccinate. Delay it a bit, space them out.
16557.name: Temple Grandin

16558.quote: I am blessed to have so many great things in my life - family, friends and God. All will be in my thoughts daily.
16558.name: Lil' Kim

16565.quote: My work and my family are very important to me.
16565.name: Stephen Hawking

16566.quote: I refuse to feel guilty. I feel guilty about too much in my life but not about money. I went through periods when I had nothing, so somebody in my family has to get stinkin' wealthy.
16566.name: Jim Carrey

16567.quote: Everything I have, my career, my success, my family, I owe to America.
16567.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

16568.quote: Probably the worst time in a person's life is when they have to kill a family member because they are the devil. But otherwise it's been a pretty good day.
16568.name: Emo Philips

16569.quote: If you have learned how to disagree without being disagreeable, then you have discovered the secrete of getting along - whether it be business, family relations, or life itself.

17178.name: David Rockefeller

17179.quote: The American people know what's necessary to get this economy moving again. It's fiscal discipline in Washington, D.C. and across-the-board tax relief for working families, small businesses and family farms.
17179.name: Mike Pence

17180.quote: The Royal Family are not like you and me. They live in houses so big that you can walk round all day and never need to meet your spouse. The Queen and Prince Philip have never shared a bedroom in their lives. They don't even have breakfast together.
17180.name: A. N. Wilson

17181.quote: With the counseling of my family doctor, my mother ended up turning to Weight Watchers and their children's program. I went to weekly meetings, got counseling and would exercise with my peers who were my size. It was the first time I saw a proper children's portion size, and it wasn't two burgers, it was one.
17181.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

17182.quote: I was the youngest of my entire family so you are tap-dancing to try to get the attention of your older cousins. I really hit my social stride in 6th grade, but before that I was a pretty big dork. You learn how to be amusing and how to work for it.
17182.name: Sloane Crosley

17183.quote: To me, the kitchen is a place of adventure and entirely fun, not drudgery. I can't think of anything better to do with family and friends than to be together to create something.
17183.name: Ted Allen

17184.quote: I always loved family holidays, and I had this vision and dream as a little girl of having a big family of my own.
17184.name: Brooke Burke

17185.quote: I think with motherhood and child-rearing in general, everyone's going to tell you how to do it and why. I've always said to other mothers and women when they've asked me, that you have to find your own way and find out what works for your family, at all costs.
17185.name: Brooke Burke

17186.quote: Although my family - parents and sister - all work in the personnel management business, their real passion is performing, amateur operatic societies and so on.
17186.name: Michael Sheen

17187.quote: Film is an illusion. Fame is ephemeral. Faith and family are what endure.
17187.name: Emilio Estevez

17188.quote: I think 'Tattoo''s a song that can go so many different ways. Some people think of it as a break-up song, but, for me, it's about somebody who comes into your life and really touches you - be they a friend, a family member or someone you're in a relationship with.
17188.name: Jordin Sparks

17189.quote: It's cool to have parents and family who will always tell me the truth no matter what. They'll tell me if I'm doing something stupid!
17189.name: Jordin Sparks

17190.quote: My family was all born in Sicily and I'm Italian-American. They're the real thing. They're authentic Italians, and honestly they're the most open-minded, nicest people in the world and nothing can really offend them. That's the way I think true Sicilians are.
17190.name: Vinny Guadagnino

17191.quote: I think when someone is injured in your family, you want to speak to the individual and you want to hear their voice and you want to make sure they are OK.
17191.name: Roger Goodell

17192.quote: Growing up with my family gave me some of my best memories. I'd like to have a family of my own - slip away for a bit and do nothing but spend those early years with my children.
17192.name: Katherine Jenkins

17193.quote: I'm over the moon to be involved in the 'Doctor Who' Christmas special. I can't quite believe it as it's a part of the family tradition at the Jenkins household. I heard the news that I got the role on my 30th birthday and it was the best birthday present ever.
17193.name: Katherine Jenkins

17194.quote: You have no idea how humiliating it was, as a boy, to suddenly have all your clothes, your toys, snatched by the bailiff. I mean we were a middle-class family, it's not as if it was happening up and down the street. It made me ashamed, I felt dirty.
17194.name: John le Carre

17195.quote: I was quite able at the insignificant work I did in MI6, but absolutely dysfunctional in my domestic life. I had no experience of fatherhood. I had no example of marital bliss or the family unit.
17195.name: John le Carre

17196.quote: I like playing music because it's a good living and I get satisfaction from it. But I can't feed my family with satisfaction.
17196.name: James Hetfield

17197.quote: Baseball life is a tough life on the family.
17197.name: Nolan Ryan

17198.quote: I work six months and get three or four with the family.
17198.name: Kyle Chandler

17199.quote: I work six months and get three or four with the family. I've stopped racing to get to the red light.
17199.name: Kyle Chandler

17200.quote: I'm very, very concerned about the Bush presidency. I'm worried about the kinds of cuts in domestic programs that mean something to a lot of people, including members of my family, who depend on certain things from the government.
17200.name: Sarah Jessica Parker

17201.quote: I have a lot of responsibilities outside myself. I have a large family. I want to know I can always be helpful.
17201.name: Sarah Jessica Parker

17202.quote: My family makes these vinegars - out of everything from grapes to peaches and cherries. We go through the whole process with the giant vat and drainer, label them, and give them as Christmas presents.
17202.name: Mario Batali

17203.quote: We don't have the luxury of time. We spend more because of how we live, but it's important to be with our family and friends.
17203.name: Sara Blakely

17204.quote: I tend to show everything I do to my family, to check they won't be offended.
17204.name: David Sedaris

17205.quote: When I was growing up in Mississippi - it was good Southern food, but I also grew up with a Greek family when other kids were eating fried okra, we were eating steamed artichokes. So I think it played a big part in my healthy cooking.
17205.name: Cat Cora

17206.quote: I'm just a public-schoolboy. I've got a degree. I'm from a middle-class family in Devon. I've got no story.
17206.name: Chris Martin

17207.quote: In my family, we let our boys have a say in what veggie side they want for dinner that night. We list off a handful of options and get them excited about helping to plan the dinner menu. They're much more inclined to finish their plates when they've helped decide what goes on them.
17207.name: Cat Cora

17208.quote: To me, money is the ability to create lifelong experiences for my family and myself, to educate my children and a way to give back to humanity.
17208.name: Cat Cora

17209.quote: I've always been part of comedy. One of the things about our family was that if we were reasonably funny with each other, particularly my two brothers and myself, when my father was upset with something you'd want to make sure in some way you made him laugh. Because when he didn't laugh, you were in trouble!
17209.name: Leslie Nielsen

17210.quote: I've been experimenting more and more with LN2, liquid nitrogen. I've used it in battle on 'Iron Chef America,' but have also made some great ice creams at home for my family. Since it freezes basically on contact, you can have ice cream ready in mere minutes.
17210.name: Cat Cora

17211.quote: My family brought me up to be very respectful of people.
17211.name: Emma Bunton

17212.quote: When I'm home, the heart and soul of our family is in the kitchen. Growing up, my parents both worked, so dinnertime was for family - the TV was off. I think it's important to grab that time and really make it special, even after a tough day.
17212.name: Cat Cora

17213.quote: My parents did a great job raising me and my two sisters. We all graduated from high school and we all graduated from college. So, to be a good representative of my family is probably my greatest accomplishment thus far.
17213.name: Robert Griffin III

17214.quote: I would like a food/lifestyle show. We're not sure what that is yet. I want to be able to share what I do and how I raise my family. I feel like I have a story to tell. I enjoy talking and listening, sharing ideas and sharing advice.
17214.name: Cat Cora

17215.quote: And whereas women had to fight to find their way into the workforce, men are now fighting to reclaim their place in the family structure.
17215.name: Bob Geldof

17216.quote: I've always known I wanted a family.
17216.name: Charlize Theron

17217.quote: But I am Armenian and I understand what it is to lose a country and lose a family and have massacres and genocides and everything against my people.
17217.name: Andrea Martin

17218.quote: More than any other setting - more than battlefields or boardrooms or a spaceship headed for intergalactic travel - I'll put my money on the family to provide an endless source of comedy, tragedy and intrigue.
17218.name: Joyce Maynard

17219.quote: The importance of human life should be universally respected - and that refers to children before they are born and after. All children have the right to be brought up in a loving two-parent family where the notion of divorce is not even possible.
17219.name: Christopher Monckton

17220.quote: While Free Choice Vouchers didn't fulfill my vision of a health care system in which every American would be empowered to hire and fire their insurance company, they were a foothold for choice and competition and a safety valve for Americans whose employers are already forcing them to bear more and more of their family's health insurance costs.
17220.name: Ron Wyden

17221.quote: Everyone will be famous for 15 minutes.
17221.name: Andy Warhol

17222.quote: I have no use for people who throw their weight around as celebrities, or for those who fawn over you just because you are famous.
17222.name: Walt Disney

17223.quote: What a heavy burden is a name that has become too famous.
17223.name: Voltaire

17224.quote: We all want to be famous people, and the moment we want to be something we are no longer free.
17224.name: Jiddu Krishnamurti

17226.quote: Martyrdom is the only way a man can become famous without ability.
17226.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

17227.quote: Andy Warhol made fame more famous.
17227.name: Fran Lebowitz

17228.quote: I just want to make music, I don't want people to talk about me. All I've ever wanted to do was sing. I don't want to be a celebrity. I don't want to be in people's faces, you know, constantly on covers of magazine that I haven't even known I'm on.
17228.name: Adele

17229.quote: It's really easy to avoid the tabloids. You just live your life and don't hang out with famous people who are in the tabloids. Don't do anything controversial and be a normal person. Have friends. And get a job and keep working.
17229.name: Amanda Seyfried

17230.quote: I wanted to be successful, not famous.
17230.name: George Harrison

17231.quote: I'm not comfortable being around too many people. I don't like being out in public too much. I don't like going to bars. I don't like doing celebrity stuff. So most of the characters I play are people who don't always feel comfortable beyond their small circle of friends.
17231.name: Adam Sandler

17232.quote: How many famous and high-spirited heroes have lived a day too long?
17232.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

17233.quote: I like being famous when it's convenient for me and completely anonymous when it's not.
17233.name: Catherine Deneuve

17234.quote: I never wanted to be famous. I only wanted to be great.
17234.name: Ray Charles

17235.quote: For famous men have the whole earth as their memorial.
17235.name: Pericles

17236.quote: I know I'm not supposed to have any opinions about politics, because I'm famous.
17236.name: Cher

17237.quote: I'd rather be able to face myself in the bathroom mirror than be rich and famous.
17237.name: Ani DiFranco

17238.quote: You're not famous until my mother has heard of you.
17238.name: Jay Leno

17239.quote: It isn't necessary to be rich and famous to be happy. It's only necessary to be rich.
17239.name: Alan Alda

17240.quote: I always want to say to people who want to be rich and famous: 'try being rich first'. See if that doesn't cover most of it. There's not much downside to being rich, other than paying taxes and having your relatives ask you for money. But when you become famous, you end up with a 24-hour job.
17240.name: Bill Murray

17241.quote: There's no difference between fame and infamy now. There's a new school of professional famous people that don't do anything. They don't create anything.
17241.name: Ricky Gervais

17242.quote: Nothing in life prepares you to be famous.
17242.name: Jeff Foxworthy

17243.quote: I can do whatever I want - I'm rich, I'm famous, and I'm bigger than you.
17243.name: Don Johnson

17244.quote: It is a mark of many famous people that they cannot part with their brightest hour.
17244.name: Lillian Hellman

17245.quote: Tom Cruise, he's a lot more famous than me.
17245.name: David Beckham

17246.quote: People hate me because I am a multifaceted, talented, wealthy, internationally famous genius.
17246.name: Jerry Lewis

17247.quote: I am beautiful, famous and gorgeous.
17247.name: Anna Kournikova

17248.quote: A famous person to themselves, they don't get up in the morning and think, I'm famous. I'm not famous to me. Famous is a perception.
17248.name: Van Morrison

17249.quote: The hardest thing about being famous is that people are always nice to you. You're in a conversation and everybody's agreeing with what you're saying - even if you say something totally crazy. You need people who can tell you what you don't want to hear.
17249.name: Al Pacino

17250.quote: For a time, at least, I was the most famous person in the entire world.
17250.name: Jesse Owens

17251.quote: Fate is being kind to me. Fate doesn't want me to be too famous too young.
17251.name: Duke Ellington

17252.quote: Being big and famous doesn't get you more freedom, it gets you less.
17252.name: Robert Wyatt

17253.quote: Celebrity distorts democracy by giving the rich, beautiful, and famous more authority than they deserve.
17253.name: Maureen Dowd

17254.quote: I wrote because I needed to and wanted to. It never occurred to me that I'd become famous.
17254.name: Danielle Steel

17255.quote: Indeed, wretched the man whose fame makes his misfortunes famous.
17255.name: Lucius Accius

17256.quote: I put my money in the bank: I have to think of life after modeling, when I'm not famous any more.
17256.name: Eva Herzigova

17257.quote: My story of success and failure is not just about music and being famous. It's about living and loving and trying to find purpose in this crazy world.
17257.name: Wynonna Judd

17258.quote: Celebrity gives us delusion of self importance.
17258.name: Al Goldstein

17259.quote: I've worked with a lot of people who are more famous than myself who are terribly insecure.
17259.name: Barry Gibb

17260.quote: But I know newspapers. They have the first amendment and they can tell any lie knowing it's a lie and they're protected if the person's famous or it's a company.
17260.name: Steve Wozniak

17261.quote: Celebrity, to me, is not a thing to seek.
17261.name: Aidan Quinn

17262.quote: The thing about being famous is, it's weird. The only people who get how weird it is are other famous people.
17262.name: Margot Kidder

17263.quote: You don't have to have an attitude if you're famous.
17263.name: Adriana Lima

17264.quote: I seek no longer to be a 'famous' person, and instead I wish to live a 'normal' life.
17264.name: Sinead O'Connor

17265.quote: Public misbehavior by the famous is a powerful teaching tool.
17265.name: Bill O'Reilly

17266.quote: When you become famous, being famous becomes your profession.
17266.name: James Carville

17267.quote: Acting is not about being famous, it's about exploring the human soul.
17267.name: Annette Bening

17268.quote: I want to be famous everywhere.
17268.name: Luciano Pavarotti

17269.quote: I really hate the duties of being a celebrity, like getting dressed up for the red carpet.
17269.name: America Ferrera

17270.quote: If there's anything more mortifying than being famous at 14, it's being washed up right after.
17270.name: Moon Unit Zappa

17271.quote: My favorite thing about being famous, it's not really as big of a deal as everybody says it is. Being on the road is tough, doing interviews, and all the stuff. It's still pretty tough.
17271.name: Aaron Carter

17272.quote: I can't see any value in being a celebrity, famous for being famous.
17272.name: Noomi Rapace

17273.quote: The whole celebrity culture thing - I'm fascinated by, and repelled by, and yet I end up knowing about it.
17273.name: Anderson Cooper

17274.quote: When I'm living in the world of luxury and celebrity, which is where I found myself for a large part of my life, it's a walk-on part. Not a vital necessity, like it is for so many people. I enjoy it but I can see right through it!
17274.name: Agnetha Faltskog

17275.quote: I will either be famous or infamous.
17275.name: Otto Dix

17276.quote: Sometimes being famous gets in the way of doing what you want to do.
17276.name: Johnny Mathis

17277.quote: I think that when you are famous every weakness is exaggerated.
17277.name: Marilyn Monroe

17278.quote: Before I was famous, when I was just working in Gilbert's Lodge, everything was moving in slow motion.
17278.name: Eminem

17279.quote: Martyrdom: The only way a man can become famous without ability.
17279.name: George Bernard Shaw

17280.quote: To be famous, in fact, one has only to kill one's landlady.
17280.name: Albert Camus

17281.quote: Wood burns because it has the proper stuff in it and a man becomes famous because he has the proper stuff in him.
17281.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

17282.quote: When I started out, I didn't have any desire to be an actress or to learn how to act. I just wanted to be famous.
17282.name: Katharine Hepburn

17283.quote: Did you ever stop to think why cops are always famous for being dumb? Simple. Because they don't have to be anything else.
17283.name: Orson Welles

17284.quote: A very quiet and tasteful way to be famous is to have a famous relative. Then you can not only be nothing, you can do nothing too.
17284.name: P. J. O'Rourke

17285.quote: I'm bored with that line. I never use it anymore. My new line is 'In 15 minutes everybody will be famous.'
17285.name: Andy Warhol

17286.quote: I don't like Los Angeles. The people are awful and terribly shallow, and everybody wants to be famous but nobody wants to play the game. I'm from New York. I will kill to get what I need.
17286.name: Lady Gaga

17287.quote: The cool thing about being famous is traveling. I have always wanted to travel across seas, like to Canada and stuff.
17287.name: Britney Spears

17288.quote: My idea of a good picture is one that's in focus and of a famous person.
17288.name: Andy Warhol

17289.quote: In the future everyone will be famous for 15 minutes.
17289.name: Andy Warhol

17290.quote: After a fellow gets famous it doesn't take long for someone to bob up that used to sit by him in school.
17290.name: Kin Hubbard

17291.quote: And to me, fame is not a positive thing. The idea of being famous is a lot better than the reality. It's fantastic when you go to premieres and people cheer you, but it's not real. And it's totally not my approach to get my name on a club door just because I can.
17291.name: Tom Felton

17292.quote: I served the famous professors and scholars, and eventually they learned that the Reverend Moon is superior to them. Even Nobel laureate academics who thought they were at the center of knowledge are as nothing in front of me.
17292.name: Sun Myung Moon

17293.quote: A chair is a very difficult object. A skyscraper is almost easier. That is why Chippendale is famous.
17293.name: Ludwig Mies van der Rohe

17294.quote: If you want to be a rock star or just be famous, then run down the street naked, you'll make the news or something. But if you want music to be your livelihood, then play, play, play and play! And eventually you'll get to where you want to be.
17294.name: Eddie Van Halen

17295.quote: When we were growing up our parents somehow made it clear that being famous was good. And I mistakenly thought that if I was famous then everyone would love me.
17295.name: Ellen DeGeneres

17296.quote: I was never very interested in boys - and there were plenty of them - vying with one another to see how many famous women they would get into the hay.
17296.name: Bette Davis

17297.quote: Some of the most famous books are the least worth reading. Their fame was due to their having done something that needed to be doing in their day. The work is done and the virtue of the book has expired.
17297.name: Moliere

17298.quote: There's more pressure to be famous for being yourself than if you're being a character.
17298.name: Kim Kardashian

17299.quote: Any idiot can get laid when they're famous. That's easy. It's getting laid when you're not famous that takes some talent.
17299.name: Kevin Bacon

17300.quote: Mum loves me being famous! She is so excited and proud, as she had me so young and couldn't support me, so I am living her dream, it's sweeter for both of us. It's her 40th birthday soon and I'm going to buy her 40 presents.
17300.name: Adele

17301.quote: The fame thing is interesting because I never wanted to be famous, and I never dreamt I would be famous.
17301.name: J. K. Rowling

17302.quote: I imagined being a famous writer would be like being like Jane Austen.
17302.name: J. K. Rowling

17303.quote: There is a misleading, unwritten rule that states if a quote giving advice comes from someone famous, very old, or Greek, then it must be good advice.
17303.name: Bo Bennett

17304.quote: If you think Abraham Lincoln became famous for inventing the town car, it is time to spend a few hours on history.
17304.name: Bo Bennett

17305.quote: Forget about being world famous, it's hard enough just getting the automatic doors at the supermarket to acknowledge our existence.
17305.name: Doug Coupland

17306.quote: Yeah, I love being famous. It's almost like being white, y'know?
17306.name: Chris Rock

17307.quote: What I've learned is that you really don't need to be a celebrity or have money or have the paparazzi following you around to be famous.
17307.name: Lady Gaga

17308.quote: I've never sat there and plotted out how I was going to become successful or famous.
17308.name: Jennifer Aniston

17309.quote: I think the driving thing was curiosity about the universe. That fascinated me. I didn't think anything about being famous or anything like that, I was just interested in the concepts involved.
17309.name: Clyde Tombaugh

17310.quote: We are not interested in cloning the Michael Jordans and the Michael Jacksons of this world. The rich and the famous don't participate in this.
17310.name: Panayiotis Zavos

17311.quote: I have a profound empathy for people who are in the public eye, whether they manifest it themselves or whether it happened by accident - it doesn't matter to me. I think there's a great misunderstanding of what it is to be famous.
17311.name: Alanis Morissette

17312.quote: I thought the more famous I became, the more friendships I would have, but the opposite was true.
17312.name: Alanis Morissette

17313.quote: I'm more interested in being good than being famous.
17313.name: Annie Leibovitz

17314.quote: Aristotle was famous for knowing everything. He taught that the brain exists merely to cool the blood and is not involved in the process of thinking. This is true only of certain persons.
17314.name: Will Cuppy

17315.quote: I love being famous. It's almost like being white.
17315.name: Chris Rock

17316.quote: Dates with actors, finally, just seemed to me evenings of shop talk. I got sick of it after a hile. So the more famous I became, the more I narrowed down my choices.
17316.name: Hedy Lamarr

17317.quote: Sometimes people offer you plays, they offer you parts, but they only offer it because I'm famous.
17317.name: Chris Rock

17318.quote: I became very famous, as a teenager, and my name and photo were splashed in all the media. They made me larger than life, so I wanted to live larger than life, and the only way to do that was to be intoxicated.
17318.name: Cat Stevens

17319.quote: For me, growing up, the downside of it was that as a kid you don't want to stand out. You don't want to have a famous father let alone get a job because of your famous father, you know? But I'm a product of nepotism. That's how I got my foot in the door, through my dad.
17319.name: Jeff Bridges

17320.quote: Whenever you're the child of a famous person, you get judged in odd ways because of that.
17320.name: Jeff Bridges

17321.quote: The idea of being famous is a lot better than the reality.
17321.name: Tom Felton

17322.quote: I have been very happy, very rich, very beautiful, much adulated, very famous and very unhappy.
17322.name: Brigitte Bardot

17323.quote: It's interesting because people assume that because I'm famous I know all famous people.
17323.name: Daniel Radcliffe

17324.quote: I'm doing a new musical on Broadway, which opens in October called 'The Boy from Oz,' where I play Peter Allen. For those of you who don't know, he became first famous in America for marrying Liza Minelli.
17324.name: Hugh Jackman

17325.quote: There were a few years there when I was just so enamored with the idea of living some sort of famous person's lifestyle that really isn't suited to me.
17325.name: Daniel Radcliffe

17326.quote: I think it's useful, as a famous person, to have as little separation between the perception of you and how you really are - because otherwise I'd be sitting here thinking I'm keeping secrets, and wondering when you're going to find out.
17326.name: Daniel Radcliffe

17327.quote: In the sixties, everyone you knew became famous. My flatmate was Terence Stamp. My barber was Vidal Sassoon. David Hockney did the menu in a restaurant I went to. I didn't know anyone unknown who didn't become famous.
17327.name: Michael Caine

17328.quote: I made my living being 20 or 30 pounds heavier than the average model. And that's where I got famous.
17328.name: Tyra Banks

17329.quote: When I was going for my graduate degree, I decided I was going to make a feature film as my thesis. That's what I was famous for-that I had my thesis film be a feature film, which was 'You're a Big Boy Now.'
17329.name: Francis Ford Coppola

17330.quote: Since I was seventeen I thought I might be a star. I'd think about all my heroes, Charlie Parker, Jimi Hendrix, I had a romantic feeling about how these people became famous.
17330.name: Jean-Michel Basquiat

17331.quote: Other famous men, those of much talk and few deeds, soon evaporate. Action is the dignity of greatness.
17331.name: Jose Marti

17332.quote: Lance Armstrong, the famous cyclist and more importantly, cancer survivor, has said 'if you ever get a second chance for something, you've got to go all the way.'
17332.name: Michael N. Castle

17333.quote: The strangest part about being famous is you don't get to give first impressions anymore. Everyone already has an impression of you before you meet them.
17333.name: Kristen Stewart

17334.quote: I have no interest in Shakespeare and all that British nonsense, I just wanted to get famous and all the rest is hogwash.
17334.name: Anthony Hopkins

17335.quote: I certainly don't think you need to be famous to want to leave a legacy, but when you are famous, it's even more likely that your child will get the wrong perspective on your life if you die prematurely.
17335.name: Shania Twain

17336.quote: One thing about being famous is the people around you, you pay all their bills so they very rarely disagree with you because they want you to pick up the check.
17336.name: Charles Barkley

17337.quote: People just assume that if you're famous, you're in Hollywood.
17337.name: Megan Fox

17338.quote: If you look closely, there is no book more visual than Three Trapped Tigers, in that it is filled with blank pages, dark pages, it has stars made of words, the famous magical cube made of numbers, and there is even a page which is a mirror.
17338.name: Guillermo Cabrera Infante

17339.quote: Among famous traitors of history one might mention the weather.
17339.name: Ilka Chase

17340.quote: Know the names of past and current artists who are most famous for playing their instruments.
17340.name: Marilyn vos Savant

17341.quote: I think there are a lot of people who really want to be famous, they really do. I don't. It sort of gets in the way of the everyday things that I do.
17341.name: Johnny Mathis

17342.quote: Comedy has to be done en clair. You can't blunt the edge of wit or the point of satire with obscurity. Try to imagine a famous witty saying that is not immediately clear.
17342.name: James Thurber

17343.quote: Bruce Lee was very famous. I watched his movies and he is amazing. He is a martial arts master, his philosophy, his movement, both physically and mentally, were very strong.
17343.name: Jet Li

17344.quote: You can get rich or famous by doing the same thing.
17344.name: Ang Lee

17345.quote: And I want to do it the right way, like everybody else, not just a famous figurehead that gets a job because he is a famous basketball player. I want to really learn the business.
17345.name: Shaquille O'Neal

17346.quote: There is no fulfillment in things whatsoever. And I think one of the reasons that depression reigns supreme amongst the rich and famous is some of them thought that maybe those things would bring them happiness. But what, in fact, does is having a cause, having a passion. And that's really what gives life's true meaning.
17346.name: Benjamin Carson

17347.quote: I don't mean being famous is a perk, because one knows that it's not necessarily a perk, but there are certain perks to being well-known and respected in one's field. Public perks. Like, I don't know, general friendliness and willingness to please, just to point out two.
17347.name: Emma Thompson

17348.quote: The problem is, the more famous you get, the more people see you who didn't choose to.
17348.name: Louis C. K.

17349.quote: Look at Jessica Simpson. She's famous for being dumb. I guess it started with Marylyn Monroe, and she actually wasn't that dumb, but that's how she was perceived - and that's what got popular.
17349.name: Danica McKellar

17350.quote: Because you know when you first become famous, you start walking a little different because people are staring at you.
17350.name: Bono

17351.quote: Exposure makes you famous, not just good work. Famous is being plastered everywhere.
17351.name: Francesca Annis

17353.quote: I could have been a dental hygienist with nothing bad ever appearing in print about me, but that's not how I've chosen to lead my life. I knew that you put yourself under a microscope the more famous you become.
17353.name: Julia Roberts

17354.quote: I can't advise any of the young ones, because I don't know what their background was, but I would suggest that anyone who wants to be famous more than anything - there's a real problem.
17354.name: Shirley MacLaine

17355.quote: I'm sick to death of famous people standing up and using their celebrity to promote a cause. If I see a particular need, I do try to help. But there's a lot that can be achieved by putting a check in the right place and shutting up about it.
17355.name: Russell Crowe

17356.quote: Barack Obama is the most famous living person in the history of the world.
17356.name: Dee Dee Myers

17357.quote: Famous people come up to me, but I don't know who they are because my sight is so bad. It's always at the pool of the Four Seasons in Beverly Hills when I don't have my lenses in and my glasses are in my room.
17357.name: Helena Bonham Carter

17358.quote: I was famous overnight. I went from nowhere to being really big.
17358.name: Sting

17359.quote: The worst thing about being famous is the invasion of your privacy.
17359.name: Justin Timberlake

17360.quote: Hitler was so modern, in that he was obsessed with being famous. He was caught up with this rush to be have achieved greatness before turning 30.
17360.name: John Cusack

17361.quote: You know, I did not like being famous. It was a stressful and ugly time, and I'm glad it's over.
17361.name: Diablo Cody

17362.quote: To enjoy being famous, you need to have a screw loose.
17362.name: Diablo Cody

17363.quote: I'd probably be famous now if I wasn't such a good waitress.
17363.name: Jane Siberry

17364.quote: The whole 'American Idol' way of looking at things is the antithesis of what I grew up with. There are a whole lot of kids wanting to be famous now, whereas if I'd even mentioned that word to one of my teachers, I would have got into a whole load of trouble.
17364.name: Jr. Harry Connick

17365.quote: I became famous, I think, really because of the interpretation of other people's songs, way back when, and that's what I enjoy the most. And I'm a lazy bugger.
17365.name: Rod Stewart

17366.quote: There is this power that comes with being famous.
17366.name: Rod Stewart

17367.quote: I would have been very happy just working from job to job, paying my rent one movie at a time. I never wanted to be this famous. I never imagined this life for myself.
17367.name: Kristen Stewart

17368.quote: I'm willing to make compromises based on someone I think is the one, but I think it's psychologically important to people when they're famous to be the only famous person they know.
17368.name: John Mayer

17369.quote: I just like the company of beautiful women. I have a weakness in that department. And I suppose because I am fairly well off and a famous musician, I'm up for grabs. And that makes me an eligible bachelor in the press.
17369.name: Eric Clapton

17370.quote: In the beginning, I loved being famous, but now I am tired of it and I would like to go back to my freedom.
17370.name: Roberto Cavalli

17371.quote: There's a definite responsibility that comes with being famous. You shouldn't be able to just dress up and look pretty.
17371.name: Rashida Jones

17372.quote: I have to say, you know, I've seen so many people go through the cycle and become famous and not famous anymore and, you know, want - have their priorities change and want different things.
17372.name: Rashida Jones

17373.quote: I woke up one morning to find I was famous. I bought a white Rolls-Royce and drove down Sunset Boulevard, wearing dark specs and a white suit, waving like the Queen Mum.
17373.name: Peter O'Toole

17374.quote: My mom just didn't put a very high premium on me being like really famous or really wealthy or anything.
17374.name: Martha Plimpton

17375.quote: I'm not one of those famous people flying round the world emoting over every catastrophe. I'm too feeble.
17375.name: Kristin Scott Thomas

17376.quote: The first time I went to Johnny Depp's house in LA is when I realized what I was getting myself into. I knew he was famous, but I didn't really know what that entailed.
17376.name: Kate Moss

17377.quote: Duke Ellington was famous for hs very original harmonic patterns.
17377.name: Lawrence Welk

17378.quote: Why am I so famous? What am I doing right? What are the others doing wrong?
17378.name: Barbra Streisand

17379.quote: Being famous is just like being in high school. But I'm not interested in being the cheerleader. I'm not interested in being Gwen Stefani. She's the cheerleader, and I'm out in the smoker shed.
17379.name: Courtney Love

17380.quote: The fire in the belly is essential, otherwise you become Michael Buble - famous and meaningless.
17380.name: Steven Patrick Morrissey

17381.quote: I kept saying that I'd never live in L.A., and I didn't think I would. But that's where the work is, and I ended up making a lot of friends there, and my old friends moved out to Los Angeles too. And also, I think when you're famous, its hard to live in a small town.
17381.name: John Cusack

17382.quote: I lost some of my friends because I got so famous, people who just assumed that I would be different now. I felt like everyone hated me. That is the most unhappy time of my life.
17382.name: Haruki Murakami

17383.quote: Who elected Larry King America's grief counselor? We, the viewing public, did, by driving up his ratings whenever somebody famous passes.
17383.name: James Wolcott

17384.quote: I have a great job writing for 'The Office,' but, really, all television writers do is dream of one day writing movies. I'll put it this way: At the Oscars the most famous person in the room is, like, Angelina Jolie. At the Emmys the huge exciting celebrity is Bethenny Frankel. You get what I mean.
17384.name: Mindy Kaling

17385.quote: It took me fifteen years to discover I had no talent for writing, but I couldn't give it up because by that time I was too famous.
17385.name: Robert Benchley

17386.quote: I know I'm not a self-indulgent idiot I also know I'm not the second coming of Deepak Chopra. If I had believed either of those, or both, as some people do when they get famous, that's when the mental illness arrives.
17386.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

17387.quote: I know it's a cliche but I never wanted to be famous. I don't believe anybody wants to be famous.
17387.name: Jeremy Renner

17388.quote: A lot of people these days are not music lovers - they just want to be famous which is a very different thing to what I grew up believing in.
17388.name: Shirley Manson

17389.quote: The love of the famous, like all strong passions, is quite abstract. Its intensity can be measured mathematically, and it is independent of persons.
17389.name: Susan Sontag

17390.quote: I don't go to premieres. I don't go to parties. I don't covet the Oscar. I don't want any of that. I don't go out. I just have dinner at home every night with my kids. Being famous, that's a whole other career. And I haven't got any energy for it.
17390.name: Gary Oldman

17391.quote: You aren't famous until my mother has heard of you.
17391.name: Jay Leno

17392.quote: My hair was famous before I was.
17392.name: Christopher Walken

17393.quote: I'm English. Our dentistry is not world famous.
17393.name: Christian Bale

17394.quote: Just because you're not famous, doesn't mean you're not good.
17394.name: Laura Linney

17395.quote: I hear the way people talk about the children of famous people. They're not treated very well. The presumptions are usually quite awful. So I tried to establish myself with a couple of movies. After 'Juno' I thought: 'I think I've defined myself enough as my own director that I'd love to work with my father.'
17395.name: Jason Reitman

17396.quote: I've been very, very lucky in my career, in my life - from day one. When aspiring directors say, 'What's your advice?' first I say, 'Be born the son of a famous director. It's invaluable.'
17396.name: Jason Reitman

17397.quote: I have so much empathy for these young actors that are 19 and all of a sudden they're beautiful and famous and rich. I'm like, 'Oh my God, I'd be dead.'
17397.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

17398.quote: They saw me, those reckless seekers of beauty, and in a night I was famous.
17398.name: Lillie Langtry

17399.quote: Now, we believe that the majority of teachers in America know our system must be reformed, to put students first so that America can compete, that teachers don't teach to become rich or famous. They teach because they love children.
17399.name: Chris Christie

17400.quote: The stones themselves are thick with history, and those cats that dash through the alleyways must surely be the ghosts of the famous dead in feline disguise.
17400.name: Erica Jong

17401.quote: Well I would say that we're regular people first of all and we're normal and it's obvious by some of the things that have happened just because our name is famous we're not immune to tragedy.
17401.name: Brett Favre

17402.quote: A library, to modify the famous metaphor of Socrates, should be the delivery room for the birth of ideas - a place where history comes to life.
17402.name: Norman Cousins

17403.quote: It's quite a famous story that takes place on Christmas Eve, and the Germans, French, and Scottish are trying to make peace one night and they bury their dead and they play football. I play a German opera singer, in German, which I never have so I am really excited about that.
17403.name: Diane Kruger

17404.quote: I'm not a very good impersonator, my friends maybe, but not famous people.
17404.name: Diane Kruger

17405.quote: It wasn't glamorous in my day. In the regions, reporters were seen as such low life that they didn't merit their name in the Radio Times. Now people are interested in being famous. I never gave it a thought.
17405.name: Kate Adie

17406.quote: I never dreamt of being a musician for my livelihood. I certainly never would have wanted to be in the business that I'm in, meaning the fame and the glory, the glitter, the rock star, the famous part.
17406.name: Eddie Van Halen

17407.quote: I'm as famous as I want to be.
17407.name: Tracey Ullman

17408.quote: Computers are famous for being able to do complicated things starting from simple programs.
17408.name: Seth Lloyd

17409.quote: The Bronx is famous for two things. Hip-hop, and 26 world championships.
17409.name: Kurtis Blow

17410.quote: I wanted to be famous. I wanted people to talk about me.
17410.name: Haile Gebrselassie

17411.quote: I know I have this level of celebrity, of fame, international, national, whatever you want to call it, but it's a pretty surreal thing to think sometimes that you're in the middle of another famous person's life and you think to yourself, 'How the hell did I get famous? What is this some weird club that we're in?'
17411.name: Kevin Costner

17412.quote: Fact is, famous people say fame stinks because they love it so - like a secret restaurant or holiday island they don't want the hoi polloi to get their grubby paws on.
17412.name: Julie Burchill

17413.quote: Yeah, I like to be the maker of the art. And I like and want the money. But I don't really dig being famous.
17413.name: Liz Phair

17414.quote: Be very clear as to what your dream is. Nowadays it is fairly certain that 90 percent of all actors really just want to be rich and famous as the solution to all that ails.
17414.name: Dirk Benedict

17415.quote: I'm famous today. People like me today. Might not like me tomorrow. You can't count on it.
17415.name: Dave Chappelle

17416.quote: I'm glad that my parents missed one thing that was really unbelievable. They saw me hit this great success. It was a blast and we had a lot of laughs. And it was just an amazing time. They passed away. And then after I got, you know, famous, all these haters came out of nowhere.
17416.name: Dane Cook

17417.quote: As a famous person you think how you're gonna end it, get away and have a normal life.
17417.name: Gwen Stefani

17418.quote: If I wasn't even famous or had any success, I would still wake up and put tons of make-up on, and put on a cool outfit. That's always been who I've been my whole life, so that's never gonna change. I love fashion. I love getting dressed up. I love Halloween, too.
17418.name: Gwen Stefani

17419.quote: There is less pressure as a character actor. It generally means that you will be acting for all of your life, which is my intention. It is not my intention to just be a rich and famous person, that would be pretty boring.
17419.name: Tim Roth

17420.quote: I felt so painfully isolated that I vowed I would get revenge on the world by becoming a famous cartoonist.
17420.name: Robert Crumb

17421.quote: I really don't know anything else because my brothers were famous when I was two years old. So I know nothing else, no other life.
17421.name: Janet Jackson

17422.quote: If somebody for some reason, for music or for movie, becomes famous, it's because they have something, something special.
17422.name: Roberto Cavalli

17423.quote: The press attack people to sell more papers without thinking, but when you get famous you have to put up with this kind of stuff.
17423.name: Roberto Cavalli

17424.quote: There are people who appear in the magazines and I don't know who they are. I've never seen anything they've done and their careers are over already. They're famous for maybe 10 minutes. Real careers, I think, take a long time to unfold.
17424.name: Matt Damon

17425.quote: I've only ever wanted to be a singer I never wanted to be famous.
17425.name: Katherine Jenkins

17426.quote: Because I think in order to get famous you have to be known for something. Like 'You're the romantic comedy girl' or 'You're the Oscar-winning whatever girl.'
17426.name: Rachel Weisz

17427.quote: Our top story tonight: Famous TV dolphin flipper was arrested today on prostitution ring charges. He allegedly was seen transporting two 16 year olds across state line for immoral porpoises.
17427.name: Colin Mochrie

17428.quote: I never wanted to be a celebrity I never wanted to be famous. And in my daily life, I work really hard to not trade on it in any way.
17428.name: Sarah Jessica Parker

17429.quote: I mean I was famous for nothing.
17429.name: Rick Springfield

17430.quote: I didn't want kids to think that to be happy, they had to be famous or rich or live in the big city.
17430.name: Dan Savage

17431.quote: Becoming famous is a strange thing in your own right.
17431.name: Carnie Wilson

17432.quote: When you see a fantastic colour or cut in a magazine, perched up on some famous so-and-so's head, it's tempting to ask your stylist for the same, but do not be fooled. The hair in those fancy photos can be very high maintenance.
17432.name: Beth Ditto

17433.quote: I don't feel famous and I didn't want my autobiography to be like a Paris Hilton story.
17433.name: Beth Ditto

17434.quote: I always loved working as an actress, but I didn't understand why I couldn't just opt out of being famous. And then I realized you can, and I think I did. And eventually, I came to understand that you can do that and also keep working.
17434.name: Debra Winger

17435.quote: I would like to prove that on TV, everyday lives can be as compelling as the life-styles of the rich and famous. Especially lives that we catch at extraordinary moments.
17435.name: Jane Pauley

17436.quote: I would be a huge hypocrite if I didn't tell you that at one time in my life I thought the way that you made music was you got on a major label and you got famous.
17436.name: Neko Case

17437.quote: We need to teach our kids, because there is such a celebrity culture at the moment, that however rich you are, however famous you are, however glamorous you are, everyone has to live by the same rules.
17437.name: Nick Clegg

17438.quote: I don't have many famous friends, really, except Simon Cowell.
17438.name: Leona Lewis

17439.quote: Usually when I see someone famous, for some reason, I think I know them.
17439.name: Leona Lewis

17440.quote: My goal was just to work regularly. I didn't ever expect to be rich or famous. I wanted to be a working character actor.
17440.name: Harrison Ford

17441.quote: I got the famous Oprah hug!
17441.name: Taylor Lautner

17442.quote: There are hundreds of Frank Lloyd Wright buildings around the United States and in other countries, too. Wright lived into his 90s, and one of his most famous buildings, the Guggenheim Museum in New York, was completed just before his death. Wright buildings look like Wright buildings - that is their paradox.
17442.name: Jane Smiley

17443.quote: I became famous so quickly and so young - it was daunting. I was immature and I used to say some really stupid things in interviews. I never smiled on stage so I looked really serious, but it was because I hated my teeth and was incredibly nervous.
17443.name: Gary Numan
