18543.quote: Less base the fear of death than fear of life.
18543.name: Edward Young

18544.quote: I call on the Iranian people: it is not too late to replace the corrupt regime and return to your glorious Persian heritage, a heritage of culture and values and not of bombs and missiles, How can a nation allow a regime to instill fear, take away the people's freedom and shock the young generation that seeks its way out of the dictatorial Iran.
18544.name: Shimon Peres

18545.quote: I wish there were more true conversion, and then there would not be so much backsliding, and, for fear of suffering, living at ease, when there are so few to contend for Christ and His cause.
18545.name: Donald Cargill

18546.quote: Fear not and the God of mercies grant a full gale and a fair entry into His kingdom, which may carry sweetly and swiftly over the bar, that you find not the rub of death.
18546.name: Donald Cargill

18547.quote: I wish to be a martyr, and I don't fear death.
18547.name: Muqtada al Sadr

18548.quote: I don't have a fear of flying I have a fear of crashing.
18548.name: Billy Bob Thornton

18549.quote: Fear of death has never played a large part in my consciousness - perhaps unimaginative of me.
18549.name: A. N. Wilson

18550.quote: I might be deceiving myself but I do not think that I do have an inordinate fear of death.
18550.name: A. N. Wilson

18551.quote: On the one hand Twitter gives you the opportunity to engage with people, which is great, but on the other there are people who feel they can say whatever they want, put poison out there, really, without fear of any repercussions.
18551.name: Michael Sheen

18552.quote: Americans need never fear their government because of the advantage of being armed, which the Americans possess over the people of almost every other nation.
18552.name: Gouverneur Morris

18553.quote: Today it is not big business that we have to fear. It is big government.
18553.name: Wendell Phillips

18555.quote: If you have stage fright, it never goes away. But then I wonder: is the key to that magical performance because of the fear?
18555.name: Stevie Nicks

18556.quote: For me it's important to be in balance. To not let fear get in the way of things, to not worry so much about protecting yourself all the time.
18556.name: John Frusciante

18557.quote: Fear is always a good motivator.
18557.name: James Dyson

18558.quote: What our children have to fear is not the cars on the highways of tomorrow but our own pleasure in calculating the most elegant parameters of their deaths.
18558.name: J. G. Ballard

18559.quote: We are near, very near, to an end to the eurozone crisis, The worst - in the sense of the fear of the eurozone breaking up - is over. But the best isn't there yet.
18559.name: Francois Hollande

18560.quote: You always have this fear in a movie of just being somebody's woman.
18560.name: Charlize Theron

18561.quote: Perhaps we don't need these religious concoctions to pillow the fear of death. Just the fact that there is an unknown, and something greater, can bring a feeling of peace. That's enough for me.
18561.name: Brad Pitt

18562.quote: That might have a lot to do with it, but you know, I probably don't show fear, but I suffer from fear like everyone else.
18562.name: Steve Irwin

18563.quote: Honest to God, all my life I have had such a fear of spiders. In fact, I use to have a reoccurring dream about one. Very clearly, it was black with a red head. It would sit up in the corner of the bedroom and when it started getting closer, I would wake up in a panic.
18563.name: Tippi Hedren

18564.quote: You have to have fear to take risks - and I want to at least try.
18564.name: Seann William Scott

18565.quote: You live in this shadow that you're going to burn in Hell until you're saved. And I still worry about it a little. I don't believe in Heaven, but I do still fear Hell.
18565.name: Beth Ditto

18566.quote: As with most phobias, the fear of flying does make some sense, but if ever there was a fear worth quashing then this is it. After all, life is short, and there's a great big world to explore out there.
18566.name: Beth Ditto

18567.quote: You can't operate a company by fear, because the way to eliminate fear is to avoid criticism. And the way to avoid criticism is to do nothing.
18567.name: Steve Ross

18568.quote: I always have the fear that, if I don't commit 100 percent to my work, then it's gonna suffer.
18568.name: Joaquin Phoenix

18569.quote: Going to parties usually makes me feel depressed, just because I have such social fear after meeting people.
18569.name: Florence Welch

18570.quote: I'm completely in love with the world but also terrified of it. It creates some overwhelming feelings. Wanting to battle out that joy and fear is part of my music.
18570.name: Florence Welch

18571.quote: I'd gone from being this art student messing about with music to this girl with a record deal, magazine front covers and all this hype. In many ways, it was everything I ever wanted, but when it happened all I felt was total, paralysing fear.
18571.name: Florence Welch

18572.quote: Why do people do things that they fear? It may be that the fear contains information. Something can be interesting if you get to the other side of that fear.
18572.name: Craig Ferguson

18573.quote: Fear and pain and suffering is not OK for any being to feel intentionally at the hands of us.
18573.name: Leona Lewis

18574.quote: My fear is that, as soon as I get married and have kids that I'll kind of do what a lot of people do and suddenly start making, 'Now I'm gonna make films for kids.' I really hope I don't do that.
18574.name: Trey Parker

18575.quote: Freedom is contagious. That's why despots fear it so much.
18575.name: Bill Owens

18576.quote: I began to fear that Mos Def was being treated as a product, not a person, so I've been going by Yasiin since '99. At first it was just for friends and family, but now I'm declaring it openly.
18576.name: Mos Def

18577.quote: I find writing very difficult. It's hard and it hurts sometimes, and it's scary because of the fear of failure and the very unpleasant feeling that you may have reached the limit of your abilities.
18577.name: Tony Kushner

18578.quote: Respect and fear are two different things.
18578.name: Jane Smiley

18579.quote: The thing about Republicans is that they don't care so much about respect, but they love fear, at least in others.
18579.name: Jane Smiley

18580.quote: A writer of fiction lives in fear. Each new day demands new ideas and he can never be sure whether he is going to come up with them or not.
18580.name: Roald Dahl

18581.quote: I think we have lost our groove as a country. One of the reasons was the attack on 9/11. We got knocked off our game. From a country that always exported hope we went into the business of exporting fear.
18581.name: Thomas Friedman

18582.quote: The injury that we do to a man must be such that we need not fear his vengeance.
18582.name: Steve Perry

18583.quote: There is no nation so powerful, as the one that obeys its laws not from principals of fear or reason, but from passion.
18583.name: Charles de Montesquieu

18584.quote: I have now taken a serious task upon myself and I fear a greater one that is in the power of any man to perform in the given time-but it is too late to go back.
18584.name: Eli Whitney

18585.quote: Whenever there is fear, you will get wrong figures.
18585.name: W. Edwards Deming

18586.quote: All the times I've been lucky enough to be a part of a show that's actually gotten on the air, it's always that same mixture of excitement and utter fear.
18586.name: J. J. Abrams

18587.quote: We have not sought this conflict we have sought too long to avoid it our forbearance has been construed into weakness, our magnanimity into fear, until the vindication of our manhood, as well as the defence of our rights, is required at our hands.
18587.name: Robert Toombs

18588.quote: There are no guarantees. From the viewpoint of fear, none are strong enough. From the viewpoint of love, none are necessary.
18588.name: Emmanuel Teney

18589.quote: Fear not that thy life shall come to an end, but rather that it shall never have a beginning.
18589.name: John Henry Newman

18590.quote: He doesn't know the meaning of the word fear, but then again he doesn't know the meaning of most words.
18590.name: Bobby Bowden

18591.quote: People have a fear of the unknown. Insects have different senses than us, different amount of limbs and their body structure is very different. It's hard for us to really relate to them and understand them.
18591.name: Dominic Monaghan

18592.quote: I fear that our true motivation is about oil and our own flailing economy about the failure to destroy Al Qaeda and about revenge.
18592.name: Dave Matthews

18593.quote: Defeat the fear of death and welcome the death of fear.
18593.name: G. Gordon Liddy

18594.quote: With their souls of patent leather, they come down the road. Hunched and nocturnal, where they breathe they impose, silence of dark rubber, and fear of fine sand.
18594.name: Federico Garcia Lorca

18595.quote: There are only three sins - causing pain, causing fear, and causing anguish. The rest is window dressing.
18595.name: Roger Caras

18597.quote: I thought Erica Jong's Fear of Flying was one of the biggest pieces of crap that I've ever read in my life.
18597.name: Helen Reddy

18598.quote: In the '80s, I was putting out an album virtually every year, I think mostly based on fear - that if I didn't, people would soon forget about me.
18598.name: Al Yankovic

18599.quote: Somehow we can't live outside the politics of race. There's something very deep in all of us, that is taught to us when we are very, very little. Which is the disrespect and fear of the other.
18599.name: Anna Deavere Smith

18600.quote: Being brave isn't the absence of fear. Being brave is having that fear but finding a way through it.
18600.name: Bear Grylls

18601.quote: You're not human if you don't feel fear. But I've learnt to treat fear as an emotion that sharpens me. It's there to give me that edge for what I have to do.
18601.name: Bear Grylls

18602.quote: I live my life through fear. If I'm afraid of it I'll do it just so I'm not afraid of it anymore.
18602.name: Jeremy Renner

18603.quote: I talk to women's groups all over the country and see women struggling with this. The fear of not being accepted, of being different, of not having a man, all make it hard for a woman to do what she really believes is right for her.
18603.name: Olympia Dukakis

18604.quote: I am very interested in what has been called bad taste. I believe the fear of displaying a soi-disant bad taste stops us from venturing into special cultural zones.
18604.name: Manuel Puig

18605.quote: So then learn to conquer your fear. This is the only art we have to master nowadays: to look at things without fear, and to fearlessly do right.
18605.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

18607.quote: Discipline strengthens the mind so that it becomes impervious to the corroding influence of fear.
18607.name: Bernard Law Montgomery

18608.quote: It is because I believe that it is in the power of such nations to lead the world back into the paths of peace that I propose to devote myself to explaining what, in my opinion, can and should be done to banish the fear of war that hangs so heavily over the world.
18608.name: Arthur Henderson

18609.quote: Terrorism is a psychological warfare. Terrorists try to manipulate us and change our behavior by creating fear, uncertainty, and division in society.
18609.name: Patrick J. Kennedy

18610.quote: I didn't want to be on the losing side. I was fed up with Jewish weakness, timidity and fear. I didn't want any more Jewish sentimentality and Jewish suffering. I was sickened by our sad songs.
18610.name: Lionel Blue

18611.quote: Peace, if it ever exists, will not be based on the fear of war but on the love of peace.
18611.name: Julien Benda

18612.quote: Necessity of action takes away the fear of the act, and makes bold resolution the favorite of fortune.
18612.name: Francis Quarles

18613.quote: Democracy is stronger than terrorism, and we will not cower to the terrorists' campaign of fear.
18613.name: John Doolittle

18614.quote: I live in a kind of controlled awareness. I wouldn't call it fear, but it's an awareness. I know I have a responsibility to behave in a certain way. I'm able to do that.
18614.name: Mary Tyler Moore

18615.quote: I fear that the rising personal bankruptcies and repossessions are the first signs of bigger problems to come and personal debt - Gordon Brown's legacy to millions of Britain's families - will hang like a millstone around the neck of the British people for years to come.
18615.name: Vince Cable

18616.quote: Fear is a huge thing for older people.
18616.name: James Hillman

18617.quote: The elimination of the fear of death transforms the individual's way of being in the world.
18617.name: Stanislav Grof

18618.quote: Dying before dying has two important consequences: It liberates the individual from the fear of death and influences the actual experience of dying at the time of biological demise.
18618.name: Stanislav Grof

18619.quote: One of the darkest, deepest shames so many of us mothers feel nowadays is our fear that we are Bad Mothers, that we are failing our children and falling far short of our own ideals.
18619.name: Ayelet Waldman

18620.quote: By presenting a faithful and honest record of my experience as a mother, I hope to show both my readers and my children how truth can redeem even what you fear might be the gravest of sins.
18620.name: Ayelet Waldman

18621.quote: The thing about youthful offenders is that no one seems to care about them. Most people don't like adolescents - even the good ones can be snarky and unpleasant. Combine the antipathy we feel toward the average teenager with the fear inspired by youth violence, and you have a population that no one wants to deal with.
18621.name: Ayelet Waldman

18622.quote: Another parent's different approach raises the possibility that you've made a mistake with your child. We simply can't tolerate that because we fear that any mistake, no matter how minor, could have devastating consequences. So we proclaim the superiority of our own choices. We've lost sight of the fact that people have preferences.
18622.name: Ayelet Waldman

18623.quote: Fear and greed are potent motivators. When both of these forces push in the same direction, virtually no human being can resist.
18623.name: Andrew Weil

18624.quote: We all struggle with our failure to communicate and our failure to reach beyond fear to love people.
18624.name: Mira Sorvino

18625.quote: You live with the fear people might find out. Then you actually have the courage to tell people and they go, I don't think you are gay. It's enough to drive you crazy.
18625.name: Portia de Rossi

18626.quote: More than fantasy or even science fiction, Ray Bradbury wrote horror, and like so many great horror writers he was himself utterly without fear, of anything. He wasn't afraid of looking uncool - he wasn't scared to openly love innocence, or to be optimistic, or to write sentimentally when he felt that way.
18626.name: Lev Grossman

18627.quote: There is the fear, common to all English-only speakers, that the chief purpose of foreign languages is to make fun of us. Otherwise, you know, why not just come out and say it?
18627.name: Barbara Ehrenreich

18628.quote: President Obama's 100-day plan is pretty impressive. I think it's a Wow 100-plus days. The administration is not operating from fear, it is trying to drive change for the future, and that's a good thing.
18628.name: Andrea Jung

18629.quote: I have a pathological fear of being on my own. When I'm with my own thoughts, I start to unravel myself, and I start to think really dark thoughts, self-destructive thoughts.
18629.name: David Walliams

18630.quote: I don't have a fear factor. Well, not much of one. And I'm willing to risk quite a lot - as a comedian, you're always risking a lot. You're risking failure, especially if you're improvising and going on TV shows trying to make comedy out of thin air. That is quite a risky business.
18630.name: David Walliams

18631.quote: It's the opinion of some that crops could be grown on the moon which raises the fear that it may not be long before we're paying somebody not to.
18631.name: Franklin P. Jones

18632.quote: Fear can make all of us do the wrong things sometimes.
18632.name: Vanessa Paradis

18633.quote: I fear only God, all praises to Him.
18633.name: Muqtada al Sadr

18634.quote: You know, Stephen says, in the movies no one ever goes to the bathroom. They shave, they brush their teeth. He goes right at this sort of funny taboo we have about the bathroom, and he turned it into this nightmare, you know, your worst fear of what's in there.
18634.name: Lawrence Kasdan

18635.quote: My biggest fear ever is to be involved in a plane crash, so when that happened, well, I'm just thankful to be alive. I'm just grateful to be here at all.
18635.name: Travis Barker

18636.quote: Libertarians know that a free country has nothing to fear from anyone coming in or going out - while a welfare state is scared to death of poor people coming in and rich people getting out.
18636.name: Harry Browne

18637.quote: Hey, we all have our fear. Mine is bugs and lobsters!
18637.name: Brooke Burke

18638.quote: There are people who never experience that, who remain closed until death, from fear of change.
18638.name: Isabelle Adjani

18639.quote: The biggest fear I have is to die with regrets, and of course that will come true.
18639.name: Alexander Payne

18640.quote: If you don't go towards the thing you fear, you won't be able to say you lived.
18640.name: Sherri Shepherd

18641.quote: I wish I had less fear about creating my own parts.
18641.name: Kristen Wiig

18642.quote: I'd make a terrible surgeon. The fear of blood? Very high on my list.
18642.name: Kristen Wiig

18643.quote: I could write an entertaining novel about rejection slips, but I fear it would be overly long.
18643.name: Louise Brown

18644.quote: Not one has shown an iota of fear of death. They want to end this agony.
18644.name: Jack Kevorkian

18645.quote: We Hoosiers hold to some quaint notions. Some might say we 'cling' to them, though not out of fear or ignorance. We believe in paying our bills. We have kept our state in the black throughout the recent unpleasantness, while cutting rather than raising taxes, by practicing an old tribal ritual - we spend less money than we take in.
18645.name: Mitch Daniels

18646.quote: The vehemence with which certain critics have chosen not simply to criticize what I've written, but to challenge my writing this story at all, speaks of what the book is about: fear of disapproval.
18646.name: Joyce Maynard

18647.quote: I say let's go back to a truer use of the word 'freedom.' Let's start with President Franklin Roosevelt's Four Freedoms: freedom of speech and expression, freedom of worship, freedom from want and freedom from fear. I would add the freedom to bargain collectively. Those freedoms are under attack today.
18647.name: Richard Trumka

18648.quote: When we are unwilling to draw clear moral lines between free societies and fear societies, when we are unwilling to call the former good and the latter evil, we will not be able to advance the cause of peace because peace cannot be disconnected from freedom.
18648.name: Natan Sharansky

18649.quote: You know that day after day of, Oh God what am I going to do with myself feeling? The fear of the emptiness that it implies keeps me going.
18649.name: Anish Kapoor

18650.quote: I find fear is a great motivator to work hard.
18650.name: Greg Kinnear

18651.quote: They did interviews with my wife and daughter-they were genuinely in fear of me having a heart attack, working 20 hours a day, eating fast food.
18651.name: Willie Aames

18652.quote: There was a real fear that a euro-zone bank might fail, that we'd have a sovereign debt problem in one of the larger European economies. That's dissipated, thanks largely to the action of the European Central Bank.
18652.name: George Osborne

18653.quote: We poison our lives with fear of burglary and shipwreck, and, ask anyone, the house is never burgled, and the ship never goes down.
18653.name: Jean Anouilh

18654.quote: When men don't fear God, they give themselves to evil.
18654.name: Ray Comfort

18655.quote: I cannot give a single concert at which I do not play one piece after the other in an agony of terror because my memory threatens to fail me. This fear torments me for days beforehand.
18655.name: Clara Schumann

18656.quote: Worry does not mean fear, but readiness for the confrontation.
18656.name: Bashar al-Assad

18657.quote: Hope thou not much, and fear thou not at all.
18657.name: Algernon Charles Swinburne

18658.quote: We must have our say, not through violence, aggression or fear. We must speak out calmly and forcefully. We shall only be able to enter the new world era if we agree to engage in dialogue with the other side.
18658.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

18659.quote: People with bad consciences always fear the judgment of children.
18659.name: Mary McCarthy

18660.quote: As one who participated in all the wars of the state of Israel, I saw the horror of wars. I saw the fear of wars. I saw my best friends being killed in battles. I was seriously injured twice.
18660.name: Ariel Sharon

18661.quote: The world has nothing to fear from military ambition in our Government.
18661.name: James K. Polk

18662.quote: I fear other actors who are not prepared. And I fear directors who are afraid.
18662.name: Tommy Lee Jones

18663.quote: I don't think that anyone seriously fears that the world can be blown to pieces all together. But what one can fear and rightly so are regional things, like in the Middle East, India, Pakistan, the Korean Peninsula, borders in Africa, etc.
18663.name: Hans Blix

18664.quote: Change creates fear, and technology creates change. Sadly, most people don't behave very well when they are afraid.
18664.name: Daniel H. Wilson

18665.quote: Part of what Special Olympics is trying to do is break down stereotypes that still exist for people. There is still a lot of fear.
18665.name: Maria Shriver

18666.quote: The fear of the never-ending onslaught of gizmos and gadgets is nothing new. The radio, the telephone, Facebook - each of these inventions changed the world. Each of them scared the heck out of an older generation. And each of them was invented by people who were in their 20s.
18666.name: Daniel H. Wilson

18667.quote: I have a fear of poverty in old age. I have this vision of myself living in a skip and eating cat food. It's because I'm freelance, and I've never had a proper job. I don't have a pension, and my savings are dwindling. I always thought someone would just come along and look after me.
18667.name: Jenny Eclair

18668.quote: Let children read whatever they want and then talk about it with them. If parents and kids can talk together, we won't have as much censorship because we won't have as much fear.
18668.name: Judy Blume

18669.quote: The books that will never be read. And all due to the fear of censorship. As always, young readers will be the real losers.
18669.name: Judy Blume

18670.quote: There's so much fear involved in trying to do something you don't know how to do that drugs and alcohol can become a big part of your life if you have an addictive personality or are very unsure, which most songwriters are.
18670.name: Barry Mann

18671.quote: The things you fear are undefeatable, not by their nature, but by your approach.
18671.name: Jewel

18672.quote: I live in constant fear of being fired or dropped for that dark part of my work I can't control.
18672.name: Lynda Barry

18673.quote: The fear for a network is the viewer gets tired of you. Not that you lost any credibility, but they get tired of you.
18673.name: Terry Bradshaw

18674.quote: But with the right kind of coaching and determination you can accomplish anything and the biggest accomplishment that I feel I got from the film was overcoming that fear.
18674.name: Reese Witherspoon

18675.quote: We've all had that fear, that despair of losing someone, or this fierce desire because it's not reciprocated. The less reciprocation there is, the more desire we have.
18675.name: Emmanuelle Beart

18676.quote: I won't touch on risky, because that's subjective. People are just afraid of things too much. Afraid of things that don't necessarily merit fear.
18676.name: Frank Ocean

18677.quote: He who has conquered doubt and fear has conquered failure.
18677.name: James Lane Allen

18678.quote: I don't want to wake up and be bored. That's probably my greatest fear is to have nothing to do. What better job is there than to play quarterback for an NFL team, and certainly one that I've been on for a long time and had success with? I don't plan on giving it up any time soon.
18678.name: Tom Brady

18679.quote: I'm not the type of person to live in fear. I think positively.
18679.name: David Guetta

18680.quote: Sides are being divided now. It's very obvious. So if you're on the other side of the fence, you're suddenly anti-American. It's breeding fear of being on the wrong side.
18680.name: Sam Shepard

18681.quote: There is a lot of hype and fear about this much-talked-about prospect of designer babies.
18681.name: Leon Kass

18682.quote: You don't want too much fear in a market, because people will be blinded to some very good buying opportunities. You don't want too much complacency because people will be blinded to some risk.
18682.name: Ron Chernow

18683.quote: There is a kind of fear, approaching a panic, that's spreading through the Baby Boom Generation, which has suddenly discovered that it will have to provide for its own retirement.
18683.name: Ron Chernow

18684.quote: Part of the reason that the government's fear mongering is succeeding is because so many people are so ignorant, that it is easier for government to frighten people in submission.
18684.name: James Bovard

18686.quote: Defeat the fear of death and you welcome the death of fear.
18686.name: G. Gordon Liddy

18687.quote: There is a fear of emotion in tennis.
18687.name: Andy Murray

18688.quote: Forty years ago this country went down a rabbit hole in Vietnam and millions died. I fear we're going down a rabbit hole once again - and if people can stop and think and reflect on some of the ideas and issues in this movie, perhaps I've done some damn good here!
18688.name: Errol Morris

18689.quote: In tennis, it is not the opponent you fear, it is the failure itself, knowing how near you were but just out of reach.
18689.name: Andy Murray

18690.quote: The independent girl is a person before whose wrath only the most rash dare stand, and, they, it must be confessed, with much fear and trembling.
18690.name: Lou Henry Hoover

18691.quote: Hunger and fear are the only realities in dog life: an empty stomach makes a fierce dog.
18691.name: Robert Falcon Scott

18692.quote: The only men who aren't in fear of women's reactions are usually men who aren't born or who are dead.
18692.name: Warren Farrell

18693.quote: My only problem is the fear that opposition bowlers might go for my fingers and that's why I was scared of the short ball. Now I am struggling with the ball pitching up and swinging away. I just keep nicking that one.
18693.name: Shane Warne

18694.quote: A line from one of my 1997 columns - 'Do one thing every day that scares you' - is now widely attributed to Eleanor Roosevelt, though I have yet to see any evidence that she ever said it and I don't believe she did. She said some things about fear, but not that thing.
18694.name: Mary Schmich

18695.quote: A lot of children, like I did, move away from words because of the fear - which is something you have to take out of education: the fear of worrying about what marks you'll get, detention, worrying about letting people down, your parents, teachers.
18695.name: Michael Morpurgo

18696.quote: I am grateful that I didn't let fear get the best of me. It only holds you back from possibilities and greatness.
18696.name: Mariska Hargitay

18697.quote: You've got to kick fear to the side, because the payoff is huge.
18697.name: Mariska Hargitay

18698.quote: My greatest desire is that the hope that has overcome fear in my country will help vanquish it around the world.
18698.name: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva

18699.quote: In masks outrageous and austere, The years go by in single file But none has merited my fear, And none has quite escaped my smile.
18699.name: Elinor Wylie

18700.quote: Fear created the first gods in the world.
18700.name: Caecilius Statius

18701.quote: What's powerful about a love scene is not seeing the act. It's seeing the passion, the need, the desire, the caring, the fear.
18701.name: Patrick Swayze

18702.quote: But to be the best, you must face the best. And to overcome your fear, you must deal with the best.
18702.name: Barry Bonds

18703.quote: The way you deal with a scare is the way you deal with a laugh. The timing has to be perfect. When you're dealing with fear or laughter - emotions that happen spontaneously - you hope it's working. But in the moment, you really have no idea.
18703.name: Patrick Wilson

18704.quote: It is said that those whom the gods wish to destroy they first make mad. It may well be that a war neurosis stirred up by propaganda of fear and hatred is the prelude to destruction.
18704.name: John Boyd Orr

18705.quote: To drive an F1 car you have to be a little mad. On the morning of a race there's a mix of excitement and fear. If it's a wet track, then it's worse as you're not in control most of the time, which is the thing all drivers fear the most.
18705.name: Jenson Button

18706.quote: My biggest fear in life is to be average.
18706.name: M. Night Shyamalan

18707.quote: When you say 'fear of the unknown', that is the definition of fear fear is the unknown, fear is what you do not know, and it's genetically within us so that we feel safe. We feel scared of the woods because we're not familiar with it, and that keeps you safe.
18707.name: M. Night Shyamalan

18708.quote: Why fear death? It is the most beautiful adventure in life.

18884.quote: One of the things I've always enjoyed is moving around and staying fit. Physicality is such a big part of being an actor, but it's also about stillness and silence.
18884.name: Joel Edgerton

18885.quote: Clearly, society has a tremendous stake in insisting on a woman's natural fitness for the career of mother: the alternatives are all too expensive.
18885.name: Ann Oakley

18886.quote: To enjoy the glow of good health, you must exercise.
18886.name: Gene Tunney

18887.quote: It's not about weight, it's about fitness, and one component of being fit is to have relatively low body fat, because fat is not very efficient, whereas muscle is.
18887.name: Deborah Bull

18888.quote: The only weights I lift are my dogs.
18888.name: Olivia Newton-John

18889.quote: Training is such a vital part of preparation for a game, you really do train to play. It tops up your ability, like sharpening a carving knife. You can get away with not doing it for a while, as long as you have reached a certain standard of fitness.
18889.name: Graeme Le Saux

18890.quote: I love to swim for miles I could just go back and forth.
18890.name: Jill Clayburgh

18891.quote: The groundwork of all happiness is health.
18891.name: Leigh Hunt

18892.quote: I like exercise. I like a healthy body.
18892.name: Erin Gray

18893.quote: You need to eat normally and healthfully, and you need to exercise. I'm so passionate about this because I think people spend their lives not happy in their bodies.
18893.name: Courtney Thorne Smith

18894.quote: I'm still very professional about my fitness. I stay in trim as I always did.
18894.name: Peter Shilton

18895.quote: In terms of fitness and battling through cancer, exercise helps you stay strong physically and mentally.
18895.name: Grete Waitz

18896.quote: And you know, the baby boomers are getting older, and those off the rack clothes are just not fitting right any longer, and so, tailor-made suits are coming back into fashion.
18896.name: Amy Irving

18897.quote: Like most people I can be lazy, so it's nice to have a goal or deadline or reason to work out. I feel better when I get to exercise, or when I'm outdoors. I like to hike, swim and run, and I love to play soccer.
18897.name: Viggo Mortensen

18898.quote: For exercise, I now run with my chocolate Lab puppy, Oscar.
18898.name: Daniela Pestova

18899.quote: I concentrate on exercises from the waist down, since that is the laziest part of a woman's body.
18899.name: Tina Louise

18900.quote: 15 minutes a day! Give me just this and I'll prove I can make you a new man.
18900.name: Charles Atlas

18901.quote: I love Nautilus and stretching. The results are immediate, and that gives me the motivation to continue.
18901.name: Donna Dixon

18902.quote: Parentage is a very important profession, but no test of fitness for it is ever imposed in the interest of the children.
18902.name: George Bernard Shaw

18903.quote: For whatever reason, maybe it's because of my story, but people associate Livestrong with exercise and physical fitness, health and lifestyle choices like that.
18903.name: Lance Armstrong

18904.quote: Obviously, I come from one background, and the people that design fitness equipment have been doing it for years and years, and they know what works and doesn't work.
18904.name: Lance Armstrong

18905.quote: If I don't feel confident about my body, I'm not going to sit at home and feel sorry for myself and not do something about it. It's all about taking action and not being lazy. So you do the work, whether it's fitness or whatever. It's about getting up, motivating yourself and just doing it.
18905.name: Kim Kardashian

18906.quote: No one's ever achieved financial fitness with a January resolution that's abandoned by February.
18906.name: Suze Orman

18907.quote: The most important quality in a leader is that of being acknowledged as such. All leaders whose fitness is questioned are clearly lacking in force.
18907.name: Andre Maurois

18908.quote: My weight fluctuates depending on my mood and my current devotion to my fitness routine.
18908.name: Lena Dunham

18909.quote: At the start of his second term, one wonders less about Obama's fitness than his willingness: Why doesn't he do more to build and maintain the relationships required to govern in era of polarization?
18909.name: Ron Fournier

18910.quote: Family involvement is a valuable thing and playing together actively can be the '90s version of it. Instead of just watching, you can do it together, something we don't spend enough time on. We can motivate and excite each other about fitness.
18910.name: Alan Thicke

18911.quote: As a father, my first priority is to help my sons set and attain personal goals so they will develop self-confidence and individual strength. Engaging in regular fitness activities with my children helps me fulfill those responsibilities.
18911.name: Alan Thicke

18912.quote: I think fitness is important. I think a healthy lifestyle is important. I think putting positive energy out there is important and just staying connected with the people.
18912.name: LL Cool J

18913.quote: I suffer panic attacks which has made me really conscious about my fitness and I have become addicted to jogging. It might sound odd but a lot of good has come out of it. My fans send letters saying they have taken up jogging because I do it.
18913.name: Ellie Goulding

18914.quote: I'm doing four hours of gymnastics training a day, six days a week and then an extra two to three hours in a fitness center as well.
18914.name: Shawn Johnson

18915.quote: We talk a lot on 'Biggest Loser' about how fitness is a natural antidepressant, how it burns off stress. What I like about running is that it gives me time alone. I'm always busy, with people at work, with my kids. I love getting out for a run by myself and just listening to my music.
18915.name: Alison Sweeney

18916.quote: Fitness is a luxury when you are busy!
18916.name: Lauren Conrad

18917.quote: I can jog, but I can't run. That's hard for me. I like the fact that I can jog for fitness, but to me there's a huge difference between jogging and running.
18917.name: Mary Decker

18918.quote: Teaching kids about health and fitness is important to me. It's about being fit for life.
18918.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

18919.quote: A life coach does for the rest of your life what a personal trainer does for your health and fitness.
18919.name: Elaine MacDonald

18920.quote: Our children are obese, either have or being threatened by diabetes, high blood pressure, high cholesterol, and not socially adjusting properly to others because of a lack of fitness.
18920.name: Richard Simmons

18921.quote: Oh, and once, when I was in the Marines, I got a perfect score on my physical fitness test.
18921.name: Drew Carey

18922.quote: Fitness is not an option. It's part of my job.
18922.name: Alison Sweeney

18923.quote: What's wrong with extreme dieting and hard-core fitness plans is that they don't take into account the rest of your life.
18923.name: Alison Sweeney

18924.quote: I recommend that people try new stuff or take new fitness classes all the time. It's important to mix up your routine, not only for your body, but also for your mental state.
18924.name: Alison Sweeney

18925.quote: The public character of every public servant is legitimate subject of discussion, and his fitness or unfitness for office may be fairly canvassed by any person.
18925.name: Charles Babbage

18926.quote: Resting for me is fitness training.
18926.name: Jenson Button

18927.quote: I'm not in the best shape, but I want to prove to myself I can do something that seems insurmountable and inspire others by showing them no matter where they are in their fitness goals, they can do it, too.
18927.name: Ruben Studdard

18928.quote: In the British Special Air Service, combat fitness is all about running.
18928.name: Bear Grylls

18929.quote: I thought I did well for someone who has been out for 10 or 11 months. Then I was sub against Liverpool and tried to play for the guys and work on my fitness.
18929.name: Paul Gascoigne

18930.quote: My fitness trainer's English, my physio's English, some of my friends are English. I don't have a problem with English people at all.
18930.name: Andy Murray

18931.quote: I can't eat whatever I want, definitely not. I'm always controlled because I do a lot of fitness and triathlons, not just Formula One, so I always make sure I eat the right things.
18931.name: Jenson Button

18932.quote: For me, triathlons were something that was down to me and my fitness. Now, I really enjoy the pain in the triathlon of chasing someone down. It's a bit like chasing down Nico Rosberg in the last few laps at Silverstone - it makes you feel alive.
18932.name: Jenson Button

18933.quote: With fitness, I do Bikrams hot yoga. The gym that I have in my building is amazing. I love to do cardio and weights there.
18933.name: Shay Mitchell

18934.quote: They both go together you can't be in front of the camera hosting a fitness television show in front of 75 million households and not have trained 6 days per week year round - in a bikini no less.
18934.name: Kiana Tom

18935.quote: I'm 33 now and I seem to have hit a fitness plane. Shifting the wobbly bits isn't as easy as it used to be.
18935.name: Matthew Rhys

18936.quote: Fitness is a curve. You can be Lance Armstrong, or you can be really out of shape at the opposite end. People enter the curve wherever they are and then they can move up the curve, by better nutrition and better exercise.
18936.name: Gordon Strachan

18937.quote: I try and maintain a little bit of fitness, man.
18937.name: Frank Bruno

18938.quote: As the proud father of two teens and past Chairman to the Presidents Council on Physical Fitness and Sports, I am committed to educating parents and especially young people on ways to live a long, healthy and active life.
18938.name: Lee Haney

18939.quote: I believe it's extremely important to include some other type of fitness activity in your training, so cross training will help you to avoid injury when you are dancing.
18939.name: Laurieann Gibson

18940.quote: I personally love to run outdoor fitness trails. I love the meditative value I get when out alone, challenging myself to run faster and higher.
18940.name: Laurieann Gibson

18941.quote: I like starting off the new year fresh. I'm excited to see how 2013 turns out. Maybe because I'm an actress and I am always on a diet and fitness program, but my New Year's resolution is to let myself be nice to myself about my body.
18941.name: Busy Philipps

18942.quote: I don't want to lose my fitness. I'm 45. I have two babies. I've got a long way to go and I want to keep in tiptop shape. There's no magic bullet.
18942.name: Marcia Cross

18943.quote: The spirit of the Olympic movement is great for young people because it teaches them about the training and discipline required to compete. Even if they don't make the teams, they can rededicate their lives to the art of sport, discipline, and physical fitness.
18943.name: Richard M. Daley

18944.quote: A drunkard in the gutter is just where he ought to be, according to the fitness and tendency of things. Nature has set upon him the process of decline and dissolution by which she removes things which have survived their usefulness.
18944.name: William Graham Sumner

18945.quote: With both kids, I started working out again at 16 days postpartum, but I treated myself with kindness, doing mild workouts, because my fitness level was lower.
18945.name: Gabrielle Reece

18946.quote: The goodness of a thing created is the perfection of its fitness for the use which it serves. Now that use is either particular or universal.
18946.name: William Ames

18947.quote: People may say I developed an iron will, but what really happened is that I made myself much fitter. I think an iron will is always supported by fitness.
18947.name: Ivan Lendl

18948.quote: I'm enjoying myself this year and for once I'm not chasing my fitness.
18948.name: Jamie Redknapp

18949.quote: Overall, I think I'm in pretty good shape, but I'm not really someone that is gung-ho or a fitness fanatic.
18949.name: Cobi Jones

18950.quote: I've always believed fitness is an entry point to help you build that happier, healthier life. When your health is strong, you're capable of taking risks. You'll feel more confident to ask for the promotion. You'll have more energy to be a better mom. You'll feel more deserving of love.
18950.name: Jillian Michaels

18951.quote: My mother was a P.E. teacher, and she was kind of a fanatic about fitness and nutrition growing up, so it was ingrained in me at a young age. As I get older, I'm finding out it's not about getting all buffed up and looking good. It's more about staying healthy and flexible.
18951.name: Josh Duhamel

18952.quote: I have long recognized a link between fitness and mental health and I think we need to encourage young people to take part in sports and team activities because we know it has such positive results.
18952.name: Tipper Gore

18953.quote: My experience as a school nurse taught me that we need to make a concerted effort, all of us, to increase physical fitness activity among our children and to encourage all Americans to adopt a healthier diet that includes fruits and vegetables, but there is more.
18953.name: Lois Capps

18954.quote: I feel if I'm healthy and happy, I look good. With a good mixture of fitness and healthy food I always feel great!
18954.name: Candice Swanepoel

18955.quote: The main thing is that it's nice to see these young people - 9 to 14 years old - take the opportunity to get more involved in their health and fitness. We need more kids to be more active.
18955.name: Rafer Johnson

18956.quote: I have run two Olympic 'A' standard times over the past 12 months and with the time I ran at the African Championships last week I know my speed and fitness are constantly improving so that I will peak in time for the Olympics.
18956.name: Oscar Pistorius

18957.quote: My fitness is good. I hope to improve it even further during training.
18957.name: Andriy Shevchenko

18958.quote: I have been particularly struck with the overwhelming evidence which is given as to the fitness of the natives of India for high offices and employments.
18958.name: Richard Cobden

18959.quote: The health industry, the fitness industry, was really starting to pick up. This was around the mid 80's.
18959.name: Warren Cuccurullo

18960.quote: I do a one-hour workout called Drenched, a cardio-boxing fitness routine, Monday through Friday. There are usually between twenty-five and fifty people there - everyone from stay-at-home moms and professional martial artists to teenagers and seniors. They play great dance music. When I can, I take two classes back-to-back.
18960.name: Carrie Ann Inaba

18961.quote: Flexibility is crucial to my fitness. Incorporating a good warm-up and cool-down into every session decreases my chances of injury. I use both dynamic and static stretching in my training. I've starting doing a few yoga sessions which incorporates muscle strength and flexibility.
18961.name: Samantha Stosur

18962.quote: The value and utility of any experiment are determined by the fitness of the material to the purpose for which it is used, and thus in the case before us it cannot be immaterial what plants are subjected to experiment and in what manner such experiment is conducted.
18962.name: Gregor Mendel

18963.quote: My priority is to turn people - especially kids - on to sports and being active so they don't even have to think about it being good for their health. If people participate for the fun of it, and believe me - it is fun, then fitness programs will be much more successful.
18963.name: Alan Thicke

18964.quote: I think a basic level of fitness can help the body cope with all manner of incidents.
18964.name: Richard Hammond

18965.quote: I have found a flat on Merseyside and am settling down here. If I can keep playing and get back to full match fitness, I know I have a lot to offer still.
18965.name: David Ginola

18966.quote: Now I say that if you run more than 15 miles a week, it's for something other than aerobic fitness. Once you pass 15 miles, you do not see much further improvement.
18966.name: Kenneth H. Cooper

18967.quote: We are involved in youth testing internationally. We want to try to prove without a shadow of a doubt the relationship between physical fitness and health, not just physical fitness and ability to perform.
18967.name: Kenneth H. Cooper

18968.quote: I've had one very bad ankle injury but otherwise I've been incredibly lucky with my fitness. I've worked hard at it and I've always been fit even compared to other players. That sustains you through various parts of your career, but I am 36.
18968.name: Graeme Le Saux

18969.quote: I'm healthy now. I probably wouldn't say I'm at my best fitness level and I haven't played that much lately, but I'm healthy and that's all that matters.
18969.name: Mary Pierce

18970.quote: For years, I always thought it was hilarious that I was this fitness guru, because fitness was just a tool I utilized to help people improve their confidence. For me, it's never been about fitness. It's always been about helping to empower people.
18970.name: Jillian Michaels

18971.quote: I've published one book before, and now I'm writing a book of essays and stories about life in Tokyo. And I have one book coming out in May in Germany, about fitness.
18971.name: Franka Potente

18972.quote: Guided only by their feeling for symmetry, simplicity, and generality, and an indefinable sense of the fitness of things, creative mathematicians now, as in the past, are inspired by the art of mathematics rather than by any prospect of ultimate usefulness.
18972.name: E. T. Bell

18973.quote: For a good workout, I go to At One Fitness in North Hollywood, where my trainer, Jon Allsop, puts me through it all. I like it because it's a small gym and I've known the people for a long time. Jon will have me do cross-training where I'll lift weights, jump rope, throw around a medicine ball and I never get to stop.
18973.name: Tim DeKay

18974.quote: There are similarities between business and sport, in the pressures involved and in the fitness aspect too.
18974.name: Peter Shilton

18975.quote: Fitness will be a major factor in the first race and I think that will play into the hands of drivers who have been racing recently, rather than people like me who haven't raced properly for a decade. I'am not one of the favourites to start with.
18975.name: Nigel Mansell

18976.quote: I have always maintained a high level of fitness.
18976.name: Johnny Depp

18977.quote: I do not think there is any thrill that can go through the human heart like that felt by the inventor as he sees some creation of the brain unfolding to success, such emotions make a man forget food, sleep, friends, love, everything.
18977.name: Nikola Tesla

18978.quote: Just as the soul fills the body, so God fills the world. Just as the soul bears the body, so God endures the world. Just as the soul sees but is not seen, so God sees but is not seen. Just as the soul feeds the body, so God gives food to the world.
18978.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

18979.quote: We can't get to the $4 trillion in savings that we need by just cutting the 12 percent of the budget that pays for things like medical research and education funding and food inspectors and the weather service. And we can't just do it by making seniors pay more for Medicare.
18979.name: Barack Obama

18980.quote: There is no way that writers can be tamed and rendered civilized or even cured. The only solution known to science is to provide the patient with an isolation room, where he can endure the acute stages in private and where food can be poked in to him with a stick.
18980.name: Robert A. Heinlein

18981.quote: Your words are my food, your breath my wine. You are everything to me.
18981.name: Sarah Bernhardt

18982.quote: Reminds me of my safari in Africa. Somebody forgot the corkscrew and for several days we had to live on nothing but food and water.
18982.name: W. C. Fields

18983.quote: Food is an important part of a balanced diet.
18983.name: Fran Lebowitz

18984.quote: Put your nose into the Bible everyday. It is your spiritual food. And then share it. Make a vow not to be a lukewarm Christian.
18984.name: Kirk Cameron

18985.quote: I know a man who gave up smoking, drinking, sex, and rich food. He was healthy right up to the day he killed himself.
18985.name: Johnny Carson

18986.quote: Innovations that are guided by smallholder farmers, adapted to local circumstances, and sustainable for the economy and environment will be necessary to ensure food security in the future.
18986.name: Bill Gates

18987.quote: We should all grow our own food and do our own waste processing, we really should.
18987.name: Bill Gates

18988.quote: If you're using first-class land for biofuels, then you're competing with the growing of food. And so you're actually spiking food prices by moving energy production into agriculture.
18988.name: Bill Gates

18989.quote: It's easy to impress me. I don't need a fancy party to be happy. Just good friends, good food, and good laughs. I'm happy. I'm satisfied. I'm content.
18989.name: Maria Sharapova

18990.quote: The main facts in human life are five: birth, food, sleep, love and death.
18990.name: E. M. Forster

18991.quote: I have a total irreverence for anything connected with society except that which makes the roads safer, the beer stronger, the food cheaper and the old men and old women warmer in the winter and happier in the summer.
18991.name: Brendan Behan

18992.quote: No man will be a sailor who has contrivance enough to get himself into a jail for being in a ship is being in a jail, with the chance of being drowned, a man in a jail has more room, better food, and commonly better company.
18992.name: Samuel Johnson

18993.quote: Let food be thy medicine and medicine be thy food.
18993.name: Hippocrates

18994.quote: To say that a work of art is good, but incomprehensible to the majority of men, is the same as saying of some kind of food that it is very good but that most people can't eat it.
18994.name: Leo Tolstoy

18995.quote: Owners of dogs will have noticed that, if you provide them with food and water and shelter and affection, they will think you are God. Whereas owners of cats are compelled to realize that, if you provide them with food and water and affection, they draw the conclusion that they are God.
18995.name: Christopher Hitchens

18996.quote: I take care of my flowers and my cats. And enjoy food. And that's living.
18996.name: Ursula Andress

18997.quote: I tell my students, it's not difficult to identify with somebody like yourself, somebody next door who looks like you. What's more difficult is to identify with someone you don't see, who's very far away, who's a different color, who eats a different kind of food. When you begin to do that then literature is really performing its wonders.
18997.name: Chinua Achebe

18998.quote: Facts are to the mind what food is to the body.
18998.name: Edmund Burke

18999.quote: A city is a place where there is no need to wait for next week to get the answer to a question, to taste the food of any country, to find new voices to listen to and familiar ones to listen to again.
18999.name: Margaret Mead

19000.quote: Men do not have to cook their food they do so for symbolic reasons to show they are men and not beasts.
19000.name: Edmund Leach

19001.quote: When I get a little money I buy books and if any is left I buy food and clothes.
19001.name: Desiderius Erasmus

19002.quote: The first duty of government is to see that people have food, fuel, and clothes. The second, that they have means of moral and intellectual education.
19002.name: John Ruskin

19003.quote: Money is kind of a base subject. Like water, food, air and housing, it affects everything yet for some reason the world of academics thinks it's a subject below their social standing.
19003.name: Robert Kiyosaki

19004.quote: The food here is terrible, and the portions are too small.
19004.name: Woody Allen

19005.quote: It is the food which you furnish to your mind that determines the whole character of your life.
19005.name: Emmet Fox

19006.quote: Fame is a fickle food upon a shifting plate.
19006.name: Emily Dickinson

19007.quote: The class of citizens who provide at once their own food and their own raiment, may be viewed as the most truly independent and happy.
19007.name: James Madison

19008.quote: Animals that we eat are raised for food in the most economical way possible, and the serious food producers do it in the most humane way possible. I think anyone who is a carnivore needs to understand that meat does not originally come in these neat little packages.
19008.name: Julia Child

19009.quote: Music is the fourth great material want, first food, then clothes, then shelter, then music.
19009.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

19010.quote: We can no more do without spirituality than we can do without food, shelter, or clothing.
19010.name: Ernest Holmes

19011.quote: I do the same exercises I did 50 years ago and they still work. I eat the same food I ate 50 years ago and it still works.
19011.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

19012.quote: I'd like to be rich. I'd like a lot of money to put into my physicals and to buy food for all my friends.
19012.name: Syd Barrett

19013.quote: The best way to lose weight is to close your mouth - something very difficult for a politician. Or watch your food - just watch it, don't eat it.
19013.name: Edward Koch

19014.quote: Any healthy man can go without food for two days - but not without poetry.
19014.name: Charles Baudelaire

19015.quote: People love their animals so much so that they put little clothes on them and necklaces and booties and things like that. And if you love your animal, then you should feed them something that's not dangerous for them. There's a lot of poisonous stuff that they're putting in a lot of that food, those by-products.
19015.name: Ellen DeGeneres

19016.quote: If we do not permit the earth to produce beauty and joy, it will in the end not produce food, either.
19016.name: Joseph Wood Krutch

19017.quote: On the Continent people have good food in England people have good table manners.
19017.name: George Mikes

19018.quote: Agriculture is now a motorized food industry, the same thing in its essence as the production of corpses in the gas chambers and the extermination camps, the same thing as blockades and the reduction of countries to famine, the same thing as the manufacture of hydrogen bombs.
19018.name: Martin Heidegger

19019.quote: Mankind: A quality of life upgrade is available to each and every one of you. It should give you a quality of life upgrade, which means no drugs, no alcohol, no fast food - unless, of course, it's a mallard.
19019.name: Ted Nugent

19020.quote: If I like a food, I'll eat it, even if I know it's not good for me.
19020.name: Kim Kardashian

19021.quote: Poor, darling fellow - he died of food. He was killed by the dinner table.
19021.name: Diana Vreeland

19022.quote: Amazing that the human race has taken enough time out from thinking about food or sex to create the arts and sciences.
19022.name: Mason Cooley

19023.quote: Wit is the salt of conversation, not the food.
19023.name: William Hazlitt

19024.quote: You define a good flight by negatives: you didn't get hijacked, you didn't crash, you didn't throw up, you weren't late, you weren't nauseated by the food. So you are grateful.
19024.name: Paul Theroux

19025.quote: I do remember how it was to be poor. I do remember that in my early years, we had to grow and raise all of our food, even our animals. And I remember in my early life, we didn't even have electricity. So it was very, very hard times then.
19025.name: Dolly Parton

19026.quote: I say grace. I'm a big believer in grace. I happen to believe in a God that made all the food and so I'm pretty grateful for that and I thank him for that. But I'm also thankful for the people that put the food on the table.
19026.name: Alton Brown

19027.quote: What is food to one man is bitter poison to others.
19027.name: Lucretius

19028.quote: Baking cookies is comforting, and cookies are the sweetest little bit of comfort food. They are very bite-sized and personal.
19028.name: Sandra Lee

19029.quote: We are not hungry, Why foist this food upon us? We don't want to be choked. We have enough.
19029.name: Robert Mugabe

19030.quote: The worst food you'll ever eat will probably be prepared by a 'cook' who calls himself a 'chef.' Mark my words.
19030.name: Alton Brown

19031.quote: If you reject the food, ignore the customs, fear the religion and avoid the people, you might better stay at home.
19031.name: James A. Michener

19032.quote: Is it a coincidence that in 1998, Barack Obama talks about a majority coalition of welfare recipients and in 2012 we got a record number of Americans on food stamps while he's president? I don't think it's a coincidence.
19032.name: Rush Limbaugh

19033.quote: I have always said there is only one thing that can bring our nation down - our dependence on foreign countries for food and energy. Agriculture is the backbone of our economy.
19033.name: John Salazar

19034.quote: I was always a junk food person, still am.
19034.name: Dolly Parton

19035.quote: I've always liked Atlanta. And not just for the strip clubs, but the shopping and the food.
19035.name: Jon Stewart

19036.quote: Christmas is more stressful with present buying and making sure everyone gets included, but Thanksgiving is really not that. I don't ever really get stressed out about the food.
19036.name: Sandra Lee

19037.quote: I know it's not cat food, but what exactly is it that they put inside of tinned ravioli?
19037.name: Doug Coupland

19038.quote: The problem is when that fun stuff becomes the habit. And I think that's what's happened in our culture. Fast food has become the everyday meal.
19038.name: Michelle Obama

19039.quote: President Obama is the most successful food stamp president in American history. I would like to be the most successful paycheck president in American history.
19039.name: Newt Gingrich

19040.quote: If we gave up eating beef we would have roughly 20 to 30 times more land for food than we have now.
19040.name: James Lovelock

19041.quote: For the Nugent family, fast food is a running herbivore.
19041.name: Ted Nugent

19042.quote: Let me be the first to tell you, drinking alcohol is the worst thing to do in cold weather. Hot soup is the best because the process of digesting food helps to warm you up.
19042.name: Morgan Freeman

19043.quote: The passion of the Italian or the Italian-American population is endless for food and lore and everything about it.
19043.name: Mario Batali

19044.quote: I'm working harder than ever now, and I'm putting on my pants the same as I always have. I just get up every day and try to do a little better than the day before, and that is to run a great restaurant with great food, great wine, and great service. That's my philosophy.
19044.name: Emeril Lagasse

19045.quote: I was raised by a single mother who made a way for me. She used to scrub floors as a domestic worker, put a cleaning rag in her pocketbook and ride the subways in Brooklyn so I would have food on the table. But she taught me as I walked her to the subway that life is about not where you start, but where you're going. That's family values.
19045.name: Al Sharpton

19046.quote: God gives every bird its food, but He does not throw it into its nest.
19046.name: J. G. Holland

19047.quote: The secret of food lies in memory - of thinking and then knowing what the taste of cinnamon or steak is.
19047.name: Jerry Saltz

19048.quote: I've often said that the most important thing you can give your children is wings. Because, you're not gonna always be able to bring food to the nest. You're, sometimes, they're gonna have to be able to fly by themselves.
19048.name: Elizabeth Edwards

19049.quote: What the mass media offers is not popular art, but entertainment which is intended to be consumed like food, forgotten, and replaced by a new dish.
19049.name: W. H. Auden

19050.quote: My three addictions of choice are food, love and work.
19050.name: Alanis Morissette

19051.quote: If I don't get food in my mouth, I'm still happy. If my pants are round my ankles, as long as I don't get arrested for indecent exposure, I'm happy. I'm worried about keeping my hair, not how it's combed.
19051.name: Michael J. Fox

19052.quote: In a drama of the highest order there is little food for censure or hatred it teaches rather self-knowledge and self-respect.
19052.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

19053.quote: Obscenity, which is ever blasphemy against the divine beauty in life, is a monster for which the corruption of society forever brings forth new food, which it devours in secret.
19053.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

19054.quote: I have never denied my background or my culture. I have taught my child to embrace her Mexican heritage, to love my first language, Spanish, to learn about Mexican history, music, folk art, food, and even the Mexican candy I grew up with.
19054.name: Salma Hayek

19055.quote: So, what's it like in the real world? Well, the food is better, but beyond that, I don't recommend it.
19055.name: Bill Watterson

19057.quote: I remember once I read a book on mental illness and there was a nurse that had gotten sick. Do you know what she died from? From worrying about the mental patients not being able to get their food. She became a mental patient.
19057.name: Ornette Coleman

19058.quote: Revenge is barren of itself: it is the dreadful food it feeds on its delight is murder, and its end is despair.
19058.name: Friedrich Schiller

19059.quote: I offer neither pay, nor quarters, nor food I offer only hunger, thirst, forced marches, battles and death. Let him who loves his country with his heart, and not merely with his lips, follow me.
19059.name: Giuseppe Garibaldi

19060.quote: I love dogs. They live in the moment and don't care about anything except affection and food. They're loyal and happy. Humans are just too damn complicated.
19060.name: David Duchovny

19061.quote: If I agree to dispose of any part of our land to the white people I would feel guilty of taking food away from our children's mouths, and I do not wish to be that mean.
19061.name: Sitting Bull

19062.quote: Food tells you everything about the way people live and who they are.
19062.name: Martin Scorsese

19063.quote: I first got involved with ending world hunger, and I got hip to the facts about it - what a huge problem it was and how it wasn't a matter of not having food or not knowing how to end it, but it was a matter of creating the political will.
19063.name: Jeff Bridges

19064.quote: I love inventive food, but I want the classic dishes to taste like how I remember them. I get a little bummed out when there is too much fancy stuff going on and it doesn't resemble the original dish at all.
19064.name: Drew Barrymore

19065.quote: It's not difficult for me to stay healthy. I like healthy food.
19065.name: Heidi Klum

19066.quote: My inspiration was my mom. She's a great cook, and she still cooks, and we still banter back and forth about cooking. Growing up in a mostly Portuguese community, food was important and the family table was extremely important. At a very young age I understood that.
19066.name: Emeril Lagasse

19067.quote: I don't think there's going to be a day when I don't think about food or my body, but I'm living with it, and I wish I could tell young girls to find their safe place and stay with it.
19067.name: Demi Lovato

19068.quote: The fact that food plays such an important part in my films has everything to do with my family.
19068.name: Martin Scorsese

19069.quote: If your mother cooks Italian food, why should you go to a restaurant?
19069.name: Martin Scorsese

19070.quote: We take food for granted, but it isn't a luxury for many people.
19070.name: Christina Aguilera

19071.quote: If I'm a lush at anything, it's food and drink. I'm not materialistic in any way, but I value food.
19071.name: Hugh Jackman

19072.quote: My gosh, I love food. If I wasn't an actor, I could be a completely different body shape right now.
19072.name: Hugh Jackman

19073.quote: To this day, I am the least materialistic person I know, because my father didn't raise me to just go out and buy this or that car. The only reason I wanted to make money as an actor was because I'm passionate about food!
19073.name: Hugh Jackman

19074.quote: I love food, all types of food. I love Korean food, Japanese, Italian, French. In Australia, we don't have a distinctive Australian food, so we have food from everywhere all around the world. We're very multicultural, so we grew up with lots of different types of food.
19074.name: Hugh Jackman

19075.quote: Well, I have a lot of food references in my work.
19075.name: Tori Amos

19076.quote: Quarreling over food and drink, having neither scruples nor shame, not knowing right from wrong, not trying to avoid death or injury, not fearful of greater strength or of greater numbers, greedily aware only of food and drink - such is the bravery of the dog and boar.
19076.name: Xun Zi

19077.quote: Ever since Eve started it all by offering Adam the apple, woman's punishment has been to supply a man with food then suffer the consequences when it disagrees with him.
19077.name: Helen Rowland

19078.quote: We must pay greater attention to keeping our bodies and minds healthy and able to heal. Yet we are making it difficult for our defences to work. We allow things to be sold that should not be called food. Many have no nutritive value and lead to obesity, salt imbalance, and allergies.
19078.name: David Suzuki

19079.quote: When I go on Japanese Airlines, I really love it because I like Japanese food.
19079.name: Phil Collins

19080.quote: I've been all over the world. I love New York, I love Paris, San Francisco, so many places. But there's no place like New Orleans. It's got the best food. It's got the best music. It's got the best people. It's got the most fun stuff to do.
19080.name: Jr. Harry Connick

19081.quote: I hate the way they portray us in the media. If you see a black family it says they're looting, if you see a white family it says they're looking for food.
19081.name: Kanye West

19082.quote: When I got to France I realized I didn't know very much about food at all. I'd never had a real cake. I'd had those cakes from cake mixes or the ones that have a lot of baking powder in them. A really good French cake doesn't have anything like that in it - it's all egg power.
19082.name: Julia Child

19083.quote: And if you look at the reality in the United States, where you have more than 40 million people below the poverty line and 42 million on food stamps, and then you look at poverty around the world, clearly the way we're running the engine of capitalism is not serving us well.
19083.name: Simon Mainwaring

19084.quote: The lunch in a normal American restaurant is very problematic for me. I don't like to have hot food for lunch.
19084.name: Larry David

19085.quote: I was eating bad stuff. Lots of sugar and carbs, junk food all the time. It makes you very irritated.
19085.name: Avril Lavigne

19086.quote: Well, we lost a lot of our independence already. We are dependent on China for credit. We are dependent on Middle Eastern countries for energy supplies. And many Americans are dependent on the government for their income, health care, education of their children, food stamps.
19086.name: Jim DeMint

19087.quote: The vast amount of waste and sheer stupidity in government - from the Pentagon to the Food and Drug Administration - could fill committee agendas for years.
19087.name: Tom Coburn

19088.quote: I do not knowingly kill any living thing - including insects or rodents - and I thank my food for sustaining me.
19088.name: Joan Jett

19089.quote: I think one of the terrible things today is that people have this deathly fear of food: fear of eggs, say, or fear of butter. Most doctors feel that you can have a little bit of everything.
19089.name: Julia Child

19090.quote: I need my food to keep my energy up, so I can't really diet.
19090.name: Sienna Miller

19091.quote: If you don't want women to do whatever they need to do then you must provide them with food, you must provide them with shelter and their basic human rights.
19091.name: Emma Thompson

19092.quote: When two kids are being completely berserk, and they're naked and throwing food around, sometimes I just let it go because I can see a future where they're going to be dressed, and they're going to be at school. So I kind of let stuff go sometimes.
19092.name: Louis C. K.

19093.quote: Cats are very independent animals. They're very sexy, if you want. Dogs are different. They're familiar. They're obedient. You call a cat, you go, 'Cat, come here.' He doesn't come to you unless you have something in your hand that he thinks might be food. They're very free animals, and I like that.
19093.name: Antonio Banderas

19094.quote: Cats have a scam going - you buy the food, they eat the food, they go away that's the deal.
19094.name: Eddie Izzard

19095.quote: I've been to therapists my whole life. I find the less attention I pay to food, the healthier I am. Any obsession is dangerous. And a whole country that's obsessed with one thing, unless it's, like, jeans, it's very dangerous. Everyone's obsessed right now with carbohydrates in this country. It's ridiculous.
19095.name: Christina Ricci

19096.quote: Make food a very incidental part of your life by filling your life so full of meaningful things that you'll hardly have time to think about food.
19096.name: Peace Pilgrim

19097.quote: My grandfather's family used to own a pasta factory in Naples and they would go door-to-door selling their pasta. So his love of food came from his parents, which was then passed down to my mother and then again to me.
19097.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19098.quote: I love places that have an incredible history. I love the Italian way of life. I love the food. I love the people. I love the attitudes of Italians.
19098.name: Elton John

19099.quote: The highlight of my childhood was making my brother laugh so hard that food came out of his nose.
19099.name: Garrison Keillor

19100.quote: At the New York Athletic Club they serve amazing food. People go there, get healthy, and then eat themselves to death - which is, I suppose, the right way to do it.
19100.name: Oliver Reed

19101.quote: It has never made any sense to argue that, unique among the people of the world, Arabs are more concerned on a day-to-day basis about the treatment of people they don't know than they are about how they're going to put food on their own tables, or whether their sons will ever find a job.
19101.name: John Podhoretz

19102.quote: When I was 19, I made my first good week's pay as a club musician. It was enough money for me to quit my job at the factory and still pay the rent and buy some food. I freaked.
19102.name: Billy Joel

19103.quote: Most people are satisfied with the junk food being sold as music.
19103.name: Billy Joel

19104.quote: Short cycle business are being impacted by credit, and are being impacted by gasoline prices, food, distribution businesses, chemical business.
19104.name: Jack Welch

19105.quote: You're raising a kid and you give it food and shelter and, most importantly, you give it the feeling that it's special. I think people react to celebrities like that - I mean, they treat celebrities like children.
19105.name: David Duchovny

19106.quote: I just spend my money on the essentials. Just basically food and shelter.
19106.name: David Duchovny

19107.quote: When I tour, I stuff fridges full of organic food and stick to that.
19107.name: Avril Lavigne

19108.quote: Everything in food is science. The only subjective part is when you eat it.
19108.name: Alton Brown

19109.quote: The kitchen's a laboratory, and everything that happens there has to do with science. It's biology, chemistry, physics. Yes, there's history. Yes, there's artistry. Yes, to all of that. But what happened there, what actually happens to the food is all science.
19109.name: Alton Brown

19110.quote: If I can wake up everyday before I die and know that I don't have to serve anyone food or drinks, I will be happy!
19110.name: Kelly Clarkson

19111.quote: I am thankful I was born in America, although if I gain any more weight the burqa thing may start to seem like a good idea to me. See? Another plus about America, you can always find some food.
19111.name: Elayne Boosler

19112.quote: I'm girlie in the sense that I like makeup, but I also love sports and man food.
19112.name: Carrie Underwood

19113.quote: As we say in the American Institute of Wine and Food, small helpings, no seconds. A little bit of everything. No snacking. And have a good time.
19113.name: Julia Child

19114.quote: Restore human legs as a means of travel. Pedestrians rely on food for fuel and need no special parking facilities.
19114.name: Lewis Mumford

19115.quote: I like being able to walk into an old town and find good local food.
19115.name: Sienna Miller

19116.quote: I have my new food line in the works - I think it's over 200 items. Hopefully I can make a difference it's delicious food that's just so easy. I think it'll help people enjoy their lives, it's good!
19116.name: Paula Deen

19117.quote: You go to a show, and there's no food at all, so if you're doing shows back to back, you can forget eating. I remember standing up in the bath one day, and there was a mirror in front of me, and I was so thin! I hated it. I never liked being that skinny.
19117.name: Kate Moss

19118.quote: I'm too lazy and I like food and I like my free time too much to spend it working out!
19118.name: Katherine Heigl

19119.quote: Quantity in food is more to be regarded than quality. A full meal is a great enemy both to study and industry.
19119.name: Samuel Richardson

19120.quote: I find the less attention I pay to food, the healthier I am.
19120.name: Christina Ricci

19121.quote: Metaphysics is a restaurant where they give you a thirty thousand page menu, and no food.
19121.name: Robert M. Pirsig

19122.quote: If you see a black family, it's looting, but if it's a white family they are looking for food.
19122.name: Kanye West

19123.quote: Food brings people together on many different levels. It's nourishment of the soul and body it's truly love.
19123.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19124.quote: We were raised in an Italian-American household, although we didn't speak Italian in the house. We were very proud of being Italian, and had Italian music, ate Italian food.
19124.name: Francis Ford Coppola

19125.quote: It's coming home to roost over the next 50 years or so. It's not just climate change it's sheer space, places to grow food for this enormous horde. Either we limit our population growth or the natural world will do it for us, and the natural world is doing it for us right now.
19125.name: David Attenborough

19126.quote: Families are struggling against a tide of junk information on junk food.
19126.name: Diane Abbott

19127.quote: When fast food is not a treat but a dietary staple, the children surf the internet all day in dark corners of the room and are bombarded with latest gadgets. Things replace parental standards.
19127.name: Diane Abbott

19128.quote: Start with a clean grill. Keep it clean by brushing with a wire brush after preheating, and again after cooking. Make sure to oil your grates and your food before putting it on the grill to keep it from sticking.
19128.name: Emeril Lagasse

19129.quote: I will come up with a project that will wipe out poverty in the Philippines in two years. I want to remove the people from economic crisis by using the Marcos wealth. Long after I'm gone, people will remember me for building them homes and roads and hospitals and giving them food.
19129.name: Imelda Marcos

19130.quote: I can't stay away from Chinese food. I really love that stuff.
19130.name: Shaun White

19131.quote: I like to cook Puerto Rican food. That's what I grew up on: rice, beans, meat, some Italian-American food. I know my way around the kitchen.
19131.name: Jennifer Lopez

19132.quote: In most of the world, it is accepted that if animals are to be killed for food, they should be killed without suffering.
19132.name: Peter Singer

19133.quote: Well, it's very easy for me to gain weight, but even though I tried not eating for a week when I was really young, I couldn't do it any longer because I liked my food too much.
19133.name: Amanda Seyfried

19134.quote: Instead of going out to dinner, buy good food. Cooking at home shows such affection. In a bad economy, it's more important to make yourself feel good.
19134.name: Ina Garten

19135.quote: In fact, in many ways my mother was quite hippy-dippy, serving macrobiotic food and reading 'Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance.'
19135.name: Kristin Scott Thomas

19136.quote: Some argue that now isn't the time to push the green agenda - that all efforts should be on preventing a serious recession. That is a false choice.
