It fails to recognise that climate change and our carbon reliance is part of problem - high fuel prices and food shortages due to poor crop yields compound today's financial difficulties.
19136.name: Lucy Powell

19137.quote: Justice requires that everyone should have enough to eat. But it also requires that everyone should contribute to the production of food.
19137.name: Elias Canetti

19138.quote: My contribution I hope is to get people to eat full-flavored food. If I could come away with that alone, that would be a fantastic accomplishment. I'm also very proud of being a very American chef.
19138.name: Bobby Flay

19139.quote: At one point I had to shove as much food in my body as possible to pack on calories. My trainer wanted me to do six meals a day and not go two hours without eating. If I would cheat on eating one day, I could tell - I'd drop a few pounds.
19139.name: Taylor Lautner

19140.quote: I know lots and lots and lots of vegetarians who think it's perfectly all right to kill animals for food to eat, but don't do it because they think all the ways in which it's done are wrong.
19140.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

19141.quote: There's never been a culture that wasn't obsessed with food. The sort of sad thing is that our obsession is no longer with food, but with the price of food.
19141.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

19142.quote: Food is not rational. Food is culture, habit, craving and identity.
19142.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

19143.quote: Food is not just what we put in our mouths to fill up it is culture and identity. Reason plays some role in our decisions about food, but it's rarely driving the car.
19143.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

19144.quote: I first became a vegetarian when I was nine, in response to an argument made by a radical babysitter. My great change - which lasted a couple of weeks - was based on the very simple instinct that it's wrong to kill animals for food.
19144.name: Jonathan Safran Foer

19145.quote: To a historian libraries are food, shelter, and even muse.
19145.name: Barbara Tuchman

19147.quote: Well, first of all, we've got to get away from being offended by the truth. We've seen a 41 percent increase in food stamp recipients across the United States of America since President Obama was sworn in in January 2009. That has nothing to do with black, white, Hispanic or whatever. It's a fact, and we need to, you know, deal with that.
19147.name: Allen West

19148.quote: Global trade has advantages. For starters, it allows those of us who live through winter to eat fresh produce year-round. And it provides economic benefits to farmers who grow that food.
19148.name: David Suzuki

19149.quote: In the 21st century our tastes buds, our brain chemistry, our biochemistry, our hormones and our kitchens have been hijacked by the food industry.
19149.name: Mark Hyman

19151.quote: A house is no home unless it contain food and fire for the mind as well as for the body.
19151.name: Margaret Fuller

19152.quote: Used to be, conservatives revered the Average American, that Norman Rockwell oil painting of diner food, humble faith, honest toil, and Capraesque virtue.
19152.name: James Wolcott

19153.quote: Fast food is hugely important in the life of a comedy writer. All we do is order in, and what we're going to eat is hotly debated.
19153.name: Mindy Kaling

19154.quote: I became a fanatic about healthy food in 1944.
19154.name: Gloria Swanson

19155.quote: One way to find food for thought is to use the fork in the road, the bifurcation that marks the place of emergence in which a new line of development begins to branch off.
19155.name: William Irwin Thompson

19156.quote: The food isn't too bad. It's very different from the food that the astronauts ate in the very early days of the space program.
19156.name: Sally Ride

19157.quote: Listen - of course money changes everything, but so does sunlight, and so does food: These are powerful but neutral energy sources, neither inherently good nor evil but shaped only by the way we use them.
19157.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

19158.quote: I guess I feel that I was following my instincts, and at the same time being guided by the best. I became totally intrigued with Louisiana - the people, the food. It is a part of my life. Everything that has happened for me since moving here has just been icing on the cake.
19158.name: Emeril Lagasse

19159.quote: Music is one of those things that is constantly going in my head all the time. It's sort of like the evolution and creation of doing food, or my philosophy about wine. It's always beating in my head, so it keeps the spirit moving.
19159.name: Emeril Lagasse

19160.quote: I came here because the city has a tradition and is a very respected food city.
19160.name: Emeril Lagasse

19161.quote: I've always done food that can work in a set time frame. The message I'm trying to get across is, it doesn't have to take three days to do this. With planning, you can do a lot and really have quality food every day.
19161.name: Emeril Lagasse

19162.quote: If somebody has a chance to put my food in their mouth, that tells the story.
19162.name: Emeril Lagasse

19163.quote: Those other 10 o'clock shows that come on, all you get from them is headaches and nightmares when you go to bed! At least we give you food, know what I mean?
19163.name: Emeril Lagasse

19164.quote: You know, for 300 years it's been kind of the same. There are restaurants in New Orleans that the menu hasn't changed in 125 years, so how is one going to change or evolve the food?
19164.name: Emeril Lagasse

19165.quote: My Food Network shows, 'Emeril Live' and 'Essence of Emeril,' are not in production right now, but I wouldn't say that I'm necessarily leaving Food Network. I have a lot of television still in me. I enjoy teaching people, so it's just a matter of time before I do something new.
19165.name: Emeril Lagasse

19166.quote: Being a food show and being me, I always kicked it up a notch, which means I would always elevate the spice level or the complexity of a particular dish. So, it was always like we're going to kick this up a little bit.
19166.name: Emeril Lagasse

19167.quote: My food is Louisiana, New Orleans-based, well-seasoned, rustic. I think it's pretty unique because of my background being influenced by my mom, Portuguese and French Canadian. There's a lot going on there.
19167.name: Emeril Lagasse

19168.quote: Though I love the luxury of the Waldorf Towers, room service there doesn't do soul food.
19168.name: Jr. Sammy Davis

19169.quote: Freedom must be gained step by step, slowly. Freedom is a food which must be carefully administered when people are too hungry for it.
19169.name: Lech Walesa

19170.quote: We created a line of pet food called Nutrish that's made to human standards, and 100 percent of the proceeds go to animal rescue. One of our top-tier donors is the ASPCA, and they help us challenge animal shelters all across the country to get more animals placed in homes.
19170.name: Rachael Ray

19171.quote: I'm the person who wouldn't send back my food even if I got steak when I'd ordered fish.
19171.name: Anna Kendrick

19172.quote: Love food and I love to eat.
19172.name: Salma Hayek

19173.quote: Everybody has a weakness. Mine is food.
19173.name: Salma Hayek

19174.quote: A lot of food shows need only to tempt. Some food shows only need to inspire, to empower. And there are a lot of shows that do that.
19174.name: Alton Brown

19175.quote: What I've learned is I want to enjoy my life, and food is a big part of it.
19175.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

19176.quote: Research has shown that even small amounts of processed food alter the chemical balance in our brain and cause negative mood swings along with noticeable dips ill energy.
19176.name: Marilu Henner

19177.quote: I'm a home cook and love to read about food, but I'm not trained as a chef. I'm just really into cooking and passionate about it.
19177.name: Ted Allen

19178.quote: Australia is so cool that it's hard to even know where to start describing it. The beaches are beautiful so is the weather. Not too crowded. Great food, great music, really nice people. It must be a lot like Los Angeles was many years ago.
19178.name: Mary-Kate Olsen

19179.quote: I think people are smart enough to sort it out. They know when they're watching one of these food fight shows where journalists sit around and yell and scream at each other, versus serious issue reporting.
19179.name: Bob Woodward

19180.quote: Working at the Food Bank with my kids is an eye-opener. The face of hunger isn't the bum on the street drinking Sterno it's the working poor. They don't look any different, they don't behave any differently, they're not really any less educated. They are incredibly less privileged, and that's it.
19180.name: Mario Batali

19181.quote: To be interested in food but not in food production is clearly absurd.
19181.name: Wendell Berry

19182.quote: There's not one food that causes diabetes.What causes Type II diabetes is being overweight, I've just come to grips, over the past four or five months, with my diabetes.
19182.name: Paula Deen

19183.quote: I don't want to spend my life not having good food going into my pie hole. That hole was made for pies.
19183.name: Paula Deen

19184.quote: I wake up every morning happy for where I am in life. It's not all about the cooking, but the fact that I can contribute by using my influence to help people all over the country. In the last two years, my partners and I have fed more than 10 million hungry people by bringing meat to food banks.
19184.name: Paula Deen

19185.quote: I will never use a substitute for butter. Margarine is one molecule away from eating plastic. If I'm going to eat that type of food, it's going to be the real deal.
19185.name: Paula Deen

19186.quote: I thought, you know the food and the diet thing is one way to start yourself onto a healthy lifestyle, but if you don't move, if you don't start exercising you're gonna deteriorate.
19186.name: Warren Cuccurullo

19187.quote: Habaneros have a great fruity flavor, but the challenge is that you have to deflect the heat in order to taste the flavor. If you don't, you're dead. They should really have a warning sign on them. Deflect the habanero's heat by pairing it with sweet food.
19187.name: Bobby Flay

19188.quote: I like food, like any other guy, but it is not the main thing in my life. I can do without it.
19188.name: Lee Child

19189.quote: There are realities we all share, regardless of our nationality, language, or individual tastes. As we need food, so do we need emotional nourishment: love, kindness, appreciation, and support from others.
19189.name: J. Donald Walters

19190.quote: Food prices are often kept artificially high. The result is that the Millennium Development Goals set out by the United Nations at the start of the new millennium are not being reached. Fine words have not yet been turned into deeds.
19190.name: Jonathan Sacks

19191.quote: Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement, is the holy of holies of Jewish time. It is that rarest of phenomena, a Jewish festival without food. Instead it is a day of fasting and prayer, introspection and self-judgment when, collectively and repeatedly, we confess our sins and pray to be written into God's Book of Life.
19191.name: Jonathan Sacks

19192.quote: I'm into mellow dates with really good food.
19192.name: Lauren Conrad

19193.quote: I like to know exactly what's being put into my food.
19193.name: Lauren Conrad

19194.quote: There's so much importance in honoring your everyday hero. It doesn't take money. It doesn't take connections. What matters is that people get involved. Whether your passion is gun control or food or whatever it may be, everybody needs to stop being so self-absorbed.
19194.name: Debi Mazar

19195.quote: My goal is to make Italian food clean and accessible and beautiful and tasty, with simple ingredients that people can find at a local grocery store, because people don't want to go to a gourmet shop in search of items that will sit in their pantry for years after they use just a teaspoon or pinch of them.
19195.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19196.quote: I think you can tell the food is close to my heart, too, because I'm doing what I do best.
19196.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19197.quote: Food was always a big part of my life. My grandfather was one of 14 kids, and his parents had a pasta factory, so as a kid, he and his siblings would sell pasta door to door. After he became a movie producer, he opened up De Laurentiis Food Stores - one in Los Angeles and one in New York.
19197.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19198.quote: Attitudes toward food have completely changed.
19198.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19199.quote: My grandfather gave me inspiration to cook, and love food and flavors. My Aunt Raffie, gave me creativity and the inspiration to create new things. My mother inspires me to find simplicity in food.
19199.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19200.quote: There's nothing like a home-cooked meal - nothing! When people ask me what the best restaurant in L.A. is, I say, 'Uh, my house.' It's more intimate. Food can connect people in a forever sort of way.
19200.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19201.quote: I'm into very colorful food. Obviously lots of flavor, but I think we eat with our eyes first, so it has to look great. The presentation has to be great.
19201.name: Giada De Laurentiis

19202.quote: In Kenya women are the first victims of environmental degradation, because they are the ones who walk for hours looking for water, who fetch firewood, who provide food for their families.
19202.name: Wangari Maathai

19203.quote: Food is a coping mechanism people are afraid of giving it up because then they'll feel confused and lost.
19203.name: Phil McGraw

19204.quote: I love South American food, and I haven't really been down there. I really need a vacation.
19204.name: Nate Silver

19205.quote: The lack of access to proper nutrition is not only fueling obesity, it is leading to food insecurity and hunger among our children.
19205.name: Tom Vilsack

19206.quote: I can spend hours in a grocery store. I get so excited when I see food, I go crazy. I spend hours arranging my baskets so that everything fits in and nothing gets squashed. I'm really anal about it, actually.
19206.name: Cameron Diaz

19207.quote: My mom was on welfare and the occasional food stamp, but I have never participated in any of those governmental programs, even the ones that kind of work like education, scholarships and whatever, and I managed to do just fine.
19207.name: Adam Carolla

19208.quote: I cook a little bit. I make a Hungarian dish called chicken paprikash that's out of this world. I'll give a heads-up to all of your readers that it doesn't have to be between Thai and Mexican every night. Toss some Hungarian in every once in a while. You will not be sorry. Good, solid peasant food.
19208.name: Adam Carolla

19209.quote: People see you onstage and the glamorous side, but they don't see you traveling 600 miles a night, eating truck stop food and spending by yourself staring at walls.
19209.name: Jason Aldean

19211.quote: But I don't begrudge anybody, because I know how hard it is to have that dream and to make it happen, whether or not it's just to put a roof over your head and food on the table.
19211.name: Carol Burnett

19212.quote: I always made my food congenial to my constitution, and my health was always excellent.
19212.name: Giacomo Casanova

19213.quote: I learned very early that our health is always impaired by some excess either of food or abstinence, and I never had any physician except myself.
19213.name: Giacomo Casanova

19214.quote: Never be a food snob. Learn from everyone you meet - the fish guy at your market, the lady at the local diner, farmers, cheese makers. Ask questions, try everything and eat up!
19214.name: Rachael Ray

19215.quote: It's fantastic to strive towards a nice life where you eat nice organic food and your children go to a nice school and you can afford nice clothes and nice perfume and the hypoallergenic make-up. But there's never a day goes by, and I mean this from the bottom of my heart, that I don't think about where I'm from.
19215.name: Samantha Morton

19216.quote: I'm trying to cut down a little on eating, on sodium, keep my blood pressure down, which is tough. Because I love food! I do, but it's unfair how everything that's bad for you tastes so good, and all the good stuff, veggies and green things, doesn't match up.
19216.name: Ice Cube

19217.quote: I am not a great cook, I am not a great artist, but I love art, and I love food, so I am the perfect traveller.
19217.name: Michael Palin

19218.quote: Most small business owners are not particularly sophisticated business people. That's not a criticism they're passionate about cutting hair or cooking food, and that's why they got in the business, not because they have an MBA.
19218.name: Andrew Mason

19219.quote: I think one thing that kids who grow up on farms really have going for them is they have exposure to death and birth in a totally different way. I think it takes away a little bit of the mystery and a little bit of the fear, and I do wish I had that. And I wish I was able to grow my own food.
19219.name: Rachel McAdams

19220.quote: Becoming food savvy is one thing, but it's amazing how fast savvy turns to snooty, and snooty leaves you preparing three-hour meals that break your budget and that the kids won't even eat.
19220.name: Jeffrey Kluger

19221.quote: As the earth spins through space, a view from above the North Pole would encompass most of the wealth of the world - most of its food, productive machines, doctors, engineers and teachers. A view from the opposite pole would encompass most of the world's poor.
19221.name: Barry Commoner

19222.quote: Our children's health and well-being are dependent on our commitment to promoting food access and good eating habits at home, at school and in the community.
19222.name: Rod Blagojevich

19223.quote: The Middle East is ailing. The malady stems from pervasive violence, shortages of food, water and educational opportunities, discrimination against women and - the most virulent cause of all - the absence of freedom.
19223.name: Shimon Peres

19224.quote: If food is poetry, is not poetry also food?
19224.name: Joyce Carol Oates

19225.quote: I was always on the go, and thought I was too busy to develop something like this. I thought at the time that diabetes went along with bad habits, but I was the last one in my family to eat junk food.
19225.name: Angie Stone

19226.quote: Food has always brought me comfort and the bingeing is triggered when I'm in a space that is not positive.
19226.name: Janet Jackson

19227.quote: I kept thinking, 'Somebody has to make a food show that is actually educational and entertaining at the same time, a show that got down to the 'why things happen.' Plus, I hated my job - I didn't think it was very worthwhile.
19227.name: Alton Brown

19228.quote: You don't want flame to hit your food. Flame is bad. Flame does nasty things to food. It makes soot and it makes deposits of various chemicals that are not too good for us. The last thing you really want to see licking at your food while it's on a grill is an actual flame.
19228.name: Alton Brown

19229.quote: I spent a college semester in a small town in Italy - and that is where I truly tasted food for the first time.
19229.name: Alton Brown

19230.quote: You know most of the food that Americans hold so dear - things like hamburgers and hot dogs - were road food, but even before they were road food, they were peasant food.
19230.name: Alton Brown

19231.quote: I think a lot of food shows, especially when we started 'Good Eats' back in the late '90s, they were still really about food. 'Good Eats' isn't about food, it's about entertainment. If, however, we can virally infect you with knowledge or interest, then all the better.
19231.name: Alton Brown

19232.quote: I'm a filmmaker who decided to go to culinary school. All I picked up was the fact if I didn't understand what was going on with every single ingredient, I could be qualifying for, like, the lunch food job at my daughter's school.
19232.name: Alton Brown

19233.quote: I am a filmmaker. That is all I've ever been. You know, Martin Scorsese makes films about the mob. And I make movies about food.
19233.name: Alton Brown

19234.quote: Do not allow watching food to replace making food.
19234.name: Alton Brown

19235.quote: Keep it simple in the kitchen. If you use quality ingredients, you don't need anything fancy to make food delicious: just a knife, a cutting board, and some good nonstick cookware, and you're set.
19235.name: Curtis Stone

19236.quote: I hate menus, I hate choosing food. I just want to be brought. Bring me dinner!
19236.name: Hugh Laurie

19237.quote: Food - I love nuts. I eat them all the time, they're easy to carry around, and I am never hungry all day long.
19237.name: Mehmet Oz

19238.quote: Most food you drop is still perfectly edible. If it was in your eyesight the whole time, you can pick it up and eat it.
19238.name: Mehmet Oz

19239.quote: There are a lot of food Nazis in the U.S., but I believe if you can show people what's really important, they'll judge the rest for themselves.
19239.name: Mehmet Oz

19240.quote: Food is no longer sacred to us: in becoming too efficient we've changed its nature.
19240.name: Mehmet Oz

19241.quote: I think wine is such a big universe that it's kind of like food - it's intimidating to a lot of people, myself included.
19241.name: Padma Lakshmi

19242.quote: People always comment about my clothes. They don't think a fashionable woman can love food and be knowledgeable and actually cook.
19242.name: Padma Lakshmi

19243.quote: Without food, man can live at most but a few weeks without it, all other components of social justice are meaningless.
19243.name: Norman Borlaug

19244.quote: I went in saying I wanted to be the food guy.
19244.name: Ted Allen

19245.quote: Jay Leno is not a guy who likes change. He eats the same food every day.
19245.name: Ted Allen

19246.quote: You know the great irony is that people think you have to have money to enjoy fine food, which is a shame.
19246.name: Ted Allen

19247.quote: When I come home from a shoot, I'd rather reheat food I've made than eat takeout.
19247.name: Ted Allen

19248.quote: I've always hoped 'Chopped' would telegraph our enormous affection and love and admiration for chefs and food, but at the same time, we are inflicting extraordinary cruelty on them.
19248.name: Ted Allen

19249.quote: In recent years, I've been writing because I'm fortunate enough to work in the world of food television, to travel and taste and learn about cooking from the best chefs in the business.
19249.name: Ted Allen

19250.quote: Believe me, I understand the need for easy and speedy. After a 12-hour day of shooting 'Chopped,' say, I'm talking stir-fry, spaghetti, heck, peanut-butter sandwiches. But that's not about the joy of food. That's survival.
19250.name: Ted Allen

19251.quote: I think what I do differently from a lot of TV chefs is that I break down barriers and make fine food more accessible to the regular person, who might be intimidated. I try hard, particularly with wine, to make it not intimidating. It's sort of a teaching job.
19251.name: Ted Allen

19252.quote: The interesting thing is, while we die of diseases of affluence from eating all these fatty meats, our poor brethren in the developing world die of diseases of poverty, because the land is not used now to grow food grain for their families.
19252.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19253.quote: Back in 1983, the United States government approved the release of the first genetically modified organism. In this case, it was a bacteria that prevents frost on food crops.
19253.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19254.quote: I love food and I love my curves.
19254.name: Jordin Sparks

19255.quote: I used to eat because food tastes so good. I love food, it's one of the best things on this planet. But I changed the way I was thinking. I started asking myself, 'Hey, am I eating because it tastes good? Or because I really need some more? Am I really still hungry?'
19255.name: Jordin Sparks

19256.quote: I don't enjoy good food. I don't enjoy flashy cars. I don't care if I live in a dump. I don't enjoy good clothes. This is the best I've dressed in months.
19256.name: Jack Kevorkian

19257.quote: It's all about who's where on the food chain. When I'm the story editor, I expect my writers to follow my vision. When I'm working for another editor, I'm obliged to follow their vision.
19257.name: Len Wein

19258.quote: I moved to New York last year and I love it. It's a huge change and I've always wanted to spend time there. It's like a more intense London, and everything's up a few notches. The lights are brighter, the pace is faster and the food's better.
19258.name: Rachel Weisz

19259.quote: And I think of that again as I've written in several of my beauty books, a lot of health comes from the proper eating habits, which are something that - you know, I come from a generation that wasn't - didn't have a lot of food.
19259.name: Joan Collins

19260.quote: There are pockets of great food in Spain, but there are also pockets of very mediocre food in Spain, and the same in Morocco and the same in Croatia and the same in Germany and the same in Austria.
19260.name: Mario Batali

19261.quote: Finishing food is about the tiny touches. In the last seconds you can change everything.
19261.name: Mario Batali

19262.quote: Everyone makes pesto in a food processor. But the texture is better with a mortar and pestle, and it's just as fast.
19262.name: Mario Batali

19263.quote: As far away as you can get from the process of mechanisms and machinery, the more likely your food's going to taste good. And that - that is probably the largest thing I can hand to anybody is let your hands touch it. Let them make it.
19263.name: Mario Batali

19264.quote: When you cut that eggplant up and you roast it in the oven and you make the tomato sauce and you put it on top, your soul is in that food, and there's something about that that can never be made by a company that has three million employees.
19264.name: Mario Batali

19265.quote: Bologna is the best city in Italy for food and has the least number of tourists. With its medieval beauty, it has it all.
19265.name: Mario Batali

19266.quote: Shop often, shop hard, and spend for the best stuff available - logic dictates that you can make delicious food only with delicious ingredients.
19266.name: Mario Batali

19267.quote: Unlike curing cancer or heart disease, we already know how to beat hunger: food.
19267.name: Mario Batali

19268.quote: I was at a party, and some squiggly looking dude with a bow tie came up and said, 'How'd you like to be on TV?' Turns out he was the programming guy at the Food Network. They had me come into the office, and I did a 'Ready, Set, Cook' with Emeril Lagasse, I believe.
19268.name: Mario Batali

19269.quote: Cookbooks have all become baroque and very predictable. I'm looking for something different. A lot of chefs' cookbooks are food as it's done in the restaurants, but they are dumbed down, and I hate it when they dumb them down.
19269.name: Mario Batali

19270.quote: My last meal? The food would be much less significant than the company.
19270.name: Mario Batali

19271.quote: When I was growing up in Mississippi - it was good Southern food, but I also grew up with a Greek family when other kids were eating fried okra, we were eating steamed artichokes. So I think it played a big part in my healthy cooking.
19271.name: Cat Cora

19272.quote: My Mom always cooked healthy. Greek food lends itself to cooking healthy.
19272.name: Cat Cora

19273.quote: I think the biggest thing is clean as you go. Wash all your knives, cutting boards, dishes, when you are done cooking, not look at a sink full of dishes after you are done. Cleaning as you go helps keep away cross contamination and you avoid having food borne bacteria.
19273.name: Cat Cora

19274.quote: It's fun to pick a cuisine and say I'm going to research Ethiopian food, and see what it's all about. You find that there are a lot of similarities in cuisines from around the world and a lot of similar flavors.
19274.name: Cat Cora

19275.quote: We incorporated new tastes and flavors into our kids' diets from a very early age, which helped to develop their palates and prevented them from becoming picky eaters. We don't buy junk food and give them options of fresh fruit, yogurt, raw almonds, or dried whole grain cereals for snack time.
19275.name: Cat Cora

19276.quote: I would like a food/lifestyle show. We're not sure what that is yet. I want to be able to share what I do and how I raise my family. I feel like I have a story to tell. I enjoy talking and listening, sharing ideas and sharing advice.
19276.name: Cat Cora

19277.quote: Chronic malnutrition, or the lack of proper nutrition over time directly contributes to three times as many child deaths as food scarcity. Yet surprisingly, you don't really hear about this hidden crisis through the morning news, Twitter or headlines of major newspapers.
19277.name: Cat Cora

19278.quote: I think about food all the time. It's my passion it's my profession. But some people think about food all the time because they're hungry. We can put an end to this if we join forces and lend a hand.
19278.name: Cat Cora

19279.quote: I think people are more savvy about cooking, food and dining. I notice they are looking for more value for their money - not in larger portions but more in terms of healthier, fresh, farm-to-table dishes with a nice presentation.
19279.name: Cat Cora

19280.quote: I like to abide by the seasons and let the natural flavor in food speak for itself. I use quick cooking techniques of high heat with very little fat, such as quick saute or wok stir-frying.
19280.name: Cat Cora

19281.quote: I add a lot of citrus to my food and I think that flavors it. And, to me, that what makes it healthier, lower in fat, lower in calories. It adds lots of flavor. Spices, of course. But citrus is definitely kind of my go-to to season and really to really make those flavors, make that food come alive.
19281.name: Cat Cora

19282.quote: Even more importantly, it's wine, food and the arts. Incorporating those three enhances the quality of life.
19282.name: Robert Mondavi

19283.quote: Don't you have a machine that puts food into the mouth and pushes it down?
19283.name: Nikita Khrushchev

19284.quote: When my work gets crazy, I make sure to always have vitamins, water and proper food with me. That has helped me to lose 33 pounds.
19284.name: Carnie Wilson

19285.quote: When you love food as much as I do, staying healthy is not easy. I mean, moderation, not deprivation. That's my new way of living. I always want more and that's just my life.
19285.name: Carnie Wilson

19286.quote: I used food as a coping mechanism for many, many years, and it was my best friend for a long time.
19286.name: Carnie Wilson

19287.quote: Food decisions - do I eat this or not? - are always going to be there.
19287.name: Carnie Wilson

19288.quote: I always think I am one of the millions and millions of people that struggles with an addiction to food. I don't know how to relax, that's my problem.
19288.name: Carnie Wilson

19289.quote: My work has also motivated me to put a lot of time into seeking out good food and to spend more money on it.
19289.name: Michael Pollan

19290.quote: In addition to contributing to erosion, pollution, food poisoning, and the dead zone, corn requires huge amounts of fossil fuel - it takes a half gallon of fossil fuel to produce a bushel of corn.
19290.name: Michael Pollan

19291.quote: I just like food too much, and I don't want to change. I spent so much of childhood trying to change, and I just got sick of it, I don't want to look like Britney Spears, I just don't want to. She's hideous.
19291.name: Beth Ditto

19292.quote: Olympia was a town crawling with music. I was new to the whole punk scene. The culture shock continued Olympia had bagels! We didn't have bagels in Arkansas. You could order vegetarian food all over town! It was so crazy to me - a place with so many vegetarians, the restaurants made special dishes for them?
19292.name: Beth Ditto

19293.quote: If my daughter wants to get into this business, I would support that decision. She's going to have a hard time not being in it. She loves food and she's around it all the time.
19293.name: Bobby Flay

19294.quote: For me, it's all about moderation. I don't kick things out of my diet, like carbs. But I'm not going to eat fast food.
19294.name: Bobby Flay

19295.quote: When I go to a restaurant, I eat three-quarters of the food in front of me. That cuts my calorie intake by 25 percent.
19295.name: Bobby Flay

19296.quote: Basically, there are two things we know: Everybody has less time, and the general public is demanding better food - better in terms of quality and better in terms of flavor.
19296.name: Bobby Flay

19297.quote: I couldn't relate to kid stuff. 'Jimmy doesn't like me!' Who cares? I was worried we didn't have gas money or food. Those were my concerns.
19297.name: Leighton Meester

19298.quote: I don't let it bother me too much if someone doesn't like me. I just figure there's no accounting for taste. It's not me, it's my acting. It's like if someone doesn't like someone's food, they just don't like my acting.
19298.name: Anna Chlumsky

19299.quote: Well mine is not gimmicky - it is the 6 food groups that God made, and exercising every day. Trying to think positively.
19299.name: Richard Simmons

19300.quote: Progress would not have been the rarity it is if the early food had not been the late poison.
19300.name: Walter Bagehot

19301.quote: The number one mistake is giving pets table scraps. I made the mistake thinking I was showing my dog love by giving her food and treats. You see a tiny 4 oz. piece of cheese, but for a Boston Terrier like mine, that's like one and a half hamburgers. That's unhealthy.
19301.name: Alison Sweeney

19302.quote: There are times, like after a long day of work, when the thought of an easy drive-through is enticing. But then I remember how crappy I felt when I ate fast food in the past, and it inspires me to head to the grocery store or my local farmer's market and whip up an easy but healthier option.
19302.name: Alison Sweeney

19303.quote: I have encouraged my kids to eat well from day one. I add flavor - herbs and spices - to everything because I don't want them getting used to starchy, bland food. I also want them to experiment - they don't have to love everything, but they do have to try it.
19303.name: Alison Sweeney

19304.quote: I try to eat in a way that makes me feel good. If that means a little bite of chocolate I do that, but I try not to use food as a reward for myself.
19304.name: Jennifer Garner

19305.quote: If there is to be any hope of prosperity for this country it is by reversing that policy which made us simply the kitchen garden for supplying the British with cheap food.
19305.name: Eamon de Valera

19306.quote: Eating when you're not hungry and taking in that amount of food is exhausting.
19306.name: Chris Hemsworth

19307.quote: Just because the Americans are so good at rattling out accessible and cheap junk food, nobody looks twice when it comes to their food. But there are golden nuggets everywhere.
19307.name: Jamie Oliver

19308.quote: He looked about as inconspicuous as a tarantula on a slice of angel food.
19308.name: Raymond Chandler

19309.quote: I'm lucky because my dad taught me to be frugal and save. And that's important because I want to know that I don't have to take an acting job for two or three years if I don't want to and that I'll still be able to make my house and car payments and buy food for my dogs.
19309.name: Ashley Greene

19310.quote: I've worked on films where the budgets are almost limitless and you're in trailers that are bigger than a hotel room. You're taken care of and the food is amazing, the quality of the job is amazing and then you work on smaller things but it never dictates my happiness or my willingness to go to work.
19310.name: Dominic Monaghan

19311.quote: I am your fairy tale. Your dream. Your wishes and desires, and I am your thirst and your hunger and your food and your drink.
19311.name: Klaus Kinski

19312.quote: The music I do is food, that will be your dinner.
19312.name: Ziggy Marley

19313.quote: A society that thinks the choice between ways of living is just a choice between equally eligible 'lifestyles' turns universities into academic cafeterias offering junk food for the mind.
19313.name: George Will

19314.quote: I love to cook so much. I like to cook everything. I really like to eat my food.
19314.name: Lea Michele

19315.quote: No matter where I've been overseas, the food stinks, except in Italy.
19315.name: Carmen Electra

19316.quote: I love food, I love eating.
19316.name: Robin Gibb

19317.quote: I don't have a dime left. I am dependent on my friends for food and a small old-age pension.
19317.name: Bela Lugosi

19318.quote: Well, food's always the way to anybody's heart, I think, guy or girl.
19318.name: Josh Hutcherson

19319.quote: People need dreams, there's as much nourishment in 'em as food.
19319.name: Dorothy Gilman

19320.quote: People come up to me all the time and say, 'Oh, I love to watch Food Network,' and I ask them what they cook, and they say, 'I don't really cook.' They're afraid, they're intimidated, they know all about food from eating out and watching TV, but they don't know where to start in their own kitchen.
19320.name: Michael Symon

19321.quote: Somewhere between 50 to 60 percent of the food you eat has been touched by immigrant hands, and it is fair to say some of them are not here as they should be here. But if you didn't have these folks, you would be spending a lot more - three, four or five times more - for food, or we would have to import food and have all the food security risks.
19321.name: Tom Vilsack

19322.quote: Local and regional food systems are about opportunity.
19322.name: Tom Vilsack

19323.quote: The food pyramid is very complicated. It doesn't give you as much info in a quick glance as the plate does.
19323.name: Tom Vilsack

19324.quote: You know, rural Americans are a special people. Their labor puts food on our table and fuel in our gas tanks. Their service in our military sets a powerful example of leadership, honor and sacrifice. Their spirit of community inspires us all.
19324.name: Tom Vilsack

19325.quote: Let us build a 21st-century rural economy of cutting-edge companies and technologies that lead us to energy and food security. Such an investment will revitalize rural America, re-establish our moral leadership on climate security and eliminate our addiction to foreign oil.
19325.name: Tom Vilsack

19326.quote: Food during my early years was a very difficult issue for me. I grew up in an addictive family. My mother had serious problems with alcohol and prescription drugs. I was an overweight kid. I can remember back in those days there weren't the strategies that there are today to deal with those issues.
19326.name: Tom Vilsack

19327.quote: Food is a fairly significant aspect of my life. I have struggled mightily with food. With my weight. And I'm conscious of it. So I have a sensitivity to people who struggle with their weight.
19327.name: Tom Vilsack

19328.quote: If you think of what food is, it's the energy we use to do our daily work. I want people to know about the USDA. This is a very important department. It's not fully appreciated as such.
19328.name: Tom Vilsack

19329.quote: You know how you wake up in the morning and sometimes you look gorgeous and other times you look like you got hit by a mack truck? I realized that my mack truck is food. If I have no sugar, yeast or wine, I have no undereye bags and my skin is perfect.
19329.name: Mariska Hargitay

19330.quote: As long as there's pasta and Chinese food in the world, I'm okay.
19330.name: Michael Chang

19331.quote: All artists are people of growth. It's like food, you take the good and leave the rest.
19331.name: Andrew Jack

19332.quote: Compassion is a call, a demand of nature, to relieve the unhappy as hunger is a natural call for food.
19332.name: Joseph Butler

19333.quote: My feeling is that labels are for canned food, I am what I am - and I know what I am.
19333.name: Michael Stipe

19334.quote: I love home cooking, and I'm not a great one for fast food.
19334.name: Bear Grylls

19335.quote: When I'm filming, survival requires movement. You need your energy, and you've got to eat the bad stuff, and survival food is rarely pretty, but you kind of do it. I get in that zone, and I eat the nasty stuff, but I'm not like that when I'm back home.
19335.name: Bear Grylls

19336.quote: Jackie Chan is a very good comedy/martial arts star. He does one kind of martial arts that Jet Li doesn't know how to do and Jet Li does a martial art that Jackie Chan doesn't know how to do. You can both go to two Chinese restaurants, but both can have different kinds of food.
19336.name: Jet Li

19337.quote: I only like food without color, like potatoes, bread, and pasta.
19337.name: Emma Roberts

19338.quote: Stuffing is my favorite food in the world! I actually have been known to go buy stuffing and make it in the middle of summer.
19338.name: Emma Roberts

19339.quote: Food is for eating, and good food is to be enjoyed, I think food is, actually, very beautiful in itself.
19339.name: Delia Smith

19340.quote: When you're out grocery shopping for your family, maybe you can put a can of cat or dog food in your cart and bring it to an animal relief center.
19340.name: Rachael Ray

19341.quote: I don't categorize food as bad or a guilty pleasure.
19341.name: Rachael Ray

19342.quote: The magazine, the daytime show, we've always tried to write affordable, accessible. Those are key words for us, and I do mean us, a huge staff of people at the magazine who love to cook affordable, friendly food that helps families eat better for less.
19342.name: Rachael Ray

19343.quote: You know, food is such - it's a hug for people.
19343.name: Rachael Ray

19344.quote: My husband cooks fancier food for himself than I've ever cooked on-air. I call him from the road, and he's making champagne-vanilla salmon or black-cherry pork chop. Half of me is feeling unworthy. Not only am I not a chef, I'm not a better cook than my own husband!
19344.name: Rachael Ray

19345.quote: It only looks like I get to eat a lot of food on TV. I really just get the one bite and the crew and guests eat everything else.
19345.name: Rachael Ray

19346.quote: When I do a 30-minute meal, for instance, on Food Network, that's my food you see at the end of the show and it's not perfect. And if sometimes things break or drop or the pasta hits the wall when I'm draining it, they never stop tape. They just kind of let me go with it.
19346.name: Rachael Ray

19347.quote: My mom, who's been in the restaurant business for 40 years, is the number-one influence in my life. But I look up to a lot of people in the industry. Tops on my list is Mario Batali. My mom and Mario taught me the same lesson: Food is love.
19347.name: Rachael Ray

19348.quote: Good food and a warm kitchen are what makes a house a home. I always tried to make my home like my mother's, because Mom was magnificent at stretching a buck when it came to decorating and food. Like a true Italian, she valued beautification in every area of her life, and I try to do the same.
19348.name: Rachael Ray

19349.quote: I would say, stay the hell away from the party scene. Anything you put in front of your goal, and especially something like that, whether it's too much gambling, too much food, too much cold beers on the weekend - anything that you put in front of the prize is going to end up getting in the way and hurting you in the end.
19349.name: Brad Renfro

19350.quote: A human being has been given an intellect to make choices, and we know there are other food sources that do not require the killing of a creature that would protest being killed.
19350.name: Mary Tyler Moore

19351.quote: A lot of people think Japanese food is difficult, a lot of work. But you don't have to buy the knife I have. You don't have to train as long as I have. You can do my cooking in your kitchen.
19351.name: Masaharu Morimoto

19352.quote: My late wife Olympia was Goan and I've been to India many times. I love the food there. We used to do our shopping in Southall, where you can find cheap but wonderful fruit like mangoes, vegetables and spices. I didn't do much of the cooking, as Olympia did a lot - I was the under-chef and did some of the chopping.
19352.name: Vince Cable

19353.quote: The food in the House of Commons is fairly good. The cafe in Portcullis House is really very high quality, and you also have a choice of eating in the more traditional restaurants, the Churchill Room or the Members' Dining Room. I don't often eat in them, though, as I'm usually on the run.
19353.name: Vince Cable

19355.quote: I feed my kids organic food and milk, but I've also been known to buy the odd Lunchable. My kids are not allowed to watch TV during the week, but on weekends even the 2-year-old veges out to 'The Simpsons.'
19355.name: Ayelet Waldman

19356.quote: It makes me so angry - there's enough food in the world but people are starving. It's all political.
19356.name: Judith Light

19357.quote: Clearly, America's dysfunctional food culture must bear some of the blame for our excess pounds, but it's likely our walking-averse lifestyles contribute as well.
19357.name: Andrew Weil

19358.quote: Everyone prefers some foods over others, but some adults take this tendency to an extreme. These people tend to prefer the kinds of bland food they may have enjoyed as children - such as plain or buttered pasta, macaroni and cheese, cheese pizza, French fries and grilled cheese sandwiches - and to restrict their eating to just a few dishes.
19358.name: Andrew Weil

19359.quote: It does kids no favors, and sets them up for a potential lifetime of poor health and social embarrassment, to excuse them from family meals of real food. Everyone benefits from healthy eating, but it is particularly crucial at the beginning of life.
19359.name: Andrew Weil

19360.quote: A lot of times on tour it's about, 'OK, where am I today? Wow, I'm in Costa Rica. What is their famous dish?' And it's about trying the food, and really experiencing it.
19360.name: Fergie

19361.quote: I can safely say that other than macaroni and cheese, there's no processed food in my life. There's no inorganic food in my life these days. There's no junk food. There's not a lot of sugar. There's no soy. I mean, really everything that's going into my body is pretty pure.
19361.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

19362.quote: There is no reasoning, no process of inference or comparison there is no thinking about things, no putting two and two together there are no ideas - the animal does not think of the box or of the food or of the act he is to perform.
19362.name: Edward Thorndike

19363.quote: If newspapers were a baseball team, they would be the Mets - without the hope for those folks at the very pinnacle of the financial food chain - who average nearly $24 million a year in income - 'next year.'
19363.name: Eric Alterman

19364.quote: The most used piece of kit in my kitchen is my saucepan. I use it every morning to cook my porridge in. The least used piece of equipment? I'd say a food mixer. I've never used it, I don't really know what they're for.
19364.name: David Walliams

19365.quote: When I want comfort food, I buy Maltesers. I like all chocolates, but especially those. You can eat them, and because they're so light, you can convince yourself that they are not actually that fattening.
19365.name: David Walliams

19366.quote: Anybody who finds it easy to make money on the horses is probably in the dog food business.
19366.name: Franklin P. Jones

19367.quote: I love 'Top Chef.' I think it rewrote the book on how food shows are presented on TV.
19367.name: Andy Cohen

19368.quote: St. Louis has a lot of weird food customs that you don't see other places - and a lot of great ethnic neighborhoods. There's a German neighborhood. A great old school Italian neighborhood, with toasted ravioli, which seems to be a St. Louis tradition. And they love provolone cheese in St. Louis.
19368.name: Andy Cohen

19369.quote: Customers want good value, but they care more than ever how food and clothing products are made.
19369.name: Stuart Rose

19370.quote: People ask me how I keep my figure, and I tell them it's because I paint. When you're covered in paint, it's quite hard to put food in your mouth!
19370.name: Jane Seymour

19371.quote: It is great to add some glamour to the food industry, like television shows have done for the food world and inspiring people to work in the industry. The flip side of that is unfortunately people think that after they get their qualifications, they get their invitation to compete on 'Top Chef.'
19371.name: Curtis Stone

19372.quote: There are probably close to a million people in the hospitality industry here in the United States, and there are probably only a few hundred opportunities in the food media industry.
19372.name: Curtis Stone

19373.quote: For me, food is all about balance. If you eat plenty of fruits, vegetables, and an appropriate amount of poultry, fish, and red meat that are sourced from good places, you're doing well. It's important to make sure that the meat you're consuming is hormone-free.
19373.name: Curtis Stone

19374.quote: In my travels, I also noticed that kids in Thailand like spicy food, and kids in India love curry. I'm hoping to introduce my son, Hudson, to lots of veggies and spices when he's young. I say that before he's started on solid foods, so it could be easier in theory than practice!
19374.name: Curtis Stone

19375.quote: I need protein from food rather than just protein supplements. I changed my diet.
19375.name: Travis Barker

19376.quote: The best thing you can do for someone is make them a beautiful plate of food. How else can you invade someone's body without actually touching them?
19376.name: Padma Lakshmi

19377.quote: Wine, like food, is so emotional. If you think about it, so much of the courting ritual is surrounded by wine and food. There's a built-in romance to wine.
19377.name: Padma Lakshmi

19378.quote: I really like to sometimes go into food detox and eat very simply.
19378.name: Padma Lakshmi

19379.quote: Part of my job as a food writer is to describe food. So my work on 'Top Chef,' I feel, is an extension of that. When we give a criticism to the contestant, we want to make sure we tell them why it's not working and why it would work if they did it a different way.
19379.name: Padma Lakshmi

19380.quote: From the simple stringing together of lemon garlands for the goddess Durga, to dividing the prasadam or blessed foods for the children first, I came to associate food not only with feminity, but also with purity and divinity.
19380.name: Padma Lakshmi

19381.quote: We tend to connect bad food and bad habits with romance and sex.
19381.name: Marilu Henner

19382.quote: Australia is the only island continent on the planet, which means that changes caused by planet-warming pollution - warmer seas, which can drive stronger storms, and more acidic oceans, which wreak havoc on the food chain - are even more deadly here.
19382.name: Jeff Goodell

19383.quote: With nine degrees of warming, computer models project that Australia will look like a disaster movie. Habitats for most vertebrates will vanish. Water supply to the Murray-Darling Basin will fall by half, severely curtailing food production.
19383.name: Jeff Goodell

19384.quote: They're now turning those seeds into intellectual property, so they have a virtual lock on the seeds upon which we all depend for our food and survival.
19384.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19385.quote: We are already producing enough food to feed the world. We already have technology in place that allows us to produce more than we can find a market for.
19385.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19386.quote: The American public is not aware that there might be potential allergenic and toxic reactions. With regular food, at least people know which foods they have an allergy to.
19386.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19387.quote: The public should know that the liability issues here have yet to be resolved, or even raised. If you're a farmer and you're growing a genetically engineering food crop, those genes are going to flow to the other farm.
19387.name: Jeremy Rifkin

19388.quote: I love Alton Brown's show 'Good Eats,' about the chemistry of food. It's really thoughtful.
19388.name: Ina Garten

19389.quote: The thing about all my food is that everything is a remembered flavor. Maybe it's something I had as a child or maybe it's something I had in Milan, but I want it to taste better than you ever thought.
19389.name: Ina Garten

19390.quote: I worked for the Office of Management and Budget in the White House, on nuclear energy policy. But I decided it would be much more fun to have a specialty food store, so I left Washington D.C. and moved to the Hamptons. And how glad I am that I did!
19390.name: Ina Garten

19391.quote: There's nothing more romantic than Italian food.
19391.name: Elisha Cuthbert

19392.quote: No, I love Montreal, I think I love Montreal more than Montreal loves me, I love the food there.
19392.name: Kathy Griffin

19393.quote: Food is my thing, I do not smoke or drink, so food is my vice.
19393.name: Kathy Griffin

19394.quote: I just don't crave junk food.
19394.name: Cat Deeley

19395.quote: I don't feel any pressure to lose weight - and in any case, if I didn't have my food I'd be a nasty piece of work and wouldn't be able to function.
19395.name: Cat Deeley

19396.quote: I want to make wines that harmonize with food - wines that almost hug your tongue with gentleness.
19396.name: Robert Mondavi

19397.quote: It's my first presenting role so I'll be nervous, but it's going to be great fun. I can't wait to sample the food and meet the celebrities. Hopefully I can inject some of my own glamour.
19397.name: Nicole Appleton

19398.quote: High-quality food is better for your health.
19398.name: Michael Pollan

19399.quote: Let's keep the chemists over here and the food over here, that's my feeling. What do I know? But that is a big aspect of fast food is their ability to artificially taint the colors and the smells and stuff to stimulate appetite.
19399.name: Greg Kinnear

19400.quote: They did interviews with my wife and daughter-they were genuinely in fear of me having a heart attack, working 20 hours a day, eating fast food.
19400.name: Willie Aames

19401.quote: In England and America people tend to graze all day long, but I think it's such a waste to be constantly picking at food because you then can't enjoy a proper full meal when the time comes.
19401.name: Nigella Lawson

19402.quote: I have an enormous fondness for delicious food. It's very comforting.
19402.name: Teri Garr

19403.quote: Long as I was riding in a big Cadillac and dressed nice and had plenty of food, that's all I cared about.
19403.name: Etta James

19404.quote: Food is meant to be used as fuel for our bodies. If you're using it for any other reasons, take a step back and ask yourself, 'What's up.'
19404.name: Jennifer Hudson

19405.quote: I wanted to be a great white hunter, a prospector for gold, or a slave trader. But then, when I was eight, my parents sent me to a boarding school in South Africa. It was the equivalent of a British public school with cold showers, beatings and rotten food. But what it also had was a library full of books.
19405.name: Wilbur Smith

19406.quote: Even though I grew up as a Sephardic Jew in Brooklyn where we ate Syrian food and went to temple, it was still America.
19406.name: Isaac Mizrahi

19407.quote: Most of my life I was occupied with American television and American food. My ethnicity was my choice. It still is.
19407.name: Isaac Mizrahi

19408.quote: I'm not really into gourmet food I'm the kind of guy who just stops by a place that looks good rather than heading for the restaurant of the moment.
19408.name: Lee Child

19409.quote: I love Italian food but that's too generic a term for what's available now: you have to narrow it down to Tuscan, Sicilian, and so on.
19409.name: Lee Child

19411.quote: It's easy to be lazy when there's food lying around backstage or there's a fast-food joint a couple blocks away. But if you walk a little further, ask around a bit, of course there are exciting things to discover.
19411.name: Alex Kapranos

19412.quote: The wonderful thing about Food for Thought is that it lets you keep your hand in theater and be in front of a live audience without a commitment of six months, or even three months.
19412.name: Treat Williams

19413.quote: Food was a constant topic of conversation in our household.
19413.name: Paul Lynde

19414.quote: Every country can be defined through their food, their music and their language. That's the soul of a country.
19414.name: Quincy Jones

19415.quote: I have a fear of poverty in old age. I have this vision of myself living in a skip and eating cat food. It's because I'm freelance, and I've never had a proper job. I don't have a pension, and my savings are dwindling. I always thought someone would just come along and look after me.
19415.name: Jenny Eclair

19416.quote: For much of the female half of the world, food is the first signal of our inferiority. It lets us know that our own families may consider female bodies to be less deserving, less needy, less valuable.
19416.name: Gloria Steinem

19417.quote: My grandmother was the greatest cook in the world. She could just go in there, the whole kitchen would look like a tornado hit it and then she'd come out with the best food. Then she'd sit at the table and she wouldn't eat!
19417.name: Edie Brickell

19418.quote: Absolutely, there is a connection between food and love. I always say, when there's love in my heart or I'm feeling particularly good, the food comes out that much better. And so I think Valentine's Day is a special day.
19418.name: Todd English

19419.quote: When the farmer can sell directly to the consumer, it is a more active process. There's more contact. The consumer can know, who am I buying this from? What's their name? Do they have a face? Is the food they are selling coming out of Mexico with pesticides?
19419.name: Jerry Brown

19420.quote: All I ever wanted to do was to make food accessible to everyone to show that you can make mistakes - I do all the time - but it doesn't matter.
19420.name: Jamie Oliver

19421.quote: It's very clear that there's a lot of double standards going on. Should there be a 30mph speed limit? Of course there bloody should. And certainly with kids and school food, kids need to be nannied for sure. So give them a bloody good meal at school.
19421.name: Jamie Oliver

19422.quote: If you only design menus that are essentially junk or fast food, the whole infrastructure supports junk.
19422.name: Jamie Oliver

19423.quote: Give your kids a bloody knife and fork and let me put some fresh food in front of them they can eat.
19423.name: Jamie Oliver

19424.quote: Heads know that failing to invest in good, nutritious food is a false economy and parents won't tolerate reconstituted turkey being put back on the menu.
19424.name: Jamie Oliver

19425.quote: I want Americans to enjoy food. I want them to celebrate food. I want them to, on occasions, to have big cakes and great things. And I want them to indulge.
19425.name: Jamie Oliver

19426.quote: I wouldn't say that processed food, ready meals and even takeaways aren't relevant to modern life, it's just that over the past 40 years there are three generations of people who have come out of school and gone through their home life without ever being shown how to cook properly.
19426.name: Jamie Oliver

19427.quote: The average housewife goes to the restaurant to relax and enjoy the food. But when Eva walks in, she becomes the center of attention.
19427.name: Eva Gabor

19428.quote: Your diet is a bank account. Good food choices are good investments.
19428.name: Bethenny Frankel

19429.quote: Never eat while doing something else, because you won't get the satisfaction from your food and you'll be more likely to overeat.
19429.name: Bethenny Frankel

19430.quote: Food is not your best friend or enemy.
19430.name: Bethenny Frankel

19431.quote: Part of treatment for drugs and alcohol is you abstain from these, but with eating disorders you can't abstain from food so the treatment is longer than drugs and alcohol.
19431.name: Carre Otis

19432.quote: You have to find a balance with food in your life - you can't take out food. It can be absolutely terrifying.
19432.name: Carre Otis

19433.quote: While weight loss is important, what's more important is the quality of food you put in your body - food is information that quickly changes your metabolism and genes.
19433.name: Mark Hyman

19434.quote: A dead cow or sheep lying in a pasture is recognized as carrion. The same sort of a carcass dressed and hung up in a butcher's stall passes as food.
19434.name: John Harvey Kellogg

19435.quote: The food in such places is so tasteless because the members associate spices and garlic with just the sort of people they're trying to keep out.
19435.name: Calvin Trillin

19436.quote: When it comes to Chinese food I have always operated under the policy that the less known about the preparation the better. A wise diner who is invited to visit the kitchen replies by saying, as politely as possible, that he has a pressing engagement elsewhere.
19436.name: Calvin Trillin

19437.quote: I don't think I've ever read a food piece or a food book.
19437.name: Calvin Trillin

19438.quote: I don't cook. I don't know anything about food. I've never reviewed a restaurant.
19438.name: Calvin Trillin

19439.quote: Canadians are very well behaved, they don't throw their food.
19439.name: Calvin Trillin

19440.quote: Be what you would seem to be - or, if you'd like it put more simply - a house is no home unless it contains food and fire for the mind as well as the body.
19440.name: Margaret Fuller

19441.quote: Japanese food makes me feel particularly good.
19441.name: David Mitchell

19442.quote: I was always the new kid in school, I'm the kid from a broken family, I'm the kid who had no dad showing up at the father-son stuff, I'm the kid that was using food stamps at the grocery store.
19442.name: Dave Mustaine

19443.quote: When service members are discharged, we should express our gratitude for their profound personal sacrifice, not hand them a bill for their hospital food.
19443.name: Barbara Boxer

19444.quote: I love doing demonstrations. I think to be a great chef you have to be a great teacher. I love doing classes with people who love food and enjoy food, bringing them all around one table so to speak.
19444.name: Michael Symon

19445.quote: Recipes are important but only to a point. What's more important than recipes is how we think about food, and a good cookbook should open up a new way of doing just that.
19445.name: Michael Symon

19446.quote: Go to the grocery store and buy better things. Buy quality, buy organic, buy natural, go to the farmers market. Immediately that's going to increase the quality of the food you make.
19446.name: Michael Symon

19447.quote: I don't think any other holiday embraces the food of the Midwest quite like Thanksgiving. There's roasted meat and mashed potatoes. But being here is also about heritage. Cleveland is really a giant melting pot - not only is my family a melting pot, but so is the city.
19447.name: Michael Symon

19448.quote: My goal in 'Live to Cook' is to make great food more approachable for home cooks.
19448.name: Michael Symon

19449.quote: I don't do yoga. I bite the hella outta my nails. I smoke, I eat all the wrong food, I don't exercise.
19449.name: Lisa Marie Presley

19450.quote: For some Chicago expats, food is the medicine that blunts the pain of separation.
19450.name: Mary Schmich

19451.quote: The best way to lose weight is to close your mouth - something very difficult for a politician. Or watch your food - just watch it, don't eat it.
19451.name: Ed Koch

19452.quote: It was my Uncle George who discovered that alcohol was a food well in advance of modern medical thought.
19452.name: P. G. Wodehouse

19453.quote: I love England, especially the food. There's nothing I like more than a lovely bowl of pasta.
19453.name: Naomi Campbell

19454.quote: A fly cannot go in unless it stops somewhere therefore weapons, fuel, food, money will not go to Afghanistan unless the neighbors of Afghanistan are working, are cooperating, either being themselves the origin or the transit.
19454.name: Lakhdar Brahimi

19455.quote: Queuing tips for fans: wrap up and bring food!
19455.name: Niall Horan

19456.quote: I think the most wonderful thing in the world is another chef. I'm always excited about learning new things about food.
19456.name: Paul Prudhomme

19457.quote: Creole is New Orleans city food. Communities were created by the people who wanted to stay and not go back to Spain or France.
19457.name: Paul Prudhomme

19458.quote: Another nice thing was that I would type out letters home for the admiral's stewards. They would then feed me the same food the admiral ate.
19458.name: Jack Adams

19459.quote: I've always felt that sexuality is a really slippery thing. In this day and age, it tends to get categorized and labeled, and I think labels are for food. Canned food.
19459.name: Michael Stipe

19460.quote: I'm reading a lot of different books, but I always think I have to switch it up a little bit. It's like food - everything in moderation, same with my books, same with my reading. You read books that are good for you and you learn a lot of stuff, then you read 'Fifty Shades of Grey,' which is like candy.
19460.name: Shay Mitchell

19461.quote: I can't deliver lines, but I can talk about food all night long.
19461.name: Tom Colicchio

19462.quote: Hunger is a political issue, and there are several things politically that are keeping people hungry - not funding food stamps adequately, not funding school lunches adequately. So there is a political solution to the problem of hunger.
19462.name: Tom Colicchio

19463.quote: You can buy a box of low-fat macaroni and cheese made with powdered nonsense. I'm not worried if I'm using four different cheeses and it's high in fat. It's real food. That's what's more important.
19463.name: Tom Colicchio

19464.quote: I think steak is the ultimate comfort food, and if you're going out for one, that isn't the time to scrimp on calories or quality.
19464.name: Tom Colicchio

19465.quote: You have to know the classics if you want to cook modern food.
19465.name: Tom Colicchio

19466.quote: In New York, I'll walk down the street and someone will say, 'Nice show,' and that's it. If I'm at a food festival, it's open season.
19466.name: Tom Colicchio

19467.quote: As a chef, I had started working with groups like Share Our Strength and various local food banks in New York, raising money for hunger-related issues. And not only me, but the entire restaurant industry has been very focused on this issue.
19467.name: Tom Colicchio

19468.quote: There's the issue of hunger, and there's an issue of if you're going to cut out food programs. We should be focusing on healthy food. Right now, fruits and vegetables are very expensive. So what can we do on the policy side to bring the cost of fruits and vegetables down?
19468.name: Tom Colicchio

19469.quote: A couple of months ago, I was down in Florida for the Food and Wine Festival. And this journalist grabbed me and said, 'How does it feel to be a TV guy? You're no longer in the restaurant business.' And I laughed. I asked him, 'How long do you think it takes me to do a season?' He said, 'Well, 200 days.' And I was like, '200 days? Try 20!'
19469.name: Tom Colicchio

19470.quote: Asian food is very easy to like because it hits your mouth very differently than European food does. In European food, there may be two things to hit - maybe sweet and salty, maybe salty-savory, but Asian kind of works around, plus you have that distinct flavor that's usually working in Asian food.
19470.name: Tom Colicchio

19471.quote: We are not really privy to all that crazy stuff that goes on in the show. I go to work, eat, and talk about food. The wild things happen when we aren't around. I expected Top Chef to last three or four seasons and we are now shooting season ten.
19471.name: Tom Colicchio

19472.quote: We're adults. We're the ones who should teach the kids what's good to eat. I don't think the government should ever regulate what we eat at home, but we're feeding them in school with tax dollars. Quite frankly, if my tax dollars are being spent to feed kids, I'd rather feed them better food.
19472.name: Tom Colicchio

19473.quote: I travel around and hear from so many kids. Their parents say they were always very picky but they watch the show and they want to try stuff. The show is entertainment, but I think it has done so much for the public perception of what food can be.
19473.name: Tom Colicchio

19474.quote: There's a food revolution going on throughout the country. And it doesn't matter if you're down south, up north in Maine, if you're out west in Portland or Seattle.
19474.name: Tom Colicchio

19475.quote: Everything is just better in California - the wine, the food, fruits and vegetables, the comforts of living. Even the instrumentalists are generous and curious. Everything is wonderful.
19475.name: Beth Anderson

19476.quote: But it's really hard to eat good when you're traveling because you see fast food and you want to go to this restaurant and that restaurant.
19476.name: Nicole Polizzi

19477.quote: But Australia faces additional regional and global challenges also crucial to our nation's future - climate change, questions of energy and food security, the rise of China and the rise of India. And we need a strong system of global and regional relationships and institutions to underpin stability.
19477.name: Kevin Rudd

19478.quote: You feel better when you're eating food that retains nutritional value.
19478.name: Amber Heard

19479.quote: In the States, you can buy Chinese food. In Beijing you can buy hamburger. It's very close. Now I feel the world become a big family, like a really big family. You have many neighbors. Not like before, two countries are far away.
19479.name: Jet Li

19480.quote: The less you do to beautiful food, the better it's going to taste. You don't need to mess with it all the time.
19480.name: Gail Simmons

19481.quote: Patience is the secret to good food.
19481.name: Gail Simmons

19482.quote: I'm tempted by everything. My husband makes fun of me because every day it's a new food that I love. I have a weakness for butterscotch pudding, ice cream in any flavor and dark chocolate, although that's one thing I do keep in my house - 70% dark chocolate.
19482.name: Gail Simmons

19483.quote: Like baseball, food will never go out of style we will always need to eat and we will always find it entertaining. I think of food TV this way - all the fun and none of the calories.
19483.name: Gail Simmons

19484.quote: There's not a single chef I know of that does not think about the politics of the food they're serving.
19484.name: Gail Simmons

19485.quote: I had decided I wanted to write about food, and I knew the only way to do that is to speak with authority, which meant learning the language and knowing what that experience is like.
19485.name: Gail Simmons

19486.quote: It's better to get the nutrients for healthy skin from food, not supplements. Salmon, walnuts, blueberries, spinach, lots of my favorite foods happen to be amazing for skin too.
19486.name: Gail Simmons

19487.quote: There are days when I literally have to eat 17 plates of food - it's intense. It's about moderation. You just need a few bites to get the gist of a dish.
19487.name: Gail Simmons

19488.quote: Find combinations of flavors you love and buy the best quality ingredients you can afford. Your food is only going to be as good as the sum of its parts, like anything else.
19488.name: Gail Simmons

19489.quote: Fast sex, like fast food, is cheap, but it doesn't nourish the body - or the soul.
19489.name: Suzanne Fields

19490.quote: To me, food is as much about the moment, the occasion, the location and the company as it is about the taste.
19490.name: Heston Blumenthal

19491.name: Heston Blumenthal

19492.quote: You think about some of the most memorable meals you've ever had the food will be good but it will often be about locating a mental memory and taste is inexorably linked to all the other senses and memory, so ultimately it is all about taste.
19492.name: Heston Blumenthal

19493.quote: It's easy for people in an air-conditioned room to continue with the policies of destruction of Mother Earth. We need instead to put ourselves in the shoes of families in Bolivia and worldwide that lack water and food and suffer misery and hunger.
19493.name: Evo Morales

19494.name: Sandra Lee

19495.quote: I'm not sure that some of the food purists are in touch with what really goes on in American households.
19495.name: Sandra Lee

19496.quote: It's really easy to figure out why I love what I love, the holidays and food. I know the difference between having them and not having them.
19496.name: Sandra Lee

19497.quote: I'm the only girl on The Food Network who grills - I have two bestselling grilling books. I try to really focus on what men and women can do outside together out on the grill. I think it's really fun to have men and women out there together, having fun, working and enjoying themselves.
19497.name: Sandra Lee

19498.quote: I like doing food as a focal point on my table. It is not like going out and buying flowers or candles, which are expensive.
19498.name: Sandra Lee

19499.quote: We have reduced sales tax on food. Now we want it eliminated.
19499.name: Joe Manchin

19500.quote: Woe to us if we get our satisfaction from the food in the kitchen and the TV in the den and the sex in the bedroom with an occasional tribute to the cement blocks in the basement!
19500.name: John Piper

19501.name: Jacques Pepin

19502.name: Jacques Pepin

19503.quote: When I pair food and wine, I start with the food. If I have a beautiful roasted bird, I might choose a Cabernet or Pinot Noir, or maybe a Syrah, depending on the sauce and what is in my cellar.
19503.name: Jacques Pepin

19504.quote: I taped my first series for PBS in 1982 at WJCT-TV in Jacksonville, Florida. The show, called 'Everyday Cooking with Jacques Pepin,' was about saving time and money in the kitchen - and it was a celebration of simple and unpretentious food.
19504.name: Jacques Pepin

19505.quote: When I wrote 'Fast Food My Way' in 2004, I hoped that my friends would prepare my recipes. Now, more people cook from that book than any other I've written in the past 30 years.
19505.name: Jacques Pepin

19506.quote: This June, I'll travel once again to the Food and Wine Magazine Classic in Aspen, Colorado. For many years, my dear friend Julia Child and I have teamed up to teach classes together at the event for the past seven years, my daughter, Claudine, has been my cooking partner on stage.
19506.name: Jacques Pepin

19507.quote: The agony of my feelings allowed me no respite no incident occurred from which my rage and misery could not extract its food.

19508.quote: Somewhere near you, somebody right now is trying to help the indigent and poor - providing food, shelter, clothing or simple kindness.

19514.name: Eric Ries

19519.quote: I probably grow half my food. It's a good way to keep perspective.

19521.name: Michelle Bachelet

19522.quote: We simply can no longer afford to deny the full potential of one half of the population. The world needs to tap into the talent and wisdom of women. 19522.name: Michelle Bachelet

19523.quote: Yeah, well, food is always a part of everything.

19524.name: Ezra Miller

19543.name: Michael Pollan

19555.quote: The murals in restaurants are on par with the food in museums.

19556.quote: I get way too much happiness from good food.

19559.quote: I am a serious food lover and Peruvian cuisine is one of the best in the world.

19563.name: Heather Mills

19564.quote: I got a fascination with food.
19564.name: Heather Mills

19567.quote: I love tiny, plastic realistic food magnets. I don't know why. They're hilarious.

19568.quote: I'm not a food critic, and I'm not really an authority to write anything on food.

19569.quote: A lot of food criticism has a similar flavor to it, and I'm probably going to write about it in a different way.

19571.name: Bill O'Reilly

19572.quote: Not to like ice cream is to show oneself uninterested in food.

19580.quote: I came literally to the table with a wealth of knowledge by simply understanding how food should taste.

19581.quote: I have an amazing relationship with food.

19587.quote: I'm not too into fast food, but you know if I was, it would be chicken.
19587.name: Giancarlo Esposito

19588.name: Baz Luhrmann

19589.name: Denise Mina

19590.quote: First I would probably place men at the bottom of the food chain. On a grander scale, I would say they're reacting to change. Feminism has got to be part of that.
19590.name: Neil LaBute

19591.name: Matt Stone

19592.quote: I think there's a lot of work to be done with our societies. My biggest passions are the environment and health. And when I say 'health' I mean the secrets behind health and our food system.
19592.name: Shailene Woodley

19598.quote: America is a such a melting pot, I'm not sure if roast chicken is the classic comfort food for everybody.

19599.quote: There is great food in Vegas.
19599.name: Eric Ripert

19600.quote: I don't follow the food trends.
19600.name: Eric Ripert

19601.quote: I suppose women are attracted to the bad-boy image sometimes because it's fun to have an adventure. It's like eating junk food, it's fun at the time, but ultimately not the best choice.
19601.name: Dita Von Teese

19602.quote: Looking back, there is nothing wrong with that peace, love and equality that the hippies espoused. In many ways, we have regressed because they were into organic food, back to nature, make love not war, be good to all men, share and share alike - which is what many are talking about now.
19602.name: Imelda Staunton

19603.quote: Taste as you go. When you taste the food throughout the cooking process you can make adjustments as you go.
19603.name: Anne Burrell

19604.name: Nicole Scherzinger

19606.name: Mark Hyman

19607.name: Mark Hyman

19608.name: Mark Hyman

19609.quote: Most schools have only a microwave or deep fryer, hardly the tools needed to feed our children real, fresh food.
19609.name: Mark Hyman

19610.quote: When it becomes a revolutionary act to eat real food, we are in trouble.
19610.name: Mark Hyman

19611.name: Liv Tyler
