19612.name: Luke Scott

19613.quote: Bahrainis are better off than many other Arabs. We have a welfare state, everybody gets a salary whether they have a job or not. Electricity and food are subsidized school and healthcare are free. And we don't differentiate between Bahrainis and foreigners. We are very proud of that.
19613.name: Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa

19614.quote: It's a funny thing about me. I don't have any interest in food most of the time now, although when I was a kid I was always hungry.

19617.name: Gro Harlem Brundtland

19618.name: Gabrielle Reece

19620.quote: Food is fuel and not a solution to anything other than giving your body nutrients. I love chocolate like the next girl, but it's not going to change my situation.
19620.name: Gabrielle Reece

19621.quote: I love HGTV. I love the Food Network.
19621.name: Tim Gunn

19622.quote: You can give men food and leisure and amusements and good conditions of work, and still they will remain unsatisfied. You can deny them all these things, and they will not complain so long as they feel that they have something to die for.
19622.name: Christopher Dawson

19623.quote: When you get to fifty-two food becomes more important than sex.
19623.name: Tom Lehrer

19624.quote: If I am in London I like a quick get away to The Olde Bell in Hurley, It's nearby and no stress - great food and beautiful walks.
19624.name: Sadie Frost

19625.name: Jim Ryun

19630.name: Ron Ben-Israel

19631.name: Marcy Kaptur

19632.quote: I love making Italian food. And coconut chicken.
19632.name: Joe Jonas

19633.quote: Sometimes I even now feel like a stranger in my country. But I knew there would be problems because I had seen the world as a skater. And now? A lot of people in eastern Germany have lost jobs, rents went up, food costs went up, unemployment went to 20 percent. Freedom is good, but it is not easy.
19633.name: Katarina Witt

19634.quote: I heard about the project over a year before we began. My American agent said, 'Oh, you might want to read 'In Cold Blood' because they're talking about you for Capote, but the script's with Johnny Depp and Sean Penn at the moment.' 19927.name: T. D. Jakes

19938.name: Jonathan Sacks

19942.name: Karl Barth

19943.quote: I find forgiveness to be really healthy.

19944.quote: My desire is to stand up and brush myself off when I make mistakes and ask for forgiveness.

19945.name: Jennifer O'Neill

19946.quote: I think it's important to remember that Christianity was based in love and tolerance and forgiveness and acceptance.
19946.name: Kristin Chenoweth

19947.quote: I think we learn the most from imperfect relationships - things like forgiveness and compassion.
19947.name: Andrea Thompson

19948.name: Edward Albert

19949.quote: When there's that forgiveness present and compassion, it just helps you live so much easier.
19949.name: Craig T. Nelson

19950.quote: Forgiveness is indifference. Forgiveness is impossible while love lasts.
19950.name: Mary Chesnut

19951.name: Suze Orman

19952.quote: Whenever men take the law into their own hands, the loser is the law. And when the law loses, freedom languishes.
19952.name: Robert Kennedy

19960.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower

19961.quote: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.

19962.name: Ron Paul

19963.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

20630.quote: Jazz is about freedom within discipline. Usually a dictatorship like in Russia and Germany will prevent jazz from being played because it just seemed to represent freedom, democracy and the United States.
20630.name: Dave Brubeck

20631.quote: Many people don't understand how disciplined you have to be to play jazz, And that is really the idea of democracy - freedom within the Constitution or discipline. You don't just get out there and do anything you want.
20631.name: Dave Brubeck

20632.quote: Jazz stands for freedom. It's supposed to be the voice of freedom: Get out there and improvise, and take chances, and don't be a perfectionist - leave that to the classical musicians.
20632.name: Dave Brubeck

20633.quote: I was 37 when my father died-and I no longer had any freedom of choice over what I would do with the rest of my life.
20633.name: Paul Getty

20634.quote: This enemy of peace in the world today is unlike any we have seen in the past, and our military is learning from, and building on, previous successes while carrying peace and freedom into the future.
20634.name: Mark Kennedy

20635.quote: I have just enough people paying attention that I have the freedom to be in charge. And I have a great record company - Nonesuch understands what I'm about.
20635.name: Emmylou Harris

20636.quote: The United States is a giant island of freedom, achievement, wealth and prosperity in a world hostile to our values.
20636.name: Phyllis Schlafly

20637.quote: Maybe a part of me recognized how right the improvising spirit of jazz is. Not the sounds, but the freedom to work with musicians who work that way. It felt very natural to me, but I think there's a way to do it without it being a jazz record.
20637.name: Jane Siberry

20638.quote: That happens every time I get behind a guitar, regardless of what I'm saying, 'cause music is freedom and being free is the closest I've ever felt to being spiritual.
20638.name: Ben Harper

20639.quote: You have an absolute freedom in Mexican writing today in which you don't necessarily have to deal with the Mexican identity. You know why? Because we have an identity, We know who we are. We know what it means to be a Mexican.
20639.name: Carlos Fuentes

20640.quote: For science must breathe the oxygen of freedom.
20640.name: John Charles Polanyi

20641.quote: It's good that the first half of the speech emphasized freedom, because George W. Bush has been the global champion for freedom. As he said, if we don't fight tyranny it will not leave us alone in peace.
20641.name: Ernest Istook

20642.quote: A culture without property, or in which creators can't get paid, is anarchy, not freedom.
20642.name: Lawrence Lessig

20643.quote: The attitude is we live and let live. This is actually an amazing change in values in a rather short time and it's an example of freedom from religion.
20643.name: Tom Wolfe

20644.quote: I don't have anything to prove anymore. I don't have a record deal, no one has any expectations, I'm in a position of freedom. I don't need anyone's approval.
20644.name: Juliana Hatfield

20645.quote: Working with David Cronenberg or Darren Aronofsky or even Steven Soderbergh isn't really like a typical Hollywood movie. These are true artists, and have a certain amount of freedom when they work, and they're more like independent filmmakers making their way through big studios.
20645.name: Vincent Cassel

20646.quote: Your life is the sum result of all the choices you make, both consciously and unconsciously. If you can control the process of choosing, you can take control of all aspects of your life. You can find the freedom that comes from being in charge of yourself.
20646.name: Robert Foster Bennett

20647.quote: I have always that there ought to be some kind of mandatory national service, not necessarily in the military but to show everybody that freedom isn't free, that everybody has an obligation to the nation as a community.
20647.name: Robert M. Gates

20648.quote: It is not natural or inevitable that half the world goes hungry that the freedom of markets trumps protection of the planet or that citizens' rights come second to those of corporations.
20648.name: Frances O'Grady

20649.quote: In times such as these, people should recognize that evil knows no borders, knows no limits and knows no compassion. Those around the globe that value freedom must continue to persevere even in the darkest of times.
20649.name: Michael Burgess

20650.quote: To her audience, Janis Joplin has remained a symbol, artifact and reminder of late Sixties youth culture. Her popularity never derived from her musical ability, but from her capacity to link her fantasies of freedom and immortality with ours.
20650.name: Jon Landau

20651.quote: The enemies of freedom will not prevail.
20651.name: Bill Frist

20652.quote: In short, is not liberty the freedom of every person to make full use of his faculties, so long as he does not harm other persons while doing so?
20652.name: Frederic Bastiat

20653.quote: How can you be conservative and justify wiretapping people without a warrant? We're supposed to be the party of personal freedom and civil liberties.
20653.name: Roger Stone

20654.quote: Another hero was Tom Swift, in the books. What he stood for, the freedom, the scientific knowledge and being and engineer gave him the ability to invent solutions to problems. He's always been a hero to me. I buy old Tom Swift books now and read them to my own children.
20654.name: Steve Wozniak

20655.quote: Real change isn't found in some new way to think about yourself, but in freedom from the need to think about yourself at all.
20655.name: Guy Finley

20656.quote: It's great to have the freedom to enjoy your work and not feel like you're leaving your other life behind.
20656.name: Anna Paquin

20657.quote: I always wanted to make a children's album because you have the freedom to explore so many wonderful topics and sounds.
20657.name: Lisa Loeb

20658.quote: The first of all commodities to be exchanged is labour, and the freedom of man consists only in the exercise of the right to determine for himself in what manner his labour shall be employed, and how he will dispose of its products.
20658.name: Henry Charles Carey

20659.quote: You know, you don't retreat in the defense of freedom. You don't retreat in the defense of moral government and limited government. You don't retreat because people are going to defend bad things.
20659.name: Russell Pearce

20660.quote: If governments let themselves be fully bound by the decisions of their parliaments without protecting their own freedom to act, a breakup of Europe would be a more probable outcome than deeper integration.
20660.name: Mario Monti

20661.quote: It the British System is the most gigantic system of slavery the world has yet seen, and therefore it is that freedom gradually disappears from every country over which England is enabled to obtain control.
20661.name: Henry Charles Carey

20662.quote: Yes, we have the freedom to do what we please, but it only works because we don't do everything we might please - we should exercise some degree of personal, and corporate, responsibility.
20662.name: Tammy Bruce

20663.quote: Freedom of expression comes with responsibilities, especially when it comes with serious implications for peace.
20663.name: Mohammed Morsi

20664.quote: My name became known because I was, one might say accidentally the target of state repression and because so many people throughout the country and other parts of the world organized around the demand for my freedom.
20664.name: Angela Davis

20665.quote: Creative freedom is an imperative for me, but it doesn't really exist in a Hollywood game.
20665.name: Mira Nair

20666.quote: America has never seen itself as a national state like all others, but rather as an experiment in human freedom and democracy.
20666.name: Brent Scowcroft

20667.quote: I want to have the freedom to do whatever I want.
20667.name: Paul Walker

20668.quote: Money buys many things, The best of which is freedom.
20668.name: Mary Renault

20669.quote: You, the foreign media, have been the companion of my people in its long and painful journey to freedom.
20669.name: Corazon Aquino

20670.quote: You have spent many lives and much treasure to bring freedom to many lands that were reluctant to receive it. And here you have a people who won it by themselves and need only the help to preserve it.
20670.name: Corazon Aquino

20671.quote: My father described this tall lady who stands in the middle of the New York harbor, holding high a torch to welcome people seeking freedom in America. I instantly fell in love.
20671.name: Yakov Smirnoff

20672.quote: Wherever on this planet ideals of personal freedom and dignity apply, there you will find the cultural inheritance of England.
20672.name: Karel Capek

20673.quote: Not to mention the fact that of course terrorists hate freedom. I think they do hate. But believe me, I don't think they sit there abstractly hating freedom.
20673.name: Zbigniew Brzezinski

20674.quote: People ask 'How does doing a film compare to doing an ad?' Well, when you're doing a commercial you don't have to sell tickets. You have a captured audience. Which is actually completely rare and great it gives you a lot of freedom. When you make a film, you have to do advertisements for the film.
20674.name: Mike Mills

20675.quote: I was inspired to write this book by those who are sceptical of the power of freedom to change the world.
20675.name: Natan Sharansky

20676.quote: The three main sources of scepticism are first, that not every people desires freedom second, that democracy in certain parts of the world would be dangerous and third, that there is little the world's democracies can do to advance freedom outside their countries.
20676.name: Natan Sharansky

20677.quote: By helping readers understand these mechanics, I hope they will appreciate why freedom is for everyone, why it is essential for our security and why the free world plays a critically important role in advancing democracy around the globe.
20677.name: Natan Sharansky

20678.quote: Believe me, the drug of freedom is universally potent.
20678.name: Natan Sharansky

20679.quote: I am optimistic that peace can be achieved in the region because I believe that every society on earth can be free and that if freedom comes to the Middle East, there can be peace.
20679.name: Natan Sharansky

20680.quote: I take life as it happens. And I give myself a lot of freedom.
20680.name: Jean Paul Gaultier

20681.quote: I used to think that if I had success I would have freedom. But I have less freedom now than I've ever had. And what gives me satisfaction is not the jewelry and not the cars. What gives me satisfaction is doing things for others, like children.
20681.name: Criss Angel

20682.quote: When I went off to the army when I was 17 years old, I believed in America and the rights of freedom. But today I believe my government is lying to the American people and that my president, George Bush, is a criminal.
20682.name: Jack Herer

20683.quote: Without freedom of the press, there can be no representative government.
20683.name: Charles Maurice de Talleyrand

20684.quote: I have a fantastic relationship with money. I use it to buy my freedom.
20684.name: Gianni Versace

20685.quote: Three simple words - freedom, justice and honesty. These sum up what the Liberal Democrats stand for.
20685.name: Charles Kennedy

20687.quote: A man of strength and wisdom, John Paul became an inspiration to generations of both Catholics and non-Catholics throughout the world by encouraging freedom, promoting peace and respecting all faiths.
20687.name: Greg Walden

20688.quote: As a child I was given the freedom to explore my passion for acting, but I also grew up in a home where there were a lot of rules. I didn't have 'yes' parents.
20688.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

20689.quote: If a jerk burns the flag, America is not threatened, democracy is not under siege, freedom is not at risk.
20689.name: Gary Ackerman

20690.quote: I know what you're going to say! 'They are men, and men should be free.' A free man is dangerous to himself and everyone else. Freedom should be left to those who can put it to good use.
20690.name: Dave Sim

20691.quote: Freedom is a muscle, you have to exercise it.
20691.name: Roy Scheider

20692.quote: People want the freedom. They want to be able to shop. If you don't like the shop trading hours and you're a shop owner, you don't have to open.
20692.name: Jay Weatherill

20693.quote: A trait which differentiated New York from European cities was the incredible freedom and ease in which life, including sexual life, could be carried on, on many levels.
20693.name: Jerzy Kosinski

20694.quote: School gives you the freedom to explore different philosophies, religions, aspects of yourself, and subjects.
20694.name: Leigh Steinberg

20695.quote: The humor is essentially dark for a cartoon and sophisticated. But at the same time, being a cartoon gives the writers more freedom than in a normal sitcom. It always pushes the line that, despite human failings, the Simpsons are really decent people.
20695.name: Dan Castellaneta

20696.quote: We need international support so that our people live a life of normality, of dignity, of liberty and freedom. I hope that our cry for freedom may be heard.
20696.name: Mahmoud Abbas

20697.quote: In terms of filming, yes, it really does feel over now. There's a real sense of freedom now. It's a good time to finish, I think. As much as I'm going to miss it I'm ready to move on and do different things.
20697.name: Rupert Grint

20698.quote: Our soldiers have nobly fought to protect freedom since our country's birth, and have fought to protect those that could not protect themselves, even in foreign lands when called upon.
20698.name: John Linder

20699.quote: To stop terrorists before the strike, we must do three things: deny them entry into the country, curtail their freedom of action inside the country, and deprive them of material and moral support from within the country.
20699.name: Richard Perle

20700.quote: I think that we could be more careful about what we're saying to young women in terms of their expectations. It's unrealistic to expect people to always be in designer clothes. Girls growing up deserve more freedom in how they look and how they feel about how they look.
20700.name: Emily Procter

20701.quote: I was the youngest child and got a lot more freedom than my brother and sister. I used to wander, doing my own thing under the radar, but I didn't get in bad, bad trouble.
20701.name: Paul Giamatti

20702.quote: I grew up under Communism so we could only learn Russian, and then when Communism fell in 1989 we could learn a few more things and have the freedom to travel and the freedom of speech - and the freedom of dreaming, really.
20702.name: Petra Nemcova

20703.quote: Now we understand much more clearly. why people from all over the world want to come to New York and to America. It's called freedom.
20703.name: Rudy Giuliani

20704.quote: The balance between freedom and security is a delicate one.
20704.name: Mark Udall

20705.quote: Freedom - an occupied space which must be reoccupied every day.
20705.name: John Ralston Saul

20706.quote: Spirit borrows from matter the perceptions on which it feeds and restores them to matter in the form of movements which it has stamped with its own freedom.
20706.name: Henri Bergson

20707.quote: We live in a land like no other - a land of freedom and opportunity unparalleled on the face of the globe.
20707.name: Bob Taft

20708.quote: We've got to understand that the whole nature of the way American democracy guards its freedom has been changed.
20708.name: John Ashcroft

20709.quote: When public access to voting is impaired or when public confidence in voting is diluted, democracy suffers and our freedom is less secure.
20709.name: DeForest Soaries

20710.quote: If technology has finally caught up with individual liberty, why would anyone who loves freedom want to rethink that?
20710.name: Matt Drudge

20711.quote: I am somebody who, - I'm not saying I'm perfect, but I need that freedom, that ability to make mistakes out there. Because there's a fine line between making a mistake or being brilliant.
20711.name: Tiffeny Milbrett

20712.quote: I am not an anti to anything which will bring freedom to my class.
20712.name: Mary Harris Jones

20713.quote: We are a nation in which freedom is alive in the squares and streets, in the daily work of the communications media, in the open relationship between the governing and the governed.
20713.name: Vicente Fox

20714.quote: If you ask me to summarise our mission, I would put it this way: We were a military regime that sought to lay the foundations for freedom and liberty in a complex society.
20714.name: Ibrahim Babangida

20715.quote: Most importantly, nothing has happened to change my conviction that freedom and the love of liberty remain the essential defining attributes of our national character as a people.
20715.name: Ibrahim Babangida

20716.quote: The challenge as we saw in the Nigerian project was to restructure the economy decisively in the direction of a modern free market as an appropriate environment for cultivation of freedom and democracy and the natural emergence of a new social order.
20716.name: Ibrahim Babangida

20717.quote: While it's really hard to do, at the same time, I'm escaping my body, which I really want to do. I'm living someone else's life. I get very intensely into the story, into the interviews and the research. I'm experiencing things along with my subjects. I have a freedom I don't have in my physical life.
20717.name: Laura Hillenbrand

20718.quote: I've never had anything but the freedom to do what I wanted just as long as it made me happy.
20718.name: Rene Redzepi

20719.quote: Fulfill - you can far more than fulfill - the brightest anticipations of those who, in the name of human freedom, and in the face of threats that have ripened into terrible realities since, fought that battle which placed you where you now stand.
20719.name: Robert Dale Owen

20720.quote: The wretch who lives without freedom feels like dressing in the mud from the streets Those who have you, o Liberty, do not know. you. Those who do not have you should not speak of you, but win you.
20720.name: Jose Marti

20721.quote: I like movies that pop, that have a little bit of candy on, that freedom to have a little bit of extra fun, but are rooted in real behaviour. Rooted in cause and effect, never violating reality.
20721.name: Tony Gilroy

20722.quote: The media bring our wars home, but only rarely have they been able to do it in complete freedom.
20722.name: Bruce Jackson

20723.quote: You make a movie for 9k for the freedom it allows you.
20723.name: Edward Burns

20724.quote: The men and women who serve in our military have won for us every hour we live in freedom, sometimes at the expense of the very hours of the lifetimes they had hoped to live.
20724.name: Bob Riley

20725.quote: Freedom to differ is not limited to things that do not matter mush. That would be a mere shadow of freedom. The test of its substance is the right to differ as to things that touch the heart of the existing order.
20725.name: Robert Jackson

20726.quote: There is a bright spot or two for the Spaniards. French toast has become freedom toast on the Air Force One breakfast menu, but the Spanish omelet is still a Spanish omelet.
20726.name: Suzanne Fields

20727.quote: When I was in jail, I was a lot of people's favorite person. I practically ran the jail. I had more freedom than the police.
20727.name: Flavor Flav

20728.quote: A growing number of young women who have the freedom to decide have decided that career can wait, and the delicious early years of their children's lives can't.
20728.name: Suzanne Fields

20729.quote: People ask me if I ever thought of writing a children's book. I say, 'If I had a serious brain injury I might well write a children's book', but otherwise the idea of being conscious of who you're directing the story to is anathema to me, because, in my view, fiction is freedom and any restraints on that are intolerable.
20729.name: Martin Amis

20730.quote: To me, music has to be about freedom. It's the most important thing in my life.
20730.name: Joss Stone

20731.quote: The very first things that I did, even in theater, were bad guys. They are meaty roles for the most part. With the bad guy you have more freedom to experiment and go further out than with a good guy.
20731.name: Benicio Del Toro

20732.quote: Without economic development, any potential for political openness and freedom will be questionable.
20732.name: Jose Maria Aznar

20733.quote: Our constitutional liberties shall not be sacrificed in our search for greater security, for that is what our enemies and all enemies of freedom and democracy hope to achieve.
20733.name: Tammy Baldwin

20734.quote: The main thing I believe in is freedom.
20734.name: Charles Evers

20735.quote: We must guard against the overreaching hand of big government trying to take away our freedom. And we must always protect the environment in a manner consistent with our values.
20735.name: Steve Forbes

20736.quote: If I am outspoken of the dangers of intemperance to members of our armed forces, it is because we are all especially concerned for the welfare of those who are risking their lives in the cause of freedom.
20736.name: William Lyon Mackenzie King

20737.quote: What is our freedom fight about? Is it about the liberation of children or just having sex with them?
20737.name: Kate Millett

20738.quote: Although we have, in theory, abolished human slavery, recognized women's rights, and stopped child labor, we continue to enslave other species who, if we simply pay attention, show quite clearly that they experience parental love, pain, and the desire for freedom, just as we do.
20738.name: Ingrid Newkirk

20739.quote: Men must stop being jealous of their power and generously allow freedom and responsibility to others. The reward is harmonious families and society.
20739.name: Delphine de Girardin

20740.quote: A friend is one who knows you and loves you just the same.
20740.name: Elbert Hubbard

20741.quote: Don't walk behind me I may not lead. Don't walk in front of me I may not follow. Just walk beside me and be my friend.
20741.name: Albert Camus

20742.quote: An insincere and evil friend is more to be feared than a wild beast a wild beast may wound your body, but an evil friend will wound your mind.
20742.name: Buddha

20743.quote: Friendship, is not something you learn in school. But if you haven't learned the meaning of friendship, you really haven't learned anything.
20743.name: Muhammad Ali

20744.quote: Lots of people want to ride with you in the limo, but what you want is someone who will take the bus with you when the limo breaks down.
20744.name: Oprah Winfrey

20745.quote: When we honestly ask ourselves which person in our lives means the most to us, we often find that it is those who, instead of giving advice, solutions, or cures, have chosen rather to share our pain and touch our wounds with a warm and tender hand.
20745.name: Henri Nouwen

20746.quote: In everyone's life, at some time, our inner fire goes out. It is then burst into flame by an encounter with another human being. We should all be thankful for those people who rekindle the inner spirit.
20746.name: Albert Schweitzer

20747.quote: A friend should be one in whose understanding and virtue we can equally confide, and whose opinion we can value at once for its justness and its sincerity.
20747.name: Robert Hall

20748.quote: One of the most beautiful qualities of true friendship is to understand and to be understood.
20748.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

20749.quote: A true friend never gets in your way unless you happen to be going down.
20749.name: Arnold H. Glasow

20750.quote: A single rose can be my garden, a single friend, my world.
20750.name: Leo Buscaglia

20751.quote: A friendship can weather most things and thrive in thin soil but it needs a little mulch of letters and phone calls and small, silly presents every so often - just to save it from drying out completely.
20751.name: Pam Brown

20752.quote: I value the friend who for me finds time on his calendar, but I cherish the friend who for me does not consult his calendar.
20752.name: Robert Brault

20753.quote: Let us be grateful to people who make us happy, they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
20753.name: Marcel Proust

20754.quote: Be courteous to all, but intimate with few, and let those few be well tried before you give them your confidence.
20754.name: George Washington

20755.quote: Think where man's glory most begins and ends, and say my glory was I had such friends.
20755.name: William Butler Yeats

20756.quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art, It has no survival value rather it is one of those things that give value to survival.
20756.name: C. S. Lewis

20757.quote: The friend who can be silent with us in a moment of despair or confusion, who can stay with us in an hour of grief and bereavement, who can tolerate not knowing, not healing, not curing, that is a friend who cares.
20757.name: Henri Nouwen

20758.quote: True friends stab you in the front.
20758.name: Oscar Wilde

20759.quote: It is one of the blessings of old friends that you can afford to be stupid with them.
20759.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

20760.quote: A friend is someone who gives you total freedom to be yourself.
20760.name: Jim Morrison

20761.quote: A true friend freely, advises justly, assists readily, adventures boldly, takes all patiently, defends courageously, and continues a friend unchangeably.
20761.name: William Penn

20762.quote: A friend to all is a friend to none.
20762.name: Aristotle

20763.quote: Friendship is a single soul dwelling in two bodies.
20763.name: Aristotle

20764.quote: But friendship is precious, not only in the shade, but in the sunshine of life, and thanks to a benevolent arrangement the greater part of life is sunshine.
20764.name: Thomas Jefferson

20765.quote: Walking with a friend in the dark is better than walking alone in the light.
20765.name: Helen Keller

20766.quote: Friends and good manners will carry you where money won't go.
20766.name: Margaret Walker

20767.quote: I cannot even imagine where I would be today were it not for that handful of friends who have given me a heart full of joy. Let's face it, friends make life a lot more fun.
20767.name: Charles R. Swindoll

20768.quote: Am I not destroying my enemies when I make friends of them?
20768.name: Abraham Lincoln

20769.quote: In the sweetness of friendship let there be laughter, and sharing of pleasures. For in the dew of little things the heart finds its morning and is refreshed.
20769.name: Khalil Gibran

20770.quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
20770.name: Euripides

20771.quote: Never explain - your friends do not need it and your enemies will not believe you anyway.
20771.name: Elbert Hubbard

20772.quote: It is only the great hearted who can be true friends. The mean and cowardly, Can never know what true friendship means.
20772.name: Charles Kingsley

20773.quote: The friend in my adversity I shall always cherish most. I can better trust those who helped to relieve the gloom of my dark hours than those who are so ready to enjoy with me the sunshine of my prosperity.
20773.name: Ulysses S. Grant

20774.quote: I don't need a friend who changes when I change and who nods when I nod my shadow does that much better.
20774.name: Plutarch

20775.quote: A hug is like a boomerang - you get it back right away.
20775.name: Bil Keane

20776.quote: Each friend represents a world in us, a world not born until they arrive, and it is only by this meeting that a new world is born.
20776.name: Anais Nin

20777.quote: My best friend is the man who in wishing me well wishes it for my sake.
20777.name: Aristotle

20778.quote: A true friend is someone who is there for you when he'd rather be anywhere else.
20778.name: Len Wein

20779.quote: So long as the memory of certain beloved friends lives in my heart, I shall say that life is good.
20779.name: Helen Keller

20780.quote: The only way to have a friend is to be one.
20780.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

20781.quote: Be true to your work, your word, and your friend.
20781.name: Henry David Thoreau

20782.quote: There is nothing on this earth more to be prized than true friendship.
20782.name: Thomas Aquinas

20783.quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
20783.name: Jean de La Fontaine

20784.quote: When you choose your friends, don't be short-changed by choosing personality over character.
20784.name: W. Somerset Maugham

20785.quote: The friend is the man who knows all about you, and still likes you.
20785.name: Elbert Hubbard

20786.quote: A friendship founded on business is better than a business founded on friendship.
20786.name: John D. Rockefeller

20787.quote: The language of friendship is not words but meanings.
20787.name: Henry David Thoreau

20788.quote: An excellent man he has no enemies and none of his friends like him.
20788.name: Oscar Wilde

20789.quote: Be slow to fall into friendship but when thou art in, continue firm and constant.
20789.name: Socrates

20790.quote: Men kick friendship around like a football, but it doesn't seem to crack. Women treat it like glass and it goes to pieces.
20790.name: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

20791.quote: Wishing to be friends is quick work, but friendship is a slow ripening fruit.
20791.name: Aristotle

20792.quote: It is more shameful to distrust our friends than to be deceived by them.
20792.name: Confucius

20793.quote: It's the friends you can call up at 4 a.m. that matter.
20793.name: Marlene Dietrich

20794.quote: The most I can do for my friend is simply be his friend.
20794.name: Henry David Thoreau

20795.quote: Friends, they cherish one another's hopes. They are kind to one another's dreams.
20795.name: Henry David Thoreau

20796.quote: I have friends in overalls whose friendship I would not swap for the favor of the kings of the world.
20796.name: Thomas A. Edison

20797.quote: Laughter is not at all a bad beginning for a friendship, and it is far the best ending for one.
20797.name: Oscar Wilde

20798.quote: You can always tell a real friend: when you've made a fool of yourself he doesn't feel you've done a permanent job.
20798.name: Laurence J. Peter

20799.quote: He has no enemies, but is intensely disliked by his friends.
20799.name: Oscar Wilde

20800.quote: A man's growth is seen in the successive choirs of his friends.
20800.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

20801.quote: Love is blind friendship closes its eyes.
20801.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

20802.quote: A friend may well be reckoned the masterpiece of nature.
20802.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

20803.quote: If it's very painful for you to criticize your friends - you're safe in doing it. But if you take the slightest pleasure in it, that's the time to hold your tongue.
20803.name: Alice Duer Miller

20804.quote: True friendship can afford true knowledge. It does not depend on darkness and ignorance.
20804.name: Henry David Thoreau

20805.quote: Never make friends with people who are above or below you in status. Such friendships will never give you any happiness.
20805.name: Chanakya

20806.quote: The world is round so that friendship may encircle it.
20806.name: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

20807.quote: My best friend is the one who brings out the best in me.
20807.name: Henry Ford

20808.quote: What is a friend? A single soul dwelling in two bodies.
20808.name: Aristotle

20809.quote: Be slow in choosing a friend, slower in changing.
20809.name: Benjamin Franklin

20810.quote: The greatest gift of life is friendship, and I have received it.
20810.name: Hubert H. Humphrey

20811.quote: He who hath many friends hath none.
20811.name: Aristotle

20812.quote: There is a magnet in your heart that will attract true friends. That magnet is unselfishness, thinking of others first when you learn to live for others, they will live for you.
20812.name: Paramahansa Yogananda

20813.quote: Silences make the real conversations between friends. Not the saying but the never needing to say is what counts.
20813.name: Margaret Lee Runbeck

20814.quote: Nothing but heaven itself is better than a friend who is really a friend.
20814.name: Plautus

20815.quote: Our friends interpret the world and ourselves to us, if we take them tenderly and truly.
20815.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

20816.quote: Let there be no purpose in friendship save the deepening of the spirit.
20816.name: Khalil Gibran

20817.quote: A friend is one who walks in when others walk out.
20817.name: Walter Winchell

20818.quote: Never contract friendship with a man that is not better than thyself.
20818.name: Confucius

20819.quote: The sincere friends of this world are as ship lights in the stormiest of nights.
20819.name: Giotto di Bondone

20820.quote: There is some self-interest behind every friendship. There is no friendship without self-interests. This is a bitter truth.
20820.name: Chanakya

20821.quote: She is a friend of mind. She gather me, man. The pieces I am, she gather them and give them back to me in all the right order. It's good, you know, when you got a woman who is a friend of your mind.
20821.name: Toni Morrison

20822.quote: Rejoicing in our joy, not suffering over our suffering, makes someone a friend.
20822.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

20823.quote: Friendship and money: oil and water.
20823.name: Mario Puzo

20824.quote: A true friend is one who overlooks your failures and tolerates your success!
20824.name: Doug Larson

20825.quote: If you have one true friend you have more than your share.
20825.name: Thomas Fuller

20826.quote: A true friend is the greatest of all blessings, and that which we take the least care of all to acquire.
20826.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

20827.quote: We call that person who has lost his father, an orphan and a widower that man who has lost his wife. But that man who has known the immense unhappiness of losing a friend, by what name do we call him? Here every language is silent and holds its peace in impotence.
20827.name: Joseph Roux

20828.quote: A quarrel between friends, when made up, adds a new tie to friendship.
20828.name: Saint Francis de Sales

20829.quote: Lovers have a right to betray you, friends don't.
20829.name: Judy Holliday

20830.quote: No person is your friend who demands your silence, or denies your right to grow.
20830.name: Alice Walker

20831.quote: I always felt that the great high privilege, relief and comfort of friendship was that one had to explain nothing.
20831.name: Katherine Mansfield

20832.quote: Friendship is one mind in two bodies.
20832.name: Mencius

20833.quote: A man cannot be said to succeed in this life who does not satisfy one friend.
20833.name: Henry David Thoreau

20834.quote: It takes a long time to grow an old friend.
20834.name: John Leonard

20835.quote: It is not so much our friends' help that helps us, as the confidence of their help.
20835.name: Epicurus

20836.quote: Sometimes being a friend means mastering the art of timing. There is a time for silence. A time to let go and allow people to hurl themselves into their own destiny. And a time to prepare to pick up the pieces when it's all over.
20836.name: Octavia Butler

20837.quote: If instead of a gem, or even a flower, we should cast the gift of a loving thought into the heart of a friend, that would be giving as the angels give.
20837.name: George MacDonald

20838.quote: Friendship multiplies the good of life and divides the evil.
20838.name: Baltasar Gracian

20839.quote: But friendship is the breathing rose, with sweets in every fold.
20839.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

20840.quote: Friendship is certainly the finest balm for the pangs of disappointed love.
20840.name: Jane Austen

20841.quote: Fear makes strangers of people who would be friends.
20841.name: Shirley MacLaine

20842.quote: To avoid being mistaken for a sellout, I chose my friends carefully. The more politically active black students. The foreign students. The Chicanos. The Marxist professors and structural feminists and punk-rock performance poets.
20842.name: Barack Obama

20843.quote: Friendship needs no words - it is solitude delivered from the anguish of loneliness.
20843.name: Dag Hammarskjold

20844.quote: A man's friendships are one of the best measures of his worth.
20844.name: Charles Darwin

20845.quote: A friend is, as it were, a second self.
20845.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

20846.quote: Friendship is held to be the severest test of character. It is easy, we think, to be loyal to a family and clan, whose blood is in your own veins.
20846.name: Charles Alexander Eastman

20847.quote: I have learned that to be with those I like is enough.
20847.name: Walt Whitman

20848.quote: Some people go to priests others to poetry I to my friends.
20848.name: Virginia Woolf

20849.quote: The bird a nest, the spider a web, man friendship.
20849.name: William Blake

20850.quote: As iron sharpens iron, so a friend sharpens a friend.
20850.name: King Solomon

20851.quote: Yes'm, old friends is always best, 'less you can catch a new one that's fit to make an old one out of.
20851.name: Sarah Orne Jewett

20852.quote: It is important to our friends to believe that we are unreservedly frank with them, and important to friendship that we are not.
20852.name: Mignon McLaughlin

20853.quote: Without wearing any mask we are conscious of, we have a special face for each friend.
20853.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

20854.quote: Never have a companion that casts you in the shade.
20854.name: Baltasar Gracian

20855.quote: The real test of friendship is: can you literally do nothing with the other person? Can you enjoy those moments of life that are utterly simple?
20855.name: Eugene Kennedy

20856.quote: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by the doubling of our joy and the dividing of our grief.
20856.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

20857.quote: Since there is nothing so well worth having as friends, never lose a chance to make them.
20857.name: Francesco Guicciardini

20858.quote: Cherish your human connections: your relationships with friends and family.
20858.name: Joseph Brodsky

20859.quote: Sweet is the memory of distant friends! Like the mellow rays of the departing sun, it falls tenderly, yet sadly, on the heart.
20859.name: Washington Irving

20860.quote: Life has no blessing like a prudent friend.
20860.name: Euripides

20861.quote: Love demands infinitely less than friendship.
20861.name: George Jean Nathan

20862.quote: Many a person has held close, throughout their entire lives, two friends that always remained strange to one another, because one of them attracted by virtue of similarity, the other by difference.
20862.name: Emil Ludwig

20863.quote: Friendship at first sight, like love at first sight, is said to be the only truth.
20863.name: Herman Melville

20864.quote: All you need to do to be my friend is like me.
20864.name: Taylor Swift

20866.quote: Nothing so fortifies a friendship as a belief on the part of one friend that he is superior to the other.
20866.name: Honore de Balzac

20867.quote: There is no friend like an old friend who has shared our morning days, no greeting like his welcome, no homage like his praise.
20867.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

20868.quote: One's friends are that part of the human race with which one can be human.
20868.name: George Santayana

20869.quote: It seems to me that trying to live without friends is like milking a bear to get cream for your morning coffee. It is a whole lot of trouble, and then not worth much after you get it.
20869.name: Zora Neale Hurston

20870.quote: When a friend is in trouble, don't annoy him by asking if there is anything you can do. Think up something appropriate and do it.
20870.name: E. W. Howe

20871.quote: Instead of loving your enemies - treat your friends a little better.
20871.name: E. W. Howe

20872.quote: Mighty proud I am that I am able to have a spare bed for my friends.
20872.name: Samuel Pepys

20873.quote: The best time to make friends is before you need them.
20873.name: Ethel Barrymore

20874.quote: That friendship will not continue to the end which is begun for an end.
20874.name: Francis Quarles

20875.quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.
20875.name: Bruce Lee

20876.quote: We're born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for the moment that we're not alone.
20876.name: Orson Welles

20877.quote: Friendship is always a sweet responsibility, never an opportunity.
20877.name: Khalil Gibran

20878.quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
20878.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

20879.quote: Between men and women there is no friendship possible. There is passion, enmity, worship, love, but no friendship.
20879.name: Oscar Wilde

20880.quote: Love is friendship that has caught fire. It is quiet understanding, mutual confidence, sharing and forgiving. It is loyalty through good and bad times. It settles for less than perfection and makes allowances for human weaknesses.
20880.name: Ann Landers

20881.quote: If we listened to our intellect, we'd never have a love affair. We'd never have a friendship. We'd never go into business, because we'd be cynical. Well, that's nonsense. You've got to jump off cliffs all the time and build your wings on the way down.
20881.name: Ray Bradbury

20882.quote: Friendship often ends in love but love in friendship - never.
20882.name: Charles Caleb Colton

20883.quote: Be true to yourself, help others, make each day your masterpiece, make friendship a fine art, drink deeply from good books - especially the Bible, build a shelter against a rainy day, give thanks for your blessings and pray for guidance every day.
20883.name: John Wooden

20884.quote: True friendship multiplies the good in life and divides its evils. Strive to have friends, for life without friends is like life on a desert island, to find one real friend in a lifetime is good fortune to keep him is a blessing.
20884.name: Baltasar Gracian

20885.quote: Peace and friendship with all mankind is our wisest policy, and I wish we may be permitted to pursue it.
20885.name: Thomas Jefferson

20886.quote: Friendship with ones self is all important, because without it one cannot be friends with anyone else in the world.
20886.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

20887.quote: Friendship is but another name for an alliance with the follies and the misfortunes of others. Our own share of miseries is sufficient: why enter then as volunteers into those of another?
20887.name: Thomas Jefferson

20888.quote: Eros will have naked bodies Friendship naked personalities.
20888.name: C. S. Lewis

20889.quote: Peace, commerce and honest friendship with all nations entangling alliances with none.
20889.name: Thomas Jefferson

20890.quote: True friendship is a plant of slow growth, and must undergo and withstand the shocks of adversity, before it is entitled to the appellation.
20890.name: George Washington

20891.quote: A friendship that like love is warm A love like friendship, steady.
20891.name: Thomas Moore

20892.quote: True friendship ought never to conceal what it thinks.
20892.name: St. Jerome

20893.quote: A woman may very well form a friendship with a man, but for this to endure, it must be assisted by a little physical antipathy.
20893.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

20894.quote: Love is a friendship set to music.
20894.name: Joseph Campbell

20895.quote: The two most misused words in the entire English vocabulary are love and friendship. A true friend would die for you, so when you start trying to count them on one hand, you don't need any fingers.
20895.name: Larry Flynt

20896.quote: All lasting business is built on friendship.
20896.name: Alfred A. Montapert

20897.quote: Friendship is the shadow of the evening, which increases with the setting sun of life.
20897.name: Jean de La Fontaine

20898.quote: Friendship, like the immortality of the soul, is too good to be believed.
20898.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

20899.quote: Perfect friendship is the friendship of men who are good, and alike in excellence for these wish well alike to each other qua good, and they are good in themselves.
20899.name: Aristotle

20900.quote: The greatest healing therapy is friendship and love.
20900.name: Hubert H. Humphrey

20902.quote: Experts on romance say for a happy marriage there has to be more than a passionate love. For a lasting union, they insist, there must be a genuine liking for each other. Which, in my book, is a good definition for friendship.
20902.name: Marilyn Monroe

20903.quote: Friendship may, and often does, grow into love, but love never subsides into friendship.
20903.name: Lord Byron

20904.quote: A tree is known by its fruit a man by his deeds. A good deed is never lost he who sows courtesy reaps friendship, and he who plants kindness gathers love.
20904.name: Saint Basil

20905.quote: False friendship, like the ivy, decays and ruins the walls it embraces but true friendship gives new life and animation to the object it supports.
20905.name: Richard Burton

20906.quote: I had three chairs in my house one for solitude, two for friendship, three for society.
20906.name: Henry David Thoreau

20907.quote: I think it's important to have closure in any relationship that ends - from a romantic relationship to a friendship. You should always have a sense of clarity at the end and know why it began and why it ended. You need that in your life to move cleanly into your next phase.
20907.name: Jennifer Aniston

20908.quote: Friendship is a plant of slow growth and must undergo and withstand the shocks of adversity before it is entitled to the appellation.
20908.name: George Washington

20909.quote: Depth of friendship does not depend on length of acquaintance.
20909.name: Rabindranath Tagore

20910.quote: Friendship, like credit, is highest when it is not used.
20910.name: Elbert Hubbard

20911.quote: The rule of friendship means there should be mutual sympathy between them, each supplying what the other lacks and trying to benefit the other, always using friendly and sincere words.
20911.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

20912.quote: How can sincerity be a condition of friendship? A taste for truth at any cost is a passion which spares nothing.
20912.name: Albert Camus

20913.quote: It may happen sometimes that a long debate becomes the cause of a longer friendship. Commonly, those who dispute with one another at last agree.
20913.name: Elbert Hubbard

20914.quote: Friendship is two-sided. It isn't a friend just because someone's doing something nice for you. That's a nice person. There's friendship when you do for each other. It's like marriage - it's two-sided.
20914.name: John Wooden

20915.quote: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, indignation and compassion.
20915.name: Simone de Beauvoir

20916.quote: Dad needs to show an incredible amount of respect and humor and friendship toward his mate so the kids understand their parents are sexy, they're fun, they do things together, they're best friends. Kids learn by example. If I respect Mom, they're going to respect Mom.
20916.name: Tim Allen

20917.quote: There is something in the unselfish and self-sacrificing love of a brute, which goes directly to the heart of him who has had frequent occasion to test the paltry friendship and gossamer fidelity of mere Man.
20917.name: Edgar Allan Poe

20918.quote: There is no friendship, no love, like that of the parent for the child.
20918.name: Henry Ward Beecher

20919.quote: The essence of true friendship is to make allowance for another's little lapses.
20919.name: David Storey

20920.quote: The Bush Administration's failure to be consistently involved in helping Israel achieve peace with the Palestinians has been both wrong for our friendship with Israel, as well as badly damaging to our standing in the Arab world.
20920.name: Barack Obama

20921.quote: What I cannot love, I overlook. Is that real friendship?
20921.name: Anais Nin

20922.quote: Friendship is the marriage of the soul, and this marriage is liable to divorce.
20922.name: Voltaire

20923.quote: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.
20923.name: Elie Wiesel

20924.quote: It is one of the severest tests of friendship to tell your friend his faults. So to love a man that you cannot bear to see a stain upon him, and to speak painful truth through loving words, that is friendship.
20924.name: Henry Ward Beecher

20925.quote: True friendship is like sound health the value of it is seldom known until it is lost.
20925.name: Charles Caleb Colton

20926.quote: What sweetness is left in life, if you take away friendship? Robbing life of friendship is like robbing the world of the sun. A true friend is more to be esteemed than kinsfolk.
20926.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

20927.quote: Friendship is a pretty full-time occupation if you really are friendly with somebody. You can't have too many friends because then you're just not really friends.
20927.name: Truman Capote

20928.quote: Marriage: A friendship recognized by the police.
20928.name: Robert Louis Stevenson

20929.quote: If there is such a thing as a good marriage, it is because it resembles friendship rather than love.
20929.name: Michel de Montaigne

20930.quote: However rare true love may be, it is less so than true friendship.
20930.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

20931.quote: What men have called friendship is only a social arrangement, a mutual adjustment of interests, an interchange of services given and received it is, in sum, simply a business from which those involved propose to derive a steady profit for their own self-love.
20931.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

20932.quote: Don't flatter yourself that friendship authorizes you to say disagreeable things to your intimates. The nearer you come into relation with a person, the more necessary do tact and courtesy become.
20932.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

20933.quote: Friendship is Love without his wings!
20933.name: Lord Byron

20934.quote: Laughter is not a bad beginning for a friendship, and it is the best ending for one.
20934.name: Henry Ward Beecher

20935.quote: Friendship is the source of the greatest pleasures, and without friends even the most agreeable pursuits become tedious.
20935.name: Thomas Aquinas

20936.quote: I have a loyalty that runs in my bloodstream, when I lock into someone or something, you can't get me away from it because I commit that thoroughly. That's in friendship, that's a deal, that's a commitment. Don't give me paper - I can get the same lawyer who drew it up to break it. But if you shake my hand, that's for life.
20936.name: Jerry Lewis

20937.quote: Fan the sinking flame of hilarity with the wing of friendship and pass the rosy wine.
20937.name: Charles Dickens

20938.quote: Loyalty and friendship, which is to me the same, created all the wealth that I've ever thought I'd have.
20938.name: Ernie Banks

20939.quote: People come in and out of our lives, and the true test of friendship is whether you can pick back up right where you left off the last time you saw each other.
20939.name: Lisa See

20940.quote: Sympathy constitutes friendship but in love there is a sort of antipathy, or opposing passion. Each strives to be the other, and both together make up one whole.
20940.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

20941.quote: If we are to judge of love by its consequences, it more nearly resembles hatred than friendship.
20941.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

20942.quote: Love, friendship and respect do not unite people as much as a common hatred for something.
20942.name: Anton Chekhov

20943.quote: In friendship as well as love, ignorance very often contributes more to our happiness than knowledge.
20943.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

20945.quote: Friendship is like money, easier made than kept.
20945.name: Samuel Butler

20946.quote: Even in the common affairs of life, in love, friendship, and marriage, how little security have we when we trust our happiness in the hands of others!
20946.name: William Hazlitt

20947.quote: Love is the attempt to form a friendship inspired by beauty.
20947.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

20948.quote: Of all the things which wisdom provides to make us entirely happy, much the greatest is the possession of friendship.
20948.name: Epicurus

20949.quote: Friendship, like love, is destroyed by long absence, though it may be increased by short intermissions.
20949.name: Samuel Johnson

20950.quote: Love is friendship set on fire.
20950.name: Jeremy Taylor

20951.quote: True happiness arises, in the first place, from the enjoyment of one's self, and in the next, from the friendship and conversation of a few select companions.
20951.name: Joseph Addison

20952.quote: Caring for but never trying to own may be a further way to define friendship.
20952.name: William Glasser

20953.quote: If a man does not make new acquaintances as he advances through life, he will soon find himself left alone. A man, sir, should keep his friendship in a constant repair.
20953.name: Samuel Johnson

20954.quote: The fact is, with every friendship you make, and every bond of trust you establish, you are shaping the image of America projected to the rest of the world. That is so important. So when you study abroad, you're actually helping to make America stronger.
20954.name: Michelle Obama

20955.quote: No distance of place or lapse of time can lessen the friendship of those who are thoroughly persuaded of each other's worth.
20955.name: Robert Southey

20956.quote: My parents, and librarians along the way, taught me about the space between words about the margins, where so many juicy moments of life and spirit and friendship could be found. In a library, you could find miracles and truth and you might find something that would make you laugh so hard that you get shushed, in the friendliest way.
20956.name: Anne Lamott

20957.quote: Friendship increases in visiting friends, but in visiting them seldom.
20957.name: Francis Bacon

20958.quote: If one of two lovers is loyal, and the other jealous and false, how may their friendship last, for Love is slain!
20958.name: Marie de France

20959.quote: There is a scarcity of friendship, but not of friends.
20959.name: Thomas Fuller

20960.quote: No matter what message you are about to deliver somewhere, whether it is holding out a hand of friendship, or making clear that you disapprove of something, is the fact that the person sitting across the table is a human being, so the goal is to always establish common ground.
20960.name: Madeleine Albright

20961.quote: To be capable of steady friendship or lasting love, are the two greatest proofs, not only of goodness of heart, but of strength of mind.
20961.name: William Hazlitt

20962.quote: The greatest sweetener of human life is Friendship. To raise this to the highest pitch of enjoyment, is a secret which but few discover.
20962.name: Joseph Addison

20963.quote: The feeling of friendship is like that of being comfortably filled with roast beef love, like being enlivened with champagne.
20963.name: Samuel Johnson

20964.quote: Do not keep on with a mockery of friendship after the substance is gone - but part, while you can part friends. Bury the carcass of friendship: it is not worth embalming.
20964.name: William Hazlitt

20965.quote: Business, you know, may bring you money, but friendship hardly ever does.
20965.name: Jane Austen

20966.quote: Real friendship, like real poetry, is extremely rare - and precious as a pearl.
20966.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

20967.quote: I have long enjoyed the friendship and companionship of Republicans because I am by instinct a teacher, and I would like to teach them something.
20967.name: Woodrow Wilson

20968.quote: Bad faith likes discourse on friendship and loyalty.
20968.name: Mason Cooley

20969.quote: One friend in a lifetime is much, two are many, three are hardly possible. Friendship needs a certain parallelism of life, a community of thought, a rivalry of aim.
20969.name: Henry Adams

20970.quote: To want friendship is a great fault. Friendship ought to be a gratuitous joy, like the joys afforded by art or life.
20970.name: Simone Weil

20971.quote: The friendship that can cease has never been real.
20971.name: St. Jerome

20972.quote: Tis the privilege of friendship to talk nonsense, and have her nonsense respected.
20972.name: Charles Lamb

20973.quote: All those who offer an opinion on any doubtful point should first clear their minds of every sentiment of dislike, friendship, anger or pity.
20973.name: Sallust

20974.quote: General benevolence, but not general friendship, made a man what he ought to be.
20974.name: Jane Austen

20975.quote: Moral science is better occupied when treating of friendship than of justice.
20975.name: Thomas Aquinas

20976.quote: But it all comes down to friendship, treating people right.
20976.name: Ernie Banks

20977.quote: Few things tend more to alienate friendship than a want of punctuality in our engagements. I have known the breach of a promise to dine or sup to break up more than one intimacy.
20977.name: William Hazlitt

20978.quote: It is difficult to obtain the friendship of a cat. It is a philosophical animal, one that does not place its affections thoughtlessly.
20978.name: Theophile Gautier

20979.quote: The beginning of a friendship, the fact that two people out of the thousands around them can meet and connect and become friends, seems like a kind of magic to me. But maintaining a friendship requires work. I don't mean that as a bad thing. Good art requires work as well.
20979.name: Charles de Lint

20980.quote: Friendship has its illusions no less than love.
20980.name: Stendhal

20981.quote: The dupe of friendship, and the fool of love have I not reason to hate and to despise myself? Indeed I do and chiefly for not having hated and despised the world enough.
20981.name: William Hazlitt

20982.quote: Friendship is almost always the union of a part of one mind with the part of another people are friends in spots.
20982.name: George Santayana

20983.quote: I understand by this passion the union of desire, friendship, and tenderness, which is inflamed by a single female, which prefers her to the rest of her sex, and which seeks her possession as the supreme or the sole happiness of our being.
20983.name: Edward Gibbon

20984.quote: When two people first meet, they can only have a very ordinary kind of friendship. But when you begin to understand each other, when you get close to them, you discover that you're suddenly eager to know him or her even better.
20984.name: Zhang Ziyi

20985.quote: There are no rules for friendship. It must be left to itself. We cannot force it any more than love.
20985.name: William Hazlitt

20986.quote: She discovered with great delight that one does not love one's children just because they are one's children but because of the friendship formed while raising them.
20986.name: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

20987.quote: All love that has not friendship for its base, is like a mansion built upon the sand.
20987.name: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

20988.quote: One of the surest evidences of friendship that one individual can display to another is telling him gently of a fault. If any other can excel it, it is listening to such a disclosure with gratitude, and amending the error.
20988.name: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

20989.quote: Sixth grade was a big time, in my childhood, of hoops and friendship, and coming up with funny things.
20989.name: Adam Sandler

20990.quote: For prayer is nothing else than being on terms of friendship with God.
20990.name: Saint Teresa of Avila

20992.quote: Our scientific age demands that we provide definitions, measurements, and statistics in order to be taken seriously. Yet most of the important things in life cannot be precisely defined or measured. Can we define or measure love, beauty, friendship, or decency, for example?
20992.name: Dennis Prager

20993.quote: Love between man and man is impossible because there must not be sexual intercourse and friendship between man and woman is impossible because there must be sexual intercourse.
20993.name: James Joyce

20994.quote: I love life in spite of all that mars it. I love friendship, jokes and laughter.
20994.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

20995.quote: It must be remembered that the sea is a great breeder of friendship. Two men who have known each other for twenty years find that twenty days at sea bring them nearer than ever they were before, or else estrange them.
20995.name: Gilbert Parker

21593.quote: When you're out of sight for as long as I was, there's a funny feeling of betrayal that comes over people when they see you again.
21593.name: Esther Williams

21594.quote: I'd like to do a film which is funny.
21594.name: Clive Owen

21595.quote: Japanese people have a funny habit of abbreviating names.
21595.name: Shigeru Miyamoto

21596.quote: I find it very easy playing Bond. I think he's hilarious. He gets himself into some extraordinarily funny situations.
21596.name: Daniel Craig

21597.quote: At home in L.A., Sunday is lazy. It's the wife and me lying in bed with coffee, watching 'The Soup' or something funny on TiVo. The kid will occasionally join us. Eventually, breakfast is at a place down the street called Paty's. And we always have some kind of great dinner - my wife makes a great roast beef.
21597.name: Eric McCormack

21598.quote: What other people call dark and despairing, I call funny.
21598.name: David Sedaris

21599.quote: The funny thing is that I'm the girl who no one sees at the beach. Ask anyone who's traveled with me. Normally, I'm in so many layers, I look like Lawrence of Arabia!
21599.name: Vera Wang

21600.quote: Who do I like? I am a big fan of French and Saunders - not that that they are particularly stand-up I have to say, but I think they have been great for women and they are of themselves just incredibly funny whether they are male or female.
21600.name: Jo Brand

21601.quote: The thing I thought about doing it was it's Comic Relief and you've got to be funny. So although I did try to sing properly it obviously has hilarious results when you can't sing.
21601.name: Jo Brand

21602.quote: I made a supreme effort not to do that thing that parents do, which is to bore people without children to death by going on and on about how funny their children are, so there's none of that hopefully.
21602.name: Jo Brand

21603.quote: I thought I was funny as a kid.
21603.name: Jo Brand

21604.quote: It used to be that you had to make female TV characters perfect so no one would be offended by your 'portrayal' of women. Even when I started out on 'The Office' eight years ago, we could write our male characters funny and flawed, but not the women. And now, thankfully, it's completely different.
21604.name: Mindy Kaling

21605.quote: People don't want to listen to a celebrity tweeting about their charities and shows. That's why comedy writers do well - we put out little funny ideas.
21605.name: Mindy Kaling

21606.quote: The reason why you know more funny dudes than funny chicks is that dudes are funnier than chicks. If my daughter has a mediocre sense of humor, I'm just gonna tell her, 'Be a staff writer for a sitcom. Because they'll have to hire you, they can't really fire you, and you don't have to produce that much. It'll be awesome.'
21606.name: Adam Carolla

21607.quote: I don't hate humanity and I'm not interested in people who do. Although, it's funny, actually, some of my favorite writers really do. Like Martin Amis. My dirty secret. 'London Fields' is one of my favorite books ever. And it's indefensible! But he's so funny, I forgive him everything.
21607.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

21608.quote: I used to say, 'Man, I think I'd be a really good dad. I'll be a great provider. I'm funny I'll go on trips with them - I'll do all sorts of stuff.' But the momming? I'm not made for that. I have a really good mom I know what she put into it.
21608.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

21609.quote: It's funny, I do try to maintain health. I started doing Bikram yoga which is that hothouse yoga, the 105 degrees yoga for 90 minutes. It's great, you purge out all the sweat and you're drinking water.
21609.name: Bryan Cranston

21610.quote: It's funny how many people will come to Vegas to see your show where they might not come out to see you unless you come to their hometown.
21610.name: Reba McEntire

21611.quote: It's funny: I'm a lifelong musician, but because I principally play the piano it's been a solitary thing.
21611.name: Gary Oldman

21612.quote: Our records, if you have a dark sense of humor, were funny, but our records weren't about comedy. They were about protests, fantasy, confrontation and all that.
21612.name: Ice Cube

21613.quote: It's funny how people who ain't never been down there can think that America is so fair and that we should be alright. It's funny that the people who have their foot on our neck are telling us, 'Get up. What's wrong with you?'
21613.name: Ice Cube

21614.quote: It's a funny show. The characters are surprisingly likable, given how ugly they are. We've got this huge cast of characters that we can move around. And over the last few seasons, we've explored some of the secondary characters' personal lives a bit more.
21614.name: Matt Groening

21615.quote: Laurence Olivier said in an interview once that when he plays a tragedy he always aims for the funny parts, and the other way around. Because in a comedy you look for what's serious. I think that's true. Sometimes things are really funny if you're absolutely earnest. If you're really serious, it's hilarious.
21615.name: Christopher Walken

21616.quote: I never know when I am being funny, and the other way too. I don't think you can think about that. I don't think you can try to be funny. Some people are just funny.
21616.name: Christopher Walken

21617.quote: I tend to head for what's amusing because a lot of things aren't happy. But usually you can find a funny side to practically anything.
21617.name: Maggie Smith

21618.quote: The funny thing is, Dennis Miller got me back into comedy.
21618.name: Tommy Chong

21619.quote: I'm half Jewish, I'm half black, I look in-between. I dress funny. I play all these different styles of music on one record. It's like, What is he doing?
21619.name: Lenny Kravitz

21620.quote: The fans of 'The Hunger Games,' of the book, are very passionate. It's funny: Even at my concerts there are people holding up 'Cinna' signs.
21620.name: Lenny Kravitz

21621.quote: It's funny how the music industry is enraged about the Internet and the way things are copied without being paid for. But you know why people steal the music? Because they can't afford the music.
21621.name: Tom Petty

21622.quote: It's funny, I can sit through the worst horror film ever made but even a quite good romantic comedy can drive me nuts.
21622.name: Jason Reitman

21623.quote: Life's pretty funny when you're objectively on the outside looking at it.
21623.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

21624.quote: People used to be funny about approaching me, but now they seem to think I'm as sane as anyone who's done what I've done in movies can be.
21624.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

21625.quote: You know, you can touch a stick of dynamite, but if you touch a venomous snake it'll turn around and bite you and kill you so fast it's not even funny.
21625.name: Steve Irwin

21626.quote: I have this horrible sense of humor where I think discomfort is funny - partly because I experience discomfort a lot, and it's a way of laughing at it and getting a release.
21626.name: Joaquin Phoenix

21627.quote: I can never tell when something is funny. I just have to do it onstage and find out.
21627.name: Margaret Cho

21628.quote: My parents are very funny when they have to deal with anything racy or off-color. They usually pretend they don't speak English.
21628.name: Margaret Cho

21629.quote: Well, I mean, if a joke or humor is bawdy, it's got to be funny enough to warrant it. You can't just have it bawdy or dirty just for the sake of being that - it's got to be funny.
21629.name: Betty White

21630.quote: In this world, everyone wants to know everything about you, and I think that's funny.
21630.name: Leighton Meester

21631.quote: I'm just not one of those naturally funny, relaxed actors who enjoy the spotlight and are so good at it.
21631.name: Heath Ledger

21632.quote: I turned down 'Some Like It Hot.' See how smart I am? I felt I couldn't bring anything funny to it. The outfit was funny. I don't need to compete with the wardrobe.
21632.name: Jerry Lewis

21633.quote: I mean, sometimes, a comedian becomes an actor, and they just don't deliver, because the bottom line of comedy is to be funny, and the bottom line of acting is to be truthful, and they get that mixed up sometimes, or don't even notice that that's the thing.
21633.name: Eddie Izzard

21634.quote: I need to be cheered up a lot. I think funny people are people who need to be cheered up.
21634.name: Lynda Barry

21635.quote: Boston is actually the capital of the world. You didn't know that? We breed smart-ass, quippy, funny people. Not that I'm one of them. I just sorta sneaked in under the radar.
21635.name: John Krasinski

21636.quote: It's not so much what you learn about Mumbai, it's what you learn about yourself, really. It's a funny old hippie thing, but it's true as well. You find out a lot about yourself and your tolerance, and about your inclusiveness.
21636.name: Danny Boyle

21637.quote: I was lucky. My family is wonderful. And it's funny, because most of my best friends come from very large families. So it always felt as if I had lots of siblings, though in the end I had to leave them and go home. I kind of got the best of both worlds as a kid.
21637.name: Sophia Bush

21638.quote: I think there have always been funny women, from Carol Burnett to Joan Rivers. When the audience sees a woman, they innately know she's worked twice as hard to get there, she's had to prove that she can be the leader, first, and then be funny on top of it. She has to emit a confidence that she's in control.
21638.name: Wendy Liebman

21639.quote: Justin Timberlake is everything, and what more could you want in a person? He's funny. He's cute. He's great. He just understands. I get him and he gets me, and that's cool.
21639.name: Britney Spears

21640.quote: When humor can be made to alternate with melancholy, one has a success, but when the same things are funny and melancholic at the same time, it's just wonderful.
21640.name: Francois Truffaut

21641.quote: When human judgment and big data intersect there are some funny things that happen.
21641.name: Nate Silver

21642.quote: It's funny, when bands or younger musicians ask me: 'So, what does it take to make it?' Well, first explain to me what you mean by 'making it': Do you want to be a rock star or do you want music to be your livelihood?
21642.name: Eddie Van Halen

21643.quote: I mean it's funny, playing music, how of course you want it to do well, you want them to like it, but it's not competitive like an election, it's the Olympics, it's not a Formula 1 race. The Billboard charts are just to show you what people like.
21643.name: Eddie Van Halen

21644.quote: It's funny how making odd noises can get you into strange situations sometimes.
21644.name: Eric San

21645.quote: I love things made out of animals. It's just so funny to think of someone saying, 'I need a letter opener. I guess I'll have to kill a deer.
21645.name: David Sedaris

21646.quote: It's funny - if you impersonate somebody, they have no idea it's them.
21646.name: Tracey Ullman

21647.quote: Being funny, it turns out, is like being a bank. It's a confidence trick. As long as everyone believes in you, you are fine.
21647.name: Evan Davis

21648.quote: It's funny, as you live through something you're not aware of it.
21648.name: Maya Lin

21649.quote: Maybe I'm delusional but I'm usually funny. It's not 100% but I have a pretty good batting average.
21649.name: Adam Carolla

21650.quote: If Joy Behar or Sherri Shepherd was a dude, they'd be off TV. They're not funny enough for dudes. What if Roseanne Barr was a dude? Think we'd know who she was?
21650.name: Adam Carolla

21651.quote: It's funny when you're a kid how you can acclimate to almost anything.
21651.name: Adam Carolla

21652.quote: I sometimes lie awake at night trying to think of something funny that Richard Nixon said.
21652.name: Lyn Nofziger

21653.quote: My father was always a straight-up funny guy. He was silly. He was my inspiration.
21653.name: Mike Myers

21654.quote: As a writer, or as a filmmaker, you have to present yourself, and part of what yourself is is what you're interested in, or what you think is funny, or what you think is sad, or what you think is horrible.
21654.name: Charlie Kaufman

21655.quote: People ask 'do you make a conscious effort not to swear?' - if you're doing silly stuff you're not tempted to put swearing in. All the comics from my childhood, who were funny without swearing, were the people that influenced me. What I do is quite traditional anyway.
21655.name: Tim Vine

21656.quote: I always find it kind of embarrassing, kind of funny, and kind of exciting. In New York I'm recognized a lot, although nobody says anything. You know, they stare at you just a second too long. But in Paris it's not as commonplace to be recognized.
21656.name: Marc Jacobs

21657.quote: I don't think, 'Gee, I'd like to dress this person.' There was a picture in Us magazine. It was a jersey dress, and Courtney Love was wearing it. I have this thing about Courtney Love, this funny worship.
21657.name: Marc Jacobs

21658.quote: I grew up in a funny way.
21658.name: Gordon Ramsay

21659.quote: I got to dress up in funny clothes and run around New Zealand with a bow and arrow for 18 months, how bad could that be?
21659.name: Orlando Bloom

21660.quote: It was always a fantasy of mine growing up - my favorite program was always 'Little House on the Prairie' - so I always wanted to wear those looks. When I was a child, I wouldn't let my mom put me in anything but calico dresses and now, whaddaya know, every day I'm in a calico dress, basically, so it's kind of funny.
21660.name: Chloe Sevigny

21661.quote: Something about New York, man: You can do more comedy there probably than you can anywhere in the world. If you're interested in being funny, New York is the place to go.
21661.name: Dave Chappelle

21662.quote: It's funny with fiction - once you cut something, it hasn't happened anymore.
21662.name: George Saunders

21663.quote: I read the script for Wonder Boys, and I said that was almost perfect, it was so classy, cool and funny. It's a really specific thing. We stuck to it, it turned out good and a lot of people liked it.
21663.name: Jr. Robert Downey

21664.quote: It's funny that there was so much disturbance about having a Catholic in the White House with Kennedy, and when we finally get a religion in the White House that's causing a lot of conflicts, and concerns, and disturbances for a lot of people, it's in the Bush Administration.
21664.name: Roger Ebert

21665.quote: If you use tact you can say anything, then make it funny.
21665.name: Dane Cook

21666.quote: I think Chris Rock at the Oscars was a great example. I thought that was intellectually hilarious. The Gap starts a war with Banana Republic, That to me was funny.
21666.name: Christopher Meloni

21667.quote: I'd love to date somebody cool, fun, funny.
21667.name: Rihanna

21668.quote: You know, I've always thought that it would be really funny if somebody made a romantic comedy where absolutely everything went well from beginning to end.
21668.name: Fiona Apple
