21669.quote: I'm very silly as a person, but quality silliness on-screen has more of an art to it. Harrison Ford, whom I was in 'Morning Glory' with, has mastered that dry funny better than anyone.
21669.name: Rachel McAdams

21670.quote: This is going to sound really funny. I have a poster of Zac Efron on my wall! I think every girl has a poster of him in their room so, why not join the club!
21670.name: Vanessa Hudgens

21671.quote: I'm an unorthodox type of guy, a funny guy - at least I think I'm funny. And one of the things I like to do is come up with nicknames for myself.
21671.name: Shaquille O'Neal

21672.quote: Hurried and worried until we're buried, and there's no curtain call, Lifes a very funny proposition after all.
21672.name: George M. Cohan

21673.quote: In a funny way, poems are suited to modern life. They're short, they're intense. Nobody has time to read a 700-page book. People read magazines, and a poem takes less time than an article.
21673.name: Caroline Kennedy

21674.quote: I don't have a caustic sense of humor. What I find funny, that humor comes from a much gentler place.
21674.name: Vera Farmiga

21675.quote: On the stage you're there, it's live. There's a beginning, a middle, an end. When something is funny you hear it right away.
21675.name: Theodore Bikel

21676.quote: Some of the writers I admire who seem very, very funny and very emotional to me can develop a closeness with the reader without giving too much of themselves away. Lorrie Moore comes to mind, as does David Sedaris. When they write, the reader thinks that they're being trusted as a friend.
21676.name: Sloane Crosley

21677.quote: I think a lot of humor is about distracting yourself. Pretend you're not trying to make it funny. Because for some reason the effort to be funny smells like sulphur in our culture.
21677.name: Sloane Crosley

21678.quote: It's funny. People often compare me to other humor essayists. They're usually quite nice comparisons I will accept those gladly. But I am always sort of appalled at the idea of being lumped with other, more chick-y female writers. And the truth is probably that neither comparison is accurate.
21678.name: Sloane Crosley

21679.quote: Queer Eye for the Straight Guy is a form of service journalism. To be successful, I think it has to be a combination of a good story, it has to be funny, and it also needs to be packed with useful information.
21679.name: Ted Allen

21680.quote: With improv, it's a combination of listening and not trying to be funny.
21680.name: Kristen Wiig

21681.quote: For a culture that has such a problem with death, we seem to deal with it in a quite bizarre way. We see people shot, killed and blown up, and we find it funny and sexy and all those things. But, the reality of it is that every day people die, and people are really sad and they grieve and they go through a really difficult process with it.
21681.name: Michael Sheen

21682.quote: Sometimes I feel like there are people just waiting for me to fall. The funny thing is, I can't give them anything. I have just never been a partier, even in school.
21682.name: Jordin Sparks

21683.quote: It's funny. When I saw the script in my inbox and it said 'Sparkle,' I thought, 'For real? It's really called 'Sparkle?'' I was wondering, too, how does 'Jordin Sparks as Sparkle' sound?
21683.name: Jordin Sparks

21684.quote: I'm so single. It's funny. I'm usually a relationship girl. I love being in love and having a partner in crime. But it's good to be your own partner in crime. God, that makes me sound like I have multiple-personality disorder.
21684.name: Brittany Snow

21685.quote: I think things are funny when the character is taking it totally seriously.
21685.name: Rachel Weisz

21686.quote: The word 'Spanx' was funny. It made people laugh. No one ever forgot it.
21686.name: Sara Blakely

21687.quote: It's painful for me to watch someone who isn't funny. It's horrifying to sit in the back and watch some guy who just totally sucks.
21687.name: Joe Rogan

21688.quote: If you are a great dramatic actor then you often don't know if people are enjoying your stuff at all because they are sitting there in silence. But with comedy it's a simple premise. If it's funny, people laugh. If it's not, they don't.
21688.name: Steve Coogan

21689.quote: The surprising thing is that I was not funny in high school. I was always jealous of the funny kids because they always got the girls. I couldn't tell a joke to save my life.
21689.name: Seann William Scott

21690.quote: I don't really necessarily think I'm a funny guy, but I like the opportunity to take on something that I don't feel I'm the best at doing.
21690.name: Seann William Scott

21691.quote: I'm never afraid to try something if I think it's funny. And I know I'll regret it if I don't.
21691.name: Seann William Scott

21692.quote: Here is my prescription to heal all wounds. Watch the film 'Funny Girl' at least five times, eat at least 45 chocolate bars, and hang out with all those friends you blew off to hang out with your ex. I truly believe that, through a combination of Nutella, old pals and Barbra Streisand, we can achieve happiness and, very probably, world peace.
21692.name: Beth Ditto

21693.quote: My size has helped make me an amazing performer too. The cliche of the Funny Fat Friend: I absolutely was that character - I am that character, It's a complicated bag of tools I acquired, and I've put them all to work onstage.
21693.name: Beth Ditto

21694.quote: It sounds funny, but the 2008 Olympics were something that just kind of happened, and I was lucky they came at a point when I was uninjured and well prepared. As a gymnast, you can't ask for much more.
21694.name: Shawn Johnson

21695.quote: I think I have an inner confidence that my tastes are pretty simple, that what I find funny finds a wide audience. I'm not particularly intellectual or clever or minority-focused in my creative instincts. And I'm certainly not aware of suppressing more sophisticated ambitions.
21695.name: Rowan Atkinson

21696.quote: Funny things tend not to happen to me. I am not a natural comic. I need to think about things a lot before I can be even remotely amusing.
21696.name: Rowan Atkinson

21697.quote: This may sound funny, but as much as the 'Today' show matured me, it also was something of a cocoon. I'd been happy there. I never went into the boss's office and pounded my fist on the desk, saying, 'Give me more money! Give me a prime-time show!'
21697.name: Jane Pauley

21698.quote: I think I'm funny because my family, my siblings were funny.
21698.name: Martin Short

21699.quote: It's funny how the hippies and the punks tried to get rid of the conservatives, but they always seem to get the upper hand in the end.
21699.name: Bjork

21700.quote: I show them the funny part, the silly part, the laughing part, the crazy part and then the really deep, deep part where I'm talking from my heart to these people. Because I've been through everything they've been through.
21700.name: Richard Simmons

21701.quote: Especially with a comedy, you've got the clear cut goal of trying to make a scene funny. It's not like drama where you're trying to achieve some kind of emotion or trying to further the story along. You're trying to figure out what's the funniest way to do something.
21701.name: Luke Wilson

21702.quote: I've started looking at my own father a bit funny. He assures me, though, that I really am the son of a Scottish postman.
21702.name: Craig Ferguson

21703.quote: I don't know now if I'm funny. I just keep talking and hope that I hit something that's funny.
21703.name: Craig Ferguson

21704.quote: In terms of the creative side of it, it's really been a thing where you come up with the funny stuff is usually at a bar or out talking to people or whatever.
21704.name: Trey Parker

21705.quote: It's funny because I think a lot of it is simply, We've never considered ourselves satirists, but because we're on Comedy Central and because we're South Park on Comedy Central, we can do any topic we want.
21705.name: Trey Parker

21706.quote: No, writing musicals is the hardest thing in the world. And it was really funny, because I remember when the South Park movie came out, there were some critics that said, 'Well it's obvious that in order to get it to be 90 minutes they filled some time with music.'
21706.name: Trey Parker

21707.quote: Nothing's funny about someone who's successful.
21707.name: Drew Carey

21708.quote: TV is easier: it's all planned out for you and the audience is there to see a show and they are all pumped up but when you are in a comedy club, you have to be really funny to win them over.
21708.name: Drew Carey

21709.quote: It's funny because I'm a sucker for glitz and glitter when it comes to clothes and nail polish, but with my makeup, I'm more comfortable with a natural look. It feels more like me.
21709.name: Alison Sweeney

21711.quote: I'm on so late I'm definitely the last seconds of anyone's attention. So I just want to give them something dumb to laugh at, so they go, 'That's funny,' then fall asleep.
21711.name: Jimmy Fallon

21712.quote: I recently spent quite a bit of time in Sheffield, England, which is where I'm from. I wouldn't move back there, but it's funny when you spend a bit of time in the place where you were brought up. You kind of realize how that place has had quite a big effect on you or made you a certain way.
21712.name: Jarvis Cocker

21713.quote: I listen like mad to any conversation taking place next to me just trying to hear why this is funny. Women's restrooms are especially great. I wash my hands twice waiting for people to come in and start talking.
21713.name: Lynda Barry

21714.quote: I don't just try to be funny.
21714.name: Bil Keane

21715.quote: It's harder to be funny if you're handsome than if you're very normal-looking. It's just more relatable. You're the underdog. I mean it's funny to see people struggle, and you don't buy that Brad Pitt is struggling, you know that guy could be the most skill-less guy in the world, but if you look like that you will be fine for the rest of your life.
21715.name: Jonah Hill

21716.quote: It's funny, because I never think of myself as Little Miss All-Together.
21716.name: Courteney Cox

21717.quote: When I was a kid I didn't feel like I fit in because - this is really silly and I probably shouldn't say it, but, I didn't think anything was funny. So I used to go home and literally cry to my mom and my step-dad at the time and I didn't think anything was funny. I couldn't laugh.
21717.name: Courteney Cox

21718.quote: I realized my family was funny, because nobody ever wanted to leave our house.
21718.name: Anthony Anderson

21719.quote: You know what? I never really factor Hollywood into anything. I'm a black actor, so I can't really control what Hollywood thinks. I gotta go do my thing, and my jokes have got to be funny. Whatever I do has got to be great.
21719.name: Jamie Foxx

21720.quote: I really wanted to just be a musician. I didn't want to be anything else, but I was funny and all that.
21720.name: Jamie Foxx

21721.quote: For years I used to bore my wife over lunch with stories about funny incidents.
21721.name: James Herriot

21722.quote: Movies these days have made killers into funny people. What's that all about? I've got kids and family and friends, and I don't like bad things. I don't think they're funny, and it's irresponsible to make movies that don't show you how that's not good.
21722.name: Billy Bob Thornton

21723.quote: I tell you, it's funny because the only time I think about HIV is when I have to take my medicine twice a day.
21723.name: Magic Johnson

21724.quote: A comedian's body is funny as well as his mind being funny, his whole personage is funny.
21724.name: Bobby Darin

21725.quote: I want to be in 'Funny Girl.' And I want Ryan Murphy to direct it.
21725.name: Lea Michele

21726.quote: It would be pretty funny to see a Beverly Hills white girl with mad rap skills.
21726.name: Tori Spelling

21727.quote: Being a funny person does an awful lot of things to you. You feel that you mustn't get serious with people. They don't expect it from you, and they don't want to see it. You're not entitled to be serious, you're a clown.
21727.name: Fanny Brice

21728.quote: Comedy is not funny. Comedy is hard work and timing and lots and lots of rehearsals.
21728.name: Larry Hagman

21729.quote: That's why I like to get out there, and get people to see the other side of Mitt, and know us in a different reflection when you see the family and how funny he is with the boys and with the grandkids. And you know, just what a super guy he is. That's part of what I am doing, is letting people see the other side of Mitt.
21729.name: Ann Romney

21731.quote: Memories are doing funny things to us.
21731.name: Milos Forman

21732.quote: My dad loved to laugh. He was very funny and very silly.
21732.name: Mike Myers

21733.quote: Europe is scooters. Europe is five young people on one bench sharing a chocolate bar. Their idea of entertainment and fun is so much different than ours, which is exactly why a movie about them would be funny.
21733.name: Mike Myers

21734.quote: So that's why one of my rules of parody writing is that it's gotta be funny regardless of whether you know the source material. It has to work on its own merit.
21734.name: Al Yankovic

21735.quote: People never ask people doing serious music, 'Do you ever think about doing funny music?'
21735.name: Al Yankovic

21736.quote: I've never really understood that. It's a funny thing people sometimes accuse us of condescending to our characters somehow-that to me is kind of inexplicable.
21736.name: Joel Coen

21737.quote: Ninety-eight per cent of laughter is nothing to do with jokes, which do not deserve to bear the weight of all the funny stuff in the world.
21737.name: Arthur Smith

21738.quote: The history of the relationship between comedy and swimming is short indeed. Of course it is always funny when someone falls into water, but that's about it.
21738.name: Arthur Smith

21739.quote: What's so great about working with really funny women is that vanity comes second. Whatever makes it real and funny, they're going to go for, and it's just great.
21739.name: Paul Feig

21740.quote: What I don't like is when I see stuff that I know has had a lot of improv done or is playing around where there's no purpose to the scene other than to just be funny. What you don't want is funny scene, funny scene, funny scene, and now here's the epiphany scene and then the movie's over.
21740.name: Paul Feig

21741.quote: Women's humor seems to be a little more supportive. It's just kind of trying to make the other one laugh through funny voices and kind of talking about other people. I respond to that. I feel less like I'm going to get beat up in a room full of women than I do in a room full of guys.
21741.name: Paul Feig

21742.quote: It's funny when people say you have sex appeal or call you the next Brad Pitt. I just laugh. I'm not that. I don't want to be that.
21742.name: Kellan Lutz

21743.quote: By no means do I want to be a piece of meat for the rest of my career. It's funny when you get asked to do a talk show, and then they follow it up with requesting you take your shirt off.
21743.name: Kellan Lutz

21744.quote: See, I don't really go after girls. Most of the girlfriends I've had have come after me. So it's really funny when girls get offended because I don't hit on them.
21744.name: Kellan Lutz

21745.quote: It's interesting that whenever I meet some of the other Bond girls, I always have something in common, and it is an interesting sorority. We all share about our Bonds. 'Did your Bond do that?' 'Yes mine did!' So it is quite funny conversations. We may as well be in high school.
21745.name: Jane Seymour

21746.quote: You know, Stephen says, in the movies no one ever goes to the bathroom. They shave, they brush their teeth. He goes right at this sort of funny taboo we have about the bathroom, and he turned it into this nightmare, you know, your worst fear of what's in there.
21746.name: Lawrence Kasdan

21748.quote: My main point is to be funny if I can slip a message in there, fine.
21748.name: Flip Wilson

21749.quote: Things can be funny only when we are in fun. When we're 'dead earnest,' humor is the only thing that is dead.
21749.name: Flip Wilson

21750.quote: Funny is not a color. Being black is only good from the time you get from the curtain to the microphone.
21750.name: Flip Wilson

21751.quote: I don't believe that anybody has come to a conclusion on why something is funny. It's funny because it's ridiculous and it's ridiculous for different reasons at different times.
21751.name: Jackie Mason

21752.quote: There are so many funny women in the world, and there has been for so many years, so I'll be happy when people can just move on from that, and things can just be 'comedies' and not 'female' or 'male,' and everyone gets an equal opportunity.
21752.name: Kristen Wiig

21753.quote: But if something funny happens, I can't resist. I have to tell the people.
21753.name: Kathy Griffin

21754.quote: I would like to do something modern and possibly funny.
21754.name: Dan Stevens

21755.quote: I've always enjoyed making people laugh. But in order for me to be funny, I have to get ticked off about something.
21755.name: Carl Hiaasen

21756.quote: Everyone comes up to me saying, 'Cooee, Julie! Hello!' as if I know them. Of course I don't bloody know them. Am I flummoxed by it? Sometimes. I think, 'Ooh, love, go easy.' For a time, I did feel this pressure that I had to be funny, but it passes.
21756.name: Julie Walters

21757.quote: Oh all the time when Victoria Wood and I did our series. There were people asking 'Can women be funny?' People still ask that. It's like asking: 'Can women breathe in and out?'
21757.name: Julie Walters

21758.quote: I was the little, funny one. I felt I was the child among grown women.
21758.name: Julie Walters

21759.quote: It's a real primal thing, watching someone get hurt. It's funny and accessible.
21759.name: Johnny Knoxville

21760.quote: It's a funny thing - when I'm crazed with work, spending time with my children relaxes me. Yet, at the end of a long weekend with them, the very thing I need to relax is a little work and time away from them!
21760.name: Emily Giffin

21761.quote: It's really funny because the same people who loved me as Stringer Bell were the same people that were watching 'Daddy's Little Girls' literally in tears.
21761.name: Idris Elba

21762.quote: I had seen movies before that that had made me laugh, but I had never seen anything even remotely close to as funny as Richard Pryor was, just standing there talking.
21762.name: Joe Rogan

21763.quote: I wouldn't totally rule out doing Letterman or the Tonight Show if I had a set that I just happened to write that I thought was funny but was still appropriate for network censors. But I'm not going to go out of my way.
21763.name: Joe Rogan

21764.quote: The audience changes every night. You're the same person. You have to speak your mind and do the stuff that you think is funny and makes you laugh.
21764.name: Joe Rogan

21765.quote: The misconception is that standup comics are always on. I don't know any really funny comics that are annoying and constantly trying to be funny all the time.
21765.name: Joe Rogan

21766.quote: I used to say I wanted somebody funny and intelligent, but kindness is the most important quality in a man.
21766.name: Cat Deeley

21767.quote: The great thing is that the funny side of getting old is fuel for my comedy.
21767.name: Steve Coogan

21768.quote: I think it's always funny when you see kids do Shakespeare.
21768.name: Steve Coogan

21769.quote: But with comedy it's a simple premise. If it's funny, people laugh. If it's not, they don't.
21769.name: Steve Coogan

21770.quote: Hitchcock had a charm about him. He was very funny at times. He was incredibly brilliant in his field of suspense.
21770.name: Tippi Hedren

21771.quote: One lion thinks it's just hilarious to tackle us. He's very funny about it, and we always know when it will happen.
21771.name: Tippi Hedren

21772.quote: Working with Chaplin was very amusing and strange. His films are so funny, but working with him, I found him to be a very serious man. Whereas the films of Hitchcock are macabre, he could be a very funny man to work with, always telling jokes and holding court. Of course, when I worked with Charlie he was getting older.
21772.name: Tippi Hedren

21773.quote: I actually find novels that are determined to be funny at every turn quite oppressive.
21773.name: Ian Mcewan

21774.quote: It's funny, though, with films, because you can incorporate a variety of elements, and sometimes that can work for you and sometimes I think it can work against you.
21774.name: Guy Pearce

21775.quote: Comedians don't laugh. They're too busy analyzing why it's funny or not.
21775.name: James Lipton

21776.quote: What was really funny is that as I got older all those guys who called me a sissy in junior high school wanted me to be their best friend because they wanted to meet all the girls that I knew in figure skating.
21776.name: Scott Hamilton

21777.quote: I can't not find humor in elements of most parts of life, but at the same time nothing ever seems perpetually funny to me.
21777.name: Greg Kinnear

21778.quote: And, in a funny way, each death is different and you mourn each death differently and each death brings back the death you mourned earlier and you get into a bit of a pile-up.
21778.name: Nigella Lawson

21779.quote: Also, in a funny way, if you have been happily married there are no unresolved areas, nothing to prove to yourself after the other dies.
21779.name: Nigella Lawson

21780.quote: People often ask me how I make things funny. I don't make things funny.
21780.name: Richard Russo

21781.quote: If you work at comedy too laboriously, you can kill what's funny in the joke.
21781.name: Richard Russo

21782.quote: For some reason and I don't know why, but I don't think that I'm funny in California. So I always want to do my movies east somewhere.
21782.name: Kevin James

21783.quote: I took 'P.S. I Love You' thinking it was going to be a little funny, and I ended up crying every day on that film.
21783.name: Hilary Swank

21784.quote: I think 'Saturday Night Live', starting in the 1970s, really gave women an outlet to be funny. A lot of those women went on to have film careers, from Kristen Wiig now to Tina Fey and Gilda Radner.
21784.name: Emma Stone

21785.quote: I write about wounds, the eternal treasons of life. It's not very funny, but it's sincere. My commitment is to sincerity.
21785.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

21786.quote: When I was doing ensemble theater and comedy work, I felt I had some talents. But when I started doing my shows in Berkeley and found that I could be funny on my own, I was shocked.
21786.name: Whoopi Goldberg

21787.quote: Memory is funny. Once you hit a vein the problem is not how to remember but how to control the flow.
21787.name: Tobias Wolff

21788.quote: People just don't laugh when their family is violated, and you don't shrug it off. You band together and you defend together. It's a funny, primitive instinct.
21788.name: Phillip Noyce

21789.quote: There's always something funny about men chasing women.
21789.name: David Spade

21790.quote: I don't know who the hell Paul Lynde is, or why he's funny, and I prefer it to be a mystery to me.
21790.name: Paul Lynde

21791.quote: Politicians, talk in generalities and lies, and I think they've caused all our grief. They're so awful, they're really funny. I hate thinking this because my dad loved politics.
21791.name: Paul Lynde

21792.quote: As soon as I realized you could be funny as a job, that was the job I wanted.
21792.name: Seth Rogen

21793.quote: I think when you do comedy, you play by a different set of rules. No one really wants you to be in that good shape. Being in good shape implies a level of vanity that isn't necessarily funny.
21793.name: Seth Rogen

21794.quote: To me, what separates a funny movie from a good movie is something personal.
21794.name: Seth Rogen

21795.quote: I can't watch other people doing comedy. As soon as somebody starts being funny I have to turn off because it upsets me. I get comedy indigestion. I just hate anybody else being funny. That's my job.
21795.name: Jenny Eclair

21796.quote: As a five-year-old in Berlin in 1965, I didn't know that funny women existed. It wasn't until I got back to England that I realised women could be funny.
21796.name: Jenny Eclair

21797.quote: Leno, Conan. They are both really funny. They really know how to land one.
21797.name: Jimmy Fallon

21798.quote: Straight men just can't imagine the bliss of being in a relationship with someone who finds farting as funny as they do.
21798.name: Graham Norton

21799.quote: We live in a funny time. If you don't go corporate, you can't compete. You're relegated as irrelevant. People used to admire that.
21799.name: Ethan Hawke

21800.quote: You can't teach somebody how to be funny. You're either funny, or you ain't.
21800.name: Denis Leary

21801.quote: The things that make me angry still make me angry. George Carlin is 67, and he's still as funny as he's ever been, and he's still angry. And that makes me feel good, because I feel like if I stick around long enough, I'll still be able to work.
21801.name: Denis Leary

21802.quote: The fact that the Kardashians could be more popular than a show like 'Mad Men' is disgusting. It's a super disgusting part of our culture, but I still find it funny to make a joke about it.
21802.name: Jonah Hill

21803.quote: I don't happen to have a sense of humor personally, so I don't know what's funny about a character, This happens to be a feature of my life generally.
21803.name: Wallace Shawn

21804.quote: I was making my living from a joke about my appearance that I didn't understand, and in a way still don't, because when I look in a mirror it doesn't seem funny to me.
21804.name: Wallace Shawn

21805.quote: For some reason, people find me funny. It's quite hard to define why a thought is funny. It's even harder to define why a person would be funny. It's a word that I can't define at all. But whether I know quite what it is or not, I seem to be it.
21805.name: Wallace Shawn

21806.quote: We all know funny people who can't get it down on the page - even funny writers who can't get it down on the page.
21806.name: Calvin Trillin

21807.quote: If it's inappropriate to write about, if there's nothing funny about it, then it's not funny.
21807.name: Calvin Trillin

21808.quote: It's funny how a chubby kid can just be having fun, and people call it entertainment!
21808.name: Garth Brooks

21809.quote: Sometimes, comics will make the observation that it's not jokes that are funny, it's characters that are funny. And isn't that true! That's why I always kill jokes. I'm terrible at them, because I get the joke right, but I can't get the character right, and it just goes down like a lead balloon.
21809.name: David Mitchell

21810.quote: I would call it a comedy variety show. We have some people just doing straight standup. We usually try to have one musical act of sort. So its just people being funny in different ways, not just sketch, not just standup, not just characters, all of those things.
21810.name: Todd Barry

21811.quote: Animals are sentient, intelligent, perceptive, funny and entertaining. We owe them a duty of care as we do to children.
21811.name: Michael Morpurgo

21812.quote: Strange questions are the more interesting ones. Children by and large don't try to trip you up, they want to find out how you do this funny thing that you do, if they've loved a story they love to know how it started.
21812.name: Michael Morpurgo

21813.quote: It's so funny, because right now I'm very tired and my brains a little dead, I tend to get very focused and serious. So, I'm probably coming off a lot more like Scully right now.
21813.name: Gillian Anderson

21814.quote: I tend to play characters that I can infuse with certain kinds of humour. Even the baddest guy can be funny in his own particular way. I want the audience to engage with the character on some deeper level so that they leave the cinema still thinking about him.
21814.name: Samuel L. Jackson

21815.quote: It's a required part of your film history to know who Woody is. His movies are so wonderful, and not just funny but so insightful about human behavior.
21815.name: Scarlett Johansson

21816.quote: I have no idea what I'm going to say when I stand up to give a toast. But I do know that anything I say I find funny.
21816.name: Don Rickles

21817.quote: You know what's funny to me? Attitude.
21817.name: Don Rickles

21818.quote: Some people say funny things, but I say things funny.
21818.name: Don Rickles

21819.quote: We are supposed to enjoy the good stuff now, while we can, with the people we love. Life has a funny way of teaching us that lesson over and over again.
21819.name: Sheena Easton

21820.quote: I also think if you're an actor and you can improvise, when you go on an audition and you can improvise you're just a genius. If you can, you know, take a Tide commercial and you can just say one funny line that's not in the commercial they think you're a genius.
21820.name: Amy Poehler

21821.quote: Most of the gaffes I've made have not been funny - they've been stupid.
21821.name: Jim Lehrer

21822.quote: My little dog, he did not get ill. It is so funny that people get ill on a boat and dogs do not.
21822.name: Anna Held

21823.quote: Who knew Rob Lowe was funny? On 'Parks and Rec,' we've got some of the funniest comedy writers, some of the funniest comedians in the world working there. And if anything, we don't just effuse to one another and be like, 'Oh, Rob Lowe's really funny,' if he wasn't.
21823.name: Chris Pratt

21824.quote: The American audience has really opened up to women being A.) funny and B.) kinda crude. 'Bridesmaids' is R-rated, and I think it was a major coup for women to have an R-rated comedy that did really well. Same as 'Bad Teacher.'
21824.name: Chris Pratt

21825.quote: It's interesting - I always thought when I was doing more melodramatic stuff like 'Everwood' that the directors were constantly reeling me in and stopping me from being funny.
21825.name: Chris Pratt

21826.quote: The key is just to ignore the pain, because physical comedy only works if you see someone get hurt and they aren't actually hurt. If someone gets hit in the face with a bat, falls down, and gets back up, it's funny. If they stay down and their jaw is wired shut in the next scene, it's really tragic and weird. You have to pretend it doesn't hurt.
21826.name: Chris Pratt

21827.quote: It's a funny relationship that makeup artists have. I always feel kind of like a dentist. People look at me and think of pain.
21827.name: Rick Baker

21828.quote: I love Charlie, Billy Burke's character. Writing for him is so spectacular, he's so funny and wry and every scene he's in he just takes. There's a scene in 'Eclipse' where Bella tells him she's a virgin, and it's the funniest, most awkward scene I've ever seen on film.
21828.name: Melissa Rosenberg

21829.quote: It's funny how I use social media because I don't use it to promote my restaurants that much. I use it for social issues and I think that's what it's for. I do a few things - I mess around with music a lot because that's a passion of mine. If something strikes me and I want to share it, I do.
21829.name: Tom Colicchio

21830.quote: He is very dry but also very funny, I think people tend to feel odd when I do my act. Unless you are an ironic person, it's not a good place for you to be.
21830.name: Colin Quinn

21831.quote: You know, the funny thing about Lorne and that show is that, you can go over one million things, but in a business of bean counters, he still likes to laugh at small things and creates a show around it.
21831.name: Colin Quinn

21833.quote: Marie Antoinette was funny, I'm sure she was just misinterpreted. You know the 'Let them eat cake' line. She seems like she was kind of funny, like a Chelsea Handler or Kathy Griffin type.
21833.name: Colin Quinn

21834.quote: You can't make everybody laugh. You gotta just do what you think is funny. Just be obstreperous to everybody.
21834.name: Colin Quinn

21835.quote: You know how it is with writing. You just write what you want to write. There's no way to predict what is good or bad. You just do what you think is funny, and either it works or you're finished. It's impossible to predict anything.
21835.name: Colin Quinn

21836.quote: I've dated some women who have turned me on to some funny things that are strange for men to actually do, but these things have become part of my process. I think the things I do for my appearance help make me look better. I even colour my hair because I like how it makes me look.
21836.name: Ryan Seacrest

21837.quote: I'm terrible at practical jokes. I do them too well, so they're not funny. I end up saying, 'Oh, no, I'm joking, I'm joking.'
21837.name: Anna Torv

21838.quote: Everybody's funny if you love them.
21838.name: Anna Torv

21839.quote: People don't realize that I'm really funny and I'm an excellent bridge player.
21839.name: Sheryl Crow

21840.quote: People say funny things all the time during really serious moments in life.
21840.name: Mark Ruffalo

21841.quote: I had a very funny family.
21841.name: Zach Braff

21842.quote: I think I would say 'The King's Speech' is surprisingly funny, in fact the audiences in London, Toronto, LA, New York commented there's more laughter in this film than in most comedies, while it is also a moving tear-jerker with an uplifting ending.
21842.name: Tom Hooper

21843.quote: The funny thing is that I write and I act a lot about being Jewish, but I don't really think about it as a regular person.
21843.name: Liev Schreiber

21844.quote: It's funny, when people talk about the 70s I can tell you the year of every album but when it comes to the later efforts I can't remember the exact years, it's funny isn't it?
21844.name: Steve Hackett

21845.quote: I've always found it easier to be funny than to be serious.
21845.name: Molly Ivins

21846.quote: And the funny thing is, I've always been an optimist - it's practically a congenital disorder with me.
21846.name: Molly Ivins

21847.quote: It's funny how intimate it feels to get a text.
21847.name: Sophie Ellis Bextor

21848.quote: I knew exactly what to do on Alien, it was funny.
21848.name: Ridley Scott

21849.quote: I come more to Scotland than I ever used to, so I feel more connected to it, more part of the zeitgeist. You know when you realize you have a choice and I'm choosing my homeland. It's funny: when you get older these things creep up to you.
21849.name: Alan Cumming

21850.quote: It's funny, because when you're younger you're in a rush to be 18 or 21 or whatever. But then you hit 30. And now, the days go by like hours. You think, 40, man, this could be the halfway point. It could be the three-quarters point, you know? Who knows?
21850.name: Mark Wahlberg

21851.quote: I'm one of those hovering mothers and I know it's really important to have an independent child, so I'm trying to back off, but it's hard. I love him so much, and he's so funny and cute to me.
21851.name: Selma Blair

21852.quote: I actually was class clown, but I don't know how that happened because I've never been considered an outwardly funny person-as the people in this room will attest.
21852.name: Janeane Garofalo

21853.quote: I actually was class clown, but I don't know how that happened because I've never been considered an outwardly funny person.
21853.name: Janeane Garofalo

21854.quote: Comedy is surprises, so if you're intending to make somebody laugh and they don't laugh, that's funny.
21854.name: Norm MacDonald

21855.quote: Scream was great for what it was. For a horror film, it was intelligent, it was funny, it took a laugh at itself.
21855.name: Neve Campbell

21856.quote: When I was a kid, I wanted to be serious, like Daniel Day-Lewis. No one really dreams of being a comic actor, do they? Now I realise how stupid that is - and it's because comic acting isn't taken seriously enough. It's a discipline. You know instantly - either you're funny and getting the laughs, or you're not.
21856.name: Chris O'Dowd

21857.quote: I think there's something in the fact that it's hard to be good looking and funny. You have to have an oddball quality people have to sympathise with you to find you funny.
21857.name: Chris O'Dowd

21858.quote: One of the things I like about acting is that, in a funny way, I come back to myself.
21858.name: Bill Murray

21859.quote: For a Catholic kid in parochial school, the only way to survive the beatings - by classmates, not the nuns - was to be the funny guy.
21859.name: George A. Romero

21860.quote: It's sort of an action flick. You can't be that funny trying to steal diamonds.
21860.name: Anthony Anderson

21861.quote: I do find comedy difficult. I don't know why. Maybe I think about it too much. There's a tremendous amount of pressure to be funny.
21861.name: Michelle Pfeiffer

21862.quote: I think sometimes my humor is extremely dry, and a lot of times I would say things that I thought were very funny but, I have a reputation of - people think of me as a very fundamentalist, humorless fellow.
21862.name: Ian MacKaye

21863.quote: I don't dismiss the music that I was involved with, I don't think it was a joke, I don't think it was funny or a phase, I don't think it was just something I was doing back then, to me it was who I am. It connects all the way through. I don't distance myself from any of it.
21863.name: Ian MacKaye

21864.quote: Even as a kid I was never the generator of humor, but I always knew who was funny, who to hang out with.
21864.name: Andrew Stanton

21865.quote: In Italy, I had an Afro, and a lot of the kids came up and felt my hair. It really was funny. I wish I had understood Italian.
21865.name: Sugar Ray Leonard

21866.quote: I think a lot comes from having the experience of doing stand-up comedy. It allows you to figure out the psychology of an audience what things are funny and not.
21866.name: Keenen Ivory Wayans

21867.quote: Life is funny and it is interesting how we make it as serious as possible.
21867.name: Elisha Cuthbert

21868.quote: It's funny, though, speaking of fathers and sons, because me and John Goodman played father and son, like, five or six years ago in the film 'Death Sentence,' and I got back with him again in 'Inside Llewyn Davis.'
21868.name: Garrett Hedlund

21869.quote: It's funny that I got to do 'On the Road' because the thing that had the biggest impact on me growing up was reading books. I was very inspired by the book and this spirit of Dean Moriarty and how envious we all are of somebody who can be that carefree.
21869.name: Garrett Hedlund

21870.quote: It's funny - I read that women look to chiseled-faced guys for one-night stands, and to round-faced guys for marriage. When I'm rounder in the face, I like to say, 'This is my long-term look.' Or 'This is my wife-and-kids look right here.'
21870.name: Garrett Hedlund

21871.quote: This is the great thing about Northern Ireland. I walk down the street and people stop me and say things like, 'I know you. You're that wee golfer, aren't you?' I say, 'Yeah, that's me.' They say, 'Keep it up, wee man.' It's very funny and that's why I want to stay here as long as possible.
21871.name: Rory McIlroy

21872.quote: I have an all-Japanese design team, and none of them speak English. So it's often funny and surprising how my ideas end up lost in translation.
21872.name: Pharrell Williams

21873.quote: The most important thing is to write material that YOU think is funny. If you don't think it's funny, but you're convinced that other people will think it is, well they won't.
21873.name: Mo Rocca

21874.quote: When it comes to war, we focus more on the mainstream coverage of the event, rather than the event itself. People dying is never funny. Protest puppets are always funny.
21874.name: Mo Rocca

21875.quote: I think that Obama is very cool. And I think he's clever, and I think he can be witty. But I don't think he's funny in either the way that Reagan was funny - or John McCain and Dick Cheney are both funny in that ruthless, kind of mean way.
21875.name: Mo Rocca

21876.quote: We want to be funny. We want to make people laugh, We'll do whatever it takes.
21876.name: Colin Mochrie

21877.quote: But, sooner or later I'd love to do a comedy. I mean I think that, you know, people don't think that that's in my wheelhouse because I've sort of played a lot of dramatic stuff and that's certainly a side of myself that I want at some point in the right context, in the right stuff, that I find really funny.
21877.name: Matthew Fox

21878.quote: I love nerds. Comic-Con junkies are the tastemakers of tomorrow. Isn't that funny? The tables have turned.
21878.name: Kristen Bell

21879.quote: I think the Cold War works as a great analogy or simile for different kinds of conflict. It's funny, when you look back at it, it's one of the last times that the boundaries were clear. Now, as we see on 'Homeland,' there are no clear boundaries and enemies.
21879.name: Matthew Rhys

21880.quote: I always just wanted to be funny. I never really planned to be scary.
21880.name: R. L. Stine

21881.quote: I started writing when I was 9 years old. I was like this weird kid who would just stay in my room, typing little funny magazines and drawing comic strips.
21881.name: R. L. Stine

21882.quote: The token gay character is always so funny and so fantastic. That's happened a lot. Or they're often purely victims.
21882.name: Ezra Miller

21883.quote: You can't be funny if you don't have good material.
21883.name: Matt LeBlanc

21884.quote: I have funny bones. If there's ever any kind of tension, I'll always be the one to try and be funny to loosen things up.
21884.name: Matt LeBlanc

21885.quote: It's funny - nowadays people that are famous get chased by paparazzi. They have this fame, but they don't have the money to hide from it.
21885.name: Matt LeBlanc

21886.quote: Being funny with a funny voice is more my comfort zone, a broader character that I try to humanize, a kind of silly or wacky persona that I try to fill in.
21886.name: Hank Azaria

21887.quote: You can't be funny for funny's sake. You try to get as outrageous situation as you can but it always has to be believable and based in real character motivations and what people would really do.
21887.name: Hank Azaria

21888.quote: It's funny, because I sometimes feel that I'm most creative when I'm pregnant.
21888.name: Georgina Chapman

21889.quote: Johnny Rotten. He's a big fan of mine. I used to see him out in the audience in England and he'd stand up and holler. He's funny. Smart too, and a nice guy. Don't think he's a jerk because he isn't.
21889.name: Don Van Vliet

21890.quote: If people want to compete for leadership of a religious group, they can compete in piety. A chilling thought. Or funny.
21890.name: Mary Douglas

21891.quote: Back in the '70s, like one of my favorite movies ever was 'The Bad News Bears', and that was a kids' movie, but I don't think of it that way. I think of it as just a great movie because Walter Matthau was so funny and so harsh with those kids.
21891.name: Jack Black

21892.quote: I just couldn't go back to Suddenly Susan after David Strickland's suicide. I didn't see how we could make the show light and funny any more.
21892.name: Judd Nelson

21893.quote: It's funny now how much we look at - whatever you want to call it: art, design, culture stuff, film - online, and how in the online world, you're instantly global.
21893.name: Mike Mills

21894.quote: One can always come up with funny lists and jokes. You know what? I take it back. Not everyone can always come up with funny lists and some jokes. I'm very lucky to have a gift where I can do that pretty ably.
21894.name: John Hodgman

21895.quote: People forget how outcast 'They Might Be Giants' can be. They have a reputation for writing really deft, funny, clever melodies, and they also make a lot of music for kids, which is terrific, but when you see them in concert, they can rock the house.
21895.name: John Hodgman

21896.quote: It's so funny looking back, but my so-called overnight success actually took 15 years. I remember when I didn't have any money, and my only car was mom's Hyundai.
21896.name: Criss Angel

21897.quote: Mmmm, the comedy that matters is the comedy you pull out of thin air. It's a bit like when something funny has happened and you try to explain it to someone else and end up saying, 'You had to be there.'
21897.name: Jack Dee

21898.quote: Plus, I love comic writing. Nothing satisfies me more than finding a funny way to phrase something.
21898.name: Michael Pollan

21899.quote: It's funny, because I'm a man of strong opinions and when I make one, I stand by it even if it starts to appear incorrect to me after a while.
21899.name: Danny Bonaduce

21900.quote: I think I have a dark view of the world. I have to make everything funny, otherwise it all seems so sad.
21900.name: Moon Unit Zappa

21901.quote: It's sad and upsetting when you see somebody crying hysterically, but at the same time it's real funny.
21901.name: Seth Green

21902.quote: Well in the book Carrie was my alter ego. In real life, Sarah Jessica and I don't look anything alike. But people do say that we sound alike. Sarah Jessica is an adorable girl and she is very funny.
21902.name: Candace Bushnell

21903.quote: I think if actors don't think of themselves as funny in real life they think they can't do comedy.
21903.name: Ben Barnes

21904.quote: I joke around a lot about the manic times because they're funny. We manics do outrageous things and it is part of our colorful nature.
21904.name: Patty Duke

21905.quote: I like all Jim Carrey films. They're really funny.
21905.name: Rupert Grint

21906.quote: Yes, I believe blue material is funny, but if that's all you've got, you're dead in the water. It's not good.
21906.name: Howard Stern

21907.quote: I'm not a very serious person. You know how they say that clowns are very funny in public and are really sad at home? I'm really kind of stupid at home and more serious in public.
21907.name: Roland Joffe

21908.quote: It's funny, because I did all of these interviews as soon as I had the baby, and they were asking questions, and I really didn't have an idea of anything, because I was so blurry.
21908.name: Emily Procter

21909.quote: That's a funny thing, fame. People definitely do treat you differently. When you begin to be successful, people say, 'Don't go changing.' Well, that's easy to say, but the fact is, you don't change at all - other people do.
21909.name: Jonathan Rhys Meyers

21910.quote: I tell girls all the time that the men that have fallen in love with me, have all fallen during a man repeller stage, funny how life works out like that.
21910.name: Rachel Roy

21911.quote: I think it's really important for celebrities to use their power of money and fame to get their voices out there. It's funny to me that we're expected to keep quiet just because of who we are. Why do I lose my right to speak my mind because I'm famous?
21911.name: Lisa Edelstein

21912.quote: I'm not a movie guy, I'm not a TV sitcom guy, but whatever seems to fit and is funny is good for me.
21912.name: Dave Attell

21913.quote: You have to understand the tone of the movie, because if it's supposed to be funny, it can be funny violent like the Home Alone stuff, but you have to really understand the tone of what you're doing and make the action work for that and for the character.
21913.name: David R. Ellis

21914.quote: I really love 'Soapdish.' I wish 'Soapdish' had more of a moment because I felt that that is a really strong, funny movie. Kevin Kline is hilarious in that movie.
21914.name: Elisabeth Shue

21915.quote: I don't know. I think it's funny! I think it's funny! I go, what? It's so absurd. I'm alone.
21915.name: Danny DeVito

21916.quote: It's funny that all these goths paint their faces with such white make-up and that is the actual colour of my skin, I am that pale!
21916.name: Kelly Osbourne

21917.quote: To this day, I've found that it doesn't matter what a guy looks like if he's really funny. His sense of humor makes him attractive. On the other hand, you don't hear men saying, 'No she's not pretty, but is she ever funny!'
21917.name: Catherine O'Hara

21918.quote: Everything seems fine until you're about 40. Then something is definitely beginning to go wrong. And you look in the mirror with your old habit of thinking, 'While I accept that everyone grows old and dies, it's a funny thing, but I'm an exception to that rule.'
21918.name: Martin Amis

21919.quote: It's funny, but when I arrived in California to start college I was much more interested in becoming a surfer and cruise along in life from one beach to the next. I didn't plan out any huge career for myself.
21919.name: Benicio Del Toro

21920.quote: I was going through a little bit of turbulence in my career. And so, it's funny how turbulence itself will make you hold onto something for security. And so the only thing I knew is trust in the Lord and lean not unto your own heart, in all thy ways acknowledge him and he shall direct thy path.
21920.name: Emmitt Smith

21921.quote: I actually feel like, for a lot of my career, I wasn't able to show my comedic range. I did a lot of dramas and dramedies. I was on 'E.R.' That's not generally thought of as a funny show.
21921.name: Busy Philipps

21922.quote: I have an older sister named Haley and she wanted to be an actress. So I wanted to be an actress. It's really funny the way that some people don't give kids enough credit for like really being driven, and really wanting to do things so badly.
21922.name: Hilary Duff

21923.quote: If I'm in something funny, I like to try and find some kind of serious line in it that people can relate to.
21923.name: Ron Livingston

21924.quote: If you could cross a lion and a monkey, that's what I'd be, because monkeys are funny and lions are strong.
21924.name: Marlon Wayans

21925.quote: I'm good at coming up with wacky characters and funny dialogue.
21925.name: Marlon Wayans

21926.quote: Comedy clubs can be brutal. Those people are for real, and if you aren't funny, they aren't laughing. They don't care who you are.
21926.name: Marlon Wayans

21927.quote: Gotta stay in the gym, stay funny, stay sharp. I just love working.
21927.name: Marlon Wayans

21928.quote: I think it's actually a misperception that I am a comedic actress. I do more drama than comedy but very little of it has been seen. When you are in big funny movies and they do well and your little part in it kind of explodes people perceive you as a comedian.
21928.name: Octavia Spencer

21929.quote: I don't think of myself as a comedian, but as an artist, a scientist and chemist who just happens to be funny. I started doing stand-up to add another level to my game. I feel that I'm a young rookie with a veteran's skill.
21929.name: Marlon Wayans

21930.quote: I feel cheesy when I see 'Silver Spoons.' Some of it was funny, but some of it was just cheese! My kids love it, but I look at it and cringe.
21930.name: Ricky Schroder

21931.quote: I've got to get on myself to be sharp, funny and loose.
21931.name: David Spade

21932.quote: Sometimes I am so dry that people don't know I'm kidding and think I'm being serious. I enjoy this because their reactions are often funny.
21932.name: Robert Crais

21933.quote: I would love to play 'Funny Girl' or 'Evita,' but I idolize the women who have played those parts. I don't know if there needs to be another version of those shows.
21933.name: Idina Menzel

21934.quote: I understand a woman who validates herself by getting attention from the opposite sex. I have a friend who is that to a T, Doesn't mean she isn't a good person. That's a funny character to play.
21934.name: Cheryl Hines

21935.quote: At school I was very shy. I wasn't funny really.
21935.name: Michel Gondry

21936.quote: I love weird or funny or beautiful sentences Joy Williams could write a microwave-oven manual and I'm sure I'd love it, because the sentences would be tuned up like music.
21936.name: Karen Russell

21937.quote: I remember listening to the radio as a kid and finding that the songs always made me feel more peaceful. Funny, but the more hurtin' the music was, the better it made me feel. I think of that now when I write my songs. I may not be feelin' the blues myself, but I'm writing them for other people who have a hard life.
21937.name: Chris Isaak

21938.quote: What was funny if you were there is that we were all immensely sophisticated people who knew exactly what she was going to say and we're chatting away, nice to see you.
21938.name: Anthony Holden

21939.quote: I'm so unprofessional on set it's not even funny.
21939.name: Katharine McPhee

21940.quote: It's funny that it all becomes about clothes. It's bizarre. You work your butt off and then you win an award and it's all about your dress. You can't get away from it.
21940.name: Reese Witherspoon

21941.quote: I follow the most random people on Twitter. I follow famous people like Khloe Kardashian, who surprisingly makes really funny tweets all the time.
21941.name: Chloe Moretz

21942.quote: I was not particularly bright, I wasn't very athletic, I was a little too tall, odd, funny looking, I was just really weird as a kid.
21942.name: Uma Thurman

21943.quote: I think it's so funny when people think they can't control a movie star. They can. We're just women, you know.
21943.name: Esther Williams

21944.quote: I always approach comedy roles pretending they aren't funny.
21944.name: Brendan Fraser

21945.quote: I feel funny about owning art. I don't really want to say: 'Wow, come and see my Monet - it's in a dark room at the bottom of my cellar.'
21945.name: Baz Luhrmann

21946.quote: I love Mikhail Bulgakov. He is very original and takes the story to unexpected places. I didn't realise political writing could be so funny.
21946.name: Denise Mina

21947.quote: And there's a visceral fun in watching Team America and making it, like taking a puppet and throwing it against the wall. Because it's not CG, there's something funny about it.
21947.name: Matt Stone

21948.quote: So often, I read scripts and am like, 'This would never happen in real life. It's not trying to be funny. It's trying to be serious.'
21948.name: Shailene Woodley

21949.quote: Acting is all about big hair and funny props, All the great actors knew it. Olivier knew it, Brando knew it.
21949.name: Harold Ramis

21950.quote: Billy Crystal knows how to make people laugh. He's got 30 years on stage, there's no telling him what's funny.
21950.name: Harold Ramis

21951.quote: I'm not a believer in the pratfall. I don't think it's funny just to have someone fall down.
21951.name: Harold Ramis

21952.quote: They did that little thing on South Park, and they mentioned my name and had a character of me judging a Halloween contest. It was really funny.That made me the coolest aunt on earth.
21952.name: Tina Yothers

21953.quote: There's a constant flow of child actors. It's kind of funny to watch the new crew come through. I think, You poor little things. You're going to have to struggle for a long time.
21953.name: Tina Yothers

21954.quote: It's funny, growing up there was never anybody around me with any kind of artistic bent.
21954.name: Nick Offerman

21955.quote: When I was in college, I was in the theater department, which for anyone who has been involved in any kind of theater program, you know that it's really wacky and tight-knit, a real family. Me and my good friends from college would do random shows and plays that were sometimes serious, but most of the time really goofy and funny.
21955.name: Darren Criss

21956.quote: With Portlandia, I don't think our intention is always to find something funny. Sometimes the humor comes from taking something really seriously. We're okay with making somebody feel uncomfortable or uneasy.
21956.name: Carrie Brownstein

21957.quote: I got to play with Nintendo's Wii, yes it's a funny name and not very revolutionary but it was fun whipping your arms around.
21957.name: Olivia Munn

21958.quote: Jon Stewart hires people that he thinks are funny. That's it. That's the only requirement.
21958.name: Olivia Munn

21959.quote: It is possible in this world to be pretty and funny and successful all at the same time.
21959.name: Olivia Munn

21960.quote: I think it's always funny when somebody thinks you're going to do something super sexy and then you don't.
21960.name: Olivia Munn

21961.quote: Sometimes in the most tragic situation, something just profoundly funny happens.
21961.name: David Hyde Pierce

21962.quote: And I think that being able to make people laugh and write a book that's funny makes the information go down a lot easier and it makes it a lot more fun to read, easier to understand, and often stronger. So there's all kinds of advantages to it.
21962.name: Al Franken

21963.quote: It is funny what a year can do.
21963.name: Victor Cruz

21964.quote: It's funny, in a way the actor is a writer. It's not like the two things are so separate as to be like apples and oranges. The writer and the actor are one.
21964.name: Sam Shepard

21965.quote: Stealing, you'll go far in life. Actually, there is something funny about getting away with it.
21965.name: Mike Judge

21966.quote: Movies don't look hard, but figuring it out, getting the shape of it, getting everybody's character right and having it be funny, make sense and be romantic, it's creating a puzzle. Yes, having been a writer for so long, I have an awareness of when things are going awry, but it doesn't mean I know how to fix them.
21966.name: Nancy Meyers

21967.quote: I can do comedy, so people want me to do that, but the other side of comedy is depression. Deep, deep depression is the flip side of comedy. Casting agents don't realize it but in order to be funny you have to have that other side.
21967.name: Parker Posey

21968.quote: What's funny is my husband doesn't have any tattoos at all, so he must be the very conservative one.
21968.name: Ashley Scott

21969.quote: I watched a lot of silent directors who were absolutely great like John Ford and Fritz Lang, Tod Browning, and also some very modern directors like The Coen Brothers. The directors take the freedom within their own movies to be melodramatic or funny when they chose to be. They do whatever they want and they don't care about the genre.
21969.name: Michel Hazanavicius

21970.quote: What I fell in love with as a child was 'My Fair Lady,' 'Funny Face,' 'American in Paris,' and 'Singin' in the Rain.' Just perfect movies to me and I was dancing. I started ballet when I was three. And I fell in love with those movies and fell in love with Audrey Hepburn and Leslie Caron.
21970.name: Dianna Agron

21971.quote: My job is mostly to entertain and be funny.
21971.name: Rosie O'Donnell

21972.quote: Sometimes you have to take the focus off of you and put it on someone else and it's funny what you can accomplish and how much strength you really have.
21972.name: Hoda Kotb

21973.quote: I don't think I was funny until college. I lived with some Harvard MD/PhD students - they were so smart, and what I contributed to the house was, I was the funny one.
21973.name: Wendy Liebman

21974.quote: When I was younger I wanted to be a big movie star who'd get to be funny on talk shows and then I wanted to retire and write science fiction.
21974.name: Scott Thompson

21975.quote: When you are not treated seriously, you develop comically. Its sense of oneself is so fractured and fragile that it's like the picked-on kid who has to become funny.
21975.name: Scott Thompson

21976.quote: I got pregnant at 40 by surprise. It's funny, because when we found out we were pregnant, I said, 'Okay, let's experience that.' You just have to just go with it because it's rare.
21976.name: Julianna Margulies

21977.quote: Billy is a funny, cheeky, lovely boy and I love being with him. Parenthood is terrifying though. I can barely walk past a building without panicking that it's going to collapse on his head.
21977.name: Rufus Sewell

21978.quote: The funny thing is the songs that people think are about me probably aren't. And the songs that are probably are the ones they wouldn't think, so that's where it kind of is funny.
21978.name: LeAnn Rimes

21979.quote: Funny, I don't feel any more powerful today than yesterday.
21979.name: Jerry B. Jenkins

21980.quote: The Islam of the 18th, 19th and first half of the 20th century was a poor thing. Nobody bothered about it. Islam was that funny sort of pure system of beliefs that depressed people in the Middle East held as their religion.
21980.name: John Keegan

21981.quote: Most of my ideas just come out funny.
21981.name: Tim Heidecker

21982.quote: Sometimes laughing isn't the best judge of what's funny, 'cause I think there's a lot of things that are really funny that don't make you laugh, that don't make you physically, audibly make a noise, but is something that is much more powerful than that.
21982.name: Tim Heidecker

21983.quote: There is nothing funny about a well-adjusted, intelligent person making the right choices.
21983.name: Tim Heidecker

21984.quote: I'm always in situations where you can't be funny, and yet I want to do it anyway.
21984.name: Tim Heidecker

21985.quote: It's a funny thing about me. I don't have any interest in food most of the time now, although when I was a kid I was always hungry.
21985.name: Alan Ladd

21986.quote: I wasn't even 20 at the time, but it taught me something about drugs. They can take a good man, a warm, funny, loving family man, and turn him into a loser and worse.
21986.name: Michael Bergin

21987.quote: I believe, in a funny way, the job of the novelist is to be out there on the fringes and speaking for an experience that has not really been spoken for.
21987.name: Donna Tartt

21988.quote: Funny, how moms can tell you what to do no matter how old or big you are.
21988.name: Gabrielle Reece

21989.quote: I didn't grow up identifying with beauty. I grew up thinking I could be smart and funny - those are the things I got feedback on.
21989.name: Lauren Graham

21990.quote: Inappropriateness is funny to me. Rudeness is hilarious.
21990.name: Zach Galifianakis

21991.quote: I think if they put a laugh track on 'Intervention,' it would be funny.
21991.name: Zach Galifianakis

21992.quote: We all know how funny Morrissey is. Actually, you know what? I say that sarcastically. His songs are some of the funniest songs I've ever heard in my life. I mean, really. I mean, not that the 'Girlfriend in a Coma' is, like, really funny.
21992.name: Zach Galifianakis

21993.quote: When I was in high school I used to sit by myself in the cafeteria - not necessarily by choice - but I thought it was funny to talk to people that weren't there.
21993.name: Zach Galifianakis

21994.quote: Laughter is involuntary. If it's funny you laugh.
21994.name: Tom Lehrer

21995.quote: What's funny about that is when I was writing Twilight just for myself and not thinking of it as a book, I was not thinking about publishing, and yet at the same time I was casting it in my head. Because when I read books, I see them very visually.
21995.name: Stephenie Meyer

21996.quote: I auditioned for a solo in church and got it. I was about seven and I sang a song called, 'Jesus, I Heard You Had a Big House' and I remember people standing up at the end and me thinking, 'Oh, I think I'm going to like this.' That's how it all began. Sounds funny to say you got your start in church, but I did.
21996.name: Kristin Chenoweth

21997.quote: It's so different when you change your hair color, you're treated so differently. It's a very funny experience. It's fun - I love changing up my hair.
21997.name: Kate Bosworth

21998.quote: I'm a big fan of certain new acts. I love any genre of music, and I think it's really great to see that there are new artists coming through. It's kinda funny to think that I'm like the old man on campus now. But I'm really happy for groups like One Direction. I think they're really good guys.
21998.name: Joe Jonas

21999.quote: When I turned about 12 or 13, I realised that being funny wasn't about remembering jokes. It was about creating them.
21999.name: Paul Merton

22000.quote: They're great girls. They're very funny, they're very smart, they're fun to be with. They're very lively, as I think people can tell. And you know, they're very confident girls.
22000.name: Laura Bush

22001.quote: And regardless of the fact that in this country, certainly in the arts, we treat comedy as a second-class citizen, I've never thought of it that way. I've always thought it to be important. The last time I looked, the Greeks were holding up two masks. I've always thought of it not only as having equal value, but as the craft of it, being funny.
22001.name: Jeff Daniels

22002.quote: It's funny, but we were living on this small island off the coast of Charleston, South Carolina when I was 9.
22002.name: Josh Lucas

22003.quote: I have no agenda except to be funny. Neither I or the writers profess to offer any worldly wisdom.
22003.name: Julia Louis-Dreyfus

22004.quote: In my experience, it's not just that serious books get a hearing on comedy shows. But serious books get a serious hearing, as well as a funny one, on comedy shows.
22004.name: Michael Mandelbaum

22005.quote: It's a bit like school camp, shooting a film. Everyone's on heat. It's a strange energy. It's full of adrenalin. I funnel my excess energy in funny little ways. I do a lot of dancing in my trailer. I love music.
22005.name: Alice Englert

22006.quote: Here's the funny thing about the response I've been aware of to my dating famous people: It's been very negative. I'm either not good-looking enough, not a good enough actor or not successful enough for these people.
22006.name: Dax Shepard

22007.quote: I like the hot-cold, the sugar-salt, being able to play over-the-top and dramatic things - in the same film. Just as in my life, I can be very funny and at other times almost extinguished.
22007.name: Jean Dujardin

22008.quote: I'm an off-road racecar driver. And I think every woman in my life has told me that's not a sensible hobby. But when I was growing, even more than I wanted to be funny, I wanted to be a racecar driver. That's all I thought about. I worked for a race team when I was 15 and I traveled with them.
22008.name: Dax Shepard

22009.quote: Kyle Baker's work is really funny, but it's also got a very clear vision.
22009.name: Bill Sienkiewicz

22010.quote: It's funny: I've been very successful and done a lot of films, and I don't really have an agent - I don't really pursue jobs, I let people come to me.
22010.name: Rick Baker

22011.quote: If you look at the game and everything, it's not quite like looking at an animated film, because that's total character. This, this is really movement, but it's got funny little things if you look for the humor. They're actually getting to the character.
22011.name: Don Bluth

22012.quote: It's a funny thing because you look at the careers of other filmmakers, and you see them sort of slow down, and you realize, maybe this becomes harder to do as you get older. That's sort of a cautionary thing. I hope it doesn't happen to me.
22012.name: Joel Coen

22013.quote: There's a darkness under 'The Hangover' because ultimately there's a missing person and it's not really that funny. There's a sort of darkness under it that I love, and still people are laughing as hard if not harder than they did in 'Old School.'
22013.name: Todd Phillips

22014.quote: I think people like comedies and I think concept driven comedies seem to be working when it's a clear concept and you deliver funny stuff.
22014.name: Todd Phillips

22015.quote: Now that I'm more mature, in a funny way, I can even appreciate that I've bad to become more aware of my body. Since I've chosen acting as my career, I have to keep my weight down anyway-I've been used to it for years, so it's no problem. And there's nothing I can't do.
22015.name: Dana Hill

22016.quote: Comedy is so subjective. You could be in a room with 400 people laughing at a joke and you could just not think it's funny. You're just sitting there like, 'Am I in the twilight zone? Why is everyone laughing?' It's such a personal thing. People have such a personal visceral response to comedy.
22016.name: Todd Phillips

22017.quote: I would do it today because the thing that appealed to me was not necessarily the mechanics of the robot, but it was his personality and how funny and charming he was.
22017.name: John Badham

22018.quote: You know, if I started worrying about what the critics think, I'd never make another comedy. You couldn't pick a less funny group than critics - you couldn't find a more bitter group of people!
22018.name: Todd Phillips

22019.quote: When I was a kid I had this funny blonde hair and everyone called me 'Chick' because I looked like Tweety Bird.
22019.name: Nicky Hilton

22020.quote: I think that 'Hangover II' is as funny as 'The Hangover I,' honest to God, but I think that it's a little bit darker, and the stakes are a little bit higher.
22020.name: Todd Phillips

22021.quote: I don't think know if anything's going to translate anywhere. You're making a movie, you hope it's going to be funny, you can't think about how it's going to go over.
22021.name: Ben Stiller

22022.quote: If you can find the line between sympathetic and creepy, you have reached a very funny area.
22022.name: Jason Segel

22023.quote: I don't think the public is dying to see me necessarily be funny all the time.
22023.name: Ben Stiller

22024.quote: I love New York. I was sad, depressed and incredibly moved by our fellow countrymen and what they've done. I wanted to give people a chance to see something funny, have a distraction.
22024.name: Ben Stiller

22025.quote: Jim Carrey, a comic genius, has a harder time overcoming the public's desire for him to be funny simply because he's so good at it.
22025.name: Ben Stiller

22026.quote: If you take a bunch of superstars and put them in a room where they don't have their assistants and entourage, it's funny to see what happens.
22026.name: Daryl Hall

22027.quote: Because death and illness are the most horrible things in life, of course that's where the most absurdly funny things are going to happen.
22027.name: Julia Sweeney

22028.quote: I think one of the basic tasks in life - one of the nice things we can do for each other - is to take things that are horrible and scary and make them acceptable and less frightening and, if possible, funny. It feels great to succeed at that.
22028.name: Julia Sweeney

22029.quote: I appreciate humor so much, but I'm actually not a funny girl.
22029.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

22030.quote: During the Great Depression, when people laughed their worries disappeared. Audiences loved these funny men. I decided to become one.
22030.name: Jerry Stiller

22031.quote: I remember interviewing someone I actually felt bad for, and therefore didn't want to take an ironic stance against him. It actually turned out to be a really funny piece.
22031.name: Rob Corddry

22032.quote: I don't think my judgment is that good. I don't know what is funny.
22032.name: Jerry Stiller

22033.quote: It's funny, the hardest thing to do is to make something look like it's fast, loose and improvised, and get somebody to laugh.
22033.name: Abel Ferrara

22034.quote: Sometimes we have to actually say, I think you're really funny, but none of your jokes are going to make it on the air. So just answer my questions. Seriously.
22034.name: Rob Corddry

22035.quote: I'm not a comedian. I'm an actor who just happens to be funny on occasion.
22035.name: Anthony Anderson

22036.quote: The prospects for a coherent, hilarious and consistent American comedy seem to lessen every year, as the poor waterlogged, gassy corpse called 'Evan Almighty' proved when it floated ashore recently. So there's a temptation to think too highly of Robin Williams's uneven but occasionally funny 'License to Wed.'
22036.name: Stephen Hunter

22037.quote: Look not mournfully into the past, it comes not back again. Wisely improve the present, it is thine. Go forth to meet the shadowy future without fear and with a manly heart.
22037.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

22038.quote: Cease to inquire what the future has in store, and take as a gift whatever the day brings forth.
22038.name: Horace

22039.quote: There is nothing like a dream to create the future.
22039.name: Victor Hugo

22040.quote: Trying to predict the future is like trying to drive down a country road at night with no lights while looking out the back window.
22040.name: Peter Drucker

22041.quote: Let the future tell the truth, and evaluate each one according to his work and accomplishments. The present is theirs the future, for which I have really worked, is mine.
22041.name: Nikola Tesla

22042.quote: If future generations are to remember us more with gratitude than sorrow, we must achieve more than just the miracles of technology. We must also leave them a glimpse of the world as it was created, not just as it looked when we got through with it.
22042.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

22043.quote: The future is no more uncertain than the present.
22043.name: Walt Whitman

22044.quote: There is never time in the future in which we will work out our salvation. The challenge is in the moment the time is always now.
22044.name: James A. Baldwin

22045.quote: Hold fast to the Bible. To the influence of this Book we are indebted for all the progress made in true civilization and to this we must look as our guide in the future.
22045.name: Ulysses S. Grant

22046.quote: I haven't been faithful to my own advice in the past. I will in the future.
22046.name: Billy Graham

22047.quote: I look to the future because that's where I'm going to spend the rest of my life.
22047.name: George Burns

22048.quote: Every man has his own destiny: the only imperative is to follow it, to accept it, no matter where it leads him.
22048.name: Henry Miller

22049.quote: We must welcome the future, remembering that soon it will be the past and we must respect the past, remembering that it was once all that was humanly possible.
22049.name: George Santayana

22050.quote: The secret of your future is hidden in your daily routine.
22050.name: Mike Murdock

22051.quote: Control your own destiny or someone else will.
22051.name: Jack Welch

22052.quote: I am tomorrow, or some future day, what I establish today. I am today what I established yesterday or some previous day.
22052.name: James Joyce

22053.quote: Fear not for the future, weep not for the past.
22053.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

22054.quote: A great source of calamity lies in regret and anticipation therefore a person is wise who thinks of the present alone, regardless of the past or future.
22054.name: Oliver Goldsmith

22055.quote: Never make predictions, especially about the future.
22055.name: Casey Stengel

22056.quote: You know when you're young you think you will always be. As you become more fragile, you reflect and you realize how much comfort can come from the past. Hymns can carry you into the future.
22056.name: Andy Griffith

22057.quote: The youth is the hope of our future.
22057.name: Jose Rizal

22058.quote: Our awesome responsibility to ourselves, to our children, and to the future is to create ourselves in the image of goodness, because the future depends on the nobility of our imaginings.
22058.name: Barbara Grizzuti Harrison

22059.quote: In the future everyone will be famous for 15 minutes.
22059.name: Andy Warhol

22060.quote: Even though the future seems far away, it is actually beginning right now.
22060.name: Mattie Stepanek

22061.quote: The past cannot be changed. The future is yet in your power.
22061.name: Mary Pickford

22062.quote: We must respect the past, and mistrust the present, if we wish to provide for the safety of the future.
22062.name: Joseph Joubert

22063.quote: The future is called 'perhaps,' which is the only possible thing to call the future. And the important thing is not to allow that to scare you.
22063.name: Tennessee Williams

22064.quote: There is always one moment in childhood when the door opens and lets the future in.
22064.name: Graham Greene

22065.quote: I touch the future. I teach.
22065.name: Christa McAuliffe

22066.quote: The past, the present and the future are really one: they are today.
22066.name: Harriet Beecher Stowe

22067.quote: I know not why there is such a melancholy feeling attached to the remembrance of past happiness, except that we fear that the future can have nothing so bright as the past.
22067.name: Julia Ward Howe

22068.quote: Enjoy present pleasures in such a way as not to injure future ones.
22068.name: Seneca

22069.quote: The wise man must remember that while he is a descendant of the past, he is a parent of the future.
22069.name: Herbert Spencer

22070.quote: For all of its uncertainty, we cannot flee the future.
22070.name: Barbara Jordan

22071.quote: But I dare not think too far into the future on the risk that I'll miss the present.
22071.name: Colin Farrell

22072.quote: The key to making healthy decisions is to respect your future self. Honor him or her. Treat him or her like you would treat a friend or a loved one. A Stanford study showed that those who saw a photo of their future self made smarter financial decisions.
22072.name: A. J. Jacobs

22073.quote: They gave each other a smile with a future in it.
22073.name: Ring Lardner

22074.quote: The future is always beginning now.
22074.name: Mark Strand

22075.quote: Do not dwell in the past, do not dream of the future, concentrate the mind on the present moment.
22075.name: Buddha

22076.quote: The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
22076.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

22077.quote: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future it is something you design for the present.
22077.name: Jim Rohn

22078.quote: Let us not seek the Republican answer or the Democratic answer, but the right answer. Let us not seek to fix the blame for the past. Let us accept our own responsibility for the future.
22078.name: John F. Kennedy

22079.quote: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
22079.name: John F. Kennedy

22080.quote: Learn from the past, set vivid, detailed goals for the future, and live in the only moment of time over which you have any control: now.
22080.name: Denis Waitley

22081.quote: Let him who would enjoy a good future waste none of his present.
22081.name: Roger Babson

22082.quote: I'll never stop dreaming that one day we can be a real family, together, all of us laughing and talking, loving and understanding, not looking at the past but only to the future.
22082.name: LaToya Jackson

22083.quote: The best thing about the future is that it comes one day at a time.
22083.name: Abraham Lincoln

22084.quote: Change your life today. Don't gamble on the future, act now, without delay.
22084.name: Simone de Beauvoir
