26930.name: Alfred Lord Tennyson

26931.quote: True happiness consists not in the multitude of friends, but in the worth and choice.
26931.name: Ben Jonson

26932.quote: Lovers who love truly do not write down their happiness.
26932.name: Anatole France

26933.quote: It's pretty hard to tell what does bring happiness poverty and wealth have both failed.
26933.name: Kin Hubbard

26934.quote: Happiness is brief. It will not stay. God batters at its sails.
26934.name: Euripides

26935.quote: Money can't buy you happiness, but it can buy you a yacht big enough to pull up right alongside it.
26935.name: David Lee Roth

26936.quote: Happiness isn't something you experience it's something you remember.
26936.name: Oscar Levant

26937.quote: Happiness is itself a kind of gratitude.
26937.name: Joseph Wood Krutch

26938.quote: It is the chiefest point of happiness that a man is willing to be what he is.
26938.name: Desiderius Erasmus

26939.quote: It is not easy to find happiness in ourselves, and it is not possible to find it elsewhere.
26939.name: Agnes Repplier

26940.quote: The moments of happiness we enjoy take us by surprise. It is not that we seize them, but that they seize us.
26940.name: Ashley Montagu

26941.quote: To describe happiness is to diminish it.
26941.name: Stendhal

26942.quote: Our happiness depends on wisdom all the way.
26942.name: Sophocles

26943.quote: Happiness includes chiefly the idea of satisfaction after full honest effort. No one can possibly be satisfied and no one can be happy who feels that in some paramount affairs he failed to take up the challenge of life.
26943.name: Arnold Bennett

26944.quote: If you hope for happiness in the world, hope for it from God, and not from the world.
26944.name: David Brainerd

26945.quote: Desire is individual. Happiness is common.
26945.name: Julian Casablancas

26946.quote: One of the keys to happiness is a bad memory.
26946.name: Rita Mae Brown

26947.quote: Happiness never lays its finger on its pulse.
26947.name: Adam Smith

26948.quote: Happiness is the interval between periods of unhappiness.
26948.name: Don Marquis

26949.quote: Happiness is like a cloud, if you stare at it long enough, it evaporates.
26949.name: Sarah McLachlan

26950.quote: People let their own hang-ups become the obstacles between them and personal happiness.
26950.name: Lucinda Williams

26951.quote: Unquestionably, it is possible to do without happiness it is done involuntarily by nineteen-twentieths of mankind.
26951.name: John Stuart Mill

26952.quote: Happiness is a virtue, not its reward.
26952.name: Baruch Spinoza

26953.quote: Happiness is mostly a by-product of doing what makes us feel fulfilled.
26953.name: Benjamin Spock

26954.quote: Happiness seems made to be shared.
26954.name: Pierre Corneille

26955.quote: There is only one passion, the passion for happiness.
26955.name: Denis Diderot

26956.quote: The happiness of most people is not ruined by great catastrophes or fatal errors, but by the repetition of slowly destructive little things.
26956.name: Ernest Dimnet

26957.quote: Happiness is a by-product. You cannot pursue it by itself.
26957.name: Sam Levenson

26958.quote: Happiness is the harvest of a quiet eye.
26958.name: Austin O'Malley

26959.quote: Happiness does not consist in self-love.
26959.name: Joseph Butler

26960.quote: Growth itself contains the germ of happiness.
26960.name: Pearl S. Buck

26961.quote: To buy happiness is to sell soul.
26961.name: Douglas Horton

26962.quote: Only man clogs his happiness with care, destroying what is with thoughts of what may be.
26962.name: John Dryden

26963.quote: Happiness is composed of misfortunes avoided.
26963.name: Alphonse Karr

26964.quote: Love is the most terrible, and also the most generous of the passions it is the only one which includes in its dreams the happiness of someone else.
26964.name: Alphonse Karr

26965.quote: Satisfaction of one's curiosity is one of the greatest sources of happiness in life.
26965.name: Linus Pauling

26966.quote: Life in common among people who love each other is the ideal of happiness.
26966.name: George Sand

26967.quote: We possess only the happiness we are able to understand.
26967.name: Maurice Maeterlinck

26968.quote: How easy to be amiable in the midst of happiness and success.
26968.name: William Ellery Channing

26969.quote: If you have easy self-contentment, you might have a very, very cheap source of happiness.
26969.name: Leon Kass

26970.quote: To attain happiness in another world we need only to believe something, while to secure it in this world we must do something.
26970.name: Charlotte Perkins Gilman

26971.quote: We are no longer happy so soon as we wish to be happier.
26971.name: Walter Savage Landor

26972.quote: The right to happiness is fundamental.
26972.name: Anna Pavlova

26973.quote: Life everlasting in a state of happiness is the greatest desire of all men.
26973.name: Joseph Franklin Rutherford

26974.quote: The happiness which is lacking makes one think even the happiness one has unbearable.
26974.name: Joseph Roux

26975.quote: There is happiness in duty, although it may not seem so.
26975.name: Jose Marti

26976.quote: The secret of happiness is to admire without desiring. And that is not happiness.
26976.name: F. H. Bradley

26977.quote: Happiness will come from materialism, not from meaning.
26977.name: Andrei Platonov

26978.quote: So long as we can lose any happiness, we possess some.
26978.name: Booth Tarkington

26979.quote: Happiness is hard to recall. Its just a glow.
26979.name: Frank McCourt

26980.quote: The action is best that secures the greatest happiness for the greatest number.
26980.name: William Dean Howells

26981.quote: There is no worse sorrow than remembering happiness in the day of sorrow.
26981.name: Alfred de Musset

26982.quote: Affection is responsible for nine-tenths of whatever solid and durable happiness there is in our lives.
26982.name: C. S. Lewis

26983.quote: If we can but prevent the government from wasting the labours of the people, under the pretence of taking care of them, they must become happy.
26983.name: Thomas Jefferson

26984.quote: Happiness is not something you postpone for the future it is something you design for the present.
26984.name: Jim Rohn

26985.quote: Thousands of candles can be lighted from a single candle, and the life of the candle will not be shortened. Happiness never decreases by being shared.
26985.name: Buddha

26986.quote: You will never be happy if you continue to search for what happiness consists of. You will never live if you are looking for the meaning of life.
26986.name: Albert Camus

26987.quote: To enjoy good health, to bring true happiness to one's family, to bring peace to all, one must first discipline and control one's own mind. If a man can control his mind he can find the way to Enlightenment, and all wisdom and virtue will naturally come to him.
26987.name: Buddha

26988.quote: The U. S. Constitution doesn't guarantee happiness, only the pursuit of it. You have to catch up with it yourself.
26988.name: Benjamin Franklin

26989.quote: Your success and happiness lies in you. Resolve to keep happy, and your joy and you shall form an invincible host against difficulties.
26989.name: Helen Keller

26990.quote: Happiness resides not in possessions, and not in gold, happiness dwells in the soul.
26990.name: Democritus

26991.quote: It is very important to generate a good attitude, a good heart, as much as possible. From this, happiness in both the short term and the long term for both yourself and others will come.
26991.name: Dalai Lama

26992.quote: Happiness cannot be traveled to, owned, earned, worn or consumed. Happiness is the spiritual experience of living every minute with love, grace, and gratitude.
26992.name: Denis Waitley

26993.quote: God cannot give us a happiness and peace apart from Himself, because it is not there. There is no such thing.
26993.name: C. S. Lewis

26994.quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
26994.name: Euripides

26995.quote: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own, Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy.
26995.name: Robert A. Heinlein

26996.quote: Money has never made man happy, nor will it, there is nothing in its nature to produce happiness. The more of it one has the more one wants.
26996.name: Benjamin Franklin

26997.quote: Today I choose life. Every morning when I wake up I can choose joy, happiness, negativity, pain, To feel the freedom that comes from being able to continue to make mistakes and choices - today I choose to feel life, not to deny my humanity but embrace it.
26997.name: Kevyn Aucoin

26998.quote: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
26998.name: Victor Hugo

26999.quote: Many persons have a wrong idea of what constitutes true happiness. It is not attained through self-gratification but through fidelity to a worthy purpose.
26999.name: Helen Keller

27000.quote: Happiness and moral duty are inseparably connected.
27000.name: George Washington

27001.quote: The care of human life and happiness, and not their destruction, is the first and only object of good government.
27001.name: Thomas Jefferson

27002.quote: But O, how bitter a thing it is to look into happiness through another man's eyes.
27002.name: William Shakespeare

27003.quote: I heard a definition once: Happiness is health and a short memory! I wish I'd invented it, because it is very true.
27003.name: Audrey Hepburn

27004.quote: Happiness is having a large, loving, caring, close-knit family in another city.
27004.name: George Burns

27005.quote: The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life.
27005.name: William Morris

27006.quote: Happiness is not being pained in body or troubled in mind.
27006.name: Thomas Jefferson

27007.quote: Truth is a deep kindness that teaches us to be content in our everyday life and share with the people the same happiness.
27007.name: Khalil Gibran

27008.quote: Success is getting what you want. Happiness is wanting what you get.
27008.name: Dale Carnegie

27009.quote: True happiness involves the full use of one's power and talents.
27009.name: John W. Gardner

27010.quote: Man falls from the pursuit of the ideal of plan living and high thinking the moment he wants to multiply his daily wants. Man's happiness really lies in contentment.
27010.name: Mahatma Gandhi

27011.quote: No one has a right to consume happiness without producing it.
27011.name: Helen Keller

27012.quote: Love is when the other person's happiness is more important than your own.
27012.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

27013.quote: No matter how dull, or how mean, or how wise a man is, he feels that happiness is his indisputable right.
27013.name: Helen Keller

27014.quote: Never make friends with people who are above or below you in status. Such friendships will never give you any happiness.
27014.name: Chanakya

27015.quote: Since you get more joy out of giving joy to others, you should put a good deal of thought into the happiness that you are able to give.
27015.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

27016.quote: God will prepare everything for our perfect happiness in heaven, and if it takes my dog being there, I believe he'll be there.
27016.name: Billy Graham

27017.quote: Marriage is the most natural state of man, and, the state in which you will find solid happiness.
27017.name: Benjamin Franklin

27018.quote: It is a curious sensation: the sort of pain that goes mercifully beyond our powers of feeling. When your heart is broken, your boats are burned: nothing matters any more. It is the end of happiness and the beginning of peace.
27018.name: George Bernard Shaw

27019.quote: Choose your life's mate carefully. From this one decision will come 90 percent of all your happiness or misery.
27019.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

27020.quote: Are you bored with life? Then throw yourself into some work you believe in with all your heart, live for it, die for it, and you will find happiness that you had thought could never be yours.
27020.name: Dale Carnegie

27021.quote: They must often change, who would be constant in happiness or wisdom.
27021.name: Confucius

27022.quote: We find delight in the beauty and happiness of children that makes the heart too big for the body.
27022.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

27023.quote: Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
27023.name: Joseph Addison

27024.quote: Politicians also have no leisure, because they are always aiming at something beyond political life itself, power and glory, or happiness.
27024.name: Aristotle

27025.quote: Different men seek after happiness in different ways and by different means, and so make for themselves different modes of life and forms of government.
27025.name: Aristotle

27026.quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
27026.name: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

27027.quote: A mother's happiness is like a beacon, lighting up the future but reflected also on the past in the guise of fond memories.
27027.name: Honore de Balzac

27028.quote: There is no value in life except what you choose to place upon it and no happiness in any place except what you bring to it yourself.
27028.name: Henry David Thoreau

27029.quote: The man who makes everything that leads to happiness depends upon himself, and not upon other men, has adopted the very best plan for living happily. This is the man of moderation, the man of manly character and of wisdom.
27029.name: Plato

27030.quote: The only thing that could spoil a day was people. People were always the limiters of happiness except for the very few that were as good as spring itself.
27030.name: Ernest Hemingway

27031.quote: Money won't buy happiness, but it will pay the salaries of a large research staff to study the problem.
27031.name: Bill Vaughan

27032.quote: To find out what one is fitted to do, and to secure an opportunity to do it, is the key to happiness.
27032.name: John Dewey

27033.quote: Success is not the key to happiness. Happiness is the key to success. If you love what you are doing, you will be successful.
27033.name: Albert Schweitzer

27034.quote: Happiness is neither virtue nor pleasure nor this thing nor that but simply growth, We are happy when we are growing.
27034.name: William Butler Yeats

27035.quote: The smallest seed of faith is better than the largest fruit of happiness.
27035.name: Henry David Thoreau

27036.quote: Happiness does not come from doing easy work but from the afterglow of satisfaction that comes after the achievement of a difficult task that demanded our best.
27036.name: Theodore Isaac Rubin

27037.quote: I would maintain that thanks are the highest form of thought, and that gratitude is happiness doubled by wonder.
27037.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

27039.quote: Happiness lies in the joy of achievement and the thrill of creative effort.
27039.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt

27040.quote: We have no more right to consume happiness without producing it than to consume wealth without producing it.
27040.name: George Bernard Shaw

27041.quote: Never permit a dichotomy to rule your life, a dichotomy in which you hate what you do so you can have pleasure in your spare time. Look for a situation in which your work will give you as much happiness as your spare time.
27041.name: Pablo Picasso

27042.quote: I start to think there really is no cure for depression, that happiness is an ongoing battle, and I wonder if it isn't one I'll have to fight for as long as I live. I wonder if it's worth it.
27042.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

27043.quote: Happiness can exist only in acceptance.
27043.name: George Orwell

27044.quote: People take different roads seeking fulfillment and happiness. Just because they're not on your road doesn't mean they've gotten lost.
27044.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

27045.quote: Remember happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have it depends solely on what you think.
27045.name: Dale Carnegie

27046.quote: There is no austerity equal to a balanced mind, and there is no happiness equal to contentment there is no disease like covetousness, and no virtue like mercy.
27046.name: Chanakya

27047.quote: There is nothing I fear more than waking up without a program that will help me bring a little happiness to those with no resources, those who are poor, illiterate, and ridden with terminal disease.
27047.name: Nelson Mandela

27048.quote: The happiness of this life depends less on what befalls you than the way in which you take it.
27048.name: Elbert Hubbard

27049.quote: A man who as a physical being is always turned toward the outside, thinking that his happiness lies outside him, finally turns inward and discovers that the source is within him.
27049.name: Soren Kierkegaard

27050.quote: The world is full of a lot of fear and a lot of negativity, and a lot of judgment. I just think people need to start shifting into joy and happiness. As corny as it sounds, we need to make a shift.
27050.name: Ellen DeGeneres

27051.quote: There is joy in work. There is no happiness except in the realization that we have accomplished something.
27051.name: Henry Ford

27052.quote: Be more dedicated to making solid achievements than in running after swift but synthetic happiness.
27052.name: Abdul Kalam

27053.quote: Life is essentially a cheat and its conditions are those of defeat the redeeming things are not happiness and pleasure but the deeper satisfactions that come out of struggle.
27053.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

27054.quote: Part of the happiness of life consists not in fighting battles, but in avoiding them. A masterly retreat is in itself a victory.
27054.name: Norman Vincent Peale

27055.quote: The word 'happiness' would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
27055.name: Carl Jung

27056.quote: No one is in control of your happiness but you therefore, you have the power to change anything about yourself or your life that you want to change.
27056.name: Barbara de Angelis

27057.quote: Our object in the construction of the state is the greatest happiness of the whole, and not that of any one class.
27057.name: Plato

27058.quote: Success is getting what you want. Happiness is liking what you get.
27058.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

27059.quote: Success in its highest and noblest form calls for peace of mind and enjoyment and happiness which come only to the man who has found the work that he likes best.
27059.name: Napoleon Hill

27060.quote: Of course, to have money is just great because you can do what you think is important to you. I always was a rich person because money's not related to happiness.
27060.name: Paulo Coelho

27061.quote: Happiness is a butterfly, which when pursued, is always just beyond your grasp, but which, if you will sit down quietly, may alight upon you.
27061.name: Nathaniel Hawthorne

27062.quote: Wealth, like happiness, is never attained when sought after directly. It comes as a by-product of providing a useful service.
27062.name: Henry Ford

27063.quote: We all want to help one another. Human beings are like that. We want to live by each other's happiness, not by each other's misery.
27063.name: Charlie Chaplin

27064.quote: Love is the master key that opens the gates of happiness.
27064.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

27065.quote: The happiness of society is the end of government.
27065.name: John Adams

27066.quote: The happiness and peace attained by those satisfied by the nectar of spiritual tranquillity is not attained by greedy persons restlessly moving here and there.
27066.name: Chanakya

27067.quote: Happiness is a ball after which we run wherever it rolls, and we push it with our feet when it stops.
27067.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

27068.quote: A really great talent finds its happiness in execution.
27068.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

27069.quote: All you need for happiness is a good gun, a good horse, and a good wife.
27069.name: Daniel Boone

27070.quote: It is necessary to the happiness of man that he be mentally faithful to himself. Infidelity does not consist in believing, or in disbelieving, it consists in professing to believe what he does not believe.
27070.name: Thomas Paine

27071.quote: The person who seeks all their applause from outside has their happiness in another's keeping .
27071.name: Dale Carnegie

27072.quote: The secret of happiness is this: let your interests be as wide as possible, and let your reactions to the things and persons that interest you be as far as possible friendly rather than hostile.
27072.name: Bertrand Russell

27073.quote: The greatest happiness is to know the source of unhappiness.
27073.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky

27074.quote: The secret to happiness is to face the fact that the world is horrible.
27074.name: Bertrand Russell

27075.quote: The art of being happy lies in the power of extracting happiness from common things.
27075.name: Henry Ward Beecher

27076.quote: Action may not bring happiness but there is no happiness without action.
27076.name: William James

27077.quote: The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved loved for ourselves, or rather in spite of ourselves.
27077.name: Victor Hugo

27078.quote: God isn't compatible with machinery and scientific medicine and universal happiness. You must make your choice. Our civilization has chosen machinery and medicine and happiness.
27078.name: Aldous Huxley

27079.quote: The only way to find true happiness is to risk being completely cut open.
27079.name: Chuck Palahniuk

27080.quote: There is no greater sorrow than to recall happiness in times of misery.
27080.name: Dante Alighieri

27081.quote: The essence of philosophy is that a man should so live that his happiness shall depend as little as possible on external things.
27081.name: Epictetus

27082.quote: Happiness is beneficial for the body, but it is grief that develops the powers of the mind.
27082.name: Marcel Proust

27083.quote: Money is human happiness in the abstract he, then, who is no longer capable of enjoying human happiness in the concrete devotes himself utterly to money.
27083.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

27084.quote: One of the first conditions of happiness is that the link between Man and Nature shall not be broken.
27084.name: Leo Tolstoy

27085.quote: For the poison of hatred seated near the heart doubles the burden for the one who suffers the disease he is burdened with his own sorrow, and groans on seeing another's happiness.
27085.name: Aeschylus

27086.quote: Happiness? A good cigar, a good meal, a good cigar and a good woman - or a bad woman it depends on how much happiness you can handle.
27086.name: George Burns

27087.quote: I've made an odd discovery. Every time I talk to a savant I feel quite sure that happiness is no longer a possibility. Yet when I talk with my gardener, I'm convinced of the opposite.
27087.name: Bertrand Russell

27088.quote: Contempt for happiness is usually contempt for other people's happiness, and is an elegant disguise for hatred of the human race.
27088.name: Bertrand Russell

27089.quote: It is not in the pursuit of happiness that we find fulfillment, it is in the happiness of pursuit.
27089.name: Denis Waitley

27090.quote: A wise woman recognizes when her life is out of balance and summons the courage to act to correct it, she knows the meaning of true generosity, happiness is the reward for a life lived in harmony, with a courage and grace.
27090.name: Suze Orman

27091.quote: What we call happiness in the strictest sense comes from the (preferably sudden) satisfaction of needs which have been dammed up to a high degree.
27091.name: Sigmund Freud

27092.quote: If there were in the world today any large number of people who desired their own happiness more than they desired the unhappiness of others, we could have a paradise in a few years.
27092.name: Bertrand Russell

27093.quote: Live by this credo: have a little laugh at life and look around you for happiness instead of sadness. Laughter has always brought me out of unhappy situations.
27093.name: Red Skelton

27094.quote: Doing nothing is happiness for children and misery for old men.
27094.name: Victor Hugo

27095.quote: A smile is happiness you'll find right under your nose.
27095.name: Tom Wilson

27096.quote: The first requisite for the happiness of the people is the abolition of religion.
27096.name: Karl Marx

27097.quote: Life's greatest happiness is to be convinced we are loved.
27097.name: Victor Hugo

27098.quote: Happiness is a hard master, particularly other people's happiness.
27098.name: Aldous Huxley

27099.quote: I do believe that if you haven't learnt about sadness, you cannot appreciate happiness.
27099.name: Nana Mouskouri

27100.quote: Where fear is, happiness is not.
27100.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

27101.quote: Friendship improves happiness and abates misery, by the doubling of our joy and the dividing of our grief.
27101.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

27102.quote: To be perfectly happy it does not suffice to possess happiness, it is necessary to have deserved it.
27102.name: Victor Hugo

27103.quote: How to gain, how to keep, how to recover happiness is in fact for most men at all times the secret motive of all they do, and of all they are willing to endure.
27103.name: William James

27104.quote: Procrastination is one of the most common and deadliest of diseases and its toll on success and happiness is heavy.
27104.name: Wayne Gretzky

27105.quote: If all our happiness is bound up entirely in our personal circumstances it is difficult not to demand of life more than it has to give.
27105.name: Bertrand Russell

27106.quote: Morality is not the doctrine of how we may make ourselves happy, but how we may make ourselves worthy of happiness.
27106.name: Immanuel Kant

27107.quote: One test of the correctness of educational procedure is the happiness of the child.
27107.name: Maria Montessori

27108.quote: Men can only be happy when they do not assume that the object of life is happiness.
27108.name: George Orwell

27109.quote: Just as a cautious businessman avoids investing all his capital in one concern, so wisdom would probably admonish us also not to anticipate all our happiness from one quarter alone.
27109.name: Sigmund Freud

27110.quote: Of all forms of caution, caution in love is perhaps the most fatal to true happiness.
27110.name: Bertrand Russell

27111.quote: Wisdom allows nothing to be good that will not be so forever no man to be happy but he that needs no other happiness than what he has within himself no man to be great or powerful that is not master of himself.
27111.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

27112.quote: Now and then it's good to pause in our pursuit of happiness and just be happy.
27112.name: Guillaume Apollinaire

27113.quote: Happiness is the reward we get for living to the highest right we know.
27113.name: Richard Bach

27114.quote: My happiness grows in direct proportion to my acceptance, and in inverse proportion to my expectations.
27114.name: Michael J. Fox

27115.quote: Beauty is the promise of happiness.
27115.name: Edmund Burke

27116.quote: Happiness is not a reward - it is a consequence. Suffering is not a punishment - it is a result.
27116.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

27118.quote: If virtue promises happiness, prosperity and peace, then progress in virtue is progress in each of these for to whatever point the perfection of anything brings us, progress is always an approach toward it.
27118.name: Epictetus

27119.quote: Fun I love, but too much fun is of all things the most loathsome. Mirth is better than fun, and happiness is better than mirth.
27119.name: William Blake

27120.quote: Did perpetual happiness in the Garden of Eden maybe get so boring that eating the apple was justified?
27120.name: Chuck Palahniuk

27121.quote: A man is not rightly conditioned until he is a happy, healthy, and prosperous being and happiness, health, and prosperity are the result of a harmonious adjustment of the inner with the outer of the man with his surroundings.
27121.name: James Allen

27122.quote: He who has so little knowledge of human nature as to seek happiness by changing anything but his own disposition will waste his life in fruitless efforts.
27122.name: Samuel Johnson

27123.quote: Imagination disposes of everything it creates beauty, justice, and happiness, which are everything in this world.
27123.name: Blaise Pascal

27124.quote: Happiness is a byproduct of function, purpose, and conflict those who seek happiness for itself seek victory without war.
27124.name: William S. Burroughs

27125.quote: Resolve not to be poor: whatever you have, spend less. Poverty is a great enemy to human happiness it certainly destroys liberty, and it makes some virtues impracticable, and others extremely difficult.
27125.name: Samuel Johnson

27126.quote: Happiness is a how not a what. A talent, not an object.
27126.name: Hermann Hesse

27127.quote: Happiness is not an ideal of reason, but of imagination.
27127.name: Immanuel Kant

27128.quote: Bride: A woman with a fine prospect of happiness behind her.
27128.name: Ambrose Bierce

27129.quote: Happiness in this world, when it comes, comes incidentally. Make it the object of pursuit, and it leads us a wild-goose chase, and is never attained. Follow some other object, and very possibly we may find that we have caught happiness without dreaming of it.
27129.name: Nathaniel Hawthorne

27130.quote: Happiness is not a brilliant climax to years of grim struggle and anxiety. It is a long succession of little decisions simply to be happy in the moment.
27130.name: J. Donald Walters

27131.quote: It were a real increase of human happiness, could all young men from the age of nineteen be covered under barrels, or rendered otherwise invisible and there left to follow their lawful studies and callings, till they emerged, sadder and wiser, at the age of twenty-five.
27131.name: Thomas Carlyle
