29776.quote: The only way I'd be caught without makeup is if my radio fell in the bathtub while I was taking a bath and electrocuted me and I was in between makeup at home. I hope my husband would slap a little lipstick on me before he took me to the morgue.
29776.name: Dolly Parton

29777.quote: It may be that the satisfaction I need depends on my going away, so that when I've gone and come back, I'll find it at home.
29777.name: Rumi

29778.quote: I believe the home and marriage is the foundation of our society and must be protected.
29778.name: Billy Graham

29779.quote: I suppose I could have stayed home and baked cookies and had teas.
29779.name: Hillary Clinton

29780.quote: There's a tremendous difference between alone and lonely. You could be lonely in a group of people. I like being alone. I like eating by myself. I go home at night and just watch a movie or hang out with my dog. I have to exert myself and really say, oh God, I've got to see my friends 'cause I'm too content being by myself.
29780.name: Drew Barrymore

29781.quote: Of all the home remedies, a good wife is best.
29781.name: Kin Hubbard

29782.quote: To be happy at home is the ultimate result of all ambition, the end to which every enterprise and labor tends, and of which every desire prompts the prosecution.
29782.name: Samuel Johnson

29783.quote: Charity begins at home, and justice begins next door.
29783.name: Charles Dickens

29784.quote: Analogies, it is true, decide nothing, but they can make one feel more at home.
29784.name: Sigmund Freud

29785.quote: Home is a name, a word, it is a strong one stronger than magician ever spoke, or spirit ever answered to, in the strongest conjuration.
29785.name: Charles Dickens

29786.quote: Now, I know there are many Americans who say, 'Get out of Afghanistan. Bring 'em all home.' And there are others who say, 'Put in hundreds of thousands of more.'
29786.name: Hillary Clinton

29787.quote: There are a number of things wrong with Washington. One of them is that everyone is too far from home.
29787.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower

29788.quote: No one realizes how beautiful it is to travel until he comes home and rests his head on his old, familiar pillow.
29788.name: Lin Yutang

29789.quote: But, you know, you can't be a star at home.
29789.name: Jim Carrey

29790.quote: For me, nothing has ever taken precedence over being a mother and having a family and a home.
29790.name: Jessica Lange

29791.quote: I used to work in a funeral home to feel good about myself, just the fact that I was breathing.
29791.name: Chuck Palahniuk

29792.quote: The means of defense against foreign danger historically have become the instruments of tyranny at home.
29792.name: James Madison

29793.quote: As much as I would love to be a person that goes to parties and has a couple of drinks and has a nice time, that doesn't work for me. I'd just rather sit at home and read, or go out to dinner with someone, or talk to someone I love, or talk to somebody that makes me laugh.
29793.name: Daniel Radcliffe

29794.quote: I have Social Disease. I have to go out every night. If I stay home one night I start spreading rumors to my dogs.
29794.name: Andy Warhol

29795.quote: I love cats because I enjoy my home and little by little, they become its visible soul.
29795.name: Jean Cocteau

29796.quote: What power can poverty have over a home where loving hearts are beating with a consciousness of untold riches of the head and heart?
29796.name: Orison Swett Marden

29797.quote: I had a lot of dates but I decided to stay home and dye my eyebrows.
29797.name: Andy Warhol

29798.quote: We cannot defend freedom abroad by deserting it at home.
29798.name: Edward R. Murrow

29799.quote: There's really no point in having children if you're not going to be home enough to father them.
29799.name: Anthony Edwards

29800.quote: When everyone goes home, you're stuck with yourself.
29800.name: Layne Staley

29801.quote: The loss of liberty at home is to be charged to the provisions against danger, real or imagined, from abroad.
29801.name: James Madison

29802.quote: I think the best thing I can do is to be a distraction. A husband lives and breathes his work all day long. If he comes home to more table thumping, how can the poor man ever relax?
29802.name: Jackie Kennedy

29803.quote: I've always looked for the perfect life to step into. I've taken all the paths to get where I wanted.But no matter where I go, I still come home me.
29803.name: Layne Staley

29804.quote: If you want to be certain, you should never get married. You should never change jobs. In fact, you might as well just stay home. Because I don't know anybody who is certain. That need to be certain is just procrastination.
29804.name: Mark Burnett

29805.quote: We are not about to send American boys 9 or 10 thousand miles away from home to do what Asian boys ought to be doing for themselves.
29805.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

29806.quote: I should like to know what is the proper function of women, if it is not to make reasons for husbands to stay at home, and still stronger reasons for bachelors to go out.
29806.name: George Eliot

29807.quote: The way to work with a bully is to take the ball and go home. First time, every time. When there's no ball, there's no game. Bullies hate that. So they'll either behave so they can play with you or they'll go bully someone else.
29807.name: Seth Godin

29808.quote: If your neighbors think you're a detective because a cop always brings you home, you might be a redneck.
29808.name: Jeff Foxworthy

29809.quote: Owning a home is a keystone of wealth - both financial affluence and emotional security.
29809.name: Suze Orman

29810.quote: If they had a social gospel in the days of the prodigal son, somebody would have given him a bed and a sandwich and he never would have gone home.
29810.name: Vance Havner

29811.quote: If I don't feel confident about my body, I'm not going to sit at home and feel sorry for myself and not do something about it. It's all about taking action and not being lazy. So you do the work, whether it's fitness or whatever. It's about getting up, motivating yourself and just doing it.
29811.name: Kim Kardashian

29812.quote: I got a lovely check today from being a writer that I earned by sitting at home. That's rewarding.
29812.name: Harvey Fierstein

29813.quote: If you want to be an entrepreneur, it's not a job, it's a lifestyle. It defines you. Forget about vacations, about going home at 6 pm - last thing at night you'll send emails, first thing in the morning you'll read emails, and you'll wake up in the middle of the night. But it's hugely rewarding as you're fulfilling something for yourself.
29813.name: Niklas Zennstrom

29814.quote: It is a universal truth that the loss of liberty at home is to be charged to the provisions against danger, real or pretended, from abroad.
29814.name: James Madison

29815.quote: A good job is more than just a paycheck. A good job fosters independence and discipline, and contributes to the health of the community. A good job is a means to provide for the health and welfare of your family, to own a home, and save for retirement.
29815.name: James H. Douglas

29816.quote: Basically, I believe the world is a jungle, and if it's not a bit of a jungle in the home, a child cannot possibly be fit to enter the outside world.
29816.name: Bette Davis

29817.quote: I never married because there was no need. I have three pets at home which answer the same purpose as a husband. I have a dog which growls every morning, a parrot which swears all afternoon, and a cat that comes home late at night.
29817.name: Marie Corelli

29818.quote: To me luxury is to be at home with my daughter, and the occasional massage doesn't hurt.
29818.name: Olivia Newton-John

29819.quote: If an ass goes travelling he will not come home a horse.
29819.name: Thomas Fuller

29820.quote: This nation will remain the land of the free only so long as it is the home of the brave.
29820.name: Elmer Davis

29821.quote: Yesterday's home runs don't win today's games.
29821.name: Babe Ruth

29822.quote: The human brain now holds the key to our future. We have to recall the image of the planet from outer space: a single entity in which air, water, and continents are interconnected. That is our home.
29822.name: David Suzuki

29823.quote: Education begins at home and I applaud the parents who recognize that they - not someone else - must take responsibility to assure that their children are well educated.
29823.name: Ernest Istook

29824.quote: Children that are raised in a home with a married mother and father consistently do better in every measure of well-being than their peers who come from divorced or step-parent, single-parent, cohabiting homes.
29824.name: Todd Tiahrt

29825.quote: Reading isn't good for a ballplayer. Not good for his eyes. If my eyes went bad even a little bit I couldn't hit home runs. So I gave up reading.
29825.name: Babe Ruth

29826.quote: I like making things. I have a wood shop at home. I am a terrible carpenter but I love doing it.
29826.name: P. J. O'Rourke

29827.quote: On stage I make love to twenty five thousand people and then I go home alone.
29827.name: Janis Joplin

29828.quote: Every strike brings me closer to the next home run.
29828.name: Babe Ruth

29829.quote: All philosophies, if you ride them home, are nonsense, but some are greater nonsense than others.
29829.name: Samuel Butler

29830.quote: I never learned hate at home, or shame. I had to go to school for that.
29830.name: Dick Gregory

29831.quote: And I come here as a daughter, raised on the South Side of Chicago - by a father who was a blue-collar city worker and a mother who stayed at home with my brother and me.
29831.name: Michelle Obama

29832.quote: Maria is the best reason to come home.
29832.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

29833.quote: Prepare for death, if here at night you roam, and sign your will before you sup from home.
29833.name: Samuel Johnson

29834.quote: When you're safe at home you wish you were having an adventure when you're having an adventure you wish you were safe at home.
29834.name: Thornton Wilder

29835.quote: And when the day arrives I'll become the sky and I'll become the sea and the sea will come to kiss me for I am going home. Nothing can stop me now.
29835.name: Trent Reznor

29836.quote: The tragedy of modern war is that the young men die fighting each other - instead of their real enemies back home in the capitals.
29836.name: Edward Abbey

29837.quote: There are things they tell us that sound good to hear, but when they have accomplished their purpose they will go home and will not try to fulfill our agreements with them.
29837.name: Sitting Bull

29838.quote: For me, already being part of a single parent household and knowing it was just me and my mom, you'd would wake up times and hope that the next day you'd be able to be alongside your mother because she was out trying to make sure that I was taken care of. But all I cared about was her being home.
29838.name: LeBron James

29839.quote: Perhaps it is a universal truth that the loss of liberty at home is to be charged to provisions against danger, real or pretended, from abroad.
29839.name: James Madison

29840.quote: One never reaches home, but wherever friendly paths intersect the whole world looks like home for a time.
29840.name: Hermann Hesse

29841.quote: A smile abroad is often a scowl at home.
29841.name: Alfred Lord Tennyson

29842.quote: A whopping 89 percent of buyers start their home search online. How your house looks online is the modern equivalent of 'curb appeal.' Rent a wide-angle lens and good lighting, get rid of your clutter and post at least eight great photos to win the beauty contest.
29842.name: Barbara Corcoran

29843.quote: Children are not casual guests in our home. They have been loaned to us temporarily for the purpose of loving them and instilling a foundation of values on which their future lives will be built.
29843.name: James Dobson

29844.quote: Things aren't right. If a burglar breaks into your home and you shoot him, he can sue you. For what, restraint of trade?
29844.name: Bill Maher

29845.quote: So I'm more at home with my backpack, sleeping in a hotel room or on a bus or on an airplane, than I am necessarily on a bed. It's weird being here. It feels like I'm standing next to my real life.
29845.name: Henry Rollins

29846.quote: Always there has been some terrible evil at home or some monstrous foreign power that was going to gobble us up if we did not blindly rally behind it.
29846.name: Douglas MacArthur

29847.quote: There are many truths of which the full meaning cannot be realized until personal experience has brought it home.
29847.name: John Stuart Mill

29848.quote: I take my children everywhere, but they always find their way back home.
29848.name: Robert Orben

29849.quote: I can remember being home from school with tonsillitis and writing stories in bed to pass the time.
29849.name: Stephen King

29850.quote: Home computers are being called upon to perform many new functions, including the consumption of homework formerly eaten by the dog.
29850.name: Doug Larson

29851.quote: Television has brought back murder into the home - where it belongs.
29851.name: Alfred Hitchcock

29852.quote: If one more 'journalist' makes a cavalier statement about me and my band, I will personally or with my fans' help, greet them at their home and discover just how much they believe in their freedom of speech.
29852.name: Marilyn Manson

29853.quote: Whether you come back by page or by the big screen, Hogwarts will always be there to welcome you home.
29853.name: J. K. Rowling

29854.quote: I've always thought my soundtracks do pretty good, because they're basically professional equivalents of a mix tape I'd make for you at home.
29854.name: Quentin Tarantino

29855.quote: I don't claim to be knowledgeable about theology. Most of my knowledge comes out of my experience and the lessons in the Bible. Every Sunday I'm home I teach 45 minutes and we boiled them down to one page for the new book, 'Through the Year with Jimmy Carter.'
29855.name: Jimmy Carter

29856.quote: American and Israel share a special bond. Our relationship is unique among all nations. Like America, Israel is a strong democracy, a symbol of freedom, and an oasis of liberty, a home to the oppressed and persecuted.
29856.name: William J. Clinton

29857.quote: The Internet is just bringing all kinds of information into the home. There's just a lot of distraction, a lot of competition for the parent's voice to resonate in the children's ears.
29857.name: Phil McGraw

29858.quote: After I hit a home run I had a habit of running the bases with my head down. I figured the pitcher already felt bad enough without me showing him up rounding the bases.
29858.name: Mickey Mantle

29859.quote: People are surprised at how down-to-earth I am. I like to stay home on Friday nights and listen to 'The Art of Happiness' by the Dalai Lama.
29859.name: Carmen Electra

29860.quote: I came home every Friday afternoon, riding the six miles on the back of a big mule. I spent Saturday and Sunday washing and ironing and cooking for the children and went back to my country school on Sunday afternoon.
29860.name: Ida B. Wells

29861.quote: I was coming home from kindergarten - well they told me it was kindergarten. I found out later I had been working in a factory for ten years. It's good for a kid to know how to make gloves.
29861.name: Ellen DeGeneres

29862.quote: I think about being married again, having a home and a wife. No one can ever be married too many times, and maybe if I keep trying I'll get it right one day.
29862.name: Richard Pryor

29863.quote: Never be the only one, except, possibly, in your own home.
29863.name: Alice Walker

29864.quote: No man can call himself liberal, or radical, or even a conservative advocate of fair play, if his work depends in any way on the unpaid or underpaid labor of women at home, or in the office.
29864.name: Gloria Steinem

29865.quote: I would like to spend the whole of my life traveling, if I could anywhere borrow another life to spend at home.
29865.name: William Hazlitt

29866.quote: There are more than 300,000 families in the Gulf region that lost their homes and are waiting for peace of mind. The hurricane exposed the sad reality of poverty in America. We saw, in all its horrific detail, the vulnerabilities of living in inadequate housing and the heartbreak of losing one's home.
29866.name: Jr. Harry Connick

29867.quote: The perfect date for me would be staying at home, making a big picnic in bed, eating Wotsits and cookies while watching cable TV.
29867.name: Kim Kardashian

29868.quote: He that loves not his wife and children feeds a lioness at home, and broods a nest of sorrows.
29868.name: Jeremy Taylor

29869.quote: We have two dogs, Mabel and Wolf, and three cats at home, Charlie, George and Chairman. We have two cats on our farm, Tom and Little Sister, two horses, and two mini horses, Hannah and Tricky. We also have two cows, Holy and Madonna. And those are only the animals we let sleep in our bed.
29869.name: Ellen DeGeneres

29870.quote: Why should people go out and pay money to see bad films when they can stay at home and see bad television for nothing?
29870.name: Samuel Goldwyn

29871.quote: Those who visit foreign nations, but associate only with their own country-men, change their climate, but not their customs. They see new meridians, but the same men and with heads as empty as their pockets, return home with traveled bodies, but untravelled minds.
29871.name: Charles Caleb Colton

29872.quote: Bad psychoanalysis would say I enjoyed pleasing people, working really hard and pleasing people, which is probably related to my father in some way. But I really liked working hard. When I worked at Disneyland, I'd do 12 hours straight and go home thrilled.
29872.name: Steve Martin

29873.quote: One of the greatest things drama can do, at it's best, is to redefine the words we use every day such as love, home, family, loyalty and envy. Tragedy need not be a downer.
29873.name: Ben Kingsley

29874.quote: When I come home, my daughter will run to the door and give me a big hug, and everything that's happened that day just melts away.
29874.name: Hugh Jackman

29875.quote: I still close my eyes and go home - I can always draw from that.
29875.name: Dolly Parton

29876.quote: My mother never gave up one me. I messed up in school so much they were sending me home, but my mother sent me right back.
29876.name: Denzel Washington

29877.quote: When a criminal breaks into your home I'll let the liberals call the lawyer. I'm going to call Smith &amp Wesson.
29877.name: Rick Perry

29878.quote: I figure that if the children are alive when I get home, I've done my job.
29878.name: Roseanne Barr

29879.quote: Students never think it can be the teacher's fault and so I thought I was stupid. I was frustrated and would come home and cry because I couldn't do it. Then we got a new teacher who made math accessible. That made all the difference and I learned that it's how you present it that makes it scary or friendly.
29879.name: Danica McKellar

29880.quote: The physician can bury his mistakes, but the architect can only advise his client to plant vines - so they should go as far as possible from home to build their first buildings.
29880.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

29881.quote: General Howard informed me, in a haughty spirit, that he would give my people 30 days to go back home, collect all their stock, and move onto the reservation.
29881.name: Chief Joseph

29882.quote: The secret of a successful marriage is not to be at home too much.
29882.name: Colin Chapman

29883.quote: Since I'm always working, my best holiday memories are definitely when I can just go home and spend time with my family.
29883.name: Chris Brown

29884.quote: That is the returning to God which in reality is never concluded on earth but yet leaves behind in the soul a divine home sickness, which never again ceases.
29884.name: Max Muller

29885.quote: There's a continuity between what I care about in any form: I care about it in my music, in article-writing, in how I dress, in how I live, in my relationships, in how I navigate paparazzi, how I decorate my home. There's such a continuity between everything that I don't really care what form it shows up in.
29885.name: Alanis Morissette

29886.quote: I love you - I am at rest with you - I have come home.
29886.name: Dorothy L. Sayers

29887.quote: Childhood obesity is best tackled at home through improved parental involvement, increased physical exercise, better diet and restraint from eating.
29887.name: Bob Filner

29888.quote: England is my home. London is my home. New York feels like, if I have to spend a year living in an unfamiliar city, this is a pretty lovely one to spend a year in, but I will be going home at the end of it, certainly.
29888.name: Daniel Radcliffe

29889.quote: Think you're escaping and run into yourself. Longest way round is the shortest way home.
29889.name: James Joyce

29890.quote: The average husband enjoys the total effect of his home but is usually unable to contribute any of the details of work and organisation that make it enjoyable.
29890.name: Havelock Ellis

29891.quote: If you reject the food, ignore the customs, fear the religion and avoid the people, you might better stay at home.
29891.name: James A. Michener

29892.quote: I think when the full horror of being fifty hits you, you should stay home and have a good cry.
29892.name: Josh Billings

29893.quote: Caesar might have married Cleopatra, but he had a wife at home. There's always something.
29893.name: Will Cuppy

29894.quote: Here's kind of my motto - if you're not happy at home, you're not happy anywhere else.
29894.name: Angie Harmon

29895.quote: Don't you stay at home of evenings? Don't you love a cushioned seat in a corner, by the fireside, with your slippers on your feet?
29895.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

29896.quote: Better do a good deed near at home than go far away to burn incense.
29896.name: Amelia Earhart

29897.quote: One small cat changes coming home to an empty house to coming home.
29897.name: Pam Brown

29898.quote: Here's how I think of my money - as soldiers - I send them out to war everyday. I want them to take prisoners and come home, so there's more of them.
29898.name: Kevin O'Leary

29899.quote: Yes, I've kissed a lot of guys. I like to kiss, but that's it. I don't go home with anyone. I sleep with my animals, like my baby monkey, Brigitte Bardot.
29899.name: Paris Hilton

29900.quote: I had only one superstition. I made sure to touch all the bases when I hit a home run.
29900.name: Babe Ruth

29901.quote: By the time you get dressed, drive out there, play 18 holes and come home, you've blown seven hours. There are better things you can do with your time.
29901.name: Richard M. Nixon

29902.quote: To be an ideal guest, stay at home.
29902.name: E. W. Howe

29903.quote: Why would I retire? Sit at home and watch TV? No thanks. I'd rather be out playing.
29903.name: Paul McCartney

29904.quote: The words that a father speaks to his children in the privacy of home are not heard by the world, but, as in whispering galleries, they are clearly heard at the end, and by posterity.
29904.name: Jean Paul

29905.quote: Since the departure of good old-fashioned entertainers the re-emergence of somebody who wants to be an entertainer has unfortunately become a synonym for camp. I don't think I'm camper than any other person who felt at home on stage, and felt more at home on stage than he did offstage.
29905.name: David Bowie

29906.quote: Christmas is, of course, the time to be home - in heart as well as body.
29906.name: Garry Moore

29907.quote: Those men are most apt to be obsequious and conciliating abroad, who are under the discipline of shrews at home.
29907.name: Washington Irving

29908.quote: Think about the comfortable feeling you have as you open your front door. That's but a hint of what we'll feel some day on arriving at the place our Father has lovingly and personally prepared for us in heaven. We will finally - and permanently - be 'at home' in a way that defies description.
29908.name: Charles Stanley

29909.quote: I was making a lot of 8mm home movies, since I was twelve, making little dramas and comedies with the neighborhood kids.
29909.name: Steven Spielberg

29910.quote: Teach love, generosity, good manners and some of that will drift from the classroom to the home and who knows, the children will be educating the parents.
29910.name: Roger Moore

29911.quote: It's not like I'm this glamour diva who hands everything over and I just sit on my throne at home.
29911.name: Heidi Klum

29912.quote: To be honest, when I'm home, every day is a Friday for me. It doesn't really matter what day it is for me. A lot of my friends actually have time off during the week, and so it doesn't prohibit me from enjoying myself when I am home on a Monday or a Tuesday.
29912.name: Danica Patrick

29913.quote: The most influential of all educational factors is the conversation in a child's home.
29913.name: William Temple

29914.quote: Nature is the mother and the habitat of man, even if sometimes a stepmother and an unfriendly home.
29914.name: John Dewey

29915.quote: A man travels the world in search of what he needs and returns home to find it.
29915.name: George Edward Moore

29916.quote: I report to you that our country is challenged at home and abroad: that it is our will that is being tried and not our strength our sense of purpose and not our ability to achieve a better America.
29916.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

29917.quote: The war is dreadful. It is the business of the artist to follow it home to the heart of the individual fighters - not to talk in armies and nations and numbers - but to track it home.
29917.name: David Herbert Lawrence

29918.quote: I missed my home - like the physicality of my home, I missed my friends and my family mostly and just hanging out and being in your home country - culturally it feels right and that is what I miss.
29918.name: Orlando Bloom

29919.quote: Where there is a mother in the home, matters go well.
29919.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

29920.quote: To Adam Paradise was home. To the good among his descendants home is paradise.
29920.name: Augustus Hare

29921.quote: And when I was young, my family was perfectly nice. I write a lot about it, as you noticed. But it was rather limited. I think, I don't think anyone in my family would really feel I'd done them an injustice by saying that. We didn't see many people. There were many books. It was as if I wanted to get away from home.
29921.name: Christopher Hitchens

29922.quote: The penalty for getting mugged in an American city and losing your ID is that you can't fly home.
29922.name: Christopher Hitchens

29923.quote: In high school, a teacher once suggested that I be a math major in college. I thought, 'Me? You've got to be joking!' I mean, in junior high, I used to come home and cry because I was so afraid of my math homework. Seriously, I was terrified of math.
29923.name: Danica McKellar

29924.quote: It takes a lot of work to put together a marriage, to put together a family and a home.
29924.name: Elizabeth Edwards

29925.quote: I much prefer working with kids whose life could be completely upended by a reading of a book over a weekend. You give them a book to read - they go home and come back a changed person. And that is so much more interesting and exciting.
29925.name: Russell Banks

29926.quote: How much a dunce that has been sent to roam, excels a dunce that has been kept at home.
29926.name: William Cowper

29927.quote: Let architects sing of aesthetics that bring Rich clients in hordes to their knees Just give me a home, in a great circle dome Where stresses and strains are at ease.
29927.name: R. Buckminster Fuller

29928.quote: At every party there are two kinds of people - those who want to go home and those who don't. The trouble is, they are usually married to each other.
29928.name: Ann Landers

29929.quote: We live in grief for having left the womb, for having left the teat, then school, then home. In my case, it was leaving marriages, and the death of my wife.
29929.name: William Shatner

29930.quote: Marrying a man is like buying something you've been admiring for a long time in a shop window. You may love it when you get it home, but it doesn't always go with everything else in the house.
29930.name: Jean Kerr

29931.quote: Racism is taught in the home. We agree on that? Well, it's very hard to teach racism to a teenager who's listening to rap music and who idolizes, say, Snoop Dogg. It's hard to say, 'That guy is less than you.' The kid is like, 'I like that guy, he's cool. How is he less than me?
29931.name: Jay-Z

29932.quote: Some men like a dull life - they like the routine of eating breakfast, going to work, coming home, petting the dog, watching TV, kissing the kids, and going to bed. Stay clear of it - it's often catching.
29932.name: Hedy Lamarr

29933.quote: I learn something not because I have to, but because I really want to. That's the same view I have for performing. I'm performing because I really want to, not because I have to bring bread back home.
29933.name: Yo-Yo Ma

29934.quote: I'm the type of woman you might say is too good. I'll massage a man's feet, have dinner cooked when he gets home. But once they leave, the door is closed, and the locks are changed.
29934.name: Angie Stone

30248.quote: Education was the most important value in our home when I was growing up. People don't always realize that my parents shared a sense of intellectual curiosity and a love of reading and of history.
30248.name: Caroline Kennedy

30249.quote: But I do believe that a woman's truest place is in a home, with a husband and with children, and with large freedom, pecuniary freedom, personal freedom, and the right to vote.
30249.name: Lucy Stone

30250.quote: My wife and I had decided not to let anybody take pictures of our home because it was just the last place on earth we had that was unscathed. But people have climbed over the fence they've taken aerial shots. They've gotten my address and put it on the Internet.
30250.name: Steven Tyler

30251.quote: I love being home at Christmastime.
30251.name: Ashley Tisdale

30252.quote: I feel like I'm working on an oil rig right now. I'm away from home a lot.
30252.name: Hugh Laurie

30253.quote: Most of American life consists of driving somewhere and then returning home, wondering why the hell you went.
30253.name: John Updike

30254.quote: I'm a home cook and love to read about food, but I'm not trained as a chef. I'm just really into cooking and passionate about it.
30254.name: Ted Allen

30255.quote: Being from Africa is the best thing that could have ever, ever happened to me. I cannot see it any other way. All of my fundamental principles that were instilled in me in my home, from my childhood, are still with me.
30255.name: Hakeem Olajuwon

30256.quote: I've seen the greatest actors in the world, transcendent talents, who can't find a home.
30256.name: Laura Linney

30257.quote: Once I am in the square circle, I am in my home.
30257.name: Jr. Floyd Mayweather

30258.quote: And, you know, being able to wear the stars and stripes, when you step up on one of the blocks or, you know, when you step off of an airplane or when you hear the national anthem play, you know, it's one of the greatest feelings in the world because you know that there are people at home who are supporting you and watching you.
30258.name: Michael Phelps

30259.quote: The people recognize themselves in their commodities they find their soul in their automobile, hi-fi set, split-level home, kitchen equipment.
30259.name: Herbert Marcuse

30260.quote: The only instrument I can play is piano. Whenever I make songs at home, I play the piano and make them on the piano.
30260.name: Yoko Ono

30261.quote: We have to judge politicians by their cumulative score. In one innings they make a great catch, in another they drop the ball. In one they score a home run, in another they strike out. But it is their cumulative batting average that we are interested in.
30261.name: Jesse Jackson

30262.quote: In Afghanistan, there is a plan to build democracy hundreds of thousands of troops are protecting it. There is a plan to rebuild and reconstruct there. But many thousands of Americans die from violence and poverty every year and we don't have a plan for reconstruction at home.
30262.name: Jesse Jackson

30263.quote: I grew up in a house where my father encouraged my brother and me to fail. I specifically remember coming home and saying, 'Dad, Dad, I tried out for this or that and I was horrible,' and he would high-five me and say, 'Way to go.'
30263.name: Sara Blakely

30264.quote: My humanitarian work evolved from being with my family. My mom, my dad, they really set a great example for giving back. My mom was a nurse, my dad was a school teacher. But my mom did a lot of things for geriatrics and elderly people. She would do home visits for free.
30264.name: Cat Cora

30265.quote: And I think what people in New Jersey have gotten to know about me over the last decade that I've been in public life is what you see is what you get. And I'm no different when I'm sitting with you than I am when I'm at home or anyplace else.
30265.name: Chris Christie

30266.quote: But as far as Twitter, I'll be in a restaurant and I'll get home and somebody tweeted and they talked about what I ordered and what I was wearing. In some cases, that could be dangerous, because you don't want everybody to know where you are every second of every day.
30266.name: Carrie Underwood

30267.quote: I'm a private person too, and we don't ever film anything in our home because it's off limits. It's like letting people see your messy house.
30267.name: Carrie Underwood

30268.quote: If you're not a competitor, you've just got to go home.
30268.name: Venus Williams

30269.quote: Not much shocked me. You know, I worked in a home for Alzheimer's patients and my dad used to be really into murders and stuff, so I saw dead bodies. It desensitised me to a lot of things.
30269.name: Ellie Goulding

30270.quote: I love prints of skulls and bones and have some taxidermy - a crow and a rabbit - to remind me of home. I like art and have a big portrait of Bjork.
30270.name: Ellie Goulding

30271.quote: I never remember having a plan. All I could think about was how I was going to afford to get into college or where I was going to stay because I hated being at home. I didn't really have time to think about anything in the future. I didn't think about a career or anything. I went to uni, got a couple of jobs, so I sort of funded it myself.
30271.name: Ellie Goulding

30272.quote: When I stepped out into the bright sunlight from the darkness of the movie house, I had only two things on my mind: Paul Newman and a ride home.
30272.name: S. E. Hinton

30273.quote: The bullied straight kid goes home to a shoulder to cry on and support and can talk freely about his experience at school and why he's being bullied. I couldn't go home and open up to my parents.
30273.name: Dan Savage

30274.quote: When I met my husband, I refused to invite him home for Passover because I was embarrassed my mother might serve all the catered dishes in the wrong order.
30274.name: Erica Jong

30275.quote: You make movies for the people. If critics happen to like them too, well, that's a home run.
30275.name: Vin Diesel

30276.quote: Women are oppressed in the east, in the west, in the south, in the north. Women are oppressed inside, outside home, a woman is oppressed in religion, she is oppressed outside religion.
30276.name: Taslima Nasrin

30277.quote: A man's home may seem to be his castle on the outside inside is more often his nursery.
30277.name: Clare Boothe Luce

30278.quote: I can't drag myself away from 'Final Cut Pro.' It is a digital video editing system. I am obsessed with it, but I am always away from home, and I can't use it.
30278.name: Margaret Cho

30279.quote: When I do get free time, I spend a lot of it at home with my family and my close friends and I think that's what keeps me happy, healthy, grounded, and totally in check.
30279.name: Leighton Meester

30280.quote: I can write pretty much anywhere if you give me time and some quiet. The home is not usually the best place because I have four children. It's usually pandemonium around here!
30280.name: Harlan Coben

30281.quote: Baseball is like driving, it's the one who gets home safely that counts.
30281.name: Tommy Lasorda

30282.quote: Anyone that has a job that takes them away from home, I think, can understand the difficulties in maintaining consistency, not only with your family and those you love but with your friends.
30282.name: Heath Ledger

30283.quote: I often feel very guilty because of the time that I spend outside of my home and the little time that sometimes I have for my kids.
30283.name: Antonio Banderas

30284.quote: I have a fantastic studio in my home, and it's my biggest toy. I have about a half a million dollars worth of musical equipment in my house.
30284.name: Antonio Banderas

30285.quote: I had known Cole Porter in Hollywood and New York, spent many a warm hour at his home, and met the talented and original people who were drawn to him.
30285.name: Gene Tierney

30286.quote: I have a three-year-old and a four-year-old at home, and my mornings are about just dealing with the fact of that. I oddly enjoy it.
30286.name: Damian Lewis

30287.quote: I have a five year-old son and a three year-old daughter. I want my son to have a choice to contribute fully in the workforce or at home. And I want my daughter to have the choice to not just succeed, but to be liked for her accomplishments.
30287.name: Sheryl Sandberg

30288.quote: I was taught a lot of Bible at home and had a voracious appetite for reading the Bible.
30288.name: Amy Grant

30289.quote: Dreams are where we visit the many lands and landscapes of human possibility and discover the one where we feel at home. The great religious leaders were all dreamers.
30289.name: Jonathan Sacks

30290.quote: We need to rediscover the idea of the common good and work together to build a home.
30290.name: Jonathan Sacks

30291.quote: The message of Passover remains as powerful as ever. Freedom is won not on the battlefield but in the classroom and the home. Teach your children the history of freedom if you want them never to lose it.
30291.name: Jonathan Sacks

30292.quote: If you live in a good neighborhood, you drive home and there's a bank. There's grocery stores and big houses - but no motels. What that tells you psychologically is you protect your money and buy good things for your family to eat in your nice big house.
30292.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

30293.quote: When I was 14, I felt very rundown I had a home to go to, but I felt like I was 60 or something, older than I feel now. And I don't know if it's something that happens at 14, or whether it was adolescence or whether I was gay, or closeted gay, or whatever it was, I felt that.
30293.name: Gus Van Sant

30294.quote: I think it can be hard for any man to sometimes be upstaged by his wife. So when I'm home, I work very hard to be Todd's wife and Jade's mother. I have no problem going back to those traditional roles. I try to be Giada, the young girl that he met 20 years ago and fell in love with.
30294.name: Giada De Laurentiis

30295.quote: At home, you always have to be a politician when you're abroad, you almost feel yourself a statesman.
30295.name: Harold MacMillan

30296.quote: My husband had a very strong identity and was successful in his life. Thank God for that. There's no way I can control him. I wouldn't stay married to him if I felt I could. I can readily take my business personality into the home. But he forces me to be a partner rather than the boss.
30296.name: Barbara Corcoran

30297.quote: If you've gone into a marriage and you haven't been clear about how you're going to handle money, how you want to raise kids, who is going to work or stay home or what have you, then you've set yourself up for failure.
30297.name: Phil McGraw

30298.quote: So long as I can stay mentally alert - inquiring, curious - I want to keep going. I love my wife and my children, but I don't want to sit around at home with them. We go on safaris and things like that. I can do that for a couple of weeks a year. I'm just not ready to stop, to die.
30298.name: Rupert Murdoch

30299.quote: Everybody at home speaks mandarin except me.
30299.name: Rupert Murdoch

30300.quote: The wonderful world of home appliances now makes it possible to cook indoors with charcoal and outdoors with gas.
30300.name: Bill Vaughan

30301.quote: It is often easier to become outraged by injustice half a world away than by oppression and discrimination half a block from home.
30301.name: Carl T. Rowan

30302.quote: I've been a very lucky guy. I played on championship teams. I played for Canada. I've won some awards and I'm very proud of those accomplishments. But I don't think there's anything greater than to come home and to be recognized at home. This is the pinnacle.
30302.name: Bobby Orr

30303.quote: Don't get me wrong - I've gone to a club. But I'd much rather be with my close friends at home or a concert, or on a trip. I'll go dancing with my grandma. She likes to cut a rug!
30303.name: Zac Efron

30304.quote: By measuring the proportion of children living with the same parents from birth and whether their parents report a good quality relationship we are driving home the message that social programmes should promote family stability and avert breakdown.
30304.name: Iain Duncan Smith

30305.quote: There are 80 million moms in the United States. Forty million stay at home with their children.
30305.name: Andrew Shue

30306.quote: I was lucky. My family is wonderful. And it's funny, because most of my best friends come from very large families. So it always felt as if I had lots of siblings, though in the end I had to leave them and go home. I kind of got the best of both worlds as a kid.
30306.name: Sophia Bush

30307.quote: I'm lucky that my real-life Mom has both a great sense of humor about herself and an amazing ability to slip into complete denial if the subject matter gets a little too close to home.
30307.name: Cathy Guisewite

30308.quote: When I'm at home in Virginia, I become more hermit-like. I like my own home.
30308.name: Robert Duvall

30309.quote: It's like kids playing house: 'You play the father, I'll play the mother.' You know, you dress up, you play, they pay, you go home. It's a game - acting's a game.
30309.name: Robert Duvall

30310.quote: I've always taken my love of children from my father. He was a children magnet. Suddenly, having my first child hit home what my dad went through.
30310.name: Robert Carlyle

30311.quote: There's definitely space for uniqueness in a home console.
30311.name: Shigeru Miyamoto

30312.quote: A good wife is someone who thinks she has done everything right: raising the kids, being there for the husband, being home, trying to do it all.
30312.name: Julianna Margulies

30313.quote: David Lee Roth had the idea that if you covered a successful song, you were half way home. C'mon - Van Halen doing 'Dancing in the Streets'? It was stupid. I started feeling like I would rather bomb playing my own songs than be successful playing someone else's music.
30313.name: Eddie Van Halen

30314.quote: When I'm home on a break, I lock myself in my room and play guitar. After two or three hours, I start getting into this total meditation. It's a feeling few people experience, and that's usually when I come up with weird stuff. It just flows. I can't force myself. I don't sit down and say I've got to practice.
30314.name: Eddie Van Halen

30315.quote: The juvenile sea squirt wanders through the sea searching for a suitable rock or hunk of coral to cling to and make its home for life. For this task, it has a rudimentary nervous system. When it finds its spot and takes root, it doesn't need its brain anymore so it eats it!
30315.name: Daniel Dennett

30316.quote: I have always drawn strength from being close to home.
30316.name: Arthur Ashe

30317.quote: The show doesn't drive home a lesson, but it can open up people's minds enough for them to see how stupid every kind of prejudice can be.
30317.name: Redd Foxx

30318.quote: My idea of heaven used to be relaxing at home with a cheese plate and champagne.
30318.name: Lea Michele

30319.quote: And it took me, since I was 17 and left home, running from God, to now, as a 30-year-old man, when I honestly feel like I've come full circle and my heart's finally in the right place.
30319.name: Scott Stapp

30320.quote: I hit the ground running, without a lot of training, so I had to do whatever I could do to survive as a professional, and if that meant being that character 24/7 and acting out, I was going to do that. I lived those characters, I brought them home with me.
30320.name: Nicolas Cage

30321.quote: I bought a Yamaha-1 and I was doing 180 miles per hour home on the 405 and that's really, really crazy but I did it.
30321.name: Nicolas Cage

30322.quote: The thing I like about baseball is that it's one-on-one. You stand up there alone, and if you make a mistake, it's your mistake. If you hit a home run, it's your home run.
30322.name: Hank Aaron

30323.quote: Just as the police review their operational tactics, so we in the Home Office will review the powers available to the police.
30323.name: Theresa May

30324.quote: Hit a home run - put your head down, drop the bat, run around the bases, because the name on the front is more - a lot more important than the name on the back.
30324.name: Ryne Sandberg

30325.quote: No, I can tell you one of the first things that happens to a home secretary when they arrive in the job is that they are given a briefing about the security matters that they will be dealing with and I deal with security matters on a daily basis.
30325.name: Theresa May

30326.quote: Believe me, you can get into a lot of trouble being sixteen years old in a foreign country with no adult telling you when to come home.
30326.name: Cameron Diaz

30327.quote: I made a choice to stay home and raise five boys. Believe me, it was hard work.
30327.name: Ann Romney

30328.quote: I have lived in Mumbai for more than 20 years, have my domicile here, my home and family here.
30328.name: Shahrukh Khan

30329.quote: I'm lucky. The best possible place in the world for training is Addis Ababa, so I am home all the time except when I am racing. I like to be there, near my family, my kids, also the real estate business I run with my wife.
30329.name: Haile Gebrselassie

30330.quote: When I make a film I'm away from home for two to three months. So I want my kids to look at my films one day and say, I love his movies, I love his choices-because he loved them.
30330.name: Kevin Costner

30331.quote: How we are using up our home, how we are living and polluting the planet is frightening. It was evident when I was a child. It's more evident now.
30331.name: Maya Lin

30332.quote: I would drive home and see people wearing my No. 34 jersey and wonder why, because I didn't feel worthy of that. And all the time I just knew people were staring at me, talking about me everywhere I went.
30332.name: Ricky Williams

30333.quote: I'm kind of a dork. I don't have much game. I'm not particularly comfortable in bars or clubs. I much prefer being home playing Scrabble, having dinner with a couple friends, going to see a movie, or losing a whole weekend to Season 14 of Law and Order or The Simpsons.
30333.name: Wentworth Miller

30334.quote: Entertainers are there to entertain. They aren't there to teach your children the lessons that you haven't bothered to teach them at home yourself.
30334.name: Wentworth Miller

30335.quote: I like spending time at home. In Paris, people drop by and have a bite to eat, or they drop by and watch Friends on TV. I take my dog to the office there, and I walk to work sometimes.
30335.name: Marc Jacobs

30336.quote: Words today are like the shells and rope of seaweed which a child brings home glistening from the beach and which in an hour have lost their luster.
30336.name: Cyril Connolly

30337.quote: Especially when you play at home, you need a good atmosphere behind you.
30337.name: Jose Mourinho

30338.quote: I've never been a hands-on dad. I'm not ashamed to admit it, but you can't run a restaurant and be home for tea at 4:30 and bath and change nappies.
30338.name: Gordon Ramsay

30339.quote: We want you to sit down and leave your egos at home and let's get an understanding as to where all this is foolishness coming from. There are others who are putting things out there or throwing a stick and hiding their hand and keeping things built up in the media.
30339.name: Afrika Bambaataa

30340.quote: The best thing that ever happened to me is that nothing happened in writing. I ended up working for engineering companies, and that's where I found my material, in the everyday struggle between capitalism and grace. Being broke and tired, you don't come home your best self.
30340.name: George Saunders

30341.quote: The silver and black may have another home, but the Raiders will always belong to the people of Los Angeles.
30341.name: Ice Cube

30342.quote: I am delighted to be back home in Galway, the place I first came to as a 19-year-old in 1960. It's here where my heart is and will forever be.
30342.name: Michael D. Higgins

30343.quote: Actors always talk about taking their work home and I always think: 'What are you on? You just turn it off. You are at work and then you go home.'
30343.name: Bill Nighy

30344.quote: The warrior may fight for gold or for an immediate gain, or for something to take home for the winter to feed the family. The soldier is part of a more complex society. He's fighting for a group ethic of some sort.
30344.name: C. J. Cherryh

30345.quote: We used to go to the pictures every Saturday night but we had to leave a little bit early and get home and watch Match of the Day - and my wife still complains she missed the last five minutes of every film we saw.
30345.name: Brian Clough

30346.quote: When my mother got home from work, she would take me to the movies. It was her way of getting out, and she would take me with her. I'd go home and act all the parts. It had a tremendous influence on my becoming an actor.
30346.name: Al Pacino

30347.quote: When I was doing 'Scarface,' I remember being in love at that time. One of the few times in my life. And I was so glad it was at that time. I would come home and she would tell me about her life that day and all her problems and I remember saying to her, look, you really got me through this picture because I would shed everything when I came home.
30347.name: Al Pacino

30348.quote: You're always tellin' me to go out more, Go ahead, get out and see the world, But then I think, why should I? I'd rather stay home and cry.
30348.name: Gwen Stefani

30349.quote: I really like having a life outside work. I sometimes wish I did more career stuff and was in that Hollywood scene a bit more. But Toronto's my home.
30349.name: Rachel McAdams

30350.quote: My family went through divorces and remarriages and the later, blended home - and then watched that home explode, too.
30350.name: Jeffrey Kluger

30351.quote: Spare a thought for the poor introverts among us. In a world of party animals and glad-handers, they're the ones who stand by the punch bowl. In a world of mixers and pub crawls, they prefer to stay home with a book. Everywhere around them, cell phones ring and e-mails chime and they just want a little quiet.
30351.name: Jeffrey Kluger

30352.quote: There's only one thing harder than living in a home with an adolescent - and that's being an adolescent. The moodiness, the volatility, the wholesale lack of impulse control, all would be close to clinical conditions if they occurred at another point in life. In adolescence, they're just part of the behavioral portfolio.
30352.name: Jeffrey Kluger

30353.quote: Coming home to my family afterward makes the work richer, easier and more fun.
30353.name: Edie Falco

30354.quote: Our children's health and well-being are dependent on our commitment to promoting food access and good eating habits at home, at school and in the community.
30354.name: Rod Blagojevich

30355.quote: Pride, avarice, and envy are in every home.
30355.name: Thornton Wilder

30356.quote: Many working mothers feel guilty about not being at home. And when they are there, they wish it could be perfect. This pressure to make every minute happy puts working parents in a bind when it comes to setting limits and modifying behavior.
30356.name: Cathy Rindner Tempelsman

30357.quote: You want to come home to a nice firm bed with the corners tucked in so you start over, like each night is like a new night.
30357.name: Gabrielle Union

30358.quote: Drama can feel like therapy whereas comedy feels like there's been a pressure and a weight lifted off of you. You come to work and you laugh all day, you go home and you feel light and there's a certain feeling when you're sitting with the audience and they leave after 90 minutes and it's just pure escapism and they're happy.
30358.name: Gabrielle Union

30359.quote: Even cooking at home, the difference between my wife cooking and me cooking is major. When my wife cooks, the kitchen looks like a disaster. When I cook it's completely clean and organized and it doesn't look like anyone has been cooking in there.
30359.name: Tom Colicchio

30360.quote: You come to work and you laugh all day, you go home and you feel light and there's a certain feeling when you're sitting with the audience and they leave after 90 minutes and it's just pure escapism and they're happy.
30360.name: Gabrielle Union

30361.quote: Most cooks try to learn by making dishes. Doesn't mean you can cook. It means you can make that dish. When you can cook is when you can go to a farmers market, buy a bunch of stuff, then go home and make something without looking at a recipe. Now you're cooking.
30361.name: Tom Colicchio

30362.quote: When I get old, I'm going to the old folks' home. I don't want to be one of those guys who's hanging around the house bothering the kids. But not just any old folks' home. I want the whole top floor.
30362.name: Shaquille O'Neal

30363.quote: We're adults. We're the ones who should teach the kids what's good to eat. I don't think the government should ever regulate what we eat at home, but we're feeding them in school with tax dollars. Quite frankly, if my tax dollars are being spent to feed kids, I'd rather feed them better food.
30363.name: Tom Colicchio

30364.quote: I'm a married man. If I want sex at this particular point in my life, I go home for it.
30364.name: Davy Jones

30365.quote: The environment doesn't change that radically. You are still going to go home at night and NBC is going to be there, ABC and CBS will still be there.
30365.name: Dick Wolf

30366.quote: I don't need to be asking for money for local museums and other projects just to make me look good back home.
30366.name: Jim DeMint

30367.quote: In the mind, in the heart, I was always home. I always imagined, really, going back home.
30367.name: Miriam Makeba

30368.quote: You earn very little money on independent films and I'm the provider for my home, so I do have to think of taking one for the accountant time and again and that means studio pictures.
30368.name: Vera Farmiga

30369.quote: I was living on the wrong side of the tracks in Evanston, Illinois, in a home for boys. We had these Jackson 5 records. I really related to their voices - they were about my age, but they were doing it.
30369.name: Eddie Vedder

30370.quote: I'm like a really goofy home ec teacher.
30370.name: Alton Brown

30371.quote: I know people that could serve me canned tuna and saltine crackers and have me feel more at home at their table than some people who can cook circles around me. The more you try to impress people, generally the less you do.
30371.name: Alton Brown

30372.quote: There's nothing like a good cheating song to make me want to run home to be with my wife.
30372.name: Steven Curtis Chapman

30373.quote: They pick all of us out, and then they decide, they computerize, decide if they like it or don't like it, and then they go home, and then they come back again because they're not sure what they saw.
30373.name: Alice Cooper

30374.quote: I remind everyone: Whether you school them at home or send them to school, you as a parent have the responsibility to make sure they learn and behave. Teachers and principals may help, but parents are the ones who must accept responsibility.
30374.name: Ernest Istook

30375.quote: I want kids to have a chance to dream of becoming something like I did in my life, and when you're living in a home that's dysfunctional and unhealthy that way, you don't dream like that.
30375.name: Picabo Street

30376.quote: The hardest thing is spending twelve hours a day accommodating the rest of the world, then going home at night and criticizing it. I would be curious about what I'd write if I didn't have to worry about offending.
30376.name: Sloane Crosley

30377.quote: Like most citizens of popular and international urban centres, I don't take advantage of the cultural opportunities. Perhaps this comes from growing up in suburbia. Home is where you eat, sleep, read, watch television and ignore your parents. It is not where you go to the ballet and then attend a heated panel discussion about it afterwards.
30377.name: Sloane Crosley

30378.quote: If I go into a sandwich shop or anywhere that features 'Today's specials' on a chalkboard more than 10 feet away, I have to ask for a printed menu. I smile at people I don't know on the street and ignore those I do. When at home, I often find myself grabbing my 'back-up' glasses to search for the better-loved pair I have left on top of my dresser.
30378.name: Sloane Crosley

30379.quote: However, I was a restaurant critic at Chicago magazine before I worked at Esquire, and I've been a really enthusiastic home cook for a long time. It's just something I'm passionate about.
30379.name: Ted Allen

30380.quote: When I come home from a shoot, I'd rather reheat food I've made than eat takeout.
30380.name: Ted Allen

30381.quote: I chose America as my home because I value freedom and democracy, civil liberties and an open society.
30381.name: George Soros

30382.quote: While I enjoy spending time in L.A., Britain is my home.
30382.name: Michael Sheen

30383.quote: I think I'm becoming more relaxed in front of a camera. I suppose I'll always feel slightly more at home on stage. It's more of an actor's medium. You are your own editor, nobody else is choosing what is being seen of you.
30383.name: Michael Sheen

30384.quote: I've now been in this country for thirteen years, since I was seventeen. So this is my second home.
30384.name: Hakeem Olajuwon

30385.quote: I really see myself as a homegirl. Wales is my first home. London is my second home - I've been there 14 years now.
30385.name: Katherine Jenkins

30386.quote: I love coming back to Neath - this is home and always will be.
30386.name: Katherine Jenkins

30387.quote: Oh, stuff the critics. I don't care. Too many people are snooty about classical. Look, I wasn't brought up in a home where we listened to classical music. It was a singing teacher that thought it would be best for my voice. Then I moved into crossover. And if that makes the music accessible to more people, then great.
30387.name: Katherine Jenkins

30388.quote: I'm launching my own festival in South Wales. It's something I've wanted to do for a long time. It's going to be held at Margam Park, because I wanted the venue to be as close to my home as possible.
30388.name: Katherine Jenkins

30389.quote: I wish I got a little bit more time at home. I am away a lot and being around my loved ones and friends is good for me. It grounds me. It's something I need to make more time for. I think I need a little more balance.
30389.name: Katherine Jenkins

30390.quote: I go home and don't get treated any differently. People have known me all my life and are interested and very supportive but because they have known me forever I don't get any diva treatment. My mum still tells me off if I haven't loaded the dishwasher for her.
30390.name: Katherine Jenkins

30391.quote: With all the hundreds of dresses and shoes I have, it would be an absolute crime if I don't have a little girl. I have a whole room at home filled with my stage wear.
30391.name: Katherine Jenkins

30392.quote: In general, shorter is better. If you can encapsulate your idea into a single captivating sentence, you're halfway home.
30392.name: Len Wein

30393.quote: I don't like travelling. Which is ridiculous. And it's not because I'm afraid of dying on the plane or anything. I just like to stay at home.
30393.name: Rachel Weisz

30394.quote: The killer app that got the world ready for appliances was the light bulb. So the light bulb is what wired the world. And they weren't thinking about appliances when they wired the world. They were really thinking about - they weren't putting electricity into the home. They were putting lighting into the home.
30394.name: Jeff Bezos

30395.quote: The one thing that offends me the most is when I walk by a bank and see ads trying to convince people to take out second mortgages on their home so they can go on vacation. That's approaching evil.
30395.name: Jeff Bezos

30396.quote: The relevance for 9/11 is that what 9/11 marked was the beginning of a struggle in which the terrorists come at us and strike us here on our home territory. And it's a global operation. It doesn't know national boundaries or national borders.
30396.name: Dick Cheney

30397.quote: An education program is, by definition, a societal program. Work should be done at school, rather than at home.
30397.name: Francois Hollande

30398.quote: I'm not squeamish at all. As a child I dragged a dead squirrel home on my skateboard and cut it open and tried to look at its brain.
30398.name: Jessica Biel

30399.quote: Events at home, at work, in the street - these are the bases for a story.
30399.name: Naguib Mahfouz

30400.quote: I remember when I came home from the hospital after having my son, I wore a Narciso Rodriguez black coat. Then, I was using this fragrance that I had created. I walk by that coat, and it still smells like that fragrance. It takes you right there.
30400.name: Sarah Jessica Parker

30401.quote: And I came back and it was great, 'cuz George had set up all these flowers all over the studio saying welcome home. So then we got it together again. I always felt it was better on the White one for me. We were more like a band, you know.
30401.name: Ringo Starr

30402.quote: I'm just like so many women - I was frustrated, I had these white pants that I had spent a lot of money on, and you get home and you think, 'What am I really supposed to wear under this?' So it was a frustrated consumer moment.
30402.name: Sara Blakely

30403.quote: I believe that parents need to make nutrition education a priority in their home environment. It's crucial for good health and longevity to instill in your children sound eating habits from an early age.
30403.name: Cat Cora

30404.quote: The thing about being at home versus being out in the world working is, it's a whole different vibe. When I'm home with my kids and partner, I will cook - even though she's a very good cook. She's learned over the years. We started with basics, you know, how to saute onions, how to saute mushrooms.
30404.name: Cat Cora

30405.quote: If eating out, order your meal and ask the server to wrap up half of the portion to take home with your for the next day, keeping your portion size in check, and stretching your dollar into two meals.
30405.name: Cat Cora

30406.quote: I've been experimenting more and more with LN2, liquid nitrogen. I've used it in battle on 'Iron Chef America,' but have also made some great ice creams at home for my family. Since it freezes basically on contact, you can have ice cream ready in mere minutes.
30406.name: Cat Cora

30407.quote: When I'm home, the heart and soul of our family is in the kitchen. Growing up, my parents both worked, so dinnertime was for family - the TV was off. I think it's important to grab that time and really make it special, even after a tough day.
30407.name: Cat Cora

30408.quote: From the moment this baby came into our home, those two dogs have never been more in love. It's the most beautiful thing I've ever witnessed. People keep saying, 'Oh, you're a single mom.' I'm like, 'Actually, I'm not. I've got two boys helping.'
30408.name: Charlize Theron

30409.quote: The earth is my altar, the sky is my dome, mind is my garden, the heart is my home and I'm always at home - yea, I'm always at Om.
30409.name: Eden Ahbez

30410.quote: A girl's got to do what she's got to do to make somebody pay her a compliment. If that means moaning 'til the cows come home, then so be it.
30410.name: Cat Deeley

30411.quote: I carry groceries home on the tank of my motorcycle.
30411.name: Stephan Jenkins

30412.quote: I race historic muscle cars back in Australia, and that's my hobby. And I try to race home as soon as I've finished a movie but don't tell anyone.
30412.name: Eric Bana

30413.quote: My grandmother always taught me, 'If you don't have a home, family, and church, you don't have anything.'
30413.name: Jennifer Hudson

30414.quote: When I go on the plane to fly home, I'm literally capable of forgetting what I do for a job. That also comes about because I choose to take massive breaks between projects, and because I choose to do this ridiculous thing of keeping home, home.
30414.name: Eric Bana

30415.quote: Family makes a house a home.
30415.name: Jennifer Hudson

30416.quote: When I shoot I'll take my family with me - one movie a year and then the rest of the time at home.
30416.name: Eric Bana

30417.quote: I don't get a chance to be home much.
30417.name: Jennifer Hudson

30418.quote: I love being at home, being with friends and family. I'm of European stock, brought up in Australia. I'm a passionate guy. I just love life.
30418.name: Eric Bana

30420.quote: Irish women are always carrying water on their heads, and always carrying their husbands home from pubs. Such things are the greatest posture-builders in the world.
30420.name: Peter O'Toole

30421.quote: I cook all my meals at home.
30421.name: Jennifer Hudson

30422.quote: My mother is a special story. She went through so much to bring us up, four men at home, especially when our country was going through really difficult times.
30422.name: Novak Djokovic

30423.quote: I have a life that I enjoy I try and value the things that I think are worth valuing and everything else is icing. You know, it is a kick to go down the red carpet in that dress and then you go back home.
30423.name: Jewel

30424.quote: I consider myself a product of Alaska. The love and the debt that I feel to my home state, you always want your hometown to be the proudest of you.
30424.name: Jewel

30425.quote: But you know, there's something about the kids finishing their homework in a given day, working one-on-one, getting all this attention - they go home, they're finished. They don't stall, they don't do their homework in front of the TV.
30425.name: Dave Eggers

30426.quote: I met a lot of great people in Saudi Arabia and I'd like to see them again. And I'd love to spend more time in the desert and in the mountains. I felt really at home there.
30426.name: Dave Eggers

30427.quote: I believe that the fight against crime starts in the home. Parents must take responsibility for their children and show them love and guidance from an early age so they learn to respect the rights of others.
30427.name: Blanche Lincoln

30428.quote: I've never had WiFi at home. I'm too easily distracted, and YouTube is too tempting.
30428.name: Dave Eggers

30429.quote: I've done a lot of partying in my time because I didn't want to go home and I didn't know what to do.
30429.name: Natalie Imbruglia

30430.quote: I like to listen to mellow stuff on the road like Travis, as we are constantly surrounded by rock music on tour and so its nice listening to mellow stuff. Obviously back at home I listen to a lot more rock music.
30430.name: Ville Valo

30431.quote: I don't want to get home from work and wonder if I could have done better if I didn't go out that night. What you're doing is going to go on the big screen and go down in history.
30431.name: Seann William Scott

30432.quote: My favorite show is America's Funniest Home Videos. People will get hit on the head and I feel bad cause I'm laughing my head off!
30432.name: Corbin Bleu

30433.quote: The thrill of coming home has never changed.
30433.name: Guy Pearce

30434.quote: I'm kind of a homebody. My husband says I like to just stay home and do nothing, but that's just how I am.
30434.name: Kristi Yamaguchi

30435.quote: I saw the president make the tough calls in the Situation Room - and today, our troops in Iraq have finally come home so America can do some nation building here at home. That was the change that we believed in. That was the change we fought for. That was the change President Obama delivered.
30435.name: Rahm Emanuel

30436.quote: Everywhere you hang your hat is home. Home is the bright cave under the hat.
30436.name: Lance Morrow

30437.quote: When I am made fun of in the press I just remember those days when I'd come home to find that the water had been turned off because my mother couldn't afford the bill. Suddenly, everything feels easier.
30437.name: Beth Ditto

30438.quote: Having robbed children of any sense that their Father is in Heaven and that they are His creation, we then launched an experiment in raising them without earthly fathers too. Having neither a Father in heaven or a father in the home, many young men make gangs their families.
30438.name: Gary Bauer

30439.quote: Do I ever think Gossip will be really massive in America? No, I don't think it'll happen - and that's fine. It's kind of nice because I get to experience everything at once. I get to come home and it not be weird, like in Paris or something. It is nice to be completely anonymous.
30439.name: Beth Ditto

30440.quote: As the prospect of a Tory government gets nearer, many traditional Labour voters - some who switched away in recent times and many who stayed at home - seem more determined to prevent that happening.
30440.name: Lucy Powell

30441.quote: I feel an obligation to set the record straight. Actors that say they're affected by something, that it changes their life, that they take it home with them, they're just trying to get nominated for an Oscar!
30441.name: Joaquin Phoenix

30442.quote: When I was younger, my coach, Liang Chow, made all the decisions. I would go to the gym for practice, do exactly what Chow told me to do, go home, come back and start all over again. If Chow told me to do 50 squat jumps, I did 50 squat jumps.
30442.name: Shawn Johnson

30443.quote: I keep my own personality in a cupboard under the stairs at home so that no one else can see it or nick it.
30443.name: Dawn French

30444.quote: New England is the home of all that is good and noble with all her sternness and uncompromising opinions.
30444.name: Ellen Henrietta Swallow Richards

30445.quote: The aesthetic came along the way, I think - just through experimenting, and going on tour, and trying stuff out on stage, having fun with it, and not taking it too seriously. If I had a ballgown at home, I'd wear it onstage. If I found something in a charity shop, I'd wear it. That's where it grew from - just wanting to play dress-up.
30445.name: Florence Welch

30446.quote: Mr. Bean is at his best when he is not using words, but I am equally at home in both verbal and nonverbal expression.
30446.name: Rowan Atkinson

30447.quote: Confronting a stadium audience, you can't see the whites of their eyes. It's just an amorphous mass of noise and, of course, you can't see the alleged billions watching at home either, so the degree to which you are intimidated is quite low.
30447.name: Rowan Atkinson

30448.quote: Obviously, the easiest recipes are the most successful when it comes to the home cook, because they're not intimidated by them. If I'm doing 'Boy Meets Grill,' and I do something very simple like grilled hamburgers or steaks or chicken, those are the most sought-after recipes.
30448.name: Bobby Flay

30449.quote: I can't grill vegetables, shellfish or steaks without tongs. Don't bother with those long-handled grilling tongs normally found in the BBQ section of your home store. Get intimate with your grill and opt for the regular stainless steel tongs.
30449.name: Bobby Flay

30450.quote: I think my children know that Mother's priority is to be with them first. But I don't think it has to be an either/or situation. Work is very important to me, and it wouldn't be in the best interest of my children for me to stay home seven days a week.
30450.name: Jane Pauley

30451.quote: Once you're halfway home, you know that you can probably get the rest of the way there.
30451.name: Janis Ian

30452.quote: Most of us in the baby-boom generation were raised by full-time mothers. Even as recently as 14 years ago, 6 out of 10 mothers with babies were staying at home. Today that is totally reversed. Does that mean we love our children less than our mothers loved us? No, but it certainly causes a lot of guilt trips.
30452.name: Jane Pauley

30453.quote: I grew up in a very toxic home.
30453.name: Bethenny Frankel

30454.quote: A nutritionist helps me eat healthily at home.
30454.name: Leighton Meester

30455.quote: At home it's all Batman and Star Wars and they do gang up on me. Sometimes I don't want to dress up as Darth Vader or play train sets, so I'll go out for a drink with the girls.
30455.name: Sadie Frost

30456.quote: I really don't like to do back-to-back movies. I concentrate on things at home. My family and school life are important to me. I try to do one movie a year.
30456.name: Anna Chlumsky

30457.quote: With fiction, you can talk about plot, character and narrative, whereas a poem brings home the fact that everything that happens in a work of literature happens in terms of language. And this is daunting stuff to deal with.
30457.name: Terry Eagleton

30458.quote: I tentatively believe in a god. I was brought up in a fairly religious home. I think the world is compatible with reincarnation, karma, all that stuff.
30458.name: Bjorn Lomborg

30459.quote: I'm very lucky. I am one of those people who is able to go home, shut the front door and completely focus on the kids.
30459.name: Nick Clegg

30460.quote: Acting is probably the greatest therapy in the world. You can get a lot stuff out of you on the set so you don't have to take it home with you at night. It's the stuff between the lines, the empty space between those lines which is interesting.
30460.name: Robert Carlyle

30461.quote: I am reasonably happy. I didn't find Jesus or anything like that. Part of it is that I just feel that I could go home. I did not feel like that for a long time, but I could go back now.
30461.name: Craig Ferguson

30462.quote: The technological revolution at home makes it much easier for computers to do our work.
30462.name: Fareed Zakaria

30463.quote: The American dream seems to be thriving in Europe not at home.
30463.name: Fareed Zakaria

30464.quote: I am an American citizen and it is my home now. I like the U.S.A., which is not a place too many people have liked since Bush. The U.S. has a young population, and everything can change within a year.
30464.name: Isabel Allende

30465.quote: A kid in an abusive home has far fewer rights than any POW. There is no Geneva Convention for kids.
30465.name: Andrew Vachss

30466.quote: My free time at home is usually spent emailing, listening to music, reading and talking on the phone. I wish I was on the phone less, but I have been fortunate to stay in touch with so many incredible friends.
30466.name: Steve Nash

30467.quote: I grew up in a home environment where I wasn't getting esteem for anything I did.
30467.name: Ben Affleck

30468.quote: I listen to the phone-ins on the way home and I know how the fans feel.
30468.name: Steven Gerrard

30469.quote: Power doesn't have to be on such a big scale for powerful things to occur. Within your own home, you can be a powerful woman as a mother, influencing your children's lives.
30469.name: Jill Scott

30470.quote: Every man who has shown the world the way to beauty, to true culture, has been a rebel, a 'universal' without patriotism, without home, who has found his people everywhere.
30470.name: Chaim Potok

30471.quote: The day I finished 'Twilight,' I came home and started bulking up. For 'New Moon,' I'm 30 pounds heavier than I was in 'Twilight.'
30471.name: Taylor Lautner

30472.quote: By the time I got home at night, my eyes were so chlorinated I saw rings around every light.
30472.name: Esther Williams

30473.quote: When I came home for the summer after my first year of college, I told my mother that my best friend and I were driving to California. She laughed out loud - 2,000 miles in a what? Well, my best friend had an old Chevy. What could go wrong?
30473.name: Jane Smiley

30474.quote: In the later books I am much more at home in the use of language to describe things. I had never thought of that until a critic pointed that out.
30474.name: Robert Morgan

30475.quote: I got a scholarship to Seattle University and I was writing arrangements for singers and everybody. But the music course was too dry and I really wanted to get away from home.
30475.name: Quincy Jones

30476.quote: My doctor asked me if I smoked, and I said only when I'm working, golfing, or drinking. Then I realized the only time I don't smoke is when I'm home. I didn't even realize I'd become a smoker.
30476.name: Dennis Franz

30477.quote: Unless you have been to boarding-school when you are very young, it is absolutely impossible to appreciate the delights of living at home.
30477.name: Roald Dahl

30478.quote: My mom enlisted in the U.S. Navy in World War II, and my parents actually bought our home thanks to the loan she got through the GI Bill.
30478.name: Thomas Friedman

30479.quote: I was not born in a home where there were stereotypes. So that was very useful because it gave me the sense of possibilities, of flying, if I may say, of making my hopes and dreams a reality.
30479.name: Michelle Bachelet

30480.quote: I was a loner as a child and happiest at home, launching toy rockets and aeroplanes. When I started causing trouble in my third year at grammar school, Mum was really surprised. My parents sent me to a child psychologist, who suggested I might have Asperger's syndrome.
30480.name: Gary Numan

30481.quote: I don't know what my label is. I just think of myself as a plain forward. I like to think I have some finesse to my game, but inside the paint is where men are made. If you can't play there, you should be home with your mama.
30481.name: Karl Malone

30482.quote: I'm not afraid to call a wine that tastes like Skittles or green peppers mixed with orange marmalade. I'll say, 'It tastes like chicken.' I mean, that's not what people think of when they think of wine, but that's what it tastes like to me and it hits home.
