30482.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

30483.quote: I'm still really close with everyone at home and their parents - and their brothers and sisters. I was so, so, so lucky to grow up as part of a community and I don't take that for granted. I try very hard to stay part of it.
30483.name: Jennifer Garner

30484.quote: And now, I still really don't care that much but now I have music playing all the time at home, which is a first for me. Whatever. Everything from Ani DiFranco to Dave Matthews to Jack Johnson and Norah Jones.
30484.name: Jennifer Garner

30485.quote: There's an internal battle. I need to work, I need to work, I need to work and I need to be home with my kids and the kids win.
30485.name: Jennifer Garner

30486.quote: My sisters both are working mothers. I understand that my being an actress as well as being at home isn't some heroic thing. That doesn't mean it isn't confusing or difficult - especially that question of how you find a balance.
30486.name: Jennifer Garner

30487.quote: This is truly a blessing. Breyon Prescott, Peter Edge and Tom Corson believe in me and have introduced me to a home that also believes and knows exactly what to do with the type of music I'm doing.
30487.name: Brandy Norwood

30488.quote: No, let's make sure that people understand that this is a very important war that is helping to protect us here at home. And that we have no choice but to win it. As difficult as it is.
30488.name: John Boehner

30489.quote: Americans, particularly after World War II, tended to romanticize war because in World War II our cause was the cause of humanity, and our soldiers brought home glory and victory, and thank God that they did. But it led us to romanticize it to some extent.
30489.name: Neil Sheehan

30490.quote: Five thousand people every day lose their home because of a medical bankruptcy. Most of them had insurance.
30490.name: Debbie Stabenow

30491.quote: Every woman I've had a relationship with has found this maddening the fact that I will talk about anything on the stage, and reveal all this stuff, and yet when I'm at home, I clam up and won't discuss anything intimate or personal.
30491.name: Jarvis Cocker

30492.quote: In the holy city of Mecca, violence of any kind was forbidden. From the moment they left home, pilgrims were not permitted to carry weapons, to swat an insect or speak an angry word, a discipline that introduced them to a new way of living.
30492.name: Karen Armstrong

30493.quote: At home in Victoria, we have three dogs, Tosh and Lucy, they're half Blue Heelers, and then there's Torrin a little Maltese terrier. She gets more attention in the house than anyone else! Yes, I miss them a lot.
30493.name: Chris Hemsworth

30494.quote: It's like, now you're actually complaining because you're making $9 million and guys are making more? If it makes you that upset, quit. Leave the game. Go home then and try finding another job that's going to pay you that.
30494.name: Eric Davis

30495.quote: After all, I long to be in America again, nay, if I can go home to return no more to Europe, it seems to me that I shall ever enjoy more peace of mind, and even Physical comfort than I can meet with in any portion of the world beside.
30495.name: John James Audubon

30496.quote: In all honesty, at that time, I never saw myself as an author, I was just a Mom in a state of panic, trying to enter a short story contest to win the prize money in order to keep the lights on in my home.
30496.name: Leslie Banks

30497.quote: It's a sad day when the leaders of the free world engage in such deception and trickery. I voted against this unnecessary war and will continue to argue that the best way to support our troops is to bring them home.
30497.name: Major R. Owens

30498.quote: At one point my dad called me and said, 'You have always been a great salesman. I think it's time you come home and sell swimming pools.'
30498.name: Courteney Cox

30499.quote: When I was a kid I didn't feel like I fit in because - this is really silly and I probably shouldn't say it, but, I didn't think anything was funny. So I used to go home and literally cry to my mom and my step-dad at the time and I didn't think anything was funny. I couldn't laugh.
30499.name: Courteney Cox

30500.quote: Great music is its own movie, already. And the challenge, as a music fan, is to keep the song as powerful as it wants to be, to not tamper with it and to somehow give it a home.
30500.name: Cameron Crowe

30501.quote: It's hard for women who make a lot of money and make decisions all day long, then they have to come home and be 'Stupid Sally.' Men need respect, and they need to know that they can lead in the relationship, so even if they don't make the most money they need to be able to call the shots.
30501.name: Patti Stanger

30502.quote: You may not like the idea of putting money into a home when you're moving out. But it's demanded by the market. You need to show it off. You don't have to rip out the kitchen and bathroom. But maybe replace the tiles or the countertops. Get professional advice.
30502.name: Barbara Corcoran

30503.quote: The most influential factor in selling a home is always price. Don't build 'wiggle room' into the asking price. There's a price war out there and you have to win it from the get-go.
30503.name: Barbara Corcoran

30504.quote: I live a dual life. On the red carpet, it's complete glam. But at home, I'm a jeans and T-shirt kind of girl. Simple can be beautiful.
30504.name: Ashley Greene

30505.quote: You can't control the paparazzi. But if you go to Coachella you're going to get photographed. Whereas if you're at home, walking down the street you probably won't. It's something I've learnt to navigate my way around but I try to keep my private life private.
30505.name: Ashley Greene

30506.quote: I speak relatively little, except when I'm at home and I'm asking for things.
30506.name: Roger Moore

30507.quote: When I was at college, I worked in a department store called Brit Home Stores, which is a pretty lackluster department store, selling clothes for middle-aged women. My job was to walk the floor and find anything that was damaged, take it to the store room and log it.
30507.name: Dominic Monaghan

30508.quote: The 4th Amendment and the personal rights it secures have a long history. At the very core stands the right of a man to retreat into his own home and there be free from unreasonable governmental intrusion.
30508.name: Potter Stewart

30509.quote: Home is where my mom is.
30509.name: Brittany Murphy

30510.quote: My home town is very small and very remote and we don't have a movie house.
30510.name: Tommy Lee Jones

30511.quote: Man hath still either toys or care: But hath no root, nor to one place is tied, but ever restless and irregular, about this earth doth run and ride. He knows he hath a home, but scarce knows where He says it is so far, that he has quite forgot how to go there.
30511.name: Henry Vaughan

30512.quote: I practice yoga at home to a TV show called 'Inhale,' taught by Steve Ross. I figured that if the people on the show could stretch that deep then I could too. I ended up pulling my hip flexor. But that's how I met my husband. Paul was the physical therapist my coach called to meet with me after hours.
30512.name: Danica Patrick

30513.quote: Nevertheless most of the evergreen forests of the north must always remain the home of wild animals and trappers, a backward region in which it is easy for a great fur company to maintain a practical monopoly.
30513.name: Ellsworth Huntington

30514.quote: Take, for example, the African jungle, the home of the cheetah. On whom does the cheetah prey? The old, the sick, the wounded, the weak, the very young, but never the strong. Lesson: If you would not be prey, you had better be strong.
30514.name: G. Gordon Liddy

30515.quote: When I was at home, I felt loved and safe. My sisters were always a safe haven for me. I knew they would always play with me and make me feel like I was one of them.
30515.name: Khloe Kardashian

30516.quote: One thing I've been happy as peach pie about - because I'm all about the children and the happiness of a woman because that makes the happiness of the home - is that nannies, day cares and babysitters are all collapsing, which is forcing moms and dads to raise their children at home.
30516.name: Laura Schlessinger

30517.quote: It's easier to date a football player for sure. Football players have one game a week, and they practice every day, but they're all at home. In basketball, they're on the road all the time.
30517.name: Khloe Kardashian

30518.quote: I do have 14 tattoos, but I also do come home every single night and watch reality TV with my cat.
30518.name: Lea Michele

30519.quote: All my day is spent dealing with other people. When I come home I like it to be empty. The presence of others in my house kind of annoys me. I love coming home and shutting the doors. I feel brain dead. I'm relatively available, but not to live with.
30519.name: Graham Norton

30520.quote: I still cook at home. A lot of chefs I think don't cook at home. But I still do, I love cooking at home, I love having friends.
30520.name: Rene Redzepi

30521.quote: I just moved into a new house, so I love spending time at home. Everything for me is all about self-care because I really feel that if I'm at my best, than I'm able to come to my job and really be feeling the best, so if I'm not working out or going on a hike, than I'm at home recharging and cooking dinner and hanging out with my cat.
30521.name: Lea Michele

30522.quote: If you're a misanthrope you stay at home. There are certain writers who really don't like other people. I'm not like that, I don't think.
30522.name: Paul Theroux

30523.quote: Secretly, I'm a real big nerd. I'd rather stay home and play Scrabble than go to a Hollywood party, any day of the week. And I love reading about history and watching the Discovery Channel.
30523.name: Sprague Grayden

30524.quote: When I began to make some money, I really wanted to have a home.
30524.name: Paul Theroux

30525.quote: I am at home in many cultures. I live actively in three continents and I've done that for most of my life, so I just make films as I see the world, and that happens to speak to people. I do things that I want to do.
30525.name: Mira Nair

30526.quote: Sometimes I do envision just being a stay at home mom but not working isn't an option for me currently.
30526.name: Tori Spelling

30527.quote: New York City is home to so many people from so many places and the uniqueness of it is that you never feel a foreigner. English is almost hardly ever heard in the subway. In fact, it's weird.
30527.name: Mira Nair

30528.quote: We have three generations at home, including my father-in-law. I keep a very low profile, and a lot of things I do are very much with the family in mind. I have actually made films with the family around me.
30528.name: Mira Nair

30529.quote: I'm hoping someday that some kid, black or white, will hit more home runs than myself. Whoever it is, I'd be pulling for him.
30529.name: Hank Aaron

30530.quote: This whole head of the home thing has been blown way out of proportion. Some guys just take it way too far. Some parents take it way too far. Yet children need guidance. They need a parent to help and guide them. They also need a friend. They need a confidant.
30530.name: Donny Osmond

30531.quote: You know, the sad thing of post-9/11, which was of course horrific, was that the city in which I felt completely at home for two decades, suddenly people like us - brown people - were looked at as the 'Others.'
30531.name: Mira Nair

30532.quote: I play basketball probably four to five days a week when I'm back home.
30532.name: Josh Hutcherson

30533.quote: It's not always possible to sit down and eat at home in this day and age of fast-paced living, but if you are going to eat out, do so as a family and support all the great local places in your areas. I'll still eat at the same diner I did as a kid with my parents.
30533.name: Michael Symon

30534.quote: I don't know of a Democrat - whether they're a conservative, a centrist or a liberal Democrat - that doesn't think that it's important to have quality jobs that pay decent wages so that families can support themselves, so that they can have the dignity of being able to afford health care, put money aside for pension, buy a home.
30534.name: Tom Vilsack

30535.quote: When we started the show, 'Dallas' was known as the city where JFK was assassinated. By the end it was known as JR's home town.
30535.name: Larry Hagman

30536.quote: I think because my life is so insane and it's constantly going at 120 miles per hour, my favorite thing to do is sit at home in front of the TV and check out.
30536.name: Sean Hayes

30537.quote: I like to feel the butterflies in the stomach, I like to go home and have a restless night and wonder how I'm going to be able to accomplish this feat, get jittery. That hunger and those butterflies in the stomach are very essential for all creative people.
30537.name: Amitabh Bachchan

30538.quote: I got a telegraph from my mother who said that my step-father had had a heart attack, come home and earn a living. So I went back to England and the only thing I knew to earn any cash was through hairdressing.
30538.name: Vidal Sassoon

30539.quote: I came home after a year and although my profession was only hairdressing, I knew I could change it.
30539.name: Vidal Sassoon

30540.quote: Recently I heard a 'wise guy' story that I had a party at my home for twenty-five men. It's an interesting story, but I don't know twenty-five men I'd want to invite ta a party.
30540.name: Joan Crawford

30541.quote: But inspiration? - That's when you come home from abroad and are asked: Well, have you found inspiration? - and fortunately you haven't. But the impressions sink in, of course, and may emerge later: None of us has invented the house that was done many thousands of years ago.
30541.name: Arne Jacobsen

30542.quote: I have two homes in Malibu, a home in Canada that I'm building, and I just love pouring my heart out into this part of my life.
30542.name: Pamela Anderson

30543.quote: The coolest thing, and I have it at home, is a huge Hulk Hogan, normal-sized pinball machine. When people come over they play it for hours. When you hit the bumpers and the bells ring it goes, 'Oh yeah!' The whole time you're playing this machine it's yelling and screaming at you, 'What you gonna do, brother?!' I think that's the coolest.
30543.name: Hulk Hogan

30544.quote: To be honest, I find going out pretty scary and intimidating. Got all those people checking you out, with only one purpose: hooking up. I'm quite the dork, I'd rather sit home and play Scrabble. But that doesn't get you a girl, does it?
30544.name: Wentworth Miller

30545.quote: I think any branding for me is band-related. It's really weird to get used to the exposure, because I am a naturally introverted person, and I'm not exactly social. Occasionally I can get comfortable enough to talk, but I spend a lot of my days not talking, especially when I'm at home and not on tour.
30545.name: Nate Ruess

30546.quote: But for me, I thought you made a record, you got on a bus, went out and played your shows and made a lot of money. That was the way it was supposed to go down. But there's a lot more to it than that. There are a lot of early mornings, late nights, a lot of traveling, a lot of being away from home, being away from your family.
30546.name: Jason Aldean

30547.quote: In principle if I could not have a home I wouldn't. But not having a home would be too difficult procedurally, going from hotel to hotel, the gap of three hours where you're hungry and tired.
30547.name: Lee Child

30548.quote: Reading the play at home, however fulfilling, can never be the vivacious experience that Shakespeare intended.
30548.name: Arthur Smith

30549.quote: I have a little kitchen office at home, where I do all my kids' stuff.
30549.name: Katey Sagal

30550.quote: I think the advent of the Internet gave us all a big boost, because by the time the Internet became mainstream and you could get it in your home, a lot of us were used to dealing in fan culture, writing to magazines or anything at the back of comic books.
30550.name: Kevin Smith

30551.quote: Well, I'm not good with sliminess. I hate the thought of creatures that have slime on them or creatures that leave a slimy trail. At home, the sight of a slug can bring up my breakfast.
30551.name: Jenny Eclair

30552.quote: I think it's really important to give yourself a very big question that you're working on that you can come home to, even if you, you know, are going to have to go without a cup of coffee or even a meal, that that should nourish you.
30552.name: Anna Deavere Smith

30553.quote: I was from such a large family that when I first met my wife, I told her: 'You can go work outside of the house and I'll stay home and continue making my cartoon strips. Maybe I'll make some commercials nearby, you know I'll do anything locally, but I would love to just stay at home and raise the kids like I did when I was growing up.'
30553.name: Robert Rodriguez

30554.quote: I made a real specific decision when I came out of school and most artists were writing about home - if you were a woman, you were writing about being a woman - and I decided not to do that, write about what you know. That's not what I do. I went as far away from home as possible in terms of the development of my imagination.
30554.name: Anna Deavere Smith

30555.quote: I love my parents. But I'm almost 28 and it's not fun to be asked, 'What are you doing today? What do you want for dinner? When are you going to be home?' It just makes you feel like a kid. It's this juxtaposition of feeling annoyed and really lucky to have people who love you so much.
30555.name: Jonah Hill

30556.quote: Christianity is not about religion. It's about faith, about being held, about being forgiven. It's about finding joy and finding home.
30556.name: Bear Grylls

30557.quote: I'm always amazed when a pitcher becomes angry at a hitter for hitting a home run off him. When I strike out, I don't get angry at the pitcher, I get angry at myself. I would think that if a pitcher threw up a home run ball, he should be angry at himself.
30557.name: Willie Stargell

30558.quote: I love home cooking, and I'm not a great one for fast food.
30558.name: Bear Grylls

30559.quote: I try and eat really healthy when I'm home, but I certainly don't eat worms and snakes.
30559.name: Bear Grylls

30560.quote: I exercise about 40 minutes a day, and I'll run one day and do circuit training the next day. I live in an area where there are brilliant hills and mountains, so I get a good hill run with my dog. At home, I'll do the circuit training with old weights, along with pull-ups in the trees and that sort of stuff.
30560.name: Bear Grylls

30561.quote: When I'm filming, survival requires movement. You need your energy, and you've got to eat the bad stuff, and survival food is rarely pretty, but you kind of do it. I get in that zone, and I eat the nasty stuff, but I'm not like that when I'm back home.
30561.name: Bear Grylls

30562.quote: Survival requires us to leave our prejudices at home. It's about doing whatever it takes - and ultimately those with the biggest heart will win.
30562.name: Bear Grylls

30563.quote: I only scream and scratch when something's only 'really good' or 'good', I want to be great, or let's go home.
30563.name: Jeremy Renner

30564.quote: Land is the secure ground of home, the sea is like life, the outside, the unknown.
30564.name: Stephen Gardiner

30565.quote: Nice to see your home fans boo you. That's what loyal support is.
30565.name: Wayne Rooney

30566.quote: About 15 years ago I went though a period of a year or so when I just couldn't find anything good. My wife noticed I was having trouble reading menus. I bought some cheap reading glasses in a drug store. I got home and suddenly all these books that weren't good were good.
30566.name: Richard Russo

30567.quote: The American consumer is also the American worker, and if we don't do something to protect our manufacturing base here at home, it is going to be hard to buy any retail goods.
30567.name: Lindsey Graham

30568.quote: I went to the store and bought lady fingers, when I got home I noticed one of the fingers was missing so I went back to the store and the manager was nice enough to give me the finger.
30568.name: Jay London

30569.quote: Brazil is where I belong, the place that feels like home. They love their family, their country and God, and are not afraid to let anybody know it.
30569.name: Dionne Warwick

30570.quote: At home, growing up, we weren't really poor. We had everything we needed, we just didn't have what we wanted.
30570.name: Barbara Kingsolver

30571.quote: He's a good tough producer, yes. But I don't think that he's unreasonable unless he feels threatened. And when somebody's in your home, I think everybody in the home gets threatened.
30571.name: Liza Minnelli

30572.quote: I lived at home till I was 29.
30572.name: Ray Romano

30573.quote: My folks were raised pure prohibitionist. They were very good people, with high moral standards - but very repressed. There was no hugging and kissing in my home.
30573.name: Hugh Hefner

30574.quote: Men can have a huge turnover of sponsorship and still survive a lot better than the women. But the women's ratings are better, at least at home in the United States than in the men's tennis.
30574.name: Billie Jean King

30575.quote: I'd rather rot on my own floor than be found by a bunch of bingo players in a nursing home.
30575.name: Florence King

30576.quote: I read the Odyssey because it was the story of a man who returned home after being absent for more than twenty years and was recognized only by his dog.
30576.name: Guillermo Cabrera Infante

30577.quote: On my visits back home, if they saw that I was getting a big head, they'd let me know right away.
30577.name: John Ratzenberger

30578.quote: Ladies and gentlemen, god bless America - land of the free, home of the brave.
30578.name: Dave Grohl

30579.quote: For President Obama, 'home of the brave' are not just the last words of our national anthem, but also a call to action. This is why the president's policies and our platform include incentives to train and hire our troops returning home. Not only because of our moral responsibility, but because it makes for a stronger, more secure American economy.
30579.name: Cory Booker

30580.quote: It's not about finding a home so much as finding yourself.
30580.name: Jason Behr

30581.quote: I spend plenty of time in London and it doesn't scare me, but it's a lonely place, even if you've got friends there. My job takes me all around the world, meeting lots of interesting people. But I think if I couldn't get home, if I couldn't get back to what I consider my real life I'd be frightened.
30581.name: Shirley Henderson

30582.quote: My wife is the boss at home, and my daughters are the bosses. I am just the worker. We are a very warm family and very happy.
30582.name: Jet Li

30583.quote: Leaving home in a sense involves a kind of second birth in which we give birth to ourselves.
30583.name: Robert Neelly Bellah

30584.quote: Every time I took a long leave from home, I felt as if I were going to conquer the world. Or rather, take possession of what is my birthright, my inheritance.
30584.name: Ella Maillart

30585.quote: But, yeah, I'm really happy when I'm writing. When I'm being creative and when I have something that I can put down. You know, if you go out and you overhear a conversation or you have a thought, you have a receptacle to go home and say, 'Oh, this would be great in this script.' Your antenna's out in a different way, and I love that time.
30585.name: Josh Radnor

30586.quote: I do 280 episodes of TV a year, write 15 recipes for the magazine, and publish an annual book. With all of that, we try to get one weekend a month with Isaboo at our home in the Adirondacks to relax and recharge.
30586.name: Rachael Ray

30587.quote: I live in, literally, the same home when I was swiping my first bank card and wondering if I'd have to put back the Charmin. We still don't have a dishwasher. My mom has done all these gardens so now my house looks like the garden shack in the middle of Versailles.
30587.name: Rachael Ray

30588.quote: I have this extraordinary life during the day, and then I get to come home to my sweet husband who loves to cook with me. I have a nice glass of wine, he has some scotch, we chat, we cook, and we hang out with the dog. I have an absolute dream life.
30588.name: Rachael Ray

30589.quote: Good food and a warm kitchen are what makes a house a home. I always tried to make my home like my mother's, because Mom was magnificent at stretching a buck when it came to decorating and food. Like a true Italian, she valued beautification in every area of her life, and I try to do the same.
30589.name: Rachael Ray

30590.quote: Praying privately in churches, I began to discover that heaven was my true home and also that it was here and now, woven into this life.
30590.name: Lionel Blue

30591.quote: During the Second World War, evacuated to non-Jewish households, I encountered Christianity at home and in school.
30591.name: Lionel Blue

30592.quote: I fantasize about having a manual job where I can come home at night, read a book and not feel responsible for what will happen the next day.
30592.name: Jodie Foster

30593.quote: I came from a broken home, so my mom was a major influence in my life.
30593.name: Julius Erving

30594.quote: I want any excuse to come home. My dad is not a spring chicken any more. If anyone says, 'Go buy a postage stamp in London,' I'll go and do it.
30594.name: Emily Mortimer

30595.quote: I had to learn to dance for 'The Adjustment Bureau' and it was nearly impossible. I turned up with my knees knocking in my leotard and went home and cried my eyes out.
30595.name: Emily Blunt

30596.quote: I hate formal stuff. I love looking like a doll and all that stuff and playing dress up, but when I'm home, sweat pants, t-shirt. When I'm in the studio, sweat pants, t-shirt.
30596.name: Nicki Minaj

30597.quote: The culture is going into a psychological depression. We are concerned about our place in the world, about being competitive: Will my children have as much as I have? Will I ever own my own home? How can I pay for a new car? Are immigrants taking away my white world?
30597.name: James Hillman

30598.quote: I buy records - vinyl. I have a record player at home.
30598.name: Amber Heard

30599.quote: One of the biggest challenges in my job is letting go of the movie once you go home at night, and knowing you can't do anything to your performance once you've laid it on film.
30599.name: Amber Heard

30600.quote: There are no college courses to build up self-esteem or high school or elementary school. If you don't get those values at a early age, nurtured in your home, you don't get them.
30600.name: T. D. Jakes

30601.quote: I love being on stage if I'm not on a set. If I'm at home, I'm usually in my office editing or reconstructing my website or whatever it may be. I just love putting creativity into a performance, so if the right script comes along, and I certainly am reading comedies and dramas now, then I'm ready willing and able to give it a shot.
30601.name: Dane Cook

30602.quote: I do portraits. I usually do live models in a class environment, but I've been painting at home more. I really love the human form, and I love faces. I've tried to do landscapes a few times.
30602.name: Michelle Pfeiffer

30603.quote: I've gone very far, far away, but my character keeps me close to home.
30603.name: Fran Drescher

30604.quote: During the periods in my marriage when I chose to stay home with my kids rather than work as an attorney, it caused me no end of anxiety. Despite the fact that I knew I was contributing to our family by caring for our children, I still felt that my worth was less because I wasn't earning.
30604.name: Ayelet Waldman

30605.quote: Why go for a costly, sickly, mass-produced purebred when shelters are full of one-of-a-kind mixed breeds who are literally dying for a home?
30605.name: Ingrid Newkirk

30606.quote: I am a particular fan of integrative exercise - that is, exercise that occurs in the course of doing some productive activity such as gardening, bicycling to work, doing home improvement projects and so on.
30606.name: Andrew Weil

30607.quote: A beautiful bouquet or a long-lasting flowering plant is a traditional gift for women, but I have recommended that both men and women keep fresh flowers in the home for their beauty, fragrance, and the lift they give our spirits.
30607.name: Andrew Weil

30608.quote: Part of the reason I sort of shot out like a cannon out of Michigan and left home at such an early age is because I had to feel independent.
30608.name: Madonna Ciccone

30609.quote: I know this sounds generic, but I'm so happy to be home with my husband, my family, and my dog.
30609.name: Fergie

30610.quote: Turn up the lights. I don't want to go home in the dark.
30610.name: O. Henry

30611.quote: Divorce is one of the key predictors of poverty for a child growing up in a home that's broken.
30611.name: Mike Huckabee

30612.quote: I support workplace clean air. But a federal ban on smoking would mean that you couldn't smoke in your own home. I don't care what people do in their home.
30612.name: Mike Huckabee

30613.quote: It's like, if you can't focus on a movie for 90 minutes without looking at your phone, then don't go to the movies! You've got some issues, so you should probably stay home and work on those issues, and not distract everyone with lights, and sounds, oh my gosh, the tapping on the screens, it makes me crazy!
30613.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

30614.quote: I'm a better person in a relationship, and I'm a happier person. I need to come home at the end of the day and have it not be about me and my freaking hair and makeup and character motivations anymore. And I think my work is more inspired when home is safe and sound and solid, because what I do for a living is so bananas and so insecure.
30614.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

30615.quote: I will end up with someone in the arts. I am positive. I eat, breathe and sleep acting. And I'll end up with someone who is happy staying at home and having me cook supper. But I also really need to be intellectually challenged and stimulated. I want someone bookish, and someone who is passionate.
30615.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

30616.quote: After spending time with the rescued turkeys at Farm Sanctuary's shelter and seeing how similar they are to my furry companion animals at home, I knew I needed to do everything in my power to protect these friendly and curious birds from the daily pain and suffering they endure on factory farms.
30616.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

30617.quote: When you have the paparazzi hiding in the bushes outside your home, the only thing you can control is how you respond publicly.
30617.name: Portia de Rossi

30618.quote: When I joined Custer I donned the uniform of a soldier. It was a bit awkward at first but I soon got to be perfectly at home in men's clothes.
30618.name: Calamity Jane

30619.quote: My divorce came to me as a complete surprise. That's what happens when you haven't been home in eighteen years.
30619.name: Lee Trevino

30620.quote: You know, you go home and you try on a new mascara, and I guess a male CEO can't do that.
30620.name: Andrea Jung

30621.quote: We talk a lot in our home together about where we're going, what I'm doing.
30621.name: Melinda Gates

30622.quote: At home I've got a very puerile, juvenile sense of humour.
30622.name: Thom Yorke

30623.quote: To the former child migrants, who came to Australia from a home far away, led to believe this land would be a new beginning, when only to find it was not a beginning, but an end, an end of innocence - we apologise and we are sorry. To the mothers who lost the maternal right to love and care for their child - we apologise, and we are sorry.
30623.name: Malcolm Turnbull

30624.quote: My father was always depressed. When he was home and sober, he was mostly in his room.
30624.name: Sherman Alexie

30625.quote: I think it's easiest to teach by example. My dad didn't tell us to work hard we just saw how hard he worked. I know I have shortcomings - like a short fuse - but I've learned you can't come home from a long day of work and snap at the kids.
30625.name: Chris O'Donnell

30626.quote: Imagine if you had baseball cards that showed all the performance stats for your people: batting averages, home runs, errors, ERAs, win/loss records. You could see what they did well and poorly and call on the right people to play the right positions in a very transparent way.
30626.name: Ray Dalio

30627.quote: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow. The important thing is not to stop questioning.
30627.name: Albert Einstein

30628.quote: We must accept finite disappointment, but never lose infinite hope.
30628.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

30629.quote: None are more hopelessly enslaved than those who falsely believe they are free.
30629.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

30630.quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
30630.name: Maya Angelou

30631.quote: I find hope in the darkest of days, and focus in the brightest. I do not judge the universe.
30631.name: Dalai Lama

30632.quote: I hope to stand firm enough to not go backward, and yet not go forward fast enough to wreck the country's cause.
30632.name: Abraham Lincoln

30633.quote: A little more persistence, a little more effort, and what seemed hopeless failure may turn to glorious success.
30633.name: Elbert Hubbard

30634.quote: Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torments of man.
30634.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

30635.quote: Lord save us all from a hope tree that has lost the faculty of putting out blossoms.
30635.name: Mark Twain

30636.quote: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul - and sings the tunes without the words - and never stops at all.
30636.name: Emily Dickinson

30637.quote: This suspense is terrible. I hope it will last.
30637.name: Oscar Wilde

30638.quote: Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not remember that what you now have was once among the things you only hoped for.
30638.name: Epicurus

30639.quote: Be careful to leave your sons well instructed rather than rich, for the hopes of the instructed are better than the wealth of the ignorant.
30639.name: Epictetus

30640.quote: He that lives upon hope will die fasting.
30640.name: Benjamin Franklin

30641.quote: Three grand essentials to happiness in this life are something to do, something to love, and something to hope for.
30641.name: Joseph Addison

30642.quote: You may not always have a comfortable life and you will not always be able to solve all of the world's problems at once but don't ever underestimate the importance you can have because history has shown us that courage can be contagious and hope can take on a life of its own.
30642.name: Michelle Obama

30643.quote: Youth is easily deceived because it is quick to hope.
30643.name: Aristotle

30644.quote: Hope is the dream of a waking man.
30644.name: Aristotle

30645.quote: We must free ourselves of the hope that the sea will ever rest. We must learn to sail in high winds.
30645.name: Aristotle Onassis

30646.quote: In the end, that's what this election is about. Do we participate in a politics of cynicism or a politics of hope?
30646.name: Barack Obama

30647.quote: Tomorrow hopes we have learned something from yesterday.
30647.name: John Wayne

30648.quote: Courage is like love it must have hope for nourishment.
30648.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

30649.quote: Hope is tomorrow's veneer over today's disappointment.
30649.name: Evan Esar

30650.quote: Never deprive someone of hope it might be all they have.
30650.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

30651.quote: Everything that is done in the world is done by hope.
30651.name: Martin Luther

30652.quote: Hope springs eternal in the human breast: Man never is, but always To be Blest.
30652.name: Alexander Pope

30653.quote: God grant me the courage not to give up what I think is right even though I think it is hopeless.
30653.name: Chester W. Nimitz

30654.quote: I simply can't build my hopes on a foundation of confusion, misery and death, I think, peace and tranquillity will return again.
30654.name: Anne Frank

30655.quote: In this world you've just got to hope for the best and prepare for the worst and take whatever God sends.
30655.name: Lucy Maud Montgomery

30656.quote: Chance has never yet satisfied the hope of a suffering people.
30656.name: Marcus Garvey

30657.quote: A strong mind always hopes, and has always cause to hope.
30657.name: Thomas Carlyle

30658.quote: We have always held to the hope, the belief, the conviction that there is a better life, a better world, beyond the horizon.
30658.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt

30659.quote: When we have lost everything, including hope, life becomes a disgrace, and death a duty.
30659.name: W. C. Fields

30660.quote: I said to my soul, be still, and wait without hope, For hope would be hope for the wrong thing.
30660.name: T. S. Eliot

30661.quote: Where there is no vision, there is no hope.
30661.name: George Washington Carver

30662.quote: A whole stack of memories never equal one little hope.
30662.name: Charles M. Schulz

30663.quote: Expecting something for nothing is the most popular form of hope.
30663.name: Arnold H. Glasow

30664.quote: At the end of the day, we must go forward with hope and not backward by fear and division.
30664.name: Jesse Jackson

30665.quote: Every day begins with an act of courage and hope: getting out of bed.
30665.name: Mason Cooley

30666.quote: Hope is the last thing a person does before they are defeated.
30666.name: Henry Rollins

30667.quote: Hope is a good breakfast, but it is a bad supper.
30667.name: Francis Bacon

30668.quote: Hope is the only universal liar who never loses his reputation for veracity.
30668.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

30669.quote: My hope still is to leave the world a bit better than when I got here.
30669.name: Jim Henson

30670.quote: Hopeful thinking can get you out of your fear zone and into your appreciation zone.
30670.name: Martha Beck

30671.quote: To live without Hope is to Cease to live.
30671.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky

30672.quote: Beware how you take away hope from another human being.
30672.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

30673.quote: Don't give up. Don't lose hope. Don't sell out.
30673.name: Christopher Reeve

30674.quote: It is only hope which is real, and reality is a bitterness and a deceit.
30674.name: William Makepeace Thackeray

30675.quote: I hope that I may always desire more than I can accomplish.
30675.name: Michelangelo

30676.quote: Hope is like the sun, which, as we journey toward it, casts the shadow of our burden behind us.
30676.name: Samuel Smiles

30677.quote: The trouble with most people is that they think with their hopes or fears or wishes rather than with their minds.
30677.name: Will Durant

30678.quote: Hope is like peace. It is not a gift from God. It is a gift only we can give one another.
30678.name: Elie Wiesel

30679.quote: Things start out as hopes and end up as habits.
30679.name: Lillian Hellman

30680.quote: The work goes on, the cause endures, the hope still lives and the dreams shall never die.
30680.name: Edward Kennedy

30682.quote: I place no hope in my strength, nor in my works: but all my confidence is in God my protector, who never abandons those who have put all their hope and thought in him.
30682.name: Francois Rabelais

30683.quote: I have tried to keep on with my striving because this is the only hope I have of ever achieving anything worthwhile and lasting.
30683.name: Arthur Ashe

30684.quote: Uncertainty is the refuge of hope.
30684.name: Henri Frederic Amiel

30685.quote: It's time to get real, folks. Hope and change ain't working. Hope and change is not a solution. Hope and change is not a job.
30685.name: Herman Cain

30686.quote: One lives in the hope of becoming a memory.
30686.name: Antonio Porchia

30687.quote: All human wisdom is summed up in two words wait and hope.
30687.name: Alexandre Dumas

30688.quote: The world is bad but not without hope. It is only hopeless when you look at it from an ideal viewpoint.
30688.name: Friedrich Durrenmatt

30689.quote: All hope abandon, ye who enter here!
30689.name: Dante Alighieri

30690.quote: How disappointment tracks the steps of hope.
30690.name: Letitia Elizabeth Landon

30691.quote: At the moment of death I hope to be surprised.
30691.name: Ivan Illich

30692.quote: I wish I could know everything ever, like that would be my wish - that's what I hope heaven is, that they tell you who shot JFK and all that stuff.
30692.name: Louis C. K.

30693.quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
30693.name: Jonas Salk

30694.quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left, and could say, 'I used everything you gave me'.
30694.name: Erma Bombeck

30696.quote: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
30696.name: Helen Keller

30697.quote: Any people anywhere, being inclined and having the power, have the right to rise up, and shake off the existing government, and form a new one that suits them better. This is a most valuable - a most sacred right - a right, which we hope and believe, is to liberate the world.
30697.name: Abraham Lincoln

30698.quote: All that I am, or hope to be, I owe to my angel mother.
30698.name: Abraham Lincoln

30699.quote: Imagine all the people living life in peace. You may say I'm a dreamer, but I'm not the only one. I hope someday you'll join us, and the world will be as one.
30699.name: John Lennon

30700.quote: If people are good only because they fear punishment, and hope for reward, then we are a sorry lot indeed.
30700.name: Albert Einstein

30701.quote: I hope we shall crush in its birth the aristocracy of our monied corporations which dare already to challenge our government to a trial by strength, and bid defiance to the laws of our country.
30701.name: Thomas Jefferson

30702.quote: All the great things are simple, and many can be expressed in a single word: freedom, justice, honor, duty, mercy, hope.
30702.name: Winston Churchill

30703.quote: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
30703.name: Maya Angelou

30704.quote: The hope of a secure and livable world lies with disciplined nonconformists who are dedicated to justice, peace and brotherhood.
30704.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

30705.quote: My dream is of a place and a time where America will once again be seen as the last best hope of earth.
30705.name: Abraham Lincoln

30706.quote: A very small degree of hope is sufficient to cause the birth of love.
30706.name: Stendhal

30707.quote: I am prepared for the worst, but hope for the best.
30707.name: Benjamin Disraeli

30708.quote: Israel was not created in order to disappear - Israel will endure and flourish. It is the child of hope and the home of the brave. It can neither be broken by adversity nor demoralized by success. It carries the shield of democracy and it honors the sword of freedom.
30708.name: John F. Kennedy

30709.quote: Most of the important things in the world have been accomplished by people who have kept on trying when there seemed to be no hope at all.
30709.name: Dale Carnegie

30710.quote: Few things in the world are more powerful than a positive push. A smile. A world of optimism and hope. A 'you can do it' when things are tough.
30710.name: Richard M. DeVos

30711.quote: In giving freedom to the slave, we assure freedom to the free - honorable alike in what we give and what we preserve. We shall nobly save, or meanly lose, the last best hope of earth.
30711.name: Abraham Lincoln

30712.quote: Action and reaction, ebb and flow, trial and error, change - this is the rhythm of living. Out of our over-confidence, fear out of our fear, clearer vision, fresh hope. And out of hope, progress.
30712.name: Bruce Barton

30713.quote: Come, gentlemen, I hope we shall drink down all unkindness.
30713.name: William Shakespeare

30714.quote: If you die you're completely happy and your soul somewhere lives on. I'm not afraid of dying. Total peace after death, becoming someone else is the best hope I've got.
30714.name: Kurt Cobain

30715.quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
30715.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

30716.quote: I hope our wisdom will grow with our power, and teach us, that the less we use our power the greater it will be.
30716.name: Thomas Jefferson

30717.quote: One loves to possess arms, though they hope never to have occasion for them.
30717.name: Thomas Jefferson

30718.quote: I totally disagree with the view that the Tibet struggle will die, and there will be no hope for Tibet, after the Dalai Lama passes away.
30718.name: Dalai Lama

30719.quote: The rich are always going to say that, you know, just give us more money and we'll go out and spend more and then it will all trickle down to the rest of you. But that has not worked the last 10 years, and I hope the American public is catching on.
30719.name: Warren Buffett

30720.quote: If money is your hope for independence you will never have it. The only real security that a man will have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience, and ability.
30720.name: Henry Ford

30721.quote: My theory has always been, that if we are to dream, the flatteries of hope are as cheap, and pleasanter, than the gloom of despair.
30721.name: Thomas Jefferson

30722.quote: Hope is some extraordinary spiritual grace that God gives us to control our fears, not to oust them.
30722.name: Vincent McNabb

30723.quote: I hope that no American will waste his franchise and throw away his vote by voting either for me or against me solely on account of my religious affiliation. It is not relevant.
30723.name: John F. Kennedy

30724.quote: What is true of the individual will be tomorrow true of the whole nation if individuals will but refuse to lose heart and hope.
30724.name: Mahatma Gandhi

30725.quote: No matter how dark the moment, love and hope are always possible.
30725.name: George Chakiris

30726.quote: Disappointment is a sort of bankruptcy - the bankruptcy of a soul that expends too much in hope and expectation.
30726.name: Eric Hoffer

30727.quote: He who has faith has, an inward reservoir of courage, hope, confidence, calmness, and assuring trust that all will come out well - even though to the world it may appear to come out most badly.
30727.name: B. C. Forbes

30728.quote: Forgiving does not erase the bitter past. A healed memory is not a deleted memory. Instead, forgiving what we cannot forget creates a new way to remember. We change the memory of our past into a hope for our future.
30728.name: Lewis B. Smedes

30729.quote: It is only by not paying one's bills that one can hope to live in the memory of the commercial classes.
30729.name: Oscar Wilde

30730.quote: Desire is the starting point of all achievement, not a hope, not a wish, but a keen pulsating desire which transcends everything.
30730.name: Napoleon Hill

30731.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
30731.name: Robert Fulghum

30732.quote: I hope everyone that is reading this is having a really good day. And if you are not, just know that in every new minute that passes you have an opportunity to change that.
30732.name: Gillian Anderson

30733.quote: I hope I shall possess firmness and virtue enough to maintain what I consider the most enviable of all titles, the character of an honest man.
30733.name: George Washington

30734.quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
30734.name: Bill Cosby

30735.quote: I hope the millions of people I've touched have the optimism and desire to share their goals and hard work and persevere with a positive attitude.
30735.name: Michael Jordan

30736.quote: He who has health, has hope and he who has hope, has everything.
30736.name: Thomas Carlyle

30737.quote: And God help Bruce Springsteen when they decide he's no longer God, They'll turn on him, and I hope he survives it.
30737.name: John Lennon

30738.quote: The great gift of Easter is hope - Christian hope which makes us have that confidence in God, in his ultimate triumph, and in his goodness and love, which nothing can shake.
30738.name: Basil Hume

30739.quote: The ninety and nine are with dreams, content but the hope of the world made new, is the hundredth man who is grimly bent on making those dreams come true.
30739.name: Edgar Allan Poe

30740.quote: But I have found that in the simple act of living with hope, and in the daily effort to have a positive impact in the world, the days I do have are made all the more meaningful and precious. And for that I am grateful.
30740.name: Elizabeth Edwards

30741.quote: A leader is a dealer in hope.
30741.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

30742.quote: I only hope that we don't lose sight of one thing - that it was all started by a mouse.
30742.name: Walt Disney

30743.quote: Infuse your life with action. Don't wait for it to happen. Make it happen. Make your own future. Make your own hope. Make your own love. And whatever your beliefs, honor your creator, not by passively waiting for grace to come down from upon high, but by doing what you can to make grace happen, yourself, right now, right down here on Earth.
30743.name: Bradley Whitford

30744.quote: I would rather entertain and hope that people learned something than educate people and hope they were entertained.
30744.name: Walt Disney

30745.quote: Hope is definitely not the same thing as optimism. It is not the conviction that something will turn out well, but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
30745.name: Vaclav Havel

30746.quote: I think that when you get dressed in the morning, sometimes you're really making a decision about your behavior for the day. Like if you put on flipflops, you're saying: 'Hope I don't get chased today.' 'Be nice to people in sneakers.'
30746.name: Demetri Martin

30747.quote: Our human compassion binds us the one to the other - not in pity or patronizingly, but as human beings who have learnt how to turn our common suffering into hope for the future.
30747.name: Nelson Mandela

30748.quote: On every front there are clear answers out there that can make this country stronger, but we're going to break through the fear and the frustration people are feeling. Our job is to make sure that even as we make progress, that we are also giving people a sense of hope and vision for the future.
30748.name: Barack Obama

30750.quote: Love, we say, is life but love without hope and faith is agonizing death.
30750.name: Elbert Hubbard

30751.quote: Depression can seem worse than terminal cancer, because most cancer patients feel loved and they have hope and self-esteem.
30751.name: David D. Burns

30752.quote: In motivating people, you've got to engage their minds and their hearts. I motivate people, I hope, by example - and perhaps by excitement, by having productive ideas to make others feel involved.
30752.name: Rupert Murdoch

30753.quote: Selfishness must always be forgiven you know, because there is no hope of a cure.
30753.name: Jane Austen

30754.quote: Maybe all one can do is hope to end up with the right regrets.
30754.name: Arthur Miller

30755.quote: Man wants to live, but it is useless to hope that this desire will dictate all his actions.
30755.name: Albert Camus

30756.quote: He who despairs of the human condition is a coward, but he who has hope for it is a fool.
30756.name: Albert Camus

30757.quote: Poets have said that the reason to have children is to give yourself immortality. Immortality? Now that I have five children, my only hope is that they are all out of the house before I die.
30757.name: Bill Cosby

30758.quote: Creativity is a great motivator because it makes people interested in what they are doing. Creativity gives hope that there can be a worthwhile idea. Creativity gives the possibility of some sort of achievement to everyone. Creativity makes life more fun and more interesting.
30758.name: Edward de Bono

30759.quote: A good teacher can inspire hope, ignite the imagination, and instill a love of learning.
30759.name: Brad Henry

30760.quote: I'll always stay connected with Apple. I hope that throughout my life I'll sort of have the thread of my life and the thread of Apple weave in and out of each other, like a tapestry. There may be a few years when I'm not there, but I'll always come back.
30760.name: Steve Jobs

30761.quote: Fear cannot be without hope nor hope without fear.
30761.name: Baruch Spinoza

30762.quote: My message to you all is of hope, courage and confidence. Let us mobilize all our resources in a systematic and organized way and tackle the grave issues that confront us with grim determination and discipline worthy of a great nation.
30762.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

30763.quote: It is difficult to say what is impossible, for the dream of yesterday is the hope of today and the reality of tomorrow.
30763.name: Robert H. Schuller

30764.quote: When I die, I hope to go to Heaven, whatever the Hell that is.
30764.name: Ayn Rand

30765.quote: I've tried to reduce profanity but I reduced so much profanity when writing the book that I'm afraid not much could come out. Perhaps we will have to consider it simply as a profane book and hope that the next book will be less profane or perhaps more sacred.
30765.name: Ernest Hemingway

30766.quote: If children have the ability to ignore all odds and percentages, then maybe we can all learn from them. When you think about it, what other choice is there but to hope? We have two options, medically and emotionally: give up, or Fight Like Hell.
30766.name: Lance Armstrong

30767.quote: For love would be love of the wrong thing there is yet faith, But the faith and the love and the hope are all in the waiting.
30767.name: T. S. Eliot

30768.quote: You are not here merely to make a living. You are here in order to enable the world to live more amply, with greater vision, with a finer spirit of hope and achievement. You are here to enrich the world, and you impoverish yourself if you forget the errand.
30768.name: Woodrow Wilson

30769.quote: Desperation is the raw material of drastic change. Only those who can leave behind everything they have ever believed in can hope to escape.
30769.name: William S. Burroughs

30770.quote: The sudden disappointment of a hope leaves a scar which the ultimate fulfillment of that hope never entirely removes.
30770.name: Thomas Hardy

30771.quote: Faith has to do with things that are not seen and hope with things that are not at hand.
30771.name: Thomas Aquinas

30773.quote: The essence of optimism is that it takes no account of the present, but it is a source of inspiration, of vitality and hope where others have resigned it enables a man to hold his head high, to claim the future for himself and not to abandon it to his enemy.
30773.name: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

30774.quote: I tremble for my country when I hear of confidence expressed in me. I know too well my weakness, that our only hope is in God.
30774.name: Robert E. Lee

30775.quote: Our worldly successes cannot be guaranteed, but our ability to achieve spiritual success is entirely up to us, thanks to the grace of God. The best advice I know is to give is to give those worldly things your best but never your all - reserve the ultimate hope for the only one who can grant it.
30775.name: Mitt Romney

30776.quote: Posterity: you will never know how much it has cost my generation to preserve your freedom. I hope you will make good use of it.
30776.name: John Quincy Adams

30777.quote: Marriage is like putting your hand into a bag of snakes in the hope of pulling out an eel.
30777.name: Leonardo da Vinci

30778.quote: My favorite fruit is grapes. Because with grapes, you always get another chance. 'Cause, you know, if you have a crappy apple or a peach, you're stuck with that crappy piece of fruit. But if you have a crappy grape, no problem - just move on to the next. 'Grapes: The Fruit of Hope.'
30778.name: Demetri Martin

30779.quote: I don't know what can be so dangerous about giving people hope.
30779.name: Joel Osteen

30780.quote: Those who hope for no other life are dead even for this.
30780.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

30781.quote: It is often when night looks darkest, it is often before the fever breaks that one senses the gathering momentum for change, when one feels that resurrection of hope in the midst of despair and apathy.
30781.name: Hillary Clinton

30782.quote: And I hope that five years and 10 years from now, I'll be a better man, a more mature man, a wiser man, a more humble man and a more spirited man to serve the good of my people and the good of humanity.
30782.name: Louis Farrakhan

30783.quote: What gives me the most hope every day is God's grace knowing that his grace is going to give me the strength for whatever I face, knowing that nothing is a surprise to God.
30783.name: Rick Warren

30784.quote: I've seen the ticket, and I still can't believe it. When I see the money, I hope I don't hit the floor.
30784.name: Judy Garland

30785.quote: As for gun control advocates, I have no hope whatever that any facts whatever will make the slightest dent in their thinking - or lack of thinking.
30785.name: Thomas Sowell

30786.quote: Together we will build an America where hope is a new job with a paycheck, not a faded word on an old bumper sticker.
30786.name: Mitt Romney

30787.quote: Pakistan not only means freedom and independence but the Muslim Ideology which has to be preserved, which has come to us as a precious gift and treasure and which, we hope other will share with us.
30787.name: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

30788.quote: The worst thing that can happen in a democracy - as well as in an individual's life - is to become cynical about the future and lose hope.
30788.name: Hillary Clinton

30789.quote: I would describe myself as emotional and highly strung. If something upsets me, it really upsets me. If something makes me angry, I get really angry. But it's all very upfront. I can't hide it. I'm also loyal and I hope I'm fun.
30789.name: Nicole Kidman

30790.quote: Faith is not simply a patience that passively suffers until the storm is past. Rather, it is a spirit that bears things - with resignations, yes, but above all, with blazing, serene hope.
30790.name: Corazon Aquino

30791.quote: If you wish to succeed in life, make perseverance your bosom friend, experience your wise counselor, caution your elder brother, and hope your guardian genius.
30791.name: Joseph Addison

30792.quote: Our forces saved the remnants of the Jewish people of Europe for a new life and a new hope in the reborn land of Israel. Along with all men of good will, I salute the young state and wish it well.
30792.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower

30793.quote: Middle age is when you're sitting at home on a Saturday night and the telephone rings and you hope it isn't for you.
30793.name: Ogden Nash

30794.quote: To hope means to be ready at every moment for that which is not yet born, and yet not become desperate if there is no birth in our lifetime.
30794.name: Erich Fromm

30795.quote: When people talk of the freedom of writing, speaking or thinking I cannot choose but laugh. No such thing ever existed. No such thing now exists but I hope it will exist. But it must be hundreds of years after you and I shall write and speak no more.
30795.name: John Adams

30796.quote: Hope is the pillar that holds up the world. Hope is the dream of a waking man.
30796.name: Pliny the Elder

30797.quote: God's mercy and grace give me hope - for myself, and for our world.
30797.name: Billy Graham

30798.quote: War is just when it is necessary arms are permissible when there is no hope except in arms.
30798.name: Niccolo Machiavelli

30799.quote: My friends, love is better than anger. Hope is better than fear. Optimism is better than despair. So let us be loving, hopeful and optimistic. And we'll change the world.
30799.name: Jack Layton

30800.quote: Hope is the word which God has written on the brow of every man.
30800.name: Victor Hugo

30801.quote: There is no medicine like hope, no incentive so great, and no tonic so powerful as expectation of something tomorrow.
30801.name: Orison Swett Marden

30802.quote: The only way I'd be caught without makeup is if my radio fell in the bathtub while I was taking a bath and electrocuted me and I was in between makeup at home. I hope my husband would slap a little lipstick on me before he took me to the morgue.
30802.name: Dolly Parton

30803.quote: It is a vain hope to make people happy by politics.
30803.name: Thomas Carlyle

30804.quote: Marriage is the death of hope.
30804.name: Woody Allen

30805.quote: At twenty a man is full of fight and hope. He wants to reform the world. When he is seventy he still wants to reform the world, but he know he can't.
30805.name: Rodney Dangerfield

30806.quote: Fifty percent of people won't vote, and fifty percent don't read newspapers. I hope it's the same fifty percent.
30806.name: Gore Vidal

30807.quote: Present, n. That part of eternity dividing the domain of disappointment from the realm of hope.
30807.name: Ambrose Bierce

30808.quote: There is no despair so absolute as that which comes with the first moments of our first great sorrow, when we have not yet known what it is to have suffered and be healed, to have despaired and have recovered hope.
30808.name: George Eliot

30809.quote: Religion. A daughter of Hope and Fear, explaining to Ignorance the nature of the Unknowable.
30809.name: Ambrose Bierce

30810.quote: People crushed by laws, have no hope but to evade power. If the laws are their enemies, they will be enemies to the law and those who have most to hope and nothing to lose will always be dangerous.
30810.name: Edmund Burke

30811.quote: Why are we so full of restraint? Why do we not give in all directions? Is it fear of losing ourselves? Until we do lose ourselves there is no hope of finding ourselves.
30811.name: Henry Miller

30812.quote: The most insignificant people are the most apt to sneer at others. They are safe from reprisals. And have no hope of rising in their own self esteem but by lowering their neighbors.
30812.name: William Hazlitt

30813.quote: The less we deserve good fortune, the more we hope for it.
30813.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

30814.quote: I hope for nothing. I fear nothing. I am free.
30814.name: Nikos Kazantzakis

30815.quote: I'm a romantic a sentimental person thinks things will last, a romantic person hopes against hope that they won't.
30815.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

30816.quote: Neither should a ship rely on one small anchor, nor should life rest on a single hope.
30816.name: Epictetus

30817.quote: I knew I was a winner back in the late sixties. I knew I was destined for great things. People will say that kind of thinking is totally immodest. I agree. Modesty is not a word that applies to me in any way - I hope it never will.
30817.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

30818.quote: It is in the admission of ignorance and the admission of uncertainty that there is a hope for the continuous motion of human beings in some direction that doesn't get confined, permanently blocked, as it has so many times before in various periods in the history of man.
30818.name: Richard P. Feynman

30819.quote: Man is, properly speaking, based upon hope, he has no other possession but hope this world of his is emphatically the place of hope.
30819.name: Thomas Carlyle

30820.quote: Solitude is not something you must hope for in the future. Rather, it is a deepening of the present, and unless you look for it in the present you will never find it.
30820.name: Thomas Merton

30821.quote: Be prepared, work hard, and hope for a little luck. Recognize that the harder you work and the better prepared you are, the more luck you might have.
30821.name: Ed Bradley

30822.quote: Man needs, for his happiness, not only the enjoyment of this or that, but hope and enterprise and change.
30822.name: Bertrand Russell

30823.quote: Conservatism is not about leaving people behind. Conservatism is about empowering people to catch up, to give them the tools at their disposable that make it possible for them to access all the hope, all the promise, all the opportunity that America offers. And our programs to help them should reflect that.
30823.name: Marco Rubio

30824.quote: Confidence is that feeling by which the mind embarks in great and honorable courses with a sure hope and trust in itself.
30824.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

30825.quote: I hope that posterity will judge me kindly, not only as to the things which I have explained, but also to those which I have intentionally omitted so as to leave to others the pleasure of discovery.
30825.name: Rene Descartes

30826.quote: But what we call our despair is often only the painful eagerness of unfed hope.
30826.name: George Eliot

30827.quote: If the United Nations once admits that international disputes can be settled by using force, then we will have destroyed the foundation of the organization and our best hope of establishing a world order.
30827.name: Dwight D. Eisenhower

30828.quote: Litigant. A person about to give up his skin for the hope of retaining his bones.
30828.name: Ambrose Bierce

30829.quote: Woe to the man whose heart has not learned while young to hope, to love - and to put its trust in life.
30829.name: Joseph Conrad

30830.quote: When things are bad, we take comfort in the thought that they could always get worse. And when they are, we find hope in the thought that things are so bad they have to get better.
30830.name: Malcolm Forbes

30831.quote: While it is important for people to see your promise you must also remember that hope is the keeper of both happiness and disappointment, the father of both progress and failure.
30831.name: Bryant H. McGill

30832.quote: In a World where people are surrounded by darkness, ignorance and fear, it is a sign of hope to be celebrating Islam's message of peace and light, and the last great Messenger, born and chosen to deliver them to all mankind.
30832.name: Cat Stevens

30833.quote: Today's students can put dope in their veins or hope in their brains. If they can conceive it and believe it, they can achieve it. They must know it is not their aptitude but their attitude that will determine their altitude.
30833.name: Jesse Jackson

30834.quote: Every parent is at some time the father of the unreturned prodigal, with nothing to do but keep his house open to hope.
30834.name: John Ciardi

30835.quote: We should not moor a ship with one anchor, or our life with one hope.
30835.name: Epictetus

30836.quote: All the interests of my reason, speculative as well as practical, combine in the three following questions: 1. What can I know? 2. What ought I to do? 3. What may I hope?
30836.name: Immanuel Kant

30837.quote: Hope, deceiving as it is, serves at least to lead us to the end of our lives by an agreeable route.
30837.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

30838.quote: The mind is never satisfied with the objects immediately before it, but is always breaking away from the present moment, and losing itself in schemes of future felicity, The natural flights of the human mind are not from pleasure to pleasure, but from hope to hope.
30838.name: Samuel Johnson

30839.quote: Gratitude is merely the secret hope of further favors.
30839.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

30840.quote: Love can no more continue without a constant motion than fire can and when once you take hope and fear away, you take from it its very life and being.
30840.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

30841.quote: Hope is the greatest thing for moms of autism. Hope is what gets us out of bed in the morning. I'm on a mission to tell parents that there is a way.
30841.name: Jenny McCarthy

30842.quote: I hope you love birds too. It is economical. It saves going to heaven.
30842.name: Emily Dickinson

30843.quote: Comedy is defiance. It's a snort of contempt in the face of fear and anxiety. And it's the laughter that allows hope to creep back on the inhale.
30843.name: Will Durst

30844.quote: Keep all special thoughts and memories for lifetimes to come. Share these keepsakes with others to inspire hope and build from the past, which can bridge to the future.
30844.name: Mattie Stepanek

30845.quote: Many believe - and I believe - that I have been designated for this work by God. In spite of my old age, I do not want to give it up I work out of love for God and I put all my hope in Him.
30845.name: Michelangelo

30846.quote: In most of mankind gratitude is merely a secret hope of further favors.
30846.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

30847.quote: I hate the idea of causes, and if I had to choose between betraying my country and betraying my friend, I hope I should have the guts to betray my country.
30847.name: E. M. Forster

30848.quote: Little progress can be made by merely attempting to repress what is evil. Our great hope lies in developing what is good.
30848.name: Calvin Coolidge

30849.quote: The charm of fishing is that it is the pursuit of what is elusive but attainable, a perpetual series of occasions for hope.
30849.name: John Buchan

30850.quote: I have often said that I wish I had invented blue jeans: the most spectacular, the most practical, the most relaxed and nonchalant. They have expression, modesty, sex appeal, simplicity - all I hope for in my clothes.
30850.name: Yves Saint Laurent

30851.quote: If you start in the pit of despair with these profane, awful things, even a glimmer of hope or awareness is going to occur that's much brighter coming from this dark, awful beginning.
30851.name: Chuck Palahniuk

30852.quote: I hope all of you are going to fill out your census form when it comes in the mail next month. If you don't return the form the area you live in might get less government money and you wouldn't want that to happen, would you.
30852.name: Andy Rooney

30853.quote: The future is not Big Government. Self-serving politicians. Powerful bureaucrats. This has been tried, tested throughout history. The result has always been disaster. President Obama, your agenda is not new. It's not change, and it's not hope.
30853.name: Rush Limbaugh

30854.quote: Hope begins in the dark, the stubborn hope that if you just show up and try to do the right thing, the dawn will come. You wait and watch and work: you don't give up.
30854.name: Anne Lamott

30855.quote: Isn't it the moment of most profound doubt that gives birth to new certainties? Perhaps hopelessness is the very soil that nourishes human hope perhaps one could never find sense in life without first experiencing its absurdity.
30855.name: Vaclav Havel

30856.quote: Man's only true happiness is to live in hope of something to be won by him. Reverence something to be worshipped by him, and love something to be cherished by him, forever.
30856.name: John Ruskin

30857.quote: Hope is the feeling we have that the feeling we have is not permanent.
30857.name: Mignon McLaughlin

30858.quote: Ideology, politics and journalism, which luxuriate in failure, are impotent in the face of hope and joy.
30858.name: P. J. O'Rourke

30859.quote: But what is Hope? Nothing but the paint on the face of Existence the least touch of truth rubs it off, and then we see what a hollow-cheeked harlot we have got hold of.
30859.name: Lord Byron

30860.quote: How wonderful that we have met with a paradox. Now we have some hope of making progress.
30860.name: Niels Bohr

30861.quote: Let's drink to the spirit of gallantry and courage that made a strange Heaven out of unbelievable Hell, and let's drink to the hope that one day this country of ours, which we love so much, will find dignity and greatness and peace again.
30861.name: Noel Coward

30862.quote: Children are God's Apostles, sent forth, day by day, to preach of love, and hope, and peace.
30862.name: James Russell Lowell

30863.quote: In the night of death, hope sees a star, and listening love can hear the rustle of a wing.
30863.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

30864.quote: I really feel like life will dictate itself. You should allow it to unfold as naturally as possible. Just go with the flow. When you're really desperate, you say a few prayers and hope for the best. That's the way I've always lived my life.
30864.name: Shania Twain

30865.quote: One thing I hope I'll never be is drunk with my own power. And anybody who says I am will never work in this town again.
30865.name: Jim Carrey

30866.quote: I hope to have communion with the people, that is the most important thing.
30866.name: Pope John Paul II

30867.quote: Love is a springtime plant that perfumes everything with its hope, even the ruins to which it clings.
30867.name: Gustave Flaubert

30868.quote: A mission is a place where you ask nonbelievers to come and find faith and hope and feel love.
30868.name: Robert H. Schuller

30869.quote: I'm not the type of guy who enjoys one-night stands. It leaves me feeling very empty and cynical. It's not even fun sexually. I need to feel something for the woman and entertain the vain hope that it may lead to a relationship.
30869.name: Ben Affleck

30870.quote: Yesterday I was a dog. Today I'm a dog. Tomorrow I'll probably still be a dog. Sigh! There's so little hope for advancement.
30870.name: Charles M. Schulz

30871.quote: You can't go around hoping that most people have sterling moral characters. The most you can hope for is that people will pretend that they do.
30871.name: Fran Lebowitz

30872.quote: I hope it is true that a man can die and yet not only live in others but give them life, and not only life, but that great consciousness of life.
30872.name: Jack Kerouac

30873.quote: Compromise is but the sacrifice of one right or good in the hope of retaining another - too often ending in the loss of both.
30873.name: Tryon Edwards

30874.quote: The happy Union of these States is a wonder their Constitution a miracle their example the hope of Liberty throughout the world.
30874.name: James Madison

30875.quote: In the long term we can hope that religion will change the nature of man and reduce conflict. But history is not encouraging in this respect. The bloodiest wars in history have been religious wars.
30875.name: Richard M. Nixon

30876.quote: Today I can declare my hope and declare it from the bottom of my heart that we will eventually see the time when that number of nuclear weapons is down to zero and the world is a much better place.
30876.name: Colin Powell

30877.quote: None who have always been free can understand the terrible fascinating power of the hope of freedom to those who are not free.
30877.name: Pearl S. Buck

30878.quote: The youth is the hope of our future.
30878.name: Jose Rizal

30879.quote: Nor dread nor hope attend a dying animal a man awaits his end dreading and hoping all.
30879.name: William Butler Yeats

30880.quote: Among physicists, I'm respected I hope.
30880.name: Stephen Hawking

30881.quote: I hope that no more groans of wounded men and women will ever go to the ear of the Great Spirit Chief above, and that all people may be one people.
30881.name: Chief Joseph

30882.quote: What we hope ever to do with ease, we must learn first to do with diligence.
30882.name: Samuel Johnson

30883.quote: Exploiting people's emotions of fear, envy and anxiety is not hope, it's not change, it's partisanship. We don't need partisanship. We don't need demagoguery, we need solutions.
30883.name: Paul Ryan

30884.quote: I wish you a tolerable Thursday. That's all any of us can hope for.
30884.name: April Winchell

30885.quote: There is a subconscious way of taking violence as a way of expression, as a normality, and it has a lot of effects in the youth in the way they absorb education and what they hope to get out of life.
30885.name: Salma Hayek

30886.quote: The hope and change the Democrats had in mind was nothing more than a retread of the failed and discredited socialist policies that have been the enemy of freedom for centuries all over the world. I fear America is teetering towards tyranny.
30886.name: Jim DeMint

30887.quote: I want no epitaphs of profound history and all that type of thing. I contributed. I would hope they would say that, and I would hope somebody liked me.
30887.name: Brian Clough

30888.quote: We are long before we are convinced that happiness is never to be found, and each believes it possessed by others, to keep alive the hope of obtaining it for himself.
30888.name: Samuel Johnson

30889.quote: The natural flights of the human mind are not from pleasure to pleasure, but from hope to hope.
30889.name: Samuel Johnson

30890.quote: Hope is being able to see that there is light despite all of the darkness.
30890.name: Desmond Tutu

30891.quote: Pessimists are the people who have no hope for themselves or for others. Pessimists are also people who think the human race is beneath their notice, that they're better than other human beings.
30891.name: James A. Baldwin

30892.quote: The sea, the great unifier, is man's only hope. Now, as never before, the old phrase has a literal meaning: we are all in the same boat.
30892.name: Jacques Yves Cousteau

30893.quote: The present is the ever moving shadow that divides yesterday from tomorrow. In that lies hope.
30893.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

30894.quote: Absence from whom we love is worse than death, and frustrates hope severer than despair.
30894.name: William Cowper

30895.quote: Hope is a state of mind, not of the world. Hope, in this deep and powerful sense, is not the same as joy that things are going well, or willingness to invest in enterprises that are obviously heading for success, but rather an ability to work for something because it is good.
30895.name: Vaclav Havel

30896.quote: For me, already being part of a single parent household and knowing it was just me and my mom, you'd would wake up times and hope that the next day you'd be able to be alongside your mother because she was out trying to make sure that I was taken care of. But all I cared about was her being home.
30896.name: LeBron James

30897.quote: A strange thing is memory, and hope one looks backward, and the other forward one is of today, the other of tomorrow. Memory is history recorded in our brain, memory is a painter, it paints pictures of the past and of the day.
30897.name: Grandma Moses

30898.quote: Your ordinary acts of love and hope point to the extraordinary promise that every human life is of inestimable value.
30898.name: Desmond Tutu
