30899.quote: If I had to choose between betraying my country and betraying my friend, I hope I should have the guts to betray my country.
30899.name: E. M. Forster

30900.quote: Hope is the only bee that makes honey without flowers.
30900.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

30901.quote: When too many Americans don't vote or participate, some see apathy and despair. I see disappointment and even outrage. And I believe that out of this frustration can come hope and action.
30901.name: Paul Wellstone

30902.quote: At the end of the day, all you can hope for is to go on. The older I get, the more I realize that just keeping on keeping on is what life's all about.
30902.name: Janis Ian

30903.quote: This man is freed from servile bands, Of hope to rise, or fear to fall Lord of himself, though not of lands, And leaving nothing, yet hath all.
30903.name: Lord Byron

30904.quote: From too much love of living, From hope and fear set free, We thank with brief thanksgiving Whatever gods may be That no life lives for ever That dead men rise up never That even the weariest river Winds somewhere safe to sea.
30904.name: Algernon Charles Swinburne

30905.quote: When I was young, my ambition was to be one of the people who made a difference in this world. My hope is to leave the world a little better for having been there.
30905.name: Jim Henson

30906.quote: I know some people say I can be funny. But there is always a deeper meaning to what I say. I am a socialist at heart and have the interests of the poor in mind. When people see how I manage to work my way out of tough situations, it gives them hope in their own life.
30906.name: Lalu Prasad Yadav

30907.quote: I've learnt that through life you just get on with it. You're going to meet a lot of dishonest people along the line and you say good luck to them. I hope they live in comfort. Then I start sticking more pins in their effigies.
30907.name: Roger Moore

30908.quote: Hope travels through, nor quits us when we die.
30908.name: Alexander Pope

30909.quote: If you keep thinking about what you want to do or what you hope will happen, you don't do it, and it won't happen.
30909.name: Desiderius Erasmus

30910.quote: I hope to make people realize how totally helpless animals are, how dependent on us, trusting as a child must that we will be kind and take care of their needs.
30910.name: James Herriot

30911.quote: I hope I am remembered by my children as a good father.
30911.name: Orson Scott Card

30912.quote: Every year we celebrate the holy season of Advent, O God. Every year we pray those beautiful prayers of longing and waiting, and sing those lovely songs of hope and promise.
30912.name: Karl Rahner

30913.quote: It is practically impossible to teach good programming to students that have had a prior exposure to BASIC: as potential programmers they are mentally mutilated beyond hope of regeneration.
30913.name: Edsger Dijkstra

30914.quote: Well, I'm like a drug addict, I'm always saying I'm going to stop, and then I don't, what I've said consistently is that I hope I know when to stop: when it starts to get repetitive.
30914.name: Stephen King

30915.quote: You cannot hope to sweep someone else away by the force of your writing until it has been done to you.
30915.name: Stephen King

30916.quote: If we were logical, the future would be bleak, indeed. But we are more than logical. We are human beings, and we have faith, and we have hope, and we can work.
30916.name: Jacques Yves Cousteau

30917.quote: You just have to keep trying to do good work, and hope that it leads to more good work. I want to look back on my career and be proud of the work, and be proud that I tried everything. Yes, I want to look back and know that I was terrible at a variety of things.
30917.name: Jon Stewart

30918.quote: An athlete cannot run with money in his pockets. He must run with hope in his heart and dreams in his head.
30918.name: Emil Zatopek

30919.quote: Nothing that is worth doing can be achieved in a lifetime therefore we must be saved by hope.
30919.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

30920.quote: Few tragedies can be more extensive than the stunting of life, few injustices deeper than the denial of an opportunity to strive or even to hope, by a limit imposed from without, but falsely identified as lying within.
30920.name: Stephen Jay Gould

30921.quote: Now, I look at where I am now and I know what I wanna to do. What I would like to be able to do is to spend whatever time I have left and to give, and maybe some hope to others.
30921.name: Jim Valvano

30922.quote: All people hope Islam helps everything in life. Islam will make jobs. Islam will make freedom. Islam will make everything.
30922.name: Ahmed Ali

30923.quote: Drugs are the enemies of ambition and hope - and when we fight against drugs we are fighting for the future.
30923.name: Bob Riley

30924.quote: In economics, hope and faith coexist with great scientific pretension and also a deep desire for respectability.
30924.name: John Kenneth Galbraith

30925.quote: Being generous or doing things for others actually makes me feel good so I don't do it because I hope karma will come round and get me and I'll benefit from it.
30925.name: David Schwimmer

30926.quote: I just hope that our fans are people who are inspired by music, and just use our music as a background or inspiration for whatever it is they do.
30926.name: Maynard James Keenan

30927.quote: The results of political changes are hardly ever those which their friends hope or their foes fear.
30927.name: Thomas Huxley

30928.quote: It's a good place when all you have is hope and not expectations.
30928.name: Danny Boyle

30929.quote: I had in mind a message, although I hope it doesn't intrude too badly, persuading Americans, and especially Southerners, of the critical importance of land and our vanishing natural environment and wildlife.
30929.name: E. O. Wilson

30930.quote: The secret is not to give up hope. It's very hard not to because if you're really doing something worthwhile I think you will be pushed to the brink of hopelessness before you come through the other side.
30930.name: George Lucas

30931.quote: You all know that I have been sustained throughout my life by three saving graces - my family, my friends, and a faith in the power of resilience and hope. These graces have carried me through difficult times and they have brought more joy to the good times than I ever could have imagined.
30931.name: Elizabeth Edwards

30932.quote: Where I am today, I still have my ups and downs, but I take it one day at a time and I just hope that I can be the best that I can possibly be, not only for myself, but also young people that are out there today that need someone to look up to.
30932.name: Demi Lovato

30933.quote: Many possessions, if they do not make a man better, are at least expected to make his children happier and this pathetic hope is behind many exertions.
30933.name: George Santayana

30934.quote: A good question is never answered. It is not a bolt to be tightened into place but a seed to be planted and to bear more seed toward the hope of greening the landscape of idea.
30934.name: John Ciardi

30935.quote: I do not at all have the mind of a bully, in my mind bullies are intolerant of contrary opinion, domineering and rather cowardly. I would hope that none of those terms could be fairly used in describing me.
30935.name: Conrad Black

30936.quote: In love, unlike most other passions, the recollection of what you have had and lost is always better than what you can hope for in the future.
30936.name: Stendhal

30937.quote: I hope I didn't bore you too much with my life story.
30937.name: Elvis Presley

30938.quote: All I can do is leave it in God's hands and hope that my fans feel where I'm coming from.
30938.name: Aaliyah

30939.quote: Hope is the best possession. None are completely wretched but those who are without hope. Few are reduced so low as that.
30939.name: William Hazlitt

30940.quote: Not without hope we suffer and we mourn.
30940.name: William Wordsworth

30941.quote: The cause of my life has been to oppose superstition. It's a battle you can't hope to win - it's a battle that's going to go on forever. It's part of the human condition.
30941.name: Christopher Hitchens

30942.quote: I hope for the day when everyone can speak again of God without embarrassment.
30942.name: Paul Tillich

30943.quote: If we hope for what we are not likely to possess, we act and think in vain, and make life a greater dream and shadow than it really is.
30943.name: Joseph Addison

30944.quote: The reason I never give up hope is because everything is so basically hopeless.
30944.name: Anne Lamott

30945.quote: Hope has a good memory, gratitude a bad one.
30945.name: Baltasar Gracian

30946.quote: I hope to die in the saddle seat.
30946.name: Albert Ellis

30947.quote: I'm hopeful. I know there is a lot of ambition in Washington, obviously. But I hope the ambitious realize that they are more likely to succeed with success as opposed to failure.
30947.name: George W. Bush

30948.quote: What can I know? What ought I to do? What can I hope?
30948.name: Immanuel Kant

30949.quote: The only hope of socialism resides in those who have already brought about in themselves, as far as is possible in the society of today, that union between manual and intellectual labor which characterizes the society we are aiming at.
30949.name: Simone Weil

30950.quote: Art is the most beautiful deception of all. And although people try to incorporate the everyday events of life in it, we must hope that it will remain a deception lest it become a utilitarian thing, sad as a factory.
30950.name: Claude Debussy

30951.quote: If you hope for happiness in the world, hope for it from God, and not from the world.
30951.name: David Brainerd

30952.quote: I hope that what you take away from my album is not just the music - which I did want to be fun, and I did want it to be about individuality, but please also take away from it that there's no dream that's too big.
30952.name: Lady Gaga

30953.quote: I know the world is filled with troubles and many injustices. But reality is as beautiful as it is ugly. I think it is just as important to sing about beautiful mornings as it is to talk about slums. I just couldn't write anything without hope in it.
30953.name: Oscar Hammerstein II

30954.quote: Hope is the denial of reality.
30954.name: Margaret Weis

30955.quote: Acting provides the fulfillment of never being fulfilled. You're never as good as you'd like to be. So there's always something to hope for.
30955.name: Washington Irving

30956.quote: Ah, Hope! what would life be, stripped of thy encouraging smiles, that teach us to look behind the dark clouds of today, for the golden beams that are to gild the morrow.
30956.name: Susanna Moodie

30957.quote: I am probably the most selfish man you will ever meet in your life. No one gets the satisfaction or the joy that I get out of seeing kids realize there is hope.
30957.name: Jerry Lewis

30958.quote: A radical inner transformation and rise to a new level of consciousness might be the only real hope we have in the current global crisis brought on by the dominance of the Western mechanistic paradigm.
30958.name: Stanislav Grof

30959.quote: I am a beneficiary of the American people's generosity, and I hope we can have comprehensive immigration legislation that allows this country to continue to be enriched by those who were not born here.
30959.name: Madeleine Albright

30960.quote: The screen is a magic medium. It has such power that it can retain interest as it conveys emotions and moods that no other art form can hope to tackle.
30960.name: Stanley Kubrick

30961.quote: It is the around-the-corner brand of hope that prompts people to action, while the distant hope acts as an opiate.
30961.name: Eric Hoffer

30962.quote: About the most originality that any writer can hope to achieve honestly is to steal with good judgment.
30962.name: Josh Billings

30963.quote: Expect to have hope rekindled. Expect your prayers to be answered in wondrous ways. The dry seasons in life do not last. The spring rains will come again.
30963.name: Sarah Ban Breathnach

30964.quote: Hundreds of thousands of American servicemen and women are deployed across the world in the war on terror. By bringing hope to the oppressed, and delivering justice to the violent, they are making America more secure.
30964.name: George W. Bush

30965.quote: I can only hope to be 10 percent of the mom mine was to me. She encouraged me to be confident and enjoy life. That's what I want for my son.
30965.name: Charlize Theron

30966.quote: I would hope that a wise Latina woman with the richness of her experiences would more often than not reach a better conclusion than a white male who hasn't lived that life.
30966.name: Sonia Sotomayor

30967.quote: My hopes are not always realized, but I always hope.
30967.name: Ovid

30968.quote: I don't feel a lack of hope. It's just disappointment that after all these years we're still fighting meaningless wars for a handful of people.
30968.name: Geezer Butler

30969.quote: A man must love a thing very much if he not only practices it without any hope of fame and money, but even, without any hope of doing it well.
30969.name: Oliver Herford

30970.quote: Theater is, of course, a reflection of life. Maybe we have to improve life before we can hope to improve theater.
30970.name: William Ralph Inge

30971.quote: Concerning God, freewill and destiny: Of all that earth has been or yet may be, all that vain men imagine or believe, or hope can paint or suffering may achieve, we descanted.
30971.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

30972.quote: When he is late for dinner and I know he must be either having an affair or lying dead in the street, I always hope he's dead.
30972.name: Judith Viorst

30973.quote: Like all of us in this storm between birth and death, I can wreak no great changes on the world, only small changes for the better, I hope, in the lives of those I love.
30973.name: Dean Koontz

30974.quote: A propensity to hope and joy is real riches one to fear and sorrow real poverty.
30974.name: David Hume

30975.quote: Blues are the songs of despair, but gospel songs are the songs of hope.
30975.name: Mahalia Jackson

30976.quote: Everyone who feels stuck in the Obama economy is right to focus on the here and now. And I hope you understand this too, if you're feeling left out or passed by: You have not failed, your leaders have failed you.
30976.name: Paul Ryan

30977.quote: A great tennis career is something that a 15-year-old normally doesn't have. I hope my example helps other teens believe they can accomplish things they never thought possible.
30977.name: Maria Sharapova

30978.quote: Anarchy is the only slight glimmer of hope.
30978.name: Mick Jagger

30979.quote: Hope founded upon a human being, a man-made philosophy or any institution is always misplaced, because these things are unreliable and fleeting.
30979.name: Charles Stanley

30980.quote: I hope that you will learn to take responsibility for your decisions. don't take counsel of your fears.
30980.name: Thomas S. Monson

30981.quote: Minds that are ill at ease are agitated by both hope and fear.
30981.name: Ovid

30982.quote: Just as despair can come to one only from other human beings, hope, too, can be given to one only by other human beings.
30982.name: Elie Wiesel

30983.quote: But then there are magical, beautiful things in the world. There's incredible acts of kindness and bravery, and in the most unlikely places, and it gives you hope.
30983.name: Dave Matthews

30984.quote: When I consider life, it is all a cheat. Yet fooled with hope, people favor this deceit.
30984.name: John Dryden

30985.quote: My hope is that gays will be running the world, because then there would be no war. Just a greater emphasis on military apparel.
30985.name: Roseanne Barr

30986.quote: One of the most difficult things everyone has to learn is that for your entire life you must keep fighting and adjusting if you hope to survive. No matter who you are or what your position is you must keep fighting for whatever it is you desire to achieve.
30986.name: Sr. George Allen

30987.quote: Faith is the very first thing you should pack in a hope chest.
30987.name: Sarah Ban Breathnach

30988.quote: I hope that people will finally come to realize that there is only one 'race' - the human race - and that we are all members of it.
30988.name: Margaret Atwood

30989.quote: Architecture is basically a container of something. I hope they will enjoy not so much the teacup, but the tea.
30989.name: Yoshio Taniguchi

30990.quote: Hope is not the conviction that something will turn out well but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
30990.name: Vaclav Havel

30991.quote: If someone decides to be a musician now, it means because there is no hope of money at the end of it, it means they really want to be a musician. And if someone is writing now, there is no hope for money at the end of it.
30991.name: Doug Coupland

30992.quote: It took me less than half a lifetime to realize that regret is one of the few guaranteed certainties. Sooner or later everything is touched by it, despite our naive and senseless hope that just this time we will be spared its cold hand on our heart.
30992.name: Jonathan Carroll

30993.quote: Hope is a great falsifier. Let good judgment keep her in check.
30993.name: Baltasar Gracian

30994.quote: The origin of the absurd idea of immortal life is easy to discover it is kept alive by hope and fear, by childish faith, and by cowardice.
30994.name: Clarence Darrow

30995.quote: A lot of people, because of my contempt for the false consolations of religion, think of me as a symbolic public opponent of that in extremis. And sometimes that makes me feel a bit alarmed, to be the repository of other people's hope.
30995.name: Christopher Hitchens

30996.quote: There are only two lasting bequests we can hope to give our children. One of these is roots, the other, wings.
30996.name: Hodding Carter

30997.quote: Under Barack Obama, the only 'Change' is that 'Hope' has been hard to find. Now millions of Americans are insecure about their future. But instead of inspiring us by reminding us of what makes us special, he divides us against each other. He tells Americans they're worse off because others are better off. That people got rich by making others poor.
30997.name: Marco Rubio

30998.quote: I hope I'm wrong, but I am afraid that Iraq is going to turn out to be the greatest disaster in American foreign policy - worse than Vietnam, not in the number who died, but in terms of its unintended consequences and its reverberation throughout the region.
30998.name: Madeleine Albright

30999.quote: I hope when I'm dead I'll be considered an icon, though.
30999.name: Lady Gaga

31000.quote: Designing a house is like doing a movie: Once you're done, you want to say, 'I hope you all enjoy it.'
31000.name: Jennifer Aniston

31001.quote: There can be hope only for a society which acts as one big family, not as many separate ones.
31001.name: Anwar Sadat

31002.quote: Hope lies in dreams, in imagination, and in the courage of those who dare to make dreams into reality.
31002.name: Jonas Salk

31003.quote: I doubt I'll be singing forever, because at some point people aren't going to want to hear my music, and I hope that I'll still get the opportunity to write songs.
31003.name: Adele

31004.quote: I see the whole concept of Generation X implies that everyone has lost hope.
31004.name: Alanis Morissette

31005.quote: Just as a mother finds pleasure in taking her little child on her lap, there to feed and caress him, in like manner our loving God shows His fondness for His beloved souls who have given themselves entirely to Him and have placed all their hope in His goodness.
31005.name: Alphonsus Liguori

31006.quote: One must always hope when one is desperate, and doubt when one hopes.
31006.name: Gustave Flaubert

31007.quote: To my great disappointment, it appears that the politics of division are making a big comeback. Many Americans share my disappointment - especially those who were filled with great hope a few years ago, when then-Senator Obama announced his candidacy in Springfield, Illinois.
31007.name: Paul Ryan

31008.quote: Hope and change? We're not doing that anymore. They're doing attack and blame. And so, I just think people are going to see through this. They want real leadership. They want us to get this country on the right track.
31008.name: Paul Ryan

31009.quote: We really feel happier when things look bleak. Hope is endurance. Hope is holding on and going on and trusting in the Lord.
31009.name: Michael Novak

31010.quote: Who dares nothing, need hope for nothing.
31010.name: Friedrich Schiller

31011.quote: I hope that women everywhere will wear this jewelry and feel the passion and love that is, to me, the real spirit of True Harmony.
31011.name: Carol Alt

31012.quote: Someday I hope to write a book where the royalties will pay for the copies I give away.
31012.name: Clarence Darrow

31013.quote: One of my favorite people is Gypsy Rose Lee. She bears out the Biblical promise that he who has, gets. And I hope she gets a lot more.
31013.name: Hedy Lamarr

31014.quote: If you use your imagination, you can look at any actress and see her nude, I hope to make you use your imagination.
31014.name: Hedy Lamarr

31015.quote: Having a sense of purpose is having a sense of self. A course to plot is a destination to hope for.
31015.name: Bryant H. McGill

31016.quote: Truth is not a matter of fact but a state of harmony with progress and hope. Enveloped only in its wings will we ever soar to the promise of our greater selves.
31016.name: Bryant H. McGill

31017.quote: All kids need is a little help, a little hope and somebody who believes in them.
31017.name: Magic Johnson

31018.quote: Hope is patience with the lamp lit.
31018.name: Tertullian

31019.quote: I just hope that theaters remain. I think there's something very wonderful about getting into a dark room with a bunch of people. There's something cool about that. Brings us all together in one room where we can experience all those emotions.
31019.name: Jeff Bridges

31020.quote: I hope to be scaring children for the rest of my life.
31020.name: Tom Felton

31021.quote: Counting is the religion of this generation it is its hope and its salvation.
31021.name: Gertrude Stein

31022.quote: It is natural to indulge in the illusions of hope. We are apt to shut our eyes to that siren until she allures us to our death.
31022.name: Gertrude Stein

31023.quote: Hope of ill gain is the beginning of loss.
31023.name: Democritus

31024.quote: Death is the great hope of all life the desire to expend itself to be used and consumed by its own longing for itself.
31024.name: Bryant H. McGill

31025.quote: Freedom is not a gift nor does it simply exist for us to have, but rather it is a sacred duty, and its blessed yield of hope is born from none other than the blood of the innocent.
31025.name: Bryant H. McGill

31026.quote: In the company of the accomplished, people hope it will rub off on themselves, in the company of the misfortunate, they fear it!
31026.name: Bryant H. McGill

31027.quote: The greatest joys are found not only in what we do and feel, but also in what we hope for.
31027.name: Bryant H. McGill

31028.quote: At a time when unbridled greed, malignant aggression, and existence of weapons of mass destruction threatens the survival of humanity, we should seriously consider any avenue that offers some hope.

31029.quote: I am so excited to let fans in on how important my relationship with my family is to me. I hope to motivate mothers and daughters to build lifetimes of memories together and inspire kids around the world to live their dreams.
31029.name: Miley Cyrus

31030.quote: Between the fear that something would happen and the hope that still it wouldn't, there is much more space than one thinks. On that narrow, hard, bare and dark space a lot of us spend their lives.
31030.name: Ivo Andric

31031.quote: Hope, like faith, is nothing if it is not courageous it is nothing if it is not ridiculous.
31031.name: Thornton Wilder

31032.quote: When hope is not pinned wriggling onto a shiny image or expectation, it sometimes floats forth and opens.
31032.name: Anne Lamott

31033.quote: I'm actually not a big fan of the word hope. I think it's a depressing word. I don't want to hope - I want to know. Like I don't hope there's a God, I know there's a God.
31033.name: Kelly Clarkson

31034.quote: What greater aspiration and challenge are there for a mother than the hope of raising a great son or daughter?
31034.name: Rose Kennedy

31035.quote: Right now I'm not involved with anybody, but I hope by 75 I will be again.
31035.name: Stevie Nicks

31036.quote: Every night when I go to bed, I hope that I may never wake again, and every morning renews my grief.
31036.name: Franz Schubert

31037.quote: People always ask me if I'm going to stop modeling because I have started an acting career. I hope to continue to model for years to come.
31037.name: Tyra Banks

31038.quote: The care of the Earth is our most ancient and most worthy, and after all our most pleasing responsibility. To cherish what remains of it and to foster its renewal is our only hope.
31038.name: Wendell Berry

31039.quote: Life has changed enormously, and I hope - I hope more people read good things.
31039.name: Barbara Bush

31040.quote: Like any good tree that one would hope to grow, we must set our roots deep into the ground so that what is real will prosper in the Light of Love.
31040.name: Billy Corgan

31041.quote: Life without idealism is empty indeed. We just hope or starve to death.
31041.name: Pearl S. Buck

31042.quote: They say a person needs just three things to be truly happy in this world: someone to love, something to do, and something to hope for.
31042.name: Tom Bodett

31043.quote: That's all a man can hope for during his lifetime - to set an example - and when he is dead, to be an inspiration for history.
31043.name: William McKinley

31044.quote: There is a powerful need for people to feel that gust of hope rise up again.
31044.name: Cat Stevens

31045.quote: When you put something out there into the world, there's all these words you don't want to hear, that you hope people don't say. I don't like anything that starts with 're' - like retro, reinvent, recreate - I hate that. It's always like living in the past - copying, emulating.
31045.name: Jack White

31046.quote: Her beauty didn't do her any good and she couldn't use it in any positive way or manipulative way. I just hope that people will look and see and believe in that hope of love, that hope of freedom, even if it was just for a limited time.
31046.name: Diane Kruger

31047.quote: I hope my music sets up the platform for me to be able to do lots of things - to have a cowboy-boot line, maybe, or do a perfume or makeup deal.
31047.name: Miranda Lambert

31048.quote: Logic is one thing, the human animal another. You can quite easily propose a logical solution to something and at the same time hope in your heart of hearts it won't work out.

31049.name: James Wolcott

31050.quote: I, for one, hope that youth will again revolt and again demoralize the dead weight of conformity that now lies upon us.
31050.name: Howard Mumford Jones

31051.quote: There will always be a place for us somewhere, somehow, as long as we see to it that working people fight for everything they have, everything they hope to get, for dignity, equality, democracy, to oppose war and to bring to the world a better life.

31052.quote: I try to make my life about service, and hope that one day we can all 'see' a little better because God is with everyone and everywhere.

31053.quote: I try to give people hope. Even though life is bleak, there's hope out there.
31053.name: Danielle Steel

31054.quote: My dear sister, I hope, when God Almighty in his righteous providence shall take me out of time into eternity, that it will be by a flash of lightning.
31054.name: James Otis

31055.quote: For all their current prestige, Osama bin Laden and the suicide bombers are still regarded in all but the most desperate districts of Gaza or Peshawar as romantics with little chance of more than symbolic victories, however bloody and brutal. That gives both the Middle East and the West a small and distant hope of security.
31055.name: James Buchan

31056.quote: There are no greater treasures than the highest human qualities such as compassion, courage and hope. Not even tragic accident or disaster can destroy such treasures of the heart.
31056.name: Daisaku Ikeda

31057.quote: When one takes action for others, one's own suffering is transformed into the energy that can keep one moving forward a light of hope illuminating a new tomorrow for oneself and others is kindled.

31058.quote: The worst enemy of human hope is not brute facts, but men of brains who will not face them.
31058.name: Max Eastman

31059.quote: I have been reading Stephen King since CARRIE and hope to read him for many years to come.
31059.name: Dean Koontz

31060.quote: The hope of the nation which throughout the nineteenth century had not for a moment reconciled itself with the loss of independence, and fighting for its own freedom, fought at the same time for the freedom of other nations.
31060.name: Lech Walesa

31061.quote: I hope to work harder than ever to help people around the world.
31061.name: Lech Walesa

31062.quote: Hope is like a road in the country there was never a road, but when many people walk on it, the road comes into existence.
31062.name: Lin Yutang

31063.name: Knute Nelson

31064.quote: One thing that being a scientist has taught me is that you can never be certain about anything. You never know the truth. You can only approach it and hope to get a bit nearer to it each time. You iterate towards the truth. You don't know it.
31064.name: James Lovelock

31065.quote: If the character is true, the movie will fall into place. Or at least that's what you hope.

31066.quote: For now, I'm just going to keep doing the work and hope I don't get fired. If people want to put me up on their walls, I'll love it.

31067.quote: Many will view the compromises that will be made during your negotiations as painful concessions. But why not view them as peace offerings, ones that will provide in return the priceless gifts of hope, security and freedom for our children and our children's?

31068.quote: Pity the selfishness of lovers: it is brief, a forlorn hope it is impossible.

31071.quote: They have a kind of Bob Hope and Bing Crosby thing going on.

31072.quote: One of the greatest delusions in the world is the hope that the evils in this world are to be cured by legislation.

31076.quote: I hope to inspire people, influence people.

31077.quote: There is nothing so well known as that we should not expect something for nothing - but we all do and call it Hope.

31079.quote: What I hope in my ideal world is that with each project, I'll either get to work with a really great script that would force me to grow, or work with a really great actor who will make me better.

31080.quote: I hope that anyone I worked with wouldn't exploit our relationship.
31080.name: Laura Linney

31082.quote: I don't want to make films that give you the answer. If there is a message to my films - and I hope there isn't - it's to be open-minded.

31083.quote: When you're young, you want to make every kind of film: musicals, Westerns, horror. Slowly you begin to hear your own voice. I hope people receive what I do as small, personal films that are somewhat contrarian about their main characters.

31084.quote: So, influenced by these advisors and this hope, I have at length allowed my friends to publish the work, as they had long besought me to do.
31084.name: Nicolaus Copernicus

31085.quote: As a black man, my hope is that I can touch more and more people all over the world of different races and different colours.

31086.quote: I hope you will no longer accuse me of a lack of delicacy. as I now count on your understanding.

31090.quote: I just hope I can live long enough to see the fame.

31096.quote: Change is not a destination, just as hope is not a strategy.

31097.quote: I think they'd rather us follow our hearts and I hope that's what some people will understand.

31098.quote: Americans appreciate the way our friends around the world are sticking by us, and we all hope for their continued support in what's going to be some very trying times.
31098.name: Joe Lando

31099.quote: Hope is the feeling that the feeling you have isn't permanent.

31101.quote: There's always hope. You can lose everything else in the world, but Jews never lose hope.

31104.quote: The contrasts between what is spent today to educate a child in the poorest New York City neighborhoods, where teacher salaries are often even lower than the city averages, and spending levels in the wealthiest suburban areas are daunting challenges to any hope New Yorkers might retain that even semblances of fairness still prevail.

31105.quote: If we all worked on the assumption that what is accepted as true is really true, there would be little hope of advance.

31106.quote: I don't want to hope anymore. I don't think we should hope anymore. We hoped enough. Now we have to do. We all have to do now.
31106.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

31107.quote: The poor prey on one another because their lives offer no hope and communicate the tragic message to these human beings that they have no possibility to attain a decent standard of living.
31107.name: Thabo Mbeki

31108.quote: I never make a movie for awards consideration. I will use the hope of getting an Academy Award a) to honor the people who work so hard and also b) it's the greatest Good Housekeeping seal in the world. It's the greatest brand. It's as good as Louis Vuitton and Dior in the world of moviemaking. It's the Super Bowl.
31108.name: Harvey Weinstein

31109.quote: I hope to continue my friendship with France and its filmmakers for many years to come.
31109.name: Harvey Weinstein

31110.quote: I would hope that understanding and reconciliation are not limited to the 19th hole alone.
31110.name: Gerald R. Ford

31111.quote: The great hope of society is in individual character.
31111.name: William Ellery Channing

31112.quote: I kind of call myself an atheist, I suppose - although quite a spiritual atheist, I hope.
31112.name: Danny Boyle

31113.quote: In between films I like to travel and hope to visit every continent before I become a mother.
31113.name: Diane Kruger

31114.quote: I hope I left behind a legacy that people will enjoy. But whatever they want to say, I can't predict.

31115.quote: Bottom up thinkers try to start from experience and move from experience to understanding. They don't start with certain general principles they think beforehand are likely to be true they just hope to find out what reality is like.

31116.quote: I don't know how many good books I still have in me I hope there are another four or five.
31116.name: Haruki Murakami

31117.quote: I hope I never get so hard up I have to do advertisements. I've gotten ridiculous offers.
31117.name: Tracey Ullman

31118.name: Mikhail Bakunin

31119.quote: It has never been, and never will be easy work! But the road that is built in hope is more pleasant to the traveler than the road built in despair, even though they both lead to the same destination.
31119.name: Marion Zimmer Bradley

31120.quote: You never know what movie I will be in next, but let's just hope it's sells (for my sake at least)!
31120.name: Cameron Diaz

31121.quote: What can you do if a part of it is uphill? You can't work out another route. You've just got to run the one they give you. But they tell me London is a nice course. Even the cobbles, I hope, are not very much of a problem for me.

31122.quote: Nothing you write, if you hope to be good, will ever come out as you first hoped.
31122.name: Lillian Hellman

31123.quote: We will have to give up the hope that, if we try hard, we somehow will always do right by our children. The connection is imperfect. We will sometimes do wrong.
31123.name: Judith Viorst

31124.quote: There is no hope even that woman, with her right to vote, will ever purify politics.
31124.name: Emma Goldman

31125.quote: I think by now I have made it fairly clear that I am not very happy with the word hope. I don't believe in people just hoping.
31125.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

31126.quote: My opinion is the greatest reward that any government could get is the approval of the people. If the people are happy and the people are at peace and the government has done something for them, that's the greatest reward I think any government could hope for.
31126.name: Aung San Suu Kyi

31127.quote: To communicate the truths of history is an act of hope for the future.
31127.name: Daisaku Ikeda

31128.quote: There are a lot of movies I'd like to throw away. That's not to say that I went in with that attitude. Any film I ever started, I went in with all the hope and best intentions in the world, but some films just don't work.
31128.name: Kiefer Sutherland

31129.quote: The other day I got a text from a boy, but it wasn't hot. I mean, if you're going to text me every day, you haven't seen me for months and you're trying to seduce me, you'd better spice up that text and make it more exciting than 'How was your day? I hope you're having a beautiful one.' Sadly, I haven't been doing a lot of kissing lately.
31129.name: Chloe Sevigny

31130.quote: I hope that through my example, such as my role on 'The West Wing,' I can help change attitudes on deafness and prove we can really do everything, except hear.
31130.name: Marlee Matlin

31131.quote: I hope I'm not a tourist attraction - I'm sure that they come here really because St. Andrews is just amazing, a beautiful place.
31131.name: Prince William

31132.quote: I have learned from my experiences in this industry that there is absolutely no way to control people's opinions on your performance in your movie. You go out there, promote your film and hope people like the work you did.
31132.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

31133.quote: I love Bono. I really respect what he has done for Africa and how he has used his fame to do good in the world. I hope I can do half as much in my life.
31133.name: Alicia Keys

31134.quote: Over the past few years, the road to confrontation has shown its consequences: loss of innocent lives, destruction and fear. Most costly, however, was the loss of hope. 31134.name: King Abdullah II

31135.quote: Is Israel going to continue to be 'Fortress Israel'? Or, as we all hope, become accepted into the neighborhood, which I believe is the only way we can move forward in harmony.
31135.name: King Abdullah II

31136.quote: I hope that none of the countries in the Middle East are planning anything but the peaceful utilization of nuclear energy.
31136.name: King Abdullah II

31137.quote: At the end of the day we want to bring stability and hope to Iraq. That's the only way to defeat terrorism.
31137.name: King Abdullah II

31138.quote: We have to always hope in humanity that people will make the right choices.
31138.name: King Abdullah II

31139.quote: You have to trust your kids. They have to experience life, and you just hope you've provided them a foundation for what's right and what isn't.
31139.name: Jack Nicklaus

31140.quote: I am not afraid of dying. I have lived longer than most people in the world. What scares me is to have a body that works but a brain that is waving goodbye. If that happens, I hope I die quickly.
31140.name: Henning Mankell

31141.quote: In the kind of world we have today, transformation of humanity might well be our only real hope for survival.
31141.name: Stanislav Grof

31142.quote: Looking after my health today gives me a better hope for tomorrow.
31142.name: Anne Wilson Schaef

31143.quote: I hope by the time I'm 30 to have a husband and maybe a baby.
31143.name: Vanessa Hudgens

31144.quote: They who do not understand that a man may be brought to hope that which of all things is the most grievous to him, have not observed with sufficient closeness the perversity of the human mind.
31144.name: Anthony Trollope

31145.quote: In both children and adults, there can be a hard-to-deny link between a robust sense of hope and either work productivity or academic achievement.
31145.name: Jeffrey Kluger

31146.quote: It's far too much to say that effective hoping is the only - or even the biggest - part of what it takes to succeed. 31146.name: Jeffrey Kluger

31147.quote: It seems to me there is a change in what audiences want to see. I can only hope that's correct, because there's an awful lot of people of my age around now and we outnumber the others.
31147.name: Maggie Smith

31148.quote: Today is a celebration of hope for the Iraqi people. The Iraqi people can now take control of their government and their future by creating a society that protects the rights endowed to us by our creator - life, liberty and freedom.
31148.name: Jim DeMint

31149.quote: Yes, I've listened to just a few audiobooks - but hope to listen to more. I've wanted to investigate how my own books sound in this format and find the experience of listening, and not reading, quite fascinating.
31149.name: Joyce Carol Oates

31150.quote: I have more awareness of other people and, I hope, more sensitivity to their needs. I also find that I'm more direct and outspoken.
31150.name: Christopher Reeve

31151.quote: I do sometimes strongly hope that in a past life, my most recent life before this, I was absolutely horrible, evil, hideous. Because otherwise - well, hell, to even things up next time around, I'm going to have to pay for this one, am I not?
31151.name: Vanessa Paradis

31152.quote: I have always striven to raise the voice of hope for a world where hate gives way to respect and oppression to liberation.
31152.name: Theodore Bikel

31153.quote: One of the principal goals in my life has been to avoid embarrassing my children by doing the job I do. I hope I've managed to do that, and I hope that, with the job I'm in now, they are, if not proud, at least unembarrassed by it. I must say, my three are most agreeable children, who do nothing but delight me.
31153.name: Hugh Laurie

31154.quote: Hope is a necessity for normal life and the major weapon against the suicide impulse.
31154.name: Karl A. Menninger

31155.quote: I hope the Guggenheim plan will be revived.
31155.name: David Rockefeller

31156.quote: My hope and prayer is that the body of Christ in America will awake with holy boldness, a boldness content neither with silence nor mere words but that backs up those words with action and results.
31156.name: Frank R. Wolf

31157.quote: I suppose if I'd got a brilliant first and done research I might still be a don today, but I hope not. People become dons because they are incapable of doing anything else in life.
31157.name: A. N. Wilson

31158.quote: I hope to one day co-sign a lease with another person but, well, it doesn't plague me that I have yet to do so. Put it this way: I've never had to violently tug at my own pillow at 2 A.M. to get myself to stop snoring.
31158.name: Sloane Crosley

31159.quote: I love being able to sing for my job. I am blessed beyond words and I hope my fans can feel that while I'm on stage!
31159.name: Jordin Sparks

31160.quote: I really feel confident about my dancing now, so I hope there could be a place for me in the West End or on Broadway - maybe a musical, maybe my own show.
31160.name: Katherine Jenkins

31161.quote: Overcoming the Cold War required courage from the people of Central and Eastern Europe and what was then the German Democratic Republic, but it also required the steadfastness of Western partner over many decades when many had long lost hope of integration of the two Germanys and Europe.
31161.name: Angela Merkel

31162.quote: It was an amazing adventure, it was my dream to be in an American musical, I really hope you are going to love what you are going to see.
31162.name: Marion Cotillard

31163.quote: I never read the life of any important person without discovering that he knew more and could do more than I could ever hope to know or do in half a dozen lifetimes.
31163.name: J. B. Priestley

31164.quote: We need to have a pro-growth policy put in place that offers people hope and offers the opportunity for businesses to expand and for them to have confidence in what the world is going to look like for the next two or three or four years with respect to economic policy.
31164.name: Dick Cheney

31165.quote: I am proud to have been capable of giving people hope again.
31165.name: Francois Hollande

31166.quote: I know where I'm going and I have told the French. I am sure if hope is there, we will be able to put France back on its feet, to live better in five years than we do today.

31167.quote: There are hurdles, there are handicaps, hardships you have to face in life, but you hope for a great future.
31167.name: Anil Kapoor

31168.quote: It's always been my hope, as an actor, to reveal only what is relevant about myself to the work.
31168.name: Eric Bana

31287.quote: Inventions have long since reached their limit, and I see no hope for further development.

31289.quote: You hope people are going to be listening to you after you're gone. And they like you better after you're gone.
31289.name: Tom Waits

31290.quote: As a young actor, people were trying to define who I was before I really knew that for myself. But I still remember thinking, 'This is what I love doing, and I hope I'm going to be able to do it forever.'

31296.quote: We are all here to be a service to those who can't be a service to themselves. We can give people hope and more reasons for being human.
31296.name: Dionne Warwick

31297.quote: My hope is that countries like Morocco will have investment to create work, so people don't have to leave.
31297.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

31298.quote: Yes, well I really hope I can make a difference, even in the smallest way. I am looking forward to helping as much as I can.
31298.name: Kate Middleton

31299.quote: My daddy, Rev. A. D. King, my granddaddy, Martin Luther King, Senior - we are a family of faith, hope and love.
31299.name: Alveda King

31300.quote: We're reclaiming America and restoring honor. I believe we do that with faith, with hope, with charity, and honoring our brothers and our sisters as we honor each other.

31303.name: Victoria Justice

31305.quote: When I was a kid, my father didn't really have much hope for me. He thought I was a dreamer he didn't think I would amount to anything. My mother also.
31305.name: Frank Gehry

31309.name: Khloe Kardashian

31310.name: Kevin Smith

31318.name: Bill Owens

31319.quote: I hope that at the end of the seven years, people will say that I have been of some inspirational value to them at home in terms of inclusiveness and abroad, I look forward to representing Ireland.
31319.name: Michael D. Higgins

31496.quote: I met Woz when I was 13, at a friend's garage. He was about 18. He was, like, the first person I met who knew more electronics than I did at that point. 31498.quote: Humor has been the balm of my life, but it's been reserved for those close to me, not part of the public Lana.

31499.quote: I think people are sexy when they have a sense of humor, when they are smart, when they have some sense of style, when they are kind, when they express their own opinions, when they are creative, when they have character.

31503.name: Madonna Ciccone

31506.quote: Humor has justly been regarded as the finest perfection of poetic genius.
31506.name: Thomas Carlyle

31508.quote: One of the things that binds us as a family is a shared sense of humor.
31508.name: Ralph Fiennes

31509.quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
31509.name: Lord Chesterfield

31510.quote: A sense of humor keen enough to show a man his own absurdities will keep him from the commission of all sins, or nearly all, save those worth committing.

31515.quote: Honest good humor is the oil and wine of a merry meeting, and there is no jovial companionship equal to that where the jokes are rather small and laughter abundant.

31520.quote: You are not angry with people when you laugh at them. Humor teaches tolerance.

31524.quote: I realize that humor isn't for everyone. It's only for people who want to have fun, enjoy life, and feel alive.

31525.quote: Men are happy to be laughed at for their humor, but not for their folly.
31525.name: Jonathan Swift

31526.quote: I am often the brunt of my own humor.
31526.name: Charles R. Swindoll

31527.quote: Cynicism is humor in ill health.

31528.quote: In prehistoric times, mankind often had only two choices in crisis situations: fight or flee. In modern times, humor offers us a third alternative fight, flee - or laugh.

31530.quote: It is quite true, as some poets said, that the God who created man must have had a sinister sense of humor, creating him a reasonable being, yet forcing him to take this ridiculous posture, and driving him with blind craving for this ridiculous performance.

31531.quote: I like a man who can be a real friend, has a good sense of humor, a good pair of shoes and a healthy gold card.
31531.name: Victoria Beckham

31532.quote: OK, in all seriousness, I would say I couldn't be in a relationship without equality, generosity, integrity, spirit, kindness and humor. And awesomeness.

31533.name: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

31534.quote: Confidence is at the root of so many attractive qualities, a sense of humor, a sense of style, a willingness to be who you are no matter what anyone else might think or say and it's true, I do have a certain fondness for women that have dark hair.

31535.quote: Sometimes the only way to deal with horrific things in life is through a dark sense of humor.

31606.quote: You've got to have a sense of humor to keep your sanity.

31615.quote: If one tends to be a humorous person and you have a sense of humor the rest of your life then you can certainly lighten the load, I think, by bringing that to your trials and tribulations. It's easy to have a sense of humor when everything is going well.

31616.quote: Humor is such a wonderful thing, helping you realize what a fool you are but how beautiful that is at the same time.

31617.quote: Every time I do a movie like 'Finding Neverland' or 'Chocolat' or 'Shakespeare' in Love,' we deal with the creative process, but there's humor and fun along the way. I always love that kind of movie.

31619.quote: There are just certain things that turn my head. It may be a girl's sense of humor, it may be her wit, or her belief system it could be a lot of different things.

31626.quote: Mixing humor and politics is something that works.
31626.name: Bryan Cranston

31627.quote: People with no humor, they're outta my life.
31627.name: Patti LaBelle

31628.quote: My fam is just a regular family. But all of them have great senses of humor.

31630.quote: I don't have a caustic sense of humor. What I find funny, that humor comes from a much gentler place.

31633.name: Sloane Crosley

31634.quote: I think that sense of humor is important in marriage. A sense of humor gets people through marriage.

31638.quote: I have wit in my work and a sense of humor, but I do not use irony in any way.

31639.quote: I find intelligence sexy. I find a sense of humor sexy. I find sensitivity sexy.

31640.quote: If I ever have sex with someone I might be able to develop a sense of humor.

31641.quote: I realized women and humor were linked very closely.

31642.quote: Me and Matt love to argue, but in general our sense of humor is pretty much alike.

31646.quote: God has a most wicked sense of humor.

31652.quote: If you're that hypersensitive about color and don't have a sense of humor, don't marry out of your race.

31653.quote: The humor section is the last place an author wants to be. They put your stuff next to collections of Cathy cartoons.

31665.quote: The comic is the perception of the opposite humor is the feeling of it.
31665.name: Umberto Eco

31666.quote: I wish I could be as thin as Jessica Simpson. I think she looks gorgeous! I have had Jessica on my show several times, and I can tell you that girl is genuine and funny with a great self-deprecating sense of humor.
31666.name: Rachael Ray

31667.quote: I think God has a tremendous sense of humor.
31667.name: Rainn Wilson

31668.quote: I like being a Baha'i who has an out-there sense of humor. God gives us talents and faculties, and making people laugh is one of mine.
31668.name: Rainn Wilson

31669.quote: I'm sure there are people who survive tragedy without humor, but I've never met any of them. Nor would I be particularly interested in writing about them if I did meet them.
31669.name: Ayelet Waldman

31670.quote: Men live by intervals of reason under the sovereignty of humor and passion.
31670.name: Thomas Browne

31671.quote: What's great about the geek spirit is that life never seems to stop us, and they never seem to kill our enthusiasm, our optimism and our hunger to experience the world. We keep our sense of humor, we protect our dignity, we talk to our friends about the experience and then we start again fresh the very next day.
31671.name: Paul Feig

31672.quote: Women's humor seems to be a little more supportive. It's just kind of trying to make the other one laugh through funny voices and kind of talking about other people. I respond to that. I feel less like I'm going to get beat up in a room full of women than I do in a room full of guys.
31672.name: Paul Feig

31673.quote: I want everything I do to have humor in it, because it seems to me that all of life has that.
31673.name: Lawrence Kasdan

31674.quote: Things can be funny only when we are in fun. When we're 'dead earnest,' humor is the only thing that is dead.
31674.name: Flip Wilson

31675.quote: I get asked, 'How can you have such failures in your films?' Well, what else is life about? There's some sense of constant failure in something. Humor gives you a distance from it.
31675.name: Alexander Payne

31676.quote: Humor can be an incredible, lacerating and effective weapon.
31676.name: Carl Hiaasen

31677.quote: My books are shelved in different places, depending on the bookstore. Sometimes they can be found in the Mystery section, sometimes in the Humor department, and occasionally even in the Literature aisle, which is somewhat astounding.
31677.name: Carl Hiaasen

31678.quote: Humor can be an incredible lacerating and effective weapon. And that is the way I use it.
31678.name: Carl Hiaasen

31679.quote: The first glass is for myself, the second for my friends, the third for good humor, and the forth for my enemies.
31679.name: William Temple

31680.quote: I don't think my sense of humor has changed at all I was born with this, for better or for worse.
31680.name: Ivan Reitman

31681.quote: I can't not find humor in elements of most parts of life, but at the same time nothing ever seems perpetually funny to me.
31681.name: Greg Kinnear

31682.quote: At the risk of appearing disingenuous, I don't really think of myself as 'writing humor.' I'm simply reporting on the world I observe, which is frequently hilarious.
31682.name: Richard Russo

31683.quote: I never worry about people not taking my work seriously as a result of the humor. In the end, the comic's best trick is the illusion that comedy is effortless. That people imagine what he's doing is easy is an occupational hazard.
31683.name: Richard Russo

31684.quote: Putting a little time aside for clean fun and good humor is very necessary to relieve the tensions of our time.
31684.name: Hattie McDaniel

31685.quote: Those years on the golf course as a caddie, boy, those people were something. They were vulgar, some were alcoholics, racist, they were very difficult people to deal with. A lot of them didn't have a sense of humor.
31685.name: Martin Sheen

31686.quote: You see, that's another thing that my parents gave me: an enormously great sense of humor.
31686.name: Liza Minnelli

31687.quote: People come up to me as I leave the stage after a performance and tell me tey saw my mother onstage with me every time I sing. I keep a sense of humor about it.
31687.name: Lorna Luft

31688.quote: I don't think I would describe my sense of humor. Doesn't sound like the kind of thing I'd do.
31688.name: Tommy Lee Jones

31689.quote: I think in life, the sense of humor and comedy always exists.
31689.name: Mike Epps

31690.quote: Stand-up comics reflect less of a visual humor and more of a commentary.
31690.name: Shel Silverstein

31691.quote: I can't not put humor in a book.
31691.name: Albert Brooks

31692.quote: As I get older, my sense of humor is my biggest asset.
31692.name: David Alan Grier

31693.quote: With Ricky Gervais, it's all shades of wrong, it's my kind of humor.
31693.name: Emily Blunt

31694.quote: I don't know how many sacred cows there are today. I think there's a little confusion between humor and gross passing for humor. That's kind of regrettable.
31694.name: Bob Newhart

31695.quote: I'll do humor about myself, I'll poke fun and everything, but that's me and I can do it to me. I think it's cruel to do it to somebody else.
31695.name: Delta Burke

31696.quote: I don't happen to have a sense of humor personally, so I don't know what's funny about a character, This happens to be a feature of my life generally.
31696.name: Wallace Shawn

31697.quote: With humor, it's so subjective that trying to think of what the ideal reader would think would drive you crazy.
31697.name: Calvin Trillin

31698.quote: People who know me know I have a sense of humor that can really push the envelope.
31698.name: Carmen Electra

31699.quote: Any film which views the darker side of life, which is death with a sense of humor, is very much to my taste.
31699.name: Carter Burwell

31700.quote: I love Sell Out, I think it's great. I love the jingles. The whole thing as an album is a wonderful piece of work. The cover. Everything about it. It's got humor, great songs, irony.
31700.name: Roger Daltrey

31701.quote: If golf wasn't enjoyable and there wasn't a lot of humor and enjoyment, even though the game is so frustrating, you would wonder why you put yourself through it.
31701.name: Ray Romano

31702.quote: Political correctness? In my humor, I never talk about politics. I was never much into all that.
31702.name: Don Rickles

31703.quote: Advertisers also know that humor can help bond us to their product.
31703.name: Allen Klein

31704.quote: Laughter, and the broader category of humor, are key elements in helping us go on with our life after a loss.
31704.name: Allen Klein

31705.quote: When we are dealing with death we are constantly being dragged down by the event: Humor diverts our attention and lifts our sagging spirits.
31705.name: Allen Klein

31706.quote: Whether planned or not, humor takes our mind off of our troubles.
31706.name: Allen Klein

31707.quote: Any attempts at humor immediately after September 11th were deemed tasteless.
31707.name: Allen Klein

31708.quote: Since the goal of my programs is to show audiences how humor can both help them heal as well as deal with not-so-funny stuff, I decided to discuss the events of the previous week, the pain all of us were feeling, and how humor and some laughter might be beneficial.
31708.name: Allen Klein

31709.quote: In looking for humor, keep in mind this guideline: Sometimes it takes a little time to see the humor in your upsets you may not find something to laugh about immediately.
31709.name: Allen Klein

31710.quote: Sometimes it takes ten seconds to see some humor in your dilemmas, sometimes ten years.
31710.name: Allen Klein

31711.quote: Throughout history, great leaders have known the power of humor.
31711.name: Allen Klein

31712.quote: Humor can be one of our best survival tools.
31712.name: Allen Klein

31713.quote: Today's business and health care climate may not be pleasant. Cutbacks, pay cuts and layoffs do not make anyone's job easy. But that does not mean that the humor need stop.
31713.name: Allen Klein

31714.quote: Humor can help you cope with the unbearable so that you can stay on the bright side of things until the bright side actually comes along.
31714.name: Allen Klein

31715.quote: When we can find some humor in our upsets, they no longer seem as large or as important as they once did.
31715.name: Allen Klein

31716.quote: Humor expands our limited picture frame and gets us to see more than just our problem.
31716.name: Allen Klein

31717.quote: Philip Larkin has a tough honesty and sense of humor that I find irresistible, as a contemporary poet.
31717.name: Robert Morgan

31718.quote: Sometimes the only way to make palatable that which is appalling and apprehensive is to season it with some humor.
31718.name: Terrence Howard

31719.quote: My humor tends to be a little more edgy than is appropriate for 'Twilight,' although I got some in there. That was fun! There's just a tonal difference. For me, storytelling is storytelling. But, I do like writing for grown ups.
31719.name: Melissa Rosenberg

31720.quote: Everybody's got a different sense of humor. It's just different styles.
31720.name: Colin Quinn

31721.quote: For the most part, comedians are pretty friendly with each other. They always say they badmouth each other, but most of the time, they're friends. We're the only ones that can really stand our type of humor.

31722.quote: I used to watch 'The Waltons' and sob because my family was nothing like that. We had a cruel sense of humor in my family.
31722.name: Paula Poundstone

31723.quote: Insult is powerful. Insult begets both rage and humor and often at the same time.
31723.name: Suzanne Fields

31724.quote: I think in my case, I had no choice but to have a good sense of humor. I grew up with my dad, Danny Thomas, and George Burns and Bob Hope and Milton Berle and Sid Caesar and all those guys were at our house all the time and telling jokes and making each other laugh.

31725.quote: Bathroom humor, fart, and poo poo humor in movies gets a laugh. It's a pretty easy audience, and that's been around for ages.
31725.name: Selma Blair

31726.quote: The love of truth lies at the root of much humor.
31726.name: Robertson Davies

31727.quote: I really hate sitcoms on television with canned laughter and stuff. What really makes me laugh is the real-life stuff. I've got a dry sense of humor.
31727.name: Katie Price

31728.quote: I've never met a person who has more integrity than my husband. I respect that. There's his humor and intelligence, too, and he's really cute, all those things - but if you don't respect your partner, you'll get sick of him.
31728.name: Michelle Pfeiffer

31729.quote: When you meet someone new who instantly gets you, your sense of humor and your attitudes and your worldview, even if theirs are different - and you get them in return. You both talk and talk and agree and laugh and nod and yes, yes, of course you should get another round of drinks.
31729.name: Erin Morgenstern

31730.quote: I visited Jobs for the last time in his Palo Alto, Calif., home. He had moved to a downstairs bedroom because he was too weak to go up and down stairs. He was curled up in some pain, but his mind was still sharp and his humor vibrant.

31731.quote: I think sometimes my humor is extremely dry, and a lot of times I would say things that I thought were very funny but, I have a reputation of - people think of me as a very fundamentalist, humorless fellow.

31733.quote: Even as a kid I was never the generator of humor, but I always knew who was funny, who to hang out with.

31734.quote: It felt as if things were literally slipping through my fingers. Things were just streaming away from me. I lost my sense of humor. I'm still looking for that.
31734.name: Michelle Williams

31735.quote: Our ability to find humor in the world, to make connections between previously unconnected notions, to create new ideas, to share in a common culture: All these essentially human acts depend on memory.
31735.name: Joshua Foer

31736.quote: The guys in my band are great-we watch movies, we eat pizza, take walks, read books. Everybody has a really great sense of humor. And my boyfriend comes and visits me on the road.
31736.name: Lisa Loeb

31737.quote: You can find heroism everyday, like guys working terrible jobs because they've got to support their families. Or as far as humor, the things I see on the job, on the street, are far funnier than anything you'll ever see on TV.
31737.name: Harvey Pekar

31738.quote: I consider myself to have a decent sense of humor. What's life without a sense of humor?
31738.name: Mayer Hawthorne

31739.quote: My sense of humor is a turkey, and I pull it out of the oven and baste it in reality.
31739.name: Tracy Morgan

31740.quote: To me, sadness and humor aren't disrelated and humor is the best tool I've had against the sadness in my life.
31740.name: Mike Mills

31741.quote: As a person, he was wonderful. He really was a great person. He was full of life. He had a great sense of humor. Very talented, of course, but very caring to his parents. There was a very endearing quality about Elvis.
31741.name: Priscilla Presley

31742.quote: My type of humor is me not caring whether people know what I'm talking about or not.
31742.name: John Hodgman

31743.quote: It is the ability to take a joke, not make one, that proves you have a sense of humor.
31743.name: Max Eastman

31744.quote: If you get a diagnosis, get on a therapy, keep a good attitude and keep your sense of humor.
31744.name: Teri Garr
