31745.name: Dan Castellaneta

31746.quote: I make fun of situations and try and find the humor in things, but it's never at the expense of the other guy.
31746.name: Bob Uecker

31747.quote: To this day, I've found that it doesn't matter what a guy looks like if he's really funny. His sense of humor makes him attractive. On the other hand, you don't hear men saying, 'No she's not pretty, but is she ever funny!'
31747.name: Catherine O'Hara

31748.quote: That is the saving grace of humor, if you fail no one is laughing at you.
31748.name: A. Whitney Brown

31749.quote: I tried to go out for theater or theater arts, but I was too scared or too intimidated. But I had a lot of friends on the cross country team that had great senses of humor.
31749.name: Dana Carvey

31750.quote: There are so many things to talk about between black people, Hispanic people, white people, gay people, men, women, it's all based on fear. We all have fears, this thing that stops us from embracing as we are one. We are never going to be one. People are messed up, but humor lets us see how ignorant we can be.
31750.name: Marlon Wayans

31751.quote: Humor helps ease the tension of race and the differences in society. If there wasn't comedy I don't know if Obama could have ever become president.
31751.name: Marlon Wayans

31752.quote: You learn timing on the road. You learn structure and how to read an audience. You learn so much about the business of laughter that you can't learn on a set, because it's all on you. Sometimes you bomb, and you know not to tell that joke again, You just hope people find the humor in the awkwardness.
31752.name: Marlon Wayans

31753.quote: I try to cope with everything through humor.
31753.name: Gail Porter

31754.quote: I think that different pleasures work for different readers - a friend of mine won't read anything that's not a cardiovascular sort of page-turner. I tend to care less about plot, but I'm a sucker for humor and strangeness.
31754.name: Karen Russell

31755.quote: We do not take humor seriously enough.
31755.name: Konrad Lorenz

31756.quote: Colombian humor is very black, very sarcastic.
31756.name: Barbet Schroeder

31757.quote: Some major writers have a huge impact, like Ayn Rand, who to my mind is a lousy fiction writer because her writing has no compassion and virtually no humor. She has a philosophical and economical message that she is passing off as fiction, but it really isn't fiction at all.
31757.name: Theodore Sturgeon

31758.quote: Even celebrities, most people have a sense of humor. Most of the people we meet who we've done on the show, like it.
31758.name: Matt Stone

31759.quote: Never say a humorous thing to a man who does not possess humor. He will always use it in evidence against you.
31759.name: Herbert Beerbohm Tree

31760.quote: I think hip-hop does a very good job of infusing comedy and humor and wit into music, a lot more than other genres.
31760.name: Carrie Brownstein

31761.quote: With Portlandia, I don't think our intention is always to find something funny. Sometimes the humor comes from taking something really seriously. We're okay with making somebody feel uncomfortable or uneasy.
31761.name: Carrie Brownstein

31762.quote: I try to bring it across on my record, in my dress, in what I do and what I say because to me humor is important. You should have a dose of that and I guess giving it is what I'm here for.
31762.name: Bootsy Collins

31763.quote: Men love it. They have a sense of humor, whereas a lot of women are threatened or just don't get it.
31763.name: Lara Flynn Boyle

31764.quote: I have a dark sense of humor.
31764.name: Olivia Munn

31765.quote: With actors like Steve McQueen, Paul Newman and Harrison Ford, what made them such icons is that even in dramatic movies, their characters had a sense of humor.
31765.name: Patrick Wilson

31766.quote: I love a man with a great sense of humor and who is intelligent - a man who has a great smile. He has to make me laugh. I like a man who is very ambitious and driven and who has a good heart and makes me feel safe. I like a man who is very strong and independent and confident - that is very sexy - but at the same time, he's very kind to people.
31766.name: Nicole Scherzinger

31767.quote: They don't make you pay for the humor. It's up and down, but they're trying to give you as many laughs as possible in 2 minutes. They are the most honest comedians ever.
31767.name: Mike Judge

31768.quote: I don't know if my sense of humor goes over Americans' heads.
31768.name: Ryan Kwanten

31769.quote: I think the Canadian sense of humor is dryer than America's and juicier than Britain's. I think it's a cross between the two of them, really.
31769.name: Scott Thompson

31770.quote: I think Canadian humor is a little less broad than American humor.
31770.name: Scott Thompson

31771.quote: Anyone in the humor business isn't thinking clearly if he doesn't surround himself with idea people. Otherwise, you settle for mediocrity - or you burn yourself out.
31771.name: Hank Ketcham

31772.quote: Bob Hope, like Mark Twain, had a sense of humor that was uniquely American, and like Twain, we'll likely not see another like him.
31772.name: Dick Van Dyke

31773.quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
31773.name: Daniel H. Wilson

31774.quote: Well, it's a humor strip, so my first responsibility has always been to entertain the reader, But if, in addition, I can help move readers to thought and judgment about issues that concern me, so much the better.
31774.name: Garry Trudeau

31775.quote: Humor can inform and break down stigma, which is a huge issue in the military.
31775.name: Garry Trudeau

31776.quote: My dad's sense of humor was direct and sometimes surreal - his quick wit is well known amongst our family and friends. He raised me on Spike Jones records and W.C. Fields movies, and his sense of humor fell somewhere in between.
31776.name: Tony Visconti

31777.quote: But it also became the experience, or was the experience, of the writers who were attracted to this kind of humor. They're all men or women who come from the same kind of experience in their own lives.
31777.name: Norman Lear

31778.quote: If you look at the game and everything, it's not quite like looking at an animated film, because that's total character. This, this is really movement, but it's got funny little things if you look for the humor. They're actually getting to the character.
31778.name: Don Bluth

31779.quote: Sometimes Americans don't quite get my sense of humor. My good ol' British sarcasm seems to go over their heads.
31779.name: Lee Westwood

31780.quote: I'm not an expert on the Malaysian sense of humor.
31780.name: Ben Stiller

31781.quote: The polls indicated that I was feisty, that I was tough, that I had a sense of humor, but they weren't quite sure if they liked me and they didn't know whether or not that I was sensitive.
31781.name: Geraldine Ferraro

31782.quote: He was just trying to tease me - I knew that later - but he said he'd have to leave because it wasn't fair to have anyone in the room who was going to make fun of what he had to say. He had a good sense of humor, really.
31782.name: Fay Wray

31783.quote: I appreciate humor so much, but I'm actually not a funny girl.
31783.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

31784.quote: I suppose I look for humor in most situations because it humanizes things it makes a character much more three-dimensional if there's some kind of humor. Not necessarily laugh-out-loud type of stuff, just a sense that there is a humorous edge to things. I do like that.
31784.name: Colm Meaney

31785.quote: Some people say my humor focuses too much on stereotypes. It doesn't. It focuses on facts.
31785.name: Sarah Silverman

31786.quote: I'm not for gratuitous nudity, but if there's humor, I don't have a problem.
31786.name: Rebecca Romijn

31787.quote: There's a hysterical, tired sense of humor that comes after working 14 hours a day, six days a week. I like those things because they take the pressure off the constant stress.
31787.name: Tom Berenger

31788.quote: Negative humor is forgotten immediately. It's the stuff that makes us feel better about our lives that lives long. Much more satisfying. Enter children's books.
31788.name: Berkeley Breathed

31789.quote: My legacy would be that you don't have to give up anything. You can be chic but have a sense of humor, you can be sexy but comfortable, you can be timeless but fresh.
31789.name: Michael Kors

31790.quote: I mean, yeah, I'm sure that Python and the other things have paved the way for a greater understanding of the British sense of humor, but I don't think it's all that different than the American sense of humor.
31790.name: Simon Pegg

31791.quote: I think at its best the American sense of humor is the same as the British sense of humor at its best, which is to be wry and ironic and self deprecating.
31791.name: Simon Pegg

31792.quote: However, frat-boy humor is funny and it always will be.
31792.name: Craig Kilborn

31793.quote: My dad instilled in me a great sense of humor. I wasn't bullied at school because my outward attitude was confident, and that helps.
31793.name: Warwick Davis

31794.quote: My parents armed me with an amazing sense of humor, and it's what you need when, well, it's what anyone needs in this world.
31794.name: Warwick Davis

31795.quote: We are really living the American dream, to be a successful brand in the States and in Europe and to steep ourselves in our heritage. But we do it with a sense of humor. We don't take ourselves too seriously in fashion.
31795.name: Tommy Hilfiger

31796.quote: I'll let you in on a secret: I can't stand Jay Ward. I hate being compared to Rocky and Bullwinkle. It's just a different style of humor.
31796.name: John Kricfalusi

31797.quote: Joe Barbera's s always complaining that he can't get humor into cartoons anymore. Just do it. You've got your money. Why do they let the networks run their lives?
31797.name: John Kricfalusi

31798.quote: A farce, or slapstick humor, does well universally.
31798.name: John Ratzenberger

31799.quote: Sure, the comedians who swear or use scatological humor can get laughs, but they're uncomfortable laughs.
31799.name: John Ratzenberger

31800.quote: I think up until the point when we started in the business, which was in the early '70s, most of the humor was political. The smart humor was political satire.
31800.name: David Zucker

31801.quote: Do feminists have a sense of humor? Yes.
31801.name: Gloria Allred

31802.quote: I genuinely liked all of the cast members very much. Steve had a wicked sense of humor. I remember Russell coming to my rescue, once. I watched Eric evolve before everyone's eyes. Maurice loved what he did, so. He treated his character with respect, down to the costuming.
31802.name: Madeleine Stowe

31803.quote: Lesbian humor isn't trying to sell anything, it doesn't have to sell out. Coming out as a lesbian onstage is still a very political act if it weren't, more women would do it.
31803.name: Kate Clinton

31804.quote: Confidence and a good sense of humor can usually win a chick over.
31804.name: Danny McBride

31805.quote: I liked the humor of it, I've always enjoyed a sense of humor in God and in religion and in spirituality.
31805.name: Amber Tamblyn

31806.quote: I don't think I could ever do a network sitcom because the humor is often based on some trite circumstance. I don't want to be a part of a show where it's mostly about coming up with the jokes.
31806.name: Sherilyn Fenn

31807.quote: The waltz is a very important part of my life. It's a very important way for me to express my positiveness, bringing humor to the world.
31807.name: Andre Rieu

31808.quote: Roosevelt's humor was broad, his manner friendly. Of wit there was little of philosophy, none. What did he possess? Intuition, inspiration, love of adventure.
31808.name: Emanuel Celler

31809.quote: But if you don't watch me, I will try and sneak in some humor. I see humor everywhere in life around me.
31809.name: Marion Ross

31810.quote: While it is true that Frank had a great sense of humor, he was also very serious about composing music. In reality there are only a handful of skilled players who can play his most complex pieces. It takes a lot of patience to learn and requires a fantastic memory.
31810.name: Dweezil Zappa

31811.quote: I was a product of a divorced family and I used humor as a weapon to combat sadness. I used comedy to make my mother laugh in light of the darkness that she faced, and to me it became a very powerful tool at a very young age, at six. I saw how therapeutic it could be.
31811.name: Josh Gad

31812.quote: Jazz can be so serious, no sense of humor.
31812.name: Chad Smith

31813.quote: I was a little shocked at how adult some of the humor was, because I was never that into animation before and when I watched 'Shrek' I really laughed out loud.
31813.name: Cheryl Hines

31814.quote: I'm not just a big-haired redhead country singer who dresses flamboyantly, has this wicked sense of humor and wears rhinestones.
31814.name: Naomi Judd

31815.quote: There is humor in the specter of the worst disaster in our nation's history. All I have to do is sweep away the debris of shock to find it.
31815.name: Will Durst

31816.quote: Academics tend to have wonderfully infantile senses of humor.
31816.name: John Lithgow

31817.quote: Probably it is impossible for humor to be ever a revolutionary weapon. Candide can do little more than generate irony.
31817.name: Lionel Trilling

31818.quote: A good actor is someone who knows how to take the part and make it real and make it honest and be effective in it. If it's in a funny movie and, as long as they are cast in an appropriate way, humor will come from it.
31818.name: Ivan Reitman

31819.quote: I think I've learned that if you want to be successful, you have to tell your story honestly and from your heart - and I think a healthy sense of humor doesn't hurt either.
31819.name: Dorothea Benton Frank

31820.quote: We're starting to push the envelope in terms of the expectations, and you can also have your own style, personality and sense of humor, because now we're allowed to.
31820.name: Lisa Guerrero

31821.quote: If I can't see the humor in it, how am I going to be funny?
31821.name: Casey Affleck

31822.quote: It's very hard to write humor.
31822.name: Mark Strand

31823.quote: Humor has become so cliche and boring that nothing's funny anymore unless it involves something totally disgusting that offends somebody or makes them feel really uncomfortable.
31823.name: Tom DeLonge

31824.quote: I don't need someone with a hot body. He can be fat or overweight and have a belly. It's very much about style and substance and humor, interest, curiosity and really being smart.
31824.name: Kate Walsh

31825.quote: Bands from Akron have a sense of humor and don't tend to take themselves too seriously.
31825.name: Dan Auerbach

31826.quote: Suspense is very important. Even though this is humor and they're short stories, that theory of building suspense is still there.
31826.name: Sergio Aragones

31827.quote: I've always chosen my band members based on their sense of humor. It might sound stupid, but it means not only are they fun to live with on a tour bus for years, but humor implies intelligence.
31827.name: Kristin Hersh

31828.quote: I am a great believer that what makes our show different is the humor.
31828.name: Treat Williams

32009.name: Calvin Trillin

32010.quote: We imagine that we want to escape our selfish and commonplace existence, but we cling desperately to our chains.
32010.name: Anne Sullivan Macy

32011.quote: The imagination is man's power over nature.
32011.name: Wallace Stevens

32012.quote: Imagination has brought mankind through the dark ages to its present state of civilization. Imagination led Columbus to discover America. Imagination led Franklin to discover electricity.
32012.name: L. Frank Baum

32013.quote: What we imagine is order is merely the prevailing form of chaos.
32013.name: Kerry Thornley

32014.quote: You need imagination in order to imagine a future that doesn't exist.
32014.name: Azar Nafisi

32015.quote: The most imaginative people are the most credulous, for them everything is possible.
32015.name: Alexander Chase

32016.quote: There are no shortcuts in life - only those we imagine.
32016.name: Frank Leahy

32017.quote: The true sign of intelligence is not knowledge but imagination.
32017.name: Albert Einstein

32018.quote: Logic will get you from A to B. Imagination will take you everywhere.
32018.name: Albert Einstein

32019.quote: Music is a moral law. It gives soul to the universe, wings to the mind, flight to the imagination, and charm and gaiety to life and to everything.
32019.name: Plato

32020.quote: I am enough of an artist to draw freely upon my imagination.
32020.name: Albert Einstein

32021.quote: To raise new questions, new possibilities, to regard old problems from a new angle, requires creative imagination and marks real advance in science.
32021.name: Albert Einstein

32022.quote: All religion, my friend, is simply evolved out of fraud, fear, greed, imagination, and poetry.
32022.name: Edgar Allan Poe

32023.quote: The moment a person forms a theory, his imagination sees in every object only the traits which favor that theory.
32023.name: Thomas Jefferson

32024.quote: Reason is the natural order of truth but imagination is the organ of meaning.
32024.name: C. S. Lewis

32025.quote: This world is but a canvas to our imagination.
32025.name: Henry David Thoreau

32026.quote: Imagination was given to man to compensate him for what he is not a sense of humor to console him for what he is.
32026.name: Francis Bacon

32027.quote: The imagination imitates. It is the critical spirit that creates.
32027.name: Oscar Wilde

32028.quote: There are no great limits to growth because there are no limits of human intelligence, imagination, and wonder.
32028.name: Ronald Reagan

32029.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
32029.name: Robert Fulghum

32030.quote: Love is the triumph of imagination over intelligence.
32030.name: H. L. Mencken

32031.quote: Reality leaves a lot to the imagination.
32031.name: John Lennon

32032.quote: All the breaks you need in life wait within your imagination, Imagination is the workshop of your mind, capable of turning mind energy into accomplishment and wealth.
32032.name: Napoleon Hill

32033.quote: Intelligence is the wife, imagination is the mistress, memory is the servant.
32033.name: Victor Hugo

32034.quote: Science does not know its debt to imagination.
32034.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

32035.quote: Every human has four endowments- self awareness, conscience, independent will and creative imagination. These give us the ultimate human freedom, The power to choose, to respond, to change.
32035.name: Stephen Covey

32036.quote: Love is a canvas furnished by nature and embroidered by imagination.
32036.name: Voltaire

32037.quote: First comes thought then organization of that thought, into ideas and plans then transformation of those plans into reality. The beginning, as you will observe, is in your imagination.
32037.name: Napoleon Hill

32038.quote: It is usually the imagination that is wounded first, rather than the heart it being much more sensitive.
32038.name: Henry David Thoreau

32039.quote: Generally speaking, a howling wilderness does not howl: it is the imagination of the traveler that does the howling.
32039.name: Henry David Thoreau

32040.quote: Imagination is the beginning of creation. You imagine what you desire, you will what you imagine and at last you create what you will.
32040.name: George Bernard Shaw

32041.quote: There are lots of people who mistake their imagination for their memory.
32041.name: Josh Billings

32042.quote: Formulate and stamp indelibly on your mind a mental picture of yourself as succeeding. Hold this picture tenaciously. Never permit it to fade. Your mind will seek to develop the picture, Do not build up obstacles in your imagination.
32042.name: Norman Vincent Peale

32043.quote: We are more often frightened than hurt and we suffer more from imagination than from reality.
32043.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

32044.quote: Imagination is the key to my lyrics. The rest is painted with a little science fiction.
32044.name: Jimi Hendrix

32045.quote: And by the way, everything in life is writable about if you have the outgoing guts to do it, and the imagination to improvise. The worst enemy to creativity is self-doubt.
32045.name: Sylvia Plath

32046.quote: Disneyland will never be completed. It will continue to grow as long as there is imagination left in the world.
32046.name: Walt Disney

32047.quote: A good teacher can inspire hope, ignite the imagination, and instill a love of learning.
32047.name: Brad Henry

32048.quote: The man who will use his skill and constructive imagination to see how much he can give for a dollar, instead of how little he can give for a dollar, is bound to succeed.
32048.name: Henry Ford

32049.quote: We are so obsessed with doing that we have no time and no imagination left for being. As a result, men are valued not for what they are but for what they do or what they have - for their usefulness.
32049.name: Thomas Merton

32050.quote: The reason we have poverty is that we have no imagination. There are a great many people accumulating what they think is vast wealth, but it's only money, they don't know how to enjoy it, because they have no imagination.
32050.name: Alan Watts

32051.quote: The tree which moves some to tears of joy is in the eyes of others only a green thing that stands in the way. Some see nature all ridicule and deformity, and some scarce see nature at all. But to the eyes of the man of imagination, nature is imagination itself.
32051.name: William Blake

32052.quote: There are many ways to be free. One of them is to transcend reality by imagination, as I try to do.
32052.name: Anais Nin

32053.quote: Few people have the imagination for reality.
32053.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

32054.quote: Why does the eye see a thing more clearly in dreams than the imagination when awake?
32054.name: Leonardo da Vinci

32055.quote: We cast away priceless time in dreams, born of imagination, fed upon illusion, and put to death by reality.
32055.name: Judy Garland

32056.quote: The only limit to your impact is your imagination and commitment.
32056.name: Tony Robbins

32057.quote: Cowardice, is almost always simply a lack of ability to suspend functioning of the imagination.
32057.name: Ernest Hemingway

32058.quote: The nose of a mob is its imagination. By this, at any time, it can be quietly led.
32058.name: Edgar Allan Poe

32059.quote: Imagination is the true magic carpet.
32059.name: Norman Vincent Peale

32060.quote: Falling in love consists merely in uncorking the imagination and bottling the common sense.
32060.name: Helen Rowland

32061.quote: We are the miracle of force and matter making itself over into imagination and will. Incredible. The Life Force experimenting with forms. You for one. Me for another. The Universe has shouted itself alive. We are one of the shouts.
32061.name: Ray Bradbury

32062.quote: Nothing is more fearful than imagination without taste.
32062.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

32063.quote: My main point here is that if you are the child of God and God is a part of you, the in your imagination God suppose to look like you. And when you accept a picture of the deity assigned to you by another people, you become the spiritual prisoners of that other people.
32063.name: John Henrik Clarke

32064.quote: All the works of man have their origin in creative fantasy. What right have we then to depreciate imagination.
32064.name: Carl Jung

32065.quote: Aptitude found in the understanding and is often inherited. Genius coming from reason and imagination, rarely.
32065.name: Marcus Aurelius

32066.quote: America was not built on fear. America was built on courage, on imagination and an unbeatable determination to do the job at hand.
32066.name: Harry S. Truman

32067.quote: The power of imagination makes us infinite.
32067.name: John Muir

32068.quote: Life is only a dream and we are the imagination of ourselves.
32068.name: Bill Hicks

32070.quote: Without leaps of imagination, or dreaming, we lose the excitement of possibilities. Dreaming, after all, is a form of planning.
32070.name: Gloria Steinem

32071.quote: The soul without imagination is what an observatory would be without a telescope.
32071.name: Henry Ward Beecher

32072.quote: Neither a lofty degree of intelligence nor imagination nor both together go to the making of genius. Love, love, love, that is the soul of genius.
32072.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

32073.quote: Do not quench your inspiration and your imagination do not become the slave of your model.
32073.name: Vincent Van Gogh

32074.quote: I am certain of nothing but the holiness of the heart's affections, and the truth of imagination.
32074.name: John Keats

32075.quote: Happiness is ideal, it is the work of the imagination.
32075.name: Marquis de Sade

32076.quote: The human race is governed by its imagination.
32076.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

32077.quote: Imagination is the real and eternal world of which this vegetable universe is but a faint shadow.
32077.name: William Blake

32078.quote: A lady's imagination is very rapid it jumps from admiration to love, from love to matrimony in a moment.
32078.name: Jane Austen

32079.quote: Without this playing with fantasy no creative work has ever yet come to birth. The debt we owe to the play of the imagination is incalculable.
32079.name: Carl Jung

32080.quote: Imagination disposes of everything it creates beauty, justice, and happiness, which are everything in this world.
32080.name: Blaise Pascal

32081.quote: Imagination was given to man to compensate him for what he isn't. A sense of humor was provided to console him for what he is.
32081.name: Horace Walpole

32082.quote: The use of travelling is to regulate imagination by reality, and instead of thinking how things may be, to see them as they are.
32082.name: Samuel Johnson

32083.quote: The debt we owe to the play of imagination is incalculable.
32083.name: Carl Jung

32084.quote: Imagination is a poor matter when it has to part company with understanding.
32084.name: Thomas Carlyle

32085.quote: Liberty: One of Imagination's most precious possessions.
32085.name: Ambrose Bierce

32086.quote: Knowledge is a polite word for dead but not buried imagination.
32086.name: Edward Estlin (e. e. cummings)

32087.quote: My view is that at a younger age your optimism is more and you have more imagination etc. You have less bias.
32087.name: Abdul Kalam

32088.quote: Imagination is not only the uniquely human capacity to envision that which is not, and therefore the fount of all invention and innovation. In its arguably most transformative and revelatory capacity, it is the power to that enables us to empathize with humans whose experiences we have never shared.
32088.name: J. K. Rowling

32089.quote: Our thoughts and imagination are the only real limits to our possibilities.
32089.name: Orison Swett Marden

32090.quote: A certificate of live birth is not the same thing by any stretch of the imagination as a birth certificate.
32090.name: Donald Trump

32091.quote: For me, insanity is super sanity. The normal is psychotic. Normal means lack of imagination, lack of creativity.
32091.name: Jean Dubuffet

32092.quote: Imagination is the eye of the soul.
32092.name: Joseph Joubert

32094.quote: Men often take their imagination for their heart and they believe they are converted as soon as they think of being converted.
32094.name: Blaise Pascal

32095.quote: You have all the reason in the world to achieve your grandest dreams. Imagination plus innovation equals realization.
32095.name: Denis Waitley

32096.quote: Being an actor is the loneliest thing in the world. You are all alone with your concentration and imagination, and that's all you have.
32096.name: James Dean

32097.quote: Those Dutchmen had hardly any imagination or fantasy, but their good taste and their scientific knowledge of composition were enormous.
32097.name: Vincent Van Gogh

32098.quote: Let us leave pretty women to men devoid of imagination.
32098.name: Marcel Proust

32099.quote: Here is everything which can lay hold of the eye, ear and imagination - everything which can charm and bewitch the simple and ignorant. I wonder how Luther ever broke the spell.
32099.name: John Adams

32100.quote: There is nothing heavier than compassion. Not even one's own pain weighs so heavy as the pain one feels for someone, for someone, pain intensified by the imagination and prolonged by a hundred echos.
32100.name: Milan Kundera

32101.quote: My country has contrived for me the most insignificant office that ever the invention of man contrived or his imagination conceived.
32101.name: John Adams

32102.quote: To speak of morals in art is to speak of legislature in sex. Art is the sex of the imagination.
32102.name: George Jean Nathan

32103.quote: However my parents - both of whom came from impoverished backgrounds and neither of whom had been to college, took the view that my overactive imagination was an amusing quirk that would never pay a mortgage or secure a pension.
32103.name: J. K. Rowling

32104.quote: Apathy can be overcome by enthusiasm, and enthusiasm can only be aroused by two things: first, an ideal, with takes the imagination by storm, and second, a definite intelligible plan for carrying that ideal into practice.
32104.name: Arnold J. Toynbee

32105.quote: I had a very happy childhood, but I wasn't that happy a child. I liked being alone and creating characters and voices. I think that's when your creativity is developed, when you're young. I liked the world of the imagination because it was an easy place to go to.
32105.name: David Walliams

32106.quote: We especially need imagination in science. It is not all mathematics, nor all logic, but it is somewhat beauty and poetry.
32106.name: Maria Montessori

32107.quote: Were it not for imagination a man would be as happy in arms of a chambermaid as of a duchess.
32107.name: Samuel Johnson

32108.quote: An idea is salvation by imagination.
32108.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

32109.quote: To treat your facts with imagination is one thing, to imagine your facts is another.
32109.name: John Burroughs

32110.quote: Wherever you write is supposed to be a little bit of a refuge, a place where you can get away from the world. The more closed in you are, the more you're forced back on your own imagination.
32110.name: Stephen King

32111.quote: The world of reality has its limits the world of imagination is boundless.
32111.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

32112.quote: For strange effects and extraordinary combinations we must go to life itself, which is always far more daring than any effort of the imagination.
32112.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

32113.quote: The imagination is the spur of delights, all depends upon it, it is the mainspring of everything now, is it not by means of the imagination one knows joy? Is it not of the imagination that the sharpest pleasures arise?
32113.name: Marquis de Sade

32114.quote: Having imagination it takes you an hour to write a paragraph that if you were unimaginative would take you only a minute.
32114.name: Franklin P. Adams

32115.quote: The woman who appeals to a man's vanity may stimulate him, the woman who appeals to his heart may attract him, but it is the woman who appeals to his imagination who gets him.
32115.name: Helen Rowland

32116.quote: Los Angeles gives one the feeling of the future more strongly than any city I know of. A bad future, too, like something out of Fritz Lang's feeble imagination.
32116.name: Henry Miller

32117.quote: My imagination can picture no fairer happiness than to continue living for art.
32117.name: Clara Schumann

32118.quote: Fantasy mirrors desire. Imagination reshapes it.
32118.name: Mason Cooley

32119.quote: We're living in a time when the world has suddenly discovered India because it's run out of raw material for its imagination. The raw materials for imagination are inexhaustible here.
32119.name: Deepak Chopra

32120.quote: A poet ought not to pick nature's pocket. Let him borrow, and so borrow as to repay by the very act of borrowing. Examine nature accurately, but write from recollection, and trust more to the imagination than the memory.
32120.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

32121.quote: It takes a lot of imagination to be a good photographer. You need less imagination to be a painter because you can invent things. But in photography everything is so ordinary it takes a lot of looking before you learn to see the extraordinary.
32121.name: David Bailey

32122.quote: Don Quixote's misfortune is not his imagination, but Sancho Panza.
32122.name: Franz Kafka

32123.quote: My imagination is a monastery and I am its monk.
32123.name: John Keats

32124.quote: What the imagination seizes as beauty must be truth.
32124.name: John Keats

32125.quote: The scientific imagination always restrains itself within the limits of probability.
32125.name: Thomas Huxley

32126.quote: Memories, imagination, old sentiments, and associations are more readily reached through the sense of smell than through any other channel.
32126.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

32127.quote: The degree in which a poet's imagination dominates reality is, in the end, the exact measure of his importance and dignity.
32127.name: George Santayana

32128.quote: A nickname is the heaviest stone that the devil can throw at a man. It is a bugbear to the imagination, and, though we do not believe in it, it still haunts our apprehensions.
32128.name: William Hazlitt

32129.quote: Every great advance in science has issued from a new audacity of imagination.
32129.name: John Dewey

32130.quote: What distinguishes a great artist from a weak one is first their sensibility and tenderness second, their imagination, and third, their industry.
32130.name: Salman Rushdie

32131.quote: Imagination is always the fabric of social life and the dynamic of history. The influence of real needs and compulsions, of real interests and materials, is indirect because the crowd is never conscious of it.
32131.name: Simone Weil

32132.quote: He who has imagination without learning has wings but no feet.
32132.name: Joseph Joubert

32133.quote: Taste refers to the past, imagination to the future.
32133.name: Mason Cooley

32134.quote: Imagination has rules, but we can only guess what they are.
32134.name: Mason Cooley

32135.quote: Skill without imagination is craftsmanship and gives us many useful objects such as wickerwork picnic baskets. Imagination without skill gives us modern art.
32135.name: Tom Stoppard

32136.quote: I can't satisfy myself with just trying to tie all of my imagination into music, especially when music is not appreciated as an art form as much as it used to be.
32136.name: Marilyn Manson

32137.quote: No amount of skillful invention can replace the essential element of imagination.
32137.name: Edward Hopper

32138.quote: He is the true enchanter, whose spell operates, not upon the senses, but upon the imagination and the heart.
32138.name: Washington Irving

32139.quote: One who has imagination without learning has wings without feet.
32139.name: Joseph Joubert

32140.quote: Censorship is never over for those who have experienced it. It is a brand on the imagination that affects the individual who has suffered it, forever.
32140.name: Noam Chomsky

32141.quote: Imagination is the highest kite one can fly.
32141.name: Lauren Bacall

32142.quote: Where there is no imagination there is no horror.
32142.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

32143.quote: The public has an appetite for anything about imagination - anything that is as far away from reality as is creatively possible.
32143.name: Steven Spielberg

32144.quote: Sometimes I feel like a figment of my own imagination.
32144.name: Lily Tomlin

32145.quote: Free enterprise empowers entrepreneurs who have ideas and imagination, investors who take risks, and workers who hone their skills and offer their labor.
32145.name: Paul Ryan

32146.quote: True change takes place in the imagination.
32146.name: Thomas Moore

32147.quote: I must confess that my imagination refuses to see any sort of submarine doing anything but suffocating its crew and floundering at sea.
32147.name: H. G. Wells

32148.quote: Classical plays require more imagination and more general training to be able to do. That's why I like playing Shakespeare better than anything else.
32148.name: Vivien Leigh

32149.quote: Belief in the supernatural reflects a failure of the imagination.
32149.name: Edward Abbey

32150.quote: It is not that the child lives in a world of imagination, but that the child within us survives and starts into life only at rare moments of recollection, which makes us believe, and it is not true, that, as children, we were imaginative?
32150.name: Cesare Pavese

32151.quote: When the imagination and will power are in conflict, are antagonistic, it is always the imagination which wins, without any exception.
32151.name: Emile Coue

32152.quote: The level of our success is limited only by our imagination and no act of kindness, however small, is ever wasted.
32152.name: Aesop

32153.quote: It is all very well to copy what one sees, but it is far better to draw what one now only sees in one's memory. That is a transformation in which imagination collaborates with memory.
32153.name: Edgar Degas

32154.quote: Growing up, I didn't have a lot of toys, and personal entertainment depended on individual ingenuity and imagination - think up a story and go live it for an afternoon.
32154.name: Terry Brooks

32155.quote: The great instrument of moral good is the imagination.
32155.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

32156.quote: Hope lies in dreams, in imagination, and in the courage of those who dare to make dreams into reality.
32156.name: Jonas Salk

32157.quote: Out with stereotypes, feminism proclaims. But stereotypes are the west's stunning sexual personae, the vehicles of art's assault against nature. The moment there is imagination, there is myth.
32157.name: Camille Paglia

32158.quote: For imagination sets the goal picture which our automatic mechanism works on. We act, or fail to act, not because of will, as is so commonly believed, but because of imagination.
32158.name: Maxwell Maltz

32159.quote: Reason respects the differences, and imagination the similitudes of things.
32159.name: Percy Bysshe Shelley

32160.quote: The conscious process is reflected in the imagination the unconscious process is expressed as karma, the generation of actions divorced from thinking and alienated from feeling.
32160.name: William Irwin Thompson

32161.quote: Uttering a word is like striking a note on the keyboard of the imagination.
32161.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein

32162.quote: If you use your imagination, you can look at any actress and see her nude, I hope to make you use your imagination.
32162.name: Hedy Lamarr

32163.quote: Panic is a sudden desertion of us, and a going over to the enemy of our imagination.
32163.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

32164.quote: Never lose sight of the fact that all human felicity lies in man's imagination, and that he cannot think to attain it unless he heeds all his caprices. The most fortunate of persons is he who has the most means to satisfy his vagaries.
32164.name: Marquis de Sade

32165.quote: I've always felt that what I have going for me is not my imagination, because everyone has an imagination. What I have is a relentlessly controlled imagination. What looks like wild invention is actually quite carefully calculated.
32165.name: Terry Pratchett

32166.quote: When you start to develop your powers of empathy and imagination, the whole world opens up to you.
32166.name: Susan Sarandon

32167.quote: The realities of the world seldom measure up to the sublime designs of human imagination.
32167.name: Bryant H. McGill

32168.quote: But if I have a lot of imagination, I could tell myself whatever I wanted, you know. I handle myself quite well. I'm kind of fascist with myself, you know. There's no discussion. There is an order. You follow it.
32168.name: Karl Lagerfeld

32169.quote: My imagination makes me human and makes me a fool it gives me all the world, and exiles me from it.
32169.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

32170.quote: To have frequent recourse to narrative betrays great want of imagination.
32170.name: Lord Chesterfield

32171.quote: Wit is the appearance, the external flash of imagination. Thus its divinity, and the witty character of mysticism.
32171.name: Karl Wilhelm Friedrich Schlegel

32172.quote: Truth titillates the imagination far less than fiction.
32172.name: Marquis de Sade

32173.quote: I have a huge, active imagination, and I think I'm really scared of being alone because if I'm left to my own devices, I'll just turn into a madwoman.
32173.name: Claire Danes

32174.quote: The Jewish festival of freedom is the oldest continuously observed religious ritual in the world. Across the centuries, Passover has never lost its power to inspire the imagination of successive generations of Jews with its annually re-enacted drama of slavery and liberation.
32174.name: Jonathan Sacks

32175.quote: I love theatrics and have a huge imagination: Why would I want to sit onstage and sing a bunch of ballads back-to-back?
32175.name: Christina Aguilera

32176.quote: I don't think art is propaganda it should be something that liberates the soul, provokes the imagination and encourages people to go further. It celebrates humanity instead of manipulating it.
32176.name: Keith Haring

32177.quote: There are moments when a man's imagination, so easily subdued to what it lives in, suddenly rises above its daily level and surveys the long windings of destiny.
32177.name: Edith Wharton

32178.quote: What's cool is when you're able to give your audience imagination and you don't have to cage them in like animals.
32178.name: Shia LaBeouf

32179.quote: Children do not give up their innate imagination, curiosity, dreaminess easily. You have to love them to get them to do that.
32179.name: R. D. Laing

32180.quote: Life is possible only by the deficiencies of our imagination and memory.
32180.name: Emile M. Cioran

32181.quote: Reason clears and plants the wilderness of the imagination to harvest the wheat of art.
32181.name: Austin O'Malley

32182.quote: I've done a lot of bad things. Use your imagination.
32182.name: Katy Perry

32184.quote: Belief is nothing but a more vivid, lively, forcible, firm, steady conception of an object, than what the imagination alone is ever able to attain.
32184.name: David Hume

32185.quote: The pleasures of the imagination are as it were only drawings and models which are played with by poor people who cannot afford the real thing.
32185.name: Georg C. Lichtenberg

32186.quote: I think what's really the most ideal thing is for the player themselves, within their own imagination, to carve out what they view as being the essence of the character.
32186.name: Shigeru Miyamoto

32187.quote: My imagination completely controls me, and forever feeds the fire that burns with dark red light in my heart by bringing me the best dreams. I've always had a wild imagination, a big heart and a tortured soul so I feel that dark fantasy, love and horror are in my blood.
32187.name: Kim Elizabeth

32189.quote: In the world of words, the imagination is one of the forces of nature.
32189.name: Wallace Stevens

32190.quote: It's a slight stretch of the imagination but most people are alike in most ways so I've never had any trouble identifying with the character that I'm playing.
32190.name: Jack Nicholson

32191.quote: You will recognize your own path when you come upon it, because you will suddenly have all the energy and imagination you will ever need.
32191.name: Jerry Gillies

32192.quote: Our imagination is the only limit to what we can hope to have in the future.
32192.name: Charles Kettering

32193.quote: A man at work, making something which he feels will exist because he is working at it and wills it, is exercising the energies of his mind and soul as well as of his body. Memory and imagination help him as he works.
32193.name: William Morris

32194.quote: You will certainly not doubt the necessity of studying astronomy and physics, if you are desirous of comprehending the relation between the world and Providence as it is in reality, and not according to imagination.
32194.name: Maimonides

32195.quote: Imagination, the supreme delight of the immortal and the immature, should be limited. In order to enjoy life, we should not enjoy it too much.
32195.name: Vladimir Nabokov

32196.quote: A writer should have the precision of a poet and the imagination of a scientist.
32196.name: Vladimir Nabokov

32197.quote: Fortunately, somewhere between chance and mystery lies imagination, the only thing that protects our freedom, despite the fact that people keep trying to reduce it or kill it off altogether.
32197.name: Luis Bunuel

32198.quote: I have a very vivid imagination.
32198.name: Janice Dickinson

32199.quote: Works of imagination should be written in very plain language the more purely imaginative they are the more necessary it is to be plain.
32199.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

32200.quote: Talent, lying in the understanding, is often inherited genius, being the action of reason or imagination, rarely or never.
32200.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

32201.quote: This is one of those cases in which the imagination is baffled by the facts.
32201.name: Adam Smith

32202.quote: Only in men's imagination does every truth find an effective and undeniable existence. Imagination, not invention, is the supreme master of art as of life.
32202.name: Joseph Conrad

32203.quote: If the reporter has killed our imagination with his truth, he threatens our life with his lies.
32203.name: Karl Kraus

32204.quote: It takes no imagination to live within your means.
32204.name: Francis Ford Coppola

32205.quote: A great wind is blowing, and that gives you either imagination or a headache.
32205.name: Catherine the Great

32206.quote: I don't want to discredit people's individuality, but I think people are pretty much the same. People are very similar. If you have a good enough imagination then you can feel things that you personally have never done before. That's acting.
32206.name: Kristen Stewart

32207.quote: My parents thought it was nice to develop my imagination, but they never seriously thought that anything would ever come of it. They said that I couldn't be an actress because I would be taller than all my leading men, so I thought I would be a writer instead.
32207.name: Nicole Kidman

32208.quote: If you got a good imagination, a lot of confidence and you kind of know what you are saying, then you might be able to do it. I know a lot of colorful characters at home that would make great actors.
32208.name: Jason Statham

32209.quote: What really fascinates me is this need that is so strong now that if you read a work of the imagination you instantly have to say, 'Oh, what this really is is so-and-so,' reducing it to a simple formula.
32209.name: Doris Lessing

32210.quote: I believe in imagination. I did Kramer vs. Kramer before I had children. But the mother I would be was already inside me.
32210.name: Meryl Streep

32211.quote: One longs for a director with a sense of imagination.
32211.name: Alan Rickman

32212.quote: We say God and the imagination are one, How high that highest candle lights the dark.
32212.name: Wallace Stevens

32213.quote: I think my securities far outweigh my insecurities. I am not nearly as afraid of myself and my imagination as I used to be.
32213.name: Billy Connolly

32214.quote: I love sci-fi because it leads in the imagination, and I always say it has the most intelligent fans in the world.
32214.name: Robert Carlyle

32215.quote: Everything, I think, about acting is based on imagination.
32215.name: Christina Ricci

32216.quote: The opportunities of man are limited only by his imagination. But so few have imagination that there are ten thousand fiddlers to one composer.
32216.name: Charles Kettering

32217.quote: Imagination is the wide-open eye which leads us always to see truth more vividly.
32217.name: Christopher Fry

32218.quote: An opera begins long before the curtain goes up and ends long after it has come down. It starts in my imagination, it becomes my life, and it stays part of my life long after I've left the opera house.
32218.name: Maria Callas

32219.quote: You may be sure that the Americans will commit all the stupidities they can think of, plus some that are beyond imagination.
32219.name: Charles de Gaulle

32220.quote: Being an actor means asking people to look at you. I guess I accept that. But it's a profession in which the job is to show another world and other people. You may access it through bits of yourself, and your imagination and experience, but actually, in the end, you're not playing yourself.
32220.name: Ralph Fiennes

32221.quote: Fear of error which everything recalls to me at every moment of the flight of my ideas, this mania for control, makes men prefer reason's imagination to the imagination of the senses. And yet it is always the imagination alone which is at work.
32221.name: Louis Aragon

32222.quote: If we divine a discrepancy between a man's words and his character, the whole impression of him becomes broken and painful he revolts the imagination by his lack of unity, and even the good in him is hardly accepted.
32222.name: Charles Horton Cooley

32223.quote: People write memoirs because they lack the imagination to make things up.
32223.name: Tom Robbins

32224.quote: Imagination, its limits are only those of the mind itself.
32224.name: Rod Serling

32225.quote: Well, I'm not a method actress by any stretch of the imagination so the best thing that I can do is be as real as possible and find whatever commonality in that character that I can see myself.
32225.name: Rashida Jones

32226.quote: I would warn you that I do not attribute to nature either beauty or deformity, order or confusion. Only in relation to our imagination can things be called beautiful or ugly, well-ordered or confused.
32226.name: Baruch Spinoza

32227.quote: Our democracy, our constitutional framework is really a kind of software for harnessing the creativity and political imagination for all of our people. The American democratic system was an early political version of Napster.
32227.name: Al Gore

32228.quote: Vision - It reaches beyond the thing that is, into the conception of what can be. Imagination gives you the picture. Vision gives you the impulse to make the picture your own.
32228.name: Robert Collier

32229.quote: Fools act on imagination without knowledge, pedants act on knowledge without imagination.
32229.name: Alfred North Whitehead

32230.quote: Kindness and intelligence don't always deliver us from the pitfalls and traps: there are always failures of love, of will, of imagination. There is no way to take the danger out of human relationships.
32230.name: Barbara Grizzuti Harrison

32231.quote: Musicals are, by nature, theatrical, meaning poetic, meaning having to move the audience's imagination and create a suspension of disbelief, by which I mean there's no fourth wall.
32231.name: Stephen Sondheim

32232.quote: In rising financial markets, the world is forever new. The bull or optimist has no eyes for past or present, but only for the future, where streams of revenue play in his imagination.
32232.name: James Buchan

32233.quote: The face of nature and civilization in this our country is to a certain point a very sufficient literary field. But it will yield its secrets only to a really grasping imagination. To write well and worthily of American things one need even more than elsewhere to be a master.
32233.name: Henry James

32234.quote: It always amuses me that the biggest praise for my work comes for the imagination, while the truth is that there's not a single line in all my work that does not have a basis in reality. The problem is that Caribbean reality resembles the wildest imagination.
32234.name: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

32235.quote: You have to come in and be that character when you walk into the room. That's what one of my first acting teachers taught me. You know, don't go in there being Jennifer and then expect to flip and change, because they're not going to have that imagination.
32235.name: Jennifer Lopez

32236.quote: Ghost stories really scare me. I have such a big imagination that after I watch a horror movie like 'The Grudge', I look in the corners of my room for the next two days.
32236.name: Vanessa Hudgens

32237.quote: To put yourself in another's place requires real imagination, but by doing so each Girl Scout will be able to love among others happily.
32237.name: Juliette Gordon Low

32238.quote: One of the virtues of being very young is that you don't let the facts get in the way of your imagination.
32238.name: Sam Levenson

32239.quote: In my wildest imagination, I never thought that the fifth of six children born to Helen and Buddy Watts - in a poor black neighborhood, in the poor rural community of Eufaula, Oklahoma - would someday be called Congressman.
32239.name: J. C. Watts

32240.quote: Essentially, I'm untrained, so I just go with my imagination and try to put myself as solidly as I can into the shoes of whatever person I'm going to be playing.
32240.name: Christian Bale

32241.quote: I paint what cannot be photographed, that which comes from the imagination or from dreams, or from an unconscious drive.
32241.name: Man Ray

32242.quote: I had a good imagination and I still have one a child-like imagination that hasn't gone away.
32242.name: Laura Linney

32243.quote: I try to decorate my imagination as much as I can.
32243.name: Franz Schubert

32244.quote: As great scientists have said and as all children know, it is above all by the imagination that we achieve perception, and compassion, and hope.
32244.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

32245.quote: We are all afraid for our confidence, for the future, for the world. That is the nature of the human imagination. Yet every man, every civilization, has gone forward because of its engagement with what it has set itself to do.
32245.name: Jacob Bronowski

32246.quote: I do a lot of curiosity buying I buy it if I like the album cover, I buy it if I like the name of the band, anything that sparks my imagination. I still like to go to record stores, I like to just wander around and I'll buy whatever catches my attention.
32246.name: Bruce Springsteen

32247.quote: I do a lot of curiosity buying I buy it if I like the album cover, I buy it if I like the name of the band, anything that sparks my imagination.
32247.name: Bruce Springsteen

32248.quote: I always won in my imagination. I always hit the game-winning shot, or I hit the free throw. Or if I missed, there was a lane violation, and I was given another one.
32248.name: Mike Krzyzewski

32249.quote: Imagination has a great deal to do with winning.
32249.name: Mike Krzyzewski

32250.quote: Our world faces a true planetary emergency. I know the phrase sounds shrill, and I know it's a challenge to the moral imagination.
32250.name: Al Gore

32251.quote: The source and center of all man's creative power, is his power of making images, or the power of imagination.
32251.name: Robert Collier

32252.quote: I used my imagination to make the grass whatever color I wanted it to be.
32252.name: Whoopi Goldberg

32253.quote: I don't want to go on much longer, really. I think that would suggest a lack of imagination. A certain lack of dignity also.
32253.name: Steven Patrick Morrissey

32254.quote: You can understand nothing about art, particularly modern art, if you do not understand that imagination is a value in itself.
32254.name: Milan Kundera

32255.quote: The past is really almost as much a work of the imagination as the future.
32255.name: Jessamyn West

32256.quote: Put off your imagination, as you put off your overcoat, when you enter the laboratory. Put it on again, as you put on your overcoat, when you leave.
32256.name: Claude Bernard

32257.quote: Some of us are interested in directors, but really the vast majority of us are interested in actors. You experience the films through the actors, so they're all locked into your imagination in some kind of layer of fantasy or hatred or wherever they settle into your imagination.
32257.name: Danny Boyle

32258.quote: You experience the films through the actors, so they're all locked into your imagination in some kind of layer of fantasy or hatred or wherever they settle into your imagination.
32258.name: Danny Boyle

32259.quote: It was just very interesting to me that certain types of women inspire people's imagination, and all of them were very difficult women.
32259.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

32260.quote: My imagination, my ability to understand the way love and people grow over time, how passion can surprise and renew, utterly failed me.
32260.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

32261.quote: I know how fiction matters to me, because if I want to express myself, I have to make up a story. Some people call it imagination. To me, it's not imagination. It's just a way of watching.
32261.name: Haruki Murakami

32262.quote: Jehovah God is truly rich far beyond the imagination of humankind.
32262.name: Joseph Franklin Rutherford

32263.quote: My identity is linked to my grandmother, who's pure Filipino, as pure as you can probably get. And that shaped my imagination. So that's how I identify.
32263.name: Jessica Hagedorn

32264.quote: Today the function of the artist is to bring imagination to science and science to imagination, where they meet, in the myth.
32264.name: Cyril Connolly

32265.quote: The imagination is part of the arsenal that actors draw from.
32265.name: Bryan Cranston

32266.quote: If Copenhagen were a person, that person would be generous, beautiful, elderly, but with a flair. A human being that has certain propensities for quarrelling, filled with imagination and with appetite for the new and with respect for the old - somebody who takes good care of things and of people.
32266.name: Connie Nielsen

32267.quote: The four cornerstones of character on which the structure of this nation was built are: Initiative, Imagination, Individuality and Independence.
32267.name: Eddie Rickenbacker

32268.quote: Obviously the imagination is fueled by emotions beyond the control of the conscious mind.
32268.name: Joyce Carol Oates

32269.quote: Another side to me is this very sexual being. When I look back on my life, it's always been there. It's been there since I was 10 years old, having the imagination that I had.
32269.name: Janet Jackson

32270.quote: I had a pretty sexual imagination for a kid.
32270.name: Janet Jackson

32271.quote: The English language is nobody's special property. It is the property of the imagination: it is the property of the language itself.
32271.name: Derek Walcott

32272.quote: It would be a bitter cosmic joke if we destroy ourselves due to atrophy of the imagination.
32272.name: Martha Gellhorn

32273.quote: Novelists are not equipped to make a movie, in my opinion. They make their own movie when they write: they're casting, they're dressing the scene, they're working out where the energy of the scene is coming from and they're also relying tremendously on the creative imagination of the reader.
32273.name: John le Carre

32274.quote: I don't think it's possible to touch people's imagination today by aesthetic means.
32274.name: J. G. Ballard

32275.quote: To regard the imagination as metaphysics is to think of it as part of life, and to think of it as part of life is to realize the extent of artifice. We live in the mind.
32275.name: Wallace Stevens

32276.quote: The most dire disaster in love is the death of imagination.
32276.name: George Meredith

32277.quote: People can die of mere imagination.
32277.name: Geoffrey Chaucer

32278.quote: I guess I'm a very keen observer, and I'd like to think I have a good imagination.
32278.name: Eric Bana

32279.quote: Sometimes a character is really based on research that you do. Other times it's just based on your imagination or perhaps your conversation with the director. Or sometimes all of the above. It depends on the movie and character.
32279.name: Joaquin Phoenix

32280.quote: For us artists there waits the joyous compromise through art with all that wounded or defeated us in daily life in this way, not to evade destiny, as the ordinary people try to do, but to fulfil it in its true potential - the imagination.
32280.name: Lawrence Durrell

32281.quote: I'm a light sleeper. I've never been one of those people who can put their head down and suddenly everything disappears. Nighttime is the time I get most scared, anxious or worried. In those darker moments before waking or sleeping is when I feel most, I don't know, I can turn on myself, and my imagination can take me dark places.
32281.name: Florence Welch

32282.quote: It would be too frightening for me to consider myself a role model. But I like the idea of not being afraid of letting your imagination rule you, to feel the freedom of expression, to let creativity be your overwhelming drive rather than other things.
32282.name: Florence Welch

32283.quote: I've got quite a vivid imagination and I'm easily overwhelmed by sensations and things that are beautiful or scary. I don't think I've ever seen a ghost - I think I'm probably haunted by my own ghosts than real ones.
32283.name: Florence Welch

32284.quote: It is clear that the pharmaceutical industry is not, by any stretch of the imagination, doing enough to ensure that the poor have access to adequate medical care.
32284.name: Paul Farmer

32285.quote: I was raised not to be afraid to show emotion or imagination.
32285.name: Javier Bardem

32286.quote: Pulp existed for 12 years before we got famous. Now, you could say that was just lack of imagination, but it's some kind of quality isn't it? Tenacity. You could also say it was sloth.
32286.name: Jarvis Cocker

32287.quote: Today mythical thinking has fallen into disrepute we often dismiss it as irrational and self-indulgent. But the imagination is also the faculty that has enabled scientists to bring new knowledge to light and to invent technology that has made us immeasurably more effective.
32287.name: Karen Armstrong

32288.quote: I enjoy working on a movie that lets your imagination run wild, it's great to be a part of and watch.
32288.name: Chris Hemsworth

32289.quote: I'm not a passive person by any stretch of the imagination.
32289.name: Courteney Cox

32290.quote: My greatest strength as a child, I realize now, was my imagination. While every other kid was reading and writing, I had seven whole hours a day to practice my imagination. When do you get that space in your life, ever?
32290.name: Barbara Corcoran

32291.quote: If my accent betrayed my foreign birth, it also stamped me as an enemy, in the imagination of the producers.
32291.name: Bela Lugosi

32292.quote: Appealing workplaces are to be avoided. One wants a room with no view, so imagination can meet memory in the dark.
32292.name: Annie Dillard

32293.quote: I wouldn't say that I've had a tough life by any stretch of the imagination.
32293.name: Duncan Sheik

32294.quote: Philosophy and Art both render the invisible visible by imagination.
32294.name: George Henry Lewes

32295.quote: I made a real specific decision when I came out of school and most artists were writing about home - if you were a woman, you were writing about being a woman - and I decided not to do that, write about what you know. That's not what I do. I went as far away from home as possible in terms of the development of my imagination.
32295.name: Anna Deavere Smith

32296.quote: A discerning eye needs only a hint, and understatement leaves the imagination free to build its own elaborations.
32296.name: Russell Page

32297.quote: There is only one admirable form of the imagination: the imagination that is so intense that it creates a new reality, that it makes things happen.
32297.name: Sean O'Faolain

32298.quote: For someone who writes fiction, in order to activate the imagination and the unconscious, it's essential to be free.
32298.name: Manuel Puig

32299.quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
32299.name: Jonas Salk

32300.quote: Dr. Einstein was not successful in school, but he found something in the air from his own imagination and his own brain power, and look what he did.
32300.name: Eartha Kitt

32301.quote: One travels to run away from routine, that dreadful routine that kills all imagination and all our capacity for enthusiasm.
32301.name: Ella Maillart

32302.quote: I can get very philosophical and ask the questions Keats was asking as a young guy. What are we here for? What's a soul? What's it all about? What is thinking about, imagination?
32302.name: Jane Campion

32303.quote: There's no artist in this world that doesn't enjoy the dream that if they have bad reviews now, the story of Keats can redeem them, in their fantasy or imagination, in the future. I think Keats' poem 'Endymion' is a really difficult poem, and I'm not surprised that a lot of people pulled it apart in a way.
32303.name: Jane Campion

32304.quote: I feel that directors at times are like the janitors on the set. I am the secretary, I am the organizer, I am the maid, and I ask if they have eaten or rested. The best things are always out of your control. It's those moments that surpass the imagination that are thrilling.
32304.name: Jane Campion

32305.quote: To my mind the boy who gives least promise is one in whom the critical faculty develops in advance of the imagination.
32305.name: Quintilian

32306.quote: Every time you get on a stage or in front of a camera, the whole exercise is about imagination. You're constantly depicting something that doesn't exist, and trying to find the reality of it. Once you settle on that premise, everything else is a matter of degrees.
32306.name: Ron Perlman

32307.quote: Three centuries after the appearance of Franklin's 'Courant,' it no longer requires a dystopic imagination to wonder who will have the dubious distinction of publishing America's last genuine newspaper. Few believe that newspapers in their current printed form will survive.
32307.name: Eric Alterman

32308.quote: To me, it's far more efficient to mobilize the imagination. It's far more efficient to hear a creaking step, for example, than to see the face of a monster, which usually looks ridiculous, and where you know that the blood is ketchup.
32308.name: Michael Haneke

32309.quote: Without imagination we can go nowhere. And imagination is not restricted to the arts. Every scientist I have met who has been a success has had to imagine.
32309.name: Rita Dove

32310.quote: I would find myself laughing and wondering where these ideas came from. You can call it imagination, I suppose. But I was grateful for wherever they came from.
32310.name: Amy Tan

32311.quote: Imagination is the air of mind.
32311.name: Philip James Bailey

32312.quote: Cynicism and naivety lie cheek by jowl in the American imagination if the United States is one of the most venal nations on Earth, it is also one of the most earnestly idealistic.
32312.name: Terry Eagleton

32313.quote: The development of beauty in chess never depends on you alone. No matter how much imagination and creativity you invest, you still do not create beauty. Your opponent must react at the same highest level.
32313.name: Vladimir Kramnik

32314.quote: It's through the small things that we develop our moral imagination, so that we can understand the sufferings of others.
32314.name: Alexander McCall Smith

32315.quote: Imagination is not the exclusive appanage of artists, but belongs in varying degrees to all men.
32315.name: George Henry Lewes

32316.quote: He is indebted to his memory for his jests and to his imagination for his facts.
32316.name: Richard Brinsley Sheridan

32317.quote: The first piece of music that captured my imagination was probably Ray Charles Live At Newport.
32317.name: Van Morrison

32318.quote: I write from my imagination, not from what I've read in books or seen on TV or to make money. I wrote from an idea I was passionate about.
32318.name: Dirk Benedict

32319.quote: Someone once said that history has more imagination than all the scenario writers in the Pentagon, and we have a lot of scenario writers here. No one ever wrote a scenario for commercial airliners crashing into the World Trade Center.
32319.name: Paul Wolfowitz

32320.quote: I don't like this idea of Method. I come from that school, but what I was taught was that it's your imagination. You do your homework, and you use your imagination.
32320.name: Mark Ruffalo

32321.quote: The desire to live in our imagination is driven by this suspicion that we're disembodied sensibilities cobbled into our bodies. That idea has infused most of human thought since the very beginning.
32321.name: Richard Powers

32322.quote: I still have a photo on my wall of the greatest idol I will ever have in my life, and it's myself at eight. Because that's when the forces of imagination have the same value as the real world, when they're an instrument of survival: when my mother disappeared, and I imagined a mother. That was me at my best.
32322.name: Henning Mankell

32323.quote: I like something where I can really use my imagination and be an active participant in the construction of the monster and usually that's in the world of the supernatural or the world of the fantastic, so that's why those kinds of stories about demons and the supernatural appeal to me or maybe I'm really interested in that subject.
32323.name: Sam Raimi

32324.quote: Our imagination just needs space. It's all it needs, that moment where you just sort of stare into the distance where your brain gets to sort of somehow rise up.
32324.name: Glen Hansard

32325.quote: One way we can enliven the imagination is to push it toward the illogical. We're not scientists. We don't always have to make the logical, reasonable leap.
32325.name: Stella Adler

32326.quote: I deeply adored my mum. She was an extraordinary person, even for the prejudice I'm likely to have. She was beautiful, amusing, a tremendous elaborator of things into comic proportions and extravagant in her imagination.
32326.name: Andrew Motion

32327.quote: The human imagination, has great difficulty in living strictly within the confines of a materialist practice or philosophy. It dreams, like a dog in its basket, of hares in the open.
32327.name: John Berger

32328.quote: I'm an emotional sort of person in general and I have a vivid imagination, so I feel the whole spectrum of emotion strongly when I write.
32328.name: Erin Morgenstern

32329.quote: Ultimately, so much Dr. Seuss is about empowerment. He invites us to disappear into our imagination and then blows the doors off what that can mean.
32329.name: Gary Ross

32330.quote: I use a lot of film images, analogies, and imagination.
32330.name: Carlos Fuentes

32331.quote: I am not interested in slice of life, what I want is a slice of the imagination.
32331.name: Carlos Fuentes

32332.quote: There must be room for the imagination to exercise its powers we must conceive and apprehend a thousand things which we do not actually witness.
32332.name: William Godwin

32333.quote: There can be no passion, and by consequence no love, where there is not imagination.
32333.name: William Godwin

32334.quote: There's just so many great stories in the past that you can know a little bit about, but you can't know it all, and that's where imagination can work.
32334.name: Geraldine Brooks

32335.quote: The thing that most attracts me to historical fiction is taking the factual record as far as it is known, using that as scaffolding, and then letting imagination build the structure that fills in those things we can never find out for sure.
32335.name: Geraldine Brooks

32336.quote: You want to do something that shows some type individuality and talent and imagination - at the same time, you want to be truthful to the predecessors, because obviously the audience liked something about them and you have to replicate that experience to a certain extent.
32336.name: Renny Harlin

32337.quote: A young imagination is bold, likes to make bigger leaps. It likes to, well, imagine that the dustbuster is a dinosaur that the computer mouse is a hotrod that the box is a cave that the rawhide is a torch, or a baton, or something.
32337.name: Mo Rocca

32338.quote: Lyrically I like to use themes that make the listener use his or her imagination, and to give a little of the lessons I've learned in my own life.
32338.name: Ronnie James Dio

32339.quote: Many memory techniques involve creating unforgettable imagery, in your mind's eye. That's an act of imagination. Creating really weird imagery really quickly was the most fun part of my training to compete in the U.S. Memory Competition.
32339.name: Joshua Foer

32340.quote: I tried to stir the imagination and enthusiasms of students to take risks, to do what they were most afraid of doing, to widen their horizons of action.
32340.name: James Broughton

32341.quote: Dreaming is an act of pure imagination, attesting in all men a creative power, which if it were available in waking, would make every man a Dante or Shakespeare.
32341.name: Frederick Henry Hedge

32342.quote: I feel very giddy with the idea of making my imagination take form and being able to put on a show where people leave feeling like they've experienced something.
32342.name: Carly Rae Jepsen

32343.quote: On the one hand, the guns were there to help capture the imagination of the people. But more important, since we knew that you couldn't observe the police without guns, we took our guns with us to let the police know that we have an equalizer.
32343.name: Bobby Seale

32344.quote: How can a doctor judge a woman's sanity by merely bidding her good morning and refusing to hear her pleas for release? Even the sick ones know it is useless to say anything, for the answer will be that it is their imagination.
32344.name: Nellie Bly

32345.quote: I look back into past history, the stored experiences or products of the imagination. I look no further forward than the evening.
32345.name: Jerzy Kosinski

32346.quote: Love doesn't grow on trees like apples in Eden - it's something you have to make. And you must use your imagination too.
32346.name: Joyce Cary

32347.quote: I have been afraid all my life that I am going to die. All my life it has been stuffed in my imagination.
32347.name: Patty Duke

32348.quote: There is no better way of exercising the imagination than the study of law. No poet ever interpreted nature as freely as a lawyer interprets the truth.
32348.name: Jean Giraudoux

32349.quote: We all know here that the law is the most powerful of schools for the imagination. No poet ever interpreted nature as freely as a lawyer interprets the truth.
32349.name: Jean Giraudoux

32350.quote: When something is such a creative medium as the web, the limits to it are our imagination.
32350.name: Tim Berners Lee

32351.quote: You will obtain a vision of matter that is perhaps fatiguing for your imagination, but pure and stripped of what the requirements of life make you add to it in external perception.
32351.name: Henri Bergson

32352.quote: I have an imagination because my life is so boring that my imagination lets me get off the reality of what's going on.
32352.name: Dave Attell

32353.quote: I'm looking for a way out of here. I can't have it physically, so I'm going to have it intellectually. It was a beautiful thing to ride Seabiscuit in my imagination. And it's just fantastic to be there alongside Louie as he's breaking the NCAA mile record. People at these vigorous moments in their lives - it's my way of living vicariously.
32353.name: Laura Hillenbrand

32354.quote: My favorite literature to read is fairly dry history. I like the framework, and my imagination can do the rest.
32354.name: Andrew Bird

32355.quote: I suffer from the delusion that every product of my imagination is not only possible, but always on the cusp of becoming real.
32355.name: Sean Parker

32356.quote: Vision gets the dreams started. Dreaming employs your God-given imagination to reinforce the vision. Both are part of something I believe is absolutely necessary to building the life of a champion, a winner, a person of high character who is consistently at the top of whatever game he or she is in.
32356.name: Emmitt Smith

32357.quote: Use your imagination, and you'll see that even the most narrow, humdrum lives are infinite in scope if you examine them with enough care.
32357.name: Mark Haddon

32358.quote: I don't necessarily start with the beginning of the book. I just start with the part of the story that's most vivid in my imagination and work forward and backward from there.
32358.name: Beverly Cleary

32359.quote: I think my imagination dictates the technologies I use. But at the same time, my imagination can be technologic. Sometimes I see a tool and I know immediately how to use it, but most of the time I use the tool for an idea I already have.
32359.name: Michel Gondry

32361.quote: It's not only imagination, it's the distortion of the vision. You suddenly think, This person is idealistic, this person is strong, this person has dreams, when you know better most of the time. You put what you want to see on people.
32361.name: Olivier Martinez
