33053.quote: He that is jealous is not in love.
33053.name: Saint Augustine

33054.quote: It is not love that is blind, but jealousy.
33054.name: Lawrence Durrell

33055.quote: Jealousy is all the fun you think they had.
33055.name: Erica Jong

33056.quote: Jealousy is the tribute mediocrity pays to genius.
33056.name: Fulton J. Sheen

33057.quote: Jealousy is no more than feeling alone against smiling enemies.
33057.name: Elizabeth Bowen

33058.quote: That's the way I got along in life. I don't ever remember being particularly jealous of anybody, because I figured if I can't do it myself, I don't deserve to get it.
33058.name: Clyde Tombaugh

33059.quote: Jealous, adj. Unduly concerned about the preservation of that which can be lost only if not worth keeping.
33059.name: Ambrose Bierce

33060.quote: Jealousy is a dog's bark which attracts thieves.
33060.name: Karl Kraus

33061.quote: You can be the moon and still be jealous of the stars.
33061.name: Gary Allan

33062.quote: Jealousy is never satisfied with anything short of an omniscience that would detect the subtlest fold of the heart.
33062.name: George Eliot

33063.quote: The jealous are possessed by a mad devil and a dull spirit at the same time.
33063.name: Johann Kaspar Lavater

33064.quote: Jealousy is the fear of comparison.
33064.name: Max Frisch

33065.quote: I am drawn to women who are independent and creative, which is problematic because it's a struggle, a competition of careers. There's jealousy.
33065.name: Marilyn Manson

33066.quote: If one of two lovers is loyal, and the other jealous and false, how may their friendship last, for Love is slain!
33066.name: Marie de France

33067.quote: Like hatred, jealousy is forbidden by the laws of life because it is essentially destructive.
33067.name: Alexis Carrel

33068.quote: Moral indignation is jealousy with a halo.
33068.name: H. G. Wells

33069.quote: Jealousy, that dragon which slays love under the pretence of keeping it alive.
33069.name: Havelock Ellis

33070.quote: Jealousy - that jumble of secret worship and ostensible aversion.
33070.name: Emile M. Cioran

33071.quote: Hunger, revenge, to sleep are petty foes, But only death the jealous eyes can close.
33071.name: William Wycherley

33072.quote: More men die of jealousy than of cancer.
33072.name: Joseph P. Kennedy

33073.quote: Those who are believed to be most abject and humble are usually most ambitious and envious.
33073.name: Baruch Spinoza

33074.quote: There is never jealousy where there is not strong regard.
33074.name: Washington Irving

33075.quote: There's no regret. You can't regret. I mean, I've felt regret but I've also refused to allow regret to sow a seed and live in me because I don't believe it. You feel it, it's like guilt, it's like jealousy, it's like all those horrible things. You've just got to snip them and get them out, because they're no good.
33075.name: Jude Law

33076.quote: I would rather drudge out my life on a cotton plantation, till the grave opened to give me rest, than to live with an unprincipled master and a jealous mistress.
33076.name: Harriet Ann Jacobs

33077.quote: As iron is eaten away by rust, so the envious are consumed by their own passion.
33077.name: Antisthenes

33078.quote: There is no greater glory than love, nor any great punishment than jealously.
33078.name: Lope de Vega

33079.quote: The lovesick, the betrayed, and the jealous all smell alike.
33079.name: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

33080.quote: The envious die not once, but as oft as the envied win applause.
33080.name: Baltasar Gracian

33081.quote: Jealousy is the fear or apprehension of superiority: envy our uneasiness under it.
33081.name: William Shenstone

33082.quote: I have never been jealous. Not even when my dad finished fifth grade a year before I did.
33082.name: Jeff Foxworthy

33083.quote: Jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire.
33083.name: Solomon Ibn Gabirol

33084.quote: Jealousy is the tie that binds, and binds, and binds.
33084.name: Helen Rowland

33085.quote: Magnanimous people have no vanity, they have no jealousy, and they feed on the true and the solid wherever they find it. And, what is more, they find it everywhere.
33085.name: Van Wyck Brooks

33086.quote: From heresy, frenzy and jealousy, good Lord deliver me.
33086.name: Ludovico Ariosto

33087.quote: Passion can quickly slip to jealousy, or even hatred.
33087.name: Arthur Golden

33088.quote: Jealousy is the jaundice of the soul.
33088.name: John Dryden

33089.quote: Jealousy is the grave of affection.
33089.name: Mary Baker Eddy

33090.quote: Man is jealous because of his amour propre woman is jealous because of her lack of it.
33090.name: Germaine Greer

33091.quote: But I like not these great success of yours for I know how jealous are the gods.
33091.name: Herodotus

33092.quote: Nothing is more capable of troubling our reason, and consuming our health, than secret notions of jealousy in solitude.
33092.name: Aphra Behn

33093.quote: The knives of jealousy are honed on details.
33093.name: Ruth Rendell

33094.quote: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own, Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy.
33094.name: Robert A. Heinlein

33095.quote: Serious sport has nothing to do with fair play. It is bound up with hatred, jealousy, boastfulness, disregard of all rules and sadistic pleasure in witnessing violence. In other words, it is war minus the shooting.
33095.name: George Orwell

33096.quote: Anger and jealousy can no more bear to lose sight of their objects than love.
33096.name: George Eliot

33097.quote: What I needed most was to love and to be loved, eager to be caught. Happily I wrapped those painful bonds around me and sure enough, I would be lashed with the red-hot pokers or jealousy, by suspicions and fear, by burst of anger and quarrels.
33097.name: Saint Augustine

33098.quote: Jealousy is bred in doubts. When those doubts change into certainties, then the passion either ceases or turns absolute madness.
33098.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

33099.quote: I don't think that you can fake warmth. You can fake lust, jealousy, anger those are all quite easy. But actual, genuine warmth? I don't think you can fake it.
33099.name: Keira Knightley

33100.quote: The thermometer of success is merely the jealousy of the malcontents.
33100.name: Salvador Dali

33101.quote: Jealousy lives upon doubts. It becomes madness or ceases entirely as soon as we pass from doubt to certainty.
33101.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

33102.quote: It's amazing the clarity that comes with psychotic jealousy.
33102.name: Rupert Everett

33103.quote: Lovers may be - and indeed generally are - enemies, but they never can be friends, because there must always be a spice of jealousy and a something of Self in all their speculations.
33103.name: Lord Byron

33104.quote: What makes the pain we feel from shame and jealousy so cutting is that vanity can give us no assistance in bearing them.
33104.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

33105.quote: Love shouldn't be about jealousy or anything like that. It should be about commitment and being able to trust that person. If you can't have that from the get-go, there's a problem.
33105.name: Aaron Carter

33106.quote: There is a sort of jealousy which needs very little fire it is hardly a passion, but a blight bred in the cloudy, damp despondency of uneasy egoism.
33106.name: George Eliot

33107.quote: The surest route to breeding jealousy is to compare. Since jealousy comes from feeling less than another, comparisons only fan the fires.
33107.name: Dorothy Corkville Briggs

33108.quote: Dogs are our link to paradise. They don't know evil or jealousy or discontent.
33108.name: Milan Kundera

33109.quote: To talk about balance, it's easier to talk about what's out of balance. And I think anytime that you have any disease, and disease meaning lack of ease, lack of flow, dis-ease. So any time there's disease, you're out of balance, whether it's jealousy, anger, greed, anxiety, fear.
33109.name: Ricky Williams

33110.quote: That is ever the way. 'Tis all jealousy to the bride and good wishes to the corpse.
33110.name: James M. Barrie

33111.quote: Back then I didn't think a woman like that, or a relationship like that, could exist with complete freedom and no jealousy or possessiveness. I thought it sounded too good to be true and I was certainly convinced it wasn't the life for me!
33111.name: Sylvia Kristel

33112.quote: Jealousy is not at all low, but it catches us humbled and bowed down, at first sight.
33112.name: Sidonie Gabrielle Colette

33113.quote: Nature is at work. Character and destiny are her handiwork. She gives us love and hate, jealousy and reverence. All that is ours is the power to choose which impulse we shall follow.
33113.name: David Seabury

33114.quote: People can do all kinds of things that maybe aren't wise in hindsight because of jealousy.
33114.name: Kristin Bauer van Straten

33115.quote: In my experience lust only ever leads to misery. All that suspicion and jealousy and anguish it unleashes. I don't want those things in my life.
33115.name: Chrissie Hynde

33116.quote: There is something mean in human nature that prefers to think evil, that gives a willing ear and a ready welcome to calumny, a sort of jealousy of goodness and greatness and things of good report.
33116.name: Richard Le Gallienne

33117.quote: Jealousy would be far less torturous if we understood that love is a passion entirely unrelated to our merits.
33117.name: Paul Eldridge

33118.quote: I feel like a lot of the female relationships I see on TV or in movies are in some way free of the kind of jealousy and anxiety and posturing that has been such a huge part of my female friendships, which I hope lessens a little bit with age.
33118.name: Lena Dunham

33119.quote: But when I would see the surrogate, my first instinct, my first reaction would be jealousy, because she was doing what I wanted to do.
33119.name: Cheryl Tiegs

33120.quote: I have experienced jealousy, possessiveness, verbal abuse and violence from men, but I have also experienced jealousy, possessiveness, verbal abuse and violence from women, usually when I failed to respond to their advances.
33120.name: Julie Burchill

33121.quote: I do not say anything from jealousy.
33121.name: Anna Held

33122.quote: Lovers may be and indeed generally are enemies, but they never can be friends, because there must always be a spice of jealousy and a something of Self in all their speculations.
33122.name: George Byron

33123.quote: I do a lot of sexy publicity, but I have yet to have any bad experiences regarding jealousy.
33123.name: Brooke Burke

33124.quote: Religion can make it worse. Are you supposing that if people were encouraged to believe in a transcendent reality, and to be encouraged by grand rituals and music and preaching, to love their neighbors, then they would put jealousy and frustration aside?
33124.name: Mary Douglas

33125.quote: The jealousy and resentment that animate the terrorists also affect many of our former cold war allies.
33125.name: Richard Perle

33126.quote: I like jealous men. I love jealousy. I do.
33126.name: Adriana Lima

33127.quote: There tends to be a jealousy in England towards countries that are successful.
33127.name: Chris O'Dowd

33128.quote: No jealousy their dawn of love overcast, nor blasted were their wedded days with strife each season looked delightful as it past, to the fond husband and the faithful wife.
33128.name: James Beattie

33129.quote: You will not accept credit that is due to another, or harbor jealousy of an explorer who is more fortunate.
33129.name: Abbott L. Lowell

33130.quote: It is remarkable that jealousy of individual property in land often goes along with very exaggerated doctrines of tribal or national property in land.
33130.name: William Graham Sumner

33131.quote: Jealousy is love bed of burning snarl.
33131.name: George Meredith

33132.quote: I don't watch that much comedy. I think it's professional jealousy. That and a lack of support for my community.
33132.name: Michael Ian Black

33133.quote: Obviously, in dealing with a relationship, sexuality has to be involved, and jealousy and emotions like that. And I don't know, I've always been intrigued by those emotions.
33133.name: Adrian Lyne

33134.quote: My birth neither shook the German Empire nor caused much of an upheaval in the home. It pleased mother, caused father a certain amount of pride and my elder brother the usual fraternal jealousy of a hitherto only son.
33134.name: Conrad Veidt

33135.quote: That's one of the reasons I moved to Florida. Of course, the main reason is the weather and the training. But there's more jealousy in Switzerland because it's so little and they don't have so many athletes.
33135.name: Martina Hingis

33136.quote: When I see a good singer, I get teary-eyed. Part of it is jealousy because all comedians are frustrated rock stars. That's a fact.
33136.name: Jeff Ross

33137.quote: Critics? Don't talk to me of critics! You think some jackanapes journalist, his soul eaten away by the maggots of jealousy and failure, has anything worthwhile to say of art? I don't.
33137.name: Jonathan Raban

33138.quote: On the same line of reasoning, if Australians were to be Australians, or rather if Australians were as separate from any other nation as Australia from any other land, there would be no jealousy between them on England's account.
33138.name: Henry Lawson

33139.quote: That is ever the way. Tis all jealousy to the bride and good wishes to the corpse.
33139.name: J. M. Barrie

33140.quote: I don't get jealousy, I don't get how people hate each other - I never did.
33140.name: Nas

33141.quote: What we used to say was whoever had the bow tie got to lead the band. There was never any jealousy.
33141.name: Pete Fountain

33142.quote: The true sign of intelligence is not knowledge but imagination.
33142.name: Albert Einstein

33144.quote: A people without the knowledge of their past history, origin and culture is like a tree without roots.
33144.name: Marcus Garvey

33145.quote: Knowledge of what is does not open the door directly to what should be.
33145.name: Albert Einstein

33146.quote: Ignorance is the curse of God knowledge is the wing wherewith we fly to heaven.
33146.name: William Shakespeare

33147.quote: Real knowledge is to know the extent of one's ignorance.
33147.name: Confucius

33148.quote: He who knows nothing is closer to the truth than he whose mind is filled with falsehoods and errors.
33148.name: Thomas Jefferson

33149.quote: I was bold in the pursuit of knowledge, never fearing to follow truth and reason to whatever results they led, and bearding every authority which stood in their way.
33149.name: Thomas Jefferson

33150.quote: Knowledge is love and light and vision.
33150.name: Helen Keller

33151.quote: If money is your hope for independence you will never have it. The only real security that a man will have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience, and ability.
33151.name: Henry Ford

33152.quote: When you know a thing, to hold that you know it, and when you do not know a thing, to allow that you do not know it - this is knowledge.
33152.name: Confucius

33153.quote: Pain and foolishness lead to great bliss and complete knowledge, for Eternal Wisdom created nothing under the sun in vain.
33153.name: Khalil Gibran

33154.quote: No man can reveal to you nothing but that which already lies half-asleep in the dawning of your knowledge.
33154.name: Khalil Gibran

33155.quote: Knowledge is knowing that we cannot know.
33155.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

33156.quote: Perplexity is the beginning of knowledge.
33156.name: Khalil Gibran

33157.quote: To know, is to know that you know nothing. That is the meaning of true knowledge.
33157.name: Socrates

33158.quote: It is not when truth is dirty, but when it is shallow, that the lover of knowledge is reluctant to step into its waters.
33158.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

33159.quote: Human behavior flows from three main sources: desire, emotion, and knowledge.
33159.name: Plato

33160.quote: And what, Socrates, is the food of the soul? Surely, I said, knowledge is the food of the soul.
33160.name: Plato

33161.quote: To know that we know what we know, and to know that we do not know what we do not know, that is true knowledge.
33161.name: Nicolaus Copernicus

33162.quote: Entire ignorance is not so terrible or extreme an evil, and is far from being the greatest of all too much cleverness and too much learning, accompanied with ill bringing-up, are far more fatal.
33162.name: Plato

33163.quote: The learning and knowledge that we have, is, at the most, but little compared with that of which we are ignorant.
33163.name: Plato

33164.quote: Opinion is the medium between knowledge and ignorance.
33164.name: Plato

33165.quote: Knowledge without justice ought to be called cunning rather than wisdom.
33165.name: Plato

33166.quote: All the knowledge I possess everyone else can acquire, but my heart is all my own.
33166.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

33167.quote: There is much pleasure to be gained from useless knowledge.
33167.name: Bertrand Russell

33168.quote: The possession of knowledge does not kill the sense of wonder and mystery. There is always more mystery.
33168.name: Anais Nin

33169.quote: Knowledge which is acquired under compulsion obtains no hold on the mind.
33169.name: Plato

33171.quote: The only real security that a man can have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience and ability.
33171.name: Henry Ford

33173.quote: Let us tenderly and kindly cherish, therefore, the means of knowledge. Let us dare to read, think, speak, and write.
33173.name: John Adams

33174.quote: We know accurately only when we know little, with knowledge doubt increases.
33174.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

33175.quote: One whose knowledge is confined to books and whose wealth is in the possession of others, can use neither his knowledge nor wealth when the need for them arises.
33175.name: Chanakya

33176.quote: Knowledge has to be improved, challenged, and increased constantly, or it vanishes.
33176.name: Peter Drucker

33177.quote: Even the knowledge of my own fallibility cannot keep me from making mistakes. Only when I fall do I get up again.
33177.name: Vincent Van Gogh

33178.quote: All our knowledge begins with the senses, proceeds then to the understanding, and ends with reason. There is nothing higher than reason.
33178.name: Immanuel Kant

33179.quote: Knowledge is power. Information is liberating. Education is the premise of progress, in every society, in every family.
33179.name: Kofi Annan

33180.quote: All our knowledge has its origins in our perceptions.
33180.name: Leonardo da Vinci

33181.quote: Where is all the knowledge we lost with information?
33181.name: T. S. Eliot

33182.quote: Where there is shouting, there is no true knowledge.
33182.name: Leonardo da Vinci

33183.quote: If knowledge can create problems, it is not through ignorance that we can solve them.
33183.name: Isaac Asimov

33184.quote: Suppose that we are wise enough to learn and know - and yet not wise enough to control our learning and knowledge, so that we use it to destroy ourselves? Even if that is so, knowledge remains better than ignorance.
33184.name: Isaac Asimov

33185.quote: The aim of education is the knowledge not of facts but of values.
33185.name: William Ralph Inge

33186.quote: I prefer tongue-tied knowledge to ignorant loquacity.
33186.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

33187.quote: Knowledge which is divorced from justice, may be called cunning rather than wisdom.
33187.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

33188.quote: Today knowledge has power. It controls access to opportunity and advancement.
33188.name: Peter Drucker

33189.quote: Knowledge is a polite word for dead but not buried imagination.
33189.name: Edward Estlin (e. e. cummings)

33190.quote: Those people who develop the ability to continuously acquire new and better forms of knowledge that they can apply to their work and to their lives will be the movers and shakers in our society for the indefinite future.
33190.name: Brian Tracy

33191.quote: Property may be destroyed and money may lose its purchasing power but, character, health, knowledge and good judgement will always be in demand under all conditions.
33191.name: Roger Babson

33192.quote: The true method of knowledge is experiment.
33192.name: William Blake

33193.quote: Humility and knowledge in poor clothes excel pride and ignorance in costly attire.
33193.name: William Penn

33194.quote: Reading furnishes the mind only with materials of knowledge it is thinking that makes what we read ours.
33194.name: John Locke

33195.quote: As the biggest library if it is in disorder is not as useful as a small but well-arranged one, so you may accumulate a vast amount of knowledge but it will be of far less value than a much smaller amount if you have not thought it over for yourself.
33195.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

33196.quote: The only good is knowledge, and the only evil is ignorance.
33196.name: Herodotus

33197.quote: If education is always to be conceived along the same antiquated lines of a mere transmission of knowledge, there is little to be hoped from it in the bettering of man's future. For what is the use of transmitting knowledge if the individual's total development lags behind?
33197.name: Maria Montessori

33198.quote: Knowledge is of two kinds. We know a subject ourselves, or we know where we can find information upon it.
33198.name: Samuel Johnson

33199.quote: Knowledge is power only if man knows what facts not to bother with.
33199.name: Robert Staughton Lynd

33200.quote: I would rather excel in the knowledge of what is excellent, than in the extent of my power and possessions.
33200.name: Plutarch

33201.quote: I had therefore to remove knowledge, in order to make room for belief.
33201.name: Immanuel Kant

33202.quote: Without knowledge action is useless and knowledge without action is futile.
33202.name: Abu Bakr

33203.quote: No man's knowledge here can go beyond his experience.
33203.name: John Locke

33204.quote: This life that has been given to us as a gift, as such a precious gift. To really try to understand it, really try to recognize it, is the greatest meditation. Through the media of this Knowledge we can tap into our inner sources that are so beautiful.
33204.name: Prem Rawat

33205.quote: Our knowledge can only be finite, while our ignorance must necessarily be infinite.
33205.name: Karl Popper

33206.quote: Consider your origins: you were not made to live as brutes, but to follow virtue and knowledge.
33206.name: Dante Alighieri

33207.quote: Knowledge is power. Information is power. The secreting or hoarding of knowledge or information may be an act of tyranny camouflaged as humility.
33207.name: Robin Morgan

33208.quote: Depend upon it there comes a time when for every addition of knowledge you forget something that you knew before. It is of the highest importance, therefore, not to have useless facts elbowing out the useful ones.
33208.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

33209.quote: They say a little knowledge is a dangerous thing, but it's not one half so bad as a lot of ignorance.
33209.name: Terry Pratchett

33210.quote: Evil being the root of mystery, pain is the root of knowledge.
33210.name: Simone Weil

33211.quote: It is harder to conceal ignorance than to acquire knowledge.
33211.name: Arnold H. Glasow

33212.quote: We are drowning in information but starved for knowledge.
33212.name: John Naisbitt

33213.quote: Knowledge is like money: to be of value it must circulate, and in circulating it can increase in quantity and, hopefully, in value.
33213.name: Louis L'Amour

33214.quote: Cherish that which is within you, and shut off that which is without for much knowledge is a curse.
33214.name: Zhuangzi

33215.quote: If you first fortify yourself with the true knowledge of the Universal Self, and then live in the midst of wealth and worldliness, surely they will in no way affect you.
33215.name: Ramakrishna

33216.quote: The knower and the known are one. Simple people imagine that they should see God as if he stood there and they here. This is not so. God and I, we are one in knowledge.
33216.name: Meister Eckhart

33217.quote: To be educated, a person doesn't have to know much or be informed, but he or she does have to have been exposed vulnerably to the transformative events of an engaged human life.
33217.name: Thomas More

33218.quote: Without self knowledge, without understanding the working and functions of his machine, man cannot be free, he cannot govern himself and he will always remain a slave.
33218.name: G. I. Gurdjieff

33219.quote: Even knowledge has to be in the fashion, and where it is not, it is wise to affect ignorance.
33219.name: Baltasar Gracian

33220.quote: We live on an island surrounded by a sea of ignorance. As our island of knowledge grows, so does the shore of our ignorance.
33220.name: John Archibald Wheeler

33221.quote: Every addition to true knowledge is an addition to human power.
33221.name: Horace Mann

33222.quote: Knowledge is the life of the mind.
33222.name: Abu Bakr

33223.quote: Knowledge is the eye of desire and can become the pilot of the soul.
33223.name: Will Durant

33224.quote: When a man's knowledge is not in order, the more of it he has the greater will be his confusion.
33224.name: Herbert Spencer

33225.quote: I think we risk becoming the best informed society that has ever died of ignorance.
33225.name: Ruben Blades

33226.quote: To acquire knowledge, one must study but to acquire wisdom, one must observe.
33226.name: Marilyn vos Savant

33227.quote: Any knowledge that doesn't lead to new questions quickly dies out: it fails to maintain the temperature required for sustaining life.
33227.name: Wislawa Szymborska

33228.quote: The ability to perceive or think differently is more important than the knowledge gained.
33228.name: David Bohm

33229.quote: Knowledge is not a passion from without the mind, but an active exertion of the inward strength, vigor and power of the mind, displaying itself from within.
33229.name: Ralph Cudworth

33230.quote: I'm hungry for knowledge. The whole thing is to learn every day, to get brighter and brighter. That's what this world is about. You look at someone like Gandhi, and he glowed. Martin Luther King glowed. Muhammad Ali glows. I think that's from being bright all the time, and trying to be brighter.
33230.name: Jay-Z

33231.quote: Never stop learning knowledge doubles every fourteen months.
33231.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

33232.quote: The knowledge of yourself will preserve you from vanity.
33232.name: Miguel de Cervantes

33233.quote: If you have knowledge, let others light their candles in it.
33233.name: Margaret Fuller

33234.quote: It is one of my sources of happiness never to desire a knowledge of other people's business.
33234.name: Dolley Madison

33235.quote: The knowledge of anything, since all things have causes, is not acquired or complete unless it is known by its causes.
33235.name: Avicenna

33236.quote: Having knowledge but lacking the power to express it clearly is no better than never having any ideas at all.
33236.name: Pericles

33237.quote: A man of knowledge lives by acting, not by thinking about acting.
33237.name: Carlos Castaneda

33238.quote: We don't know all the answers. If we knew all the answers we'd be bored, wouldn't we? We keep looking, searching, trying to get more knowledge.
33238.name: Jack LaLanne

33239.quote: I'll come to you with gifts of knowledge, wisdom and truth.
33239.name: Barry White

33240.quote: To know what you know and what you do not know, that is true knowledge.
33240.name: Kong Fu Zi

33241.quote: Knowledge is soon changed, then lost in the mist, an echo half-heard.
33241.name: Gene Wolfe

33242.quote: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
33242.name: Thomas Carlyle

33243.quote: For beautiful eyes, look for the good in others for beautiful lips, speak only words of kindness and for poise, walk with the knowledge that you are never alone.
33243.name: Audrey Hepburn

33244.quote: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
33244.name: Albert Einstein

33245.quote: The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack of will.
33245.name: Vince Lombardi

33246.quote: The only source of knowledge is experience.
33246.name: Albert Einstein

33247.quote: It is the supreme art of the teacher to awaken joy in creative expression and knowledge.
33247.name: Albert Einstein

33248.quote: Whoever undertakes to set himself up as a judge of Truth and Knowledge is shipwrecked by the laughter of the gods.
33248.name: Albert Einstein

33249.quote: Science investigates religion interprets. Science gives man knowledge which is power religion gives man wisdom which is control.
33249.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

33250.quote: Beware of false knowledge it is more dangerous than ignorance.
33250.name: George Bernard Shaw

33251.quote: The gift of fantasy has meant more to me than my talent for absorbing positive knowledge.
33251.name: Albert Einstein

33252.quote: There comes a time when the mind takes a higher plane of knowledge but can never prove how it got there.
33252.name: Albert Einstein

33253.quote: The fact that I can plant a seed and it becomes a flower, share a bit of knowledge and it becomes another's, smile at someone and receive a smile in return, are to me continual spiritual exercises.
33253.name: Leo Buscaglia

33254.quote: Faith is a knowledge within the heart, beyond the reach of proof.
33254.name: Khalil Gibran

33255.quote: A thorough knowledge of the Bible is worth more than a college education.
33255.name: Theodore Roosevelt

33256.quote: An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.
33256.name: Benjamin Franklin

33257.quote: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.
33257.name: Bruce Lee

33258.quote: A little knowledge that acts is worth infinitely more than much knowledge that is idle.
33258.name: Khalil Gibran

33259.quote: Carry out a random act of kindness, with no expectation of reward, safe in the knowledge that one day someone might do the same for you.
33259.name: Princess Diana

33260.quote: It takes considerable knowledge just to realize the extent of your own ignorance.
33260.name: Thomas Sowell

33261.quote: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.
33261.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

33262.quote: I think this is the most extraordinary collection of talent, of human knowledge, that has ever been gathered at the White House - with the possible exception of when Thomas Jefferson dined alone.
33262.name: John F. Kennedy

33263.quote: True knowledge exists in knowing that you know nothing.
33263.name: Socrates

33264.quote: Thought is the wind, knowledge the sail, and mankind the vessel.
33264.name: Augustus Hare

33266.quote: The greater our knowledge increases the more our ignorance unfolds.
33266.name: John F. Kennedy

33267.quote: True friendship can afford true knowledge. It does not depend on darkness and ignorance.
33267.name: Henry David Thoreau

33268.quote: Knowledge will forever govern ignorance and a people who mean to be their own governors must arm themselves with the power which knowledge gives.
33268.name: James Madison

33269.quote: A good decision is based on knowledge and not on numbers.
33269.name: Plato

33270.quote: I wash my hands of those who imagine chattering to be knowledge, silence to be ignorance, and affection to be art.
33270.name: Khalil Gibran

33271.quote: The doorstep to the temple of wisdom is a knowledge of our own ignorance.
33271.name: Benjamin Franklin

33272.quote: Knowledge of the self is the mother of all knowledge. So it is incumbent on me to know my self, to know it completely, to know its minutiae, its characteristics, its subtleties, and its very atoms.
33272.name: Khalil Gibran

33273.quote: I believe that imagination is stronger than knowledge. That myth is more potent than history. That dreams are more powerful than facts. That hope always triumphs over experience. That laughter is the only cure for grief. And I believe that love is stronger than death.
33273.name: Robert Fulghum

33274.quote: The person you consider ignorant and insignificant is the one who came from God, that he might learn bliss from grief and knowledge from gloom.
33274.name: Khalil Gibran

33275.quote: The goal of education is the advancement of knowledge and the dissemination of truth.
33275.name: John F. Kennedy

33276.quote: All men by nature desire knowledge.
33276.name: Aristotle

33277.quote: The one exclusive sign of thorough knowledge is the power of teaching.
33277.name: Aristotle

33278.quote: Wonder rather than doubt is the root of all knowledge.
33278.name: Abraham Joshua Heschel

33279.quote: The saddest aspect of life right now is that science gathers knowledge faster than society gathers wisdom.
33279.name: Isaac Asimov

33280.quote: Knowledge cultivates your seeds and does not sow in your seeds.
33280.name: Khalil Gibran

33281.quote: If the Great Way perishes there will morality and duty. When cleverness and knowledge arise great lies will flourish. When relatives fall out with one another there will be filial duty and love. When states are in confusion there will be faithful servants.
33281.name: Lao Tzu

33282.quote: Those who have knowledge, don't predict. Those who predict, don't have knowledge.
33282.name: Lao Tzu

33283.quote: Our treasure lies in the beehive of our knowledge. We are perpetually on the way thither, being by nature winged insects and honey gatherers of the mind.
33283.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

33284.quote: After all manner of professors have done their best for us, the place we are to get knowledge is in books. The true university of these days is a collection of books.
33284.name: Albert Camus

33285.quote: The recipe for perpetual ignorance is: Be satisfied with your opinions and content with your knowledge.
33285.name: Elbert Hubbard

33286.quote: There is one quality which one must possess to win, and that is definiteness of purpose, the knowledge of what one wants, and a burning desire to possess it.
33286.name: Napoleon Hill

33287.quote: In a battle all you need to make you fight is a little hot blood and the knowledge that it's more dangerous to lose than to win.
33287.name: George Bernard Shaw

33288.quote: Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge: it is those who know little, and not those who know much, who so positively assert that this or that problem will never be solved by science.
33288.name: Charles Darwin

33289.quote: Where is the Life we have lost in living? Where is the wisdom we have lost in knowledge? Where is the knowledge we have lost in information?
33289.name: T. S. Eliot

33290.quote: Good nature is worth more than knowledge, more than money, more than honor, to the persons who possess it.
33290.name: Henry Ward Beecher

33291.quote: All men are born with a nose and ten fingers, but no one was born with a knowledge of God.
33291.name: Voltaire

33292.quote: Three passions, simple but overwhelmingly strong, have governed my life: the longing for love, the search for knowledge, and unbearable pity for the suffering of mankind.
33292.name: Bertrand Russell

33293.quote: Only on paper has humanity yet achieved glory, beauty, truth, knowledge, virtue, and abiding love.
33293.name: George Bernard Shaw

33294.quote: What we want is to see the child in pursuit of knowledge, and not knowledge in pursuit of the child.
33294.name: George Bernard Shaw

33295.quote: Compassion is sometimes the fatal capacity for feeling what it is like to live inside somebody else's skin. It is the knowledge that there can never really be any peace and joy for me until there is peace and joy finally for you too.
33295.name: Frederick Buechner

33297.quote: The interpretation of dreams is the royal road to a knowledge of the unconscious activities of the mind.
33297.name: Sigmund Freud

33298.quote: Wisdom is the right use of knowledge. To know is not to be wise. Many men know a great deal, and are all the greater fools for it. There is no fool so great a fool as a knowing fool. But to know how to use knowledge is to have wisdom.
33298.name: Charles Spurgeon

33299.quote: The modern mind is in complete disarray. Knowledge has stretched itself to the point where neither the world nor our intelligence can find any foot-hold. It is a fact that we are suffering from nihilism.
33299.name: Albert Camus

33300.quote: I think I have a duty as a recovering guy to help, to make my knowledge of what I went through accessible.
33300.name: Charlie Sheen

33301.quote: A belief in hell and the knowledge that every ambition is doomed to frustration at the hands of a skeleton have never prevented the majority of human beings from behaving as though death were no more than an unfounded rumor.
33301.name: Aldous Huxley

33302.quote: Sorrow is knowledge, those that know the most must mourn the deepest, the tree of knowledge is not the tree of life.
33302.name: Lord Byron

33303.quote: It is an infantile superstition of the human spirit that virginity would be thought a virtue and not the barrier that separates ignorance from knowledge.
33303.name: Voltaire

33304.quote: Data is not information, information is not knowledge, knowledge is not understanding, understanding is not wisdom.
33304.name: Clifford Stoll

33305.quote: I'm a student of world religion, so to me, it's hugely important to have knowledge and to understand what people are doing.
33305.name: Will Smith

33306.quote: Music is the one incorporeal entrance into the higher world of knowledge which comprehends mankind but which mankind cannot comprehend.
33306.name: Ludwig van Beethoven

33307.quote: Science is a way of thinking much more than it is a body of knowledge.
33307.name: Carl Sagan

33308.quote: Knowledge becomes evil if the aim be not virtuous.
33308.name: Plato

33309.quote: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
33309.name: Bertrand Russell

33310.quote: Dogmatism and skepticism are both, in a sense, absolute philosophies one is certain of knowing, the other of not knowing. What philosophy should dissipate is certainty, whether of knowledge or ignorance.
33310.name: Bertrand Russell

33311.quote: Liberty cannot be preserved without general knowledge among the people.
33311.name: John Adams

33312.quote: Love takes up where knowledge leaves off.
33312.name: Thomas Aquinas

33313.quote: We did it Disneyland, in the knowledge that most of the people I talked to thought it would be a financial disaster - closed and forgotten within the first year.
33313.name: Walt Disney

33314.quote: The wise man should restrain his senses like the crane and accomplish his purpose with due knowledge of his place, time and ability.
33314.name: Chanakya

33315.quote: The greatest obstacle to discovery is not ignorance - it is the illusion of knowledge.
33315.name: Daniel J. Boorstin

33316.quote: Knowledge comes, but wisdom lingers. It may not be difficult to store up in the mind a vast quantity of facts within a comparatively short time, but the ability to form judgments requires the severe discipline of hard work and the tempering heat of experience and maturity.
33316.name: Calvin Coolidge

33317.quote: Because in the school of the Spirit man learns wisdom through humility, knowledge by forgetting, how to speak by silence, how to live by dying.
33317.name: Johannes Tauler

33318.quote: We are here and it is now. Further than that, all human knowledge is moonshine.
33318.name: H. L. Mencken

33319.quote: A toothache, or a violent passion, is not necessarily diminished by our knowledge of its causes, its character, its importance or insignificance.
33319.name: T. S. Eliot

33320.quote: Do not share the knowledge with which you have been blessed with everyone in general, as you do with some people in particular and know that there are some men in whom Allah, may He he glorified, has placed hidden secrets, which they are forbidden to reveal.
33320.name: Ali ibn Abi Talib

33321.quote: There's only one effectively redemptive sacrifice, the sacrifice of self-will to make room for the knowledge of God.
33321.name: Aldous Huxley

33322.quote: God had brought me to my knees and made me acknowledge my own nothingness, and out of that knowledge I had been reborn. I was no longer the centre of my life and therefore I could see God in everything.
33322.name: Bede Griffiths

33323.quote: Youth is the period in which a man can be hopeless. The end of every episode is the end of the world. But the power of hoping through everything, the knowledge that the soul survives its adventures, that great inspiration comes to the middle-aged.
33323.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

33324.quote: No group and no government can properly prescribe precisely what should constitute the body of knowledge with which true education is concerned.
33324.name: Franklin D. Roosevelt

33325.quote: Knowledge is of no value unless you put it into practice.
33325.name: Anton Chekhov

33326.quote: The advertisements in a newspaper are more full knowledge in respect to what is going on in a state or community than the editorial columns are.
33326.name: Henry Ward Beecher

33327.quote: A manager is responsible for the application and performance of knowledge.
33327.name: Peter Drucker

33328.quote: Knowledge about life is one thing effective occupation of a place in life, with its dynamic currents passing through your being, is another.
33328.name: William James

33329.quote: It is in moments of illness that we are compelled to recognize that we live not alone but chained to a creature of a different kingdom, whole worlds apart, who has no knowledge of us and by whom it is impossible to make ourselves understood: our body.
33329.name: Marcel Proust

33331.quote: Thought must be divided against itself before it can come to any knowledge of itself.
33331.name: Aldous Huxley

33332.quote: Knowledge is invariably a matter of degree: you cannot put your finger upon even the simplest datum and say this we know.
33332.name: T. S. Eliot

33333.quote: Checking the results of a decision against its expectations shows executives what their strengths are, where they need to improve, and where they lack knowledge or information.
33333.name: Peter Drucker

33334.quote: Integrity without knowledge is weak and useless, and knowledge without integrity is dangerous and dreadful.
33334.name: Samuel Johnson

33335.quote: Anyone who thinks that the vice-president can take a position independent of the president of his administration simply has no knowledge of politics or government. You are his choice in a political marriage, and he expects your absolute loyalty.
33335.name: Hubert H. Humphrey

33336.quote: Mistakes are, after all, the foundations of truth, and if a man does not know what a thing is, it is at least an increase in knowledge if he knows what it is not.
33336.name: Carl Jung

33337.quote: He who has so little knowledge of human nature as to seek happiness by changing anything but his own disposition will waste his life in fruitless efforts.
33337.name: Samuel Johnson

33338.quote: Faith: Belief without evidence in what is told by one who speaks without knowledge, of things without parallel.
33338.name: Ambrose Bierce

33339.quote: The first step in a person's salvation is knowledge of their sin.
33339.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

33340.quote: It makes a great deal of difference whether one wills not to sin or has not the knowledge to sin.
33340.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

33341.quote: Universities exist to transmit knowledge and understanding of ideas and values to students not to provide entertainment for spectators or employment for athletes.
33341.name: Milton Friedman

33342.quote: A civilization is a heritage of beliefs, customs, and knowledge slowly accumulated in the course of centuries, elements difficult at times to justify by logic, but justifying themselves as paths when they lead somewhere, since they open up for man his inner distance.
33342.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

33343.quote: Knowledge rests not upon truth alone, but upon error also.
33343.name: Carl Jung

33344.quote: Science is organized knowledge. Wisdom is organized life.
33344.name: Immanuel Kant

33345.quote: The degree of one's emotions varies inversely with one's knowledge of the facts.
33345.name: Bertrand Russell

33346.quote: Happiness exists on earth, and it is won through prudent exercise of reason, knowledge of the harmony of the universe, and constant practice of generosity.
33346.name: Jose Marti

33347.quote: Illness is the doctor to whom we pay most heed to kindness, to knowledge, we make promise only pain we obey.
33347.name: Marcel Proust

33348.quote: The more knowledge you have, the greater will be your fear of Allah.
33348.name: Abu Bakr

33349.quote: The small part of ignorance that we arrange and classify we give the name of knowledge.
33349.name: Ambrose Bierce

33350.quote: Ardor, n. The quality that distinguishes love without knowledge.
33350.name: Ambrose Bierce

33351.quote: In friendship as well as love, ignorance very often contributes more to our happiness than knowledge.
33351.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

33352.quote: The study and knowledge of the universe would somehow be lame and defective were no practical results to follow.
33352.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

33353.quote: It is now common knowledge that the average American gains 7 pounds between Thanksgiving and New Year's Day.
33353.name: Marilu Henner

33354.quote: Between falsehood and useless truth there is little difference. As gold which he cannot spend will make no man rich, so knowledge which cannot apply will make no man wise.
33354.name: Samuel Johnson

33356.quote: Wisdom is knowledge which has become a part of one's being.
33356.name: Orison Swett Marden

33357.quote: If you want to know the taste of a pear, you must change the pear by eating it yourself. If you want to know the theory and methods of revolution, you must take part in revolution. All genuine knowledge originates in direct experience.
33357.name: Mao Zedong

33358.quote: Knowledge can be communicated, but not wisdom. One can find it, live it, be fortified by it, do wonders through it, but one cannot communicate and teach it.
33358.name: Hermann Hesse

33360.quote: Vanity of science. Knowledge of physical science will not console me for ignorance of morality in time of affliction, but knowledge of morality will always console me for ignorance of physical science.
33360.name: Blaise Pascal

33361.quote: The knowledge of God is very far from the love of Him.
33361.name: Blaise Pascal

33362.quote: Every great advance in natural knowledge has involved the absolute rejection of authority.
33362.name: Thomas Huxley

33363.quote: To be conscious that you are ignorant of the facts is a great step to knowledge.
33363.name: Benjamin Disraeli

33364.quote: Prices are important not because money is considered paramount but because prices are a fast and effective conveyor of information through a vast society in which fragmented knowledge must be coordinated.
33364.name: Thomas Sowell

33365.quote: The great end of life is not knowledge but action.
33365.name: Francis Bacon

33366.quote: The more extensive a man's knowledge of what has been done, the greater will be his power of knowing what to do.
33366.name: Benjamin Disraeli

33367.quote: It is not ignorance but knowledge which is the mother of wonder.
33367.name: Joseph Wood Krutch

33368.quote: Knowledge slowly builds up what Ignorance in an hour pulls down.
33368.name: George Eliot

33369.quote: Scientists have become the bearers of the torch of discovery in our quest for knowledge.
33369.name: Stephen Hawking

33370.quote: Those Dutchmen had hardly any imagination or fantasy, but their good taste and their scientific knowledge of composition were enormous.
33370.name: Vincent Van Gogh

33371.quote: A little knowledge is a dangerous thing, but a little want of knowledge is also a dangerous thing.
33371.name: Samuel Butler

33372.quote: The price one pays for pursuing any profession, or calling, is an intimate knowledge of its ugly side.
33372.name: James A. Baldwin

33373.quote: Parents are usually more careful to bestow knowledge on their children rather than virtue, the art of speaking well rather than doing well but their manners should be of the greatest concern.
33373.name: R. Buckminster Fuller

33374.quote: He that hath knowledge spareth his words.
33374.name: Francis Bacon

33375.quote: To act on the belief that we possess the knowledge and the power which enable us to shape the processes of society entirely to our liking, knowledge which in fact we do not possess, is likely to make us do much harm.
33375.name: Friedrich August von Hayek

33376.quote: Some people drink from the fountain of knowledge, others just gargle.
33376.name: Robert Anthony

33377.quote: The two operations of our understanding, intuition and deduction, on which alone we have said we must rely in the acquisition of knowledge.
33377.name: Rene Descartes

33378.quote: Although modesty is natural to man, it is not natural to children. Modesty only begins with the knowledge of evil.
33378.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

33379.quote: Science knows no country, because knowledge belongs to humanity, and is the torch which illuminates the world. Science is the highest personification of the nation because that nation will remain the first which carries the furthest the works of thought and intelligence.
33379.name: Louis Pasteur

33380.quote: The desire of excessive power caused the angels to fall the desire of knowledge caused men to fall.
33380.name: Francis Bacon

33381.quote: The fundament upon which all our knowledge and learning rests is the inexplicable.
33381.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

33382.quote: Wisdom is the power to put our time and our knowledge to the proper use.
33382.name: Thomas J. Watson

33383.quote: It is beyond a doubt that all our knowledge that begins with experience.
33383.name: Immanuel Kant

33384.quote: It's very strange that most people don't care if their knowledge of their family history only goes back three generations.
33384.name: Doug Coupland

33385.quote: Knowledge and human power are synonymous.
33385.name: Francis Bacon

33386.quote: Leisure and curiosity might soon make great advances in useful knowledge, were they not diverted by minute emulation and laborious trifles.
33386.name: Samuel Johnson

33387.quote: The youth of an art is, like the youth of anything else, its most interesting period. When it has come to the knowledge of good and evil it is stronger, but we care less about it.
33387.name: Samuel Butler

33388.quote: There are three principal means of acquiring knowledge, observation of nature, reflection, and experimentation. Observation collects facts reflection combines them experimentation verifies the result of that combination.
33388.name: Denis Diderot

33389.quote: Intuition and concepts constitute, the elements of all our knowledge, so that neither concepts without an intuition in some way corresponding to them, nor intuition without concepts, can yield knowledge.
33389.name: Immanuel Kant

33390.quote: If a little knowledge is dangerous, where is the man who has so much as to be out of danger?
33390.name: Thomas Huxley

33391.quote: The greatest gift is the passion for reading. It is cheap, it consoles, it distracts, it excites, it gives you knowledge of the world and experience of a wide kind. It is a moral illumination.
33391.name: Moses Hadas

33392.quote: Knowledge without education is but armed injustice.
33392.name: Horace

33393.quote: Knowledge is proud that it knows so much wisdom is humble that it knows no more.
33393.name: William Cowper

33394.quote: Science is the father of knowledge, but opinion breeds ignorance.
33394.name: Hippocrates

33395.quote: Knowledge is not eating, and we cannot expect to devour and possess what we mean. Knowledge is recognition of something absent it is a salutation, not an embrace.
33395.name: George Santayana

33396.quote: When you deal with a person who's experiencing dementia, you can see where they're struggling with knowledge. You can see what they forget completely, what they forget but they know what they once knew. You can tell how they're trying to remember.
33396.name: Walter Mosley

33397.quote: I think a lot of people, even Christians, are willing to be satisfied with gaining lots and lots of biblical knowledge - and many people go to Bible studies and don't realize it isn't enough to know what's right, it's applying the information and the knowledge that you have.
33397.name: Charles Stanley

33398.quote: We can be knowledgable with other men's knowledge but we cannot be wise with other men's wisdom.
33398.name: Michel de Montaigne

33399.quote: There is no desire more natural than the desire for knowledge.
33399.name: Michel de Montaigne

33400.quote: Zeal without knowledge is fire without light.
33400.name: Thomas Fuller

33401.quote: Our knowledge is a little island in a great ocean of nonknowledge.
33401.name: Isaac Bashevis Singer

33402.quote: Sin, guilt, neurosis they are one and the same, the fruit of the tree of knowledge.
33402.name: Henry Miller

33403.quote: I served the famous professors and scholars, and eventually they learned that the Reverend Moon is superior to them. Even Nobel laureate academics who thought they were at the center of knowledge are as nothing in front of me.
33403.name: Sun Myung Moon

33404.quote: What does mysticism really mean? It means the way to attain knowledge. It's close to philosophy, except in philosophy you go horizontally while in mysticism you go vertically.
33404.name: Elie Wiesel

33405.quote: I had rather excel others in the knowledge of what is excellent, than in the extent of my power and dominion.
33405.name: Alexander the Great

33406.quote: If the education of our kids comes from radio, television, newspapers - if that's where they get most of their knowledge from, and not from the schools, then the powers that be are definitely in charge, because they own all those outlets.
33406.name: Maynard James Keenan

33407.quote: In expanding the field of knowledge we but increase the horizon of ignorance.
33407.name: Henry Miller

33408.quote: If in preaching the gospel you substitute your knowledge of the way of salvation for confidence in the power of the gospel, you hinder people from getting to reality.
33408.name: Oswald Chambers

33409.quote: A novel that does not uncover a hitherto unknown segment of existence is immoral. Knowledge is the novel's only morality.
33409.name: Milan Kundera

33410.quote: And I pray thee, loving Jesus, that as Thou hast graciously given me to drink in with delight the words of Thy knowledge, so Thou wouldst mercifully grant me to attain one day to Thee, the fountain of all wisdom and to appear forever before Thy face.
33410.name: Venerable Bede

33411.quote: If repression has indeed been the fundamental link between power, knowledge, and sexuality since the classical age, it stands to reason that we will not be able to free ourselves from it except at a considerable cost.
33411.name: Michel Foucault

33412.quote: The improver of natural knowledge absolutely refuses to acknowledge authority, as such. For him, skepticism is the highest of duties blind faith the one unpardonable sin.
33412.name: Thomas Huxley

33413.quote: Knowledge of God's Word is a bulwark against deception, temptation, accusation, even persecution.
33413.name: Edwin Louis Cole

33414.quote: It is not knowledge, but the act of learning, not possession but the act of getting there, which grants the greatest enjoyment.
33414.name: Carl Friedrich Gauss

33415.quote: Borrowing knowledge of reality from all sources, taking the best from every study, Science of Mind brings together the highest enlightenment of the ages.
33415.name: Ernest Holmes

33416.quote: I don't claim to be knowledgeable about theology. Most of my knowledge comes out of my experience and the lessons in the Bible. Every Sunday I'm home I teach 45 minutes and we boiled them down to one page for the new book, 'Through the Year with Jimmy Carter.'
33416.name: Jimmy Carter

33417.quote: Nothing leads so straight to futility as literary ambitions without systematic knowledge.
33417.name: H. G. Wells

33418.quote: The medieval university looked backwards it professed to be a storehouse of old knowledge. The modern university looks forward, and is a factory of new knowledge.
33418.name: Thomas Huxley

33419.quote: I know that I have lived because I have felt, and, feeling giving me the knowledge of my existence, I know likewise that I shall exist no more when I shall have ceased to feel.
33419.name: Giacomo Casanova

33420.quote: A jazz musician can improvise based on his knowledge of music. He understands how things go together. For a chef, once you have that basis, that's when cuisine is truly exciting.
33420.name: Charlie Trotter

33421.quote: The advancement and diffusion of knowledge is the only guardian of true liberty.
33421.name: James Madison

33422.quote: The aim of education is the knowledge, not of facts, but of values.
33422.name: William S. Burroughs

33423.quote: Knowledge of what is possible is the beginning of happiness.
33423.name: George Santayana

33424.quote: The Supreme Court has insulted you over and over again, Lord. They've taken your Bible away from the schools. They've forbidden little children to pray. They've taken the knowledge of God as best they can, and organizations have come into court to take the knowledge of God out of the public square of America.
33424.name: Pat Robertson

33425.quote: Life is a culmination of the past, an awareness of the present, an indication of a future beyond knowledge, the quality that gives a touch of divinity to matter.
33425.name: Charles Lindbergh

33426.quote: The seat of knowledge is in the head of wisdom, in the heart. We are sure to judge wrong, if we do not feel right.
33426.name: William Hazlitt

33427.quote: Only divine love bestows the keys of knowledge.
33427.name: Arthur Rimbaud

33428.quote: The improvement of understanding is for two ends: first, our own increase of knowledge secondly, to enable us to deliver that knowledge to others.
33428.name: John Locke

33429.quote: The only fence against the world is a thorough knowledge of it.
33429.name: John Locke

33430.quote: All our knowledge merely helps us to die a more painful death than animals that know nothing.
33430.name: Maurice Maeterlinck

33431.quote: Knowledge is recognition of something absent it is a salutation, not an embrace.
33431.name: George Santayana

33432.quote: The utmost extent of man's knowledge, is to know that he knows nothing.
33432.name: Joseph Addison

33433.quote: We own almost all our knowledge not to those who have agreed but to those who have differed.
33433.name: Charles Caleb Colton

33434.quote: Zeal will do more than knowledge.
33434.name: William Hazlitt

33435.quote: The animals that depend on instinct have an inherent knowledge of the laws of economics and of how to apply them Man, with his powers of reason, has reduced economics to the level of a farce which is at once funnier and more tragic than Tobacco Road.
33435.name: James Thurber

33436.quote: We can't have full knowledge all at once. We must start by believing then afterwards we may be led on to master the evidence for ourselves.
33436.name: Thomas Aquinas

33437.quote: Wonder is the desire for knowledge.
33437.name: Thomas Aquinas

33438.quote: When a doctor does go wrong he is the first of criminals. He has nerve and he has knowledge.
33438.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

33439.quote: His ignorance was as remarkable as his knowledge.
33439.name: Arthur Conan Doyle

33440.quote: How dreadful knowledge of the truth can be when there's no help in the truth.
33440.name: Sophocles

33441.quote: Where all is but dream, reasoning and arguments are of no use, truth and knowledge nothing.
33441.name: John Locke

33442.quote: It is the province of knowledge to speak, and it is the privilege of wisdom to listen.
33442.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

33443.quote: The knowledge of God is the cause of things. For the knowledge of God is to all creatures what the knowledge of the artificer is to things made by his art.
33443.name: Thomas Aquinas

33444.quote: My mom took me to see Carnal Knowledge and The Wild Bunch and all these kind of movies when I was a kid.
33444.name: Quentin Tarantino

33445.quote: Your knowledge of what is going on can only be superficial and relative.
33445.name: William S. Burroughs
