34623.quote: I never learn anything talking. I only learn things when I ask questions.
34623.name: Lou Holtz

34624.quote: People always ask me, 'What is it that you regret?' And I say, 'nothing, because I could not buy what I've learned.' And I apply those things to my life I learn. And hopefully, hopefully it helps me to be a better human in the future and make better choices.
34624.name: Katy Perry

34625.quote: The minute that you're not learning I believe you're dead.
34625.name: Jack Nicholson

34626.quote: Anyone who stops learning is old, whether at twenty or eighty. Anyone who keeps learning stays young. The greatest thing in life is to keep your mind young.
34626.name: Henry Ford

34627.quote: The only thing that interferes with my learning is my education.
34627.name: Albert Einstein

34628.quote: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
34628.name: Colin Powell

34629.quote: Learning to trust is one of life's most difficult tasks.
34629.name: Isaac Watts

34630.quote: Learning is the beginning of wealth. Learning is the beginning of health. Learning is the beginning of spirituality. Searching and learning is where the miracle process all begins.
34630.name: Jim Rohn

34631.quote: Leave all the afternoon for exercise and recreation, which are as necessary as reading. I will rather say more necessary because health is worth more than learning.
34631.name: Thomas Jefferson

34632.quote: Develop a passion for learning. If you do, you will never cease to grow.
34632.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

34633.quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
34633.name: W. Clement Stone

34634.quote: Everybody who is incapable of learning has taken to teaching.
34634.name: Oscar Wilde

34635.quote: While I thought that I was learning how to live, I have been learning how to die.
34635.name: Leonardo da Vinci

34636.quote: Learning without thought is labor lost thought without learning is perilous.
34636.name: Confucius

34637.quote: No man ever prayed heartily without learning something.
34637.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

34638.quote: I made decisions that I regret, and I took them as learning experiences, I'm human, not perfect, like anybody else.
34638.name: Queen Latifah

34639.quote: A lot of the problems I had with fame I was bringing on myself. A lot of self-loathing, a lot of woe-is-me. Now I'm learning to see the positive side of things, instead of, like, 'I can't go to Kmart. I can't take my kids to the haunted house.'
34639.name: Eminem

34640.quote: Success is the result of perfection, hard work, learning from failure, loyalty, and persistence.
34640.name: Colin Powell

34641.quote: It is only when we forget all our learning that we begin to know.
34641.name: Henry David Thoreau

34642.quote: A little learning is a dangerous thing, but we must take that risk because a little is as much as our biggest heads can hold.
34642.name: George Bernard Shaw

34643.quote: Don't limit a child to your own learning, for he was born in another time.
34643.name: Rabindranath Tagore

34644.quote: Instead of giving money to found colleges to promote learning, why don't they pass a constitutional amendment prohibiting anybody from learning anything? If it works as good as the Prohibition one did, why, in five years we would have the smartest race of people on earth.
34644.name: Will Rogers

34645.quote: Men have a respect for scholarship and learning greatly out of proportion to the use they commonly serve.
34645.name: Henry David Thoreau

34646.quote: Entire ignorance is not so terrible or extreme an evil, and is far from being the greatest of all too much cleverness and too much learning, accompanied with ill bringing-up, are far more fatal.
34646.name: Plato

34647.quote: The learning and knowledge that we have, is, at the most, but little compared with that of which we are ignorant.
34647.name: Plato

34648.quote: Change is the end result of all true learning.
34648.name: Leo Buscaglia

34649.quote: The only real progress lies in learning to be wrong all alone.
34649.name: Albert Camus

34650.quote: Never make your home in a place. Make a home for yourself inside your own head. You'll find what you need to furnish it - memory, friends you can trust, love of learning, and other such things. That way it will go with you wherever you journey.
34650.name: Tad Williams

34651.quote: Each year has been so robust with problems and successes and learning experiences and human experienes that a year is a lifetime at Apple. So this has been ten lifetimes.
34651.name: Steve Jobs

34652.quote: Why don't they pass a constitutional amendment prohibiting anybody from learning anything? If it works as well as prohibition did, in five years Americans would be the smartest race of people on Earth.
34652.name: Will Rogers

34653.quote: A good teacher can inspire hope, ignite the imagination, and instill a love of learning.
34653.name: Brad Henry

34654.quote: Ignorance of all things is an evil neither terrible nor excessive, nor yet the greatest of all but great cleverness and much learning, if they be accompanied by a bad training, are a much greater misfortune.
34654.name: Plato

34655.quote: We do not learn and what we call learning is only a process of recollection.
34655.name: Plato

34656.quote: When man learns to understand and control his own behavior as well as he is learning to understand and control the behavior of crop plants and domestic animals, he may be justified in believing that he has become civilized.
34656.name: Ayn Rand

34657.quote: I would fain grow old learning many things.
34657.name: Plato

34658.quote: Wisdom is learning what to overlook.
34658.name: William James

34659.quote: The knack of flying is learning how to throw yourself at the ground and miss.
34659.name: Douglas Adams

34660.quote: If I am through learning, I am through.
34660.name: John Wooden

34661.quote: These things will destroy the human race: politics without principle, progress without compassion, wealth without work, learning without silence, religion without fearlessness and worship without awareness.
34661.name: Anthony de Mello

34662.quote: Defense is a definite part of the game, and a great part of defense is learning to play it without fouling.
34662.name: John Wooden

34663.quote: There's always failure. And there's always disappointment. And there's always loss. But the secret is learning from the loss, and realizing that none of those holes are vacuums.
34663.name: Michael J. Fox

34664.quote: Winning is great, sure, but if you are really going to do something in life, the secret is learning how to lose. Nobody goes undefeated all the time. If you can pick up after a crushing defeat, and go on to win again, you are going to be a champion someday.
34664.name: Wilma Rudolph

34665.quote: As long as you live, keep learning how to live.
34665.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

34666.quote: Some of the companies we helped start are names you know. An office supply company called Staples - where I'm pleased to see the Obama campaign has been shopping The Sports Authority, which became a favorite of my sons. We started an early childhood learning center called Bright Horizons that First Lady Michelle Obama rightly praised.
34666.name: Mitt Romney

34667.quote: Not to unlearn what you have learned is the most necessary kind of learning.
34667.name: Antisthenes

34668.quote: Play is often talked about as if it were a relief from serious learning. But for children play is serious learning. Play is really the work of childhood.
34668.name: Fred Rogers

34669.quote: An organization's ability to learn, and translate that learning into action rapidly, is the ultimate competitive advantage.
34669.name: Jack Welch

34670.quote: I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning to sail my ship.
34670.name: Aeschylus

34671.quote: A weed is a plant that has mastered every survival skill except for learning how to grow in rows.
34671.name: Doug Larson

34672.quote: The love of learning, the sequestered nooks, And all the sweet serenity of books.
34672.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

34673.quote: The books that help you most are those which make you think that most. The hardest way of learning is that of easy reading but a great book that comes from a great thinker is a ship of thought, deep freighted with truth and beauty.
34673.name: Pablo Neruda

34674.quote: Learning is finding out what you already know.
34674.name: Richard Bach

34675.quote: Life is like playing a violin solo in public and learning the instrument as one goes on.
34675.name: Samuel Butler

34676.quote: Suppose that we are wise enough to learn and know - and yet not wise enough to control our learning and knowledge, so that we use it to destroy ourselves? Even if that is so, knowledge remains better than ignorance.
34676.name: Isaac Asimov

34677.quote: Education is learning what you didn't even know you didn't know.
34677.name: Daniel J. Boorstin

34678.quote: Every act of conscious learning requires the willingness to suffer an injury to one's self-esteem. That is why young children, before they are aware of their own self-importance, learn so easily.
34678.name: Thomas Szasz

34679.quote: Painful as it may be, a significant emotional event can be the catalyst for choosing a direction that serves us - and those around us - more effectively. Look for the learning.
34679.name: Louisa May Alcott

34680.quote: A little learning, indeed, may be a dangerous thing, but the want of learning is a calamity to any people.
34680.name: Frederick Douglass

34681.quote: Learning is not attained by chance, it must be sought for with ardor and diligence.
34681.name: Abigail Adams

34682.quote: Start with God - the first step in learning is bowing down to God only fools thumb their noses at such wisdom and learning.
34682.name: King Solomon

34683.quote: Take those chances and you can achieve greatness, whereas if you go conservative, you'll never know. I truly believe what doesn't kill you makes you stronger. Even if you fail, learning and moving on is sometimes the best thing.
34683.name: Danica Patrick

34684.quote: I like to think of my behavior in the sixties as a 'learning experience.' Then again, I like to think of anything stupid I've done as a 'learning experience.' It makes me feel less stupid.
34684.name: P. J. O'Rourke

34685.quote: Learning, n. The kind of ignorance distinguishing the studious.
34685.name: Ambrose Bierce

34686.quote: Seeing much, suffering much, and studying much, are the three pillars of learning.
34686.name: Benjamin Disraeli

34687.quote: Learning and innovation go hand in hand. The arrogance of success is to think that what you did yesterday will be sufficient for tomorrow.
34687.name: William Pollard

34688.quote: Desperation is a necessary ingredient to learning anything, or creating anything. Period. If you ain't desperate at some point, you ain't interesting.
34688.name: Jim Carrey

34689.quote: Never become so much of an expert that you stop gaining expertise. View life as a continuous learning experience.
34689.name: Denis Waitley

34690.quote: The great awareness comes slowly, piece by piece. The path of spiritual growth is a path of lifelong learning. The experience of spiritual power is basically a joyful one.
34690.name: M. Scott Peck

34691.quote: The least of the work of learning is done in the classroom.
34691.name: Thomas Merton

34692.quote: A University should be a place of light, of liberty, and of learning.
34692.name: Benjamin Disraeli

34693.quote: Learning too soon our limitations, we never learn our powers.
34693.name: Mignon McLaughlin

34694.quote: People usually think according to their inclinations, speak according to their learning and ingrained opinions, but generally act according to custom.
34694.name: Francis Bacon

34695.quote: Learning how to be still, to really be still and let life happen - that stillness becomes a radiance.
34695.name: Morgan Freeman

34696.quote: The only things worth learning are the things you learn after you know it all.
34696.name: Harry S. Truman

34697.quote: There are three ingredients in the good life: learning, earning and yearning.
34697.name: Christopher Morley

34698.quote: People need to be made more aware of the need to work at learning how to live because life is so quick and sometimes it goes away too quickly.
34698.name: Andy Warhol

34699.quote: Everyone can relate to love, hurt, pain, learning how to forgive, needing to get over, needing the power of God in their life.
34699.name: Tyler Perry

34700.quote: Libraries allow children to ask questions about the world and find the answers. And the wonderful thing is that once a child learns to use a library, the doors to learning are always open.
34700.name: Laura Bush

34701.quote: Whoso neglects learning in his youth, loses the past and is dead for the future.
34701.name: Euripides

34702.quote: I thank my God for graciously granting me the opportunity of learning that death is the key which unlocks the door to our true happiness.
34702.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

34703.quote: Education is not the piling on of learning, information, data, facts, skills, or abilities - that's training or instruction - but is rather making visible what is hidden as a seed.
34703.name: Thomas Moore

34704.quote: For a man to attain to an eminent degree in learning costs him time, watching, hunger, nakedness, dizziness in the head, weakness in the stomach, and other inconveniences.
34704.name: Miguel de Cervantes

34705.quote: I continuously go further and further learning about my own limitations, my body limitation, psychological limitations. It's a way of life for me.
34705.name: Ayrton Senna

34706.quote: The truth of our faith becomes a matter of ridicule among the infidels if any Catholic, not gifted with the necessary scientific learning, presents as dogma what scientific scrutiny shows to be false.
34706.name: Thomas Aquinas

34707.quote: The fundament upon which all our knowledge and learning rests is the inexplicable.
34707.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

34708.quote: Patriotism, when it wants to make itself felt in the domain of learning, is a dirty fellow who should be thrown out of doors.
34708.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

34709.quote: Much learning does not teach understanding.
34709.name: Heraclitus

34710.quote: Learning is a result of listening, which in turn leads to even better listening and attentiveness to the other person. In other words, to learn from the child, we must have empathy, and empathy grows as we learn.
34710.name: Alice Miller

34711.quote: Failure is a great teacher, and I think when you make mistakes and you recover from them and you treat them as valuable learning experiences, then you've got something to share.
34711.name: Steve Harvey

34712.quote: It does not require great learning to be a Christian and be convinced of the truth of the Bible. It requires only an honest heart and a willingness to obey God.
34712.name: Albert Barnes

34713.quote: Learning sleeps and snores in libraries, but wisdom is everywhere, wide awake, on tiptoe.
34713.name: Josh Billings

34714.quote: Men of polite learning and a liberal education.
34714.name: Matthew Henry

34715.quote: I saw as a teacher how, if you take that spark of learning that those children have, and you ignite it, you can take a child from any background to a lifetime of creativity and accomplishment.
34715.name: Paul Wellstone

34716.quote: Even from their infancy we frame them to the sports of love: their instruction, behavior, attire, grace, learning and all their words azimuth only at love, respects only affection. Their nurses and their keepers imprint no other thing in them.
34716.name: Michel de Montaigne

34717.quote: Learning hath gained most by those books by which the printers have lost.
34717.name: Thomas Fuller

34718.quote: One of the reasons people stop learning is that they become less and less willing to risk failure.
34718.name: John W. Gardner

34719.quote: One of the greatest and simplest tools for learning more and growing is doing more.
34719.name: Washington Irving

34720.quote: The thing about being autistic is that you gradually get less and less autistic, because you keep learning, you keep learning how to behave. It's like being in a play I'm always in a play.
34720.name: Temple Grandin

34721.quote: If we wish to know the force of human genius, we should read Shakespeare. If we wish to see the insignificance of human learning, we may study his commentators.
34721.name: William Hazlitt

34722.quote: Words are but wind and learning is nothing but words ergo, learning is nothing but wind.
34722.name: Jonathan Swift

34723.quote: So in my freshman year at the University of Alabama, learning the literature on evolution, what was known about it biologically, just gradually transformed me by taking me out of literalism and increasingly into a more secular, scientific view of the world.
34723.name: E. O. Wilson

34724.quote: It is not knowledge, but the act of learning, not possession but the act of getting there, which grants the greatest enjoyment.
34724.name: Carl Friedrich Gauss

34725.quote: I'd like to be more patient! I just want everything now. I've tried to meditate, but it's really hard for me to stay still. I'd like to try to force myself to do it, because everybody says how wonderful meditation is for you, but I can't shut my mind up. So patience and learning is the key.
34725.name: Ellen DeGeneres

34726.quote: We have domesticated God's transcendence. We often learn about God at about the same time as we are learning about Santa Claus but our ideas about Santa Claus change, mature and become more nuanced, whereas our ideas of God can remain at a rather infantile level.
34726.name: Karen Armstrong

34727.quote: Neither comprehension nor learning can take place in an atmosphere of anxiety.
34727.name: Rose Kennedy

34728.quote: Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning.
34728.name: William Arthur Ward

34729.quote: But if somebody dies, if something happens to you, there is a normal process of depression, it is part of being human, and some people view it as a learning experience etc.
34729.name: Bob Geldof

34730.quote: I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning how to sail my ship.
34730.name: Louisa May Alcott

34731.quote: The highest activity a human being can attain is learning for understanding, because to understand is to be free.
34731.name: Baruch Spinoza

34732.quote: I am learning all the time. The tombstone will be my diploma.
34732.name: Eartha Kitt

34733.quote: When you stop learning, stop listening, stop looking and asking questions, always new questions, then it is time to die.
34733.name: Lillian Smith

34734.quote: What spectacle can be more edifying or more seasonable, than that of Liberty and Learning, each leaning on the other for their mutual and surest support?
34734.name: James Madison

34735.quote: I did stand-up comedy for 18 years. Ten of those years were spent learning, four years were spent refining, and four years were spent in wild success. I was seeking comic originality, and fame fell on me as a byproduct. The course was more plodding than heroic.
34735.name: Steve Martin

34736.quote: You aren't learning anything when you're talking.
34736.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

34737.quote: Irregularity and want of method are only supportable in men of great learning or genius, who are often too full to be exact, and therefore they choose to throw down their pearls in heaps before the reader, rather than be at the pains of stringing them.
34737.name: Joseph Addison

34738.quote: While the laughter of joy is in full harmony with our deeper life, the laughter of amusement should be kept apart from it. The danger is too great of thus learning to look at solemn things in a spirit of mockery, and to seek in them opportunities for exercising wit.
34738.name: Lewis Carroll

34739.quote: Learning is its own exceeding great reward.
34739.name: William Hazlitt

34740.quote: The beautiful thing about learning is nobody can take it away from you.
34740.name: B. B. King

34741.quote: Only by learning to live in harmony with your contradictions can you keep it all afloat.
34741.name: Audre Lorde

34742.quote: Poverty must not be a bar to learning and learning must offer an escape from poverty.
34742.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

34743.quote: He who has imagination without learning has wings but no feet.
34743.name: Joseph Joubert

34744.quote: A happy life is one spent in learning, earning, and yearning.
34744.name: Lillian Gish

34745.quote: I'm learning the power of going away for the weekend and keeping myself company.
34745.name: Zoe Saldana

34746.quote: We come to love not by finding a perfect person but by learning to see an imperfect person perfectly.
34746.name: Sam Keen

34747.quote: I had a lot of trouble with engineers, because their whole background is learning from a functional point of view, and then learning how to perform that function.
34747.name: Brian Eno

34748.quote: One who has imagination without learning has wings without feet.
34748.name: Joseph Joubert

34749.quote: Learning how to operate a soul figures to take time.
34749.name: Timothy Leary

34750.quote: If you're going to go through hell, I suggest you come back learning something.
34750.name: Drew Barrymore

34751.quote: Never seem wiser, nor more learned, than the people you are with. Wear your learning, like your watch, in a private pocket: and do not merely pull it out and strike it merely to show that you have one.
34751.name: Lord Chesterfield

34752.quote: Wisdom has never made a bigot, but learning has.
34752.name: Josh Billings

34753.quote: I fear the boredom that comes with not learning and not taking chances.
34753.name: Robert Fulghum

34754.quote: Perhaps I am doomed to retrace my steps under the illusion that I am exploring, doomed to try and learn what I should simply recognize, learning a mere fraction of what I have forgotten.
34754.name: Andre Breton

34755.quote: The most useful piece of learning for the uses of life is to unlearn what is untrue.
34755.name: Antisthenes

34756.quote: I think you're working and learning until you die.
34756.name: J. K. Rowling

34757.quote: I started practicing yoga. I started learning some hands-on healing stuff. And I found really good chiropractors, really good massage therapists, and what I found is I've been able to actually peel off layers of trauma on my body and actually move better now than I did.
34757.name: Ricky Williams

34758.quote: I'm learning a lot about myself being alone, and doing what I'm doing.
34758.name: Chantal Kreviazuk

34759.quote: No, I'm no enemy to learning it hurts not me.
34759.name: William Congreve

34760.quote: The main part of intellectual education is not the acquisition of facts but learning how to make facts live.
34760.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

34761.quote: Some are so very studious of learning what was done by the ancients that they know not how to live with the moderns.
34761.name: William Penn

34762.quote: Meditation here may think down hours to moments. Here the heart may give a useful lesson to the head and learning wiser grow without his books.
34762.name: William Cowper

34763.quote: Secretary Powell and I agree on every single issue that has ever been before this administration except for those instances where Colin's still learning.
34763.name: Donald Rumsfeld

34764.quote: Learning should be a joy and full of excitement. It is life's greatest adventure it is an illustrated excursion into the minds of the noble and the learned.
34764.name: Taylor Caldwell

34765.quote: A major advantage of age is learning to accept people without passing judgment.
34765.name: Liz Carpenter

34766.quote: Why waste time learning, when ignorance is instantaneous?
34766.name: Bill Watterson

34767.quote: And I believe that the best learning process of any kind of craft is just to look at the work of others.
34767.name: Wole Soyinka

34768.quote: Never seem more learned than the people you are with. Wear your learning like a pocket watch and keep it hidden. Do not pull it out to count the hours, but give the time when you are asked.
34768.name: Lord Chesterfield

34769.quote: English people don't have very good diction. In France you have to pronounce very particularly and clearly, and learning French at an early age helped me enormously.
34769.name: Vivien Leigh

34770.quote: I never found accents difficult, after learning languages.
34770.name: Vivien Leigh

34771.quote: Artists working for other artists is all about knowing, learning, unlearning, initiating long-term artistic dialogues, making connections, creating covens, and getting temporary shelter from the storm.
34771.name: Jerry Saltz

34772.quote: We are learning, too, that the love of beauty is one of Nature's greatest healers.
34772.name: Ellsworth Huntington

34773.quote: Justice turns the scale, bringing to some learning through suffering.
34773.name: Aeschylus

34774.quote: True, a little learning is a dangerous thing, but it still beats total ignorance.
34774.name: Abigail Van Buren

34775.quote: No, I got a GED in my 30s. My kids know that I never stop learning, and they know I love reading. I have books overflowing everywhere. I am current on today's events and I read the paper every day, and we talk about it, so they see that appetite.
34775.name: Michael J. Fox

34776.quote: This has been a learning experience for me. I also thought that privacy was something we were granted in the Constitution. I have learned from this when in fact the word privacy does not appear in the Constitution.
34776.name: Bill Maher

34777.quote: Philosophy is a kind of journey, ever learning yet never arriving at the ideal perfection of truth.
34777.name: Albert Pike

34778.quote: Learning music by reading about it is like making love by mail.
34778.name: Luciano Pavarotti

34779.quote: Learning to dislike children at an early age saves a lot of expense and aggravation later in life.
34779.name: Robert Byrne

34780.quote: The trouble with learning from experience is that you never graduate.
34780.name: Doug Larson

34781.quote: Perhaps the mission of those who love mankind is to make people laugh at the truth, to make truth laugh, because the only truth lies in learning to free ourselves from insane passion for the truth.
34781.name: Umberto Eco

34782.quote: That is what learning is. You suddenly understand something you've understood all your life, but in a new way.
34782.name: Doris Lessing

34783.quote: Learning to play with a big amplifier is like trying to control an elephant.
34783.name: Ritchie Blackmore

34784.quote: Yes. I did more research than I ever wanted to and saw some things I wish I didn't. I went on ride-alongs, spent time with Homicide, Cold Case, and SVU detectives, hung out in subways learning how to spot pervs and pick-pockets, viewed an autopsy, went to a police firing range, and witnessed court cases and I read, read, read.
34784.name: Mariska Hargitay

34785.quote: Learning is acquired by reading books, but the much more necessary learning, the knowledge of the world, is only to be acquired by reading men, and studying all the various facets of them.
34785.name: Lord Chesterfield

34786.quote: Let ignorance talk as it will, learning has its value.
34786.name: Jean de La Fontaine

34787.quote: Learning to make films is very easy. Learning what to make films about is very hard.
34787.name: George Lucas

34788.quote: It's only through listening that you learn, and I never want to stop learning.
34788.name: Drew Barrymore

34789.quote: I'm just learning who I am and how relationships work and how to make them function. No different from anyone else.
34789.name: Drew Barrymore

34790.quote: What makes a child gifted and talented may not always be good grades in school, but a different way of looking at the world and learning.
34790.name: Chuck Grassley

34791.quote: Never stop learning knowledge doubles every fourteen months.
34791.name: Anthony J. D'Angelo

34792.quote: The learning process is something you can incite, literally incite, like a riot.
34792.name: Audre Lorde

34793.quote: It's mainly about working hard and proving to people you're serious about it, and stretching yourself and learning. The mistake a lot of actors make, particularly young ones, is allowing themselves to feel that they're the finished articles, the bee's knees, and it's not true.
34793.name: Daniel Radcliffe

34794.quote: Wear your learning like your watch, in a private pocket and do not pull it out, and strike it, merely to show that you have one.
34794.name: Lord Chesterfield

34795.quote: We tried to have diplomas without learning, we tried to have jobs without work, we tried to have houses without savings, we tried to have government without responsibility.
34795.name: Newt Gingrich

34796.quote: This life is a process of learning.
34796.name: Lauryn Hill

34797.quote: In the transmission of human culture, people always attempt to replicate, to pass on to the next generation the skills and values of the parents, but the attempt always fails because cultural transmission is geared to learning, not DNA.
34797.name: Gregory Bateson

34798.quote: Scholastic learning and polemical divinity retarded the growth of all true knowledge.
34798.name: David Hume

34799.quote: My father is a real idealist, and he's all about learning. If I asked for a pair of Nikes growing up, it was just a resounding 'No.' But if I asked for a saxophone, one would appear and next day and I'd be signed up for lessons. So anything to do with education or learning, my father would spare no expense.
34799.name: Hugh Jackman

34800.quote: You can be self-empowered and still learning about how you think about things daily.
34800.name: Tori Amos

34801.quote: Human beings are accustomed to think of intellect as the power of having and controlling ideas and of ability to learn as synonymous with ability to have ideas. But learning by having ideas is really one of the rare and isolated events in nature.
34801.name: Edward Thorndike

34802.quote: I always found the extraordinary loss of life in the First World War very moving. I remember learning about it as a very young child, as an eight- or nine-year-old, asking my teachers what poppies were for. Every year the teachers would suddenly wear these red paper flowers in their lapels, and I would say 'What does that mean?'
34802.name: Tom Hiddleston

34803.quote: There is, so I believe, in the essence of everything, something that we cannot call learning. There is, my friend, only a knowledge - that is everywhere.
34803.name: Hermann Hesse
