36295.name: Ralph Marston

36296.quote: There is a vitality, a life force, an energy, a quickening, that is translated through you into action, and because there is only one of you in all time, this expression is unique.
36296.name: Martha Graham

36297.quote: These technologies can make life easier, can let us touch people we might not otherwise. You may have a child with a birth defect and be able to get in touch with other parents and support groups, get medical information, the latest experimental drugs. These things can profoundly influence life. I'm not downplaying that.
36297.name: Steve Jobs

36298.quote: Life is very interesting, in the end, some of your greatest pains, become your greatest strengths.
36298.name: Drew Barrymore

36299.quote: Today is life-the only life you are sure of. Make the most of today. Get interested in something. Shake yourself awake. Develop a hobby. Let the winds of enthusiasm sweep through you. Live today with gusto.
36299.name: Dale Carnegie

36300.quote: Every year of my life I grow more convinced that it is wisest and best to fix our attention on the beautiful and the good, and dwell as little as possible on the evil and the false.
36300.name: Richard Cecil

36301.quote: This is love: to fly toward a secret sky, to cause a hundred veils to fall each moment. First to let go of life. Finally, to take a step without feet.
36301.name: Rumi

36302.quote: Maxim for life: You get treated in life the way you teach people to treat you.
36302.name: Wayne Dyer

36303.quote: Every man is the architect of his own life. He builds it just the way he wants it. However, after he has built what he wants, he sometimes decides that he doesn't like what he has built and looks for someone or something to blame instead of changing himself.
36303.name: Sydney Madwed

36304.quote: Whatever you do in life, surround yourself with smart people who'll argue with you.
36304.name: John Wooden

36305.quote: Every human is an artist. The dream of your life is to make beautiful art.
36305.name: Miguel Angel Ruiz

36306.quote: Character, in the long run, is the decisive factor in the life of an individual and of nations alike.
36306.name: Theodore Roosevelt

36307.quote: Blood relatives often have nothing to do with family, and similarly, family is about who you choose to make your life with.
36307.name: Oliver Hudson

36308.name: Scott Brooks

36309.quote: How do you go from where you are to where you wanna be? And I think you have to have an enthusiasm for life. You have to have a dream, a goal. And you have to be willing to work for it.
36309.name: Jim Valvano

36310.quote: The real test of friendship is: can you literally do nothing with the other person? Can you enjoy those moments of life that are utterly simple?
36310.name: Eugene Kennedy

36311.quote: The most glorious moments in your life are not the so-called days of success, but rather those days when out of dejection and despair you feel rise in you a challenge to life, and the promise of future accomplishments.
36311.name: Gustave Flaubert

36312.quote: You come to a point in your life when you really don't care what people think about you, you just care what you think about yourself.
36312.name: Evel Knievel

36313.quote: A well-developed sense of humor is the pole that adds balance to your steps as you walk the tightrope of life.
36313.name: William Arthur Ward

36314.quote: I've been absolutely terrified every moment of my life - and I've never let it keep me from doing a single thing I wanted to do.
36314.name: Georgia O'Keeffe

36315.quote: Do the best you can, and don't take life too serious.
36315.name: Will Rogers

36316.quote: We only live once, but once is enough if we do it right. Live your life with class, dignity, and style so that an exclamation, rather than a question mark signifies it!
36316.name: Gary Ryan Blair

36317.quote: Life is only a dream and we are the imagination of ourselves.
36317.name: Bill Hicks

36318.quote: I actually thought that it would be a little confusing during the same period of your life to be in one meeting when you're trying to make money, and then go to another meeting where you're giving it away. I mean is it gonna erode your ability, you know, to make money? Are you gonna somehow get confused about what you're trying to do?
36318.name: Bill Gates

36319.quote: Attention to health is life's greatest hindrance.
36319.name: Plato

36320.quote: Friendship multiplies the good of life and divides the evil.
36320.name: Baltasar Gracian

36321.quote: School is practice for future life, practice makes perfect and nobody's perfect, so why practice?
36321.name: Billie Joe Armstrong

36322.quote: At times in my life the only place I have been happy is when I am on stage.
36322.name: Bob Dylan

36323.quote: What you get is a living, what you give is a life.
36323.name: Lillian Gish

36324.quote: Be patient and understanding. Life is too short to be vengeful or malicious.
36324.name: Phillips Brooks

36325.quote: I haven't lived a perfect life. I have regrets. But that's from a lifetime of taking chances, making decisions, and trying not to be frozen. The only thing that I can do with my regrets is understand them.
36325.name: Kevin Costner

36326.quote: The value of life lies not in the length of days, but in the use we make of them, Whether you find satisfaction in life depends not on your tale of years, but on your will.
36326.name: Michel de Montaigne

36327.quote: My trust in a higher power that wants me to survive and have love in my life, is what keeps me moving forward.
36327.name: Kenny Loggins

36328.quote: It takes half your life before you discover life is a do-it-yourself project.
36328.name: Napoleon Hill

36329.quote: He who binds to himself a joy Does the winged life destroy But he who kisses the joy as it flies Lives in eternity's sun rise.
36329.name: William Blake

36330.quote: Let us put our minds together and see what life we can make for our children.
36330.name: Sitting Bull

36331.quote: Communication is a skill that you can learn. It's like riding a bicycle or typing. If you're willing to work at it, you can rapidly improve the quality of evry part of your life.
36331.name: Brian Tracy

36332.quote: Life lived for tomorrow will always be just a day away from being realized.
36332.name: Leo Buscaglia

36333.quote: I never did a day's work in my life. It was all fun.
36333.name: Thomas A. Edison

36334.quote: Let love flow so that it cleanses the world. Then man can live in peace, instead of the state of turmoil he has created through his past ways of life, with all those material interests and earthly ambitions.
36334.name: Sai Baba

36335.quote: Sometimes it's the smallest decisions that can change your life forever.
36335.name: Keri Russell

36336.quote: There is a fountain of youth: it is your mind, your talents, the creativity you bring to your life and the lives of people you love. When you learn to tap this source, you will truly have defeated age.
36336.name: Sophia Loren

36337.quote: Life is just one damned thing after another.
36337.name: Elbert Hubbard

36338.quote: That's the way I got along in life. I don't ever remember being particularly jealous of anybody, because I figured if I can't do it myself, I don't deserve to get it.
36338.name: Clyde Tombaugh

36339.quote: Love, we say, is life but love without hope and faith is agonizing death.
36339.name: Elbert Hubbard

36340.quote: The happiness of this life depends less on what befalls you than the way in which you take it.
36340.name: Elbert Hubbard

36341.quote: It is possible to become discouraged about the injustice we see everywhere. But God did not promise us that the world would be humane and just. He gives us the gift of life and allows us to choose the way we will use our limited time on earth. It is an awesome opportunity.
36341.name: Cesar Chavez

36342.quote: And by the way, everything in life is writable about if you have the outgoing guts to do it, and the imagination to improvise. The worst enemy to creativity is self-doubt.
36342.name: Sylvia Plath

36343.quote: Man is subject to innumerable pains and sorrows by the very condition of humanity, and yet, as if nature had not sown evils enough in life, we are continually adding grief to grief and aggravating the common calamity by our cruel treatment of one another.
36343.name: Joseph Addison

36344.quote: Television is not real life. In real life people actually have to leave the coffee shop and go to jobs.
36344.name: Bill Gates

36345.quote: To expect too much is to have a sentimental view of life and this is a softness that ends in bitterness.
36345.name: Flannery O'Connor

36346.quote: We have to be able to grow up. Our wrinkles are our medals of the passage of life. They are what we have been through and who we want to be.
36346.name: Lauren Hutton

36347.quote: Polygamy: An endeavour to get more out of life than there is in it.
36347.name: Elbert Hubbard

36348.quote: What material success does is provide you with the ability to concentrate on other things that really matter. And that is being able to make a difference, not only in your own life, but in other people's lives.
36348.name: Oprah Winfrey

36349.quote: My Alma mater was books, a good library, I could spend the rest of my life reading, just satisfying my curiosity.
36349.name: Malcolm X

36350.quote: Live by this credo: have a little laugh at life and look around you for happiness instead of sadness. Laughter has always brought me out of unhappy situations.
36350.name: Red Skelton

36351.quote: It's not the men in my life that count, it's the life in my men.
36351.name: Mae West

36352.quote: Life is about not knowing, having to change, taking the moment and making the best of it, without knowing what's going to happen next.
36352.name: Gilda Radner

36353.quote: What they're not ready for is guys like you and I and Nails and all the other gnarly gnarlingtons in my life, that we are high priests, Vatican assassin warlocks. Boom. Print that, people. See where that goes.
36353.name: Charlie Sheen

36354.quote: I blame my mother for my poor sex life. All she told me was 'the man goes on top and the woman underneath.' For three years my husband and I slept in bunk beds.
36354.name: Joan Rivers

36355.quote: Imagination and fiction make up more than three quarters of our real life.
36355.name: Simone Weil

36356.quote: Sleep - the most beautiful experience in life - except drink.
36356.name: W. C. Fields

36357.quote: Art washes away from the soul the dust of everyday life.
36357.name: Pablo Picasso

36358.quote: Be strong, believe in freedom and in God, love yourself, understand your sexuality, have a sense of humor, masturbate, don't judge people by their religion, color or sexual habits, love life and your family.
36358.name: Madonna Ciccone

36359.quote: For if there is a sin against life, it consists perhaps not so much in despairing of life as in hoping for another life and in eluding the implacable grandeur of this life.
36359.name: Albert Camus

36360.quote: As a remedy to life in society I would suggest the big city. Nowadays, it is the only desert within our means.
36360.name: Albert Camus

36361.quote: It is normal to give away a little of one's life in order not to lose it all.
36361.name: Albert Camus

36362.quote: I've always taken 'The Wizard of Oz' very seriously, you know. I believe in the idea of the rainbow. And I've spent my entire life trying to get over it.
36362.name: Judy Garland

36363.quote: The highest and most beautiful things in life are not to be heard about, nor read about, nor seen but, if one will, are to be lived.
36363.name: Soren Kierkegaard

36364.quote: There are moments in life, when the heart is so full of emotion That if by chance it be shaken, or into its depths like a pebble Drops some careless word, it overflows, and its secret, Spilt on the ground like water, can never be gathered together.
36364.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

36365.quote: It's funny the way most people love the dead. Once you are dead, you are made for life.
36365.name: Jimi Hendrix

36366.quote: Life takes its path and sometimes there are people to blame. Of course there are bad people in this world. Good, bad, it happens unfortunately. But in a way I think if there was more focus on the good, more good would happen.
36366.name: Andrea Corr

36367.quote: Life all comes down to a few moments. This is one of them.
36367.name: Charlie Sheen

36368.quote: The joy of life consists in the exercise of one's energies, continual growth, constant change, the enjoyment of every new experience. To stop means simply to die. The eternal mistake of mankind is to set up an attainable ideal.
36368.name: Aleister Crowley

36369.quote: One's family is the most important thing in life. I look at it this way: One of these days I'll be over in a hospital somewhere with four walls around me. And the only people who'll be with me will be my family.
36369.name: Robert Byrd

36370.quote: The direction in which education starts a man will determine his future in life.
36370.name: Plato

36371.quote: I like people that enjoy life, 'cause I do the same.
36371.name: Lil Wayne

36372.quote: For God so loved the World that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
36372.name: Jesus Christ

36373.quote: So if you stay ready, you ain't gotta get ready, and that is how I run my life.
36373.name: Will Smith

36374.quote: Life is too short to spend hoping that the perfectly arched eyebrow or hottest new lip shade will mask an ugly heart.
36374.name: Kevyn Aucoin

36375.quote: We don't get a chance to do that many things, and every one should be really excellent. Because this is our life. Life is brief, and then you die, you know? So this is what we've chosen to do with our life.
36375.name: Steve Jobs

36376.quote: If I had to choose a religion, the sun as the universal giver of life would be my god.
36376.name: Napoleon Bonaparte

36377.quote: Life is made up, not of great sacrifices or duties, but of little things, in which smiles and kindness, and small obligations given habitually, are what preserve the heart and secure comfort.
36377.name: Humphry Davy

36378.quote: There has never yet been a man in our history who led a life of ease whose name is worth remembering.
36378.name: Theodore Roosevelt

36379.quote: I just got one last thing, I urge all of you, all of you, to enjoy your life, the precious moments you have. To spend each day with some laughter and some thought, to get you're emotions going.
36379.name: Jim Valvano

36380.quote: Do what you love to do and give it your very best. Whether it's business or baseball, or the theater, or any field. If you don't love what you're doing and you can't give it your best, get out of it. Life is too short. You'll be an old man before you know it.
36380.name: Al Lopez

36381.quote: I don't think you ever stop giving. I really don't. I think it's an on-going process. And it's not just about being able to write a check. It's being able to touch somebody's life.
36381.name: Oprah Winfrey

36382.quote: Faith is the first factor in a life devoted to service. Without it, nothing is possible. With it, nothing is impossible.
36382.name: Mary McLeod Bethune

36383.quote: My goal is to be one with the music. I just dedicate my whole life to this art.
36383.name: Jimi Hendrix

36384.quote: A life lived with integrity - even if it lacks the trappings of fame and fortune is a shining star in whose light others may follow in the years to come.
36384.name: Denis Waitley

36385.quote: If a man can bridge the gap between life and death, if he can live on after he's dead, then maybe he was a great man.
36385.name: James Dean

36386.quote: I like the idea of being alone. I like the idea of often being alone in all aspects of my life. I like to feel lonely. I like to need things.
36386.name: Robert Plant

36387.quote: Life is what we make it, always has been, always will be.
36387.name: Grandma Moses

36388.quote: For the meaning of life differs from man to man, from day to day and from hour to hour. What matters, therefore, is not the meaning of life in general but rather the specific meaning of a person's life at a given moment.
36388.name: Viktor E. Frankl

36389.quote: One's life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, indignation and compassion.
36389.name: Simone de Beauvoir

36390.quote: I'm at the age where food has taken the place of sex in my life. In fact, I've just had a mirror put over my kitchen table.
36390.name: Rodney Dangerfield

36391.quote: If I have any worth, it is to live my life for God so as to teach these peoples even though some of them still look down on me.
36391.name: Saint Patrick

36392.quote: Life could be wonderful if people would leave you alone.
36392.name: Charlie Chaplin

36393.quote: I really believe that everyone has a talent, ability, or skill that he can mine to support himself and to succeed in life.
36393.name: Dean Koontz

36394.quote: I lost my sense of trust, honesty and compassion. I crashed down and became what I consider an emotional mess. I've never been so miserable in my whole life. I just wanted to go to bed and never get up.
36394.name: Shania Twain

36395.quote: I have found it easier to identify with the characters who verge upon hysteria, who were frightened of life, who were desperate to reach out to another person. But these seemingly fragile people are the strong people really.
36395.name: Tennessee Williams

36396.quote: Life can be pulled by goals just as surely as it can be pushed by drives.
36396.name: Viktor E. Frankl

36397.quote: I have been up against tough competition all my life. I wouldn't know how to get along without it.
36397.name: Walt Disney

36398.quote: Life is all memory, except for the one present moment that goes by you so quickly you hardly catch it going.
36398.name: Tennessee Williams

36399.quote: I have a lot of things to prove to myself. One is that I can live my life fearlessly.
36399.name: Oprah Winfrey

36400.quote: You make mistakes, but I don't have any regrets. I'm the kind of person who takes responsibility for it and deals with it. I learn from everything I do. I work very hard, I have so many things going on in my life. Get to know me and see who I am.
36400.name: Kim Kardashian

36401.quote: Photography takes an instant out of time, altering life by holding it still.
36401.name: Dorothea Lange

36402.quote: Life's pretty good, and why wouldn't it be? I'm a pirate, after all.
36402.name: Johnny Depp

36403.quote: Sorrow is knowledge, those that know the most must mourn the deepest, the tree of knowledge is not the tree of life.
36403.name: Lord Byron

36404.quote: Creativity is a great motivator because it makes people interested in what they are doing. Creativity gives hope that there can be a worthwhile idea. Creativity gives the possibility of some sort of achievement to everyone. Creativity makes life more fun and more interesting.
36404.name: Edward de Bono

36405.quote: Gratitude helps you to grow and expand gratitude brings joy and laughter into your life and into the lives of all those around you.
36405.name: Eileen Caddy

36406.quote: If I were to say, 'God, why me?' about the bad things, then I should have said, 'God, why me?' about the good things that happened in my life.
36406.name: Arthur Ashe

36407.quote: Music is love, love is music, music is life, and I love my life. Thank you and good night.
36407.name: A. J. McLean

36408.quote: I was set free because my greatest fear had been realized, and I still had a daughter who I adored, and I had an old typewriter and a big idea. And so rock bottom became a solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
36408.name: J. K. Rowling

36409.quote: I don't think I've ever worked so hard on something, but working on Macintosh was the neatest experience of my life. Almost everyone who worked on it will say that. None of us wanted to release it at the end. It was as though we knew that once it was out of our hands, it wouldn't be ours anymore.
36409.name: Steve Jobs

36410.quote: Words can never adequately convey the incredible impact of our attitudes toward life. The longer I live the more convinced I become that life is 10 percent what happens to us and 90 percent how we respond to it.
36410.name: Charles R. Swindoll

36411.quote: I'll always stay connected with Apple. I hope that throughout my life I'll sort of have the thread of my life and the thread of Apple weave in and out of each other, like a tapestry. There may be a few years when I'm not there, but I'll always come back.
36411.name: Steve Jobs

36412.quote: Friends are as companions on a journey, who ought to aid each other to persevere in the road to a happier life.
36412.name: Pythagoras

36413.quote: The first thing which I can record concerning myself is, that I was born. These are wonderful words. This life, to which neither time nor eternity can bring diminution - this everlasting living soul, began. My mind loses itself in these depths.
36413.name: Groucho Marx

36414.quote: Take control of your consistent emotions and begin to consciously and deliberately reshape your daily experience of life.
36414.name: Tony Robbins

36415.quote: When it comes to life the critical thing is whether you take things for granted or take them with gratitude.
36415.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

36416.quote: He who is void of virtuous attachments in private life is, or very soon will be, void of all regard for his country. There is seldom an instance of a man guilty of betraying his country, who had not before lost the feeling of moral obligations in his private connections.
36416.name: Samuel Adams

36417.quote: Sometimes, I feel like one who is on the sidelines, who has missed life itself.
36417.name: Nelson Mandela

36418.quote: Hold fast to dreams, for if dreams die, life is a broken-winged bird that cannot fly.
36418.name: Langston Hughes

36419.quote: Life is to be entered upon with courage.
36419.name: Alexis de Tocqueville

36420.quote: Difficult times have helped me to understand better than before, how infinitely rich and beautiful life is in every way, and that so many things that one goes worrying about are of no importance whatsoever.
36420.name: Isak Dinesen

36421.quote: Haters never win. I just think that's true about life, because negative energy always costs in the end.
36421.name: Tom Hiddleston

36422.quote: In life you need either inspiration or desperation.
36422.name: Tony Robbins

36423.quote: They tell us that suicide is the greatest piece of cowardice, that suicide is wrong when it is quite obvious that there is nothing in the world to which every man has a more unassailable title than to his own life and person.
36423.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

36424.quote: Your problem is how you are going to spend this one odd and precious life you have been issued. Whether you're going to spend it trying to look good and creating the illusion that you have power over people and circumstances, or whether you are going to taste it, enjoy it and find out the truth about who you are.
36424.name: Anne Lamott

36425.quote: You can't make positive choices for the rest of your life without an environment that makes those choices easy, natural, and enjoyable.
36425.name: Deepak Chopra

36426.quote: Woz is living his own life now. He hasn't been around Apple for about five years. But what he did will go down in history.
36426.name: Steve Jobs

36427.quote: Half our life is spent trying to find something to do with the time we have rushed through life trying to save.
36427.name: Will Rogers

36428.quote: Choice of attention - to pay attention to this and ignore that - is to the inner life what choice of action is to the outer. In both cases, a man is responsible for his choice and must accept the consequences, whatever they may be.
36428.name: W. H. Auden

36429.quote: It is a bit embarrassing to have been concerned with the human problem all one's life and find at the end that one has no more to offer by way of advice than 'try to be a little kinder.'
36429.name: Aldous Huxley

36430.quote: I think togetherness is a very important ingredient to family life.
36430.name: Barbara Bush

36431.quote: Sometimes you trust someone who turns out not to be honest. There are a lot of things that happen in life that don't turn out the way you're given the impression that they will. And I think that's all kind of a con. But I think we've probably all been hurt.
36431.name: Sigourney Weaver

36432.quote: My guiding principles in life are to be honest, genuine, thoughtful and caring.
36432.name: Prince William

36433.quote: Be thou the rainbow in the storms of life. The evening beam that smiles the clouds away, and tints tomorrow with prophetic ray.
36433.name: Lord Byron

36434.quote: I do not believe in excuses. I believe in hard work as the prime solvent of life's problems.
36434.name: James Cash Penney

36435.quote: I made a mistake by being ejected from the presidency. Next time, I will choose a Cabinet which will allow me to be life President.
36435.name: Nelson Mandela

36436.quote: Life is too short to worry about anything. You had better enjoy it because the next day promises nothing.
36436.name: Eric Davis

36437.quote: The personal life deeply lived always expands into truths beyond itself.
36437.name: Anais Nin

36438.quote: You must pass your days in song. Let your whole life be a song.
36438.name: Sai Baba

36439.quote: A bachelor's life is a fine breakfast, a flat lunch, and a miserable dinner.
36439.name: Francis Bacon

36440.quote: If you have no confidence in self, you are twice defeated in the race of life. With confidence, you have won even before you have started.
36440.name: Marcus Tullius Cicero

36441.quote: You know what your problem is, it's that you haven't seen enough movies - all of life's riddles are answered in the movies.
36441.name: Steve Martin

36442.quote: Life is 10% what happens to you and 90% how you react to it.
36442.name: Charles R. Swindoll

36443.quote: You were made by God and for God, and until you understand that, life will never make sense.
36443.name: Rick Warren

36444.quote: Life is essentially a cheat and its conditions are those of defeat the redeeming things are not happiness and pleasure but the deeper satisfactions that come out of struggle.
36444.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

36445.quote: My general attitude to life is to enjoy every minute of every day. I never do anything with a feeling of, 'Oh God, I've got to do this today.'
36445.name: Richard Branson

36446.quote: When you do the common things in life in an uncommon way, you will command the attention of the world.
36446.name: George Washington Carver

36447.quote: Without knowing what I am and why I am here, life is impossible.
36447.name: Leo Tolstoy

36448.quote: My focus is to forget the pain of life. Forget the pain, mock the pain, reduce it. And laugh.
36448.name: Jim Carrey

36449.quote: Life is lived on the edge.
36449.name: Will Smith

36450.quote: Life opens up opportunities to you, and you either take them or you stay afraid of taking them.
36450.name: Jim Carrey

36451.quote: Part of the happiness of life consists not in fighting battles, but in avoiding them. A masterly retreat is in itself a victory.
36451.name: Norman Vincent Peale

36452.quote: Never build your emotional life on the weaknesses of others.
36452.name: George Santayana

36453.quote: Justice in the life and conduct of the State is possible only as first it resides in the hearts and souls of the citizens.
36453.name: Plato

36454.quote: A dog will teach you unconditional love. If you can have that in your life, things won't be too bad.
36454.name: Robert Wagner

36455.quote: You are doomed to make choices. This is life's greatest paradox.
36455.name: Wayne Dyer

36456.quote: I wish to preach, not the doctrine of ignoble ease, but the doctrine of the strenuous life.
36456.name: Theodore Roosevelt

36457.quote: You use your money to buy privacy because during most of your life you aren't allowed to be normal.
36457.name: Johnny Depp

36458.quote: I lead no party I follow no leader. I have given the best part of my life to careful study of Islam, its law and polity, its culture, its history and its literature.
36458.name: Muhammad Iqbal

36459.quote: We must declare ourselves, become known allow the world to discover this subterranean life of ours which connects kings and farm boys, artists and clerks. Let them see that the important thing is not the object of love, but the emotion itself.
36459.name: Gore Vidal

36460.quote: Faith means living with uncertainty - feeling your way through life, letting your heart guide you like a lantern in the dark.
36460.name: Dan Millman

36461.quote: You see, in life, lots of people know what to do, but few people actually do what they know. Knowing is not enough! You must take action.
36461.name: Tony Robbins

36462.quote: Life is not an easy matter, You cannot live through it without falling into frustration and cynicism unless you have before you a great idea which raises you above personal misery, above weakness, above all kinds of perfidy and baseness.
36462.name: Leon Trotsky

36463.quote: I have a loyalty that runs in my bloodstream, when I lock into someone or something, you can't get me away from it because I commit that thoroughly. That's in friendship, that's a deal, that's a commitment. Don't give me paper - I can get the same lawyer who drew it up to break it. But if you shake my hand, that's for life.
36463.name: Jerry Lewis

36464.quote: Find ecstasy in life the mere sense of living is joy enough.
36464.name: Emily Dickinson

36465.quote: You hear a lot about God these days: God, the beneficent God, the all-great God, the Almighty God, the most powerful God, the giver of life God, the creator of death. I mean, we're hearing about God all the time, so we better learn how to deal with it. But if we know anything about God, God is arbitrary.
36465.name: Bob Dylan

36466.quote: Death is not the greatest loss in life. The greatest loss is what dies inside us while we live.
36466.name: Norman Cousins

36467.quote: Just when I think I have learned the way to live, life changes.
36467.name: Hugh Prather

36468.quote: I remember a specific moment, watching my grandmother hang the clothes on the line, and her saying to me, 'you are going to have to learn to do this,' and me being in that space of awareness and knowing that my life would not be the same as my grandmother's life.
36468.name: Oprah Winfrey

36469.quote: When life knocks you down, try to land on your back. Because if you can look up, you can get up. Let your reason get you back up.
36469.name: Les Brown

36470.quote: A lot of us grow up and we grow out of the literal interpretation that we get when we're children, but we bear the scars all our life. Whether they're scars of beauty or scars of ugliness, it's pretty much in the eye of the beholder.
36470.name: Stephen King

36471.quote: In the last analysis, the individual person is responsible for living his own life and for 'finding himself.' If he persists in shifting his responsibility to somebody else, he fails to find out the meaning of his own existence.
36471.name: Thomas Merton

36472.quote: Every life has a measure of sorrow, and sometimes this is what awakens us.
36472.name: Steven Tyler

36473.quote: It's surprising how many persons go through life without ever recognizing that their feelings toward other people are largely determined by their feelings toward themselves, and if you're not comfortable within yourself, you can't be comfortable with others.
36473.name: Sydney J. Harris

36474.quote: My philosophy is that not only are you responsible for your life, but doing the best at this moment puts you I the best place for the next moment.
36474.name: Oprah Winfrey

36475.quote: People have a moral standard about what they will do and will not do. At the end of the day someone who cheats has a lower moral standard than someone who does not. And they will cheat in other areas of life as well.
36475.name: Carl Lewis

36476.quote: The tragedy of life is in what dies inside a man while he lives - the death of genuine feeling, the death of inspired response, the awareness that makes it possible to feel the pain or the glory of other men in yourself.
36476.name: Norman Cousins

36477.quote: A man who has been the indisputable favorite of his mother keeps for life the feeling of a conqueror.
36477.name: Sigmund Freud

36478.quote: Having Down syndrome is like being born normal. I am just like you and you are just like me. We are all born in different ways, that is the way I can describe it. I have a normal life.
36478.name: Chris Burke

36479.quote: Saving faith is an immediate relation to Christ, accepting, receiving, resting upon Him alone, for justification, sanctification, and eternal life by virtue of God's grace.
36479.name: Charles Spurgeon

36480.quote: Cease trying to work everything out with your minds. It will get you nowhere. Live by intuition and inspiration and let your whole life be Revelation.
36480.name: Eileen Caddy

36481.quote: If you wish to succeed in life, make perseverance your bosom friend, experience your wise counselor, caution your elder brother, and hope your guardian genius.
36481.name: Joseph Addison

36482.quote: I haven't understood a bar of music in my life, but I have felt it.
36482.name: Igor Stravinsky

36483.quote: This is the highest wisdom that I own freedom and life are earned by those alone who conquer them each day anew.
36483.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

36484.quote: Not by appointment do we meet delight Or joy they heed not our expectancy But round some corner of the streets of life they of a sudden greet us with a smile.
36484.name: Gerald Massey

36485.quote: The meaning of life is contained in every single expression of life. It is present in the infinity of forms and phenomena that exist in all of creation.
36485.name: Michael Jackson

36486.quote: The highest education is that which does not merely give us information but makes our life in harmony with all existence.
36486.name: Rabindranath Tagore

36487.quote: Millions of young Americans have graduated from college during the Obama presidency, ready to use their gifts and get moving in life. Half of them can't find the work they studied for, or any work at all. So here's the question: Without a change in leadership, why would the next four years be any different from the last four years?
36487.name: Paul Ryan

36488.quote: The game of life is a game of boomerangs. Our thoughts, deeds and words return to us sooner or later with astounding accuracy.
36488.name: Florence Scovel Shinn

36489.quote: If a man neglects education, he walks lame to the end of his life.
36489.name: Plato

36490.quote: All my life I've looked at words as though I were seeing them for the first time.
36490.name: Ernest Hemingway

36491.quote: Love is the greatest refreshment in life.
36491.name: Pablo Picasso

36492.quote: Because we have so much eye candy and mind candy, spending so much time trying to pay the rent, all of this conspires to keep us from thinking too hard or taking action from that. Our time is stolen. So much of our daily life is stolen.
36492.name: Lydia Lunch

36493.quote: I spent my whole life in the private sector, 25 years in the private sector. I understand that when government takes more money out of the hands of people, it makes it more difficult for them to buy things. If they can't buy things, the economy doesn't grow. If the economy doesn't grow, we don't put Americans to work.
36493.name: Mitt Romney

36494.quote: Black Consciousness is an attitude of the mind and a way of life, the most positive call to emanate from the black world for a long time.
36494.name: Steven Biko

36495.quote: I don't believe in an afterlife, so I don't have to spend my whole life fearing hell, or fearing heaven even more. For whatever the tortures of hell, I think the boredom of heaven would be even worse.
36495.name: Isaac Asimov

36496.quote: The safest course is to do nothing against one's conscience. With this secret, we can enjoy life and have no fear from death.
36496.name: Voltaire

36497.quote: With an eye made quiet by the power of harmony, and the deep power of joy, we see into the life of things.
36497.name: William Wordsworth

36498.quote: To have courage for whatever comes in life - everything lies in that.
36498.name: Saint Teresa of Avila

36499.quote: The changes in our life must come from the impossibility to live otherwise than according to the demands of our conscience not from our mental resolution to try a new form of life.
36499.name: Leo Tolstoy

36500.quote: I have dreamed in my life, dreams that have stayed with me ever after, and changed my ideas they have gone through and through me, like wine through water, and altered the color of my mind.
36500.name: Emily Bronte

36501.quote: No one is in control of your happiness but you therefore, you have the power to change anything about yourself or your life that you want to change.
36501.name: Barbara de Angelis

36502.quote: The purpose of human life is to serve, and to show compassion and the will to help others.
36502.name: Albert Schweitzer

36503.quote: I've made some great mistakes in my life, but, you know, they were honest mistakes.
36503.name: Henry Rollins

36504.quote: To gather with God's people in united adoration of the Father is as necessary to the Christian life as prayer.
36504.name: Martin Luther

36505.quote: Telling a teenager the facts of life is like giving a fish a bath.
36505.name: Arnold H. Glasow

36506.quote: The good life is a process, not a state of being. It is a direction not a destination.
36506.name: Carl Rogers

36507.quote: Somebody should tell us, right at the start of our lives, that we are dying. Then we might live life to the limit, every minute of every day. Do it! I say. Whatever you want to do, do it now! There are only so many tomorrows.
36507.name: Pope Paul VI

36508.quote: I don't think I could live without hair, makeup and styling, let alone be the performer I am. I am a glamour girl through and through. I believe in the glamorous life and I live one.
36508.name: Lady Gaga

36509.quote: The greatest humiliation in life, is to work hard on something from which you expect great appreciation, and then fail to get it.
36509.name: E. W. Howe

36510.quote: As we advance in life we learn the limits of our abilities.
36510.name: Henry Ford

36511.quote: Yes, you can lose somebody overnight, yes, your whole life can be turned upside down. Life is short. It can come and go like a feather in the wind.
36511.name: Shania Twain

36512.quote: Tragedy in life normally comes with betrayal and compromise, and trading on your integrity and not having dignity in life. That's really where failure comes.
36512.name: Tom Cochrane

36513.quote: Trust is the glue of life. It's the most essential ingredient in effective communication. It's the foundational principle that holds all relationships.
36513.name: Stephen Covey

36514.quote: If you find someone you love in your life, then hang on to that love.
36514.name: Princess Diana

36515.quote: It is a common saying, and in everybody's mouth, that life is but a sojourn.
36515.name: Plato

36516.quote: There is no force like success, and that is why the individual makes all effort to surround himself throughout life with the evidence of it as of the individual, so should it be of the nation.
36516.name: Marcus Garvey

36517.quote: When you're passionate about something, you want it to be all it can be. But in the endgame of life, I fundamentally believe the key to happiness is letting go of that idea of perfection.
36517.name: Debra Messing

36518.quote: Being taken for granted can be a compliment. It means that you've become a comfortable, trusted element in another person's life.
36518.name: Joyce Brothers

36519.quote: The more sand that has escaped from the hourglass of our life, the clearer we should see through it.
36519.name: Jean Paul

36520.quote: Our heavenly Father understands our disappointment, suffering, pain, fear, and doubt. He is always there to encourage our hearts and help us understand that He's sufficient for all of our needs. When I accepted this as an absolute truth in my life, I found that my worrying stopped.
36520.name: Charles Stanley

36521.quote: I wanted to write about the moment when your addictions no longer hide the truth from you. When your whole life breaks down. That's the moment when you have to somehow choose what your life is going to be about.
36521.name: Chuck Palahniuk

36522.quote: I'm a heroine addict. I need to have sex with women who have saved someone's life.
36522.name: Mitch Hedberg

36523.quote: Thank you, God, for this good life and forgive us if we do not love it enough.
36523.name: Garrison Keillor

36524.quote: I never regret anything. Because every little detail of your life is what made you into who you are in the end.
36524.name: Drew Barrymore

36525.quote: Life belongs to the living, and he who lives must be prepared for changes.
36525.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

36526.quote: You can't live your life blaming your failures on your parents and what they did or didn't do for you. You're dealt the cards that you're dealt. I realised it was a waste of time to be angry at my parents and feel sorry for myself.
36526.name: Drew Barrymore

36527.quote: Take a chance! All life is a chance. The man who goes farthest is generally the one who is willing to do and dare.
36527.name: Dale Carnegie

36528.quote: Early in life I had to choose between honest arrogance and hypocritical humility. I chose the former and have seen no reason to change.
36528.name: Frank Lloyd Wright

36529.quote: What we call the secret of happiness is no more a secret than our willingness to choose life.
36529.name: Leo Buscaglia

36530.quote: There is only one success - to be able to spend your life in your own way.
36530.name: Christopher Morley

36531.quote: Smoking kills. If you're killed, you've lost a very important part of your life.
36531.name: Brooke Shields

36532.quote: The highest use of capital is not to make more money, but to make money do more for the betterment of life.
36532.name: Henry Ford

36533.quote: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
36533.name: Lao Tzu

36534.quote: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
36534.name: Oscar Wilde

36535.quote: Friends can help each other. A true friend is someone who lets you have total freedom to be yourself - and especially to feel. Or, not feel. Whatever you happen to be feeling at the moment is fine with them. That's what real love amounts to - letting a person be what he really is.
36535.name: Jim Morrison

36536.quote: Sometimes the heart sees what is invisible to the eye.
36536.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

36537.quote: Love is like a friendship caught on fire. In the beginning a flame, very pretty, often hot and fierce, but still only light and flickering. As love grows older, our hearts mature and our love becomes as coals, deep-burning and unquenchable.
36537.name: Bruce Lee

36538.quote: Love is composed of a single soul inhabiting two bodies.
36538.name: Aristotle

36539.quote: I have decided to stick with love. Hate is too great a burden to bear.
36539.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36540.quote: Affection is responsible for nine-tenths of whatever solid and durable happiness there is in our lives.
36540.name: C. S. Lewis

36541.quote: Immature love says: 'I love you because I need you.' Mature love says 'I need you because I love you.'
36541.name: Erich Fromm

36542.quote: Where there is love there is life.
36542.name: Mahatma Gandhi

36543.quote: We're born alone, we live alone, we die alone. Only through our love and friendship can we create the illusion for the moment that we're not alone.
36543.name: Orson Welles

36544.quote: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
36544.name: Thomas Carlyle

36545.quote: A man reserves his true and deepest love not for the species of woman in whose company he finds himself electrified and enkindled, but for that one in whose company he may feel tenderly drowsy.
36545.name: George Jean Nathan

36546.quote: I have found the paradox, that if you love until it hurts, there can be no more hurt, only more love.
36546.name: Mother Teresa

36547.quote: For it was not into my ear you whispered, but into my heart. It was not my lips you kissed, but my soul.
36547.name: Judy Garland

36548.quote: A kiss is a lovely trick designed by nature to stop speech when words become superfluous.
36548.name: Ingrid Bergman

36549.quote: Let us always meet each other with smile, for the smile is the beginning of love.
36549.name: Mother Teresa

36550.quote: A flower cannot blossom without sunshine, and man cannot live without love.
36550.name: Max Muller

36551.quote: If you live to be a hundred, I want to live to be a hundred minus one day so I never have to live without you.
36551.name: A. A. Milne

36552.quote: Gravitation is not responsible for people falling in love.
36552.name: Albert Einstein

36553.quote: Love begins at home, and it is not how much we do, but how much love we put in that action.
36553.name: Mother Teresa

36554.quote: Love does not begin and end the way we seem to think it does. Love is a battle, love is a war love is a growing up.
36554.name: James A. Baldwin

36555.quote: Can miles truly separate you from friends, If you want to be with someone you love, aren't you already there?
36555.name: Richard Bach

36556.quote: A woman knows the face of the man she loves as a sailor knows the open sea.
36556.name: Honore de Balzac

36557.quote: A man is already halfway in love with any woman who listens to him.
36557.name: Brendan Francis

36558.quote: Love is a force more formidable than any other. It is invisible - it cannot be seen or measured, yet it is powerful enough to transform you in a moment, and offer you more joy than any material possession could.
36558.name: Barbara de Angelis

36559.quote: Time is too slow for those who wait, too swift for those who fear, too long for those who grieve, too short for those who rejoice, but for those who love, time is eternity.
36559.name: Henry Van Dyke

36561.quote: A kiss makes the heart young again and wipes out the years.
36561.name: Rupert Brooke

36562.quote: Absence diminishes mediocre passions and increases great ones, as the wind extinguishes candles and fans fires.
36562.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

36563.quote: I was born with an enormous need for affection, and a terrible need to give it.
36563.name: Audrey Hepburn

36564.quote: At the touch of love everyone becomes a poet.
36564.name: Plato

36565.quote: Love is our true destiny. We do not find the meaning of life by ourselves alone - we find it with another.
36565.name: Thomas Merton

36566.quote: Love yourself first and everything else falls into line. You really have to love yourself to get anything done in this world.
36566.name: Lucille Ball

36567.quote: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.
36567.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

36568.quote: Love is a better teacher than duty.
36568.name: Albert Einstein

36569.quote: Come live in my heart, and pay no rent.
36569.name: Samuel Lover

36570.quote: Love is always bestowed as a gift - freely, willingly and without expectation. We don't love to be loved we love to love.
36570.name: Leo Buscaglia

36571.quote: Love is like war: easy to begin but very hard to stop.
36571.name: H. L. Mencken

36572.quote: If you press me to say why I loved him, I can say no more than because he was he, and I was I.
36572.name: Michel de Montaigne

36573.quote: The hunger for love is much more difficult to remove than the hunger for bread.
36573.name: Mother Teresa

36574.quote: Love is life. And if you miss love, you miss life.
36574.name: Leo Buscaglia

36575.quote: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
36575.name: Audrey Hepburn

36576.quote: What we have once enjoyed we can never lose. All that we love deeply becomes a part of us.
36576.name: Helen Keller

36577.quote: As soon go kindle fire with snow, as seek to quench the fire of love with words.
36577.name: William Shakespeare

36578.quote: Faith makes all things possible, love makes all things easy.
36578.name: Dwight L. Moody

36579.quote: Friendship often ends in love but love in friendship - never.
36579.name: Charles Caleb Colton

36580.quote: A very small degree of hope is sufficient to cause the birth of love.
36580.name: Stendhal

36581.quote: Once the realization is accepted that even between the closest human beings infinite distances continue, a wonderful living side by side can grow, if they succeed in loving the distance between them which makes it possible for each to see the other whole against the sky.
36581.name: Rainer Maria Rilke

36582.quote: The best proof of love is trust.
36582.name: Joyce Brothers

36583.quote: A part of kindness consists in loving people more than they deserve.
36583.name: Joseph Joubert

36584.quote: Love isn't something you find. Love is something that finds you.
36584.name: Loretta Young

36585.quote: I like not only to be loved, but also to be told I am loved.
36585.name: George Eliot

36586.quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
36586.name: Edgar Allan Poe

36587.quote: A pair of powerful spectacles has sometimes sufficed to cure a person in love.
36587.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

36588.quote: Life without love is like a tree without blossoms or fruit.
36588.name: Khalil Gibran

36589.quote: A loving heart is the truest wisdom.
36589.name: Charles Dickens

36590.quote: All my life, my heart has yearned for a thing I cannot name.
36590.name: Andre Breton

36591.quote: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
36591.name: Victor Hugo

36592.quote: Love can sometimes be magic. But magic can sometimes, just be an illusion.
36592.name: Javan

36593.quote: First love is only a little foolishness and a lot of curiosity.
36593.name: George Bernard Shaw

36594.quote: Love makes your soul crawl out from its hiding place.
36594.name: Zora Neale Hurston

36595.quote: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
36595.name: Oscar Wilde

36596.quote: Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
36596.name: Robert Frost

36597.quote: I can live without money, but I cannot live without love.
36597.name: Judy Garland

36598.quote: Love is the flower you've got to let grow.
36598.name: John Lennon

36599.quote: True love is like ghosts, which everyone talks about and few have seen.
36599.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

36600.quote: The hours I spend with you I look upon as sort of a perfumed garden, a dim twilight, and a fountain singing to it. You and you alone make me feel that I am alive. Other men it is said have seen angels, but I have seen thee and thou art enough.
36600.name: George Edward Moore

36601.quote: All love shifts and changes. I don't know if you can be wholeheartedly in love all the time.
36601.name: Julie Andrews

36602.quote: Love is a smoke made with the fume of sighs.
36602.name: William Shakespeare

36603.quote: Before I met my husband, I'd never fallen in love. I'd stepped in it a few times.
36603.name: Rita Rudner

36604.quote: If you would be loved, love, and be loveable.
36604.name: Benjamin Franklin

36605.quote: Love many things, for therein lies the true strength, and whosoever loves much performs much, and can accomplish much, and what is done in love is done well.
36605.name: Vincent Van Gogh

36606.quote: Love does not dominate it cultivates.
36606.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

36607.quote: Only do what your heart tells you.
36607.name: Princess Diana

36608.quote: You never lose by loving. You always lose by holding back.
36608.name: Barbara de Angelis

36609.quote: Love, it surrounds every being and extends slowly to embrace all that shall be.
36609.name: Khalil Gibran

36610.quote: Love is the joy of the good, the wonder of the wise, the amazement of the Gods.
36610.name: Plato

36611.quote: Love is a canvas furnished by nature and embroidered by imagination.
36611.name: Voltaire

36612.quote: It's useless to hold a person to anything he says while he's in love, drunk, or running for office.
36612.name: Shirley MacLaine

36613.quote: Love is a gross exaggeration of the difference between one person and everybody else.
36613.name: George Bernard Shaw

36614.quote: What love we've given, we'll have forever. What love we fail to give, will be lost for all eternity.
36614.name: Leo Buscaglia

36615.quote: To fear love is to fear life, and those who fear life are already three parts dead.
36615.name: Bertrand Russell

36616.quote: One is loved because one is loved. No reason is needed for loving.
36616.name: Paulo Coelho

36618.quote: Love is when you meet someone who tells you something new about yourself.
36618.name: Andre Breton

36619.quote: It is difficult to know at what moment love begins it is less difficult to know that it has begun.
36619.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

36620.quote: How absurd and delicious it is to be in love with somebody younger than yourself. Everybody should try it.
36620.name: Barbara Pym

36621.quote: In love the paradox occurs that two beings become one and yet remain two.
36621.name: Erich Fromm

36622.quote: When love is not madness, it is not love.
36622.name: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

36623.quote: The love we give away is the only love we keep.
36623.name: Elbert Hubbard

36624.quote: Love is an act of endless forgiveness, a tender look which becomes a habit.
36624.name: Peter Ustinov

36625.quote: Blessed is the influence of one true, loving human soul on another.
36625.name: George Eliot

36626.quote: To love another person is to see the face of God.
36626.name: Victor Hugo

36627.quote: A kiss is a rosy dot over the 'i' of loving.
36627.name: Cyrano de Bergerac

36628.quote: Love is the only sane and satisfactory answer to the problem of human existence.
36628.name: Erich Fromm

36629.quote: Absence - that common cure of love.
36629.name: Lord Byron

36630.quote: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
36630.name: Victor Hugo

36631.quote: The only abnormality is the incapacity to love.
36631.name: Anais Nin

36632.quote: There is no disguise which can hide love for long where it exists, or simulate it where it does not.
36632.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

36633.quote: Love consists in this, that two solitudes protect and touch and greet each other.
36633.name: Rainer Maria Rilke

36634.quote: Be of love a little more careful than of anything.
36634.name: Edward Estlin (e. e. cummings)

36635.quote: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
36635.name: Emily Bronte

36636.quote: Love takes off masks that we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.
36636.name: James A. Baldwin

36637.quote: A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
36637.name: Jesus Christ

36638.quote: Love is supreme and unconditional like is nice but limited.
36638.name: Duke Ellington

36639.quote: Gestures, in love, are incomparably more attractive, effective and valuable than words.
36639.name: Francois Rabelais

36640.quote: Looking back, I have this to regret, that too often when I loved, I did not say so.
36640.name: David Grayson

36641.quote: I love that feeling of being in love, the effect of having butterflies when you wake up in the morning. That is special.
36641.name: Jennifer Aniston

36642.quote: I believe in the compelling power of love. I do not understand it. I believe it to be the most fragrant blossom of all this thorny existence.
36642.name: Theodore Dreiser

36643.quote: Lord, grant that I might not so much seek to be loved as to love.
36643.name: Francis of Assisi

36644.quote: Sometimes it's a form of love just to talk to somebody that you have nothing in common with and still be fascinated by their presence.
36644.name: David Byrne

36645.quote: There is a woman at the begining of all great things.
36645.name: Alphonse de Lamartine

36646.quote: Love knows not distance it hath no continent its eyes are for the stars.
36646.name: Gilbert Parker

36647.quote: The sweetest of all sounds is that of the voice of the woman we love.
36647.name: Jean de la Bruyere

36648.quote: The degree of loving is measured by the degree of giving.
36648.name: Edwin Louis Cole

36649.quote: People think love is an emotion. Love is good sense.
36649.name: Ken Kesey

36650.quote: Love is the only reality and it is not a mere sentiment. It is the ultimate truth that lies at the heart of creation.
36650.name: Rabindranath Tagore

36651.quote: Love is the greatest refreshment in life.
36651.name: Pablo Picasso

36652.quote: There is only one kind of love, but there are a thousand imitations.
36652.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

36653.quote: Love is the delusion that one woman differs from another.
36653.name: H. L. Mencken

36654.quote: If you wished to be loved, love.
36654.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

36655.quote: Love is my religion - I could die for it.
36655.name: John Keats

36656.quote: Tell me who admires and loves you, and I will tell you who you are.
36656.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

36657.quote: Love shall be our token love be yours and love be mine.
36657.name: Christina Rossetti

36658.quote: He is not a lover who does not love forever.
36658.name: Euripides

36659.quote: Love is the hardest habit to break, and the most difficult to satisfy.
36659.name: Drew Barrymore

36660.quote: When we are in love we seem to ourselves quite different from what we were before.
36660.name: Blaise Pascal

36661.quote: The most powerful weapon on earth is the human soul on fire.
36661.name: Ferdinand Foch

36662.quote: Love is all we have, the only way that each can help the other.
36662.name: Euripides

36663.quote: Choose your love, Love your choice.
36663.name: Thomas S. Monson

36664.quote: Falling in love consists merely in uncorking the imagination and bottling the common sense.
36664.name: Helen Rowland

36665.quote: Love is an emotion experienced by the many and enjoyed by the few.
36665.name: George Jean Nathan

36666.quote: If you could only love enough, you could be the most powerful person in the world.
36666.name: Emmet Fox

36667.quote: To witness two lovers is a spectacle for the gods.
36667.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

36668.quote: Love means to commit yourself without guarantee.
36668.name: Anne Campbell

36669.quote: Follow love and it will flee, flee love and it will follow thee.
36669.name: John Gay

36670.quote: The way to know life is to love many things.
36670.name: Vincent Van Gogh

36671.quote: Your words are my food, your breath my wine. You are everything to me.
36671.name: Sarah Bernhardt

36672.quote: The fact is that love is of two kinds, one which commands, and one which obeys. The two are quite distinct, and the passion to which the one gives rise is not the passion of the other.
36672.name: Honore de Balzac

36673.quote: Love is only a dirty trick played on us to achieve continuation of the species.
36673.name: W. Somerset Maugham

36674.quote: Down on your knees, and thank heaven, fasting, for a good man's love.
36674.name: Euripides

36675.quote: Love takes up where knowledge leaves off.
36675.name: Thomas Aquinas

36676.quote: Fortune and love favor the brave.
36676.name: Ovid

36677.quote: There is no surprise more magical than the surprise of being loved: It is God's finger on man's shoulder.
36677.name: Charles Morgan

36678.quote: Each moment of a happy lover's hour is worth an age of dull and common life.
36678.name: Aphra Behn

36679.quote: Love is suffering. One side always loves more.
36679.name: Catherine Deneuve

36680.quote: Love is what you've been through with somebody.
36680.name: James Thurber

36681.quote: Love looks through a telescope envy, through a microscope.
36681.name: Josh Billings

36682.quote: Love in its essence is spiritual fire.
36682.name: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

36683.quote: There are never enough I Love You's.
36683.name: Lenny Bruce

36684.quote: Love is always being given where it is not required.
36684.name: E. M. Forster

36685.quote: Friendship is Love without his wings!
36685.name: Lord Byron

36686.quote: Come live with me and be my love, And we will all the pleasures prove, That valleys, groves, hills, and fields, Woods, or steepy mountain yields.
36686.name: Christopher Marlowe

36687.quote: The truth is that there is only one terminal dignity - love. And the story of a love is not important - what is important is that one is capable of love. It is perhaps the only glimpse we are permitted of eternity.
36687.name: Helen Hayes

36688.quote: We are all born for love. It is the principle of existence, and its only end.
36688.name: Benjamin Disraeli

36689.quote: Love is the poetry of the senses.
36689.name: Honore de Balzac

36690.quote: There is always something left to love. And if you ain't learned that, you ain't learned nothing.
36690.name: Lorraine Hansberry

36691.quote: Love means to love that which is unlovable or it is no virtue at all.
36691.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

36692.quote: People who throw kisses are hopelessly lazy.
36692.name: Bob Hope

36693.quote: Love is not only something you feel, it is something you do.
36693.name: David Wilkerson

36694.quote: Love is the great miracle cure. Loving ourselves works miracles in our lives.
36694.name: Louise L. Hay

36695.quote: In every living thing there is the desire for love.
36695.name: David Herbert Lawrence

36696.quote: Love is but the discovery of ourselves in others, and the delight in the recognition.
36696.name: Alexander Smith

36698.quote: We may give without loving, but we cannot love without giving.
36698.name: Bernard Meltzer

36700.quote: Sometimes it's hard to be a woman giving all your love to just one man.
36700.name: Tammy Wynette

36701.quote: To love abundantly is to live abundantly, and to love forever is to live forever.
36701.name: Henry Drummond

36702.quote: Love is that splendid triggering of human vitality the supreme activity which nature affords anyone for going out of himself toward someone else.
36702.name: Jose Ortega y Gasset

36703.quote: When you love a man, he becomes more than a body. His physical limbs expand, and his outline recedes, vanishes. He is rich and sweet and right. He is part of the world, the atmosphere, the blue sky and the blue water.
36703.name: Gwendolyn Brooks

36704.quote: If you can learn to love yourself and all the flaws, you can love other people so much better. And that makes you so happy.
36704.name: Kristin Chenoweth

36705.quote: Say what you will, 'tis better to be left than never to have been loved.
36705.name: William Congreve

36706.quote: Sympathy constitutes friendship but in love there is a sort of antipathy, or opposing passion. Each strives to be the other, and both together make up one whole.
36706.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

36707.quote: Love is the power to see similarity in the dissimilar.
36707.name: Theodor Adorno

36708.quote: If thou must love me, let it be for naught except for love's sake only.
36708.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

36709.quote: Take away love and our earth is a tomb.
36709.name: Robert Browning

36710.quote: Love is the word used to label the sexual excitement of the young, the habituation of the middle-aged, and the mutual dependence of the old.
36710.name: John Ciardi

36711.quote: Love is the child of illusion and the parent of disillusion.
36711.name: Miguel de Unamuno

36712.quote: Do you have to have a reason for loving?
36712.name: Brigitte Bardot

36713.quote: The first magic of love is our ignorance that it can ever end.
36713.name: Benjamin Disraeli

36714.quote: Love's greatest gift is its ability to make everything it touches sacred.
36714.name: Barbara de Angelis

36715.quote: The quarrels of lovers are the renewal of love.
36715.name: Jean Racine

36716.quote: When you're in love you never really know whether your elation comes from the qualities of the one you love, or if it attributes them to her whether the light which surrounds her like a halo comes from you, from her, or from the meeting of your sparks.
36716.name: Natalie Clifford Barney

36717.quote: What the world really needs is more love and less paper work.
36717.name: Pearl Bailey

36718.quote: Woe to the man whose heart has not learned while young to hope, to love - and to put its trust in life.
36718.name: Joseph Conrad

36719.quote: Let no one who loves be unhappy, even love unreturned has its rainbow.
36719.name: James M. Barrie

36720.quote: I don't know that love changes. People change. Circumstances change.
36720.name: Nicholas Sparks

36721.quote: No one has ever loved anyone the way everyone wants to be loved.
36721.name: Mignon McLaughlin

36722.quote: He who loves, flies, runs, and rejoices he is free and nothing holds him back.
36722.name: Henri Matisse

36724.quote: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
36724.name: David Viscott

36725.quote: It is easier to love humanity as a whole than to love one's neighbor.
36725.name: Eric Hoffer

36726.quote: Though lovers be lost love shall not.
36726.name: Dylan Thomas

36727.quote: Nobody has ever measured, not even poets, how much the heart can hold.
36727.name: Zelda Fitzgerald

36728.quote: When you love someone all your saved up wishes start coming out.
36728.name: Elizabeth Bowen

36729.quote: Love means not ever having to say you're sorry.
36729.name: Erich Segal

36730.quote: There is no limit to the power of loving.
36730.name: John Morton

36731.quote: Love you will find only where you may show yourself weak without provoking strength.
36731.name: Theodor Adorno

36732.quote: Love is a springtime plant that perfumes everything with its hope, even the ruins to which it clings.
36732.name: Gustave Flaubert

36733.quote: O, thou art fairer than the evening air clad in the beauty of a thousand stars.
36733.name: Christopher Marlowe

36734.quote: Love is a mutual self-giving which ends in self-recovery.
36734.name: Fulton J. Sheen

36735.quote: To love for the sake of being loved is human, but to love for the sake of loving is angelic.
36735.name: Alphonse de Lamartine

36736.quote: You don't want to love - your eternal and abnormal craving is to be loved. You aren't positive, you're negative. You absorb, absorb, as if you must fill yourself up with love, because you've got a shortage somewhere.
36736.name: David Herbert Lawrence

36737.quote: There is more pleasure in loving than in being beloved.
36737.name: Thomas Fuller

36738.quote: When love is at its best, one loves so much that he cannot forget.
36738.name: Helen Hunt Jackson

36739.quote: Love is like a faucet, it turns off and on.
36739.name: Billie Holiday

36740.quote: More than kisses, letters mingle souls.
36740.name: John Donne

36741.quote: Stand by your man. Give him two arms to cling to and something warm to come to.
36741.name: Tammy Wynette

36743.quote: There is room in the smallest cottage for a happy loving pair.
36743.name: Friedrich Schiller

36745.quote: With our love, we could save the world.
36745.name: George Harrison

36746.quote: Pains of love be sweeter far than all other pleasures are.
36746.name: John Dryden

36747.quote: To good and true love fear is forever affixed.
36747.name: Francois Rabelais

36748.quote: What is love? It is the morning and the evening star.
36748.name: Sinclair Lewis

36750.quote: True love is quiescent, except in the nascent moments of true humility.
36750.name: Bryant H. McGill

36751.quote: Only love interests me, and I am only in contact with things that revolve around love.
36751.name: Marc Chagall

36752.quote: You don't have to go looking for love when it's where you come from.
36752.name: Werner Erhard

36753.quote: It is very easy to love alone.
36753.name: Gertrude Stein

36754.quote: Who so loves believes the impossible.
36754.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

36755.quote: Only divine love bestows the keys of knowledge.
36755.name: Arthur Rimbaud

36756.quote: The richest love is that which submits to the arbitration of time.
36756.name: Lawrence Durrell

36757.quote: We perceive when love begins and when it declines by our embarrassment when alone together.
36757.name: Jean de la Bruyere

36758.quote: Love ceases to be a pleasure when it ceases to be a secret.
36758.name: Aphra Behn

36759.quote: All love is vanquished by a succeeding love.
36759.name: Ovid

36760.quote: We can only learn to love by loving.
36760.name: Iris Murdoch

36761.quote: We are most alive when we're in love.
36761.name: John Updike

36762.quote: Who ever loved that loved not at first sight?
36762.name: Christopher Marlowe

36763.quote: Love is when he gives you a piece of your soul, that you never knew was missing.
36763.name: Torquato Tasso

36764.quote: Love is an energy which exists of itself. It is its own value.
36764.name: Thornton Wilder

36765.quote: In love there are two things - bodies and words.
36765.name: Joyce Carol Oates

36766.quote: We love but once, for once only are we perfectly equipped for loving.
36766.name: Cyril Connolly

36767.quote: I long for the raised voice, the howl of rage or love.
36767.name: Leslie Fiedler

36769.quote: But love's a malady without a cure.
36769.name: John Dryden

36770.quote: Love is much nicer to be in than an automobile accident, a tight girdle, a higher tax bracket or a holding pattern over Philadelphia.
36770.name: Judith Viorst

36771.quote: Is it not by love alone that we succeed in penetrating to the very essence of being?
36771.name: Igor Stravinsky

36772.quote: Who would give a law to lovers? Love is unto itself a higher law.
36772.name: Boethius

36774.quote: When we lose one we love, our bitterest tears are called forth by the memory of hours when we loved not enough.
36774.name: Maurice Maeterlinck

36775.quote: The cure for all the ills and wrongs, the cares, the sorrows, and the crimes of humanity, all lie in the one word 'love'. It is the divine vitality that everywhere produces and restores life.
36775.name: Lydia M. Child

36776.quote: Oh, love will make a dog howl in rhyme.
36776.name: Francis Beaumont

36777.quote: Love is a hole in the heart.
36777.name: Ben Hecht

36778.quote: Love is the magician that pulls man out of his own hat.
36778.name: Ben Hecht

36779.quote: In our life there is a single color, as on an artist's palette, which provides the meaning of life and art. It is the color of love.
36779.name: Marc Chagall

36780.quote: To enlarge or illustrate this power and effect of love is to set a candle in the sun.
36780.name: Robert Burton

36781.quote: One must not trifle with love.
36781.name: Alfred de Musset

36782.quote: All love is lost but upon God alone.
36782.name: William Dunbar

36783.quote: Darkness cannot drive out darkness only light can do that. Hate cannot drive out hate only love can do that.
36783.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36784.quote: Life is a song - sing it. Life is a game - play it. Life is a challenge - meet it. Life is a dream - realize it. Life is a sacrifice - offer it. Life is love - enjoy it.
36784.name: Sai Baba

36785.quote: We must develop and maintain the capacity to forgive. He who is devoid of the power to forgive is devoid of the power to love. There is some good in the worst of us and some evil in the best of us. When we discover this, we are less prone to hate our enemies.
36785.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36786.quote: Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
36786.name: William Shakespeare

36787.quote: When the power of love overcomes the love of power the world will know peace.
36787.name: Jimi Hendrix

36788.quote: You can search throughout the entire universe for someone who is more deserving of your love and affection than you are yourself, and that person is not to be found anywhere. You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe deserve your love and affection.
36788.name: Buddha

36789.quote: Choose a job you love, and you will never have to work a day in your life.
36789.name: Confucius

36790.quote: A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
36790.name: Mignon McLaughlin

36791.quote: Spread love everywhere you go. Let no one ever come to you without leaving happier.
36791.name: Mother Teresa

36792.quote: I refuse to accept the view that mankind is so tragically bound to the starless midnight of racism and war that the bright daybreak of peace and brotherhood can never become a reality, I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word.
36792.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36793.quote: All major religious traditions carry basically the same message, that is love, compassion and forgiveness the important thing is they should be part of our daily lives.
36793.name: Dalai Lama

36794.quote: I believe that unarmed truth and unconditional love will have the final word in reality. This is why right, temporarily defeated, is stronger than evil triumphant.
36794.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36795.quote: To love beauty is to see light.
36795.name: Victor Hugo

36796.quote: There is a sacredness in tears. They are not the mark of weakness, but of power. They speak more eloquently than ten thousand tongues. They are the messengers of overwhelming grief, of deep contrition, and of unspeakable love.
36796.name: Washington Irving

36797.quote: My great hope is to laugh as much as I cry to get my work done and try to love somebody and have the courage to accept the love in return.
36797.name: Maya Angelou

36798.quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
36798.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

36799.quote: Love and compassion are necessities, not luxuries. Without them humanity cannot survive.
36799.name: Dalai Lama

36800.quote: Don't aim for success if you want it just do what you love and believe in, and it will come naturally.
36800.name: David Frost

36801.quote: It is easy to hate and it is difficult to love. This is how the whole scheme of things works. All good things are difficult to achieve and bad things are very easy to get.
36801.name: Confucius

36802.quote: I love people who make me laugh. I honestly think it's the thing I like most, to laugh. It cures a multitude of ills. It's probably the most important thing in a person.
36802.name: Audrey Hepburn

36803.quote: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive - to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
36803.name: Marcus Aurelius

36804.quote: The love of family and the admiration of friends is much more important than wealth and privilege.
36804.name: Charles Kuralt

36805.quote: Man must evolve for all human conflict a method which rejects revenge, aggression and retaliation. The foundation of such a method is love.
36805.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36806.quote: There can be no deep disappointment where there is not deep love.
36806.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36807.quote: Love begins by taking care of the closest ones - the ones at home.
36807.name: Mother Teresa

36808.quote: If music be the food of love, play on.
36808.name: William Shakespeare

36809.quote: Never forget the three powerful resources you always have available to you: love, prayer, and forgiveness.
36809.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

36810.quote: If you have only one smile in you give it to the people you love.
36810.name: Maya Angelou

36811.quote: Love is the only force capable of transforming an enemy into friend.
36811.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36812.quote: Have we not come to such an impasse in the modern world that we must love our enemies - or else? The chain reaction of evil - hate begetting hate, wars producing more wars - must be broken, or else we shall be plunged into the dark abyss of annihilation.
36812.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36813.quote: Hatred does not cease by hatred, but only by love this is the eternal rule.
36813.name: Buddha

36814.quote: All you need is love. But a little chocolate now and then doesn't hurt.
36814.name: Charles M. Schulz

36815.quote: Happiness cannot be traveled to, owned, earned, worn or consumed. Happiness is the spiritual experience of living every minute with love, grace, and gratitude.
36815.name: Denis Waitley

36816.quote: I love those who can smile in trouble, who can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but they whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves their conduct, will pursue their principles unto death.
36816.name: Leonardo da Vinci

36817.quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
36817.name: Bruce Lee

36818.quote: Before marriage, a girl has to make love to a man to hold him. After marriage, she has to hold him to make love to him.
36818.name: Marilyn Monroe

36819.quote: It may be true that the law cannot make a man love me, but it can keep him from lynching me, and I think that's pretty important.
36819.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36820.quote: At the center of non-violence stands the principle of love.
36820.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36821.quote: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
36821.name: Maya Angelou

36822.quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
36822.name: Euripides

36823.quote: Between men and women there is no friendship possible. There is passion, enmity, worship, love, but no friendship.
36823.name: Oscar Wilde

36824.quote: Let us more and more insist on raising funds of love, of kindness, of understanding, of peace. Money will come if we seek first the Kingdom of God - the rest will be given.
36824.name: Mother Teresa

36825.quote: Let us not be satisfied with just giving money. Money is not enough, money can be got, but they need your hearts to love them. So, spread your love everywhere you go.
36825.name: Mother Teresa

36826.quote: You can't stop loving or wanting to love because when its right it's the best thing in the world. When you're in a relationship and its good, even if nothing else in your life is right, you feel like your whole world is complete.
36826.name: Keith Sweat

36827.quote: A coward is incapable of exhibiting love it is the prerogative of the brave.
36827.name: Mahatma Gandhi

36828.quote: You can't blame gravity for falling in love.
36828.name: Albert Einstein

36829.quote: Never trust anyone completely but God. Love people, but put your full trust only in God.
36829.name: Lawrence Welk

36830.quote: If you love someone, set them free. If they come back they're yours if they don't they never were.
36830.name: Richard Bach

36831.quote: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
36831.name: Rita Rudner

36832.quote: If you love somebody, let them go, for if they return, they were always yours. And if they don't, they never were.
36832.name: Khalil Gibran

36833.quote: I love you when you bow in your mosque, kneel in your temple, pray in your church. For you and I are sons of one religion, and it is the spirit.
36833.name: Khalil Gibran
