36834.quote: I say what I want to say and do what I want to do. There's no in between. People will either love you for it or hate you for it.
36834.name: Eminem

36835.quote: It is not enough to say we must not wage war. It is necessary to love peace and sacrifice for it.
36835.name: Jr. Martin Luther King

36836.quote: You, yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
36836.name: Buddha

36837.quote: People love chopping wood. In this activity one immediately sees results.
36837.name: Albert Einstein

36838.quote: The foundation stones for a balanced success are honesty, character, integrity, faith, love and loyalty.
36838.name: Zig Ziglar

36839.quote: Love is friendship that has caught fire. It is quiet understanding, mutual confidence, sharing and forgiving. It is loyalty through good and bad times. It settles for less than perfection and makes allowances for human weaknesses.
36839.name: Ann Landers

36840.quote: If you want a love message to be heard, it has got to be sent out. To keep a lamp burning, we have to keep putting oil in it.
36840.name: Mother Teresa

36841.quote: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own, Jealousy is a disease, love is a healthy condition. The immature mind often mistakes one for the other, or assumes that the greater the love, the greater the jealousy.
36841.name: Robert A. Heinlein

36842.quote: Intense love does not measure, it just gives.
36842.name: Mother Teresa

36843.quote: But let there be spaces in your togetherness and let the winds of the heavens dance between you. Love one another but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
36843.name: Khalil Gibran

36844.quote: Even the rich are hungry for love, for being cared for, for being wanted, for having someone to call their own.
36844.name: Mother Teresa

36845.quote: Love is a fruit in season at all times, and within reach of every hand.
36845.name: Mother Teresa

36846.quote: I love mirrors. They let one pass through the surface of things.
36846.name: Claude Chabrol

36847.quote: Be Impeccable With Your Word. Speak with integrity. Say only what you mean. Avoid using the word to speak against yourself or to gossip about others. Use the power of your word in the direction of truth and love.
36847.name: Miguel Angel Ruiz

36848.quote: The beginning of love is to let those we love be perfectly themselves, and not to twist them to fit our own image. Otherwise we love only the reflection of ourselves we find in them.
36848.name: Thomas Merton

36849.quote: If we listened to our intellect, we'd never have a love affair. We'd never have a friendship. We'd never go into business, because we'd be cynical. Well, that's nonsense. You've got to jump off cliffs all the time and build your wings on the way down.
36849.name: Ray Bradbury

36850.quote: Kindness in words creates confidence. Kindness in thinking creates profoundness. Kindness in giving creates love.
36850.name: Lao Tzu

36851.quote: Anyway, no drug, not even alcohol, causes the fundamental ills of society. If we're looking for the source of our troubles, we shouldn't test people for drugs, we should test them for stupidity, ignorance, greed and love of power.
36851.name: P. J. O'Rourke

36852.quote: The beauty of a woman must be seen from in her eyes, because that is the doorway to her heart, the place where love resides.
36852.name: Audrey Hepburn

36853.quote: And ever has it been known that love knows not its own depth until the hour of separation.
36853.name: Khalil Gibran

36854.quote: The things that will destroy America are prosperity-at-any-price, peace-at-any-price, safety-first instead of duty-first, the love of soft living, and the get-rich-quick theory of life.
36854.name: Theodore Roosevelt

36855.quote: Absence from those we love is self from self - a deadly banishment.
36855.name: William Shakespeare

36856.quote: Love of beauty is taste. The creation of beauty is art.
36856.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

36857.quote: I honestly think it is better to be a failure at something you love than to be a success at something you hate.
36857.name: George Burns

36858.quote: Love is the ability and willingness to allow those that you care for to be what they choose for themselves without any insistence that they satisfy you.
36858.name: Wayne Dyer

36859.quote: Men always want to be a woman's first love - women like to be a man's last romance.
36859.name: Oscar Wilde

36860.quote: Love is like a beautiful flower which I may not touch, but whose fragrance makes the garden a place of delight just the same.
36860.name: Helen Keller

36861.quote: I love sleep. My life has the tendency to fall apart when I'm awake, you know?
36861.name: Ernest Hemingway

36862.quote: If we lose love and self respect for each other, this is how we finally die.
36862.name: Maya Angelou

36863.quote: There is always the danger that we may just do the work for the sake of the work. This is where the respect and the love and the devotion come in - that we do it to God, to Christ, and that's why we try to do it as beautifully as possible.
36863.name: Mother Teresa

36864.quote: The course of true love never did run smooth.
36864.name: William Shakespeare

36865.quote: I know of only one duty, and that is to love.
36865.name: Albert Camus

36866.quote: One should always be in love. That is the reason one should never marry.
36866.name: Oscar Wilde

36867.quote: We've got this gift of love, but love is like a precious plant. You can't just accept it and leave it in the cupboard or just think it's going to get on by itself. You've got to keep watering it. You've got to really look after it and nurture it.
36867.name: John Lennon

36868.quote: A man can be happy with any woman, as long as he does not love her.
36868.name: Oscar Wilde

36869.quote: The greatest gift that you can give to others is the gift of unconditional love and acceptance.
36869.name: Brian Tracy

36870.quote: Many people mistake our work for our vocation. Our vocation is the love of Jesus.
36870.name: Mother Teresa

36871.quote: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. And the only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle. As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
36871.name: Steve Jobs

36872.quote: Forgiveness is the final form of love.
36872.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

36873.quote: The most important thing a father can do for his children is to love their mother.
36873.name: Theodore Hesburgh

36874.quote: Joy is a net of love by which you can catch souls.
36874.name: Mother Teresa

36875.quote: I try to give to the poor people for love what the rich could get for money. No, I wouldn't touch a leper for a thousand pounds yet I willingly cure him for the love of God.
36875.name: Mother Teresa

36876.quote: If someone thinks that love and peace is a cliche that must have been left behind in the Sixties, that's his problem. Love and peace are eternal.
36876.name: John Lennon

36877.quote: The first duty of love is to listen.
36877.name: Paul Tillich

36878.quote: I see when men love women. They give them but a little of their lives. But women when they love give everything.
36878.name: Oscar Wilde

36879.quote: Work is love made visible. And if you cannot work with love but only with distaste, it is better that you should leave your work and sit at the gate of the temple and take alms of those who work with joy.
36879.name: Khalil Gibran

36880.quote: Our life of poverty is as necessary as the work itself. Only in heaven will we see how much we owe to the poor for helping us to love God better because of them.
36880.name: Mother Teresa

36881.quote: There are four questions of value in life, What is sacred? Of what is the spirit made? What is worth living for, and what is worth dying for? The answer to each is the same. Only love.
36881.name: Johnny Depp

36882.quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
36882.name: Jean de La Fontaine

36883.quote: Power is of two kinds. One is obtained by the fear of punishment and the other by acts of love. Power based on love is a thousand times more effective and permanent then the one derived from fear of punishment.
36883.name: Mahatma Gandhi

36884.quote: We are not the same persons this year as last nor are those we love. It is a happy chance if we, changing, continue to love a changed person.
36884.name: W. Somerset Maugham

36885.quote: God proved His love on the Cross. When Christ hung, and bled, and died, it was God saying to the world, 'I love you.'
36885.name: Billy Graham

36886.quote: Falling in love and having a relationship are two different things.
36886.name: Keanu Reeves

36887.quote: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together, but do so with all your heart.
36887.name: Marcus Aurelius

36888.quote: Trust is to human relationships what faith is to gospel living. It is the beginning place, the foundation upon which more can be built. Where trust is, love can flourish.
36888.name: Barbara Smith

36889.quote: As selfishness and complaint pervert the mind, so love with its joy clears and sharpens the vision.
36889.name: Helen Keller

36890.quote: When you fish for love, bait with your heart, not your brain.
36890.name: Mark Twain

36891.quote: I love deadlines. I like the whooshing sound they make as they fly by.
36891.name: Douglas Adams

36892.quote: Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
36892.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

36893.quote: The man of knowledge must be able not only to love his enemies but also to hate his friends.
36893.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

36894.quote: Love is like a virus. It can happen to anybody at any time.
36894.name: Maya Angelou

36895.quote: It has always seemed strange to me, the things we admire in men, kindness and generosity, openness, honesty, understanding and feeling, are the concomitants of failure in our system. And those traits we detest, sharpness, greed, acquisitiveness, meanness, egotism and self-interest, are the traits of success. And while men admire the quality of the first they love the produce of the second.
36895.name: John Steinbeck

36896.quote: Love one another and help others to rise to the higher levels, simply by pouring out love. Love is infectious and the greatest healing energy.
36896.name: Sai Baba

36897.quote: Christmas, my child, is love in action. Every time we love, every time we give, it's Christmas.
36897.name: Dale Evans

36898.quote: We never know the love of a parent till we become parents ourselves.
36898.name: Henry Ward Beecher

36899.quote: I love the man that can smile in trouble, that can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but he whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves his conduct, will pursue his principles unto death.
36899.name: Thomas Paine

36900.quote: Love is a serious mental disease.
36900.name: Plato

36901.quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
36901.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

36902.quote: I love those who yearn for the impossible.
36902.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

36903.quote: Love to faults is always blind, always is to joy inclined. Lawless, winged, and unconfined, and breaks all chains from every mind.
36903.name: William Shakespeare

36904.quote: What does love look like? It has the hands to help others. It has the feet to hasten to the poor and needy. It has eyes to see misery and want. It has the ears to hear the sighs and sorrows of men. That is what love looks like.
36904.name: Saint Augustine

36905.quote: The sadness of the women's movement is that they don't allow the necessity of love. See, I don't personally trust any revolution where love is not allowed.
36905.name: Maya Angelou

36906.quote: Love. Fall in love and stay in love. Write only what you love, and love what you write. The key word is love. You have to get up in the morning and write something you love, something to live for.
36906.name: Ray Bradbury

36907.quote: I love life because what more is there?

37445.quote: I think the biggest disease the world suffers from in this day and age is the disease of people feeling unloved. I know that I can give love for a minute, for half an hour, for a day, for a month, but I can give. I am very happy to do that, I want to do that.
37445.name: Princess Diana

37446.quote: The love of learning, the sequestered nooks, And all the sweet serenity of books.
37446.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

37447.quote: Don't threaten me with love, baby. Let's just go walking in the rain.
37447.name: Billie Holiday

37448.quote: Men often pass from love to ambition, but they seldom come back again from ambition to love.
37448.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37449.quote: If you cannot inspire a woman with love of you, fill her above the brim with love of herself all that runs over will be yours.
37449.name: Charles Caleb Colton

37450.quote: I understand now that the vulnerability I've always felt is the greatest strength a person can have. You can't experience life without feeling life. What I've learned is that being vulnerable to somebody you love is not a weakness, it's a strength.
37450.name: Elisabeth Shue

37451.quote: If a man is truly in love, the most beautiful woman in the world couldn't take him away. Maybe for a few days, but not forever.
37451.name: Eva Gabor

37452.quote: If I think more about death than some other people, it is probably because I love life more than they do.
37452.name: Angelina Jolie

37453.quote: Love is the river of life in the world.
37453.name: Henry Ward Beecher

37454.quote: The love that lasts longest is the love that is never returned.
37454.name: W. Somerset Maugham

37455.quote: I love quotations because it is a joy to find thoughts one might have, beautifully expressed with much authority by someone recognized wiser than oneself.
37455.name: Marlene Dietrich

37456.quote: If so many men, so many minds, certainly so many hearts, so many kinds of love.
37456.name: Leo Tolstoy

37457.quote: Love is anterior to life, posterior to death, initial of creation, and the exponent of breath.
37457.name: Emily Dickinson

37458.quote: Tell the truth. Sing with passion. Work with laughter. Love with heart. 'Cause that's all that matters in the end.
37458.name: Kris Kristofferson

37459.quote: Getting divorced just because you don't love a man is almost as silly as getting married just because you do.
37459.name: Zsa Zsa Gabor

37460.quote: Give a little love to a child, and you get a great deal back.
37460.name: John Ruskin

37461.quote: It is with true love as it is with ghosts everyone talks about it, but few have seen it.
37461.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37462.quote: He who knows no hardships will know no hardihood. He who faces no calamity will need no courage. Mysterious though it is, the characteristics in human nature which we love best grow in a soil with a strong mixture of troubles.
37462.name: Harry Emerson Fosdick

37463.quote: Love is never defeated, and I could add, the history of Ireland proves it.
37463.name: Pope John Paul II

37464.quote: I love chicken. I would eat chicken fingers on Thanksgiving if it were socially acceptable.
37464.name: Todd Barry

37465.quote: In friendship as well as love, ignorance very often contributes more to our happiness than knowledge.
37465.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37466.quote: Neither a lofty degree of intelligence nor imagination nor both together go to the making of genius. Love, love, love, that is the soul of genius.
37466.name: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart

37467.quote: The motto of chivalry is also the motto of wisdom to serve all, but love only one.
37467.name: Honore de Balzac

37468.quote: When we ask for love, we don't ask others to be fair to us-but rather to care for us, to be considerate of us. There is a world of difference here between demanding justice, and begging or pleading for love.
37468.name: Mortimer Adler

37469.quote: He who does not love his own language is worse than an animal and smelly fish.
37469.name: Jose Rizal

37470.quote: The secret of a happy marriage is finding the right person. You know they're right if you love to be with them all the time.
37470.name: Julia Child

37471.quote: We always love those who admire us, but we do not always love those whom we admire.
37471.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37472.quote: When people are lame, they love to blame.
37472.name: Robert Kiyosaki

37473.quote: When you're taught to love everyone, to love your enemies, then what value does that place on love?
37473.name: Marilyn Manson

37474.quote: A James Cagney love scene is one where he lets the other guy live.
37474.name: Bob Hope

37475.quote: We are nearer loving those who hate us than those who love us more than we wish.
37475.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37476.quote: If love is the treasure, laughter is the key.
37476.name: Yakov Smirnoff

37477.quote: I am deeply grateful to the citizens of Sarajevo and the Sarajevo Canton assembly for bestowing upon me this incredible honor of citizenship. I am so proud to now be a part of such an extraordinary part of the world and fellow citizen to the people I deeply love and admire.
37477.name: Angelina Jolie

37478.quote: You will reciprocally promise love, loyalty and matrimonial honesty. We only want for you this day that these words constitute the principle of your entire life and that with the help of divine grace you will observe these solemn vows that today, before God, you formulate.
37478.name: Pope John Paul II

37479.quote: My trust in a higher power that wants me to survive and have love in my life, is what keeps me moving forward.
37479.name: Kenny Loggins

37480.quote: If you love something let it go free. If it doesn't come back, you never had it. If it comes back, love it forever.
37480.name: Douglas Horton

37481.quote: I love my children beyond all reason. They're my joy, even when they're wild with kid energy.
37481.name: Christopher Meloni

37482.quote: We may sooner be brought to love them that hate us, than them that love us more than we would have them do.
37482.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37483.quote: Little children are still the symbol of the eternal marriage between love and duty.
37483.name: George Eliot

37484.quote: Love has its own time, its own season, and its own reasons from coming and going. You cannot bribe it or coerce it or reason it into staying. You can only embrace it when it arrives and give it away when it comes to you.
37484.name: Kent Nerburn

37485.quote: Love does not alter the beloved, it alters itself.
37485.name: Soren Kierkegaard

37486.quote: We pardon to the extent that we love.
37486.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37488.quote: To love someone means to see him as God intended him.
37488.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky

37489.quote: Love can no more continue without a constant motion than fire can and when once you take hope and fear away, you take from it its very life and being.
37489.name: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

37490.quote: Let us be about setting high standards for life, love, creativity, and wisdom. If our expectations in these areas are low, we are not likely to experience wellness. Setting high standards makes every day and every decade worth looking forward to.
37490.name: Greg Anderson

37491.quote: Art is not the application of a canon of beauty but what the instinct and the brain can conceive beyond any canon. When we love a woman we don't start measuring her limbs.
37491.name: Pablo Picasso

37492.quote: Just as in earthly life lovers long for the moment when they are able to breathe forth their love for each other, to let their souls blend in a soft whisper, so the mystic longs for the moment when in prayer he can, as it were, creep into God.
37492.name: Soren Kierkegaard

37493.quote: Romance is tempestuous. Love is calm.
37493.name: Mason Cooley

37494.quote: Where love is concerned, too much is not even enough.
37494.name: Pierre Beaumarchais

37495.quote: I really love idiot, enlightened characters - these characters who fail to engage with the drama of their immediate circumstances they fail to be reactive and enrolled by drama as it happens around them.
37495.name: Chuck Palahniuk

37496.quote: This is the miracle that happens every time to those who really love: the more they give, the more they possess.
37496.name: Rainer Maria Rilke

37497.quote: The main facts in human life are five: birth, food, sleep, love and death.
37497.name: E. M. Forster

37498.quote: A religious man is a person who holds God and man in one thought at one time, at all times, who suffers harm done to others, whose greatest passion is compassion, whose greatest strength is love and defiance of despair.
37498.name: Abraham Joshua Heschel

37499.quote: I did not just fall in love. I made a parachute jump.
37499.name: Zora Neale Hurston

37500.quote: Metaphors are dangerous. Love begins with a metaphor. Which is to say, love begins at the point when a woman enters her first word into our poetic memory.
37500.name: Milan Kundera

37501.quote: At the end of the day, you know, love does not happen between two perfect people as much as we would wish.
37501.name: Hillary Clinton

37502.quote: Even if a unity of faith is not possible, a unity of love is.
37502.name: Hans Urs von Balthasar

37503.quote: A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
37503.name: Mignon McLaughlin

37504.quote: By all means, marry. If you get a good wife, you'll become happy if you get a bad one, you'll become a philosopher.
37504.name: Socrates

37505.quote: It is not a lack of love, but a lack of friendship that makes unhappy marriages.
37505.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

37506.quote: How can a woman be expected to be happy with a man who insists on treating her as if she were a perfectly normal human being.
37506.name: Oscar Wilde

37507.quote: Don't marry the person you think you can live with marry only the individual you think you can't live without.
37507.name: James C. Dobson

37508.quote: A good marriage would be between a blind wife and a deaf husband.
37508.name: Michel de Montaigne

37509.quote: Let the wife make the husband glad to come home, and let him make her sorry to see him leave.
37509.name: Martin Luther

37510.quote: My most brilliant achievement was my ability to be able to persuade my wife to marry me.
37510.name: Winston Churchill

37511.quote: Before marriage, a girl has to make love to a man to hold him. After marriage, she has to hold him to make love to him.
37511.name: Marilyn Monroe

37512.quote: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
37512.name: Rita Rudner

37513.quote: Happy is the man who finds a true friend, and far happier is he who finds that true friend in his wife.
37513.name: Franz Schubert

37514.quote: Marriage is neither heaven nor hell, it is simply purgatory.
37514.name: Abraham Lincoln

37515.quote: One should always be in love. That is the reason one should never marry.
37515.name: Oscar Wilde

37516.quote: Every good relationship, especially marriage, is based on respect. If it's not based on respect, nothing that appears to be good will last very long.
37516.name: Amy Grant

37517.quote: I have learned that only two things are necessary to keep one's wife happy. First, let her think she's having her own way. And second, let her have it.
37517.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

37518.quote: More marriages might survive if the partners realized that sometimes the better comes after the worse.
37518.name: Doug Larson

37519.quote: When marrying, ask yourself this question: Do you believe that you will be able to converse well with this person into your old age? Everything else in marriage is transitory.
37519.name: Friedrich Nietzsche

37520.quote: There is nothing in the world like the devotion of a married woman. It is a thing no married man knows anything about.
37520.name: Oscar Wilde

37521.quote: One advantage of marriage is that, when you fall out of love with him or he falls out of love with you, it keeps you together until you fall in again.
37521.name: Judith Viorst

37522.quote: Sometimes I wonder if men and women really suit each other. Perhaps they should live next door and just visit now and then.
37522.name: Katharine Hepburn

37523.quote: If I get married, I want to be very married.
37523.name: Audrey Hepburn

37524.quote: Do you know what it means to come home at night to a woman who'll give you a little love, a little affection, a little tenderness? It means you're in the wrong house, that's what it means.
37524.name: Henny Youngman

37525.quote: The secret of a happy marriage remains a secret.
37525.name: Henny Youngman

37526.quote: A dress that zips up the back will bring a husband and wife together.
37526.name: James H. Boren

37527.quote: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
37527.name: Benjamin Franklin

37528.quote: Where there's marriage without love, there will be love without marriage.
37528.name: Benjamin Franklin

37529.quote: Marriage is a wonderful institution, but who wants to live in an institution?
37529.name: Groucho Marx

37530.quote: I'd marry again if I found a man who had fifteen million dollars, would sign over half to me, and guarantee that he'd be dead within a year.
37530.name: Bette Davis

37531.quote: A good husband is never the first to go to sleep at night or the last to awake in the morning.
37531.name: Honore de Balzac

37532.quote: Let us now set forth one of the fundamental truths about marriage: the wife is in charge.
37532.name: Bill Cosby

37533.quote: If you want to sacrifice the admiration of many men for the criticism of one, go ahead, get married.
37533.name: Katharine Hepburn

37534.quote: Being divorced is like being hit by a Mack truck. If you live through it, you start looking very carefully to the right and to the left.
37534.name: Jean Kerr

37535.quote: When you make the sacrifice in marriage, you're sacrificing not to each other but to unity in a relationship.
37535.name: Joseph Campbell

37536.quote: Marriage is a great institution, but I'm not ready for an institution.
37536.name: Mae West

37537.quote: Bachelors know more about women than married men if they didn't they'd be married too.
37537.name: H. L. Mencken

37538.quote: No man should marry until he has studied anatomy and dissected at least one woman.
37538.name: Honore de Balzac

37539.quote: All men make mistakes, but married men find out about them sooner.
37539.name: Red Skelton

37540.quote: A journey is like marriage. The certain way to be wrong is to think you control it.
37540.name: John Steinbeck

37541.quote: For years my wedding ring has done its job. It has led me not into temptation. It has reminded my husband numerous times at parties that it's time to go home. It has been a source of relief to a dinner companion. It has been a status symbol in the maternity ward.
37541.name: Erma Bombeck

37542.quote: A man in love is incomplete until he has married. Then he's finished.
37542.name: Zsa Zsa Gabor

37543.quote: Never get married in college it's hard to get a start if a prospective employer finds you've already made one mistake.
37543.name: Elbert Hubbard

37544.quote: He's the kind of man a woman would have to marry to get rid of.
37544.name: Mae West

37545.quote: To keep your marriage brimming, With love in the loving cup, Whenever you're wrong, admit it Whenever you're right, shut up.
37545.name: Ogden Nash

37546.quote: Love: A temporary insanity curable by marriage.
37546.name: Ambrose Bierce

37547.quote: Marriage resembles a pair of shears, so joined that they cannot be separated often moving in opposite directions, yet always punishing anyone who comes between them.
37547.name: Sydney Smith

37548.quote: Marriage has no guarantees. If that's what you're looking for, go live with a car battery.
37548.name: Erma Bombeck

37549.quote: When a man opens a car door for his wife, it's either a new car or a new wife.
37549.name: Prince Philip

37550.quote: It's tough to stay married. My wife kisses the dog on the lips, yet she won't drink from my glass.
37550.name: Rodney Dangerfield

37551.quote: There's only one way to have a happy marriage and as soon as I learn what it is I'll get married again.
37551.name: Clint Eastwood

37552.quote: Politics doesn't make strange bedfellows - marriage does.
37552.name: Groucho Marx

37553.quote: When a man steals your wife, there is no better revenge than to let him keep her.
37553.name: Sacha Guitry

37554.quote: A successful marriage is an edifice that must be rebuilt every day.
37554.name: Andre Maurois

37555.quote: There is nothing nobler or more admirable than when two people who see eye to eye keep house as man and wife, confounding their enemies and delighting their friends.
37555.name: Homer

37556.quote: Basically my wife was immature. I'd be at home in the bath and she'd come in and sink my boats.
37556.name: Woody Allen

37557.quote: Love is moral even without legal marriage, but marriage is immoral without love.
37557.name: Ellen Key

37558.quote: By our Heavenly Father and only because of God, only because of God. We're like other couples. We do not get along perfectly we do not go without arguments and, as I call them, fights, and heartache and pain and hurting each other. But a marriage is three of us.
37558.name: Barbara Mandrell

37559.quote: Marrying an old bachelor is like buying second-hand furniture.
37559.name: Jr. H. Jackson Brown

37560.quote: If there is such a thing as a good marriage, it is because it resembles friendship rather than love.
37560.name: Michel de Montaigne

37561.quote: Marriage, n: the state or condition of a community consisting of a master, a mistress, and two slaves, making in all, two.
37561.name: Ambrose Bierce

37562.quote: Marriage is an adventure, like going to war.
37562.name: Gilbert K. Chesterton

37563.quote: Strike an average between what a woman thinks of her husband a month before she marries him and what she thinks of him a year afterward, and you will have the truth about him.
37563.name: H. L. Mencken

37564.quote: Men have a much better time of it than women. For one thing, they marry later for another thing, they die earlier.
37564.name: H. L. Mencken

37565.quote: Well married a person has wings, poorly married shackles.
37565.name: Henry Ward Beecher

37566.quote: The big difference between sex for money and sex for free is that sex for money usually costs a lot less.
37566.name: Brendan Behan

37567.quote: Marriage is a series of desperate arguments people feel passionately about.
37567.name: Katharine Hepburn

37568.quote: I think women are natural caretakers. They take care of everybody. They take care of their husbands and their kids and their dogs, and don't spend a lot of time just getting back and taking time out.
37568.name: Reese Witherspoon

37569.quote: Bachelors have consciences, married men have wives.
37569.name: Samuel Johnson

37570.quote: It's not beauty but fine qualities, my girl, that keep a husband.
37570.name: Euripides

37571.quote: A man marries to have a home, but also because he doesn't want to be bothered with sex and all that sort of thing.
37571.name: W. Somerset Maugham

37572.quote: An ideal wife is one who remains faithful to you but tries to be just as charming as if she weren't.
37572.name: Sacha Guitry

37573.quote: A psychiatrist asks a lot of expensive questions your wife asks for nothing.
37573.name: Joey Adams

37574.quote: If you made a list of reasons why any couple got married, and another list of the reasons for their divorce, you'd have a hell of a lot of overlapping.
37574.name: Mignon McLaughlin

37575.quote: There were three of us in this marriage, so it was a bit crowded.
37575.name: Princess Diana

37576.quote: Marrying for love may be a bit risky, but it is so honest that God can't help but smile on it.
37576.name: Josh Billings

37577.quote: Why does a woman work ten years to change a man's habits and then complain that he's not the man she married?
37577.name: Barbra Streisand

37578.quote: Do not put such unlimited power into the hands of husbands. Remember all men would be tyrants if they could.
37578.name: Abigail Adams

37579.quote: The concept of two people living together for 25 years without a serious dispute suggests a lack of spirit only to be admired in sheep.
37579.name: A. P. Herbert

37580.quote: Men who have a pierced ear are better prepared for marriage - they've experienced pain and bought jewelry.
37580.name: Rita Rudner

37581.quote: The majority of husbands remind me of an orangutan trying to play the violin.
37581.name: Honore de Balzac

37582.quote: Marriage is like a cage one sees the birds outside desperate to get in, and those inside equally desperate to get out.
37582.name: Michel de Montaigne

37583.quote: The true index of a man's character is the health of his wife.
37583.name: Cyril Connolly

37584.quote: A wedding is a funeral where you smell your own flowers.
37584.name: Eddie Cantor

37585.quote: No man is regular in his attendance at the House of Commons until he is married.
37585.name: Benjamin Disraeli

37586.quote: Almost no one is foolish enough to imagine that he automatically deserves great success in any field of activity yet almost everyone believes that he automatically deserves success in marriage.
37586.name: Sydney J. Harris

37587.quote: Getting divorced just because you don't love a man is almost as silly as getting married just because you do.
37587.name: Zsa Zsa Gabor

37588.quote: Marriage is a bribe to make the housekeeper think she's a householder.
37588.name: Thornton Wilder

37589.quote: A happy marriage is a long conversation which always seems too short.
37589.name: Andre Maurois

37590.quote: In marriage there are no manners to keep up, and beneath the wildest accusations no real criticism. Each is familiar with that ancient child in the other who may erupt again. We are not ridiculous to ourselves. We are ageless. That is the luxury of the wedding ring.
37590.name: Enid Bagnold

37591.quote: All marriages are happy. It's the living together afterward that causes all the trouble.
37591.name: Raymond Hull

37592.quote: The first time you marry for love, the second for money, and the third for companionship.
37592.name: Jackie Kennedy

37593.quote: Marriage must incessantly contend with a monster that devours everything: familiarity.
37593.name: Honore de Balzac

37594.quote: It destroys one's nerves to be amiable every day to the same human being.
37594.name: Benjamin Disraeli

37595.quote: A husband is what is left of a lover, after the nerve has been extracted.
37595.name: Helen Rowland

37596.quote: Marriage is nature's way of keeping us from fighting with strangers.
37596.name: Alan King

37597.quote: Marriage may be the closest thing to Heaven or Hell any of us will know on this earth.
37597.name: Edwin Louis Cole

37598.quote: Any intelligent woman who reads the marriage contract, and then goes into it, deserves all the consequences.
37598.name: Isadora Duncan

37599.quote: Marriage should be a duet - when one sings, the other claps.
37599.name: Joe Murray

37600.quote: It takes patience to appreciate domestic bliss volatile spirits prefer unhappiness.
37600.name: George Santayana

37601.quote: Marriage is a wonderful invention: then again, so is a bicycle repair kit.
37601.name: Billy Connolly

37602.quote: Happiness in marriage is entirely a matter of chance.
37602.name: Jane Austen

37603.quote: Love is often the fruit of marriage.
37603.name: Moliere

37604.quote: It is a full time job being honest one moment at a time, remembering to love, to honor, to respect. It is a practice, a discipline, worthy of every moment.
37604.name: Jasmine Guy

37605.quote: Plant and your spouse plants with you weed and you weed alone.
37605.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

37606.quote: Marriage, a market which has nothing free but the entrance.
37606.name: Michel de Montaigne

37607.quote: They dream in courtship, but in wedlock wake.
37607.name: Alexander Pope

37608.quote: The bonds of matrimony are like any other bonds - they mature slowly.
37608.name: Peter De Vries

37609.quote: Only choose in marriage a man whom you would choose as a friend if he were a woman.
37609.name: Joseph Joubert

37610.quote: My husband and I are either going to buy a dog or have a child. We can't decide whether to ruin our carpet or ruin our lives.
37610.name: Rita Rudner

37611.quote: Marriage is a feast where the grace is sometimes better than the dinner.
37611.name: Charles Caleb Colton

37612.quote: Daddy was real gentle with kids. That's why I expected so much out of marriage, figuring that all men should be steady and pleasant.
37612.name: Loretta Lynn

37613.quote: It isn't tying himself to one woman that a man dreads when he thinks of marrying it's separating himself from all the others.
37613.name: Helen Rowland

37614.quote: She's been married so many times she has rice marks on her face.
37614.name: Henny Youngman

37615.quote: Marriage is good for those who are afraid to sleep alone at night.
37615.name: St. Jerome

37616.quote: Marriage is the alliance of two people, one of whom never remembers birthdays and the other who never forgets them.
37616.name: Ogden Nash

37617.quote: He that loves not his wife and children feeds a lioness at home, and broods a nest of sorrows.
37617.name: Jeremy Taylor

37618.quote: Marriage is an attempt to solve problems together which you didn't even have when you were on your own.
37618.name: Eddie Cantor

37619.quote: Marriage is not about age it's about finding the right person.
37619.name: Sophia Bush

37620.quote: I married the first man I ever kissed. When I tell this to my children, they just about throw up.
37620.name: Barbara Bush

37621.quote: Marriage: A word which should be pronounced 'mirage'.
37621.name: Herbert Spencer

37622.quote: The difficulty with marriage is that we fall in love with a personality, but must live with a character.
37622.name: Peter De Vries

37623.quote: In olden times sacrifices were made at the altar - a practice which is still continued.
37623.name: Helen Rowland

37624.quote: I've had an exciting time I married for love and got a little money along with it.
37624.name: Rose Kennedy

37625.quote: Married men live longer than single men. But married men are a lot more willing to die.
37625.name: Johnny Carson

37626.quote: Faithful women are all alike, they think only of their fidelity, never of their husbands.
37626.name: Jean Giraudoux

37627.quote: Take care of him. And make him feel important. And if you can do that, you'll have a happy and wonderful marriage. Like two out of every ten couples.
37627.name: Neil Simon

37628.quote: Caesar might have married Cleopatra, but he had a wife at home. There's always something.
37628.name: Will Cuppy

37629.quote: I don't think my wife likes me very much, when I had a heart attack she wrote for an ambulance.
37629.name: Frank Carson

37630.quote: On rare occasions one does hear of a miraculous case of a married couple falling in love after marriage, but on close examination it will be found that it is a mere adjustment to the inevitable.
37630.name: Emma Goldman

37631.quote: Never feel remorse for what you have thought about your wife she has thought much worse things about you.
37631.name: Jean Rostand

37632.quote: Marrying a man is like buying something you've been admiring for a long time in a shop window. You may love it when you get it home, but it doesn't always go with everything else in the house.
37632.name: Jean Kerr

37633.quote: Love in marriage should be the accomplishment of a beautiful dream, and not, as it too often is, the end.
37633.name: Alphonse Karr

37634.quote: When I get married, it'll be no secret.
37634.name: Elvis Presley

37635.quote: Never tell a secret to a bride or a groom wait until they have been married longer.
37635.name: E. W. Howe

37636.quote: Marriage is the highest state of friendship. If happy, it lessens our cares by dividing them, at the same time that it doubles our pleasures by mutual participation.
37636.name: Samuel Richardson

37637.quote: Protecting the institution of marriage safeguards, I believe, the American family.
37637.name: John Boehner

37638.quote: When you have a baby, love is automatic, when you get married, love is earned.
37638.name: Marie Osmond

37639.quote: I like getting married, but I don't like being married.
37639.name: Don Adams

37640.quote: Sensual pleasures have the fleeting brilliance of a comet a happy marriage has the tranquillity of a lovely sunset.
37640.name: Ann Landers

37641.quote: Married people from my generation are like an endangered species!
37641.name: Patrice Leconte

37642.quote: I enjoy being single, but I loved being married.
37642.name: Stephanie Mills

39538.quote: As long as man continues to be the ruthless destroyer of lower living beings he will never know health or peace. For as long as men massacre animals, they will kill each other.
39538.name: Pythagoras

39539.quote: I hate this fast growing tendency to chain men to machines in big factories and deprive them of all joy in their efforts - the plan will lead to cheap men and cheap products.
39539.name: Richard Wagner

39540.quote: They died hard, those savage men - like wounded wolves at bay. They were filthy, and they were lousy, and they stunk. And I loved them.
39540.name: Douglas MacArthur

39541.quote: Men in general are quick to believe that which they wish to be true.
39541.name: Julius Caesar

39542.quote: All men's misfortunes spring from their hatred of being alone.
39542.name: Jean de la Bruyere

39543.quote: Why is it that, as a culture, we are more comfortable seeing two men holding guns than holding hands?
39543.name: Ernest Gaines

39544.quote: The chief difference between words and deeds is that words are always intended for men for their approbation, but deeds can be done only for God.
39544.name: Leo Tolstoy

39545.quote: Reasonable men adapt to the world around them unreasonable men make the world adapt to them. The world is changed by unreasonable men.
39545.name: Edwin Louis Cole

39546.quote: One can be a brother only in something. Where there is no tie that binds men, men are not united but merely lined up.
39546.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

39547.quote: Men judge us by the success of our efforts. God looks at the efforts themselves.
39547.name: Charlotte Bronte

39548.quote: Only the unknown frightens men. But once a man has faced the unknown, that terror becomes the known.
39548.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

39549.quote: The 'morality of compromise' sounds contradictory. Compromise is usually a sign of weakness, or an admission of defeat. Strong men don't compromise, it is said, and principles should never be compromised.
39549.name: Andrew Carnegie

39550.quote: Men do not understand books until they have a certain amount of life, or at any rate no man understands a deep book, until he has seen and lived at least part of its contents.
39550.name: Ezra Pound

39552.quote: The belief in a supernatural source of evil is not necessary men alone are quite capable of every wickedness.
39552.name: Joseph Conrad

39553.quote: Injustice, poverty, slavery, ignorance - these may be cured by reform or revolution. But men do not live only by fighting evils. They live by positive goals, individual and collective, a vast variety of them, seldom predictable, at times incompatible.
39553.name: Isaiah Berlin

39554.quote: He had read much, if one considers his long life but his contemplation was much more than his reading. He was wont to say that if he had read as much as other men he should have known no more than other men.
39554.name: Isaac Asimov

39555.quote: Controversy equalizes fools and wise men - and the fools know it.
39555.name: Oliver Wendell Holmes

39556.quote: Girls have an unfair advantage over men: if they can't get what they want by being smart, they can get it by being dumb.
39556.name: Yul Brynner

39557.quote: Men trust their ears less than their eyes.
39557.name: Herodotus

39558.quote: Our whole constitutional heritage rebels at the thought of giving government the power to control men's minds.
39558.name: Thurgood Marshall

39559.quote: At every crossroads on the path that leads to the future, tradition has placed 10,000 men to guard the past.
39559.name: Maurice Maeterlinck

39560.quote: Every woman needs one man in her life who is strong and responsible. Given this security, she can proceed to do what she really wants to do-fall in love with men who are weak and irresponsible.
39560.name: Richard J. Needham

39561.quote: We say nothing essential about the cathedral when we speak of its stones. We say nothing essential about Man when we seek to define him by the qualities of men.
39561.name: Antoine de Saint-Exupery

39562.quote: There is frequently more to be learned from the unexpected questions of a child than the discourses of men.
39562.name: John Locke

39563.quote: Wine hath drowned more men than the sea.
39563.name: Thomas Fuller

39564.quote: The worst thing about some men is that when they are not drunk they are sober.
39564.name: William Butler Yeats

39565.quote: Some old men, continually praise the time of their youth. In fact, you would almost think that there were no fools in their days, but unluckily they themselves are left as an example.
39565.name: Alexander Pope

39566.quote: Inconsistencies in men are generally testimony to their immaturity.
39566.name: Edwin Louis Cole

39567.quote: I do not consider divorce an evil by any means. It is just as much a refuge for women married to brutal men as Canada was to the slaves of brutal masters.
39567.name: Susan B. Anthony

39568.quote: If one were to bring ten of the wisest men in the world together and ask them what was the most stupid thing in existence, they would not be able to discover anything so stupid as astrology.
39568.name: David Hilbert

39569.quote: Strong women only marry weak men.
39569.name: Bette Davis

39570.quote: Men don't and can't live by exchanging articles, but by producing them. They don't live by trade, but by work. Give up that foolish and vain title of Trades Unions and take that of laborers Unions.
39570.name: John Ruskin

39571.quote: Prejudices are so to speak the mechanical instincts of men: through their prejudices they do without any effort many things they would find too difficult to think through to the point of resolving to do them.
39571.name: Georg C. Lichtenberg

39572.quote: No man has any natural authority over his fellow men.
39572.name: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

39573.quote: In a free society the state does not administer the affairs of men. It administers justice among men who conduct their own affairs.
39573.name: Walter Lippmann

39574.quote: The most positive men are the most credulous.
39574.name: Alexander Pope

39575.quote: My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All I am I owe to my mother. I attribute all my success in life to the moral, intellectual and physical education I received from her.
39575.name: George Washington

39576.quote: The natural state of motherhood is unselfishness. When you become a mother, you are no longer the center of your own universe. You relinquish that position to your children.
39576.name: Jessica Lange

39577.quote: My mother had a great deal of trouble with me, but I think she enjoyed it.
39577.name: Mark Twain

39578.quote: Men are what their mothers made them.
39578.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

39579.quote: My mother said to me, 'If you are a soldier, you will become a general. If you are a monk, you will become the Pope.' Instead, I was a painter, and became Picasso.
39579.name: Pablo Picasso

39580.quote: Mothers are fonder than fathers of their children because they are more certain they are their own.
39580.name: Aristotle

39581.quote: The mother-child relationship is paradoxical and, in a sense, tragic. It requires the most intense love on the mother's side, yet this very love must help the child grow away from the mother, and to become fully independent.
39581.name: Erich Fromm

39582.quote: Only God Himself fully appreciates the influence of a Christian mother in the molding of character in her children.
39582.name: Billy Graham

39583.quote: That strong mother doesn't tell her cub, Son, stay weak so the wolves can get you. She says, Toughen up, this is reality we are living in.
39583.name: Lauryn Hill

39584.quote: It is not until you become a mother that your judgment slowly turns to compassion and understanding.
39584.name: Erma Bombeck

39585.quote: I ask people why they have deer heads on their walls. They always say because it's such a beautiful animal. There you go. I think my mother is attractive, but I have photographs of her.
39585.name: Ellen DeGeneres

39586.quote: I am sure that if the mothers of various nations could meet, there would be no more wars.
39586.name: E. M. Forster

39587.quote: When you are a mother, you are never really alone in your thoughts. A mother always has to think twice, once for herself and once for her child.
39587.name: Sophia Loren

39588.quote: Yes, Mother. I can see you are flawed. You have not hidden it. That is your greatest gift to me.
39588.name: Alice Walker

39589.quote: Sweater, n.: garment worn by child when its mother is feeling chilly.
39589.name: Ambrose Bierce

39590.quote: Who in their infinite wisdom decreed that Little League uniforms be white? Certainly not a mother.
39590.name: Erma Bombeck

39591.quote: The mother's heart is the child's schoolroom.
39591.name: Henry Ward Beecher

39592.quote: My mother taught me about the power of inspiration and courage, and she did it with a strength and a passion that I wish could be bottled.
39592.name: Carly Fiorina

39593.quote: My mother taught me to treat a lady respectfully.
39593.name: Chris Brown

39594.quote: I've been through it all, baby, I'm mother courage.
39594.name: Elizabeth Taylor

39595.quote: Being a mother is hard and it wasn't a subject I ever studied.
39595.name: Ruby Wax

39596.quote: It is only in the act of nursing that a woman realizes her motherhood in visible and tangible fashion it is a joy of every moment.
39596.name: Honore de Balzac

39597.quote: I'm a Mommy's Girl - the strongest influence in my young life was my mom.
39597.name: Susie Bright

39598.quote: When you have a good mother and no father, God kind of sits in. It's not enough, but it helps.
39598.name: Dick Gregory

39599.quote: Mothers always find ways to fit in the work - but then when you're working, you feel that you should be spending time with your children and then when you're with your children, you're thinking about working.
39599.name: Alice Hoffman

39600.quote: How simple a thing it seems to me that to know ourselves as we are, we must know our mothers names.
39600.name: Alice Walker

39601.quote: Every man must define his identity against his mother. If he does not, he just falls back into her and is swallowed up.
39601.name: Camille Paglia

39602.quote: My mother used to tell me man gives the award, God gives the reward. I don't need another plaque.
39602.name: Denzel Washington

39603.quote: Motherhood is priced Of God, at price no man may dare To lessen or misunderstand.
39603.name: Helen Hunt Jackson

39604.quote: The fastest way to break the cycle of perfectionism and become a fearless mother is to give up the idea of doing it perfectly - indeed to embrace uncertainty and imperfection.
39604.name: Arianna Huffington

39605.quote: Throughout my life, my mom has been the person that I've always looked up to.
39605.name: Mike Krzyzewski

39606.quote: When motherhood becomes the fruit of a deep yearning, not the result of ignorance or accident, its children will become the foundation of a new race.
39606.name: Margaret Sanger

39607.quote: Completeness? Happiness? These words don't come close to describing my emotions. There truly is nothing I can say to capture what motherhood means to me, particularly given my medical history.
39607.name: Anita Baker

39608.quote: Motherhood has a very humanizing effect. Everything gets reduced to essentials.
39608.name: Meryl Streep

39609.quote: What do girls do who haven't any mothers to help them through their troubles?
39609.name: Louisa May Alcott

39610.quote: Only mothers can think of the future - because they give birth to it in their children.
39610.name: Maxim Gorky

39611.quote: Take motherhood: nobody ever thought of putting it on a moral pedestal until some brash feminists pointed out, about a century ago, that the pay is lousy and the career ladder nonexistent.
39611.name: Barbara Ehrenreich

39612.quote: I was a brownie for a day. My mom made me stop. She didn't want me to conform.
39612.name: Sandra Bullock

39613.quote: Mothers are the necessity of invention.
39613.name: Bill Watterson

39614.quote: Where there is a mother in the home, matters go well.
39614.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

39615.quote: I was raised by a single mother who made a way for me. She used to scrub floors as a domestic worker, put a cleaning rag in her pocketbook and ride the subways in Brooklyn so I would have food on the table. But she taught me as I walked her to the subway that life is about not where you start, but where you're going. That's family values.
39615.name: Al Sharpton

39616.quote: My mom always said that there would be haters. Not everyone can love ya.
39616.name: Joel Madden

39617.quote: I may be the only mother in America who knows exactly what their child is up to all the time.
39617.name: Barbara Bush

39618.quote: The Vatican is against surrogate mothers. Good thing they didn't have that rule when Jesus was born.
39618.name: Elayne Boosler

39619.quote: Just as a mother finds pleasure in taking her little child on her lap, there to feed and caress him, in like manner our loving God shows His fondness for His beloved souls who have given themselves entirely to Him and have placed all their hope in His goodness.
39619.name: Alphonsus Liguori

39620.quote: It's the moms of this nation - single, married, widowed - who really hold this country together. We're the mothers, we're the wives, we're the grandmothers, we're the big sisters, we're the little sisters, we're the daughters. You know it's true, don't you? You're the ones who always have to do a little more.
39620.name: Ann Romney

39621.quote: If there were no schools to take the children away from home part of the time, the insane asylums would be filled with mothers.
39621.name: E. W. Howe

39622.quote: I sing seriously to my mom on the phone. To put her to sleep, I have to sing 'Maria' from West Side Story. When I hear her snoring, I hang up.
39622.name: Adam Sandler

39623.quote: My mother was a personal friend of God's. They had ongoing conversations.
39623.name: Della Reese

39624.quote: I am no mother, and I won't be one.
39624.name: Brigitte Bardot

39625.quote: Of all the roles I've played, none has been as fulfilling as being a mother.
39625.name: Annette Funicello

39626.quote: Mothers don't let your daughters grow up to be models unless you're present.
39626.name: Janice Dickinson

39627.quote: I owe much to mother. She had an expert's understanding, but also approached art emotionally.
39627.name: David Rockefeller

39628.quote: A woman must combine the role of mother, wife and politician.
39628.name: Emma Bonino

39629.quote: I wish my mother had left me something about how she felt growing up. I wish my grandmother had done the same. I wanted my girls to know me.
39629.name: Carol Burnett

39630.quote: My mother taught me that we all have the power to achieve our dreams. What I lacked was the courage.
39630.name: Clay Aiken

39631.quote: I basically became a cheerleader because I had a very strict mom. That was my way of being a bad girl.
39631.name: Sandra Bullock

39632.quote: There are only two things a child will share willingly communicable diseases and its mother's age.
39632.name: Benjamin Spock

39633.quote: Motherhood is the strangest thing, it can be like being one's own Trojan horse.
39633.name: Rebecca West

39634.quote: Mommy smoked but she didn't want us to. She saw smoke coming out of the barn one time, so we got whipped.
39634.name: Loretta Lynn

39635.quote: I loved raising my kids. I loved the process, the dirt of it, the tears of it, the frustration of it, Christmas, Easter, birthdays, growth charts, pediatrician appointments. I loved all of it.
39635.name: Jane Elliot

39636.quote: I think while all mothers deal with feelings of guilt, working mothers are plagued by guilt on steroids!
39636.name: Arianna Huffington

39637.quote: What is free time? I'm a single mother. My free moments are filled with loving my little girl.
39637.name: Roma Downey

39638.quote: I am truly my mother's son.
39638.name: David Geffen

39639.quote: My sisters and mom raised me to respect women and open doors for them.
39639.name: Milo Ventimiglia

39640.quote: My mother gets all mad at me if I stay in a hotel. I'm 31-years-old, and I don't want to sleep on a sleeping bag down in the basement. It's humiliating.
39640.name: Ben Affleck

39641.quote: I wanted to escape so badly. But of course I knew I couldn't just give up and leave school. It was only when I heard my mom's voice that I came out of my hiding place.
39641.name: Zhang Ziyi

39642.quote: Mother is far too clever to understand anything she does not like.
39642.name: Arnold Bennett

39643.quote: Everyone checks out my mom. My mom's hot.
39643.name: Ashley Scott

39644.quote: I want to be a cool mom.
39644.name: Tori Spelling

39645.quote: Why do grandparents and grandchildren get along so well? The mother.
39645.name: Claudette Colbert

39646.quote: I want to be more successful as a mother than I am in show business.
39646.name: Celine Dion

39647.quote: My mother worked in factories, worked as a domestic, worked in a restaurant, always had a second job.
39647.name: Ed Bradley

39648.quote: I guess I was a mom so late in life, my daughter was the greatest thing since sliced bread.
39648.name: Candice Bergen

39649.quote: Always it gave me a pang that my children had no lawful claim to a name.
39649.name: Harriet Ann Jacobs

39650.quote: I think my mother is my biggest influence. There are so many things I hate about her but at the same time I'm thankful for her. All I know is that when I'm a parent I want to be just like my mom. I can talk to my mom more than any of my friends could talk to their parents.
39650.name: Nikki Reed

39651.quote: I'm so happy and thankful I made it a point be a stay-at-home mom.
39651.name: Candace Cameron Bure

39652.quote: I'd lose my mind if I heard my kid call the nanny Mommy.
39652.name: Toni Braxton

39653.quote: My mother told me on several different occasions that she was livin' her dream vicariously through me. She once said that I was getting' to do all the things that she would have wanted to have done.
39653.name: Buck Owens

39654.quote: My parents, especially my mother, were no influence on me whatsoever.
39654.name: Andy Partridge

39655.quote: Motherhood is at its best when the tender chords of sympathy have been touched.
39655.name: Paul Harris

39656.quote: Morality and its victim, the mother - what a terrible picture! Is there indeed anything more terrible, more criminal, than our glorified sacred function of motherhood?
39656.name: Emma Goldman

39657.quote: The man in our society is the breadwinner the woman has enough to do as the homemaker, wife and mother.
39657.name: Dorothy Fields

39658.quote: I stand fearlessly for small dogs, the American Flag, motherhood and the Bible. That's why people love me.
39658.name: Art Linkletter

39659.quote: My mother thinks I could have even run a larger company.
39659.name: Christie Hefner

39660.quote: My mom taught us the Serenity Prayer at a young age.
39660.name: Toby Keith

39661.quote: What motivated me? My mother. My mother was an immigrant woman, a peasant woman, struggled all her life, worked in the garment center.
39661.name: Al Lewis

39662.quote: The woman is uniformly sacrificed to the wife and mother.
39662.name: Elizabeth Cady Stanton

39663.quote: I'm sure that my mom would have been happy with any path I chose.
39663.name: Joely Fisher

39664.quote: I auditioned on my own. I tried to make a mark for myself without anybody's help, not even Mom's.
39664.name: Kate Hudson

39665.quote: Giving birth was easier than having a tattoo.
39665.name: Nicole Appleton

39666.quote: If my mom reads that I'm grammatically incorrect I'll have hell to pay.
39666.name: Larisa Oleynik

39667.quote: If you ever become a mother, can I have one of the puppies?
39667.name: Charles Pierce

39668.quote: I'd go to, like, six different schools in one year. We were on welfare, and my mom never ever worked.
39668.name: Eminem

39669.quote: We need somebody who's got the heart, the empathy, to recognize what it's like to be a young teenage mom, the empathy to understand what it's like to be poor or African-American or gay or disabled or old - and that's the criterion by which I'll be selecting my judges.
39669.name: Barack Obama

39670.quote: Dad needs to show an incredible amount of respect and humor and friendship toward his mate so the kids understand their parents are sexy, they're fun, they do things together, they're best friends. Kids learn by example. If I respect Mom, they're going to respect Mom.
39670.name: Tim Allen

39671.quote: Mom and Dad were married 64 years. And if you wondered what their secret was, you could have asked the local florist - because every day Dad gave Mom a rose, which he put on her bedside table. That's how she found out what happened on the day my father died - she went looking for him because that morning, there was no rose.
39671.name: Mitt Romney

39672.quote: My mom and dad gave their kids the greatest gift of all - the gift of unconditional love. They cared deeply about who we would be, and much less about what we would do.
39672.name: Mitt Romney

39673.quote: A guy is a lump like a doughnut. So, first you gotta get rid of all the stuff his mom did to him. And then you gotta get rid of all that macho crap that they pick up from beer commercials. And then there's my personal favorite, the male ego.
39673.name: Roseanne Barr

39674.quote: When my mom ran for the Senate, my dad was there for her every step of the way. I can still hear her saying in her beautiful voice, 'Why should women have any less say than men, about the great decisions facing our nation?'
39674.name: Mitt Romney

39675.quote: Being a Hot Mom means being respected as a mom and a woman. And, the key to being a Hot Mom is having a sense of humor about yourself and all the crazy situations that arise.
39675.name: Jami Gertz

39676.quote: I believe this with all my heart: The greatest coach of all time in my eyes is my mom. She's instilled in me a toughness and a perseverance and just a never-quit mentality, and I thank her every day for providing me, for what she sacrificed her life for.
39676.name: Scott Brooks

39677.quote: My mom was such a strong character. I don't want to say she was like a man, but she was tough.
39677.name: Lance Armstrong

39678.quote: My mom and I have always been really close. She's always been the friend that was always there. There were times when, in middle school and junior high, I didn't have a lot of friends. But my mom was always my friend. Always.
39678.name: Taylor Swift

39679.quote: For everything I do, I think about a 6-year-old girl and her mom that I saw at my concert last night. I think about what those two individuals would think if I were at a club last night. I never want to be arrested, and I never want to get a DUI, those are my moral values.
39679.name: Taylor Swift

39680.quote: It was my 16th birthday - my mom and dad gave me my Goya classical guitar that day. I sat down, wrote this song, and I just knew that that was the only thing I could ever really do - write songs and sing them to people.
39680.name: Stevie Nicks

39681.quote: As a mom, I know it is my responsibility, and no one else's, to raise my kids. But we have to ask ourselves, what does it mean when so many parents are finding their best efforts undermined by an avalanche of advertisements aimed at our kids.
39681.name: Michelle Obama

39682.quote: One of the greatest titles in the world is parent, and one of the biggest blessings in the world is to have parents to call mom and dad.
39682.name: Jim DeMint

39683.quote: I love those hockey moms. You know what they say the difference between a hockey mom and a pit bull is? Lipstick.
39683.name: Sarah Palin

39684.quote: For me, already being part of a single parent household and knowing it was just me and my mom, you'd would wake up times and hope that the next day you'd be able to be alongside your mother because she was out trying to make sure that I was taken care of. But all I cared about was her being home.
39684.name: LeBron James

39685.quote: Don't let people disrespect you. My mom says don't open the door to the devil. Surround yourself with positive people.
39685.name: Jr. Cuba Gooding

39686.quote: Having a child makes you realize the importance of life - narcissism goes out the window. Heaven on earth is looking at my little boy. The minute he was born, I knew if I never did anything other than being a mom, I'd be fine.
39686.name: Jenny McCarthy

39687.quote: My mom and I had the same vision, and we want the same things. We would always make a goal list every year.
39687.name: Kim Kardashian

39688.quote: I don't want to be perfect, but I do want to be a role model. My mom always tells me that imperfections equal beauty. All of us are imperfect.
39688.name: Miley Cyrus

39689.quote: When you are getting ready to become a mom, being in love with someone just isn't enough. You need to think about whether he would be a good parent and raise your children with similar beliefs.
39689.name: Cindy Crawford

39690.quote: My sisters and my mom, those people help me get through every single day.
39690.name: Demi Lovato

39691.quote: I told my mom, 'I'm not buying another magazine until I can get past this thought of looking like the girl on the cover'. She said, 'Miley, you are the girl on the cover,' and I was, like, 'I know, but I don't feel like that girl every day.' You can't always feel perfect.
39691.name: Miley Cyrus

39692.quote: When love is gone, there's always justice. And when justice is gone, there's always force. And when force is gone, there's always Mom. Hi, Mom!
39692.name: Laurie Anderson

39693.quote: I love my mom. My mom loves me. We don't have an easy relationship. I don't think we ever will, but I'd rather have a complicated, misunderstood relationship than have no relationship at all.
39693.name: Tori Spelling

39694.quote: My mom never taught me to be waiting for some prince on a white horse to swipe me off my feet.
39694.name: Tyra Banks

39695.quote: I always wanted what Mom and Dad had.
39695.name: Kim Kardashian

39696.quote: My dad is still Christian Scientist. My mom's not, and I'm not. But I believe in God, and that there's a higher power and an intelligence that's bigger than us and that we can rely on. It's not just us, thinking we are the ones in control of everything. That idea gives me support.
39696.name: Ellen DeGeneres

39697.quote: My mom took me to see Carnal Knowledge and The Wild Bunch and all these kind of movies when I was a kid.
39697.name: Quentin Tarantino

39698.quote: People think I have courage. The courage in my family are my wife Pam, my three daughters, here, Nicole, Jamie, LeeAnn, my mom, who's right here too.
39698.name: Jim Valvano

39699.quote: When I was 5, some financial things happened, and I moved seven times in a year. We moved from apartment to apartment, sometimes living with friends. My mom would always say, 'Don't get comfortable, because we may not be here long.'
39699.name: LeBron James

39700.quote: I can only hope to be 10 percent of the mom mine was to me. She encouraged me to be confident and enjoy life. That's what I want for my son.
39700.name: Charlize Theron

39701.quote: You know, I don't think any mother aims to be a single mom. I didn't wish for that, but it happened.
39701.name: Charlize Theron

39702.quote: My mom decorated with lots of antiques. I never liked it when I was a little girl - I wanted to live in a modern house. But now I love it.
39702.name: Paris Hilton

39703.quote: Looking back, I think I was always musical. My dad was very musical, and I think my mom was musical.
39703.name: Paul McCartney

39704.quote: It wasn't so long ago that I was a working mom myself. And I know that sometimes, much as we all hate to admit it, it's just easier to park the kids in front of the TV for a few hours, so we can pay the bills or do the laundry or just have some peace and quiet for a change.
39704.name: Michelle Obama

39705.quote: The person who has inspired me my whole life is my Mom, because she taught me commitment. She sacrificed.
39705.name: Mike Krzyzewski

39706.quote: My mom is always telling me it takes a long time to get to the top, but a short time to get to the bottom.
39706.name: Miley Cyrus

39707.quote: My mom and I are very close.
39707.name: Lady Gaga

39708.quote: My mom is the backbone not just of my family but of many families.
39708.name: Shia LaBeouf

39709.quote: I could get away with not taking care of myself as a bachelorette but as a mom I can't.
39709.name: Alanis Morissette

39710.quote: Mom was 50 when my Dad died. She got on a bus every weekday for years, and rode 40 miles each morning to Madison. She earned a new degree and learned new skills to start her small business. It wasn't just a new livelihood. It was a new life.
39710.name: Paul Ryan

39711.quote: And to this day, my Mom is my role model.
39711.name: Paul Ryan

39712.quote: A Romney-Ryan administration will protect and strengthen Medicare, for my Mom's generation, for my generation, and for my kids and yours.
39712.name: Paul Ryan

39713.quote: What makes me happy is just curling up in with my mom in her bed and watching a marathon of 'CSI' and 'Grey's Anatomy' episodes with pints of ice cream.
39713.name: Taylor Swift

39714.quote: I started cooking when I was about 10. I have memories like when I was 6 or 7 with my mom, and when I was 12 I started getting real serious about cooking.
39714.name: Emeril Lagasse

39715.quote: Studies show that children best flourish when one mom and one dad are there to raise them.
39715.name: John Boehner

39716.quote: I know I'm talented, but I wasn't put here to sing. I was put here to be a wife and a mom and look after my family. I love what I do, but it's not where it begins and ends.
39716.name: Amy Winehouse

39718.quote: When I was really young, my mom enrolled me in dance classes.
39718.name: Jeff Bridges

39719.quote: I think my love of journalizing my life comes from my mom.
39719.name: Jeff Bridges

39720.quote: My mom wasn't a movie star.
39720.name: Jeff Bridges

39721.quote: I became a mom at 37 and having a child has been an emancipation for me.
39721.name: Tori Amos

39722.quote: My inspiration was my mom. She's a great cook, and she still cooks, and we still banter back and forth about cooking. Growing up in a mostly Portuguese community, food was important and the family table was extremely important. At a very young age I understood that.
39722.name: Emeril Lagasse

39723.quote: My parents were working class folks. My dad was a bartender for most of his life, my mom was a maid and a cashier and a stock clerk at WalMart. We were not people of financial means in terms of significant financial means. I always told them, 'I didn't always have what I wanted. I always had what I needed.' My parents always provided that.
39723.name: Marco Rubio

39724.quote: My dad was a bartender. My mom was a cashier, a maid and a stock clerk at K-Mart. They never made it big. They were never rich. And yet they were successful. Because just a few decades removed from hopelessness, they made possible for us all the things that had been impossible for them.
39724.name: Marco Rubio

39725.quote: My mom and I have always been very close. She is my best friend. She had to make a lot of sacrifices early on in my life to make sure I got to do what I wanted to do.
39725.name: Norah Jones

39726.quote: My mom brought me up to believe that my talent is a gift and a blessing.
39726.name: Christina Aguilera

39727.quote: Thankfully, I have my mom and a small group of close friends who are there for me 24/7 and whom I can trust and depend on.
39727.name: Christina Aguilera

39728.quote: I remember watching the Grammys and looking at the performances and crying to my mom, saying how much I wanted to be there.
39728.name: Christina Aguilera

39729.quote: I always wanted to be a mom.
39729.name: Heidi Klum

39730.quote: When I was younger, I had a perm, and it was really big. My mom was a hairdresser, so even my dad had a perm! I looked like a poodle, but it was cool at the time.
39730.name: Heidi Klum

39731.quote: I'm a lioness. I have four cubs. I'm a mom. I want to take care of my kids and protect them.
39731.name: Heidi Klum

39732.quote: My mom is at my house every day, and she nags me about everything, especially hygiene.
39732.name: Shia LaBeouf

39733.quote: I remember driving to North Carolina when I was a little girl in a snowstorm to get down to my mom's family in the Carolinas. There were chains on the car - it was the late sixties - and we were just singing in the car. Christmas carols.
39733.name: Tori Amos

39734.quote: When I was little, my mom tells me, I used to say things like, 'Mom do you hear the string section? Do you hear the string section?' And she would look at me and say, 'No honey, I don't know what you're talking about.'
39734.name: Tori Amos

39735.quote: Being the only man in the household with my mom definitely helped me grow up fast.
39735.name: LeBron James

39736.quote: If I could get any animal it would be a dolphin. I want one so bad. Me and my mom went swimming with dolphins and I was like, 'How do we get one of those?' and she was like, 'You can't get a dolphin. What are you gonna do, like, put it in your pool?'
39736.name: Miley Cyrus

39737.quote: I'm not a religious person. My mom was of Jewish blood and my dad was Protestant.
39737.name: Daniel Radcliffe

39738.quote: My dad believes in God, I think. I'm not sure if my mom does. I don't.
39738.name: Daniel Radcliffe

39739.quote: Fortunately, when you're a mom, the responsibility of caring for your child can keep you going.
39739.name: Shania Twain

39740.quote: My mom has made it possible for me to be who I am. Our family is everything. Her greatest skill was encouraging me to find my own person and own independence.
39740.name: Charlize Theron

39741.quote: I forgive my mom for being a psycho and my dad for being a loser.
39741.name: Nikki Sixx

39742.quote: It is a sad commentary of our times when our young must seek advice and counsel from 'Dear Abby' instead of going to Mom and Dad.
39742.name: Abigail Van Buren

39743.quote: I hear my friends and my mom tell me I'm special, but honestly, I still don't get it.
39743.name: LeBron James

39744.quote: My mom and I have always been there for each other. We had some tough times, but she was always there for me.
39744.name: LeBron James

39745.quote: I don't want to have kids for like 10 years. I still have a lot to do. I don't even know if I could handle a dog right now. I'm so not ready. Someday I'll be a mom but not until I'm in my 30s.
39745.name: Avril Lavigne

39746.quote: As a mom I know that raising children is the hardest job there is.
39746.name: Hilary Rosen

39747.quote: I consider my mom and all my sisters my friends.
39747.name: Alexa Vega

39748.quote: The best situation is being a single parent. The best part about is that you get time off, too, because the kids are with their mom, so it's the best of both worlds. There's a lot to be said for it.
39748.name: Larry David

39749.quote: My mom, Irmelin, taught me the value of life. Her own life was saved by my grandmother during World War II.
39749.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

39750.quote: I'm going to let people know that it's cool to have a child and be young and still be a good mom. It's really tough, but I'm doing it.
39750.name: Brandy Norwood

39751.quote: My mom, God rest her soul - she liked nicknames. In the womb she named me Skip. There was another black guy in Piedmont, W.Va., and his name was Skip. They called him Big Skip, and I was Little Skip.
39751.name: Henry Louis Gates

39752.quote: I feel like a good mom. I'm a strong woman now, Don't look down on me. Pray for me because I'm trying.
39752.name: Fantasia Barrino

39753.quote: And the greatest lesson that mom ever taught me though was this one. She told me there would be times in your life when you have to choose between being loved and being respected. Now she said to always pick being respected.
39753.name: Chris Christie

39754.quote: Being a mom has made me so tired. And so happy.
39754.name: Tina Fey

39755.quote: My father wasn't really involved and my mom is the light in my life.
39755.name: Marion Jones

39756.quote: The real estate agent had to go door-to-door in the apartment building we wanted to rent, asking if it was OK for this interracial family - my mom is white and I was a 1-year-old half-African kid - to live in the apartment building.
39756.name: Tom Morello

39757.quote: My dad never blew anything up, but he probably had friends who did. He and my mom have always preached that the pen is mightier than a Molotov cocktail.
39757.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

39758.quote: I grabbed my mom and I went to the couch and I said, 'Mom I want to ask Jesus to come into my heart.' And I got on my knee and I asked Jesus to come into my heart, forgive me of my sins, and make me a child of God.
39758.name: Tim Tebow

39759.quote: My mom used to make everything. She had a great garden and composted and made everything from scratch - peanut butter, bread, jelly, everything. I don't know how she did it because all those things take time and love and labour. I only do half the stuff she does - but there's still time.
39759.name: Julia Roberts

39760.quote: I'm a mom, so I have to be comfortable. Jeans are a staple - I have way too many in my closet! It's warm in Florida, so I wear jeans and a tank top every day. I love my True Religions, my Rich and Skinny, and Citizens of Humanity. But I also love getting dressed up!
39760.name: Candace Cameron Bure

39761.quote: Mom spent the time that she was supposed to be a kid actully raising children, her younger brother and younger sister. She was tough as nails and did not suffer fools at all. And the truth was she could not afford to. She spoke the truth, bluntly, directly, and without much varnish. I am her son.
39761.name: Chris Christie

39762.quote: I didn't understand that I could sing until I was like 11 or 12. My mom heard me singing around the house and she said, What are you doing? You really can sing! So then I started going to school and singing to the girls.
39762.name: Chris Brown
