39763.quote: My mom being a psychotherapist, I've been brought up with that whole psychoanalytical terrain.
39763.name: Helena Bonham Carter

39764.quote: I think the real heroic teachers are the ones who work with kids, like my mom and my sister do.
39764.name: David Duchovny

39765.quote: I probably have an earlier curfew than anyone. My mom wants to keep me really safe and my dad's not overly protective, but he's a dad no matter what.
39765.name: Miley Cyrus

39766.quote: People always accuse me of being motivational in a way, like it was a bad thing, but that's just how I was raised. My mom raised me in a positive environment, with lots of love in my heart, and that reflects in my music.
39766.name: Lenny Kravitz

39767.quote: My mom used to say that I became a fighter and a scrapper and a tough guy to protect who I am at my core.
39767.name: Vin Diesel

39768.quote: My mom knows when something is real and something is not.
39768.name: Christina Ricci

39769.quote: I've never had a very closely connected family. My parents split up when I was young and I was living with my mom for a little while, then I was kind of just on my own really young. It wasn't some kind of global tragedy, it was just never really a very close-knit family. So there was support in the sense that they didn't stand in my way.
39769.name: Ani DiFranco

39770.quote: I just go about my life. I'm a mom, I drive an SUV, I go to the grocery store every day. I'm definitely not a celebrity. I always say that I'm a celebrity-adjacent.
39770.name: Diablo Cody

39771.quote: Fact: The new '90210' is cooler than the old '90210.' It's the lithe, streamlined Skipper to the elder series' venerable Barbie. Gone are the traditional parents - they've been replaced by a hipster mom n' pop who get busted necking in the car.
39771.name: Diablo Cody

39772.quote: I make a lot of mistakes, too, and I'm constantly re-evaluating how I'm doing things and trying to be better every day, whether it's as a mom or taking care of myself.
39772.name: Mia Hamm

39773.quote: Most children - I know I did when I was a kid - fantasize another set of parents. Or fantasize no parents. They don't tell their real parents about that - you don't want to tell Mom and Dad. Kids lead a very private life. And I was a typical child, I think. I was a liar.
39773.name: Maurice Sendak

39774.quote: Most children - I know I did when I was a kid - fantasize another set of parents. Or fantasize no parents. They don't tell their real parents about that - you don't want to tell Mom and Dad.
39774.name: Maurice Sendak

39775.quote: My mom and I were super tight. I think she really wanted me to be an artist, you know? She used to like to tell people she wanted to be Beethoven's mother. That was her thing. She wanted to be the mother of this person.
39775.name: Jr. Harry Connick

39776.quote: My dad and mom believed that you do what you have to do in private and don't make a big deal out of it. Just try to help people as much as you can.
39776.name: Jr. Harry Connick

39777.quote: My relationship with my mom is really the single most profound relationship that I've ever had in my life.
39777.name: Mindy Kaling

39778.quote: My parents are wonderful, and I'm really lucky - but my mom has always been almost exclusively a right-brained person. She goes completely on her feelings of things, on her intuition, and so she instilled that in my brothers and I.
39778.name: Brandon Boyd

39779.quote: My dad is a Deadhead, my mom's a Jewish-American princess from Jersey.
39779.name: Adam Lambert

39780.quote: Never play cards with a man called Doc. Never eat at a place called Mom's. Never sleep with a woman whose troubles are worse than your own.
39780.name: Nelson Algren

39781.quote: My Mom said she learned how to swim when someone took her out in the lake and threw her off the boat. I said, 'Mom, they weren't trying to teach you how to swim.'
39781.name: Paula Poundstone

39782.quote: My mom was a waitress, and my dad was a plumber who worked for the City of San Clemente fixing mains breaks, so not too glamorous.
39782.name: Shaun White

39783.quote: I like to work. The self-esteem and satisfaction that I get from working makes me a better person, which makes me a better mom. I feel lucky because I have the luxury of working only one or two days a week.
39783.name: Cindy Crawford

39784.quote: I don't drink, and I don't smoke. It's a personal preference. My mom has never drunk or smoked. I look up to my mom.
39784.name: Ashley Tisdale

39785.quote: I pretty much borrow my entire beauty regime from my mom.
39785.name: Rashida Jones

39786.quote: I know my mom said as early as she can remember letting me watch TV, my one treat a week when I was like 6 was to stay up and watch 'Saturday Night Live.'
39786.name: Rashida Jones

39787.quote: I want to be as healthy as I can because I'm a mom now.
39787.name: Jessica Simpson

39788.quote: I have so much respect for my mom and all the women across the world.
39788.name: Jessica Simpson

39789.quote: I guess now that I think back, I used to play priest and be a funny priest. I don't know, I grew up in such a Catholic family that I kind of liked to test the boundaries a little bit and I think I had fun watching my mom laugh.
39789.name: Jenny McCarthy

39790.quote: When I was a little girl, rocking my little dolls, I remember thinking I would be the world's best mom, and so far I've done it.
39790.name: Jenny McCarthy

39791.quote: When I was in nursery school, the teachers asked me, y'know, 'What does your dad do for a living?' So I said 'He helps women get pregnant!' They called my mom and they were like, 'What exactly does your husband do?'
39791.name: Natalie Portman

39792.quote: Like a lot of you, I grew up in a family on the ragged edges of the middle class. My daddy sold carpeting and ended up as a maintenance man. After he had a heart attack, my mom worked the phones at Sears so we could hang on to our house.
39792.name: Elizabeth Warren

39793.quote: I could do without 'cool' publications calling me 'mom jazz.' But I laughed all the way to the bank, baby.
39793.name: Norah Jones

39794.quote: My mom just didn't put a very high premium on me being like really famous or really wealthy or anything.
39794.name: Martha Plimpton

39795.quote: It's not common for a woman on television, especially if she's the mom of the family, to be funny. She's usually a straight man or foil.
39795.name: Martha Plimpton

39796.quote: My mom and I used to listen to records, read, and take train rides across the country in the summer. It was a very chill life. She didn't expose me to anything that was ahead of my development, but she expected me to adjust to her world - she did not expect to adjust to mine.
39796.name: Martha Plimpton

39797.quote: Isn't it so weird the day you wake up and you're just going with the flow? And you just suddenly are a mom.
39797.name: Katherine Heigl

39798.quote: I'm a sappy mom now. I didn't think I would be. I thought I'd be a cool mom who keeps everything in perspective.
39798.name: Katherine Heigl

39799.quote: I was always a drama queen. I remember playing in the kitchen, trying to get my mom to think I was dead and call the police. When she didn't, I would cry. I was always theatrical. I don't think any of my relatives are surprised.
39799.name: Amy Lee

39800.quote: My mom knows pretty well how I see her.
39800.name: Lena Dunham

39801.quote: I'm ridiculous in my oversharing my mom and sister are very open but a little more judicious than me, and my father is a decidedly private person.
39801.name: Lena Dunham

39802.quote: God blessed me with two unbelievable parents, and I am just like both of them. I have the smile and charisma of my mother and the big heart of my mom, because she wants to save the world and help the world, so I am just like her.
39802.name: Magic Johnson

39803.quote: My mom was always saying: 'Be whatever you want to be, but stick with it. Don't waver. Don't change who you are for anybody.'
39803.name: Miranda Lambert

39804.quote: My mom always says I cut my teeth on the church pew.
39804.name: Miranda Lambert

39805.quote: My mom said the only reason men are alive is for lawn care and vehicle maintenance.
39805.name: Tim Allen

39806.quote: Well, my mom is single and we've both been single at the same time over the last ten years, so I really related to the bond between my character and Diane's.
39806.name: Amanda Peet

39807.quote: I always knew I wanted kids, but when my mom passed away I was like, 'I want a bunch of kids. I want three kids or four kids, and I want to have that relationship again.' I can't bring my mom back, but I can have children.
39807.name: Mindy Kaling

39808.quote: Not to be weird, but I still have an ongoing relationship with my mom, even though she passed away, and I've been surprised at how much I've been able to convey to her. Now I sound like a total weirdo, but that's true.
39808.name: Mindy Kaling

39809.quote: My mom loved rock 'n roll. My father hated it. We couldn't play it when he was around.
39809.name: Patti Smith

39810.quote: I made some truly awful movies. 'Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot' was the worst. If you ever want someone to confess to murder just make him or her sit through that film. They will confess to anything after 15 minutes.
39810.name: Sylvester Stallone

39811.quote: I used to say, 'Man, I think I'd be a really good dad. I'll be a great provider. I'm funny I'll go on trips with them - I'll do all sorts of stuff.' But the momming? I'm not made for that. I have a really good mom I know what she put into it.
39811.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

39812.quote: Washington has got to, across the board, lower taxes for small businesses so that our mom and pops can reinvest and hire people, so that our businesses can thrive.
39812.name: Sarah Palin

39813.quote: I'm really happy to be a mom, and I'm proud of the phase I'm in.
39813.name: Liz Phair

39814.quote: Mom ran the house, so we grew up Portuguese.
39814.name: Emeril Lagasse

39815.quote: My food is Louisiana, New Orleans-based, well-seasoned, rustic. I think it's pretty unique because of my background being influenced by my mom, Portuguese and French Canadian. There's a lot going on there.
39815.name: Emeril Lagasse

39816.quote: My family, you know, are all still, you know, very close. We're all still very close. Mom and Daddy are still alive. So, what more can you ask for? Your kids are healthy.
39816.name: Reba McEntire

39817.quote: I know how to do anything, I'm a mom.
39817.name: Roseanne Barr

39818.quote: Being a singer is all about me. About ego. Being a mom is all about being selfless - two different worlds.
39818.name: Gwen Stefani

39819.quote: My mom used to say that Greek Easter was later because then you get stuff cheaper.
39819.name: Amy Sedaris

39820.quote: As far as I'm concerned, there's no job more important on the planet than being a mom.
39820.name: Mark Wahlberg

39821.quote: I didn't come from a trailer park. I grew up middle class and my dad had money and my mom made my lunch. I got a car when I was sixteen. I'm proud of that.
39821.name: Kid Rock

39822.quote: I did find some time to go to a record store and check out 'Headstrong' actually in the racks. It was pretty cool I never thought I'd see my own CD sitting there with everyone else's. I made my Mom take lots of pics!
39822.name: Ashley Tisdale

39823.quote: Once in high school, I completely over plucked my left eyebrow all the way up to where you're not supposed to. I had no idea what I was doing and it looked terrible! My mom was like 'What did you do to yourself?' I was so embarrassed.
39823.name: Ashley Tisdale

39824.quote: The 'believe' tattoo is because my mom always told me to believe.
39824.name: Ashley Tisdale

39825.quote: My mom is very confident and she was always a role model of mine.
39825.name: Ashley Tisdale

39826.quote: My mom put me and my sisters in the water to feel comfortable, to have water safety.
39826.name: Michael Phelps

39827.quote: Even in high school, I'd tell my mom I was sick of swimming and wanted to try to play golf. She wasn't too happy. She'd say, 'Think about this.' And I'd always end up getting back in the pool.
39827.name: Michael Phelps

39828.quote: My humanitarian work evolved from being with my family. My mom, my dad, they really set a great example for giving back. My mom was a nurse, my dad was a school teacher. But my mom did a lot of things for geriatrics and elderly people. She would do home visits for free.
39828.name: Cat Cora

39829.quote: Growing up, my ideals were Barbra Streisand, Cher, and my mom.
39829.name: Kevyn Aucoin

39830.quote: My mom insisted on multigrain bread and never allowed soda in the house.
39830.name: Vin Diesel

39831.quote: I was always at peace because of the way my mom treated me.
39831.name: Martina Hingis

39832.quote: Come Christmas Eve, we usually go to my mom and dad's. Everybody brings one gift and then we play that game when we all steal it from each other. Some are really cool, others are useful and some are a bit out there.
39832.name: Amy Grant

39833.quote: Depending on what day of the week it is and what time of the month it is, I'm a good friend or not a good friend. I'm more or less a good mom or not a good mom, more or less a good mate or not a good mate. That's just life, whether or not you're public.
39833.name: Amy Grant

39834.quote: My mom's discipline worked out perfectly. I wouldn't change a thing.
39834.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39835.quote: My mom's never been married. I've never even seen my mom kiss a dude.
39835.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39836.quote: If you would ask my mom what books I liked growing up, I liked Dr. Seuss.
39836.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39837.quote: I was born and raised in East Los Angeles by a single mom who had three biological kids and adopted four more. I never met my dad.
39837.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39838.quote: When I got into junior high school, that's when my mom let me dress how I wanted to dress. Up to that point I wore suits to school all the time.
39838.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39839.quote: I remember when I was 11, I told my mom, 'One day I'm going to buy you a house.' And she said, 'Boy, don't you be making promises you can't keep.' I was like: 'No, Ma, it's not a promise. I'm going to buy you a house one day.'
39839.name: William Adams (will.i.am)

39840.quote: These days it's cool to be ethnic and to be different, but when I was a kid, it was not cool - at all. My friends would come over and my mom would make crepes with eggs, stuffed with mozzarella cheese, tomatoes and spinach. And they'd be like, 'What is this?'
39840.name: Giada De Laurentiis

39841.quote: Every time I think I have something under control, it changes and I don't have it under control. I think it takes several years to get there. Jade is 19 months old, so right now I'm on alert all the time. And as a mom I think you're constantly worrying about things.
39841.name: Giada De Laurentiis

39842.quote: Mom and Pop were just a couple of kids when they got married. He was eighteen, she was sixteen and I was three.
39842.name: Billie Holiday

39843.quote: I must admit, even though I'm the product of two Jewish parents, I think the Irish temper got in there somewhere, so I'm going to check Mom's genealogy.
39843.name: Harvey Weinstein

39844.quote: I didn't know my Dad - he moved out early. And my mom's politics were kind of hardscrabble. She didn't think about Democrats or Republicans. She thought about who made sense. I've been both in my life.
39844.name: Dennis Miller

39845.quote: With my new venture, Club Mom, we want to empower moms to feel their value and also build their collective power to make their lives better and easier. We want to bring them together as a community to share experiences and information.
39845.name: Andrew Shue

39846.quote: Because sorry to say, women run the house. They run the family. They hold things up. I mean, it's like you don't ever see your mom get sick because she handles everything. And it's kind of amazing I think to show people just how strong women are.
39846.name: Sophia Bush

39847.quote: I'm lucky that my real-life Mom has both a great sense of humor about herself and an amazing ability to slip into complete denial if the subject matter gets a little too close to home.
39847.name: Cathy Guisewite

39848.quote: I'm more straightforward, and I speak up more than I did before. When I was younger, I wouldn't speak up as much, but now that I'm a mom, things have changed.
39848.name: Britney Spears

39849.quote: My mom is going to kill me for talking about sleeping with people. But I don't want to put myself in the position where I'm in a monogamous relationship right now. I'm not dating just one person. 'Sex and the City' changed everything for me because those girls would sleep with so many people.
39849.name: Lindsay Lohan

39850.quote: President Obama's fight for rural America is personal. He was raised by a single mom and grandparents from Kansas. He hails from a farming state, Illinois.
39850.name: Tom Vilsack

39851.quote: I don't have anything against my mom, but my family has no emotional connection to each other.
39851.name: Adam Carolla

39852.quote: My mom was on welfare and the occasional food stamp, but I have never participated in any of those governmental programs, even the ones that kind of work like education, scholarships and whatever, and I managed to do just fine.
39852.name: Adam Carolla

39853.quote: I love being a single mom. But it's definitely different when you're dating.
39853.name: Brooke Burns

39854.quote: Yes, I always remember my dad's, mom's and my grandma's perfumes.
39854.name: Marc Jacobs

39855.quote: Financial hardships were rough on us, even though Mom had a good job at G.M.
39855.name: Ryan White

39856.quote: It was always a fantasy of mine growing up - my favorite program was always 'Little House on the Prairie' - so I always wanted to wear those looks. When I was a child, I wouldn't let my mom put me in anything but calico dresses and now, whaddaya know, every day I'm in a calico dress, basically, so it's kind of funny.
39856.name: Chloe Sevigny

39857.quote: You do need parental guidance and I was in a great position with both my mum and dad. They split when I was a baby but even though I stayed with my mom they were both very much involved in my upbringing.
39857.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

39858.quote: My mom always says, 'If you don't believe in something, you'll lose yourself completely.'
39858.name: Hilary Duff

39859.quote: I was thinking that when I have children, that I should always dress as a character for them, so they think their mom is Alice in Wonderland or Cinderella.
39859.name: Gwen Stefani

39860.quote: It's superfun being a mom, but it's hard too.
39860.name: Gwen Stefani

39861.quote: Being a mom is hard, I think a lot of working moms feel that way.
39861.name: Gwen Stefani

39862.quote: My mom always said I was the peacemaker in the family. My older brother, Eric, was the leader, the creative one. I was just his puppet.
39862.name: Gwen Stefani

39863.quote: I was thinking that when I have children, that I should always dress as a character for them, so they think their mom is Alice in Wonderland or Cinderella. It would be totally messed up!
39863.name: Gwen Stefani

39864.quote: My mom and dad met at Anaheim High School. After they got married, all they wanted to do was have four children, and they did.
39864.name: Gwen Stefani

39865.quote: I wish I had an extra day with my mom sometimes. Or another hour in the day with my family, husband and children.
39865.name: Mary J. Blige

39866.quote: The golden child may be the oldest one, unless it's the youngest. It may be the toughest one, unless it's the most sensitive. It's not even necessary that Mom and Dad have the same favorite - and typically they don't.
39866.name: Jeffrey Kluger

39867.quote: In Hollywood, you play a mom, and the next thing you know, you're on 'The Golden Girls.' They age you so fast.
39867.name: Gabrielle Union

39868.quote: In Hollywood, you play a mom and instantly, you've got osteoporosis.
39868.name: Gabrielle Union

39869.quote: My mom is painfully sweet she's from Nebraska.
39869.name: Gabrielle Union

39870.quote: My mom was a diabetic. Her sister was a diabetic, so I was already a candidate.
39870.name: Angie Stone

39871.quote: When my dad divorced my mom it was kind of like him leaving me also.
39871.name: Nicole Richie

39872.quote: After my mom died, there was so much written about her fashion and her style and all that, and I felt that one of the most important parts of her was missing, her real intellectual curiosity.
39872.name: Caroline Kennedy

39873.quote: No matter how good you are, at some point your kids are gonna have to create their own independence and think that Mom and Dad aren't cool, just to establish themselves. That's what adolescence is about. They're gonna go through that no matter what.
39873.name: Eddie Vedder

39874.quote: I was always okay with the fact that I was taller and bigger than everybody else growing up. My mom, my dad, and my friends always told me I was beautiful.
39874.name: Jordin Sparks

39875.quote: When I turned 18, my mom, my nana and I all went and had tattoos of our favorite Bible verses put on the inside of our wrists. Mine is 1st Timothy, 4:12.
39875.name: Jordin Sparks

39876.quote: When I was 7, I came up with the idea of 'charm socks.' My mom would take me to buy bags of plastic charms, we would sew them on frilly white socks, and I sold them at school.
39876.name: Sara Blakely

39877.quote: My Mom always cooked healthy. Greek food lends itself to cooking healthy.
39877.name: Cat Cora

39878.quote: From the moment this baby came into our home, those two dogs have never been more in love. It's the most beautiful thing I've ever witnessed. People keep saying, 'Oh, you're a single mom.' I'm like, 'Actually, I'm not. I've got two boys helping.'
39878.name: Charlize Theron

39879.quote: So far I'm not surprised by anything about being a mom. It's all pretty great - but that's what I expected.
39879.name: Charlize Theron

39880.quote: I was worried about my mom more than I was worried about the president. And then I was worried about the president, and then I was worried about myself.
39880.name: Monica Lewinsky

39881.quote: Aretha Franklin was a teenage mom, a musician who came from an incredibly Christian background, but there was a lot of love, which is really inspiring in a feminist way.
39881.name: Beth Ditto

39882.quote: When I moved out of my mom's house at 18 I was almost as sad to leave her sewing machine behind as anything else.
39882.name: Beth Ditto

39883.quote: I was given baby doll toys myself, and they proved a stark reminder that my life was expected to revolve around childbearing - just as my mom's had before me, and her mom's had before her.
39883.name: Beth Ditto

39884.quote: We all seek approval, and our mother's seal is usually the most important. The nitty gritty is that we have to accept ourselves, even if it is just to be ready for the next cut-down. Mom's blessing or not.
39884.name: Beth Ditto

39885.quote: I was brought up by a single mom in a poor town in Arkansas and while some aspects of small-town life were really positive - like the fact that everyone there is really sweet and hospitable - there is also this close-minded mentality, and that naturally made me want to rebel.
39885.name: Beth Ditto

39886.quote: My mother told me Homer Ditto was not my father. Nope. Mom had had a fling with some other guy who was my dad. Some dude who didn't stick around too long who Mom was happy to get rid of. She chose Homer, and Homer chose me, so he lent me his name even though I didn't have his blood.
39886.name: Beth Ditto

39887.quote: If my Dad doesn't like you, you will know. My Mom is just too innocent to ever lie. She doesn't even cuss.
39887.name: Channing Tatum

39888.quote: I have a chaperone everywhere I go - my mom.
39888.name: Shawn Johnson

39889.quote: Something my mom taught me when I was little is that everything happens for a reason.
39889.name: Shawn Johnson

39890.quote: There is nothing I love more than my role as a mom.
39890.name: Jennifer Hudson

39891.quote: I look up to my mom. She's a beautiful woman.
39891.name: Leighton Meester

39892.quote: My mom, she wasn't like a baseball mother who knew everything about the game. She just wanted me to be happy with what I was doing.
39892.name: David Ortiz

39893.quote: I feel like I've lived quite a sheltered life, like my mom and dad were quite protective of me.
39893.name: Leona Lewis

39894.quote: I bought a house for my mom, I bought a house for my dad, I bought a house for my sister.
39894.name: Trey Parker

39895.quote: There is nothing worse that a thirteen-year-old boy. You're embarrassed by your parents, and you're trying to find your independance because, deep inside, you are so dependent on your mom.
39895.name: Ben Affleck

39896.quote: A friend of my mom's was a casting director so, really as kind of a lark, I had a couple of acting jobs that had just enough exposure to give me the option to continue if I wanted to. I followed through with it.
39896.name: Ben Affleck

39897.quote: I'm a religious person. I remember my mom told me: 'Vengeance belongs to God. It's up to him to wreak vengeance.' It's hard for me to get to that point, but that's the work of God.
39897.name: Rodney King

39898.quote: Sunscreen is my number 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 tip. I'm a fanatic, partially because I live in L.A. and have fair skin and freckles, and partially because of my kids. My mom always made me wear sunscreen and I'm trying to be that mom for them.
39898.name: Alison Sweeney

39899.quote: I've actually suffered from allergies my entire life. My mom had allergies, so I was aware of what an issue they can be. Many people allow their allergies to affect their lives. As a mom with two kids and two jobs, I just can't let allergies slow me down. It's a day to day thing that can really be remedied by finding the right medication.
39899.name: Alison Sweeney

39900.quote: My mom was paranoid about my safety.
39900.name: Jane Smiley

39901.quote: Mom was a smoker. My grandfather was a smoker. My aunts were smokers. My uncles were smokers. I don't know any smokers now, not even my mom.
39901.name: Jane Smiley

39902.quote: My mom drives me crazy sometimes, but I have a good relationship with her.
39902.name: Seth Rogen

39903.quote: My mom enlisted in the U.S. Navy in World War II, and my parents actually bought our home thanks to the loan she got through the GI Bill.
39903.name: Thomas Friedman

39904.quote: My dad is like a cactus - introverted and tough. I'm a people person, like my mom, but I got my competitiveness from my dad. He came to this country from Belarus with nothing and built a real business. He's my hero for giving me that need to run a business and for having enormous confidence in me.
39904.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

39905.quote: People who build family businesses are not classically trained. They have to deal with an enormous amount of politics. You think corporate politics are tough? Go work for your dad or your mom.
39905.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

39906.quote: It's about getting the kids up and fed, getting one to school, getting the other down for a nap, going to the grocery store, picking one up from school, getting the other one down for another nap, cooking dinner, I live my life at these two extremes. I'm either a full-time stay-at-home mom or a full-time actress.
39906.name: Jennifer Garner

39907.quote: I remember, my mom didn't have any help, so if she needed to be somewhere after school, we'd just go down to the neighbors' and she'd give us a snack and make sure we did our homework. There weren't any latchkey kids.
39907.name: Jennifer Garner

39908.quote: My mom has always said that the one thing she wishes she had done differently is have a job. She felt like the single-mindedness made her a little nuts sometimes, and she could have used an outlet for herself when we were little.
39908.name: Jennifer Garner

39909.quote: My mom grew up in poverty in Oklahoma - like Dust Bowl, nine people in one room kind of place - and the way she got out of poverty was through education. My dad grew up without a dad, with very little and he also made his way out through education.
39909.name: Jennifer Garner

39910.quote: My mom was really vigorous about making sure that we saw things and that we questioned things. Education was so important to both of my parents.
39910.name: Jennifer Garner

39911.quote: I've always wanted to be a mom at 23, 24ish, ever since I was a little girl. I'm right on schedule.
39911.name: Brandy Norwood

39912.quote: It's her first grandchild, so she's really, really, really excited. I guess my mom is a little more stressed out than me.
39912.name: Brandy Norwood

39913.quote: Mom would kill me if I showed my navel.
39913.name: Brandy Norwood

39914.quote: My hat was pulled down and this girl said 'Are you really him?' I whispered 'Yeah, I'm really him.' She screamed, 'Mom! Dad! It's Heath Ledger!
39914.name: Josh Hartnett

39915.quote: In all honesty, at that time, I never saw myself as an author, I was just a Mom in a state of panic, trying to enter a short story contest to win the prize money in order to keep the lights on in my home.
39915.name: Leslie Banks

39916.quote: When I was a kid I didn't feel like I fit in because - this is really silly and I probably shouldn't say it, but, I didn't think anything was funny. So I used to go home and literally cry to my mom and my step-dad at the time and I didn't think anything was funny. I couldn't laugh.
39916.name: Courteney Cox

39917.quote: I really want to adopt a child, I want to be called 'Mom.' It really is the most beautiful word in the English language.
39917.name: Patti Stanger

39918.quote: I wanted to be a 150% entrepreneur and a 150% mom, and I found that I was having a very hard time doing both. I was about 75% and 75% - still better than 100%, but not what I was accustomed to at work.
39918.name: Barbara Corcoran

39919.quote: Every single thing I learned about marketing and building my business, I learned from my mom, and she had never been in the workforce. She just had great practical sense.
39919.name: Barbara Corcoran

39920.quote: My guess is my brother would call his mom and his dad pretty regularly, a lot more than I probably did.
39920.name: Jeb Bush

39921.quote: When I was 15, I worked at a dry cleaner because I wanted Abercrombie & Fitch jeans. My mom told me I could have $20 jeans, not $70 jeans, unless I was willing to work for them. So I did!
39921.name: Ashley Greene

39922.quote: Growing up my whole life, my mom was telling me how incredible and special I was and that I was going to change the world. I think it's important for girls to know that they can change the world, that they do have an impact.
39922.name: Ashley Greene

39923.quote: I remember getting this scrapbook that this girl made, that I actually gave to my mom to hold onto because she has a 'Twilight' shrine in their house in Florida. It was just this scrapbook of me, starting with 'Twilight,' and the whole progression of me and my career throughout that, and other stuff that I had done in between.
39923.name: Ashley Greene

39924.quote: My mom lived by herself with two kids. Sacrifice was the name of the game at our house.
39924.name: Victor Cruz

39925.quote: My mom and dad just loved the fact that I fooled around. They just embraced it. They'd always kind of enjoy it, and they liked it when I made them laugh.
39925.name: Dominic Monaghan

39926.quote: Imagine my surprise when, after a lifetime of teaching me to keep personal things to myself, Mom insisted my drawings were the start of a comic strip for millions of people to enjoy.
39926.name: Cathy Guisewite

39927.quote: Mothers send strips to daughters to make a point. Daughters smack strips down on the breakfast table to make a point. My own mom sometimes cuts a strip out and sends it to me to make sure I understand her.
39927.name: Cathy Guisewite

39928.quote: The relationship between Cathy and Mom in the strip is the one relationship drawn from real life that I have proudly never even tried to disguise.
39928.name: Cathy Guisewite

39929.quote: My mom, she is the most unbelievable mom that you could ever have in your entire life and she's always with me on everything. The most I've ever been away from her is two days. I love her more than anybody could ever know.
39929.name: Dakota Fanning

39930.quote: I want to be a loving mom.
39930.name: Tori Spelling

39931.quote: I want to be a mom who listens.
39931.name: Tori Spelling

39932.quote: I am proud of my kids, but I also want to make my mom proud of me. I'm still a momma's girl at the heart of the situation.
39932.name: Tori Spelling

39933.quote: Sometimes I do envision just being a stay at home mom but not working isn't an option for me currently.
39933.name: Tori Spelling

39934.quote: There are days when I struggle with wanting to be a full-time, stay-at-home mom, and feeling guilty about that because I work.
39934.name: Tori Spelling

39935.quote: I got my first tattoo when I was 16 years old and I went with my mom to get it done - she has a bunch too so we're tattoo buddies now.
39935.name: Josh Hutcherson

39936.quote: I think because I became a mom later in life, everything in life means more.
39936.name: Mariska Hargitay

39937.quote: My mom was sarcastic about men. She would tell me Adam was the rough draft and Eve was the final product. She was a feminist minister, an earth mom who wore a bra only on Sundays.
39937.name: Daphne Zuniga

39938.quote: I'm a soccer mom. I'm T-ball, soccer, karate, homework, keeping them on their schedules. I love being the snack mom, when I get to bring the cut oranges. I have one of those coolers with wheels. I'm at every game, every practice, sitting on my blanket. I love it.
39938.name: Pamela Anderson

39939.quote: Many of my books come from what if questions that I can't answer, things that I'm worried about as either a woman, a wife, a mom, an American.
39939.name: Jodi Picoult

39940.quote: My dad sold encyclopedias and my mom worked in a factory office.
39940.name: Mike Myers

39941.quote: My mom was a single mom, and she had enough on her plate. I knew when I was doing something I wasn't supposed to, and I tried to keep her from finding out about it. I did a pretty good job of that.
39941.name: Jason Aldean

39942.quote: I'm a better mother if I'm also doing my work. Some women find a lot more satisfaction from doing the hardest job, which is being a mom. But I like my day job, so I juggle a lot.
39942.name: Katey Sagal

39943.quote: My mom was a teacher - I have the greatest respect for the profession - we need great teachers - not poor or mediocre ones.
39943.name: Condoleezza Rice

39944.quote: Being a mom makes me feel whole and like I understand the meaning of life.
39944.name: Rebecca Romijn

39945.quote: There is nothing better than being a parent. It is the most challenging job one could ever ask for. I love being a mom and I love being a friend to my children as well.
39945.name: Marlee Matlin

39946.quote: My friends and I would get up early and take our horses through the national forest. My mom was very free. It was always 'Out of the house!' There was no watching television on weekends.
39946.name: Anna Torv

39947.quote: I grew up with just my mom. She and I were like best friends. She's a very independent woman and I admire that about her. In my life, I've tried to be like that. To be okay with being on my own and being independent.
39947.name: Emma Roberts

39948.quote: You don't realize how hard it is to live on your own. But there's no mom to do your laundry, and make you dinner and to do things for you, and you don't think about little things like buying paper towels and salt.
39948.name: Emma Roberts

39949.quote: I work too much to be an appropriate parent. I feel like a bad mom to my dog some days because I'm just not here enough. I just feel like I would do a bad job if I took the time to literally give birth to a kid right now and try and juggle everything I'm doing.
39949.name: Rachael Ray

39950.quote: I live in, literally, the same home when I was swiping my first bank card and wondering if I'd have to put back the Charmin. We still don't have a dishwasher. My mom has done all these gardens so now my house looks like the garden shack in the middle of Versailles.
39950.name: Rachael Ray

39951.quote: My mom, who's been in the restaurant business for 40 years, is the number-one influence in my life. But I look up to a lot of people in the industry. Tops on my list is Mario Batali. My mom and Mario taught me the same lesson: Food is love.
39951.name: Rachael Ray

39952.quote: Good food and a warm kitchen are what makes a house a home. I always tried to make my home like my mother's, because Mom was magnificent at stretching a buck when it came to decorating and food. Like a true Italian, she valued beautification in every area of her life, and I try to do the same.
39952.name: Rachael Ray

39953.quote: I came from a broken home, so my mom was a major influence in my life.
39953.name: Julius Erving

39954.quote: I lived with my mom in a really small apartment. My bedroom was like in the living room. That's why I still love to sleep on couches now.
39954.name: Alicia Keys

39955.quote: My mom is definitely my rock.
39955.name: Alicia Keys

39956.quote: My mom always said, 'Don't date a guy who thinks he's prettier than you.'
39956.name: Alicia Keys

39957.quote: My mom was an actress in the local Seattle theater doing experimental plays.
39957.name: Rainn Wilson

39958.quote: Everything I am is because of my mom.
39958.name: Sarah Michelle Gellar

39959.quote: In a school where everyone is famous or rich or whatever, you have a culture, 'What does your dad do?' 'What does your mom do?'
39959.name: Cynthia Nixon

39960.quote: We've all seen the mom who devotes all her time and attention to her child and is so hungry for adult interaction that as soon as she's around another adult, she's not paying attention anymore.
39960.name: Cynthia Nixon

39961.quote: My nickname for my mom was 'The Compass.'
39961.name: Dane Cook

39962.quote: Well, you know, I was raised by a 1970s feminist. My mom had a consciousness-raising group. I used to sit at the top of the stairs and listen to them.
39962.name: Ayelet Waldman

39963.quote: Grades were important in our house. I was reading by two. My mom would sit there and read with me, read with me, read with me. It was wonderful.
39963.name: Fergie

39964.quote: When I was growing up, my mother was always a friend to my siblings and me (in addition to being all the other things a mom is), and I was always grateful for that because I knew she was someone I could talk to and joke with, and argue with and that nothing would ever harm that friendship.
39964.name: Marlo Thomas

39965.quote: Dinner 'conversation' at the Cohens' meant my sister, mom, and I relaying in brutal detail the day's events in a state of amplified hysteria, while my father listened to his own smooth jazz station in his head.
39965.name: Andy Cohen

39966.quote: If you go from a structure where you have the support and that partner and that construction of a family and that's broken apart, I think that's probably a lot harder than always being a single mom and having the father being a support in another area.
39966.name: Bridget Moynahan

39967.quote: Ever since I was a little kid, I've felt comfortable in a suit. It all started when my mom bought me a three-piece Pierre Cardin suit. I wore that thing everywhere. Eventually I realized I was going to be the kid who got beat up in school, but I kept wearing it.
39967.name: Paul Feig

39968.quote: I was blessed, because I come from a family where they knock you down before you float away. I have a lot of brothers who just make sure we have our feet on the ground, and my mom is a rock star. She is an amazing mother.
39968.name: Kellan Lutz

39969.quote: I spend my afternoons painting and working on my Open Hearts jewelry line for Kay Jewelers. I designed an image of a heart that isn't completely closed. My mom always told me to live with an open heart - when life gets tough, you should go out and help someone else.
39969.name: Jane Seymour

39970.quote: What does good in bed mean to me? When I'm sick and I stay home from school propped up with lots of pillows watching TV and my mom brings me soup - that's good in bed.
39970.name: Brooke Shields

39971.quote: My mom passed away a day before high school started, and her dream was for me to be a full rock and roll guy, and play drums in a band.
39971.name: Travis Barker

39972.quote: My mom listened to the Beatles and Elvis, a lot of different types of music.
39972.name: Travis Barker

39973.quote: My mom died when I was 16. I had a rough childhood, you know what I mean, but it made me strong.
39973.name: Travis Barker

39974.quote: My mom was scared of the old Times Square so I was never allowed to go. Now I'm scared of the new Times Square, so I still never go.
39974.name: Padma Lakshmi

39975.quote: I'm an immigrant kid who came to America from India when I was very young and grew up in New York City with a single mom and really was influenced by all of those immigrant cultures bumping up against each other.
39975.name: Padma Lakshmi

39976.quote: I never Tweet about my daughter. Never. I just want to be respectful of her privacy. My job as a mom is to know when to open my mouth and when not to.
39976.name: Padma Lakshmi

39977.quote: I think I'm a really hands-on mom.
39977.name: Brooke Burke

39978.quote: When I was a new mom, I used to think that life was going to be balanced, and I strived for that. But life is crazy!
39978.name: Brooke Burke

39979.quote: My mom was a ventriloquist and she always was throwing her voice. For ten years I thought the dog was telling me to kill my father.
39979.name: Wendy Liebman

39980.quote: Wigs have always been a part of my life and have become a staple accessory in my closet. I can remember being a little girl and hearing all the commotion in my house from my mom, aunts and grandmother when picking out their wigs for the day. It was such a good time for them and part of their everyday beauty routine.
39980.name: Sherri Shepherd

39981.quote: My mom passed away at 41 from diabetes. And I'm 42, thank you. I didn't want to do that to my son. So any time I was at the gym, that thing that helped me do that last squat was my son calling some other woman mommy. And that would just give me that extra oomph to do that last squat. I want to be around for him.
39981.name: Sherri Shepherd

39982.quote: I don't spend a lot of time online. My mother's really good at picking out if she sees a really great review, and she'll forward it to me. She's like my little Internet filter. It's always nice to see something going up if I want to find something on Nathan Fillion, I do know where to look, but I've got a nice little delivery system in my mom.
39982.name: Nathan Fillion

39983.quote: I listened to the radio, so I was influenced by everyone from Michael Jackson to Milli Vanilli. But thankfully my dad had a collection of Cat Stevens albums while my mom was listening to jazz.
39983.name: Jason Mraz

39984.quote: I like to write and draw and paint, and my mom's an artist, so I think I get caught up in thinking, 'I'm afraid it's gonna be bad,' and it's hard for me to start sometimes.
39984.name: Kristen Wiig

39985.quote: We never had a bathtub. Mom would bathe me in the wooden or tin washtub in the kitchen, or in a big lard can.
39985.name: Ethel Waters

39986.quote: Mom was the greatest influence of my childhood. She wanted to save me from the vice, lust, and drinking that was all about me.
39986.name: Ethel Waters

39987.quote: Mom never quit on me. My only regret is that she didn't live long enough to share some of the money and comforts my work in show business has brought me.
39987.name: Ethel Waters

39988.quote: In her whole life Mom never earned more than five or six dollars a week. Being without a husband, it was hard for her to find any place at all for us to live.
39988.name: Ethel Waters

39989.quote: That's the hardest thing about being a mom. You want to be cool, and you want them to like you all the time, but you can't always have that. You're gonna have times where you have to say no, and you won't be the most popular person in the house.
39989.name: Martina McBride

39990.quote: My mom used to have a lot of European cinema playing in the house, so I'd catch bits and pieces of films.
39990.name: Mia Wasikowska

39991.quote: Being a mom's so empowering and incredible. I'm one of those people who believes that life brings things to you at a certain time for a certain reason, and if you just go with it, that's where the best moments come from.
39991.name: Ashlee Simpson

39992.quote: I think my mom put it best. She said, 'Little girls soften their daddy's hearts.'
39992.name: Paul Walker

39993.quote: I love my mom and dad.
39993.name: Taylor Momsen

39994.quote: Postpartum depression is a very real and very serious problem for many mothers. It can happen to a first time mom or a veteran mother. It can occur a few days, or a few months after childbirth.
39994.name: Richard J. Codey

39995.quote: My mom didn't let me play video games growing up, so now I do. Gaming gives me a chance to just let go, blow somebody up and fight somebody from another dimension. It's all escapism.
39995.name: Wayne Brady

39996.quote: This is the place where anybody - like an African American kid raised by a single mom - can be president.
39996.name: Jennifer M. Granholm

39997.quote: You can be good at technology and like fashion and art. You can be good at technology and be a jock. You can be good at technology and be a mom. You can do it your way, on your terms.
39997.name: Marissa Mayer

39998.quote: I slept with my mom until I was 16 years old.
39998.name: Jennifer Hudson

39999.quote: If I could be a third of the woman that my mom is and have a third of the strength that she has, then I will have done good by this life.
39999.name: Brittany Murphy

40000.quote: It's always been my mom and I against the world.
40000.name: Brittany Murphy

40001.quote: I always wanted to be a young mom, but generations of women have worked so hard so we can have a career and wait to have children. So I say carpe diem - take advantage of that.
40001.name: Brittany Murphy

40002.quote: Home is where my mom is.
40002.name: Brittany Murphy

40003.quote: A company that pays attention to the family unit is a successful company. We don't isolate the family. We don't make rides that say, 'Hey mom, dad, you go sit on the bench.'
40003.name: Michael Eisner

40004.quote: I grew up in Marcy Projects in Brooklyn, and my mom and pop had an extensive record collection, so Michael Jackson and Stevie Wonder and all of those sounds and souls of Motown filled the house.
40004.name: Jay-Z

40005.quote: He was doing - Ray was designing the clothes for my mom's show from California. And one of the first appearances I ever made on television was on my mother's show and Ray and Bob did the clothes for that. It has been a long time.
40005.name: Liza Minnelli

40006.quote: Sinatra was just one of Mom's friends.
40006.name: Lorna Luft

40007.quote: My mom is not trying to live vicariously through me.
40007.name: Victoria Justice

40008.quote: I was almost 8 years old when I was watching a kid on a TV commercial, and I told my mom that I wanted to do the same thing. She said that I would need to get an agent and that she would research it.
40008.name: Victoria Justice

40009.quote: I'd say that if you had a strained relationship with your mom, for whatever reason, the best thing to do is be open with each other, talk it over, try and work it out somehow as opposed to just putting a wall up and pushing them away.
40009.name: Victoria Justice

40010.quote: My mom's a social worker, and my dad works in non-profit organisations.
40010.name: Seth Rogen

40011.quote: For now I'm just enjoying being a mom. I don't want to be more famous and more rich. I want to be a good mom.
40011.name: Jewel

40012.quote: My mom was truly an iconic figure, a great journalist and a pioneering woman who died at 54 of cancer without ever having revealed to viewers that she was ill.
40012.name: David Frum

40013.quote: My mom didn't want me to go to college. She didn't want me to read - when I read, I may as well have been holding a pineapple.
40013.name: Lynda Barry

40014.quote: My beloved Mom and Pop always rated tops with each other, and that's the way it will always be.
40014.name: Ethel Merman

40015.quote: Mom claimed that I could carry a tune at 2 or 3 years of age. Maybe she was a little prejudiced.
40015.name: Ethel Merman

40016.quote: Mom and Pop were proud of my popularity, but from their point of view, show business was no way to make a living.
40016.name: Ethel Merman

40017.quote: My mom was a professional. My dad and mom met each other in a movie called 'New Faces of 1937.' My mom went under the name Thelma Leeds, and she did a few movies, and she was really a great singer, and when she married my dad and started to have a family, she sang at parties.
40017.name: Albert Brooks

40018.quote: I had a non-existent knowledge of Queen Victoria's early years. Like everyone else, I thought of her as an old lady dressed in black. My mom had told me about her, though, that she had a very loving relationship with Albert, that they had lots of kids, and that he died young.
40018.name: Emily Blunt

40019.quote: I'm so proud to represent the people of South Florida. I was so honored when President Obama asked me to serve as chair of the Democratic Party. But there's one job I'm even more proud of, and that's being a mom to my three kids, Rebecca, Jake and Shelby.
40019.name: Debbie Wasserman Schultz

40020.quote: I have great faith that Heaven's there and I'll see my brothers and my mom and dad when I get there.
40020.name: Ernie Harwell

40021.quote: My mom was amazing. She believed in me and we were best friends.
40021.name: Carmen Electra

40022.quote: My mom was a seamstress, and I wish I'd learned to sew because I'm obsessed with 'Project Runway!'
40022.name: Carmen Electra

40023.quote: If I have any talent at all it's from God, and my mom, who was on Capitol Records also.
40023.name: Garth Brooks

40024.quote: My mom and dad got divorced when I was very young, and growing up in a family where the head of the household wasn't a man made a big difference.
40024.name: Dave Mustaine

40025.quote: I want to be a fun mom. Not a gasping for air mom.
40025.name: Mariska Hargitay

40026.quote: Every kid needs to say, 'I want what my mom and dad have.'
40026.name: Josh McDowell

40027.quote: I could never have pictured myself writing a book when I was 25 years old. My mom was an English teacher but I wasn't that way growing up.
40027.name: Tony Dungy

40028.quote: My mom obviously had a problem.
40028.name: Dave Pelzer

40029.quote: It's been very hard, after being mostly a mom, to develop an adult life of my own. And not being married anymore, I have to come up with challenges.
40029.name: Danielle Steel

40030.quote: I grew up painting and playing piano so when I was a little kid I thought I was going to be an artist or a painter but my mom had me taking piano lessons for about 10-12 years as a young kid.
40030.name: Mike Shinoda

40031.quote: I've never had siblings, I didn't grow up in a big family it was just me and my single mom. And hectic family dysfunction was actually something that I craved.
40031.name: Emmy Rossum

40032.quote: I grew up in a predominantly Caucasian neighborhood, but my mom is Filipino-Spanish and my dad is Irish.
40032.name: Shay Mitchell

40033.quote: I look at my father. He is one of my heroes. He is such an incredible, classy man. He was such a great father and such a great husband in so many ways, and we lived through some pretty tough times losing my mom. When I see all that he did, I think, 'Wow, that's a really wonderful man.'
40033.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

40034.quote: AIDS can destroy a family if you let it, but luckily for my sister and me, Mom taught us to keep going. Don't give up, be proud of who you are, and never feel sorry for yourself.
40034.name: Ryan White

40035.quote: My parents are wonderful, and I'm really lucky - but my mom has always been almost exclusively a right-brained person.
40035.name: Brandon Boyd

40036.quote: Also, my mom and family are very important to me and I know that this is not expected.
40036.name: Christina Milian

40037.quote: I shoplifted. I was about five years old, and I took a candy from a store. We paid for three of them, but I took four, and I went home and cried. My mom took me back, and I paid for the missing piece.
40037.name: Carrie-Anne Moss

40038.quote: I had to take my makeup off at work every night. I wasn't allowed to do it at home because my mom said that when your work day is done, you're done with work.
40038.name: Jodie Foster

40039.quote: When you think of couponing, you picture a mom cutting coupons out of the back of the newspaper.
40039.name: Andrew Mason

40040.quote: I'm a military kid, both parents in the military - Mom did 12 years, Dad did 21, served in two wars. So discipline is something that was huge.
40040.name: Robert Griffin III

40041.quote: It's fun to play mom. Last I knew I was playing a 17-year-old who graduated.
40041.name: Selma Blair

40042.quote: I always say I am a realist, and my mom says, 'No, you just have anxiety.'
40042.name: Jessica Chastain

40043.quote: I wanted to perform well for my mom and dad, because in high school, I didn't have a job. My brothers, they worked at Pizza Hut or places like that, but sports, that was my way of giving back.
40043.name: Junior Seau

40044.quote: All of us kids ended up 'doing Mom.' There are four of us who've tried show business. Five if you insist on counting my sister the nun, who does liturgical dance.
40044.name: Bill Murray

40045.quote: I was class mom at the preschool one year and I was pretty much asked not to do that again!
40045.name: Julie Bowen

40046.quote: It was my mom and I against the world. We lived in New York in this bohemian lifestyle where an extended group of artists and photographers were like my aunts and uncles.
40046.name: Brooke Shields

40047.quote: My parents divorced when I was young but I was brought up in two really loving households. I didn't have a contentious relationship with my mom or dad.
40047.name: Matt Damon

40048.quote: Country was about character. Country's changed because of monsters like Clear Channel who bought up all the stations and sliced them up into formats. Our demographic is now the soccer mom.
40048.name: Gary Allan

40049.quote: I have lots of records, quite a collection, actually, that I stole from my mom. I have the original 'Thriller' album and I have a really great 'Elton John's Greatest Hits,' and I also have a N.E.R.D. album. Records sound more original. They have more edge.
40049.name: Elisha Cuthbert

40050.quote: My mom and dad worked very hard to give me the best chance in - not just in golf but in life. You know, I was an only child, you know, my dad worked three jobs at one stage. My mom worked night shifts in a factory.
40050.name: Rory McIlroy

40051.quote: Dad and mom would have preferred that I be a doctor, a lawyer, a scientist, or a great humanitarian.
40051.name: Levon Helm

40052.quote: I think a good mom is an awake mom. At least for me, I've always been a kinder, better person awake than sleep-deprived!
40052.name: Lisa Loeb

40053.quote: My mom was a great cook and great baker all her life.
40053.name: Mandy Patinkin

40054.quote: No, my mom kind of led me toward acting. She wanted to be an actress when she was younger. That made me interested in it when I was a kid, because she and I are very close.
40054.name: Stephen Colbert

40055.quote: For many women, going back to work a few months after having a baby is overwhelming and unmanageable. As strange as it may seem, things get even more difficult for a working mom after the second and third baby arrive. By that time, the romance of being a modern 'superwoman' wears off and reality sets in.
40055.name: Mika Brzezinski

40056.quote: One of my most sentimental items is my grandmother's engagement ring that my mom gave me a few years ago. It's a Victorian-style setting that's closed in the back, so it doesn't sparkle the way diamonds do now. I wear it as a pendant.
40056.name: Georgina Chapman

40057.quote: Once you're a mom, always a mom. It's like riding a bike, you never forget.
40057.name: Taraji P. Henson

40058.quote: My mom was always really healthy and cautious about her diet, so I'm not a big sugar guy.
40058.name: Paul Walker

40059.quote: My mom's hot. I mean she's old, but my mom's out of control.
40059.name: Paul Walker

40060.quote: We busted a lot of family secrets with this. But to make a long story short, my parents relationship was built heavily on security issues for my Mom, and when my Dad couldn't provide security, the relationship unraveled.
40060.name: Kenny Loggins

40061.quote: My mom took me to a Dolly Parton concert when I was 3.
40061.name: Kat Dennings

40062.quote: One time my mom tried to ground me, but that lasted 15 minutes.
40062.name: Bam Margera

40063.quote: OK, so my parents were married in 1955 and my mom knew my dad was gay and my dad knew he was gay and so I was, like, 'Why in the heck did you get married?' Like, what was going on? What was that time? It's like this crazy paradox that my whole life is based on, or my family's based on. So I spent a lot of time trying to understand '55.
40063.name: Mike Mills

40064.quote: My daughter's name is Neesyn Dacey but everyone calls her Dacey. Her mom chose Neesyn and I chose Dacey after she was born. The mother is a good friend of mine who I was seeing a while ago. We are no longer together.
40064.name: Bode Miller

40065.quote: My mom played the recorder. But not having electricity, we had minimal exposure to music. As I got a little older, we had Walkmans and things that were battery-powered, but it would have been nice to be growing up in the iPod era. A tape only has six songs on a side.
40065.name: Bode Miller

40066.quote: It's so funny looking back, but my so-called overnight success actually took 15 years. I remember when I didn't have any money, and my only car was mom's Hyundai.
40066.name: Criss Angel

40067.quote: As a small business owner for the last 15 years, when I think of what truly changed my life, it was my faith, a strong family, my mom did a really, really good job of encouraging me in very clear and discernible ways.
40067.name: Tim Scott

40068.quote: When you're sick, nobody takes care of you like your mom.
40068.name: Trisha Yearwood

40069.quote: We didn't have movies in this little mining town. When I was 12 my mom took me to New York and I saw Bye Bye Birdie, with people singing and dancing, and that was it.
40069.name: Margot Kidder

40070.quote: I gave guitar lessons. I tried to join bands. My mom always said it was obvious that nothing was going to stop me.
40070.name: Janis Ian

40071.quote: Before you're a mom you don't know what gear is going to be relevant.
40071.name: Emily Procter

40072.quote: My mom and my dad were married 56 years, and the fact that I reconciled with my dad I think made their marriage a little bit better as well.
40072.name: Larry Elder

40073.quote: I was embarrassed that I even wanted to become an actress because coming from L.A., with two older sisters in the business and a mom who had been a ballet dancer, it was such a cliche.
40073.name: Elizabeth Olsen

40074.quote: From the very start of all of this, my mom has read the scripts first. And if she liked something, she let me read it. She told our agent what kinds of parts that we would want.
40074.name: Anna Chlumsky

40075.quote: I had no idea of the size of my bank account as a teen, and I didn't care to know. That was my mom's job, I figured that I would just find out when I turned 18. If you can't trust your mom, then who can you trust?
40075.name: Anna Chlumsky

40076.quote: My mom, she's still always there for me. Always.
40076.name: David Ortiz

40077.quote: When I was growing up in New Jersey, my mom would regularly take my sister and I into the city to see shows. I have many fond memories of standing in the half-price ticket line in Times Square and going to matinees.
40077.name: Trey Anastasio

40078.quote: More and more couples are having this negotiation or discussion, but I'm still amazed at the number who aren't and where the cultural norm sort of kicks in and they just assume that mom's got to be the one who stays home, not dad.
40078.name: James Levine

40079.quote: My mom had started to go to work when I was nine or ten, so I was aware of women trying to find their own identities by working. But I was still influenced by men to such an extreme. I wanted to play their games and wanted to compete in their world and be like them.
40079.name: Elisabeth Shue

40080.quote: My mom had this romantic notion of her children playing classical music. The idea is you learn it when you're still learning language. It's using the same part of the brain.
40080.name: Andrew Bird

40081.quote: I burnt myself out of skating. I was ready to focus on being a mom.
40081.name: Kristi Yamaguchi

40082.quote: I've realized how precious life is. When I was younger, I was more adventurous. I felt invincible. I was game for everything. As a mom, I don't want to get injured because then I can't take care of my kids.
40082.name: Kristi Yamaguchi

40083.quote: I lived in small town out in the desert and my friend used to steal his mom's car in the middle of the night. He'd drive over to my house, I'd sneak out and we'd go out to the desert and just burn things down.
40083.name: Mark Hoppus

40084.quote: My mom's gonna be the biggest star - mark my words right now!
40084.name: Vinny Guadagnino

40085.quote: My house has always been like everyone's house. You walk in, you're a part of the family, no matter who you are, what celebrity status you are, everyone is treated the same - with love from my mom.
40085.name: Vinny Guadagnino

40086.quote: So, I remember when I was a kid, I was waiting for my mom to come home when she was working late, and, you know, I was like, 'Oh my God, what happened to her? Is she OK? Did something happen to her getting in the car?' I was a little kid. But those are actually early onsets of anxiety.
40086.name: Vinny Guadagnino

40087.quote: I got a family house for everybody to live in - my mom, my sisters and I. And I made sure that it has a separate apartment downstairs for myself. Family is more important than anything. We don't come from any money. So once I get them settled in, in a nice house, then I'll branch out and see if I can get something else.
40087.name: Vinny Guadagnino

40088.quote: My mom said, 'Don't get married. You're too young. Go out there and experience what life has to offer.' And I did.
40088.name: Emmitt Smith

40089.quote: I'm kind of lucky that we've finished shooting 'Cougar Town,' so I'm able to kind of just enjoy my pregnancy and be a stay-at-home mom and go to prenatal Pilates and do all that fun stuff that, if I were working, would be almost impossible to do.
40089.name: Busy Philipps

40090.quote: Birdie is amazing and such an incredible child and I'm having such a great time being a mom but I still want to have a career and I still look forward to auditions and parts, and when I don't get them I'm disappointed.
40090.name: Busy Philipps

40091.quote: I'm somebody who doesn't work with a stylist. I'll be honest with you, I'm a mom and it's just not something I want to put money toward because it's expensive to have somebody who helps dress you and I feel like I have to pay for preschool and so many things, so I don't have a stylist.
40091.name: Busy Philipps

40092.quote: Mom always tells me to celebrate everyone's uniqueness. I like the way that sounds.
40092.name: Hilary Duff

40093.quote: My mom taught me not to talk about money.
40093.name: Hilary Duff

40094.quote: I love my mom. I totally look up to her, and she just doesn't let anybody take advantage of me. People might call that a stage mom.
40094.name: Hilary Duff

40095.quote: My relationship with my mom is so amazing. We never got to have that stage that people go through, like when you're 13 and you think you're too cool for your parents. When you're embarrassed by them and stuff. We never went through that because I was constantly working and she constantly had to be there.
40095.name: Hilary Duff

40096.quote: My mom had me when she was 16, and I was an only child, which is probably why I received a lot of love and didn't miss that my father wasn't around.
40096.name: Brett Ratner

40097.quote: Miami Beach - that's where I grew up, in a middle-class Jewish family led by my maternal grandfather. Me, my great-grandmother - a Holocaust survivor, who was my roommate - my grandparents, my mom and her brother all shared a four-bedroom house.
40097.name: Brett Ratner

40098.quote: We didn't have a TV in the living room and all my friends thought we were kind of weird. When they'd come over, my mom wanted to talk to them about current events.
40098.name: Eliza Dushku

40099.quote: My mom is this liberal, feminist, Mormon powerhouse. I just love her to death.
40099.name: Eliza Dushku

40100.quote: I was raised in Boston by three older brothers and a very strong and empowering single mom.
40100.name: Eliza Dushku

40101.quote: My mom is like this hard-core, liberal feminist. She's a professor in Boston, and she's been teaching women's studies for 30 years and international politics.
40101.name: Eliza Dushku

40102.quote: As a mom, I don't have much time for beauty.
40102.name: Idina Menzel

40103.quote: My biggest project right now is trying to be a really great mom and learning how to balance family and career. I'm just trying to spend as much time with my family as I can.
40103.name: Idina Menzel

40104.quote: I'm a mom - I'm lucky if I get to shower in the morning. Luckily, nail polish stays on my toes. I've been so bad on the upkeep, though.
40104.name: Idina Menzel

40105.quote: I've always wanted to be a mom.
40105.name: Holly Madison

40106.quote: I want my daughter to be proud of me and look up to me. I think early on in my pregnancy I realized that to be the mom I want to be, I had to change my life, and that's what I'm doing.
40106.name: Holly Madison

40107.quote: My mom and dad played this music all the time when I was growing up, so to me songs by Jerry Lee and Fats Domino are the classics, they're the best songs ever.
40107.name: Chris Isaak

40108.quote: I was brought up as an only child, and we were very close. But when I was 14, we got evicted. We came home to a padlock, and I looked up at my mom and she was crying, and there was nothing to do.
40108.name: Dwayne Johnson

40109.quote: I spend as much time with my kids as any mom who stays home. I only work during the hours they're at school, but there is always the sense of trying to catch up with all their stuff and not only organize my work life but also their school lives.
40109.name: Patricia Heaton

40110.quote: My mom's the one I look up to for everything. I feel like I'm a lump of clay and she's moulding me into a woman.
40110.name: Chloe Moretz

40111.quote: My mom has always said that if I get a big head, she'll take me out of this business as quickly as I got into it.
40111.name: Chloe Moretz

40112.quote: I just got my phone back yesterday. My mom had it for two days. I was supposed to read a book and I really wanted to play Call Of Duty.
40112.name: Chloe Moretz

40113.quote: My mom won't let me buy high-fashion stuff unless it's TK Maxx or a birthday occasion.
40113.name: Chloe Moretz

40114.quote: The one thing my mom will let me get is a nice shoe sometimes.
40114.name: Chloe Moretz

40115.quote: My mom won't let anyone treat me like a little princess.
40115.name: Chloe Moretz

40116.quote: My brother Trevor is theatrically trained. I used to watch him when I was younger and I was in love with it. It just seemed really fun to be someone else. So I begged my mom she was hesitant, but she eventually allowed me. And it turned out well, I guess.
40116.name: Chloe Moretz

40117.quote: My mom gives me an allowance. She keeps me pretty tight-reined.
40117.name: Chloe Moretz

40118.quote: The problem with me is, anything that's easy I will just overdo it. Especially with clothes. But I'm 14 - my mom is super-strict about that.
40118.name: Chloe Moretz

40119.quote: We were poor. But my mom never accepted that. She worked hard to become a residential contractor - got her master's with honors at the University of New Orleans. I used to go to every class with her. Her father was my paternal figure.
40119.name: Frank Ocean

40120.quote: I've learned that every working mom is a superwoman.
40120.name: Uma Thurman

40121.quote: I'm an actress and mom, and I probably don't have enough of an active spiritual life. And I don't know why people run around calling themselves by the names of religions when they don't actually practise them.
40121.name: Uma Thurman

40122.quote: My mother was a single mom, and most of the women I know are strong.
40122.name: Regina King

40123.quote: I think I've become more like my mom just because of what we're both interested in, children and teaching and writing.
40123.name: Jenna Bush

40124.quote: I had always loved to write and my mom was my editor for my school papers.
40124.name: Jenna Bush

40126.quote: I'm more like my father, personality-wise. But my mom and I get alone really well - obviously, because my mom and my dad get along so well.
40126.name: Jenna Bush

40127.quote: I'm sure there were times when I wish I had thought, 'Gosh, that might really embarrass mom and dad,' but our parents didn't raise us to think about them. They're very selfless and they wanted us to have as normal of a college life as possible. So really, we didn't think of any repercussions.
40127.name: Jenna Bush

40128.quote: I prefer to imagine that my wife, a few friends, and occasionally my mom are the only ones who read what I do, though I realize that this is somewhat unrealistic.
40128.name: Chris Ware

40129.quote: When I was a kid, my mom used to run the vacuum cleaner, and the noise would bother me so much that I would run into the woods to calm down. I feel like that vacuum cleaner has been on since I moved to New York City.
40129.name: Steve Burns

40130.quote: There's been times when I've had heartbreaking moments and I'm like, 'I can't believe you said that,' or 'I can't believe you did that'. And it hurts, it still hurts, and it'll always hurt, but I've never had somebody that I truly cared about just walk out on me, whether it was a boyfriend, or an aunt, mom or dad.
40130.name: Shailene Woodley

40131.quote: My mom would take me to restaurants, and the first thing I'd ask for would be a pen and a napkin, and I'd sketch shoes and shoes and shoes.
40131.name: Alexander Wang

40132.quote: My mom would put me in these preppy little suits and slick my hair to the side. I have these baby pictures of me where I'm this little preppy kid with a sweater tied around my neck.
40132.name: Alexander Wang

40133.quote: I was a hyper kid in school and the teacher suggested to my mom she needed to do something with me.
40133.name: Devon Sawa

40134.quote: My mother kept asking me, 'When are you going to do a gospel album?' And I've always wanted to do a gospel album. Everybody was going on about it, so mom started hounding me more.
40134.name: Alan Jackson

40135.quote: My dad is a bank president and my mom was an accountant and they didn't think that seeking the life of a freelance writer was very practical, you see. Of course, I was just as determined to do it.
40135.name: Kevin J. Anderson

40136.quote: I know that I'm getting the real deal with my mom. I know that she's telling it like it is. She's proud of me when I've earned it and she's disappointed in me when I've earn that. She's really my spectrum on where I am as a person.
40136.name: Lara Flynn Boyle

40137.quote: I had such a great mom and I know that I'd never be that mom. I wouldn't want to bring a child into this world unless I could be.
40137.name: Lara Flynn Boyle

40138.quote: My mom calls me an older soul because, growing up, she taught me stuff real early. Now I spend most of my time chasing wisdom, chasing understanding.
40138.name: Ray Lewis

40139.quote: Mom thinks I live in this dream world where everybody's Ivana Trump.
40139.name: Kathie Lee Gifford

40140.quote: Over the years my mom has become a self-taught Biblical scholar.
40140.name: Kathie Lee Gifford

40141.quote: My mom used to tell me: 'It's not what you weigh it's what you look like.'
40141.name: Gina Carano

40142.quote: My mom and my father's birthday are on the same day.
40142.name: Victor Cruz

40143.quote: My mom was dying for me to write a book, she was my biggest advocate.
40143.name: Victor Cruz

40144.quote: Growing up, my mom was very strict about how I dressed and how I behaved, and I said to myself that I wasn't going to be like that. But now I know I'm going to be exactly like my mom. I'm going to be worse!
40144.name: Nicole Scherzinger

40145.quote: Sure, my childhood was unusual. All these eccentric, wild people frequented our home: rock stars, drag queens, models, bikers, freaks. But I was not this little rich girl. My mom and I lived in an apartment.
40145.name: Liv Tyler

40146.quote: My mom's been married three times my dad has been married a lot. I didn't really see my dad that much.
40146.name: Skeet Ulrich

40147.quote: I want to make my music and be a happy woman, a good wife, a good mom and one day hopefully have a child of my own.
40147.name: LeAnn Rimes

40148.quote: My dad is a very quick-witted, sarcastic, dry, humorous guy, whereas my mom's very silly, and that side of the family is very musical.
40148.name: Tim Heidecker

40149.quote: Once my mom passed away, I have nobody to answer to. It's great.
40149.name: Jessica Hahn

40150.quote: My mom really instilled in me that I'm beautiful and I can do anything, and I echo that now with my own girls.
40150.name: Jennie Garth

40151.quote: I love kids and children, and I love being a mom.
40151.name: Jennie Garth

40152.quote: I was actually the one who decided to move to LA. Mom and I were driving on Sunset Boulevard during one of our trips back to see her family, and I said, 'Can we just stay?' So we did.
40152.name: Lily Collins

40153.quote: I'm a competitive person and it is in my nature to try hard in every match I play. The only time I'm not competitive is when I'm playing against my mom.
40153.name: Michael Chang

40154.quote: One day my dad would say, 'OK, if you want to play tennis I can help you out.' And that's how it started. And I had a goal. I wanted to beat my mom first. And my parents and my brother. And that was the ultimate goal.
40154.name: Caroline Wozniacki

40155.quote: My mom was always the support. I can always go out to her and she'll always find the positive in things.
40155.name: Caroline Wozniacki

40156.quote: My mom is great and I make sure that we pray together before every race. She helps me put everything in perspective and remind me of the real reason I run.
40156.name: Allyson Felix

40157.quote: No matter what, like, I couldn't - I could break a world record, get an Olympic gold medal, and my mom would be, like, you could have done better. But you looked pretty. That's what she says all the time.
40157.name: Ryan Lochte

40158.quote: I care so passionately about improving the quality of life for women and girls, not just here in the United States, but internationally as well. I am a single mom and I raised a daughter who is now a young adult.
40158.name: Valerie Jarrett

40159.quote: The fact that I'm very close with my past relationships is something I pride myself on. My mom is still close to her first husband. It's nice to be able to enjoy someone in a different form.
40159.name: Kate Bosworth

40160.quote: I have to keep reminding myself that I am their mother. Sometimes we are sitting at home and I feel like we are waiting for our mom to come home.
40160.name: Ruby Wax

40161.quote: When I was a child, I wanted to be an actor, but I had really bad buckteeth. I didn't want to get braces, but my mom said I couldn't be an actor if I didn't get the braces. So, I got the braces.
40161.name: James Franco

40162.quote: Our last jam session was this past Christmas. Dad played his harmonica, mom sang in English and Italian, and I played guitar. I'm so happy that we could share that musical experience for one last time.
40162.name: Tony Visconti

40163.quote: My mom cooked pot roast with noodles and frozen vegetables. Or she'd make spaghetti or hot dogs, or heat up TV dinners. Before I started modeling at age 19, I was 5'8 and weighed 165 pounds.
40163.name: Carol Alt

40164.quote: My father still is a lawyer, and my mom was a teacher and then later a career counselor.
40164.name: Steve Case

40165.quote: I remember that at the beginning of the month, the kind of menus my mom and father would prepare for us would have fish, chicken. But at the end of the month - because my father would be waiting for paycheck - the refrigerator would get empty. I remember that without a lot of food left, some of the best meals happened right there.
40165.name: Jose Andres Puerta

40166.quote: Simon is cool. You know, it's different if you ever see him around his mom. He acts totally different.
40166.name: Ruben Studdard

40167.quote: I want to make sure I continue to make good music that my mom and everybody around me can be proud of.
40167.name: Ruben Studdard

40168.quote: I grew up in the '80s, and there was no bigger group than New Edition in R&ampB. I broke my piggy bank so me and my mom could go to a New Edition concert together.
40168.name: Ruben Studdard

40169.quote: I'm from Tennessee. My mom lives in Nashville. I'm born and bred country. That's all I listen to.
40169.name: Lucy Hale

40170.quote: I've never had my brows done - I tweeze them myself. I used to watch my mom pluck her brows, that's how I learned.
40170.name: Emmy Rossum

40172.quote: My hero is Michelle Williams, who I grew close to when we did 'Meek's Cutoff.' She's an extraordinary actor and mom.
40172.name: Zoe Kazan

40173.quote: When I look up and see a star, I know my mom is there. She's with me all the time. It's a powerful connection.
40173.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

40174.quote: My mom was an aesthetician and she went to beauty school back in the '60s. I just remember watching her do her makeup all the time. She always had her nails done, makeup on - her face was ready to go when she went out. I loved it.
40174.name: Emmanuelle Chriqui

40175.quote: I grew up in a family of Republicans. And when I was 18 and registering to vote, my mom's only instruction was 'You just go in and pull the big Republican lever.' That's my welcome to adulthood. She's like, 'No, don't even read it. Just pull the Republican lever.
40175.name: Tina Fey

40176.quote: My mom started smoking when she was 11. She went to the hill next door to try her first cigarette. She set the entire hill on fire, but it didn't deter her.
40176.name: Loni Anderson
