40586.quote: There are people who have money and people who are rich.
40586.name: Coco Chanel

40587.quote: Many people take no care of their money till they come nearly to the end of it, and others do just the same with their time.
40587.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

40588.quote: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.
40588.name: George Burns

40589.quote: After a certain point, money is meaningless. It ceases to be the goal. The game is what counts.
40589.name: Aristotle Onassis

40590.quote: I'd like to live as a poor man with lots of money.
40590.name: Pablo Picasso

40591.quote: It is not the creation of wealth that is wrong, but the love of money for its own sake.
40591.name: Margaret Thatcher

40592.quote: Money is the barometer of a society's virtue.
40592.name: Ayn Rand

40593.quote: A bank is a place that will lend you money if you can prove that you don't need it.
40593.name: Bob Hope

40594.quote: I have no money, no resources, no hopes. I am the happiest man alive.
40594.name: Henry Miller

40595.quote: We go to school to learn to work hard for money. I write books and create products that teach people how to have money work hard for them.
40595.name: Robert Kiyosaki

40596.quote: We've got to put a lot of money into changing behavior.
40596.name: Bill Gates

40597.quote: A wise man should have money in his head, but not in his heart.
40597.name: Jonathan Swift

40598.quote: Money is better than poverty, if only for financial reasons.
40598.name: Woody Allen

40599.quote: I've got all the money I'll ever need, if I die by four o'clock.
40599.name: Henny Youngman

40600.quote: A woman's best protection is a little money of her own.
40600.name: Clare Boothe Luce

40601.quote: A good reputation is more valuable than money.
40601.name: Publilius Syrus

40602.quote: Friendship is like money, easier made than kept.
40602.name: Samuel Butler

40603.quote: If saving money is wrong, I don't want to be right!
40603.name: William Shatner

40604.quote: Money is a strange business. People who haven't got it aim it strongly. People who have are full of troubles.
40604.name: Ayrton Senna

40605.quote: Liking money like I like it, is nothing less than mysticism. Money is a glory.
40605.name: Salvador Dali

40606.quote: It doesn't matter about money having it, not having it. Or having clothes, or not having them. You're still left alone with yourself in the end.
40606.name: Billy Idol

40607.quote: A man is usually more careful of his money than of his principles.
40607.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

40608.quote: Profit is sweet, even if it comes from deception.
40608.name: Sophocles

40609.quote: Money: power at its most liquid.
40609.name: Mason Cooley

40610.quote: If you can count your money, you don't have a billion dollars.
40610.name: J. Paul Getty

40611.quote: Money differs from an automobile or mistress in being equally important to those who have it and those who do not.
40611.name: John Kenneth Galbraith

40612.quote: It is a waste of money to help those who show no desire to help themselves.
40612.name: Taylor Caldwell

40613.quote: A billion here, a billion there, and pretty soon you're talking about real money.
40613.name: Everett Dirksen

40614.quote: All riches have their origin in mind. Wealth is in ideas - not money.
40614.name: Robert Collier

40615.quote: I've made all my money on my own without my family and I work very hard.
40615.name: Paris Hilton

40616.quote: Banks have a new image. Now you have 'a friend,' your friendly banker. If the banks are so friendly, how come they chain down the pens?
40616.name: Alan King

40617.quote: Money's a horrid thing to follow, but a charming thing to meet.
40617.name: Henry James

40618.quote: A man with money is no match against a man on a mission.
40618.name: Doyle Brunson

40619.quote: Money is our madness, our vast collective madness.
40619.name: David Herbert Lawrence

40620.quote: Men make counterfeit money in many more cases, money makes counterfeit men.
40620.name: Sydney J. Harris

40621.quote: No complaint, is more common than that of a scarcity of money.
40621.name: Adam Smith

40622.quote: Wealth flows from energy and ideas.
40622.name: William Feather

40623.quote: I am fiercely loyal to those willing to put their money where my mouth is.
40623.name: Paul Harvey

40624.quote: Many folks think they aren't good at earning money, when what they don't know is how to use it.
40624.name: Frank A. Clark

40625.quote: There was a time when a fool and his money were soon parted, but now it happens to everybody.
40625.name: Adlai E. Stevenson

41491.name: Loretta Young

41492.quote: Well, I thought the deal was, when you went to work for the government you weren't supposed to make money!
41492.name: Joe Biden

41493.quote: When it comes to money nobody should give up anything.
41493.name: Anthony Trollope

41494.quote: In the NFL a lot of times everyone gets caught up in the business side of things. For them it's all about money and it really leaves a sour taste in your mouth.
41494.name: Brett Favre

41495.quote: My recollection is - and I'd have to confirm this - but I don't recall paying any money to go to law school.
41495.name: Joe Biden

41496.quote: I couldn't relate to kid stuff. 'Jimmy doesn't like me!' Who cares? I was worried we didn't have gas money or food. Those were my concerns.
41496.name: Leighton Meester

41497.quote: During the Depression, my dad made radios to sell to make extra money. Nobody had any money to buy the radios, so he would trade them for dogs. He built kennels in the backyard, and he cared for the dogs.
41497.name: Betty White

41498.quote: One thing I have clear is that I don't want to work for money anymore.
41498.name: Antonio Banderas

41499.quote: Money speaks, but it speaks with a male voice.
41499.name: Andrea Dworkin

41500.quote: But it's a blessing to be so successful within a year it's the greatest feeling in the world, making money and doing the things that I'm doing, and I definitely trying to continue doing what I'm doing.
41500.name: Ludacris

41501.quote: What counts in Hollywood is box office. It doesn't really matter what people think of you as an actor because, as long as you have been in a movie that has made money, you will always get another job.
41501.name: Diane Kruger

41502.quote: Research is four things: brains with which to think, eyes with which to see, machines with which to measure and, fourth, money.
41502.name: Albert Szent-Gyorgyi

41503.quote: I could be making a lot more money now if I had chosen a different kind of movie, but none of that matters to me, I've done the parts I wanted to do.
41503.name: Jessica Lange

41504.quote: Because bankers measure their self-worth in money, and pay themselves a lot of it, they think they're fine fellows and don't need to explain themselves.
41504.name: James Buchan

41505.quote: To give money to a woman - and here I must speak as a man - is to deny her special quality, her irreplaceability, and reduce her unique amiability to a commodity. Money takes away her name, while transforming her lover into a nameless customer of a market of appetites.
41505.name: James Buchan

41506.quote: I used to get my money at the end of the week, buy my mum something, or buy a record, and that was it.
41506.name: Elton John

41507.quote: What most people don't seem to realize is that there is just as much money to be made out of the wreckage of a civilization as from the upbuilding of one.
41507.name: Margaret Mitchell

41508.quote: I have no one to leave the money to. I'm a single man. I like spending my money.
41508.name: Elton John

41510.quote: Kids are meant to believe that their stepping stone to massive money is 'The X Factor.'
41510.name: Iain Duncan Smith

41511.quote: The way the bankers have kind of toppled the way money is distributed, and taken most of it into their own hands, is as good as Stalin or Hitler.
41511.name: Mario Batali

41512.quote: I saw Deep Purple live once and I paid money for it and I thought, 'Geez, this is ridiculous.' You just see through all that sort of stuff. I never liked those Deep Purples or those sort of things. I always hated it. I always thought it was a poor man's Led Zeppelin.
41512.name: Angus Young

41513.quote: Thankfully, due to the United Kingdom and the commitment of the Westminster government we are able to ensure that money brought in, whether it be from the City of London or from North Sea oil, can be pooled and directed to wherever it is needed most. That is what being in the United Kingdom is all about.
41513.name: Iain Duncan Smith

41514.quote: Nothing except the mint can make money without advertising.
41514.name: Thomas B. Macaulay

41515.quote: Because I don't take money, I'll go anywhere and do a benefit concert with almost any orchestra.
41515.name: David Ogden Stiers

41516.quote: Kids are meant to believe that their stepping stone to massive money is 'The X Factor.' Luck is great, but most of life is hard work. We do not celebrate people who have made success out of serious hard work.
41516.name: Iain Duncan Smith

41517.quote: The fellow that has no money is poor. The fellow that has nothing but money is poorer still.
41517.name: Billy Sunday

41518.quote: People look at me, and they go, 'You're white, you're smart, you must have went to college. You must have grown up with money.'
41518.name: Adam Carolla

41519.quote: Old friends pass away, new friends appear. It is just like the days. An old day passes, a new day arrives. The important thing is to make it meaningful: a meaningful friend - or a meaningful day.
41519.name: Dalai Lama

41520.quote: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive - to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
41520.name: Marcus Aurelius

41521.quote: Prayer is the key of the morning and the bolt of the evening.
41521.name: Mahatma Gandhi

41522.quote: If it's your job to eat a frog, it's best to do it first thing in the morning. And If it's your job to eat two frogs, it's best to eat the biggest one first.
41522.name: Mark Twain

41523.quote: Today I choose life. Every morning when I wake up I can choose joy, happiness, negativity, pain, To feel the freedom that comes from being able to continue to make mistakes and choices - today I choose to feel life, not to deny my humanity but embrace it.
41523.name: Kevyn Aucoin

41524.quote: I wake up every morning at nine and grab for the morning paper. Then I look at the obituary page. If my name is not on it, I get up.
41524.name: Benjamin Franklin

41525.quote: Love. Fall in love and stay in love. Write only what you love, and love what you write. The key word is love. You have to get up in the morning and write something you love, something to live for.
41525.name: Ray Bradbury

41526.quote: The sun is new each day.
41526.name: Heraclitus

41527.quote: Thank God every morning when you get up that you have something to do that day, which must be done, whether you like it or not.
41527.name: James Russell Lowell

41528.quote: An early-morning walk is a blessing for the whole day.
41528.name: Henry David Thoreau

41529.quote: In the morning a man walks with his whole body in the evening, only with his legs.
41529.name: Ralph Waldo Emerson

41530.quote: Commitment is a big part of what I am and what I believe. How committed are you to winning? How committed are you to being a good friend? To being trustworthy? To being successful? How committed are you to being a good father, a good teammate, a good role model? There's that moment every morning when you look in the mirror: Are you committed, or are you not?
41530.name: LeBron James

41531.quote: I feel sorry for people who don't drink. They wake up in the morning and that's the best they're going to feel all day.
41531.name: Dean Martin

41532.quote: Each day is a little life: every waking and rising a little birth, every fresh morning a little youth, every going to rest and sleep a little death.
41532.name: Arthur Schopenhauer

41533.quote: Think in the morning. Act in the noon. Eat in the evening. Sleep in the night.
41533.name: William Blake

41534.quote: Be pleasant until ten o'clock in the morning and the rest of the day will take care of itself.
41534.name: Elbert Hubbard

41535.quote: The man with the best job in the country is the vice-president. All he has to do is get up every morning and say, 'How is the president?'
41535.name: Will Rogers

41536.quote: I think that when you get dressed in the morning, sometimes you're really making a decision about your behavior for the day. Like if you put on flipflops, you're saying: 'Hope I don't get chased today.' 'Be nice to people in sneakers.'
41536.name: Demetri Martin

41537.quote: Everyone has highs and lows that they have to learn from, but every morning I start off with a good head on my shoulders, saying to myself, 'It's going to be a good day!'.
41537.name: Lindsay Lohan

41538.quote: I miss Saturday morning, rolling out of bed, not shaving, getting into my car with my girls, driving to the supermarket, squeezing the fruit, getting my car washed, taking walks.
41538.name: Barack Obama

41539.quote: Do not say, 'It is morning,' and dismiss it with a name of yesterday. See it for the first time as a newborn child that has no name.
41539.name: Rabindranath Tagore

41540.quote: I have always been delighted at the prospect of a new day, a fresh try, one more start, with perhaps a bit of magic waiting somewhere behind the morning.
41540.name: J. B. Priestley

41541.quote: This morning when I put on my underwear I could hear the fruit-of-the-loom guys laughing at me.
41541.name: Rodney Dangerfield

41542.quote: If you're bored with life - you don't get up every morning with a burning desire to do things - you don't have enough goals.
41542.name: Lou Holtz

41543.quote: When I woke up this morning my girlfriend asked me, 'Did you sleep good?' I said 'No, I made a few mistakes.'
41543.name: Steven Wright

41544.quote: He, who every morning plans the transactions of the day, and follows that plan, carries a thread that will guide him through a labyrinth of the most busy life.
41544.name: Victor Hugo

41545.quote: I wake up some mornings and sit and have my coffee and look out at my beautiful garden, and I go, 'Remember how good this is. Because you can lose it.'
41545.name: Jim Carrey

41546.quote: Nothing is more beautiful than the loveliness of the woods before sunrise.
41546.name: George Washington Carver

41547.quote: Each morning when I awake, I experience again a supreme pleasure - that of being Salvador Dali.
41547.name: Salvador Dali

41548.quote: Opportunities are like sunrises. If you wait too long, you miss them.
41548.name: William Arthur Ward

41549.quote: In a real dark night of the soul, it is always three o'clock in the morning, day after day.
41549.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

41550.quote: Arranging a bowl of flowers in the morning can give a sense of quiet in a crowded day - like writing a poem or saying a prayer.
41550.name: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

41551.quote: It ain't as bad as you think. It will look better in the morning.
41551.name: Colin Powell

41552.quote: Each morning sees some task begun, each evening sees it close Something attempted, something done, has earned a night's repose.
41552.name: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

41553.quote: First thing every morning before you arise say out loud, 'I believe,' three times.
41553.name: Ovid

41554.quote: Every morning I get up and look through the Forbes list of the richest people in America. If I'm not there, I go to work.
41554.name: Robert Orben

41555.quote: Some mornings, it's just not worth chewing through the leather straps.
41555.name: Emo Philips

41556.quote: Manners is the key thing. Say, for instance, when you're growing up, you're walking down the street, you've got to tell everybody good morning. Everybody. You can't pass one person.
41556.name: Usain Bolt

41557.quote: A good idea will keep you awake during the morning, but a great idea will keep you awake during the night.
41557.name: Marilyn vos Savant

41558.quote: Early morning cheerfulness can be extremely obnoxious.
41558.name: William Feather

41559.quote: The problem with marriage is that it ends every night after making love, and it must be rebuilt every morning before breakfast.
41559.name: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

41560.quote: I'm always thinking about creating. My future starts when I wake up every morning, Every day I find something creative to do with my life.
41560.name: Miles Davis

41561.quote: It's always such a joy that you wake up in the morning and there's work to do.
41561.name: Jerome Lawrence

41562.quote: I remind myself every morning: Nothing I say this day will teach me anything. So if I'm going to learn, I must do it by listening.
41562.name: Larry King

41563.quote: Good morning is a contradiction of terms.
41563.name: Jim Davis

41564.quote: I had a monumental idea this morning, but I didn't like it.
41564.name: Samuel Goldwyn

41565.quote: I love the smell of juice boxes in the morning.
41565.name: Robert Duvall

41566.quote: I never really look for anything. What God throws my way comes. I wake up in the morning and whichever way God turns my feet, I go.
41566.name: Pearl Bailey

41567.quote: Lose an hour in the morning, and you will spend all day looking for it.
41567.name: Richard Whately

41568.quote: The most efficient way to live reasonably is every morning to make a plan of one's day and every night to examine the results obtained.
41568.name: Alexis Carrel

41569.quote: If some great catastrophe is not announced every morning, we feel a certain void. Nothing in the paper today, we sigh.
41569.name: Lord Acton

41570.quote: Morning comes whether you set the alarm or not.
41570.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

41571.quote: Never face facts if you do you'll never get up in the morning.
41571.name: Marlo Thomas

41572.quote: Tell him he can have my title, but I want it back in the morning.
41572.name: Jack Dempsey

41573.quote: We could hardly wait to get up in the morning.
41573.name: Wilbur Wright

41574.quote: It was a splendid summer morning and it seemed as if nothing could go wrong.
41574.name: John Cheever

41575.quote: I feel sorry for people who don't drink. When they wake up in the morning, that's as good as they're going to feel all day.
41575.name: Frank Sinatra

41576.quote: I may be drunk, Miss, but in the morning I will be sober and you will still be ugly.
41576.name: Winston Churchill

41577.quote: My formula for living is quite simple. I get up in the morning and I go to bed at night. In between, I occupy myself as best I can.
41577.name: Cary Grant

41578.quote: For the past 33 years, I have looked in the mirror every morning and asked myself: 'If today were the last day of my life, would I want to do what I am about to do today?' And whenever the answer has been 'No' for too many days in a row, I know I need to change something.
41578.name: Steve Jobs

41579.quote: A good wife is one who serves her husband in the morning like a mother does, loves him in the day like a sister does and pleases him like a prostitute in the night.
41579.name: Chanakya

41580.quote: It is well enough that people of the nation do not understand our banking and monetary system, for if they did, I believe there would be a revolution before tomorrow morning.
41580.name: Henry Ford

41581.quote: I arise in the morning torn between a desire to improve the world and a desire to enjoy the world. This makes it hard to plan the day.
41581.name: E. B. White

41582.quote: In the sweetness of friendship let there be laughter, and sharing of pleasures. For in the dew of little things the heart finds its morning and is refreshed.
41582.name: Khalil Gibran

41583.quote: When you rise in the morning, give thanks for the light, for your life, for your strength. Give thanks for your food and for the joy of living. If you see no reason to give thanks, the fault lies in yourself.
41583.name: Tecumseh

41584.quote: The brain is a wonderful organ it starts working the moment you get up in the morning and does not stop until you get into the office.
41584.name: Robert Frost

41585.quote: Probably the happiest period in life most frequently is in middle age, when the eager passions of youth are cooled, and the infirmities of age not yet begun as we see that the shadows, which are at morning and evening so large, almost entirely disappear at midday.
41585.name: Eleanor Roosevelt

41586.quote: True terror is to wake up one morning and discover that your high school class is running the country.
41586.name: Kurt Vonnegut

41587.quote: I have to be alone very often. I'd be quite happy if I spent from Saturday night until Monday morning alone in my apartment. That's how I refuel.
41587.name: Audrey Hepburn

41588.quote: If you're going to do something tonight that you'll be sorry for tomorrow morning, sleep late.
41588.name: Henny Youngman

41589.quote: What's money? A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
41589.name: Bob Dylan

41590.quote: Who will tell whether one happy moment of love or the joy of breathing or walking on a bright morning and smelling the fresh air, is not worth all the suffering and effort which life implies.
41590.name: Erich Fromm

41591.quote: I look upon death to be as necessary to our constitution as sleep. We shall rise refreshed in the morning.
41591.name: Benjamin Franklin

41592.quote: After all those years as a woman hearing 'not thin enough, not pretty enough, not smart enough, not this enough, not that enough,' almost overnight I woke up one morning and thought, 'I'm enough.'
41592.name: Anna Quindlen

41593.quote: There's nothing sadder in this world than to awake Christmas morning and not be a child.
41593.name: Erma Bombeck

41594.quote: A good husband is never the first to go to sleep at night or the last to awake in the morning.
41594.name: Honore de Balzac

41595.quote: All men are children, and of one family. The same tale sends them all to bed, and wakes them in the morning.
41595.name: Henry David Thoreau

41596.quote: I've been saying for a couple of years now that people need to let God out of the Sunday morning box, that He doesn't want to just be with you for an hour or two on Sunday morning and then put back in His box to sit there until you have an emergency, but He wants to invade your Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
41596.name: Joyce Meyer

41597.quote: It is a common experience that a problem difficult at night is resolved in the morning after the committee of sleep has worked on it.
41597.name: John Steinbeck

41598.quote: The light which puts out our eyes is darkness to us. Only that day dawns to which we are awake. There is more day to dawn. The sun is but a morning star.
41598.name: Henry David Thoreau

41599.quote: One morning I shot an elephant in my pajamas. How he got into my pajamas I'll never know.
41599.name: Groucho Marx

41600.quote: I recently took up ice sculpting. Last night I made an ice cube. This morning I made 12, I was prolific.
41600.name: Mitch Hedberg

41601.quote: Every morning I jump out of bed and step on a landmine. The landmine is me. After the explosion, I spent the rest of the day putting the pieces together.
41601.name: Ray Bradbury

41602.quote: I have a great deal of company in the house, especially in the morning when nobody calls.
41602.name: Henry David Thoreau

41603.quote: In my afternoon walk I would fain forget all my morning occupations and my obligations to society.
41603.name: Henry David Thoreau

41604.quote: And this President wakes up every morning, looks out across America and is proud to announce, 'It could be worse.' It could be worse? Is that what it means to be an American? It could be worse? Of course not. What defines us as Americans is our unwavering conviction that we know it must be better.
41604.name: Mitt Romney

41605.quote: Just in terms of allocation of time resources, religion is not very efficient. There's a lot more I could be doing on a Sunday morning.
41605.name: Bill Gates

41606.quote: A leaf fluttered in through the window this morning, as if supported by the rays of the sun, a bird settled on the fire escape, joy in the task of coffee, joy accompanied me as I walked.
41606.name: Anais Nin

41607.quote: I love that feeling of being in love, the effect of having butterflies when you wake up in the morning. That is special.
41607.name: Jennifer Aniston

41608.quote: The person who doesn't scatter the morning dew will not comb gray hairs.
41608.name: Hunter S. Thompson

41609.quote: Burning desire to be or do something gives us staying power - a reason to get up every morning or to pick ourselves up and start in again after a disappointment.
41609.name: Marsha Sinetar

41610.quote: To be intimate with a married man, when my own father cheated on my mother, is not something I could forgive. I could not look at myself in the morning if I did that. I wouldn't be attracted to a man who would cheat on his wife.
41610.name: Angelina Jolie

41611.quote: I have retired, but if there's anything that would kill me it is to wake up in the morning not knowing what to do.
41611.name: Nelson Mandela

41612.quote: Mom and Dad were married 64 years. And if you wondered what their secret was, you could have asked the local florist - because every day Dad gave Mom a rose, which he put on her bedside table. That's how she found out what happened on the day my father died - she went looking for him because that morning, there was no rose.
41612.name: Mitt Romney

41613.quote: I woke up one morning thinking about wolves and realized that wolf packs function as families. Everyone has a role, and if you act within the parameters of your role, the whole pack succeeds, and when that falls apart, so does the pack.
41613.name: Jodi Picoult

41614.quote: There's pros and cons of a big church. Cons is I don't get to know everybody, I don't get to go to their ballgame, I don't get to marry everybody, but the pros are you get all this community, 800 ushers come in to serve, getting there at 7 in the morning on their day off and coming in on Saturday to make all those wafers.
41614.name: Joel Osteen

41615.quote: Morning without you is a dwindled dawn.
41615.name: Emily Dickinson

41616.quote: We sleep, but the loom of life never stops, and the pattern which was weaving when the sun went down is weaving when it comes up in the morning.
41616.name: Henry Ward Beecher

41617.quote: My mother had morning sickness after I was born.
41617.name: Rodney Dangerfield

41618.quote: If one morning I walked on top of the water across the Potomac River, the headline that afternoon would read: 'President Can't Swim.'
41618.name: Lyndon B. Johnson

41619.quote: I slept with faith and found a corpse in my arms on awakening I drank and danced all night with doubt and found her a virgin in the morning.
41619.name: Aleister Crowley

41620.quote: It was one of those evenings when men feel that truth, goodness and beauty are one. In the morning, when they commit their discovery to paper, when others read it written there, it looks wholly ridiculous.
41620.name: Aldous Huxley

41621.quote: I think about baseball when I wake up in the morning. I think about it all day and I dream about it at night. The only time I don't think about it is when I'm playing it.
41621.name: Carl Yastrzemski

41622.quote: I think it's been hard for people to understand how Islam can be a good religion, and yet the Islamists are evil. Those of us who have had experience with Islam understand this, just as we understand the difference between snake handlers and people going to church on Sunday morning.
41622.name: P. J. O'Rourke

41623.quote: Nature gives to every time and season some beauties of its own and from morning to night, as from the cradle to the grave, it is but a succession of changes so gentle and easy that we can scarcely mark their progress.
41623.name: Charles Dickens

41624.quote: The great fun in my life has been getting up every morning and rushing to the typewriter because some new idea has hit me.
41624.name: Ray Bradbury

41625.quote: When traveling with someone, take large does of patience and tolerance with your morning coffee.
41625.name: Helen Hayes

41626.quote: Freedom itself was attacked this morning by a faceless coward, and freedom will be defended.
41626.name: George W. Bush

41627.quote: I would like to find a stew that will give me heartburn immediately, instead of at three o clock in the morning.
41627.name: John Barrymore

41628.quote: That's the trouble with being me. At this point, nobody gives a damn what my problem is. I could literally have a tumor on the side of my head and they'd be like, 'Yeah, big deal. I'd eat a tumor every morning for the kinda money you're pulling down.'
41628.name: Jim Carrey

41629.quote: In these times you have to be an optimist to open your eyes when you awake in the morning.
41629.name: Carl Sandburg

41630.quote: Hope is the greatest thing for moms of autism. Hope is what gets us out of bed in the morning. I'm on a mission to tell parents that there is a way.
41630.name: Jenny McCarthy

41631.quote: I like to use 'I Can't Believe it's Not Butter' on my toast in the morning, because sometimes when I eat breakfast, I like to be incredulous. How was breakfast? Unbelievable.
41631.name: Demetri Martin

41632.quote: Human life is as evanescent as the morning dew or a flash of lightning.
41632.name: Samuel Butler

41633.quote: There is no friend like an old friend who has shared our morning days, no greeting like his welcome, no homage like his praise.
41633.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

41634.quote: I myself spent nine years in an insane asylum and I never had the obsession of suicide, but I know that each conversation with a psychiatrist, every morning at the time of his visit, made me want to hang myself, realizing that I would not be able to cut his throat.
41634.name: Antonin Artaud

41635.quote: Man is born in a day, and he dies in a day, and the thing is easily over but to have a sick heart for three-fourths of one's lifetime is simply to have death renewed every morning and life at that price is not worth living.
41635.name: Gilbert Parker

41636.quote: If you want to be an entrepreneur, it's not a job, it's a lifestyle. It defines you. Forget about vacations, about going home at 6 pm - last thing at night you'll send emails, first thing in the morning you'll read emails, and you'll wake up in the middle of the night. But it's hugely rewarding as you're fulfilling something for yourself.
41636.name: Niklas Zennstrom

41637.quote: The thing I love most about going on vacation is that I get to leave behind any kind of schedule. My entire life is scheduled from morning to night, and when I'm on vacation, there is no schedule.
41637.name: Kelly Clarkson

41638.quote: I never married because there was no need. I have three pets at home which answer the same purpose as a husband. I have a dog which growls every morning, a parrot which swears all afternoon, and a cat that comes home late at night.
41638.name: Marie Corelli

41639.quote: When I woke up Sunday morning at the Open and stepped outside and felt the wind and rain in my face, I knew I had an excellent chance to win if I just took my time and trusted myself.
41639.name: Tom Kite

41640.quote: On Sunday morning, I'm not nervous, I can't wait to tell what God wants me to say.
41640.name: Charles Stanley

41641.quote: It seems to me that trying to live without friends is like milking a bear to get cream for your morning coffee. It is a whole lot of trouble, and then not worth much after you get it.
41641.name: Zora Neale Hurston

41642.quote: The happiest part of a man's life is what he passes lying awake in bed in the morning.
41642.name: Samuel Johnson

41643.quote: The bed is a bundle of paradoxes: we go to it with reluctance, yet we quit it with regret we make up our minds every night to leave it early, but we make up our bodies every morning to keep it late.
41643.name: Ogden Nash

41644.quote: I protest that if some great Power would agree to make me always think what is true and do what is right, on condition of being turned into a sort of clock and would up every morning before I got out of bed, I should instantly close with the offer.
41644.name: Thomas Huxley

41645.quote: It is a matter of shame that in the morning the birds should be awake earlier than you.
41645.name: Abu Bakr

41646.quote: It is a good morning exercise for a research scientist to discard a pet hypothesis every day before breakfast. It keeps him young.
41646.name: Konrad Lorenz

41647.quote: There is only one thing that a man really wants to do, all his life and that is, to find his way to his God, his Morning Star, salute his fellow man, and enjoy the woman who has come the long way with him.
41647.name: David Herbert Lawrence

41648.quote: And I know this happens because I took economics, and I'd explain it to ya, but I flunked that course. Not my fault. They taught it at 8 o'clock in the morning. And there is absolutely nothing you can learn out of one bloodshot eye.
41648.name: Lewis Black

41649.quote: Then there is a still higher type of courage - the courage to brave pain, to live with it, to never let others know of it and to still find joy in life to wake up in the morning with an enthusiasm for the day ahead.
41649.name: Howard Cosell

41650.quote: Make sure you never, never argue at night. You just lose a good night's sleep, and you can't settle anything until morning anyway.
41650.name: Rose Kennedy

41651.quote: I have so many things to work on, and so many ways that I fail. But that's what grace is all about. and I constantly wake up every morning trying to get better, trying to improve, trying to walk closer to God.
41651.name: Tim Tebow

41652.quote: My children are the reason I laugh, smile and want to get up every morning.
41652.name: Gena Lee Nolin

41653.quote: What is love? It is the morning and the evening star.
41653.name: Sinclair Lewis

41654.quote: On a day when you're tired, it's important to just say good morning to everyone so they're kind of aware that it's gonna be a good day. Jamie Lee Curtis told me that.
41654.name: Lindsay Lohan

41655.quote: On that Sunday morning the first thing that impressed the people who approached the tomb was the unusual position of the one and a half to two ton stone that had been lodged in front of the doorway.
41655.name: Josh McDowell

41656.quote: A bachelor is a man who comes to work each morning from a different direction.
41656.name: Sholom Aleichem

41657.quote: Like a morning dream, life becomes more and more bright the longer we live, and the reason of everything appears more clear. What has puzzled us before seems less mysterious, and the crooked paths look straighter as we approach the end.
41657.name: Jean Paul

41658.quote: Every year, August lashes out in volcanic fury, rising with the din of morning traffic, its great metallic wings smashing against the ground, heating the air with ever-increasing intensity.
41658.name: Henry Rollins

41659.quote: I am so blessed. I've been way over-blessed. At 64 years old, I look forward to going to bed every night so I can wake up in the morning and see what blessing is going to come my way that day. Because you never, ever know what God's got in store for you.
41659.name: Paula Deen

41660.quote: Above all, this country is our own. Nobody has to get up in the morning and worry what his neighbors think of him. Being a Jew is no problem here.
41660.name: Golda Meir

41661.quote: I always do an all-night horror marathon on Saturdays where we start at seven and go until five in the morning.
41661.name: Quentin Tarantino

41662.quote: Art is why I get up in the morning but my definition ends there. You know I don't think its fair that I'm living for something I can't even define.
41662.name: Ani DiFranco

41663.quote: Your body tells you what it needs, and if you sleep past your alarm on a Saturday morning, it's probably because you need the sleep.
41663.name: Sophia Bush

41664.quote: You wake up in the morning and you look at your old spoon, and you say to yourself, 'Mick, it's time to get yourself a new spoon.' And you do.
41664.name: Mick Jagger

41665.quote: I, of course, meditate for two hours every morning. It's part of my schedule I wake up at 4 a.m. every day and I love it.
41665.name: Deepak Chopra

41666.quote: I spend my happiest hours in reading Vedantic books. They are to me like the light of the morning, like the pure air of the mountains - so simple, so true, if once understood.
41666.name: Max Muller

41667.quote: I love being. There's so much wisdom in it. You wake up in the morning and you think, Hey, isn't it great just being?
41667.name: Gwyneth Paltrow

41668.quote: I never knew a man come to greatness or eminence who lay abed late in the morning.
41668.name: Jonathan Swift

41669.quote: Cinema in India is like brushing your teeth in the morning. You can't escape it.
41669.name: Shahrukh Khan

41670.quote: The great secret of doctors, known only to their wives, but still hidden from the public, is that most things get better by themselves most things, in fact, are better in the morning.
41670.name: Lewis Thomas

41671.quote: What inspires you, what excites you when you wake up in the morning?
41671.name: Jennifer Aniston

41672.quote: Smile in the mirror. Do that every morning and you'll start to see a big difference in your life.
41672.name: Yoko Ono

41673.quote: I'm going to marry a Jewish woman because I like the idea of getting up Sunday morning and going to the deli.
41673.name: Michael J. Fox

41674.quote: And if small businesspeople say they made it on their own, all they are saying is that nobody else worked seven days a week in their place. Nobody showed up in their place to open the door at five in the morning. Nobody did their thinking, and worrying, and sweating for them.
41674.name: Paul Ryan

41675.quote: Driving a motorcycle is like flying. All your senses are alive. When I ride through Beverly Hills in the early morning, and all the sprinklers have turned off, the scents that wash over me are just heavenly. Being House is like flying, too. You're free of the gravity of what people think.
41675.name: Hugh Laurie

41676.quote: The two most joyous times of the year are Christmas morning and the end of school.
41676.name: Alice Cooper

41677.quote: A play is much easier to maintain your personal life with because if you're rehearsing, you're working like from 11 to 6 or 11 to 5 and you get to have your whole morning and your whole evening. When you're doing the play, you have all day.
41677.name: Maggie Gyllenhaal

41678.quote: There was a chance for me to write one song for the section where Elvis sat in his black leather outfit and sang the old hits. At eight oclock the next morning I had written Memories.
41678.name: Mac Davis

41679.quote: When I wake up in the morning, I feel just like any other insecure 24-year-old girl.
41679.name: Lady Gaga

41680.quote: How like herrings and onions our vices are in the morning after we have committed them.
41680.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

41681.quote: When I travel, I like to take advantage of room service. I'm really into eggs Benedict in the morning.
41681.name: Jenny McCarthy

41682.quote: There is a one woman in China that claimed she paid $50 to get my e-mail address. It was pretty shocking. I got one this morning from Scotland. A girl's requesting a signed photo of me.
41682.name: Michael Phelps

41683.quote: First of all, let me say, 1:15 in the morning, for 20,000 people to still be here, I wasn't the winner, tennis was. That's awesome. I don't know if I've ever felt so good here before.
41683.name: Andre Agassi

41684.quote: In the morning we received some very thin coffee. For lunch we had potato soup with a few pieces of meat in it, in the evening we had a very thin meat soup with some potatoes in it.
41684.name: Leon Askin

41685.quote: I woke up one morning to find I was famous. I bought a white Rolls-Royce and drove down Sunset Boulevard, wearing dark specs and a white suit, waving like the Queen Mum.
41685.name: Peter O'Toole

41686.quote: I am not a morning person. I like to sleep in.
41686.name: Martha Plimpton

41687.quote: I try to make films that I find exciting. It makes me want to get out of bed at five in the morning, have my make-up done and play for the rest of the day.
41687.name: Kristin Scott Thomas

41688.quote: Making films can be absolutely fantastic, but it can also be incredibly dull. You spend the whole day sitting by yourself in your trailer and then you get called to deliver one sentence - then you're told to come back and do it again at 5:30 the following morning.
41688.name: Kristin Scott Thomas

41689.quote: What's the first thing I do when I wake up in the morning? Wish I hadn't.
41689.name: Steven Patrick Morrissey

41690.quote: I drink a bucket of white tea in the morning. I read about this tea of the Emperor of China, which is supposedly the tea of eternal youth. It's called Silver Needle. It's unbelievably expensive, but I get it on the Web.
41690.name: Antonio Banderas

41691.quote: It was really like waking up one morning and going, Wow, I enjoy being with this person more than anybody else in my life, and it just turned out to be mutual.
41691.name: Brian Austin Green

41692.quote: I have never been bored an hour in my life. I get up every morning wondering what new strange glamorous thing is going to happen and it happens at fairly regular intervals.
41692.name: William Allen White

41693.quote: Get up tomorrow early in the morning, and earlier than you did today, and do the best that you can. Always stay near me, for tomorrow I will have much to do and more than I ever had, and tomorrow blood will leave my body above the breast.
41693.name: Joan of Arc

41694.quote: I'd hate to be a teetotaler. Imagine getting up in the morning and knowing that's as good as you're going to feel all day.
41694.name: Dean Martin

41695.quote: I get up early in the morning, 4 o'clock, and I sit at my desk and what I do is just dream. After three or four hours, that's enough. In the afternoon, I run.
41695.name: Haruki Murakami

41696.quote: Somebody said to me this morning, 'To what do you attribute your longevity?' I don't know. I mean, I couldn't have planned my life out better. By all accounts I should be dead! The abuse I put my body through: the drugs, the alcohol, the lifestyle I've lived the last 30 years!
41696.name: Ozzy Osbourne

41697.quote: Training is full-on. Some days I really don't want to get out of bed and hit that track again. Sunday and Monday morning sessions are always horrible. But who really looks forward to going to work on a Monday morning?
41697.name: Jessica Ennis

41698.quote: I'll never forget one morning I walked in and I had a hell of a bruise - it had been a difficult night the night before - and a client said to me, 'Good God, Vidal, what happened to your face?' And I said, 'Oh, nothing, madam, I just fell over a hairpin.'
41698.name: Vidal Sassoon

41699.quote: I should just put it bluntly, because we're all sort of friends here now - it's exceedingly likely that my greatest success is behind me. Oh, so Jesus, what a thought! You know that's the kind of thought that could lead a person to start drinking gin at nine o'clock in the morning, and I don't want to go there.
41699.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

41700.quote: There's nothing in the world more silent than the telephone the morning after everybody pans your play. It won't ring from room service your mother won't be calling you. If the phone has not rung by 8 in the morning, you're dead.
41700.name: David Mamet

41701.quote: I'm a car fanatic and each morning I wake up with a smile on my face, whether I'm commentating on the Formula One or at Silver Hatch racetrack in Roary the Racing Car.
41701.name: Murray Walker

41702.quote: The day of the sun is like the day of a king. It is a promenade in the morning, a sitting on the throne at noon, a pageant in the evening.
41702.name: Wallace Stevens

41703.quote: When you walk out of your house in the morning, you don't know what you're going to see.
41703.name: Kyle Chandler

41704.quote: Chronic malnutrition, or the lack of proper nutrition over time directly contributes to three times as many child deaths as food scarcity. Yet surprisingly, you don't really hear about this hidden crisis through the morning news, Twitter or headlines of major newspapers.
41704.name: Cat Cora

41705.quote: I worked at Salon.com way back when they started, and there's just unmeasurable value to distributing words online, too, but I still get my news from the newspaper in the morning.
41705.name: Dave Eggers

41706.quote: I mean, if you have to wake up in the morning to be validated by the editorial page of the New York Times, you got a pretty sorry existence.
41706.name: Karl Rove

41707.quote: Early this morning, I signed my death warrant.
41707.name: Michael Collins

41708.quote: For me the greatest revenge of all is having a happy adulthood, waking up in my gorgeous turquoise bedroom in the morning beside a person who really inspires me. That's the best revenge a girl-loving girl from the Bible belt could possibly have. And, importantly, it's healthy.
41708.name: Beth Ditto

41709.quote: For us political activists and candidates, the morning after any election is a mix of emotions - the personal and the immediate, the culmination of your own recent campaigning efforts and the fortunes of your party and the success or otherwise of what you stand for and believe in.
41709.name: Lucy Powell

41710.quote: One morning, about four o'clock, I was driving my car just about as fast as I could. I thought, Why am I out this time of night? I was miserable, and it came to me: I'm falling in love with somebody I have no right to fall in love with.
41710.name: June Carter Cash

41711.quote: I think my real depressions started when I was about 16 and doing The Patty Duke Show. I would go to bed at about 10 o'clock on a Friday night and not get up again until 6:30 Monday morning.
41711.name: Patty Duke

41712.quote: I am a fashion designer. I'm not an environmentalist. When I get up in the morning, number one I'm a mother and a wife, and number two I design clothes. So the main thing I need to do is create, hopefully, exquisitely beautiful, desirable objects for my customer.
41712.name: Stella McCartney

41713.quote: It was huge to read the Proverbs of the day every morning, it was huge to read the Psalm of the day every morning and to get that in us and get us going before the day even started.
41713.name: Tim Tebow

41714.quote: You know how you wake up in the morning and sometimes you look gorgeous and other times you look like you got hit by a mack truck? I realized that my mack truck is food. If I have no sugar, yeast or wine, I have no undereye bags and my skin is perfect.
41714.name: Mariska Hargitay

41715.quote: I exercise every morning. I do light weights - 5lb and 10lb arm exercises - and then lie and lift my arms and legs. It's all about keeping core strength. I do a lot of stretching too.
41715.name: Larry Hagman

41716.quote: Later, in the early teens, I used to ride my bike every Saturday morning to the nearest airport, ten miles away, push airplanes in and out of the hangars, and clean up the hangars.
41716.name: Alan Shepard

41717.quote: My days, if they start in the morning with a cuddle from my son, are just so much more glorious than they were prior to that.
41717.name: Russell Crowe

41718.quote: Every morning I wake at 6am or 6.30am, champing at the bit.
41718.name: John Grisham

41719.quote: The quality of life is so much higher anyplace you can ski in the morning and surf in the evening - there's something to be said for that.
41719.name: Ian Somerhalder

41720.quote: I had the perfect job for a gamer. From February to October, I'd get up at 7 in the morning with nothing to do but play games until I had to be at the park around 1 or 2 o'clock. When I got back after the game, I played until 3 or 4 in the morning.
41720.name: Curt Schilling

41721.quote: I started running 3 miles every morning after throat surgery to remove a cyst last year. The gym used to be my adversary. But that has all changed. Now, I look forward to it every morning.
41721.name: Rachael Ray

41722.quote: Sometimes I wake up in the morning and I am like, 'This is a high-top day' or 'This is a bob day,' but when I get my clothes on that's when I see.
41722.name: Nicki Minaj

41723.quote: When I get up in the morning and put on a pink or a green wig, I see myself as a piece of animation. It lets me be the person I want to be, a person who's not embarrassed to have fun.
41723.name: Nicki Minaj

41724.quote: My brain is so anxiety-prone, like a pinball machine. If I don't get up in the morning and focus my thinking, my breathing, and my being for about 12 minutes, I'm just a screwball all day long.
41724.name: Rainn Wilson

41725.quote: I always like to start my morning with a good amount of fruit. I really like pineapple, particularly because of the enzymes that it has. Sometimes I have oatmeal. But if I'm feeling like I really want to be watching my weight more, then I definitely do a protein, like an omelet, scrambled eggs or some smoked salmon.
41725.name: Cynthia Nixon

41726.quote: Couldn't start the morning without caffeine.
41726.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

41727.quote: I really am super lazy and doing long hair, especially mine, is a big pain in the butt. It's filled with cowlicks and kinks and curls and frizz - and it was taking too much time in the morning.
41727.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

41728.quote: I loved fantasy, but I particularly loved the stories in which somebody got out of where they were and into somewhere better - as in the 'Chronicles Of Narnia,' 'The Wizard Of Oz,' 'The Phantom Tollbooth,' the 'Dungeons &amp Dragons' cartoon on Saturday morning in the '80s.
41728.name: Lev Grossman

41729.quote: I have an orthopedic pillow that's made out of a sponge material. I have a plate in my throat, and I have to be careful or I could end up with a bad neck in the morning. That pillow is a must everywhere I go.
41729.name: Lee Trevino

41730.quote: When you really deep down look at it, we go to bed every night, get up every morning, stay here for 70 or 80 years, and then we die.
41730.name: Lee Trevino

41731.quote: The most used piece of kit in my kitchen is my saucepan. I use it every morning to cook my porridge in. The least used piece of equipment? I'd say a food mixer. I've never used it, I don't really know what they're for.
41731.name: David Walliams

41732.quote: I have a Viking stove. The color is butter lemon, and I had to wait several months for it, because that color wasn't available and I really wanted butter lemon! But I don't know that it's seriously ever been cooked on. I mean, I make tea every morning. Does that count?
41732.name: Andy Cohen

41733.quote: Thanks to the greatest invention of recent years, the MP3-playing alarm clock, I can now choose the song that wakes me up in the morning.
41733.name: Rob Sheffield

41734.quote: Stood off and on during the night, determining not to come to anchor till morning, fearing to meet with shoals continued our course in the morning and as the island was found to be six or seven leagues distant, and the tide was against us, it was noon when we arrived there.
41734.name: Christopher Columbus

41735.quote: Tomorrow morning before we depart, I intend to land and see what can be found in the neighborhood.
41735.name: Christopher Columbus

41736.quote: You've got to set yourself up to be as healthy as you can. The thing we tend to do is when it gets to be a bit too hard, we actually opt out for the absolute worst option. For example, if you're in a rush in a morning and you feel like you don't have time to make breakfast, you skip it.
41736.name: Curtis Stone

41737.quote: I'm not a morning person. I'm really not.
41737.name: Brooke Burke

41738.quote: My extravagance is my garden - it's the first thing I look at every morning when I wake up. It gives me so much pleasure.
41738.name: Ina Garten

41739.quote: It is a challenge, with the global fame, to try to act like I put my pants on one leg at a time, when in fact I have Pippa Middleton help me put my pants on every morning. She's my lady-in-waiting as well.
41739.name: Kathy Griffin

41740.quote: I never laugh or smile when I am writing. When I come home for lunch after writing all morning, my wife says I look like I just came home from a funeral. This is not bragging. This is an illness.
41740.name: Carl Hiaasen

41741.quote: When I wake up in the morning, I feel like a billionaire without paying taxes.
41741.name: Ernie Banks

41742.quote: I wake up early in the morning and walk for an hour. If I have something to write, I prefer to write in the morning until midday, and in the afternoon, I eat.
41742.name: Naguib Mahfouz

41743.quote: I was a government employee in the morning and a writer in the evening.
41743.name: Naguib Mahfouz

41744.quote: I kind of woke up one morning and was like, 'Oh I see what's happening, I get everything'. I woke up and was like, 'I get it, I'm a product.'
41744.name: Taylor Momsen

41745.quote: We were doing it under the most extraordinary circumstances, but the first out of the tent in the morning would be David Lean. He said to me on the very first day of shooting, Pete, this is the beginning of a great adventure.
41745.name: Peter O'Toole

41746.quote: Most songs have meager beginnings. You wake up in the morning, you throw on your suspenders, and you subvocalize and just think. They seem to form like calcium. I can't think of a story right off the bat that was that interesting. I write things on the back of my hand, usually, and sing into a tape recorder.
41746.name: Tom Waits

41747.quote: Hitchhiking was such a pure form of existence. You'd wake up in the morning, and you'd have no idea what your day was going to be. And that's something I've never been able to shake. I loved that.
41747.name: John Hawkes

41748.quote: I had the closest thing I have ever had to an out-of-body experience lying in bed one morning. I turned on the 'Today' programme and item four on the news was: 'The shadow chancellor has ruled himself out of the leadership.' I lay there thinking that's interesting, then I realised it was me.
41748.name: George Osborne

41749.quote: I half knew what to expect when I saw the cricket ground in the morning. It was when I started to talk to people working out there, I began to find what I was looking for.
41749.name: Ian Botham

41750.quote: I wake up laughing. Yes, I wake up in the morning and there I am just laughing my head off.
41750.name: Bruce Willis

41751.quote: I love such mirth as does not make friends ashamed to look upon one another next morning.
41751.name: Izaak Walton

41752.quote: I am really passionate about my career and my music and I am so lucky to be able to do what I do for a job, so for all the early morning starts and long days, I could never trade it all in.
41752.name: Rachel Stevens

41753.quote: London is completely unpredictable when it comes to weather. You'll start a scene, and it's a beautiful morning. You get there at 6 in the morning, set up, you start the scene, start shooting. Three hours later, it is pitch black and rainy.
41753.name: David Schwimmer

41754.quote: I derive no pleasure from prosecuting a man, even though I know he's guilty do you think I could sleep at night or look at myself in the mirror in the morning if I hounded an innocent man?
41754.name: Jim Garrison

41755.quote: I was the type of guy that used to get up in the morning and go out and just out run everybody on the field without stretching or warming up or anything.
41755.name: Bo Jackson

41756.quote: Of all the songs I've recorded, 'Amarillo By Morning' always sticks out in my mind.
41756.name: George Strait

41757.quote: I don't mind traveling that much when I can go somewhere and stay there for a while, but touring is different. You rarely see anything. You get there early in the morning and you're resting all day, and you go in and do a sound check, and you do the show, and then bam you're gone.
41757.name: George Strait

41758.quote: The repose of sleep refreshes only the body. It rarely sets the soul at rest. The repose of the night does not belong to us. It is not the possession of our being. Sleep opens within us an inn for phantoms. In the morning we must sweep out the shadows.
41758.name: Gaston Bachelard

41759.quote: Too much coffee. Too much coffee and Gatorade. It's a hell of a mix. If you're ever tired in the morning, just try that mix, and tell me what you think.
41759.name: Kevin Garnett

41760.quote: My principal motivation is supporting my family, which is not a bad reason for getting up in the morning. That's always been my motivation - to take care of the people who rely on me.
41760.name: Tony Parsons

41761.quote: I have to say that when you tour the world, obviously, the jetlags and different hours and ways of living and traveling, a lot of hours in the plane, and you wake up in the morning and you're not quite sure where you are, and it is very tiring.
41761.name: Celine Dion

41762.quote: If we were to wake up some morning and find that everyone was the same race, creed and color, we would find some other causes for prejudice by noon.
41762.name: George Aiken

41763.quote: I eat as much as the next girl, but I work my butt of in the gym every morning! The key is moderation. I splurge on the weekend. A big bowl of pasta and a delicious slice of cake for dessert are my favorites.
41763.name: Giuliana Rancic

41764.quote: In live action movies, you just hope that everything works. Because the actor may had a bad morning and doesn't play good, or accidents happen continuously. Many things contradict what you are trying to say. But in cartoons, nothing contradict what you want to say.
41764.name: John Hench

41765.quote: I've never been a TV junkie. I remember watching Letterman way back when he had a morning show.
41765.name: Todd Barry

41766.quote: If you're changing the world, you're working on important things. You're excited to get up in the morning.
41766.name: Larry Page

41767.quote: My wife gets all the money I make. I just get an apple and clean clothes every morning.
41767.name: Ray Romano

41768.quote: Wherever my story takes me, however dark and difficult the theme, there is always some hope and redemption, not because readers like happy endings, but because I am an optimist at heart. I know the sun will rise in the morning, that there is a light at the end of every tunnel.
41768.name: Michael Morpurgo

41769.quote: What I couldn't help noticing was that I learned more about the novel in a morning by trying to write a page of one than I'd learned in seven years or so of trying to write criticism.
41769.name: Philip Pullman

41770.quote: I was so obsessed by this problem that I was thinking about it all the time - when I woke up in the morning, when I went to sleep at night - and that went on for eight years.
41770.name: Andrew Wiles

41771.quote: There's also a sense of freedom. I was so obsessed by this problem that I was thinking about if all the time - when I woke up in the morning, when I went to sleep at night, and that went on for eight years.
41771.name: Andrew Wiles

41772.quote: Prince used to call me up 3am in the morning and invite me to hear some of his new songs.
41772.name: Sheena Easton

41773.quote: The one ironclad rule is that I have to try. I have to walk into my writing room and pick up my pen every weekday morning.
41773.name: Anne Tyler

41774.quote: To drive an F1 car you have to be a little mad. On the morning of a race there's a mix of excitement and fear. If it's a wet track, then it's worse as you're not in control most of the time, which is the thing all drivers fear the most.
41774.name: Jenson Button

41775.quote: A lot of people think Formula One isn't a sport because everyone drives a car when they go to work in the morning. But we're pulling up to six G on a corner or during breaking, which is almost like being a fighter pilot. So we have to do a lot of work on our neck muscles.
41775.name: Jenson Button

41776.quote: How many women have the courage to start properly with a cold, cold bath early in the morning? I jump in, throw the water, cold as ice, and after the first plunge I am happy.
41776.name: Anna Held

41777.quote: I am not a morning person.
41777.name: Laurell K. Hamilton

41778.quote: I couldn't wait for the sun to come up the next morning so that I could get out on the course again.
41778.name: Ben Hogan

41779.quote: Whereas I used to get depressed or neurotic or dwell on things, I see my son's bright eyes and smile in the morning, and suddenly, I don't feel like I'm depressed anymore. There's nothing to be depressed about when you've got that.
41779.name: Corey Feldman

41780.quote: Most of the top actors and actresses may be working in ten or twelve films at the same time, so they will give one director two hours and maybe shoot in Bombay in the morning and Madras in the evening. It happens.
41780.name: Satyajit Ray

41781.quote: The question is the morning after. What sort of Iraq do we wake up to after the bombing? What happens in the region? What impact could it have? These are questions leaders I have spoken to have posed.
41781.name: Kofi Annan

41782.quote: I never really drank coffee in college, but now I'm on my feet all day and out all night and can't believe it hasn't always been in my life. When morning comes I crave it.
41782.name: Gail Simmons

41783.quote: The thing with me is, if I wake up one morning and I'm not happy working as an actress, I'll stop. It's not something I have to do. It's not a vocation.
41783.name: Samantha Morton

41784.quote: Those golden minutes before you are completely awake, when your mind is just drifting, you have no censorship you are ready to develop any kind of idea. That's when I come up with the best and worst ideas. That is the privilege of being a writer - that you can stay in bed for an hour in the morning and it's work time.
41784.name: Jo Nesbo

41785.quote: The episodes all blend together for me, so I don't remember. I can't even remember what I had for breakfast this morning. I always feel I must be such a disappointment to them.
41785.name: Sarah Michelle Gellar

41786.quote: I still love doing what I do, and I'm really lucky to get up in the morning and want to go to work.
41786.name: Heston Blumenthal

41787.quote: It seems to me madness to wake up in the morning and do something other than paint, considering that one may not wake up the following morning.
41787.name: Frank Auerbach

41788.quote: Now, on nights that I can't sleep, I play video games alone until the morning.
41788.name: Namie Amuro

41789.quote: In West Virginia, the most vulnerable people we have are people who get up every morning and go to work.
41789.name: Joe Manchin

41790.quote: She got the magazine on a Wednesday morning, and on Thursday announced our marriage was over.
41790.name: David Gest

41791.quote: I don't go to Mass every day. But I go to church every day. Just sitting there, thinking - it's a great way to start the morning, you know? You feel so good coming out, and your approach to everything is suddenly really clear.
41791.name: Mark Wahlberg

41792.quote: But to the slave mother New Year's day comes laden with peculiar sorrows. She sits on her cold cabin floor, watching the children who may all be torn from her the next morning and often does she wish that she and they might die before the day dawns.
41792.name: Harriet Ann Jacobs

41793.quote: On the last morning of Virginia's bloodiest year since the Civil War, I built a fire and sat facing a window of darkness where at sunrise I knew I would find the sea.

42398.quote: The movies I made early on may not have been great, but they were all commercially successful.
42398.name: Christina Ricci

42399.quote: Movies such as 'Mr. Smith Goes to Washington' in 1939 to 'Dave' in 1993 portray Washington leaders as the ultimate Everymen - decent people just like you and me, only thrust onto greatness.
42399.name: Ron Fournier

42400.quote: I do not quote my own movies. I think I would be pretty insufferable if I did.
42400.name: Diablo Cody

42401.quote: People don't have these tidy little redemption arcs in reality the way they do in movies.
42401.name: Diablo Cody

42402.quote: I'm not an especially highbrow person, but I have always loved small, quirky, edgy movies.
42402.name: Diablo Cody

42403.quote: I don't know why, but I've always been a sucker for roller coasters in movies.
42403.name: Diablo Cody

42404.quote: Oh, I adored Mickey Mouse when I was a child. He was the emblem of happiness and funniness. You went to the movies then, you saw two movies and a short. When Mickey Mouse came on the screen and there was his big head, my sister said she had to hold onto me. I went berserk.
42404.name: Maurice Sendak

42405.quote: Going to the movies was a big event in my youth. My father would be the initiator - he'd have me put on a jacket to see a film.
42405.name: Ralph Fiennes

42406.quote: You can't work in the movies. Movies are all about lighting. Very few filmmakers will concentrate on the story. You get very little rehearsal time, so anything you do onscreen is a kind of speed painting.
42406.name: John Malkovich

42407.quote: I like very much to do movies.
42407.name: John Malkovich

42408.quote: I like to direct movies, but I don't like to goof around for eight years talking about it.
42408.name: John Malkovich

42409.quote: Quite often - a lot of the work I had done had been extensively with women. Most especially in the theater, but also quite often in the movies. That has its own delights, and maybe pitfalls too.
42409.name: John Malkovich

42410.quote: You have to read scripts and audition and develop relationships. It takes a long time to develop a body of work but over the last 25 years I guess I've done that many movies. In hindsight it may seem effortless, but there's a lot of work that goes into it.
42410.name: Jr. Harry Connick

42411.quote: More and more major businesses and industries are being run on software and delivered as online services - from movies to agriculture to national defense.
42411.name: Marc Andreessen

42412.quote: Steven Spielberg is unique. I feel that the kinds of movies he loves are the same kinds of movies that the big mass audience loves. He's very fortunate because he can do the things he naturally likes the best, and he's been very successful.
42412.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42413.quote: When newspapers started to publish the box office scores of movies, I was horrified. Those results are totally fake because they never include the promotion budget.
42413.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42414.quote: I wanted to write and direct movies and not be forced to adapt them from a bestselling book.
42414.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42415.quote: I'm no longer dependent on the movie business to make a living. So if I want to make movies as other old guys would play golf, I can.
42415.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42416.quote: I've been offered lots of movies. There's always some actor who's doing a project and would like to have me do it. But you look at the project and think, 'Gee, there are a lot of good directors who could do that.' I'd like to do something only I can do.
42416.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42417.quote: People feel the worst film I made was 'Jack.' But to this day, when I get checks from old movies I've made, 'Jack' is one of the biggest ones. No one knows that. If people hate the movie, they hate the movie. I just wanted to work with Robin Williams.
42417.name: Francis Ford Coppola

42418.quote: I'm not mad about movies, there are too many people involved in the making of them, and they lack a definitive creative focus.
42418.name: David Bailey

42419.quote: I had to act in a school play when I was about ten years old. I really didn't want to do it. But everyone had to do it so I didn't have a choice. A talent agent came and watched it and later gave me some work. It's funny because I'd always known that I wanted a movie career. I just didn't think that I would be in the movies.
42419.name: Kristen Stewart

42420.quote: I like being in movies that have a great story. I'm not so interested in being a Hollywood star. It's a job, you know. When you wake up at six in the morning every day for a week, it feels like hard work.
42420.name: Kristen Stewart

42421.quote: I mean, I love L.A. - I love living here. But I wish that we could make things without the need to hit a home run every single time. It's a unique thing to Hollywood that if you don't do that every time, then you're considered a failure. But it's like, 'Well, are you making movies to be successful? Or are you making movies to learn something?'
42421.name: Kristen Stewart

42422.quote: It's not like I sit around watching my movies again and again, but I've never quite believed actors when they say they don't watch themselves.
42422.name: Kristen Stewart

42423.quote: It's a funny thing: You want so badly for people to see what you do - you're proud of it - and I like the effect that movies have on people. But the attention can also make me uncomfortable.
42423.name: Kristen Stewart

42424.quote: Very often when I go in to meet for movies or pilots, I'm put on videotape. I hate the notion that that tape is going to sit on a shelf and never get better.
42424.name: David Ogden Stiers

42425.quote: I love movies that make me cry, because they're tapping into a real emotion in me, and I always think afterwards: how did they do that?
42425.name: John Lasseter

42426.quote: The reason I chose the movies that I did was based on where they were being filmed.
42426.name: Meryl Streep

42427.quote: I mean, why am I considered an 'it girl?' Because I'm in a lot of movies right now or am on the covers of magazines? I just hope there is something solid behind that. Because here's the thing with 'it girl' status. It's great and amazing that anybody is saying that at all. But how long does that last?
42427.name: Amanda Seyfried

42428.quote: It's like why people read scary books or go see scary movies. Because it creates a distance. They're scared, but they're not going to get hurt.
42428.name: Vincent D'Onofrio

42429.quote: I wanted to be in Jim Carrey comedy movies before I met him. I wanted to be a comedian on Stage 19, yukking it up.
42429.name: Jenny McCarthy

42430.quote: I wouldn't like to be in movies. Movie people are strange. They live a different life than musicians do.
42430.name: Stevie Nicks

42431.quote: I love scary movies. I like blood and gore, and I love Halloween movies.
42431.name: Carrie Underwood

42432.quote: My movies just kind of sneak up on you. I don't have to worry too much about what everybody is going to say. Anyway, I really don't pay attention to what the world says about my movies. I just care about what my buddies think.
42432.name: Adam Sandler

42433.quote: I'm not looking to get away from anything. I like what I've done. I like what I get to do and I enjoy working with my friends. I loved those movies, but this is incredible.
42433.name: Adam Sandler

42434.quote: Kids end up seeing my movies anyway but some of the mothers get mad at me so I figured I'd make one that I can't get yelled at for.
42434.name: Adam Sandler

42435.quote: I like movies I can relate to.
42435.name: Kim Cattrall

42436.quote: I don't know many women who can relate to Sharon Stone and the kind of movies she does. I don't know a lot of guys who can relate to Tom Cruise's movies because they're on a kind of fantastic level.
42436.name: Kim Cattrall

42437.quote: There are some movies that I would like to forget, for the rest of my life. But even those movies teach me things.
42437.name: Antonio Banderas

42438.quote: I feel like a lot of the female relationships I see on TV or in movies are in some way free of the kind of jealousy and anxiety and posturing that has been such a huge part of my female friendships, which I hope lessens a little bit with age.
42438.name: Lena Dunham

42439.quote: I spent all my time on my movies worried that people were eating and that the schedule was being kept, so to have experts in those areas giving me the brain space as a writer and director is huge.
42439.name: Lena Dunham

42440.quote: Movies are movies, and I don't think any of them are going to hurt the moral fiber of America and all that nonsense.
42440.name: Richard Pryor

42441.quote: I like the George Romero films, which were really great, social satire movies really twisted.
42441.name: John Cusack

42442.quote: I love these movies where it's just about the film. You don't have my face on the poster. It's all about the movie. I like that.
42442.name: John Cusack

42443.quote: It seems to me that one thing people do over and over again is try to figure out how to get married, stay married, fall in love, how to rekindle all this stuff. It seems to me to be a pretty eternal theme so I don't know if you can get typecast from making movies about men relating to women. It seems to be what is going on on the planet a lot.
42443.name: John Cusack

42444.quote: The movies have got more corporate, they're making fewer movies in general, and those they are making are all $200-$300m tent-pole releases that eat up all the oxygen.
42444.name: John Cusack

42445.quote: Usually I do everything reverse. I practice something in movies and then I try it in real life.
42445.name: John Cusack

42446.quote: I don't want to produce anymore small or independent movies because it's just too hard these days.
42446.name: John Cusack

42447.quote: I was never into the popular school or clique or anything. Then I started doing movies when I was in high school, so then I got popular. Then the girls paid attention to you who didn't before.
42447.name: John Cusack

42448.quote: My dad had a commercial film company, so he had a videotape player before anyone. So he got Mel Brooks movies or Citizen Kane or some classic old movies. And every summer the revival house in Evanston would show the great films from the '50s and '60s and '70s.
42448.name: John Cusack

42449.quote: I think being self-referential is really narcissistic. Who's to say anybody's even thinking of you that much? But some of these movies that I've done, people still recite lines to me, even 20 years later.
42449.name: John Cusack

42450.quote: It's like those high-school yearbook photos that everyone would rather not see: Oh my God, look at that mullet hair. I have those photos too, but for me, they're, like, entire movies. And they show them on cable.
42450.name: John Cusack

42451.quote: Most movies, once the action starts there's no more characters. You say a couple of dumb lines and then there's just explosions until the end.
42451.name: John Cusack

42452.quote: Being alone is scarier than any boogey man and the reason why I don't choose to see Horror movies as a rule.
42452.name: Tom Sizemore

42453.quote: You go back to those films of the '40s and '50s and hear the dialogue, the way the people played off each other - the wordplay. I think we've really lost that in movies.
42453.name: Clive Owen

42454.quote: I go off and make movies I come home, and I'm a dad and I hang with my girls.
42454.name: Clive Owen

42455.quote: The financial implode is bound to be reflected in the movies that are being made, there's no question.
42455.name: Clive Owen

42456.quote: A huge part of acting in movies is appetite. You do your best work when you've got a lot of appetite and you really want to embrace something. When you get tired, you don't have that hunger.
42456.name: Clive Owen

42457.quote: Obviously, I'm attracted to heavier movies.
42457.name: Clive Owen

42458.quote: I want to be in movies that stand the test of time.
42458.name: Clive Owen

42459.quote: Ultimately, to have a career in movies, to a certain extent, certainly in England, you can't sustain a career in just English movies.
42459.name: Clive Owen

42460.quote: A lot of times you get credit for stuff in your movies you didn't intend to be there.
42460.name: Spike Lee

42461.quote: In the Rodgers and Hammerstein generation, popular hits came out of shows and movies.
42461.name: Stephen Sondheim

42462.quote: You're creating new things in movies and people are going to steal them.
42462.name: Daniel Craig

42463.quote: When you're making movies you've got to get obsessive.
42463.name: Daniel Craig

42464.quote: I guess you could say I've been in my share of violent movies.
42464.name: Daniel Craig

42465.quote: I was sick and tired of being an English actor who did a lot of American movies because I was cheap and good.
42465.name: Daniel Craig

42466.quote: I always wanted to make movies.
42466.name: Daniel Craig

42467.quote: If I wanted to make spy movies for the rest of my life, that would be one thing, but I don't want to just make spy movies.
42467.name: Daniel Craig

42468.quote: Some people think literature is high culture and that it should only have a small readership. I don't think so, I have to compete with popular culture, including TV, magazines, movies and video games.
42468.name: Haruki Murakami

42469.quote: It's the contemporary woman that movies don't know what to do with, other than bathe her in a bridal glow in romantic comedies where both the romance and the comedy are artificial sweeteners.
42469.name: James Wolcott

42470.quote: People talk about mumblecore but I prefer bumblecore, hyper-realistic bee movies about how bees really are.
42470.name: Mindy Kaling

42471.quote: I have a great job writing for 'The Office,' but, really, all television writers do is dream of one day writing movies. I'll put it this way: At the Oscars the most famous person in the room is, like, Angelina Jolie. At the Emmys the huge exciting celebrity is Bethenny Frankel. You get what I mean.
42471.name: Mindy Kaling

42472.quote: Woody Allen is really the ultimate. I love that he believed in himself enough to do what he did. And I have that same feeling - that there's nobody that looks like me in movies, nobody would cast me as a romantic lead, but I want to do it and I feel confident that I can.
42472.name: Mindy Kaling

42473.quote: I think these movies are as much for people of that time as for people who weren't born. For people who weren't born, they see how leaders must act under a crisis situation, not trying to be re-elected or not trying to check polls, that they go from their gut check.
42473.name: Kevin Costner

42474.quote: I'm not a film buff. I don't watch a lot of movies.
42474.name: Denzel Washington

42475.quote: Growing up I didn't watch movies.
42475.name: Denzel Washington

42476.quote: It's simple: You get a part. You play a part. You play it well. You do your work and you go home. And what is wonderful about movies is that once they're done, they belong to the people. Once you make it, it's what they see. That's where my head is at.
42476.name: Denzel Washington

42477.quote: I tend to think of action movies as exuberant morality plays in which good triumphs over evil.
42477.name: Sylvester Stallone

42478.quote: I made some truly awful movies. 'Stop! Or My Mom Will Shoot' was the worst. If you ever want someone to confess to murder just make him or her sit through that film. They will confess to anything after 15 minutes.
42478.name: Sylvester Stallone
