42479.quote: Now, if you are like me - if you are like practically anybody in America - then you probably hold some negative opinions about the French, based upon movies, rumors, recent headlines, unfortunate run-ins with Parisian waiters, or, you know, all that unpleasantness surrounding the Vichy regime.
42479.name: Elizabeth Gilbert

42480.quote: Movies were never an art form, they were entertainment. It just evolved into an art form from there, and it's still evolving in different ways.
42480.name: David Mamet

42481.quote: I'm not impressed by someone's degree, I'm impressed by them making movies.
42481.name: Richard King

42482.quote: I love horror, I love scary movies, I love thrillers. If things creep you out and spook you? I love it.
42482.name: Lana Parrilla

42483.quote: Although charismatic, James Dean is no Harrison Ford. In the majority of his movies, sooner or later he got the crap beaten out of him.
42483.name: Dean Koontz

42484.quote: I think we're very complicated and we're capable of all kinds of things, and movies don't reflect that.
42484.name: Ryan Gosling

42485.quote: I think it's more interesting to see people who don't feel appropriately. I relate to that, because sometimes I don't feel anything at all for things I'm supposed to, and other times I feel too much. It's not always like it is in the movies.
42485.name: Ryan Gosling

42486.quote: A lot of action movies today seem to have scenes that just lead up to the action.
42486.name: Jason Statham

42487.quote: How many movies do you see when you can say this director really knew what film he wanted to make? I can count them on the fingers of one hand.
42487.name: Gary Oldman

42488.quote: I have three kids who like Harry Potter so I was sort of aware of it. You can't really move from it: it's on buses, in stores, it's everywhere. One of my kids has read the books the other two are too small but they like the movies.
42488.name: Gary Oldman

42489.quote: The movies I watch and the music I listen to and the books I read - those are important to me. It's very important to me, and I don't know what I would do without those things.
42489.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42490.quote: We can now have action movies with two stars where one might be African American and one might be Asian American. One of them doesn't have to be white, and the other one doesn't have to be the ethnic sidekick. We're way over that. And I think it's happening in society, too.
42490.name: Roger Ebert

42491.quote: I just knew that was what I wanted to do. I was going to perform as a singer I was going to perform as a dancer, and I was, you know, going to do movies and be an actress. I was going to do it or die trying. That's what my life was.
42491.name: Jennifer Lopez

42492.quote: I feel I want to grow as an actress and be better. I want to progress as a singer and songwriter, and produce movies and everything. So there'll be no time when I feel I've done it all.
42492.name: Jennifer Lopez

42493.quote: No, but way before that, I've been doing little dances in movies for years. Yeah, that was an amazing chance. You know, at my age to be able to do a music dance video, very unusual.
42493.name: Christopher Walken

42494.quote: I've made movies that we're very successful that we're a complete surprise, and I've made movies that I thought we're going to be very successful that, you know.
42494.name: Christopher Walken

42495.quote: My favorite characters are the ones that are the most successful movies.
42495.name: Christopher Walken

42496.quote: I think that if I had grown up and had been in show business and the movies twenty five, thirty years earlier, I think I would have made a lot more musical movies.
42496.name: Christopher Walken

42497.quote: I've made three musical movies which is pretty good considering that not many are made but I was lucky in other ways. I came along when independent movies were starting to boom.
42497.name: Christopher Walken

42498.quote: When videotape came so a lot of movies that I do have a kind of afterlife in video. Things where movies that I do would come and go they still come and go but you can go rent them and see them on TV.
42498.name: Christopher Walken

42499.quote: I think if you do something effectively whether you're the lover or the comic or the action guy or the villain like I play movies are very expensive to make. Chances are you'll get asked to play that part again.
42499.name: Christopher Walken

42500.quote: I have been in movies that I thought I wasn't very good in.
42500.name: Christopher Walken

42501.quote: I make movies that nobody will see. I've made movies that even I have never seen.
42501.name: Christopher Walken

42502.quote: I used to be prettier than I am, but I think I look better now. I was a pretty boy. Particularly in my early movies. I don't like looking at them so much. There's a sort of pretty thing about me.
42502.name: Christopher Walken

42503.quote: I've made movies that I thought were good. I've made movies that I thought were okay, but then I was very good. And sometimes you're in a movie and you think, I wish more people saw that - because you're good. And it just works out that the movie gets lost. But that's show business.
42503.name: Christopher Walken

42504.quote: I aim for a lifetime full of movies.
42504.name: Salma Hayek

42505.quote: I don't know why I don't watch a lot of movies I can barely keep up with the things my friends are in. There isn't enough time in life.
42505.name: Meryl Streep

42506.quote: It was like in Samoa when they'd put up a movie screen on the beach and show movies and the locals would run behind the sheet to see where the people went. It was pretty grim.
42506.name: Dick Wolf

42507.quote: And being as I'm somebody who loves movies like The Machinist, I also love going along to big mass entertainment movies. I get in the mood for all kinds of movies, and so I like to try each of them.
42507.name: Christian Bale

42508.quote: In terms of the romantic kind of lead, I just never enjoy those movies very much. Maybe they'll come to interest me more as I get older. I doubt it, but maybe. Romantic comedies tend to be, for me, an oxymoron.
42508.name: Christian Bale

42509.quote: There are movies that require fantasy and slightly more fantastical acting. Lines that are good for certain movies, in real life circumstances, would be absolutely unbelievable things to really say, and you would look at these people like they're freaks for conversing that way. But somehow for certain styles of movies, it works, and it seems fine.
42509.name: Christian Bale

42510.quote: I like the idea of movies having a magic element. How many times have you seen an actor in a movie who you know only as the character? It's wonderful, isn't it?
42510.name: Christian Bale

42511.quote: I don't get it when you get so much openness about the way movies are made, and the special effects and the behind-the-scenes stuff and all of that. I can't help but feel like this reduces it a little bit.
42511.name: Christian Bale

42512.quote: I always leave that for other people to decide, because some of the things I consider to be disasters are some people's favorite movies. And that's what I like so much, is that you never know. Something intrigues somebody and means nothing to somebody else.
42512.name: Christian Bale

42513.quote: I'm so grateful for what Disney gave me and the experiences that I got, but at the end of the day, I can do so much more than what I did on that channel and in those movies.
42513.name: Ashley Tisdale

42514.quote: I can't watch scary movies right now, because living on my own, it kind of freaks me out.
42514.name: Ashley Tisdale

42515.quote: Where I live, nobody who's fourteen is having sex and doing major drugs. And I think if you see it in the movies, you may be influenced by it. I think it's so important to preserve your innocence.
42515.name: Natalie Portman

42516.quote: There are movies where we are interested in seeing people's lives without agreeing with what they're doing.
42516.name: Natalie Portman

42517.quote: I tend to make low-budget movies but, yeah, I make more money than I ever thought I would make.
42517.name: Laura Linney

42518.quote: The best movies have one sentence that they're exploring, a thesis, something that people can argue about over dinner afterward.
42518.name: Helen Hunt

42519.quote: Being the son of a filmmaker, you are aware of a career as a director. You don't think of it as just movies, but as a life.
42519.name: Jason Reitman

42520.quote: I want my movies to be audience experiences. As much as I like Michael Haneke, I'm not going to make a Haneke film. That's just not in my DNA.
42520.name: Jason Reitman

42521.quote: There are only so many movies you can direct. And yet there are movies that I want to make sure make it to the screen in as honest a way as possible.
42521.name: Jason Reitman

42522.quote: I'm trying to figure myself out through my movies. Whether it's big stuff like what we're doing here, or little stuff like, 'Why aren't I happier?' With every film I feel like I'm apologising for something. I feel I'm most successful when I'm looking for something that embarrasses me about my character that I'd like to expose.
42522.name: Jason Reitman

42523.quote: There certainly is no secret in that there are plenty of people who don't like plenty of my movies. Each one of my films is personal each one of my films is emotionally autobiographical. And I like directors who do that. With each one of my films, I'm exploring one of my own issues and I try to expose myself a little in the film.
42523.name: Jason Reitman

42524.quote: I hate movies that tell people what to think. I'm proud that Democrats thought 'Thank You For Smoking' was their film and Republicans thought it was theirs. I'm proud that pro-choice people thought 'Juno' was their film and pro-life people thought it was theirs.
42524.name: Jason Reitman

42525.quote: I'm not going to have a perfect career. It's better to be Billy Wilder and make lots of movies and have five or six great ones than to make so few movies that when you make a bad one it crushes you.
42525.name: Jason Reitman

42526.quote: As far as writing, I like watching bad movies. Nothing stops me in my tracks more than watching a great film like 'The Godfather' or 'Dog Day Afternoon' or 'The Graduate.' You watch one of those, and you never want to write again. Whereas with bad movies, it makes you think, If that counts, I certainly could write.
42526.name: Jason Reitman

42527.quote: I think romance is a tool, comedy is a tool and drama is a tool. I really just want to tell stories that challenge the viewer, move people, make you laugh, perhaps push an idea about being open-minded but never settle on a genre or an opinion. I hate genre. I like movies that are original in their approach.
42527.name: Jason Reitman

42528.quote: I hear the way people talk about the children of famous people. They're not treated very well. The presumptions are usually quite awful. So I tried to establish myself with a couple of movies. After 'Juno' I thought: 'I think I've defined myself enough as my own director that I'd love to work with my father.'
42528.name: Jason Reitman

42529.quote: I'm not Michael Moore. I think Michael Moore wants to tell you how to think. He wants to give you answers. I make movies to raise my own personal questions and not to give answers.
42529.name: Jason Reitman

42530.quote: Well, Toronto, I consider to be the birthplace of my films. I've made three films and this is the third one to premiere here in the same theater on the same day at the same time - they are my audience. They're the people that I think about while I'm writing, directing, and editing. I specifically make movies for them.
42530.name: Jason Reitman

42531.quote: I work constantly but I work at a lot of different things. You know, I run a theater company in New York, I direct plays, act in plays, in movies, so I try to keep it eclectic.
42531.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

42532.quote: There are characters in movies who I call 'film characters.' They don't exist in real life. They exist to play out a scenario. They can be in fantastic films, but they are not real characters what happens to them is not lifelike.
42532.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

42533.quote: People used to be funny about approaching me, but now they seem to think I'm as sane as anyone who's done what I've done in movies can be.
42533.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

42534.quote: You have to understand that crew members make movies so they're seeing a lot of actors all the time in their career acting.
42534.name: Philip Seymour Hoffman

42535.quote: What I like to do is just make good music, good movies, hopefully perform a good show full of energy and just have some fun.
42535.name: LL Cool J

42536.quote: I don't wanna abandon my identity as LL Cool J, but at the same time, I had to figure out how to let people know that I'm really serious about making these movies.
42536.name: LL Cool J

42537.quote: The person that made me want to make movies, and the reason I do films, is Bruce Lee. He was an incredible actor, and he had a lot of charisma. Handsome, action, you know, everything was there. I loved Bruce Lee.
42537.name: LL Cool J

42538.quote: I play Xbox. I have a little boy to look after. I have dogs. You know, I have things to do. I would love to be able to sit down and watch something like a movie. I watch my own movies because I have to.
42538.name: Tom Hardy

42539.quote: I've turned down twentysomething million dollars for movies.
42539.name: Vin Diesel

42540.quote: You make movies for the people. If critics happen to like them too, well, that's a home run.
42540.name: Vin Diesel

42541.quote: When you go to the movies with your whole family, it's a different experience. For some reason, it's something that you're all doing together and you take away something special in that.
42541.name: Vin Diesel

42542.quote: But then I go through long periods where I don't listen to things, usually when I'm working. In between the records and in between the writing I suck up books and music and movies and anything I can find.
42542.name: Bruce Springsteen

42543.quote: I remember looking through magazines or watching movies even just a couple of years ago and being like, 'I really want to be part of that,' but not realizing what that was.
42543.name: Leighton Meester

42544.quote: A lot of movies treat kids like idiots.
42544.name: Anna Chlumsky

42545.quote: I've always wanted to make movies.
42545.name: Fred Durst

42546.quote: I think ever since I was preteen I wanted to direct movies and tell stories.
42546.name: Fred Durst

42547.quote: I want to make timeless movies.
42547.name: Fred Durst

42548.quote: When I started to watch some of the films I'd done, I realized I was doing movies that I might not actually want to see.
42548.name: Heath Ledger

42549.quote: Making movies is difficult and you get disorientated sometimes - even when you're working with fantastic talent.
42549.name: Antonio Banderas

42550.quote: I've done many different movies in many different contexts.
42550.name: Antonio Banderas

42551.quote: Listen, I think movies serve many different purposes, from those movies that are frivolous and just an entertainment, to movies that just go to exploring the complexities of the human soul. Everything is valid if it's done with honesty and dignity, and I actually do both of those types of movies in my career.
42551.name: Antonio Banderas

42552.quote: I cry a lot, you know. Which is very difficult for a man to recognise, but I do. I cry in movies, you know, just watching movies.
42552.name: Antonio Banderas

42553.quote: There are some movies that I would like to forget, for the rest of my life - really! But even those movies that I'd like to forget teach me things.
42553.name: Antonio Banderas

42554.quote: I remember being a kid and sleeping over at my friend's house and staying up late and watching 'Nosferatu.' Vampire movies are supposed to be secret and bad. They should be rated R.
42554.name: Ethan Hawke

42555.quote: The nature of the movies is different than it was five years ago, and they're all driven by the possibilities of CGI, which means you can make anything happen on screen that you can possibly desire.
42555.name: Tom Hanks

42556.quote: It's just as hard, staying happily married as it is doing movies.
42556.name: Tom Hanks

42557.quote: I've made over 20 movies, and 5 of them are good.
42557.name: Tom Hanks

42558.quote: The nature of motion capture is only going to work for certain films. It's not going to put any other type of movies out of business.
42558.name: Tom Hanks

42559.quote: I hadn't made a big-budget film, and in Hollywood there's a sort of man and boys situation. You're a man, you make $80 million movies! As if it's harder to make an $80 million movie. Well, I guess businesswise it is because you have more executives to argue with.
42559.name: Gus Van Sant

42560.quote: I think I took my eye off the ball. From about 2005, 2006, 2007, I was out of it. I thought I could oversee movies and have it done for me, so to speak.
42560.name: Harvey Weinstein

42561.quote: I've been involved with violent movies, and then I've also said at a certain point, 'I can't take it anymore. Please cut it.' You know, you've got to respect the filmmaker, and it's a really tough issue.
42561.name: Harvey Weinstein

42562.quote: We didn't care if we were well-liked as long as the movies were good. We served the movie - that was our master at Miramax. In our second incarnation, the movie is still the master but we're getting the same results in more subtle ways.
42562.name: Harvey Weinstein

42563.quote: When we talk about Oscars, it's almost as a symbol of excellence, and the American public and the worldwide public accept that symbol. So, a movie like 'The Artist' that costs $14 million, has to go out and compete with movies that cost $140 million. How does David deal with Goliath?
42563.name: Harvey Weinstein

42564.quote: Last year, when 'Black Swan,' 'True Grit' and 'King's Speech' all grossed over $100 million, it gave studios and independent financiers the confidence to make daring movies and not do the same old you-know-what.
42564.name: Harvey Weinstein

42565.quote: My movies are important on an economic basis, on an artistic basis.
42565.name: Harvey Weinstein

42566.quote: When people ask me what makes movies great, it's the material.
42566.name: Harvey Weinstein

42567.quote: All my movies got screwed up because of my personality.
42567.name: Harvey Weinstein

42568.quote: Over the years with movies, I've given directors notes.
42568.name: Harvey Weinstein

42569.quote: Audiences want to see intelligent movies.
42569.name: Harvey Weinstein

42570.quote: You know, my movies are important on an economic basis, on an artistic basis.
42570.name: Harvey Weinstein

42571.quote: I've had such a great track record in making a huge profit when the movies are smaller.
42571.name: Harvey Weinstein

42572.quote: All my life, I have loved and been inspired by French cinema, and as a studio head it has been my pride and joy to have the ability to bring movies to audiences around the world.
42572.name: Harvey Weinstein

42573.quote: Well, I think one of the main things that you have to think about when acting in the movies is to try not to make the acting show.
42573.name: James Stewart

42574.quote: I was so young, and making movies, going to the studio every morning at dawn was magic.
42574.name: Natalie Wood

42575.quote: I'm an actor. And I guess I've done so many movies I've achieved some high visibility. But a star? I guess I still think of myself as kind of a worker ant.
42575.name: Bill Vaughan

42576.quote: Movies are open doors, and at every door, I change character and life.
42576.name: Juliette Binoche

42577.quote: I just think old old movies, they make you concentrate and pay attention so much more. They feel so warm. A lot of modern digital videotape, it's just too bright. Don't know why, it's not warm.
42577.name: Jack White

42578.quote: I love huge movies. Not sure I am the guy to make them, but you can rely on me being there watching them.
42578.name: Danny Boyle

42579.quote: Actors are steeped in a world of agents and where the next job is coming from and what are their expenses and what is the hotel like. You want to take them out of that world and dump them into another world, so that when you meet them on the screen they don't seem like the guy who was in two others movies that year.
42579.name: Danny Boyle

42580.quote: I love watching the Bond movies obviously and I grew up reading the books as a kid. I've always loved them because of that.
42580.name: Danny Boyle

42581.quote: People say you never remember anybody who dies in movies, and it's true, you don't. You don't even remember people who disappear.
42581.name: Danny Boyle

42582.quote: I like action movies, even though I think action movies are kind of derided now. But there is something extraordinary about action movies, which is absolutely linked to the invention of cinema and what cinema is and why we love it.
42582.name: Danny Boyle

42583.quote: Movies about space raise those questions of what we're doing here, and that inevitably introduces a spiritual dimension.
42583.name: Danny Boyle

42584.quote: All I do is go to the movies.
42584.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

42585.quote: I like all of the mental, psychological thriller movies too. I enjoy horror movies across the board.
42585.name: Sophia Bush

42586.quote: I would do anything for a part, nearly anything. Being in movies doesn't mean being pretty.
42586.name: Diane Kruger

42587.quote: Critics can be harsh and I think it's going to take me a long time to make people see what I have inside of me and that I really put my guts into movies and that I'm not superficial and that I'm not just a pretty face.
42587.name: Diane Kruger

42588.quote: I don't make movies thinking: 'Oh, this is going to be a huge box-office hit.'
42588.name: Diane Kruger

42589.quote: Sundance is weird. The movies are weird - you actually have to think about them when you watch them.
42589.name: Britney Spears

42590.quote: I like the good feeling movies.
42590.name: Robert Duvall

42591.quote: I don't stop. It's my nature. People have to tell me to slow down. I plan on playing every role on Broadway. I want to do 'Evita.' I want to do 'Sweeney Todd' with Chris Colfer. We want to do 'Wicked.' I'll be Elphaba and he wants to play 'Guy-linda.' I want to do movies, make music. 'Glee' is only the beginning.
42591.name: Lea Michele

42592.quote: I love John Waters. There's stuff in it that's beyond the boundaries of my taste, but his movies have always been like that.
42592.name: Tracey Ullman

42593.quote: I'll probably pursue doing more movies, but not horror or movies with killers in them. I'll try to stick to happy movies. I want to act and direct like Jodie Foster. I admire her because she went to college and she's still doing the same thing.
42593.name: Lindsay Lohan

42594.quote: I want to make all kinds of movies. I do want to make big movies that are a lot of fun to go to, but I also want to make movies that are going to stimulate some thought and maybe raise some awareness.
42594.name: Nicolas Cage

42595.quote: I do like to move and get physical in my movies.
42595.name: Nicolas Cage

42596.quote: I'm an enormous admirer of Christopher Lee. He's somebody, along with Vincent Price, who I celebrate, and I wanted my movies to show that celebration and that honoring of these great film stars that were unafraid to go into horror and Grand Guignol and the macabre.
42596.name: Nicolas Cage

42597.quote: I have eclectic tastes in the movies I want to do.
42597.name: Nicolas Cage

42598.quote: I don't want to just do independent movies and I don't want to just do adventure films. I enjoy both, and I think both are cogent.
42598.name: Nicolas Cage

42599.quote: I'm the first to admit that I like going to, or my memories at least of going to Clint Eastwood movies or Charles Bronson or James Bond.
42599.name: Nicolas Cage

42600.quote: I may be alone in this, but I do sense the power of film, in that movies have the ability to literally change people's minds. That's pretty powerful stuff when you consider that.
42600.name: Nicolas Cage

42601.quote: I like fantasy. I like horror, science fiction because I can get avant-garde with those performances in those movies.
42601.name: Nicolas Cage

42602.quote: I care about the connection with the audience. Film is such a powerful medium. Movies can change the way people think.
42602.name: Nicolas Cage

42604.quote: You don't want to be photographed? You don't want to be known? Then you don't need to be out there peddling movies.
42604.name: Cameron Diaz

42605.quote: I haven't deliberately set out to play the blonde bombshell in my movies. In fact, it's probably been quite the opposite. After the success of The Mask, I wasn't offered all that many blonde bombshell parts, to be honest. I think people believed from the beginning that I could actually walk and talk at the same time.
42605.name: Cameron Diaz

42606.quote: I actually think I have an audience member's sensibility about going to the movies.
42606.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42607.quote: I enjoy sports. I get a real joy from playing sports but I don't look for those movies. Oliver Stone wanted to know if I would do Any Given Sunday and it just didn't appeal to me.
42607.name: Kevin Costner

42608.quote: I'm proud of all the movies I've made. They're not sequels, they're not franchises. And the reason I pick my films carefully is that I don't want to spit on my life. I like to think of myself as more than that.
42608.name: Kevin Costner

42609.quote: When I make a film I'm away from home for two to three months. So I want my kids to look at my films one day and say, I love his movies, I love his choices-because he loved them.
42609.name: Kevin Costner

42610.quote: There are a lot of things that come to bear on movies now that I don't think are good for movies. They're trying to appeal to the biggest demographic and, when they do that, you sometimes flatten out.
42610.name: Kevin Costner

42611.quote: I'm glad movies aren't going to please everybody, they can't. But what they have to be is recognisable. I don't equate myself with a master painter, but I think you can recognise my films.
42611.name: Kevin Costner

42613.quote: I've never really broken this down before, but, in movies, you almost have no connection to fans. And if you do TV, you're kind of connected, but they know you as the TV name not your real name. If you do radio, there's more of a bond there. And then if you do a podcast it's like you're literally inside of your fans.
42613.name: Adam Carolla

42614.quote: And I love Mel Brooks. My Dad loved his movies, too, they're awesome, the kind of thing that if you're in for ten minutes, you're in for two hours.
42614.name: Mike Myers

42615.quote: I mean, I kind of remember, I'm 36 now, so it's kind of hard for me to relate to what it was like when I was 25, or 24, but I do remember a period in time when that's how I defined who I was, by the music I listened to and the movies I went to.
42615.name: Liz Phair

42616.quote: I do like escapism. I like going to the movies on a Friday night and seeing something fun.
42616.name: Charlie Kaufman

42617.quote: I want to make movies that pierce people's hearts and touch them in some way, even if it's just for the night while they're in the cinema in that moment, I want to bring actual tears to their eyes and goosebumps to their skin.
42617.name: Russell Crowe

42618.quote: When we shoot 24, there are so many things I have to worry about, from the script to technical things to my performance, that I don't have a second to be bored or take anything for granted. We produce 24 hours of film a season, which is like making 12 movies.
42618.name: Kiefer Sutherland

42619.quote: There are a lot of movies I'd like to throw away. That's not to say that I went in with that attitude. Any film I ever started, I went in with all the hope and best intentions in the world, but some films just don't work.
42619.name: Kiefer Sutherland

42620.quote: I crave working on those small independent movies because I love going to see those myself.
42620.name: Orlando Bloom

42621.quote: Lord of the Rings was my first experience making movies and at the time, I had no ideas how movies were done. I thought that's the way they're done, so in a way, I had nothing to compare it to.
42621.name: Orlando Bloom

42622.quote: The truth is - I found myself doing these huge action-adventure movies, and um, and which are cool man. And I really love doing them. And thankfully I haven't had too much dialogue, because if I had I would have really made a mess of it. You know what I mean?
42622.name: Orlando Bloom

42623.quote: Yeah, I mean the material, directors, the other cast, and if you think you can do something with the character then you do it and go from there. I am looking forward to doing some smaller movies.
42623.name: Orlando Bloom

42624.quote: I've done movies with a sword before. But I haven't really been given the full responsibility of something like a Ridley Scott film.
42624.name: Orlando Bloom

42625.quote: Movies like that aren't about the visual effects and explosions. They're human stories about family, about life, about death.
42625.name: Orlando Bloom

42626.quote: Just because you've made a couple movies, you've done some good movies, you've been nominated for some Academy Awards, whatever, nobody's entitled. It's a business. If they don't see it, I can think they're wrong, but I'm not entitled to a $15 million budget to make a film.
42626.name: Edward Norton

42627.quote: People wrestle sometimes making movies, and I think that conflict is a very essential thing. I think a lot of very happy productions have produced a lot of very banal movies.
42627.name: Edward Norton

42628.quote: I like making movies for myself and my friends and people with my sensibility.
42628.name: Edward Norton

42630.quote: There's this index that tallies up how much your movies have made, and if they haven't grossed a certain amount, then you're not bankable. I know I'm not Will Smith but, you know, my ranking's pretty low. The only studio picture I've done is 'Zodiac,' and that didn't perform that well.
42630.name: Chloe Sevigny

42631.quote: I couldn't survive just doing independent movies. And I'd rather do modelling than movies or TV I didn't like.
42631.name: Chloe Sevigny

42632.quote: I didn't know what types of movies I wanted to do. I want to do things that are different. I want to take my time with each role.
42632.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

42633.quote: I just want to keep doing what I'm doing and hopefully people will watch my movies.
42633.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

42634.quote: I grew up when I was 15 when I had my first opportunity in movies. I watched every great movie for a year and a half, and since then I've asked myself how I can emulate such artistry. That's really my motivation. I want to do something as good as my heroes have done.
42634.name: Leonardo DiCaprio

42635.quote: I like to think the movies that I've picked have something worthwhile to say. Something relevant.
42635.name: Mark Ruffalo

42636.quote: I loved old black and white movies, especially the Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers musicals. I loved everything about them - the songs, the music, the romance and the spectacle. They were real class and I knew that I wanted to be in that world.
42636.name: Sharon Stone

42637.quote: I had a daughter who was 9 years old and I had the feeling I wasn't going to be a real parent if I didn't quit making movies for a while and spend time with her. I also felt that I'd made enough movies and said what I had to say at the time.
42637.name: Jane Campion

42638.quote: And if people come up and say they like the movies you're in, it's a great compliment.
42638.name: Jason Statham

42639.quote: The thing about the UK is we don't really make that many great movies.
42639.name: Jason Statham

42640.quote: It's something I never dreamed I'd be doing, making movies.
42640.name: Jason Statham

42641.quote: Jet was very busy. I've been inspired by a lot of his movies.
42641.name: Jason Statham

42642.quote: Hollywood has the idea that movies have to be dumb. But especially movies for or about teenagers have to be really dumb!
42642.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42643.quote: I don't blame folks for not wanting to put me in their movies or whatever. I understand if their audiences had an association with me.
42643.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42644.quote: If the goal is to get the best artists, actors, and filmmakers in the world to create the best movies, Hollywood does a decent job. And I think no one would disagree with me that it also makes a ton of bad movies and employs a bunch of hacks.
42644.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42645.quote: Movies are different from real life.
42645.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42646.quote: I mean, movies in general tend to sort of portray time, space and identity as these very solid things. Time moves forward. Space is what it is. You are you, and you're always you.
42646.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42647.quote: Even today, in our progressive times, in most movies that come out, the men have to have biceps and the women have to be thin or something.
42647.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42648.quote: There's an absolute prejudice that good movies are dramas and comedies are more dismissable. But I couldn't disagree more.
42648.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt

42649.quote: I was a very interested arts student, I was always into that part of school and when I got into high school I went into architectural drafting. It gave me an understanding of how to build things and it's really helped me put things in perspective. With my music and my movies, to me it's all art.
42649.name: Ice Cube

42650.quote: A lot of people just go to movies that feed into their preexisting and not so noble needs and desires: They just go to action pictures, and things like that.
42650.name: Roger Ebert

42651.quote: Class is often invisible in America in the movies, and usually not the subject of the film.
42651.name: Roger Ebert

42652.quote: Movies absorb our attention more completely, I think.
42652.name: Roger Ebert

42653.quote: The movies that are made more thoughtfully or made or with more ambition often get just get drowned out by the noise.
42653.name: Roger Ebert

42654.quote: When my mother got home from work, she would take me to the movies. It was her way of getting out, and she would take me with her. I'd go home and act all the parts. It had a tremendous influence on my becoming an actor.
42654.name: Al Pacino

42655.quote: It's never really that much fun for me to do movies anyway, because you - you know, you have to get up very early in the morning and you have to go in and you spend a lot of time waiting around.
42655.name: Al Pacino

42656.quote: My childhood was influenced by the roles my father played in his movies. Whether Abraham Lincoln or Tom Joad in the 'Grapes of Wrath,' his characters communicated certain values which I try to carry with me to this day.
42656.name: Jane Fonda

42657.quote: I remember saying goodbye to my father the night he left to join the Navy. He didn't have to. He was older than other servicemen and had a family to support but he wanted to be a part of the fight against fascism, not just make movies about it. I admired this about him.
42657.name: Jane Fonda

42658.quote: De Niro was a hero of mine. And Sean Penn. But I've realized I can't operate at that level of intensity. That's okay for movies. On TV, when you live with horror day in and day out, you have to protect yourself.
42658.name: Christopher Meloni

42659.quote: I rarely see one of the 'summer blockbuster' movies. I'd like to see a stronger focus on smaller, smarter movies.
42659.name: Christopher Meloni

42660.quote: I took acting classes in college, and once I graduated, I decided to give acting a shot when I couldn't really think of anything else to do. It took me a couple of years to get an agent, and my first big break was The Fanelli Boys, which was a sitcom on NBC. Then I did a few television movies.
42660.name: Christopher Meloni

42661.quote: I was watching 'Up In The Air' and I thought, 'Jesus, who's the old gray-haired guy?' And it was me. I never wear makeup for movies and now it's starting to show.
42661.name: George Clooney

42662.quote: The physical part of comedy is as hard as a lot of action movies. It scares me, but in a way that I like.
42662.name: Rachel McAdams

42663.quote: My passion is doing movies, and as long as I keep doing that, I'll be happy. I want to do movies, fun roles and dramatic ones. I love all of it.
42663.name: Vanessa Hudgens

42664.quote: My passion is doing movies, so as long as I keep doing that I will be happy.
42664.name: Vanessa Hudgens

42665.quote: I'm fed up with the idiots, the ever-widening gap between people who know how to make movies and the people who green-light the movies.
42665.name: Sean Connery

42666.quote: Reality TV looks more like America than movies do.
42666.name: Gabrielle Union

42667.quote: I'm a weird big guy. Doing rapping, doing movies. Do a lot of stuff. But always do things the right way.
42667.name: Shaquille O'Neal

42668.quote: I've played a lot of mothers in my movies.
42668.name: Vera Farmiga

42669.quote: There really are three types of 'religious' movies: the ones that make fun of it, the ones that vilify it and the ones that literally preach to the converted.
42669.name: Vera Farmiga

42670.quote: I, for one, am tired of seeing movies about men damaging each other.
42670.name: Vera Farmiga

42671.quote: I am a filmmaker. That is all I've ever been. You know, Martin Scorsese makes films about the mob. And I make movies about food.
42671.name: Alton Brown

42672.quote: Why be boring? Have some fun. Rock shows should be like movies: I don't go to a movie hoping it'll change my life.
42672.name: Alice Cooper

42673.quote: Even if we die at 100, we're still dying young. I want at least 700 years. There's a lot of travelling and books to read and movies to see. I'm not going to squeeze it all in in 85 years.
42673.name: Alexander Payne

42674.quote: I'm a big fan of vampire movies generally and that sort of tradition of characters.
42674.name: Michael Sheen

42675.quote: Before I'd written movies, I never could do big set-piece scenes with a lot of different speakers - when you've got twelve people around a dinner table talking at cross purposes. I had always been impressed by other people's ability to do that.
42675.name: Joan Didion

42676.quote: My interest in film is sort of catholic - apart from science fiction and horror movies, I'll watch almost everything.
42676.name: James Dyson

42677.quote: I definitely have found a balance. I've had so many offers in the past to do different movies or different things and I always choose tournaments over it.
42677.name: Serena Williams

42679.quote: I grew up on Bette Davis movies, and Marlene Dietrich, Marilyn Monroe.
42679.name: Charlize Theron

42680.quote: I don't think we're living in great times for movies, to tell you the truth.
42680.name: Gabriel Byrne

42681.quote: You have to get the audience invested even if you're doing something that they think is dumb, it's kind of what these movies are all about.
42681.name: Halle Berry

42682.quote: If you really want to be competitive in today's market you have to be in movies that make money.
42682.name: Halle Berry

42683.quote: And you also have to do movies that are about commerce because that's what is required of the industry today.
42683.name: Halle Berry

42684.quote: The movies people don't talk about or remember after six months' time don't really matter.
42684.name: Eric Bana

42685.quote: Billions of people have seen and been influenced by movies in the short history of this industry.
42685.name: Conrad Hall

42686.quote: Well, it was actually - I brought the idea of doing a documentary to HBO back in 2000, when there were some press reports sort of were bandied about that there were going to TV movies based on some of the books that were out.
42686.name: Monica Lewinsky

42687.quote: I find that when you see somebody in the tabloids all the time, you have no desire to see them in movies.
42687.name: Seann William Scott

42688.quote: I'm not sure anybody's ready to see me in a drama. And loving movies so much, I've seen a lot of comics try to make that transition too fast, and it can be detrimental. And I don't think I've had as much success as I need in the comedy genre to open up those opportunities.
42688.name: Seann William Scott

42689.quote: There are a lot of movies I've done that come and go, and don't really establish a growing fan base.
42689.name: Seann William Scott

42690.quote: I don't generally do movies that get good reviews.
42690.name: Seann William Scott

42691.quote: I was a total athlete. I loved sports, but when I realized I wasn't going to be a professional athlete, I realized I wanted to be in movies.
42691.name: Seann William Scott

42692.quote: Working on the 'Ice Age' movies, I'm really proud to be in them.
42692.name: Seann William Scott

42693.quote: The irony is that you can't use real rain to make movies.
42693.name: Greg Kinnear

42694.quote: My bar for being successful is being able to do movies that really mean something to me and being able to make a living off of that.
42694.name: Channing Tatum

42695.quote: I can't do the same movies all my life. I'm conscious of that. But it's a trade-off. 'Dear John' allowed me to do movies I've wanted to do. You learn to balance it out. I'm still learning. Only now am I getting to do the kinds of movies that I have wanted to do. So it's a steady climb. You don't jump into a Soderbergh film.
42695.name: Channing Tatum

42696.quote: I've been on so many movies. Generally, I haven't gotten to be on the ground level. As of two years ago, in 'Dear John,' I got to really be on the ground floor. I wasn't a producer. I felt like I put the work in, and I did have a lot of sway on what got fixed, reshoots, so on and so forth. It felt really good.
42696.name: Channing Tatum

42697.quote: I still think that movies are amazing I respect actors and directors.
42697.name: Joaquin Phoenix

42698.quote: The reason I keep making movies is I hate the last thing I did. I'm trying to rectify my wrongs.
42698.name: Joaquin Phoenix

42699.quote: I don't really make movies because I want to see my face on a billboard or because I want to get good reviews or have a big box office. That doesn't really matter to me at all.
42699.name: Joaquin Phoenix

42700.quote: You see so many earnest characters in movies all the time, everyone has a purpose.
42700.name: Joaquin Phoenix

42701.quote: The only reason why I would like to be accepted? Because if your movies don't do well, after a while you don't get to make any more movies.
42701.name: Joaquin Phoenix

42702.quote: I happen to be interested in watching a face age. I like faces of women aging so it makes me personally quite sad. That's a beautiful gift from God. If people don't want to see that anymore then I won't be in anymore movies.
42702.name: Debra Winger

42703.quote: People pay to see movies with women looking beautiful, but I think there will be a place for me to play women looking my own age.
42703.name: Debra Winger

42704.quote: Awards were made in Hollywood, in whatever the time it was created. They're to promote each other's movies. You give me an award, I give you an award and people will believe that we are great movies and they'll go to see them. It's still the same.
42704.name: Javier Bardem

42705.quote: Some quality performances and movies have a chance to be rewarded, but it's not like it's a bible.
42705.name: Javier Bardem

42706.quote: I don't really care where movies come from as long as they're worth making.
42706.name: Javier Bardem

42707.quote: Now, there are so many movies, so many festivals, and so many awards going on, each judged with each other, like your work is worse than others and that's not fair. How can you tell what's best and what's worst from these awards? We're talking about art.
42707.name: Javier Bardem

42708.quote: Bond is the longest-running franchise ever and there's a reason for that: they are action movies but they are also touched by current events without being political or too serious.
42708.name: Javier Bardem

42709.quote: I'm a fan of action movies.
42709.name: Kate Beckinsale

42710.quote: I think what's dangerous about being an actor who does action movies is you think, 'Well, I can totally handle myself now.' But if my opponent didn't know the other half of the routine, I don't know how well I'd do.
42710.name: Kate Beckinsale

42711.quote: I missed out on everything. Sometimes on the street I see teenagers hanging out and going to the movies, going to concerts, and I get so jealous.
42711.name: Adriana Lima

42712.quote: I really don't like to do back-to-back movies. I concentrate on things at home. My family and school life are important to me. I try to do one movie a year.
42712.name: Anna Chlumsky

42713.quote: Usually when you see females in movies, they feel like they have these metallic structures around them, they are caged in by male energy.
42713.name: Bjork

42714.quote: I think what a lot of action movies lose these days, especially the ones that deal with fantasy, is you stop caring at some point because you've lost human scale.
42714.name: Harrison Ford

42715.quote: With the CGI, suddenly there's a thousand enemies instead of six - the army goes off into the horizon. You don't need that. The audience loses its relationship with the threat on the screen. That's something that's consistently happening and it makes these movies like video games and that's a soulless enterprise. It's all kinetics without emotion.
42715.name: Harrison Ford

42716.quote: If military movies were automatically successful we'd make nothing but military movies. But seriously, patriotism is one thing that all Americans have in common.
42716.name: Tommy Lee Jones

42717.quote: I love vampire movies. I think they are sexy.
42717.name: Marguerite Moreau

42718.quote: Yes, I'm going to be the President of the United States. You know why? You think you can get chicks by being in the movies? You can really get chicks by being the President.
42718.name: Ben Affleck

42719.quote: I kinda see my current position like this: Here's your five minutes in the toy store, so you gotta do all the good movies you can before 'Chuck Woolery' rings the bell.
42719.name: Ben Affleck

42720.quote: The one benefit of having done all kinds of movies as an actor is, you learn the pros and cons of being tempted to do a really big movie because it costs a lot of money.
42720.name: Ben Affleck

42721.quote: You're basically the sum of all the experiences you've ever had, and they're sort of shaken up in you and reproduced in the things you create, and that includes seeing movies.
42721.name: Ben Affleck

42722.quote: Not that it entirely matters: There is a perception that all actors make their movies. A lot of people assume you're responsible. George Clooney told me actors get all of the blame and all the credit.
42722.name: Ben Affleck

42723.quote: My movies are unadorned, they're not particularly fancy, I think they're kind of workmanlike in some ways, focusing on the writing and the acting.
42723.name: Ben Affleck

42724.quote: I knew I had to get out of Boston and stop making movies there, at least for one movie, otherwise no one would ever consider me for a movie that took place south of Providence.
42724.name: Ben Affleck

42725.quote: I've never held myself up particularly high when I had movies that worked, and I never held myself all that low when I had failures.
42725.name: Ben Affleck

42726.quote: You don't go to the movies to do historical research, unless it's historical research about the movies.
42726.name: Tony Kushner

42727.quote: Making movies is a very different experience in a lot of ways. It's difficult when you're used to owning the copyright and having a landlord's possessory rights - I rent my plays to the companies that do them and, if I'm upset, I can pull the play. But the only two directors I've worked with are pretty great.
42727.name: Tony Kushner

42728.quote: As much as I hate his movies, Oliver Stone has an aspiration I admire, and that is that he wants his art to be part of what makes and changes public policy and cultural practice.
42728.name: Tony Kushner

42729.quote: I write plays and movies, I live and work at the borderline between word and image just as any cartoonist or illustrator does. I'm not a pure writer. I use words as the score for kinetic imagistic representations.
42729.name: Tony Kushner

42730.quote: I just love movies, so suddenly, you're political about movies, and that's dark. It's just not fun when something you love becomes calculated.
42730.name: Kevin Smith

42731.quote: I always, always meant to be on stage. I only ended up even auditioning for television and movies because I was understudying a Turgenev play on Broadway and was so broke that, when I got a mini-series, I had to take it and was so ashamed because I was such a snob.
42731.name: Jennifer Garner

42732.quote: On radio and television, magazines and the movies, you can't tell what you're going to get. When you look at the comic page, you can usually depend on something acceptable by the entire family.
42732.name: Bil Keane

42733.quote: I really care about this stuff, I care about movies, and you just have to be strong and don't be stupid freedom of choice is a big responsibility, and I'm lucky enough not to have to just take any movie to pay the rent, so there's no need to be greedy.
42733.name: Jonah Hill

42734.quote: I love movies with spectacle but spectacle can be a performance, it doesn't have to be a creature.
42734.name: J. J. Abrams

42735.quote: I hope to make movies that are so small they don't need to make anything to be profitable.
42735.name: J. J. Abrams

42736.quote: I have nothing against 3-D in theory. But I've also never run to the movies because something's in 3-D.
42736.name: J. J. Abrams

42737.quote: When I was a kid going into the movies, you weren't force-fed information everywhere you looked about what the movie was going to be.
42737.name: J. J. Abrams

42738.quote: When I was a little kid - and even still - I loved magic tricks. When I saw how movies got made - at least had a glimpse when I went on the Universal Studios tour with my grandfather, I remember feeling like this was another means by which I could do magic.
42738.name: J. J. Abrams

42739.quote: Making movies was more a reaction to not being chosen for sports. Other kids were out there playing at whatever I was off making something blow up and filming it, or making a mould of my sister's head using alginating plaster.
42739.name: J. J. Abrams

42740.quote: I don't see that many movies lately that are actually about something, that are trying to challenge something about the way that people interact.
42740.name: Maggie Gyllenhaal

42741.quote: I feel like I'm a fighter. I've fought my whole life to get to where I'm at. I like fight movies. When someone gets knocked down, I like to root for him to succeed.
42741.name: Rick Schroder

42742.quote: I appreciate a slow-burn romance. In most movies, everyone is just tearing their clothes off in the first scene.
42742.name: Emily Blunt

42743.quote: I really unfortunately don't have tons of hilarious Sundance stories, because really I am not the biggest fan of hanging out, but the reason why is because I never go see other people's movies and I think that's the way to do it.
42743.name: Lizzy Caplan

42744.quote: I was influenced when I was younger by the cartoon movies that Disney put out, like Cinderella and what not. I watched those movies over and over when I was younger and the music is ingrained into my head. Nowadays, I'm still humming the tunes. It taught me the fundamentals.
42744.name: Zac Efron

42745.quote: Movies these days have made killers into funny people. What's that all about? I've got kids and family and friends, and I don't like bad things. I don't think they're funny, and it's irresponsible to make movies that don't show you how that's not good.
42745.name: Billy Bob Thornton

42746.quote: I'm a movie nut. I go to the movies probably twice a week, and if I'm not doing anything at night, I'm usually watching a movie or two.
42746.name: Dominic Monaghan

42747.quote: I think there's a vague sense out there that movies are becoming more and more unreal. I know I've felt it.
42747.name: Christopher Nolan

42748.quote: I've always been a movie guy, movies have been my thing. I love movies, all kinds of movies.
42748.name: Christopher Nolan

42749.quote: You know when Hollywood does a great big blockbuster that really wraps you up in a world, and lets you believe in extraordinary things that move you in some way, in an almost operatic sensibility? That to me is the most fun I have at the movies.
42749.name: Christopher Nolan

42750.quote: But in the back of my mind I've always looked to the biggest-scale Hollywood movies. Because to me the most satisfying experience is of watching a movie, if it's done really well. And so that aspiration is always it for me, if I have the opportunity to do it.
42750.name: Christopher Nolan

42751.quote: To be honest, I don't enjoy watching movies much when I'm working. They tend to fall apart on me a bit.
42751.name: Christopher Nolan

42752.quote: I go to the movies at least five times a week, and after a while everything becomes a blur to me.
42752.name: David Sedaris

42753.quote: But most good movies have a gun in them.
42753.name: David Sedaris

42754.quote: Well, getting behind the camera is something I've always wanted to get involved with. Ever since I was doing movies like 'Zathura' I was very interested in all the different jobs on set and kind of soaking all the information up like a sponge.
42754.name: Josh Hutcherson

42755.quote: The way I look at it, movies are a different medium for storytelling than books.
42755.name: Josh Hutcherson

42756.quote: I love doing roles and movies that are different from each other.
42756.name: Josh Hutcherson

42757.quote: In all honesty I think that I've had a very normal life, even though I've been making movies since I was 9.
42757.name: Josh Hutcherson

42758.quote: There's definitely a large fan base for the 'Twilight' and 'Harry Potter' movies that need their next fix.
42758.name: Josh Hutcherson

42759.quote: I like simple things. I like to sneak in the theatre and watch movies. I'm a movie buff.
42759.name: Justin Timberlake

42760.quote: If I did any movies I'd have to take a break from singing, because I'd want it to be really good.
42760.name: Justin Timberlake

42761.quote: Not everybody goes to movies to get their life changed.
42761.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42762.quote: The music led to the acting. But movies aren't something you can just will yourself into. Someone has to choose you, and you have to be quite fortunate to be chosen.
42762.name: Ice T

42763.quote: I quit doing the movies because the wrestling was going so good and was so on fire during the '80s and '90s, but I was getting all these movie scripts.
42763.name: Hulk Hogan

42764.quote: Shooting this one was kind of like a two month party, we would literally play music between takes, and other movies that were shooting on our lot would play hookey, come over and hang out and stuff. We had a great time.
42764.name: Mike Myers

42765.quote: Comedy. It was just huge in my house. Peter Sellers and Alec Guinness, Monty Python and all those James Bond movies were highly regarded.
42765.name: Mike Myers

42766.quote: I grew up in Toronto and as long as I can remember, as long as there was cable, even those old cable boxes that were wired to the TV, there have been Bollywood movies on Toronto TV.
42766.name: Mike Myers

42767.quote: I really don't have any solutions and I don't like movies that do.
42767.name: Charlie Kaufman

42768.quote: I've kind of come to the conclusion that what passes for realism in movies has nothing to do with reality and that my stuff is more realistic than that.
42768.name: Charlie Kaufman

42769.quote: In a lot of movies, especially big studio ones, they're not constructed in any other way than to get people to like them and then tell their friends. It's a product.
42769.name: Charlie Kaufman

42770.quote: I'm very particular about the kind of music that I record and sing, and it would be the same way about the kind of movies that I would do.
42770.name: Jason Aldean

42771.quote: Movies, as evidenced by a chorus of protesting and celebrating Americans, influence broader trends.
42771.name: Anna Deavere Smith

42772.quote: I'm blessed to have cool roles in these big movies.
42772.name: Jeremy Renner

42773.quote: There's too much down time making movies. That leads to boredom. And that leads to trouble.
42773.name: Jeremy Renner

42774.quote: The trouble with movies as a business is that it's an art, and the trouble with movies as art is that it's a business.
42774.name: Charlton Heston

42775.quote: I find that you learn from others. It's very much about watching TV and watching movies for me and grasping that way and watching other people act.
42775.name: Callan McAuliffe

42776.quote: Most of the movies I saw growing up were viewed as totally disposable, fine for quick consumption, but they have survived 50 years and are still growing.
42776.name: Manuel Puig

42777.quote: Live theater to me is much more free than the movies or television.
42777.name: Eartha Kitt

42778.quote: The only thing I can't do is hear. I can drive, I have a life with four kids, I work on TV, I do movies, so the deafness question, is it that they want to know because, what? Not sure.
42778.name: Marlee Matlin

42779.quote: All my movies, like Revenge, are under two hours.
42779.name: Tony Scott

42780.quote: I couldn't be happier about being a part of 'Hunger Games' and to play Katniss. I have a huge responsibility to the fans of this incredible book and I don't take it lightly. I will give everything I have to these movies and to this role to make it worthy of Suzanne Collins' masterpiece.
42780.name: Jennifer Lawrence

42781.quote: I never think it's right to chew gum in front of other people, but a lot of times I'll come in for a meeting chewing gum and I'll forget I'm chewing it. Then you don't want to swallow it because it stays in your system for seven years or something, so I've asked to throw it away. I've started to wonder if that's why I didn't get certain movies.
42781.name: Jennifer Lawrence

42782.quote: I do believe that movies are subject to a million interpretations.
42782.name: Oliver Stone

42784.quote: I've always wanted to get into acting, ever since I was younger. I'd put on shows for my family and run around play dress-up all the time. I think I was 4 when I told them I wanted to do movies.
42784.name: Emma Roberts

42785.quote: I've only been to high school on TV and in movies. I've never actually been to high school.
42785.name: Emma Roberts

42786.quote: I just feel like with independent movies, they're really free to do whatever they want. They're not afraid to make a statement about anything, and there's not a huge studio behind them making sure that everything is wholesome and politically correct and all that.
42786.name: Emma Roberts

42787.quote: I really like Gwyneth Paltrow a lot, as far as her career, because I think she's done a lot of small movies but she's also done great, big movies, and she's a really great actress.
42787.name: Emma Roberts

42788.quote: I love doing kind of more kiddish-oriented movies, but I also love doing adult things. And I think it's fun to do a mix.
42788.name: Emma Roberts

42789.quote: I loved the movies and I wanted to be like Marilyn Monroe. I thought she was so glamorous and everyone seemed to love her. I wanted to be like that and I told everyone I would be the next Marilyn Monroe.
42789.name: Sharon Stone

42790.quote: TV is so different from the movies. It takes a lot of stamina because you work such long hours. It is really challenging. You are learning the next day's lines while you are shooting today's scenes. I found courage I never realised I had. I hope to do more.
42790.name: Sharon Stone

42791.quote: I think I made good movies.
42791.name: Jane Campion

42792.quote: I like movies that are about real people in real time with real problems.
42792.name: Josh Radnor

42793.quote: I learned a lesson which I didn't heed: Don't put yourself in your movies. It's too much.
42793.name: Josh Radnor

42794.quote: I went through this very serious Woody Allen phase in college and a little bit after college. I still see his movies.
42794.name: Josh Radnor

42795.quote: I actually have a thing about proper nouns. They clang on my ear in a weird way when I hear them dropped into movies.
42795.name: Josh Radnor

42796.quote: When I go to movies and I love the movie, it's because it feels like it articulated something about how we're living now, and also gives me some insight into my own life. I feel actually altered after having seen it.
42796.name: Josh Radnor

42797.quote: A lot of times, we're just sold these movies that are really cynically conceived and marketed, and they just want you there opening weekend, before everybody finds out it's not so good.
42797.name: Josh Radnor

42798.quote: I didn't have any ambition to produce big mainstream popcorn movies.
42798.name: Jodie Foster

42799.quote: I'm a sci-fi girl. If I can have anything in life, I'd want tons of great science-fiction movies and stories. It's so progressive, beautiful, and imaginative.
42799.name: Zoe Saldana

42800.quote: I think as an American society, when we're paying too many taxes or dealing with war, we don't want to see sad things at the movies.
42800.name: Zoe Saldana

42801.quote: All through my life what I've loved doing is watching movies. I love the escapism of film, I love stories. So it is incredible to be able to be in them as much as I am, to see them from the first stitch in a costume to the end product.
42801.name: Keira Knightley

42802.quote: I like to play guitar, jam out, play the blues, go watch movies. I love movies.
42802.name: Dane Cook

42803.quote: I spent much of my later childhood and adolescence very, very involved and interested in art, and particularly in animated movies.
42803.name: Stanislav Grof

42804.quote: I have to say I regretted giving up animated movies.
42804.name: Stanislav Grof

42805.quote: I've had the good fortune to have a much more diverse life than most people would, professional sports and television and news and movies.
42805.name: Ted Turner

42806.quote: I love crying at romantic movies like 'The Notebook.' I'm always bawling.
42806.name: Fergie

42807.quote: I filmed seven movies in 2011 and I think that was a mistake. I pushed myself too hard and I want to be able to come to work each day and give 100 percent. I guess I found out what my boundaries are.
42807.name: Anna Kendrick

42808.quote: I'm into 'The Walking Dead,' 'Shaun of the Dead,' obviously, and I've seen all the Romero movies. I am a classic zombie queen. And I love the White Walkers on 'Game of Thrones.' Weirdly, it wasn't until pretty late in life that I found my entry point into horror films.
42808.name: Anna Kendrick

42809.quote: It's like, if you can't focus on a movie for 90 minutes without looking at your phone, then don't go to the movies! You've got some issues, so you should probably stay home and work on those issues, and not distract everyone with lights, and sounds, oh my gosh, the tapping on the screens, it makes me crazy!
42809.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

42810.quote: Sometimes I make very selfish choices like I did 'Once Upon A Time' for my inner 8-year-old and my hypothetical future child. I've done some movies because I would regret them if I didn't, but other projects I've done because they've scared me or if I felt I needed to do a big romantic comedy to help me professionally.
42810.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

42811.quote: I don't even like watching sex scenes in movies. I have a slight prudish side to me.
42811.name: Portia de Rossi

42812.quote: The one regret I have about my own abortions is that they cost money that might otherwise have been spent on something more pleasurable, like taking the kids to movies and theme parks.
42812.name: Barbara Ehrenreich

42813.quote: People called '28 Days' and '28 Weeks' zombie movies, and they're not! It's some sort of virus they're not dead.
42813.name: George A. Romero

42814.quote: All movies assault the viewer in one way or another.
42814.name: Michael Haneke

42815.quote: The movies and the parts I'm being offered are becoming better and better.
42815.name: Vanessa Paradis

42816.quote: I always hated high-school shows and high-school movies, because they were always about the cool kids. It was always about dating and sex, and all the popular kids, and the good-looking kids. And the nerds were super-nerdy cartoons, with tape on their glasses. I never saw 'my people' portrayed accurately.
42816.name: Paul Feig

42817.quote: Movies for adults sucked in the 1980s, and music for adults sucked even worse whether we're talking about Kathleen Turner flicks or Sting albums, the decade's non-teen culture has no staying power at all.
42817.name: Rob Sheffield

42818.quote: When I meet gay fans out and about, they're so great to talk to - and I'm big on hugging, because I'm from the Midwest. They're just so energetic and loving. I'm proud to have those fans, and their support means a lot to me. I don't want just girls coming to my movies I want guys to come, too!
42818.name: Kellan Lutz

42819.quote: I guess maybe I try to make movies that are closer to real life than are many Hollywood movies. But I still try to stay within a commercial narrative, a contemporary American vernacular.
42819.name: Alexander Payne

42820.quote: It's so great in Hollywood now. You have people past 40 sitting and talking about serious stuff, writing and making movies and TV, but there's laser pistols and superheroes and alien monsters involved. It's viable and mainstream.
42820.name: Nathan Fillion

42821.quote: My fans mean everything to me - especially the sisters! When you're on 'The View' or you're doing movies and stuff, you're a little bit insulated. It means so much to me when a woman comes up to me and says, 'Sherri, you said what I feel.' That just means so much to me to know that I have that support.
42821.name: Sherri Shepherd

42822.quote: I'll tell you what I really enjoy. We all go to the movies, we all watch television, we know what they're about, how they work. When the main character is a cop or a spy, it's very exciting, but I also very much enjoy when the main characters are nobodies - a trucker.
42822.name: Nathan Fillion

42823.quote: I like making sci-fi movies because I like watching sci-fi movies. I like watching horror. I like being in a horror movie. I'm a fan. My perspective's a little different just because I get to participate as well as spectate.
42823.name: Nathan Fillion

42824.quote: I have a trophy case that contains all the action figures ever made of me. It also has items I've stolen from my movies, like three guns and holsters from 'Serenity'.
42824.name: Nathan Fillion

42825.quote: I've always fantasized about being on TV. And I was. Then I fantasized about being in the movies. What could be better than captain of a space ship? I get to ride horses, shoot guns, have adventures.
42825.name: Nathan Fillion

42826.quote: For movies to get greenlit solely based on the success of other movies that have a lot of women in them? It's so ridiculous to me.
42826.name: Kristen Wiig

42827.quote: I do sort of gravitate towards smaller, indie-type movies.
42827.name: Kristen Wiig

42828.quote: I think people like to see the lives of artists that are legends. They always go through the dark periods and I think just as humans we like to see that and them coming out of it. I love those kinds of movies.
42828.name: Kristen Wiig

42829.quote: When you're on your deathbed, you probably aren't counting the movies you've made.
42829.name: Kristen Wiig

42830.quote: I don't rehearse a lot. I try to keep it organic. Even in movies, the less I rehearse, the better I am.
42830.name: Kristen Wiig

42831.quote: I don't like doing movies, period. Movies are hard. I like TV.
42831.name: Kathy Griffin

42832.quote: I don't think people have been able to deal with the fact that African American filmmakers can make movies about life and relationships.
42832.name: Tim Robbins

42833.quote: I have personal beliefs and they are sometimes reflected in the movies I make, but I also reflect other points of view.
42833.name: Tim Robbins

42834.quote: I enjoy about 1 out of 100 movies, it's about the same proportion to books published that I care to read.
42834.name: Jim Harrison

42835.quote: The long and short of it is that I am now in a position in England to green light movies, and that's really excellent - not high-budget movies, but movies none the less.
42835.name: Idris Elba

42836.quote: I had seen movies before that that had made me laugh, but I had never seen anything even remotely close to as funny as Richard Pryor was, just standing there talking.
42836.name: Joe Rogan

42837.quote: I'm also doing constant book readings, movies. You name it, I'm doing it.
42837.name: Lynn Redgrave

42838.quote: I was at the end of the studio system so when I walked into movies, I had a magnificent suite in which I had a living room and a kitchen and a complete makeup room. I had everything just for me. With the independents, you're kind of roughing it, literally.
42838.name: Tippi Hedren

42839.quote: I could really use a corporate sponsor. People think that because you're in the movies, you're rich. I have allocated all my resources to Shambala so the animals will always be safe.
42839.name: Tippi Hedren

42840.quote: So I do have to work, you know, and I find as many movies and TV shows that I can, because otherwise I wouldn't have an income.
42840.name: Tippi Hedren

42841.quote: I don't enjoy movies in 3D. I find I can't engage with the story as well.
42841.name: Guy Pearce

42842.quote: I've been asked to do action-oriented movies in the past and they just haven't been right for me.
42842.name: Guy Pearce

42844.quote: Here's the thing about movies, all movies end up on television. That's their life. Whether you like it or not, I don't care how much money you spend on it, or how big or broad the film is, or who the actors are in it, eventually it's all coming out of the box.
42844.name: Greg Kinnear

42845.quote: If you're working on a movie, you want it to be projected on the largest tapestry possible, and the sound to be perfect, and for that kind of communal experience of the movies to take place for it.
42845.name: Greg Kinnear

42846.quote: Audiences don't ever disappoint me, in the sense that movies I feel really good about, they usually feel really good about too.
42846.name: Greg Kinnear

42847.quote: I just like to act and write and produce. To me, making movies is the ultimate goal.
42847.name: Jonah Hill

42848.quote: Besides the fact that I make movies, there's nothing interesting about my life at all, unfortunately.
42848.name: Jonah Hill

42849.quote: Once you make a movie like 'Superbad,' when it's popular and you're the lead, you get offered all kinds of things and there's a temptation to make bad movies either for the money or to maintain your relevance in pop culture.
42849.name: Jonah Hill

42850.quote: All my friends were in college when I was making 'Superbad.' We were drinking beer and watching movies and eating pizza. It wasn't like I was going to nice restaurants or anything like that, and I lived like a frat guy. Eventually it was time to grow up, be healthy and be responsible. You can't live like a kid forever, you know?
42850.name: Jonah Hill

42851.quote: I think our culture has gotten so skewed. People assume that because you're an actor you want to write a book to exploit your celebrity, but my celebrity is only a byproduct of me making movies. I have no intention of being a celebrity.
42851.name: Jonah Hill

42852.quote: Look, at the same time that I don't want to be a celebrity, I understand that when you make movies you put yourself out in the public eye. I'd be a baby and a fool to be like, 'Why are there cameras taking pictures of me?' when I'm on a billboard for a movie. I think that's a very absurd concept.
42852.name: Jonah Hill

42853.quote: I'm really proud of 'Moneyball.' To me, it's about feeling pride in a movie I made. I think when I'm an old man I'll be able to show it to my grandkids with pride. That's all I can really go for: making movies to please me.
42853.name: Jonah Hill

42854.quote: I love it, man I'm 23 years old and I'm lucky enough to write movies as a job! I just feel really blessed and can't believe it's happening.
42854.name: Jonah Hill

42855.quote: People are always wondering if I am an artist or political activist or politician. Maybe I'll just clearly tell you: Whatever I do is not art. Let's say it is just objects or materials, movies or writing, but not art, OK?
42855.name: Ai Weiwei

42858.quote: In movies and in television the robots are always evil. I guess I am not into the whole brooding cyberpunk dystopia thing.
42858.name: Daniel H. Wilson

42859.quote: I cast unusual people in my movies.
42859.name: Albert Brooks

42860.quote: I've always been in the middle of making my own movies, so taking acting jobs that take me away from that has been impossible.
42860.name: Albert Brooks

42861.quote: By the way, movies are like sporting events in that you're as good as the movie you're in. You can sit in a room for 20 years and go do a movie and you can just kill in it and you move to the head of the line again. By the same token, you can do five movies a year and if they're dreck, it's nothing.
42861.name: Albert Brooks

42862.quote: Listen, there are some movies that are set in stone and the writer or the director does not want to change, but I've never worked on a movie, including my own, that didn't take advantage of a rehearsal process.
42862.name: Albert Brooks

42863.quote: I've done performances in movies that I was immensely proud of and the movies didn't take off like a rocket at Cape Canaveral, it didn't take off.
42863.name: Albert Brooks

42864.quote: My mom was a professional. My dad and mom met each other in a movie called 'New Faces of 1937.' My mom went under the name Thelma Leeds, and she did a few movies, and she was really a great singer, and when she married my dad and started to have a family, she sang at parties.
42864.name: Albert Brooks

42865.quote: I got into film-making because I was interested in making entertaining movies, which I felt there was a lack of.
42865.name: Guy Ritchie

42866.quote: What I liked about American movies when I was a kid was that they're sort of larger than life and I think I'm still suffering from that reaction.
42866.name: Guy Ritchie

42867.quote: I'm just happy to be a film where for once I don't have to worry about my hair, because my managers are always complaining about my hair looking depressing in my movies. Which is true. I mean, it's true.
42867.name: Emily Mortimer

42868.quote: Movies are movies: they take you back in time, and how it still is for some.
42868.name: Tina Turner

42869.quote: I was always attracted to science fiction movies.
42869.name: Tina Turner

42870.quote: I watch and listen to movies today and am shocked by the way actors deliver their lines. Everybody mumbles now and I don't understand why.
42870.name: Maureen O'Hara

42871.quote: Making movies is just like betting on horses at the racetrack.
42871.name: Maureen O'Hara

42872.quote: It just proves good movies don't need 100 million dollars to be good.
42872.name: Emily Blunt

42873.quote: Why should you have to atone for making big movies?
42873.name: Emily Blunt

42874.quote: In terms of number of movies, I've been in an extraordinary amount. If you count only the minutes I'm onscreen, it's not so long.
42874.name: Wallace Shawn

42875.quote: I've found that if you wear a beret, people think you're either a cabdriver or a producer of dirty movies.
42875.name: Ernie Harwell

42876.quote: I never read. The paper or anything. I watch a lot of movies, and TV series and stuff. But I never, never read.
42876.name: Andy Murray

42877.quote: In live action movies, you just hope that everything works. Because the actor may had a bad morning and doesn't play good, or accidents happen continuously. Many things contradict what you are trying to say. But in cartoons, nothing contradict what you want to say.
42877.name: John Hench

42878.quote: John Barry was my hero when I was about 13. His scores to the James Bond movies were the scores of my life back then.
42878.name: Carter Burwell

42879.quote: Well, look at all of these summer blockbusters. You can't help but laugh a little, because you've already seen a lot of these movies 482 times.
42879.name: Sean Penn

42880.quote: You can figure out who you were by which movies you loved when.
42880.name: Mary Schmich

42881.quote: I like being in kids' movies, and I like being in family movies.
42881.name: Bill Nighy

42882.quote: The movies were custard compared to politics.
42882.name: Nancy Reagan

42883.quote: I've seen little pieces of 'Interview with a Vampire' when it was on TV, but I kind of always go yuck! I don't watch R-rated movies, so that really cuts down on a lot of the horror.
42883.name: Stephenie Meyer

42884.quote: I look at myself as an audience member. I still love movies, and I still go and sit in the back of the big dark room with everybody else, and I want the same thrill.
42884.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42885.quote: I grew up watching those blaxploitation movies. Ron O'Neal, Richard Roundtree, Jim Brown, Pam Grier. For the first time, I saw 'The Negro' get one over on 'The Man.'
42885.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42886.quote: I kind of realize that I have a tendency to choose the kind of films I watched when I was a kid and would go home and pretend with my friends that we were in those movies after we saw them.
42886.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42887.quote: All movies aren't fun some are hard work. You try to do something and convey a set of emotions that have to do with some real life kind of stuff.
42887.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42888.quote: People go to movies on Saturday to get away from the war in Iraq and taxes and election news and pedophiles online and just go and have some fun. I like doing movies that are fun.
42888.name: Samuel L. Jackson

42889.quote: For a number of years, I'd been around the kind of people who financed movies and the kind of people who are there to make the deals for movies. But I'd always had this naive idea that everybody wants to make movies as good as they can be, which is stupid.
42889.name: David Fincher

42890.quote: A lot of the themes of my movies, the actual stories, come from tabloid stories.
42890.name: Errol Morris

42891.quote: It's a required part of your film history to know who Woody is. His movies are so wonderful, and not just funny but so insightful about human behavior.
42891.name: Scarlett Johansson
