42892.quote: I was going to make movies. I was the one in the family who was always rolling the video camera, making movies of my brothers around town, and then screening them for my parents. I still would love to make movies someday, that's something that really means a lot to me, and I know I'll have the chance to do it one day.
42892.name: Joe Jonas

42893.quote: Bill Hanna and I owe an awful lot to television, but we both got our start and built the first phase of our partnership in the movies.
42893.name: Joseph Barbera

42894.quote: I'd love to act more. I've had to turn down multiple movies because I was on tour, but it's encouraging to know that someday there might be the right role, the right timing. And I've been writing a lot of music, so hopefully very soon I'll have recorded a project of my own. I also want to get a boat and open a restaurant.
42894.name: Joe Jonas

42895.quote: When we were doing 'Freaks and Geeks', I didn't quite understand how movies and TV worked, and I would improvise even if the camera wasn't on me. I thought I was helping the other actors by keeping them on their toes, but nobody appreciated it when I would trip them up. So I was improvising a little bit back then, but not in a productive way.
42895.name: James Franco

42896.quote: My agent said, 'You aren't good enough for movies.' I said, 'You're fired.'
42896.name: Sally Field

42897.quote: I don't make movies because I think audiences will want to go see them.
42897.name: Jerry Bruckheimer

42898.quote: Studios, because they are investing a great deal of money in movies, they want a guarantee that when they hire somebody that person can deliver for them. Everything is fear based, so they pigeonhole people. But I've written everything, from Westerns to sci-fi to dramedy, I've done it all.
42898.name: Melissa Rosenberg

42899.quote: I think that my vampires in general were influenced by my being allowed to watch the Hammer vampire films. Vampire Circus, also shown as Circus of Fear, was one of those movies.
42899.name: Laurell K. Hamilton

42900.quote: I've managed to do movies and still keep a lifestyle where I can go to ballgames, go to a grocery store like everybody else.
42900.name: Chris Evans

42901.quote: If your goal is to be the biggest movie star in the world, a 10-movie contract is gold. It was never my goal. Up until now, I made movies - and I have a nice house, a nice car. I'm fortunate, happy and grateful. Life is good.
42901.name: Chris Evans

42902.quote: All my good movies, nobody sees.
42902.name: Chris Evans

42903.quote: I don't know any form of art or entertainment that can affect people the way movies can. I know it sounds ridiculous, but they can change your world. They can change your views.
42903.name: Chris Evans

42904.quote: What do I geek out about? What am I? Hmmm. I love movies. I watch movies. I like big, sweeping epics, like Ed Zwick stuff: 'The Last Samurai,' 'Legends of the Fall,' 'Blood Diamond,' 'Glory.'
42904.name: Chris Evans

42905.quote: It seems like the studios are either making giant blockbusters, or really super-small indies. And the mid-level films I grew up on, like 'Back to the Future' and all those John Hughes movies, the studios aren't doing. It's hard to get them on their feet.
42905.name: Chris Evans

42906.quote: Movies are movies, television is television.
42906.name: Dirk Benedict

42907.quote: I've had nine of my books adapted to film, and almost all were enjoyable. I've been very lucky with Hollywood, and look forward to more movies being adapted. But I don't get involved in that process. I know nothing about making movies and I stay away from it and hope for the best.
42907.name: John Grisham

42908.quote: My grandmother and I saw an average of eight movies a week, double features, second run.
42908.name: Carol Burnett

42909.quote: I don't like to watch my own movies - I fall asleep in my own movies.
42909.name: Robert De Niro

42910.quote: Movies are hard work. The public doesn't see that. The critics don't see it. But they're a lot of work. A lot of work.
42910.name: Robert De Niro

42911.quote: I'll work with a director if I think I'm going to get into a comfortable situation, and if it's someone I respect and who respects me, even if they're not so well known. Movies are hard to make, and you have to work toward a common ethic and do your best.
42911.name: Robert De Niro

42912.quote: Skinniness is not your friend when you're over 40. I'd like to gain a good 10 pounds, but I did always have a fat, round face that plagued me when I was young. When I started to make movies, I couldn't look at myself.
42912.name: Ellen Barkin

42913.quote: The way Hollywood portrays mothers - you're either all good and saint-like, or you're all bad. And I think the real honesty of motherhood is not given a voice in movies. I miss that as an audience member.
42913.name: Ellen Barkin

42914.quote: When they make a woman's picture, they treat it like a 'woman's picture.' In the '40s, they didn't treat Joan Crawford movies like that, but as the big movies of their year. I'm upset that there's no 'Terminator' with a woman in Arnold Schwarzenegger's role. Because that would make just as much money.
42914.name: Ellen Barkin

42915.quote: I'm always working on stuff. But they never materialize. I'm always working on movies and TV shows.
42915.name: Colin Quinn

42916.quote: American movies and music deliver themes of freedom, innocence, and power that appeal to others - partly because America itself was put together out of a multiplicity of national traditions.
42916.name: Todd Gitlin

42917.quote: Violent behavior exists in one's psychological makeup much deeper than the level that receives information from television or movies.
42917.name: Richard King

42918.quote: When I go into making a movie, personally, I don't try to bring other pieces of movies with me.
42918.name: Amber Heard

42919.quote: I think there's an instinct to make grotesque horror films that are purely carnal, like the 'Saw' movies.
42919.name: Amber Heard

42920.quote: I think more than writers, the major influences on me have been European movies, jazz, and Abstract Expressionism.
42920.name: Don DeLillo

42921.quote: I watch movies occasionally, and I watch documentaries. Virtually nothing else.
42921.name: Don DeLillo

42922.quote: I never stopped studying Buddhism. In the past few years, in between movies, I do a retreat.
42922.name: Jet Li

42923.quote: I am so happy because I want more people to like martial arts movie not just martial arts audience. Even martial arts can be used in comedy, in drama, in horror movies, in different kinds of movies.
42923.name: Jet Li

42924.quote: Coming Home had been made before and Apocalypse Now and Deer Hunter, different kinds of movies.
42924.name: Oliver Stone

42926.quote: I'm terrible at horror movies, by the way. I get scared so easily.
42926.name: Oliver Stone

42927.quote: Part of the reason why movie bosses are so obsessed with crime movies is because they know that world and the criminals. And that's what they are - they would not hesitate to act illegally to achieve profit and gain.
42927.name: Peter Mullan

42928.quote: One of the joys of going to the movies was that it was trashy, and we should never lose that.
42928.name: Oliver Stone

42929.quote: As a kid, I liked the 'Halloween' movies and 'Nightmare On Elm Street' and all that kind of stuff. But as an adult, I really don't watch much horror, to be honest.
42929.name: Corey Feldman

42930.quote: I'm a big kid, I'm a kid at heart, so I still love the classic family films, such as the great Warner Bros film 'Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory' - not the remake, but the original. It's still one of the best movies, hands down, ever made, and of course that goes back to the ingenuity of the characters and the storyline.
42930.name: Corey Feldman

42931.quote: I wanted to escape Small Town U.S.A. To dismiss the boundaries, to explore. My life experience came from watching movies, TV, and reading books and magazines. When your culture comes from watching TV everyday, you're bombarded with images of things that seem cool, places that seem interesting, people who have jobs and careers and opportunities.
42931.name: Trent Reznor

42932.quote: If dreams are like movies, then memories are films about ghosts.
42932.name: Adam Duritz

42933.quote: I went to film school and wanted to learn everything there was about making movies.
42933.name: Zach Braff

42934.quote: I'm a person who likes these sort of movies, sad but moving 'art movies' that normally are at a festival and then they go to a small art house theater and disappear.
42934.name: Zach Braff

42935.quote: In theater or movies you see either 'I'm religious' or 'I'm an atheist.' I've never seen too much discussion of 'I believe there's a higher power but I'm hesitant to reach out to him because I don't know if I'm worthy of his attention.'
42935.name: Zach Braff

42936.quote: I've never been interested in action movies. Definitely not interested in sci-fi.
42936.name: Carrie-Anne Moss

42937.quote: And the VCR did the same thing: the movie industry thought nobody would ever watch movies any more.
42937.name: Niklas Zennstrom

42938.quote: I'm a spoilt brat. I thought I was just going to walk in and make movies. But I'd been my own boss for so long that all of a sudden to be facing a roomful of people who were niggling over every little scene, I just thought I'd go back and draw my comics and have a happy life.
42938.name: Frank Miller

42939.quote: I grew up on the crime stuff. Spillane, Chandler, Jim Thompson, and noir movies like Fuller, Orson Welles, Fritz Lang. When I first showed up in New York to write comics back in the late 1970s, I came with a bunch of crime stories but everybody just wanted men in tights.
42939.name: Frank Miller

42940.quote: In some movies you feel like you're a very small part of a huge machine. Whereas in the theater you can have a very small part, but you can still feel the weight and the gravity of it. Given the nature of theater, it's a more concentrated and quiet experience.
42940.name: Minnie Driver

42941.quote: I don't know if I see myself as really an action hero, but I like doing physical movies and I like doing movies where the writing is very lean.
42941.name: Jodie Foster

42942.quote: I love European movies and I kind of grew up on European films.
42942.name: Jodie Foster

42943.quote: If I have to produce movies, direct movies, whatever to change the way Hollywood treats older women, I'll do it. If I have to bend the rules, I will. If I have to break them, I will.
42943.name: Naomi Watts

42944.quote: I've always had this idea that I wanted movies to make people better not worse.
42944.name: Jodie Foster

42945.quote: I love making movies, but there's nothing like being in front of an audience.
42945.name: Patrick Wilson

42946.quote: So, yes, there's nothing I love more than listening to directors talk about their movies.
42946.name: Jodie Foster

42947.quote: With actors like Steve McQueen, Paul Newman and Harrison Ford, what made them such icons is that even in dramatic movies, their characters had a sense of humor.
42947.name: Patrick Wilson

42948.quote: The movies I made when I was 14 or 15, I have a hard time looking at those. Those were the awkward years. I don't know if anybody can look at something they did when they were 14 and not wince.
42948.name: Jodie Foster

42949.quote: Movies will end up being this esoteric art form, where only singular people will put films out in a small group of theaters.
42949.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42950.quote: I made about 28 movies, and I think about five of them were good.
42950.name: Chevy Chase

42951.quote: I grew up watching Steven Spielberg and scary movies.
42951.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42952.quote: Even in the former Soviet Union, they have good copies of my movies.
42952.name: Dario Argento

42953.quote: My normal cycle for movies is eighteen months and each part is separate.
42953.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42954.quote: Maybe when I stop making movies, I'll understand my work better.
42954.name: Dario Argento

42955.quote: When I was a kid, I had two great guilty pleasures. One was horror movies and the other was martial arts movies.
42955.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42956.quote: The thing that's protected me creatively is that the movies have made profits.
42956.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42957.quote: I do other sorts of things. I act in other people's movies. I direct operas. I write books.
42957.name: Werner Herzog

42958.quote: American movies are often very good at mining those great underlying myths that make films robustly travel across class, age, gender, culture.
42958.name: Tom Hooper

42959.quote: The first two movies I directed failed, when I was 21 and 23, and that was the greatest thing that could have happened.
42959.name: M. Night Shyamalan

42960.quote: All studio movies are the middle of the Bell curve. The only way to do something is to do it yourself. And the only way to do that is to not take any money from anyone or take as little money as possible from anyone and that's it.
42960.name: Thomas Lennon

42961.quote: I manage to hide in my movies.
42961.name: Liev Schreiber

42962.quote: Hollywood and the recording industry argue that current law permits the copying of songs and movies, and sharing them on the Internet. This enables young people to grow up learning how to steal.
42962.name: Suzanne Fields

42963.quote: Well, the thing about great fictional characters from literature, and the reason that they're constantly turned into characters in movies, is that they completely speak to what makes people human.
42963.name: Keira Knightley

42964.quote: I didn't know this about myself, but when 'Pirates of the Caribbean' came out I realised that I didn't enjoy a huge amount of recognition. I didn't react to it well, but I think life is about finding out who you are and what you like. So I started doing independent movies and art-house films instead.
42964.name: Keira Knightley

42965.quote: I use to watch like maybe three or four movies, five days out of the week. I was a movie buff, but I really didn't know what it was like behind the scenes, or the whole political process of it.
42965.name: Michelle Rodriguez

42966.quote: Man, I love the 'Lord of the Rings' movies. Some people would say I'm weird for liking those types of movies, but they are so cool.
42966.name: Robert Griffin III

42967.quote: I want to work with great directors. I want to work on good material with good actors. I've probably done 20 movies at this point and a lot of independents. It's been an incredible ride and I love it and I'm just going to keep going and doing what I'm doing.
42967.name: Famke Janssen

42968.quote: I love scary movies. The Shining and Don't Look Now are two of the best.
42968.name: Famke Janssen

42969.quote: Everybody gets typecast in movies, but you have to make wise choices. I'd say around 90 percent of movie casting is about the way you look, so you have to fight that. If producers had their way, I'd only be in action films, but I'm interested in a more varied career than that.
42969.name: Famke Janssen

42970.quote: I like to go from mainstream movies to more artsy films. I don't sign on for the money. Maybe I should, but I don't. There's always a good reason for doing something.
42970.name: Famke Janssen

42971.quote: I love the first two X-Men movies because I thought that Bryan Singer did such a great job. He elevated that whole genre. He's a very talented director.
42971.name: Famke Janssen

42972.quote: I love music, and after my first experience with movies, I can't wait to do more.
42972.name: Rihanna

42973.quote: When I started doing movies, every crew member was older than me.
42973.name: Elizabeth Hurley

42974.quote: When you kill somebody in the movies, it matters, whereas in literature it can be allegorical.
42974.name: Barbet Schroeder

42975.quote: In social institutions, the whole is always less than the sum of its parts. There will never be a state as good as its people, or a church worthy of its congregation, or a university equal to its faculty and students.
42975.name: Edward Abbey

42976.quote: There is no such thing as a self-made man. We are made up of thousands of others. Everyone who has ever done a kind deed for us, or spoken one word of encouragement to us, has entered into the makeup of our character and our thoughts, as well as our success.
42976.name: George Matthew Adams

42977.quote: I had always loved beautiful and artistic things, though before leaving America I had had very little chance of seeing any.
42977.name: Emma Albani

42978.quote: Exploration is really the essence of the human spirit.
42978.name: Frank Borman

42979.quote: The only business of the head in the world is to bow a ceaseless obeisance to the heart.
42979.name: William Butler Yeats

42980.quote: Though one sits in meditation in a particular place, the Self in him can exercise its influence far away. Though still, it moves everywhere,The Self cannot be known by anyone who desists not from unrighteous ways, controls not his senses, stills not his mind, and practices not meditation.
42980.name: Lu Yen

42981.quote: That which exists through itself is called The Eternal. The Eternal has neither name nor shape. It is the one essence, the one primal spirit. Essence and life cannot be seen. They are contained in the light of heaven. The light of heaven cannot be seen. It is contained in the two eyes.
42981.name: Lu Yen

42982.quote: If the thoughts are absolutely tranquil the heavenly heart can be seen. The heavenly heart lies between sun and moon (i.e. between the two eyes). It is the home of the inner light. To make light circulate is the deepest and most wonderful secret. The light is easy to move, but difficult to fix. If it is made to circulate long enought, then it crystallizes itself; that is the natural spirit body,
42982.name: Lu Yen

42983.quote: True thoughts have duration in themselves. If the thoughts endure, the seed is enduring; if the seed endures, the energy endures; if the energy endures, then will the spirit endure. The spirit is thought; thought is the heart; the heart is the fire; the fire is the Elixir.
42983.name: Lu Yen

42984.quote: Two stones build two houses, three stones build six houses, four build twenty-four houses, five build one hundred and twenty houses, six build seven hundred and twenty houses and seven build five thousand and forty houses. From thence further go and reckon what the mouth cannot express and the ear cannot hear.
42984.name: Sepher Yezirah

42985.quote: Tomorrow is a satire on today, And shows its weakness.
42985.name: Edward Young

42986.quote: A soul without reflection, like a pile Without inhabitant, to ruin runs.
42986.name: Edward Young

42987.quote: By all means use some time to be alone.
42987.name: Edward Young

42988.quote: Too low they build who build below the skies.
42988.name: Edward Young

42989.quote: It takes vision and courage to create-it takes faith and courage to prove.
42989.name: Owen D. Young

42990.quote: Selfishness is the only real atheism; aspiration, unselfishness, the only real religion.
42990.name: Israel Zangwill

42991.quote: One of my favorite philosophical tenets is that people will agree with you only if they already agree with you. You do not change people's minds.
42991.name: Frank Zappa

42992.quote: Choose silence of all virtues, for by it you hear other men's imperfections, and conceal your own.
42992.name: Zeno

42993.quote: In Fame's temple there is always a niche to be found for rich dunces, importunate scoundrels or successful butchers of the human race.
42993.name: Zimmerman

42994.quote: Before God manifested Himself, when all things were still hidden in Him, He began by forming an imperceptible point; that was His own thought. With this thought He then began to construct a mysterious and holy form, the Universe.
42994.name: Zohar

42995.quote: Every soul is subject to the trial of Transmigration,An individual does not know that he is called for assessment before entering this World as well as after leaving it. He does not know how many transformations and esoteric trials he has to pass through,and that souls revolve like a stone shot from a sling.
42995.name: Zohar

42996.quote: All souls must undergo transmigration and the souls of men revolve like a stone which is thrown from a sling, so many turns before the final release,Only those who have not completed their perfection must suffer the wheel of rebirth by being reborn into another human body.
42996.name: Zohar

42997.quote: To understand a holy unity, examine the flame rising from a candle. We see at first two kinds of light, one glistening white and one blue or black. The white light is above and rises in a straight line, the blue or black light is beneath and appears to be the source of the white; yet the two lights are so closely united they form one single flame. But the source formed by the blue or black light is, in turn, attached to the wick under it. The white light never changes, it always remains white; but several shades are distinguishable in the lower light. Moreover, the lower light moves in two opposite directions; above, it is connected to the white light, and below, it is attached to the burning matter; this matter continually consumes itself and rises toward the upper light. It is thus that all that is, reunites with the one unity.
42997.name: Zohar

42998.quote: The entire lower world was created in the likeness of the higher world. All that exists in the higher world appears like an image in this lower world; yet all this is but One.
42998.name: Zohar

42999.quote: Temptation is the fire that brings up the scum of the heart.
42999.name: Thomas Boston

43000.quote: Be good, be kind, be humane, and charitable; love your fellows; console the afflicted; pardon those who have done you wrong.
43000.name: Zoroaster

43002.quote: Technological change defines the horizon of our material world as it shapes the limiting conditions of what is possible and what is barely imaginable. It erodes, assumptions about the nature of our reality, the 'pattern' in which we dwell, and lays open new choices.
43002.name: Shoshana Zuboff

43003.quote: Hearing, seeing and understanding each other, humanity from one end of the earth to the other now lives simultaneously, omnipresent like a god thanks to its own creative ability. And, thanks to its victory over space and time, it would now be splendidly united for all time, if it were not confused again and again by that fatal delusion which causes humankind to keep on destroying this grandiose unity and to destroy itself with the same resources which gave it power over the elements.
43003.name: Stefan Zweig

43004.quote: Many children, many cares; no children, no felicity.
43004.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43005.quote: A sound discretion is not so much indicated by never making a mistake as by never repeating it.
43005.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43006.quote: Enthusiasm is the inspiration of everything great. Without it no man is to be feared, and with it none despised.
43006.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43007.quote: Fame - a few words upon a tombstone, and the truth of those not to be depended on.
43007.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43008.quote: Good men have the fewest fears. He has but one great fear who fears to do wrong; he has a thousand who has overcome it.
43008.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43010.quote: Kindness is a language the dumb canspeak and the deaf can hear and understand.
43010.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43011.quote: It is ever the invisible that is the object of our profoundest worship. With the lover it is not the seen but the unseen that he muses upon.
43011.name: Christian Nestell Bovee

43012.quote: Fate is not an eagle, it creeps like a rat.
43012.name: Elizabeth Bowen

43013.quote: When you love someone all your saved-up wishes start coming out.

The players listen very carefully and respectfully to all that the clever men have to say about what is to happen in the next generation. The players then wait until all the clever men are dead, and bury them nicely. Then they go and do something else. That is all. For a race of simple tastes, however, it is great fun.

43208.name: I Ching

43209.quote: The superior man acquaints himself with many sayings of antiquity and many deeds of the past, in order to strengthen his character thereby.
43209.name: I Ching

43210.quote: Great indeed is the sublimity of the Creative, to which all beings owe their beginning and which permeates all heaven.
43210.name: I Ching

43211.quote: Of all that is good, sublimity is supreme. Succeeding is the coming together of all that is beautiful. Furtherance is the agreement of all that is just. Perseverance is the foundation of all actions.
43211.name: I Ching

43212.quote: The unassuming youth seeking instruction with humility gains good fortune.
43212.name: I Ching

43213.quote: It is an inexorable Law of Nature that bad must follow good, that decline must follow a rise. To feel that we can rest on our achievements is a dangerous fallacy. Inner strength can overcome anything that occurs outside.
43213.name: I Ching

43214.quote: ,Insidious is the cry for 'revolution,' at a time when not even the germs of new institutions exist, let alone the moral and political consciousness that could lead to a basic modification of social life. If there will be a 'revolution' in America today, it will no doubt be a move towards some variety of fascism. We must guard against the kind of revolutionary rhetoric that would have had Karl Marx burn down the British Museum because it was merely part of a repressive society. It would be criminal to overlook the serious flaws and inadequacies in our institutions, or to fail to utilize the substantial degree of freedom that most of us enjoy, within the framework of these flawed institutions, to modify them or even replace them by a better social order. One who pays some attention to history will not be surprised if those who cry most loudly that we must smash and destroy are later found among the administrators of some new system of repression.
43214.name: Noam Chomsky

43215.quote: Do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Let the day's own trouble be sufficient for the day.
43215.name: Jesus Christ

43216.quote: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him. God is a spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
43216.name: Jesus Christ

43217.quote: I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly dreaming I am a man.
43217.name: Chuang

43218.quote: A dog is not considered a good dog because he is a good barker. A man is not considered a good man because he is a good talker.
43218.name: Chuang-tzu

43219.quote: This is no time for ease and comfort. It is the time to dare and endure.
43219.name: Winston Churchill

43220.quote: The greatest lesson in life is to know that even fools are right sometimes.
43220.name: Winston Churchill

43221.quote: This is one of those cases in which the imagination is baffled by the facts.
43221.name: Winston Churchill

43222.quote: There is no such thing as a good tax.
43222.name: Winston Churchill

43223.quote: In wartime, truth is so precious that she should always be attended by a bodyguard of lies.
43223.name: Winston Churchill

43224.quote: A prisoner of war is a man who tries to kill you and fails, and then asks you not to kill him.
43224.name: Winston Churchill

43225.quote: Love is the word used to label the sexual excitement of the young, the habituation of the middle-aged, and the mutual dependence of the old.
43225.name: John Ciardi

43226.quote: Oh! how many torments lie in the small circle of a wedding ring.
43226.name: Colley Cibber

43227.quote: Religions change; Beer and Wine remain.
43227.name: Hervey Allen

43228.quote: One problem with gazing too frequently into the past is that we may turn around to find the future has run out on us.
43228.name: Michael Cibenko

43229.quote: Avarice in old age is foolish; for what can be more absurd than to increase our provisions for the road the nearer we approach to our journey's end.
43229.name: Cicero

43230.quote: The nobler a man, the harder it is for him to suspect inferiority in others.
43230.name: Cicero

43231.quote: That last day does not bring extinction to us, but change of place.
43231.name: Cicero

43232.quote: The life of the dead is placed in the memory of the living.
43232.name: Cicero

43233.quote: Every man can tell how many goats or sheep he possesses, but not how many friends.
43233.name: Cicero

43234.quote: The rule of friendship means there should be mutual sympathy between them, each supplying what the other lacks and trying to benefit the other, always using friendly and sincere words.
43234.name: Cicero

43235.quote: What is thine is mine, and all mine is thine.
43235.name: Cicero

43236.quote: Glory follows virtue as if it were its shadow.
43236.name: Cicero

43237.quote: True glory takes root, and even spreads; all false pretences, like flowers, fall to the ground; nor can any counterfeit last long.
43237.name: Cicero

43238.quote: We think a happy life consists in tranquility of mind.
43238.name: Cicero

43239.quote: In honorable dealing you should consider what you intended, not what you said or thought.
43239.name: Cicero

43240.quote: Justice consists in doing no injury to men; decency in giving them no offense.
43240.name: Cicero

43241.quote: If you pursue good with labor, the labor passes away but the good remains; if you pursue evil with pleasure, the pleasure passes away and the evil remains.
43241.name: Cicero

43242.quote: Liberty consists in the power of doing that which is permitted by the law.
43242.name: Cicero

43243.quote: Nor has he spent his life badly who has passed it in privacy.
43243.name: Cicero

43245.quote: In everything satiety closely follows the greatest pleasures.
43245.name: Cicero

43246.quote: The safety of the people shall be the highest law.
43246.name: Cicero

43247.quote: The countenance is the portrait of the soul, and the eyes mark its intentions.
43247.name: Cicero

43248.quote: When you are aspiring to the highest place, it is honorable to reach the second or even the third rank.
43248.name: Cicero

43249.quote: The noblest spirit is most strongly attracted by thelove of glory.
43249.name: Cicero

43250.quote: Virtue is a habit of the mind, consistent with nature and moderation and reason.
43250.name: Cicero

43251.quote: A dream is a wish your heart makes - When you're fast asleep.
43251.name: Cinderella

43252.quote: War is a series of catastrophes which result in victory.
43252.name: Sarah Cleghorn

43253.quote: A truly American sentiment recognizes the dignity of labor and the fact that honor lies in honest toil.
43253.name: Grover Cleveland

43254.quote: It is not the greatness of a man's means that makes him independent, so much as the smallness of his wants.
43254.name: William Cobbett

43255.quote: The actual tragedies of life bear no relation to one's preconceived ideas. In the event, one is always bewildered by their simplicity, their grandeur of design, and by that element of the bizzare which seems inherent in them.
43255.name: Jean Cocteau

43256.quote: We must believe in luck for how else can we explain the success of those we don't like?
43256.name: Jean Cocteau

43257.quote: What really matters is the name you succeed in imposing on the facts not the facts themselves.
43257.name: Jerome Cohen

43260.quote: Sympathy constitutes friendship; but in love there is a sort of antipathy, or opposing passion. Each strives to be the other, and both together make up one whole.
43260.name: Samuel T. Coleridge

43261.quote: Real pain can alone cure us of imaginary ills. We feel a thousand miseries till we are lucky enought to feel misery.
43261.name: Samuel T. Coleridge

43262.quote: Truth is a good dog; but always beware of barking too close to the heels of an error, lest you get your brains kicked out.
43262.name: Samuel T. Coleridge

43263.quote: You will never do anything in this world without courage. It is the greatest quality of the mind next to honor.
43263.name: James L. Allen

43264.quote: The writer who loses his self-doubt, who gives way as he grows old to a sudden euphoria, to prolixity, should stop writing immediately: the time has come for him to lay aside his pen.
43264.name: Colette

43265.quote: Time spent with cats is never wasted.
43265.name: Collette

43266.quote: But when ill indeed, Even dismissing the doctor don't always succeed.
43266.name: George Colman

43267.quote: Pleasure is to Women what the Sun is to the Flower; if moderately enjoyed, it beautifies, it refreshes, and it improves; if immoderately, it withers, etiolates, and destroys.
43267.name: Colton

43268.quote: The intoxication of anger, like that of the grape, shows us to others, but hides us from ourselves.
43268.name: Charles C. Colton

43269.quote: Happiness, that grand mistress of the ceremonies in the dance of life, impels us through all its mazes and meanderings, but leads none of us by the same route.
43269.name: Charles C. Colton

43270.quote: Ennui has made more gamblers than avarice, more drunkards than thirst, and perhaps as many suicides as despair.
43270.name: Charles C. Colton

43271.quote: No man can purchase his virtue too dear, for it is the only thing whose value must ever increase with the price it has cost us. Our integrity is never worth so much as when we have parted with our all to keep it.
43271.name: Charles C. Colton

43272.quote: In life we shall find many men that are great, and some that are good, but very few men that are both great and good.
43272.name: Charles C. Colton

43273.quote: Friendship often ends in love; but love in friendship-never.
43273.name: Charles C. Colton

43274.quote: Small miseries, like small debts, hit us in so many places, and meet us at so many turns and corners, that what they want in weight, they make up in number, and render it less hazardous to stand the fire of one cannon ball, than a volley composed of such a shower of bullets.
43274.name: Charles C. Colton

43275.quote: It is an easy and vulgar thing to please the mob, and no very arduous task to astonish them.
43275.name: Charles C. Colton

43276.quote: To know the pains of power, we must go to those who have it; to know its pleasures, we must go to those who seek it: the pains of power are real, its pleasures imaginary.
43276.name: Charles C. Colton

43277.quote: The bed is a bundle of paradoxes: we go to it with reluctance, yet we quit it with regret; we make up our minds every night to leave it early, but we make up our bodies every morning to keep it late.
43277.name: Charles C. Colton

43278.quote: It is only when the rich are sick that they fully feel the impotence of wealth.
43278.name: Charles C. Colton

43279.quote: Our incomes are like our shoes; if too small, they gall and pinch us; but if too large, they cause us to stumble and to trip.
43279.name: Charles C. Colton

43280.quote: Constant success shows us but one side of the world; adversity brings out the reverse of the picture.
43280.name: Charles Caleb Colton

43281.quote: They must often change who would be constant in happiness or wisdom.
43281.name: Confucius

43282.quote: Death and life have their determined appointments; riches and honours depend upon heaven.
43282.name: Confucius

43283.quote: Death and life have their determined appointments; riches and honors depend upon heaven.
43283.name: Confucius

43284.quote: Never contract friendship with a man that is not better than thyself.
43284.name: Confucius

43285.quote: Heaven means to be one with God.
43285.name: Confucius

43286.quote: Study the past, if you would divine the future.
43286.name: Confucius

43287.quote: Our greatest glory consists not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
43287.name: Confucius

43288.quote: When you are laboring for others let it be with the same zeal as if it were for yourself.
43288.name: Confucius

43289.quote: If I am walking with two other men, each of them will serve as my teacher. I will pick out the good points of the one and imitate them, and the bad points of the other and correct them in myself.
43289.name: Confucius

43290.quote: The perfecting of one's self is the fundamental base of all progress and all moral development.
43290.name: Confucius

43291.quote: A superior man is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
43291.name: Confucius

43292.quote: To practice five things under all circumstances constitutes perfect virtue; these five are gravity, generosity of soul, sincerity, earnestness, and kindness.
43292.name: Confucius

43293.quote: The superior man thinks always of virtue; the common man thinks of comfort.
43293.name: Confucius

43294.quote: Virtue is not left to stand alone. He who practices it will have neighbors.
43294.name: Confucius

43295.quote: To see and listen to the wicked is already the beginning of wickedness.
43295.name: Confucius

43296.quote: We must select the illusion which appeals to our temperament, and embrace it with passion, if we want to be happy.
43296.name: Cyril Connolly

43297.quote: The only way for writers to meet is to share a quick peek over a common lamp-post.
43297.name: Cyril Connolly

43298.quote: All ambitions are lawful except those which climb upward on the miseries or credulities of mankind.
43298.name: Joseph Conrad

43299.quote: The belief in a supernatural source of evil is not necessary; men alone are quite capable of every wickedness.
43299.name: Joseph Conrad

43300.quote: The coward wretch whose hand and heart Can bear to torture aught below, Is ever first to quail and start From the slightest pain or equal foe.
43300.name: Eliza Cook

43301.quote: You say that love is nonsense,.I tell you it is no such thing. For weeks and months it is a steady physical pain, an ache about the heart, never leaving one, by night or by day; a long strain on one's nerves like toothache orrheumatism, not intolerable at any one instant, but exhausting by its steady drain on the strength.
43301.name: Henry Adams

43302.quote: Money is better than poverty, if only for financial reasons.
43302.name: Woody Allen

43303.quote: I cannot give advice. How can I when I do not authorise success. I authorise it alright. Smile.
43303.name: Mason Cooley

43304.quote: Advice is more agreeable in the mouth than in the ear.
43304.name: Mason Cooley

43305.quote: Good advice is never as helpful as an interest-free loan.
43305.name: Mason Cooley

43306.quote: My regimen is lust and avarice for exercise, gluttony and sloth for relaxation.
43306.name: Mason Cooley

43307.quote: Faith of the bore: everything is worth saying.
43307.name: Mason Cooley

43308.quote: Never ask a bore a question.
43308.name: Mason Cooley

43309.quote: Complainers change their complaints, but they never reduce the amount of time spent in complaining.
43309.name: Mason Cooley

43310.quote: Excuses change nothing, but make everyone feel better.
43310.name: Mason Cooley

43311.quote: Change often makes accepted customs into crimes.
43311.name: Mason Cooley

43312.quote: Change is upsetting. Repetition is tedious. Three cheers for variation!
43312.name: Mason Cooley

43313.quote: I change my opinions often, but not my way of thinking.
43313.name: Mason Cooley

43314.quote: Our most important decisions are made while we are thinking about something else.
43314.name: Mason Cooley

43315.quote: Most of my decisions in life seem absent-minded but inevitable.
43315.name: Mason Cooley

43316.quote: Prudence suspects that happiness is a bait set by risk.
43316.name: Mason Cooley

43317.quote: In love, self-love is always at risk.
43317.name: Mason Cooley

43319.quote: Proverbial wisdom counsels against risk and change. But sitting ducks fare worst of all.
43319.name: Mason Cooley

43320.quote: Life is the risk we cannot refuse.
43320.name: Mason Cooley

43321.quote: When understanding would be too difficult, I become trusting.
43321.name: Mason Cooley

43322.quote: Every path to a new understanding begins in confusion.
43322.name: Mason Cooley

43323.quote: Understanding replaces imaginary fears with real ones.
43323.name: Mason Cooley

43324.quote: The business of America is business.
43324.name: Calvin Coolidge

43325.quote: All growth depends upon activity. There is no development physically or intellectually without effort, and effort means work.
43325.name: Calvin Coolidge

43326.quote: Prosperity is only an instrument to be used, not a deity to be worshipped.
43326.name: Calvin Coolidge

43327.quote: Fraud and falsehood only dread examination. Truth invites it.
43327.name: Thomas Cooper

43328.quote: Every man of courage is a man of his word.
43328.name: Pierre Corneille

43329.quote: Love lives on hope, and dies when hope is dead; It is a flame which sinks for lack of fuel.
43329.name: Pierre Corneille

43330.quote: To conquer without risk is to triumph without glory.
43330.name: Pierre Corneille

43331.quote: Obstacles are things a person sees when he takes his eyes off his goal.
43331.name: Cossman

43332.quote: There is no cosmetic for beauty like happiness.
43332.name: Countess of Blessington

43333.quote: Poverty wants some, luxury many, and avarice all things.
43333.name: Abraham Cowley

43334.quote: Begin, be bold, and venture to be wise; He who defers his work from day to day, Does on a river's bank expecting stay; Till the whole stream which stopped him should be gone, That runs, and as it runs, for ever will run on.
43334.name: Abraham Cowley

43335.quote: Money was made, not to command our will, But all our lawful pleasures to fulfill. Shame and woe to us, if we our wealth obey; The horse doth with the horseman away.
43335.name: Abraham Cowley

43336.quote: I would not enter in my list of friends, Who needlessly sets foot upon a worm. An inadvertent step may crush the snail That crawls at evening in the public path, But he has the humanity, forewarned, Will tread aside, and let the reptile live.
43336.name: William Cowper

43337.quote: Reasoning at every step he treads, Man yet mistakes his way, Whilst meaner things, whom instinct leads, Are rarely known to stray.
43337.name: William Cowper

43338.quote: Acquaint thyself with God, if thou would'st taste His works. Admitted once to his embrace, Thou shalt perceive that thou was blind before: Thine eye shall be instructed; and thine heart Made pure shall relish with divine delight Till then unfelt, what hands divine have wrought.
43338.name: William Cowper

43339.quote: O solitude, where are the charms That sages have seen in thy face? Better dwell in the midst of alarms, Than reign in this horrible place.
43339.name: William Cowper

43340.quote: Every sin is the result of a collaboration.
43340.name: Stephen Crane

43341.quote: A man said to the universe: 'Sir, I exist!' 'However,' replied the universe, 'That fact has not created in me A sense of obligation'.
43341.name: Stephen Crane

43342.quote: Oh hast thou forgotten this day we must part? It may be for years and it may be forever; Oh why art thou silent, thou voice of my heart?
43342.name: Julia Crawford

43343.quote: International business may conduct its operations with scraps of paper, but the ink it uses is human blood.
43343.name: Eric Ambler

43344.quote: Love is the extra effort we make in our dealings with those whom we do not like and once you understand that, you understand all. This idea that love overtakes you is nonsense. This is but a polite manifestation of sex. To love another you have to undertake some fragment of their destiny.
43344.name: Quentin Crisp

43345.quote: Instead of this we have luxury and avarice; public indigence side by side with private opulence; we glorify wealth and pursue idleness; between the worthy and the unworthy we make no distinction; all the prizes of virtue are awarded to ambition.
43345.name: Gaius Sallustius Crispus

43346.quote: In battle it is the cowards who run the most risk; bravery is a rampart of defense.
43346.name: Gaius Sallustius Crispus

43347.quote: It will be found an unjust and unwise jealousy to deprive a man of his natural liberty upon the supposition he may abuse it.
43347.name: Oliver Cromwell

43348.quote: Age , is a matter of feeling, not of years.
43348.name: George Williams Curtis

43349.quote: The poet ranks far below the painter in the representation of visible things, and far below the musician in that of invisible thin.
43349.name: Leonardo Da Vinci

43350.quote: Although nature commences with reason and ends in experience it is necessary for us to do the opposite, that is to commence with experience and from this to proceed to investigate the reason.
43350.name: Leonardo Da Vinci

43351.quote: Men of lofty genius when they are doing the least work are most active.
43351.name: Leonardo Da Vinci

43352.quote: Swift speedy time, feathered with flying hours, Dissolves the beauty of the fairest brow.
43352.name: Samuel Daniel

43353.quote: This is perhaps the most distinctive Buddhist teaching, that suffering is the product of 'the craving of the passions, the craving for existence, the craving fornonexistence.' It is, however, far from an obvious truth. Certain cases of suffering areplainly due to craving, namely, those that are due to frustrated desires. Desires may be eased by satisfaction or extirpation; and one may allow that if one stopped desiring, itwould amount to preventing all the suffering due to frustration. But this does not provethe general case,. Body, feelings, perception, mentality, and consciousness are separate sets of graspings. There is nothing that -does- the grasping. -We- are the aggregate ofthe graspings, not something, apart from them, that does the grasping. This is an interesting and startling thought.
43353.name: Arthur Coleman Danto

43354.quote: There is no such thing as justice - in or out of court.
43354.name: Clarence S. Darrow

43355.quote: There is a soul of truth in error; there is a soul of good in evil.
43355.name: Clarence S. Darrow

43356.quote: History shows that the human mind, fed by constant accessions of knowledge, periodically grows too large for its theoretical coverings, and bursts them asunder to appear in new habiliments, as the feeding and growing grub, at intervals, casts its too narrow skin and assumes another,. Truly the imago state of Man seems to be terribly distant, but every moult is a step gained.
43356.name: Charles Darwin

43357.quote: We must, however, acknowledge, as it seems to me, that man with all his noble qualities,still bears in his bodily frame the indelible stamp of his lowly origin.
43357.name: Charles Darwin

43358.quote: In the survival of favoured individuals and races, during the constantly-recurring struggle for existence, we see a powerful and ever-acting form of selection.
43358.name: Charles Darwin

43359.quote: Only that in you which is me can hear what I'm saying.
43359.name: Baba Ram Dass

43360.quote: Never swap horses crossing a stream.
43360.name: American Proverb

43361.quote: The methodological advice to interpret in a way that optimizes agreement should not be conceived as resting on a charitable assumption about human intelligence that might turn out to be false. If we cannot find a way to interpret the utterances and other behaviour of a creature as revealing a set of beliefs largely consistent and true by our standards, we have no reason to count that creature as rational, as having beliefs, or as saying anything.
43361.name: Donald Davidson

43362.quote: Happiness is always a by-product. It is probably a matter of temperament, and for anything I know it may be glandular. But it is not something that can be demanded from life, and if you are not happy you had better stop worrying about it and see what treasures you can pluck from your own brand of unhappiness.
43362.name: Robertson Davies

43363.quote: Love is not enough. It must be the foundation, the cornerstone- but not the complete structure. It is much too pliable, too yielding.
43363.name: Bette Davis

43364.quote: That's the nature of women, not to love when we love them, and to love when we love them not.
43364.name: Miguel De Cervantes

43365.quote: A great obstacle to happiness is to anticipate too great a happiness.
43365.name: Bernard le Bovier de Fontenelle

43366.quote: Faced with crisis, the man of character falls back on himself. He imposes his own stamp of action, takes responsibility for it, makes it his own.
43366.name: Charles De Gaulle

43367.quote: Imagination is the one weapon in the war against reality.
43367.name: Jules de Gaultier

43368.quote: If the secret of being a bore is to tell all, the secret of pleasing is to say just enough to be?not understood, but divined.
43368.name: Remy De Gourmont

43369.quote: Grief at the absence of a loved one is happiness compared to life with a person one hates.
43369.name: Jean De La Bruy?re

43370.quote: Every government has as much of a duty to avoid war as a ship's captain has to avoid a shipwreck.
43370.name: Guy de Maupassant

43371.quote: Action is coarsened thought; thought becomes concrete, obscure, and unconscious.
43371.name: Henri Frederic Amiel

43372.quote: Even on the most exalted throne in the world we areonly sitting on our own bottom.
43372.name: Michel de Montaigne

43373.quote: When I play with my cat, who knows if I am not more of a pastime to her than she is to me?
43373.name: Michel Eyquem de Montaigne

43374.quote: Truly, it is not want, but rather abundance, that breeds avarice.
43374.name: Michel Eyquem de Montaigne

43375.quote: Ambition is not a vice of little people.
43375.name: Michel de Montainge

43376.quote: Champagne is the only wine a woman can drink and still remain beautiful.
43376.name: Madame de Pompadour

43377.quote: My manner of thinking, so you say, cannot be approved. Do you suppose I care? A poor fool indeed is he who adopts a manner of thinking for others! My manner of thinking stems straight from my considered reflections; it holds with my existence, with the way I am made. It is not in my power to alter it; and were it, I'd not do so.
43377.name: Donatien Alphonse Francois de Sade

43378.quote: Love does not consist in gazing at each other but in looking outward together in the same direction.
43378.name: Antoine de Saint-Exup?ry

43379.quote: Have patience with all things, but chiefly have patience with yourself. Do not lose courage in considering your own imperfections, but instantly set about remedying them - every day begin the task anew.
43379.name: Francis de Sales

43380.quote: We cease loving ourselves if no one loves us.
43380.name: Madame De Sta?l

43381.quote: Men will never establish any equality with which they can be contented. Whatever efforts a people may make, they will never succeed in reducing all the conditions of society to a perfect level.
43381.name: Alexis de Tocqueville

43382.quote: We are almost always guilty of the hate we encounter.
43382.name: Luc De Vauvenargues

43383.quote: The opera is like a husband with a foreign title - expensive to support, hard to understand and therefore a supreme social challenge.
43383.name: Cleveland Amory

43384.quote: You can't make the Duchess of Windsor into Rebecca of Sunnybrook Farm. The facts of life are very stubborn things.
43384.name: Cleveland Amory

43385.quote: Dream as if you'll live forever. Live as if you'll die today.
43385.name: James Dean

43386.quote: Dreaming permits each and every one of us to be quietly and safely insane every night of our lives.
43386.name: William Dement

43387.quote: As a vessel is known by the sound, whether it be cracked or not; so men are proved, by their speeches, whether they be wise or foolish.
43387.name: Demosthenes

43388.quote: Ambition is like love, impatient both of delays and rivals.
43388.name: Denham

43389.quote: Youth, what man's age is like to be, doth show; We may our ends by our beginnings know.
43389.name: John Denham

43390.quote: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid,for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
43390.name: Deuteronomy

43391.quote: The bonds of matrimony are like any other bonds - they mature slowly.
43391.name: Peter DeVries

43392.quote: The difficulty with marriage is that we fall in love with a personality, but must live with a character.
43392.name: Peter DeVries

43393.quote: The road to success is filled with women pushing their husbands along.
43393.name: Thomas R. Dewar

43394.quote: Complete adaptation to environment means death. The essential point in all response is the desire to control environment.
43394.name: John Dewey

43395.quote: Conflict is the gadfly of thought. It stirs us to observation and memory. It instigates to invention. It shocks us out of sheeplike passivity, and sets us at noting and contriving.
43395.name: John Dewey

43396.quote: Independent self people (would be) a counterproductive anachronism in the collective society of the future (,) (where) people will be defined by their associations.
43396.name: John Dewey

43397.quote: Health is the greatest possession. Contentment is the greatest treasure. Confidence is the greatest friend. Non-being is the greatest joy.
43397.name: The Dhammapada

Surely it is worth something to feel that there are no priests, no popes, no parties, no governments, no kings, no gods, to whom your intellect can be compelled to pay a reluctant homage. Surely it is a joy to know that all the cruel ingenuity of bigotry can devise no prison, no dungeon, no cell in which for one instant to confine a thought; that ideas cannot be dislocated by racks, nor crushed in iron boots, nor burned with fire. 44230.name: Lao-Tzu

44818.name: Akhenaton

44819.name: Akhenaton

44821.quote: The higher the sun ariseth, the less shadow doth he cast; even so the greater is the goodness, the less doth it covet praise; yet cannot avoid its rewards in honours.
44821.name: Akhenaton

44822.quote: If thou be industrious to procure wealth, be generous in the disposal of it. Man never is so happy as when he giveth happiness unto another.
44822.name: Akhenaton

It behooveth thee, therefore, O child of calamity! early to fortify thy mind with courage and patience, that thou mayest support, with a becoming resolution, thy allotted portion of human evil.
44823.name: Akhenaton

44824.quote: Hear the words of prudence, give heed unto her counsels, and store them in thine heart; her maxims are universal, and all the virtues lean upon her; she is the guide and the mistress of human life.
44824.name: Akhenaton

45016.quote: Change can take place only when liberal and radical pressures are both strong. Liberal reforms and radical change are thus complementary rather than antagonistic. Together they make it possible continually to test the limits of what can be done.
