45534.quote: I got to experience soccer at the highest level at a young age I decided I wanted to be part of that for as long as possible.
45534.name: Mia Hamm

45535.quote: Living in an age of advertisement, we are perpetually disillusioned. The perfect life is spread before us every day, but it changes and withers at a touch.
45535.name: J. B. Priestley

45536.quote: Age, like distance lends a double charm.
45536.name: Oliver Herford

45537.quote: Utility is the great idol of the age, to which all powers must do service and all talents swear allegiance.
45537.name: Friedrich Schiller

45538.quote: Anyone who writes an autobiographical work at the age of 34 is, at best, presumptuous. It occurred to me that it was time to set the record straight.
45538.name: Jessica Savitch

45539.quote: New needs need new techniques. And the modern artists have found new ways and new means of making their statements, the modern painter cannot express this age, the airplane, the atom bomb, the radio, in the old forms of the Renaissance or of any other past culture.
45539.name: Jackson Pollock

45540.quote: One of the tough things about being an actor, probably the hardest thing, is getting your foot in the door, and my father handled that for me at a very early age.
45540.name: Jeff Bridges

45541.quote: Any role that big is going to be a challenge for any actor, but for an actor of a young age, it's going to be even tougher.
45541.name: Jeff Bridges

45542.quote: Now is the age of anxiety.
45542.name: W. H. Auden

45543.quote: I think it's pretty crazy to say you've been typecast at the age of 20 before you've even really started getting going.
45543.name: Tom Felton

45544.quote: At the age of four with paper hats and wooden swords we're all Generals. Only some of us never grow out of it.
45544.name: Peter Ustinov

45545.quote: My inspiration was my mom. She's a great cook, and she still cooks, and we still banter back and forth about cooking. Growing up in a mostly Portuguese community, food was important and the family table was extremely important. At a very young age I understood that.
45545.name: Emeril Lagasse

45546.quote: The great book for you is the book that has the most to say to you at the moment when you are reading. I do not mean the book that is most instructive, but the book that feeds your spirit. And that depends on your age, your experience, your psychological and spiritual need.
45546.name: Robertson Davies

45547.quote: Age gives you a great sense of proportion. You can be very hard on yourself when you're younger but now I just think 'well everybody's absolutely mad and I'm doing quite well'.
45547.name: Steven Morrissey

45548.quote: If the nineteenth century was the age of the editorial chair, ours is the century of the psychiatrist's couch.
45548.name: Marshall McLuhan

45549.quote: American youth attributes much more importance to arriving at driver's license age than at voting age.
45549.name: Marshall McLuhan

45550.quote: I think a child should be allowed to take his father's or mother's name at will on coming of age. Paternity is a legal fiction.
45550.name: James Joyce

45551.quote: Old age is the most unexpected of all things that happen to a man.
45551.name: Leon Trotsky

45552.quote: You get to a certain age where you prepare yourself for happiness. Sometimes you never remember to actually get happy.
45552.name: John Mayer

45553.quote: eing a father at a later age is different from when I had my other two daughters when I was in my 20s and 30s. If you're in your 60s and you're with the kid every day, you're dealing with the mind of a child, so it opens up that childishness in you again.
45553.name: Martin Scorsese

45554.quote: A moment comes, which comes but rarely in history, when we step out from the old to the new when an age ends and when the soul of a nation long suppressed finds utterance.
45554.name: Jawaharlal Nehru

45555.quote: There is nothing in socialism that a little age or a little money will not cure.
45555.name: Will Durant

45556.quote: If you age with somebody, you go through so many roles - you're lovers, friends, enemies, colleagues, strangers you're brother and sister. That's what intimacy is, if you're with your soulmate.
45556.name: Cate Blanchett

45557.quote: With age, you see people fail more. You see yourself fail more. How do you keep that fearlessness of a kid? You keep going. Luckily, I'm not afraid to make a fool of myself.
45557.name: Hugh Jackman

45558.quote: I'm not skinny for the wrong reasons. It's not because I'm bulimic or anorexic or doing drugs. Compared to a lot of actresses my age, I'm actually overweight.
45558.name: Lindsay Lohan

45559.quote: It seems that when you get to a certain age you almost give yourself permission to misbehave and say what you think. People allow it, with very old people.
45559.name: Julie Walters

45560.quote: I'm not as far along as Jack Nicklaus was at this age, but I'm trying.
45560.name: Tiger Woods

45561.quote: When superstition is allowed to perform the task of old age in dulling the human temperament, we can say goodbye to all excellence in poetry, in painting, and in music.
45561.name: Denis Diderot

45562.quote: Peace is the one condition of survival in this nuclear age.
45562.name: Adlai E. Stevenson

45563.quote: What could be more beautiful than a dear old lady growing wise with age? Every age can be enchanting, provided you live within it.
45563.name: Brigitte Bardot

45564.quote: You'd think that in this age, especially in the 21st century - especially with all the technology and all the discoveries that we've made - that we would figure out how to tackle abuse.
45564.name: Tori Amos

45565.quote: Here comes 40. I'm feeling my age and I've ordered the Ferrari. I'm going to get the whole mid-life crisis package.
45565.name: Keanu Reeves

45566.quote: At a young age winning is not the most important thing, the important thing is to develop creative and skilled players with good confidence.
45566.name: Arsene Wenger

45567.quote: We live in an age where the artist is forgotten. He is a researcher. I see myself that way.
45567.name: David Hockney

45568.quote: I lived the true American dream, because I was able to pursue what I set as my goals at a very young age. You're safer in the race car than you are in cars going to and from the track. I see all these old people who don't have anything to do but eat, drink and sleep.
45568.name: Mario Andretti

45569.quote: Everybody looks like clones and the only people you notice are my age. I don't notice anybody unless they look great, and every now and again they do, and they are usually 70.
45569.name: Vivienne Westwood

45570.quote: Photography suits the temper of this age - of active bodies and minds. It is a perfect medium for one whose mind is teeming with ideas, imagery, for a prolific worker who would be slowed down by painting or sculpting, for one who sees quickly and acts decisively, accurately.
45570.name: Edward Weston

45571.quote: I never - you know also one of the things that would save me for a man my age, it was not that easy to lose that much weight and fall down and look like something draped.
45571.name: Karl Lagerfeld

45572.quote: I wish I'd gotten sober at a younger age.
45572.name: Janice Dickinson

45573.quote: Middle Age is that perplexing time of life when we hear two voices calling us, one saying, 'Why not?' and the other, 'Why bother?'.
45573.name: Sydney J. Harris

45574.quote: Dallas' hit a chord back in the late Seventies and Eighties because it was the age of greed: here you have this unapologetic character who is mean and nasty and ruthless and does it all with an evil grin. I think people related to JR back then because we all have someone we know exactly like him. Everyone in the world knows a JR.
45574.name: Larry Hagman

45575.quote: I've never been more in love with anyone nearly half my age than I am today. I'd get married in a minute if I weren't still married to somebody else.
45575.name: Rod Stewart

45576.quote: At my age you don't go into fatherhood lightly.
45576.name: Rod Stewart

45577.quote: I didn't know a time when there wasn't a war because I spent all my time from the age of two or three to eight in a coal cellar really.
45577.name: David Bailey

45578.quote: My best friend just had a baby, and she's my age. So I'm a godmom now, which is crazy.
45578.name: Kristen Stewart

45579.quote: I think I'm a bit less inhibited, and not thinking too much before speaking. It's not about being shameful, I'm just a bit more unabashedly myself because of this thing, and it probably started at age 15. I can be around people and say what I think without fear.
45579.name: Kristen Stewart

45580.quote: At a certain age, death becomes familiar to you-or a loss becomes familiar-the tragedies that are more commonplace in life.
45580.name: Jessica Lange

45581.quote: TV is sort of the only way to go for an actress my age to make a decent salary with independent films, you just can't.
45581.name: Jessica Lange

45582.quote: Memory in youth is active and easily impressible in old age it is comparatively callous to new impressions, but still retains vividly those of earlier years.
45582.name: Charlotte Bronte

45583.quote: At its best our age is an age of searchers and discoverers, and at its worst, an age that has domesticated despair and learned to live with it happily.
45583.name: Flannery O'Connor

45584.quote: Study after study confirms that even when you control for variables like profession, education, hours worked, age, marital status, and children, men still are compensated substantially more - even in professions, like nursing, dominated by women. No wonder there's a gender gap.
45584.name: Dee Dee Myers

45585.quote: I learned from a very young age that if I pursued the things that truly excited me, that they would reward in more important ways, like happiness.
45585.name: Brandon Boyd

45586.quote: I always wanted to be a designer. I read books on fashion from the age of 12.
45586.name: Alexander McQueen

45587.quote: When I was a little kid I used to play with guys twice my age, so, I was the last one picked, so if I picked I knew that I had to get the ball to the scorer if I wanted to stay on the court, so that was pretty much my job.
45587.name: Jason Kidd

45588.quote: We have become a society that can't self-correct, that can't address its obvious problems, that can't pull out of its nosedive. And so to our list of disasters let us add this fourth entry: we have entered an age of folly that - for all our Facebooking and the twittling tweedle-dee-tweets of the twitterati - we can't wake up from.
45588.name: Thomas Frank

45589.quote: The divine right of husbands, like the divine right of kings, may, it is hoped, in this enlightened age, be contested without danger.
45589.name: Mary Wollstonecraft

45590.quote: In every age there has been a stream of popular opinion that has carried all before it, and given a family character, as it were, to the century.
45590.name: Mary Wollstonecraft

45591.quote: Look, demanding somebody do anything in this day and age is not going to fly.
45591.name: John Mayer

45592.quote: I was very successful from a very early age, and I want to keep it.
45592.name: John Mayer

45593.quote: When you get to a certain age, there is no coming back.
45593.name: Brian Clough

45594.quote: Most of the basic material a writer works with is acquired before the age of fifteen.
45594.name: Willa Cather

45595.quote: I would always encourage people of any age not to be so quick to follow other people's truths but to search and follow your own moral code and live by your own integrity, and mostly just be brave.
45595.name: Jewel

45596.quote: I don't believe in happy endings, but I do believe in happy travels, because ultimately, you die at a very young age, or you live long enough to watch your friends die. It's a mean thing, life.
45596.name: George Clooney

45597.quote: Even truth needs to be clad in new garments if it is to appeal to a new age.
45597.name: Georg C. Lichtenberg

45598.quote: You can have a spiritual awakening and discover a new side of you at any age. And best of all, love can happen at any age. Life can just start to get exciting when you're in your 40s and 50s. You have to believe that.
45598.name: Salma Hayek

45599.quote: America doesn't reward people of my age, either in day-to-day life or for their performances.
45599.name: Meryl Streep

45600.quote: I really think we should pass a law in every state, I don't care whether it takes the independence away from an old person or not. You shouldn't be driving a car if you're over the age of 80. Maybe even less than that.
45600.name: Evel Knievel

45601.quote: I think I'm past the age of getting lost.
45601.name: Amanda Seyfried

45602.quote: I conceived in art college at the age of 20, near the end of term.
45602.name: Joni Mitchell

45603.quote: I've been screaming at the top of my lungs at my family, 'Work out! Work out! Old age is coming!'.
45603.name: Cher

45604.quote: 'The Christmas Song,' by Nat King Cole, is not only a masterful performance to me it just sounds like the holidays. I've never sung it, because Nat's version is so perfect. I gotta leave it alone.
45604.name: Jr. Harry Connick

45605.quote: I was a queen, and you took away my crown a wife, and you killed my husband a mother, and you deprived me of my children. My blood alone remains: take it, but do not make me suffer long.
45605.name: Marie Antoinette

45606.quote: I just don't want to die alone, that's all. That's not too much to ask for, is it It would be nice to have someone care about me, for who I am, not about my wallet.
45606.name: Richard Pryor

45607.quote: There is no end of craving. Hence contentment alone is the best way to happiness. Therefore, acquire contentment.
45607.name: Sivananda

45608.quote: It doesn't matter about money having it, not having it. Or having clothes, or not having them. You're still left alone with yourself in the end.
45608.name: Billy Idol

45609.quote: The words of the Bible, and the Bible alone, should be heard from the pulpit.
45609.name: Ellen G. White

45610.quote: Down to Gehenna, or up to the Throne, He travels the fastest who travels alone.
45610.name: Rudyard Kipling

45611.quote: No woman can be handsome by the force of features alone, any more that she can be witty by only the help of speech.
45611.name: Kin Hubbard

45612.quote: Music should probably provide answers in terms of lyrical content, and giving people a sense of togetherness and oneness, as opposed to being alone in their thoughts and dilemmas or regrets or happiness or whatever.
45612.name: Peabo Bryson

45613.quote: If we take science as our sole guide, if we accept and hold fast that alone which is verifiable, the old theology must go.
45613.name: John Burroughs

45614.quote: Time alone reveals the just man but you might discern a bad man in a single day.
45614.name: Sophocles

45615.quote: What is the worst of woes that wait on age? What stamps the wrinkle deeper on the brow? To view each loved one blotted from life's page, And be alone on earth, as I am now.
45615.name: Lord Byron

45617.quote: Recommend virtue to your children it alone, not money, can make them happy. I speak from experience.
45617.name: Ludwig van Beethoven

45618.quote: The want of logic annoys. Too much logic bores. Life eludes logic, and everything that logic alone constructs remains artificial and forced.
45618.name: Andre Gide

45619.quote: We learn about life not from plusses alone, but from minuses as well.
45619.name: Anton Chekhov

45620.quote: So during those first moments of the day, which are yours and yours alone, you can circumvent these boundaries and concentrate fully on spiritual matters. And this gives you the opportunity to plan the time management of the entire day.
45620.name: Menachem Mendel Schneerson

45621.quote: Music is amazing. There's some metaphysical comfort where it allows you to be isolated and alone while telling you that you are not alone... truly, the only cure for sadness is to share it with someone else.
45621.name: Wayne Coyne

45622.quote: Early on, if I was alone two three nights in a row, I'd start writing poems about suicide.
45622.name: Jack Nicholson

45623.quote: Know then this truth, enough for man to know virtue alone is happiness below.
45623.name: Alexander Pope

45624.quote: Observe, record, tabulate, communicate. Use your five senses. Learn to see, learn to hear, learn to feel, learn to smell, and know that by practice alone you can become expert.
45624.name: William Osler

45625.quote: When you're surrounded by all these people, it can be even lonelier than when you're by yourself. You can be in a huge crowd, but if you don't feel like you can trust anybody or talk to anybody, you feel like you're really alone.
45625.name: Fiona Apple

45626.quote: I need to do things on my own, need to be left alone.
45626.name: Henry Rollins

45627.quote: Sometimes I think we're alone in the universe, and sometimes I think we're not. In either case the idea is quite staggering.
45627.name: Arthur C. Clarke

45628.quote: The person who tries to live alone will not succeed as a human being. His heart withers if it does not answer another heart. His mind shrinks away if he hears only the echoes of his own thoughts and finds no other inspiration.
45628.name: Pearl S. Buck

45629.quote: Compassion alone stands apart from the continuous traffic between good and evil proceeding within us.
45629.name: Eric Hoffer

45630.quote: The momentum of freedom in our world is unmistakable - and it is not carried forward by our power alone. We can trust in that greater power Who guides the unfolding of the years. And in all that is to come, we can know that His purposes are just and true.
45630.name: George W. Bush

45631.quote: If we were to wipe out insects alone on this planet, the rest of life and humanity with it would mostly disappear from the land. Within a few months.
45631.name: E. O. Wilson

45632.quote: It is very easy to love alone.
45632.name: Gertrude Stein

45633.quote: The law was made for one thing alone, for the exploitation of those who don't understand it, or are prevented by naked misery from obeying it.
45633.name: Bertolt Brecht

45634.quote: Sometimes I think we're alone. Sometimes I think we're not. In either case, the thought is staggering.
45634.name: R. Buckminster Fuller

45635.quote: Marriage is good for those who are afraid to sleep alone at night.
45635.name: St. Jerome

45636.quote: We need quiet time to examine our lives openly and honestly - spending quiet time alone gives your mind an opportunity to renew itself and create order.
45636.name: Susan Taylor

45637.quote: In any great organization it is far, far safer to be wrong with the majority than to be right alone.
45637.name: John Kenneth Galbraith

45638.quote: Nothing we do, however virtuous, can be accomplished alone therefore we are saved by love.
45638.name: Reinhold Niebuhr

45639.quote: Love turns, with a little indulgence, to indifference or disgust hatred alone is immortal.
45639.name: William Hazlitt

45640.quote: I don't even know how to use a parking meter, let alone a phone box.
45640.name: Princess Diana

45641.quote: To the press alone, chequered as it is with abuses, the world is indebted for all the triumphs which have been gained by reason and humanity over error and oppression.
45641.name: James Madison

45642.quote: I think I meant that, given the circumstances of my childhood, I had the illusion that it's easier to be alone. To have your relationships be casual and also to pose as a solitary person, because it was more romantic. You know, I was raised on the idea of the ramblin' man and the loner.
45642.name: Steve Martin

45643.quote: Bid, then, the tender light of faith to shine By which alone the mortal heart is led Unto the thinking of the thought divine.
45643.name: George Santayana

45644.quote: No memory is ever alone it's at the end of a trail of memories, a dozen trails that each have their own associations.
45644.name: Louis L'Amour

45645.quote: We gave up some of our country to the white men, thinking that then we could have peace. We were mistaken. The white man would not let us alone.
45645.name: Chief Joseph

45646.quote: We don't accomplish anything in this world alone... and whatever happens is the result of the whole tapestry of one's life and all the weavings of individual threads form one to another that creates something.
45646.name: Sandra Day O'Connor

45647.quote: A man filled with the love of God is not content with blessing his family alone, but ranges through the whole world, anxious to bless the whole human race.
45647.name: Jr. Joseph Smith

45648.quote: The best artist has that thought alone Which is contained within the marble shell The sculptor's hand can only break the spell To free the figures slumbering in the stone.
45648.name: Michelangelo

45649.quote: To love our neighbor as ourselves is such a truth for regulating human society, that by that alone one might determine all the cases in social morality.
45649.name: John Locke

45650.quote: Throughout my whole life, as a performer, I've never played with a band. I've always played alone, so I was never required to stay in rhythm or anything. So it was a real different experience for me to start playing with a band. There were so many basic things for me to learn.
45650.name: Steve Martin

45651.quote: We perceive when love begins and when it declines by our embarrassment when alone together.
45651.name: Jean de la Bruyere

45652.quote: A political prisoner is someone who is out fighting for his or her people's rights and freedom and is imprisoned for that alone.
45652.name: Leonard Peltier

45653.quote: He who studies books alone will know how things ought to be, and he who studies men will know how they are.
45653.name: Charles Caleb Colton

45654.quote: Sensual love deceives one as to the nature of heavenly love it could not do so alone, but since it unconsciously has the element of heavenly love within it, it can do so.
45654.name: Franz Kafka

45655.quote: I once asked a hermit in Italy how he could venture to live alone, in a single cottage, on the top of a mountain, a mile from any habitation? He replied, that Providence was his next-door neighbor.
45655.name: Laurence Sterne

45656.quote: For what Harley Street specialist has time to understand the body, let alone the mind or both in combination, when he is a slave to thirteen thousand a year?
45656.name: Virginia Woolf

45657.quote: Rigid, the skeleton of habit alone upholds the human frame.
45657.name: Virginia Woolf

45658.quote: Whoever thinks that he alone has speech, or possesses speech or mind above others, when unfolded such men are seen to be empty.
45658.name: Sophocles

45659.quote: The rewards of virtue alone abide secure.
45659.name: Sophocles

45660.quote: Never trust a man, who when left alone with a tea cosey... Doesn't try it on.
45660.name: Billy Connolly

45661.quote: It is not necessary that you leave the house. Remain at your table and listen. Do not even listen, only wait. Do not even wait, be wholly still and alone. The world will present itself to you for its unmasking, it can do no other, in ecstasy it will writhe at your feet.
45661.name: Franz Kafka

45662.quote: At the beginning and at the end of love, the two lovers are embarrassed to find themselves alone.
45662.name: Jean de la Bruyere

45663.quote: And then when all around grows dark, when we feel utterly alone, when all men right and left pass us by and know us not, a forgotten feeling rises in the breast.
45663.name: Max Muller

45664.quote: I have three phobias which, could I mute them, would make my life as slick as a sonnet, but as dull as ditch water: I hate to go to bed, I hate to get up, and I hate to be alone.
45664.name: Tallulah Bankhead

45665.quote: There is a destiny which makes us brothers none goes his way alone. All that we send into the lives of others comes back into our own.
45665.name: Edwin Markham

45666.quote: We can only know one thing about God - that he is what we are not. Our wretchedness alone is an image of this. The more we contemplate it, the more we contemplate him.
45666.name: Simone Weil

45667.quote: What troubles me is the Internet and the electronic technology revolution. Shyness is fueled in part by so many people spending huge amounts of time alone, isolated on e-mail, in chat rooms, which reduces their face-to-face contact with other people.
45667.name: Philip Zimbardo

45668.quote: Genius begins great works labor alone finishes them.
45668.name: Joseph Joubert

45669.quote: The people, and the people alone, are the motive force in the making of world history.
45669.name: Mao Zedong

45670.quote: What is it that love does to a woman? Without she only sleeps with it alone, she lives.
45670.name: Ovid

45671.quote: Man cannot live by bread alone he must have peanut butter.
45671.name: James A. Garfield

45672.quote: I'm done with men... I'm going to be alone. I have no luck with relationships. I don't think I'm made for marriage.
45672.name: Halle Berry

45673.quote: I cannot live under pressures from patrons, let alone paint.
45673.name: Michelangelo

45674.quote: The best of artists has no conception that the marble alone does not contain within itself.
45674.name: Michelangelo

45675.quote: No woman has to be a victim of physical abuse. Women have to feel like they are not alone.
45675.name: Salma Hayek

45676.quote: Victims always feel alone and helpless.
45676.name: Deepak Chopra

45677.quote: It is a great mystery that though the human heart longs for Truth, in which alone it finds liberation and delight, the first reaction of human beings to Truth is one of hostility and fear!
45677.name: Anthony de Mello

45678.quote: To have striven, to have made the effort, to have been true to certain ideals - this alone is worth the struggle.
45678.name: William Osler

45679.quote: I'm learning a lot about myself being alone, and doing what I'm doing.
45679.name: Chantal Kreviazuk

45680.quote: It's time to end the cruel slaughter of whales and leave these magnificent creatures alone.
45680.name: Paul McCartney

45681.quote: God created man and, finding him not sufficiently alone, gave him a companion to make him feel his solitude more keenly.
45681.name: Paul Valery

45682.quote: When you stand alone and sell yourself, you can't please everyone. But when you're different, you can last.
45682.name: Don Rickles

45683.quote: I believe that no man who holds a leader's position should ever accept favors from either side. He is then committed to show favors. A leader must stand alone.
45683.name: Mother Jones

45684.quote: As far as loneliness, I feel Los Angeles and its layout, having to drive everywhere - it is a lonely place. It's an isolated city in that respect because you're driving to places alone listening to the radio.
45684.name: Jason Schwartzman

45685.quote: The Bible was a consolation to a fellow alone in the old cell. The lovely thin paper with a bit of matress stuffing in it, if you could get a match, was as good a smoke as I ever tasted.
45685.name: Brendan Behan

45686.quote: Too small is our world to allow discrimination, bigotry and intolerance to thrive in any corner of it, let alone in the United States of America.
45686.name: Eliot Engel

45687.quote: When thinking about companions gone, we feel ourselves doubly alone.
45687.name: Walter Scott

45688.quote: It's better to be healthy alone than sick with someone else.
45688.name: Phil McGraw

45689.quote: The best thing I've learned is, if you're going out, never go out alone - you leave yourself vulnerable. If you've got someone else there you trust, they can say, be wary of that person. I probably used to be too trusting of people.
45689.name: Daniel Radcliffe

45690.quote: The strongest man in the world is he who stands most alone.
45690.name: Henrik Ibsen

45691.quote: Another thing to do with the blues is how they were recorded. They were done on the quick, and some of that stuff was made on wire, not even tape, let alone digital.
45691.name: Keith Richards

45692.quote: Golf... is the infallible test. The man who can go into a patch of rough alone, with the knowledge that only God is watching him, and play his ball where it lies, is the man who will serve you faithfully and well.
45692.name: P. G. Wodehouse

45693.quote: Talent alone won't make you a success. Neither will being in the right place at the right time, unless you are ready. The most important question is: 'Are your ready?'
45693.name: Johnny Carson

45694.quote: Tis the last rose of summer Left blooming alone All her lovely companions Are faded and gone.
45694.name: Thomas More

45695.quote: Lord, Bless our enemies have mercy upon them, may they turn their course and let us alone, and let us live in peace at our homes in our own native land.
45695.name: William Pennington

45696.quote: I grew up in a very large family in a very small house. I never slept alone until after I was married.
45696.name: Lewis Grizzard

45697.quote: I like singer-songwriters, and I find sad songs comforting rather than depressing. It makes you realise you're not alone in the world.
45697.name: Natalie Imbruglia

45698.quote: Without strength and courage it's really hard to perform at the highest levels of international figure skating, because you're alone on the ice and you only have seven minutes over two nights to prove yourself.
45698.name: Scott Hamilton

45699.quote: Life is so impermanent that it's not about somebody else or things around me, it's about knowing you are completely alone in this world and being content inside.
45699.name: K. D. Lang

45700.quote: Woman must have her freedom, the fundamental freedom of choosing whether or not she will be a mother and how many children she will have. Regardless of what man's attitude may be, that problem is hers - and before it can be his, it is hers alone.
45700.name: Margaret Sanger

45701.quote: The foundations of a strong economy don't rest alone on the decisions of Chancellors or the spending programmes of government.
45701.name: George Osborne

45702.quote: You can't play a symphony alone, it takes an orchestra to play it.
45702.name: Navjot Singh Sidhu

45703.quote: For the first time, I lived alone... in a luxury apartment on Sunset Strip. For a few days I loved the idea, but I got lonely and restless.
45703.name: Patty Duke

45704.quote: People must insist on the right to say no, to be alone, to stand out from the herd. Creative artists can say all this in their own way and in their own field, by hard, rigorous work.
45704.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

45705.quote: The right to be let alone is the underlying principle of the Constitution's Bill of Rights.
45705.name: Erwin Griswold

45706.quote: In days of doubt, in days of dreary musings on my country's fate, you alone are my comfort and support, oh great, powerful, righteous, and free Russian language!
45706.name: Ivan Turgenev

45707.quote: At the moment of childbirth, every woman has the same aura of isolation, as though she were abandoned, alone.
45707.name: Boris Pasternak

45708.quote: Of all our possessions, wisdom alone is imortal.
45708.name: Isocrates

45709.quote: What good is sitting all alone in your room?
45709.name: Liza Minnelli

45710.quote: A career is all very well, but no one lives by work alone.
45710.name: Lorna Luft

45711.quote: Happiness must be cultivated. It is like character. It is not a thing to be safely let alone for a moment, or it will run to weeds.
45711.name: Elizabeth Stuart Phelps

45712.quote: The biggest opportunity in 2013 is in Africa. It has seven out of the ten fastest-growing economies in the world. In Nigeria alone there are 100 million people with mobile phones. In total, 300 million Africans - five times the population of Britain - are in the middle class.
45712.name: David Miliband

45713.quote: The problems that the world faces - from nuclear proliferation to climate change - can't be tackled by the West alone. They need a coalition of not just West and East, but they need a coalition of Christian and Jew and Muslim.
45713.name: David Miliband

45714.quote: This is nourishing, redemptive we become less alone inside.
45714.name: David Foster Wallace

45715.quote: I would say, 'I'm alone, but I'm not lonely.' But I was just kidding myself.
45715.name: Bruce Willis

45716.quote: He who does not fill his world with phantoms remains alone.
45716.name: Antonio Porchia

45717.quote: I used to do a lot of interviews in the early '80s, when my career started, but it came to a point when I decided I didn't want to talk anymore, and people kind of understood that and left me alone.
45717.name: George Strait

45718.quote: So many people suffer from abuse, and suffer alone.
45718.name: Pamela Stephenson

45719.quote: Men was formed for society, and is neither capable of living alone, nor has the courage to do it.
45719.name: William Blackstone

45720.quote: Is it not careless to become too local when there are four hundred billion stars in our galaxy alone.
45720.name: A. R. Ammons

45721.quote: You can either invade a country or leave them alone and trade with them. When goods cross borders, armies don't.
45721.name: John Stossel

45722.quote: It's a terrible thing to be alone - yes it is - it is - but don't lower your mask until you have another mask prepared beneath - as terrible as you like - but a mask.
45722.name: Katherine Mansfield

45723.quote: You'd think I'd have been happiest in my life playing music in front of 50,000 people at Gillette Stadium. But let me tell you, it's an odd feeling to feel alone in the spotlight.
45723.name: Kenny Chesney

45724.quote: You're alone in your ideas, because you're the only one who knows what's possible.
45724.name: Bethenny Frankel

45725.quote: I was born to be alone, and I always shall be but now I want to be.
45725.name: Mary MacLane

45726.quote: I've performed solo for 20 years now, but I don't do much of it, because if you only play alone, you go crazy and out of tune and play foolish music.
45726.name: Steve Lacy

45727.quote: Nobody was playing the soprano saxophone and certainly nobody was trying to do anything with it. So I was all alone. I didn't know that at first.
45727.name: Steve Lacy

45728.quote: We're all outsiders in a way. We're all alone and can become very lonely.
45728.name: Hugo Weaving

45729.quote: I delight in my family obligations, but they leave little time for breaks let alone quick trips across the country.
45729.name: Carre Otis

45730.quote: The employee is regarded by the employer merely in the light of his value as an operative. His productive capacity alone is taken into account.
45730.name: Leland Stanford

45731.quote: I feel less alone when I read the books of Ratzinger.
45731.name: Oriana Fallaci

45732.quote: You know golf is very lonely. When I'm in the States, I feel like if I just think about Taiwan, my friends, my fans, I won't feel like I'm alone.
45732.name: Yani Tseng

45733.quote: Even crushed against his brother in the Tube the average Englishman pretends desperately that he is alone.
45733.name: Germaine Greer

45734.quote: We've just got to be careful - with all sports, let alone cricket - I think there's so much emphasis on doing the right thing all the time, but I think the public want to be entertained when they come to watch sport.
45734.name: Shane Warne

45735.quote: It depends on the situation. I mean, on one hand there's the argument that people should be left alone on the other hand, there's the argument to wade in a stop slaughters in places like Bosnia and Kosovo and what we probably should have done in Rwanda.
45735.name: Jello Biafra

45736.quote: Picture yourself vividly as winning, and that alone will contribute immeasurably to success.
45736.name: Harry Emerson Fosdick

45737.quote: When I was in my early 20s, I had my hair permed. Bad idea! It turned into total frizz. My advice to women is, if you have nice hair already, don't get a perm, leave your hair alone!
45737.name: Mariska Hargitay

45738.quote: The development of beauty in chess never depends on you alone. No matter how much imagination and creativity you invest, you still do not create beauty. Your opponent must react at the same highest level.
45738.name: Vladimir Kramnik

45739.quote: I don't know that I spent any more time alone than any other kid, but being by myself never bothered me.
45739.name: Joseph Barbera

45740.quote: I still don't like going to bed alone.
45740.name: James Franco

45741.quote: Improvisation is almost like the retarded cousin in the comedy world. We've been trying forever to get improvisation on TV. It's just like stand-up. It's best when it's just left alone. It doesn't translate always on TV. It's best live.
45741.name: Amy Poehler

45742.quote: Look, the center right coalition in American politics today is best understood as a coalition of groups and individuals that on the issue that brings them to politics what they want from the government is to be left alone.
45742.name: Grover Norquist

45743.quote: Luckily, my husband is my business partner as well as my life partner, so I never had to do the heavy lifting alone, literally or figuratively.
45743.name: Josie Maran

45744.quote: Religion is the possibility of the removal of every ground of confidence except confidence in God alone.
45744.name: Karl Barth

45745.quote: Smart businesses do not look at labor costs alone anymore. They do look at market access, transportation, telecommunications infrastructure and the education and skill level of the workforce, the development of capital and the regulatory market.
45745.name: Janet Napolitano

45746.quote: Your Majesty, I took the liberty because I was so desirous of visiting alone with you for a few minutes before the rest of the other peasants arrived.
45746.name: Walter Annenberg

45747.quote: If you talk to geneticists they are constantly finding that your genes are being switched on and off because of the environment. Genes alone do not determine an exact path in your life.
45747.name: Jeffrey Eugenides

45748.quote: Yes, I am seeking a husband. As soon as the right man asks me, I shall say, It is not good for a woman to live alone.
45748.name: Anna Held

45749.quote: I knew I was alone in a way that no earthling has ever been before.
45749.name: Michael Collins

45750.quote: Other nations use 'force' we Britons alone use 'Might'.
45750.name: Evelyn Waugh

45751.quote: With 'Twilight,' you have these massive tomes that you have to condense. With 'Penoza,' we had an eight episode Dutch series that, just for the pilot alone, I condensed three episodes. So, there's a lot of filling in and a ton of invention that has to happen to fill out eight episodes.
45751.name: Melissa Rosenberg

45752.quote: Is there no Latin word for Tea? Upon my soul, if I had known that I would have let the vulgar stuff alone.
45752.name: Hilaire Belloc

45753.quote: For me the Anita series is built like a mystery series, which means that as much as possible each book stands alone, so you have a mystery to solve from the beginning to the end of the book.
45753.name: Laurell K. Hamilton

45754.quote: It helps to be able to be alone. 'Cuz writing is done alone, unless you collaborate, but I don't do that. Ask my ex-wife.
45754.name: Dirk Benedict

45755.quote: My favorite thing is to be alone in a room with a blank paper in front of me and the time to fill it.
45755.name: Dirk Benedict

45756.quote: The question of whether or to what extent human activities are causing global warming is not a matter of ideology, let alone of belief. The issue is simply one of risk management.
45756.name: Malcolm Turnbull

45757.quote: Once you grow past Mommy and Daddy coming running when you're hurt, you're really on your own. You're alone, and there's no one to help you.
45757.name: Octavia Butler

45758.quote: The only people who like to live alone more than comics are priests.
45758.name: Colin Quinn

45759.quote: I feel most empires fell when they started to act human, but then look at Russia. They kept a pretty strong hand, and they fell from Afghanistan alone because Afghanistan is the graveyard of empires. I guess you just can't sustain it.
45759.name: Colin Quinn

45761.quote: By 2050, the Australian population is expected to grow from 22 million to 36 million. That increase alone will put huge pressure on our towns and our cities. We will need more homes, more roads, more rail lines, more hospitals, more schools, just to accommodate so many Australians.
45761.name: Kevin Rudd

45762.quote: Very few people are original. There's very little original anything out there. Because to be original means you have to stand alone.
45762.name: Susan Powter

45763.quote: Californians invented the concept of life-style. This alone warrants their doom.
45763.name: Don DeLillo

45764.quote: He travels fastest who travels alone, and that goes double for she. Real feminism is spinsterhood.
45764.name: Florence King

45765.quote: The Lord had the wonderful advantage of being able to work alone.
45765.name: Kofi Annan

45766.quote: Your life is yours and yours alone. Rise up and live it.
45766.name: Terry Goodkind

45767.quote: By far the greatest part of those goods which are the objects of desire, are procured by labour and they may be multiplied, not in one country alone, but in many, almost without any assignable limit, if we are disposed to bestow the labour necessary to obtain them.
45767.name: David Ricardo

45768.quote: Trust him not with your secrets, who, when left alone in your room, turns over your papers.
45768.name: Johann Kaspar Lavater

45769.quote: You may tell a man thou art a fiend, but not your nose wants blowing to him alone who can bear a thing of that kind, you may tell all.
45769.name: Johann Kaspar Lavater

45770.quote: Between 1910 and 1950 approximately 350 lives of Jesus were published in the English language alone.
45770.name: John Clayton

45771.quote: You watch a hockey game, and the hand-eye coordination and the speed is really miraculous how those guys track the puck alone, just following it with their eyes.
45771.name: Liev Schreiber

45772.quote: I never wanted to go on stage alone because if you mess up, who can you blame?
45772.name: Patti LaBelle

45773.quote: I don't know much about only children. I was the middle one of three, and if ever I was alone with mum and dad, it was a rare moment.
45773.name: Elizabeth Hurley

45774.quote: Now, on nights that I can't sleep, I play video games alone until the morning.
45774.name: Namie Amuro

45775.quote: Why can't everybody leave everybody else the hell alone.
45775.name: Jimmy Durante

45776.quote: I don't wanna hear nobody complain that they're getting paid all this money and people won't leave them alone. It's part of it.
45776.name: Mark Wahlberg

45777.quote: It's very hard to write a song alone. It's only by jamming that you can get a song together.
45777.name: Maurice Gibb

45778.quote: I was able to support myself by acting alone about six years ago. Until then, I was just scraping by.
45778.name: Edie Falco

45779.quote: Eagles commonly fly alone. They are crows, daws, and starlings that flock together.
45779.name: John Webster

45780.quote: I like being alone and I think this movie, as much as it is an investigation of connection and people bonding, I also think it's just as much about loneliness.
45780.name: Jason Schwartzman

45781.quote: I am very averse to bringing myself forward in print, but as my account will only appear as an appendage to a former production, and as it will be confined to such topics as have connection with my authorship alone, I can hardly accuse myself of a personal intrusion.
45781.name: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley

45782.quote: The secret to being a writer is that you have to write. It's not enough to think about writing or to study literature or plan a future life as an author. You really have to lock yourself away, alone, and get to work.

45783.quote: When I was old enough to go to movies alone, I got to see 'Frankenstein' and 'Dracula' on the big screen. I just fell in love with them.
45783.name: George A. Romero

45784.quote: Autobiography begins with a sense of being alone. It is an orphan form.
45784.name: John Berger

45785.quote: Young people discovering their sexuality must know they walk with a strong tradition and that they are not alone. They have a right to information without being pressured.
45785.name: Jasmine Guy

45786.quote: Laws are generally found to be nets of such a texture, as the little creep through, the great break through, and the middle-sized are alone entangled in it.
45786.name: William Shenstone

45787.quote: The athlete of today is not an athlete alone. He's the center of a team - doctors, scientists, coaches, agents and so on.
45787.name: Emil Zatopek

45788.quote: I don't treat the band like I'm above them or that they're a hired hand for me. We've never worked that way. So I'm a team player. I would be very uncomfortable having to do this alone.
45788.name: Tom Petty

45789.quote: It is said that man doesn't live by bread alone. Sometimes this is unfortunate, because people who cannot live by bread alone too often kill other people in consequence of the fights they get into.
45789.name: John McCarthy

45790.quote: For an adult, eating alone at McDonald's is admitting a kind of defeat.
45790.name: Jonathan Carroll

45791.quote: I tour alone. There's no sound check, no back up. I stay with the hosts I am in a family home and it's really nourishing. I just have to remember after the show not to run out into the living room in my pyjamas. Every day, it's a new relationship being built. It's odd and wonderful.
45791.name: Jane Siberry

45792.quote: I hope this will help new moms not feel alone or desperate, and that there is no shame in their feelings. PPD is out of their control, but the treatment and healing process is not.
45792.name: Brooke Shields

45793.quote: It's good that the first half of the speech emphasized freedom, because George W. Bush has been the global champion for freedom. As he said, if we don't fight tyranny it will not leave us alone in peace.
45793.name: Ernest Istook

45794.quote: All my fans tell me what a glamorous life I have, but I tell them how hard I work and how many nights I spend alone with my dogs, eating chicken pot pie in my bedroom.
45794.name: Shannen Doherty

45795.quote: I've been left alone, even by the paparazzi, because what sells is sex and scandal. Absent that, they really don't have much interest in you. I'm still married, still working, still happy.
45795.name: Matt Damon

45796.quote: Although born in a prosperous realm, we did not believe that its boundaries should limit our knowledge, and that the lore of the East should alone enlighten us.
45796.name: Charles de Secondat

45797.quote: Science and vision are not opposites or even at odds. They need each other. I sometimes hear other startup folks say something along the lines of: 'If entrepreneurship was a science, then anyone could do it.' I'd like to point out that even science is a science, and still very few people can do it, let alone do it well.
45797.name: Eric Ries

45798.quote: A movie like House of the Dead with around $7 million budget or Alone in the Dark with around $16 million budget are much easier to make profit than the typical $50 million major motion picture.
45798.name: Uwe Boll

45799.quote: If you're truly in a band and you guys have been together for a long time, there's a family bond that you have. In fact, I've talked about this with therapists, especially if you're talking about a relationship, because when you're with somebody, you're going to your family, and she's alone.
45799.name: Gary Allan

45800.quote: I mean one of the things about being alone is that you've no people to define yourself off, I mean, people are like all-round mirrors, because let's face it, we don't often see ourselves all round in a mirror anyway, do we.
45800.name: Diana Wynne Jones

45801.quote: The devil had as good have let Paul alone, for he no sooner comes into prison but he falls a preaching, at which the gates of Satan's prison fly open, and poor sinners come forth.
45801.name: William Gurnall

45802.quote: Every three days on average, I am alone on stage, facing the public.
45802.name: Placido Domingo

45803.quote: But in the end, in the end one is alone. We are all of us alone. I mean I'm told these days we have to consider ourselves as being in society... but in the end one knows one is alone, that one lives at the heart of a solitude.
45803.name: Harold Bloom

45804.quote: The Jew does not wish to be isolated. He fears being alone, without allies.
45804.name: Meir Kahane

45805.quote: I think that in itself is kind of an amazing achievement to be able to say that your full-time career is in any creative arts, let alone a show that has kept people interested for coming on four seasons and hopefully more.
45805.name: Anna Paquin

45806.quote: In today's interdependent world, a threat to one becomes a menace to all. And no state can defeat these challenges and threats alone.
45806.name: Michelle Bachelet

45808.quote: Christmas lights may be the loneliest thing for me, especially if you mix them up with reindeers and sleighs. I feel alone. I feel isolated. I feel I do not belong.
45808.name: Mira Nair

45809.quote: In my cranky old age, I actually prefer recording alone now, on 'The Simpsons,' for example, because I find that the director can just focus on what I'm doing and I can do a lot of variations. A lot of times, when I record with a group, I'll stay after class for another hour or two.
45809.name: Hank Azaria

45811.quote: It felt like the first thing, but when I first started out, I got a job adapting a book by Russell Banks called 'Rule Of The Bone.' I didn't do a very good job. I didn't really know what I was doing in general, let alone how to adapt a book.
45811.name: Paul Thomas Anderson

45812.quote: Let me alone: I have yet my legs and one arm. Tell the surgeon to make haste and his instruments. I know I must lose my right arm, so the sooner it's off the better.
45812.name: Horatio Nelson

45813.quote: On the stage, you alone hold the key, and on the night you have to trust that the director has inspired you enough to take the material and run with it.
45813.name: Greta Scacchi

45814.quote: We cannot know the whole truth, which belongs to God alone, but our task nevertheless is to seek to know what is true. And if we offend gravely enough against what we know to be true, as by failing badly enough to deal affectionately and responsibly with our land and our neighbors, truth will retaliate with ugliness, poverty, and disease.
45814.name: Wendell Berry

45815.quote: I am convinced that living in an enclave shapes the personality, and living alone shapes the personality too.
45815.name: Mary Douglas

45816.quote: European investment in Texas alone exceeds all U.S. investment in China and Japan put together.
45816.name: John Bruton

45817.quote: There's great sadness and life doesn't work out like you would want, on a lot of levels, but there's no need to feel all alone. This happens to everybody, so there's no self-pity. This is the ride that humans are on, and all of it is essential for our natural part of it.
45817.name: Mike Mills

45818.quote: I like to be alone so I can write. But focus can hurt you. I don't want to be some stress casualty in early middle age.
45818.name: James Ellroy

45819.quote: I am aware that in presenting myself as the advocate of the Indians and their rights, I shall stand very much alone.
45819.name: Sam Houston

45820.quote: A singer for me is more like someone who is standing alone with a microphone like Scott Walker, rather than someone who is bashing a plank and is spitting all over a microphone.
45820.name: Graham Coxon

45821.quote: You have to respect your audience. Without them, you're essentially standing alone, singing to yourself.
45821.name: K. D. Lang

45822.quote: She goes through the vale of death alone, each time a babe is born. As it is the right neither of man nor the state to coerce her into this ordeal, so it is her right to decide whether she will endure it.
45822.name: Margaret Sanger

45823.quote: There's nobody else on the face of this earth that's playing a sport at a highest level... with a transplant. That alone continues to inspire me, because I realize throughout the whole world the struggles that people are going through. I need to inspire them the best way I can.
45823.name: Alonzo Mourning

45824.quote: This communication alone, by the comparison of the antagonisms, rivalries, movements which give birth to decisive moments, permits the evolution of the soul, whereby a man realizes himself on earth. It is impossible to be concerned with anything else in art.
45824.name: Robert Delaunay

45825.quote: I think all teenagers feel alone, and that nobody else knows what they are going through and all that sort of stuff.
45825.name: Nicholas Hoult

45826.quote: Life certainly points it out to you - 'you can go this way or the other way.' You have to decide and it's a very strong decision because, would you sleep well knowing that you're living in the best place, but you're letting the place where you should live alone?
45826.name: Gael Garcia Bernal

45827.quote: People with fertility problems are not alone. It is a very very common problem for couples today. I've seen statistics that are just staggering.
45827.name: Michael Zaslow

45828.quote: No One Is Alone by Stephen Sondheim is all about thinking for yourself and being your own person.
45828.name: Bernadette Peters

45829.quote: I sailboat raced, I love to go out on my motorcycle alone, but I also love my family dearly. I love that aspect of my life as well.
45829.name: Bob Seger

45830.quote: Shockingly, a University of Pennsylvania study says the number of young people addicted to gambling - largely due to increased exposure to the Internet and Internet gambling - grew by an alarming 20 percent between 2004 and 2005 alone.
45830.name: Spencer Bachus

45831.quote: My early childhood prepared me to be a social psychologist. I grew up in a South Bronx ghetto in a very poor family. From Sicilian origin, I was the first person in my family to complete high school, let alone go to college.
45831.name: Philip Zimbardo

45832.quote: Anyone who writes knows that ultimately the majority of your time is spent alone in a room with a piano or a guitar, no matter what the project is.
45832.name: Trey Anastasio

45833.quote: You have to understand the tone of the movie, because if it's supposed to be funny, it can be funny violent like the Home Alone stuff, but you have to really understand the tone of what you're doing and make the action work for that and for the character.
45833.name: David R. Ellis

45834.quote: As the only girl growing up among three brothers, I was always afraid of being excluded. If there was a game to be played, a sport to be learned, a competition to join, I was on my feet and ready. I didn't spend much time alone for fear that I'd miss out.
45834.name: Elisabeth Shue

45835.quote: I like to read books and be alone I'm not social butterfly person.
45835.name: Hope Solo

45836.quote: I don't know. I think it's funny! I think it's funny! I go, what? It's so absurd. I'm alone.
45836.name: Danny DeVito

45837.quote: I personally love to run outdoor fitness trails. I love the meditative value I get when out alone, challenging myself to run faster and higher.
45837.name: Laurieann Gibson

45838.quote: I can work myself up into a fearful, paralyzing state of mind that can last for days, weeks even months where I feel mad, totally isolated and alone, overwhelmed and completely out of control.
45838.name: Vinny Guadagnino

45839.quote: I can't write without a reader. It's precisely like a kiss - you can't do it alone.
45839.name: John Cheever

45840.quote: Glasgow's not a media center. When you're there, when you're hanging about, you feel quite detached from musical movements or fashions or anything like that. You do feel quite alone, in a good way.
45840.name: Alex Kapranos

45841.quote: I believe in capitalism for everybody, not necessarily high finance but capitalism that works for the working men and women of this country who are out there paddling alone in America right now.
45841.name: Rick Santorum

45842.quote: But there's not enough time in life to go sit at a party, have a drink, and make idle conversation. There's too many important things to do. Just being together with my husband, spending time alone, which I have very little of.
45842.name: Pia Zadora

45843.quote: Tell me who is able to keep his bed chaste, or which goddess is able to live with one god alone?
45843.name: Sextus Propertius

45844.quote: A book is sent out into the world, and there is no way of fully anticipating the responses it will elicit. Consider the responses called forth by the Bible, Homer, Shakespeare - let alone contemporary poetry or a modern novel.
45844.name: Chaim Potok

45845.quote: I feel completely alone - it's like melting, I am the structure, and I am also Alain Robert.
45845.name: Alain Robert

45846.quote: I love working with a cast and a group of people every day, which is different than recording because you're usually pretty isolated and alone. They serve as a good balance for each other.
45846.name: Idina Menzel

45847.quote: I mean Buckingham Palace has never hired a professional public relations outfit let alone a Madison Avenue type and they would throw up their hands in horror at the very idea.
45847.name: Anthony Holden

45848.quote: Mr. Churchill is proud of Britain's stand alone, after France had fallen and before America entered the War.
45848.name: Eamon de Valera

45849.quote: I'm actually not an exhibitionist at all. When you get onstage and you get under the lights playing music, I feel more hidden and more alone than anywhere else. You hide behind your music and let your emotions come out through the music.
45849.name: Tim McGraw

45850.quote: I love nicknames. It makes me feel loved. It makes me feel less alone in this world.
45850.name: Ellen Page

45851.quote: But there is a discomfort that surrounds grief. It makes even the most well-intentioned people unsure of what to say. And so many of the freshly bereaved end up feeling even more alone.
45851.name: Meghan O'Rourke

45852.quote: Despite the demands of this job, one of the things my wife and I try to do is to spend time together alone. And one of the things we really enjoy doing together is seeing a good movie.
45852.name: Warren Christopher

45853.quote: I have Graham Greene's telephone number, but I wouldn't dream of using it. I don't seek out writers because we all want to be alone.
45853.name: Patricia Highsmith

45854.quote: We are the only class in history that has been left to fight its battles alone, unaided by the ruling powers. White labor and the freed black men had their champions, but where are ours?
45854.name: Elizabeth Cady Stanton

45855.quote: I'm more like my father, personality-wise. But my mom and I get alone really well - obviously, because my mom and my dad get along so well.
45855.name: Jenna Bush

45856.quote: As I've gotten older I've occasionally found myself nostalgic for earlier periods of solitude, though I realize that's also likely a false nostalgia, as I know there was nothing I wanted more during those periods than to not be alone, whatever that means.
45856.name: Chris Ware

45857.quote: He alone loves the Creator perfectly who manifests a pure love for his neighbor.
45857.name: Venerable Bede

45858.quote: For every five well-adjusted and smoothly functioning Americans, there are two who never had the chance to discover themselves. It may well be because they have never been alone with themselves.
45858.name: Marya Mannes
