47429.name: Tennessee Williams

47430.quote: We sometimes congratulate ourselves at the moment of waking from a troubled dream it may be so the moment after death.
47430.name: Nathaniel Hawthorne

47431.quote: Creativity is not merely the innocent spontaneity of our youth and childhood it must also be married to the passion of the adult human being, which is a passion to live beyond one's death.
47431.name: Rollo May

47432.quote: If you have only one passion in life - football - and you pursue it to the exclusion of everything else, it becomes very dangerous. When you stop doing this activity it is as though you are dying. The death of that activity is a death in itself.
47432.name: Eric Cantona

47433.quote: When the will defies fear, when duty throws the gauntlet down to fate, when honor scorns to compromise with death - that is heroism.
47433.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

47434.quote: Some people think football is a matter of life and death. I assure you, it's much more serious than that.
47434.name: Bill Shankly

47435.quote: In the attempt to defeat death man has been inevitably obliged to defeat life, for the two are inextricably related. Life moves on to death, and to deny one is to deny the other.
47435.name: Henry Miller

47436.quote: Death is delightful. Death is dawn, The waking from a weary night Of fevers unto truth and light.
47436.name: James Russell Lowell

47437.quote: I'm sick to death of people saying we've made 11 albums that sounds exactly the same, Infact, we've made 12 albums that sound exactly the same.
47437.name: Angus Young

47438.quote: Hunger, revenge, to sleep are petty foes, But only death the jealous eyes can close.
47438.name: William Wycherley

47439.quote: People have their own deaths as well as their own lives, and even if there is nothing beyond death, we shall differ in our nothingness.
47439.name: E. M. Forster

47440.quote: Death destroys a man, but the idea of death saves him.
47440.name: E. M. Forster

47441.quote: Men do not accept their prophets and slay them, but they love their martyrs and worship those whom they have tortured to death.
47441.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky

47442.quote: Don't be afraid to feel as angry or as loving as you can, because when you feel nothing, it's just death.
47442.name: Lena Horne

47443.quote: In order to go on living one must try to escape the death involved in perfectionism.
47443.name: Hannah Arendt

47444.quote: We do not celebrate the death of our enemies.
47444.name: Yitzhak Rabin

47445.quote: A country that relies on aid? Death is better than that. It stops you from achieving your potential, just as colonialism did.
47445.name: Imran Khan

47446.quote: Death be not proud, though some have called thee Mighty and dreadful, for thou art not so. For, those, whom thou think'st thou dost overthrow. Die not, poor death, nor yet canst thou kill me.
47446.name: John Donne

47447.quote: Kurt and I weren't the closest of friends, but I knew him well enough to be devastated by his death. For such a quiet person, he was so excited about having a child.
47447.name: Layne Staley

47448.quote: The Teutons have been singing the swan song ever since they entered the ranks of history. They have always confounded truth with death.
47448.name: Henry Miller

47449.quote: Divorce is probably as painful as death.
47449.name: William Shatner

47450.quote: Death has a tendency to encourage a depressing view of war.
47450.name: Donald Rumsfeld

47451.quote: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.
47451.name: Evelyn Beatrice Hall

47452.quote: I'm Irish. I think about death all the time.
47452.name: Jack Nicholson

47453.quote: What you possess in the world will be found at the day of your death to belong to someone else. But what you are will be yours forever.
47453.name: Henry Van Dyke

47454.quote: The very essence of literature is the war between emotion and intellect, between life and death. When literature becomes too intellectual - when it begins to ignore the passions, the emotions - it becomes sterile, silly, and actually without substance.
47454.name: Isaac Bashevis Singer

47455.quote: Which death is preferably to every other? 'The unexpected'.
47455.name: Julius Caesar

47456.quote: I mean, whatever kills you kills you, and your death is authentic no matter how you die.
47456.name: Jerry Garcia

47457.quote: Not all moral issues have the same moral weight as abortion and euthanasia. There may be legitimate diversity of opinion even among Catholics about waging war and applying the death penalty, but not... with regard to abortion and euthanasia.
47457.name: Pope Benedict XVI

47458.quote: The darkness of death is like the evening twilight it makes all objects appear more lovely to the dying.
47458.name: Jean Paul

47459.quote: I've looked that old scoundrel death in the eye many times but this time I think he has me on the ropes.
47459.name: Douglas MacArthur

47460.quote: Death is the only pure, beautiful conclusion of a great passion.
47460.name: David Herbert Lawrence

47461.quote: Death doesn't affect the living because it has not happened yet. Death doesn't concern the dead because they have ceased to exist.
47461.name: W. Somerset Maugham

47462.quote: A tragedy need not have blood and death it's enough that it all be filled with that majestic sadness that is the pleasure of tragedy.
47462.name: Jean Racine

47463.quote: There is no cure for birth and death save to enjoy the interval.
47463.name: George Santayana

47464.quote: The fear of death often proves mortal, and sets people on methods to save their Lives, which infallibly destroy them.
47464.name: Joseph Addison

47465.quote: There's nothing wrong in suffering, if you suffer for a purpose. Our revolution didn't abolish danger or death. It simply made danger and death worthwhile.
47465.name: H. G. Wells

47466.quote: As long as you have capital punishment there is no guarantee that innocent people won't be put to death.
47466.name: Paul Simon

47467.quote: In every death, a busy world comes to an end.
47467.name: Mason Cooley

47468.quote: Defoe says that there were a hundred thousand country fellows in his time ready to fight to the death against popery, without knowing whether popery was a man or a horse.
47468.name: William Hazlitt

47469.quote: It is old age, rather than death, that is to be contrasted with life. Old age is life's parody, whereas death transforms life into a destiny: in a way it preserves it by giving it the absolute dimension. Death does away with time.
47469.name: Simone de Beauvoir

47470.quote: Here I am trying to live, or rather, I am trying to teach the death within me how to live.
47470.name: Jean Cocteau

47471.quote: For death is not the worst, but when one wants to die and is not able even to have that.
47471.name: Sophocles

47472.quote: If forgers and malefactors are put to death by the secular power, there is much more reason for excommunicating and even putting to death one convicted of heresy.
47472.name: Thomas Aquinas

47473.quote: If what you do is being threatened as a profession, that could be scary. But that's the same reason why I walked out on stage many times after receiving death threats. I couldn't live without doing what I wanted to do. So at the same time I have to be willing to die for it.
47473.name: Marilyn Manson

47474.quote: And as long as you're subject to birth and death, you'll never attain enlightenment.
47474.name: Bodhidharma

47475.quote: Good music comes out of people playing together, knowing what they want to do and going for it. You have to sweat over it and bug it to death. You can't do it by pushing buttons and watching a TV screen.
47475.name: Keith Richards

47476.quote: A real hangover is nothing to try out family remedies on. The only cure for a real hangover is death.
47476.name: Robert Benchley

47477.quote: The human consciousness is really homogeneous. There is no complete forgetting, even in death.
47477.name: David Herbert Lawrence

47478.quote: Death never takes the wise man by surprise, he is always ready to go.
47478.name: Jean de La Fontaine

47479.quote: As a well spent day brings happy sleep, so life well used brings happy death.
47479.name: Leonardo DaVinci

47480.quote: Death is frightening, and so is Eternal Life.
47480.name: Mason Cooley

47481.quote: To have the truth in your possession you can be found guilty, sentenced to death.
47481.name: Peter Tosh

47482.quote: Communism is the death of the soul. It is the organization of total conformity - in short, of tyranny - and it is committed to making tyranny universal.
47482.name: Adlai E. Stevenson

47483.quote: For the wretched one night is like a thousand for someone faring well death is just one more night.
47483.name: Sophocles

47484.quote: Not even old age knows how to love death.
47484.name: Sophocles

47485.quote: I look at 'Death Proof' and realize I had too much time.
47485.name: Quentin Tarantino

47486.quote: Death comes at you no matter what you do in this life, and to equate drugs with death is a facile comparison.
47486.name: Jerry Garcia

47487.quote: A man who cannot be enticed by money or intimidated by the threat of jail or death has two of the strongest weapons that anyone has to offer.
47487.name: Jesse Jackson

47488.quote: The government is tottering. We must deal it the death blow an any cost. To delay action is the same as death.
47488.name: Vladimir Lenin

47489.quote: I was court-martialled in my absence, and sentenced to death in my absence, so I said they could shoot me in my absence.
47489.name: Brendan Behan

47490.quote: The leading cause of death among fashion models is falling through street grates.
47490.name: Dave Barry

47491.quote: The true face of smoking is disease, death and horror - not the glamour and sophistication the pushers in the tobacco industry try to portray.
47491.name: David Byrne

47492.quote: My father's death, my move, and my frightening and difficult delivery created a tremendous amount of stress, pain, and sadness for me. I was practically devastated beyond recovery.
47492.name: Brooke Shields

47493.quote: Death is really a great blessing for humanity, without it there could be no real progress. People who lived for ever would not only hamper and discourage the young, but they would themselves lack sufficient stimulus to be creative.
47493.name: Alfred Adler

47494.quote: To the well-organized mind, death is but the next great adventure.
47494.name: J. K. Rowling

47495.quote: Sleep is good, death is better but of course, the best thing would to have never been born at all.
47495.name: Heinrich Heine

47496.quote: All stories interest me, and some haunt me until I end up writing them. Certain themes keep coming up: justice, loyalty, violence, death, political and social issues, freedom.
47496.name: Isabel Allende

47497.quote: Well, to the people who pray for me to not only have an agonising death, but then be reborn to have an agonising and horrible eternal life of torture, I say, 'Well, good on you. See you there.
47497.name: Christopher Hitchens

47498.quote: Til the infallibility of human judgements shall have been proved to me, I shall demand the abolition of the penalty of death.
47498.name: Marquis de Sade

47499.quote: An insatiable appetite for glory leads to sacrifice and death, but innate instinct leads to self-preservation and life.
47499.name: Jose Marti

47500.quote: Nothing in life is promised except death.
47500.name: Kanye West

47501.quote: Salman Rushdie, indeed any writer who abuses the prophet or indeed any prophet under Islamic law, the sentence for that is actually death.
47501.name: Cat Stevens

47502.quote: Don't be afraid of death so much as an inadequate life.
47502.name: Bertolt Brecht

47503.quote: Of emotions, of love, of breakup, of love and hate and death and dying, mama, apple pie, and the whole thing. It covers a lot of territory, country music does.
47503.name: Johnny Cash

47504.quote: The ideal death, I think, is what was the ideal Victorian death, you know, with your grandchildren around you, a bit of sobbing. And you say goodbye to your loved ones, making certain that one of them has been left behind to look after the shop.
47504.name: Terry Pratchett

47505.quote: I'll keep peace at all cost, even if I choke to death on my tongue.
47505.name: Paula Deen

47506.quote: It is natural to indulge in the illusions of hope. We are apt to shut our eyes to that siren until she allures us to our death.
47506.name: Gertrude Stein

47507.quote: Just as I shall select my ship when I am about to go on a voyage, or my house when I propose to take a residence, so I shall choose my death when I am about to depart from life.
47507.name: Seneca

47508.quote: Days will prove that the assassination policy will not finish the Hamas. Hamas leaders wish to be martyrs and are not scared of death. Jihad will continue and the resistance will continue until we have victory, or we will be martyrs.
47508.name: Ahmed Yassin

47509.quote: Death is the great hope of all life the desire to expend itself to be used and consumed by its own longing for itself.
47509.name: Bryant H. McGill

47510.quote: Our criminal justice system is fallible. We know it, even though we don't like to admit it. It is fallible despite the best efforts of most within it to do justice. And this fallibility is, at the end of the day, the most compelling, persuasive, and winning argument against a death penalty.
47510.name: Eliot Spitzer

47511.quote: Death is the golden key that opens the palace of eternity.
47511.name: John Milton

47512.quote: Long hair is an unpardonable offense which should be punishable by death.
47512.name: Steven Morrissey

47513.quote: The kids out there want something they can relate to, something that's real most of that whiny stuff isn't real. The cheesy pop songs just bore me to death.
47513.name: Jonathan Davis

47514.quote: I was brought up by very witty people who were dealing with quite difficult things: disease and death... I was brought up by people who tended to giggle at funerals.
47514.name: Emma Thompson

47515.quote: Life without idealism is empty indeed. We just hope or starve to death.
47515.name: Pearl S. Buck

47516.quote: Everything tends to make us believe that there exists a certain point of the mind at which life and death, the real and the imagined, past and future, the communicable and the incommunicable, high and low, cease to be perceived as contradictions.
47516.name: Andre Breton

47517.quote: I have no fear of death. More important, I don't fear life.
47517.name: Steven Seagal

47518.quote: O Death, rock me asleep, bring me to quiet rest, let pass my weary guiltless ghost out of my careful breast.
47518.name: Anne Boleyn

47519.quote: Death comes in a flash, and that's the truth of it, the person's gone in less than 24 frames of film.
47519.name: Martin Scorsese

47520.quote: At the moment of death I hope to be surprised.
47520.name: Ivan Illich

47521.quote: I was court-martial in my absence, and sentenced to death in my absence, so I said they could shoot me in my absence.
47521.name: Thomas Hardy

47523.quote: You've never seen death? Look in the mirror every day and you will see it like bees working in a glass hive.
47523.name: Jean Cocteau

47524.quote: After the writer's death, reading his journal is like receiving a long letter.
47524.name: Jean Cocteau

47525.quote: The day of my birth, my death began its walk. It is walking toward me, without hurrying.
47525.name: Jean Cocteau

47527.quote: Talk to people in their own language. If you do it well, they'll say, 'God, he said exactly what I was thinking.' And when they begin to respect you, they'll follow you to the death.
47527.name: Lee Iacocca

47528.quote: I was very sad to hear of the death of Ronnie Barker, who was such a warm, friendly and encouraging presence to have when I started in television. He was also a great comic actor to learn from.
47528.name: John Cleese

47529.quote: The world is put back by the death of every one who has to sacrifice the development of his or her peculiar gifts to conventionality.
47529.name: Florence Nightingale

47530.quote: I am not the born how can there be either birth or death for me?
47530.name: Guru Nanak

47531.quote: The desire to die was my one and only concern to it I have sacrificed everything, even death.
47531.name: Emile M. Cioran

47532.quote: Life inspires more dread than death - it is life which is the great unknown.
47532.name: Emile M. Cioran

47533.quote: Buddhas move freely through birth and death, appearing and disappearing at will.
47533.name: Bodhidharma

47534.quote: We were aware of the fact that death walks hand in hand with struggle.
47534.name: Stokely Carmichael

47535.quote: It is not tolerable, it is not possible, that from so much death, so much sacrifice and ruin, so much heroism, a greater and better humanity shall not emerge.
47535.name: Charles de Gaulle

47536.quote: If your best friend has stolen your girlfriend, it does become life and death.
47536.name: Ben Kingsley

47537.quote: I'm possibly a very morbid person but I think about death a lot.
47537.name: Daniel Radcliffe

47538.quote: Quarreling over food and drink, having neither scruples nor shame, not knowing right from wrong, not trying to avoid death or injury, not fearful of greater strength or of greater numbers, greedily aware only of food and drink - such is the bravery of the dog and boar.
47538.name: Xun Zi

47539.quote: I grew up in the suburbs and basically associate the suburbs with cultural death.
47539.name: Billy Corgan

47540.quote: You know Americans are obsessed with life and death and rebirth, that's the American Cycle. You know, awakening, tragic, horrible death and then Phoenix rising from the ashes. That's the American story, again and again.
47540.name: Billy Corgan

47541.quote: I was fantasising about my own death, I started thinking what my funeral would be like and what music would be played, I was at that level of insanity.
47541.name: Billy Corgan

47542.quote: Andrew Wood's death changed things for a few weeks. I probably got even heavier into drugs after that.
47542.name: Layne Staley

47543.quote: Only in death will I relinquish my belts.
47543.name: Manny Pacquiao

47544.quote: Benjamin Franklin said there were only two things certain in life: death and taxes. But I'd like to add a third certainty: trash. And while some in this room might want to discuss reducing taxes, I want to talk about reducing trash.
47544.name: Ruth Ann Minner

47545.quote: When you break up, your whole identity is shattered. It's like death.
47545.name: Dennis Quaid

47546.quote: Deep down, no one really believes they have a right to live. But this death sentence generally stays tucked away, hidden beneath the difficulty of living. If that difficulty is removed from time to time, death is suddenly there, unintelligibly.
47546.name: Jean Baudrillard

47547.quote: Nothing endears so much a friend as sorrow for his death. The pleasure of his company has not so powerful an influence.
47547.name: David Hume

47548.quote: I saw also that there was an ocean of darkness and death, but an infinite ocean of light and love, which flowed over the ocean of darkness.
47548.name: George Fox

47549.quote: There is something about poverty that smells like death.
47549.name: Zora Neale Hurston

47550.quote: As long as you don't make waves, ripples, life seems easy. But that's condemning yourself to impotence and death before you are dead.
47550.name: Jeanne Moreau

47551.quote: If Shaw and Einstein couldn't beat death, what chance have I got? Practically none.
47551.name: Mel Brooks

47552.quote: If some persons died, and others did not die, death would be a terrible affliction.
47552.name: Jean de la Bruyere

47553.quote: The passion of hatred is so long lived and so obstinate a malady that the surest sign of death in a sick person is their desire for reconciliation.
47553.name: Jean de la Bruyere

47554.quote: There are only three events in a man's life birth, life, and death he is not conscious of being born, he dies in pain, and he forgets to live.
47554.name: Jean de la Bruyere

47555.quote: Old age, calm, expanded, broad with the haughty breadth of the universe, old age flowing free with the delicious near-by freedom of death.
47555.name: Edith Wharton

47556.quote: Everything one does in life, even love, occurs in an express train racing toward death. To smoke opium is to get out of the train while it is still moving. It is to concern oneself with something other than life or death.
47556.name: Jean Cocteau

47557.quote: People praise virtue, but they hate it, they run away from it. It freezes you to death, and in this world you've got to keep your feet warm.
47557.name: Denis Diderot

47558.quote: Families survive, one way or another. You have a tie, a connection that exists long after death, through many lifetimes.
47558.name: Jessica Lange

47559.quote: See, I have set before you this day life and good, death and evil... I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse therefore choose life.
47559.name: Moses

47560.quote: Death in itself is nothing but we fear to be we know not what, we know not where.
47560.name: John Dryden

47561.quote: For those who live neither with religious consolations about death nor with a sense of death (or of anything else) as natural, death is the obscene mystery, the ultimate affront, the thing that cannot be controlled. It can only be denied.
47561.name: Susan Sontag

47562.quote: Death is with you all the time you get deeper in it as you move towards it, but it's not unfamiliar to you. It's always been there, so what becomes unfamiliar to you when you pass away from the moment is really life.
47562.name: Bell Hooks

47563.quote: People think celebrities don't have to worry about human things like sickness and death and rent. It's like you've traveled to this Land of Celebrity, this other country. They want you to tell about what you saw.
47563.name: David Duchovny

47564.quote: The essence of the Hebrew Bible, transmitted by Christianity, is separation: between life and death, nature and God, good and evil, man and woman, and the holy and the profane.
47564.name: Dennis Prager

47565.quote: When I listen to music, I don't want to hear about flowers. I like death and destruction.
47565.name: Jonathan Davis

47566.quote: In the last analysis, it is our conception of death which decides our answers to all the questions that life puts to us.
47566.name: Dag Hammarskjold

47567.quote: The compact which exists between the North and the South is a covenant with death and an agreement with hell.
47567.name: William Lloyd Garrison

47568.quote: His death was the first time that Ed Wynn ever made anyone sad.
47568.name: Red Skelton

47569.quote: But I was very, very lucky, and it was a wake up call as far as motorbikes are concerned. I never flirted with death on the bike, but now I'm totally convinced they're death machines.
47569.name: Liam Neeson

47570.quote: To be honest, I'm scared to death of rollercoaster rides.
47570.name: Liam Neeson

47571.quote: There is no fundamental difference between the preparation for death and the practice of dying, and spiritual practice leading to enlightenment.
47571.name: Stanislav Grof

47572.quote: I was blessed with a birth and a death, and I guess I just want some say in between.
47572.name: Ani DiFranco

47573.quote: All those vitamins aren't to keep death at bay, they're to keep deterioration at bay.
47573.name: Jeanne Moreau

47574.quote: No one else can take risks for us, or face our losses on our behalf, or give us self-esteem. No one can spare us from life's slings and arrows, and when death comes, we meet it alone.
47574.name: Martha Beck

47575.quote: My mortal foe can no ways wish me a greater harm than England's hate neither should death be less welcome unto me than such a mishap betide me.
47575.name: Elizabeth I

47576.quote: The meaning of life is not to be discovered only after death in some hidden, mysterious realm on the contrary, it can be found by eating the succulent fruit of the Tree of Life and by living in the here and now as fully and creatively as we can.
47576.name: Paul Kurtz

47577.quote: Death is not more certainly a separation of our souls from our bodies than the Christian life is a separation of our souls from worldly tempers, vain indulgences, and unnecessary cares.
47577.name: William Law

47578.quote: I don't think kids have a problem with death. It's us older ones who are nearer to it, that start being frightened.
47578.name: Helena Bonham Carter

47579.quote: The great fear that hung over the business community in the 1970s was death by regulation, and the great goal of the conservative movement, as it rose to triumph in the 1980s, was to remove that threat - to keep OSHA, the EPA, and the FTC from choking off entrepreneurship with their infernal meddling in the marketplace.
47579.name: Thomas Frank

47580.quote: Life is doubt, and faith without doubt is nothing but death.
47580.name: Miguel de Unamuno

47581.quote: The death of Pope John Paul II led many of different faiths and of no faith to acknowledge their debt to the Roman Catholic Church for holding on to absolutes that the rest of us can measure ourselves against.
47581.name: Suzanne Fields

47582.quote: You don't have people chanting 'Death to America' in Israel.
47582.name: Benjamin Netanyahu

47583.quote: The earth is rocky and full of roots it's clay, and it seems doomed and polluted, but you dig little holes for the ugly shriveled bulbs, throw in a handful of poppy seeds, and cover it all over, and you know you'll never see it again - it's death and clay and shrivel, and your hands are nicked from the rocks, your nails black with soil.
47583.name: Anne Lamott

47584.quote: The death of any man aged 56 is very sad for his widow and family. And no one would deny that Steve Jobs was a brilliant and highly innovative technician, with great business flair and marketing ability.
47584.name: A. N. Wilson

47585.quote: I'm scared to death of being poor. It's like a fat girl who loses 500 pounds but is always fat inside. I grew up poor and will always feel poor inside. It's my pet paranoia.
47585.name: Cher

47586.quote: Your body must become familiar with its death - in all its possible forms and degrees - as a self-evident, imminent, and emotionally neutral step on the way towards the goal you have found worthy of your life.
47586.name: Dag Hammarskjold

47587.quote: Death is a billion-dollar business. They can't even pass a law where it takes seven days to get a gun. Why don't you have to go through the same kind of screening you do to get a driver's license? It's totally insane.
47587.name: John Cusack

47588.quote: As a kid, all I thought about was death. But you can't tell your parents that.
47588.name: Maurice Sendak

47589.quote: The death penalty is becoming a way of life in this country.
47589.name: Dennis Miller

47590.quote: I mean, I'm 48 years old and I've been through a lot in my life - you know, loss, whether it be death, illness, separation. I mean, the failed expectations... We all have dreams.
47590.name: Annie Lennox

47591.quote: Death comes not to the living soul, nor age to the loving heart.
47591.name: Phoebe Cary

47593.quote: At the New York Athletic Club they serve amazing food. People go there, get healthy, and then eat themselves to death - which is, I suppose, the right way to do it.
47593.name: Oliver Reed

47594.quote: Property is unstable, and youth perishes in a moment. Life itself is held in the grinning fangs of Death, Yet men delay to obtain release from the world. Alas, the conduct of mankind is surprising.
47594.name: Plautus

47595.quote: Well, there's a remedy for all things but death, which will be sure to lay us flat one time or other.
47595.name: Miguel de Cervantes

47596.quote: Old age is always wakeful as if, the longer linked with life, the less man has to do with aught that looks like death.
47596.name: Herman Melville

47597.quote: Life and death. They are somehow sweetly and beautifully mixed, but I don't know how.
47597.name: Gloria Swanson

47598.quote: Doing linear scans over an associative array is like trying to club someone to death with a loaded Uzi.
47598.name: Larry Wall

47599.quote: I'm sick to death of famous people standing up and using their celebrity to promote a cause. If I see a particular need, I do try to help. But there's a lot that can be achieved by putting a check in the right place and shutting up about it.
47599.name: Russell Crowe

47600.quote: Life is a predicament which precedes death.
47600.name: Henry James

47601.quote: Death is the easiest of all things after it, and the hardest of all things before it.
47601.name: Abu Bakr

47602.quote: Death is inevitable, but Life - that's the tricky bit where things happen.
47602.name: Simon Travaglia

47603.quote: She looks like a warrior. I mean, Bellatrix does mean warrior. And she's also a bit of a fatale. She's the right hand of Voldemort, and the only woman death eater.
47603.name: Helena Bonham Carter

47604.quote: People think celebrities don't have to worry about human things like sickness and death and rent. It's like you've traveled to this Land of Celebrity, this other country.
47604.name: David Duchovny

47605.quote: For the sake of goodness and love, man shall let death have no sovereignty over his thoughts.
47605.name: Thomas Mann

47606.quote: I can't turn on the television without seeing me, or open the newspaper without seeing me and, honestly, I'm sick to death of me.
47606.name: Elizabeth Edwards

47607.quote: He who does not fear death cares naught for threats.
47607.name: Pierre Corneille

47608.quote: To die for one's country is such a worthy fate that all compete for so beautiful a death.
47608.name: Pierre Corneille

47609.quote: Each instant of life is a step toward death.
47609.name: Pierre Corneille

47610.quote: You always think that 70 is the end of the road: 'Somebody died when they were 73 good life'. You're closer to death, and you better make sure you don't waste too much of your time doing things you don't want to do. No point in saying things you don't believe in.
47610.name: Ian Mckellen

47611.quote: When I'm lying in my bed I think about life and I think about death and neither one particularly appeals to me.
47611.name: Steven Morrissey

47612.quote: Science without conscience is the death of the soul.
47612.name: Francois Rabelais

47613.quote: Had it not been for slavery, the death penalty would have likely been abolished in America. Slavery became a haven for the death penalty.
47613.name: Angela Davis

47614.quote: So much of motion, is so much of life, and so much of joy, and to stand still, or get on but slowly, is death and the devil.
47614.name: Laurence Sterne

47615.quote: Death is the mother of Beauty hence from her, alone, shall come fulfillment to our dreams and our desires.
47615.name: Wallace Stevens

47616.quote: In Sleep we lie all naked and alone, in Sleep we are united at the heart of night and darkness, and we are strange and beautiful asleep for we are dying the darkness and we know no death.
47616.name: Thomas Wolfe

47617.quote: If efforts to do social work are couched in selfish motives, then they will die a premature death. Why would my efforts get politicised? I have values I inherited from my father. He helped many. Anyone, even a postman knocking on our door would get a glass of water and some sweets.
47617.name: Sachin Tendulkar

47618.quote: But I have been in some very beautiful churches, then I've looked outside and seen people starving to death.
47618.name: Don Van Vliet

47619.quote: For tis not in mere death that men die most.
47619.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

47620.quote: The Greeks said grandly in their tragic phrase, 'Let no one be called happy till his death' to which I would add, 'Let no one, till his death, be called unhappy.
47620.name: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

47621.quote: 'Hamlet' is one of the most dangerous things ever set down on paper. All the big, unknowable questions like what it is to be a human being the difference between sanity and insanity the meaning of life and death what's real and not real. All these subjects can literally drive you mad.
47621.name: Michael Sheen

47622.quote: If we openly declare what is wrong with us, what is our deepest need, then perhaps the death and despair will by degrees disappear.
47622.name: J. B. Priestley

47623.quote: The most dire disaster in love is the death of imagination.
47623.name: George Meredith

47624.quote: To be immortal is commonplace except for man, all creatures are immortal, for they are ignorant of death what is divine, terrible, incomprehensible, is to know that one is immortal.
47624.name: Jorge Luis Borges

47625.quote: Life and death have been lacking in my life.
47625.name: Jorge Luis Borges

47626.quote: Ultimately life is disease, death and oblivion. It's still better than high school.
47626.name: Dan Savage

47627.quote: My children are magical creatures and I love them to death.
47627.name: Jack Black

47628.quote: But then I'm one of those guys that is still a bit afraid of the telephone, its implications for conversation. I still wonder if the jukebox might be the death of live music.
47628.name: Tom Waits

47629.quote: Perhaps we don't need these religious concoctions to pillow the fear of death. Just the fact that there is an unknown, and something greater, can bring a feeling of peace. That's enough for me.
47629.name: Brad Pitt

47630.quote: If a lot of people gripped a knife and fork the way they do a golf club, they'd starve to death.
47630.name: Sam Snead

47631.quote: In almost every interview someone asks what does HIM stand for. I can't even remember our latest lie about that. When Hanson was hot, we said it means Hanson Is Murder. The name doesn't have a particular history. His Infernal Majesty was a totally different band. I think HIM derives from some death metal joke.
47631.name: Ville Valo

47632.quote: Early this morning, I signed my death warrant.
47632.name: Michael Collins

47633.quote: I don't think I would want the responsibility for enforcing the death penalties. There's always the inevitable question of whether someone you gave the order to execute might truly have been innocent.
47633.name: Jesse Ventura

47634.quote: I hit rock bottom, but thank God my bottom wasn't death.
47634.name: Stevie Ray Vaughan

47635.quote: In an artwork you're always looking for artistic decisions, so an ashtray is perfect. An ashtray has got life and death.
47635.name: Damien Hirst

47636.quote: Since I was a child, death is definitely something that I think about every day. But I think that everybody does. You try and avoid it, but it's such a big thing that you can't.
47636.name: Damien Hirst

47637.quote: The difference between art about death and actual death is that one's a celebration and the other's a dull fact.
47637.name: Damien Hirst

47638.quote: I was taught to confront things you can't avoid. Death is one of those things. To live in a society where you're trying not to look at it is stupid because looking at death throws us back into life with more vigour and energy. The fact that flowers don't last for ever makes them beautiful.
47638.name: Damien Hirst

47639.quote: I wouldn't feel satisfied being on set every day doing a romantic comedy - I'd be bored to death.
47639.name: Joaquin Phoenix

47640.quote: It's not life or death it's a game and at the end of the game there is going to be a winner and a loser.
47640.name: Bernhard Langer

47641.quote: Miller didn't write Death of a Salesman. He released it. It was there inside him, waiting to be turned loose. That's the measure of its merit.
47641.name: Elia Kazan

47642.quote: Death is like an arrow that is already in flight, and your life lasts only until it reaches you.
47642.name: Georg Hermes

47643.quote: I was never afraid of failure after that because, I think, coming that close to death you get kissed. With the years, the actual experience of course fades, but the flavor of it doesn't. I just had a real sense of what choice do I have but to live fully?
47643.name: Debra Winger

47644.quote: I think that obviously, there is a perverse attraction to a fundamentally changed world or the end of the world. There is a death wish, a perverse death wish. Not just for ourselves, not just for the movie 'Death Wish,' but for the end of all human life.
47644.name: John Hodgman

47645.quote: When you think about it, the end of the world is a little bit like death: We all know it's going to come eventually, and as we get older, we feel we see the signs more and more distinctly.
47645.name: John Hodgman

47646.quote: I try to write lyrics so that they won't age, which sort of leaves you with the big subjects like death and love and sex and violence.
47646.name: Florence Welch

47647.quote: A friend said to me, 'Be glad for your troubles - they strengthen you.' Well, if that's the truth, I'm going to be so strong they'll have to beat me to death!
47647.name: Sonia Johnson

47648.quote: She goes through the vale of death alone, each time a babe is born. As it is the right neither of man nor the state to coerce her into this ordeal, so it is her right to decide whether she will endure it.
47648.name: Margaret Sanger

47649.quote: Emigration is no longer a solution it's a defeat. People are risking death, drowning every day, but they're knocking on doors that are not open.
47649.name: Tahar Ben Jelloun

47650.quote: In Goddess religion death is not feared, but is understood to be a part of life, followed by birth and renewal.
47650.name: Carol P. Christ

47651.quote: Death's an old joke, but each individual encounters it anew.
47651.name: Ivan Turgenev

47652.quote: Feminists bore me to death. I follow my instinct and if that supports young girls in any way, great. But I'd rather they saw it more as a lesson about following their own instincts rather than imitating somebody.
47652.name: Bjork

47653.quote: No real English gentleman, in his secret soul, was ever sorry for the death of a political economist.
47653.name: Walter Bagehot

47654.quote: There are hundreds of Frank Lloyd Wright buildings around the United States and in other countries, too. Wright lived into his 90s, and one of his most famous buildings, the Guggenheim Museum in New York, was completed just before his death. Wright buildings look like Wright buildings - that is their paradox.
47654.name: Jane Smiley

47655.quote: Vets do what doctors used to - diagnose the injury or the condition, patch it up as best they can and remind you that these things happen and that in life we are also in the midst of death.
47655.name: Jane Smiley

47656.quote: Somehow, knowing that Alzheimer's is coming mocks all one's aspirations - to tell stories, to think through certain issues as only a novel can do, to be recognised for one's accomplishments and hard work - in a way that old familiar death does not.
47656.name: Jane Smiley

47657.quote: We should weep for men at their birth, not at their death.
47657.name: Charles de Montesquieu

47658.quote: You only live twice. Once when you are born and once when you look death in the face.
47658.name: Ian Fleming

47659.quote: I think when you're 10 years old, it's too much to see something with the threat of death in every episode. Kids are better left naive about certain things.
47659.name: J. J. Abrams

47660.quote: I love myself. Anything that has my name I'm tickled to death.
47660.name: Barbara Corcoran

47661.quote: Sin brought death, and death will disappear with the disappearance of sin.
47661.name: Mary Baker Eddy

47662.quote: There is nothing glamorous about death.
47662.name: Roger Moore

47663.quote: My book 'Trust Your Heart', which is the story of my life, will be followed by 'Singing Lessons', a memoir of love, loss, hope, and healing, which talks about the death of my son and the hope that has been the aftermath of the healing from that tragedy.
47663.name: Judy Collins

47664.quote: Defeat the fear of death and welcome the death of fear.
47664.name: G. Gordon Liddy

47665.quote: The coward sneaks to death the brave live on.
47665.name: George Sewell

47666.quote: Only those who spread treachery, fire, and death out of hatred for the prosperity of others are undeserving of pity.
47666.name: Jose Marti

47667.quote: If the heart stops for more than two minutes, you have massive brain death. There are only two minutes between our conscious world and zero. That's how fragile our consciousness is.
47667.name: Robin Gibb

47668.quote: The police came to me to say I had death threats and that I had to be careful!
