47841.quote: It looks to me to be obvious that the whole world cannot eat an American diet.
47841.name: Jerry Brown

47842.quote: I don't believe in depriving myself of any food or being imprisoned by a diet.
47842.name: Joely Fisher

47843.quote: A boxer's diet should be low in fat and high in proteins and sugar. Therefore you should eat plenty of lean meat, milk, leafy vegetables, and fresh fruit and ice cream for sugar.
47843.name: Gene Tunney

47844.quote: I've been on a diet for two weeks and all I've lost is two weeks.
47844.name: Totie Fields

47845.quote: I am now in that happy comfortable state that I do not hesitate to indulge in any fancy in regard to diet, but watch the consequences, and do not continue any course which adds to weight or bulk and consequent discomfort.
47845.name: William Banting

47846.quote: Leave the table while you still feel you could eat a little more.
47846.name: Helena Rubinstein

47847.quote: You can't be fat and fast, too so lift, run, diet and work.
47847.name: Hank Stram

47848.quote: I don't believe in fad diets.
47848.name: Jenny Craig

47849.quote: Dieting is murder on the road. Show me a man who travels and I'll show you one who eats.
47849.name: Bruce Froemming

47850.quote: A friend doesn't go on a diet because you are fat.
47850.name: Erma Bombeck

47851.quote: In the course of my life, I have often had to eat my words, and I must confess that I have always found it a wholesome diet.
47851.name: Winston Churchill

47852.quote: Bodybuilding is much like any other sport. To be successful, you must dedicate yourself 100% to your training, diet and mental approach.
47852.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

47853.quote: Food is an important part of a balanced diet.
47853.name: Fran Lebowitz

47854.quote: There were years when I was a beer and tequila guy, then I got real fat. And then I found that you could actually go on a diet and drink scotch. Then I got hooked on scotch, and if you get hooked on scotch, then everything else just tastes wrong.
47854.name: Ron White

47855.quote: Healthy people are those who live in healthy homes on a healthy diet in an environment equally fit for birth, growth work, healing, and dying... Healthy people need no bureaucratic interference to mate, give birth, share the human condition and die.
47855.name: Ivan Illich

47856.quote: I still indulge in a glass of wine or chocolate - treats are mandatory. Without deviating from the day-to-day healthy diet once in a while, it wouldn't be sustainable for me, and that's what I wanted: an approach to eating to last my entire life.
47856.name: Alanis Morissette

47857.quote: I've just been growing right along. It's painful, but it's a great pain, and I like suffering for great results. It's like going to the gym. It hurts really bad at first, but after a couple of months and after that diet, you're looking so hot.
47857.name: Mary J. Blige

47858.quote: If I go on a diet and work out, I'm always in a bad mood. I'd rather be a little heavier but nice.
47858.name: Salma Hayek

47859.quote: Hate is a draining bottomless pit from whence nothing good or of any value can come. Try to eat a balanced diet. Guys only want one thing.
47859.name: Christopher Meloni

47860.quote: It's never been an issue for me - I don't want to go on a diet, I don't want to eat a Caesar salad with no dressing, why would I do that? I ain't got time for this, just be happy and don't be stupid. If I've got a boyfriend and he loves my body then I'm not worried.
47860.name: Adele

47861.quote: An optimist is a person who starts a new diet on Thanksgiving Day.
47861.name: Irv Kupcinet

47862.quote: And I believe that the best buy in public health today must be a combination of regular physical exercise and a healthy diet.
47862.name: Julie Bishop

47863.quote: The best doctors in the world are Doctor Diet, Doctor Quiet, and Doctor Merryman.
47863.name: Jonathan Swift

47864.quote: Childhood obesity is best tackled at home through improved parental involvement, increased physical exercise, better diet and restraint from eating.
47864.name: Bob Filner

47865.quote: I have to be on such a strict diet constantly.
47865.name: Lady Gaga

47866.quote: For four to six months at a time, I would barely eat. I lived on a diet of Melba toast, carrots, and black coffee.
47866.name: Alanis Morissette

47867.quote: The USDA is not our ally here. We have to take matters into our own hands, not only by advocating for a better diet for everyone - and that's the hard part - but by improving our own. And that happens to be quite easy. Less meat, less junk, more plants.
47867.name: Mark Bittman

47868.quote: The heart, like the stomach, wants a varied diet.
47868.name: Gustave Flaubert

47869.quote: I'm only drinking white wine because I'm on a diet and I don't eat.
47869.name: Oliver Reed

47870.quote: I drink Diet Coke from the minute I get up to the minute I go to bed.
47870.name: Karl Lagerfeld

47871.quote: I'm a wonderful disaster. So are you. We're all a mess. We're in this culture that says take this pill and you'll be happy, go on this diet and you'll be thinner, have your teeth whitened, people will love you more.
47871.name: Emilio Estevez

47872.quote: Cutting meat out of your diet is the best thing you can do for animals and your own health.
47872.name: Joan Jett

47873.quote: The medical literature tells us that the most effective ways to reduce the risk of heart disease, cancer, stroke, diabetes, Alzheimer's, and many more problems are through healthy diet and exercise. Our bodies have evolved to move, yet we now use the energy in oil instead of muscles to do our work.
47873.name: David Suzuki

47874.quote: I need my food to keep my energy up, so I can't really diet.
47874.name: Sienna Miller

47875.quote: I absolutely relate to being alone in squalor, trying to come up with something adequate. I relate to that, and I've been known to crawl out of bed and drink out of a 2-liter bottle of Diet Coke.
47875.name: Diablo Cody

47876.quote: Environmental concern is a little like dieting or paying off credit-card debt - an episodically terrific idea that burns brightly and then seems to fade when we realize there's a reason we need to diet or pay down our debt. The reason is that it's really, really hard, and too many of us in too many spheres of life choose the easy over the hard.
47876.name: Jon Meacham

47877.quote: I put on fifteen pounds of muscle, so that was a lot of eating chicken and a high protein, low-carb diet. Also a lot of heavy lifting and a very different kind of training with an ex-navy SEAL guy who wanted to kill me every time I got with him. In a good way.
47877.name: Josh Hutcherson

47878.quote: I don't do the gym and I don't diet. I'm vegetarian but I don't diet.
47878.name: Pamela Anderson

47879.quote: Weight Watchers is not intimidating. It's not a diet. It's a lifestyle.
47879.name: Jessica Simpson

47880.quote: The one thing I like about 'Playboy' is they don't have the anorexic look. The women are voluptuous. So I didn't really want to diet. I just wanted to tone up.
47880.name: Jenny McCarthy

47881.quote: In the 1970s we got nouvelle cuisine, in which a lot of the old rules were kicked over. And then we had cuisine minceur, which people mixed up with nouvelle cuisine but was actually fancy diet cooking.
47881.name: Julia Child

47882.quote: You don't want to make a steady diet of just lettuce. You don't want to make a steady diet of fried chicken.
47882.name: Paula Deen

47883.quote: I'm terrible with my workout regime and following it strictly. I'm terrible with a healthy diet and following it strictly. I'm terrible on the weekends about getting up at reasonable hours and all of those things. But, when it comes to my work and the discipline it takes to get to work on time - I hate unprofessionalism.
47883.name: Katherine Heigl

47884.quote: We always think of a diet with a big groan. But I think diets are fun. I think it is an American pastime for a lot of women.
47884.name: Mindy Kaling

47885.quote: Frankly, I don't trust any diet that doesn't allow sugar.
47885.name: Bethenny Frankel

47886.quote: I don't care how pumped up or psyched you are to start a new diet or a new program - that emotion will fade.
47886.name: Phil McGraw

47887.quote: It's my firm intention to whop cancer into submission and I truly believe I've given myself the best start possible by radically overhauling my diet and by staying true to my motto, which is: Don't worry, be happy, feel good. The first thing I did when I was diagnosed was to turn vegan.
47887.name: Larry Hagman

47888.quote: For so many years, I felt so insecure, so inferior, and I still have those moments, but I have a newfound confidence since I got in shape and changed my diet.
47888.name: Marc Jacobs

47889.quote: My interesting diet tips are eat early and don't nosh between meals. I mean, I can pack it away.
47889.name: Carol Burnett

47890.quote: I try not to be but I'm super-neurotic about diet. I'm neurotic about trying not to be neurotic! I'm like every other girl. I have to try really hard my whole life to try to be fit. And I'm super-vain. And I want to wear cute clothes.
47890.name: Gwen Stefani

47891.quote: A balanced diet may be the best medicine. I was eating too much good eats. But people consider that part of your job, you know? Eat. And I do!
47891.name: Alton Brown

47892.quote: I saw many people who had advanced heart disease and I was so frustrated because I knew if they just knew how to do the right thing, simple lifestyle and diet steps, that the entire trajectory of their life and health would have been different.
47892.name: Mehmet Oz

47893.quote: There's no quick or magical way to lose weight. You just have to do it the natural way - diet and exercise and stick to it - and be able to do it at your own pace.
47893.name: Jordin Sparks

47894.quote: I am fussy, about my diet and straining my voice. I know, sounds a bit over the top. But I'm not as bad as I used to be. These days I don't drink alcohol for five days before a show - very dehydrating for the vocal cords, and all that acid reflux. I used to ban it for a fortnight. Nightmare.
47894.name: Katherine Jenkins

47895.quote: I do follow a version of the Dukan diet, but I don't follow it to the extreme so a lot of fish and vegetables. If I want chocolate I'll let myself have a bit of chocolate in moderation.
47895.name: Katherine Jenkins

47896.quote: Right now I'd love to be sitting on a Greek island somewhere because of being Greek American, eating great octopus salad and some fantastic lamb. Or sipping a little ouzo. I think the Mediterranean diet is one of the healthiest... Lots of nuts, vegetables, fruits, fresh fish, lean meats, yogurt.
47896.name: Cat Cora

47897.quote: I always had to diet. I'm diabetic, so it's a lifestyle for me anyway just to stay healthy and not end up in the hospital.
47897.name: Halle Berry

47898.quote: My nutritionist has done a great job in changing my diet after we established I am allergic to things like gluten - I can't eat pizza, pasta and bread. I have lost some weight, but my movement is sharper and I feel great.
47898.name: Novak Djokovic

47899.quote: I pay attention to my diet to be a healthier gymnast, but I'm not obsessive over it.
47899.name: Shawn Johnson

47900.quote: As American as an apple is and as American as baseball is, they don't go together. You can't be chewing an apple at a baseball game. You've got to let go of the diet that day.
47900.name: Kevin James

47901.quote: For me, it's all about moderation. I don't kick things out of my diet, like carbs. But I'm not going to eat fast food.
47901.name: Bobby Flay

47902.quote: I can't be on the cheeseburger diet all the time.
47902.name: Bobby Flay

47903.quote: But if you pick up every other magazine, it is the peanut butter diet, or the cabbage soup diet, and then you go to the radio and you hear that you can drink some solution and you will lose weight overnight. It just does not work that way!
47903.name: Richard Simmons

47904.quote: I try not to diet because it never really works for me, if I tell myself I can't eat something then I tend to want to eat everything in sight.
47904.name: Leona Lewis

47905.quote: Our pets rely on us entirely for their nutrition. So if you're making your own judgments, that could lead to a mistake. At the same time, we have more control over our pet's diet than we do with our children or with ourselves, so your vet can tell you what is appropriate for your dog and you can assign them that.
47905.name: Alison Sweeney

47906.quote: Since having the babies, I realize that 90 percent of losing weight is my diet.
47906.name: Mariah Carey

47907.quote: Unless you're living on the street and surviving on a diet of discarded turkey drumsticks, there's no point in being gloomy. We've spent too long trying to cheer ourselves up by spending money on brightly coloured things we don't really need. We've stopped using our imaginations.
47907.name: Jarvis Cocker

47908.quote: I had to find a diet that would kick me back into dating shape, because I know that I can't date at size 8. I have to date at size 2. And it's just a fact of nature. Go get your injections and your chemical peels. You gotta look good to attract a man.
47908.name: Patti Stanger

47909.quote: I'm on the Sensa diet. It's a little magic powder based on Dr. Hirsh's clinical trials and studies and it basically signals the brain that you're full through smellology.
47909.name: Patti Stanger

47910.quote: But I don't do the diet thing anymore. I'm a big believer in feeding your body what it needs. Deny yourself something and you're going to end up shoving your face full of it.
47910.name: Ashley Greene

47911.quote: Sometimes I've had to put myself on a diet.
47911.name: Roger Moore

47912.quote: I was a vegan for two years, and I really enjoyed it. Then, I got to a point in my life at which I wanted to do something else, so now I'm a vegetarian. You should make your diet one that best fits you and how you feel. Listen to your body. The most important thing is to exercise, drink lots of water, and take really good care of yourself.
47912.name: Lea Michele

47913.quote: I would eat healthy at times and pig out at times. But I never had to go on a strict diet plan.
47913.name: Tori Spelling

47914.quote: As for my diet, I try to eat lean, clean and healthy - nothing too surprising. And I avoid too much meat or dairy because they slow you down.
47914.name: Bear Grylls

47915.quote: I became a vegetarian out of compassion for animals and to live as healthy as possible. I realized soon after that I was truly concerned with nonviolent consumption and my own health, a vegan diet was the best decision.
47915.name: Davey Havok

47916.quote: I've never been a huge sweets eater, and I've always loved a Mediterranean diet. We eat a lot of dark leafy greens, and a couple meals each week are meat-free. We enjoy eating a balanced diet.
47916.name: Rachael Ray

47917.quote: I have argued for years that we do not have a health care system in America. We have a disease-management system - one that depends on ruinously expensive drugs and surgeries that treat health conditions after they manifest rather than giving our citizens simple diet, lifestyle and therapeutic tools to keep them healthy.
47917.name: Andrew Weil

47918.quote: In L.A., I get a meal delivery service called Diet Designs. I like a nice butter lettuce salad with some avocado, fresh grapefruit, shredded chicken breast and raw almond slices with a sesame vinaigrette dressing. I also love juicing and am kind of obsessed with it.
47918.name: Fergie

47919.quote: I did every diet: Atkins. Cabbage-soup diet. Dean Ornish. But I couldn't live the rest of my life like a rabbit.
47919.name: Mike Huckabee

47920.quote: I've never had body issues, I've never had an eating disorder. I've never had to go on a diet and that's because of Weight Watchers.
47920.name: Ginnifer Goodwin

47921.quote: I've drunk Amazon's free Diet Coke. Nothing makes more sense to me than a company trying to make bookselling into a profitable business. I'm not anti-Amazon, and I'm not pro-publishers either. I'm pro-books.
47921.name: Lev Grossman

47922.quote: These days I travel so much it's hard to get into a routine. When I'm on the road, I tend to use hotel gyms. When I'm home in L.A., I like to hike and hit the surf. All in all, I try to keep a balanced diet and exercise routine, which has stood me in good stead to date.
47922.name: Curtis Stone

47923.quote: I need protein from food rather than just protein supplements. I changed my diet.
47923.name: Travis Barker

47924.quote: I've tried just about every crazy diet you can imagine.
47924.name: Brooke Burke

47925.quote: Their diet is basically boiled vegetables, fish and rice. No fat, no sugar. You notice when you live there that there are no fat people.
47925.name: Arsene Wenger

47926.quote: As a coach you can influence the diet of your players. You can point out what is wrong.
47926.name: Arsene Wenger

47927.quote: All the pre-made sauces in a jar, and frozen and canned vegetables, processed meats, and cheeses which are loaded with artificial ingredients and sodium can get in the way of a healthy diet. My number one advice is to eat fresh, and seasonally.
47927.name: Todd English

47928.quote: Your diet is a bank account. Good food choices are good investments.
47928.name: Bethenny Frankel

47929.quote: My diet is mostly chicken and fish. I make sure I get a lot of vegetables, a lot of fruit. I am a big fruit man, I am a vegetable man anyway. And I also get a lot of rest. That's the key I may be up early, but I'm in bed early too.
47929.name: Magic Johnson

47930.quote: The doctor asked what my diet was like and I had to sit down and realize it's not normal, and hadn't been normal for about 20 years.
47930.name: Carre Otis

47931.quote: The first couple of days on the detox diet aren't pleasant.
47931.name: Carol Vorderman

47932.quote: I was starting to become impotent through this diet and couldn't perform. How many people who are taking the little blue pill, if they started to change what they are eating most of the time, could change the way their sex life is?
47932.name: Morgan Spurlock

47933.quote: Getting as much sleep as possible and following a healthy diet will stop you from feeling run-down if, like me, you're super-stressed.
47933.name: Elizabeth Hurley

47934.quote: Do not suppose, however, that I intend to urge a diet of classics on anybody. I have seen such diets at work. I have known people who have actually read all, or almost all, the guaranteed Hundred Best Books. God save us from reading nothing but the best.
47934.name: Robertson Davies

47935.quote: But I can only take so much TV, because there is so much advice. I find people will preach about virtually anything - your diet, how to live your life, how to improve your golf. The lot. I have always had a thing against the Mister Know-It-Alls.
47935.name: Bill Murray

47936.quote: I'm on a strict gossip diet. No gossip websites, no gossip magazines. Otherwise, I find it paralyzing to exist.
47936.name: Julie Bowen

47937.quote: The number of kids affected by obesity has tripled since 1980, and this can be traced in large part to lack of exercise and a healthy diet.
47937.name: Virginia Foxx

47938.quote: The best anti-aging advice I've ever received? Drink a lot of water and have a plant-based diet. I also do mindful meditation with my daughter every day. It takes ten minutes. I think reducing stress plays a big part in anti-aging.
47938.name: Carolyn Murphy

47939.quote: I grew up with a heavy diet of gospel, folk, and blues because those are kind of the cornerstones of traditional American music.
47939.name: Ben Harper

47940.quote: In the 20 long, hungry years between my late teens and late 30s I bought in to virtually every new diet and/or exercise regime that hoved into view, particularly at this most vulnerable time for those of us prone to poor body image - a new year.
47940.name: Arabella Weir

47941.quote: Sticking to a diet required me to have a permanently low self-esteem. But happily, I developed other skills beyond a fluctuating weight, eventually building up a different source of self-worth.
47941.name: Arabella Weir

47942.quote: I tried the Atkins diet in the Seventies when pregnant with my son, as I didn't want to pile on the pounds. Now, so long as I'm healthy, I don't care what my scales say.
47942.name: Britt Ekland

47943.quote: I try my best to be extremely disciplined about my diet.
47943.name: Mika Brzezinski

47944.quote: My mom was always really healthy and cautious about her diet, so I'm not a big sugar guy.
47944.name: Paul Walker

47945.quote: Push-ups, sit-ups, and a strict diet of raisins. That's my plan.
47945.name: Jack Black

47946.quote: Mexican food is far more varied than people think. It changes like dialects. I was brought up in Jalisco by the sea on a basic diet - tomatoes, chillis, peppers of every size and rice, which is a Mexican staple. The Pacific coast has a huge array of seafood.
47946.name: Gael Garcia Bernal

47947.quote: I think violence, cynicism, brutality and fashion are the staples of our diet. I think in the grand history of story-telling, going back to people sitting around fires, the dark side of human nature has always been very important. Movies are part of that tradition.
47947.name: Eric Stoltz

47948.quote: I'm an emotional eater. When I get upset, my diet goes out the window.
47948.name: Kelly Osbourne

47949.quote: I like starting off the new year fresh. I'm excited to see how 2013 turns out. Maybe because I'm an actress and I am always on a diet and fitness program, but my New Year's resolution is to let myself be nice to myself about my body.
47949.name: Busy Philipps

47950.quote: I like food too much to go on some crazy diet. French fries are my favorite downfall.
47950.name: Holly Madison

47951.quote: Going meat-free can make a huge difference. Studies show that vegetarians are, on average, 10 to 20 pounds lighter than meat-eaters and that a vegetarian diet reduces our risk of heart disease by 40 percent and adds seven or more years to our lifespan.
47951.name: Ingrid Newkirk

47952.quote: Perhaps one of the most important things you can do for human beings is wean them off an animal-based diet. It hardens the arteries and runs up our health-care costs. The last thing a poor person can afford is a heart attack or cancer or a stroke. And that's all linked to a meat-based diet. I think animal liberation is human liberation.
47952.name: Ingrid Newkirk

47953.quote: Look at the average American diet: ice cream, butter, cheese, whole milk, all this fat. People don't realize how much of this stuff you get by the end of the day. High blood pressure is from all this high-fat eating.
47953.name: Jack LaLanne

47954.quote: I won't sit here and say I've never had a pimple, but I try to have a really great diet, you know, lots of vegetables and fish. And I think stress plays a huge part too.
47954.name: Janelle Monae

47955.quote: And I grew up on a steady diet of science fiction, especially apocalyptic and postapocalyptic fiction.
47955.name: Justin Cronin

47956.quote: I don't have a problem with my body. I don't diet, and I'm not hiding anything. I'm not going to be the subject of a movie of the week 10 years from now.
47956.name: Lara Flynn Boyle

47957.quote: You can't exercise your way out of a bad diet.
47957.name: Mark Hyman

47958.quote: The very fact that we are having a national conversation about what we should eat, that we are struggling with the question about what the best diet is, is symptomatic of how far we have strayed from the natural conditions that gave rise to our species, from the simple act of eating real, whole, fresh food.
47958.name: Mark Hyman

47959.quote: Lifestyle change and changes in diet work faster, better and more cheaply than any medication and are as effective or more effective than gastric bypass without any side effects or long-term complications.
47959.name: Mark Hyman

47960.quote: When I was pregnant. I exercised and was healthy, but it was also the first time since I was 14 that I wasn't on a diet.
47960.name: Liv Tyler

47961.quote: I box for four hours a week and my diet is pretty healthy.
47961.name: Tony Parsons

47962.quote: My biggest regret is putting my body through fad diets - Atkins, cleanses, the hCG diet.
47962.name: Jennie Garth

47963.quote: We are also in the process of defining how best to work together with food and other companies to address diet and physical activity factors in order to prevent chronic diseases.
47963.name: Gro Harlem Brundtland

47964.quote: If you can eat 70 percent raw or introduce raw into your diet, it will help your health.
47964.name: Carol Alt

47965.quote: I was elected to the Diet in the same way as at every parliamentary election.
47965.name: Fritz Sauckel

47966.quote: I was member of the Diet as long as it existed, until May 1933.
47966.name: Fritz Sauckel

47967.quote: The Diet was dissolved by a Reich Government decree.
47967.name: Fritz Sauckel

47968.quote: Far too many times over the next 12 to 15 years it was brought to my attention that people who followed my exercise guidelines exactly but ignored their diet their weight and their cigarette smoking had heart attacks at age 55.
47968.name: Kenneth H. Cooper

47969.quote: 'Do What You Gotta Do' is a positive, inspirational song that says no matter what it is whether you're up against challenges or trying to get your dreams and aspirations met, you should do what whatever you have to do shy of killing yourself or someone else.
47969.name: Angie Stone

47970.quote: A successful life is one that is lived through understanding and pursuing one's own path, not chasing after the dreams of others.
47970.name: Chin-Ning Chu

47971.quote: In our increasingly secular society, with so many disparate gods and different faiths, superhero films present a unique canvas upon which our shared hopes, dreams and apocalyptic nightmares can be projected and played out.
47971.name: Tom Hiddleston

47972.quote: There are a lot of things that are personally uncomfortable to show, especially me without makeup and completely bloated or crying. But I've realized that it's time for me to show my audience that you don't have to be perfect to achieve your dreams.
47972.name: Katy Perry

47973.quote: She still talks to me now, only now she talks to me in my dreams. And I can't wait to go to sleep tonight because we have a lot to talk about. I love you.
47973.name: Jamie Foxx

47974.quote: Do It Under the Influence Yourself! That's what we're shooting for! Get drunk and make your dreams come true.
47974.name: Aziz Ansari

47975.quote: Life being what it is, one dreams of revenge.
47975.name: Paul Gauguin

47976.quote: I couldn't find the sports car of my dreams, so I built it myself.
47976.name: Ferdinand Porsche

47977.quote: Learn from your dreams what you lack.
47977.name: W. H. Auden

47978.quote: I've had quite a lot of luck with dreams. I've often awoken in the night with a phrase or even a whole song in my head.
47978.name: Brian Eno

47979.quote: I think there's a time as a writer when you want to see the best things in life, and you go out wherever you go with your dreams as a writer or a composer.
47979.name: Tori Amos

47980.quote: In my dreams, I could be a Princess, and that's what I was. Like most little girls, I believed nothing less than a Prince could make my dreams come true.
47980.name: Loretta Young

47981.quote: With unemployment still abysmally high, the Obama economy is crushing Hispanics' dreams for their children to live a better life.
47981.name: Marco Rubio

47982.quote: Mitt Romney will stop the attacks on job creators, encourage entrepreneurs to chase their dreams, and bring good jobs and a better future to all Americans.
47982.name: Marco Rubio

47983.quote: We're special because dreams that are impossible anywhere else, come true here. That's not just my story. That's your story. That's our story.
47983.name: Marco Rubio

47984.quote: The curse of the romantic is a greed for dreams, an intensity of expectation that, in the end, diminishes the reality.
47984.name: Marya Mannes

47985.quote: The dreams which reveal the supernatural are promises and messages that God sends us directly: they are nothing but His angels, His ministering spirits , who usually appear to us when we are in a great predicament.
47985.name: Paracelsus

47986.quote: Not all lucid dreams are useful but they all have a sense of wonder about them. If you must sleep through a third of your life, why should you sleep through your dreams, too?
47986.name: Stephen LaBerge

47987.quote: There's always going to be dreams and goals I have, but I never really tell people what they are.
47987.name: Tyra Banks

47988.quote: Intellectual despair results in neither weakness nor dreams, but in violence. It is only a matter of knowing how to give vent to one's rage whether one only wants to wander like madmen around prisons, or whether one wants to overturn them.
47988.name: Georges Bataille

47989.quote: Every comedian dreams of hosting 'The Tonight Show' and, for seven months, I got to. I did it my way, with people I love, and I do not regret a second.
47989.name: Conan O'Brien

47990.quote: Reality seems valueless by comparison with the dreams of fevered imaginations reality is therefore abandoned.
47990.name: Emile Durkheim

47991.quote: Without peace, all other dreams vanish and are reduced to ashes.
47991.name: Jawaharlal Nehru

47992.quote: People who insist on telling their dreams are among the terrors of the breakfast table.
47992.name: Max Beerbohm

47993.quote: We must stop talking about the American dream and start listening to the dreams of Americans.
47993.name: Max Beerbohm

47994.quote: Our dreams drench us in senses, and senses steps us again in dreams.
47994.name: Amos Bronson Alcott

47995.quote: My imagination completely controls me, and forever feeds the fire that burns with dark red light in my heart by bringing me the best dreams. I've always had a wild imagination, a big heart and a tortured soul so I feel that dark fantasy, love and horror are in my blood.
47995.name: Kim Elizabeth

47996.quote: Like dreams, statistics are a form of wish fulfillment.
47996.name: Jean Baudrillard

47997.quote: All art is exorcism. I paint dreams and visions too the dreams and visions of my time. Painting is the effort to produce order order in yourself. There is much chaos in me, much chaos in our time.
47997.name: Otto Dix

47998.quote: I have been interested in dreams, really since I was a kid. I have always been fascinated by the idea that your mind, when you are asleep, can create a world in a dream and you are perceiving it as though it really existed.
47998.name: Christopher Nolan

47999.quote: Never in my wildest dreams did I entertain the idea that I would become a fashion designer.
47999.name: Giorgio Armani

48000.quote: I might be writing what people expect me to write, writing from that place where I might be ruled by economic considerations. To overcome that, I started working with my dreams, because I'm not so censored when I use dream material.
48000.name: Kathy Acker

48001.quote: I envy people with dreams and passions, but I don't think that way. I still don't have a 'bliss' to follow. For people like me - I suspect that's most people - holding out for a 'dream' or a 'passion' is paralyzing. I just like having work I enjoy that feels meaningful. That's hard enough... but it's enough.
48001.name: Jane Pauley

48002.quote: Saddle your dreams before you ride em.
48002.name: Mary Webb

48003.quote: Genius is an African who dreams up snow.
48003.name: Vladimir Nabokov

48004.quote: Acting is also working with people who invite you into their dreams and trust you with their innermost being.
48004.name: Catherine Deneuve

48005.quote: So many financial dreams are thwarted by the failure to act upon good intentions.
48005.name: Suze Orman

48006.quote: I was not looking for my dreams to interpret my life, but rather for my life to interpret my dreams.
48006.name: Susan Sontag

48007.quote: We use our parents like recurring dreams, to be entered into when needed.
48007.name: Doris Lessing

48008.quote: Dreams get you into the future and add excitement to the present.
48008.name: Robert Conklin

48009.quote: I've woken up from dreams and the whole song is there. I'm listening to it in my dreams. I consciously have to wake myself up and get a tape recorder because I hear it like a record.
48009.name: Lenny Kravitz

48010.quote: As I live and am a man, this is an unexaggerated tale - my dreams become the substances of my life.
48010.name: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

48011.quote: I think when you move past your fear and you go after your dreams wholeheartedly, you become free.
48011.name: LL Cool J

48012.quote: Through hard work, perseverance and a faith in God, you can live your dreams.
48012.name: Benjamin Carson

48013.quote: If you're the type of person who has to fulfill your dreams, you've gotta be resourceful to make sure you can do it. I came out to California when I was 21, thinking my New York credentials would take me all the way. I came back home a year later all dejected and a failure.
48013.name: Vin Diesel

48014.quote: I've said it before, but it's absolutely true: My mother gave me my drive, but my father gave me my dreams. Thanks to him, I could see a future.
48014.name: Liza Minnelli

48015.quote: Hold fast to dreams For when dreams go Life is a barren field Frozen with snow.
48015.name: Langston Hughes

48016.quote: We must not let our passions destroy our dreams.
48016.name: Thomas S. Monson

48017.quote: I mean, I'm 48 years old and I've been through a lot in my life - you know, loss, whether it be death, illness, separation. I mean, the failed expectations... We all have dreams.
48017.name: Annie Lennox

48018.quote: My life turned out to be beyond my greatest dreams.
48018.name: Anthony Hopkins

48019.quote: My mother taught me that we all have the power to achieve our dreams. What I lacked was the courage.
48019.name: Clay Aiken

48020.quote: Dreams come true without that possibility, nature would not incite us to have them.
48020.name: John Updike

48021.quote: People ask how can a Jewish kid from the Bronx do preppy clothes? Does it have to do with class and money? It has to do with dreams.
48021.name: Ralph Lauren

48022.quote: Death is the mother of Beauty hence from her, alone, shall come fulfillment to our dreams and our desires.
48022.name: Wallace Stevens

48023.quote: Our politics are our deepest form of expression: they mirror our past experiences and reflect our dreams and aspirations for the future.
48023.name: Paul Wellstone

48024.quote: Our dreams are firsthand creations, rather than residues of waking life. We have the capacity for infinite creativity at least while dreaming, we partake of the power of the Spirit, the infinite Godhead that creates the cosmos.
48024.name: Jackie Gleason

48025.quote: Dreams do come true, even for someone who couldn't speak English and never had a music lesson or much of an education.
48025.name: Lawrence Welk

48026.quote: It is exactly because we are a city that embraces freedom, that welcomes everyone and encourages their dreams, that New York remains on the front lines in the war on terror.
48026.name: Michael Bloomberg

48027.quote: Ironically, it is exactly because we are a city that embraces freedom, that welcomes everyone and encourages their dreams, that New York remains on the front lines in the war on terror.
48027.name: Michael Bloomberg

48028.quote: Believe it or not, lots of people change their majors and abandon their dreams just to avoid a couple of math classes in college.
48028.name: Danica McKellar

48029.quote: Of all our dreams today there is none more important - or so hard to realise - than that of peace in the world. May we never lose our faith in it or our resolve to do everything that can be done to convert it one day into reality.
48029.name: Lester B. Pearson

48030.quote: It has been my observation that parents kill more dreams than anybody.
48030.name: Spike Lee

48031.quote: Sigmund Freud said we act out our own dreams, but if you are only an actor you are not acting out your own dream. You are simply participating in someone else's dream.
48031.name: John Malkovich

48032.quote: I have those dreams that you can't put into words.
48032.name: Jr. Harry Connick

48033.quote: I worked on my voice for Sweet Dreams, but only to match my speaking voice to Patsy's actual singing voice. That was my way into that character.
48033.name: Jessica Lange

48034.quote: I'm very comfortable with the nature of life and death, and that we come to an end. What's most difficult to imagine is that those dreams and early yearnings and desires of childhood and adolescence will also disappear. But who knows? Maybe you become part of the eternal whatever.
48034.name: Hugh Hefner

48035.quote: A dream is a scripture, and many scriptures are nothing but dreams.
48035.name: Umberto Eco

48036.quote: Dreams are the seeds of change. Nothing ever grows without a seed, and nothing ever changes without a dream.
48036.name: Debby Boone

48037.quote: My dreams have become puny with the reality my life has become.
48037.name: Imelda Marcos

48038.quote: My dreams were always small and puny. All I ever needed was a little house with a little picket fence by the sea. Little did I know that I would live in Malacanang Palace for 20 years and visit all the major palaces of mankind. And then also meet ordinary citizens and the leaders of superpowers.
48038.name: Imelda Marcos

48040.quote: Worse than not realizing the dreams of your youth, would be to have been young and never dreamed at all.
48040.name: Jean Genet

48041.quote: My life has been a continuous fulfillment of dreams. It appears that everything I saw and did has a new, and perhaps, more significant meaning, every time I see it. The earth is good. It is a privilege to live thereon.
48041.name: Liberty Hyde Bailey

48042.quote: Literature for me isn't a workaday job, but something which involves desires, dreams and fantasy.
48042.name: Antonio Tabucchi

48043.quote: I love watching people's dreams come true.
48043.name: Jessica Simpson

48044.quote: And our dreams are who we are.
48044.name: Barbara Sher

48045.quote: You can't break my spirit, it's my dreams you take.
48045.name: James Blunt

48046.quote: Big dreams create the magic that stir men's souls to greatness.
48046.name: Bill McCartney

48047.quote: I don't like dreams or reality. I like when dreams become reality because that is my life.
48047.name: Jean Paul Gaultier

48048.quote: My office is at Yankee stadium. Yes, dreams do come true.
48048.name: Derek Jeter

48049.quote: I believe history will come to view 9/11 as an event on par with November 22, 1963, the date on which John F. Kennedy was murdered, cutting short a presidency that was growing ever more promising. Dreams died that day in Dallas it is easy to imagine the 1960s turning out rather differently had President Kennedy lived.
48049.name: Jon Meacham

48050.quote: You control your future, your destiny. What you think about comes about. By recording your dreams and goals on paper, you set in motion the process of becoming the person you most want to be. Put your future in good hands - your own.
48050.name: Mark Victor Hansen

48051.quote: Only in dreams, in poetry, in play do we sometimes arrive at what we were before we were this thing that, who knows, we are.
48051.name: Julio Cortazar

48052.quote: From time immemorial artistic insights have been revealed to artists in their sleep and in dreams, so that at all times they ardently desired them.
48052.name: Paracelsus

48053.quote: Field of Dreams is probably our generation's It's A Wonderful Life.
48053.name: Kevin Costner

48054.quote: I'm a big fan of dreams. Unfortunately, dreams are our first casualty in life - people seem to give them up, quicker than anything, for a 'reality.'
48054.name: Kevin Costner

48055.quote: 'The Cut' is going to give someone the opportunity of a lifetime and help that person achieve his or her dreams.
48055.name: Tommy Hilfiger

48056.quote: I came at age in the '60s, and initially my hopes and dreams were invested in politics and the movements of the time - the anti-war movement, the civil rights movement. I worked on Bobby Kennedy's campaign for president as a teenager in California and the night he was killed.
48056.name: David Talbot

48057.quote: Happiness is making your dreams come true.
48057.name: Jourdan Dunn

48058.quote: I want to keep my dreams, even bad ones, because without them, I might have nothing all night long.
48058.name: Joseph Heller

48059.quote: I am a child of Hollywood and dreams. To me, to be on the red carpet is the best place in the world.
48059.name: Steven Cojocaru

48060.quote: The old studios that mass-produced dreams are gone with the wind, just like the old downtown theaters that were the temples of the dreams.
48060.name: Suzanne Fields

48061.quote: This city can be kind of brutal, so you see your dreams from every different angle, but ultimately it's about acting and if you enjoy acting, you will always enjoy acting.
48061.name: Radha Mitchell

48062.quote: In my lifetime, I've discovered a great many incredibly talented individuals. Some have achieved stardom. Simultaneously, I've seen many dreams shattered, egos destroyed and lives changed forever. The end destination may well be fame and fortune, but the road to stardom is littered with broken hearts.
48062.name: Nigel Lythgoe

48063.quote: Youth is in a grand flush, like the hot days of ending summer and pleasant dreams thrall your spirit, like the smoky atmosphere that bathes the landscape of an August day.
48063.name: Donald G. Mitchell

48064.quote: Dreams are, by definition, cursed with short life spans.
48064.name: Candice Bergen

48065.quote: If you want to achieve your dreams, you must follow them, and the best way to follow them is not to think about wanting to be very rich, but to think about doing something that you really want to do.
48065.name: Jackie Collins

48066.quote: My dreams were at once more fantastic and agreeable than my writings.
48066.name: Mary Wollstonecraft Shelley

48067.quote: In Dreams... well, I was slightly overcompensating with that. I was a bit like a director for hire, so maybe I was putting too much imagery that was familiar to me into it.
48067.name: Neil Jordan

48068.quote: An Academy Award nomination is stuff dreams are made of.
48068.name: Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy

48070.quote: We grew up founding our dreams on the infinite promise of American advertising. I still believe that one can learn to play the piano by mail and that mud will give you a perfect complexion.
48070.name: Zelda Fitzgerald

48071.quote: I never had any big dreams about doing something on a huge scale.
48071.name: Alison Krauss

48072.quote: When I first left Iran at the age of 13, Iran had become such a shining star - it was the point to which all my desires and dreams returned.
48072.name: Azar Nafisi

48073.quote: When I won in 2003, never in my wildest dreams did I ever think I would win Wimbledon and have my kids seeing me lift the trophy, so this is pretty surreal. And yeah, I was almost shocked in the moment that it all came together so nicely.
48073.name: Roger Federer

48074.quote: Dream study impacts culture. We are put in touch with the inner poet who dreams. We hear our inner, subjective response to the outer world. That helps spiritualize our lives.
48074.name: Henry Reed

48075.quote: Freud published The Interpretation of Dreams in 1900. It introduced the notion that there existed certain predictable and identifiable processes by which dreams were formed.
48075.name: Henry Reed

48076.quote: It is easier to learn to interpret dreams if you have a reason to use them for something constructive. You apply your dream insights to making constructive changes in your life.
48076.name: Henry Reed

48077.quote: People are learning to feel more comfortable hearing one another's dreams. It used to be that if you told a dream in public, someone had to make a joke to relieve the tension introduced by that alternative reality.
48077.name: Henry Reed

48078.quote: People don't think their dreams amount to much, but when I ask them to examine them for common themes, they surprise themselves at how accurate they are! They see that their dreams have value.
48078.name: Henry Reed

48079.quote: The usual comment from psychologists and psychiatrists was that it's best not to encourage people to look at their dreams because they are liable to stir up problems for themselves.
48079.name: Henry Reed

48080.quote: Not only the priceless heritage of our fathers, of our seamen, of our Empire builders is being thrown away in a war that serves no British interests - but our alliance leader Stalin dreams of nothing but the destruction of that heritage of our fathers?
48080.name: John Amery

48081.quote: That's what noir feels like to me. It feels like some kind of recurring dream, with very strong archetypes operating. You know, the guilty girl being pursued, falling, all kinds of stuff that we see in our dreams all the time.
48081.name: Brian De Palma

48082.quote: I always wanted to be a Californian. In my wildest dreams, I always liked California - it's the place where oranges grows on trees! Fruit just falls off the trees.
48082.name: Eric Burdon

48084.quote: I thin many people's deviant behavior starts with dreams because dreams are so non-linear... as if there's an assumption that everything has to be linear or has to be plotted.
48084.name: Robyn Hitchcock

48086.quote: It is an everlasting desire to make my dreams come true. And it's getting to the point now where it's like, come on I want my dreams to come true so that I can get on with the rest of my life. Sometimes I think about the rest of my life when I'm done.
48086.name: Picabo Street

48087.quote: One of my dreams in life is to do fund-raising for the youth.
48087.name: Picabo Street

48088.quote: Anderson Cooper every night dreams about getting my job permanently really.
48088.name: Regis Philbin

48089.quote: So, I think that Marilyn, what she gave the world, and in many ways Kennedy too, was that they had dreams and they didn't allow anybody to take away their dreams.
48089.name: Sally Kirkland

48090.quote: It's weird to say, but every time I look at my daughter and I see this little living breathing thing that came from me, that represents all of the hopes and dreams that I would want for her, I see a miracle.
48090.name: Josh Gad

48091.quote: My dreams are of water. And my nightmares.
48091.name: Siouxsie Sioux

48092.quote: You have to work hard for what you want to achieve and you have to set goals and dreams and really go for them.
48092.name: Natalie du Toit

48093.quote: I'm thinking of slowing down on modeling and branching out to other things. I want to pursue some new and old dreams and start making them happen.
48093.name: Chanel Iman

48094.quote: You cannot live to please everyone else. You have to edify, educate and fulfill your own dreams and destiny, and hope that whatever your art is that you're putting out there, if it's received, great, I respect you for receiving it. If it's not received, great, I respect you for not.
48094.name: Octavia Spencer

48095.quote: I was always a closet lover of acting. My mom was very practical. She never, ever restricted our dreams, always told us we could do or be anything. Then I said, 'Maybe I want to be an actor'. And she said, 'Maybe not that'.
48095.name: Octavia Spencer

48096.quote: My career was full of struggles and dreams, disappointments and peaks and valleys. But there was no Twitter, no Facebook or TMZ. Young actors could make mistakes and not become the focus of tabloids.
48096.name: Ricky Schroder

48097.quote: It is great good health to believe, as the Hindus do, that there are 33 million gods and goddesses in the world. It is great good health to want to understand one's dreams. It is great good health to desire the ambiguous and paradoxical.
48097.name: Clive Barker

48098.quote: In opposition to this detachment, he finds an image of man which contains within itself man's dreams, man's illness, man's redemption from the misery of poverty - poverty which can no longer be for him a sign of the acceptance of life.
48098.name: Salvatore Quasimodo

48099.quote: Don't let your dreams be dreams.
48099.name: Jack Johnson

48100.quote: It was taunted as reality. It was dangled as a carrot. In terms of people's hopes and dreams, to say that that is less of a reality than the daily grind they find themselves in is maybe not correct.
48100.name: Martin Mull

48101.quote: Screenplays I didn't really care about, journalism, travel books, getting my writer friends to write about their dreams or something. I just determined to write the books I had to write.
48101.name: Kazuo Ishiguro

48102.quote: I enjoy making solo albums because over the years it's evolved into more of a genuine personal expression of story-telling and day dreams, and I work in a way that has more control.
48102.name: Bruce Dickinson

48103.quote: We can escape the commonplace only by manipulating it, controlling it, thrusting it into our dreams or surrendering it to the free play of our subjectivity.
48103.name: Raoul Vaneigem

48104.quote: Ever since we were little, we were so on fire for our dreams. We never let anyone blow our flames out.
48104.name: Kelly Rowland

48105.quote: I am not ridiculing verbal mechanisms, dreams, or repressions as origins of poetry all three of them and more besides may have a great deal to do with it.
48105.name: Allen Tate

48106.quote: I love to work with the younger kids who are trying to live out their dreams, if in fact that's what they plan on doing after college to take the next step. A very select few have that opportunity so when you do have the opportunity you know, those guys take advantage of it.
48106.name: Roger Clemens

48107.quote: College baseball, I love it. I love to work with the younger kids who are trying to live out their dreams, if in fact that's what they plan on doing after college to take the next step.
48107.name: Roger Clemens

48108.quote: My childhood dreams were focused on being part of the effort to make humanity a multiplanetary species.
48108.name: Peter Diamandis

48109.quote: We control the content of our dreams.
48109.name: Thom Gunn

48110.quote: I can have my goals, and I can have my dreams. My goal is to make the finals and improve my position. I want to run all decent races. I don't want to look back and say I ran a terrible race.
48110.name: Oscar Pistorius

48111.quote: We in the majority have worked hard to empower people to create opportunities, to make jobs, to do things that turn America into a place where people can achieve their dreams.
48111.name: Robin Hayes

48112.quote: My hero's, my dreams, and my future lie in Yankee Stadium and they can't take that from me.
48112.name: Derek Jeter

48113.quote: Field of Dreams is the only movie - and I saw it in the theater - on an afternoon when I was on location somewhere, and there were like 12 people in the theater. I was just so devastated I couldn't get out of my seat. And I sat and watched it a second time.
48113.name: Paul Reiser

48114.quote: Maybe the body learns from dreams. Maybe the muscles, the neutrons, revitalize.
48114.name: Michael Zaslow

48115.quote: Here's what I see all across this great city - people working together to make Boston a better place to live and to raise children, to grow and pursue dreams.
48115.name: Thomas Menino

48116.quote: Men act out like they're horrified by marriage, but when they find the woman of their dreams, they love it.
48116.name: Rachel Hunter

48117.quote: The hoary joke in the literary world, based on 'Dreams From My Father,' was that if things had worked out differently for Barack Obama, he could have made it as a writer.
48117.name: James Fallows

48118.quote: Well, my thoughts about California are kind of mythological. To me, as well as being a real place, it's a place where people go to find something - to find happiness or to realize their dreams. So it has that kind of quality of heroism and heartache, and Australia has that, as well.
48118.name: Colin Hay

48119.quote: America is not just a democracy, it represents a certain culture of competitive mobility and personality aspirations, politics is not merely a clash of interests, but a clash of dreams.
48119.name: David Brooks

48120.quote: I knew I wanted to do something creative. I didn't think I'd have the luxury of doing something like that, because I didn't know anyone who had pursued anything they really adored, but I had dreams for singing or writing.
48120.name: Lana Del Rey

48121.quote: I still marvel at how God turns dreams into reality.
48121.name: Martha Reeves

48122.quote: I worshipped Berry Gordy for the creative dreams he had made come true.
48122.name: Martha Reeves

48123.quote: So we see Edward as a young man on the road and he meets a giant and he brings the giant to a circus where he meets a Miss Calloway. He sees the woman of his dreams and I am the only one who knows who she is.
48123.name: Danny DeVito

48124.quote: Never let your dreams go away.
48124.name: Mike Piazza

48125.quote: Politics are beautiful. They enable a community to live collectively with one another. It's not about stabbing each other in the back it's about enabling people to reach their dreams and pursue happiness.
48125.name: Ben Nicholson

48127.quote: And they were writing scripts where Christine had hit the glass ceiling. And I always thought Christine would never hit the glass ceiling. I thought her dreams would take her. Maybe her dreams wouldn't take her where she wanted, but she still had her dreams.
48127.name: Sharon Gless

48128.quote: Dreams say what they mean, but they don't say it in daytime language.
48128.name: Gail Godwin

48129.quote: You've got to have dreams to keep you going.
48129.name: Steve Waugh

48130.quote: I'm very ambitious. I live in reality but I have dreams I want to fulfill - I want to be a director, and I've already started my own production company. But I also have a measure of success that I keep to myself. It's something very personal to me.
48130.name: Alex Pettyfer

48131.quote: When I was a kid, I have two dreams. I want to be a baseball player. Hometown, Hiroshima, has a Japanese baseball franchise team called Hiroshima Carps. You know, and then I want to be a sushi chef. I want to make own restaurant - sushi restaurant.
48131.name: Masaharu Morimoto

48132.quote: People with disabilities have abilities too and that is what this course is all about - making sure those abilities blossom and shine so that all the dreams you have can come true.
48132.name: Mary McAleese

48133.quote: If our dreams were more regular, more connected, more stable, they would also have more practical importance for us.
48133.name: Ernst Mach

48134.quote: When I grew up, I only had two dreams. One was to be a cowboy and another was to be in the military. I grew up extremely patriotic and riding horses.
48134.name: Chris Kyle

48135.quote: Humanity needs dreams to be able to survive the miseries of daily existence, even if only for an instant.
48135.name: Oscar Niemeyer

48136.quote: One of the things I've started doing lately is tracking my dreams. I feel like there's a lot of information there and you can really bring those emotions to the situations that may feel mundane or familiar. That gives them new life and gives you a new relationship with it - if that makes any sort of sense.
48136.name: Jennifer Carpenter

48137.quote: I wanted to raise the voice of a lot of the people that I knew growing up, and this was, for the most part, poor people who had extraordinary dreams but also very amazing obstacles.
48137.name: Edwidge Danticat

48138.quote: My mother dreamed dreams for Joaquin and for me long before we could dream them for ourselves.
48138.name: Julian Castro

48139.quote: I have actual dreams of Bruce Springsteen calling me up on stage to wear a bandanna and play rhythm guitar next to Little Steven.
48139.name: Tom Perrotta

48140.quote: Sexual dreams aren't usually about sex.
48140.name: Pamela Stephenson

48141.quote: He's dreaming with his eyes open, and those that dream with their eyes open are dangerous, for they do not know when their dreams come to an end.
48141.name: Hugo Pratt

48142.quote: We had common interests in the beauty of the French language. We both had a tremendous love of jazz. We shared dreams of getting married and having a family, living in the country, leading an idyllic life.
48142.name: David Amram

48143.quote: Dream lofty dreams, and as you dream, so you shall become. Your vision is the promise of what you shall one day be your ideal is the prophecy of what you shall at last unveil.
48143.name: James Lane Allen

48144.quote: Thanking you once more, I want to wish you the best of luck for your future life and to conclude by saying to you: Dream your dreams and may they come true!
48144.name: Felix Bloch

48145.quote: 'Dreams From My Father' reveals more about Obama than is usually known about political leaders until after they're dead. Perhaps more than it intends, it shows his mind working, in real time, sentence by sentence, in what feels like a private audience with the reader.
48145.name: Jonathan Raban

48146.quote: The only book by a modern president that bears serious comparison with Obama's 'Dreams From My Father' is Jimmy Carter's short campaign autobiography, 'Why Not the Best?,' published in 1975.
48146.name: Jonathan Raban

48147.quote: When you stop having dreams and ideals - well, you might as well stop altogether.
48147.name: Marian Anderson

48148.quote: Here Fashion is a despot, and no one dreams of evading its dictates.
48148.name: Marguerite Gardiner

48149.quote: If you were to ask my agent, they would confirm this: I'm drawn to locations. What really drew me to 'The 4400,' aside from the fact that it was sci-fi, was the fact that it was shot in the city of my dreams: Vancouver.
48149.name: Billy Campbell

48150.quote: There has been enough suffering in our country, there has been enough of children whose dreams die before they have a chance to grow and there has been enough of our elders who, having served their nation, are forced into indignity in their old age.
48150.name: John Agyekum Kufuor

48151.quote: Just really, really believe in what you're trying to do. Don't let people alter that. Let people advise you and lead you down paths to make smart business decisions. But trust your instinct and trust that overwhelming drive that made you put all your dreams and everything on the line.
48151.name: Luke Bryan

48152.quote: Let your dreams outgrow the shoes of your expectations.
48152.name: Ryunosuke Satoro

48153.quote: I was working at the store on the Sony studios in Culver City. And I was literally holding a shirt when they came in and told me I'd got the part! It just shows dreams do come true.
48153.name: Derek Luke

48154.quote: Then I was working in a store in Newark, New Jersey, and I saw an actor in person, and I got so excited. My whole day changed. That's when I decided to challenge myself to make my dreams become a reality.
48154.name: Derek Luke

48155.quote: I want to still be singing at 70 years old. I want to be open to the dreams I haven't even dreamed up.
48155.name: Fantasia Barrino

48156.quote: I would love to spend all my time writing to you I'd love to share with you all that goes through my mind, all that weighs on my heart, all that gives air to my soul phantoms of art, dreams that would be so beautiful if they could come true.
48156.name: Luigi Pirandello

48157.quote: Don't think your dreams don't come true, because they do. You'd better be careful what you wish for. And I truly and honestly - one day I am doing the 'Beaver' show and I said, 'This is the show I have always wanted to do.
48157.name: Barbara Billingsley

48158.quote: Tis education forms the common mind just as the twig is bent the tree's inclined.
48158.name: Alexander Pope

48670.quote: I just go where my heart tells me, where my gut tells me to go, where I'm enjoying my life the most, where I feel like I can have the most success. I've truly enjoyed my experience in NASCAR, to the point that I want to do it full time.
48670.name: Danica Patrick

48671.quote: The great awareness comes slowly, piece by piece. The path of spiritual growth is a path of lifelong learning. The experience of spiritual power is basically a joyful one.
48671.name: M. Scott Peck

48672.quote: I've learned from experience that if you work harder at it, and apply more energy and time to it, and more consistency, you get a better result. It comes from the work.
48672.name: Louis C. K.

48673.quote: It is impossible to experience one's death objectively and still carry a tune.
48673.name: Woody Allen

48674.quote: And to get real work experience, you need a job, and most jobs will require you to have had either real work experience or a graduate degree.
48674.name: Donald Norman

48675.quote: When you make a commitment to a relationship, you invest your attention and energy in it more profoundly because you now experience ownership of that relationship.
48675.name: Barbara de Angelis

48676.quote: What is the price of experience? Do men buy it for a song? Or wisdom for a dance in the street? No, it is bought with the price of all the man hath, his house, his wife, his children.
48676.name: William Blake

48677.quote: In times of rapid change, experience could be your worst enemy.
48677.name: J. Paul Getty

48678.quote: A few years' experience will convince us that those things which at the time they happened we regarded as our greatest misfortunes have proved our greatest blessings.
48678.name: George Mason

48679.quote: In order to experience everyday spirituality, we need to remember that we are spiritual beings spending some time in a human body.
48679.name: Barbara de Angelis

48680.quote: But human experience is usually paradoxical, that means incongruous with the phrases of current talk or even current philosophy.
48680.name: George Eliot

48681.quote: Is it not rather what we expect in men, that they should have numerous strands of experience lying side by side and never compare them with each other?
48681.name: George Eliot

48682.quote: In spite of his practical ability, some of his experience had petrified into maxims and quotations.
48682.name: George Eliot

48683.quote: I must take issue with the term 'a mere child,' for it has been my invariable experience that the company of a mere child is infinitely preferable to that of a mere adult.
48683.name: Fran Lebowitz

48684.quote: Most people go through life dreading they'll have a traumatic experience. Freaks were born with their trauma. They've already passed their test in life. They're aristocrats.
48684.name: Diane Arbus

48685.quote: Natural abilities are like natural plants, that need pruning by study and studies themselves do give forth directions too much at large, except they be bounded in by experience.
48685.name: Francis Bacon

48686.quote: No man's knowledge here can go beyond his experience.
48686.name: John Locke

48687.quote: To reach something good it is very useful to have gone astray, and thus acquire experience.
48687.name: Saint Teresa of Avila

48688.quote: A conception not reducible to the small change of daily experience is like a currency not exchangeable for articles of consumption it is not a symbol, but a fraud.
48688.name: George Santayana

48689.quote: The reward of suffering is experience.
48689.name: Harry S. Truman

48690.quote: I deepen my experience of God through prayer, meditation, and forgiveness.
48690.name: Marianne Williamson

48691.quote: I haven't been as wild with my money as somebody like me might have been. I've been very safe, very conservative with investments. I don't blow money. I don't have a ton of houses. I know things can go away. I've already had that experience.
48691.name: Jim Carrey

48692.quote: Let us be about setting high standards for life, love, creativity, and wisdom. If our expectations in these areas are low, we are not likely to experience wellness. Setting high standards makes every day and every decade worth looking forward to.
48692.name: Greg Anderson

48693.quote: The physical world, including our bodies, is a response of the observer. We create our bodies as we create the experience of our world.
48693.name: Deepak Chopra

48694.quote: Difficult times always create opportunities for you to experience more love in your life.
48694.name: Barbara de Angelis

48695.quote: I think everyone should experience defeat at least once during their career. You learn a lot from it.
48695.name: Lou Holtz

48696.quote: Acting is a question of absorbing other people's personalities and adding some of your own experience.
48696.name: Jean-Paul Sartre

48697.quote: It is important to expect nothing, to take every experience, including the negative ones, as merely steps on the path, and to proceed.
48697.name: Ram Dass

48698.quote: The only relevant test of the validity of a hypothesis is comparison of prediction with experience.
48698.name: Milton Friedman

48699.quote: Studies perfect nature and are perfected still by experience.
48699.name: Francis Bacon

48700.quote: All theory is against freedom of the will all experience for it.
48700.name: Samuel Johnson

48701.quote: The great difficulty in education is to get experience out of ideas.
48701.name: George Santayana

48702.quote: It is beyond a doubt that all our knowledge that begins with experience.
48702.name: Immanuel Kant

48703.quote: I firmly believe that all human beings have access to extraordinary energies and powers. Judging from accounts of mystical experience, heightened creativity, or exceptional performance by athletes and artists, we harbor a greater life than we know.
48703.name: Jean Houston

48704.quote: But perhaps the rest of us could have separate classes in science appreciation, the wonder of science, scientific ways of thinking, and the history of scientific ideas, rather than laboratory experience.
48704.name: Richard Dawkins

48705.quote: The greatest gift is the passion for reading. It is cheap, it consoles, it distracts, it excites, it gives you knowledge of the world and experience of a wide kind. It is a moral illumination.
48705.name: Moses Hadas

48706.quote: The questions which one asks oneself begin, at least, to illuminate the world, and become one's key to the experience of others.
48706.name: James A. Baldwin

48707.quote: Suffering is but another name for the teaching of experience, which is the parent of instruction and the schoolmaster of life.
48707.name: Horace

48708.quote: Any experience can be transformed into something of value.
48708.name: Vash Young

48709.quote: As human beings, we are vulnerable to confusing the unprecedented with the improbable. In our everyday experience, if something has never happened before, we are generally safe in assuming it is not going to happen in the future, but the exceptions can kill you and climate change is one of those exceptions.
48709.name: Al Gore

48710.quote: To have God speak to the heart is a majestic experience, an experience that people may miss if they monopolize the conversation and never pause to hear God's responses.
48710.name: Charles Stanley

48711.quote: I wish I could give you a lot of advice, based on my experience of winning political debates. But I don't have that experience. My only experience is at losing them.
48711.name: Richard M. Nixon

48712.quote: A leader who confines his role to his people's experience dooms himself to stagnation a leader who outstrips his people's experience runs the risk of not being understood.
48712.name: Henry A. Kissinger

48713.quote: Reason, observation, and experience the holy trinity of science.
48713.name: Robert Green Ingersoll

48714.quote: Everybody experiences far more than he understands. Yet it is experience, rather than understanding, that influences behavior.
48714.name: Marshall McLuhan

48715.quote: The statesman's duty is to bridge the gap between his nation's experience and his vision.
48715.name: Henry A. Kissinger

48716.quote: Tactics, fitness, stroke ability, adaptability, experience, and sportsmanship are all necessary for winning.
48716.name: Fred Perry

48717.quote: I gave my beauty and my youth to men. I am going to give my wisdom and experience to animals.
48717.name: Brigitte Bardot

48718.quote: Recommend virtue to your children it alone, not money, can make them happy. I speak from experience.
48718.name: Ludwig van Beethoven

48719.quote: The only faith that wears well and holds its color in all weathers is that which is woven of conviction and set with the sharp mordant of experience.
48719.name: James Russell Lowell

48720.quote: I understand now that the vulnerability I've always felt is the greatest strength a person can have. You can't experience life without feeling life. What I've learned is that being vulnerable to somebody you love is not a weakness, it's a strength.
48720.name: Elisabeth Shue

48721.quote: When we learn from experience, the scars of sin can lead us to restoration and a renewed intimacy with God.
48721.name: Charles Stanley

48722.quote: The belief that all genuine education comes about through experience does not mean that all experiences are genuinely or equally educative.
48722.name: John Dewey

48723.quote: The trouble with this country is that there are too many politicians who believe, with a conviction based on experience, that you can fool all of the people all of the time.
48723.name: Franklin P. Adams

48724.quote: Whatever you dwell on in the conscious grows in your experience.
48724.name: Brian Tracy

48725.quote: I am so used to seeing the sort of play which deals with one man and two women. They do not leave me with the feeling I have made a full theatrical meal they do not give me the experience of the multiplicity of life.
48725.name: E. M. Forster

48726.quote: The historian must have some conception of how men who are not historians behave. Otherwise he will move in a world of the dead. He can only gain that conception through personal experience, and he can only use his personal experiences when he is a genius.
48726.name: E. M. Forster

48727.quote: Happiness isn't something you experience it's something you remember.
48727.name: Oscar Levant

48728.quote: No experience is a cause of success or failure. We do not suffer from the shock of our experiences, so-called trauma - but we make out of them just what suits our purposes.
48728.name: Alfred Adler

48729.quote: You cannot, in human experience, rush into the light. You have to go through the twilight into the broadening day before the noon comes and the full sun is upon the landscape.
48729.name: Woodrow Wilson

48730.quote: I don't claim to be knowledgeable about theology. Most of my knowledge comes out of my experience and the lessons in the Bible. Every Sunday I'm home I teach 45 minutes and we boiled them down to one page for the new book, 'Through the Year with Jimmy Carter.'
48730.name: Jimmy Carter

48731.quote: 'Donny and Marie' was a great experience. I tried so hard to be a great talk show host but it's all about relaxing and enjoying it. Marie and I finally figured that out. I would have liked it to continue but I'm kind of glad it's over because of the phenomenal workload.
48731.name: Donny Osmond

48732.quote: I didn't go to high school, so I don't have a high school experience. I was home-schooled during high school.
48732.name: Josh Hutcherson

48733.quote: My faith experience, well, as you can imagine, you need a lot of faith to raise five boys.
48733.name: Ann Romney

48734.quote: It's been quite an experience, being conservative and living in the North East.
48734.name: Ann Romney

48735.quote: There can be nothing exclusive about substantial art. It comes directly out of the heart of the experience of life and thinking about life and living life.
48735.name: Charles Ives

48736.quote: I decided blacks should not have to experience the difficulties I had faced, so I decided to open a flying school and teach other black women to fly.
48736.name: Bessie Coleman

48737.quote: The only time I ever went hunting I remembered it as a grisly experience.
48737.name: Gloria Swanson

48738.quote: When you do find humor in trying times, one of the first and most important changes you experience is that you see your perplexing problems in a new way - you suddenly have a new perspective on them.
48738.name: Allen Klein

48739.quote: My Marine experience helped shape who I am now personally and professionally, and I am grateful for that on an almost daily basis.
48739.name: Jim Lehrer

48740.quote: A sense of freedom is something that, happily, comes with age and life experience.
48740.name: Diane Keaton

48741.quote: The act of writing... is the act of trying to understand why my opinion is what it is. And ultimately, I think that's the same experience the reader has when they pick up one of my books.
48741.name: Jodi Picoult

48742.quote: To pursue a so-called Third Way is foolish. We had our experience with this in the 1960s when we looked for a socialism with a human face. It did not work, and we must be explicit that we are not aiming for a more efficient version of a system that has failed.
48742.name: Vaclav Klaus

48743.quote: And I thought, when I have kids, that's the sort of well told, silly, and fun fairy tale that I would want to take them to. But it was an amazing experience. And I think Shrek is a real classic, a fairy tale classic.
48743.name: Mike Myers

48744.quote: I would love to be a father. I had a great father who taught me how gratifying that is. I'm not going to deny myself that. I think I'd be good at it. Everybody wants that experience. I definitely do.
48744.name: Mike Myers

48745.quote: You can never regret anything you do in life. You kind of have to learn the lesson from whatever the experience is and take it with you on your journey forward.
48745.name: Aubrey O'Day

48746.quote: When I go to my live shows it's often a multigenerational audience, a family bonding experience.
48746.name: Al Yankovic

48747.quote: Directing is a more pragmatic experience, where you have to deal with the restrictions of time and money that force you to make certain decisions you don't have to make when you're writing.
48747.name: Charlie Kaufman

48748.quote: When I'm writing, I'm trying to immerse myself in the chaos of an emotional experience, rather than separate myself from it and look back at it from a distance with clarity and tell it as a story. Because that's how life is lived, you know?
48748.name: Charlie Kaufman

48749.quote: I think you just assume that your memory is just sort of a video playback of your experience, but it's nothing like that at all. It's a complete refabrication of an event and a lot of it is made up, because you're filling in spaces.
48749.name: Charlie Kaufman

48750.quote: Reading the play at home, however fulfilling, can never be the vivacious experience that Shakespeare intended.
48750.name: Arthur Smith

48751.quote: Learning is a tunnel experience that makes us think more broadly.
48751.name: Anna Deavere Smith

48752.quote: In life there are no problems, that is, objective and external choices there is only the life which we do not resolve as a problem but which we live as an experience, whatever the final result may be.
48752.name: Alberto Moravia

48753.quote: Have you ever watched someone become American? Last week, at a national citizenship conference I organize, thirty immigrants from 17 countries swore an oath and became citizens of the United States. It was a stirring experience for the hundreds of people in the room.
48753.name: Eric Liu

48754.quote: People who run for president seriously and people who become president enter a bizarre secret society in which they have had an experience that none of us will ever have.
48754.name: John Hodgman

48755.quote: The most experience I had in the criminology field is playing a thug as an actor. That was my first paid job. The police academy at the college was paying people to reenact the calls that potential cops would get. So I got to play thugs and people who were unruly.
48755.name: Jeremy Renner

48756.quote: It was a very profound experience, getting in touch with that part of us, in all of us human beings, that is committed beyond yourself to the point of giving everything you have, including your life, for other people, for your fellow man.
48756.name: Raul Julia

48757.quote: While I was trying to save money to go to the National Institute of Dramatic Art in Australia I ended up getting all of this experience which meant that by the time I had enough money in the bank to go to school I didn't really need to go to school anymore.
48757.name: Russell Crowe

48758.quote: You can learn more from the lows than the highs. The highs are great but the lows make you really look at things in a different way and want to improve.
