48758.name: Wayne Rooney

48759.quote: As is known, it is in the realm of experience inaugurated by psychoanalysis that we may grasp along what imaginary lines the human organism, in the most intimate recesses of its being, manifests its capture in a symbolic dimension.
48759.name: Jacques Lacan

48760.quote: I think the most interesting parts of human experience might be the sparks that come from that sort of chipping flint of cultures rubbing against each other. And living on the border between Mexico and the U.S. for so many years gave me a lot of insight into that.
48760.name: Barbara Kingsolver

48761.quote: I eventually became proud of my strikeouts, because each one represented another learning experience.
48761.name: Willie Stargell

48762.quote: I think experience will teach you a combination of liberalism and conservatism. We have to be progressive and at the same time we have to retain values. We have to hold onto the past as we explore the future.
48762.name: Oliver Stone

48763.quote: I would vote for the man who's lived life, who's done different occupations, who's been out in the real world and struggled to make a living, struggled to raise a family, struggled with life as it exists. So I'd vote for experience, honest experience.
48763.name: Oliver Stone

48764.quote: It was a great experience for a kid, because it was a bunch of kids playing on pirate ships and water slides, so looking back on it, it was the fondest experience of my childhood.
48764.name: Corey Feldman

48765.quote: We certainly want those at the top to do well, but if you base your entire presidency and your entire economic platform on helping them do even better, you're missing what makes the economy tick. Because not everyone has been as fortunate as Mitt Romney, you cannot base your whole approach on a life experience as rarified as his.
48765.name: Charles Schumer

48766.quote: There are many reasons why Mitt Romney should not become president, but perhaps the most important of all is the narrowness of his experience, perspective and vision.
48766.name: Charles Schumer

48767.quote: There are more people than you think who want to have a challenging experience, in which they are obliged to reflect about the past.
48767.name: Umberto Eco

48768.quote: When I'm writing, I'm constantly thinking about myself, because it's the only experience I have to draw on. And I don't see an exact reflection of myself in every face in the audience, but I know that my songs have validity to them, and that's why the fans are there.
48768.name: Chester Bennington

48769.quote: I think women don't grow up with the harsh world of criticism that men grow up with, we are more sensitively treated, and when you first experience the world of film-making you have to develop a very tough skin.
48769.name: Jane Campion

48770.quote: With 'Bright Star' and with 'The Piano,' too, I felt a kind of sadness about it being in such a different era, because of my lack of experience with the era. And one of the ways I'd get over it is to remind myself that every film, even if it's contemporary, creates its own world.
48770.name: Jane Campion

48771.quote: In almost everything, experience is more valuable than precept.
48771.name: Quintilian

48772.quote: You shouldn't be afraid of failure - when something fails, you think, 'What did I learn from that experience? I can do better next time.' Then kill that project and move on to the next. Don't get disappointed.
48772.name: Niklas Zennstrom

48773.quote: I think that the mark of a great book is that it will meet you wherever you're at and you'll feel and experience something new and different each time you read it.
48773.name: Josh Radnor

48774.quote: Well, I stopped drinking. That was actually a big deal. I didn't go through any harrowing rock-bottom experience. I just made a decision to stop drinking.
48774.name: Josh Radnor

48775.quote: Whatever it is you want to do, take a job in that field. You will learn by experience and, slow and steady, you'll get it done!
48775.name: Rachael Ray

48776.quote: I feel that the Christian experience and the Jewish one have much to give each other. If this open society continues and there is no return to political anti-Semitism, then this encounter, deeper than any theology, may happen.
48776.name: Lionel Blue

48777.quote: One of the things in the back of my mind is that, after my sports experience, I never want to be, totally consumed by any one endeavor, other than my family life.
48777.name: Julius Erving

48778.quote: By experience we find out a short way by a long wandering.
48778.name: Roger Ascham

48779.quote: I think most artists will experience a lot of negative people on Twitter but, thank God, I've got so many followers that I'm not able to see them that much. I'll see some from time to time but, for the most part, I always focus on something good.
48779.name: Nicki Minaj

48780.quote: I think we're the only jokeless show on television. I mean really, we have no setups and no punch lines. It's not a joke show. There are funny lines and funny moments but again the comedy is born of the human experience and awkward pauses are a great part of what it is to be human.
48780.name: Rainn Wilson

48781.quote: Experience tells you what to do confidence allows you to do it.
48781.name: Stan Smith

48782.quote: My time at Shell was a most valuable experience because it taught me to look at the world in a long-term way. Shell takes a 20-year view on events and plans for different scenarios. It makes you see the world as a kind of large matrix.
48782.name: Vince Cable

48783.quote: I feel that between my experience and my mother's, breast cancer is a little bit like someone who lives next door. I know what that person looks like and what their daily habits are.
48783.name: Cynthia Nixon

48784.quote: An adolescent is somebody who is in between things. A teenager is somebody who's kind of permanently there. And so living with them through the various teenage hopes and sorrows and joys was curiously enough a maturing experience for me.
48784.name: Andrew Greeley

48785.quote: I raised five children. They all have different personalities. All of them have different issues, different levels of success. That was a learning experience for me.
48785.name: T. D. Jakes

48786.quote: Physics is experience, arranged in economical order.
48786.name: Ernst Mach

48787.quote: Individuals approaching death often experience encounters with their dead relatives, who seem to welcome them to the next world. These deathbed visions are authentic and convincing they are often followed by a state of euphoria and seem to ease the transition.
48787.name: Stanislav Grof

48788.quote: I read Freud's Introductory Lectures in Psychoanalysis in basically one sitting. I decided to enroll in medical school. It was almost like a conversion experience.
48788.name: Stanislav Grof

48789.quote: Dying before dying has two important consequences: It liberates the individual from the fear of death and influences the actual experience of dying at the time of biological demise.
48789.name: Stanislav Grof

48790.quote: I mean, I'm an uncle of seven or eight, and I don't mind it at all! Kids are great. Kids are the best six-hour experience you can have!
48790.name: Chris O'Dowd

48791.quote: By presenting a faithful and honest record of my experience as a mother, I hope to show both my readers and my children how truth can redeem even what you fear might be the gravest of sins.
48791.name: Ayelet Waldman

48792.quote: I have my team. Like if you see everyone around me - I have my hair and makeup girl, my assistant. They're very calm, they're all about positive energy. There're no drama queens. Everyone wants everyone else to have a positive experience. There are no agendas. I think it creates a healthy environment and there are no boundaries to cross.
48792.name: Fergie

48793.quote: When you're a soul singer, I'm singing a lot of songs about love and relationships that I think a lot of girls really relate to. For whatever reason, that seems to get 'em excited. The DJ, everyone always says the DJ gets all the chicks, but that's never been my experience.
48793.name: Mayer Hawthorne

48794.quote: My experience, with both my parents, is that grief has a lot of down, sad things, but I was also really emotionally raw, in the first year after each of them passed. Flowers smelled more intensely, my relationships were hotter, and I was more willing to risk. I was going for it a lot more. I was 'unsober' and I wasn't playing by my rules.
48794.name: Mike Mills

48795.quote: Quality is a direct experience independent of and prior to intellectual abstractions.
48795.name: Robert M. Pirsig

48796.quote: Although we have, in theory, abolished human slavery, recognized women's rights, and stopped child labor, we continue to enslave other species who, if we simply pay attention, show quite clearly that they experience parental love, pain, and the desire for freedom, just as we do.
48796.name: Ingrid Newkirk

48797.quote: Fundamental ideas are not a consequence of experience, but a result of the particular constitution and activity of the mind, which is independent of all experience in its origin, though constantly combined with experience in its exercise.
48797.name: William Whewell

48798.quote: People only talk about what a joyous experience it is, but there is terror: Your life, as you know it, is over. It's over the day that child is born. It's over, and something completely new starts.
48798.name: Bill Murray

48799.quote: Emigration, forced or chosen, across national frontiers or from village to metropolis, is the quintessential experience of our time.
48799.name: John Berger

48800.quote: Experience is that marvelous thing that enable you to recognize a mistake when you make it again.
48800.name: Franklin P. Jones

48801.quote: Films that are entertainments give simple answers but I think that's ultimately more cynical, as it denies the viewer room to think. If there are more answers at the end, then surely it is a richer experience.
48801.name: Michael Haneke

48802.quote: You can use your means in a good and bad way. In German-speaking art, we had such a bad experience with the Third Reich, when stories and images were used to tell lies. After the war, literature was careful not to do the same, which is why writers began to reflect on the stories they told and to make readers part of their texts. I do the same.
48802.name: Michael Haneke

48803.quote: What's great about the geek spirit is that life never seems to stop us, and they never seem to kill our enthusiasm, our optimism and our hunger to experience the world. We keep our sense of humor, we protect our dignity, we talk to our friends about the experience and then we start again fresh the very next day.
48803.name: Paul Feig

48804.quote: The greatest way for people to experience a comedy is to go in not knowing anything about it. But because of marketing, it's impossible. Marketing meaning that in order to get people to come you can't just go, 'Hey, there's a great movie - we're not going to show you anything from it but trust us!'
48804.name: Paul Feig

48805.quote: 'Let God be true but every man a liar' is the language of true faith.
48805.name: Aiden Wilson Tozer

48806.quote: In Barack Obama, Democrats have put forth a man of strong religious faith who is comfortable connecting his spiritual life to his public role as a policymaker.
48806.name: Mike McCurry

48807.quote: Flatter not thyself in thy faith in God if thou hast not charity for thy neighbor.
48807.name: Francis Quarles

48808.quote: But I don't necessarily define my faith by going to church every Sunday.
48808.name: Miley Cyrus

48809.quote: What is faith? If you believe something because you have evidence for it, or rational argument, that is not faith. So faith seems to be believing something despite the absence of evidence or rational argument for it.
48809.name: Peter Singer

48810.quote: Machiavelli's teaching would hardly have stood the test of Parliamentary government, for public discussion demands at least the profession of good faith.
48810.name: Lord Acton

48811.quote: My coming to faith did not start with a leap but rather a series of staggers from what seemed like one safe place to another. Like lily pads, round and green, these places summoned and then held me up while I grew. Each prepared me for the next leaf on which I would land, and in this way I moved across the swamp of doubt and fear.
48811.name: Anne Lamott

48812.quote: Skepticism has never founded empires, established principals, or changed the world's heart. The great doers in history have always been people of faith.
48812.name: Edwin Hubbel Chapin

48813.quote: When Christians start thinking about Jesus, things start breaking down, they lose their faith. It's perfectly possible to go to church every Sunday and not ask any questions, just because you like it as a way of life. They fear that if they ask questions they'll lose their Christ, the very linchpin of their religion.
48813.name: A. N. Wilson

48814.quote: The greatest act of faith is when a man understands he is not God.
48814.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

48815.quote: The great act of faith is when a man decides he is not God.
48815.name: Jr. Oliver Wendell Holmes

48816.quote: Not truth, but faith, it is that keeps the world alive.
48816.name: Edna St. Vincent Millay

48817.quote: A faith is something you die for, a doctrine is something you kill for. There is all the difference in the world.
48817.name: Tony Benn

48818.quote: The essential element in personal magnetism is a consuming sincerity - an overwhelming faith in the importance of the work one has to do.
48818.name: Bruce Barton

48819.quote: By gold all good faith has been banished by gold our rights are abused the law itself is influenced by gold, and soon there will be an end of every modest restraint.
48819.name: Sextus Propertius

48820.quote: I don't have faith in young people any more. I don't waste time trying to communicate with them.
48820.name: Vivienne Westwood

48821.quote: Of all our dreams today there is none more important - or so hard to realise - than that of peace in the world. May we never lose our faith in it or our resolve to do everything that can be done to convert it one day into reality.
48821.name: Lester B. Pearson

48822.quote: Act strenuously, would appear to be our faith, and right thinking will take care of itself.
48822.name: Irving Babbitt

49649.quote: The funny thing is people won't let me pay for things. I'll be in a restaurant and the manager will say, 'Oh no, it's on the house.'
49649.name: Richard Branson

49650.quote: 'Married with Children' was racy. It was sexist. It was a lot of things, but mostly it was funny.
49650.name: Katey Sagal

49651.quote: My mother was a terrific force in my life. Wartime-generation woman, hadn't gone to university but should have done. Was very funny, very verbal, very clever, very witty.
49651.name: Ian Hislop

49652.quote: I was doing sketches that were funny but socially irresponsible. I felt I was deliberately being encouraged and I was overwhelmed.
49652.name: Dave Chappelle

49653.quote: It's funny recently I've started to notice people's impersonations of me, and it's basically like a hyperactive child.
49653.name: Dave Grohl

49654.quote: It's funny I actually made poorer decisions when I sobered up then when I was screwed up.
49654.name: Corey Feldman

49655.quote: It's funny, having the same name as someone. Me, Emma Watson and Emma Stone, the amount of times I've been called Emma Watson or Emma Stone is so funny. It's just 'cause we're all named Emma. None of us look alike.
49655.name: Emma Roberts

49656.quote: I don't really have a type of guy I like. It's just like nice guys, cute boys I mean, ones that are funny.
49656.name: Emma Roberts

49657.quote: But I think Kiss Kiss, Bang Bang really got that thing where, if a movie reads really funny and then has some dramatic or violent or sinister stuff in it, you can't forget that primarily it has to be even funnier than you read it or that other stuff doesn't work.
49657.name: Jr. Robert Downey

49658.quote: I wish I could be as thin as Jessica Simpson. I think she looks gorgeous! I have had Jessica on my show several times, and I can tell you that girl is genuine and funny with a great self-deprecating sense of humor.
49658.name: Rachael Ray

49659.quote: And at the time, it is funny how you can look at something and say, for example with my shoulder injury, when it first happened I said this is the worst thing that could happen to me. Why me, why now? Now I look back and say it was probably the best thing that happened to me.
49659.name: Drew Brees

49660.quote: I think we're the only jokeless show on television. I mean really, we have no setups and no punch lines. It's not a joke show. There are funny lines and funny moments but again the comedy is born of the human experience and awkward pauses are a great part of what it is to be human.
49660.name: Rainn Wilson

49661.quote: We've got a bunch of new writers now who tell me they grew up watching The Simpsons. It's bizarre, and they're writing some very funny stuff.
49661.name: Matt Groening

49662.quote: Sometimes people get mad at The Simpsons' subversive story telling, but there's another message in there, which is a celebration of making wild, funny stories.
49662.name: Matt Groening

49663.quote: I can always get better. A lot of my ex-girlfriends don't think I'm funny.
49663.name: Dane Cook

49664.quote: I didn't plan to be the rude middle-class comedian. You write a certain type of joke that you find funny, and mine happen to be often rude. Yes, it's juvenile, but that's me.
49664.name: Jimmy Carr

49665.quote: Only bad golfers are lucky. They're the ones bouncing balls off trees, curbs, turtles and cars. Good golfers have bad luck. When you hit the ball straight, a funny bounce is bound to be unlucky.
49665.name: Lee Trevino

49666.quote: Music is more difficult - try naming a political band. The Dead Kennedys. The Dead Kennedys are political, but they are more funny than they are political.
49666.name: Thom Yorke

49667.quote: We sit in a room for months trying to think of funny things.
49667.name: David Walliams

49668.quote: I love a smart, well-written show, and '30 Rock,' well, you can't get any better than that. Tina Fey poos funny. There's nothing that she does that isn't funny. That show is an example of how brilliant she is. It's so smart. They've done some brilliant commentary about the 'Housewives' with 'Queen of Jordan,' their show-within-the-show.
49668.name: Andy Cohen

49669.quote: I am accusing him of stealing my best material, he was a very funny man.
49669.name: Frank Carson

49670.quote: It's unbearable when someone changes around you. Just imagine that your life partner changes, then it is difficult to cope with. Or your mother. Or your father. They were strong and now they're like a baby - it's not so funny.
49670.name: Michael Haneke

49671.quote: 'Funny Games' was conceived as a provocation. My other films are different. If people feel my other films are, or respond to them as provocation, then that's quite different. 'Funny Games' is the only one of mine where my intention was to provoke the audience.
49671.name: Michael Haneke

49672.quote: When I first envisioned 'Funny Games' in the mid-1990s, it was my intention to have an American audience watch the movie. It is a reaction to a certain American cinema, its violence, its naivety, the way American cinema toys with human beings. In many American films, violence is made consumable.
49672.name: Michael Haneke

49673.quote: I have an inability to enjoy things, but that's why we're in comedy. If we were happy, we wouldn't be funny, I guess.
49673.name: Paul Feig

49674.quote: For years, it's driven me crazy that women don't have better roles, especially in comedies. I know so many funny women but I always felt... misogynist streak is too strong a term - but a dismissiveness.
49674.name: Paul Feig

49675.quote: I love funny people, and when I'm with funny people, or people who are amusing in their weirdness, I love it. Because that to me is funny, as opposed to someone who stops and says, 'Hey let me tell you a joke.'
49675.name: Paul Feig

49676.quote: 'Funny People' is my favorite performance of myself to date. Even though it's a comedy and there are serious moments, I really felt like Leo felt like a real person. It didn't feel like I was playing myself. Whether it's a comedy or drama, I just try to make it as realistic as possible.
49676.name: Jonah Hill

49677.quote: I don't want to be the one to break it to you, but the future ain't that funny.
49677.name: Albert Brooks

49678.quote: Twitter, to me, works if you're funny. Twitter doesn't work as a promotional tool unless you do it very, very, very occasionally.
49678.name: Albert Brooks

49679.quote: I've been to many funerals of funny people, and they're some of the funniest days you'll ever have, because the emotions run high.
49679.name: Albert Brooks

49680.quote: I think a lot of times on TV we see caricatures - that's what's funny.
49680.name: Mayim Bialik

49681.quote: I love being a dad, it keeps me fit and inspired and children are so funny. They always supply you with acting material!
49681.name: Wesley Snipes

49682.quote: It's funny how most activists are pacifists.
49682.name: Craig Bruce

49683.quote: I've always been part of comedy. One of the things about our family was that if we were reasonably funny with each other, particularly my two brothers and myself, when my father was upset with something you'd want to make sure in some way you made him laugh. Because when he didn't laugh, you were in trouble!
49683.name: Leslie Nielsen

49684.quote: So what I do now is to pre-empt that by making the up into a virtue, and telling funny stories about how crap I am before people have a chance to notice it for themselves and think maybe I haven't realised.
49684.name: Emily Mortimer

49685.quote: If you think something's funny, go with that. Most comedians pull jokes from a place of honesty.
49685.name: Olivia Munn

49687.quote: I really don't know what makes a comedian. I think it's a family background and environment. Yet if you put the same ingredients in another person, he may never utter a funny line.
49687.name: Bob Newhart

49688.quote: You can go to a play that is enjoyable because it's funny, and then on the next night you can go to a play that's enjoyable because it's 'disturbing.'
49688.name: Wallace Shawn

49689.quote: 'Lucky' is for laughs, and there's really nothing funny that I'm doing on 'Dexter.' I think more than anything, both comment on the fact that anybody is capable of anything. Just because they are the shy guy in the corner doesn't mean that they are a harmless little bunny.
49689.name: Colin Hanks

49690.quote: There have been times when I felt suicidal and I would stop my head from going in that direction of negativity because I thought there'd be something I'd miss that was funny in the future. If there's a chance I'm going to laugh tomorrow then want to live to experience that.
49690.name: Dave Navarro

49691.quote: And remember, it's also very funny, because side by side with grief lies joy.
49691.name: Fran Drescher

49692.quote: I liked getting the best villain award. I thought that was funny.
49692.name: Stephen Dorff

49693.quote: The music industry is really funny, when you have a hit record, everyone knows who are you, everyone wants to do duets with you, then if you have a miss, people suffer from amnesia.
49693.name: Seal

49694.quote: This is funny because I just had a job over the summer for VH1, a project I did called Strange Frequency where I got to play a Goth rock band singer.
49694.name: Charisma Carpenter

49695.quote: I mean, I'm married first of all to one of, if not the most wonderful women in the world. She is everything - funny, attractive, hard-working, she has integrity, she loves me to bits.
49695.name: Seal

49696.quote: A film that I love is 'Raising Arizona' and that's funny but it's quite indie and weird and odd and quirky. I'd love to do something like that. Who knows?
49696.name: Stephen Moyer

49697.quote: And of course Marc Cherry heightens it and makes it hilarious. But there's so many universal themes in the show, and he made it so funny. We knew he was onto something if he could keep it up and, thankfully, he did.
49697.name: James Denton

49698.quote: It's so funny when you're actually directing because things start popping that you don't expect to pop, and something that you think is going to pop, maybe doesn't quite have the impetus that you thought it might.
49698.name: Stephen Moyer

49699.quote: Well, I'm not afraid to say something if I think it's funny, even if it's harsh or racist.
49699.name: Sarah Silverman

49700.quote: The promos with all of the beautiful women probably attracted some men, but the mystery story line is pretty cool. It's got that dark edge, and people will watch anything funny.
49700.name: James Denton

49701.quote: But I think you can make fun of anything as long as it's funny enough.
49701.name: Sarah Silverman

49702.quote: It's funny, because '1600 Penn' was the first time I really started to read the reviews, because I am an executive producer and I wanted to see what people were enjoying and not enjoying as a means to an end, right?
49702.name: Josh Gad

49703.quote: I mean, I talk about being Jewish a lot. It's funny because I do think of myself as Jewish ethnically, but I'm not religious at all. I have no religion.
49703.name: Sarah Silverman

49704.quote: It's funny because 'The Book of Mormon' is 'The Book of Mormon' now. When I was doing it at the very beginning, and I was a part of it for four years and always believed in it, I never really knew if it was going to be more than a convention for 'South Park' fans.
49704.name: Josh Gad

49705.quote: I know people will think it's funny because I've done glamour modelling in the past, but I felt embarrassed about my body and just wanted to cover it up.
49705.name: Jennifer Ellison

49706.quote: I got the wake-up call that no one is policing our oceans. I wondered, how can I do anything? What really can I do to make things better? There are some perks to being a celebrity. My job is to be funny once in a while, but it's my responsibility to make good use of it.
49706.name: Angela Kinsey

49707.quote: My parents, grandparents, aunts and uncles were all funny, and I felt that energy, that delivery, that timing, that sarcasm. All that stuff seeped into my brain.
49707.name: Jeff Ross

49708.quote: Wikipedia is just an incredible thing. It is fact-encirclingly huge, and it is idiosyncratic, careful, messy, funny, shocking and full of simmering controversies - and it is free, and it is fast.
49708.name: Nicholson Baker

49709.quote: I don't write literary fiction - I write books that are entertaining, but are also, I hope, well-constructed and thoughtful and funny and have things to say about men and women and families and children and life in America today.
49709.name: Jennifer Weiner

49710.quote: Do you want me to apologize after every joke? If it doesn't offend somebody it's probably not a joke. It's probably an observation that's not funny. It's gotta offend somebody somewhere.
49710.name: Jeff Ross

49711.quote: Billy Tauzin is one of the most interesting people in Washington. He is smart, funny, and interesting.
49711.name: Tucker Carlson

49712.quote: I've actually tried to roast somebody that I don't like, and it doesn't go well. Either they're a bad sport or I'm not as funny as I could be.
49712.name: Jeff Ross

49713.quote: My parents are both very funny but they're also relatively soft-spoken, normal human beings while I'm just a lunatic. I don't know where this loud, ballsy, hammy ridiculousness came from. I'm just glad I followed my goals and my parents did too. It's not like we even had a plan when I dragged my mom to Los Angeles.
49713.name: Emma Stone

49714.quote: It's funny, though, because when I first started going to races after we met, I was extremely nervous. It's like being backstage and hoping you don't trip over something or break an amp or accidentally speak into a live microphone, so I was really hesitant.
49714.name: Ashley Judd

49715.quote: People are funny, and in the most tragic situations, when comedy erupts from nowhere, it can turn on its head within the space of a second or a minute. You're laughing one minute and you're crying the next and that's just life for me, and that is what people are like.
49715.name: Sally Hawkins

49716.quote: So it was just funny to read a script that was just similar to what had been going on in my life.
49716.name: Piper Perabo

49717.quote: When we criticize in Iran the actions of the government, the fundamentalists say that we and the Bush Administration are in the same camp. The funny thing is that human rights activists and Mr. Bush can never be situated in the same group.
49717.name: Shirin Ebadi

49718.quote: I have a funny family, but none of them are remotely in show business.
49718.name: Wanda Sykes

49719.quote: It is funny because the guy who is my boss now, Howard Stern, has a similarity there. He got big being a regular guy. He wasn't the greatest looking guy in the world.
49719.name: Artie Lange

49720.quote: But I think funny and talent will always win out I mean, of course there are hurdles, but I think if you're funny you will get over all of that.
49720.name: Wanda Sykes

49721.quote: The last person they expected to connect with a screenplay was the comedic, blonde actress with the funny voice.
49721.name: Joey Lauren Adams

49722.quote: The empires of the future are the empires of the mind.
49722.name: Winston Churchill

49723.quote: Every saint has a past and every sinner has a future.
49723.name: Oscar Wilde

49724.quote: Again, you can't connect the dots looking forward you can only connect them looking backwards. So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future. You have to trust in something - your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever. This approach has never let me down, and it has made all the difference in my life.
49724.name: Steve Jobs

49725.quote: I never think of the future - it comes soon enough.
49725.name: Albert Einstein

49726.quote: It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves.
49726.name: William Shakespeare

49727.quote: The distinction between the past, present and future is only a stubbornly persistent illusion.
49727.name: Albert Einstein

49728.quote: You can't connect the dots looking forward you can only connect them looking backwards. So you have to trust that the dots will somehow connect in your future. You have to trust in something - your gut, destiny, life, karma, whatever. This approach has never let me down, and it has made all the difference in my life.
49728.name: Steve Jobs

49729.quote: The best years of your life are the ones in which you decide your problems are your own. You do not blame them on your mother, the ecology, or the president. You realize that you control your own destiny.
49729.name: Albert Ellis

49730.quote: If we open a quarrel between past and present, we shall find that we have lost the future.
49730.name: Winston Churchill

49731.quote: Let others lead small lives, but not you. Let others argue over small things, but not you. Let others cry over small hurts, but not you. Let others leave their future in someone else's hands, but not you.
49731.name: Jim Rohn

49732.quote: Every man gotta right to decide his own destiny.
49732.name: Bob Marley

49733.quote: I do not want to foresee the future. I am concerned with taking care of the present. God has given me no control over the moment following.
49733.name: Mahatma Gandhi

49734.quote: In this bright future you can't forget your past.
49734.name: Bob Marley

49735.quote: Education is the passport to the future, for tomorrow belongs to those who prepare for it today.
49735.name: Malcolm X

49736.quote: For time and the world do not stand still. Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or the present are certain to miss the future.
49736.name: John F. Kennedy

49737.quote: Stop acting as if life is a rehearsal. Live this day as if it were your last. The past is over and gone. The future is not guaranteed.
49737.name: Wayne Dyer

49738.quote: It looks like the future's really bright.
49738.name: Michael P. Anderson

49739.quote: I believe that you control your destiny, that you can be what you want to be. You can also stop and say, 'No, I won't do it, I won't behave his way anymore. I'm lonely and I need people around me, maybe I have to change my methods of behaving,' and then you do it.
49739.name: Leo Buscaglia

49740.quote: The future starts today, not tomorrow.
49740.name: Pope John Paul II

49741.quote: What matters is to live in the present, live now, for every moment is now. It is your thoughts and acts of the moment that create your future. The outline of your future path already exists, for you created its pattern by your past.
49741.name: Sai Baba

49742.quote: Destiny is no matter of chance. It is a matter of choice. It is not a thing to be waited for, it is a thing to be achieved.
49742.name: William Jennings Bryan

49743.quote: Study the past, if you would divine the future.
49743.name: Confucius

49744.quote: Who controls the past controls the future. Who controls the present controls the past.
49744.name: George Orwell

49745.quote: I don't think the human mind can comprehend the past and the future. They are both just illusions that can manipulate you into thinking theres some kind of change.
49745.name: Bob Dylan

49746.quote: I just don't want to live like I used to. And at some point, I'm going to put a gag order on myself in terms of talking about the past. I've got to slam the door and deal with the present and the future.
49746.name: Charlie Sheen

49747.quote: Life is divided into three terms - that which was, which is, and which will be. Let us learn from the past to profit by the present, and from the present, to live better in the future.
49747.name: William Wordsworth

49748.quote: A dream is your creative vision for your life in the future. You must break out of your current comfort zone and become comfortable with the unfamiliar and the unknown.
49748.name: Denis Waitley

49749.quote: God wants us to prosper financially, to have plenty of money, to fulfill the destiny He has laid out for us.
49749.name: Joel Osteen

49750.quote: The future ain't what it used to be.
49750.name: Yogi Berra

49751.quote: There's no present. There's only the immediate future and the recent past.
49751.name: George Carlin

49752.quote: Destiny has two ways of crushing us - by refusing our wishes and by fulfilling them.
49752.name: Henri Frederic Amiel

49753.quote: Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it, if you have to, with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
49753.name: Marcus Aurelius

49754.quote: I know of no way of judging the future but by the past.
49754.name: Patrick Henry

49755.quote: Our human compassion binds us the one to the other - not in pity or patronizingly, but as human beings who have learnt how to turn our common suffering into hope for the future.
49755.name: Nelson Mandela

49756.quote: On every front there are clear answers out there that can make this country stronger, but we're going to break through the fear and the frustration people are feeling. Our job is to make sure that even as we make progress, that we are also giving people a sense of hope and vision for the future.
49756.name: Barack Obama

49757.quote: The past is a ghost, the future a dream, and all we ever have is now.
49757.name: Bill Cosby

49758.quote: No work or love will flourish out of guilt, fear, or hollowness of heart, just as no valid plans for the future can be made by those who have no capacity for living now.
49758.name: Alan Watts

49759.quote: The most glorious moments in your life are not the so-called days of success, but rather those days when out of dejection and despair you feel rise in you a challenge to life, and the promise of future accomplishments.
49759.name: Gustave Flaubert

49760.quote: The main goal of the future is to stop violence. The world is addicted to it.
49760.name: Bill Cosby

49761.quote: Elegance is not the prerogative of those who have just escaped from adolescence, but of those who have already taken possession of their future.
49761.name: Coco Chanel

49762.quote: If you believe that feeling bad or worrying long enough will change a past or future event, then you are residing on another planet with a different reality system.
49762.name: William James

49763.quote: The future rewards those who press on. I don't have time to feel sorry for myself. I don't have time to complain. I'm going to press on.
49763.name: Barack Obama

49764.quote: Upper classes are a nation's past the middle class is its future.
49764.name: Ayn Rand

49765.quote: Happy is the person who knows what to remember of the past, what to enjoy in the present, and what to plan for in the future.
49765.name: Arnold H. Glasow

49766.quote: As long as we are persistence in our pursuit of our deepest destiny, we will continue to grow. We cannot choose the day or time when we will fully bloom. It happens in its own time.
49766.name: Denis Waitley

49767.quote: Well, the future for me is already a thing of the past.
49767.name: Bob Dylan

49768.quote: The future belongs to those who prepare for it today.
49768.name: Malcolm X

49769.quote: Prediction is very difficult, especially if it's about the future.
49769.name: Niels Bohr

49770.quote: Look back over the past, with its changing empires that rose and fell, and you can foresee the future, too.
49770.name: Marcus Aurelius

49771.quote: It is not enough to understand, or to see clearly. The future will be shaped in the arena of human activity, by those willing to commit their minds and their bodies to the task.
49771.name: Robert Kennedy

49772.quote: The reason people find it so hard to be happy is that they always see the past better than it was, the present worse than it is, and the future less resolved than it will be.
49772.name: Marcel Pagnol

49773.quote: The essence of optimism is that it takes no account of the present, but it is a source of inspiration, of vitality and hope where others have resigned it enables a man to hold his head high, to claim the future for himself and not to abandon it to his enemy.
49773.name: Dietrich Bonhoeffer

49774.quote: A person often meets his destiny on the road he took to avoid it.
49774.name: Jean de La Fontaine

49775.quote: Choose your friends with caution plan your future with purpose, and frame your life with faith.
49775.name: Thomas S. Monson

49776.quote: I don't try to describe the future. I try to prevent it.
49776.name: Ray Bradbury

49777.quote: I'm not sure what the future holds but I do know that I'm going to be positive and not wake up feeling desperate. As my dad said 'Nic, it is what it is, it's not what it should have been, not what it could have been, it is what it is.'
49777.name: Nicole Kidman

49778.quote: 'Robopocalypse' explores the intertwined fates of regular people who face a future filled with murderous machines. It follows them as humanity foments the robot uprising, fails to recognize the coming storm, and then is rocked to the core by methodical, crippling attacks.
49778.name: Daniel H. Wilson

49779.quote: The poster boy for our superabled future is Oscar Pistorius, an increasingly famous South African sprinter who happens to have had both of his legs amputated below the knee. Using upside down question mark-shaped carbon fiber sprinting prosthetics, called Cheetah blades, Mr. Pistorius can challenge the fastest sprinters in the world.
49779.name: Daniel H. Wilson

49780.quote: For every minute, the future is becoming the past.
49780.name: Thor Heyerdahl

49781.quote: What appeals to me? There are things, points of view, uses of the language, habits of dress, ways of thought and believing that came to me from my grandparents and came to them from theirs. Things that are of good use in any situation, no matter what the future may hold.
49781.name: Tommy Lee Jones

49782.quote: Looking ahead, future generations may learn their social skills from robots in the first place. The cute yellow Keepon robot from Carnegie Mellon University has shown the ability to facilitate social interactions with autistic children. Morphy at the University of Washington happily teaches gestures to children by demonstration.
49782.name: Daniel H. Wilson

49783.quote: My idea in terms of managing a narrative, or in thinking in my creative life, is that you could easily argue that the past, the present and the future all occur simultaneously, and if you can postulate that, then you're not strictly bound to a linear narrative.
49783.name: Tommy Lee Jones

49784.quote: In the future, when Microsoft leaves a security-flaw in their code it won't mean that somebody hacks your computer. It will mean that somebody takes control of your servant robot and it stands in your bedroom doorway sharpening a knife and watching you sleep.
49784.name: Daniel H. Wilson

49785.quote: The future is hidden by a dark impenetrable veil, and yet we struggle to pierce through it.
49785.name: Joseph Barber Lightfoot

49786.quote: Everything about my politics has been about the future.
49786.name: David Miliband

49787.quote: I think in the future we need to look at our youth department to provide more players for the first team think it is important for a club to have a good amount of players that have roots with the club and region.
49787.name: Arsene Wenger

49788.quote: As long as I do a good job, I believe the future is going to take care of itself, but actually I like very much being in elected office and there is no consideration about doing anything different until I can be assured that we are going to have the best voting systems in the country.
49788.name: Katherine Harris

49789.quote: I have not made any plans for the future, and my wife would kill me if I announced anything before that.
49789.name: Scott Walker

49790.quote: I'd like now and into the future to play a bigger role not only in Wisconsin and the Midwest, but nationally. I'd like to have an impact.
49790.name: Scott Walker

49791.quote: What makes America amazing is that there have always been men and women of courage who were willing to think more about the future of their children and grandchildren than they did about their own political careers.
49791.name: Scott Walker

49792.quote: Also, it is interesting that developing countries, with China and India perhaps in the lead, where the future of the global environment will be decided are now on board with the case for sustainable development.
49792.name: Maurice Strong

49793.quote: We owe at least this much to future generations, from whom we have borrowed a fragile planet called Earth.
49793.name: Maurice Strong

49794.quote: The future will be the child of the past and the present, even if a rebellious child.
49794.name: George Crumb

49795.quote: Of course I am political. You 'ave to be don't you? Every day it is about your future, your right to that future. 'Ow can people ignore this? We 'ave to leave a good world for our children, n'est-ce pas?
49795.name: Emmanuelle Beart

49796.quote: If you really want something you just hang with it. We think our future's ahead and not behind.
49796.name: Jerry Only

49797.quote: The valid research for the future is on the inner side, on the spiritual side.
49797.name: Peace Pilgrim

49798.quote: By the time a person has achieved years adequate for choosing a direction, the die is cast and the moment has long since passed which determined the future.
49798.name: Zelda Fitzgerald

49799.quote: I don't want to be the one to break it to you, but the future ain't that funny.
49799.name: Albert Brooks

49800.quote: What's interesting about books that take place in the future, even twenty years in the future, is that many of them are black or white: It's either a utopia or it's misery. The real truth is that there's going to be both things in any future, just like there is now.
49800.name: Albert Brooks

49801.quote: The past is a source of knowledge, and the future is a source of hope. Love of the past implies faith in the future.
49801.name: Stephen Ambrose

49802.quote: You need people who can walk their companies into the future rather than back them into the future.

50462.quote: All we can hope for is that the thing is going to slowly and imperceptibly shift. All I can say is that 50 years ago there were no such thing as environmental policies.

50463.quote: I had a huge advantage when I started 50 years ago - my job was secure. I didn't have to promote myself. These days there's far more pressure to make a mark, so the temptation is to make adventure television or personality shows. I hope the more didactic approach won't be lost.
50463.name: David Attenborough

50464.quote: The climate, the economic situation, rising birth rates none of these things give me a lot of hope or reason to be optimistic.
50464.name: David Attenborough

50465.quote: My fondest hope is that 'Roots' may start black, white, brown, red, yellow people digging back for their own roots. Man, that would make me feel 90 feet tall.
50465.name: Alex Haley

50466.quote: Being a star has made it possible for me to get insulted in places where the average Negro could never hope to go and get insulted.
50466.name: Jr. Sammy Davis

50467.quote: There is nothing that fear and hope does not permit men to do.
50467.name: Luc de Clapiers

50468.quote: I just sort of take it from a character perspective, and I don't know if he was necessarily spiritual, but I do think he had hope. He was a character that was comfortable having hope in his life, and hope is faith.
50468.name: Ryan Gosling

50469.quote: Creativity comes from trust. Trust your instincts. And never hope more than you work.
50469.name: Rita Mae Brown

50470.quote: There is something uniquely depressing about the fact that the National Portrait Gallery's version of the Barack Obama 'Hope' poster previously belonged to a pair of lobbyists. Depressing because Mr. Obama's Washington was not supposed to be the lobbyists' Washington, the place we learned to despise during the last administration.
50470.name: Thomas Frank

50471.quote: I mean, I get letters in the mail because I had a heart defect when I was one, I had surgeries and stuff. And so you get these letters in the mail that just, they are crazy, they are just like, yes, well our son is dealing with the same thing and we saw you on TV and I mean it is such a cool thing to inspire and kind of give hope.
50471.name: Shaun White

50472.quote: In our recovery package we put new standards of accountability and transparency, which we hope will now apply.
50472.name: Nancy Pelosi

50473.quote: I hope that what it comes down to at the end of the day is that people believe that I believe what I'm singing. It comes down to being believable. You don't have to be likeable generally, though, I think I am.
50473.name: John Mayer

50474.quote: Hope is the most exciting thing in life and if you honestly believe that love is out there, it will come. And even if it doesn't come straight away there is still that chance all through your life that it will.
50474.name: Josh Hartnett

50475.quote: The hope of Internet anarchists was that repressive governments would have only two options: accept the Internet with its limitless possibilities of spreading information, or restrict Internet access to the ruling elite and turn your back on the 21st century, as North Korea has done.
50475.name: Peter Singer

50476.quote: I think you grow wherever God plants you. I hope I'm growing as a person of faith, as a Christian. That should be our number one objective this journey of life. That all starts with a personal intimate relationship with Christ and then being in prayer every single day about all of those things - being tenacious about it.
50476.name: J. C. Watts

50477.quote: I mean, why am I considered an 'it girl?' Because I'm in a lot of movies right now or am on the covers of magazines? I just hope there is something solid behind that. Because here's the thing with 'it girl' status. It's great and amazing that anybody is saying that at all. But how long does that last?
50477.name: Amanda Seyfried

50478.quote: At a time of such hope and optimism in the Middle East, we cannot let the Libyan government violate every principle of international law and human rights with impunity.
50478.name: William Hague

50479.quote: We hope that the long darkness through which the Burmese people have lived may now be coming to an end.
50479.name: William Hague

50480.quote: We hope the world will act in the spirit of enlightened self-interest.
50480.name: Atal Bihari Vajpayee

50481.quote: A poor man with nothing in his belly needs hope, illusion, more than bread.
50481.name: Georges Bernanos

50482.quote: If the skies fall, one may hope to catch larks.
50482.name: Francois Rabelais

50483.quote: On what rests the hope of the republic? One country, one language, one flag!
50483.name: Alexander Henry

50484.quote: What is music anyway? It's a form of communication, and that's why I play the kind of music that I think - that I hope - can communicate with people.
50484.name: Kenny G

50485.quote: See, my hope and dream is that people have a good time watching basketball. It's not church. It's not serious.
50485.name: Charles Barkley

50486.quote: For me, Barack Obama's election was a milestone of the most extraordinary kind. On the day he was elected I felt such hope in my heart. I thought we were seeing the beginning of a new era of equal opportunity across race and gender such as America had never known before.
50486.name: Jesse Jackson

50487.quote: My hope is that 10 years from now, after I've been across the street at work for a while, they'll all be glad they gave me that wonderful vote.
50487.name: Sandra Day O'Connor

50488.quote: I don't think I'm a great songwriter, but I think I've learned a lot about it, and I don't think there's any one way to do it. I don't think I can control it at all. I can just kind of hope that it happens.
50488.name: Norah Jones

50489.quote: I hope there are some audiophiles still out there.
50489.name: Norah Jones

50490.quote: You always hear people saying, 'I hope I'm not turning into my dad', but I'd be honoured if I became half as decent a bloke as he is.
50490.name: Johnny Vegas

50491.quote: Before you give up hope, turn back and read the attacks that were made on Lincoln.
50491.name: Bruce Barton

50492.quote: My hope was that organizations would start including this range of skills in their training programs - in other words, offer an adult education in social and emotional intelligence.
50492.name: Daniel Goleman

50493.quote: I hope I live long enough to see every hungry school child in the world being fed under the so-called McGovern-Dole program.
50493.name: George McGovern

50494.quote: I hope someday we will be able to proclaim that we have banished hunger in the United States, and that we've been able to bring nutrition and health to the whole world.
50494.name: George McGovern

50495.quote: I hope that as the Senate and American people learn more about me, they will see that I am an ordinary person who has been blessed with extraordinary opportunities and experiences.
50495.name: Sonia Sotomayor

50496.quote: The only way of knowing a person is to love them without hope.
50496.name: Walter Benjamin

50497.quote: My contribution I hope is to get people to eat full-flavored food. If I could come away with that alone, that would be a fantastic accomplishment. I'm also very proud of being a very American chef.
50497.name: Bobby Flay

50498.quote: I think it's a mistake to ever look for hope outside of one's self.
50498.name: Arthur Miller

50499.quote: Hope can be the most wonderful thing in the world or it can crush your heart like an eggshell.
50499.name: Harlan Coben

50500.quote: I am very lucky that I get to tell stories for a living. I love being able to grab people's attention, to keep them turning the pages, to make them stay awake all night. I want to stir the pulse, yes, but also to stir the heart. I hope 'The Woods' does that.
50500.name: Harlan Coben

50501.quote: I hope in my lifetime we can all continue to laugh at ourselves and not put down anyone for what they weigh.
50501.name: Richard Simmons

50502.quote: I feel like a lot of the female relationships I see on TV or in movies are in some way free of the kind of jealousy and anxiety and posturing that has been such a huge part of my female friendships, which I hope lessens a little bit with age.
50502.name: Lena Dunham

50503.quote: Hope is independent of the apparatus of logic.
50503.name: Norman Cousins

50504.quote: With optimism, you look upon the sunny side of things. People say, 'Studs, you're an optimist.' I never said I was an optimist. I have hope because what's the alternative to hope? Despair? If you have despair, you might as well put your head in the oven.
50504.name: Studs Terkel

50505.quote: We are biological creatures. We are born, we live, we die. There is no transcendent purpose to existence. At best we are creatures of reason, and by using reason we can cure ourselves of emotional excess. Purged of both hope and fear, we find courage in the face of helplessness, insignificance and uncertainty.
50505.name: Jonathan Sacks

50506.quote: I am inclined to attach some importance to the new system of manufacturing and venture to throw it out with the hope of its receiving a full discussion among those who are most interestedin the subject.
50506.name: Charles Babbage

50507.quote: Right now a lot of people are still choosing to go to Toronto instead of shooting in New York City, something I haven't done and something I hope I'll never have to do.
50507.name: Spike Lee

50508.quote: I don't think I'm a total pessimist, so I think you can find hope in all my films.
50508.name: Spike Lee

50509.quote: We hope that, when the insects take over the world, they will remember with gratitude how we took them along on all our picnics.
50509.name: Bill Vaughan

50510.quote: Oh man. If I had magic powers... I would hope that I would use them for good. I think I would. But I would do something pretty trivial like making traffic disappear.
50510.name: Nick Stahl

50511.quote: 'Little Miss Sunshine' snowballed. It was a tiny movie. We shot it in 30 days, and it was really fun to do, but it was one of those small movies that you don't hold out huge hope for.
50511.name: Greg Kinnear

50512.quote: The London games mark the 24th anniversary of my winning two golds and setting the world record in the heptathlon. Someone is going to want it records are made to be broken - it's only a matter of time. I hope mine will outlive me.
50512.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

50513.quote: My denial and irresponsible attitude about asthma put me at great risk and caused me so much needless suffering. My hope is that the kids I talk to learn to open up about their asthma, become educated about their condition, and seek help.
50513.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

50514.quote: The 2012 London Olympic Games fostered a generation of hope. I witnessed women participating for the very first time, representing every nation.
50514.name: Jackie Joyner-Kersee

50515.quote: I remember thinking, That's what I need - and that hope was in Jesus Christ.
50515.name: Willie Aames

50516.quote: You promised to take care of me and not to turn your back on me. How is it possible that you never wrote to me even once and you never came back to see me? Do you think that it is fun for me to spend months, even years, without any news, without any hope!
50516.name: Camille Claudel

50517.quote: And I hope America will realise, as the only superpower now, it really must use its power in a way that's going to build up the world, and to support the United Nations.
50517.name: George Carey

50518.quote: I hope to get out before they start football next year.
50518.name: Bear Bryant

50519.quote: Your own experience keeps taking you towards something. My book adds the hope that it's a better something.
50519.name: Moon Unit Zappa

50520.quote: Tragedy is restful: and the reason is that hope, that foul, deceitful thing, has no part in it.
50520.name: Jean Anouilh

50521.quote: Structure is one of the things that I always hope will reveal itself to me.
50521.name: Richard Russo

50522.quote: Chemistry is not anything an executive producer or writer can orchestrate or plan you just hope for it.
50522.name: David E. Kelley

50523.quote: You probably found 'How to Survive a Robot Uprising' in the humor section. Let's just hope that is where it belongs.
50523.name: Daniel H. Wilson

50524.quote: I hope people like me and appreciate me the way I am.
50524.name: Steve Yzerman

50525.quote: I hope that when I'm 80 years old, people will still be talking about my wedding.
50525.name: Jennifer Hudson

50526.quote: I set records that will never be equaled. In fact, I hope 90% of them don't even get printed.
50526.name: Bob Uecker

50527.quote: Hope thou not much, and fear thou not at all.
50527.name: Algernon Charles Swinburne

50528.quote: I hope telling stories though 'Making a Difference' - as in my academic work and nonprofit work - will help me to live my grandmother's adage of 'Life is not about what happens to you, but about what you do with what happens to you.
50528.name: Chelsea Clinton

50529.quote: 'Castle' is a guy living in a fantasy world. He's in his imagination, writing these stories of murder.
50529.name: Nathan Fillion

50530.quote: I think my printing to this day looks like the printing right out of a comic book. Actually, I always wanted to be in a comic book. I watched cartoons when I was a kid, too, and both comics and cartoons lit fire in my imagination. This realm holds a lot of interest for me, a lot of passion for me. So to be comic-ized, yeah, that's cool.
50530.name: Nathan Fillion

50531.quote: I like to have a thing suggested rather than told in full. When every detail is given, the mind rests satisfied, and the imagination loses the desire to use its own wings.
50531.name: Thomas Bailey Aldrich

50532.quote: Toy Soldiers was my introduction to film. I certainly didn't think I was doing art by any stretch of the imagination.
50532.name: Tim Robbins

50533.quote: There's the argument that you can relate to someone who's completely unrelatable. In the way that a director shows you his imagination on a film, then I get to show you my imagination in a big dumb character.
50533.name: Idris Elba

50534.quote: The march of invention has clothed mankind with powers of which a century ago the boldest imagination could not have dreamt.
50534.name: Henry George

50535.quote: I never in my wildest imagination dreamed that I would somehow become a sports commentator.
50535.name: Joe Rogan

50536.quote: It is above all by the imagination that we achieve perception and compassion and hope.
50536.name: Ursula K. Le Guin

50537.quote: My reality needs imagination like a bulb needs a socket. My imagination needs reality like a blind man needs a cane.
50537.name: Tom Waits

50538.quote: The higher the artist, the fewer the gestures. The fewer the tools, the greater the imagination. The greater the will, the greater the secret failure.
50538.name: Ben Okri

50539.quote: Politics is the enemy of the imagination.
50539.name: Ian Mcewan

50541.quote: As an actor you have to have a strong vivid imagination as you're working and when the camera's rolling, but there's certainly a part of you that is aware of real life, that you're making a movie.
50541.name: John Hawkes

50542.quote: What I really have in my head, my imagination, my understanding of music, I never really get that out.
50542.name: Wynton Marsalis

50543.quote: I surrendered to a world of my imagination, reenacting all those wonderful tales my father would read aloud to me. I became a very active reader, especially history and Shakespeare.
50543.name: Andrew Wyeth

50544.quote: I can't work completely out of my imagination. I must put my foot in a bit of truth and then I can fly free.
50544.name: Andrew Wyeth

50545.quote: My books are elegiac in the sense that they're odes to a nation that even I sometimes think may not exist anymore except in my memory and my imagination.
50545.name: Richard Russo

50546.quote: I feel like I'm a much better person when I'm developing my imagination and my innocence and my vulnerability. I like that version of me better than the version where I'm just working on my analytical mind.
50546.name: Brit Marling

50547.quote: All my life I've had the privilege to make my living with my imagination, and the most important thing has been to see my creative life grow. I was educated to do that and have lived accordingly.
50547.name: Tommy Lee Jones

50548.quote: You can have 10 bucks to 10 million bucks and if you got a crew, imagination and a lot of people willing to turn in some work next to nothing, you going to have a feature. But you can't get beyond how expensive marketing the movie is, it's so crushing.
50548.name: Kevin Smith

50549.quote: All the best have something in common, a regard for reality, an agreement to its primacy over the imagination.
50549.name: Wislawa Szymborska

50551.quote: My imagination functions much better when I don't have to speak to people.
50551.name: Patricia Highsmith

50552.quote: The Chinese art world does not exist. In a society that restricts individual freedoms and violates human rights, anything that calls itself creative or independent is a pretence. It is impossible for a totalitarian society to create anything with passion and imagination.
50552.name: Ai Weiwei

50553.quote: I suppose I'm proudest of my novels for what's imagined in them. I think the world of my imagination is a richer and more interesting place than my personal biography.
50553.name: John Irving

50554.quote: A clever, imagination, humorous request can open closed doors and closed minds.
50554.name: Percy Ross

50555.quote: I've been working on the soprano saxophone for 40 years, and the possibilities are astounding. It's up to you, the only limit is the imagination.
50555.name: Steve Lacy

50556.quote: Imagination allows us to escape the predictable. It enables us to reply to the common wisdom that we cannot soar by saying, 'Just watch!'
50556.name: Bill Bradley

50557.quote: 'Avatar' is the greatest, most comprehensive collection of movie cliches ever assembled, but it's put together in a brand new way with a new technology, and tremendous imagination, making it a true epic and a kind of a milestone.
50557.name: Joe Dante

50558.quote: Painting and sculpture are very archaic forms. It's the only thing left in our industrial society where an individual alone can make something with not just his own hands, but brains, imagination, heart maybe.
50558.name: Philip Guston

50559.quote: I feel very warm towards Mum and Dad for giving us the independence they did. My childhood, and the fact we didn't have a TV, gave me a boundless imagination.
50559.name: Dido Armstrong

50560.quote: That neither our thoughts, nor passions, nor ideas formed by the imagination, exist without the mind, is what every body will allow.
50560.name: George Berkeley

50561.quote: Imagination is the only key to the future. Without it none exists - with it all things are possible.
50561.name: Ida Tarbell

50562.quote: Usually I say I have no imagination.
50562.name: Jose Padilha

50563.quote: Imagination, the traitor of the mind, has taken my solitude and slain it.
50563.name: Robinson Jeffers

50564.quote: As a bookish child in Calcutta, I used to thrill to the adventures of bad girls whose pursuit of happiness swept them outside the bounds of social decency. Tess of the d'Urbervilles, Emma Bovary and Anna Karenina lived large in my imagination. The naughty girls of Hollywood films flirted and knew how to drive.
50564.name: Bharati Mukherjee

50565.quote: I loved the world of imagination.
50565.name: R. A. Salvatore

50566.quote: People who think my books are autobiographical, which they're not, credit me with having a much better memory than I do. I do, however, have a powerful imagination.
50566.name: Curtis Sittenfeld

50567.quote: I had been a reporter for 15 years when I set out to write my first novel. I knew how to research an article or profile a subject - skills that I assumed would be useless when it came to fiction. It was from my imagination that the characters in my story would emerge.
50567.name: Amy Waldman

50568.quote: Imagination, it turns out, is a great deal like reporting in your own head. Here is a paradox of fiction-writing. You are crafting something from nothing, which means, in one sense, that none of it is true. Yet in the writing, and perhaps in the reading, some of a character's actions or lines are truer than others.
50568.name: Amy Waldman

50569.quote: Although Bill Finger literally typed the scripts in the early days, he wrote the scripts from ideas that we mutually collaborated on. Many of the unique concepts and story twists also came from my own fertile imagination.
50569.name: Bob Kane

50570.quote: When one paints an ideal, one does not need to limit one's imagination.
50570.name: Ellen Key

50571.quote: Nature uses human imagination to lift her work of creation to even higher levels.
50571.name: Luigi Pirandello

50572.quote: When you are young your imagination is so clear.
50572.name: Nina Blackwood

50573.quote: I mean, it's fine when you're a kid and someone runs into the playground and goes, 'I've got this great game of pretend,' and you play... As an actor, getting to play, getting to use your imagination and be childish - it is weird but it's wonderful.
50573.name: Max Irons

50574.quote: An art aims, above all, at producing something beautiful which affects not our feelings but the organ of pure contemplation, our imagination.
50574.name: Eduard Hanslick

50575.quote: People can't just listen to the music and have their own imagination and take them where they wanna go.
50575.name: Ann Wilson

50576.quote: I love costumes. I love getting dressed up because it really helps my imagination make the leap to believe that I am who I say I am.
50576.name: Alessandro Nivola

50577.quote: It's just a way of trying to get to a third thing that's not particular to any quote-unquote genre. It's been great for me it's really opened me up and gotten me to use that part of my imagination. It's very scary in a lot of ways, and just as exciting.
50577.name: Charlie Hunter

50578.quote: I guess what I've learned is that there are no boundaries when it comes to imagination. It's limitless.
50578.name: Cliff Martinez

50579.quote: She has no imagination and that means no compassion.
50579.name: Michael Foot

50580.quote: To them though, not to us, we were just a catalyst for their imagination.
50580.name: Donald Sutherland

50581.quote: To put up a show is to face life's injustices with one of the few weapons available to a desperate and brave people, their imagination.
50581.name: Luigi Barzini

50582.quote: I have learned the art of filling in your lines with your visuals and your movies and your imagination.
50582.name: Daphne Zuniga

50583.quote: I definitely gravitate towards quality genre projects and genre of any kind whether it's science fiction, horror or really anything. I'm just drawn to quality. I don't think 'Darkness Falls' is horror there isn't any gore by any stretch of the imagination.
50583.name: Emma Caulfield

50584.quote: It's a wonderful thing working with young actors. I know a lot of people don't like working with children. I actually adore it, because you watch their imagination open up and you watch them start to learn this job that I've been doing for so long. They come with such a lack of cynicism.
50584.name: Michelle Forbes

50585.quote: We didn't have television until I was about eight years old, so it was either the movies or radio. A lot of radio drama. That was our television, you know. We had to use our imagination. So it was really those two things, and the comics, that I immersed myself in as a child.
50585.name: Jessica Hagedorn

50586.quote: Grandchildren have taught me how important the future is. I try to look through their eyes and envision what's in their imagination. What's the world going to look like when they're my age? That really does take a huge imagination.
50586.name: Richard Lugar

50587.quote: Catastrophes are often stimulated by the failure to feel the emergence of a domain, and so what cannot be felt in the imagination is experienced as embodied sensation in the catastrophe.
50587.name: William Irwin Thompson

50588.quote: George has only got to ring me. His imagination is so wonderful, I'd do any character he might create.
50588.name: Peter Mayhew

50589.quote: I don't know if Jim was a major part of that or not. He is one of a small group of real storytellers. He has enormous imagination and ability to write. I'm glad he's coming back. It's going to be good for the show.
50589.name: Matthew Ashford

50590.quote: No film has captivated my imagination more than 'King Kong.' I'm making movies today because I saw this film when I was 9 years old.
50590.name: Peter Jackson

50591.quote: Enthusiasm is that temper of the mind in which the imagination has got the better of the judgment.
50591.name: William Warburton

50592.quote: If there is a book that the script came from you have to read it, you have to see what you can get out of it: mood, back story and things that may not even be in the film. They kick off your imagination and broaden the character, I think.
50592.name: Miranda Otto

50593.quote: Regardless of who originally made it popular, any hit song becomes a challenge to the ingenuity and imagination of other musicians and performers.
50593.name: Les Baxter

50594.quote: Most people have no imagination. If they could imagine the sufferings of others, they would not make them suffer so. What separated a German mother from a French mother?
50594.name: Ernst Toller

50595.quote: I had this wild imagination. I was never me. All my childhood photos, I'm in fancy dress, playing a Russian refuge or Marvelous Mad Madam Mim.
50595.name: Juno Temple

50596.quote: I was brought up in a very open, rural countryside in the middle of nowhere. There were no cell phones. If your lights went out, you were lit by candlelight for a good four days before they can get to you. And so, my imagination was crazy.
50596.name: Juno Temple

50597.quote: I'm only interested in fiction that in some way or other voices the very imagination which is conceiving it.
50597.name: John C. Hawkes

50598.quote: I like photographs which leave something to the imagination.
50598.name: Fay Godwin

50599.quote: Being an actor in movies is a lot about the power of your imagination and making the circumstance real to you so the audience will feel that it's real.
50599.name: Joel Kinnaman

50600.quote: Anyone who said he wasn't afraid during the civil rights movement was either a liar or without imagination. I was scared all the time. My hands didn't shake but inside I was shaking.
50600.name: Jr. James L. Farmer

50601.quote: As an actor I think sometimes producers need a little bit of encouragement to see you in a particular role, they may not have as much imagination as you would expect.
50601.name: Steve Kanaly

50602.quote: Death? Why this fuss about death? Use your imagination, try to visualize a world without death! Death is the essential condition of life, not an evil.
50602.name: Charlotte Perkins Gilman

50603.quote: Innovation is this amazing intersection between someone's imagination and the reality in which they live. The problem is, many companies don't have great imagination, but their view of reality tells them that it's impossible to do what they imagine.
50603.name: Ron Johnson

50604.quote: It is the work of fancy to enlarge, but of judgment to shorten and contract and therefore this must be as far above the other as judgment is a greater and nobler faculty than fancy or imagination.
50604.name: Robert South

50605.quote: In The Touch, the love scenes are the same as they were in The Thorn Birds or anything else I've ever written. I find a way of saying that either it was heaven or hell but in a way that still leaves room for the reader to use their own imagination.
50605.name: Colleen McCullough

50606.quote: If they want to talk about aliens and anything like that... that's part of the gift God gave us. That's what makes life exciting. We're pretty stuck, you know. What gives flight to our life is our imagination.
50606.name: Michael Moriarty

50607.quote: Censorship is never over for those who have experienced it. It is a brand on the imagination that affects the individual who has suffered it, forever.
50607.name: Nadine Gordimer

50608.quote: There's not one major greatest influence on my career. It would be film and great artists and great imagineers - Jim Henson, Walt Disney, Charlie Chaplin, people who understand the joy of the imagination.
50608.name: Zac Posen

50609.quote: My mother was making $135 a week, but she had resilience and imagination. She might take frozen vegetables, cook them with garlic, onion and Spam, and it would taste like a four-star dinner.
50609.name: Andre Dubus III

50610.quote: There's no environment. Use your imagination. There's no fourth wall, whether it's the first time you've told this story about her life, or the sixth time.
50610.name: Jill Clayburgh

50611.quote: I guess something that I've noticed from American acts who had success in touring is more of an explanation as to their music. Which is I think quite funny. I think British acts might like to leave more to the imagination - maybe a bit more obscure perhaps - a bit more shy.
50611.name: Ben Lovett

50612.quote: There are two worlds: the world we can measure with line and rule, and the world that we feel with our hearts and imagination.
50612.name: Leigh Hunt

50613.quote: Imagination is as vital to any advance in science as learning and precision are essential for starting points.
50613.name: Percival Lowell

50614.quote: People know that they're going to see something which is entertaining but challenging as well because of the form it's in. It's dance theatre and it requires you to use your imagination - it's not straight forward.
50614.name: Matthew Bourne

50615.quote: Every day the eye is subject to a thousand tiny shocks as a thousand industries compete for the eye-kick, the visual hook that will lock the consumer into product for that crucial second where the tiny - or not so tiny - leap of the imagination is made.
50615.name: Graham Joyce

50616.quote: But the greatest thing about music is putting it out there for people to figure out. You want the listener to find the song on their own. If you give too much away, it takes away from the imagination.
50616.name: Diana Krall

50617.quote: Suddenly the whole imagination of writing and editorial and newspaper and all these presumptions about who am I reading this, and who else other people may be, and all that, it's so grimly brutal!
50617.name: Robert Creeley

50618.quote: I certainly know there are people in positions of power in the business who lack imagination and, perhaps as a result of that, think of me as 'David'. But I wouldn't really want to work with those people, you know?
50618.name: Michael C. Hall

50997.quote: In order to the existence of such a ministry in the Church, there is requisite an authority received from God, and consequently power and knowledge imparted from God for the exercise of such ministry and where a man possesses these, although the bis.
