51697.quote: Take free money. No matter how in debt you are, if your employer offers a matching contribution on a 401(k) or other retirement vehicle, you must sign up and contribute enough to get the maximum company match each year. Think of it as a bonus.
51697.name: Suze Orman

51698.quote: Growing up in a particular neighborhood, growing up in a working-class family, not having much money, all of those things fire you and can give you an edge, can give you an anger.
51698.name: Gary Oldman

51699.quote: I think it would be cool if you were writing a ransom note on your computer, if the paper clip popped up and said, 'Looks like you're writing a ransom note. Need help? You should use more forceful language, you'll get more money.
51699.name: Demetri Martin

51700.quote: 'Get a Job' is about all the rich kids we knew when we were younger, kids who never had jobs but always had money for partying or getting their hair done.
51700.name: Beth Ditto

51701.quote: I never viewed money as being 'my money' I always saw it as 'the money.' It's a resource. If it pools up around me then it needs to be flushed back out into the system.
51701.name: Louis C. K.

51702.quote: I've had people ask me in interviews what it's like to have money, but that's not how it is. I have a middle-class life. I have a room in London but not a house, nor a BMW.
51702.name: Beth Ditto

51703.quote: The people who run a university are far more qualified and intelligent in handling people than someone who inherited his money and used it to buy a pro team.
51703.name: Hayden Fry

51704.quote: For me the greatest source of income is still movies. Nothing - stocks, financial speculation, real estate speculation or businesses - makes more money for me than making movies.
51704.name: Jackie Chan

51705.quote: I don't know what your childhood was like, but we didn't have much money. We'd go to a movie on a Saturday night, then on Wednesday night my parents would walk us over to the library. It was such a big deal, to go in and get my own book.
51705.name: Robert Redford

51706.quote: A firm, for instance, that does business in many countries of the world is driven to spend an enormous amount of time, labour, and money in providing for translation services.
51706.name: Edward Sapir

51707.quote: Banks are an almost irresistible attraction for that element of our society which seeks unearned money.
51707.name: J. Edgar Hoover

51708.quote: Selling out is doing something you don't really want to do for money. That's what selling out is.
51708.name: Bono

51709.quote: Goddam money. It always ends up making you blue as hell.
51709.name: J. D. Salinger

51711.quote: For those who are able to work, work has to be seen as the best route out of poverty. For work is not just about more money - it is transformative. It's about taking responsibility for yourself and your family.
51711.name: Iain Duncan Smith

51712.quote: Money is a good thing and it's obviously useful, but to work only for money or fame would never interest me.
51712.name: Annie Lennox

51713.quote: The only thing I like more than my wife is my money, and I'm not about to lose that to her and her lawyers, that's for damn sure.
51713.name: Jon Bon Jovi

51714.quote: Things are done according to money these days.
51714.name: Shirley MacLaine

51715.quote: Our American friends offer us money, arms, and advice. We take the money, we take the arms, and we decline the advice.
51715.name: Moshe Dayan

51716.quote: For industry to settle in a country, you first need electricity for electricity, you need some trained workers for trained workers, you need some schools for schools you need some money for money, you need some industry.
51716.name: Evan Davis

51717.quote: A survey carried out across the U.S. between 2004 and 2006 showed that frequent church- or synagogue-goers are more likely to give money to charity.
51717.name: Jonathan Sacks

51718.quote: If the money's right, I'll do a film.
51718.name: Oliver Reed

51719.quote: You can spend the money on new housing for poor people and the homeless, or you can spend it on a football stadium or a golf course.
51719.name: Jello Biafra

51720.quote: I sat with him for three hours and we did not exchange a single word. At the end he handed me, as he had done before, an envelope with money in it. It would have been much nicer if he had enclosed a greeting or a loving word. I would have been so pleased if he had.
51720.name: Eva Braun

51721.quote: You must spend money to make money.
51721.name: Plautus

51722.quote: So, my happiness doesn't come from money or fame. My happiness comes from seeing life without struggle.
51722.name: Nicki Minaj

51723.quote: Abraham Lincoln comes from nothing, has no education, no money, lives in the middle of nowhere on the frontier. And despite the fact that he suffers one tragedy and one setback after another, through sheer force of will, he becomes something extraordinary: not only the president but the person who almost single-handedly united the country.
51723.name: Seth Graham-Smith

51724.quote: I know where I'm putting my money.
51724.name: Marc Andreessen

51725.quote: While teaching, I also worked undercover in the lower courts by saying I was a young law teacher wanting experience in criminal law. The judges were happy to assist me but what I learned was how corrupt the lower courts were. Judges were accepting money right in the courtroom.
51725.name: Samuel Dash

51726.quote: Money, again, has often been a cause of the delusion of the multitudes. Sober nations have all at once become desperate gamblers, and risked almost their existence upon the turn of a piece of paper.
51726.name: Charles Mackay

51727.quote: I don't even know what sound is, much less what it's for. It isn't to make money that's for sure. I've never made any.
51727.name: Don Van Vliet

51728.quote: To buy very good wine nowadays requires only money. To serve it to your guests is a sign of fatigue.
51728.name: Jr. William F. Buckley

51729.quote: I have long believed taxpayers make better use of their money than the government ever could.
51729.name: Kay Bailey Hutchison

51730.quote: I've been very well remunerated for my talents over the years so I really don't need the public's money.
51730.name: George Michael

51731.quote: I'm glad I was born when I was. My time was the golden age of variety. If I were starting out again now, maybe things would happen for me, but it certainly would not be on a variety show with 28 musicians, 12 dancers, two major guest stars, 50 costumes a week by Bob Mackie. The networks just wouldn't spend the money today.
51731.name: Carol Burnett

51732.quote: Writing is the only profession where no one considers you ridiculous if you earn no money.
51732.name: Jules Renard

51734.quote: I'm not broke. Like everybody else, I owe money.
51734.name: Marlee Matlin

51735.quote: I find it fascinating that a lot of business books that do well are from people who've never made any money in business.
51735.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

51736.quote: North Americans as a whole need to embrace having clothes altered to their body. I hear it all the time: why do the Europeans always look so good? They have a relationship with their tailor and spend the time and money to make their clothes look their best.
51736.name: Michael Kors

51737.quote: I'm concerned a little bit with the culture of celebrating the fundraise. My dad taught me that when you borrow money it's the worst day of your life.
51737.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

51738.quote: Even though I'm a hype man myself, I like the practicality of it all. People who understand how to turn a profit. At the end of the day, this is still business so I'm looking for real practical knowledge of how to actually make money, not necessarily raise it.
51738.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

51739.quote: There are three reasons for becoming a writer: the first is that you need the money the second that you have something to say that you think the world should know the third is that you can't think what to do with the long winter evenings.
51739.name: Quentin Crisp

51740.quote: That money talks, I'll not deny, I heard it once: It said, 'Goodbye'.
51740.name: Richard Armour

51741.quote: People are chasing cash, not happiness. When you chase money, you're going to lose. You're just going to. Even if you get the money, you're not going to be happy.
51741.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

51742.quote: Well, I needed the work - that's the honest answer. I haven't worked for a while, a couple of years. So I thought it would be nice to get back to work and earn some money.
51742.name: Gary Oldman

51743.quote: I want to sit with 80- and 90-year-old people more than anyone. They have played this game before. Not one of them has told me, 'I wish I had more money.'
51743.name: Gary Vaynerchuk

51744.quote: 'The Panorama' is also the last place anywhere in New York where the World Trade Center still stands, whole, as it stood in the early morning of September 11. I can also see the corner where I saw the first tower fall and howled out loud. Seeing the buildings again here is uplifting, healing.
51744.name: Jerry Saltz

51745.quote: Experience has taught me, when I am shaving of a morning, to keep watch over my thoughts, because, if a line of poetry strays into my memory, my skin bristles so that the razor ceases to act.
51745.name: A. E. Housman

51746.quote: And my only rule being if when I wake in the morning I'm looking forward to the things that I have to do that day, then I'm on the right track.
51746.name: Demetri Martin

51747.quote: You have to have a dream so you can get up in the morning.
51747.name: Billy Wilder

51748.quote: And if I had a preference, it would be to be able to not be in the studio until 4 in the morning.
51748.name: Alanis Morissette

51749.quote: I recorded my hair this morning, tonight I'm watching the highlights.
51749.name: Jay London

51750.quote: The first thing I think about when I wake up most mornings is the fact that I'm tired. I have been tired for decades. I am tired in the morning and I am tired while becalmed in the slough of the afternoon, and I am tired in the evening, except right when I try to go to sleep.
51750.name: Susan Orlean

51751.quote: Mom was 50 when my Dad died. She got on a bus every weekday for years, and rode 40 miles each morning to Madison. She earned a new degree and learned new skills to start her small business. It wasn't just a new livelihood. It was a new life.
51751.name: Paul Ryan

51752.quote: I think the worst and most insidious procrastination for me is research. I will be looking for some bit of fact or figure to include in the novel, and before I know, I've wasted an entire morning delving into that subject matter without a word written.
51752.name: James Rollins

51753.quote: When I wake up in the morning, I just can't get started until I've had that first, piping hot pot of coffee. Oh, I've tried other enemas.
51753.name: Emo Philips

51754.quote: These flowers, which were splendid and sprightly, waking in the dawn of the morning, in the evening will be a pitiful frivolity, sleeping in the cold night's arms.
51754.name: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

51755.quote: My heart is singing for joy this morning! A miracle has happened! The light of understanding has shone upon my little pupil's mind, and behold, all things are changed!
51755.name: Anne Sullivan

51756.quote: I still, at hotel rooms, I do this one sort of not-so-cool thing: continually shoving my room service tray in front of someone else's door. Because I don't want the remnants. I don't want to be caught, like, being like the pig that I was at two in the morning.
51756.name: Drew Barrymore

51757.quote: To simply wake up every morning a better person than when I went to bed.
51757.name: Sidney Poitier

51758.quote: The less I behave like Whistler's mother the night before, the more I look like her the morning after.
51758.name: Tallulah Bankhead

51759.quote: I don't have to wait until the next morning to regret something I did that was kinda dumb.
51759.name: Bobby Knight

51760.quote: I've just finished my 20th book this past year and I'm working on my 21st book about the Middle East right now that I'll finish this year. And I get up early in the morning and when I get tired of the computer and tired of doing research, I walk 20 steps out to my woodshop and I either build furniture or paint paintings. I'm an artist too.
51760.name: Jimmy Carter

51761.quote: Fashion should be something that in the morning, when you open your window, you say, 'Oh fantastic, sun!' Then you take your shower, you say, 'OK fantastic, which colour I wear today because I feel happy?' This should be fashion.
51761.name: Roberto Cavalli

51762.quote: Every night when I go to bed, I hope that I may never wake again, and every morning renews my grief.
51762.name: Franz Schubert

51763.quote: I'm very happy with the way I look. I wake up some morning, catch myself in the bathroom mirror, and go, 'hey girl, you're alright'. But on the other hand, I find the website stuff, and the polls, something completely removed from my own personal life. You can't take anything like that too seriously, otherwise you'd end up in the loony bin.
51763.name: Cameron Diaz

51764.quote: One morning, just like 9/11, there's going to be a disaster. I have yet to see the United Nations do anything effective with either Iran or North Korea.
51764.name: Newt Gingrich

51765.quote: By Thursday morning, we'd gotten over the worst of it.
51765.name: William Scranton

51766.quote: I woke up this morning, and I still don't believe I won the Daytona 500.
51766.name: Dale Earnhardt

51767.quote: Swallow a toad in the morning and you will encounter nothing more disgusting the rest of the day.
51767.name: Nicolas Chamfort

51768.quote: I obviously take a lot of pride in what I do on the football field, because that has the ability to influence a lot of people. That puts smiles on people's faces. That gives people a pep in their step on Monday morning when they go back to work.
51768.name: Drew Brees

51769.quote: Autumn arrives in early morning, but spring at the close of a winter day.
51769.name: Elizabeth Bowen

51770.quote: I'm a very early riser, and I don't like to miss that beautiful early morning light.
51770.name: David Hockney

51771.quote: I draw flowers every day and send them to my friends so they get fresh blooms every morning.
51771.name: David Hockney

51772.quote: In the morning, I practice 15 minutes of yoga.
51772.name: Vivienne Westwood

51773.quote: There are pros and cons of experience. A con is that you can't look at the business with a fresh pair of eyes and as objectively as if you were a new CEO. 51773.name: Andrea Jung

51774.quote: Most of the time I spend when I get up in the morning is trying to figure out what is going to happen.
51774.name: Madeleine Albright

51775.quote: You know, I looked at my face in the mirror this morning, and I like being old. My face has more content and when I train in the gym now, I am not training to be strong or handsome - just better than I was yesterday. These days the race is just against myself.
51775.name: Jean Claude Van Damme

51776.quote: Every morning I wake up and thank God.
51776.name: Aaron Neville

51777.quote: I usually decide what to wear in the morning, but sometimes, I'll have a favorite coat or sweater or shoes, and I'll wear them everyday for a week!
51777.name: Cameron Russell

51778.quote: Making love in the morning got me through morning sickness. I found I could be happy and throw up at the same time.
51778.name: Pamela Anderson

51779.quote: I'm not an employee who goes to the office every morning at the same time. Then, vacations are needed.
51779.name: Karl Lagerfeld

51780.quote: I saw how many people were poor and how many kids my age went to school hungry in the morning, which I don't think most of my contemporaries in racially segregated schools in the South thought very much about at the time.
51780.name: Charles Kuralt

51781.quote: Your computer needn't be the first thing your see in the morning and the last thing you see at night.
51781.name: Simon Mainwaring

51782.quote: Acting is invigorating. But I don't analyse it too much. It's like a dog smelling where it's going to do its toilet in the morning.
51782.name: Liam Neeson

51783.quote: I do believe at the end of the night when you're with your family, the character gets hung up on the door like a coat, and is there to be taken on the next morning.
51783.name: Liam Neeson

51784.quote: As far as I'm concerned, the entire reason for becoming a writer is not having to get up in the morning.
51784.name: Neil Gaiman

51785.quote: You can't be as old as I am without waking up with a surprised look on your face every morning: 'Holy Christ, whaddya know - I'm still around!' It's absolutely amazing that I survived all the booze and smoking and the cars and the career.
51785.name: Paul Newman

51786.quote: It's wonderful to have the most important thing in the world there first thing in the morning. And especially in this business, where the opportunity to think everything is about you is there every day, now I really know that it isn't all about me.
51786.name: Kate Beckinsale

51787.quote: It didn't matter what you look like. You don't have to get up at 5:30 in the morning and there's a lot to be said for that. Corpse Bride can just play all my parts from now on and I'll just do the voice.
51787.name: Helena Bonham Carter

51788.quote: This morning, I went to wipe my hands on a tea towel, and while I was using it, it seemed like it felt a bit light. I unfolded it and realized my daughter had cut little bits out of it to make frocks for her dolls!
51788.name: Emma Thompson

51789.quote: It's a privilege to serve the poor, to be servants of noble Africans, but I better belong in the rehearsal room or in the studio with my band. That's where I want to be and I still wake up in the morning with melodies in my head.
51789.name: Bono

51790.quote: I've been keeping a diary for thirty-three years and write in it every morning. Most of it's just whining, but every so often there'll be something I can use later: a joke, a description, a quote. It's an invaluable aid when it comes to winning arguments. 'That's not what you said on February 3, 1996,' I'll say to someone.
51790.name: David Sedaris

51791.quote: I pray every night before I go to sleep and every morning when I wake up.
51791.name: Demi Lovato

51792.quote: Do you know how many calories are in butter and cheese and ice cream? Would you get your dog up in the morning for a cup of coffee and a donut?
51792.name: Jack LaLanne

51793.quote: But I try to steal other moments. Sometimes I get up very early in the morning and enjoy a quiet house and cup of tea before the craziness begins. Other times, I'll take a quick walk on the beach. You can find peace in a few minutes.
51793.name: Cindy Crawford

51794.quote: I'm actually one of those people who get up energetic in the morning.
51794.name: Elizabeth Edwards

51795.quote: I was taught that to create anything you had to believe in failure, simply because you had to be prepared to go through an idea without any fear. Failure, you learned, as I did in art school, to be a wonderful thing. It allowed you to get up in the morning and take the pillow off your head.
51795.name: Malcolm Mclaren

51796.quote: I became a musician so I wouldn't have to get up at 6 in the morning.
51796.name: Norah Jones

51797.quote: My father-in-law gets up at 5 o'clock in the morning and watches the Discovery Channel. I don't know why there's this big rush to do this.
51797.name: Jeff Foxworthy

51798.quote: Let me tell you, it is still morning in America. It just happens to be kind of a head pounding, hung over for four hours in America - and it's shaping up to be a nasty day, but its still morning in America.
51798.name: Glenn Beck

51799.quote: I was in Washington, D.C., on the morning show, by the time I was 18, programming a station by 19, No. 1 in the mornings. I think I was making, I don't know, a quarter of a million dollars by the time I was 25.
51799.name: Glenn Beck

51800.quote: You won't see me in a better mood than 4:00 in the morning on my way to work.
51800.name: Christina Ricci

51801.quote: I'm always in bed by 11 or 12 and people laugh all the time - they want me to hang out until two in the morning, but n-n-no, I need my nine hours.
51801.name: Christina Ricci

51802.quote: We, the people. Manifest Destiny. Conceived in liberty. Fear itself. Ask not. Morning in America. United we stand. Yes, we can. In times of great change and tumult, presidents seek to inspire beleaguered Americans by reminding them of their national identity.
51802.name: Ron Fournier

51803.quote: I hear that 5 o'clock whistle in my mind like Fred Flintstone and I have to stop. I'm also not much of a morning writer. I have a sweet spot from about 11am to 4pm. But I really work during that time.
51803.name: Diablo Cody

51804.quote: I am never at my best in the early morning, especially a cold morning in the Yorkshire spring with a piercing March wind sweeping down from the fells, finding its way inside my clothing, nipping at my nose and ears.
51804.name: James Herriot

51805.quote: I wake up in the morning, I do a little stretching exercises, pick up the horn and play.
51805.name: Herb Alpert

51806.quote: If you're the village blacksmith and a model T comes along, you better become a mechanic. People's lives are better when they get news online versus having to wait for the morning paper. It's a lot more efficient, a lot more real time, a lot less waste.
51806.name: Marc Andreessen

51807.quote: If I want to get work done, that's usually about 3 in the morning.
51807.name: Marc Andreessen

51808.quote: I see myself at 7:30 in the morning and it's not too pretty.
51808.name: Rod Stewart

51809.quote: I like being in movies that have a great story. I'm not so interested in being a Hollywood star. It's a job, you know. When you wake up at six in the morning every day for a week, it feels like hard work.
51809.name: Kristen Stewart

51810.quote: 'Not again!' I thought to myself this morning, as news trickled out that John McCain was set to pick Alaska governor Sarah Palin as his running mate. Not again, because too often women are promoted for the wrong reasons, and then blamed when things don't go right.
51810.name: Dee Dee Myers

51811.quote: Left to themselves, things tend to go from bad to worse. Murphy's First Corollary If you tell the boss you were late for work because you had a flat tire, the next morning you will have a flat tire.
51811.name: George Edward Woodberry

51812.quote: I can't tell you enough about cinnamon. Cinnamon is an awesome spice to use and it goes great with something like apples in the morning or in a mixture of fruit or in your oatmeal or even in your cereal.
51812.name: Emeril Lagasse

51813.quote: My favorite meal would have to be good old-fashioned eggs, over easy, with bacon. Many others, but you can't beat that on a Sunday morning, especially with a cup of tea.
51813.name: Gary Oldman

51814.quote: No man knows till he has suffered from the night how sweet and dear to his heart and eye the morning can be.
51814.name: Bram Stoker

51815.quote: I love the smell of shampoo on a girl's hair. You can walk past someone and be like, 'Wow, you took a shower this morning, didn't you? Because you smell lovely.'
51815.name: Jensen Ackles

51816.quote: 'Old times' never come back and I suppose it's just as well. What comes back is a new morning every day in the year, and that's better.
51816.name: George Edward Woodberry

51817.quote: There is a fundamental situation in which the country has reached rock bottom, that a mother can't send her children out of the house in the morning. The country has reached rock bottom and this needs to be changed.
51817.name: Benjamin Netanyahu

51818.quote: Sometimes, getting up in the morning and brishing your teath is the hardest part of the day - it all just hurts.
51818.name: Tom Brady

51819.quote: You lie awake at 3 in the morning thinking of story ideas. You're online at 8 a.m. on a Sunday or midnight on a Wednesday. It's a job that you never push aside.
51819.name: James Daly

51820.quote: Each morning my characters greet me with misty faces willing, though chilled, to muster for another day's progress through the dazzling quicksand the marsh of blank paper.
51820.name: John Updike

51821.quote: You always say 'I'll quit when I start to slide', and then one morning you wake up and realize you've done slid.
51821.name: Sugar Ray Robinson

51822.quote: I'm not one of those writers I learned about who get up in the morning, put a piece of paper in their typewriter machine and start writing. That I've never understood.
51822.name: Wole Soyinka

51823.quote: When I first broke through, there was only NBC, CBS and ABC, and they had news in the morning and in the evening - there wasn't no 24-hour news.
51823.name: Dick Gregory

51824.quote: If you do cardio one day and the next day you can do weights, do it that way. If you need to do it at night or in the morning, do it that way. Whatever you need to get it done, just get it done.
51824.name: LL Cool J

51825.quote: Every Wednesday, my husband and I have a study group with our friends. I attend church. We try to devote time in the morning, say a prayer.
51825.name: Carrie Underwood

51826.quote: I wake up every morning happy for where I am in life. It's not all about the cooking, but the fact that I can contribute by using my influence to help people all over the country. In the last two years, my partners and I have fed more than 10 million hungry people by bringing meat to food banks.
51826.name: Paula Deen

51827.quote: In order to have good fried chicken, you should wash and season the bird the morning you're preparing it for dinner. Don't wait and do it right before you start cooking. Throw it in the refrigerator, seasoned, that morning, and give it a chance to soak up all the salt and pepper and goodness.
51827.name: Paula Deen

51828.quote: Yes, there's such a thing as luck in trial law but it only comes at 3 o'clock in the morning. You'll still find me in the library looking for luck at 3 o'clock in the morning.
51828.name: Louis Nizer

51829.quote: It is not time for mirth and laughter, the cold, gray dawn of the morning after.
51829.name: George Ade

51830.quote: I write when I'm inspired, and I see to it that I'm inspired at nine o'clock every morning.
51830.name: Peter De Vries

51831.quote: Do I get up every morning and ask: am I doing the things that I believe in and am I doing them for the best possible motives? Yes. Unambiguously yes.
51831.name: Nick Clegg

51832.quote: I do yoga every morning, then I run for half an hour and take a sauna.
51832.name: Antonio Banderas

51833.quote: Sometimes I have wrinkles, in the morning. It depends on what kind of night that I had. I accept myself and the way that I am growing older. I have eye bags and some people have proposed to me to take them out but I said no.
51833.name: Antonio Banderas

51834.quote: I wake up every morning, look in the mirror and ask, 'Am I a sex symbol?' Then I go back to bed again. It's stupid to think that way.
51834.name: Antonio Banderas

51835.quote: But when I felt like I had something to prove? Then I got up early every morning and worked all day long. I didn't know if I had any more talent than anyone else directing, but I knew I could work hard at it, and so I did.
51835.name: Ben Affleck

51836.quote: Since I travel so much, it's always great to be home. There's nothing like getting to raid my own refrigerator at two in the morning.
51836.name: Amy Grant

51837.quote: I get up in the morning looking for an adventure.
51837.name: George Foreman

51838.quote: I wake up every morning and I wish I were dead, and so does Jim.
51838.name: Tammy Faye Bakker

51839.quote: It's hard to think of yourself as a brand, especially when I have four daughters who kick my butt early in the morning every day before I go to work.
51839.name: Harvey Weinstein

51840.quote: I was so young, and making movies, going to the studio every morning at dawn was magic.
51840.name: Natalie Wood

51841.quote: As long as the number one worry for people, keeping them up at nights, is whether they're going to have a job in the morning, then they are less likely to resist unfair changes, or unfair treatment, or cuts in real pay at work.
51841.name: Frances O'Grady

51842.quote: It's fairness to say those who work hard, get up in the morning, cut their cloth - in other words 'we can only afford to have one or two children because we don't earn enough'. They pay their taxes and they want to know that the same kind of decision-making is taking place for those on benefits.
51842.name: Iain Duncan Smith

51843.quote: Nowadays, everybody assumes, when they wake up in the morning, if they have a question, it will get answered. Because they have the internet. No matter what the question is, someone will answer their question.
51843.name: Jack White

51844.quote: Sometimes I wish that there were a way to let people know that just because I live in a world without rules, and in a life that is lawless, doesn't mean that it doesn't hurt so bad the morning after.
51844.name: Elizabeth Wurtzel

51845.quote: We all wake up in the morning wanting to live our lives the way we know we should. But we usually don't, in small ways. That's what makes a character like Batman so fascinating. He plays out our conflicts on a much larger scale.
51845.name: Christopher Nolan

51850.quote: No city should be too large for a man to walk out of in a morning.

51867.quote: I get up at the same time every morning.

51954.quote: Leap, and the net will appear.

52042.quote: There's a lot of great movies that have won the Academy Award, and a lot of great movies that haven't. You just do the best you can.
52042.name: Clint Eastwood

52043.quote: Movies are a fad. Audiences really want to see live actors on a stage.
52043.name: Charlie Chaplin

52044.quote: Advertising is a racket, like the movies and the brokerage business. You cannot be honest without admitting that its constructive contribution to humanity is exactly minus zero.
52044.name: F. Scott Fitzgerald

52045.quote: One of my movies was called 'True Lies.' It's what the Democrats should have called their convention.
52045.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

52046.quote: Minimalism seems closest to the sophisticated storytelling of movies. Movies have really educated contemporary audiences to be the most intelligent, sophisticated audiences in history. We don't any longer need to have the relationship between one scene and the next explained. We will figure it out ourselves.
52046.name: Chuck Palahniuk

52047.quote: And I believe that you never be limited in what you do, so I like to do movies, I like to do television.
52047.name: Harvey Fierstein

52048.quote: Movies are all about plot. Theater, even if it's story heavy, it's about ideas.
52048.name: Harvey Fierstein

52049.quote: Theater has to resonate in your heart in a way that movies don't.
52049.name: Harvey Fierstein

52050.quote: I was striving to be the most muscular man, and it got me into the movies. It got me everything that I have.
52050.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger

52051.quote: I love the movies, and when I go to see a movie that's been made from one of my books, I know that it isn't going to be exactly like my novel because a lot of other people have interpreted it. But I also know it has an idea that I'll like because that idea occurred to me, and I spent a year, or a year and a half of my life working on it.
52051.name: Stephen King

52052.quote: Somebody asked me about the current choice we're being given in the presidential election. I said, Well, it's like two of the scariest movies I can imagine.
52052.name: Dean Koontz

52053.quote: To me, movies and music go hand in hand. When I'm writing a script, one of the first things I do is find the music I'm going to play for the opening sequence.
52053.name: Quentin Tarantino

52054.quote: The only reason anyone goes to Broadway is because they can't get work in the movies.
52054.name: Bette Davis

52055.quote: By going to the movies, and because of other things, too, going to college, making a wide variety of friends, moving around traveling, I became a lot more open-minded than the heritage I was born into might have suggested.
52055.name: Roger Ebert

52056.quote: I wanted to do another movie that could make us laugh and cry and feel good about the world. I wanted to do something else that could make us smile. This is a time when we need to smile more and Hollywood movies are supposed to do that for people in difficult times.
52056.name: Steven Spielberg

52057.quote: When I was a boy, I always saw myself as a hero in comic books and in movies. I grew up believing this dream.
52057.name: Elvis Presley

52058.quote: So, one way or another, I found myself in a few movies. I take it seriously when I'm on the set, but I don't take myself seriously as an actor.
52058.name: Henry Rollins

52059.quote: Movies always are open to being remade because times change so much, and the tempo of movies changes. I think of it like a James Bond. They can have different actors play the same role... I've had people come up to me and say, 'We want to remake 'The Jerk' with so and so.' And I say, 'Fine.' It just doesn't bother me. It's an honor actually.
52059.name: Steve Martin

52060.quote: I realized this is what God has dealt me, and I should be thankful considering all that's happened to me in my life, but MS caused the movies to stop - stop dead - and I miss it.
52060.name: Richard Pryor

52061.quote: My mom took me to see Carnal Knowledge and The Wild Bunch and all these kind of movies when I was a kid.
52061.name: Quentin Tarantino

52062.quote: Movies are not about the weekend that they're released, and in the grand scheme of things, that's probably the most unimportant time of a film's life.
52062.name: Quentin Tarantino

52063.quote: I'm not a Hollywood basher because enough good movies come out of the Hollywood system every year to justify its existence, without any apologies.
52063.name: Quentin Tarantino

52064.quote: Movies are my religion and God is my patron. I'm lucky enough to be in the position where I don't make movies to pay for my pool. When I make a movie, I want it to be everything to me like I would die for it.
52064.name: Quentin Tarantino

52065.quote: If you just love movies enough, you can make a good one.
52065.name: Quentin Tarantino

52066.quote: All my movies are achingly personal.
52066.name: Quentin Tarantino

52067.quote: I have loved movies as the number one thing in my life so long that I can't ever remember a time when I didn't.
52067.name: Quentin Tarantino

52068.quote: I just grew up watching a lot of movies. I'm attracted to this genre and that genre, this type of story, and that type of story. As I watch movies I make some version of it in my head that isn't quite what I'm seeing - taking the things I like and mixing them with stuff I've never seen before.
52068.name: Quentin Tarantino

52069.quote: Some mornings you wake up and think, gee I look handsome today. Other days I think, what am I doing in the movies? I wanna go back to Ireland and drive a forklift.
52069.name: Liam Neeson

52070.quote: I don't really have a schedule of when I want to show my children my movies.
52070.name: Steven Spielberg

52071.quote: I was making a lot of 8mm home movies, since I was twelve, making little dramas and comedies with the neighborhood kids.
52071.name: Steven Spielberg

52072.quote: Sexiness, particularly in movies, is the chess game in the 'Thomas Crown Affair'. It's, it's, I don't know, but Faye Dunaway comes up a lot in that thinking. It's the subtlety of sexiness. The moment you try to be sexy, then it's not.
52072.name: Daniel Craig

52073.quote: I didn't grow up thinking of movies as film, or art, but as movies, something to do on a Saturday afternoon.
52073.name: Sydney Pollack

52074.quote: I have been pregnant in so many movies it's ridiculous.
52074.name: Jennifer Aniston

52075.quote: There are a lot of movies that are unbelievable successes that I would be mortified to be a part of.
52075.name: Jennifer Aniston

52076.quote: My nominee for Best Picture of the year - maybe the best picture ever, because it's essentially made up of and is an ecstatic love letter to all other movies - is Christian Marclay's endlessly enticing must-see masterpiece 'The Clock.'
52076.name: Jerry Saltz

52077.quote: 'A Guide To Recognizing Your Saints' was the first real actor-actor part I did, and I hope I to do more. Action movies are fun, but I'd be happy not to do them if there are better roles.
52077.name: Channing Tatum

52078.quote: In all the movies I'm in love with someone in my head. There's always love in a film somewhere. It doesn't matter even if it's an action movie.
52078.name: Channing Tatum

52079.quote: I was terrified to do 'G.I. Joe.' I had no idea how to do one of those movies. I was kind of scared. You know, if one of those doesn't work, it's a huge hit on your career. People are like, 'Well he couldn't make a $170 million movie work. I don't want him in my film.'
52079.name: Channing Tatum

52080.quote: 'Immortals' is all action. I love action movies. That's really where I want to spearhead my career.
52080.name: Kellan Lutz

52081.quote: Even though I make those movies, I find myself wishing that more of those magic moments could happen in real life.
52081.name: Jane Seymour

52082.quote: I really love the independent movies and I just think that sometimes when they throw a lot of money into it and a lot of special effects and a lot of stunts that you lose the connection, the human connection and I personally love movies that are about the human connection.
52082.name: Jane Seymour

52083.quote: You know, Stephen says, in the movies no one ever goes to the bathroom. They shave, they brush their teeth. He goes right at this sort of funny taboo we have about the bathroom, and he turned it into this nightmare, you know, your worst fear of what's in there.
52083.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52084.quote: The movies that made me want to make movies were action movies, and thrillers, and Kurosawa films, you know, where you have an opportunity every day to shoot it in an unusual way. I was looking for something like that.
52084.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52085.quote: The kind of pace that you want to use in a Western - just to acknowledge the land in the distance that everyone has to travel, and the way things develop sort of slowly - it's almost the antithetical of what's currently going on in the movies, you know.
52085.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52086.quote: I really liked Carrie a lot. That was one of Brian De Palma's best movies.
52086.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52087.quote: I mean, the trouble with some of the kind of relationship movies I've done, is there's only so many ways you can shoot a conversation. I was really tired of talking heads.
52087.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52088.quote: I loved Alien, and I loved Carrie, and I loved The Exorcist - those were big movies for me. They were just brilliantly done, and unusual, and they all took horror to some new place.
52088.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52089.quote: I haven't seen Clones, which has been during this period when I haven't seen much of anything, but I did see Phantom Menace, and see my feelings about it - see, first of all, I think that when you make a lot of movies, your attitude about the movies changes.
52089.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52090.quote: I didn't really want to do another sequel. I go to those movies, and I just sort of enjoy them like a viewer.
52090.name: Lawrence Kasdan

52091.quote: For me, relationships are the real action movies. Bombs are exploding every day and the kitchen is Ground Zero.
52091.name: Michelle Williams

52092.quote: I mean, look, I love movies, not just the ones I make... In fact, I don't like the movies I make very much.
52092.name: Alexander Payne

52093.quote: Each one of my movies becomes easier to get off the ground.
52093.name: Alexander Payne

52094.quote: The novel succeeds on terms exclusive to literature. A good film succeeds on terms exclusive to the cinema. That's why so many bad novels can become good movies, like 'Jaws' or 'The Godfather.'
52094.name: Alexander Payne

52095.quote: 'Little Miss Sunshine' snowballed. It was a tiny movie. We shot it in 30 days, and it was really fun to do, but it was one of those small movies that you don't hold out huge hope for.
52095.name: Greg Kinnear

52096.quote: I think America becomes more disgruntled by going to the movies and having an endlessly good time at them.
52096.name: Fiona Shaw

52097.quote: Movies have to handle time very efficiently. They're about stringing scenes together in the present. Novels aren't necessarily about that.
52097.name: Richard Russo

52098.quote: I want to be around for a long time, singing and making albums and movies.
52098.name: Jennifer Hudson

52099.quote: For some reason and I don't know why, but I don't think that I'm funny in California. So I always want to do my movies east somewhere.
52099.name: Kevin James

52100.quote: I want to do movies that I'm proud of where my kids, at some point, can see and I can feel comfortable sitting there watching it with them. And just that move people. That make people feel a little bit better about themselves when they leave the theatre.
52100.name: Kevin James

52101.quote: I'm fighting the label of 'Black' actress simply because it's very limiting in people's eyes, especially people who are making movies.
52101.name: Whoopi Goldberg

52102.quote: I was in television drama, which is a first cousin to the movies, and I trust myself to make the right decisions.
52102.name: Lee Child

52103.quote: One of the reasons why people - particularly young people - love action movies is because what they are really looking for is justice.
52103.name: Steven Seagal

52104.quote: People go to the movies to watch a film and all they're thinking about is the actress's cellulite they saw in a magazine.
52104.name: Robert Carlyle

52105.quote: I love making movies and hope to write my own screenplay someday and do some producing and be behind-the-scenes as well.
52105.name: Victoria Justice

52106.quote: I don't direct movies for a living.
52106.name: Tommy Lee Jones

52107.quote: I would be too selfish if I said everyone should see my movies more than once. To say that would mean I'm just marketing my work!
52107.name: Abbas Kiarostami

52108.quote: I have worked on very good movies that have been buried, and I've worked on some resounding mediocrities that have been paraded through the marketplace like they were masterpieces.
52108.name: Tommy Lee Jones

52109.quote: Some movies bring out the creativity in you. Every single audience member can become creative in the face of a particular movie. If you happen to like my films, it's because my films provide a bed for you on which you can find your creativity. The Hollywood movies do not provide that for you.
52109.name: Abbas Kiarostami

52110.quote: I've made some bad movies. And I really enjoyed it!
52110.name: Tommy Lee Jones

52111.quote: I want to make movies about my country from my point of view.
52111.name: Tommy Lee Jones

52112.quote: I hope that I would be considered romantic. I don't know... one of my favorite movies is 'The Notebook' so I guess that would be considered romantic. But I think being romantic is more than the flowers and the gifts. It's about connecting with the person and being able to talk and share things with her.
52112.name: Taylor Lautner

52113.quote: It's always uncomfortable for me when I take off my shirt. No one else is taking their shift off. Why is everyone else in these movies bundled up in layers of clothing and I'm taking my clothes off all the time?
52113.name: Taylor Lautner

52114.quote: It's too expensive, that's the thing nobody wants to talk about. It is too expensive to make movies. That's not true, it is too expensive to market movies. Making movies is not.
52114.name: Kevin Smith

52115.quote: You know, comics and movies, even if you take a comic and turn it into a movie, we can't all be Joss Whedon.
52115.name: Kevin Smith

52116.quote: So I know how I watch movies which is on my laptop, man. And that's how I suspect a lot of people do it.
52116.name: Kevin Smith

52117.quote: I'd see movies, comedies, and I loved 'Animal House', I loved all the John Hughes stuff, but I never saw me and my friends totally represented.
52117.name: Kevin Smith

52118.quote: In anything I've ever written, all the characters sound like me, which I don't think is a bad thing. It makes sense. But I had always admired filmmakers who made movies that didn't sound like them at all.
52118.name: Kevin Smith

52119.quote: Other filmmakers make their movies and put them out and that's that. For me, for some odd reason, it goes deeper than that.
52119.name: Kevin Smith

52120.quote: I didn't get into this so I could talk about my work, my movies. You become an actor to act.
52120.name: Kevin Bacon

52121.quote: I don't watch the movies I make, so I haven't seen 'Footloose' since it came out. You see this young, hungry actor, it's pretty fun. I was the only one they screen tested. It was an attempt by the director and producer to talk the head of the studio into hiring me because they didn't want me.
52121.name: Kevin Bacon

52122.quote: I'll be honest with you. My kids don't watch my movies and never have. I can maybe name a film one hand that they've seen, actually, all the way through.
52122.name: Kevin Bacon

52123.quote: Music in movies is all about dissonance and consonance, tension and release.
52123.name: Quincy Jones

52124.quote: I honestly don't love the Cheech and Chong movies, I've got to say.
52124.name: Seth Rogen

52125.quote: Luckily, I think, I never really wanted to be famous, I just wanted to make movies.
52125.name: Seth Rogen

52126.quote: I don't make the best movies in the world, but at times, I do feel like I'm adding something to the cinematic community.
52126.name: Seth Rogen

52127.quote: I've seen a lot of movies get made where no one has control. No one likes it.
52127.name: Seth Rogen

52128.quote: I'm not one of those actors where filmmakers that I admire ask me to be in their movies. I meet them at parties and they're nice to me, but they never ask me to work with them.
52128.name: Seth Rogen

52129.quote: Trying to constantly get yourself into movies is extremely stressful and sometimes just impossible.
52129.name: Seth Rogen

52130.quote: Frank is such a great visual storyteller, that if you study his artwork you see that his Sin City books are already the best movies never seen on the big screen.
52130.name: Robert Rodriguez

52131.quote: I always wanted to be a stay-at-home dad making art, making movies.
52131.name: Robert Rodriguez

52132.quote: I do like strong women in my movies. I have five sisters, so I've just grown up with that model.
52132.name: Robert Rodriguez

52133.quote: I was a cartoonist when I was at university, but I decided to go into movie making knowing that I could still draw by doing movies, design work, story boards, and such.
52133.name: Robert Rodriguez

52134.quote: It's difficult to do a genre film well, and it doesn't matter if you're talking vampire movies or 'Dawn of the Dead' or 'The Thing' or 'Escape From New York.' Those kind of movies, they understand what the old-school B-movie is supposed to be, they get the throwback of it.
52134.name: Ethan Hawke

52135.quote: If I do three movies in a year, I don't feel like acting ever again.
52135.name: Ethan Hawke

52136.quote: Right now, if you're interested in being a dramatic actor, they're not making that many just regular dramas. Movies have to have some other thing going on.
52136.name: Ethan Hawke

52137.quote: I don't know what has happened to movies, but lately every movie is at least 20 minutes too long. It used to be that if you were three hours long it was because it was epic - a movie about Gandhi something with very important subject matters.
52137.name: Ethan Hawke

52138.quote: If you're not a real chameleon of an actor and if you're not one of those guys who can really shape-change themselves all the time, one of the ways to keep pushing yourself and keep changing is to be in different kinds of movies.
52138.name: Ethan Hawke

52139.quote: I don't want to imitate life in movies I want to represent it. And in that representation, you use the colors you feel, and sometimes they are fake colors. But always it's to show one emotion.
52139.name: Pedro Almodovar

52140.quote: Most movies suck, even the independent ones. Hollywood is like baseball: Hit three good ones out of 10 and you're a Hall of Famer.
52140.name: Denis Leary

52141.quote: For horror movies, color is reassuring because, at least in older films, it adds to the fakey-ness.
52141.name: Lynda Barry

52142.quote: I think everyone who makes movies should be forced to do television. Because you have to finish. You have to get it done, and there are a lot of decisions made just for the sake of making decisions. You do something because it's efficient and because it gets the story told and it connects to the audience.
52142.name: Joss Whedon

52143.quote: We were raised without movies, theater or music. We had only nature, the hills, the trees. When I got on the set of 'Manon,' I wasn't star-struck because I didn't know what a star was.
52143.name: Emmanuelle Beart

52144.quote: I don't always see my movies right away. And there are some I haven't seen at all. Sometimes that bothers the directors, so I'm obliged to see them.
52144.name: Emmanuelle Beart

52145.quote: I'm sure a bunch of 15-year-old kids would way rather I do 'Superbad 2' than 'Moneyball.' But I would love to do movies like 'Superbad' and movies like 'Moneyball.'
52145.name: Jonah Hill
